CREATE OR REPLACE PACKAGE BODY tq_lms.lms_api
AS
    PROCEDURE raise_error (v_msg IN VARCHAR2, v_err_no IN NUMBER:= NULL)
    IS
    BEGIN
        IF v_err_no IS NULL
        THEN
            raise_application_error (-20015,
                                     v_msg || ' - ' || SQLERRM (SQLCODE));
        ELSE
            raise_application_error (v_err_no,
                                     v_msg || ' - ' || SQLERRM (SQLCODE));
        END IF;
    END raise_error;

    FUNCTION trans_voucher (v_code VARCHAR2)
        RETURN VARCHAR2
    IS
        v_vchr_no   VARCHAR2 (20);
    BEGIN
        SELECT    v_code
               || '/'
               || lms_vchr_no_seq.NEXTVAL
               || '/'
               || TO_CHAR (SYSDATE, 'RR')
          INTO v_vchr_no
          FROM DUAL;

        RETURN v_vchr_no;
    END trans_voucher;

    FUNCTION annuity_check (v_ann_code NUMBER, v_ann_no VARCHAR2)
        RETURN VARCHAR2
    IS
        v_check   VARCHAR2 (2) := 'N';
        v_count   NUMBER;
    BEGIN
        SELECT COUNT (1)
          INTO v_count
          FROM lms_annuities
         WHERE     ann_code = v_ann_code
               AND ann_annuity_no = NVL (v_ann_no, ann_annuity_no);

        IF NVL (v_count, 0) > 0
        THEN
            v_check := 'Y';
        END IF;

        RETURN v_check;
    END annuity_check;

    FUNCTION get_product (v_prod_code NUMBER, v_full VARCHAR2 DEFAULT 'N')
        RETURN VARCHAR2
    IS
        v_ret_val   VARCHAR2 (50);
    BEGIN
        SELECT DECODE (v_full, 'Y', prod_desc, prod_sht_desc)
          INTO v_ret_val
          FROM lms_products
         WHERE prod_code = v_prod_code;

        RETURN v_ret_val;
    EXCEPTION
        WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND
        THEN
            RETURN NULL;
        WHEN OTHERS
        THEN
            tqc_error_manager.raise_error (
                270100301,
                text_in     => 'Error getting product details. ',
                name1_in    => 'v_prod_code',
                value1_in   => TO_CHAR (v_prod_code),
                name2_in    => 'v_full',
                value2_in   => v_full);
    END get_product;

    FUNCTION get_unprocessed_rcpt (
        v_rcpt_no                  VARCHAR2,
        v_rcpt_date                DATE,
        v_prod_code                NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
        v_alloc_to                 VARCHAR2 DEFAULT NULL,
        v_fms_receipt_pk           NUMBER,
        v_opr_receipt_trans_code   VARCHAR2 DEFAULT NULL,
        v_pol_code                 NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
        v_opr_code                 NUMBER
    )
        RETURN NUMBER
    IS
        v_ret_val   NUMBER;
    BEGIN
        SELECT SUM (NVL (tot_rcpt, 0))
          INTO v_ret_val
          FROM (SELECT SUM (
                             DECODE (opr_drcr, 'C', 1, -1)
                           * lms_process_receipts.rcpt_balance (opr_code))    tot_rcpt
                  FROM lms_ord_prem_receipts, lms_policies
                 WHERE     opr_receipt_no LIKE '%' || v_rcpt_no || '%'
                       ---AND opr_receipt_date = v_rcpt_date
                       AND NVL (opr_alloc_to, 'PR') =
                           NVL (v_alloc_to, NVL (opr_alloc_to, 'PR'))
                       AND opr_pol_code = pol_code
                       AND pol_prod_code = NVL (v_prod_code, pol_prod_code)
                       AND NVL (opr_fms_receipt_pk, 0) =
                           NVL (v_fms_receipt_pk,
                                NVL (opr_fms_receipt_pk, 0))
                       AND NVL (opr_receipt_trans_code, 'XX') =
                           NVL (v_opr_receipt_trans_code,
                                NVL (opr_receipt_trans_code, 'XX'))
                       AND pol_code = NVL (v_pol_code, pol_code)
                       AND opr_code = v_opr_code
                UNION ALL
                SELECT SUM (
                             DECODE (opr_drcr, 'C', 1, -1)
                           * lms_process_receipts.rcpt_balance (opr_code))    tot_rcpt
                  FROM lms_ord_prem_receipts, lms_annuities
                 WHERE     opr_receipt_no LIKE '%' || v_rcpt_no || '%'
                       --AND opr_receipt_date = v_rcpt_date
                       AND NVL (opr_alloc_to, 'PR') =
                           NVL (v_alloc_to, NVL (opr_alloc_to, 'PR'))
                       AND opr_ann_code = ann_code
                       AND ann_prod_code = NVL (v_prod_code, ann_prod_code)
                       AND NVL (opr_fms_receipt_pk, 0) =
                           NVL (v_fms_receipt_pk,
                                NVL (opr_fms_receipt_pk, 0))
                       AND NVL (opr_receipt_trans_code, 'XX') =
                           NVL (v_opr_receipt_trans_code,
                                NVL (opr_receipt_trans_code, 'XX'))
                       AND ann_code = NVL (v_pol_code, ann_code)
                       AND opr_code = v_opr_code/* UNION ALL
                                                 --  this is to get the updated balance when a receipt is cancelled
                                                 -- since the balance is update before deallocation is done at reverse receipts--
                                                 SELECT SUM (opr_refund_amt) tot_rcpt
                                                   FROM lms_ord_prem_receipts, lms_policies
                                                  WHERE     opr_receipt_no LIKE '%' || v_rcpt_no || '%'
                                                        --AND opr_receipt_date = v_rcpt_date
                                                        AND NVL (opr_alloc_to, 'PR') =
                                                               NVL (v_alloc_to, NVL (opr_alloc_to, 'PR'))
                                                        AND opr_pol_code = pol_code
                                                        AND pol_prod_code = NVL (v_prod_code, pol_prod_code)
                                                        AND NVL (opr_fms_receipt_pk, 0) =
                                                               NVL (v_fms_receipt_pk,
                                                                    NVL (opr_fms_receipt_pk, 0))
                                                        AND NVL (opr_receipt_trans_code, 'XX') =
                                                               NVL (v_opr_receipt_trans_code, NVL (opr_receipt_trans_code, 'XX'))
                                                        AND pol_code = NVL (v_pol_code, pol_code)
                                                        AND opr_code = v_opr_code
                                                        AND opr_source IN ('RECPT CANCELLATION')*/
                                                );

        RETURN v_ret_val;
    EXCEPTION
        WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND
        THEN
            RETURN 0;
        WHEN OTHERS
        THEN
            tqc_error_manager.raise_error (
                270100501,
                text_in     => 'Error getting unprocessed receipt details....',
                name1_in    => 'Receipt No.',
                value1_in   => v_rcpt_no,
                name2_in    => 'v_pol_code',
                value2_in   => TO_CHAR (v_pol_code),
                name3_in    => 'v_opr_code',
                value3_in   => TO_CHAR (v_opr_code));
    END get_unprocessed_rcpt;

    FUNCTION get_prod_code (
        v_pol_code   NUMBER,
        v_type       VARCHAR2,
        v_cla_type   VARCHAR2 DEFAULT 'O'
    )
        RETURN NUMBER
    IS
        v_prod_code   NUMBER;
    BEGIN
        IF v_type = 'MPR'
        THEN
            SELECT ppr_prod_code
              INTO v_prod_code
              FROM lms_pol_proposals
             WHERE ppr_code = v_pol_code;
        ELSIF v_type = 'LN'
        THEN
            SELECT pol_prod_code
              INTO v_prod_code
              FROM lms_policy_loans, lms_policies
             WHERE pln_lna_no = v_pol_code AND pln_pol_code = pol_code;
        ELSIF v_type = 'CLMR'
        THEN
            SELECT pol_prod_code
              INTO v_prod_code
              FROM lms_policies, lms_claims, lms_claim_coinsurer_recoveries
             WHERE     pol_code = clm_pol_code
                   AND clm_no = ccr_claim_no
                   AND ccr_code = v_pol_code;
        ELSE
            BEGIN
                SELECT pol_prod_code
                  INTO v_prod_code
                  FROM lms_policies
                 WHERE pol_code = v_pol_code;
            EXCEPTION
                WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND
                THEN
                    IF v_cla_type = 'G'
                    THEN
                        SELECT ipol_prod_code
                          INTO v_prod_code
                          FROM lms_individual_policies
                         WHERE ipol_code = v_pol_code;
                    ELSE
                        BEGIN
                            SELECT ann_prod_code
                              INTO v_prod_code
                              FROM lms_annuities
                             WHERE ann_code = v_pol_code;
                        EXCEPTION
                            WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND
                            THEN
                                SELECT ipol_prod_code
                                  INTO v_prod_code
                                  FROM lms_individual_policies
                                 WHERE ipol_code = v_pol_code;
                        END;
                    END IF;
            END;
        END IF;

        RETURN v_prod_code;
    EXCEPTION
        WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND
        THEN
            RETURN NULL;
        WHEN OTHERS
        THEN
            tqc_error_manager.raise_error (
                270100401,
                text_in     => 'Error getting product code...',
                name1_in    => 'Type',
                value1_in   => v_type,
                name2_in    => 'v_pol_code',
                value2_in   => TO_CHAR (v_pol_code));
    END get_prod_code;

    FUNCTION interface_enabled (v_itfc_desc VARCHAR2)
        RETURN BOOLEAN
    IS
        v_ret_val      BOOLEAN := FALSE;
        v_site_param   VARCHAR2 (5);
    BEGIN
        BEGIN
            lms_ord_misc.system_param_val ('SITE_PARAM', v_site_param);
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                tqc_error_manager.raise_error (
                    276203701,
                    text_in     => 'Parameter Error.',
                    name1_in    => 'param name',
                    value1_in   => 'SITE_PARAM');
        END;

        IF v_itfc_desc = 'CLAIM'
        THEN                                                          --CLAIMS
            v_ret_val := TRUE;
        ELSIF v_itfc_desc = 'MATURITY'
        THEN                                               --POLICY MATURITIES
            v_ret_val := TRUE;
        ELSIF v_itfc_desc = 'UWRI'
        THEN                                               --POLICY MATURITIES
            v_ret_val := TRUE;
        ELSIF v_itfc_desc = 'SURR'
        THEN                                                --POLICY SURRENDER
            v_ret_val := TRUE;
        ELSIF v_itfc_desc = 'PROVREF'
        THEN                                     --PROPOSAL OVERPAYMENT REFUND
            v_ret_val := TRUE;
        ELSIF v_itfc_desc = 'PLOVREF'
        THEN                                       --POLICY OVERPAYMENT REFUND
            v_ret_val := TRUE;
        ELSIF v_itfc_desc = 'PRCANC'
        THEN                                           --PROPOSAL CANCELLATION
            v_ret_val := TRUE;
        ELSIF v_itfc_desc = 'LOANAPP'
        THEN                                               --LOAN APPLICATIONS
            v_ret_val := TRUE;
        ELSIF v_itfc_desc = 'MED'
        THEN                                                        --MEDICALS
            v_ret_val := TRUE;
        ELSIF v_itfc_desc = 'COMM'
        THEN
            IF v_site_param != 1
            THEN                                             --COMMISSION PYMT
                v_ret_val := TRUE;
            ELSE
                v_ret_val := FALSE;
            END IF;
        ELSIF v_itfc_desc = 'LOANINT'
        THEN                                                   --LOAN INTEREST
            v_ret_val := TRUE;
        ELSIF v_itfc_desc = 'POLREF'
        THEN               --POLICY REFUND (due to death,deductions,forgery...
            v_ret_val := TRUE;
        ELSIF v_itfc_desc = 'POLCONV'
        THEN               --POLICY REFUND (due to death,deductions,forgery...
            v_ret_val := TRUE;
        ELSIF v_itfc_desc = 'HRMS'
        THEN   --COMM POSTING (posting to HRMS for agents paid thro payroll...
            IF v_site_param = 1
            THEN                                             --COMMISSION PYMT
                v_ret_val := TRUE;
            ELSE
                v_ret_val := FALSE;
            END IF;
        ELSIF v_itfc_desc = 'TRANSFER'
        THEN                                           --JV SCREEN POSTINGS...
            v_ret_val := TRUE;
        ELSIF v_itfc_desc = 'POLTX'
        THEN                                    --CONSOLIDATED POLICY TAXES...
            v_ret_val := TRUE;
        ELSIF v_itfc_desc = 'POLTAX'
        THEN                                                    --POLICY TAXES
            v_ret_val := TRUE;
        ELSIF v_itfc_desc = 'PENSTAX'
        THEN                                                   --PENSION TAXES
            v_ret_val := TRUE;
        ELSIF v_itfc_desc = 'PREMTAX'
        THEN                                                     --PREMIUM TAX
            v_ret_val := TRUE;
        ELSIF v_itfc_desc = 'LOANTAX'
        THEN                                                      --LOAN TAXES
            v_ret_val := TRUE;
        ELSIF v_itfc_desc = 'ENDR_ADD_REF'
        THEN                                         --ENDR_ADD_REF PREMIUM...
            v_ret_val := TRUE;
        ELSIF v_itfc_desc = 'LNLIQ'
        THEN                                             --LOAN LIQUIDATION...
            v_ret_val := TRUE;
        ELSIF v_itfc_desc = 'CMPFND'
        THEN                                            --COMPENSATION FUND...
            v_ret_val := TRUE;
        ELSE
            tqc_error_manager.raise_error (
                270100601,
                text_in   =>
                    'INTERFACE TYPE ' || v_itfc_desc || ' NOT DEFINED.');
        END IF;

        RETURN v_ret_val;
    END interface_enabled;

    FUNCTION pay_method_code (v_pmth_sht_desc VARCHAR2)
        RETURN NUMBER
    IS
        v_retval   NUMBER;
    BEGIN
        SELECT pmth_code
          INTO v_retval
          FROM lms_payment_methods
         WHERE pmth_sht_desc = v_pmth_sht_desc;

        RETURN v_retval;
    EXCEPTION
        WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND
        THEN
            RETURN NULL;
        WHEN OTHERS
        THEN
            tqc_error_manager.raise_error (
                270100701,
                text_in   =>
                    'Error getting payment method ' || v_pmth_sht_desc);
    END pay_method_code;

    FUNCTION bnk_account (v_pol_code lms_policies.pol_code%TYPE)
        RETURN tqc_clients.clnt_bank_acc_no%TYPE
    IS
        v_prp_bank_acc_no   tqc_clients.clnt_bank_acc_no%TYPE;
    BEGIN
        SELECT NVL (endr_bank_acc_no,
                    NVL (prp_bank_acc_no, clnt_bank_acc_no)) --prp_bank_acc_no
          INTO v_prp_bank_acc_no
          FROM lms_proposers,
               lms_policies,
               tqc_clients,
               lms_policy_endorsements
         WHERE     pol_prp_code = prp_code
               AND pol_code = v_pol_code
               AND prp_clnt_code = clnt_code
               AND pol_current_endr_code = endr_code;

        RETURN v_prp_bank_acc_no;
    EXCEPTION
        WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND
        THEN
            --RETURN NULL;
            BEGIN
                SELECT clnt_bank_acc_no                      --prp_bank_acc_no
                  INTO v_prp_bank_acc_no
                  FROM lms_proposers, lms_annuities, tqc_clients
                 WHERE     ann_prp_code = prp_code
                       AND ann_code = v_pol_code
                       AND prp_clnt_code = clnt_code;

                RETURN v_prp_bank_acc_no;
            EXCEPTION
                WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND
                THEN
                    RETURN NULL;
            END;
        WHEN OTHERS
        THEN
            tqc_error_manager.raise_error (
                270100801,
                text_in   =>
                    'GETTING BNK ACC FOR POL CODE ' || v_pol_code || '..');
    END bnk_account;

    FUNCTION bnk_bbr_code (v_pol_code lms_policies.pol_code%TYPE)
        RETURN tqc_clients.clnt_bbr_code%TYPE
    IS
        v_prp_bbr_code   tqc_clients.clnt_bbr_code%TYPE;
    BEGIN
        SELECT NVL (endr_bbr_code, NVL (prp_bbr_code, clnt_bbr_code)) --, prp_bbr_code
          INTO v_prp_bbr_code
          FROM lms_proposers,
               lms_policies,
               tqc_clients,
               lms_policy_endorsements
         WHERE     pol_prp_code = prp_code
               AND pol_code = v_pol_code
               AND clnt_code = prp_clnt_code
               AND pol_current_endr_code = endr_code;

        RETURN v_prp_bbr_code;
    EXCEPTION
        WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND
        THEN
            --RETURN NULL;
            BEGIN
                SELECT clnt_bbr_code                          --, prp_bbr_code
                  INTO v_prp_bbr_code
                  FROM lms_proposers, lms_annuities, tqc_clients
                 WHERE     ann_prp_code = prp_code
                       AND ann_code = v_pol_code
                       AND prp_clnt_code = clnt_code;

                RETURN v_prp_bbr_code;
            EXCEPTION
                WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND
                THEN
                    RETURN NULL;
            END;
        WHEN OTHERS
        THEN
            tqc_error_manager.raise_error (
                270100901,
                text_in   =>
                    'GETTING BNK BR FOR POL CODE ' || v_pol_code || '..');
    END bnk_bbr_code;

    FUNCTION get_rct_act_id (v_rct_no NUMBER)
        RETURN VARCHAR2
    IS
        v_rct_type_id   VARCHAR2 (10);
    BEGIN
        BEGIN
            SELECT rct_acct_type_id
              INTO v_rct_type_id
              FROM fms_receipts
             WHERE rct_no = v_rct_no;
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND
            THEN
                --Added by JIM to cater for Debits. Also Incase of v_rct_no is not null and missing from FMS, we can catch the problem. 01/08/2013.
                IF v_rct_no IS NOT NULL
                THEN
                    tqc_error_manager.raise_error (
                        270101001,
                        text_in   =>
                               'Error getting FMS receipt id== '
                            || v_rct_no
                            || '..');
                ELSE
                    v_rct_type_id := 'O';
                END IF;
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                tqc_error_manager.raise_error (
                    270101001,
                    text_in   =>
                        'Error getting FMS receipt id ' || v_rct_no || '..');
        END;

        RETURN v_rct_type_id;
    END get_rct_act_id;

    FUNCTION account_enabled (
        v_bbr_code    NUMBER,
        v_raise_err   VARCHAR2 DEFAULT 'Y'
    )
        RETURN VARCHAR2
    IS
        v_eft_support   VARCHAR2 (1) := 'N';
    BEGIN
        SELECT tqc_interfaces_pkg.eft_enabled (v_bbr_code)
          INTO v_eft_support
          FROM DUAL;

        RETURN v_eft_support;
    EXCEPTION
        WHEN OTHERS
        THEN
            IF SQLCODE = -20001
            THEN
                IF v_raise_err = 'Y'
                THEN
                    raise_error (
                           'v_bbr_code='
                        || v_bbr_code
                        || '...  '
                        || SQLERRM (SQLCODE));
                --raise_application_error (SQLCODE, SQLERRM);
                ELSE
                    RETURN 'REF UNDEFINED';
                END IF;
            ELSE
                raise_error (
                       'v_bbr_code='
                    || v_bbr_code
                    || '...  '
                    || SQLERRM (SQLCODE));
            END IF;
    END account_enabled;

    FUNCTION get_receipting_acc (
        v_acc_type                VARCHAR2,
        v_prod_code               NUMBER,
        v_org_code                NUMBER,
        v_brn_code                NUMBER,
        v_fms_unknown_reposting   VARCHAR2,
        v_param_val               VARCHAR2 DEFAULT NULL,
        v_fms_receipt_pk          NUMBER DEFAULT NULL
    )
        RETURN VARCHAR2
    IS
        v_trnt_code             VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_contra_acc            VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_trnt_gl_code          VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_trnt_contra_gl_code   VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_bct_code              NUMBER;
    BEGIN
        IF v_acc_type = 'CK'
        THEN
            IF NVL (v_fms_unknown_reposting, 'N') = 'Y'
            THEN
                get_gl_code ('UNK_CHKC',
                             v_prod_code,
                             v_trnt_code,
                             v_contra_acc,
                             v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
                valid_acc (v_contra_acc,
                           v_org_code,
                           v_brn_code,
                           'UNK_CHKC');
            ELSE
                get_gl_code ('CHKC',
                             v_prod_code,
                             v_trnt_code,
                             v_trnt_gl_code,
                             v_contra_acc);
                valid_acc (v_contra_acc,
                           v_org_code,
                           v_brn_code,
                           'CHKC');
            END IF;
        ELSIF v_acc_type = 'DD'
        THEN
            get_gl_code ('DDAC',
                         v_prod_code,
                         v_trnt_code,
                         v_contra_acc,
                         v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
            valid_acc (v_contra_acc,
                       v_org_code,
                       v_brn_code,
                       'DDAC');
        ELSIF v_acc_type = 'BU'
        THEN
            v_bct_code :=
                fms_rcts_pkg.get_rcpt_debited_bank (v_fms_receipt_pk);
            v_contra_acc := fms_rcts_pkg.upload_gl_contra (v_bct_code);
            valid_acc (v_contra_acc,
                       v_org_code,
                       v_brn_code,
                       'Receipting Account..');
        ELSIF v_acc_type = 'JV'
        THEN
            get_gl_code ('JV_RCT',
                         v_prod_code,
                         v_trnt_code,
                         v_contra_acc,
                         v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
            valid_acc (v_contra_acc,
                       v_org_code,
                       v_brn_code,
                       'JV_RCT');
        ELSE
            IF NVL (v_param_val, 'Y') = 'Y'
            THEN
                get_gl_code ('DR_RCT',
                             v_prod_code,
                             v_trnt_code,
                             v_contra_acc,
                             v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
                valid_acc (v_contra_acc,
                           v_org_code,
                           v_brn_code,
                           'DR_RCT');
            ELSE
                v_bct_code :=
                    fms_rcts_pkg.get_rcpt_debited_bank (v_fms_receipt_pk);
                v_contra_acc := fms_gen_pkg.bnk_acct_no (v_bct_code);
                valid_acc (v_contra_acc,
                           v_org_code,
                           v_brn_code,
                           'Receipting Account..');
            END IF;
        END IF;

        RETURN v_contra_acc;
    EXCEPTION
        WHEN OTHERS
        THEN
            raise_error (
                   'Error getting receipting account v_acc_type='
                || v_acc_type
                || '; v_prod_code='
                || v_prod_code
                || '; v_brn_code='
                || v_brn_code
                || '..');
    END get_receipting_acc;

    FUNCTION inv_all_prem_valid (v_polcode NUMBER)
        RETURN VARCHAR2
    IS
        v_prodcode   NUMBER;
        v_param      VARCHAR2 (5);
    BEGIN
        SELECT pol_prod_code
          INTO v_prodcode
          FROM lms_policies
         WHERE pol_code = v_polcode;

        BEGIN
            lms_ord_misc.system_param_val ('INVEST_ALL_PREMIUMS',
                                           v_param,
                                           v_prodcode);
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                tqc_error_manager.raise_error (
                    270101201,
                    text_in     => 'Error getting parameter details....',
                    name1_in    => 'parameter name',
                    value1_in   => v_param,
                    name2_in    => 'v_prodcode',
                    value2_in   => TO_CHAR (v_prodcode));
        END;

        RETURN v_param;
    END inv_all_prem_valid;

    FUNCTION inv_basic_prem_valid
        RETURN VARCHAR2
    IS
        v_param   VARCHAR2 (5);
    BEGIN
        BEGIN
            lms_ord_misc.system_param_val ('INVEST_BASIC_CVR_PREM_ONLY',
                                           v_param);
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                tqc_error_manager.raise_error (
                    270101301,
                    text_in     => 'Error getting parameter details....',
                    name1_in    => 'parameter name',
                    value1_in   => v_param);
        END;

        RETURN v_param;
    END inv_basic_prem_valid;

    PROCEDURE valid_acc (
        v_acc_no     VARCHAR2,
        v_org_code   NUMBER,
        v_brh_code   NUMBER,
        v_msg        VARCHAR2 DEFAULT NULL
    )
    IS
        v_brh_name   VARCHAR2 (100);
    BEGIN
        IF v_acc_no IS NULL
        THEN
            raise_error (
                   'A/C PASSED IS NULL FOR '
                || v_msg
                || '....Acc. No.'
                || v_acc_no);
        /*tqc_error_manager.raise_error (
                        270105501,
                        text_in          => 'A/C PASSED IS NULL FOR ' || v_msg || '....',
                        name1_in         => 'Acc. No.',
                        value1_in        => v_acc_no
                     ); */
        END IF;

        --RAISE_ERROR('v_acc_no=='||v_acc_no||'v_org_code==='||v_org_code);
        IF fms_interfaces_pkg.valid_trns_acc (v_acc_no,
                                              NVL (v_org_code, 1),
                                              v_brh_code) =
           FALSE
        THEN
            v_brh_name := fms_interfaces_pkg.brh_name (v_brh_code);
            raise_error (
                   'A/C FOR ('
                || v_msg
                || ') ['
                || v_acc_no
                || '] IS UNDEFINED IN ['
                || v_brh_name
                || ') [ BRH CODE'
                || v_brh_code
                || '] ORG= ['
                || v_org_code
                || ']');
        /*tqc_error_manager.raise_error(
                         270105502,
                         text_in          => 'A/C FOR ('|| v_msg|| ') ['|| v_acc_no|| '] IS UNDEFINED IN ['|| v_brh_name||') [ BRH CODE'||v_brh_code|| '] ORG= ['|| v_org_code|| ']'
                      ); */
        END IF;
    END valid_acc;

    PROCEDURE get_gl_code (
        v_trnt_type             IN     VARCHAR2,
        v_prod_code             IN     NUMBER,
        v_trnt_code                OUT VARCHAR2,
        v_trnt_gl_code             OUT VARCHAR2,
        v_trnt_contra_gl_code      OUT VARCHAR2,
        v_tt_code                      NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
        v_renewal                      VARCHAR2 DEFAULT 'N',
        v_act_code                     NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
        v_brn_code                     NUMBER DEFAULT NULL
    )
    IS
        v_errmsg             VARCHAR2 (600);
        v_prod_appl          VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_tt_prod_appl       VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_acc_type_appl      VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_search_trnt_code   VARCHAR2 (20);
    BEGIN
        ---- RAISE_ERROR('HERE v_prod_code = '||v_tt_code);
        IF NVL (v_renewal, 'N') = 'N'
        THEN
            IF v_tt_code IS NULL
            THEN
                BEGIN
                    SELECT trnt_code,
                           trnt_gl_code,
                           trnt_contra_gl_code,
                           trnt_prod_applicable,
                           trnt_acc_type_applicable
                      INTO v_trnt_code,
                           v_trnt_gl_code,
                           v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                           v_prod_appl,
                           v_acc_type_appl
                      FROM lms_transaction_types
                     WHERE trnt_type = v_trnt_type;
                EXCEPTION
                    WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND
                    THEN
                        raise_error (
                               'REV. TYPE ['
                            || v_trnt_type
                            || '] NOT DEFINED...');
                    WHEN TOO_MANY_ROWS
                    THEN
                        BEGIN
                            SELECT trnt_code,
                                   trnt_code,
                                   trnt_gl_code,
                                   trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                   trnt_prod_applicable,
                                   trnt_acc_type_applicable
                              INTO v_trnt_code,
                                   v_search_trnt_code,
                                   v_trnt_gl_code,
                                   v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                   v_prod_appl,
                                   v_acc_type_appl
                              FROM lms_transaction_types
                             WHERE     trnt_type = v_trnt_type
                                   AND TRIM (NVL (trnt_gl_code, 'DEF')) !=
                                       'DEF'
                                   AND ROWNUM <= 1;
                        EXCEPTION
                            WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND
                            THEN
                                raise_error (
                                       'REV. TYPE ['
                                    || v_trnt_type
                                    || '] NOT EXPLICITELY DEFINED...');
                        END;
                    WHEN OTHERS
                    THEN
                        raise_error (
                            'Error fetching GL code ' || v_trnt_type);
                END;
            ELSE
                BEGIN
                    SELECT tt_acc_no, tt_contra_acc, tt_applicable_at_prod
                      INTO v_trnt_gl_code, v_trnt_contra_gl_code, v_prod_appl
                      FROM lms_tax_types
                     WHERE tt_code = v_tt_code;
                EXCEPTION
                    WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND
                    THEN
                        raise_error (
                               'REV. TYPE ['
                            || v_trnt_type
                            || '-TAXCODE='
                            || v_tt_code
                            || '] NOT DEFINED...');
                    WHEN OTHERS
                    THEN
                        raise_error (
                            'Error fetching GL code ' || v_trnt_type);
                END;
            END IF;

            IF NVL (v_prod_appl, 'N') = 'Y'
            THEN
                IF v_prod_code IS NULL
                THEN
                    raise_error (
                           'DEFINE PROPOSAL/POLICY PRODUCT FIRST ...'
                        || v_trnt_type);
                END IF;

                -- RAISE_ERROR('jEDD=='||v_tt_code||'==FFSD=='||v_trnt_type||'==dDDD=='||v_prod_code);
                IF v_tt_code IS NULL
                THEN
                    BEGIN
                        SELECT DISTINCT
                               trap_trnt_code, trap_acc_no, trap_contra_acc
                          INTO v_trnt_code,
                               v_trnt_gl_code,
                               v_trnt_contra_gl_code
                          FROM lms_product_transactions,
                               lms_transaction_types
                         WHERE     trap_trnt_code = trnt_code
                               AND trap_prod_code = v_prod_code
                               AND trnt_type = v_trnt_type;

                        IF NVL (v_trnt_gl_code, 'DEF') = 'DEF'
                        THEN
                            raise_error (
                                   'v_trnt_type '
                                || v_trnt_type
                                || ' GL A/C NOT DEFINED FOR '
                                || get_product (v_prod_code, 'N'));
                        END IF;
                    EXCEPTION
                        WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND
                        THEN
                            raise_error (
                                   'REV. TYPE ['
                                || v_trnt_type
                                || '] NOT PROD. DEFINED...
                                                           PROD_CODE ='
                                || v_prod_code);
                        WHEN TOO_MANY_ROWS
                        THEN
                            BEGIN
                                SELECT DISTINCT
                                       trap_trnt_code,
                                       trap_acc_no,
                                       trap_contra_acc
                                  INTO v_trnt_code,
                                       v_trnt_gl_code,
                                       v_trnt_contra_gl_code
                                  FROM lms_product_transactions,
                                       lms_transaction_types
                                 WHERE     trap_trnt_code = trnt_code
                                       AND trap_prod_code = v_prod_code
                                       AND trnt_type = v_trnt_type
                                       AND trnt_code =
                                           NVL (v_search_trnt_code,
                                                trnt_code)
                                       AND TRIM (NVL (trap_acc_no, 'DEF')) !=
                                           'DEF'
                                       AND ROWNUM <= 1;
                            EXCEPTION
                                WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND
                                THEN
                                    raise_error (
                                           'REV. TYPE ['
                                        || v_trnt_type
                                        || '] NOT EXPLICITELY DEFINED...');
                            END;
                        WHEN OTHERS
                        THEN
                            raise_error (
                                   'Error fetching GL code for transaction type '
                                || v_trnt_type);
                    END;
                ELSE
                    BEGIN
                        SELECT ptt_acc_no, ptt_contra_acc
                          INTO v_trnt_gl_code, v_trnt_contra_gl_code
                          FROM lms_prod_tax_types
                         WHERE     ptt_tt_code = v_tt_code
                               AND ptt_prod_code = v_prod_code;
                    EXCEPTION
                        WHEN OTHERS
                        THEN
                            raise_error (
                                   'Error fetching product tax GL code. v_trnt_type '
                                || v_trnt_type
                                || ' v_prod_code '
                                || v_prod_code
                                || ' v_tt_code'
                                || v_tt_code);
                    END;
                END IF;
            END IF;
        ELSIF NVL (v_renewal, 'N') = 'A'
        THEN
            IF v_tt_code IS NULL
            THEN
                BEGIN
                    SELECT trnt_code,
                           NVL (trnt_other_prem_gl_code, trnt_gl_code),
                           NVL (trnt_other_prem_contra_gl_code,
                                trnt_contra_gl_code),
                           trnt_prod_applicable
                      INTO v_trnt_code,
                           v_trnt_gl_code,
                           v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                           v_prod_appl
                      FROM lms_transaction_types
                     WHERE trnt_type = v_trnt_type;
                EXCEPTION
                    WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND
                    THEN
                        raise_error (
                               'REV. TYPE ['
                            || v_trnt_type
                            || '] NOT DEFINED...');
                    WHEN TOO_MANY_ROWS
                    THEN
                        BEGIN
                            SELECT trnt_code,
                                   trnt_code,
                                   NVL (trnt_other_prem_gl_code,
                                        trnt_gl_code),
                                   NVL (trnt_other_prem_contra_gl_code,
                                        trnt_contra_gl_code),
                                   trnt_prod_applicable
                              INTO v_trnt_code,
                                   v_search_trnt_code,
                                   v_trnt_gl_code,
                                   v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                   v_prod_appl
                              FROM lms_transaction_types
                             WHERE     trnt_type = v_trnt_type
                                   AND TRIM (NVL (trnt_gl_code, 'DEF')) !=
                                       'DEF'
                                   AND ROWNUM <= 1;
                        EXCEPTION
                            WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND
                            THEN
                                raise_error (
                                       'REV. TYPE ['
                                    || v_trnt_type
                                    || '] NOT EXPLICITELY DEFINED...');
                        END;
                    WHEN OTHERS
                    THEN
                        raise_error (
                            'Error fetching GL code ' || v_trnt_type);
                END;
            ELSE
                BEGIN
                    SELECT NVL (tt_other_prem_acc_no, tt_acc_no),
                           NVL (tt_other_prem_contra_acc, tt_contra_acc),
                           tt_applicable_at_prod
                      INTO v_trnt_gl_code, v_trnt_contra_gl_code, v_prod_appl
                      FROM lms_tax_types
                     WHERE tt_code = v_tt_code;
                EXCEPTION
                    WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND
                    THEN
                        raise_error (
                               'REV. TYPE ['
                            || v_trnt_type
                            || '-TAXCODE='
                            || v_tt_code
                            || '] NOT DEFINED...');
                    WHEN OTHERS
                    THEN
                        raise_error (
                            'Error fetching GL code ' || v_trnt_type);
                END;
            END IF;

            IF NVL (v_prod_appl, 'N') = 'Y'
            THEN
                IF v_prod_code IS NULL
                THEN
                    raise_error (
                           'DEFINE PROPOSAL/POLICY PRODUCT FIRST ...'
                        || v_trnt_type);
                END IF;

                IF v_tt_code IS NULL
                THEN
                    BEGIN
                        BEGIN
                            SELECT DISTINCT
                                   trap_trnt_code,
                                   NVL (trap_other_prem_acc_no, trap_acc_no),
                                   NVL (trap_other_prem_contra_acc,
                                        trap_contra_acc)
                              INTO v_trnt_code,
                                   v_trnt_gl_code,
                                   v_trnt_contra_gl_code
                              FROM lms_product_transactions,
                                   lms_transaction_types
                             WHERE     trap_trnt_code = trnt_code
                                   AND trap_prod_code = v_prod_code
                                   AND trnt_type = v_trnt_type;
                        EXCEPTION
                            WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND
                            THEN
                                NULL;
                            WHEN TOO_MANY_ROWS
                            THEN
                                BEGIN
                                    SELECT DISTINCT
                                           trap_trnt_code,
                                           NVL (trap_other_prem_acc_no,
                                                trap_acc_no),
                                           NVL (trap_other_prem_contra_acc,
                                                trap_contra_acc)
                                      INTO v_trnt_code,
                                           v_trnt_gl_code,
                                           v_trnt_contra_gl_code
                                      FROM lms_product_transactions,
                                           lms_transaction_types
                                     WHERE     trap_trnt_code = trnt_code
                                           AND trap_prod_code = v_prod_code
                                           AND trnt_type = v_trnt_type
                                           AND trnt_code =
                                               NVL (v_search_trnt_code,
                                                    trnt_code)
                                           AND TRIM (
                                                   NVL (trap_acc_no, 'DEF')) !=
                                               'DEF'
                                           AND ROWNUM <= 1;
                                EXCEPTION
                                    WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND
                                    THEN
                                        raise_error (
                                               'REV. TYPE ['
                                            || v_trnt_type
                                            || '] NOT EXPLICITELY DEFINED...');
                                END;
                            WHEN OTHERS
                            THEN
                                raise_error (
                                    'ERROR FETCHING TRANSACTION TYPE DETAILS.');
                        END;

                        IF NVL (v_trnt_gl_code, 'DEF') = 'DEF'
                        THEN
                            raise_error (
                                   v_trnt_type
                                || ' GL A/C NOT DEFINED FOR '
                                || get_product (v_prod_code, 'N'));
                        END IF;
                    EXCEPTION
                        WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND
                        THEN
                            raise_error (
                                   'REV. TYPE ['
                                || v_trnt_type
                                || '] NOT PROD. DEFINED...');
                        WHEN OTHERS
                        THEN
                            raise_error (
                                   'Error fetching GL code for transaction type '
                                || v_trnt_type);
                    END;
                ELSE
                    BEGIN
                        SELECT NVL (ptt_other_prem_acc_no, ptt_acc_no),
                               NVL (ptt_other_prem_contra_acc,
                                    ptt_contra_acc)
                          INTO v_trnt_gl_code, v_trnt_contra_gl_code
                          FROM lms_prod_tax_types
                         WHERE     ptt_tt_code = v_tt_code
                               AND ptt_prod_code = v_prod_code;
                    EXCEPTION
                        WHEN OTHERS
                        THEN
                            raise_error (
                                   'Error fetching product tax GL code. v_prod_code'
                                || v_prod_code
                                || ' v_tt_code'
                                || v_tt_code);
                    END;
                END IF;
            END IF;
        ELSE
            IF v_tt_code IS NULL
            THEN
                BEGIN
                    SELECT trnt_code,
                           NVL (trnt_renewal_gl_code, trnt_gl_code),
                           NVL (trnt_renewal_contra_gl_code,
                                trnt_contra_gl_code),
                           trnt_prod_applicable,
                           trnt_acc_type_applicable
                      INTO v_trnt_code,
                           v_trnt_gl_code,
                           v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                           v_prod_appl,
                           v_acc_type_appl
                      FROM lms_transaction_types
                     WHERE trnt_type = v_trnt_type;
                EXCEPTION
                    WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND
                    THEN
                        raise_error (
                               'REV. TYPE ['
                            || v_trnt_type
                            || '] NOT DEFINED...');
                    WHEN TOO_MANY_ROWS
                    THEN
                        BEGIN
                            SELECT trnt_code,
                                   trnt_code,
                                   NVL (trnt_renewal_gl_code, trnt_gl_code),
                                   NVL (trnt_renewal_contra_gl_code,
                                        trnt_contra_gl_code),
                                   trnt_prod_applicable,
                                   trnt_acc_type_applicable
                              INTO v_trnt_code,
                                   v_search_trnt_code,
                                   v_trnt_gl_code,
                                   v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                   v_prod_appl,
                                   v_acc_type_appl
                              FROM lms_transaction_types
                             WHERE     trnt_type = v_trnt_type
                                   AND TRIM (NVL (trnt_gl_code, 'DEF')) !=
                                       'DEF'
                                   AND ROWNUM <= 1;
                        EXCEPTION
                            WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND
                            THEN
                                raise_error (
                                       'REV. TYPE ['
                                    || v_trnt_type
                                    || '] NOT EXPLICITELY DEFINED...');
                        END;
                    WHEN OTHERS
                    THEN
                        raise_error (
                            'Error fetching GL code ' || v_trnt_type);
                END;
            ELSE
                BEGIN
                    SELECT NVL (tt_renewal_acc_no, tt_acc_no),
                           NVL (tt_renewal_contra_acc, tt_contra_acc),
                           tt_applicable_at_prod
                      INTO v_trnt_gl_code, v_trnt_contra_gl_code, v_prod_appl
                      FROM lms_tax_types
                     WHERE tt_code = v_tt_code;
                EXCEPTION
                    WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND
                    THEN
                        raise_error (
                               'REV. TYPE ['
                            || v_trnt_type
                            || '-TAXCODE='
                            || v_tt_code
                            || '] NOT DEFINED...');
                    WHEN OTHERS
                    THEN
                        raise_error (
                            'Error fetching GL code ' || v_trnt_type);
                END;
            END IF;

            IF NVL (v_prod_appl, 'N') = 'Y'
            THEN
                IF v_prod_code IS NULL
                THEN
                    raise_error (
                           'DEFINE PROPOSAL/POLICY PRODUCT FIRST 2 ...'
                        || v_trnt_type);
                END IF;

                IF v_tt_code IS NULL
                THEN
                    BEGIN
                        SELECT DISTINCT
                               trap_trnt_code,
                               NVL (trap_renewal_acc_no, trap_acc_no),
                               NVL (trap_renewal_contra_acc, trap_contra_acc),
                               trnt_acc_type_applicable
                          INTO v_trnt_code,
                               v_trnt_gl_code,
                               v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                               v_acc_type_appl
                          FROM lms_product_transactions,
                               lms_transaction_types
                         WHERE     trap_trnt_code = trnt_code
                               AND trap_prod_code = v_prod_code
                               AND trnt_type = v_trnt_type;

                        IF NVL (v_trnt_gl_code, 'DEF') = 'DEF'
                        THEN
                            raise_error (
                                   ' GL A/C NOT DEFINED FOR '
                                || get_product (v_prod_code, 'N'));
                        END IF;
                    EXCEPTION
                        WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND
                        THEN
                            raise_error (
                                   'REV. TYPE ['
                                || v_trnt_type
                                || '] NOT PROD. DEFINED...');
                        WHEN TOO_MANY_ROWS
                        THEN
                            BEGIN
                                SELECT DISTINCT
                                       trap_trnt_code,
                                       NVL (trap_renewal_acc_no, trap_acc_no),
                                       NVL (trap_renewal_contra_acc,
                                            trap_contra_acc),
                                       trnt_acc_type_applicable
                                  INTO v_trnt_code,
                                       v_trnt_gl_code,
                                       v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                       v_acc_type_appl
                                  FROM lms_product_transactions,
                                       lms_transaction_types
                                 WHERE     trap_trnt_code = trnt_code
                                       AND trap_prod_code = v_prod_code
                                       AND trnt_type = v_trnt_type
                                       AND trnt_code =
                                           NVL (v_search_trnt_code,
                                                trnt_code)
                                       AND TRIM (NVL (trap_acc_no, 'DEF')) !=
                                           'DEF'
                                       AND ROWNUM <= 1;
                            EXCEPTION
                                WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND
                                THEN
                                    raise_error (
                                           'REV. TYPE ['
                                        || v_trnt_type
                                        || '] NOT EXPLICITELY DEFINED...');
                            END;
                        WHEN OTHERS
                        THEN
                            raise_error (
                                   'Error fetching GL code for transaction type '
                                || v_trnt_type);
                    END;
                ELSE
                    BEGIN
                        SELECT NVL (ptt_renewal_acc_no, ptt_acc_no),
                               NVL (ptt_renewal_contra_acc, ptt_contra_acc)
                          INTO v_trnt_gl_code, v_trnt_contra_gl_code
                          FROM lms_prod_tax_types
                         WHERE     ptt_tt_code = v_tt_code
                               AND ptt_prod_code = v_prod_code;
                    EXCEPTION
                        WHEN OTHERS
                        THEN
                            raise_error (
                                   'Error fetching product tax GL code.;v_prod_code=='
                                || v_prod_code
                                || ';v_tt_code=='
                                || v_tt_code);
                    END;
                END IF;
            END IF;
        END IF;

        -- raise_error('v_acc_type_appl=='||v_acc_type_appl);
        IF NVL (v_acc_type_appl, 'N') = 'Y'
        THEN
            BEGIN
                v_trnt_contra_gl_code :=
                    tq_fms.rcts_web_pkg.receipt_crt_acc (27, --v_sys_code      NUMBER,
                                                         v_brn_code, -- v_brh_code      NUMBER,
                                                         v_act_code --v_act_code      NUMBER
                                                                   );
            EXCEPTION
                WHEN OTHERS
                THEN
                    raise_error (
                           'Error fetching account type specific gl code;v_act_code=='
                        || v_act_code
                        || ';v_brn_code=='
                        || v_brn_code);
            END;
        END IF;
    EXCEPTION
        WHEN OTHERS
        THEN
            raise_error (
                   'Error fetching GL code.;v_trnt_type'
                || v_trnt_type
                || ';v_prod_code'
                || v_prod_code);
    END get_gl_code;

    PROCEDURE interface_append_cb_gl_trans (
        v_trans_code               NUMBER,
        v_raise_by                 VARCHAR2,
        v_pol_code                 NUMBER,
        v_prod_code                NUMBER,
        v_vchr_no                  VARCHAR2,
        v_opr_code                 NUMBER,
        v_oppr_code                NUMBER,
        v_rcpt_no                  VARCHAR2,
        v_count                    NUMBER,
        v_cb_count                 NUMBER,
        v_narrative                VARCHAR2,
        v_amount                   NUMBER,
        v_drcr                     VARCHAR2,
        v_acc_number               VARCHAR2,
        v_branch_code              NUMBER,
        v_tcg_rec           IN OUT fms_vouchers_pkg.tcg_rec_type,
        v_cad_code                 NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
        v_otop_code                NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
        v_fpmt_code                NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
        v_ort_code                 NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
        v_btr_no                   NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
        v_ppr_code                 NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
        v_ocl_code                 NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
        v_agn_code                 NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
        v_trans_no                 NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
        v_covrg_area_code          NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
        v_spoke_code               NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
        v_sbu_code                 NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
        v_loc_code                 NUMBER DEFAULT NULL
    )
    IS
        v_ref3            NUMBER;
        v_new_narrative   VARCHAR2 (100);
        v_client_name     VARCHAR2 (100);
    BEGIN
        --RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR(-20021,v_trans_code||v_raise_by );
        --RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR(-20021,v_acc_number);
        BEGIN
            IF v_acc_number IS NULL
            THEN
                raise_error ('NULL Accnt...' || v_narrative);
            ELSE
                SELECT    TO_NUMBER (TO_CHAR (SYSDATE, 'RRRR'))
                       || lms_ref3_seq.NEXTVAL
                  INTO v_ref3
                  FROM DUAL;

                INSERT INTO lms_interface_table (itb_ref3,
                                                 itb_date,
                                                 itb_transaction_code,
                                                 itb_raised_by,
                                                 itb_count,
                                                 itb_pol_code,
                                                 itb_prod_code,
                                                 itb_vchr_no,
                                                 itb_opr_code,
                                                 itb_transaction_type,
                                                 itb_amount,
                                                 itb_narrative,
                                                 itb_acc_number,
                                                 itb_drcr,
                                                 itb_branch_code,
                                                 itb_oppr_code,
                                                 itb_rcpt_no,
                                                 itb_cad_code,
                                                 itb_otop_code,
                                                 itb_fpmt_code,
                                                 itb_ort_code,
                                                 itb_ppr_code,
                                                 itb_btr_no,
                                                 itb_brr_reprint_code,
                                                 itb_ocl_code,
                                                 itb_agn_code,
                                                 itb_trans_no,
                                                 itb_covrg_area_code,
                                                 itb_spoke_code,
                                                 itb_sbu_code,
                                                 itb_loc_code)
                     VALUES (v_ref3,
                             SYSDATE,
                             v_trans_code,
                             v_raise_by,
                             v_count,
                             v_pol_code,
                             v_prod_code,
                             v_vchr_no,
                             v_opr_code,
                             'APPEND_CB',
                             v_amount,
                             v_narrative,
                             v_acc_number,
                             v_drcr,
                             v_branch_code,
                             v_oppr_code,
                             v_rcpt_no,
                             v_cad_code,
                             v_otop_code,
                             v_fpmt_code,
                             v_ort_code,
                             v_ppr_code,
                             v_btr_no,
                             v_btr_no,
                             v_ocl_code,
                             v_agn_code,
                             v_trans_no,
                             v_covrg_area_code,
                             v_spoke_code,
                             v_sbu_code,
                             v_loc_code);
            END IF;
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                raise_error ('INS_Append_cb_GL.1.' || SQLERRM);
        END;

        IF v_pol_code IS NOT NULL
        THEN
            BEGIN
                SELECT TRIM (
                              prp_first_name
                           || ' '
                           || TRIM (prp_other_names || ' ' || prp_surname))
                  INTO v_client_name
                  FROM lms_policies, lms_proposers
                 WHERE     pol_client_prp_code = prp_code
                       AND pol_code = v_pol_code;
            EXCEPTION
                WHEN OTHERS
                THEN
                    raise_error ('Error Accessing Poliocy Details');
            END;

            v_new_narrative := v_client_name;
        END IF;

        -- RAISE_ERROR(' v_acc_number' || v_acc_number||' v_count '||v_count||' v_cb_count '||v_cb_count);
        BEGIN
            fms_vouchers_pkg.append_cb_gl_trans (
                v_count,
                v_cb_count,                                         --TCB_NO ,
                NVL (v_narrative, v_new_narrative),
                v_amount,
                v_drcr,
                v_acc_number,
                v_branch_code,
                v_tcg_rec,
                v_amount,                    --v_bcamount NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                NULL,                       --v_ccb_code  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                NULL,                        --v_esc_code NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                v_covrg_area_code,           --v_sbu_code NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                v_loc_code,             --v_location_code NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                v_prod_code,                 --v_prod_code NUMBER DEFAULT NULL
                v_ref3                     --v_itfc_ref3  NUMBER  DEFAULT NULL
                      );
        --      EXCEPTION
        --         WHEN OTHERS
        --         THEN
        --            raise_error ('Append_GL.1.' || SQLERRM);
        END;
    END interface_append_cb_gl_trans;

    PROCEDURE interface_append_cb_trans (
        v_trans_code               NUMBER,
        v_raise_by                 VARCHAR2,
        v_pol_code                 NUMBER,
        v_prod_code                NUMBER,
        v_vchr_no                  VARCHAR2,
        v_opr_code                 NUMBER,
        v_oppr_code                NUMBER,
        v_rcpt_no                  VARCHAR2,
        v_cb_count                 NUMBER,
        v_narrative                VARCHAR2,
        v_amount                   NUMBER,
        v_drcr                     VARCHAR2,
        v_acc_number               VARCHAR2,
        v_branch_code              NUMBER,
        v_cb_rec            IN OUT fms_vouchers_pkg.tcb_rec_type,
        v_date                     DATE,
        v_bct_code                 NUMBER,
        v_cad_code                 NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
        v_otop_code                NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
        v_fpmt_code                NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
        v_ort_code                 NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
        v_btr_no                   NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
        v_ppr_code                 NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
        v_ocl_code                 NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
        v_agn_code                 NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
        v_trans_no                 NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
        v_covrg_area_code          NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
        v_spoke_code               NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
        v_sbu_code                 NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
        v_loc_code                 NUMBER DEFAULT NULL
    )
    IS
        v_ref3            NUMBER;
        v_new_narrative   VARCHAR2 (100);
        v_client_name     VARCHAR2 (100);
    BEGIN
        --RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR(-20021,v_trans_code||v_raise_by );
        --RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR(-20021,v_acc_number);
        BEGIN
            IF v_acc_number IS NULL
            THEN
                raise_error ('NULL Accnt...' || v_narrative);
            ELSE
                SELECT    TO_NUMBER (TO_CHAR (SYSDATE, 'RRRR'))
                       || lms_ref3_seq.NEXTVAL
                  INTO v_ref3
                  FROM DUAL;

                INSERT INTO lms_interface_table (itb_ref3,
                                                 itb_date,
                                                 itb_transaction_code,
                                                 itb_raised_by,
                                                 itb_count,
                                                 itb_pol_code,
                                                 itb_prod_code,
                                                 itb_vchr_no,
                                                 itb_opr_code,
                                                 itb_transaction_type,
                                                 itb_amount,
                                                 itb_narrative,
                                                 itb_acc_number,
                                                 itb_drcr,
                                                 itb_branch_code,
                                                 itb_oppr_code,
                                                 itb_rcpt_no,
                                                 itb_cad_code,
                                                 itb_otop_code,
                                                 itb_fpmt_code,
                                                 itb_ort_code,
                                                 itb_ppr_code,
                                                 itb_btr_no,
                                                 itb_brr_reprint_code,
                                                 itb_ocl_code,
                                                 itb_agn_code,
                                                 itb_trans_no,
                                                 itb_covrg_area_code,
                                                 itb_spoke_code,
                                                 itb_sbu_code,
                                                 itb_loc_code)
                     VALUES (v_ref3,
                             SYSDATE,
                             v_trans_code,
                             v_raise_by,
                             v_cb_count,
                             v_pol_code,
                             v_prod_code,
                             v_vchr_no,
                             v_opr_code,
                             'APPEND_CB',
                             v_amount,
                             v_narrative,
                             v_acc_number,
                             v_drcr,
                             v_branch_code,
                             v_oppr_code,
                             v_rcpt_no,
                             v_cad_code,
                             v_otop_code,
                             v_fpmt_code,
                             v_ort_code,
                             v_ppr_code,
                             v_btr_no,
                             v_btr_no,
                             v_ocl_code,
                             v_agn_code,
                             v_trans_no,
                             v_covrg_area_code,
                             v_spoke_code,
                             v_sbu_code,
                             v_loc_code);
            END IF;
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                raise_error ('INS_Append_cb_GL.1.' || SQLERRM);
        END;

        IF v_pol_code IS NOT NULL
        THEN
            BEGIN
                SELECT TRIM (
                              prp_first_name
                           || ' '
                           || TRIM (prp_other_names || ' ' || prp_surname))
                  INTO v_client_name
                  FROM lms_policies, lms_proposers
                 WHERE     pol_client_prp_code = prp_code
                       AND pol_code = v_pol_code;
            EXCEPTION
                WHEN OTHERS
                THEN
                    raise_error ('Error Accessing Poliocy Details');
            END;

            v_new_narrative := v_client_name;
        END IF;

        fms_vouchers_pkg.append_cb_trans (v_cb_count,
                                          NVL (v_narrative, v_new_narrative),
                                          v_amount,
                                          v_drcr,
                                          v_bct_code,
                                          v_branch_code,
                                          v_rcpt_no,      --V_CHQ_NO VARCHAR2,
                                          v_date,              --V_CHQ_DT DATE
                                          v_cb_rec,
                                          NULL,
                                          --v_cur_rate  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                          NULL, --v_bcAmt  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                          NULL, --v_type  VARCHAR2 DEFAULT NULL,
                                          v_ref3--v_itfc_ref3 NUMBER DEFAULT NULL
                                                );
    END interface_append_cb_trans;

                                              NULL, --v_div_code  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                              v_covrg_area_code, --v_sbu_code NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                              v_loc_code, --v_location_code NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                              v_prod_code --v_prod_code  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL

        --      EXCEPTION
        --         WHEN OTHERS
        --         THEN
        --            tqc_error_manager.raise_error
        --                               (270106502,
        --                                text_in        => 'Error appending cheque details.',
        --                                name1_in       => 'v_vchr_no',

    PROCEDURE interface_append_gl (
        v_trans_code               NUMBER,

        v_amount                   NUMBER,
        v_drcr                     VARCHAR2,
        -- If its a Credit (C), the first Account is credited and the second account is debited. if its a Debit (D), the first Account is debited and the second account is Credited.
        v_acc_number1              VARCHAR2,
        v_acc_number2              VARCHAR2,
        v_branch_code              NUMBER,
        v_trn_rec           IN OUT tq_fms.fms_vouchers_pkg.tgl_rec_type,

        v_sbu_code                 NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
        v_loc_code                 NUMBER DEFAULT NULL
    )
    IS

            THEN
                tqc_error_manager.raise_error (
                    270106701,
                    text_in     =>
                        'Either one of the account number''s passed is numll.',
                    name1_in    => 'Acc. number1',
                    value1_in   => v_acc_number1,
                    name2_in    => 'Acc. number2',
                    value2_in   => v_acc_number2,

                       || lms_ref3_seq.NEXTVAL

                  FROM DUAL;

                                                 itb_date,

                                                 itb_rcpt_no,
                                                 itb_cad_code,
                                                 itb_otop_code,
                                                 itb_fpmt_code,
                                                 itb_ort_code,
                                                 itb_ppr_code,
                                                 itb_brr_reprint_code,

                     VALUES (v_ref3,
                             SYSDATE,

                             v_raise_by,
                             v_count,
                             v_pol_code,
                             v_prod_code,
                             v_vchr_no,
                             v_opr_code,
                             'APPEND_GL',
                             v_amount,
                             v_narrative,
                             v_acc_number1,
                             v_acc_number2,
                             v_drcr,
                             v_branch_code,
                             v_oppr_code,
                             v_rcpt_no,
                             v_cad_code,
                             v_otop_code,
                             v_fpmt_code,
                             v_ort_code,
                             v_ppr_code,
                             v_btr_no,
                             v_ocl_code,
                             v_agn_code,
                             v_trans_no,
                             v_covrg_area_code,
                             v_spoke_code,
                             v_sbu_code,

        BEGIN
