    END interface_append_gl;

    PROCEDURE interface_update_vgl (
        v_trans_code               NUMBER,
        v_raise_by                 VARCHAR2,
        v_pol_code                 NUMBER,
        v_date                     DATE,
        v_opr_code                 NUMBER,
        v_oppr_code                NUMBER,
        v_btc_description          VARCHAR2,
        v_btc_type                 VARCHAR2,
        v_branch_code              NUMBER,
        v_description              VARCHAR2,
        v_ref                      VARCHAR2,
        v_gl_trans          IN OUT tq_fms.fms_vouchers_pkg.tgl_rec_type,
        v_cad_code                 NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
        v_otop_code                NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
        v_fpmt_code                NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
        v_ort_code                 NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
        v_btr_no                   NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
        v_ppr_code                 NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
        v_ocl_code                 NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
        v_agn_code                 NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
        v_trans_no                 NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
        v_curr_code                NUMBER DEFAULT NULL
    )
    IS
        v_ref3             NUMBER;
        v_vgl_no           NUMBER;
        v_cur_code         NUMBER;
        v_req_by           NUMBER;
        v_mktund           VARCHAR2 (10);
        v_backdate_param   VARCHAR2 (5);
        v_post_date        DATE := NVL (v_date, TRUNC (SYSDATE));
    BEGIN
        v_cur_code := lms_interfaces_pkg.lms_def_cur (v_branch_code);
        v_req_by := fms_interfaces_pkg.get_usercode (v_raise_by);

        BEGIN
            lms_ord_misc.system_param_val (
                'ALLOW_BACKDATING_GL_POSTING_DATE',
                v_backdate_param);
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                raise_error (
                    'Parameter Error...ALLOW_BACKDATING_GL_POSTING_DATE');
        END;

        IF v_backdate_param <> 'Y'
        THEN
            v_post_date := TRUNC (SYSDATE);
        END IF;

        --IF v_ort_code IS NOT NULL
        --THEN
        --          BEGIN
        --             SELECT 'UND'
        --               INTO v_mktund
        --               FROM LMS_POLICIES
        --              WHERE pol_code = v_pol_code;
        --          EXCEPTION
        --             WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND
        --             THEN
        --                BEGIN
        --                   SELECT 'MKT'
        --                     INTO v_mktund
        --                     FROM LMS_POL_PROPOSALS
        --                    WHERE ppr_code = v_pol_code;
        --                EXCEPTION
        --                   WHEN OTHERS
        --                   THEN
        --                      v_mktund := '';
        --                END;
        --          END;
        --END IF;
        BEGIN
            --raise_error('HERE NOW====='||v_cad_code);
            SELECT    TO_NUMBER (TO_CHAR (SYSDATE, 'RRRR'))
                   || lms_ref3_seq.NEXTVAL
              INTO v_ref3
              FROM DUAL;

            INSERT INTO lms_interface_table (itb_ref3,
                                             itb_date,
                                             itb_transaction_code,
                                             itb_raised_by,
                                             itb_pol_code,
                                             itb_opr_code,
                                             itb_transaction_type,
                                             itb_narrative,
                                             itb_branch_code,
                                             itb_batch_desc,
                                             itb_batch_type,
                                             itb_oppr_code,
                                             itb_ref,
                                             itb_vgl_post_date,
                                             itb_cad_code,
                                             itb_otop_code,
                                             itb_fpmt_code,
                                             itb_ort_code,
                                             itb_ppr_code,
                                             itb_brr_reprint_code,
                                             itb_ocl_code,
                                             itb_agn_code,
                                             itb_trans_no)
                 VALUES (v_ref3,
                         SYSDATE,
                         v_trans_code,
                         v_raise_by,
                         v_pol_code,
                         v_opr_code,
                         'UPDATE_VGL',
                         v_description,
                         v_branch_code,
                         v_btc_description,
                         v_btc_type,
                         v_oppr_code,
                         v_ref,
                         v_post_date,
                         v_cad_code,
                         v_otop_code,
                         v_fpmt_code,
                         v_ort_code,
                         v_ppr_code,
                         v_btr_no,
                         v_ocl_code,
                         v_agn_code,
                         v_trans_no);
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                raise_error (
                       'Error creating voucher.Voucher Desc.'
                    || v_btc_description);
        END;

        -- raise_error('FINALLY HERE=============');
        BEGIN
            UPDATE lms_interface_table
               SET itb_vgl_post_date = v_post_date
             WHERE     itb_transaction_type = 'APPEND_GL'
                   AND itb_transaction_code = v_trans_code;
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                raise_error (
                       'Error updating voucher posting date. Date'
                    || v_post_date);
        END;

        BEGIN
            --         raise_error('Error posting voucher====='||v_gl_trans.COUNT);
            v_vgl_no :=
                fms_interfaces_pkg.update_vgl (v_btc_description, --v_btc_description
                                               v_btc_type,        --v_btc_type
                                               v_branch_code,     --v_brh_code
                                               v_post_date,             --v_dt
                                               v_description,  --v_description
                                               v_ref,                  --v_ref
                                               v_req_by,         --v_raised_by
                                               NVL (v_curr_code, v_cur_code),
                                               -- v_cur_code,
                                               v_gl_trans,           --v_trans
                                               v_trans_code,    --v_trans code
                                               v_ref3);               --v_ref3
            fms_interfaces_pkg.post_je (v_vgl_no, v_req_by);

            UPDATE lms_interface_table
               SET itb_vgl_no = v_vgl_no
             WHERE itb_transaction_code = v_trans_code;

            v_gl_trans.delete;
        --      EXCEPTION
        --         WHEN OTHERS
        --         THEN
        --            tqc_error_manager.raise_error
        --                                        (270106803,
        --                                         text_in        => 'Error posting voucher.',
        --                                         name1_in       => 'Voucher Desc.',
        --                                         value1_in      =>    v_btc_description
        --                                                           || ' -'
        --                                                           || v_branch_code
        --                                        );
        --raise_error('Error posting voucher');
        END;

        UPDATE lms_interface_table
           SET itb_vgl_post_date = v_post_date, itb_vgl_no = v_vgl_no
         WHERE itb_transaction_code = v_trans_code;
    END interface_update_vgl;

    PROCEDURE interface_update_vcb (
        v_trans_code               NUMBER,
        v_raise_by                 VARCHAR2,
        v_pol_code                 NUMBER,
        v_date                     DATE,
        v_opr_code                 NUMBER,
        v_oppr_code                NUMBER,
        v_btc_description          VARCHAR2,
        v_btc_type                 VARCHAR2,
        v_branch_code              NUMBER,
        v_description              VARCHAR2,
        v_ref                      VARCHAR2,
        v_tcg_rec           IN OUT fms_vouchers_pkg.tcg_rec_type,
        v_cb_rec            IN OUT fms_vouchers_pkg.tcb_rec_type,
        v_rcpt_no                  VARCHAR2,
        v_paymt_mode               VARCHAR2,
        v_vcb_no               OUT NUMBER,
        v_cad_code                 NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
        v_otop_code                NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
        v_fpmt_code                NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
        v_ort_code                 NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
        v_btr_no                   NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
        v_ppr_code                 NUMBER DEFAULT NULL
    )
    IS
        v_ref3             NUMBER;
        v_no               NUMBER;
        v_cur_code         NUMBER;
        v_req_by           NUMBER;
        v_cnt              NUMBER := 0;
        v_pol_policy_no    lms_policies.pol_policy_no%TYPE;
        v_client_name      VARCHAR2 (300);
        v_new_ref          VARCHAR2 (200);
        v_dr_amount        NUMBER;
        v_cr_amount        NUMBER;
        v_backdate_param   VARCHAR2 (5);
        v_post_date        DATE := NVL (v_date, TRUNC (SYSDATE));
    BEGIN
        v_cur_code := lms_interfaces_pkg.lms_def_cur (v_branch_code);
        v_req_by := fms_interfaces_pkg.get_usercode (v_raise_by);

        BEGIN
            lms_ord_misc.system_param_val (
                'ALLOW_BACKDATING_GL_POSTING_DATE',
                v_backdate_param);
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                raise_error (
                    'Parameter Error...ALLOW_BACKDATING_GL_POSTING_DATE');
        END;

        IF v_backdate_param <> 'Y'
        THEN
            v_post_date := TRUNC (SYSDATE);
        END IF;

        BEGIN
            SELECT    TO_NUMBER (TO_CHAR (SYSDATE, 'RRRR'))
                   || lms_ref3_seq.NEXTVAL
              INTO v_ref3
              FROM DUAL;

            INSERT INTO lms_interface_table (itb_ref3,
                                             itb_date,
                                             itb_transaction_code,
                                             itb_raised_by,
                                             itb_pol_code,
                                             itb_opr_code,
                                             itb_transaction_type,
                                             itb_narrative,
                                             itb_branch_code,
                                             itb_batch_desc,
                                             itb_batch_type,
                                             itb_oppr_code,
                                             itb_ref,
                                             itb_vgl_post_date,
                                             itb_cad_code,
                                             itb_otop_code,
                                             itb_fpmt_code,
                                             itb_ort_code,
                                             itb_ppr_code,
                                             itb_btr_no)
                 VALUES (v_ref3,
                         SYSDATE,
                         v_trans_code,
                         v_raise_by,
                         v_pol_code,
                         v_opr_code,
                         'UPDATE_VCB',
                         v_description,
                         v_branch_code,
                         v_btc_description,
                         v_btc_type,
                         v_oppr_code,
                         v_ref,
                         v_post_date,
                         v_cad_code,
                         v_otop_code,
                         v_fpmt_code,
                         v_ort_code,
                         v_ppr_code,
                         v_btr_no);
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                raise_error ('INS_Update_Vgl..' || SQLERRM (SQLCODE));
        END;

        BEGIN
            UPDATE lms_interface_table
               SET itb_vgl_post_date = v_post_date
             WHERE     itb_transaction_code = v_trans_code
                   AND itb_transaction_type = 'APPEND_CB'
                   AND itb_vgl_post_date IS NULL;
        END;

        IF v_pol_code IS NOT NULL
        THEN
            BEGIN
                SELECT pol_policy_no,
                       TRIM (
                              prp_first_name
                           || ' '
                           || TRIM (prp_other_names || ' ' || prp_surname))
                  INTO v_pol_policy_no, v_client_name
                  FROM lms_policies, lms_proposers
                 WHERE     pol_client_prp_code = prp_code
                       AND pol_code = v_pol_code;
            EXCEPTION
                WHEN OTHERS
                THEN
                    raise_error ('Error Accessing Poliocy Details');
            END;

            v_new_ref := v_client_name;
        END IF;

        BEGIN
              SELECT COUNT ('*'),
                     SUM (DECODE (itb_drcr, 'D', itb_amount)),
                     SUM (DECODE (itb_drcr, 'C', itb_amount))
                INTO v_cnt, v_dr_amount, v_cr_amount
                FROM lms_interface_table
               WHERE     itb_transaction_type IN ('APPEND_CB')
                     AND itb_acc_number2 IS NULL
                     AND itb_transaction_code = v_trans_code
              HAVING SUM (DECODE (itb_drcr, 'D', itb_amount)) <>
                     SUM (DECODE (itb_drcr, 'C', itb_amount))
            GROUP BY itb_transaction_code;
        --new_med.debug_error('API549--'||v_trans_code||'v_dr_amount-'||v_dr_amount||'v_Cr_amount-'||v_cr_amount);
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND
            THEN
                v_cnt := 0;
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                v_cnt := 0;
        END;

        -- COMMIT;
        IF v_cnt > 0
        THEN
            IF v_tcg_rec.COUNT = 0
            THEN
                raise_error ('no voucher records to be  posted.........');
            END IF;

            raise_error (
                   'The transaction under trans code '
                || v_trans_code
                || ' is unbalanced.Contact Administrator v_dr_amount='
                || v_dr_amount
                || ';v_cnt='
                || v_cnt);
        END IF;

        -- raise_error('accc numb '||v_tcg_rec(1).tcg_crt_acc_number);
        BEGIN
            v_vcb_no :=
                fms_interfaces_pkg.update_vcb (v_btc_description, --'RECEIPTS BATCH',
                                               v_btc_type,             --'RV',
                                               v_branch_code,
                                               v_post_date,
                                               v_description,
                                               v_rcpt_no,
                                               v_req_by,
                                               v_cur_code,
                                               v_paymt_mode,
                                               v_cb_rec,
                                               v_tcg_rec,
                                               v_trans_code,    --v_trans code
                                               v_ref3);
            fms_post_pkg.post_cb (v_vcb_no, v_req_by);

            UPDATE lms_interface_table
               SET itb_vgl_no = v_vcb_no, itb_vgl_post_date = v_post_date
             WHERE itb_transaction_code = v_trans_code;

            --  RAISE_ERROR('v_cb_rec '||v_cb_rec.COUNT||' v_tcg_rec '||v_tcg_rec.COUNT);
            UPDATE fms_vougl
               SET vgl_itfc_ref3 = v_ref3, vgl_itfc_trans_code = v_trans_code
             WHERE vgl_no = v_vcb_no;

            BEGIN
                update_ref3 (v_trans_code);
            EXCEPTION
                WHEN OTHERS
                THEN
                    raise_error (
                        'Error Updating Receipt Ref3...' || SQLERRM (SQLCODE));
            END;

            v_tcg_rec.delete;
            v_cb_rec.delete;
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                raise_error ('Update Vcb...' || SQLERRM (SQLCODE));
        END;
    END interface_update_vcb;

    PROCEDURE interface_create_reqn (
        v_trans_code                      NUMBER,
        v_ref                             VARCHAR2,
        v_ref2                            VARCHAR2,
        v_ref_date                        DATE,
        v_narrative                       VARCHAR2,
        v_amount                          NUMBER,
        v_payee                           VARCHAR2,
        v_pay_method                      VARCHAR2,                 --CHQ, EFT
        v_payee_bank_acc_no               VARCHAR2,
        v_payee_bank_branch_code          NUMBER,
        v_source_auth_by                  VARCHAR2,
        v_source_auth_dt                  DATE,
        v_raise_by                        VARCHAR2,
        v_pmt_type                        VARCHAR2,
        v_branch_code                     NUMBER,
        v_pol_code                        NUMBER,
        v_dtls_table               IN OUT fms_cheques_pkg.type_rqn_dtls_table,
        v_fpmt_code                       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
        v_agn_code                        NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
        v_trans_no                        NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
        v_ocl_code                        NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
        v_ben_code                        NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
        v_mpt_code                        NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
        v_clnt_id_pass_no                 VARCHAR2 DEFAULT NULL,
        v_identity_type                   VARCHAR2 DEFAULT NULL,
        v_currency_code                   NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
        v_batch_no                        NUMBER DEFAULT NULL
    )
    IS
        v_ref3               NUMBER;
        v_sys_code           NUMBER;
        v_bank_code          NUMBER;
        v_bank_branch_code   NUMBER;
        v_cur_code           NUMBER;
        v_org_code           NUMBER;
        v_eft_enabled        VARCHAR2 (1);
        v_auth_by            NUMBER;
        v_req_by             NUMBER;
        v_no                 NUMBER := 1;
        v_policy_no          VARCHAR2 (30);
        v_payee_eft_rec      fms_cheques_pkg.type_payee_eft_table;
        v_payee_mft_rec      fms_cheques_pkg.type_payee_mft_table;
        v_cheque_date        DATE;
        v_sl_rqn_dtls        fms_cheques_pkg.type_sl_rqn_dtls_table;
    BEGIN
        v_sys_code := fms_interfaces_pkg.systemcode ('LMS');
        v_org_code := fms_interfaces_pkg.get_org (v_branch_code);
        -- v_cur_code := lms_interfaces_pkg.lms_def_cur (v_branch_code);
        v_cur_code :=
            NVL (v_currency_code,
                 lms_interfaces_pkg.lms_def_cur (v_branch_code));
        fms_interfaces_pkg.trans_bct (v_pmt_type,
                                      v_sys_code,
                                      v_branch_code,
                                      v_cur_code,
                                      v_bank_code,
                                      v_bank_branch_code,
                                      NVL (v_pay_method, 'CHQ'),
                                      v_mpt_code);
        v_auth_by := fms_interfaces_pkg.get_usercode (v_source_auth_by);
        v_req_by := fms_interfaces_pkg.get_usercode (v_raise_by);

        BEGIN
            v_policy_no := lms_interfaces_pkg.get_policy_no (v_pol_code);
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                v_policy_no := NULL;
        END;

        IF NVL (v_pay_method, 'CHQ') = 'EFT'
        THEN
            BEGIN
                v_eft_enabled := 'N';

                IF v_payee_bank_acc_no IS NOT NULL
                THEN
                    v_eft_enabled :=
                        account_enabled (v_payee_bank_branch_code);

                    IF v_eft_enabled = 'N'
                    THEN
                        raise_error (
                               'BANK BRANCH NOT ENABLED TO TRANSACT EFT PYMT...bbr_code='
                            || v_payee_bank_branch_code);
                    END IF;
                ELSE
                    raise_error ('PAYEE BANK A/C UNDEFINED...');
                END IF;
            EXCEPTION
                WHEN OTHERS
                THEN
                    raise_error (
                        'ERROR GETTING BANK ACC INFO...' || SQLERRM (SQLCODE));
            END;
        END IF;

        BEGIN
            SELECT    TO_NUMBER (TO_CHAR (SYSDATE, 'RRRR'))
                   || lms_ref3_seq.NEXTVAL
              INTO v_ref3
              FROM DUAL;

            INSERT INTO lms_interface_table (itb_ref3,
                                             itb_date,
                                             itb_transaction_code,
                                             itb_ref,
                                             itb_ref2,
                                             itb_sys_code,
                                             itb_ref_date,
                                             itb_transaction_type,
                                             itb_narrative,
                                             itb_amount,
                                             itb_payee,
                                             itb_pay_method,
                                             itb_payee_bank_acc_no,
                                             itb_payee_bank_branch_code,
                                             itb_source_auth_by,
                                             itb_source_auth_dt,
                                             itb_raised_by,
                                             itb_pymt_type,
                                             itb_branch_code,
                                             itb_bank_code,
                                             itb_bank_branch_code,
                                             itb_pol_code,
                                             itb_req_by,
                                             itb_acc_org_code,
                                             itb_cur_code,
                                             itb_eft_count,
                                             itb_fpmt_code,
                                             itb_agn_code,
                                             itb_trans_no,
                                             itb_ocl_code,
                                             itb_ben_code)
                 VALUES (v_ref3,
                         SYSDATE,
                         v_trans_code,
                         v_ref,
                         v_ref2,
                         v_sys_code,
                         v_ref_date,
                         NVL (v_pay_method, 'CHQ') || '_REQN',
                         v_narrative,
                         v_amount,
                         TRIM (v_payee),
                         v_pay_method,
                         v_payee_bank_acc_no,
                         v_payee_bank_branch_code,
                         v_auth_by,
                         v_source_auth_dt,
                         NVL (v_raise_by, 1),
                         v_pmt_type,
                         v_branch_code,
                         v_bank_code,
                         v_bank_branch_code,
                         v_pol_code,
                         NVL (v_req_by, 1),
                         v_org_code,
                         v_cur_code,
                         v_no,
                         v_fpmt_code,
                         v_agn_code,
                         v_trans_no,
                         v_ocl_code,
                         v_ben_code);
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                raise_error (
                       'Error creating cheque. Narrative '
                    || v_narrative
                    || '...'
                    || SQLERRM (SQLCODE));
        END;

        IF NVL (v_pay_method, 'CHQ') IN ('EFT', 'MFT')
        THEN
            IF NVL (v_pay_method, 'CHQ') IN ('EFT')
            THEN
                BEGIN
                    v_payee_eft_rec.delete;
                    v_payee_eft_rec (v_no) :=
                        fms_cheques_pkg.append_eft_payees (
                            v_no,
                            v_ref,
                            v_amount,
                            TRIM (v_payee),
                            v_payee_bank_branch_code,
                            v_payee_bank_acc_no,
                            v_ref2,
                            v_policy_no);
                EXCEPTION
                    WHEN OTHERS
                    THEN
                        raise_error (
                               'Error appending EFT payee. Payee '
                            || v_payee
                            || '...'
                            || SQLERRM (SQLCODE));
                END;

                BEGIN
                    fms_interfaces_pkg.create_eftrtgs_reqn (
                        v_sys_code, -- v_cqr_source                         NUMBER,
                        v_ref, --v_cqr_ref                            VARCHAR2,
                        v_ref2, -- v_cqr_ref2                           VARCHAR2,
                        v_ref_date, -- v_cqr_ref_date                       DATE,
                        v_narrative,
                        --v_cqr_narrative                      VARCHAR2,
                        v_branch_code,
                        --v_cqr_brh_code                       NUMBER,
                        v_bank_branch_code,
                        --v_cqr_bct_brh_code                   NUMBER,
                        v_amount, -- v_cqr_amount                         NUMBER,
                        TRIM (v_payee), --v_cqr_payee                          VARCHAR2,
                        v_pay_method,
                        -- v_cqr_pay_method                     VARCHAR2,
                        v_cur_code, -- v_cqr_cur_code                       NUMBER,
                        NULL, --  v_cur_rate                           NUMBER,
                        v_bank_code,
                        -- v_cqr_bct_code                       NUMBER,
                        v_auth_by, -- v_cqr_source_auth_by                 NUMBER,
                        v_source_auth_dt,
                        -- v_cqr_source_auth_dt                 DATE,
                        v_req_by, -- v_cqr_req_by                         NUMBER,
                        v_pmt_type,
                        --  v_cqr_pmt_type                       VARCHAR2,
                        v_payee_bank_branch_code,
                        --  v_payee_bbr_code                     NUMBER ,
                        v_payee_bank_acc_no,
                        -- v_payee_acc_no                       VARCHAR2,
                        v_dtls_table,
                        -- v_dtls_table                IN OUT   fms_cheques_pkg.type_rqn_dtls_table,
                        v_payee_eft_rec,
                        -- v_payee_eft_rec             IN OUT   fms_cheques_pkg.type_payee_eft_table,
                        NULL,
                        --v_cqr_physical_address               VARCHAR2 DEFAULT NULL,
                        NULL,
                        -- v_cqr_postal_address                 VARCHAR2 DEFAULT NULL,
                        v_trans_code,
                        -- v_itfc_trans_code                    NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                        v_ref3,
                        -- v_itfc_ref3                          NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                        NULL,
                        -- v_payee_source_pk                    NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                        NULL,
                        -- v_payee_source_type                  VARCHAR2 DEFAULT NULL,
                        NULL,
                        -- v_auto_auth                          VARCHAR2 DEFAULT 'N',
                        v_ben_code-- v_num_val_1                          NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                  );
                --               fms_cheques_pkg.create_reqn
                --                                    (v_sys_code,              -- v_cqr_source,
                --                                     v_ref,                      -- v_cqr_ref,
                --                                     v_ref2,                    -- v_cqr_ref2,
                --                                     v_ref_date,            -- v_cqr_ref_date,
                --                                     v_narrative,          -- v_cqr_narrative,
                --                                     v_branch_code,         -- v_cqr_brh_code,
                --                                     v_bank_branch_code,
                --                                                        -- v_cqr_bct_brh_code,
                --                                     v_amount,                -- v_cqr_amount,
                --                                     v_payee,                  -- v_cqr_payee,
                --                                     v_pay_method,        -- v_cqr_pay_method,
                --                                     NULL,            -- v_cqr_pay_bnk_acc_no,
                --                                     NULL,       -- v_cqr_pay_bnk_branch_code,
                --                                     v_cur_code,            -- v_cqr_cur_code,
                --                                     v_bank_code,           -- v_cqr_bct_code,
                --                                     v_auth_by,       -- v_cqr_source_auth_by,
                --                                     v_source_auth_dt,
                --                                                      -- v_cqr_source_auth_dt,
                --                                     v_req_by,                -- v_cqr_req_by,
                --                                     v_pmt_type,            -- v_cqr_pmt_type,

    PROCEDURE confirm_med_pymt (
        v_cqr_ref        VARCHAR2,                                 --v_tran_no
        v_cqr_ref2       VARCHAR2,                              --v_facil_code
        v_cheque_no      VARCHAR2,
        v_cheque_date    DATE,
        v_cqr_pmt_type   VARCHAR2
    )
    IS
    BEGIN
        UPDATE lms_pol_med_group_items
           SET pmgit_paid = 'Y',
               pmgit_cheque_no = v_cheque_no,
               pmgit_cheque_date = v_cheque_date
         WHERE     pmgit_tq_spr_code = v_cqr_ref2
               AND pmgit_pay_trans_no = v_cqr_ref
               AND pmgit_paid = 'P';
    EXCEPTION
        WHEN OTHERS
        THEN
            tqc_error_manager.raise_error (
                270102301,
                text_in     => 'UNABLE TO UPDATE THE POLICY MEDICALS.',
                name1_in    => 'Cheque No.',
                value1_in   => v_cheque_no,
                name2_in    => 'Cheque Date',
                value2_in   => TO_CHAR (v_cheque_date, 'DD/MM/RRRR'));
    END confirm_med_pymt;

    PROCEDURE populate_chq_dtls (
        chq_dtls_rec   IN OUT chq_dtls_ref_cur,
        v_brn_code            NUMBER,
        v_tran_no             NUMBER
    )
    IS
    BEGIN
        BEGIN
            OPEN chq_dtls_rec FOR
                SELECT fpmt_amount,
                       'MED_PAYMENT',
                       '6000001',
                       1,
                       3,
                       fpmt_brn_code
                  FROM lms_facilitator_payments
                 WHERE     fpmt_brn_code = v_brn_code
                       AND fpmt_pay_trans_no = v_tran_no;
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                tqc_error_manager.raise_error (
                    270102401,
                    text_in     => 'ERROR POPULATING PAYMENT DETAILS.',
                    name1_in    => 'Branch Code',
                    value1_in   => TO_CHAR (v_brn_code),
                    name2_in    => 'Tran no.',
                    value2_in   => TO_CHAR (v_tran_no));
        END;
    EXCEPTION
        WHEN OTHERS
        THEN
            tqc_error_manager.raise_error (
                270102402,
                text_in     => 'ERROR POPULATING PAYMENT DETAILS.',
                name1_in    => 'Branch Code',
                value1_in   => TO_CHAR (v_brn_code),
                name2_in    => 'Tran no.',
                value2_in   => TO_CHAR (v_tran_no));
    END populate_chq_dtls;

    PROCEDURE post_med_paymt (
        v_tran_no      NUMBER,
        v_facil_name   VARCHAR2,
        v_facil_code   NUMBER,
        v_user         VARCHAR2,
        v_sys_code     NUMBER,
        v_vchr_no      VARCHAR2
    )
    IS
        CURSOR cur_facil_pymt IS
            SELECT fpmt_code,
                   fpmt_spr_code,
                   fpmt_pay_trans_no,
                   fpmt_amount,
                   fpmt_brn_code,
                   fpmt_pymt_type,
                   fpmt_bbr_code,
                   fpmt_bbr_acc_no,
                   fmpt_prod_code
              FROM lms_facilitator_payments
             WHERE     fpmt_pay_trans_no = v_tran_no
                   AND fpmt_code = v_facil_code
                   AND fpmt_brn_code IS NOT NULL;

        v_payee_eft_rec         fms_cheques_pkg.type_payee_eft_table;
        v_trns_rec              fms_cheques_pkg.type_rqn_dtls_table;
        v_eft_enabled           VARCHAR2 (1) := 'N';
        v_crt_acc_no            VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_org_code              NUMBER;
        v_cur_code              NUMBER;
        v_bct_code              NUMBER;
        v_bct_brh_code          NUMBER;
        v_authorized_by         NUMBER;
        v_no                    NUMBER := 0;
        v_prod_code             NUMBER;
        v_trnt_code             VARCHAR2 (10);
        v_trnt_gl_code          VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_trnt_contra_gl_code   VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_gl_trans              fms_vouchers_pkg.tgl_rec_type;
        v_gl_count              NUMBER := -1;
        vgl_code                NUMBER;
        v_trans_code            NUMBER;
        v_param_val             VARCHAR2 (5);
    BEGIN
        v_trns_rec.delete;
        v_no := 0;

        BEGIN
            lms_ord_misc.system_param_val (
                'USE_CONTRAL_ACCOUNT_AT_MEDICAL_PAYMENTS',
                v_param_val);
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                raise_error (
                    'Parameter Error...USE_CONTRAL_ACCOUNT_AT_MEDICAL_PAYMENTS');
        END;

        FOR f IN cur_facil_pymt
        LOOP
            IF f.fmpt_prod_code IS NOT NULL
            THEN
                v_prod_code := f.fmpt_prod_code;
            ELSE
                BEGIN
                    SELECT prod_code
                      INTO v_prod_code
                      FROM lms_products
                     WHERE prod_default = 'Y';
                EXCEPTION
                    WHEN OTHERS
                    THEN
                        NULL;
                END;
            END IF;

            SELECT    TO_NUMBER (TO_CHAR (SYSDATE, 'RRRR'))
                   || lms_transaction_seq.NEXTVAL
              INTO v_trans_code
              FROM DUAL;

            v_org_code := fms_interfaces_pkg.get_org (f.fpmt_brn_code);
            v_no := v_no + 1;
            get_gl_code ('MED',
                         v_prod_code,
                         v_trnt_code,
                         v_crt_acc_no,
                         v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
            valid_acc (v_crt_acc_no,
                       v_org_code,
                       f.fpmt_brn_code,
                       'MED');

            IF v_param_val = 'Y'
            THEN
                valid_acc (v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                           v_org_code,
                           f.fpmt_brn_code,
                           'MED CONTRA');
            END IF;

            BEGIN
                interface_append_chq (
                    v_trans_code,                --v_trans_code        NUMBER,
                    v_user,                    --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                    NULL,                       --v_pol_code           NUMBER,
                    v_prod_code,                --v_prod_code          NUMBER,
                    v_vchr_no,                 --v_vchr_no           VARCHAR2,
                    v_no,                       --v_count              NUMBER,
                    f.fpmt_amount,              --v_amount             NUMBER,
                    v_facil_name || ' - ' || 'PAYMENT FOR MEDICALS',
                    --v_narrative          VARCHAR2,
                    (CASE
                         WHEN v_param_val = 'Y' THEN v_trnt_contra_gl_code
                         ELSE v_crt_acc_no
                     END),                  --v_acc_number           VARCHAR2,
                    v_org_code,                --v_acc_org_code        NUMBER,
                    f.fpmt_brn_code,            --v_branch_code        NUMBER,
                    'D',                      --v_drcr               VARCHAR2,
                    v_trns_rec,
                    --v_trn_rec   IN OUT   Fms_Cheques_Pkg.Type_rqn_dtls_table)
                    f.fpmt_code);      --v_fpmt_code       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL
            EXCEPTION
                WHEN OTHERS
                THEN
                    tqc_error_manager.raise_error (
                        270102501,
                        text_in   => 'Error appending cheque details.');
            END;

            IF v_no <> 0
            THEN
                BEGIN
                    interface_create_reqn (
                        v_trans_code,           --v_trans_code         NUMBER,
                        v_vchr_no,         --v_ref                   VARCHAR2,
                        f.fpmt_code,       --v_ref2                  VARCHAR2,
                        TRUNC (SYSDATE),       --v_ref_date              DATE,
                           v_facil_name
                        || ' - '
                        || 'PAYMENT FOR MEDICALS ('
                        || f.fpmt_pymt_type
                        || ')',
                        --v_narrative             VARCHAR2,
                        NVL (f.fpmt_amount, 0), --v_amount                NUMBER,
                        v_facil_name,      --v_payee                 VARCHAR2,
                        NVL (f.fpmt_pymt_type, 'CHQ'),
                        --v_pay_method            VARCHAR2, --CHQ, EFT
                        f.fpmt_bbr_acc_no, --v_payee_bank_acc_no        VARCHAR2,
                        f.fpmt_bbr_code,  --v_payee_bank_branch_code   NUMBER,
                        v_user,            --v_source_auth_by        VARCHAR2,
                        TRUNC (SYSDATE),       --v_source_auth_dt        DATE,
                        v_user,          --v_raise_by                VARCHAR2,
                        'MED',             --v_pmt_type              VARCHAR2,
                        f.fpmt_brn_code,      --v_branch_code          NUMBER,
                        NULL,                                    --v_pol_code,
                        v_trns_rec,
                        --v_dtls_table  IN OUT  Fms_Cheques_Pkg.Type_rqn_dtls_table)
                        f.fpmt_code);
                --v_dtls_table  IN OUT    Fms_Cheques_Pkg.Type_rqn_dtls_table)
                EXCEPTION
                    WHEN OTHERS
                    THEN
                        tqc_error_manager.raise_error (
                            270102502,
                            text_in   =>
                                'Error creating Medicl cheque details.');
                END;

                IF NVL (v_param_val, 'N') = 'Y'
                THEN
                    BEGIN
                        v_gl_count := v_gl_count + 2;
                        interface_append_gl (
                            v_trans_code,        --v_trans_code        NUMBER,
                            v_user,            --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                            NULL,                --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                            v_prod_code,         --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                            v_vchr_no,         --v_vchr_no           VARCHAR2,
                            NULL,                --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                            NULL,                --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                            NULL,               --v_rcpt_no          VARCHAR2,
                            v_gl_count,          --v_count             NUMBER,
                               v_facil_name
                            || ' - '
                            || 'PAYMENT FOR MEDICALS: '
                            || v_vchr_no,
                            --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                            NVL (f.fpmt_amount, 0), --v_amount            NUMBER,
                            'D',               --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                            v_crt_acc_no,    --v_acc_number1         VARCHAR2,
                            v_trnt_contra_gl_code, --v_acc_number2         VARCHAR2,
                            f.fpmt_brn_code,     --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                            v_gl_trans,
                            --v_trn_rec   IN OUT  fms_test.Fms_Vouchers_Pkg.Tgl_rec_type,
                            NULL,      --v_cad_code       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                            NULL,     --v_otop_code       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                            f.fpmt_code); --v_fpmt_code       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL)
                        interface_update_vgl (
                            v_trans_code,           --v_trans_code     NUMBER,
                            v_user,            --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                            NULL,                --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                            TRUNC (SYSDATE),            --v_date         DATE,
                            NULL,                --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                            NULL,                --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                            'LMS MEDICALS',
                            --v_btc_description   VARCHAR2,
                            'JV',             --v_btc_type           VARCHAR2,
                            f.fpmt_brn_code,
                               --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                               v_facil_name
                            || ' - '
                            || 'PAYMENT FOR MEDICALS: '
                            || v_vchr_no,
                            --v_description       VARCHAR2,
                            v_vchr_no,
                            --v_ref_no            VARCHAR2,
                            v_gl_trans,
                            --v_gl_trans  IN OUT  fms_test.Fms_Vouchers_Pkg.Tgl_rec_type,
                            NULL,
                            --v_cad_code       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                            NULL,
                            --v_otop_code       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                            f.fpmt_code);
                    --v_fpmt_code       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL)
                    EXCEPTION
                        WHEN OTHERS
                        THEN
                            tqc_error_manager.raise_error (
                                270102503,
                                text_in   => 'Error populating GL details.');
                    END;
                END IF;

                UPDATE lms_facilitator_payments
                   SET fpmt_authorised = 'Y',
                       fpmt_authorised_by = v_user,
                       fpmt_authorised_date = TRUNC (SYSDATE),
                       fpmt_pymt_vchr_no = v_vchr_no
                 WHERE fpmt_code = v_facil_code AND fpmt_authorised != 'Y';

                UPDATE lms_pol_med_group_items
                   SET pmgit_paid = 'P'
                 WHERE pmgit_fpmt_code = v_facil_code AND pmgit_paid = 'R';
            END IF;
        END LOOP;
    --   EXCEPTION
    --      WHEN OTHERS
    --      THEN
    --         tqc_error_manager.raise_error
    --                                 (270102504,
    --                                  text_in      => 'Error posting medical payment.'
    --                                 );
    END post_med_paymt;

    PROCEDURE acc_policies_qry (
        resultset    IN OUT acc_policies_ref,
        v_acc_type   IN     NUMBER,
        v_acc_code   IN     NUMBER
    )
    IS
    BEGIN
        IF v_acc_type = 'CK'
        THEN
            OPEN resultset FOR
                SELECT pol_code,
                       pol_policy_no,
                       TRIM (
                              prp_first_name
                           || ' '
                           || TRIM (prp_other_names || ' ' || prp_surname)),
                       pol_instlmt_prem,
                       pol_os_instlmt_no * NVL (pol_instlmt_prem, 0),
                       pol_tot_loan_os_amt,
                       (  NVL (pol_os_instlmt_no * NVL (pol_instlmt_prem, 0),
                               0)
                        + NVL (pol_instlmt_loan_amt, 0))
                  FROM lms_policies, lms_proposers
                 WHERE     pol_client_prp_code = prp_code
                       AND pol_code IN
                               (SELECT endr_pol_code
                                  FROM lms_policy_endorsements
                                 WHERE endr_checkoff_agen_code = v_acc_code);
        ELSIF v_acc_type = 'D'
        THEN
            OPEN resultset FOR
                SELECT pol_code,
                       pol_policy_no,
                       TRIM (
                              prp_first_name
                           || ' '
                           || TRIM (prp_other_names || ' ' || prp_surname)),
                       pol_instlmt_prem,
                       pol_os_instlmt_no * NVL (pol_instlmt_prem, 0),
                       pol_tot_loan_os_amt,
                       (  NVL (pol_os_instlmt_no * NVL (pol_instlmt_prem, 0),
                               0)
                        + NVL (pol_instlmt_loan_amt, 0))
                  FROM lms_policies, lms_proposers
                 WHERE     pol_client_prp_code = prp_code
                       AND pol_client_prp_code = v_acc_code;
        ELSE
            raise_error ('ACCOUNT TYPE NOT DEFINED..');
        END IF;
    END acc_policies_qry;

    PROCEDURE append_rct_rec (
        v_no                        NUMBER,
        pol_code                    NUMBER,
        pol_policy_no               VARCHAR2,
        pol_prem_amt                NUMBER,
        pol_loan_amt                NUMBER,
        pol_pension_amt             NUMBER,
        misc_amt                    NUMBER,
        pol_type                    VARCHAR2,
        pol_narrative               VARCHAR2,
        v_recpt_rec          IN OUT type_recpt_table,
        v_ddd_code                  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
        v_rad_code                  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
        rad_deduction_date          DATE DEFAULT NULL
    )
    IS
    BEGIN
        v_recpt_rec (v_no).pol_code := pol_code;
        v_recpt_rec (v_no).pol_policy_no := pol_policy_no;
        v_recpt_rec (v_no).pol_prem_amt := pol_prem_amt;
        v_recpt_rec (v_no).pol_loan_amt := pol_loan_amt;
        v_recpt_rec (v_no).pol_pension_amt := pol_pension_amt;
        v_recpt_rec (v_no).misc_amt := misc_amt;
        v_recpt_rec (v_no).pol_type := pol_type;
        v_recpt_rec (v_no).pol_narrative := pol_narrative;
        v_recpt_rec (v_no).ddd_code := v_ddd_code;
        v_recpt_rec (v_no).rad_code := v_rad_code;
        v_recpt_rec (v_no).rad_deduction_date := rad_deduction_date;
    EXCEPTION
        WHEN OTHERS
        THEN
            raise_error ('APPENDING LMS RCT REC.');
    END append_rct_rec;

    PROCEDURE post_update_recpt_pymt (
        v_rct_code                VARCHAR2,

        v_oppr_rct_trans_code     VARCHAR2,
        v_nfl_alloc               NUMBER,
        v_rct_branch              NUMBER,
        v_acc_type                VARCHAR2,
        v_amt                     NUMBER,
        v_description             VARCHAR2,
        v_date                    DATE,
        v_raised_by               NUMBER,
        v_currency_code           NUMBER,
        v_opr_code                NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
        v_prm_amt                 NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
        v_chk_com                 NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
        v_ln_amt                  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
        v_pn_amt                  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
        v_adm_inv                 NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
        v_fee_inv                 NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
        v_contri_inv              NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
        v_compfund                NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
        v_receipt_pk              NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
        v_fms_unknown_reposting   VARCHAR2 DEFAULT NULL,
        v_oppr_code               NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
        v_reverse_alloc           VARCHAR2 DEFAULT 'N',
        v_prem_waiver             VARCHAR2 DEFAULT 'N',
        v_trans_no                NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
        v_clm_vouch_alloc         VARCHAR2 DEFAULT 'N',
        v_clm_caus_type           VARCHAR2 DEFAULT 'DTH',
        v_rcpt_source             VARCHAR2 DEFAULT NULL,
        v_process                 VARCHAR2 DEFAULT NULL,
        v_trans_type              VARCHAR2 DEFAULT NULL,
        v_prod_code_from          VARCHAR2 DEFAULT NULL,
        v_taxes_tab               lms_process_receipts.recpt_taxes_table DEFAULT taxes_tab_def
    )
    IS
        v_count                     NUMBER;
        v_gl_trans                  fms_vouchers_pkg.tgl_rec_type;
        v_vgl_no                    NUMBER;
        v_trnt_code                 VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_trnt_gl_code              VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_unp_trnt_gl_code          VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_trnt_contra_gl_code       VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_contra_acc                VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_msg                       VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_org_code                  NUMBER;
        v_user_name                 VARCHAR2 (30);
        v_unknown_amt               NUMBER := 0;
        --      v_double_sure_amt           NUMBER                        := 0;
        v_prod_code                 NUMBER;
        v_unprocessed_rcpts         NUMBER;
        v_unprocessed_rcpts_total   NUMBER;
        v_comp_param                VARCHAR2 (5);
        v_alloc_to                  VARCHAR2 (2);
        v_opr_receipt_trans_code    VARCHAR2 (50);
        v_oppr_receipt_trans_code   VARCHAR2 (50);
        v_origin                    VARCHAR2 (5);
        v_rcpt_bal                  NUMBER;
        v_opr_drcr                  VARCHAR2 (5) := 'C';
        v_cur_code                  NUMBER;
        v_prem_amt                  NUMBER;
        v_chkoff_comm               NUMBER;
        v_loan_amt                  NUMBER;
        v_loan_principal_amt        NUMBER;
        v_loan_intr_amt             NUMBER;
        v_pens_amt                  NUMBER;
        v_inv_admin                 NUMBER;
        v_inv_fee                   NUMBER;
        v_inv_contri                NUMBER;
        v_comfnd                    NUMBER;
        v_oppr_drcr                 VARCHAR2 (5) := 'C';
        v_oppr_chk_drcr             VARCHAR2 (5) := 'D';
        v_trans_code                NUMBER;
        v_ppr_code_to               NUMBER;
        v_ppr_code_from             NUMBER;
        v_user                      VARCHAR2 (30)
            := pkg_global_vars.get_pvarchar2 ('PKG_GLOBAL_VARS.PVG_USERNAME');
        v_separate_posting          VARCHAR2 (5);
        v_ltr_btr_trans_code        lms_transactions.ltr_btr_trans_code%TYPE;
        v_source                    lms_ord_prem_receipts.opr_source%TYPE;
        v_post_cnt                  NUMBER;
        v_post                      VARCHAR2 (5);
        v_param_val                 VARCHAR2 (5);
        v_fms_receipt_pk            NUMBER;
        v_bct_code                  NUMBER;
        v_sbu_code                  NUMBER := NULL;
        v_spoke_code                NUMBER := NULL;
        v_cvrg_area                 NUMBER := NULL;
        v_location_code             NUMBER := NULL;
        v_vcb_no                    NUMBER;
        v_tot_amt                   NUMBER;
        v_pol_code                  NUMBER;
        v_branch_code               NUMBER;
        v_post_cb                   VARCHAR2 (5) := 'N';
        v_tcg_rec                   fms_vouchers_pkg.tcg_rec_type;
        v_cb_count                  NUMBER := 1;
        v_cb_rec                    fms_vouchers_pkg.tcb_rec_type;
        v_btc_type                  VARCHAR2 (5);
        v_opr_code1                 NUMBER;
        v_count1                    NUMBER := 0;
        v_rct_paymt_mode            fms_receipts.rct_paymt_mode%TYPE;
        v_trnt_type                 VARCHAR2 (10);
        v_tot_lc_prem               NUMBER;
        v_post_fees_sep             VARCHAR (1);
        v_prem_comm                 NUMBER;
        v_dir_count                 NUMBER := 0;
        v_idx                       NUMBER;
        v_direct_comm_param         VARCHAR2 (1);
        v_alloc_to_ref              VARCHAR2 (1);
        v_pol_status                VARCHAR2 (5);
        v_drcr                      VARCHAR2 (1);
        v_loan_param                VARCHAR2 (10);
        v_loan_unp_amt              NUMBER := 0;
        v_loan_narration            VARCHAR2 (30);

        CURSOR cur_pol_cb_amt IS
              SELECT SUM (NVL (opr_loan_pymt_amt, 0))
                         loan_amt,
                     SUM (NVL (opr_loan_principal_amt, 0))
                         loan_principal_amt,
                     SUM (NVL (opr_loan_interest_amt, 0))
                         loan_intr_amt,
                     SUM (NVL (opr_unprocessed_loan_amt, 0))
                         loan_unp_amt,
                     NVL (SUM (opr_refund_amt), 0)
                         suspense_amt,
                     -- OPR_PMTH_CODE,
                     NVL (SUM (premium_amt), 0)
                         premium_amt,
                     NVL (SUM (pension_contr), 0)
                         pension_contr,
                     DECODE (prod_type,
                             'IN', NVL (SUM (investment_fee), 0),
                             'PN', NVL (SUM (investment_fee), 0),
                             'AN', NVL (SUM (investment_fee), 0),
                             NVL (SUM (opr_policy_fee), 0))
                         investment_fee,
                     NVL (SUM (investment_contri), 0)
                         investment_contri,
                     NVL (SUM (investment_admin), 0)
                         investment_admin,
                     NVL (SUM (opr_fund_client_contr), 0)
                         comfnd,
                     NVL (SUM (prem_comm), 0)
                         prem_comm,
                     NVL (SUM (pens_comm), 0)
                         pens_comm,
                     NVL (SUM (prem_tax), 0)
                         prem_tax,
                     --NVL(SUM(OPR_CHK_COMM),0) chkoff_comm,
                     0
                         chkoff_comm,
                     pol_bra_code,
                     pol_prod_code,
                     pol_type,
                     pol_prod_type,
                     NVL (opr_alloc_to, 'PR')
                         alloc_to,
                     NVL (inv_all_prem_valid (pol_code), 'N')
                         inv_all_prem,
                     DECODE (NVL (endr_pay_method, 'C'),
                             'K', 'CK',
                             NVL (endr_pay_method, 'C'))
                         acc_type,
                     opr_code,
                     pol_policy_no,
                     pol_proposal_no,
                     pol_code,
                     prod_calc_inv_from_sa,
                     'N'
                         renewal,
                     opr_fms_receipt_pk,
                     endr_agen_code,
                     endr_inv_rider,
                     opr_lna_no
                FROM lms_ord_prem_receipts,
                     lms_policies,
                     lms_policy_endorsements,
                     lms_products,
                     (  SELECT opri_opr_code,
                               NVL (SUM (opri_amt), 0)              premium_amt,
                               NVL (SUM (opri_prem_tax_amt), 0)     prem_tax,
                               NVL (SUM (opri_chk_comm_amt), 0)     chkoff_comm,
                               NVL (SUM (opri_comm_amt), 0)         prem_comm
                          FROM lms_ord_receipt_instlmnts, lms_ord_prem_receipts
                         WHERE     NVL (inv_all_prem_valid (opri_pol_code), 'N') =
                                   'N'
                               AND opri_opr_code = opr_code
                               AND NVL (opr_receipt_trans_code, 'XX') =
                                   NVL (v_opr_rct_trans_code,
                                        NVL (opr_receipt_trans_code, 'XX'))
                               AND opr_receipt_no = v_rct_code
                               AND opr_code = NVL (v_opr_code, opr_code)
                      --AND OPR_RECEIPT_TRANS_CODE = NVL(v_opr_rct_trans_code,OPR_RECEIPT_TRANS_CODE)
                      GROUP BY opri_opr_code
                      UNION
                        SELECT opri_opr_code,
                               SUM (
                                     NVL (opri_amt, 0)
                                   - lms_investments.basic_prem_ratio (
                                         opri_pol_code,
                                         NVL (opri_amt, 0)))       premium_amt,
                               SUM (NVL (opri_prem_tax_amt, 0))    prem_tax,
                               --   -Lms_Investments.Basic_prem_ratio(OPRI_POL_CODE,NVL(OPRI_PREM_TAX_AMT,0)) prem_tax,
                               SUM (NVL (opri_chk_comm_amt, 0))    chkoff_comm,
                               --  -Lms_Investments.Basic_prem_ratio(OPRI_POL_CODE,NVL(OPRI_CHK_COMM_AMT,0))
                               SUM (NVL (opri_comm_amt, 0))        prem_comm
                          --   -Lms_Investments.Basic_prem_ratio(OPRI_POL_CODE,NVL(OPRI_COMM_AMT,0)) prem_comm
                          FROM lms_ord_receipt_instlmnts, lms_ord_prem_receipts
                         WHERE     NVL (inv_all_prem_valid (opri_pol_code), 'N') =
                                   'Y'
                               AND NVL (inv_basic_prem_valid, 'N') = 'Y'
                               AND opri_opr_code = opr_code
                               AND NVL (opr_receipt_trans_code, 'XX') =
                                   NVL (v_opr_rct_trans_code,
                                        NVL (opr_receipt_trans_code, 'XX'))
                               AND opr_receipt_no = v_rct_code
                               AND opr_code = NVL (v_opr_code, opr_code)
                      --AND OPR_RECEIPT_TRANS_CODE = NVL(v_opr_rct_trans_code, OPR_RECEIPT_TRANS_CODE)
                      GROUP BY opri_opr_code),
                     (  SELECT pndpo_opr_code,
                               NVL (SUM (pndpo_tot_amt), 0)
                                   pension_contr,
                               NVL (SUM (pndpo_admin_fee), 0)
                                   investment_fee,
                               NVL (SUM (pndpo_empye_amt), 0)
                                   investment_contri,
                               NVL (SUM (pndpo_empyr_amt), 0)
                                   investment_admin,
                               NVL (SUM (pndpo_comm_amt), 0)
                                   pens_comm
                          FROM lms_pension_deposits_ord, lms_ord_prem_receipts
                         WHERE     pndpo_opr_code = opr_code
                               AND NVL (opr_receipt_trans_code, 'XX') =
                                   NVL (v_opr_rct_trans_code,
                                        NVL (opr_receipt_trans_code, 'XX'))
                               AND opr_receipt_no = v_rct_code
                               AND opr_code = NVL (v_opr_code, opr_code)
                      --AND OPR_RECEIPT_TRANS_CODE = NVL(v_opr_rct_trans_code,OPR_RECEIPT_TRANS_CODE)
                      GROUP BY pndpo_opr_code)
               WHERE     pol_code = opr_pol_code
                     AND pol_current_endr_code = endr_code
                     AND opr_receipt_no = v_rct_code
                     AND opr_code = NVL (v_opr_code, opr_code)
                     AND opri_opr_code(+) = opr_code
                     AND pndpo_opr_code(+) = opr_code
                     AND NVL (v_separate_posting, 'N') = 'N'
                     AND pol_prod_code = prod_code
                     AND NVL (opr_receipt_trans_code, 'XX') =
                         NVL (v_opr_rct_trans_code,
                              NVL (opr_receipt_trans_code, 'XX'))
                     --AND OPR_RECEIPT_TRANS_CODE = NVL(v_opr_rct_trans_code,OPR_RECEIPT_TRANS_CODE)
                     AND v_oppr_code IS NULL
            GROUP BY opr_code,
                     pol_bra_code,
                     pol_prod_code,
                     pol_type,
                     pol_prod_type,
                     opr_alloc_to,
                     endr_pay_method,
                     NVL (inv_all_prem_valid (pol_code), 'N'),
                     DECODE (NVL (endr_pay_method, 'C'),
                             'K', 'CK',
                             NVL (endr_pay_method, 'C')),
                     pol_policy_no,
                     pol_code,
                     prod_calc_inv_from_sa,
                     prod_type,
                     opr_fms_receipt_pk,
                     pol_proposal_no,
                     endr_agen_code,
                     endr_inv_rider,
                     opr_lna_no
            UNION ALL
              SELECT SUM (NVL (opr_loan_pymt_amt, 0))
                         loan_amt,
                     SUM (NVL (opr_loan_principal_amt, 0))
                         loan_principal_amt,
                     SUM (NVL (opr_loan_interest_amt, 0))
                         loan_intr_amt,
                     SUM (NVL (opr_unprocessed_loan_amt, 0))
                         loan_unp_amt,
                     NVL (SUM (opr_refund_amt), 0)
                         suspense_amt,
                     -- OPR_PMTH_CODE,
                     NVL (SUM (premium_amt), 0)
                         premium_amt,
                     NVL (SUM (pension_contr), 0)
                         pension_contr,
                     DECODE (prod_type,
                             'IN', NVL (SUM (investment_fee), 0),
                             'PN', NVL (SUM (investment_fee), 0),
                             'AN', NVL (SUM (investment_fee), 0),
                             NVL (SUM (opr_policy_fee), 0))
                         investment_fee,
                     NVL (SUM (investment_contri), 0)
                         investment_contri,
                     NVL (SUM (investment_admin), 0)
                         investment_admin,
                     NVL (SUM (opr_fund_client_contr), 0)
                         comfnd,
                     NVL (SUM (prem_comm), 0)
                         prem_comm,
                     NVL (SUM (pens_comm), 0)
                         pens_comm,
                     NVL (SUM (prem_tax), 0)
                         prem_tax,
                     --NVL(SUM(OPR_CHK_COMM),0) chkoff_comm,
                     0
                         chkoff_comm,
                     pol_bra_code,
                     pol_prod_code,
                     pol_type,
                     pol_prod_type,
                     NVL (opr_alloc_to, 'PR')
                         alloc_to,
                     NVL (inv_all_prem_valid (pol_code), 'N')
                         inv_all_prem,
                     DECODE (NVL (endr_pay_method, 'C'),
                             'K', 'CK',
                             NVL (endr_pay_method, 'C'))
                         acc_type,
                     opr_code,
                     pol_policy_no,
                     pol_proposal_no,
                     pol_code,
                     prod_calc_inv_from_sa,
                     NVL (renewal, pensrenewal)
                         renewal,
                     opr_fms_receipt_pk,
                     endr_agen_code,
                     endr_inv_rider,
                     opr_lna_no
                FROM lms_ord_prem_receipts,
                     lms_policies,
                     lms_policy_endorsements,
                     lms_products,
                     (  SELECT opri_opr_code,
                               NVL (SUM (opri_amt), 0)                        premium_amt,
                               NVL (SUM (opri_prem_tax_amt), 0)               prem_tax,
                               NVL (SUM (opri_chk_comm_amt), 0)               chkoff_comm,
                               NVL (SUM (opri_comm_amt), 0)                   prem_comm,
                               lms_ord_mis.check_renewal (opri_pol_code,
                                                          opri_instlmt_no)    renewal
                          FROM lms_ord_receipt_instlmnts, lms_ord_prem_receipts
                         WHERE     NVL (inv_all_prem_valid (opri_pol_code), 'N') =
                                   'N'
                               AND opri_opr_code = opr_code
                               AND opr_receipt_no = v_rct_code
                               AND opr_code = NVL (v_opr_code, opr_code)
                               AND NVL (opr_receipt_trans_code, 'XX') =
                                   NVL (v_opr_rct_trans_code,
                                        NVL (opr_receipt_trans_code, 'XX'))
                      --AND OPR_RECEIPT_TRANS_CODE = NVL(v_opr_rct_trans_code,OPR_RECEIPT_TRANS_CODE)
                      GROUP BY opri_opr_code,
                               lms_ord_mis.check_renewal (opri_pol_code,
                                                          opri_instlmt_no)
                      UNION
                        SELECT opri_opr_code,
                               SUM (
                                     NVL (opri_amt, 0)
                                   - lms_investments.basic_prem_ratio (
                                         opri_pol_code,
                                         NVL (opri_amt, 0)))                  premium_amt,
                               SUM (NVL (opri_prem_tax_amt, 0))               prem_tax,
                               --   -Lms_Investments.Basic_prem_ratio(OPRI_POL_CODE,NVL(OPRI_PREM_TAX_AMT,0)) prem_tax,
                               SUM (NVL (opri_chk_comm_amt, 0))               chkoff_comm,
                               --  -Lms_Investments.Basic_prem_ratio(OPRI_POL_CODE,NVL(OPRI_CHK_COMM_AMT,0))
                               SUM (NVL (opri_comm_amt, 0))                   prem_comm --   -Lms_Investments.Basic_prem_ratio(OPRI_POL_CODE,NVL(OPRI_COMM_AMT,0)) prem_comm
                                                                                       ,
                               lms_ord_mis.check_renewal (opri_pol_code,
                                                          opri_instlmt_no)    renewal
                          FROM lms_ord_receipt_instlmnts, lms_ord_prem_receipts
                         WHERE     NVL (inv_all_prem_valid (opri_pol_code), 'N') =
                                   'Y'
                               AND NVL (inv_basic_prem_valid, 'N') = 'Y'
                               AND opri_opr_code = opr_code
                               AND opr_receipt_no = v_rct_code
                               AND opr_code = NVL (v_opr_code, opr_code)
                               AND NVL (opr_receipt_trans_code, 'XX') =
                                   NVL (v_opr_rct_trans_code,
                                        NVL (opr_receipt_trans_code, 'XX'))
                      --AND OPR_RECEIPT_TRANS_CODE = NVL(v_opr_rct_trans_code, OPR_RECEIPT_TRANS_CODE)
                      GROUP BY opri_opr_code,
                               lms_ord_mis.check_renewal (opri_pol_code,
                                                          opri_instlmt_no)),
                     (  SELECT pndpo_opr_code,
                               NVL (SUM (pndpo_tot_amt), 0)
                                   pension_contr,
                               NVL (SUM (pndpo_admin_fee), 0)
                                   investment_fee,
                               NVL (SUM (pndpo_empye_amt), 0)
                                   investment_contri,
                               NVL (SUM (pndpo_empyr_amt), 0)
                                   investment_admin,
                               NVL (SUM (pndpo_comm_amt), 0)
                                   pens_comm,
                               lms_ord_mis.check_renewal (pndpo_pol_code,
                                                          pndpo_instlmnt_no)
                                   pensrenewal
                          FROM lms_pension_deposits_ord, lms_ord_prem_receipts
                         WHERE     pndpo_opr_code = opr_code
                               AND opr_receipt_no = v_rct_code
                               AND opr_code = NVL (v_opr_code, opr_code)
                               AND NVL (opr_receipt_trans_code, 'XX') =
                                   NVL (v_opr_rct_trans_code,
                                        NVL (opr_receipt_trans_code, 'XX'))
                      --AND OPR_RECEIPT_TRANS_CODE = NVL(v_opr_rct_trans_code,OPR_RECEIPT_TRANS_CODE)
                      GROUP BY pndpo_opr_code,
                               lms_ord_mis.check_renewal (pndpo_pol_code,
                                                          pndpo_instlmnt_no))
               WHERE     pol_code = opr_pol_code
                     AND pol_current_endr_code = endr_code
                     AND opr_receipt_no = v_rct_code
                     AND opr_code = NVL (v_opr_code, opr_code)
                     AND opri_opr_code(+) = opr_code
                     AND pndpo_opr_code(+) = opr_code
                     AND NVL (v_separate_posting, 'N') = 'Y'
                     AND pol_prod_code = prod_code
                     AND NVL (opr_receipt_trans_code, 'XX') =
                         NVL (v_opr_rct_trans_code,
                              NVL (opr_receipt_trans_code, 'XX'))
                     AND NVL (renewal, NVL (pensrenewal, 0)) =
                         NVL (pensrenewal, NVL (renewal, 0))
                     --AND OPR_RECEIPT_TRANS_CODE = NVL(v_opr_rct_trans_code,OPR_RECEIPT_TRANS_CODE)
                     AND v_oppr_code IS NULL
            GROUP BY opr_code,
                     pol_bra_code,
                     pol_prod_code,
                     pol_type,
                     pol_prod_type,
                     opr_alloc_to,
                     endr_pay_method,
                     NVL (inv_all_prem_valid (pol_code), 'N'),
                     DECODE (NVL (endr_pay_method, 'C'),
                             'K', 'CK',
                             NVL (endr_pay_method, 'C')),
                     pol_policy_no,
                     pol_code,
                     prod_calc_inv_from_sa,
                     prod_type,
                     NVL (renewal, pensrenewal),
                     opr_fms_receipt_pk,
                     pol_proposal_no,
                     endr_agen_code,
                     endr_inv_rider,
                     opr_lna_no;

        CURSOR cur_prop_cb_amt IS
              SELECT NVL (SUM (oppr_amt), 0)              paid_amt,
                     NVL (SUM (opri_chk_comm_amt), 0)     prop_chk_amt,
                     pol_bra_code,
                     pol_prod_code,
                     oppr_code,
                     pol_proposal_no,
                     NULL                                 ppr_code,
                     oppr_fms_receipt_pk,
                     pol_code,
                     oppr_source
                FROM lms_ord_proposal_rcpts, lms_policies
               WHERE     pol_code = oppr_pol_code
                     AND oppr_pol_proposal_no = pol_proposal_no
                     AND (   oppr_receipt_no = v_rct_code
                          OR oppr_cheque_no = v_rct_code)
                     AND NVL (oppr_receipt_trans_code, 'XX') =
                         NVL (v_oppr_rct_trans_code, 'XX')
                     AND v_opr_code IS NULL
                     AND oppr_code = NVL (v_oppr_code, oppr_code)
            GROUP BY pol_bra_code,
                     pol_prod_code,
                     oppr_code,
                     pol_proposal_no,
                     pol_code,
                     oppr_fms_receipt_pk,
                     pol_code,
                     oppr_source
            UNION ALL
              SELECT NVL (SUM (oppr_amt), 0)              paid_amt,
                     NVL (SUM (opri_chk_comm_amt), 0)     prop_chk_amt,
                     ppr_brn_code,
                     ppr_prod_code,
                     oppr_code,
                     ppr_proposal_no,
                     ppr_code,
                     oppr_fms_receipt_pk,
                     oppr_pol_code,
                     oppr_source
                FROM lms_ord_proposal_rcpts, lms_pol_proposals
               WHERE     oppr_pol_proposal_no = ppr_proposal_no
                     AND oppr_pol_code IS NULL
                     AND (   oppr_receipt_no = v_rct_code
                          OR oppr_cheque_no = v_rct_code)
                     AND NVL (oppr_receipt_trans_code, 'XX') =
                         NVL (v_oppr_rct_trans_code, 'XX')
                     AND v_opr_code IS NULL
                     AND oppr_code = NVL (v_oppr_code, oppr_code)
            GROUP BY ppr_prod_code,
                     ppr_brn_code,
                     oppr_code,
                     ppr_proposal_no,
                     ppr_code,
                     oppr_fms_receipt_pk,
                     oppr_pol_code,
                     oppr_source
            UNION ALL
              SELECT NVL (SUM (oppr_amt), 0)              paid_amt,
                     NVL (SUM (opri_chk_comm_amt), 0)     prop_chk_amt,
                     ann_brn_code,
                     ann_prod_code,
                     oppr_code,
                     ann_annuity_no,
                     NULL,
                     oppr_fms_receipt_pk,
                     oppr_pol_code,
                     oppr_source
                FROM lms_ord_proposal_rcpts, lms_annuities
               WHERE     oppr_pol_proposal_no = ann_annuity_no
                     AND oppr_ann_code = ann_code
                     AND oppr_pol_code IS NULL
                     AND (   oppr_receipt_no = v_rct_code
                          OR oppr_cheque_no = v_rct_code)
                     AND NVL (oppr_receipt_trans_code, 'XX') =
                         NVL (v_oppr_rct_trans_code, 'XX')
                     AND v_opr_code IS NULL
                     AND oppr_code = NVL (v_oppr_code, oppr_code)
            GROUP BY ann_prod_code,
                     ann_brn_code,
                     oppr_code,
                     ann_annuity_no,
                     ann_code,
                     oppr_fms_receipt_pk,
                     oppr_pol_code,
                     oppr_source;

        CURSOR tax_types (v_opr_code NUMBER)
        IS
              SELECT orts_opr_code,
                     orts_add_to_receipts,
                     SUM (orts_amount)                       orts_amount,
                     NVL (ptt_acc_no, tt_acc_no)             acc_no,
                     NVL (ptt_contra_acc, tt_contra_acc)     contra_acc_no,
                     tt_code,
                     trt_code,
                     tt_desc
                FROM lms_ord_receipt_taxes,
                     lms_tax_rates,
                     lms_tax_types,
                     lms_prod_tax_types
               WHERE     orts_trt_code = trt_code
                     AND trt_tt_code = tt_code
                     AND ptt_tt_code = tt_code
                     AND ptt_prod_code = trt_prod_code
                     AND orts_opr_code = v_opr_code
                     AND tt_applicable_at_prod = 'Y'
                     AND (    tt_application_level = 'RP'
                          AND tt_type NOT IN ('FE', 'CL')
                          AND trt_applied_to = 'CL')
                     AND orts_posted = 'N'
            GROUP BY orts_opr_code,
                     orts_add_to_receipts,
                     NVL (ptt_acc_no, tt_acc_no),
                     NVL (ptt_contra_acc, tt_contra_acc),
                     tt_code,
                     trt_code,
                     tt_desc
            UNION
              SELECT orts_opr_code,
                     orts_add_to_receipts,
                     SUM (orts_amount)     orts_amount,
                     tt_acc_no             acc_no,
                     tt_contra_acc         contra_acc_no,
                     tt_code,
                     trt_code,
                     tt_desc
                FROM lms_ord_receipt_taxes, lms_tax_rates, lms_tax_types
               WHERE     orts_trt_code = trt_code
                     AND trt_tt_code = tt_code
                     AND orts_opr_code = v_opr_code
                     AND tt_applicable_at_prod = 'N'
                     AND (    tt_application_level = 'RP'
                          AND tt_type NOT IN ('FE', 'CL')
                          AND trt_applied_to = 'CL')
                     AND orts_posted = 'N'
            GROUP BY orts_opr_code,
                     orts_add_to_receipts,
                     tt_acc_no,
                     tt_contra_acc,
                     tt_code,
                     trt_code,
                     tt_desc;
    --CURSOR Prod IS SELECT PROD_CODE FROM LMS_PRODUCTS;
    BEGIN
        --        RAISE_ERROR (
        --               'v_opr_code=='
        --            || v_opr_code
        --            || 'v_rct_code='
        --            || v_rct_code
        --            || 'v_oppr_rct_trans_code='
        --            || v_oppr_rct_trans_code);

        BEGIN
            lms_ord_misc.system_param_val (
                'ALLOW_FIRSTYR_RENEWAL_SEPARATION',
                v_separate_posting);
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                raise_error (
                    'PARAMETER ERROR...ALLOW_FIRSTYR_RENEWAL_SEPARATION...');
        END;

        BEGIN
            lms_ord_misc.system_param_val ('USE_SINGLE_LOAN_ACCOUNT',
                                           v_loan_param);
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                raise_error ('PARAMETER ERROR...USE_SINGLE_LOAN_ACCOUNT...');
