        END;

        BEGIN
            fms_settings_pkg.system_param_val ('USE_CONTROL_ACCOUNT',
                                               v_param_val);
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                v_param_val := 'Y';
        END;

        BEGIN
            lms_ord_misc.system_param_val ('POST_DIRECT_COMMISSION_INCOME',
                                           v_direct_comm_param);
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                raise_error (
                    'PARAMETER ERROR...POST_DIRECT_COMMISSION_INCOME...');
        END;

        v_gl_trans.delete;
        v_count := -1;

        BEGIN
            v_org_code := fms_interfaces_pkg.get_org (v_rct_branch);
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                raise_error (
                    'Error fetching org dtls ..branch=' || v_rct_branch);
        END;

        BEGIN
            v_cur_code :=
                NVL (v_currency_code,
                     lms_interfaces_pkg.lms_def_cur (v_rct_branch));
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                raise_error (
                       'Error fetching Currency code for branch ..'
                    || v_rct_branch);
        END;

        IF v_raised_by IS NOT NULL
        THEN
            v_user := tqc_interfaces_pkg.username (v_raised_by);
        END IF;

        SELECT    TO_NUMBER (TO_CHAR (SYSDATE, 'RRRR'))
               || lms_transaction_seq.NEXTVAL
          INTO v_trans_code
          FROM DUAL;

        --           raise_error('# v_param_val = '||v_param_val
        --                   ||'; v_rcpt_source = '||v_rcpt_source
        --                   ||'; v_acc_type ='||v_acc_type
        --                   ||'; v_process ='||v_process
        --                   );

        --============================
        IF (   (    NVL (v_param_val, 'Y') = 'Y'
                AND NVL (v_rcpt_source, 'X') <> 'R')
            OR (v_acc_type IN ('DD', 'CK', 'BU'))
            OR v_process IN ('MTR',
                             'LOAN',
                             'UNPROCESSED_RCPTS',
                             'VALUATION',
                             'PN',
                             'SURR'))
        THEN
            v_cb_count := 0;

            FOR pr IN cur_prop_cb_amt
            LOOP
                IF pr.pol_bra_code IS NULL
                THEN
                    raise_error ('BRANCH NOT DEFINED FOR THIS RECORD....');
                ELSIF pr.pol_prod_code IS NULL
                THEN
                    IF pr.ppr_code IS NULL
                    THEN
                        raise_error (
                               'Define product for Annuity No.'
                            || pr.pol_proposal_no
                            || '...');
                    ELSE
                        raise_error (
                               'Define product for Proposal No.'
                            || pr.pol_proposal_no
                            || '...');
                    END IF;
                END IF;

                IF v_oppr_code IS NOT NULL
                THEN
                    BEGIN
                        SELECT NVL (oppr_drcr, 'C'),
                               DECODE (NVL (oppr_drcr, 'C'), 'C', 'D', 'C'),
                               oppr_fms_receipt_pk
                          INTO v_oppr_drcr, v_oppr_chk_drcr, v_fms_receipt_pk
                          FROM lms_ord_proposal_rcpts
                         WHERE oppr_code = v_oppr_code;

                        v_opr_drcr := v_oppr_drcr;
                    EXCEPTION
                        WHEN OTHERS
                        THEN
                            raise_error (
                                'ERROR RETRIEVING PROPOSAL RCPT DTLS...');
                    END;

                    v_fms_receipt_pk :=
                        NVL (v_receipt_pk, pr.oppr_fms_receipt_pk);

                    IF     v_fms_receipt_pk IS NULL
                       AND NVL (v_process, 'X') NOT IN ('MTR',
                                                        'LOAN',
                                                        'VALUATION',
                                                        'PN',
                                                        'SURR')
                    THEN
                        raise_error (
                            'The receipting account is yet to be handled...');
                    END IF;
                ELSE
                    v_fms_receipt_pk :=
                        NVL (v_receipt_pk, pr.oppr_fms_receipt_pk);

                    IF     v_fms_receipt_pk IS NULL
                       AND NVL (v_process, 'X') NOT IN ('MTR',
                                                        'LOAN',
                                                        'VALUATION',
                                                        'PN',
                                                        'SURR')
                    THEN
                        raise_error (
                            'The receipting account cannot be null...');
                    END IF;
                END IF;

                IF NVL (v_process, 'X') IN ('MTR')
                THEN
                    IF v_trans_type = 'FM'
                    THEN
                        v_trnt_type := 'POL_MTRF';
                    ELSE
                        v_trnt_type := 'POL_MTR';
                    END IF;

                    --               RAISE_ERROR('sSv_trnt_type'||v_trnt_type);
                    get_gl_code (v_trnt_type,
                                 NVL (v_prod_code_from, pr.pol_prod_code),
                                 v_trnt_code,
                                 v_contra_acc,
                                 v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
                    valid_acc (v_contra_acc,
                               v_org_code,
                               pr.pol_bra_code,
                               v_trans_type);
                ELSIF NVL (v_process, 'X') IN ('SURR')
                THEN
                    v_trnt_type := 'POL_SURR';

                    get_gl_code (v_trnt_type,
                                 NVL (v_prod_code_from, pr.pol_prod_code),
                                 v_trnt_code,
                                 v_contra_acc,
                                 v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
                    valid_acc (v_contra_acc,
                               v_org_code,
                               pr.pol_bra_code,
                               v_trans_type);
                ELSIF NVL (v_process, 'X') IN ('LOAN')
                THEN
                    get_gl_code ('POL_LOAN',
                                 NVL (v_prod_code_from, pr.pol_prod_code),
                                 --pr.pol_prod_code,
                                 v_trnt_code,
                                 v_contra_acc,
                                 v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
                    valid_acc (v_contra_acc,
                               v_org_code,
                               pr.pol_bra_code,
                               'POL_LOAN');
                ELSIF NVL (v_process, 'X') IN ('VALUATION')
                THEN
                    get_gl_code ('INVADM',
                                 NVL (v_prod_code_from, pr.pol_prod_code),
                                 v_trnt_code,
                                 v_contra_acc,
                                 v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
                    valid_acc (v_contra_acc,
                               v_org_code,
                               pr.pol_bra_code,
                               'INVADM');
                ELSIF NVL (v_process, 'X') IN ('PN')
                THEN
                    get_gl_code ('PRREF',
                                 NVL (v_prod_code_from, pr.pol_prod_code),
                                 v_trnt_code,
                                 v_contra_acc,
                                 v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
                    valid_acc (v_contra_acc,
                               v_org_code,
                               pr.pol_bra_code,
                               'PRREF');
                ELSE
                    v_rct_paymt_mode :=
                        fms_rcts_pkg.rct_paymt_mode (v_fms_receipt_pk);
                    v_bct_code :=
                        fms_rcts_pkg.get_rcpt_debited_bank (v_fms_receipt_pk);
                    v_contra_acc :=
                        get_receipting_acc (
                            v_acc_type,
                            pr.pol_prod_code,
                            v_org_code,
                            v_rct_branch,
                            NVL (v_fms_unknown_reposting, 'N'),
                            v_param_val,
                            v_fms_receipt_pk);
                END IF;

                IF NVL (pr.paid_amt, 0) <> 0
                THEN
                    get_gl_code ('PRRCT',
                                 pr.pol_prod_code,
                                 v_trnt_code,
                                 v_trnt_gl_code,
                                 v_trnt_contra_gl_code);

                    valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                               v_org_code,
                               pr.pol_bra_code,
                               'PRRCT');
                    v_count := v_count + 1;
                    interface_append_gl (
                        v_trans_code,                         -- v_trans_code,
                        v_user,                                 -- v_raise_by,
                        pr.pol_code,                            -- v_pol_code,
                        pr.pol_prod_code,                      -- v_prod_code,
                        NULL,                                    -- v_vchr_no,
                        NULL,                                  -- v_opr_code,,
                        pr.oppr_code,                          -- v_oppr_code,
                        v_rct_code,                               --v_rcpt_no,
                        v_count,                                   -- v_count,
                        'PROPOSAL PREMIUM - ' || pr.pol_proposal_no,
                        -- v_narrative,
                        pr.paid_amt,                              -- v_amount,
                        v_oppr_drcr,                                -- v_drcr,
                        v_trnt_gl_code,                      -- v_acc_number1,
                        pr.pol_bra_code,                     -- v_branch_code,
                        v_gl_trans,
                        NULL,
                        ---v_cad_code       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                        NULL,
                        ---v_otop_code       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                        NULL,
                        --v_fpmt_code       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                        NULL,
                        --v_ort_code        NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                        NULL,
                        --v_btr_no        NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                        pr.ppr_code);                --- NUMBER DEFAULT NULL);
                    v_tot_amt := NVL (v_tot_amt, 0) + NVL (pr.paid_amt, 0);
                END IF;
            --            IF NVL (pr.prop_chk_amt, 0) <> 0 THEN
            --                Get_Gl_Code ('CHKC',
            --                            pr.pol_prod_code,
            --                            v_trnt_code,
            --                            v_trnt_gl_code,
            --                            v_trnt_contra_gl_code
            --                           );
            --                valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code, v_org_code, pr.pol_bra_code, 'CHKC');
            --                v_count := v_count + 2;
            --                Interface_append_gl(v_trans_code,    -- v_trans_code,
            --                                  v_user,    -- v_raise_by,
            --                                    NULL,    -- v_pol_code,
            --                                  pr.pol_prod_code,    -- v_prod_code,
            --                                  NULL,    -- v_vchr_no,
            --                                  NULL,    -- v_opr_code,
            --                                  pr.oppr_code,    -- v_oppr_code,
            --                                    v_rct_code, --v_rcpt_no,
            --                                  v_count,    -- v_count,
            --                                  'CHECK OFF COMMISSION '||pr.pol_proposal_no,    -- v_narrative,
            --                                  pr.prop_chk_amt,    -- v_amount,
            --                                  v_oppr_chk_drcr,    -- v_drcr,
            --                                  v_trnt_gl_code,    -- v_acc_number1,
            --                                  v_contra_acc,    -- v_acc_number2,
            --                                  pr.pol_bra_code,    -- v_branch_code,
            --                                  v_gl_trans);
            --            END IF;
            END LOOP;

            FOR pl IN cur_pol_cb_amt
            LOOP
                v_post_cnt := NULL;
                v_post := 'Y';
                v_loan_narration := '';

                IF pl.opr_lna_no IS NOT NULL
                THEN
                    v_loan_narration := ' - LOAN - ' || pl.opr_lna_no;
                END IF;

                --            RAISE_ERROR('XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX');
                IF pl.pol_prod_code IS NULL
                THEN
                    raise_error (
                           'Define product for Policy No.'
                        || pl.pol_policy_no
                        || '...');
                END IF;

                BEGIN
                    SELECT endr_sbu_code,
                           endr_spoke_code,
                           endr_coverage_area_code,
                           endr_location_code,
                           pol_status
                      INTO v_sbu_code,
                           v_spoke_code,
                           v_cvrg_area,
                           v_location_code,
                           v_pol_status
                      FROM lms_policies, lms_policy_endorsements
                     WHERE     pol_current_endr_code = endr_code
                           AND pol_code = pl.pol_code;
                EXCEPTION
                    WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND
                    THEN
                        NULL;
                    WHEN OTHERS
                    THEN
                        NULL;
                END;

                v_alloc_to := NVL (pl.alloc_to, 'PR');
                --            IF v_alloc_to = 'PR' THEN
                get_gl_code ('UNP_PR',
                             pl.pol_prod_code,
                             v_trnt_code,
                             v_unp_trnt_gl_code,
                             v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
                valid_acc (v_unp_trnt_gl_code,
                           v_org_code,
                           v_rct_branch,
                           'UNP_PR');
                v_msg := 'UNP_PR';

                --            ELSIF v_alloc_to = 'LN' THEN
                --                Get_Gl_Code ('UNP_LN',
                --                                     pl.pol_prod_code,
                --                                     v_trnt_code,
                --                                     v_unp_trnt_gl_code,
                --                                     v_trnt_contra_gl_code
                --                                    );
                --                valid_acc (v_unp_trnt_gl_code, v_org_code, v_rct_branch, 'UNP_LN');
                --                v_msg := 'UNP_LN';
                --            ELSIF v_alloc_to = 'PN' THEN
                --                Get_Gl_Code ('UNP_PN',
                --                                     pl.pol_prod_code,
                --                                     v_trnt_code,
                --                                     v_unp_trnt_gl_code,
                --                                     v_trnt_contra_gl_code
                --                                    );
                --                valid_acc (v_unp_trnt_gl_code, v_org_code, v_rct_branch, 'UNP_PN');
                --                v_msg := 'UNP_PN';
                --            END IF;

                --            raise_error (
                --                  'v_opr_code = '
                --               || v_opr_code
                --               || '; v_Receipt_PK = '
                --               || v_Receipt_PK
                --               || '; pl.OPR_FMS_RECEIPT_PK = '
                --               || pl.OPR_FMS_RECEIPT_PK);
                IF v_opr_code IS NULL
                THEN
                    v_fms_receipt_pk :=
                        NVL (v_receipt_pk, pl.opr_fms_receipt_pk);

                    IF     v_fms_receipt_pk IS NULL
                       AND NVL (v_process, 'X') NOT IN ('MTR',
                                                        'LOAN',
                                                        'VALUATION',
                                                        'PN',
                                                        'SURR')
                    THEN
                        raise_error (
                            'Receipting account cannot be null for policy recipts...');
                    END IF;

                    IF NVL (v_process, 'X') IN ('MTR')
                    THEN
                        IF v_trans_type = 'FM'
                        THEN
                            v_trnt_type := 'POL_MTRF';
                        ELSE
                            v_trnt_type := 'POL_MTR';
                        END IF;

                        get_gl_code (
                            v_trnt_type,
                            NVL (v_prod_code_from, pl.pol_prod_code),
                            v_trnt_code,
                            v_contra_acc,
                            v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
                        valid_acc (v_contra_acc,
                                   v_org_code,
                                   pl.pol_bra_code,
                                   v_trnt_type);
                    ELSIF NVL (v_process, 'X') IN ('SURR')
                    THEN
                        v_trnt_type := 'POL_SURR';

                        get_gl_code (
                            v_trnt_type,
                            NVL (v_prod_code_from, pl.pol_prod_code),
                            v_trnt_code,
                            v_contra_acc,
                            v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
                        valid_acc (v_contra_acc,
                                   v_org_code,
                                   pl.pol_bra_code,
                                   v_trnt_type);
                    ELSIF NVL (v_process, 'X') IN ('LOAN')
                    THEN
                        v_trnt_type := 'POL_LOAN';

                        get_gl_code (
                            v_trnt_type,
                            NVL (v_prod_code_from, pl.pol_prod_code),
                            v_trnt_code,
                            v_contra_acc,
                            v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
                        valid_acc (v_contra_acc,
                                   v_org_code,
                                   pl.pol_bra_code,
                                   v_trnt_type);
                    ELSIF NVL (v_process, 'X') IN ('VALUATION')
                    THEN
                        get_gl_code (
                            'INVADM',
                            NVL (v_prod_code_from, pl.pol_prod_code),
                            v_trnt_code,
                            v_contra_acc,
                            v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
                        valid_acc (v_contra_acc,
                                   v_org_code,
                                   pl.pol_bra_code,
                                   'INVADM');
                    ELSIF NVL (v_process, 'X') IN ('PN')
                    THEN
                        get_gl_code (
                            'PRREF',
                            NVL (v_prod_code_from, pl.pol_prod_code),
                            v_trnt_code,
                            v_contra_acc,
                            v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
                        valid_acc (v_contra_acc,
                                   v_org_code,
                                   pl.pol_bra_code,
                                   'PRREF');
                    ELSIF NVL (v_process, 'X') IN ('UNPROCESSED_RCPTS')
                    THEN
                        v_contra_acc := v_unp_trnt_gl_code;
                    ELSE
                        v_rct_paymt_mode :=
                            fms_rcts_pkg.rct_paymt_mode (v_fms_receipt_pk);
                        v_bct_code :=
                            fms_rcts_pkg.get_rcpt_debited_bank (
                                v_fms_receipt_pk);
                        v_contra_acc :=
                            get_receipting_acc (
                                v_acc_type,
                                pl.pol_prod_code,
                                v_org_code,
                                v_rct_branch,
                                NVL (v_fms_unknown_reposting, 'N'),
                                v_param_val,
                                v_fms_receipt_pk);
                    END IF;

                    v_prem_amt :=
                        NVL (pl.premium_amt, 0) + NVL (v_nfl_alloc, 0);
                    v_chkoff_comm := NVL (pl.chkoff_comm, 0);
                    v_loan_amt := NVL (pl.loan_amt, 0) - NVL (v_nfl_alloc, 0);
                    v_loan_principal_amt := NVL (pl.loan_principal_amt, 0);
                    v_loan_intr_amt := NVL (pl.loan_intr_amt, 0);
                    v_loan_unp_amt := NVL (pl.loan_unp_amt, 0);
                    v_pens_amt := NVL (pl.pension_contr, 0);
                    v_inv_admin := NVL (pl.investment_admin, 0);
                    v_inv_fee := NVL (pl.investment_fee, 0);
                    v_inv_contri := NVL (pl.investment_contri, 0);
                    v_comfnd := NVL (pl.comfnd, 0);
                    v_prem_comm :=
                        NVL (pl.prem_comm, 0) + NVL (pl.pens_comm, 0);
                ELSE
                    BEGIN
                        SELECT opr_origin, NVL (opr_drcr, 'C')
                          INTO v_origin, v_opr_drcr
                          FROM lms_ord_prem_receipts
                         WHERE opr_code = v_opr_code;
                    EXCEPTION
                        WHEN OTHERS
                        THEN
                            raise_error ('ERROR RETRIEVING RCPT DTLS....');
                    END;

                    IF     NOT NVL (v_origin, 'M') = 'I'
                       AND (    NVL (v_prem_waiver, 'N') <> 'Y'
                            AND NVL (v_process, 'X') NOT IN
                                    ('MTR',
                                     'LOAN',
                                     'UNPROCESSED_RCPTS',
                                     'VALUATION',
                                     'PN',
                                     'SURR'))
                    THEN
                        SELECT opr_source
                          INTO v_source
                          FROM lms_ord_prem_receipts
                         WHERE opr_code = pl.opr_code;

                        IF v_source IN ('TRANSFER')
                        THEN
                            SELECT COUNT (1)
                              INTO v_post_cnt
                              FROM lms_ord_recpt_transfer,
                                   lms_interface_table
                             WHERE     ort_opr_code_to = pl.opr_code
                                   AND ort_code = itb_ort_code;

                            IF v_post_cnt = 0
                            THEN
                                v_post := 'N';
                            END IF;
                        ELSE
                            raise_error (
                                'INTERFACE PROCESSING ALLOWED ONLY FOR RCPTS ORIGINATING FROM FMS....');
                        END IF;
                    END IF;

                    IF v_trans_no IS NOT NULL
                    THEN
                        BEGIN
                            SELECT ltr_btr_trans_code
                              INTO v_ltr_btr_trans_code
                              FROM lms_transactions
                             WHERE ltr_trans_no = v_trans_no;
                        EXCEPTION
                            WHEN OTHERS
                            THEN
                                NULL;
                        END;
                    END IF;

                    v_fms_receipt_pk :=
                        NVL (v_receipt_pk, pl.opr_fms_receipt_pk);

                    IF     v_fms_receipt_pk IS NULL
                       AND NVL (v_process, 'X') NOT IN ('MTR',
                                                        'LOAN',
                                                        'VALUATION',
                                                        'PN',
                                                        'SURR')
                    THEN
                        raise_error (
                            'Receipting account cannot be null for policy recipts...');
                    END IF;

                    IF NVL (v_process, 'X') IN ('MTR')
                    THEN
                        IF v_trans_type = 'FM'
                        THEN
                            v_trnt_type := 'POL_MTRF';
                        ELSE
                            v_trnt_type := 'POL_MTR';
                        END IF;

                        get_gl_code (
                            v_trnt_type,
                            NVL (v_prod_code_from, pl.pol_prod_code),
                            v_trnt_code,
                            v_contra_acc,
                            v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
                        valid_acc (v_contra_acc,
                                   v_org_code,
                                   pl.pol_bra_code,
                                   v_trnt_type);
                    ELSIF NVL (v_process, 'X') IN ('SURR')
                    THEN
                        v_trnt_type := 'POL_SURR';

                        get_gl_code (
                            v_trnt_type,
                            NVL (v_prod_code_from, pl.pol_prod_code),
                            v_trnt_code,
                            v_contra_acc,
                            v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
                        valid_acc (v_contra_acc,
                                   v_org_code,
                                   pl.pol_bra_code,
                                   v_trnt_type);
                    ELSIF NVL (v_process, 'X') IN ('LOAN')
                    THEN
                        v_trnt_type := 'POL_LOAN';

                        get_gl_code (
                            v_trnt_type,
                            NVL (v_prod_code_from, pl.pol_prod_code),
                            v_trnt_code,
                            v_contra_acc,
                            v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
                        valid_acc (v_contra_acc,
                                   v_org_code,
                                   pl.pol_bra_code,
                                   v_trnt_type);
                    ELSIF NVL (v_process, 'X') IN ('VALUATION')
                    THEN
                        get_gl_code (
                            'INVADM',
                            NVL (v_prod_code_from, pl.pol_prod_code),
                            v_trnt_code,
                            v_contra_acc,
                            v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
                        valid_acc (v_contra_acc,
                                   v_org_code,
                                   pl.pol_bra_code,
                                   'INVADM');
                    ELSIF NVL (v_process, 'X') IN ('PN')
                    THEN
                        get_gl_code (
                            'PRREF',
                            NVL (v_prod_code_from, pl.pol_prod_code),
                            v_trnt_code,
                            v_contra_acc,
                            v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
                        valid_acc (v_contra_acc,
                                   v_org_code,
                                   pl.pol_bra_code,
                                   'PRREF');
                    ELSIF NVL (v_process, 'X') IN ('UNPROCESSED_RCPTS')
                    THEN
                        v_contra_acc := v_unp_trnt_gl_code;
                    ELSE
                        v_rct_paymt_mode :=
                            fms_rcts_pkg.rct_paymt_mode (v_fms_receipt_pk);
                        v_bct_code :=
                            fms_rcts_pkg.get_rcpt_debited_bank (
                                v_fms_receipt_pk);
                        v_contra_acc :=
                            get_receipting_acc (
                                v_acc_type,
                                pl.pol_prod_code,
                                v_org_code,
                                v_rct_branch,
                                NVL (v_fms_unknown_reposting, 'N'),
                                v_param_val,
                                v_fms_receipt_pk);
                    END IF;

                    --               raise_error (   'v_reverse_alloc = '
                    --                            || v_reverse_alloc
                    --                            || '; v_contra_acc = '
                    --                            || v_contra_acc
                    --                            || '; v_unp_trnt_gl_code = '
                    --                            || v_unp_trnt_gl_code
                    --                           );
                    IF NVL (v_reverse_alloc, 'N') = 'N'
                    THEN
                        v_prem_amt :=
                            NVL (pl.premium_amt, 0) + NVL (v_nfl_alloc, 0);
                        v_chkoff_comm := NVL (pl.chkoff_comm, 0);
                        v_loan_amt :=
                            NVL (pl.loan_amt, 0) - NVL (v_nfl_alloc, 0);
                        v_loan_principal_amt :=
                            NVL (pl.loan_principal_amt, 0);
                        v_loan_intr_amt := NVL (pl.loan_intr_amt, 0);
                        v_loan_unp_amt := NVL (pl.loan_unp_amt, 0);
                        v_pens_amt := NVL (pl.pension_contr, 0);
                        v_inv_admin := NVL (pl.investment_admin, 0);
                        v_inv_fee := NVL (pl.investment_fee, 0);
                        v_inv_contri := NVL (pl.investment_contri, 0);
                        v_comfnd := NVL (pl.comfnd, 0);
                        v_prem_comm :=
                            NVL (pl.prem_comm, 0) + NVL (pl.pens_comm, 0);
                    ELSE
                        IF v_ltr_btr_trans_code = 'DCOM'
                        THEN
                            get_gl_code ('AGNT_DBT',
                                         pl.pol_prod_code,
                                         v_trnt_code,
                                         v_trnt_gl_code,
                                         v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
                            valid_acc (v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                       v_org_code,
                                       pl.pol_bra_code,
                                       'AGNT_DBT');
                            v_contra_acc := v_trnt_contra_gl_code;
                        ELSIF NVL (v_prem_waiver, 'N') = 'Y'
                        THEN
                            get_gl_code ('PRWAIV',
                                         pl.pol_prod_code,
                                         v_trnt_code,
                                         v_trnt_gl_code,
                                         v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
                            valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                                       v_org_code,
                                       pl.pol_bra_code,
                                       'PRWAIV');
                            v_contra_acc := v_trnt_gl_code;
                        --claim voucher allocation
                        ELSIF NVL (v_clm_vouch_alloc, 'N') = 'Y'
                        THEN
                            IF v_clm_caus_type = 'DTH'
                            THEN
                                get_gl_code ('CP_DTH', --Claim outstanding acc
                                             pl.pol_prod_code,
                                             v_trnt_code,
                                             v_trnt_gl_code,
                                             v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
                                valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                                           v_org_code,
                                           pl.pol_bra_code,
                                           'CP_DTH');
                                v_contra_acc := v_trnt_gl_code;
                            ELSE
                                get_gl_code ('CP_DIS', --Claim outstanding acc
                                             pl.pol_prod_code,
                                             v_trnt_code,
                                             v_trnt_gl_code,
                                             v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
                                valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                                           v_org_code,
                                           pl.pol_bra_code,
                                           'CP_DIS');
                                v_contra_acc := v_trnt_gl_code;
                            END IF;
                        ELSE
                            v_fms_receipt_pk :=
                                NVL (v_receipt_pk, pl.opr_fms_receipt_pk);

                            IF     v_fms_receipt_pk IS NULL
                               AND NOT NVL (v_process, 'X') IN ('MTR',
                                                                'LOAN',
                                                                'VALUATION',
                                                                'PN',
                                                                'SURR')
                            THEN
                                raise_error (
                                    'Receipting account cannot be null for policy recipts....2.');
                            END IF;

                            IF NVL (v_process, 'X') IN ('MTR')
                            THEN
                                IF v_trans_type = 'FM'
                                THEN
                                    v_trnt_type := 'POL_MTRF';
                                ELSE
                                    v_trnt_type := 'POL_MTR';
                                END IF;

                                get_gl_code (
                                    v_trnt_type,
                                    NVL (v_prod_code_from, pl.pol_prod_code),
                                    v_trnt_code,
                                    v_contra_acc,
                                    v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
                                valid_acc (v_contra_acc,
                                           v_org_code,
                                           pl.pol_bra_code,
                                           v_trnt_type);
                            ELSIF NVL (v_process, 'X') IN ('SURR')
                            THEN
                                v_trnt_type := 'POL_SURR';

                                get_gl_code (
                                    v_trnt_type,
                                    NVL (v_prod_code_from, pl.pol_prod_code),
                                    v_trnt_code,
                                    v_contra_acc,
                                    v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
                                valid_acc (v_contra_acc,
                                           v_org_code,
                                           pl.pol_bra_code,
                                           v_trnt_type);
                            ELSIF NVL (v_process, 'X') IN ('LOAN')
                            THEN
                                v_trnt_type := 'POL_LOAN';

                                get_gl_code (
                                    v_trnt_type,
                                    NVL (v_prod_code_from, pl.pol_prod_code),
                                    v_trnt_code,
                                    v_contra_acc,
                                    v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
                                valid_acc (v_contra_acc,
                                           v_org_code,
                                           pl.pol_bra_code,
                                           v_trnt_type);
                            ELSIF NVL (v_process, 'X') IN ('VALUATION')
                            THEN
                                get_gl_code (
                                    'INVADM',
                                    NVL (v_prod_code_from, pl.pol_prod_code),
                                    v_trnt_code,
                                    v_contra_acc,
                                    v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
                                valid_acc (v_contra_acc,
                                           v_org_code,
                                           pl.pol_bra_code,
                                           'INVADM');
                            ELSIF NVL (v_process, 'X') IN ('PN')
                            THEN
                                get_gl_code (
                                    'PRREF',
                                    NVL (v_prod_code_from, pl.pol_prod_code),
                                    v_trnt_code,
                                    v_contra_acc,
                                    v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
                                valid_acc (v_contra_acc,
                                           v_org_code,
                                           pl.pol_bra_code,
                                           'PRREF');
                            ELSE
                                v_rct_paymt_mode :=
                                    fms_rcts_pkg.rct_paymt_mode (
                                        v_fms_receipt_pk);
                                v_bct_code :=
                                    fms_rcts_pkg.get_rcpt_debited_bank (
                                        v_fms_receipt_pk);
                                v_contra_acc :=
                                    get_receipting_acc (v_acc_type,
                                                        pl.pol_prod_code,
                                                        v_org_code,
                                                        v_rct_branch,
                                                        'N',
                                                        v_param_val,
                                                        v_fms_receipt_pk);
                            END IF;
                        END IF;

                        v_prem_amt :=
                            NVL (pl.premium_amt, 0) + NVL (v_nfl_alloc, 0);
                        v_chkoff_comm := NVL (pl.chkoff_comm, 0);
                        v_loan_amt :=
                            NVL (pl.loan_amt, 0) - NVL (v_nfl_alloc, 0);
                        v_loan_principal_amt :=
                            NVL (pl.loan_principal_amt, 0);
                        v_loan_intr_amt := NVL (pl.loan_intr_amt, 0);
                        v_loan_unp_amt := NVL (pl.loan_unp_amt, 0);
                        v_pens_amt := NVL (pl.pension_contr, 0);
                        v_inv_admin := NVL (pl.investment_admin, 0);
                        v_inv_fee := NVL (pl.investment_fee, 0);
                        v_inv_contri := NVL (pl.investment_contri, 0);
                        v_comfnd := NVL (pl.comfnd, 0);
                        v_prem_comm :=
                            NVL (pl.prem_comm, 0) + NVL (pl.pens_comm, 0);
                    END IF;
                END IF;

                --RAISE_ERROR(v_rct_branch||'=v_contra_acc='||v_contra_acc);
                --premium
                IF NVL (v_post, 'Y') != 'N'
                THEN
                    IF NVL (v_prem_amt, 0) <> 0
                    THEN
                        get_gl_code ('UP',
                                     pl.pol_prod_code,
                                     v_trnt_code,
                                     v_trnt_gl_code,
                                     v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                     NULL,
                                     pl.renewal);
                        valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                                   v_org_code,
                                   pl.pol_bra_code,
                                   'UP');
                        v_count := v_count + 1;
                        interface_append_gl (
                            v_trans_code,                     -- v_trans_code,
                            v_user,                             -- v_raise_by,
                            pl.pol_code,                        -- v_pol_code,
                            pl.pol_prod_code,                  -- v_prod_code,
                            NULL,                                -- v_vchr_no,
                            pl.opr_code,                        -- v_opr_code,
                            NULL,                              -- v_oppr_code,
                            v_rct_code,                           --v_rcpt_no,
                            v_count,                               -- v_count,
                               'ALLOCATED PREMIUM'
                            || ' - '
                            || NVL (pl.pol_policy_no, pl.pol_proposal_no)
                            || v_loan_narration,
                            -- v_narrative,
                            NVL (v_prem_amt, 0),                  -- v_amount,
                            v_opr_drcr,                             -- v_drcr,
                            v_trnt_gl_code,                  -- v_acc_number1,
                            pl.pol_bra_code,                 -- v_branch_code,
                            v_gl_trans,
                            NULL,
                            --v_cad_code       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                            NULL,
                            --v_otop_code              NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                            NULL,
                            --v_fpmt_code              NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                            NULL,
                            --v_ort_code               NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                            NULL,
                            --v_btr_no                 NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                            NULL,
                            --v_ppr_code               NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                            NULL,
                            --v_ocl_code                NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                            NULL,
                            --v_agn_code                NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                            NULL,
                            --v_trans_no                NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                            v_cvrg_area,
                            --v_covrg_area_code                NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                            v_spoke_code,
                            --v_spoke_code                NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                            v_sbu_code,
                            --v_sbu_code                NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                            v_location_code --v_loc_code                NUMBER DEFAULT NULL
                                           );
                        v_tot_amt := NVL (v_tot_amt, 0) + NVL (v_prem_amt, 0);
                    END IF;

                    IF     NVL (v_prem_comm, 0) <> 0
                       AND pl.endr_agen_code = 0
                       AND NVL (v_direct_comm_param, 'N') = 'Y'
                    THEN
                        get_gl_code ('DCI',
                                     pl.pol_prod_code,
                                     v_trnt_code,
                                     v_trnt_gl_code,
                                     v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                     NULL,
                                     pl.renewal);
                        valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                                   v_org_code,
                                   pl.pol_bra_code,
                                   'DCI');
                        v_count := v_count + 1;
                        interface_append_gl (
                            v_trans_code,                     -- v_trans_code,
                            v_user,                             -- v_raise_by,
                            pl.pol_code,                        -- v_pol_code,
                            pl.pol_prod_code,                  -- v_prod_code,
                            NULL,                                -- v_vchr_no,
                            pl.opr_code,                        -- v_opr_code,
                            NULL,                              -- v_oppr_code,
                            v_rct_code,                           --v_rcpt_no,
                            v_count,                               -- v_count,
                               'DIRECT COMMISSSION INCOME '
                            || ' - '
                            || NVL (pl.pol_policy_no, pl.pol_proposal_no)
                            || v_loan_narration,
                            -- v_narrative,
                            NVL (v_prem_comm, 0),                 -- v_amount,
                            v_opr_drcr,                             -- v_drcr,
                            v_trnt_gl_code,                  -- v_acc_number1,
                            pl.pol_bra_code,                 -- v_branch_code,
                            v_gl_trans,
                            NULL,
                            --v_cad_code       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                            NULL,
                            --v_otop_code              NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                            NULL,
                            --v_fpmt_code              NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                            NULL,
                            --v_ort_code               NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                            NULL,
                            --v_btr_no                 NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                            NULL,
                            --v_ppr_code               NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                            NULL,
                            --v_ocl_code                NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                            NULL,
                            --v_agn_code                NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                            NULL,
                            --v_trans_no                NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                            v_cvrg_area,
                            --v_covrg_area_code                NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                            v_spoke_code,
                            --v_spoke_code                NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                            v_sbu_code,
                            --v_sbu_code                NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                            v_location_code --v_loc_code                NUMBER DEFAULT NULL
                                           );
                        v_tot_amt :=
                            NVL (v_tot_amt, 0) + NVL (v_prem_comm, 0);
                    END IF;

                    --Check Off Commission chkoff_comm   taken care of in FMS
                    --            IF NVL(v_chkoff_comm,0) <> 0 THEN
                    --                Get_Gl_Code ('CHKC',
                    --                                     pl.pol_prod_code,
                    --                                     v_trnt_code,
                    --                                     v_trnt_gl_code,
                    --                                     v_trnt_contra_gl_code
                    --                                    );
                    --                valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code, v_org_code, pl.pol_bra_code, 'CHKC');
                    --                v_count := v_count + 2;
                    --                IF v_opr_drcr = 'C' THEN
                    --                    Interface_append_gl(v_trans_code,    -- v_trans_code,
                    --                                      v_user,    -- v_raise_by,
                    --                                        pl.pol_code,    -- v_pol_code,
                    --                                      pl.pol_prod_code,    -- v_prod_code,
                    --                                      NULL,    -- v_vchr_no,
                    --                                      pl.opr_code,    -- v_opr_code,
                    --                                        NULL,    -- v_oppr_code,
                    --                                        v_rct_code, --v_rcpt_no,
                    --                                      v_count,    -- v_count,
                    --                                      'CK OFF COMMISSION',    -- v_narrative,
                    --                                      NVL(v_chkoff_comm,0),    -- v_amount,
                    --                                      'D',    -- v_drcr,
