                                --v_sbu_code                NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                v_location_code --v_loc_code                NUMBER DEFAULT NULL
                                               );
                            v_tot_amt :=
                                NVL (v_tot_amt, 0) + NVL (v_comfnd, 0);
                        END IF;
                    END IF;

                    FOR t IN tax_types (pl.opr_code)
                    LOOP
                        IF NVL (t.orts_amount, 0) <> 0
                        THEN
                            valid_acc (t.acc_no,
                                       v_org_code,
                                       pl.pol_bra_code,
                                       'RCT TAXES');

                            IF t.orts_add_to_receipts = 'Y'
                            THEN
                                --receipt premium taxes...
                                v_count := v_count + 1;
                                interface_append_gl (
                                    v_trans_code,             -- v_trans_code,
                                    v_user,                     -- v_raise_by,
                                    pl.pol_code,                -- v_pol_code,
                                    pl.pol_prod_code,          -- v_prod_code,
                                    NULL,                        -- v_vchr_no,
                                    pl.opr_code,                -- v_opr_code,
                                    NULL,                      -- v_oppr_code,
                                    v_rct_code,                   --v_rcpt_no,
                                    v_count,                       -- v_count,
                                       t.tt_desc
                                    || ' - '
                                    || NVL (pl.pol_policy_no,
                                            pl.pol_proposal_no), -- v_narrative,
                                    NVL (t.orts_amount, 0),       -- v_amount,
                                    v_opr_drcr,                     -- v_drcr,
                                    t.acc_no,                -- v_acc_number1,
                                    pl.pol_bra_code,         -- v_branch_code,
                                    v_gl_trans,
                                    NULL,
                                    --v_cad_code       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                    NULL,
                                    --v_otop_code              NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                    NULL,
                                    --v_fpmt_code              NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                    NULL,
                                    --v_ort_code               NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                    NULL,
                                    --v_btr_no                 NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                    NULL,
                                    --v_ppr_code               NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                    NULL,
                                    --v_ocl_code                NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                    NULL,
                                    --v_agn_code                NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                    NULL,
                                    --v_trans_no                NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                    v_cvrg_area,
                                    --v_covrg_area_code                NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                    v_spoke_code,
                                    --v_spoke_code                NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                    v_sbu_code,
                                    --v_sbu_code                NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                    v_location_code --v_loc_code                NUMBER DEFAULT NULL
                                                   );
                                v_tot_amt :=
                                      NVL (v_tot_amt, 0)
                                    + NVL (t.orts_amount, 0);
                            ELSE
                                valid_acc (t.contra_acc_no,
                                           v_org_code,
                                           pl.pol_bra_code,
                                           'RCT TAXES CONTRA');
                                --receipt premium taxes...
                                v_count := v_count + 2;
                                interface_append_gl (
                                    v_trans_code,             -- v_trans_code,
                                    v_user,                     -- v_raise_by,
                                    pl.pol_code,                -- v_pol_code,
                                    pl.pol_prod_code,          -- v_prod_code,
                                    NULL,                        -- v_vchr_no,
                                    pl.opr_code,                -- v_opr_code,
                                    NULL,                      -- v_oppr_code,
                                    v_rct_code,                   --v_rcpt_no,
                                    v_count,                       -- v_count,
                                       t.tt_desc
                                    || ' - '
                                    || NVL (pl.pol_policy_no,
                                            pl.pol_proposal_no), -- v_narrative,
                                    NVL (t.orts_amount, 0),       -- v_amount,
                                    v_opr_drcr,                     -- v_drcr,
                                    t.acc_no,                -- v_acc_number1,
                                    t.contra_acc_no,         -- v_acc_number2,
                                    pl.pol_bra_code,         -- v_branch_code,
                                    v_gl_trans,
                                    NULL,
                                    --v_cad_code       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                    NULL,
                                    --v_otop_code              NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                    NULL,
                                    --v_fpmt_code              NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                    NULL,
                                    --v_ort_code               NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                    NULL,
                                    --v_btr_no                 NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                    NULL,
                                    --v_ppr_code               NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                    NULL,
                                    --v_ocl_code                NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                    NULL,
                                    --v_agn_code                NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                    NULL,
                                    --v_trans_no                NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                    v_cvrg_area,
                                    --v_covrg_area_code                NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                    v_spoke_code,
                                    --v_spoke_code                NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                    v_sbu_code,
                                    --v_sbu_code                NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                    v_location_code --v_loc_code                NUMBER DEFAULT NULL
                                                   );
                            END IF;

                            UPDATE lms_ord_receipt_taxes
                               SET orts_posted = 'Y'
                             WHERE     orts_opr_code = t.orts_opr_code
                                   AND orts_trt_code = t.trt_code;
                        END IF;
                    END LOOP;
                --END IF;
                END IF;
            END LOOP;

            -- V_OPR_CODE IS NULL AND V_OPPR_RCT_TRANS_CODE  ARE NULL IF CALLED FROM FMS.....
            IF NVL (v_post, 'Y') != 'N'
            THEN
                IF v_opr_code IS NULL OR v_oppr_code IS NULL
                THEN
                    IF     NVL (v_fms_unknown_reposting, 'N') = 'N'
                       AND NVL (v_reverse_alloc, 'N') <> 'C'
                    THEN
                        v_unknown_amt :=
                            fms_interfaces_pkg.rct_unknown_amt (v_receipt_pk);
                    END IF;

                    --RAISE_ERROR('v_gl_trans11111=============='||v_gl_trans.COUNT);
                    IF NVL (v_unknown_amt, 0) <> 0
                    THEN
                        IF v_acc_type = 'CK'
                        THEN
                            get_gl_code ('UNK_CHKC',
                                         NULL,
                                         v_trnt_code,
                                         v_trnt_gl_code,
                                         v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
                            valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                                       v_org_code,
                                       v_rct_branch,
                                       'UNK_CHKC');
                        ELSE
                            get_gl_code ('UNK',
                                         NULL,
                                         v_trnt_code,
                                         v_trnt_gl_code,
                                         v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
                            valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                                       v_org_code,
                                       v_rct_branch,
                                       'UNK');
                        END IF;

                        v_count := v_count + 1;

                        IF v_opr_drcr = 'C'
                        THEN
                            interface_append_gl (
                                v_trans_code,                 -- v_trans_code,
                                v_user,                         -- v_raise_by,
                                NULL,                           -- v_pol_code,
                                NULL,                          -- v_prod_code,
                                NULL,                            -- v_vchr_no,
                                v_opr_code,                     -- v_opr_code,
                                v_oppr_code,                   -- v_oppr_code,
                                v_rct_code,                       --v_rcpt_no,
                                v_count,                           -- v_count,
                                'ERRONEOUS CHK-OFF DEDUCTIONS', -- v_narrative,
                                NVL (v_unknown_amt, 0),           -- v_amount,
                                'D',                                -- v_drcr,
                                v_trnt_contra_gl_code,       -- v_acc_number1,
                                v_trnt_gl_code,              -- v_acc_number2,
                                v_rct_branch,                -- v_branch_code,
                                v_gl_trans);
                        ELSE
                            interface_append_gl (
                                v_trans_code,                 -- v_trans_code,
                                v_user,                         -- v_raise_by,
                                NULL,                           -- v_pol_code,
                                NULL,                          -- v_prod_code,
                                NULL,                            -- v_vchr_no,
                                v_opr_code,                     -- v_opr_code,
                                v_oppr_code,                   -- v_oppr_code,
                                v_rct_code,                       --v_rcpt_no,
                                v_count,                           -- v_count,
                                'ERRONEOUS CHK-OFF DEDUCTIONS', -- v_narrative,
                                NVL (v_unknown_amt, 0),           -- v_amount,
                                'C',                                -- v_drcr,
                                v_trnt_contra_gl_code,       -- v_acc_number1,
                                v_trnt_gl_code,              -- v_acc_number2,
                                v_rct_branch,                -- v_branch_code,
                                v_gl_trans);
                        END IF;
                    END IF;
                END IF;

                --             IF NVL (v_double_sure_amt, 0) <> 0 THEN
                --                 v_count := v_count + 2;
                --                 fms_vouchers_pkg.append_gl_trans (v_count,
                --                                                                      'DOUBLE SURE',
                --                                                                      NVL (v_double_sure_amt, 0),
                --                                                                      'D',
                --                                                                      v_contra_acc,
                --                                                                      v_trnt_gl_code,
                --                                                                      v_rct_branch,
                --                                                                      v_gl_trans
                --                                                                     );
                --             END IF;
                IF     v_oppr_code IS NULL
                   AND NVL (v_process, 'X') NOT IN ('UNPROCESSED_RCPTS')
                THEN
                    v_unprocessed_rcpts_total := 0;

                    FOR pl IN cur_pol_cb_amt
                    LOOP
                        BEGIN
                            SELECT endr_sbu_code,
                                   endr_spoke_code,
                                   endr_coverage_area_code,
                                   endr_location_code,
                                   pol_status
                              INTO v_sbu_code,
                                   v_spoke_code,
                                   v_cvrg_area,
                                   v_location_code,
                                   v_pol_status
                              FROM lms_policies, lms_policy_endorsements
                             WHERE     pol_current_endr_code = endr_code
                                   AND pol_code = pl.pol_code;
                        EXCEPTION
                            WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND
                            THEN
                                NULL;
                            WHEN OTHERS
                            THEN
                                NULL;
                        END;

                        --FOR P IN Prod LOOP
                        v_unprocessed_rcpts := 0;
                        v_unprocessed_rcpts :=
                            get_unprocessed_rcpt (v_rct_code,
                                                  v_date,
                                                  pl.pol_prod_code,
                                                  NULL,
                                                  v_receipt_pk,
                                                  v_opr_rct_trans_code,
                                                  pl.pol_code,
                                                  pl.opr_code);
                        v_unprocessed_rcpts_total :=
                              NVL (v_unprocessed_rcpts_total, 0)
                            + NVL (v_unprocessed_rcpts, 0);

                        IF ABS (NVL (v_unprocessed_rcpts, 0)) > 0
                        THEN
                            v_alloc_to := NVL (pl.alloc_to, 'PR');

                            IF v_alloc_to = 'LN'
                            THEN
                                raise_error (
                                       'POSTING TO UNP_LN BLOCKED1.....Policy No.'
                                    || pl.pol_policy_no
                                    || v_loan_narration);
                            END IF;

                            IF v_alloc_to = 'PR'
                            THEN
                                get_gl_code ('UNP_PR',
                                             pl.pol_prod_code,
                                             v_trnt_code,
                                             v_unp_trnt_gl_code,
                                             v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                             NULL,
                                             pl.renewal);
                                valid_acc (v_unp_trnt_gl_code,
                                           v_org_code,
                                           v_rct_branch,
                                           'UNP_PR');
                                v_msg := 'UNP_PR';

                                BEGIN
                                    lms_ord_misc.system_param_val (
                                        'ALLOC_INACTIVE_PREM_TO_REFUND_AC',
                                        v_alloc_to_ref);
                                EXCEPTION
                                    WHEN OTHERS
                                    THEN
                                        v_alloc_to_ref := 'N';
                                END;

                                IF     v_alloc_to_ref = 'Y'
                                   AND v_pol_status IN ('C',
                                                        'J',
                                                        'PU',
                                                        'S',
                                                        'CPU',
                                                        'DC',
                                                        'M',
                                                        'L',
                                                        'FL')
                                THEN
                                    get_gl_code ('PLREF',
                                                 pl.pol_prod_code,
                                                 v_trnt_code,
                                                 v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                                 v_unp_trnt_gl_code,
                                                 NULL,
                                                 pl.renewal);
                                    valid_acc (v_unp_trnt_gl_code,
                                               v_org_code,
                                               v_rct_branch,
                                               'PLREF');
                                    v_msg := 'PLREF';
                                END IF;
                            ELSIF v_alloc_to = 'LN'
                            THEN
                                get_gl_code ('UNP_LN',
                                             pl.pol_prod_code,
                                             v_trnt_code,
                                             v_unp_trnt_gl_code,
                                             v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                             NULL,
                                             pl.renewal);
                                valid_acc (v_unp_trnt_gl_code,
                                           v_org_code,
                                           v_rct_branch,
                                           'UNP_LN');
                                v_msg := 'UNP_LN';
                            ELSIF v_alloc_to = 'PN'
                            THEN
                                get_gl_code ('UNP_PN',
                                             pl.pol_prod_code,
                                             v_trnt_code,
                                             v_unp_trnt_gl_code,
                                             v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                             NULL,
                                             pl.renewal);
                                valid_acc (v_unp_trnt_gl_code,
                                           v_org_code,
                                           v_rct_branch,
                                           'UNP_PN');
                                v_msg := 'UNP_PN';
                            END IF;

                            IF NVL (v_process, 'X') IN ('MTR')
                            THEN
                                IF v_trans_type = 'FM'
                                THEN
                                    v_trnt_type := 'POL_MTRF';
                                ELSE
                                    v_trnt_type := 'POL_MTR';
                                END IF;

                                get_gl_code (
                                    v_trnt_type,
                                    NVL (v_prod_code_from, pl.pol_prod_code),
                                    v_trnt_code,
                                    v_contra_acc,
                                    v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
                                valid_acc (v_contra_acc,
                                           v_org_code,
                                           pl.pol_bra_code,
                                           v_trans_type);
                            ELSIF NVL (v_process, 'X') IN ('SURR')
                            THEN
                                v_trnt_type := 'POL_SURR';

                                get_gl_code (
                                    v_trnt_type,
                                    NVL (v_prod_code_from, pl.pol_prod_code),
                                    v_trnt_code,
                                    v_contra_acc,
                                    v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
                                valid_acc (v_contra_acc,
                                           v_org_code,
                                           pl.pol_bra_code,
                                           v_trans_type);
                            ELSIF NVL (v_process, 'X') IN ('LOAN')
                            THEN
                                get_gl_code (
                                    'POL_LOAN',
                                    NVL (v_prod_code_from, pl.pol_prod_code),
                                    v_trnt_code,
                                    v_contra_acc,
                                    v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
                                valid_acc (v_contra_acc,
                                           v_org_code,
                                           pl.pol_bra_code,
                                           'POL_LOAN');
                            ELSIF NVL (v_process, 'X') IN ('VALUATION')
                            THEN
                                get_gl_code (
                                    'INVADM',
                                    NVL (v_prod_code_from, pl.pol_prod_code),
                                    v_trnt_code,
                                    v_contra_acc,
                                    v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
                                valid_acc (v_contra_acc,
                                           v_org_code,
                                           pl.pol_bra_code,
                                           'INVADM');
                            ELSIF NVL (v_process, 'X') IN ('PN')
                            THEN
                                get_gl_code (
                                    'PRREF',
                                    NVL (v_prod_code_from, pl.pol_prod_code),
                                    v_trnt_code,
                                    v_contra_acc,
                                    v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
                                valid_acc (v_contra_acc,
                                           v_org_code,
                                           pl.pol_bra_code,
                                           'PRREF');
                            ELSIF NVL (v_acc_type, 'D') = 'CK'
                            THEN
                                get_gl_code (
                                    'CHKC',
                                    NVL (v_prod_code_from, pl.pol_prod_code),
                                    v_trnt_code,
                                    v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                    v_contra_acc,
                                    NULL,
                                    pl.renewal);
                                valid_acc (v_contra_acc,
                                           v_org_code,
                                           v_rct_branch,
                                           'CHKC');
                            ELSIF NVL (v_acc_type, 'D') = 'JV'
                            THEN
                                get_gl_code (
                                    'JV_RCT',
                                    NVL (v_prod_code_from, pl.pol_prod_code),
                                    v_trnt_code,
                                    v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                    v_contra_acc);
                                valid_acc (v_contra_acc,
                                           v_org_code,
                                           v_rct_branch,
                                           'JV_RCT');
                            ELSIF NVL (v_acc_type, 'D') = 'BU'
                            THEN
                                v_rct_paymt_mode :=
                                    fms_rcts_pkg.rct_paymt_mode (
                                        v_fms_receipt_pk);
                                v_bct_code :=
                                    fms_rcts_pkg.get_rcpt_debited_bank (
                                        v_fms_receipt_pk);
                                v_contra_acc :=
                                    get_receipting_acc (
                                        v_acc_type,
                                        pl.pol_prod_code,
                                        v_org_code,
                                        v_rct_branch,
                                        NVL (v_fms_unknown_reposting, 'N'),
                                        v_param_val,
                                        v_fms_receipt_pk);
                                v_msg := 'BU';
                            ELSE
                                IF (   (NVL (v_param_val, 'Y')) = 'Y'
                                    OR (v_acc_type = 'CK'))
                                THEN
                                    get_gl_code ('DR_RCT',
                                                 pl.pol_prod_code,
                                                 v_trnt_code,
                                                 v_contra_acc,
                                                 v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                                 NULL,
                                                 pl.renewal);
                                    valid_acc (v_contra_acc,
                                               v_org_code,
                                               v_rct_branch,
                                               'DR_RCT');
                                ELSE
                                    IF     NVL (v_prem_waiver, 'N') <> 'Y'
                                       AND v_clm_vouch_alloc <> 'Y'
                                    THEN
                                        v_bct_code :=
                                            fms_rcts_pkg.get_rcpt_debited_bank (
                                                pl.opr_fms_receipt_pk);
                                        v_contra_acc :=
                                            get_receipting_acc (
                                                v_acc_type,
                                                pl.pol_prod_code,
                                                v_org_code,
                                                v_rct_branch,
                                                NVL (v_fms_unknown_reposting,
                                                     'N'),
                                                v_param_val,
                                                v_fms_receipt_pk);
                                        valid_acc (v_contra_acc,
                                                   v_org_code,
                                                   v_rct_branch,
                                                   'Receipting Accuount..');
                                    END IF;
                                END IF;
                            END IF;

                            v_count := v_count + 1;
                            interface_append_gl (
                                v_trans_code,                 -- v_trans_code,
                                v_user,                         -- v_raise_by,
                                pl.pol_code,                    -- v_pol_code,
                                pl.pol_prod_code,              -- v_prod_code,
                                NULL,                            -- v_vchr_no,
                                pl.opr_code,                    -- v_opr_code,
                                v_oppr_code,                   -- v_oppr_code,
                                v_rct_code,                       --v_rcpt_no,
                                v_count,                           -- v_count,
                                   'UNPROCESSED RCPTS - DR_RCT TO '
                                || v_msg
                                || ' - '
                                || NVL (pl.pol_policy_no, pl.pol_proposal_no)
                                || v_loan_narration,
                                -- v_narrative,
                                ABS (NVL (v_unprocessed_rcpts, 0)),
                                -- v_amount,
                                v_opr_drcr,                         -- v_drcr,
                                v_unp_trnt_gl_code,
                                -- v_acc_number1,
                                v_rct_branch,                -- v_branch_code,
                                v_gl_trans,
                                NULL,
                                --v_cad_code       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                NULL,
                                --v_otop_code              NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                NULL,
                                --v_fpmt_code              NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                NULL,
                                --v_ort_code               NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                NULL,
                                --v_btr_no                 NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                NULL,
                                --v_ppr_code               NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                NULL,
                                --v_ocl_code                NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                NULL,
                                --v_agn_code                NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                NULL,
                                --v_trans_no                NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                v_cvrg_area,
                                --v_covrg_area_code                NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                v_spoke_code,
                                --v_spoke_code                NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                v_sbu_code,
                                --v_sbu_code                NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                v_location_code --v_loc_code                NUMBER DEFAULT NULL
                                               );
                            v_tot_amt :=
                                  NVL (v_tot_amt, 0)
                                + ABS (NVL (v_unprocessed_rcpts, 0));
                        END IF;

                        --END LOOP;
                        v_opr_code1 := pl.opr_code;
                    END LOOP;
                END IF;

                IF v_tot_amt <> 0
                THEN
                    SELECT DECODE (v_opr_drcr, 'D', 'C', 'D')
                      INTO v_drcr
                      FROM DUAL;

                    IF    v_process IN ('MTR',
                                        'LOAN',
                                        'UNPROCESSED_RCPTS',
                                        'VALUATION',
                                        'PN',
                                        'SURR')
                       OR v_opr_code IS NOT NULL
                    THEN
                        BEGIN
                            SELECT pol_prod_code
                              INTO v_prod_code
                              FROM lms_ord_prem_receipts, lms_policies
                             WHERE     opr_pol_code = pol_code
                                   AND opr_code = v_opr_code;
                        EXCEPTION
                            WHEN OTHERS
                            THEN
                                NULL;
                        END;

                        v_msg := 'RECEIPT ALLOCATION';
                    ELSE
                        BEGIN
                            SELECT rcd_prod_code
                              INTO v_prod_code
                              FROM fms_rcpt_dtls
                             WHERE     rcd_rct_no = v_receipt_pk
                                   AND rcd_drcr = 'C';
                        EXCEPTION
                            WHEN OTHERS
                            THEN
                                NULL;
                        END;

                        v_msg := 'RECEIPT ALLOCATION';
                    END IF;

                    v_count := v_count + 1;
                    interface_append_gl (v_trans_code,        -- v_trans_code,
                                         v_user,                -- v_raise_by,
                                         NULL,                  -- v_pol_code,
                                         v_prod_code,          -- v_prod_code,
                                         NULL,                   -- v_vchr_no,
                                         NULL,                  -- v_opr_code,
                                         NULL,                 -- v_oppr_code,
                                         v_rct_code,              --v_rcpt_no,
                                         v_count,                  -- v_count,
                                         v_msg,                -- v_narrative,
                                         NVL (v_tot_amt, 0),      -- v_amount,
                                         v_drcr,                    -- v_drcr,
                                         v_contra_acc,       -- v_acc_number1,
                                         v_rct_branch,       -- v_branch_code,
                                         v_gl_trans,
                                         NULL,
                                         --v_cad_code       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                         NULL,
                                         --v_otop_code              NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                         NULL,
                                         --v_fpmt_code              NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                         NULL,
                                         --v_ort_code               NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                         NULL,
                                         --v_btr_no                 NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                         NULL,
                                         --v_ppr_code               NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                         NULL,
                                         --v_ocl_code                NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                         NULL,
                                         --v_agn_code                NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                         NULL,
                                         --v_trans_no                NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                         v_cvrg_area,
                                         --v_covrg_area_code                NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                         v_spoke_code,
                                         --v_spoke_code                NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                         v_sbu_code,
                                         --v_sbu_code                NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                         v_location_code --v_loc_code                NUMBER DEFAULT NULL
                                                        );
                END IF;

                -- RAISE_ERROR('v_gl_trans=============='||v_gl_trans.COUNT);
                interface_update_vgl (v_trans_code,            --v_trans_code,
                                      v_user,                    --v_raise_by,
                                      NULL,                      --v_pol_code,
                                      v_date,                        --v_date,
                                      v_opr_code,                --v_opr_code,
                                      v_oppr_code,              --v_oppr_code,
                                      'LMS RECEIPTS BATCH', --v_btc_description,
                                      'JV',                      --v_btc_type,
                                      v_rct_branch,           --v_branch_code,
                                      NVL (v_description, 'LMS RECEIPT'),
                                      --v_description,
                                      v_rct_code,                 --v_rcpt_no,
                                      v_gl_trans,                 --v_gl_trans
                                      NULL,                     --v_otop_code,
                                      NULL,                     --v_otop_code,
                                      NULL,                      --v_fpmt_code
                                      NULL,                       --v_ort_code
                                      NULL,                         --v_btr_no
                                      NULL,                       --v_ppr_code
                                      NULL,  --v_ocl_code NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                      NULL,  --v_agn_code NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                      v_trans_no, --v_trans_no NUMBER DEFAULT NULL
                                      NULL                       --v_curr_code
                                          );

                BEGIN
                    UPDATE lms_interface_table
                       SET itb_process = v_process, itb_acc_type = v_acc_type
                     WHERE itb_transaction_code = v_trans_code;
                EXCEPTION
                    WHEN OTHERS
                    THEN
                        NULL;
                END;
            END IF;
        ELSE
            --raise_error('v_rct_code = '||v_rct_code||'; OPPR_RECEIPT_NO = '||v_opr_receipt_trans_code||'; v_oppr_code = '||v_oppr_code||'; v_opr_code = '||v_opr_code);
            FOR pr IN cur_prop_cb_amt
            LOOP
                v_branch_code := pr.pol_bra_code;
                v_prod_code := pr.pol_prod_code;

                IF pr.pol_bra_code IS NULL
                THEN
                    raise_error ('BRANCH NOT DEFINED FOR THIS RECORD....');
                ELSIF pr.pol_prod_code IS NULL
                THEN
                    IF pr.ppr_code IS NULL
                    THEN
                        raise_error (
                               'Define product for Annuity No.'
                            || pr.pol_proposal_no
                            || '...');
                    ELSE
                        raise_error (
                               'Define product for Proposal No.'
                            || pr.pol_proposal_no
                            || '...');
                    END IF;
                END IF;

                IF v_oppr_code IS NOT NULL
                THEN
                    BEGIN
                        --             RAISE_ERROR('v_oppr_code===M=='||v_oppr_code);
                        SELECT NVL (oppr_drcr, 'C'),
                               DECODE (NVL (oppr_drcr, 'C'), 'C', 'D', 'C'),
                               oppr_fms_receipt_pk
                          INTO v_oppr_drcr, v_oppr_chk_drcr, v_fms_receipt_pk
                          FROM lms_ord_proposal_rcpts
                         WHERE oppr_code = v_oppr_code;
                    EXCEPTION
                        WHEN OTHERS
                        THEN
                            raise_error (
                                'ERROR RETRIEVING PROPOSAL RCPT DTLS...');
                    END;

                    v_opr_drcr := v_oppr_drcr;
                    v_fms_receipt_pk :=
                        NVL (v_receipt_pk, pr.oppr_fms_receipt_pk);

                    IF v_fms_receipt_pk IS NULL
                    THEN
                        raise_error (
                            'The receipting account is yet to be handled...');
                    END IF;
                ELSE
                    v_fms_receipt_pk := pr.oppr_fms_receipt_pk;

                    IF v_fms_receipt_pk IS NULL
                    THEN
                        raise_error (
                            'The receipting account cannot be null...');
                    END IF;
                END IF;

                v_rct_paymt_mode :=
                    fms_rcts_pkg.rct_paymt_mode (v_fms_receipt_pk);
                v_bct_code :=
                    fms_rcts_pkg.get_rcpt_debited_bank (v_fms_receipt_pk);
                v_contra_acc :=
                    get_receipting_acc (v_acc_type,
                                        pr.pol_prod_code,
                                        v_org_code,
                                        v_rct_branch,
                                        NVL (v_fms_unknown_reposting, 'N'),
                                        v_param_val,
                                        v_fms_receipt_pk);

                IF NVL (pr.paid_amt, 0) <> 0
                THEN
                    get_gl_code ('PRRCT',
                                 pr.pol_prod_code,
                                 v_trnt_code,
                                 v_trnt_gl_code,
                                 v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
                    valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                               v_org_code,
                               pr.pol_bra_code,
                               'PRRCT');
                    v_count1 := v_count1 + 1;
                    interface_append_cb_gl_trans (
                        v_trans_code,                         -- v_trans_code,
                        v_user,                                 -- v_raise_by,
                        pr.pol_code,                            -- v_pol_code,
                        pr.pol_prod_code,                      -- v_prod_code,
                        NULL,                                    -- v_vchr_no,
                        NULL,                                   -- v_opr_code,
                        pr.oppr_code,                          -- v_oppr_code,
                        v_rct_code,                               --v_rcpt_no,
                        v_count1,                                  -- v_count,
                        v_cb_count,                               --v_cb_count
                        'PROPOSAL PREMIUM' || ' - ' || pr.pol_proposal_no,
                        -- v_narrative,
                        pr.paid_amt,                              -- v_amount,
                        v_oppr_drcr,                                -- v_drcr,
                        v_trnt_gl_code,                      -- v_acc_number1,
                        pr.pol_bra_code,
                        -- v_branch_code,
                        v_tcg_rec,
                        NULL,
                        ---v_cad_code       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                        NULL,
                        ---v_otop_code       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                        NULL,
                        --v_fpmt_code       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                        NULL,
                        --v_ort_code        NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                        NULL,
                        --v_btr_no        NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                        pr.ppr_code,
                        --- NUMBER DEFAULT NULL);
                        NULL,
                        --v_ocl_code,  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                        NULL,
                        --v_agn_code,  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                        NULL,
                        --v_trans_no,   NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                        v_cvrg_area,
                        --v_covrg_area_code NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                        v_spoke_code,
                        --v_spoke_code  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                        v_sbu_code,
                        --v_sbu_code   NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                        v_location_code);
                    --v_loc_code  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL
                    v_tot_amt := NVL (v_tot_amt, 0) + pr.paid_amt;
                END IF;

                v_opr_drcr := v_oppr_drcr;
                v_prod_code := pr.pol_prod_code;
                v_pol_code := pr.pol_code;
                v_branch_code := pr.pol_bra_code;
                --v_oppr_code:=pr.oppr_code;
                v_post_cb := 'Y';
            --            IF NVL (pr.prop_chk_amt, 0) <> 0 THEN
            --                Get_Gl_Code ('CHKC',
            --                            pr.pol_prod_code,
            --                            v_trnt_code,
            --                            v_trnt_gl_code,
            --                            v_trnt_contra_gl_code
            --                           );
            --                valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code, v_org_code, pr.pol_bra_code, 'CHKC');
            --                v_count := v_count + 2;
            --                Interface_append_gl(v_trans_code,    -- v_trans_code,
            --                                  v_user,    -- v_raise_by,
            --                                    NULL,    -- v_pol_code,
            --                                  pr.pol_prod_code,    -- v_prod_code,
            --                                  NULL,    -- v_vchr_no,
            --                                  NULL,    -- v_opr_code,
            --                                  pr.oppr_code,    -- v_oppr_code,
            --                                    v_rct_code, --v_rcpt_no,
            --                                  v_count,    -- v_count,
            --                                  'CHECK OFF COMMISSION '||pr.pol_proposal_no,    -- v_narrative,
            --                                  pr.prop_chk_amt,    -- v_amount,
            --                                  v_oppr_chk_drcr,    -- v_drcr,
            --                                  v_trnt_gl_code,    -- v_acc_number1,
            --                                  v_contra_acc,    -- v_acc_number2,
            --                                  pr.pol_bra_code,    -- v_branch_code,
            --                                  v_gl_trans);
            --            END IF;
            END LOOP;

            FOR pl IN cur_pol_cb_amt
            LOOP
                v_post_cnt := NULL;
                v_branch_code := pl.pol_bra_code;
                v_prod_code := pl.pol_prod_code;
                v_pol_code := pl.pol_code;

                BEGIN
                    lms_ord_misc.system_param_val ('POST_FEES_SEPARATELY',
                                                   v_post_fees_sep,
                                                   v_prod_code);
                EXCEPTION
                    WHEN OTHERS
                    THEN
                        raise_error (
                            'PARAMETER ERROR...POST_FEES_SEPARATELY...');
                END;

                BEGIN
                    SELECT opr_drcr
                      INTO v_opr_drcr
                      FROM lms_ord_prem_receipts
                     WHERE opr_code = pl.opr_code;
                EXCEPTION
                    WHEN OTHERS
                    THEN
                        v_opr_drcr := 'C';
                END;

                --            RAISE_ERROR('XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX');
                IF pl.pol_prod_code IS NULL
                THEN
                    raise_error (
                           'Define product for Policy No.'
                        || pl.pol_policy_no
                        || v_loan_narration
                        || '...');
                END IF;

                BEGIN
                    SELECT endr_sbu_code,
                           endr_spoke_code,
                           endr_coverage_area_code,
                           endr_location_code,
                           pol_status
                      INTO v_sbu_code,
                           v_spoke_code,
                           v_cvrg_area,
                           v_location_code,
                           v_pol_status
                      FROM lms_policies, lms_policy_endorsements
                     WHERE     pol_current_endr_code = endr_code
                           AND pol_code = pl.pol_code;
                EXCEPTION
                    WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND
                    THEN
                        NULL;
                    WHEN OTHERS
                    THEN
                        NULL;
                END;

                v_alloc_to := NVL (pl.alloc_to, 'PR');
                --            IF v_alloc_to = 'PR' THEN
                get_gl_code ('UNP_PR',
                             pl.pol_prod_code,
                             v_trnt_code,
                             v_unp_trnt_gl_code,
                             v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
                valid_acc (v_unp_trnt_gl_code,
                           v_org_code,
                           v_rct_branch,
                           'UNP_PR');
                v_msg := 'UNP_PR';

                --            ELSIF v_alloc_to = 'LN' THEN
                --                Get_Gl_Code ('UNP_LN',
                --                                     pl.pol_prod_code,
                --                                     v_trnt_code,
                --                                     v_unp_trnt_gl_code,
                --                                     v_trnt_contra_gl_code
                --                                    );
                --                valid_acc (v_unp_trnt_gl_code, v_org_code, v_rct_branch, 'UNP_LN');
                --                v_msg := 'UNP_LN';
                --            ELSIF v_alloc_to = 'PN' THEN
                --                Get_Gl_Code ('UNP_PN',
                --                                     pl.pol_prod_code,
                --                                     v_trnt_code,
                --                                     v_unp_trnt_gl_code,
                --                                     v_trnt_contra_gl_code
                --                                    );
                --                valid_acc (v_unp_trnt_gl_code, v_org_code, v_rct_branch, 'UNP_PN');
                --                v_msg := 'UNP_PN';
                --            END IF;

                --raise_error('# v_opr_code = '||v_opr_code||'; v_Receipt_PK = '||v_Receipt_PK||'; v_fms_receipt_pk = '||v_fms_receipt_pk||'; pl.OPR_FMS_RECEIPT_PK = '||pl.OPR_FMS_RECEIPT_PK);
                IF v_opr_code IS NULL
                THEN
                    v_post_cb := 'Y';
                    v_fms_receipt_pk :=
                        NVL (v_receipt_pk, pl.opr_fms_receipt_pk);

                    IF v_fms_receipt_pk IS NULL
                    THEN
                        raise_error (
                            'Receipting account cannot be null for policy recipts...');
                    END IF;

                    v_rct_paymt_mode :=
                        fms_rcts_pkg.rct_paymt_mode (v_fms_receipt_pk);
                    v_bct_code :=
                        fms_rcts_pkg.get_rcpt_debited_bank (v_fms_receipt_pk);
                    v_contra_acc :=
                        get_receipting_acc (
                            v_acc_type,
                            pl.pol_prod_code,
                            v_org_code,
                            v_rct_branch,
                            NVL (v_fms_unknown_reposting, 'N'),
                            v_param_val,
                            v_fms_receipt_pk);
                    v_prem_amt :=
                        NVL (pl.premium_amt, 0) + NVL (v_nfl_alloc, 0);
                    v_chkoff_comm := NVL (pl.chkoff_comm, 0);
                    v_loan_amt := NVL (pl.loan_amt, 0) - NVL (v_nfl_alloc, 0);
                    v_loan_principal_amt := NVL (pl.loan_principal_amt, 0);
                    v_loan_intr_amt := NVL (pl.loan_intr_amt, 0);
                    v_loan_unp_amt := NVL (pl.loan_unp_amt, 0);
                    v_pens_amt := NVL (pl.pension_contr, 0);
                    v_inv_admin := NVL (pl.investment_admin, 0);
                    v_inv_fee := NVL (pl.investment_fee, 0);
                    v_inv_contri := NVL (pl.investment_contri, 0);
                    v_comfnd := NVL (pl.comfnd, 0);
                    v_prem_comm :=
                        NVL (pl.prem_comm, 0) + NVL (pl.pens_comm, 0);
                ELSE
                    v_fms_receipt_pk :=
                        NVL (v_receipt_pk, pl.opr_fms_receipt_pk);

                    BEGIN
                        SELECT opr_origin,
                               NVL (opr_drcr, 'C'),
                               opr_fms_receipt_pk
                          INTO v_origin, v_opr_drcr, v_fms_receipt_pk
                          FROM lms_ord_prem_receipts
                         WHERE opr_code = v_opr_code;
                    EXCEPTION
                        WHEN OTHERS
                        THEN
                            raise_error ('ERROR RETRIEVING RCPT DTLS....');
                    END;

                    IF     NOT NVL (v_origin, 'M') = 'I'
                       AND (    NVL (v_prem_waiver, 'N') <> 'Y'
                            AND NVL (v_process, 'X') NOT IN
                                    ('MTR',
                                     'LOAN',
                                     'UNPROCESSED_RCPTS',
                                     'VALUATION',
                                     'PN',
                                     'SURR'))
                    THEN
                        SELECT opr_source
                          INTO v_source
                          FROM lms_ord_prem_receipts
                         WHERE opr_code = pl.opr_code;

                        IF v_source IN ('TRANSFER')
                        THEN
                            SELECT COUNT (1)
                              INTO v_post_cnt
                              FROM lms_ord_recpt_transfer,
                                   lms_interface_table
                             WHERE     ort_opr_code_to = pl.opr_code
                                   AND ort_code = itb_ort_code;

                            IF v_post_cnt = 0
                            THEN
                                v_post := 'N';
                            END IF;
                        ELSE
                            raise_error (
                                'INTERFACE PROCESSING ALLOWED ONLY FOR RCPTS ORIGINATING FROM FMS....');
                        END IF;
                    END IF;

                    --       raise_error('v_ltr_btr_trans_code===M'||v_ltr_btr_trans_code);
                    IF v_trans_no IS NOT NULL
                    THEN
                        BEGIN
                            SELECT ltr_btr_trans_code
                              INTO v_ltr_btr_trans_code
                              FROM lms_transactions
                             WHERE ltr_trans_no = v_trans_no;
                        EXCEPTION
                            WHEN OTHERS
                            THEN
                                NULL;
                        END;
                    END IF;

                    --               raise_error('# v_reverse_alloc = '||v_reverse_alloc||'; v_ltr_btr_trans_code = '||v_ltr_btr_trans_code||'; v_prem_waiver = '||v_prem_waiver
                    --               ||'; v_clm_vouch_alloc = '||v_clm_vouch_alloc||'; v_clm_caus_type = '||v_clm_caus_type);
                    --raise_error('# v_reverse_alloc = '||v_reverse_alloc);
                    IF NVL (v_reverse_alloc, 'N') = 'N'
                    THEN
                        v_contra_acc := v_unp_trnt_gl_code;
                        v_prem_amt := NVL (v_prm_amt, 0);
                        v_chkoff_comm := NVL (v_chk_com, 0);
                        v_loan_amt := NVL (v_ln_amt, 0);
                        v_pens_amt := NVL (v_pn_amt, 0);
                        v_inv_admin := NVL (v_adm_inv, 0);
                        v_inv_fee := NVL (v_fee_inv, 0);
                        v_inv_contri := NVL (v_contri_inv, 0);
                        v_comfnd := NVL (v_compfund, 0);
                        --raise_error('v_fms_receipt_pk === '||pl.opr_fms_receipt_pk);
                        v_fms_receipt_pk :=
                            NVL (v_receipt_pk, pl.opr_fms_receipt_pk);
                        v_bct_code :=
                            fms_rcts_pkg.get_rcpt_debited_bank (
                                v_fms_receipt_pk);
                        v_rct_paymt_mode :=
                            fms_rcts_pkg.rct_paymt_mode (v_fms_receipt_pk);
                    --                 raise_error('# v_fms_receipt_pk = '||v_fms_receipt_pk);
                    ELSE
                        IF v_ltr_btr_trans_code = 'DCOM'
                        THEN
                            v_post_cb := 'N';
                            get_gl_code ('AGNT_DBT',
                                         pl.pol_prod_code,
                                         v_trnt_code,
                                         v_trnt_gl_code,
                                         v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
                            valid_acc (v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                       v_org_code,
                                       pl.pol_bra_code,
                                       'AGNT_DBT');
                            v_contra_acc := v_trnt_contra_gl_code;
                        ELSIF NVL (v_prem_waiver, 'N') = 'Y'
                        THEN
                            v_post_cb := 'N';
                            get_gl_code ('PRWAIV',
                                         pl.pol_prod_code,
                                         v_trnt_code,
                                         v_trnt_gl_code,
                                         v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
                            valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                                       v_org_code,
                                       pl.pol_bra_code,
                                       'PRWAIV');
                            v_contra_acc := v_trnt_gl_code;
                        --claim voucher allocation
                        ELSIF NVL (v_clm_vouch_alloc, 'N') = 'Y'
                        THEN
                            v_post_cb := 'N';

                            IF v_clm_caus_type = 'DTH'
                            THEN
                                get_gl_code ('CP_DTH', --Claim outstanding acc
                                             pl.pol_prod_code,
                                             v_trnt_code,
                                             v_trnt_gl_code,
                                             v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
                                valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                                           v_org_code,
                                           pl.pol_bra_code,
                                           'CP_DTH');
                                v_contra_acc := v_trnt_gl_code;
                            ELSE
                                get_gl_code ('CP_DIS', --Claim outstanding acc
                                             pl.pol_prod_code,
                                             v_trnt_code,
                                             v_trnt_gl_code,
                                             v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
                                valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                                           v_org_code,
                                           pl.pol_bra_code,
                                           'CP_DIS');
                                v_contra_acc := v_trnt_gl_code;
                            END IF;
                        ELSIF v_process = 'VALUATION'
                        THEN
                            get_gl_code ('INVADM',
                                         pl.pol_prod_code,
                                         v_trnt_code,
                                         v_contra_acc,
                                         v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
                            valid_acc (v_contra_acc,
                                       v_org_code,
                                       pl.pol_bra_code,
                                       'INVADM');
                        ELSE
                            IF v_param_val = 'N'
                            THEN
                                v_post_cb := 'Y';
                                v_fms_receipt_pk :=
                                    NVL (v_receipt_pk, pl.opr_fms_receipt_pk);

                                IF v_fms_receipt_pk IS NULL
                                THEN
                                    raise_error (
                                           'Receipting account cannot be null for policy recipts....2. acc type'
                                        || pl.acc_type
                                        || ' pol_prod_code '
                                        || pl.pol_prod_code
                                        || '  v_rct_branch '
                                        || v_rct_branch
                                        || ' v_param_val '
                                        || v_param_val
                                        || ' v_trnt_code '
                                        || v_trnt_code);
                                END IF;

                                v_rct_paymt_mode :=
                                    fms_rcts_pkg.rct_paymt_mode (
                                        v_fms_receipt_pk);
                                v_bct_code :=
                                    fms_rcts_pkg.get_rcpt_debited_bank (
                                        v_fms_receipt_pk);
                                v_contra_acc :=
                                    get_receipting_acc (v_acc_type,
                                                        pl.pol_prod_code,
                                                        v_org_code,
                                                        v_rct_branch,
                                                        'N',
                                                        v_param_val,
                                                        v_fms_receipt_pk);
                            ELSE
                                v_contra_acc :=
                                    get_receipting_acc (v_acc_type,
                                                        pl.pol_prod_code,
                                                        v_org_code,
                                                        v_rct_branch,
                                                        'N');
                            END IF;
                        END IF;

                        v_prem_amt :=
                            NVL (pl.premium_amt, 0) + NVL (v_nfl_alloc, 0);
                        v_chkoff_comm := NVL (pl.chkoff_comm, 0);
                        v_loan_amt :=
                            NVL (pl.loan_amt, 0) - NVL (v_nfl_alloc, 0);
                        v_loan_principal_amt :=
                            NVL (pl.loan_principal_amt, 0);
                        v_loan_intr_amt := NVL (pl.loan_intr_amt, 0);
                        v_loan_unp_amt := NVL (pl.loan_unp_amt, 0);
                        v_pens_amt := NVL (pl.pension_contr, 0);
                        v_inv_admin := NVL (pl.investment_admin, 0);
                        v_inv_fee := NVL (pl.investment_fee, 0);
                        v_inv_contri := NVL (pl.investment_contri, 0);
                        v_comfnd := NVL (pl.comfnd, 0);
                        v_prem_comm :=
                            NVL (pl.prem_comm, 0) + NVL (pl.pens_comm, 0);
                    END IF;
                END IF;

                --RAISE_ERROR(v_rct_branch||'=v_contra_acc='||v_contra_acc);
                --premium
                IF NVL (v_post, 'Y') = 'N'
                THEN
                    IF NVL (v_prem_amt, 0) <> 0
                    THEN
                        IF NVL (v_post_fees_sep, 'Y') = 'N'
                        THEN
                            v_prem_amt :=
                                  NVL (v_prem_amt, 0)
                                + NVL (v_inv_fee, 0)
                                + NVL (v_inv_admin, 0)
                                + NVL (v_comfnd, 0);
                        END IF;

                        get_gl_code ('UP',
                                     pl.pol_prod_code,
                                     v_trnt_code,
                                     v_trnt_gl_code,
                                     v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                     NULL,
                                     pl.renewal);
                        valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                                   v_org_code,
                                   pl.pol_bra_code,
                                   'UP');
                        v_count := v_count + 1;
                        interface_append_gl (
                            v_trans_code,                     -- v_trans_code,
                            v_user,                             -- v_raise_by,
                            pl.pol_code,                        -- v_pol_code,
                            pl.pol_prod_code,                  -- v_prod_code,
                            NULL,                                -- v_vchr_no,
                            pl.opr_code,                        -- v_opr_code,
                            NULL,                              -- v_oppr_code,
                            v_rct_code,                           --v_rcpt_no,
                            v_count,                               -- v_count,
                               'ALLOCATED PREMIUM'
                            || ' - '
                            || NVL (pl.pol_policy_no, pl.pol_proposal_no)

                                    v_sbu_code,
                                    --v_sbu_code                NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                    v_location_code --v_loc_code                NUMBER DEFAULT NULL
                                                   );
                            END IF;

                            UPDATE lms_ord_receipt_taxes
                               SET orts_posted = 'Y'
                             WHERE     orts_opr_code = t.orts_opr_code
                                   AND orts_trt_code = t.trt_code;
                        END IF;
                    END LOOP;
                --===================================================
                END IF;
            END LOOP;

            -- V_OPR_CODE IS NULL AND V_OPPR_RCT_TRANS_CODE  ARE NULL IF CALLED FROM FMS.....

            --raise_error ('v_fms_receipt_pk = ' || v_fms_receipt_pk||'; v_post = '||v_post);
            IF NVL (v_post, 'Y') = 'N'
            THEN
                IF v_opr_code IS NULL OR v_oppr_code IS NULL
                THEN
                    IF     NVL (v_fms_unknown_reposting, 'N') = 'N'
                       AND NVL (v_reverse_alloc, 'N') <> 'C'
                    THEN
                        v_unknown_amt :=
                            fms_interfaces_pkg.rct_unknown_amt (v_receipt_pk);
                    END IF;

                    --RAISE_ERROR('v_gl_trans11111=============='||v_gl_trans.COUNT);
                    IF NVL (v_unknown_amt, 0) <> 0
                    THEN
                        IF v_acc_type = 'CK'
                        THEN
                            get_gl_code ('UNK_CHKC',
                                         NULL,
                                         v_trnt_code,
                                         v_trnt_gl_code,
                                         v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
                            valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                                       v_org_code,
                                       v_rct_branch,
                                       'UNK_CHKC');
                        ELSE
                            get_gl_code ('UNK',
                                         NULL,
                                         v_trnt_code,
                                         v_trnt_gl_code,
                                         v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
                            valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                                       v_org_code,
                                       v_rct_branch,
                                       'UNK');
                        END IF;

                        v_count := v_count + 1;

                        IF v_opr_drcr = 'C'
                        THEN
                            interface_append_gl (
                                v_trans_code,                 -- v_trans_code,
                                v_user,                         -- v_raise_by,
                                NULL,                           -- v_pol_code,
                                NULL,                          -- v_prod_code,
                                NULL,                            -- v_vchr_no,
                                v_opr_code,                     -- v_opr_code,
                                v_oppr_code,                   -- v_oppr_code,
                                v_rct_code,                       --v_rcpt_no,
                                v_count,                           -- v_count,
                                'ERRONEOUS CHK-OFF DEDUCTIONS', -- v_narrative,
                                NVL (v_unknown_amt, 0),           -- v_amount,
                                'D',                                -- v_drcr,
                                v_trnt_contra_gl_code,       -- v_acc_number1,
                                v_trnt_gl_code,              -- v_acc_number2,
                                v_rct_branch,                -- v_branch_code,
                                v_gl_trans);
                            v_tot_amt :=
                                NVL (v_tot_amt, 0) + NVL (v_unknown_amt, 0);
                        ELSE
                            interface_append_gl (
                                v_trans_code,                 -- v_trans_code,
                                v_user,                         -- v_raise_by,
                                NULL,                           -- v_pol_code,
                                NULL,                          -- v_prod_code,
                                NULL,                            -- v_vchr_no,
                                v_opr_code,                     -- v_opr_code,
                                v_oppr_code,                   -- v_oppr_code,
                                v_rct_code,                       --v_rcpt_no,
                                v_count,                           -- v_count,
                                'ERRONEOUS CHK-OFF DEDUCTIONS', -- v_narrative,
                                NVL (v_unknown_amt, 0),           -- v_amount,
                                'C',                                -- v_drcr,
                                v_trnt_contra_gl_code,       -- v_acc_number1,
                                v_trnt_gl_code,              -- v_acc_number2,
                                v_rct_branch,                -- v_branch_code,
                                v_gl_trans);
                            v_tot_amt :=
                                NVL (v_tot_amt, 0) + NVL (v_unknown_amt, 0);
                        END IF;
                    END IF;
                END IF;

                --             IF NVL (v_double_sure_amt, 0) <> 0 THEN
                --                 v_count := v_count + 2;
                --                 fms_vouchers_pkg.append_gl_trans (v_count,
                --                                                                      'DOUBLE SURE',
                --                                                                      NVL (v_double_sure_amt, 0),
                --                                                                      'D',
                --                                                                      v_contra_acc,
                --                                                                      v_trnt_gl_code,
                --                                                                      v_rct_branch,
                --                                                                      v_gl_trans
                --                                                                     );
                --             END IF;
                IF v_oppr_code IS NULL
                THEN
                    v_unprocessed_rcpts_total := 0;

                    FOR pl IN cur_pol_cb_amt
                    LOOP
                        BEGIN
                            SELECT endr_sbu_code,
                                   endr_spoke_code,
                                   endr_coverage_area_code,
                                   endr_location_code,
                                   pol_status
                              INTO v_sbu_code,
                                   v_spoke_code,
                                   v_cvrg_area,
                                   v_location_code,
                                   v_pol_status
                              FROM lms_policies, lms_policy_endorsements
                             WHERE     pol_current_endr_code = endr_code
                                   AND pol_code = pl.pol_code;
                        EXCEPTION
                            WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND
                            THEN
                                NULL;
                            WHEN OTHERS
                            THEN
                                NULL;
                        END;

                        --FOR P IN Prod LOOP
                        v_unprocessed_rcpts := 0;
                        v_unprocessed_rcpts :=
                            get_unprocessed_rcpt (v_rct_code,
                                                  v_date,
                                                  pl.pol_prod_code,
                                                  NULL,
                                                  v_receipt_pk,
                                                  v_opr_rct_trans_code,
                                                  pl.pol_code,
                                                  pl.opr_code);
                        v_unprocessed_rcpts_total :=
                              NVL (v_unprocessed_rcpts_total, 0)
                            + NVL (v_unprocessed_rcpts, 0);

                        IF ABS (NVL (v_unprocessed_rcpts, 0)) > 0
                        THEN
                            v_alloc_to := NVL (pl.alloc_to, 'PR');

                            IF v_alloc_to = 'LN'
                            THEN
                                raise_error (
                                       'POSTING TO UNP_LN BLOCKED2.....Policy No.'
                                    || pl.pol_policy_no
                                    || v_loan_narration);
                            END IF;

                            IF v_alloc_to = 'PR'
                            THEN
                                get_gl_code ('UNP_PR',
                                             pl.pol_prod_code,
                                             v_trnt_code,
                                             v_unp_trnt_gl_code,
                                             v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                             NULL,
                                             pl.renewal);
                                valid_acc (v_unp_trnt_gl_code,
                                           v_org_code,
                                           v_rct_branch,
                                           'UNP_PR');
                                v_msg := 'UNP_PR';

                                BEGIN
                                    lms_ord_misc.system_param_val (
                                        'ALLOC_INACTIVE_PREM_TO_REFUND_AC',
                                        v_alloc_to_ref);
                                EXCEPTION
                                    WHEN OTHERS
                                    THEN
                                        v_alloc_to_ref := 'N';
                                END;

                                IF     v_alloc_to_ref = 'Y'
                                   AND v_pol_status IN ('C',
                                                        'J',
                                                        'PU',
                                                        'S',
                                                        'CPU',
                                                        'DC',
                                                        'M',
                                                        'L',
                                                        'FL')
                                THEN
                                    get_gl_code ('PLREF',
                                                 pl.pol_prod_code,
                                                 v_trnt_code,
                                                 v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                                 v_unp_trnt_gl_code,
                                                 NULL,
                                                 pl.renewal);
                                    valid_acc (v_unp_trnt_gl_code,
                                               v_org_code,
                                               v_rct_branch,
                                               'PLREF');
                                    v_msg := 'PLREF';
                                END IF;
                            ELSIF v_alloc_to = 'LN'
