                            THEN
                                get_gl_code ('UNP_LN',
                                             pl.pol_prod_code,
                                             v_trnt_code,
                                             v_unp_trnt_gl_code,
                                             v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                             NULL,
                                             pl.renewal);
                                valid_acc (v_unp_trnt_gl_code,
                                           v_org_code,
                                           v_rct_branch,
                                           'UNP_LN');
                                v_msg := 'UNP_LN';
                            ELSIF v_alloc_to = 'PN'
                            THEN
                                get_gl_code ('UNP_PN',
                                             pl.pol_prod_code,
                                             v_trnt_code,
                                             v_unp_trnt_gl_code,
                                             v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                             NULL,
                                             pl.renewal);
                                valid_acc (v_unp_trnt_gl_code,
                                           v_org_code,
                                           v_rct_branch,
                                           'UNP_PN');
                                v_msg := 'UNP_PN';
                            END IF;

                            IF NVL (v_acc_type, 'D') = 'CK'
                            THEN
                                get_gl_code ('CHKC',
                                             pl.pol_prod_code,
                                             v_trnt_code,
                                             v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                             v_contra_acc,
                                             NULL,
                                             pl.renewal);
                                valid_acc (v_contra_acc,
                                           v_org_code,
                                           v_rct_branch,
                                           'CHKC');
                            ELSIF NVL (v_acc_type, 'D') = 'JV'
                            THEN
                                get_gl_code ('JV_RCT',
                                             pl.pol_prod_code,
                                             v_trnt_code,
                                             v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                             v_contra_acc);
                                valid_acc (v_contra_acc,
                                           v_org_code,
                                           v_rct_branch,
                                           'JV_RCT');
                            ELSE
                                IF (   (NVL (v_param_val, 'Y')) = 'Y'
                                    OR (v_acc_type = 'CK'))
                                THEN
                                    get_gl_code ('DR_RCT',
                                                 pl.pol_prod_code,
                                                 v_trnt_code,
                                                 v_contra_acc,
                                                 v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                                 NULL,
                                                 pl.renewal);
                                    valid_acc (v_contra_acc,
                                               v_org_code,
                                               v_rct_branch,
                                               'DR_RCT');
                                ELSE
                                    v_fms_receipt_pk :=
                                        NVL (v_receipt_pk,
                                             pl.opr_fms_receipt_pk);

                                    IF v_fms_receipt_pk IS NULL
                                    THEN
                                        raise_error (
                                            'Receipting account cannot be null for policy recipts....');
                                    END IF;

                                    IF     NVL (v_prem_waiver, 'N') <> 'Y'
                                       AND v_clm_vouch_alloc <> 'Y'
                                    THEN
                                        v_rct_paymt_mode :=
                                            fms_rcts_pkg.rct_paymt_mode (
                                                v_fms_receipt_pk);
                                        v_bct_code :=
                                            fms_rcts_pkg.get_rcpt_debited_bank (
                                                v_fms_receipt_pk);
                                        --v_bct_code:=fms_rcts_pkg.get_rcpt_debited_bank(pl.OPR_FMS_RECEIPT_PK);
                                        v_contra_acc :=
                                            get_receipting_acc (
                                                v_acc_type,
                                                pl.pol_prod_code,
                                                v_org_code,
                                                v_rct_branch,
                                                NVL (v_fms_unknown_reposting,
                                                     'N'),
                                                v_param_val,
                                                v_fms_receipt_pk);

                                        valid_acc (v_contra_acc,
                                                   v_org_code,
                                                   v_rct_branch,
                                                   'Receipting Accuount..');
                                    END IF;
                                END IF;
                            END IF;

                            v_count := v_count + 1;
                            interface_append_gl (
                                v_trans_code,                 -- v_trans_code,
                                v_user,                         -- v_raise_by,
                                pl.pol_code,                    -- v_pol_code,
                                pl.pol_prod_code,              -- v_prod_code,
                                NULL,                            -- v_vchr_no,
                                pl.opr_code,                    -- v_opr_code,
                                v_oppr_code,                   -- v_oppr_code,
                                v_rct_code,                       --v_rcpt_no,
                                v_count,                           -- v_count,
                                   'UNPROCESSED RCPTS - DR_RCT TO '
                                || v_msg
                                || ' - '
                                || NVL (pl.pol_policy_no, pl.pol_proposal_no)
                                || v_loan_narration,
                                -- v_narrative,
                                ABS (NVL (v_unprocessed_rcpts, 0)),
                                -- v_amount,
                                v_opr_drcr,                         -- v_drcr,
                                v_unp_trnt_gl_code,
                                -- v_acc_number1,
                                v_rct_branch,                -- v_branch_code,
                                v_gl_trans,
                                NULL,
                                --v_cad_code       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                NULL,
                                --v_otop_code              NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                NULL,
                                --v_fpmt_code              NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                NULL,
                                --v_ort_code               NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                NULL,
                                --v_btr_no                 NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                NULL,
                                --v_ppr_code               NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                NULL,
                                --v_ocl_code                NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                NULL,
                                --v_agn_code                NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                NULL,
                                --v_trans_no                NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                v_cvrg_area,
                                --v_covrg_area_code                NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                v_spoke_code,
                                --v_spoke_code                NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                v_sbu_code,
                                --v_sbu_code                NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                v_location_code --v_loc_code                NUMBER DEFAULT NULL
                                               );
                            v_tot_amt :=
                                  NVL (v_tot_amt, 0)
                                + ABS (NVL (v_unprocessed_rcpts, 0));
                        END IF;
                    --END LOOP;
                    END LOOP;
                END IF;

                IF NVL (v_tot_amt, 0) <> 0
                THEN
                    IF v_opr_code IS NOT NULL
                    THEN
                        SELECT pol_prod_code, pol_code, pol_bra_code
                          INTO v_prod_code, v_pol_code, v_branch_code
                          FROM lms_ord_prem_receipts, lms_policies
                         WHERE     opr_code = v_opr_code
                               AND pol_code = opr_pol_code;
                    ELSIF v_oppr_code IS NOT NULL
                    THEN
                        SELECT pol_prod_code, pol_code, pol_bra_code
                          INTO v_prod_code, v_pol_code, v_branch_code
                          FROM lms_ord_proposal_rcpts, lms_policies
                         WHERE     oppr_code = v_opr_code
                               AND pol_code = oppr_pol_code;
                    END IF;

                    v_count := v_count + 1;

                    IF v_opr_drcr = 'C'
                    THEN
                        interface_append_gl (v_trans_code,    -- v_trans_code,
                                             v_user,            -- v_raise_by,
                                             v_pol_code,        -- v_pol_code,
                                             v_prod_code,      -- v_prod_code,
                                             NULL,               -- v_vchr_no,
                                             v_opr_code,        -- v_opr_code,
                                             v_oppr_code,      -- v_oppr_code,
                                             v_rct_code,          --v_rcpt_no,
                                             v_count,              -- v_count,
                                             'RECEIPT ALLOCATION', -- v_narrative,
                                             NVL (v_tot_amt, 0),  -- v_amount,
                                             'D',                   -- v_drcr,
                                             v_contra_acc,   -- v_acc_number1,
                                             v_branch_code,  -- v_branch_code,
                                             v_gl_trans,
                                             NULL, --v_cad_code       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                             NULL, --v_otop_code              NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                             NULL, --v_fpmt_code              NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                             NULL, --v_ort_code               NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                             NULL, --v_btr_no                 NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                             NULL, --v_ppr_code               NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                             NULL, --v_ocl_code                NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                             NULL, --v_agn_code                NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                             NULL, --v_trans_no                NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                             v_cvrg_area,
                                             --v_covrg_area_code                NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                             v_spoke_code,
                                             --v_spoke_code                NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                             v_sbu_code,
                                             --v_sbu_code                NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                             v_location_code --v_loc_code                NUMBER DEFAULT NULL
                                                            );
                    ELSE
                        interface_append_gl (v_trans_code,    -- v_trans_code,
                                             v_user,            -- v_raise_by,
                                             v_pol_code,        -- v_pol_code,
                                             v_prod_code,      -- v_prod_code,
                                             NULL,               -- v_vchr_no,
                                             v_opr_code,        -- v_opr_code,
                                             v_oppr_code,      -- v_oppr_code,
                                             v_rct_code,          --v_rcpt_no,
                                             v_count,              -- v_count,
                                             'RECEIPT ALLOCATION', -- v_narrative,
                                             NVL (v_tot_amt, 0),  -- v_amount,
                                             'C',                   -- v_drcr,
                                             v_contra_acc,   -- v_acc_number1,
                                             v_branch_code,  -- v_branch_code,
                                             v_gl_trans,
                                             NULL, --v_cad_code       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                             NULL, --v_otop_code              NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                             NULL, --v_fpmt_code              NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                             NULL, --v_ort_code               NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                             NULL, --v_btr_no                 NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                             NULL, --v_ppr_code               NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                             NULL, --v_ocl_code                NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                             NULL, --v_agn_code                NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                             NULL, --v_trans_no                NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                             v_cvrg_area,
                                             --v_covrg_area_code                NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                             v_spoke_code,
                                             --v_spoke_code                NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                             v_sbu_code,
                                             --v_sbu_code                NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                             v_location_code --v_loc_code                NUMBER DEFAULT NULL
                                                            );
                    END IF;
                END IF;

                IF v_count <> 0
                THEN
                    interface_update_vgl (v_trans_code,        --v_trans_code,
                                          v_user,                --v_raise_by,
                                          NULL,                  --v_pol_code,
                                          v_date,                    --v_date,
                                          v_opr_code,            --v_opr_code,
                                          v_oppr_code,          --v_oppr_code,
                                          'LMS RECEIPTS BATCH', --v_btc_description,
                                          'JV',                  --v_btc_type,
                                          v_rct_branch,       --v_branch_code,
                                          NVL (v_description, 'LMS RECEIPT'),
                                          --v_description,
                                          v_rct_code,             --v_rcpt_no,
                                          v_gl_trans,             --v_gl_trans
                                          NULL, --v_cad_code NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                          NULL,                 --v_otop_code,
                                          NULL,                  --v_fpmt_code
                                          NULL,                   --v_ort_code
                                          NULL,                     --v_btr_no
                                          NULL,                   --v_ppr_code
                                          NULL, --v_ocl_code NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                          NULL, --v_agn_code NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                          v_trans_no, --v_trans_no NUMBER DEFAULT NULL
                                          NULL                   --v_curr_code
                                              );

                    BEGIN
                        UPDATE lms_interface_table
                           SET itb_process = v_process,
                               itb_acc_type = v_acc_type
                         WHERE itb_transaction_code = v_trans_code;
                    EXCEPTION
                        WHEN OTHERS
                        THEN
                            NULL;
                    END;
                END IF;
            ELSE                                                 --v_post ='Y'
                IF v_oppr_code IS NULL
                THEN
                    v_unprocessed_rcpts_total := 0;

                    FOR pl IN cur_pol_cb_amt
                    LOOP
                        BEGIN
                            SELECT endr_sbu_code,
                                   endr_spoke_code,
                                   endr_coverage_area_code,
                                   endr_location_code,
                                   pol_status
                              INTO v_sbu_code,
                                   v_spoke_code,
                                   v_cvrg_area,
                                   v_location_code,
                                   v_pol_status
                              FROM lms_policies, lms_policy_endorsements
                             WHERE     pol_current_endr_code = endr_code
                                   AND pol_code = pl.pol_code;
                        EXCEPTION
                            WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND
                            THEN
                                NULL;
                            WHEN OTHERS
                            THEN
                                NULL;
                        END;

                        --FOR P IN Prod LOOP
                        v_unprocessed_rcpts := 0;
                        v_unprocessed_rcpts :=
                            get_unprocessed_rcpt (v_rct_code,
                                                  v_date,
                                                  pl.pol_prod_code,
                                                  NULL,
                                                  v_receipt_pk,
                                                  v_opr_rct_trans_code,
                                                  pl.pol_code,
                                                  pl.opr_code);
                        v_unprocessed_rcpts_total :=
                              NVL (v_unprocessed_rcpts_total, 0)
                            + NVL (v_unprocessed_rcpts, 0);

                        IF ABS (NVL (v_unprocessed_rcpts, 0)) > 0
                        THEN
                            v_alloc_to := NVL (pl.alloc_to, 'PR');

                            /* IF v_alloc_to = 'LN'
                             THEN
                                raise_error
                                       (   'POSTING TO UNP_LN BLOCKED3.....Policy No.'
                                        || pl.pol_policy_no
                                       );
                             END IF;        */
                            IF v_alloc_to = 'PR'
                            THEN
                                get_gl_code ('UNP_PR',
                                             pl.pol_prod_code,
                                             v_trnt_code,
                                             v_unp_trnt_gl_code,
                                             v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                             NULL,
                                             pl.renewal);
                                valid_acc (v_unp_trnt_gl_code,
                                           v_org_code,
                                           v_rct_branch,
                                           'UNP_PR');
                                v_msg := 'UNP_PR';

                                BEGIN
                                    lms_ord_misc.system_param_val (
                                        'ALLOC_INACTIVE_PREM_TO_REFUND_AC',
                                        v_alloc_to_ref);
                                EXCEPTION
                                    WHEN OTHERS
                                    THEN
                                        v_alloc_to_ref := 'N';
                                END;

                                IF     v_alloc_to_ref = 'Y'
                                   AND v_pol_status IN ('C',
                                                        'J',
                                                        'PU',
                                                        'S',
                                                        'CPU',
                                                        'DC',
                                                        'M',
                                                        'L',
                                                        'FL')
                                THEN
                                    get_gl_code ('PLREF',
                                                 pl.pol_prod_code,
                                                 v_trnt_code,
                                                 v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                                 v_unp_trnt_gl_code,
                                                 NULL,
                                                 pl.renewal);
                                    valid_acc (v_unp_trnt_gl_code,
                                               v_org_code,
                                               v_rct_branch,
                                               'PLREF');
                                    v_msg := 'PLREF';
                                END IF;
                            ELSIF v_alloc_to = 'LN'
                            THEN
                                get_gl_code ('UNP_LN',
                                             pl.pol_prod_code,
                                             v_trnt_code,
                                             v_unp_trnt_gl_code,
                                             v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                             NULL,
                                             pl.renewal);
                                valid_acc (v_unp_trnt_gl_code,
                                           v_org_code,
                                           v_rct_branch,
                                           'UNP_LN');
                                v_msg := 'UNP_LN';

                                BEGIN
                                    lms_ord_misc.system_param_val (
                                        'ALLOC_INACTIVE_PREM_TO_REFUND_AC',
                                        v_alloc_to_ref);
                                EXCEPTION
                                    WHEN OTHERS
                                    THEN
                                        v_alloc_to_ref := 'N';
                                END;

                                IF     v_alloc_to_ref = 'Y'
                                   AND v_pol_status IN ('C',
                                                        'J',
                                                        'PU',
                                                        'S',
                                                        'CPU',
                                                        'DC',
                                                        'M',
                                                        'L',
                                                        'FL')
                                THEN
                                    get_gl_code ('PLREF',
                                                 pl.pol_prod_code,
                                                 v_trnt_code,
                                                 v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                                 v_unp_trnt_gl_code,
                                                 NULL,
                                                 pl.renewal);
                                    valid_acc (v_unp_trnt_gl_code,
                                               v_org_code,
                                               v_rct_branch,
                                               'PLREF');
                                    v_msg := 'PLREF';
                                END IF;
                            ELSIF v_alloc_to = 'PN'
                            THEN
                                get_gl_code ('UNP_PN',
                                             pl.pol_prod_code,
                                             v_trnt_code,
                                             v_unp_trnt_gl_code,
                                             v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                             NULL,
                                             pl.renewal);
                                valid_acc (v_unp_trnt_gl_code,
                                           v_org_code,
                                           v_rct_branch,
                                           'UNP_PN');
                                v_msg := 'UNP_PN';
                            END IF;

                            IF NVL (v_acc_type, 'D') = 'CK'
                            THEN
                                get_gl_code ('CHKC',
                                             pl.pol_prod_code,
                                             v_trnt_code,
                                             v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                             v_contra_acc,
                                             NULL,
                                             pl.renewal);
                                valid_acc (v_contra_acc,
                                           v_org_code,
                                           v_rct_branch,
                                           'CHKC');
                            ELSIF NVL (v_acc_type, 'D') = 'JV'
                            THEN
                                get_gl_code ('JV_RCT',
                                             pl.pol_prod_code,
                                             v_trnt_code,
                                             v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                             v_contra_acc);
                                valid_acc (v_contra_acc,
                                           v_org_code,
                                           v_rct_branch,
                                           'JV_RCT');
                            ELSE
                                IF (   (NVL (v_param_val, 'Y')) = 'Y'
                                    OR (v_acc_type = 'CK'))
                                THEN
                                    get_gl_code ('DR_RCT',
                                                 pl.pol_prod_code,
                                                 v_trnt_code,
                                                 v_contra_acc,
                                                 v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                                 NULL,
                                                 pl.renewal);
                                    valid_acc (v_contra_acc,
                                               v_org_code,
                                               v_rct_branch,
                                               'DR_RCT');
                                ELSE
                                    IF v_param_val = 'Y'
                                    THEN
                                        v_fms_receipt_pk :=
                                            NVL (v_receipt_pk,
                                                 pl.opr_fms_receipt_pk);

                                        IF v_fms_receipt_pk IS NULL
                                        THEN
                                            raise_error (
                                                'Receipting account cannot be null for policy recipts....');
                                        END IF;

                                        IF     NVL (v_prem_waiver, 'N') <>
                                               'Y'
                                           AND v_clm_vouch_alloc <> 'Y'
                                        THEN
                                            v_rct_paymt_mode :=
                                                fms_rcts_pkg.rct_paymt_mode (
                                                    v_fms_receipt_pk);
                                            v_bct_code :=
                                                fms_rcts_pkg.get_rcpt_debited_bank (
                                                    v_fms_receipt_pk);
                                            --v_bct_code:=fms_rcts_pkg.get_rcpt_debited_bank(pl.OPR_FMS_RECEIPT_PK);
                                            v_contra_acc :=
                                                fms_gen_pkg.bnk_acct_no (
                                                    v_bct_code);
                                            valid_acc (
                                                v_contra_acc,
                                                v_org_code,
                                                v_rct_branch,
                                                'Receipting Accuount..');
                                        END IF;
                                    ELSE
                                        --                              get_gl_code ('DR_RCT',
                                        --                                           pl.pol_prod_code,
                                        --                                           v_trnt_code,
                                        --                                           v_contra_acc,
                                        --                                           v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                        --                                           NULL,
                                        --                                           pl.renewal
                                        --                                          );
                                        --                              valid_acc (v_contra_acc,
                                        --                                         v_org_code,
                                        --                                         v_rct_branch,
                                        --                                         'DR_RCT'
                                        --                                        );
                                        IF     NVL (v_prem_waiver, 'N') <>
                                               'Y'
                                           AND v_clm_vouch_alloc <> 'Y'
                                        THEN
                                            v_bct_code :=
                                                fms_rcts_pkg.get_rcpt_debited_bank (
                                                    pl.opr_fms_receipt_pk);
                                            v_contra_acc :=
                                                get_receipting_acc (
                                                    v_acc_type,
                                                    pl.pol_prod_code,
                                                    v_org_code,
                                                    v_rct_branch,
                                                    NVL (
                                                        v_fms_unknown_reposting,
                                                        'N'),
                                                    v_param_val,
                                                    v_fms_receipt_pk);
                                            valid_acc (
                                                v_contra_acc,
                                                v_org_code,
                                                v_rct_branch,
                                                'Receipting Accuount..');
                                        END IF;
                                    END IF;
                                END IF;
                            END IF;

                            IF v_param_val = 'N'
                            THEN
                                v_count1 := v_count1 + 1;
                                interface_append_cb_gl_trans (
                                    v_trans_code,       --       v_trans_code,
                                    v_user,        --              v_raise_by,
                                    pl.pol_code,            --     v_pol_code,
                                    pl.pol_prod_code,        --   v_prod_code,
                                    NULL,           --              v_vchr_no,
                                    pl.opr_code,          --       v_opr_code,
                                    v_oppr_code,       --         v_oppr_code,
                                    v_rct_code,         --          v_rcpt_no,
                                    v_count1,            --           v_count,
                                    v_cb_count,           --          v_count,
                                       'UNPROCESSED RCPTS - DR_RCT TO '
                                    || v_msg
                                    || ' - '
                                    || NVL (pl.pol_policy_no,
                                            pl.pol_proposal_no)
                                    || v_loan_narration,
                                    --v_narrative,
                                    ABS (NVL (v_unprocessed_rcpts, 0)),
                                    --v_amount,
                                    v_opr_drcr,             --         v_drcr,
                                    v_unp_trnt_gl_code,      -- v_acc_number1,
                                    v_rct_branch,         --    v_branch_code,
                                    v_tcg_rec,
                                    --v_tcg_rec IN OUT  Fms_Vouchers_Pkg.tcg_rec_type,
                                    NULL,
                                    --v_cad_code       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                    NULL,
                                    --v_otop_code              NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                    NULL,
                                    --v_fpmt_code              NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                    NULL,
                                    --v_ort_code               NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                    NULL,
                                    --v_btr_no                 NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                    NULL,
                                    --v_ppr_code               NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                    NULL,
                                    --v_ocl_code                NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                    NULL,
                                    --v_agn_code                NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                    NULL,
                                    --v_trans_no                NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                    v_cvrg_area,
                                    --v_covrg_area_code                NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                    v_spoke_code,
                                    --v_spoke_code                NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                    v_sbu_code,
                                    --v_sbu_code                NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                    v_location_code --v_loc_code                NUMBER DEFAULT NULL
                                                   );
                                v_tot_amt :=
                                      NVL (v_tot_amt, 0)
                                    + ABS (NVL (v_unprocessed_rcpts, 0));
                            ELSE
                                v_count := v_count + 2;
                                interface_append_gl (
                                    v_trans_code,             -- v_trans_code,
                                    v_user,                     -- v_raise_by,
                                    pl.pol_code,                -- v_pol_code,
                                    pl.pol_prod_code,          -- v_prod_code,
                                    NULL,                        -- v_vchr_no,
                                    pl.opr_code,                -- v_opr_code,
                                    v_oppr_code,               -- v_oppr_code,
                                    v_rct_code,                   --v_rcpt_no,
                                    v_count,                       -- v_count,
                                       'UNPROCESSED RCPTS - DR_RCT TO '
                                    || v_msg
                                    || ' - '
                                    || NVL (pl.pol_policy_no,
                                            pl.pol_proposal_no)
                                    || v_loan_narration,
                                    -- v_narrative,
                                    ABS (NVL (v_unprocessed_rcpts, 0)),
                                    -- v_amount,
                                    v_opr_drcr,                     -- v_drcr,
                                    v_unp_trnt_gl_code,      -- v_acc_number1,
                                    v_contra_acc,            -- v_acc_number2,
                                    v_rct_branch,            -- v_branch_code,
                                    v_gl_trans);
                            END IF;
                        END IF;

                        IF NVL (v_prem_waiver, 'N') = 'Y'
                        THEN
                            IF NVL (v_prem_amt, 0) <> 0
                            THEN
                                get_gl_code ('PRWAIV',
                                             pl.pol_prod_code,
                                             v_trnt_code,
                                             v_trnt_gl_code,
                                             v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                             NULL,
                                             pl.renewal);
                                valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                                           v_org_code,
                                           pl.pol_bra_code,
                                           'PRWAIV');
                                v_count1 := v_count1 + 1;
                                interface_append_gl (
                                    v_trans_code,             -- v_trans_code,
                                    v_user,                     -- v_raise_by,
                                    pl.pol_code,                -- v_pol_code,
                                    pl.pol_prod_code,          -- v_prod_code,
                                    NULL,                        -- v_vchr_no,
                                    pl.opr_code,                -- v_opr_code,
                                    NULL,                      -- v_oppr_code,
                                    v_rct_code,                   --v_rcpt_no,
                                    v_count1,                      -- v_count,
                                       'PREMIUM WAIVER'
                                    || ' - '
                                    || NVL (pl.pol_policy_no,
                                            pl.pol_proposal_no)
                                    || v_loan_narration,
                                    -- v_narrative,
                                    NVL (v_prem_amt, 0),          -- v_amount,
                                    'D',                            -- v_drcr,
                                    v_trnt_gl_code,          -- v_acc_number1,
                                    pl.pol_bra_code,
                                    -- v_branch_code,
                                    v_gl_trans,
                                    NULL,
                                    --v_cad_code       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                    NULL,
                                    --v_otop_code              NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                    NULL,
                                    --v_fpmt_code              NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                    NULL,
                                    --v_ort_code               NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                    NULL,
                                    --v_btr_no                 NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                    NULL,
                                    --v_ppr_code               NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                    NULL,
                                    --v_ocl_code                NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                    NULL,
                                    --v_agn_code                NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                    NULL,
                                    --v_trans_no                NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                    v_cvrg_area,
                                    --v_covrg_area_code                NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                    v_spoke_code,
                                    --v_spoke_code                NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                    v_sbu_code,
                                    --v_sbu_code                NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                    v_location_code --v_loc_code                NUMBER DEFAULT NULL
                                                   );
                            END IF;
                        END IF;
                    --END LOOP;
                    END LOOP;
                END IF;

                IF NVL (v_tot_amt, 0) <> 0
                   AND NVL (v_prem_waiver, 'N') <> 'Y'
                THEN
                    IF v_opr_code IS NOT NULL
                    THEN
                        SELECT pol_prod_code, pol_code, pol_bra_code
                          INTO v_prod_code, v_pol_code, v_branch_code
                          FROM lms_ord_prem_receipts, lms_policies
                         WHERE     opr_code = v_opr_code
                               AND pol_code = opr_pol_code;
                    ELSIF v_oppr_code IS NOT NULL
                    THEN
                        SELECT pol_prod_code, pol_code, pol_bra_code
                          INTO v_prod_code, v_pol_code, v_branch_code
                          FROM lms_ord_proposal_rcpts, lms_policies
                         WHERE     oppr_code = v_oppr_code
                               AND pol_code = oppr_pol_code;
                    END IF;

                    --- to  do
                    --raise_error('Hill-v_bct_code  '||v_bct_code||'; v_Receipt_PK = '||v_Receipt_PK||'; v_fms_receipt_pk = '||v_fms_receipt_pk||'; v_opr_code = '||v_opr_code||'; v_btc_type = '||v_btc_type);
                    IF v_opr_drcr = 'C'
                    THEN
                        v_btc_type := 'RV';
                        interface_append_cb_trans (
                            v_trans_code,                     -- v_trans_code,
                            v_user,                             -- v_raise_by,
                            v_pol_code,                         -- v_pol_code,
                            v_prod_code,                       -- v_prod_code,
                            NULL,                                -- v_vchr_no,
                            NVL (v_opr_code1, v_opr_code),
                            -- v_opr_code,
                            v_oppr_code,                       -- v_oppr_code,
                            v_rct_code,                           --v_rcpt_no,
                            v_cb_count,                            -- v_count,
                            'RECEIPT ALLOCATION',              -- v_narrative,
                            NVL (v_tot_amt, 0),                   -- v_amount,
                            'D',                                    -- v_drcr,
                            fms_gen_pkg.bnk_acct_no (v_bct_code),
                            -- v_acc_number1,
                            fms_gen_pkg.bct_brh (v_bct_code),
                            --v_branch_code,      -- v_branch_code,
                            v_cb_rec,
                            v_date,
                            v_bct_code);
                    ELSE
                        v_btc_type := 'CV';
                        interface_append_cb_trans (
                            v_trans_code,                     -- v_trans_code,
                            v_user,                             -- v_raise_by,
                            v_pol_code,                         -- v_pol_code,
                            v_prod_code,                       -- v_prod_code,
                            NULL,                                -- v_vchr_no,
                            NVL (v_opr_code1, v_opr_code),
                            -- v_opr_code,
                            NULL,                              -- v_oppr_code,
                            v_rct_code,                           --v_rcpt_no,
                            v_cb_count,                            -- v_count,
                            'RECEIPT ALLOCATION',              -- v_narrative,
                            NVL (v_tot_amt, 0),                   -- v_amount,
                            'C',                                    -- v_drcr,
                            fms_gen_pkg.bnk_acct_no (v_bct_code),
                            -- v_acc_number1,
                            fms_gen_pkg.bct_brh (v_bct_code),
                            --v_branch_code,      -- v_branch_code,
                            v_cb_rec,
                            v_date,
                            v_bct_code);
                    END IF;

                    --             raise_error('v_bct_code  '||v_bct_code||'; v_tot_amt = '||v_tot_amt||'; v_opr_drcr = '||v_opr_drcr||'; v_btc_type = '||v_btc_type
                    --             ||'; v_fms_receipt_pk = '||v_fms_receipt_pk
                    --             ||'; v_opr_code = '||v_opr_code
                    --             ||'; v_oppr_code = '||v_oppr_code
                    --             );
                    interface_update_vcb (v_trans_code,        --v_trans_code,
                                          v_user,                --v_raise_by,
                                          NULL,                  --v_pol_code,
                                          v_date,                    --v_date,
                                          NVL (v_opr_code1, v_opr_code),
                                          --v_opr_code,
                                          v_oppr_code,          --v_oppr_code,
                                          'LMS RECEIPTS BATCH',
                                          --v_btc_description,
                                          v_btc_type,            --v_btc_type,
                                          v_rct_branch,       --v_branch_code,
                                          NVL (v_description, 'LMS RECEIPT'),
                                          --v_description,
                                          v_rct_code,             --v_rcpt_no,
                                          v_tcg_rec,
                                          v_cb_rec,
                                          v_rct_code,
                                          v_rct_paymt_mode,
                                          v_vcb_no);            --v_gl_trans);

                    BEGIN
                        UPDATE lms_interface_table
                           SET itb_process = v_process,
                               itb_acc_type = v_acc_type
                         WHERE itb_transaction_code = v_trans_code;
                    EXCEPTION
                        WHEN OTHERS
                        THEN
                            NULL;
                    END;

                    IF v_opr_drcr = 'C'
                    THEN
                        UPDATE fms_receipts
                           SET rct_vcb_no = v_vcb_no, rct_cb_posted = 'Y'
                         WHERE rct_no = v_receipt_pk;

                        UPDATE fms_trncb
                           SET tcb_payee =
                                   lms_ord_mis.get_receipt_payee (
                                       v_receipt_pk)
                         WHERE tcb_vcb_no = v_vgl_no AND tcb_payee IS NULL;
                    ELSE
                        UPDATE fms_receipts
                           SET rct_reverse_vcb_no = v_vcb_no
                         WHERE rct_no = v_receipt_pk;
                    END IF;

                    --For Direct Commission. Post.
                    IF v_dir_count <> 0
                    THEN
                        interface_update_vgl (
                            v_trans_code,                      --v_trans_code,
                            v_user,                              --v_raise_by,
                            NULL,                                --v_pol_code,
                            v_date,                                  --v_date,
                            v_opr_code,                          --v_opr_code,
                            v_oppr_code,                        --v_oppr_code,
                            'LMS RECEIPTS BATCH',         --v_btc_description,
                            'JV',                                --v_btc_type,
                            v_rct_branch,                     --v_branch_code,
                            NVL (v_description, 'LMS RECEIPT'),
                            --v_description,
                            v_rct_code,                           --v_rcpt_no,
                            v_gl_trans,                           --v_gl_trans
                            NULL,            --v_cad_code NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                            NULL,                               --v_otop_code,
                            NULL,                                --v_fpmt_code
                            NULL,                                 --v_ort_code
                            NULL,                                   --v_btr_no
                            NULL,                                 --v_ppr_code
                            NULL,            --v_ocl_code NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                            NULL,            --v_agn_code NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                            v_trans_no,       --v_trans_no NUMBER DEFAULT NULL
                            NULL                                 --v_curr_code
                                );

                        BEGIN
                            UPDATE lms_interface_table
                               SET itb_process = v_process,
                                   itb_acc_type = v_acc_type
                             WHERE itb_transaction_code = v_trans_code;
                        EXCEPTION
                            WHEN OTHERS
                            THEN
                                NULL;
                        END;
                    END IF;
                --RAISE_ERROR('AM OUTSIDE>>'||v_trans_code||';;'||v_trans_no);
                ELSE
                    --RAISE_ERROR('AM HERE=======');
                    interface_update_vgl (v_trans_code,        --v_trans_code,
                                          v_user,                --v_raise_by,
                                          NULL,                  --v_pol_code,
                                          v_date,                    --v_date,
                                          v_opr_code,            --v_opr_code,
                                          v_oppr_code,          --v_oppr_code,
                                          'LMS RECEIPTS BATCH', --v_btc_description,
                                          'JV',                  --v_btc_type,
                                          v_rct_branch,       --v_branch_code,
                                          NVL (v_description, 'LMS RECEIPT'),
                                          --v_description,
                                          v_rct_code,             --v_rcpt_no,
                                          v_gl_trans,             --v_gl_trans
                                          NULL,                 --v_otop_code,
                                          NULL,                 --v_otop_code,
                                          NULL,                  --v_fpmt_code
                                          NULL,                   --v_ort_code
                                          NULL,                     --v_btr_no
                                          NULL,                   --v_ppr_code
                                          NULL, --v_ocl_code NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                          NULL, --v_agn_code NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                          v_trans_no --v_trans_no NUMBER DEFAULT NULL
                                                    );

                    BEGIN
                        UPDATE lms_interface_table
                           SET itb_process = v_process,
                               itb_acc_type = v_acc_type
                         WHERE itb_transaction_code = v_trans_code;
                    EXCEPTION
                        WHEN OTHERS
                        THEN
                            NULL;
                    END;
                END IF;
            END IF;
        END IF;
    --    EXCEPTION
    --        WHEN OTHERS
    --        THEN
    --            raise_error ('Error Receipting...' || SQLERRM (SQLCODE));
    END post_update_recpt_pymt;

    PROCEDURE update_recpt_pymt (
        v_rct_code                   VARCHAR2,
        v_acc_type                   VARCHAR2,
        v_amt                        NUMBER,         --total for the receipt .
        v_prp_code                   NUMBER,
        v_chq_no                     VARCHAR2,
        v_chq_dt                     DATE,
        v_capture_date               DATE,
        v_pmt_type                   VARCHAR2,
        --DIRECT / CHECKOFF'D' -direct 'C' -check off , 'O' -Bank Order
        v_rct_branch                 NUMBER,
        v_description                VARCHAR2,
        v_raised_by                  NUMBER,
        v_cur_code                   NUMBER,
        v_mode                       VARCHAR2,                --cheque/cash...
        v_paid_by                    VARCHAR2,
        v_bnk_account                NUMBER,
        v_recpt_rec               IN type_recpt_table,
        v_ac_trans_code              VARCHAR2 DEFAULT NULL,
        -- e.g OLIFE-UA - Used to get control a/c for certain rcts i. Unallocated ones
        v_control_ac                 VARCHAR2 DEFAULT NULL,
        v_receipt_pk                 NUMBER,
        v_fms_unknown_reposting      VARCHAR2 DEFAULT NULL,
        v_capital_injectn            VARCHAR2 DEFAULT 'N',
        v_dd_code                    NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
        v_dd_batch                   NUMBER DEFAULT NULL
    )
    IS
        v_count                     NUMBER;
        v_oppr_code                 NUMBER;
        v_tot_amt                   NUMBER;
        v_opr_code                  NUMBER;
        v_pens_opr_code             NUMBER;
        v_ac_type                   NUMBER;
        v_only_due_inst             VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_multiple_inst             VARCHAR2 (20) := 'Y';
        v_tran_no                   NUMBER;
        v_bal_amt                   NUMBER;
        v_loan_alloc                NUMBER;
        v_alloc_amt                 NUMBER := 0;
        v_credit                    NUMBER := 0;
        v_chq_rcpt_no               VARCHAR2 (100);
        v_gl_trans                  tq_fms.fms_vouchers_pkg.tgl_rec_type;
        v_vgl_no                    NUMBER;
        v_trnt_code                 VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_trnt_gl_code              VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_trnt_contra_gl_code       VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_contra_acc                VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_chkoff_agen_code          NUMBER;
        v_chkoff_rate               NUMBER;
        os_prem_dummy               NUMBER;
        v_os_inst                   NUMBER;
        v_inst_prem                 NUMBER;
        v_pay_method_code           NUMBER;
        v_ee_contri                 NUMBER;
        v_er_contri                 NUMBER;
        v_tot_contri                NUMBER;
        v_pol_type                  VARCHAR2 (10);
        v_pol_prod_type             VARCHAR2 (10);
        v_pol_status                VARCHAR2 (10);
        v_status                    VARCHAR2 (10);
        v_ann_chk                   VARCHAR2 (10);
        v_pol_code                  NUMBER;
        v_rct_count                 NUMBER := 0;
        v_nfl_alloc                 NUMBER := 0;
        v_nf_repay_param            VARCHAR2 (5);
        v_nf_repay_param_status     VARCHAR2 (5);
        v_comp_param                VARCHAR2 (5);
        v_comp_param_status         VARCHAR2 (5);
        v_alloc_to                  VARCHAR2 (2);
        v_msg                       VARCHAR2 (2);
        v_cap_inj                   VARCHAR2 (1) := 'N';
        v_min_cap_inj               NUMBER;
        v_date                      DATE;
        v_inv_rider                 VARCHAR2 (1) := 'N';
        v_capinj_allow              VARCHAR2 (1) := 'N';
        v_total_payments            NUMBER;
        v_total_premium             NUMBER;
        v_err                       VARCHAR2 (4000);
        v_fail_dd_proc              VARCHAR2 (1) := 'N';

        CURSOR cur_pol_cb_amt (
            v_receipt_code     VARCHAR2,
            v_rct_trans_code   VARCHAR2
        )
        IS
              SELECT NVL (SUM (opr_loan_pymt_amt), 0)
                         loan_amt,
                     NVL (SUM (opr_refund_amt), 0)
                         suspense_amt,
                     -- OPR_PMTH_CODE,
                     NVL (SUM (premium_amt), 0)
                         premium_amt,
                     NVL (SUM (pension_contr), 0)
                         pension_contr,
                     NVL (SUM (investment_fee), 0)
                         investment_fee,
                     NVL (SUM (investment_contri), 0)
                         investment_contri,
                     NVL (SUM (investment_admin), 0)
                         investment_admin,
                     NVL (SUM (opr_fund_client_contr), 0)
                         comfnd,
                     (NVL (SUM (prem_comm), 0) + NVL (SUM (pens_comm), 0))
                         prem_comm,
                     NVL (SUM (pens_comm), 0)
                         pens_comm,
                     NVL (SUM (prem_tax), 0)
                         prem_tax,
                     NVL (SUM (chkoff_comm), 0)
                         chkoff_comm,
                     pol_bra_code,
                     pol_prod_code,
                     pol_type,
                     pol_prod_type
                FROM lms_ord_prem_receipts,
                     lms_policies,
                     (  SELECT opri_opr_code,
                               NVL (SUM (opri_amt), 0)              premium_amt,
                               NVL (SUM (opri_prem_tax_amt), 0)     prem_tax,
                               NVL (SUM (opri_chk_comm_amt), 0)     chkoff_comm,
                               NVL (SUM (opri_comm_amt), 0)         prem_comm
                          FROM lms_ord_receipt_instlmnts
                      GROUP BY opri_opr_code),
                     (  SELECT pndpo_opr_code,
                               NVL (SUM (pndpo_amount), 0)
                                   pension_contr,
                               NVL (SUM (pndpo_admin_fee), 0)
                                   investment_fee,
                               NVL (SUM (pndpo_empye_amt), 0)
                                   investment_contri,
                               NVL (SUM (pndpo_empyr_amt), 0)
                                   investment_admin,
                               NVL (SUM (pndpo_comm_amt), 0)
                                   pens_comm
                          FROM lms_pension_deposits_ord
                      GROUP BY pndpo_opr_code)
               WHERE     pol_code = opr_pol_code
                     AND opr_receipt_no = v_receipt_code
                     AND opri_opr_code(+) = opr_code
                     AND pndpo_opr_code(+) = opr_code
                     AND opr_receipt_trans_code = v_rct_trans_code
            GROUP BY pol_bra_code,
                     pol_prod_code,
                     pol_type,
                     pol_prod_type;

        v_opr_receipt_trans_code    VARCHAR2 (50);
        v_oppr_receipt_trans_code   VARCHAR2 (50);
        v_otop_receipt_trans_code   VARCHAR2 (50);

        CURSOR cur_prop_cb_amt (
            v_receipt_code     VARCHAR2,
            v_rct_trans_code   VARCHAR2
        )
        IS
              SELECT NVL (SUM (oppr_amt), 0)              paid_amt,
                     NVL (SUM (opri_chk_comm_amt), 0)     prop_chk_amt,
                     pol_bra_code,
                     pol_prod_code
                FROM lms_ord_proposal_rcpts, lms_policies
               WHERE     pol_code = oppr_pol_code
                     AND oppr_pol_proposal_no = pol_proposal_no
                     AND oppr_receipt_no = v_receipt_code
                     AND oppr_receipt_trans_code = v_rct_trans_code
            GROUP BY pol_bra_code, pol_prod_code
            UNION ALL
              SELECT NVL (SUM (oppr_amt), 0)              paid_amt,
                     NVL (SUM (opri_chk_comm_amt), 0)     prop_chk_amt,
                     ppr_brn_code,
                     ppr_prod_code
                FROM lms_ord_proposal_rcpts, lms_pol_proposals
               WHERE     oppr_pol_proposal_no = ppr_proposal_no
                     AND oppr_pol_code IS NULL
                     AND oppr_receipt_no = v_receipt_code
                     AND oppr_receipt_trans_code = v_rct_trans_code
            GROUP BY ppr_prod_code, ppr_brn_code
            UNION ALL
              SELECT NVL (SUM (oppr_amt), 0)              paid_amt,
                     NVL (SUM (opri_chk_comm_amt), 0)     prop_chk_amt,
                     ann_brn_code,
                     ann_prod_code
                FROM lms_ord_proposal_rcpts, lms_annuities
               WHERE     oppr_pol_proposal_no = ann_annuity_no
                     AND oppr_ann_code = ann_code
                     AND oppr_pol_code IS NULL
                     AND oppr_receipt_no = v_receipt_code
                     AND oppr_receipt_trans_code = v_rct_trans_code
            GROUP BY ann_prod_code, ann_brn_code;

        CURSOR cur_policies (v_pol_code IN NUMBER)
        IS
            SELECT pol_code,
                   pol_policy_no,
                   pol_term,
                   pol_anb,
                   pol_freq_of_payment,
                   pol_freq_days,
                   pol_status,
                   pol_type,
                   pol_cla_code,
                   pol_bra_code,
                   pol_prp_code,
                   pol_prod_code,
                   pol_current_endr_code,
                   pol_paid_to_date,
                   pol_os_instlmt_no,
                   pol_os_prem_bal_amt,
                   pol_overpayment_amt,
                   pol_tot_loan_os_amt,
                   pol_proposal_no
              FROM lms_policies
             WHERE pol_code = v_pol_code;

        CURSOR cur_pol_loan (v_pln_lna_no IN NUMBER)
        IS
            SELECT pln_lna_no,
                   pln_pol_code,
                   pln_pol_policy_no,
                   pln_principal_amount,
                   pln_os_bal_amount,
                   pln_interest_rate,
                   pln_status,
                   pln_type,
                   pln_last_lip_month_year,
                   pln_rcpt_alloc_amt,
                   pln_installment_amount,
                   pln_tot_amount_repaid,
                   pln_last_int_calc_date
              FROM lms_policy_loans
             WHERE pln_lna_no = v_pln_lna_no;

        ---****** PLN_POL_CODE = v_pol_code;
        v_org_code                  NUMBER;
        v_user_name                 VARCHAR2 (30);
        v_unalloc_amt               NUMBER := 0;
        v_double_sure_amt           NUMBER := 0;
        v_fetched_pol_code          NUMBER;
        v_fetched_policy            lms_policies.pol_policy_no%TYPE;
        v_endr_code                 NUMBER;
        v_batch_desc                VARCHAR2 (100);
        v_sl_trans                  VARCHAR2 (20) := v_ac_trans_code;
        v_prod_code                 NUMBER;
        v_proposal_no               lms_policies.pol_proposal_no%TYPE;
        v_policy_no                 lms_policies.pol_proposal_no%TYPE;
        v_prod_appl                 VARCHAR2 (4);
        vpropno                     VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_prem_amt                  NUMBER;
        v_loan_amt                  NUMBER;
        v_pension_amt               NUMBER;
        v_unprocessed_rcpts         NUMBER;
        v_param_value               VARCHAR2 (5);
        v_otop_code                 NUMBER;
        v_descriptn                 VARCHAR2 (50);
        v_oldreceipt_no             NUMBER;
        v_oldreceipt                NUMBER;
        v_nc_code                   NUMBER;
        v_rcpt_dt_param_value       VARCHAR2 (1);
        v_auto_auth_pol_on_rect     VARCHAR2 (10);
        v_rct_paymt_mode            VARCHAR2 (100) := 'CASH';
        v_deduction_date            DATE;
        v_full_inst_param           VARCHAR2 (1);
        v_update_dd_code            NUMBER;
        v_update_ddd_code           NUMBER;
    BEGIN
        IF NVL (v_amt, 0) <= 0
        THEN
            raise_error ('THERE IS NO AMOUNT TO PROCESS PAYMENT WITH...');
        END IF;

        BEGIN
            lms_ord_misc.system_param_val (
                'USE_CAPTPTURE_DATE_AS_RECEIPT_DT',
                v_rcpt_dt_param_value);
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND
            THEN
                v_rcpt_dt_param_value := 'N';
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                raise_error ('PARAMETER ERROR...');
        END;

        BEGIN
            lms_ord_misc.system_param_val ('AUTO_AUTORIZE_POLICY_ON_RECEIPT',
                                           v_auto_auth_pol_on_rect);
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND
            THEN
                v_auto_auth_pol_on_rect := 'N';
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                raise_error ('PARAMETER ERROR...');
        END;

        BEGIN
            lms_ord_misc.system_param_val ('ALLOCATE_FULL_INSTALMENT_ONLY',
                                           v_full_inst_param);
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                raise_error (
                    'PARAMETER ERROR ALLOCATE_FULL_INSTALMENT_ONLY..');
        END;

        IF v_rcpt_dt_param_value = 'Y'
        THEN
            --use receipt capture date (system date) as receipt date
            v_date := v_capture_date;
        ELSE
            BEGIN
                SELECT rct_date
                  INTO v_date
                  FROM fms_receipts
                 WHERE rct_no = v_receipt_pk;
            EXCEPTION
                WHEN OTHERS
                THEN
                    v_date := v_capture_date;
            END;
        END IF;

        v_date := TRUNC (v_date);

        --Determine the Payment Mode
        BEGIN
            SELECT rct_acct_type_id
              INTO v_rct_paymt_mode
              FROM fms_receipts
             WHERE rct_no = v_receipt_pk;
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                v_rct_paymt_mode := 'CASH';
        END;

        --RAISE_ERROR('v_rcpt_dt_param_value='||v_rcpt_dt_param_value||';;'||v_date);
        v_pay_method_code := pay_method_code (v_mode);
        v_user_name := fms_interfaces_pkg.get_username (v_raised_by);

        SELECT v_rct_code || '/' || lms_opr_receipt_trans_seq.NEXTVAL
          INTO v_opr_receipt_trans_code
          FROM DUAL;

        SELECT v_rct_code || '/' || lms_oppr_receipt_trans_seq.NEXTVAL
          INTO v_oppr_receipt_trans_code
          FROM DUAL;

        SELECT v_rct_code || '/' || lms_otop_receipt_trans_seq.NEXTVAL
          INTO v_otop_receipt_trans_code
          FROM DUAL;

        BEGIN
            SELECT opr_fms_receipt_pk
              INTO v_oldreceipt_no
              FROM lms_ord_prem_receipts
             WHERE opr_receipt_no = v_rct_code;
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                NULL;
        END;

        BEGIN
            SELECT oppr_fms_receipt_pk
              INTO v_oldreceipt
              FROM lms_ord_proposal_rcpts
             WHERE oppr_receipt_no = v_rct_code;
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                NULL;
        END;

        BEGIN
            lms_ord_misc.system_param_val ('ALLOW_CAPITAL_INJECTION',
                                           v_param_value);
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                raise_error ('PARAMETER ERROR...');
        END;

        IF NVL (v_param_value, 'N') = 'Y'
        THEN
            v_cap_inj := v_capital_injectn;
        END IF;

        -- introduction of advance receipt payment
        --create creating other payments receipts dtls
        FOR i IN 1 .. v_recpt_rec.COUNT
        LOOP
            SAVEPOINT receipt_allocation;

            --IF DIRECT DEBIT CHECK IF RECEIPT HAS ALREADY BEEN CREATED
            --FOR THE  TQC_DIRECT_DEBIT_DETAILS
            /*IF v_rct_paymt_mode = 'DD'
            THEN
                BEGIN
                    SELECT oppr_code
                      INTO v_oppr_code
                      FROM lms_ord_proposal_rcpts
                     WHERE oppr_ddd_code = v_recpt_rec (i).ddd_code;
                EXCEPTION
                    WHEN OTHERS
                    THEN
                        v_oppr_code := NULL;
                END;

                --Get opr_code
                BEGIN
                    SELECT opr_code
                      INTO v_opr_code
                      FROM lms_ord_prem_receipts
                     WHERE opr_ddd_code = v_recpt_rec (i).ddd_code;
                EXCEPTION
                    WHEN OTHERS
                    THEN
                        v_opr_code := NULL;
                END;

                IF v_oppr_code IS NOT NULL OR v_opr_code IS NOT NULL
                THEN
                    v_oppr_code := NULL;
                    v_opr_code := NULL;
                    CONTINUE;
                END IF;
            END IF;*/

            BEGIN
                v_pol_type := v_recpt_rec (i).pol_type;
                v_pol_code := v_recpt_rec (i).pol_code;
                v_deduction_date :=
                    NVL (TRUNC (v_recpt_rec (i).rad_deduction_date), v_date);


                BEGIN
                    SELECT pol_policy_no, NVL (v_pol_type, pol_type)
                      INTO v_policy_no, v_pol_type
                      FROM lms_policies
                     WHERE pol_code = v_pol_code;
                EXCEPTION
                    WHEN OTHERS
                    THEN
                        NULL;
                END;

                BEGIN
                    SELECT nc_code
                      INTO v_nc_code
                      FROM lms_agencies, lms_negative_comm
                     WHERE     nc_agn_code = agn_code
                           AND lms_ord_misc.agent_negative_commission (agn_code) >
                               0
                           AND nc_processed = 'N'
                           AND NOT nc_code IN (SELECT agd_nc_code
                                                 FROM lms_agent_deductions
                                                WHERE agd_nc_code = nc_code)
                           AND agn_code = v_pol_code;
                EXCEPTION
                    WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND
                    THEN
                        NULL;
                    WHEN OTHERS
                    THEN
                        raise_error (
                            'Error fetching agent negative COMM details...........');
                END;

                IF v_pol_type IN ('ADV', 'RPT', 'DBF')
                THEN
                    IF v_pol_type = 'ADV'
                    THEN
                        IF NVL (lms_ord_misc.advance_bal (v_pol_code), 0) <
                           v_recpt_rec (i).misc_amt
                        THEN
                            raise_error ('OVERPAYMENTS NOT ALLOWED!!!');
                        END IF;

                        v_descriptn := 'ADVANCE REPAYMENTS';
                    ELSIF v_pol_type = 'DBF'
                    THEN
                        IF NVL (
                               lms_ord_misc.agent_negative_commission (
                                   v_pol_code),
                               0) <
                           v_recpt_rec (i).misc_amt
                        THEN
                            raise_error ('OVERPAYMENTS NOT ALLOWED!!!');
                        END IF;

                        v_descriptn := 'DEBIT BROUGHT FORWARD REPAYMENTS';
                    ELSE
                        IF NVL (lms_ord_misc.rpt_reprint_amt (v_pol_code), 0) <>
                           v_recpt_rec (i).misc_amt
                        THEN
                            raise_error ('CAPTURE EXACT AMOUNT!!!');
                        END IF;

                        v_descriptn := 'REPORT REPRINTING';
                    END IF;

                    BEGIN
                        SELECT    TO_NUMBER (TO_CHAR (SYSDATE, 'RRRR'))
                               || lms_otop_code_seq.NEXTVAL
                          INTO v_otop_code
                          FROM DUAL;
                    EXCEPTION
                        WHEN OTHERS
                        THEN
                            raise_error (
                                'ERROR FETCHING OTHER PAYMENTS RECEIPT SEQUENCE...');
                    END;

                    IF v_recpt_rec (i).misc_amt <> 0
                    THEN
                        BEGIN
                            INSERT INTO lms_ord_other_pymts (
                                            otop_code,
                                            otop_date,
                                            otop_cheque_no,
                                            otop_receipt_no,
                                            otop_receipt_date,
                                            otop_done_by,
                                            otop_drcr,
                                            otop_amt,
                                            otop_pol_code,
                                            otop_source,
                                            otop_fms_receipt_pk,
                                            otop_desc,
                                            otop_cad_code,
                                            otop_btr_no,
                                            otop_type,
                                            otop_receipt_trans_code,
                                            otop_reprint_code,
                                            otop_nc_code)
                                     VALUES (
                                         v_otop_code,
                                         TRUNC (SYSDATE),
                                         v_chq_no,
                                         v_rct_code,
                                         v_date,
                                         v_user_name,
                                         DECODE (
                                             SIGN (v_recpt_rec (i).misc_amt),
                                             -1, 'D',
                                             'C'),
                                         v_recpt_rec (i).misc_amt,
                                         NULL,
                                         'RECEIPT',
                                         v_receipt_pk,
                                         v_descriptn,
                                         DECODE (v_pol_type, 'ADV', v_pol_code),
                                         NULL,
                                         --DECODE (v_pol_type, 'RPT', v_pol_code),
                                         v_pol_type,
                                         v_otop_receipt_trans_code,
                                         DECODE (v_pol_type, 'RPT', v_pol_code),
                                         DECODE (v_pol_type, 'DBF', v_nc_code));
                        EXCEPTION
                            WHEN OTHERS
                            THEN
                                raise_error (
                                    'ERROR CREATING OTHER PAYMENTS RECEIPTS DTLS...');
                        END;

                        IF v_pol_type = 'DBF'
                        THEN
                            v_pol_code := v_nc_code;
                        END IF;

                        BEGIN
                            lms_process_receipts.process_misc_pymts (
                                v_otop_code,
                                --v_otop_code    IN NUMBER?
                                v_pol_code,
