                                -- v_cad_code   IN NUMBER,
                                v_pol_type);
                        EXCEPTION
                            WHEN OTHERS
                            THEN
                                raise_error ('ERROR PROCESSING MISC. RCPT...');
                        END;
                    END IF;
                ELSE
                    --RAISE_ERROR('v_pol_type '||v_pol_type||' v_pol_code '||v_pol_code);
                    IF v_pol_type IS NULL
                    THEN
                        IF v_recpt_rec (i).pol_code IS NULL
                        THEN
                            raise_error (
                                'Receipt must have atleast one policy/proposal to proceed.');
                        END IF;

                        IF annuity_check (v_recpt_rec (i).pol_code,
                                          v_recpt_rec (i).pol_policy_no) =
                           'Y'
                        THEN
                            v_pol_type := 'PR';
                        ELSE
                            BEGIN
                                SELECT pol_type
                                  INTO v_pol_type
                                  FROM lms_policies
                                 WHERE pol_code = v_pol_code;
                            EXCEPTION
                                WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND
                                THEN
                                    BEGIN
                                        SELECT 'MPR'
                                          INTO v_pol_type
                                          FROM lms_pol_proposals
                                         WHERE ppr_code = v_pol_code;
                                    EXCEPTION
                                        WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND
                                        THEN
                                            BEGIN
                                                SELECT 'LN'
                                                  INTO v_pol_type
                                                  FROM lms_policy_loans
                                                 WHERE pln_lna_no = v_pol_code;
                                            EXCEPTION
                                                WHEN OTHERS
                                                THEN
                                                    raise_error (
                                                           'UNABLE TO GET POLICY TYPE.2..'
                                                        || v_pol_code
                                                        || '...');
                                            END;
                                        WHEN OTHERS
                                        THEN
                                            raise_error (
                                                   'UNABLE TO GET POLICY TYPE...'
                                                || v_pol_code
                                                || '...');
                                    END;
                            END;
                        END IF;
                    END IF;

                    BEGIN
                        IF v_pol_type = 'MPR'
                        THEN
                            BEGIN
                                SELECT ppr_status,
                                       ppr_proposal_no,
                                       ppr_prod_code
                                  INTO v_pol_status,
                                       v_proposal_no,
                                       v_prod_code
                                  FROM lms_pol_proposals
                                 WHERE ppr_code = v_recpt_rec (i).pol_code;
                            EXCEPTION
                                WHEN OTHERS
                                THEN
                                    IF v_rct_paymt_mode IN ('DD', 'CK', 'BU')
                                    THEN
                                        --Update the batch as failure.
                                        v_err :=
                                               'ERROR RETRIEVING PROPOSAL DETAILS FOR '
                                            || v_recpt_rec (i).pol_policy_no;
                                        update_dd_err_log (
                                            'F',
                                            v_err,
                                            v_recpt_rec (i).ddd_code,
                                            NULL,                 --v_dd_code,
                                            NULL,                --v_dd_batch,
                                            v_rct_paymt_mode,
                                            v_recpt_rec (i).rad_code,
                                            v_receipt_pk);
                                        v_fail_dd_proc := 'Y';
                                        CONTINUE;
                                    ELSE
                                        raise_error (
                                               'ERROR RETRIEVING PROPOSAL DETAILS FOR '
                                            || v_recpt_rec (i).pol_policy_no);
                                    END IF;
                            END;

                            IF v_prod_code IS NULL
                            THEN
                                BEGIN
                                    SELECT trnt_prod_applicable
                                      INTO v_prod_appl
                                      FROM lms_transaction_types
                                     WHERE trnt_type = 'PRRCT';

                                    IF NVL (v_prod_appl, 'N') = 'Y'
                                    THEN
                                        IF v_rct_paymt_mode IN  ('DD', 'CK', 'BU')
                                        THEN
                                            --Update the batch as failure.
                                            v_err :=
                                                   '[ '
                                                || v_proposal_no
                                                || ' HAS NO PRODUCT ATTACHED WHEREAS PRRCT IS SET TO APPLY AT PROD LEVEL.]';
                                            update_dd_err_log (
                                                'F',
                                                v_err,
                                                v_recpt_rec (i).ddd_code,
                                                NULL,             --v_dd_code,
                                                NULL,            --v_dd_batch,
                                                v_rct_paymt_mode,
                                                v_recpt_rec (i).rad_code,
                                                v_receipt_pk);
                                            v_fail_dd_proc := 'Y';
                                            CONTINUE;
                                        ELSE
                                            raise_error (
                                                   '[ '
                                                || v_proposal_no
                                                || ' HAS NO PRODUCT ATTACHED WHEREAS PRRCT IS SET TO APPLY AT PROD LEVEL.]');
                                        END IF;
                                    END IF;
                                EXCEPTION
                                    WHEN OTHERS
                                    THEN
                                        IF v_rct_paymt_mode IN ('DD', 'CK', 'BU')
                                        THEN
                                            --Update the batch as failure.
                                            v_err := 'GET TRN TYPE PRRCT';
                                            update_dd_err_log (
                                                'F',
                                                v_err,
                                                v_recpt_rec (i).ddd_code,
                                                NULL,             --v_dd_code,
                                                NULL,            --v_dd_batch,
                                                v_rct_paymt_mode,
                                                v_recpt_rec (i).rad_code,
                                                v_receipt_pk);
                                            v_fail_dd_proc := 'Y';
                                            CONTINUE;
                                        ELSE
                                            raise_error ('GET TRN TYPE PRRCT');
                                        END IF;
                                END;
                            END IF;

                            IF NVL (v_pol_status, 'D') = 'C'
                            THEN
                                BEGIN
                                    SELECT pol_type, pol_code
                                      INTO v_pol_type, v_pol_code
                                      FROM lms_policies
                                     WHERE pol_code IN
                                               (SELECT ppr_converted_pol_code
                                                  FROM lms_pol_proposals
                                                 WHERE ppr_code =
                                                       v_recpt_rec (i).pol_code);
                                EXCEPTION
                                    WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND
                                    THEN
                                        v_pol_type := v_recpt_rec (i).pol_type;
                                        v_pol_code := v_recpt_rec (i).pol_code;
                                    WHEN OTHERS
                                    THEN
                                        IF v_rct_paymt_mode IN ('DD', 'CK', 'BU')
                                        THEN
                                            --Update the batch as failure.
                                            v_err :=
                                                   'ERROR VERIFYING POLICY TYPE FOR '
                                                || v_pol_type
                                                || ': '
                                                || v_recpt_rec (i).pol_policy_no;
                                            update_dd_err_log (
                                                'F',
                                                v_err,
                                                v_recpt_rec (i).ddd_code,
                                                NULL,             --v_dd_code,
                                                NULL,            --v_dd_batch,
                                                v_rct_paymt_mode,
                                                v_recpt_rec (i).rad_code,
                                                v_receipt_pk);
                                            v_fail_dd_proc := 'Y';
                                            CONTINUE;
                                        ELSE
                                            raise_error (
                                                   'ERROR VERIFYING POLICY TYPE FOR '
                                                || v_pol_type
                                                || ': '
                                                || v_recpt_rec (i).pol_policy_no);
                                        END IF;
                                END;
                            END IF;
                        ELSIF v_pol_type IN ('PL', 'PR')
                        THEN
                            IF annuity_check (v_recpt_rec (i).pol_code,
                                              v_recpt_rec (i).pol_policy_no) =
                               'Y'
                            THEN
                                BEGIN
                                    SELECT 'PR',
                                           ann_code,
                                           prod_type,
                                           ann_status,
                                           ann_annuity_no
                                      INTO v_pol_type,
                                           v_pol_code,
                                           v_pol_prod_type,
                                           v_status,
                                           v_proposal_no
                                      FROM lms_annuities, lms_products
                                     WHERE     ann_prod_code = prod_code
                                           AND ann_code =
                                               v_recpt_rec (i).pol_code;
                                EXCEPTION
                                    WHEN OTHERS
                                    THEN
                                        IF v_rct_paymt_mode IN ('DD', 'CK', 'BU')
                                        THEN
                                            --Update the batch as failure.
                                            v_err :=
                                                   'ERROR VERIFYING POLICY TYPE FOR '
                                                || v_pol_type
                                                || ': '
                                                || v_recpt_rec (i).pol_policy_no;
                                            update_dd_err_log (
                                                'F',
                                                v_err,
                                                v_recpt_rec (i).ddd_code,
                                                NULL,             --v_dd_code,
                                                NULL,            --v_dd_batch,
                                                v_rct_paymt_mode,
                                                v_recpt_rec (i).rad_code,
                                                v_receipt_pk);
                                            v_fail_dd_proc := 'Y';
                                            CONTINUE;
                                        ELSE
                                            raise_error (
                                                   'ERROR VERIFYING POLICY TYPE FOR '
                                                || v_pol_type
                                                || ': '
                                                || v_recpt_rec (i).pol_policy_no);
                                        END IF;
                                END;
                            ELSE
                                BEGIN
                                    SELECT pol_type,
                                           pol_code,
                                           pol_prod_type,
                                           pol_status,
                                           pol_proposal_no
                                      INTO v_pol_type,
                                           v_pol_code,
                                           v_pol_prod_type,
                                           v_status,
                                           v_proposal_no
                                      FROM lms_policies
                                     WHERE pol_code = v_recpt_rec (i).pol_code;
                                EXCEPTION
                                    WHEN OTHERS
                                    THEN
                                        IF v_rct_paymt_mode IN ('DD', 'CK', 'BU')
                                        THEN
                                            --Update the batch as failure.
                                            v_err :=
                                                   'ERROR VERIFYING POLICY TYPE FOR '
                                                || v_pol_type
                                                || ': '
                                                || v_recpt_rec (i).pol_policy_no;
                                            update_dd_err_log (
                                                'F',
                                                v_err,
                                                v_recpt_rec (i).ddd_code,
                                                NULL,             --v_dd_code,
                                                NULL,            --v_dd_batch,
                                                v_rct_paymt_mode,
                                                v_recpt_rec (i).rad_code,
                                                v_receipt_pk);
                                            v_fail_dd_proc := 'Y';
                                            CONTINUE;
                                        ELSE
                                            raise_error (
                                                   'ERROR VERIFYING POLICY TYPE FOR '
                                                || v_pol_type
                                                || ': '
                                                || v_recpt_rec (i).pol_policy_no);
                                        END IF;
                                END;
                            END IF;
                        END IF;
                    END;

                    IF    v_pol_type IN ('PR', 'MPR')
                       OR (v_pol_type = 'PL' AND v_status = 'V')
                    THEN
                        BEGIN
                            SELECT    TO_NUMBER (TO_CHAR (SYSDATE, 'RRRR'))
                                   || lms_oppr_code_seq.NEXTVAL
                              INTO v_oppr_code
                              FROM DUAL;
                        EXCEPTION
                            WHEN OTHERS
                            THEN
                                raise_error (
                                    'ERROR POPULATING PROPOSAL RECEIPT SEQUENCE......');
                        END;

                        IF v_pol_type IN ('PR', 'PL')
                        THEN
                            IF NVL (
                                   annuity_check (
                                       v_recpt_rec (i).pol_code,
                                       v_recpt_rec (i).pol_policy_no),
                                   'N') =
                               'N'
                            THEN
                                IF v_acc_type = 'CK'
                                THEN
                                    BEGIN
                                        SELECT endr_checkoff_agen_code,
                                               lms_interfaces_pkg.agent_commission (
                                                   endr_checkoff_agen_code,
                                                   'CK')
                                          INTO v_chkoff_agen_code, v_chkoff_rate
                                          FROM lms_policies,
                                               lms_policy_endorsements
                                         WHERE     pol_code = endr_pol_code
                                               AND pol_current_endr_code =
                                                   endr_code
                                               AND pol_code = v_pol_code;
                                    EXCEPTION
                                        WHEN OTHERS
                                        THEN
                                            IF v_rct_paymt_mode IN  ('DD', 'CK', 'BU')
                                            THEN
                                                --Update the batch as failure.
                                                v_err :=
                                                       'ERROR DETERMINING THE CHECKOFF INSTITUTION FOR PROPOSAL NUMBER '
                                                    || v_recpt_rec (i).pol_policy_no;
                                                update_dd_err_log (
                                                    'F',
                                                    v_err,
                                                    v_recpt_rec (i).ddd_code,
                                                    NULL,         --v_dd_code,
                                                    NULL,        --v_dd_batch,
                                                    v_rct_paymt_mode,
                                                    v_recpt_rec (i).rad_code,
                                                    v_receipt_pk);
                                                v_fail_dd_proc := 'Y';
                                                CONTINUE;
                                            ELSE
                                                raise_error (
                                                       'ERROR DETERMINING THE CHECKOFF INSTITUTION FOR PROPOSAL NUMBER '
                                                    || v_recpt_rec (i).pol_policy_no);
                                            END IF;
                                    END;
                                END IF;
                            END IF;
                        ELSIF v_pol_type IN ('MPR')
                        THEN
                            IF v_acc_type = 'CK'
                            THEN
                                BEGIN
                                    SELECT DECODE (NVL (ppr_pymt_mode, 'C'),
                                                   'K', ppr_inst_code,
                                                   NULL),
                                           lms_interfaces_pkg.agent_commission (
                                               ppr_inst_code,
                                               'CK')
                                      -- COMMENTED BY FMS RATE GOTTEN FROM AGENCIES TBL USING FUNCTION
                                      --ENDR_CHECKOFF_RATE
                                      INTO v_chkoff_agen_code, v_chkoff_rate
                                      FROM lms_pol_proposals
                                     WHERE ppr_code = v_pol_code;
                                EXCEPTION
                                    WHEN OTHERS
                                    THEN
                                        IF v_rct_paymt_mode IN ('DD', 'CK', 'BU')
                                        THEN
                                            --Update the batch as failure.
                                            v_err :=
                                                   'ERROR DETERMINING THE CHECKOFF INSTITUTION FOR MARKETING PROPOSAL NUMBER '
                                                || v_recpt_rec (i).pol_policy_no;
                                            update_dd_err_log (
                                                'F',
                                                v_err,
                                                v_recpt_rec (i).ddd_code,
                                                NULL,             --v_dd_code,
                                                NULL,            --v_dd_batch,
                                                v_rct_paymt_mode,
                                                v_recpt_rec (i).rad_code,
                                                v_receipt_pk);
                                            v_fail_dd_proc := 'Y';
                                            CONTINUE;
                                        ELSE
                                            raise_error (
                                                   'ERROR DETERMINING THE CHECKOFF INSTITUTION FOR MARKETING PROPOSAL NUMBER '
                                                || v_recpt_rec (i).pol_policy_no);
                                        END IF;
                                END;
                            END IF;
                        END IF;

                        v_tot_amt :=
                              NVL (v_recpt_rec (i).pol_prem_amt, 0)
                            + NVL (v_recpt_rec (i).pol_loan_amt, 0)
                            + NVL (v_recpt_rec (i).pol_pension_amt, 0);
                        v_prem_amt := NVL (v_recpt_rec (i).pol_prem_amt, 0);
                        v_loan_amt := NVL (v_recpt_rec (i).pol_loan_amt, 0);
                        v_pension_amt := NVL (v_recpt_rec (i).pol_pension_amt, 0);

                        BEGIN
                            SELECT COUNT ('X')
                              INTO v_rct_count
                              FROM lms_ord_proposal_rcpts
                             WHERE     oppr_receipt_no = v_rct_code
                                   AND oppr_rad_code = v_recpt_rec (i).rad_code;

                            IF v_rct_count <> 0
                            THEN
                                IF v_rct_paymt_mode IN ('DD', 'CK', 'BU')
                                THEN
                                    --Update the batch as failure.
                                    v_err :=
                                           'PR RCT '
                                        || v_rct_code
                                        || 'ALREADY POSTED TO '
                                        || v_recpt_rec (i).pol_policy_no
                                        || ' AMOUNT '
                                        || v_tot_amt
                                        || '...';
                                    update_dd_err_log (
                                        'F',
                                        v_err,
                                        v_recpt_rec (i).ddd_code,
                                        NULL,                     --v_dd_code,
                                        NULL,                    --v_dd_batch,
                                        v_rct_paymt_mode,
                                        v_recpt_rec (i).rad_code,
                                        v_receipt_pk);
                                    v_fail_dd_proc := 'Y';
                                    CONTINUE;
                                ELSE
                                    raise_error (
                                           'PR RCT '
                                        || v_rct_code
                                        || 'ALREADY POSTED TO '
                                        || v_recpt_rec (i).pol_policy_no
                                        || ' AMOUNT '
                                        || v_tot_amt
                                        || '...');
                                END IF;
                            END IF;

                            v_ann_chk :=
                                NVL (
                                    annuity_check (
                                        v_recpt_rec (i).pol_code,
                                        v_recpt_rec (i).pol_policy_no),
                                    'N');

                            INSERT INTO lms_ord_proposal_rcpts (
                                            oppr_code,
                                            oppr_ltr_trans_no,
                                            oppr_date,
                                            oppr_cheque_no,
                                            oppr_amt,
                                            oppr_pol_code,
                                            oppr_pol_proposal_no,
                                            oppr_receipt_no,
                                            oppr_receipt_date,
                                            oppr_pmth_code,
                                            opr_chk_agen_code,
                                            opri_chk_comm_rate,
                                            opri_chk_comm_amt,
                                            oppr_done_by,
                                            oppr_drcr,
                                            oppr_receipt_trans_code,
                                            oppr_ann_code,
                                            oppr_fms_receipt_pk,
                                            oppr_deduction_date,
                                            oppr_rad_code)
                                     VALUES (
                                         v_oppr_code,
                                         NULL,
                                         TRUNC (SYSDATE),
                                         v_chq_no,
                                         v_tot_amt,
                                         DECODE (
                                             v_ann_chk,
                                             'Y', NULL,
                                             DECODE (v_pol_type,
                                                     'PR', v_pol_code,
                                                     'PL', v_pol_code,
                                                     NULL)),
                                         v_proposal_no,  --v_recpt_rec(i).POL_POLICY_NO,
                                         v_rct_code,
                                         v_date,
                                         v_pay_method_code,
                                         v_chkoff_agen_code,
                                         v_chkoff_rate,
                                         ROUND (
                                               NVL (v_chkoff_rate, 0)
                                             / 100
                                             * v_tot_amt),
                                         v_user_name,
                                         DECODE (SIGN (v_tot_amt),
                                                 1, 'C',
                                                 'D'),
                                         v_oppr_receipt_trans_code,
                                         DECODE (v_ann_chk,
                                                 'Y', v_pol_code,
                                                 NULL),
                                         v_receipt_pk,
                                         v_deduction_date,
                                         v_recpt_rec (i).rad_code); --v_pay_method);
                        EXCEPTION
                            WHEN OTHERS
                            THEN
                                IF v_rct_paymt_mode IN ('DD', 'CK', 'BU')
                                THEN
                                    --Update the batch as failure.
                                    v_err :=
                                        'ERROR INSERTING PROPOSAL RECEIPT DETAILS......';
                                    update_dd_err_log (
                                        'F',
                                        v_err,
                                        v_recpt_rec (i).ddd_code,
                                        NULL,                     --v_dd_code,
                                        NULL,                    --v_dd_batch,
                                        v_rct_paymt_mode,
                                        v_recpt_rec (i).rad_code,
                                        v_receipt_pk);
                                    v_fail_dd_proc := 'Y';
                                    CONTINUE;
                                ELSE
                                    raise_error (
                                        'ERROR INSERTING PROPOSAL RECEIPT DETAILS......');
                                END IF;
                        END;

                        IF v_acc_type = 'CK'
                        THEN
                            BEGIN
                                IF     v_pol_type IN ('PR', 'PL')
                                   AND NOT NVL (
                                               annuity_check (
                                                   v_recpt_rec (i).pol_code,
                                                   v_recpt_rec (i).pol_policy_no),
                                               'N') =
                                           'Y'
                                THEN
                                    UPDATE lms_policy_endorsements
                                       SET endr_last_prem_amt =
                                               NVL (
                                                   v_recpt_rec (i).pol_prem_amt,
                                                   endr_last_prem_amt),
                                           endr_last_pens_amt =
                                               NVL (
                                                   v_recpt_rec (i).pol_pension_amt,
                                                   endr_last_pens_amt)
                                     WHERE endr_code =
                                           (SELECT pol_current_endr_code
                                              FROM lms_policies
                                             WHERE pol_code = v_pol_code);
                                ELSIF v_pol_type = ('MPR')
                                THEN
                                    UPDATE lms_pol_proposals
                                       SET ppr_last_prem_amt =
                                               NVL (
                                                   v_recpt_rec (i).pol_prem_amt,
                                                   ppr_prem_amt)
                                     WHERE ppr_code = v_pol_code;
                                END IF;
                            EXCEPTION
                                WHEN OTHERS
                                THEN
                                    IF v_rct_paymt_mode IN ('DD', 'CK', 'BU')
                                    THEN
                                        --Update the batch as failure.
                                        v_err := 'UPDATING LAST RECEIPT AMT.';
                                        update_dd_err_log (
                                            'F',
                                            v_err,
                                            v_recpt_rec (i).ddd_code,
                                            NULL,                 --v_dd_code,
                                            NULL,                --v_dd_batch,
                                            v_rct_paymt_mode,
                                            v_recpt_rec (i).rad_code,
                                            v_receipt_pk);
                                        v_fail_dd_proc := 'Y';
                                        CONTINUE;
                                    ELSE
                                        raise_error (
                                            'UPDATING LAST RECEIPT AMT.');
                                    END IF;
                            END;
                        END IF;
                    ELSE
                        v_fetched_policy := v_recpt_rec (i).pol_policy_no;

                        IF v_pol_type != 'LN'
                        THEN
                            v_fetched_pol_code := v_pol_code;
                        ELSE
                            BEGIN
                                SELECT pln_pol_code
                                  INTO v_fetched_pol_code
                                  FROM lms_policy_loans
                                 WHERE pln_lna_no = v_pol_code;
                            EXCEPTION
                                WHEN OTHERS
                                THEN
                                    IF v_rct_paymt_mode IN ('DD', 'CK', 'BU')
                                    THEN
                                        --Update the batch as failure.
                                        v_err :=
                                               '#ERROR RETRIEVING DETAILS FOR POLICY NO. '
                                            || v_recpt_rec (i).pol_policy_no
                                            || ';'
                                            || v_recpt_rec (i).pol_code
                                            || '...';
                                        update_dd_err_log (
                                            'F',
                                            v_err,
                                            v_recpt_rec (i).ddd_code,
                                            NULL,                 --v_dd_code,
                                            NULL,                --v_dd_batch,
                                            v_rct_paymt_mode,
                                            v_recpt_rec (i).rad_code,
                                            v_receipt_pk);
                                        v_fail_dd_proc := 'Y';
                                        CONTINUE;
                                    ELSE
                                        raise_error (
                                               '#ERROR RETRIEVING DETAILS FOR POLICY NO. '
                                            || v_recpt_rec (i).pol_policy_no
                                            || ';'
                                            || v_recpt_rec (i).pol_code
                                            || '...');
                                    END IF;
                            END;
                        END IF;

                        BEGIN
                            SELECT pol_instlmt_prem,
                                   pol_current_endr_code,
                                   pol_prod_code
                              INTO v_inst_prem, v_endr_code, v_prod_code
                              FROM lms_policies
                             WHERE pol_code = v_fetched_pol_code;
                        EXCEPTION
                            WHEN OTHERS
                            THEN
                                IF v_rct_paymt_mode IN ('DD', 'CK', 'BU')
                                THEN
                                    --Update the batch as failure.
                                    v_err :=
                                           '*ERROR FETCHING DETAILS FOR POLICY NO. '
                                        || v_recpt_rec (i).pol_policy_no
                                        || ';'
                                        || v_recpt_rec (i).pol_code
                                        || '...';
                                    update_dd_err_log (
                                        'F',
                                        v_err,
                                        v_recpt_rec (i).ddd_code,
                                        NULL,                     --v_dd_code,
                                        NULL,                    --v_dd_batch,
                                        v_rct_paymt_mode,
                                        v_recpt_rec (i).rad_code,
                                        v_receipt_pk);
                                    v_fail_dd_proc := 'Y';
                                    CONTINUE;
                                ELSE
                                    raise_error (
                                           '*ERROR FETCHING DETAILS FOR POLICY NO. '
                                        || v_recpt_rec (i).pol_policy_no
                                        || ';'
                                        || v_recpt_rec (i).pol_code
                                        || '...');
                                END IF;
                        END;

                        IF    NVL (v_recpt_rec (i).pol_prem_amt, 0) <> 0
                           OR NVL (v_recpt_rec (i).pol_loan_amt, 0) <> 0
                        THEN
                            BEGIN
                                SELECT    TO_NUMBER (TO_CHAR (SYSDATE, 'RRRR'))
                                       || lms_opr_code_seq.NEXTVAL
                                  INTO v_opr_code
                                  FROM DUAL;
                            EXCEPTION
                                WHEN OTHERS
                                THEN
                                    IF v_rct_paymt_mode IN ('DD', 'CK', 'BU')
                                    THEN
                                        --Update the batch as failure.
                                        v_err :=
                                            'ERROR POPULATING POLICY RECEIPT SEQUENCE......';
                                        update_dd_err_log (
                                            'F',
                                            v_err,
                                            v_recpt_rec (i).ddd_code,
                                            NULL,                 --v_dd_code,
                                            NULL,                --v_dd_batch,
                                            v_rct_paymt_mode,
                                            v_recpt_rec (i).rad_code,
                                            v_receipt_pk);
                                        v_fail_dd_proc := 'Y';
                                        CONTINUE;
                                    ELSE
                                        raise_error (
                                            'ERROR POPULATING POLICY RECEIPT SEQUENCE......');
                                    END IF;
                            END;

                            v_tot_amt :=
                                  NVL (v_recpt_rec (i).pol_prem_amt, 0)
                                + NVL (v_recpt_rec (i).pol_loan_amt, 0);

                            IF NVL (v_recpt_rec (i).pol_prem_amt, 0) <> 0
                            THEN
                                v_alloc_to := 'PR';
                            ELSIF NVL (v_recpt_rec (i).pol_loan_amt, 0) <> 0
                            THEN
                                v_alloc_to := 'LN';
                            END IF;

                            SELECT COUNT ('X')
                              INTO v_rct_count
                              FROM lms_ord_prem_receipts
                             WHERE     opr_receipt_no = v_rct_code
                                   AND opr_rad_code = v_recpt_rec (i).rad_code;

                            IF     NVL (v_recpt_rec (i).pol_prem_amt, 0) <> 0
                               AND NVL (v_recpt_rec (i).pol_loan_amt, 0) <> 0
                            THEN
                                IF v_rct_count > 0
                                THEN
                                    IF v_rct_paymt_mode IN ('DD', 'CK', 'BU')
                                    THEN
                                        --Update the batch as failure.
                                        v_err :=
                                               '1.PL RCT '
                                            || v_rct_code
                                            || 'ALREADY POSTED TO '
                                            || v_recpt_rec (i).pol_policy_no
                                            || '..'
                                            || v_tot_amt;
                                        update_dd_err_log (
                                            'F',
                                            v_err,
                                            v_recpt_rec (i).ddd_code,
                                            NULL,                 --v_dd_code,
                                            NULL,                --v_dd_batch,
                                            v_rct_paymt_mode,
                                            v_recpt_rec (i).rad_code,
                                            v_receipt_pk);
                                        v_fail_dd_proc := 'Y';
                                        CONTINUE;
                                    ELSE
                                        raise_error (
                                               '1.PL RCT '
                                            || v_rct_code
                                            || 'ALREADY POSTED TO '
                                            || v_recpt_rec (i).pol_policy_no
                                            || '..'
                                            || v_tot_amt);
                                    END IF;
                                END IF;
                            ELSE
                            IF v_rct_count > 0
                                THEN
                                    IF v_rct_paymt_mode IN ('DD', 'CK', 'BU')
                                    THEN
                                        --Update the batch as failure.
                                        v_err :=
                                               '2.PL RCT '
                                            || v_rct_code
                                            || 'ALREADY POSTED TO '
                                            || v_recpt_rec (i).pol_policy_no
                                            || '..'
                                            || v_tot_amt;
                                        update_dd_err_log (
                                            'F',
                                            v_err,
                                            v_recpt_rec (i).ddd_code,
                                            NULL,                 --v_dd_code,
                                            NULL,                --v_dd_batch,
                                            v_rct_paymt_mode,
                                            v_recpt_rec (i).rad_code,
                                            v_receipt_pk);
                                        v_fail_dd_proc := 'Y';
                                        CONTINUE;
                                    ELSE
                                        raise_error (
                                               '2.PL RCT '
                                            || v_rct_code
                                            || 'ALREADY POSTED TO '
                                            || v_recpt_rec (i).pol_policy_no
                                            || '..'
                                            || v_tot_amt);
                                    END IF;
                                END IF;
                            END IF;

                            IF NVL (v_cap_inj, 'N') = 'Y'
                            THEN
                                BEGIN
                                    v_capinj_allow :=
                                        lms_ord_misc.allow_capital_injection_rcpt (
                                            v_pol_code,
                                            v_date,
                                            v_tot_amt);
                                EXCEPTION
                                    WHEN OTHERS
                                    THEN
                                        IF v_rct_paymt_mode IN ('DD', 'CK', 'BU')
                                        THEN
                                            --Update the batch as failure.
                                            v_err :=
                                                'CHECKING IF CAPITAL INJECTION IS ALLOWED...1';
                                            update_dd_err_log (
                                                'F',
                                                v_err,
                                                v_recpt_rec (i).ddd_code,
                                                NULL,             --v_dd_code,
                                                NULL,            --v_dd_batch,
                                                v_rct_paymt_mode,
                                                v_recpt_rec (i).rad_code,
                                                v_receipt_pk);
                                            v_fail_dd_proc := 'Y';
                                            CONTINUE;
                                        ELSE
                                            raise_error (
                                                'CHECKING IF CAPITAL INJECTION IS ALLOWED...1');
                                        END IF;
                                END;

                                IF NVL (v_capinj_allow, 'N') = 'Y'
                                THEN
                                    IF v_rct_paymt_mode IN ('DD', 'CK', 'BU')
                                    THEN
                                        --Update the batch as failure.
                                        v_err :=
                                            'THE CAPITAL INJECTION RECEIPT THRESHOLD HAS BEEN EXCEED ON THIS POLICY. CANNOT PROCEED.';
                                        update_dd_err_log (
                                            'F',
                                            v_err,
                                            v_recpt_rec (i).ddd_code,
                                            NULL,                 --v_dd_code,
                                            NULL,                --v_dd_batch,
                                            v_rct_paymt_mode,
                                            v_recpt_rec (i).rad_code,
                                            v_receipt_pk);
                                        v_fail_dd_proc := 'Y';
                                        CONTINUE;
                                    ELSE
                                        raise_error (
                                            'THE CAPITAL INJECTION RECEIPT THRESHOLD HAS BEEN EXCEED ON THIS POLICY. CANNOT PROCEED.');
                                    END IF;
                                END IF;

                                BEGIN
                                    SELECT pspl_min_contri
                                      INTO v_min_cap_inj
                                      FROM lms_prod_sa_prem_limits
                                     WHERE     pspl_pay_freq = 'CI'
                                           AND pspl_pop_code IS NULL
                                           AND pspl_prod_code = v_prod_code;
                                EXCEPTION
                                    WHEN OTHERS
                                    THEN
                                        IF v_rct_paymt_mode IN ('DD', 'CK', 'BU')
                                        THEN
                                            --Update the batch as failure.
                                            v_err :=
                                                'VALIDATE CAPITAL INJECTION AMT...';
                                            update_dd_err_log (
                                                'F',
                                                v_err,
                                                v_recpt_rec (i).ddd_code,
                                                NULL,             --v_dd_code,
                                                NULL,            --v_dd_batch,
                                                v_rct_paymt_mode,
                                                v_recpt_rec (i).rad_code,
                                                v_receipt_pk);
                                            v_fail_dd_proc := 'Y';
                                            CONTINUE;
                                        ELSE
                                            raise_error (
                                                   'VALIDATE CAPITAL INJECTION AMT...'
                                                || v_prod_code);
                                        END IF;
                                END;

                                IF NVL (v_min_cap_inj, 0) > NVL (v_tot_amt, 0)
                                THEN
                                    IF v_rct_paymt_mode IN ('DD', 'CK', 'BU')
                                    THEN
                                        --Update the batch as failure.
                                        v_err :=
                                               'MINIMUM CAPITAL INJECTION AMOUNT ALLOWED IS '
                                            || NVL (v_min_cap_inj, 0)
                                            || '...';
                                        update_dd_err_log (
                                            'F',
                                            v_err,
                                            v_recpt_rec (i).ddd_code,
                                            NULL,                 --v_dd_code,
                                            NULL,                --v_dd_batch,
                                            v_rct_paymt_mode,
                                            v_recpt_rec (i).rad_code,
                                            v_receipt_pk);
                                        v_fail_dd_proc := 'Y';
                                        CONTINUE;
                                    ELSE
                                        raise_error (
                                               'MINIMUM CAPITAL INJECTION AMOUNT ALLOWED IS '
                                            || NVL (v_min_cap_inj, 0)
                                            || '...');
                                    END IF;
                                END IF;
                            END IF;

                            BEGIN
                                INSERT INTO lms_ord_prem_receipts (
                                                opr_code,
                                                opr_ltr_trans_no,
                                                opr_date,
                                                opr_cheque_no,
                                                opr_amt,
                                                opr_pol_code,
                                                opr_pol_policy_no,
                                                opr_receipt_no,
                                                opr_receipt_date,
                                                opr_pmth_code,
                                                opr_done_by,
                                                opr_drcr,
                                                opr_source,
                                                opr_receipt_trans_code,
                                                opr_fms_receipt_pk,
                                                opr_origin,
                                                opr_alloc_to,
                                                opr_capital_injectn,
                                                opr_chk_comm,
                                                opr_chk_comm_rate,
                                                opr_lna_no,
                                                opr_deduction_date,
                                                opr_loan_pymt_amt,
                                                opr_rad_code)
                                         VALUES (
                                             v_opr_code,
                                             NULL,
                                             TRUNC (SYSDATE),
                                             SUBSTR (v_chq_no, 1, 20),
                                             v_tot_amt,
                                             v_fetched_pol_code,
                                         NVL (v_policy_no,
                                              v_recpt_rec (i).pol_policy_no),
                                             v_rct_code,
                                             v_date,
                                             v_pay_method_code,
                                             v_user_name,
                                             DECODE (SIGN (v_tot_amt),
                                                     1, 'C',
                                                     'D'),
                                             'RECEIPT',
                                             v_opr_receipt_trans_code,
                                             v_receipt_pk,
                                             'I',
                                             v_alloc_to,
                                             v_cap_inj,
                                               (v_chkoff_rate / 100)
                                             * v_tot_amt,
                                             v_chkoff_rate,
                                             DECODE (
                                                 v_pol_type,
                                                 'LN', v_recpt_rec (i).pol_code),
                                             v_deduction_date,
                                             DECODE (v_alloc_to,
                                                 'LN', v_tot_amt,
                                                 NULL),
                                             v_recpt_rec (i).rad_code);
                            EXCEPTION
                                WHEN OTHERS
                                THEN
                                    IF v_rct_paymt_mode IN ('DD', 'CK')
                                    THEN
                                        --Update the batch as failure.
                                        v_err := 'PREM RCPT DTLS...';
                                        update_dd_err_log (
                                            'F',
                                            v_err,
                                            v_recpt_rec (i).ddd_code,
                                            NULL,                     --v_dd_code,
                                            NULL,                    --v_dd_batch,
                                            v_rct_paymt_mode,
                                            v_recpt_rec (i).rad_code,
                                            v_receipt_pk);
                                        v_fail_dd_proc := 'Y';
                                        CONTINUE;
                                    ELSE
                                        raise_error ('PREM RCPT DTLS...');
                                    END IF;
                            END;

                            --Process any exceptions related to allocations.
                            /*BEGIN
                                lms_process_receipts.check_alloc_exception (
                                    v_fetched_pol_code,
                                    v_opr_code);
                            EXCEPTION
                                WHEN OTHERS
                                THEN
                                    raise_error (
                                        'Error Processing Receipt Exceptions.');
                            END;*/

                            IF v_acc_type = 'CK'
                            THEN
                                BEGIN
                                    IF v_pol_type = ('PL')
                                    THEN
                                        UPDATE lms_policy_endorsements
                                           SET endr_last_prem_amt =
                                                   NVL (
                                                       v_recpt_rec (i).pol_prem_amt,
                                                       endr_last_prem_amt),
                                               endr_last_pens_amt =
                                                   NVL (
                                                       v_recpt_rec (i).pol_pension_amt,
                                                       endr_last_pens_amt)
                                         WHERE endr_code =
                                               (SELECT pol_current_endr_code
                                                  FROM lms_policies
                                                 WHERE pol_code =
                                                       v_fetched_pol_code);
                                    ELSIF v_pol_type = ('LN')
                                    THEN
                                        UPDATE lms_policy_loans
                                           SET pln_last_pmt_amt =
                                                   NVL (
                                                       v_recpt_rec (i).pol_loan_amt,
                                                       pln_last_pmt_amt)
                                         WHERE pln_lna_no = v_pol_code;
                                    END IF;
                                EXCEPTION
                                    WHEN OTHERS
                                    THEN
                                        IF v_rct_paymt_mode IN
                                               ('DD', 'CK', 'BU')
                                        THEN
                                            --Update the batch as failure.
                                            v_err :=
                                                   'UPDATING LAST RECEIPT AMT. -'
                                            || v_pol_type
                                            || ' '
                                            || SQLERRM (SQLCODE);
                                            update_dd_err_log (
                                                'F',
                                                v_err,
                                                v_recpt_rec (i).ddd_code,
                                                NULL,             --v_dd_code,
                                                NULL,            --v_dd_batch,
                                                v_rct_paymt_mode,
                                                v_recpt_rec (i).rad_code,
                                                v_receipt_pk);
                                            v_fail_dd_proc := 'Y';
                                            CONTINUE;
                                        ELSE
                                            raise_error (
                                                   'UPDATING LAST RECEIPT AMT. -'
                                                || v_pol_type);
                                        END IF;
                                END;
                            END IF;
                        END IF;

                        IF NVL (v_recpt_rec (i).pol_pension_amt, 0) <> 0
                        THEN
                            IF NOT NVL (v_pol_prod_type, 'ED') IN
                                       ('PN', 'IN', 'AN')
                            THEN
                                IF v_rct_paymt_mode IN ('DD', 'CK', 'BU')
                                THEN
                                    --Update the batch as failure.
                                    v_err :=
                                           'AN ALLOCATION TO PENSION WAS DONE FOR POLICY NO.'
                                        || v_recpt_rec (i).pol_policy_no
                                        || ';'
                                        || v_pol_type
                                        || ';'
                                        || v_pol_prod_type
                                        || ';'
                                        || v_fetched_pol_code
                                        || ';'
                                        || v_recpt_rec (i).pol_code
                                        || ' WHICH ISNT A PENSION POLICY....';
                                    update_dd_err_log (
                                        'F',
                                        v_err,
                                        v_recpt_rec (i).ddd_code,
                                        NULL,                     --v_dd_code,
                                        NULL,                    --v_dd_batch,
                                        v_rct_paymt_mode,
                                        v_recpt_rec (i).rad_code,
                                        v_receipt_pk);
                                    v_fail_dd_proc := 'Y';
                                    CONTINUE;
                                ELSE
                                    raise_error (
                                           'AN ALLOCATION TO PENSION WAS DONE FOR POLICY NO.'
                                        || v_recpt_rec (i).pol_policy_no
                                        || ';'
                                        || v_pol_type
                                        || ';'
                                        || v_pol_prod_type
                                        || ';'
                                        || v_fetched_pol_code
                                        || ';'
                                        || v_recpt_rec (i).pol_code
                                        || ' WHICH ISNT A PENSION POLICY....');
                                END IF;
                            END IF;

                            BEGIN
                                SELECT    TO_NUMBER (
                                              TO_CHAR (SYSDATE, 'RRRR'))
                                       || lms_opr_code_seq.NEXTVAL
                                  INTO v_pens_opr_code
                                  FROM DUAL;
                            EXCEPTION
                                WHEN OTHERS
                                THEN
                                    IF v_rct_paymt_mode IN ('DD', 'CK', 'BU')
                                    THEN
                                        --Update the batch as failure.
                                        v_err :=
                                            'ERROR POPULATING POLICY RECEIPT SEQUENCE......';
                                        update_dd_err_log (
                                            'F',
                                            v_err,
                                            v_recpt_rec (i).ddd_code,
                                            NULL,                 --v_dd_code,
                                            NULL,                --v_dd_batch,
                                            v_rct_paymt_mode,
                                            v_recpt_rec (i).rad_code,
                                            v_receipt_pk);
                                        v_fail_dd_proc := 'Y';
                                        CONTINUE;
                                    ELSE
                                        raise_error (
                                            'ERROR POPULATING POLICY RECEIPT SEQUENCE......');
                                    END IF;
                            END;

                        v_tot_amt := NVL (v_recpt_rec (i).pol_pension_amt, 0);

                            SELECT COUNT ('X')
                              INTO v_rct_count
                              FROM lms_ord_prem_receipts
                             WHERE     opr_receipt_no = v_rct_code
                                   AND opr_receipt_date = v_date
                                   AND opr_amt = v_tot_amt
                                   AND opr_pens_pymt_amt =
                                   NVL (v_recpt_rec (i).pol_pension_amt, 0)
                                   AND opr_pol_policy_no =
                                       v_recpt_rec (i).pol_policy_no;

                            BEGIN
                                INSERT INTO lms_ord_prem_receipts (
                                                opr_code,
                                                opr_ltr_trans_no,
                                                opr_date,
                                                opr_cheque_no,
                                                opr_amt,
                                                opr_pol_code,
                                                opr_pol_policy_no,
                                                opr_receipt_no,
                                                opr_receipt_date,
                                                opr_pmth_code,
                                                opr_done_by,
                                                opr_drcr,
                                                opr_source,
                                                opr_receipt_trans_code,
                                                opr_fms_receipt_pk,
                                                opr_origin,
                                                opr_alloc_to,
                                                opr_capital_injectn,
                                                opr_chk_comm,
                                                opr_chk_comm_rate,
                                                opr_deduction_date)
                                         VALUES (
                                             v_pens_opr_code,
                                             NULL,
                                             TRUNC (SYSDATE),
                                             v_chq_no,
                                             v_tot_amt,
                                             v_fetched_pol_code,
                                         NVL (v_policy_no,
                                              v_recpt_rec (i).pol_policy_no),
                                             v_rct_code,
                                             v_date,
                                             v_pay_method_code,
                                             v_user_name,
                                             DECODE (SIGN (v_tot_amt),
                                                     1, 'C',
                                                     'D'),
                                             'RECEIPT',
                                             v_opr_receipt_trans_code,
                                             v_receipt_pk,
                                             'I',
                                             'PN',
                                             v_cap_inj,
                                               (v_chkoff_rate / 100)
                                             * v_tot_amt,
                                             v_chkoff_rate,
                                             v_deduction_date);
                            EXCEPTION
                                WHEN OTHERS
                                THEN
                                    IF v_rct_paymt_mode IN ('DD', 'CK', 'BU')
                                    THEN
                                        --Update the batch as failure.
                                        v_err := 'PENS/INV RCPT DTLS...';
                                        update_dd_err_log (
                                            'F',
                                            v_err,
                                            v_recpt_rec (i).ddd_code,
                                            NULL,                 --v_dd_code,
                                            NULL,                --v_dd_batch,
                                            v_rct_paymt_mode,
                                            v_recpt_rec (i).rad_code,
                                            v_receipt_pk);
                                        v_fail_dd_proc := 'Y';
                                        CONTINUE;
                                    ELSE
                                        raise_error ('PENS/INV RCPT DTLS...');
                                    END IF;
                            END;

                            --Process any exceptions related to allocations.
                            /*BEGIN
                                lms_process_receipts.check_alloc_exception (
                                    v_fetched_pol_code,
                                    v_pens_opr_code);
                            EXCEPTION
                                WHEN OTHERS
                                THEN
                                    raise_error (
                                        'Error Processing Receipt Exceptions.');
                            END;*/
                        END IF;

                        --*************************************************************************
                        --THIS IS TO OVERRIDE ALL THE ABOVE UNTIL THE PROCEDURE IS WORKING CORRECTLY
                        v_only_due_inst := 'N';

                        --*************************************************************************
                        BEGIN
                            SELECT agn_act_code
                              INTO v_ac_type
                              FROM lms_agencies,
                                   lms_policy_endorsements,
                                   lms_policies
                             WHERE     endr_code = pol_current_endr_code
                                   AND agn_code = endr_agen_code
                                   AND pol_code = v_fetched_pol_code;
                        EXCEPTION
                            WHEN OTHERS
                            THEN
                                IF v_rct_paymt_mode IN ('DD', 'CK', 'BU')
                                THEN
                                    --Update the batch as failure.
                                    v_err :=
                                           'SYSTEM UNABLE TO DETERMINE AGENCY TYPE FOR '
                                        || v_recpt_rec (i).pol_policy_no
                                        || ' POL CODE - '
                                        || v_pol_code;
                                    update_dd_err_log (
                                        'F',
                                        v_err,
                                        v_recpt_rec (i).ddd_code,
                                        NULL,                     --v_dd_code,
                                        NULL,                    --v_dd_batch,
                                        v_rct_paymt_mode,
                                        v_recpt_rec (i).rad_code,
                                        v_receipt_pk);
                                    v_fail_dd_proc := 'Y';
                                    CONTINUE;
                                ELSE
                                    raise_error (
                                           'SYSTEM UNABLE TO DETERMINE AGENCY TYPE FOR '
                                        || v_recpt_rec (i).pol_policy_no
                                        || ' POL CODE - '
                                        || v_pol_code);
                                END IF;
                        END;

                        BEGIN
                            SELECT NVL (endr_inv_rider, 'N')
                              INTO v_inv_rider
                              FROM lms_policies, lms_policy_endorsements
                             WHERE     endr_code = pol_current_endr_code
                                   AND endr_pol_code = v_pol_code;
                        EXCEPTION
                            --ADITED BY ALVIN TO CATER FOR NA DTA ON END_INV_ROIDER
                            WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND
                            THEN
                                v_inv_rider := 'N';
                            WHEN OTHERS
                            THEN
                                IF v_rct_paymt_mode IN ('DD', 'CK', 'BU')
                                THEN
                                    --Update the batch as failure.
                                    v_err :=
                                           'SYSTEM UNABLE TO DETERMINE IF INVESTMENT RIDER IS APPLICABLE FOR '
                                        || v_recpt_rec (i).pol_policy_no;
                                    update_dd_err_log (
                                        'F',
                                        v_err,
                                        v_recpt_rec (i).ddd_code,
                                        NULL,                     --v_dd_code,
                                        NULL,                    --v_dd_batch,
                                        v_rct_paymt_mode,
                                        v_recpt_rec (i).rad_code,
                                        v_receipt_pk);
                                    v_fail_dd_proc := 'Y';
                                    CONTINUE;
                                ELSE
                                    raise_error (
                                           'SYSTEM UNABLE TO DETERMINE IF INVESTMENT RIDER IS APPLICABLE FOR '
                                        || v_recpt_rec (i).pol_policy_no);
                                END IF;
                        END;

                    IF    (    NVL (v_pol_prod_type, 'ED') IN ('IN', 'AN')
                               AND NVL (v_recpt_rec (i).pol_loan_amt, 0) = 0)
                           OR (NVL (v_cap_inj, 'N') = 'Y')
                           OR (NVL (v_inv_rider, 'N') = 'Y')
                        THEN
                            IF NVL (v_recpt_rec (i).pol_prem_amt, 0) <> 0
                            THEN
                                BEGIN
                                    lms_investments.process_receipt (
                                        v_fetched_pol_code,
                                        v_opr_code,
                                        NULL);
                                EXCEPTION
                                    WHEN OTHERS
                                    THEN

                                        IF v_rct_paymt_mode IN
                                               ('DD', 'CK', 'BU')
                                        THEN
                                            --Update the batch as failure.
                                            v_err :=
                                                   'INVESTMENT ALLOCATION - '
                                                || SQLERRM (SQLCODE);
                                            update_dd_err_log (
                                                'F',
                                                v_err,
                                                v_recpt_rec (i).ddd_code,
                                                NULL,             --v_dd_code,
                                                NULL,            --v_dd_batch,
                                                v_rct_paymt_mode,
                                                v_recpt_rec (i).rad_code,
                                                v_receipt_pk);
                                            v_fail_dd_proc := 'Y';
                                            CONTINUE;
                                        ELSE
                                            raise_error (
                                                   'API  v_fetched_pol_code =='
                                                || v_fetched_pol_code);
                                        END IF;
                                END;
                            END IF;

                            IF NVL (v_recpt_rec (i).pol_pension_amt, 0) <> 0
                            THEN
                                BEGIN
                                    lms_investments.process_receipt (
