                                        v_fetched_pol_code,
                                        v_pens_opr_code,
                                        NULL);
                                EXCEPTION
                                    WHEN OTHERS
                                    THEN
                                        IF v_rct_paymt_mode IN
                                               ('DD', 'CK', 'BU')
                                        THEN
                                            --Update the batch as failure.
                                            v_err :=
                                                   'PENSION ALLOCATION - '
                                                || SQLERRM (SQLCODE);
                                            update_dd_err_log (
                                                'F',
                                                v_err,
                                                v_recpt_rec (i).ddd_code,
                                                NULL,             --v_dd_code,
                                                NULL,            --v_dd_batch,
                                                v_rct_paymt_mode,
                                                v_recpt_rec (i).rad_code,
                                                v_receipt_pk);
                                            v_fail_dd_proc := 'Y';
                                            CONTINUE;
                                        ELSE
                                            raise_error (
                                                   'PROCESSING INV. FOR POL NO. '
                                                || v_recpt_rec (i).pol_policy_no
                                                || '...');
                                        END IF;
                                END;
                            END IF;
                        ELSE
                            IF (    (NVL (v_recpt_rec (i).pol_prem_amt, 0) <> 0)
                                AND (v_pol_type != 'LN'))
                            THEN
                                BEGIN
                                    IF NVL (v_full_inst_param, 'N') = 'Y'
                                    THEN
                                        lms_process_receipts.clear_partial_installments (
                                            v_fetched_pol_code,
                                            v_opr_code);
                                    ELSE
                                        lms_process_receipts.lms_ord_premium_receipts (
                                            v_fetched_pol_code,
                                            v_opr_code,
                                            v_multiple_inst,
                                            v_only_due_inst,
                                            v_tran_no,
                                            v_ac_type,
                                            v_bal_amt);
                                    END IF;
                                EXCEPTION
                                    WHEN OTHERS
                                    THEN
                                        --Update the batch as failure.
                                        IF v_rct_paymt_mode IN
                                               ('DD', 'CK', 'BU')
                                        THEN
                                            --Update the batch as failure.
                                            v_err :=
                                                   'RISK ALLOCATION - '
                                                || SQLERRM (SQLCODE);
                                            update_dd_err_log (
                                                'F',
                                                v_err,
                                                v_recpt_rec (i).ddd_code,
                                                NULL,             --v_dd_code,
                                                NULL,            --v_dd_batch,
                                                v_rct_paymt_mode,
                                                v_recpt_rec (i).rad_code,
                                                v_receipt_pk);
                                            v_fail_dd_proc := 'Y';
                                            CONTINUE;
                                        ELSE
                                            raise_error (
                                                   'PROCESSING LMS PREM PYMT FOR '
                                                || v_recpt_rec (i).pol_policy_no
                                                || '....');
                                        END IF;
                                END;
                            END IF;

                            --******************* LOAN PAYMENT PROCESSING ************************
                            IF (NVL (v_recpt_rec (i).pol_loan_amt, 0) <> 0)
                            THEN
                                v_nfl_alloc := 0;

                                FOR cur_pol_loan_rec
                                    IN cur_pol_loan (v_pol_code)
                                LOOP
                                    BEGIN
                                        UPDATE lms_policy_loans
                                           SET pln_rcpt_alloc_amt =
                                                   v_recpt_rec (i).pol_loan_amt
                                         WHERE pln_lna_no = v_pol_code;
                                    EXCEPTION
                                        WHEN OTHERS
                                        THEN
                                            --Update the batch as failure.
                                            IF v_rct_paymt_mode IN
                                                   ('DD', 'CK', 'BU')
                                            THEN
                                                --Update the batch as failure.
                                                v_err :=
                                                       'UPDATING LOAN AMT FOR '
                                                    || v_recpt_rec (i).pol_policy_no
                                                    || '/'
                                                    || v_pol_code
                                                    || '...';
                                                update_dd_err_log (
                                                    'F',
                                                    v_err,
                                                    v_recpt_rec (i).ddd_code,
                                                    NULL,         --v_dd_code,
                                                    NULL,        --v_dd_batch,
                                                    v_rct_paymt_mode,
                                                    v_recpt_rec (i).rad_code,
                                                    v_receipt_pk);
                                                v_fail_dd_proc := 'Y';
                                                CONTINUE;
                                            ELSE
                                                raise_error (
                                                       'UPDATING LOAN AMT FOR '
                                                    || v_recpt_rec (i).pol_policy_no
                                                    || '/'
                                                    || v_pol_code
                                                    || '...');
                                            END IF;
                                    END;

                                    BEGIN
                                        lms_ord_pol_loan_pkg.process_loan_pymt (
                                            v_opr_code);
                                        /*lms_process_receipts.process_loan_pymt (
                                            v_recpt_rec (i).pol_loan_amt,
                                            --v_rcpt_alloc_amt  NUMBER,
                                            v_pol_code, --v_pln_lna_no  NUMBER,
                                            v_date,     --v_recpt_date   DATE,
                                            v_rct_code, --v_chq_rcpt_no VARCHAR2,
                                            v_opr_code,   --v_opr_code NUMBER,
                                            v_endr_code, --v_endr_code  NUMBER,
                                            v_user_name); --v_user   VARCHAR2) ;*/
                                    EXCEPTION
                                        WHEN OTHERS
                                        THEN
                                            --Update the batch as failure.
                                            IF v_rct_paymt_mode IN
                                                   ('DD', 'CK', 'BU')
                                            THEN
                                                --Update the batch as failure.
                                                v_err :=
                                                       'UPDATING LOAN RCPT FOR '
                                                    || v_recpt_rec (i).pol_policy_no
                                                || '...LOAN '
                                                || v_pol_code
                                                || '... '
                                                || SQLERRM (SQLCODE);
                                                update_dd_err_log (
                                                    'F',
                                                    v_err,
                                                    v_recpt_rec (i).ddd_code,
                                                    NULL,         --v_dd_code,
                                                    NULL,        --v_dd_batch,
                                                    v_rct_paymt_mode,
                                                    v_recpt_rec (i).rad_code,
                                                    v_receipt_pk);
                                                v_fail_dd_proc := 'Y';
                                                CONTINUE;
                                            ELSE
                                                raise_error (
                                                       'UPDATING LOAN RCPT FOR '
                                                    || v_recpt_rec (i).pol_policy_no
                                                    || '...');
                                            END IF;
                                    END;

                                FOR r
                                    IN (SELECT opr_lna_no,
                                               NVL (opr_loan_pymt_amt, 0)
                                                   loan_pymt_amt,
                                               (  NVL (
                                                      opr_loan_principal_amt,
                                                      0)
                                                + NVL (opr_loan_interest_amt,
                                                       0)
                                                + NVL (
                                                      opr_unprocessed_loan_amt,
                                                      0))
                                                   allocated
                                          FROM lms_ord_prem_receipts
                                         WHERE     opr_code = v_opr_code
                                               AND NVL (opr_loan_pymt_amt, 0) <>
                                                   0)
                                LOOP
                                    IF r.loan_pymt_amt <> r.allocated
                                    THEN
                                        IF v_rct_paymt_mode IN ('DD', 'CK')
                                        THEN
                                            --Update the batch as failure.
                                            v_err :=
                                                   'UNABLE TO ALLOCATE LOAN RCPT FOR '
                                                || v_recpt_rec (i).pol_policy_no
                                                || '...LOAN '
                                                || r.opr_lna_no
                                                || '... loan_pymt_amt '
                                                || r.loan_pymt_amt
                                                || '...allocated '
                                                || r.allocated;
                                            update_dd_err_log (
                                                'F',
                                                v_err,
                                                v_recpt_rec (i).ddd_code,
                                                NULL,             --v_dd_code,
                                                NULL,            --v_dd_batch,
                                                v_rct_paymt_mode,
                                                v_recpt_rec (i).rad_code,
                                                v_receipt_pk);
                                            v_fail_dd_proc := 'Y';
                                            CONTINUE;
                                        ELSE
                                            raise_error (
                                                   'UNABLE TO ALLOCATE LOAN RCPT FOR '
                                                || v_recpt_rec (i).pol_policy_no
                                                || '...');
                                        END IF;
                                    END IF;
                                END LOOP;


                                    IF cur_pol_loan_rec.pln_type = 'NFL'
                                    THEN
                                        BEGIN
                                            SELECT param_value, param_status
                                              INTO v_nf_repay_param,
                                                   v_nf_repay_param_status
                                              FROM lms_parameters
                                             WHERE param_name =
                                                   'TREAT_NFL_REPAYMENT_AS_PREMIUM';
                                        EXCEPTION
                                            WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND
                                            THEN
                                                --Update the batch as failure.
                                                IF v_rct_paymt_mode IN
                                                       ('DD', 'CK', 'BU')
                                                THEN
                                                    --Update the batch as failure.
                                                    v_err :=
                                                        'SYSTEM PARAMETER "TREAT_NFL_REPAYMENT_AS_PREMIUM" HAS NOT BEEN DEFINED IN THE SYSTEM....';
                                                    update_dd_err_log (
                                                        'F',
                                                        v_err,
                                                        v_recpt_rec (i).ddd_code,
                                                        NULL,     --v_dd_code,
                                                        NULL,    --v_dd_batch,
                                                        v_rct_paymt_mode,
                                                        v_recpt_rec (i).rad_code,
                                                        v_receipt_pk);
                                                    v_fail_dd_proc := 'Y';
                                                    CONTINUE;
                                                ELSE
                                                    raise_error (
                                                        'SYSTEM PARAMETER "TREAT_NFL_REPAYMENT_AS_PREMIUM" HAS NOT BEEN DEFINED IN THE SYSTEM....');
                                                END IF;
                                            WHEN OTHERS
                                            THEN
                                                IF v_rct_paymt_mode IN
                                                       ('DD', 'CK', 'BU')
                                                THEN
                                                    --Update the batch as failure.
                                                    v_err :=
                                                        'ERROR RETRIEVING DETAILS FOR SYSTEM PARAMETER "TREAT_NFL_REPAYMENT_AS_PREMIUM"...';
                                                    update_dd_err_log (
                                                        'F',
                                                        v_err,
                                                        v_recpt_rec (i).ddd_code,
                                                        NULL,     --v_dd_code,
                                                        NULL,    --v_dd_batch,
                                                        v_rct_paymt_mode,
                                                        v_recpt_rec (i).rad_code,
                                                        v_receipt_pk);
                                                    v_fail_dd_proc := 'Y';
                                                    CONTINUE;
                                                ELSE
                                                    raise_error (
                                                        'ERROR RETRIEVING DETAILS FOR SYSTEM PARAMETER "TREAT_NFL_REPAYMENT_AS_PREMIUM"...');
                                                END IF;
                                        END;

                                    IF     NVL (v_nf_repay_param, 'N') = 'Y'
                                       AND NVL (v_nf_repay_param_status, 'N') =
                                               'A'
                                        THEN
                                            v_nfl_alloc :=
                                                  NVL (v_nfl_alloc, 0)
                                                + NVL (
                                                      v_recpt_rec (i).pol_loan_amt,
                                                      0);
                                        END IF;
                                    END IF;
                                END LOOP;
                            END IF;

                            IF (    (NVL (v_recpt_rec (i).pol_pension_amt, 0) <>
                                     0)
                                AND (v_pol_type != 'LN'))
                            THEN
                                IF v_chq_no IS NULL AND v_rct_code IS NULL
                                THEN
                                    v_chq_rcpt_no := ' ';
                                ELSIF v_chq_no IS NULL
                                THEN
                                    v_chq_rcpt_no := v_rct_code;
                                ELSIF v_rct_code IS NULL
                                THEN
                                    v_chq_rcpt_no := v_chq_no;
                                ELSE

                                        v_rct_code || '/' || v_chq_no;
                                END IF;

                                    lms_investments.process_receipt (
                                        v_pol_code,
                                        v_pens_opr_code,
                                        NULL,
                                        v_chq_rcpt_no);
                                EXCEPTION
                                    WHEN OTHERS
                                    THEN
                                        IF v_rct_paymt_mode IN
                                               ('DD', 'CK', 'BU')
                                        THEN

                                            v_err :=
                                                   'UPDATING PENSION RCPT - '
                                                || SQLERRM (SQLCODE);
                                            update_dd_err_log (
                                                'F',
                                                v_err,
                                                v_recpt_rec (i).ddd_code,
                                                NULL,             --v_dd_code,
                                                NULL,            --v_dd_batch,
                                                v_rct_paymt_mode,
                                                v_recpt_rec (i).rad_code,
                                                v_receipt_pk);
                                            v_fail_dd_proc := 'Y';
                                            CONTINUE;
                                        ELSE
                                            raise_error (
                                                   'UPDATING PENSION RCPT FOR '
                                                || v_recpt_rec (i).pol_policy_no
                                                || '...');
                                        END IF;
                                END;
                            --                  BEGIN
                            --                     SELECT popns_employer_contr, popns_employee_contr,
                            --                            popns_total_contr
                            --                       INTO v_er_contri, v_ee_contri,
                            --                            v_tot_contri
                            --                       FROM LMS_POLICY_ENDORSEMENTS,
                            --                            LMS_POLICIES,
                            --                            LMS_POL_ORD_PENSION_DTLS,
                            --                            LMS_POL_ORD_ACTIVE_PENSIONS
                            --                      WHERE endr_code = pol_current_endr_code
                            --                        AND popns_pol_code = pol_code
                            --                        AND pol_code = v_pol_code
                            --                        AND poapn_pol_code = popns_pol_code
                            --                        AND poapn_endr_code = endr_code
                            --                        AND poapn_popns_code = popns_code
                            --                        AND popns_status = 'A';
                            --                  EXCEPTION
                            --                     WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND
                            --                     THEN
                            --                        NULL;
                            --                     WHEN TOO_MANY_ROWS
                            --                     THEN
                            --                        raise_error
                            --                            (   'MORE THAN ONE ACTIVE PENSION RECORD FOUND..'
                            --                             || NVL (v_fetched_policy, v_fetched_pol_code)
                            --                            );
                            --                     WHEN OTHERS
                            --                     THEN
                            --                        raise_error
                            --                           (   'COULD NOT DETERMINE MONTHLY PENSION PAYMENTS..'
                            --                            || NVL (v_fetched_policy, v_fetched_pol_code)
                            --                           );
                            --                  END;

                            --                  BEGIN
                            --                     v_tot_contri := NVL (v_recpt_rec (i).pol_pension_amt, 0);
                            --                     v_ee_contri :=

                            --                          )

                            --                          )
                            --                        * NVL (v_recpt_rec (i).pol_pension_amt, 0);
                            --                  EXCEPTION
                            --                     WHEN OTHERS
                            --                     THEN
                            --                        raise_error (   'ERROR FROM '
                            --                                     || v_recpt_rec (i).pol_policy_no
                            --                                     || '...'
                            --                                    );
                            --                  END;

                            --                  BEGIN
                            --                     Lms_Ord_Pensions.process_pension_payments
                            --                                                            (v_pol_code,

                            --                                                             v_er_contri,

                            --                                                             v_tot_contri

                            --                  EXCEPTION
                            --                     WHEN OTHERS
                            --                     THEN
                            --                        raise_error
                            --                                   ('ERROR PROCESSING PENSION CONTRIBUTION..');

                    END IF;
                END IF;

                --Update the batch as successfull.
                IF v_rct_paymt_mode IN ('DD', 'CK', 'BU')
                THEN
                    update_dd_err_log ('S',
                                       NULL,
                                       v_recpt_rec (i).ddd_code,

            EXCEPTION
                WHEN OTHERS

                        v_fail_dd_proc := 'Y';
                        CONTINUE;
                    ELSE
                        raise_error ('Creating Lms Rcpt..');
                    END IF;
            END;
        END LOOP;

        IF v_pol_type = 'ADV'
        THEN
            BEGIN
                lms_api.post_agent_adv (v_pol_code,              --v_cad_code,

                        v_err := 'REPRINTING.RCPT...' || SQLERRM (SQLCODE);

                                           v_err,

                                        v_receipt_pk,          --v_receipt_pk,
                                        v_rct_code);              --v_rct_code
            EXCEPTION
                WHEN OTHERS
                THEN
                    IF v_rct_paymt_mode IN ('DD', 'CK', 'BU')
                    THEN
                        --Update the batch as failure.
                        v_err := 'DBF.RCPT INTERFACE...' || SQLERRM (SQLCODE);
                        update_dd_err_log ('F',
                                           v_err,
                                           NULL,
                                           v_dd_code,
                                           v_dd_batch,
                                           v_rct_paymt_mode,
                                           NULL,
                                           v_receipt_pk);
                        v_fail_dd_proc := 'Y';
                    ELSE
                        raise_error ('DBF.RCPT INTERFACE...');
                    END IF;
            END;
        ELSE
           /* IF v_rct_paymt_mode IN ('DD')
            THEN
                FOR i IN 1 .. v_recpt_rec.COUNT
                LOOP
                    --Get Oppr_code
                    BEGIN
                        SELECT oppr_code
                          INTO v_oppr_code
                          FROM lms_ord_proposal_rcpts
                         WHERE oppr_ddd_code = v_recpt_rec (i).ddd_code;
                    EXCEPTION
                        WHEN OTHERS
                        THEN
                            v_oppr_code := NULL;
                    END;

                    --Get opr_code
                    BEGIN
                        SELECT opr_code
                          INTO v_opr_code
                          FROM lms_ord_prem_receipts
                         WHERE opr_ddd_code = v_recpt_rec (i).ddd_code;
                    EXCEPTION
                        WHEN OTHERS
                        THEN
                            v_opr_code := NULL;
                    END;

                    IF v_oppr_code IS NOT NULL OR v_opr_code IS NOT NULL
                    THEN
                        BEGIN
                            post_update_recpt_pymt (
                                v_rct_code,
                                v_opr_receipt_trans_code,
                                v_oppr_receipt_trans_code,
                                v_nfl_alloc,
                                v_rct_branch,
                                v_acc_type,
                                v_amt,
                                v_description,
                                v_date,
                                v_raised_by,
                                v_cur_code,
                                v_opr_code,  --v_opr_code NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                NULL,         --v_prm_amt NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                NULL,         --v_chk_com NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                NULL,          --v_ln_amt NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                NULL,          --v_pn_amt NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                NULL,         --v_adm_inv NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                NULL,         --v_fee_inv NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                NULL,      --v_contri_inv NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                NULL,        --v_compfund NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                v_receipt_pk,
                                v_fms_unknown_reposting,
                                v_oppr_code --v_oppr_code NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                           );
                        EXCEPTION
                            WHEN OTHERS
                            THEN
                                v_err :=
                                    'POST UPDATE...' || SQLERRM (SQLCODE);
                                update_dd_err_log ('F',
                                                   v_err,
                                                   v_recpt_rec (i).ddd_code,
                                                   NULL,
                                                   NULL,
                                                   v_rct_paymt_mode,
                                                   NULL,
                                                   v_receipt_pk);
                                v_fail_dd_proc := 'Y';
                        END;

                        update_dd_err_log ('Y',
                                           NULL,
                                           v_recpt_rec (i).ddd_code,
                                           NULL,
                                           NULL,
                                           v_rct_paymt_mode,
                                           NULL,
                                           v_receipt_pk);
                    END IF;

                    v_update_ddd_code := v_recpt_rec (i).ddd_code;
                END LOOP;

                BEGIN
                    SELECT ddd_dd_code
                      INTO v_update_dd_code
                      FROM tqc_direct_debit_detail
                     WHERE ddd_code = v_update_ddd_code;

                    tq_fms.fms_lms_api_wrapper.update_dd_stats (
                        v_update_dd_code);
                EXCEPTION
                    WHEN OTHERS
                    THEN
                        NULL;
                END;
            ELSE*/
                BEGIN
                    post_update_recpt_pymt (v_rct_code,
                                            v_opr_receipt_trans_code,
                                            v_oppr_receipt_trans_code,
                                            v_nfl_alloc,
                                            v_rct_branch,
                                            v_acc_type,
                                            v_amt,
                                            v_description,
                                            v_date,
                                            v_raised_by,
                                            v_cur_code,
                                            NULL, --v_opr_code NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                            NULL, --v_prm_amt NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                            NULL, --v_chk_com NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                            NULL, --v_ln_amt NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                            NULL, --v_pn_amt NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                            NULL, --v_adm_inv NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                            NULL, --v_fee_inv NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                            NULL, --v_contri_inv NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                            NULL, --v_compfund NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                            v_receipt_pk,
                                            v_fms_unknown_reposting);
                EXCEPTION
                    WHEN OTHERS
                    THEN
                        v_err := 'POST UPDATE...' || SQLERRM (SQLCODE);

                        IF v_rct_paymt_mode IN ('DD', 'CK', 'BU')
                        THEN
                            ROLLBACK;
                            v_fail_dd_proc := 'Y';

                            --Update the batch as failure.
                            BEGIN
                                update_dd_err_log ('F',
                                                   v_err,
                                                   NULL,
                                                   v_dd_code,
                                                   v_dd_batch,
                                                   v_rct_paymt_mode,
                                                   NULL,
                                                   v_receipt_pk);
                            EXCEPTION
                                WHEN OTHERS
                                THEN
                                    NULL;
                            END;
                        ELSE
                            raise_error (
                                   'ggg'
                                || v_description
                                || ';;v_pol_code='

                                || '  '
                                || v_err);
                        --RCPT INTERFACE...');

            END IF;

        IF NVL (v_fail_dd_proc, 'N') = 'Y'
        THEN
            raise_error (
                   'ERROR OCCURED DURING DD/CK BATCH ALLOCATION. ROLLBACK BATCH '
                || v_err);
        END IF;

        fms_rcts_pkg.update_source_status (v_receipt_pk, 'N');

        FOR i IN 1 .. v_recpt_rec.COUNT
        LOOP
            v_pol_type := v_recpt_rec (i).pol_type;

            BEGIN
                SELECT pol_status
                  INTO v_pol_status
                  FROM lms_policies
                 WHERE pol_code = v_recpt_rec (i).pol_code;
            EXCEPTION
                WHEN OTHERS
                THEN
                    v_pol_status := NULL;
            END;

            --attempt to authorize policy if the policy is draft.
            IF     v_auto_auth_pol_on_rect = 'Y'
               AND NVL (v_pol_type, 'PL') NOT IN ('LN')
               AND NVL (v_pol_status, 'XX') IN ('D', 'V')
            THEN
                BEGIN
                    lms_ord_misc.auto_authorize_policy (
                        v_recpt_rec (i).pol_code);
                EXCEPTION
                    WHEN OTHERS
                    THEN
                        NULL;
                END;
            END IF;

            --Send an alert after receipting. Does not raise error but logs the error in lms_error_logs
            IF v_recpt_rec (i).rad_code IS NOT NULL
            THEN
                BEGIN
                    IF NVL (v_pol_type, 'PL') <> 'LN'
                    THEN
                        lms_process_alerts.send_premium_alloc_msg (
