                            NULL,
                            v_recpt_rec (i).rad_code,
                            'PREM_ALLC_MSG');
                    ELSE
                        lms_process_alerts.send_premium_alloc_msg (
                            NULL,
                            NULL,
                            v_recpt_rec (i).rad_code,
                            'LOAN_ALLC_MSG');
                    END IF;
                EXCEPTION
                    WHEN OTHERS
                    THEN
                        NULL;
                END;
            END IF;
        END LOOP;
    --   EXCEPTION
    --      WHEN OTHERS
    --      THEN
    --         raise_error ('...');                              -- ('Ord Api...');
    END update_recpt_pymt;

    PROCEDURE process_pension_pymt (
        v_pndp_code   NUMBER,
        v_pol_code    NUMBER,
        v_pay_mthd    VARCHAR2 DEFAULT 'CHQ'
    )
    IS
        v_chq_dtls_rec          fms_cheques_pkg.type_rqn_dtls_table;
        v_payee_eft_rec         fms_cheques_pkg.type_payee_eft_table;
        v_bbr_code              NUMBER;
        v_eft_enabled           VARCHAR2 (1);
        v_pay_method            VARCHAR2 (10) := v_pay_mthd;

        CURSOR c_pndp IS
            SELECT pol_code,
                   pol_policy_no,
                   pndp_code,
                   pndp_date,
                   pndp_amount,
                   pndp_payee,
                   pndp_authorised_by,
                   pndp_bbr_code,
                   pndp_client_bank_acc
              FROM lms_policies, lms_pension_deposits
             WHERE pol_code = pndp_pol_code AND pndp_code = v_pndp_code;

        v_brh_code              NUMBER;
        v_count                 NUMBER := 0;
        v_org_code              NUMBER;
        v_crt_acc_no            VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_trnt_type             VARCHAR2 (5);
        v_prod_code             NUMBER;
        v_trnt_code             VARCHAR2 (10);
        v_trnt_gl_code          VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_trnt_contra_gl_code   VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_cla_type              VARCHAR2 (2);
        nparticipantamt         NUMBER := 0;
        v_claim_amt             NUMBER := 0;
        v_prem_drcr             VARCHAR2 (5) := 'C';
        v_narrative             VARCHAR2 (30);
        grp_amt                 NUMBER := 0;
        v_trans_code            NUMBER;
        v_class                 VARCHAR2 (10);
    BEGIN
        BEGIN
            SELECT pol_bra_code, cla_type, pol_prod_code          -- ,POL_CODE
              INTO v_brh_code, v_cla_type, v_prod_code           --,v_pol_code
              FROM lms_policies, lms_classes
             WHERE pol_cla_code = cla_code AND pol_code = v_pol_code;
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND
            THEN
                raise_error ('POLICY REC NOT FOUND ');
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                raise_error ('GETTING POLICY REC');
        END;

        SELECT    TO_NUMBER (TO_CHAR (SYSDATE, 'RRRR'))
               || lms_transaction_seq.NEXTVAL
          INTO v_trans_code
          FROM DUAL;

        FOR i IN c_pndp
        LOOP
            IF i.pndp_payee IS NULL
            THEN
                raise_error ('PAYEE NOT SPECIFIED..');
            END IF;

            v_org_code := fms_interfaces_pkg.get_org (v_brh_code);

            IF NVL (i.pndp_amount, 0) <> 0
            THEN
                IF v_cla_type = 'O'
                THEN                                                  --OLIFFE
                    raise_error ('NOT TAKEN CARE OFF..');
                ELSIF v_cla_type = 'G'
                THEN                                                   --GLIFE
                    get_gl_code ('DA',
                                 v_prod_code,
                                 v_trnt_code,
                                 v_crt_acc_no,
                                 v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
                ELSE
                    raise_error ('UNDEFINED CLASS TYPE - ' || v_cla_type);
                END IF;

                valid_acc (v_crt_acc_no,
                           v_org_code,
                           v_brh_code,
                           'DA');
                v_count := v_count + 1;
                interface_append_chq (
                    v_trans_code,                  --v_trans_code      NUMBER,
                    i.pndp_payee,
                    --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                    v_pol_code,                 --v_pol_code           NUMBER,
                    v_prod_code,                --v_prod_code          NUMBER,
                    NULL,                     --v_vchr_no            VARCHAR2,
                    v_count,                    --v_count              NUMBER,
                    NVL (i.pndp_amount, 0),
                    --v_amount             NUMBER,
                    'SCHEME WITHDRAWAL ON ' || i.pol_policy_no,
                    --v_narrative          VARCHAR2,
                    v_crt_acc_no,
                    --v_acc_number         VARCHAR2,
                    v_org_code,               --v_acc_org_code         NUMBER,
                    v_brh_code,                 --v_branch_code        NUMBER,
                    'D',                      --v_drcr               VARCHAR2,
                    v_chq_dtls_rec);
            --v_trn_rec   IN OUT   Fms_Cheques_Pkg.Type_rqn_dtls_table)
            END IF;

            IF v_cla_type = 'G'
            THEN
                v_class := 'CLMG';
            ELSE
                v_class := 'CLM';
            END IF;

            --RAISE_ERROR(v_class||'v_pay_method=='||v_pay_method);
            IF v_pay_method = 'CHQ'
            THEN
                IF v_count != 0
                THEN
                    interface_create_reqn (
                        v_trans_code,          --v_trans_code          NUMBER,
                        i.pndp_code,       --v_ref                   VARCHAR2,
                        i.pol_policy_no,   --v_ref2                  VARCHAR2,
                        i.pndp_date,           --v_ref_date              DATE,
                        'SCHEME WITHDRAWAL POL: ' || i.pol_policy_no,
                        --v_narrative             VARCHAR2,
                        i.pndp_amount,       --v_amount                NUMBER,
                        i.pndp_payee,      --v_payee                 VARCHAR2,
                        'CHQ',  --v_pay_method            VARCHAR2, --CHQ, EFT
                        NULL,           --v_payee_bank_acc_no        VARCHAR2,
                        NULL,             --v_payee_bank_branch_code   NUMBER,
                        i.pndp_authorised_by, --v_source_auth_by        VARCHAR2,
                        TRUNC (SYSDATE),       --v_source_auth_dt        DATE,
                        i.pndp_authorised_by, --v_raise_by                VARCHAR2,
                        v_class,           --v_pmt_type              VARCHAR2,
                        v_brh_code,                           --v_branch_code,
                        i.pol_code,                              --v_pol_code,
                        v_chq_dtls_rec);
                --v_dtls_table  IN OUT    Fms_Cheques_Pkg.type_rqn_dtls_table)
                END IF;
            ELSE
                IF v_count != 0
                THEN
                    interface_create_reqn (
                        v_trans_code,          --v_trans_code          NUMBER,
                        i.pndp_code,       --v_ref                   VARCHAR2,
                        i.pol_policy_no,   --v_ref2                  VARCHAR2,
                        i.pndp_date,           --v_ref_date              DATE,
                        'SCHEME WITHDRAWAL POL: ' || i.pol_policy_no,
                        --v_narrative             VARCHAR2,
                        i.pndp_amount,       --v_amount                NUMBER,
                        i.pndp_payee,      --v_payee                 VARCHAR2,
                        v_pay_method,
                        --'EFT',       --v_pay_method            VARCHAR2, --CHQ, EFT
                        i.pndp_client_bank_acc,
                        --v_payee_bank_acc_no        varchar2,
                        i.pndp_bbr_code,  --v_payee_bank_branch_code   NUMBER,
                        i.pndp_authorised_by, --v_source_auth_by        VARCHAR2,
                        TRUNC (SYSDATE),       --v_source_auth_dt        DATE,
                        i.pndp_authorised_by, --v_raise_by                VARCHAR2,
                        v_class,           --v_pmt_type              VARCHAR2,
                        v_brh_code,                           --v_branch_code,
                        i.pol_code,                              --v_pol_code,
                        v_chq_dtls_rec);
                --v_dtls_table  IN OUT    Fms_Cheques_Pkg.type_rqn_dtls_table)
                END IF;
            END IF;

            EXIT;
        END LOOP;
    --   EXCEPTION
    --      WHEN OTHERS
    --      THEN
    --         raise_error ('CREATING PENS REQN. ');
    END process_pension_pymt;

    PROCEDURE process_pens_reval_refund (
        v_pol_code       NUMBER,
        v_voucher_no     NUMBER,
        v_gross_amount   NUMBER,
        v_pay_method     VARCHAR2 DEFAULT 'CHQ'
    )
    IS
        v_chq_dtls_rec          fms_cheques_pkg.type_rqn_dtls_table;

        CURSOR c_clm_vch IS
            SELECT ppv_voucher_no            cpv_voucher_no,
                   ppv_date                  cpv_date,
                   NULL                      cpv_clm_no,
                   ppv_pol_code,
                   ROUND (ppv_amount, 2)     net_amount,
                   ppv_payee                 cpv_payee,
                   NULL                      cpv_tran_type,
                   ppv_raise_by              cpv_raise_by,
                   ppv_authorised_by         cpv_authorised_by,
                   ppv_authorised_dt         cpv_authorised_dt,
                   pol_policy_no             clm_pol_policy_no,
                   'CHQ'                     cpv_payment_mode,
                   NULL                      cpv_bbr_code,
                   NULL                      cpv_bbr_acc_no,
                   NULL                      cpv_tax_amt
              FROM lms_pol_payment_vouchers, lms_policies
             WHERE     ppv_pol_code = pol_code
                   AND ppv_pol_code = v_pol_code
                   AND ppv_voucher_no = v_voucher_no
                   AND ppv_source = 'POLICY REVALUATION REFUND';

        v_brh_code              NUMBER;
        v_count                 NUMBER := 0;
        v_org_code              NUMBER;
        v_crt_acc_no            VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_sys_code              NUMBER;
        v_bct_code              NUMBER;
        v_bct_brh_code          NUMBER;
        v_cur_code              NUMBER;
        v_auth_by               NUMBER;
        v_trnt_type             VARCHAR2 (5);
        v_prod_code             NUMBER;
        v_trnt_code             VARCHAR2 (10);
        v_trnt_gl_code          VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_trnt_contra_gl_code   VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_raised_by             NUMBER;
        v_cla_type              VARCHAR2 (2);
        nparticipantamt         NUMBER := 0;
        v_claim_amt             NUMBER := 0;
        v_prem_drcr             VARCHAR2 (5) := 'C';
        v_narrative             VARCHAR2 (30);
        v_payee_eft_rec         fms_cheques_pkg.type_payee_eft_table;
        v_eft_enabled           VARCHAR2 (1) := 'N';
        v_bbr_code              NUMBER;
        v_account_number        VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_tax_amt               NUMBER;
        v_tot_amount            NUMBER;
        v_tax_param             VARCHAR2 (5);
        v_trans_code            NUMBER;
        v_class                 VARCHAR2 (10);
    BEGIN
        BEGIN
            SELECT pol_bra_code, cla_type, pol_prod_code
              INTO v_brh_code, v_cla_type, v_prod_code
              FROM lms_policies, lms_classes
             WHERE pol_code = v_pol_code AND pol_cla_code = cla_code;
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND
            THEN
                raise_error ('POLICY REC NOT FOUND ' || v_pol_code);
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                raise_error ('GETTING POLICY REC');
        END;

        SELECT    TO_NUMBER (TO_CHAR (SYSDATE, 'RRRR'))
               || lms_transaction_seq.NEXTVAL
          INTO v_trans_code
          FROM DUAL;

        FOR i IN c_clm_vch
        LOOP
            IF NVL (v_gross_amount, 0) <> (NVL (i.net_amount, 0))
            THEN
                raise_error (
                       'GROSS AMT('
                    || NVL (v_gross_amount, 0)
                    || ') NOT EQUAL TO BREAKDOWN. NET '
                    || NVL (i.net_amount, 0));
            END IF;

            IF NVL (v_gross_amount, 0) = 0
            THEN
                raise_error ('NO AMOUNT TO PAY SPECIFIED..');
            END IF;

            v_org_code := fms_interfaces_pkg.get_org (v_brh_code);
            v_tot_amount := NVL (v_gross_amount, 0);

            IF NVL (v_tot_amount, 0) <> 0
            THEN
                get_gl_code ('INVPREM',
                             v_prod_code,
                             v_trnt_code,
                             v_crt_acc_no,
                             v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
                valid_acc (v_crt_acc_no,
                           v_org_code,
                           v_brh_code,
                           'INVPREM');
                v_count := v_count + 1;
                interface_append_chq (
                    v_trans_code,                  --v_trans_code      NUMBER,
                    i.cpv_raise_by,
                    --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                    v_pol_code,                 --v_pol_code           NUMBER,
                    v_prod_code,                --v_prod_code          NUMBER,
                    i.cpv_voucher_no,
                    --v_vchr_no            VARCHAR2,
                    v_count,                    --v_count              NUMBER,
                    v_tot_amount,               --v_amount             NUMBER,
                    'REVALUATION REFUND ON ' || i.clm_pol_policy_no,
                    v_crt_acc_no,
                    --v_acc_number         VARCHAR2,
                    v_org_code,               --v_acc_org_code         NUMBER,
                    v_brh_code,                 --v_branch_code        NUMBER,
                    'D',                      --v_drcr               VARCHAR2,
                    v_chq_dtls_rec);
            --v_trn_rec   IN OUT   Fms_Cheques_Pkg.Type_rqn_dtls_table)
            END IF;

            IF NVL (v_count, 0) <> 0
            THEN
                IF v_cla_type = 'O'
                THEN
                    v_class := 'CLM';
                ELSIF v_cla_type = 'G'
                THEN
                    v_class := 'CLMG';
                END IF;

                interface_create_reqn (
                    v_trans_code,
                    --v_trans_code         NUMBER,
                    i.cpv_voucher_no,
                    --v_ref                   VARCHAR2,
                    i.cpv_clm_no,
                    --v_ref2                  VARCHAR2,
                    i.cpv_date,                --v_ref_date              DATE,
                       'REVALUATION REFUND PENSION PAYMENT'
                    || i.clm_pol_policy_no,
                    --v_narrative             VARCHAR2,
                    i.net_amount,
                    --v_amount                NUMBER,
                    i.cpv_payee,
                    --v_payee                 VARCHAR2,
                    NVL (v_pay_method, 'CHQ'),
                    --v_pay_method            VARCHAR2, --CHQ, EFT
                    i.cpv_bbr_acc_no,
                    --v_payee_bank_acc_no        VARCHAR2,
                    i.cpv_bbr_code,
                    --v_payee_bank_branch_code   NUMBER,
                    i.cpv_authorised_by,
                    --v_source_auth_by        VARCHAR2,
                    i.cpv_authorised_dt,
                    --v_source_auth_dt        DATE,
                    i.cpv_raise_by,
                    --v_raise_by                VARCHAR2,
                    v_class,
                    --v_pmt_type              VARCHAR2,
                    v_brh_code,                               --v_branch_code,
                    v_pol_code,                                  --v_pol_code,
                    v_chq_dtls_rec);
            --v_dtls_table  IN OUT Fms_Cheques_Pkg.Type_rqn_dtls_table);
            END IF;
        END LOOP;
    EXCEPTION
        WHEN OTHERS
        THEN
            raise_application_error (
                -20001,
                'CREATING CLAIM REQN. ' || SQLERRM (SQLCODE));
    END process_pens_reval_refund;

    PROCEDURE process_claim_pymt (
        v_clm_no           VARCHAR2,
        v_cpv_voucher_no   NUMBER,
        v_gross_amount     NUMBER,
        v_loan_amount      NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
        v_os_premium       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
        v_maturities       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
        v_ck_comm          NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
        v_pay_mthd         VARCHAR2 DEFAULT 'CHQ',
        v_nfl_alloc        NUMBER DEFAULT 0,
        v_reinstmnt_amt    NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
        v_cpv_code         NUMBER DEFAULT NULL
    )
    IS
        v_chq_dtls_rec          fms_cheques_pkg.type_rqn_dtls_table;
        v_payee_eft_rec         fms_cheques_pkg.type_payee_eft_table;
        v_bbr_code              NUMBER;
        v_account_number        VARCHAR2 (30);
        v_eft_enabled           VARCHAR2 (1);
        v_pol_code              NUMBER;
        v_pay_method            VARCHAR2 (10) := v_pay_mthd;
        v_tx_type               VARCHAR2 (30);
        v_user                  VARCHAR2 (30)
            := pkg_global_vars.get_pvarchar2 ('pkg_global_vars.pvg_username');
        v_site_param            VARCHAR2 (5);
        v_unpaid_mat            NUMBER;
        v_base_cur_code         NUMBER;
        v_exchange_rate         NUMBER;
        v_cur_code              NUMBER;
        v_posting_amt           NUMBER;
        v_param_value           VARCHAR2 (5);

        CURSOR c_clm_vch IS
              SELECT cpv_voucher_no,
                     cpv_date,
                     cpv_clm_no,
                     clm_pol_policy_no,
                     NVL (cpv_payee, clm_payee)
                         cpv_payee,
                     cpv_tran_type,
                     cpv_raise_by,
                     clm_caus_type,
                     clm_pol_code,
                     clm_endr_code,
                     NVL (cpv_authorised_by, v_user)
                         cpv_authorised_by,
                     NVL (cpv_authorised_dt, TRUNC (SYSDATE))
                         cpv_authorised_dt,
                     cpv_ben_code,
                     cpv_payment_mode,
                     cpv_bbr_code,
                     cpv_bbr_acc_no,
                     cpv_clnt_mob_no,
                     cpv_clnt_id_passport_no,
                     cpv_identity_type,
                     cpv_mft_code,
                     cpv_cur_code,
                     ltr_trans_no,
                     lms_ord_mis.check_renewal_paymnt (clm_pol_code,
                                                       clm_date_death_accident)
                         renewal,
                     SUM (cpv_amount)
                         net_amount,
                     DECODE (clm_but_pay_amount,
                             NULL, SUM (NVL (cpv_penalty_amt, 0)),
                             0)
                         cpv_penalty_amt,
                     DECODE (clm_but_pay_amount,
                             NULL, SUM (NVL (cpv_sar_amt, 0)),
                             0)
                         cpv_sar_amt,
                     DECODE (clm_but_pay_amount,
                             NULL, SUM (NVL (cpv_bo_spread_amt, 0)),
                             0)
                         cpv_bo_spread_amt,
                     DECODE (clm_but_pay_amount,
                             NULL, SUM (NVL (cpv_tax_amt, 0)),
                             0)
                         cpv_tax_amt,
                     DECODE (clm_but_pay_amount,
                             NULL, NVL (clm_bonus_paid, 0),
                             0)
                         clm_bonus_paid,
                     DECODE (
                         clm_but_pay_amount,
                         NULL, SUM (
                                   NVL (cpv_disinvested_amnt,
                                        clm_disinvested_amnt)))
                         disinvested_amnt,
                     SUM (NVL (cpv_unproc_bal_amt, 0))
                         cpv_unproc_bal_amt
                FROM lms_claims, lms_clm_payment_vouchers, lms_transactions
               WHERE     cpv_clm_no = clm_no
                     AND ltr_clm_no = clm_no
                     AND cpv_clm_no = v_clm_no
                     AND cpv_voucher_no || cpv_ben_code = v_cpv_voucher_no
                     AND cpv_authorised = 'N'
            GROUP BY cpv_voucher_no,
                     cpv_date,
                     cpv_clm_no,
                     NVL (cpv_payee, clm_payee),
                     cpv_tran_type,
                     cpv_raise_by,
                     cpv_authorised_by,
                     NVL (cpv_authorised_dt, TRUNC (SYSDATE)),
                     cpv_clnt_mob_no,
                     cpv_clnt_id_passport_no,
                     cpv_identity_type,
                     cpv_mft_code,
                     cpv_ben_code,
                     clm_pol_policy_no,
                     cpv_payment_mode,
                     cpv_bbr_code,
                     cpv_bbr_acc_no,
                     clm_but_pay_amount,
                     clm_caus_type,
                     clm_pol_code,
                     clm_date_death_accident,
                     cpv_disinvested_amnt,
                     clm_disinvested_amnt,
                     clm_bonus_paid,
                     clm_endr_code,
                     cpv_cur_code,
                     ltr_trans_no;

        CURSOR c_trt_participant (v_vchr_no NUMBER)
        IS
            SELECT crctd_code,
                   crctd_prod_code,
                   crctd_rei_code,
                   crctd_agn_code,
                   crctd_agn_sht_desc,
                   crctd_amount,
                   trpa_gl_ctrl_account     trpa_gl_account,
                   rei_trt_sht_desc,
                   rei_trt_code,
                   rei_ta_code,
                   rei_uw_year,
                   rei_as_code,
                   rei_trs_code,
                   rei_trs_sht_desc,
                   -- crctd_cover_from_date, --crctd_cover_to_date,
                   pol_underwriting_year
              FROM lms_claims_ri_co_trt_dtls,
                   lms_treaty_setups,
                   lms_treaty_participants,
                   lms_policies
             WHERE     crctd_rei_code = rei_code
                   AND                                               /*NVL (*/
                       crctd_cpv_voucher_no                   /*, v_vchr_no)*/
                                            = v_vchr_no
                   AND crctd_clm_no = v_clm_no
                   AND trpa_rei_code = crctd_rei_code
                   AND crctd_pol_code = pol_code
                   AND rei_trt_code <> 1006
                   AND crctd_agn_code = trpa_agen_code
            UNION ALL
            SELECT crctd_code,
                   crctd_prod_code,
                   crctd_rei_code,
                   crctd_agn_code,
                   crctd_agn_sht_desc,
                   crctd_amount,
                   NULL     trpa_gl_account,
                   rei_trt_sht_desc,
                   rei_trt_code,
                   rei_ta_code,
                   rei_uw_year,
                   rei_as_code,
                   rei_trs_code,
                   rei_trs_sht_desc, -- crctd_cover_from_date, crctd_cover_to_date,
                   pol_underwriting_year
              FROM lms_claims_ri_co_trt_dtls,
                   lms_treaty_setups,
                   lms_agencies,
                   lms_policies
             WHERE     crctd_rei_code = rei_code
                   AND                                               /*NVL (*/
                       crctd_cpv_voucher_no                   /*, v_vchr_no)*/
                                            = v_vchr_no
                   AND crctd_clm_no = v_clm_no
                   AND rei_trt_code = 1006
                   AND crctd_pol_code = pol_code
                   AND crctd_agn_code = agn_code;

        CURSOR ord_trt_participant (v_vchr_no NUMBER)
        IS
            SELECT coript_prod_code,
                   coript_rei_code,
                   coript_agen_code,
                   coript_agen_sht_desc,
                   coript_amount,
                   trpa_gl_ctrl_account     trpa_gl_account,
                   rei_trt_sht_desc,
                   rei_trs_sht_desc,
                   rei_trs_code,
                   rei_as_code,
                   rei_uw_year,
                   rei_ta_code,
                   rei_trt_code
              FROM lms_claims_ord_part_ri_dtls,
                   lms_treaty_setups,
                   lms_treaty_participants
             WHERE     coript_rei_code = rei_code
                   AND coript_cpv_voucher_no = v_vchr_no
                   AND coript_clm_no = v_clm_no
                   AND trpa_rei_code = coript_rei_code
                   AND coript_agen_code = trpa_agen_code;

        CURSOR tax_type (v_clm_pol_code NUMBER)
        IS
            SELECT pptx_tax_amt,
                   tt_type,
                   tt_sht_desc,
                   tt_code,
                   tt_desc
              FROM lms_pol_pension_taxes, lms_tax_types
             WHERE     pptx_tt_code = tt_code
                   AND pptx_pol_code = v_clm_pol_code
                   AND pptx_popns_code IN
                           (SELECT poapn_popns_code
                              FROM lms_pol_ord_active_pensions, lms_policies
                             WHERE     poapn_pol_code = v_clm_pol_code
                                   AND poapn_endr_code =
                                       pol_current_endr_code);

        CURSOR bonus (v_clm_pol_code NUMBER)
        IS
              SELECT ltr_clm_no,
                     pbn_pol_code,
                     SUM (pbn_amt)                pbn_amt,
                     pbn_type,
                     DECODE (pbn_type,
                             'T', 'TERMINAL',
                             'R', 'REVERSIONARY',
                             'D', 'DIVIDENDS')    bonustype
                FROM lms_policy_bonus, lms_transactions
               WHERE     pbn_trans_no = ltr_trans_no
                     AND ltr_clm_no = v_clm_no
                     AND pbn_pol_code = v_clm_pol_code
            GROUP BY pbn_type, ltr_clm_no, pbn_pol_code;

        v_brh_code              NUMBER;
        v_count                 NUMBER := 0;
        v_org_code              NUMBER;
        v_crt_acc_no            VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_sys_code              NUMBER;
        v_bct_code              NUMBER;
        v_bct_brh_code          NUMBER;
        v_cur_code              NUMBER;
        v_auth_by               NUMBER;
        v_trnt_type             VARCHAR2 (5);
        v_prod_code             NUMBER;
        v_prod_type             VARCHAR2 (10);
        v_trnt_code             VARCHAR2 (10);
        v_trnt_gl_code          VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_trnt_contra_gl_code   VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_raised_by             NUMBER;
        v_cla_type              VARCHAR2 (2);
        nparticipantamt         NUMBER := 0;
        v_claim_amt             NUMBER := 0;
        v_tax_amt               NUMBER := 0;
        v_prem_drcr             VARCHAR2 (5) := 'C';
        v_narrative             VARCHAR2 (30);
        grp_amt                 NUMBER := 0;
        v_factr                 NUMBER := 1;
        v_tax_param             VARCHAR2 (5);
        v_trans_code            NUMBER;
        v_class                 VARCHAR2 (5);
        v_acnt_type             VARCHAR2 (10);
        v_pymt_class            VARCHAR2 (10);
        v_mat_amnt              NUMBER;
        vgl_trans               fms_vouchers_pkg.tgl_rec_type;
        v_gl_count              NUMBER := -1;
        v_param_val             VARCHAR2 (1);
        v_use_claim_reserve     VARCHAR2 (1) := 'N';
        v_client                VARCHAR2 (150);
        v_param_fund_value      VARCHAR2 (1);
        v_fund_value            NUMBER;
        v_param_intr            VARCHAR2 (1);
        v_intr                  NUMBER := 0;
        v_min_cpv_code          NUMBER;
    BEGIN
        --      raise_error(v_clm_no||'v_cpv_voucher_no='||v_cpv_voucher_no);
        --      raise_error('v_gross_amount=='||v_gross_amount||' v_reinstmnt_amt=='||v_reinstmnt_amt);
        BEGIN
            lms_ord_misc.system_param_val ('SITE_PARAM', v_site_param);
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                raise_error ('Parameter Error...');
        END;

        BEGIN
            lms_ord_misc.system_param_val ('USE_CONTRAL_ACCOUNT_AT_CLAIMS',
                                           v_param_val);
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                raise_error (
                    'Parameter Error...USE_CONTRAL_ACCOUNT_AT_CLAIMS');
        END;

        BEGIN
            lms_ord_misc.system_param_val ('USE_CLAIM_RESERVE',
                                           v_use_claim_reserve,
                                           NULL);
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                raise_error ('Parameter Error....USE_CLAIM_RESERVE');
        END;

        BEGIN
            SELECT pol_bra_code,
                   cla_type,
                   pol_prod_code,
                   pol_code,
                   pol_prod_type
              INTO v_brh_code,
                   v_cla_type,
                   v_prod_code,
                   v_pol_code,
                   v_prod_type
              FROM lms_policies, lms_classes
             WHERE     pol_code =
                       (SELECT DISTINCT clm_pol_code
                          FROM lms_clm_payment_vouchers, lms_claims
                         WHERE     cpv_clm_no = clm_no
                               AND cpv_clm_no = v_clm_no
                               AND cpv_voucher_no || cpv_ben_code =
                                   v_cpv_voucher_no
                               AND cpv_authorised = 'N')
                   AND pol_cla_code = cla_code;
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND
            THEN
                raise_error (
                       'POLICY REC NOT FOUND FOR CLM - '
                    || v_clm_no
                    || ';'
                    || v_cpv_voucher_no);
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                raise_error ('GETTING POLICY REC....');
        END;

        BEGIN
            SELECT TRIM (
                          prp_surname
                       || ' '
                       || TRIM (prp_other_names || ' ' || prp_first_name))
              INTO v_client
              FROM lms_policies, lms_proposers
             WHERE     pol_client_prp_code = prp_code(+)
                   AND pol_code = v_pol_code;
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND
            THEN
                raise_error (
                       'ERROR GETTING SCHEME NAME FOR CLM - '
                    || v_clm_no
                    || ';'
                    || v_cpv_voucher_no);
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                raise_error ('GETTING SCHEME NAME....');
        END;


        --raise_error('xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx');
        BEGIN
            lms_ord_misc.system_param_val ('CONSOLIDATE_CLAIM_TAX',
                                           v_tax_param);
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                raise_error ('PARAM ERROR...CONSOLIDATE_CLAIM_TAX');
        END;


        BEGIN
            lms_ord_misc.system_param_val ('POST_CLAIM_POLICY_VALUE',
                                           v_param_fund_value,
                                           v_prod_code);
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                raise_error ('Parameter Error...POST_CLAIM_POLICY_VALUE');
        END;

        BEGIN
            lms_ord_misc.system_param_val ('POST_GUARNTD_POL_INTR',
                                           v_param_intr,
                                           v_prod_code);
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                raise_error ('Parameter Error...POST_GUARNTD_POL_INTR');
        END;

        IF v_cla_type = 'O'
        THEN
            v_pymt_class := 'CLM';

            IF v_prod_type = 'AN'
            THEN
                v_pymt_class := 'CLM_ANN';
            END IF;

            SELECT MIN (cpv_code)
              INTO v_min_cpv_code
              FROM lms_clm_payment_vouchers
             WHERE cpv_clm_no = v_clm_no;


            IF v_cpv_code = v_min_cpv_code
            THEN
                SELECT NVL (clm_inv_income, 0), NVL (clm_inv_fund_value, 0)
                  INTO v_intr, v_fund_value
                  FROM lms_claims
                 WHERE clm_no = v_clm_no;

                IF v_param_fund_value = 'Y' AND v_fund_value > 0
                THEN
                    v_fund_value := ROUND (v_fund_value, 2);
                ELSE
                    v_fund_value := 0;
                END IF;

                IF v_param_intr = 'Y' AND v_intr > 0
                THEN
                    v_intr := ROUND (v_intr, 2);
                ELSE
                    v_intr := 0;
                END IF;
            END IF;
        ELSIF v_cla_type = 'G'
        THEN
            v_pymt_class := 'CLMG';
        END IF;

        --raise_error('&#&#^#');
        SELECT    TO_NUMBER (TO_CHAR (SYSDATE, 'RRRR'))
               || lms_transaction_seq.NEXTVAL
          INTO v_trans_code
          FROM DUAL;

        FOR i IN c_clm_vch
        LOOP
            IF NVL (v_gross_amount, 0) <>
               (  NVL (i.net_amount, 0)
                + NVL (v_loan_amount, 0)
                + NVL (v_os_premium, 0)
                + NVL (v_maturities, 0)
                - NVL (i.cpv_unproc_bal_amt, 0)
                + NVL (v_ck_comm, 0)
                + NVL (i.cpv_penalty_amt, 0)
                + NVL (v_reinstmnt_amt, 0))
            THEN
                raise_error (
                       'GROSS AMT('
                    || NVL (v_gross_amount, 0)
                    || ') NOT EQUAL TO BREAKDOWN: NET '
                    || NVL (i.net_amount, 0)
                    || '; LN '
                    || NVL (v_loan_amount, 0)
                    || '; P '
                    || NVL (v_os_premium, 0)
                    || '; MTR '
                    || NVL (v_maturities, 0)
                    || '; COMM '
                    || NVL (v_ck_comm, 0)
                    || '; PENALTY '
                    || NVL (i.cpv_penalty_amt, 0)
                    || '; Reinstatement Interest'
                    || NVL (v_reinstmnt_amt, 0)
                    || ' Un-allocated amount '
                    || NVL (i.cpv_unproc_bal_amt, 0));
            END IF;

            v_org_code := fms_interfaces_pkg.get_org (v_brh_code);

            IF NVL (v_tax_param, 'N') <> 'Y'
            THEN
                v_tax_amt := ROUND (i.cpv_tax_amt, 1);
            END IF;

            IF i.cpv_ben_code IS NOT NULL
            THEN
                BEGIN
                    SELECT NVL (ben_pct_benefit, 0) / 100
                      INTO v_factr
                      FROM lms_policy_beneficiaries
                     WHERE     ben_code = i.cpv_ben_code
                           AND ben_pol_code = v_pol_code;
                EXCEPTION
                    WHEN OTHERS
                    THEN
                        raise_error (
                            'UNABLE TO RETRIEVE BENEFICIARY ALLOCATION %....');
                END;
            END IF;

            BEGIN
                SELECT SUM (NVL (prmat_mat_amnt, 0))
                  INTO v_unpaid_mat
                  FROM lms_process_maturity_log
                 WHERE prmat_pol_code = i.clm_pol_code;
            EXCEPTION
                WHEN OTHERS
                THEN
                    raise_error (
                        'UNABLE TO RETRIEVE BENEFICIARY UNPAID MATURITY ....');
            END;

            IF v_cla_type = 'G'
            THEN
                FOR c_trt_participant_rec
                    IN c_trt_participant (i.cpv_voucher_no)
                LOOP
                    IF NVL (c_trt_participant_rec.crctd_amount, 0) <> 0
                    THEN
                        IF c_trt_participant_rec.trpa_gl_account IS NULL
                        THEN
                            raise_error (
                                   'GL A/C UNDEFINED FOR '
                                || c_trt_participant_rec.crctd_agn_sht_desc
                                || ','
                                || c_trt_participant_rec.rei_trt_sht_desc);
                        END IF;

                        valid_acc (c_trt_participant_rec.trpa_gl_account,
                                   v_org_code,
                                   v_brh_code,
                                   'RI RECOVERY');
                        v_count := v_count + 1;
                        interface_append_chq (
                            v_trans_code,
                            i.cpv_raise_by,
                            v_pol_code,
                            v_prod_code,
                            i.cpv_voucher_no,
                            v_count,
                            c_trt_participant_rec.crctd_amount,
                               'RI RECOVERY'
                            || ' - Claim '
                            || v_clm_no
                            || ' - '
                            || i.clm_pol_policy_no,              --v_narrative
                            c_trt_participant_rec.trpa_gl_account,
                            v_org_code,
                            v_brh_code,
                            'D',
                            v_chq_dtls_rec,
                            NULL,          --v_fpmt_code  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                            NULL,           --v_ocl_code  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                            NULL,            --v_agn_code NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                            i.ltr_trans_no);

                        BEGIN
                            INSERT INTO lms_prd_treaty_summaries (
                                            prts_code,
                                            prts_rei_code,
                                            prts_trt_code,
                                            prts_ta_code,
                                            prts_uw_year,
                                            prts_fiscal_year,
                                            prts_fiscal_month,
                                            prts_prod_code,
                                            prts_claims_paid,
                                            prts_agn_code,
                                            prts_clm_no,
                                            prts_as_code,
                                            prts_endr_code,
                                            prts_trs_code,
                                            prts_trs_sht_desc,
                                            --  prts_cover_from_date,
                                            --  prts_cover_to_date,
                                            prts_clm_voucher_no,
                                            prts_cla_code,
                                            prts_trans_no,
                                            prts_tran_type,
                                            prts_effective_date)
                                     VALUES (
                                            TO_CHAR (SYSDATE, 'YYYY')
                                         || lms_prts_code_seq.NEXTVAL,
                                         c_trt_participant_rec.crctd_rei_code,
                                         c_trt_participant_rec.rei_trt_code,
                                         c_trt_participant_rec.rei_ta_code,
                                         lms_grp_misc.get_pol_duration (
                                             i.clm_endr_code,
                                             i.clm_pol_code),
                                         c_trt_participant_rec.rei_uw_year,
                                         --TO_NUMBER (TO_CHAR (SYSDATE, 'YYYY')),
                                         TO_NUMBER (TO_CHAR (SYSDATE, 'MM')),
                                         c_trt_participant_rec.crctd_prod_code,
                                         c_trt_participant_rec.crctd_amount,
                                         c_trt_participant_rec.crctd_agn_code,
                                         v_clm_no,
                                         c_trt_participant_rec.rei_as_code,
                                         i.clm_endr_code,
                                         c_trt_participant_rec.rei_trs_code,
                                         c_trt_participant_rec.rei_trs_sht_desc,
                                         -- c_trt_participant_rec.crctd_cover_from_date,
                                         -- c_trt_participant_rec.crctd_cover_to_date,
                                         i.cpv_voucher_no,
                                         20022,
                                         i.ltr_trans_no,
                                         'CLMG',
                                         TRUNC (SYSDATE));
                        EXCEPTION
                            WHEN OTHERS
                            THEN
                                raise_error (
                                    'Error populating period summary');
                        END;

                        nparticipantamt :=
                              nparticipantamt
                            + c_trt_participant_rec.crctd_amount;
                        grp_amt :=
                            grp_amt + c_trt_participant_rec.crctd_amount;
                    END IF;

                    UPDATE lms_claims_ri_co_trt_dtls
                       SET crctd_authorised = 'Y'
                     WHERE crctd_code = c_trt_participant_rec.crctd_code;
                END LOOP;
            ELSE
                FOR ord_trt_participant_rec
                    IN ord_trt_participant (i.cpv_voucher_no)
                LOOP
                    IF NVL (ord_trt_participant_rec.coript_amount, 0) <> 0
                    THEN
                        IF ord_trt_participant_rec.trpa_gl_account IS NULL
                        THEN
                            raise_error (
                                   'GL A/C UNDEFINED FOR '
                                || ord_trt_participant_rec.coript_agen_sht_desc
                                || ','
                                || ord_trt_participant_rec.rei_trt_sht_desc);
                        END IF;

                        valid_acc (ord_trt_participant_rec.trpa_gl_account,
                                   v_org_code,
                                   v_brh_code,
                                   'RI RECOVERY');
                        v_count := v_count + 1;
                        interface_append_chq (
                            v_trans_code,
                            i.cpv_raise_by,
                            v_pol_code,
                            v_prod_code,
                            i.cpv_voucher_no,
                            v_count,
                            ord_trt_participant_rec.coript_amount * v_factr,
                               'RI RECOVERY'
                            || ' - Claim '
                            || v_clm_no
                            || ' - '
                            || i.clm_pol_policy_no,              --v_narrative
                            ord_trt_participant_rec.trpa_gl_account,
                            v_org_code,
                            v_brh_code,
                            'D',
                            v_chq_dtls_rec,
                            NULL,          --v_fpmt_code  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                            NULL,           --v_ocl_code  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                            NULL,            --v_agn_code NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                            i.ltr_trans_no    --v_trans_no NUMBER DEFAULT NULL
                                          );
                        nparticipantamt :=
                              nparticipantamt
                            + ord_trt_participant_rec.coript_amount * v_factr;
                    END IF;

                    /*IF v_site_param NOT IN ('22', '24')
                    THEN
                        BEGIN
                            INSERT INTO lms_prd_treaty_summaries (
                                            prts_code,
                                            prts_rei_code,
                                            prts_trt_code,
                                            prts_ta_code,
                                            prts_uw_year,
                                            prts_fiscal_year,
                                            prts_fiscal_month,
                                            prts_prod_code,
                                            prts_claims_paid,
                                            prts_agn_code,
                                            prts_clm_no,
                                            prts_as_code,
                                            prts_endr_code,
                                            prts_trs_code,
                                            prts_trs_sht_desc,
                                            prts_cla_code,
                                            prts_trans_no,
                                            prts_tran_type,
                                            prts_effective_date)
                                     VALUES (
                                            TO_CHAR (SYSDATE, 'YYYY')
                                         || lms_prts_code_seq.NEXTVAL,
                                         ord_trt_participant_rec.coript_rei_code,
                                         ord_trt_participant_rec.rei_trt_code,
                                         ord_trt_participant_rec.rei_ta_code,
                                         ord_trt_participant_rec.rei_uw_year,
                                         TO_NUMBER (
                                             TO_CHAR (SYSDATE, 'RRRR')),
                                         --TO_NUMBER (TO_CHAR (SYSDATE, 'YYYY')),
                                         TO_NUMBER (TO_CHAR (SYSDATE, 'MM')),
                                         ord_trt_participant_rec.coript_prod_code,
                                         ord_trt_participant_rec.coript_amount,
                                         ord_trt_participant_rec.coript_agen_code,
                                         v_clm_no,
                                         ord_trt_participant_rec.rei_as_code,
                                         i.clm_endr_code,
                                         ord_trt_participant_rec.rei_trs_code,
                                         ord_trt_participant_rec.rei_trs_sht_desc,
                                         20021,
                                         i.ltr_trans_no,
                                         'CLM',
                                         TRUNC (SYSDATE));
                        EXCEPTION
                            WHEN OTHERS
                            THEN
                                raise_error ('Error populating period summary');
                        END;
                    END IF;*/
                END LOOP;
            END IF;

            IF NVL (v_gross_amount, 0) <> 0
            THEN
                IF nparticipantamt = 0
                THEN
                    v_claim_amt :=
                          NVL (v_gross_amount, 0)
                        + NVL (i.cpv_bo_spread_amt, 0)
                        + NVL (v_tax_amt, 0);
                ELSE
                    v_claim_amt :=
                          NVL (v_gross_amount, 0)
                        + NVL (i.cpv_bo_spread_amt, 0)
                        + NVL (v_tax_amt, 0)
                        - nparticipantamt;
                END IF;

                --RAISE_ERROR('v_claim_amt='||v_claim_amt);
                IF v_cla_type = 'O'
                THEN
                    IF NVL (v_use_claim_reserve, 'N') = 'Y'
                    THEN
                        v_acnt_type := 'CLMRSV_O';
                        get_gl_code (v_acnt_type,                      --'CP',
                                     v_prod_code,
                                     v_trnt_code,
                                     v_crt_acc_no,
                                     v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                     NULL,
                                     i.renewal);
                        --  RAISE_ERROR('Error....4444');
                        valid_acc (v_crt_acc_no,
                                   v_org_code,
                                   v_brh_code,
                                   v_acnt_type);
                    ELSE                                              --OLIFFE
                        IF i.clm_caus_type = 'DTH'
                        THEN
                            v_acnt_type := 'CP_DTH';
                        ELSE
                            v_acnt_type := 'CP_DIS';
                        END IF;


                        get_gl_code (v_acnt_type,                      --'CP',
                                     v_prod_code,
                                     v_trnt_code,
                                     v_crt_acc_no,
                                     v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                     NULL,
                                     i.renewal);
                        --  RAISE_ERROR('Error....4444');
                        valid_acc (v_crt_acc_no,
                                   v_org_code,
                                   v_brh_code,
                                   v_acnt_type);
                    END IF;
                ELSIF v_cla_type = 'G'
                THEN                                                   --GLIFE
                    IF i.clm_caus_type = 'DTH'
                    THEN
                        v_acnt_type := 'CP_DTH_GB';
                    ELSIF i.clm_caus_type = 'DIS'
                    THEN
                        v_acnt_type := 'CP_DIS_GB';
                    ELSIF i.clm_caus_type = 'CIL'
                    THEN
                        v_acnt_type := 'CP_CIL_GB';
                    ELSIF i.clm_caus_type = 'WC'
                    THEN
                        v_acnt_type := 'CP_WC_GB';
                    ELSIF i.clm_caus_type = 'PA'
                    THEN
                        v_acnt_type := 'CP_PA_GB';
                    ELSE
                        v_acnt_type := 'CP_DTH_GB';
                    END IF;                                            --GLIFE

                    get_gl_code (v_acnt_type,                       --'CP_GB',
                                 v_prod_code,
                                 v_trnt_code,
                                 v_crt_acc_no,
                                 v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                 NULL,
                                 i.renewal);
                    valid_acc (v_crt_acc_no,
                               v_org_code,
                               v_brh_code,
                               v_acnt_type);
                ELSE
                    raise_error ('UNDEFINED CLASS TYPE - ' || v_cla_type);
                END IF;

                IF v_cla_type = 'G'
                THEN
                    v_exchange_rate :=
                        lms_grp_misc.get_currexch_rate (i.cpv_cur_code,
                                                        TRUNC (SYSDATE));
                    v_base_cur_code :=
                        lms_interfaces_pkg.lms_def_cur (v_brh_code);

                    BEGIN
                        lms_ord_misc.system_param_val (
                            'CLAIM_PYMT_IN_BASE_CURRENCY',
                            v_param_value);
                    EXCEPTION
                        WHEN OTHERS
                        THEN
                            raise_error (
                                'Parameter Error...CLAIM_PYMT_IN_BASE_CURRENCY');
                    END;

                    IF NVL (v_param_value, 'N') = 'Y'
                    THEN
                        i.cpv_cur_code := v_base_cur_code;
                        v_claim_amt := (v_exchange_rate * v_claim_amt);
                        v_unpaid_mat := (v_exchange_rate * v_unpaid_mat);
                        i.net_amount := (v_exchange_rate * i.net_amount);
                    ELSE
                        v_claim_amt := v_claim_amt;
                        v_unpaid_mat := v_unpaid_mat;
                        i.net_amount := i.net_amount;
                    END IF;
                END IF;

                v_count := v_count + 1;
                interface_append_chq (
                    v_trans_code,
                    i.cpv_raise_by,
                    v_pol_code,
                    v_prod_code,
                    i.cpv_voucher_no,
                    v_count,
                    v_claim_amt - NVL (v_unpaid_mat, 0),
                       'CLAIM PAYMENT ON '
                    || i.clm_pol_policy_no
                    || '-'
                    || v_clm_no
                    || '-'
                    || v_client,                                 --v_narrative
                    v_crt_acc_no,
                    v_org_code,
                    v_brh_code,
                    'D',
                    v_chq_dtls_rec,
                    NULL,                  --v_fpmt_code  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                    NULL,                   --v_ocl_code  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                    NULL,                    --v_agn_code NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                    i.ltr_trans_no);

                IF     v_param_val = 'Y'
                   AND v_crt_acc_no <>
                       NVL (v_trnt_contra_gl_code, v_crt_acc_no)
                THEN
                    valid_acc (v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                               v_org_code,
                               v_brh_code,
                               v_acnt_type);

                    v_gl_count := v_gl_count + 2;
                    interface_append_gl (
                        v_trans_code,
                        --v_trans_code        NUMBER,
                        i.cpv_raise_by,
                        --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                        v_pol_code,              --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                        v_prod_code,             --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                        i.cpv_voucher_no,
                        --v_vchr_no           VARCHAR2,
                        NULL,                    --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                        NULL,                    --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                        NULL,                   --v_rcpt_no          VARCHAR2,
                        v_gl_count,              --v_count             NUMBER,
                           'CLAIMS INCURRED ON '
                        || i.clm_pol_policy_no
                        || '= '
                        || i.cpv_voucher_no,
                        --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                        v_claim_amt,
                        --v_amount            NUMBER,
                        'C',                   --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                        v_crt_acc_no,
                        --v_acc_number1         VARCHAR2,
                        v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                        --v_acc_number2         VARCHAR2,
                        v_brh_code,
                        vgl_trans);
                    interface_update_vgl (
                        v_trans_code,               --v_trans_code     NUMBER,
                        i.cpv_raise_by,
                        --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                        NULL,                    --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                        TRUNC (SYSDATE),                --v_date         DATE,
                        NULL,                    --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                        NULL,                    --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                        v_trnt_code,
                        --v_btc_description   VARCHAR2,
                        'JV',                 --v_btc_type           VARCHAR2,
                        v_brh_code,
                           --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                           v_trnt_code
                        || '=='
                        || i.clm_pol_policy_no
                        || '= '
                        || v_clm_no
                        || '=='
                        || i.cpv_voucher_no,
                        --v_description       VARCHAR2,
                        i.cpv_voucher_no,
                        --v_ref_no            VARCHAR2,
                        vgl_trans,
                        --v_gl_trans  IN OUT  fms_test.Fms_Vouchers_Pkg.Tgl_rec_type,
                        NULL,
                        --v_cad_code       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                        NULL);
                END IF;

                IF NVL (v_unpaid_mat, 0) <> 0
                THEN
                    get_gl_code ('POL_MTR',
                                 v_prod_code,
                                 v_trnt_code,
                                 v_crt_acc_no,
                                 v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                 NULL,
                                 i.renewal);
                    valid_acc (v_crt_acc_no,
                               v_org_code,
                               v_brh_code,
                               'POL_MTR');
                    v_count := v_count + 1;
                    interface_append_chq (
                        v_trans_code,
                        i.cpv_raise_by,
                        v_pol_code,
                        v_prod_code,
                        i.cpv_voucher_no,
                        v_count,
                        v_unpaid_mat,
                           'UNPAID MATURITIES'
                        || ' - Claim '
                        || v_clm_no
                        || ' - '
                        || i.clm_pol_policy_no,                  --v_narrative
                        v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                        v_org_code,
                        v_brh_code,
                        'D',
                        v_chq_dtls_rec,
                        NULL,              --v_fpmt_code  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                        NULL,               --v_ocl_code  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                        NULL,                --v_agn_code NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                        i.ltr_trans_no);
                    grp_amt := grp_amt + v_claim_amt;
                END IF;
            END IF;


            IF NVL (v_intr, 0) > 0
            THEN
                get_gl_code ('INTR_WTH',
                             v_prod_code,
                             v_trnt_code,
                             v_crt_acc_no,
                             v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                             NULL,
                             i.renewal);
                valid_acc (v_crt_acc_no,
                           v_org_code,
                           v_brh_code,
                           'INTR_WTH');
                valid_acc (v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                           v_org_code,
                           v_brh_code,
                           'INTR_WTH CONTRA');

                v_count := v_count + 1;
                interface_append_chq (
                    v_trans_code,
                    i.cpv_raise_by,
                    v_pol_code,
                    v_prod_code,
                    i.cpv_voucher_no,
                    v_count,
                    v_intr,
                       'GUARANTEED INTEREST CLAIM- '
                    || v_clm_no
                    || ' - '
                    || i.clm_pol_policy_no,                      --v_narrative
                    v_crt_acc_no,
                    v_org_code,
                    v_brh_code,
                    'D',
                    v_chq_dtls_rec,
                    NULL,                  --v_fpmt_code  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                    NULL,                   --v_ocl_code  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                    NULL,                    --v_agn_code NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                    i.ltr_trans_no);

                v_count := v_count + 1;
                interface_append_chq (
                    v_trans_code,
                    i.cpv_raise_by,
                    v_pol_code,
                    v_prod_code,
                    i.cpv_voucher_no,
                    v_count,
                    v_intr,
                       'GUARANTEED INTEREST CLAIM- '
                    || v_clm_no
                    || ' - '
                    || i.clm_pol_policy_no,                      --v_narrative
                    v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                    v_org_code,
                    v_brh_code,
                    'C',
                    v_chq_dtls_rec,
                    NULL,                  --v_fpmt_code  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                    NULL,                   --v_ocl_code  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                    NULL,                    --v_agn_code NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                    i.ltr_trans_no);
            END IF;


            IF NVL (v_fund_value, 0) > 0
            THEN
                get_gl_code ('CP_PV',
                             v_prod_code,
                             v_trnt_code,
                             v_crt_acc_no,
                             v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                             NULL,
                             i.renewal);

    --      WHEN OTHERS
    --      THEN
    --         raise_error ('CREATING CLAIM REQN.... ');
    END process_claim_pymt;

    PROCEDURE proc_proposal_ref (
        v_pol_code     NUMBER,
        v_prod_code    NUMBER,
        v_vchr_no      NUMBER,
        v_tot_rcts     NUMBER,
        v_med_amt      NUMBER,
        v_comm_amt     NUMBER,
        v_amount       NUMBER,
        v_user_name    VARCHAR2,
        v_pay_method   VARCHAR2 DEFAULT 'CHQ'
    )
    IS
        v_brh_code                  NUMBER;
        v_bct_brh_code              NUMBER;
        v_trnt_code                 VARCHAR2 (10);
        v_trnt_gl_code              VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_trnt_contra_gl_code       VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_count                     NUMBER := 0;
        v_org_code                  NUMBER;
        v_sys_code                  NUMBER;
        v_bct_code                  NUMBER;
        v_cur_code                  NUMBER;
        v_auth_by                   NUMBER;
        v_payee                     VARCHAR2 (100);
        v_ref                       VARCHAR2 (50);
        v_prop_no                   VARCHAR2 (100);
        v_chq_dtls_rec              fms_cheques_pkg.type_rqn_dtls_table;
        v_gl_trans                  fms_vouchers_pkg.tgl_rec_type;
        v_gl_count                  NUMBER := 0;
        vgl_code                    NUMBER;
        v_trans_code                NUMBER;
        v_admin_amt                 NUMBER;
        v_charge_amt                NUMBER;
        v_adcost_param              VARCHAR2 (5);
        v_agn_code                  NUMBER;
        v_done_by                   lms_proposal_statuses.prst_done_by%TYPE;
        v_refund_chk_chrg           VARCHAR2 (5);
        v_comm_amt_ded              NUMBER;
        v_endr_to_pol_code          VARCHAR2 (100);
        v_endr_to_prp_code          VARCHAR2 (100);
        v_pay_method_code           NUMBER;
        v_proposal_no               VARCHAR2 (50);
        v_rct_branch_to             NUMBER;
        v_oppr_code                 NUMBER;
        v_rct_code                  VARCHAR2 (100);
        v_oppr_receipt_trans_code   VARCHAR2 (100);
        v_ann_chk                   VARCHAR2 (100);
        v_chkoff_rate               NUMBER;
        v_chkoff_agen_code          NUMBER := NULL;
        v_bbr_code                  NUMBER;
        v_payee_bank_acc_no         VARCHAR2 (50);
        v_clnt_mob_no               lms_pol_payment_vouchers.ppv_clnt_mob_no%TYPE;
        v_mpt_code                  lms_pol_payment_vouchers.ppv_mpt_code%TYPE;
        v_clnt_id_passport_no       lms_pol_payment_vouchers.ppv_clnt_id_passport_no%TYPE;
        v_id_type                   VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_trans_no                  NUMBER;
    --commission amt to be deducted from the client
    BEGIN
        --raise_error ('11XXXXXVV...'||v_tot_rcts||','||NVL (v_med_amt, 0)||','||NVL (v_comm_amt, 0)||','||NVL (v_amount, 0));
        BEGIN
            lms_ord_misc.system_param_val ('RECOVER_ADMINCOSTS_FROM_AGENT',
                                           v_adcost_param);
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                raise_error ('Param Error...');
        END;

        BEGIN
            lms_ord_misc.system_param_val ('REFUND_CHK_OFF_COMM_CHRG',
                                           v_refund_chk_chrg);
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                raise_error ('Param Error... REFUND_CHK_OFF_COMM_CHRG');
        END;

        BEGIN
            SELECT prst_done_by
              INTO v_done_by
              FROM lms_proposal_statuses
             WHERE     prst_pol_code = v_pol_code
                   AND prst_current = 'Y'
                   AND prst_status = 'C';
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND
            THEN
                BEGIN
                    SELECT prst_done_by
                      INTO v_done_by
                      FROM lms_proposal_statuses
                     WHERE prst_pol_code = v_pol_code AND prst_status = 'C';
                EXCEPTION
                    WHEN OTHERS
                    THEN
                        raise_error ('fetching cancellation details.2...');
                END;
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                raise_error ('fetching cancellation details....');
        END;

        SELECT prp_code,
               pol_bra_code,
               NVL (ppv_payee, endr_payee),
               pol_proposal_no,
               endr_agen_code
          INTO v_ref,
               v_brh_code,
               v_payee,
               v_prop_no,
               v_agn_code
          FROM lms_proposers,
               lms_policies,
               lms_policy_endorsements,
               lms_pol_payment_vouchers
         WHERE     pol_prp_code = prp_code
               AND pol_current_endr_code = endr_code
               AND ppv_voucher_no = v_vchr_no
               AND ppv_pol_code = pol_code
               AND pol_code = v_pol_code;

        SELECT endr_to_pol_code, endr_to_prp_code
          INTO v_endr_to_pol_code, v_endr_to_prp_code
          FROM lms_policy_endorsements
         WHERE endr_pol_code = v_pol_code;

        BEGIN
            SELECT ppvd_amount
              INTO v_admin_amt
              FROM lms_pol_payment_vouchers, lms_pol_payment_voucher_dtls
             WHERE     ppvd_ppv_voucher_no = ppv_voucher_no
                   AND ppv_voucher_no = v_vchr_no
                   AND ppvd_narrative = 'ADMIN. CHARGE';
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND
            THEN
                v_admin_amt := NULL;
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                raise_error ('Error fetching admin. charge....');
        END;

        BEGIN
            SELECT ppvd_amount
              INTO v_charge_amt
              FROM lms_pol_payment_vouchers, lms_pol_payment_voucher_dtls
             WHERE     ppvd_ppv_voucher_no = ppv_voucher_no
                   AND ppv_voucher_no = v_vchr_no
                   AND ppvd_narrative = 'PROPOSAL_CANCELLATION_CHARGES';
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND
            THEN
                v_charge_amt := NULL;
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                raise_error (
                    'Error fetching Proposal Cancellation. charge....');
        END;

        SELECT ppv_bbr_code,
               ppv_payee_bank_acc_no,
               ppv_clnt_mob_no,
               ppv_mpt_code,
               ppv_clnt_id_passport_no,
               DECODE (ppv_identity_type,
                       'I', 'NATIONAL ID',
                       'P', 'PASSPORT'),
               ppv_trans_no
          INTO v_bbr_code,
               v_payee_bank_acc_no,
               v_clnt_mob_no,
               v_mpt_code,
               v_clnt_id_passport_no,
               v_id_type,
               v_trans_no
          FROM lms_pol_payment_vouchers
         WHERE ppv_voucher_no = v_vchr_no;

        IF NVL (v_pay_method, 'CHQ') = 'EFT'
        THEN
            IF v_bbr_code IS NULL
            THEN
                raise_error ('Payment Bank not selected...');
            END IF;

            IF v_payee_bank_acc_no IS NULL
            THEN
                raise_error ('Bank account number not provided...');
            END IF;
        ELSIF NVL (v_pay_method, 'CHQ') = 'MFT'
        THEN
            IF v_clnt_mob_no IS NULL
            THEN
                raise_error ('Client Mobile number not provided...');
            END IF;

            IF v_mpt_code IS NULL
            THEN
                raise_error (
                    'Client mobile service provider not provided...');
            END IF;
        END IF;

        v_org_code := fms_interfaces_pkg.get_org (v_brh_code);

        IF NVL (v_adcost_param, 'N') = 'Y' AND v_agn_code IS NULL
        THEN
            raise_error ('AN AGENT MUST BE PROVIDED');
        END IF;

        SELECT DECODE (v_refund_chk_chrg, 'Y', 0, NVL (v_comm_amt, 0)) --v_amount already includes v_comm_amt if Y
          INTO v_comm_amt_ded
          FROM DUAL;

        IF NVL (v_adcost_param, 'N') = 'Y' AND v_agn_code IS NOT NULL
        THEN
            BEGIN
                lms_process_receipts.cancelchargesclwbk (v_pol_code,
                                                         v_amount,
                                                         v_med_amt,
                                                         v_admin_amt,
                                                         NULL,
                                                         v_charge_amt);
            EXCEPTION
                WHEN OTHERS
                THEN
                    raise_error (
                        'Unable to debit the agent with administrative cost.');
            END;

            IF NVL (v_tot_rcts, 0) <> (NVL (v_amount, 0)) -- + NVL(v_admin_amt,0) + NVL(v_charge_amt,0))
            THEN
                raise_error (
                       'THE AMOUNTS DO NOT ADD UP TO THE GROSS AMOUNT...='
                    || v_tot_rcts
                    || ';;'
                    || NVL (v_amount, 0));
            END IF;
        ELSE
            IF NVL (v_tot_rcts, 0) <>
                 NVL (v_med_amt, 0)
               + NVL (v_comm_amt, 0)
               + NVL (v_amount, 0)
               + NVL (v_admin_amt, 0)
               + NVL (v_charge_amt, 0)
            THEN
                raise_error (
                       'AMOUNTS DO NOT ADD UP TO THE GROSS AMOUNT...'
                    || v_tot_rcts
                    || '=='
                    || NVL (v_med_amt, 0)
                    || '+'
                    || NVL (v_comm_amt, 0)
                    || '+'
                    || NVL (v_amount, 0)
                    || '+'
                    || NVL (v_charge_amt, 0));
            END IF;
        END IF;

        SELECT    TO_NUMBER (TO_CHAR (SYSDATE, 'RRRR'))
               || lms_transaction_seq.NEXTVAL
          INTO v_trans_code
          FROM DUAL;

        IF NVL (v_tot_rcts, 0) != 0
        THEN
            get_gl_code ('PRREF',
                         v_prod_code,
                         v_trnt_code,
                         v_trnt_gl_code,
                         v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
            valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                       v_org_code,
                       v_brh_code,
                       'PRREF');
            valid_acc (v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                       v_org_code,
                       v_brh_code,
                       'PRREF CONTRA');
            v_gl_count := v_gl_count + 1;
            interface_append_gl (v_trans_code, --v_trans_code           NUMBER,
                                 v_user_name,  --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                                 v_pol_code,     --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                                 v_prod_code,    --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                                 v_vchr_no,  --v_vchr_no             VARCHAR2,
                                 NULL,           --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                                 NULL,           --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                                 NULL,       --v_rcpt_no             VARCHAR2,
                                 v_gl_count,     --v_count             NUMBER,
                                 'PROPOSAL CANCELLATION: ' || v_prop_no,
                                 --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                                 v_tot_rcts,     --v_amount            NUMBER,
                                 'D',          --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                                 v_trnt_gl_code,
                                 --v_acc_number           VARCHAR2,
                                 v_brh_code,     --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                                 v_gl_trans);
            --v_trn_rec   IN OUT Fms_Vouchers_Pkg.Tgl_rec_type,
            v_gl_count := v_gl_count + 1;
            interface_append_gl (v_trans_code, --v_trans_code           NUMBER,
                                 v_user_name,  --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                                 v_pol_code,     --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                                 v_prod_code,    --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                                 v_vchr_no,  --v_vchr_no             VARCHAR2,
                                 NULL,           --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                                 NULL,           --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                                 NULL,       --v_rcpt_no             VARCHAR2,
                                 v_gl_count,     --v_count             NUMBER,
                                 'PROPOSAL CANCELLATION: ' || v_prop_no,
                                 --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                                 v_amount,       --v_amount            NUMBER,
                                 'C',          --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                                 v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                 --v_acc_number           VARCHAR2,
                                 v_brh_code,     --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                                 v_gl_trans);
            --v_trn_rec   IN OUT Fms_Vouchers_Pkg.Tgl_rec_type,
            v_count := v_count + 1;

            --RAISE_ERROR('here: v_endr_to_pol_code'||v_endr_to_pol_code||'v_endr_to_prp_code '||v_endr_to_prp_code||'v_amount=='||v_amount);

            --------------------start
            IF    v_endr_to_pol_code IS NOT NULL
               OR v_endr_to_prp_code IS NOT NULL
            THEN
                IF NVL (v_amount, 0) > 0
                THEN
                    v_pay_method_code := pay_method_code ('VOUCHER');

                    BEGIN
                        SELECT pol_proposal_no, pol_bra_code
                          INTO v_proposal_no, v_rct_branch_to
                          FROM lms_policies
                         WHERE pol_code = v_endr_to_pol_code;
                    EXCEPTION
                        WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND
                        THEN
                            BEGIN
                                SELECT ppr_proposal_no, ppr_brn_code
                                  INTO v_proposal_no, v_rct_branch_to
                                  FROM lms_pol_proposals
                                 WHERE ppr_code = v_endr_to_prp_code;
                            EXCEPTION
                                WHEN OTHERS
                                THEN
                                    raise_error (
                                        'Proposal to alloc. funds to transfer not found.....');
                            END;
                    END;

                    BEGIN
                        SELECT    TO_NUMBER (TO_CHAR (SYSDATE, 'RRRR'))
                               || lms_oppr_code_seq.NEXTVAL
                          INTO v_oppr_code
                          FROM DUAL;

                        SELECT 'CANC' || pol_policy_no,
                               endr_checkoff_rate,
                               endr_checkoff_agen_code
                          INTO v_rct_code, v_chkoff_rate, v_chkoff_agen_code
                          FROM lms_policies, lms_policy_endorsements
                         WHERE     pol_code = endr_pol_code
                               AND pol_code = v_pol_code;

                        SELECT    v_rct_code
                               || '/'
                               || lms_oppr_receipt_trans_seq.NEXTVAL
                          INTO v_oppr_receipt_trans_code
                          FROM DUAL;

                        v_cur_code :=
                            lms_interfaces_pkg.lms_def_cur (v_rct_branch_to);
                        v_ann_chk :=
                            NVL (annuity_check (v_endr_to_pol_code, NULL),
                                 'N');

                        INSERT INTO lms_ord_proposal_rcpts (
                                        oppr_code,
                                        oppr_ltr_trans_no,
                                        oppr_date,
                                        oppr_cheque_no,
                                        oppr_amt,
                                        oppr_pol_code,
                                        oppr_pol_proposal_no,
                                        oppr_receipt_no,
                                        oppr_receipt_date,
                                        oppr_pmth_code,
                                        opr_chk_agen_code,
                                        opri_chk_comm_rate,
                                        opri_chk_comm_amt,
                                        oppr_done_by,
                                        oppr_drcr,
                                        oppr_receipt_trans_code,
                                        oppr_ann_code,
                                        oppr_fms_receipt_pk,
                                        oppr_from_pol_code,
