                                        oppr_ppv_voucher_no)
                                 VALUES (
                                     v_oppr_code,
                                     NULL,
                                     TRUNC (SYSDATE),
                                     NULL,
                                     v_amount,
                                     DECODE (v_ann_chk,
                                             'Y', NULL,
                                             v_endr_to_pol_code),
                                     v_proposal_no, --v_recpt_rec(i).POL_POLICY_NO,
                                     'CANCELLED_PR',
                                     TRUNC (SYSDATE),
                                     v_pay_method_code,
                                     v_chkoff_agen_code,
                                     v_chkoff_rate,
                                     ROUND (
                                           NVL (v_chkoff_rate, 0)
                                         / 100
                                         * v_amount),
                                     v_user_name,
                                     DECODE (SIGN (v_amount), 1, 'C', 'D'),
                                     v_oppr_receipt_trans_code,
                                     DECODE (v_ann_chk,
                                             'Y', v_endr_to_pol_code,
                                             NULL),
                                     NULL,
                                     v_pol_code,
                                     v_vchr_no);
                    EXCEPTION
                        WHEN OTHERS
                        THEN
                            raise_error (
                                'Error creating proposal receipt.....');
                    END;
                END IF;
            END IF;

            ------------------------stop
            IF v_endr_to_pol_code IS NULL AND v_endr_to_prp_code IS NULL
            THEN
                interface_append_chq (v_trans_code, --v_trans_code         NUMBER,
                                      v_user_name, --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                                      v_pol_code, --v_pol_code           NUMBER,
                                      v_prod_code, --v_prod_code          NUMBER,
                                      v_vchr_no, --v_vchr_no              VARCHAR2,
                                      v_count,  --v_count              NUMBER,
                                      v_amount, --v_amount             NUMBER,
                                      'PROPOSAL CANCELLATION: ' || v_prop_no,
                                      --v_narrative          VARCHAR2,
                                      v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                      --v_acc_number            VARCHAR2,
                                      v_org_code, --v_acc_org_code          NUMBER,
                                      v_brh_code, --v_branch_code        NUMBER,
                                      'D',    --v_drcr               VARCHAR2,
                                      v_chq_dtls_rec);
            --v_trn_rec   IN OUT   Fms_Cheques_Pkg.Type_rqn_dtls_table,
            END IF;
        END IF;

        IF NVL (v_med_amt, 0) != 0 AND NVL (v_adcost_param, 'N') = 'N'
        --not(NVL(v_adcost_param,'N') = 'Y' and v_agn_code is not null)
        THEN
            get_gl_code ('MED',
                         v_prod_code,
                         v_trnt_code,
                         v_trnt_gl_code,
                         v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
            valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                       v_org_code,
                       v_brh_code,
                       'MED');
            v_gl_count := v_gl_count + 1;
            interface_append_gl (v_trans_code, --v_trans_code           NUMBER,
                                 v_user_name,  --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                                 v_pol_code,     --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                                 v_prod_code,    --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                                 v_vchr_no,  --v_vchr_no             VARCHAR2,
                                 NULL,           --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                                 NULL,           --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                                 NULL,       --v_rcpt_no             VARCHAR2,
                                 v_gl_count,     --v_count             NUMBER,
                                 'MEDICAL EXPENSE - ' || v_prop_no,
                                 --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                                 v_med_amt,      --v_amount            NUMBER,
                                 'C',          --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                                 v_trnt_gl_code,
                                 --v_acc_number           VARCHAR2,
                                 v_brh_code,     --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                                 v_gl_trans);
        --v_trn_rec   IN OUT Fms_Vouchers_Pkg.Tgl_rec_type,
        END IF;

        IF     NVL (v_comm_amt, 0) != 0
           AND NVL (v_adcost_param, 'N') = 'N'
           AND NVL (v_refund_chk_chrg, 'N') = 'N'
        --not(NVL(v_adcost_param,'N') = 'Y' and v_agn_code is not null)
        THEN
            get_gl_code ('CHKC',
                         v_prod_code,
                         v_trnt_code,
                         v_trnt_gl_code,
                         v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
            valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                       v_org_code,
                       v_brh_code,
                       'CHKC');
            v_gl_count := v_gl_count + 1;
            interface_append_gl (v_trans_code, --v_trans_code           NUMBER,
                                 v_user_name,  --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                                 v_pol_code,     --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                                 v_prod_code,    --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                                 v_vchr_no,  --v_vchr_no             VARCHAR2,
                                 NULL,           --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                                 NULL,           --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                                 NULL,       --v_rcpt_no             VARCHAR2,
                                 v_gl_count,     --v_count             NUMBER,
                                 'COMMISSION EXPENSE - ' || v_prop_no,
                                 --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                                 v_comm_amt,     --v_amount            NUMBER,
                                 'C',          --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                                 v_trnt_gl_code,
                                 --v_acc_number           VARCHAR2,
                                 v_brh_code,     --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                                 v_gl_trans);
        --v_trn_rec   IN OUT Fms_Vouchers_Pkg.Tgl_rec_type,
        END IF;

        IF NVL (v_admin_amt, 0) != 0 AND NVL (v_adcost_param, 'N') = 'N'
        --not(NVL(v_adcost_param,'N') = 'Y' and v_agn_code is not null)
        THEN
            get_gl_code ('ADMN_AMT',
                         v_prod_code,
                         v_trnt_code,
                         v_trnt_gl_code,
                         v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
            valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                       v_org_code,
                       v_brh_code,
                       'ADMN_AMT');
            v_gl_count := v_gl_count + 1;
            interface_append_gl (
                v_trans_code,                 --v_trans_code           NUMBER,
                v_user_name,                   --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                v_pol_code,                      --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                v_prod_code,                     --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                v_vchr_no,                   --v_vchr_no             VARCHAR2,
                NULL,                            --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                NULL,                            --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                NULL,                        --v_rcpt_no             VARCHAR2,
                v_gl_count,                      --v_count             NUMBER,
                'ADMINISTRATION CHARGE - PROP. ' || v_prop_no,
                --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                v_admin_amt,                     --v_amount            NUMBER,
                'C',                           --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                v_trnt_gl_code,
                --v_acc_number           VARCHAR2,
                v_brh_code,                      --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                v_gl_trans);
        --v_trn_rec   IN OUT Fms_Vouchers_Pkg.Tgl_rec_type,
        END IF;

        IF NVL (v_charge_amt, 0) != 0 AND NVL (v_adcost_param, 'N') = 'N'
        --not(NVL(v_adcost_param,'N') = 'Y' and v_agn_code is not null)
        THEN
            get_gl_code ('PR_CHRG',
                         v_prod_code,
                         v_trnt_code,
                         v_trnt_gl_code,
                         v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
            valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                       v_org_code,
                       v_brh_code,
                       'PR_CHRG');
            v_gl_count := v_gl_count + 1;
            interface_append_gl (
                v_trans_code,                 --v_trans_code           NUMBER,
                v_user_name,                   --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                v_pol_code,                      --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                v_prod_code,                     --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                v_vchr_no,                   --v_vchr_no             VARCHAR2,
                NULL,                            --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                NULL,                            --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                NULL,                        --v_rcpt_no             VARCHAR2,
                v_gl_count,                      --v_count             NUMBER,
                'PROPOSAL CANCELLATION CHARGE - PROP. ' || v_prop_no,
                --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                v_charge_amt,                    --v_amount            NUMBER,
                'C',                           --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                v_trnt_gl_code,
                --v_acc_number           VARCHAR2,
                v_brh_code,                      --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                v_gl_trans);
        --v_trn_rec   IN OUT Fms_Vouchers_Pkg.Tgl_rec_type,
        END IF;

        IF v_count != 0
        THEN
            IF v_endr_to_pol_code IS NULL AND v_endr_to_prp_code IS NULL
            THEN
                interface_create_reqn (
                    v_trans_code,             --v_trans_code           NUMBER,
                    v_vchr_no,             --v_ref                   VARCHAR2,
                    v_pol_code,            --v_ref2                  VARCHAR2,
                    TRUNC (SYSDATE),           --v_ref_date              DATE,
                    'PROPOSAL CANCELLATION - ' || v_prop_no,
                    --v_narrative             VARCHAR2,
                    v_amount,                --v_amount                NUMBER,
                    v_payee,               --v_payee                 VARCHAR2,
                    NVL (v_pay_method, 'CHQ'), --v_pay_method            VARCHAR2, --CHQ, EFT
                    v_payee_bank_acc_no, --v_payee_bank_acc_no        VARCHAR2,
                    v_bbr_code,           --v_payee_bank_branch_code   NUMBER,
                    v_user_name,           --v_source_auth_by        VARCHAR2,
                    TRUNC (SYSDATE),           --v_source_auth_dt        DATE,
                    v_done_by,           --v_raise_by                VARCHAR2,
                    'POL_REF',             --v_pmt_type              VARCHAR2,
                    v_brh_code,              --v_branch_code           NUMBER,
                    v_pol_code,                                  --v_pol_code,
                    v_chq_dtls_rec,                             --v_dtls_table
                    NULL,
                    NULL,
                    v_trans_no,
                    NULL,
                    NULL,
                    v_mpt_code,
                    v_clnt_id_passport_no,
                    v_id_type);
            --v_dtls_table  IN OUT    Fms_Cheques_Pkg.Type_rqn_dtls_table)
            --create GL voucher
            END IF;

            -- RAISE_ERROR('AM HERE=======');
            interface_update_vgl (v_trans_code,     --v_trans_code     NUMBER,
                                  v_user_name, --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                                  v_pol_code,    --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                                  TRUNC (SYSDATE), --v_date              DATE,
                                  NULL,          --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                                  NULL,          --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                                  'PROPOSAL CANCELLATION ',
                                  --v_btc_description   VARCHAR2,
                                  'JV',     --v_btc_type             VARCHAR2,
                                  v_brh_code,    --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                                  'PROPOSAL REFUND : ' || v_prop_no,
                                  --v_description       VARCHAR2,
                                  v_vchr_no,  --v_ref_no             VARCHAR2,
                                  v_gl_trans);
        --v_gl_trans  IN OUT  Fms_Vouchers_Pkg.Tgl_rec_type,
        END IF;
    EXCEPTION
        WHEN OTHERS
        THEN                                       --Error processing refund..
            raise_error ('Prop.Refund...');
    END proc_proposal_ref;

    PROCEDURE process_pol_refund (
        v_pol_code         NUMBER,
        v_amount           NUMBER,
        v_commission_amt   NUMBER,
        v_med_amt          NUMBER DEFAULT 0,
        v_pens_tax         NUMBER DEFAULT 0,
        v_narrative        VARCHAR2,
        v_ref              VARCHAR2,
        v_pay_method       VARCHAR2 DEFAULT 'CHQ',
        v_voucher_no       VARCHAR2 DEFAULT NULL,
        v_stamp_duty       NUMBER DEFAULT 0,
        v_endr_code        NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
        v_client_contr     NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
        v_company_contr    NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
        v_loan_amt         NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
        v_processing_fee   NUMBER DEFAULT NULL
    )
    IS
        v_brh_code                  NUMBER;
        v_bct_brh_code              NUMBER;
        v_trnt_code                 VARCHAR2 (10);
        v_trnt_gl_code              VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_trnt_contra_gl_code       VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_count                     NUMBER := 0;
        v_org_code                  NUMBER;
        v_payee                     VARCHAR2 (100);
        v_ref2                      VARCHAR2 (50);
        v_chq_dtls_rec              fms_cheques_pkg.type_rqn_dtls_table;
        v_trnt_type                 VARCHAR2 (10);
        v_prod_code                 NUMBER;
        v_net_amt                   NUMBER;
        v_vgl_no                    NUMBER;
        v_pol_number                VARCHAR2 (30);
        v_pay_mthd                  VARCHAR2 (10);
        v_penalty_amt               NUMBER;
        v_bo_spread_amt             NUMBER;
        v_gl_trans                  fms_vouchers_pkg.tgl_rec_type;
        v_trans_code                NUMBER;
        v_ppv_raise_by              VARCHAR2 (30)
            := pkg_global_vars.get_pvarchar2 ('PKG_GLOBAL_VARS.PVG_USERNAME');
        v_tx_narrative              VARCHAR2 (30);
        v_tx_type                   VARCHAR2 (30);
        v_tax                       NUMBER DEFAULT 0;
        v_to_pol_code               NUMBER;
        v_to_ppr_code               NUMBER;
        v_gl_count                  NUMBER := 0;
        v_proposal_no               VARCHAR2 (50);
        v_oppr_receipt_trans_code   VARCHAR2 (50);
        v_cur_code                  NUMBER;
        v_chkoff_agen_code          NUMBER := NULL;
        v_chkoff_rate               NUMBER := NULL;
        v_ann_chk                   VARCHAR2 (10);
        v_pol_type                  VARCHAR2 (10);
        v_rct_code                  VARCHAR2 (50);
        v_rct_branch_to             NUMBER;
        v_oppr_code                 NUMBER;
        v_pay_method_code           NUMBER;
        v_admin_amt                 NUMBER;
        v_adcost_param              VARCHAR2 (50);
        v_agn_code                  NUMBER;
        v_endr_type                 VARCHAR2 (5);
        v_cancl_type                VARCHAR2 (5);
        v_endr_effective_date       DATE;
        v_ded_med_to_agn            VARCHAR2 (5) := 'N';
        v_ded_stampdty_to_agn       VARCHAR2 (5) := 'N';
        v_ded_adminc_to_agn         VARCHAR2 (5) := 'N';
        v_tot_dedctions             NUMBER;
        v_bbr_code                  NUMBER;
        v_payee_bank_acc_no         VARCHAR2 (50);
        v_prepared_by               lms_policy_endorsements.endr_prepared_by%TYPE;
        v_renewal                   VARCHAR2 (5);
        v_gross_amt                 NUMBER := v_amount;
        v_but_pay_amt               NUMBER;
        v_med_amt1                  NUMBER := v_med_amt;
        v_pens_tax1                 NUMBER := v_pens_tax;
        v_penalty_amt1              NUMBER := v_penalty_amt;
        v_loan_amt1                 NUMBER := v_loan_amt;
        v_bo_spread_amt1            NUMBER := v_bo_spread_amt;
        v_client_contr1             NUMBER := v_client_contr;
        v_company_contr1            NUMBER := v_company_contr;
        v_stamp_duty1               NUMBER := v_stamp_duty;
        v_ded_chkcomm_to_agn        VARCHAR2 (1) := 'N';
        v_refund_chk_chrg           VARCHAR2 (1) := 'N';
        v_clnt_mob_no               lms_pol_payment_vouchers.ppv_clnt_mob_no%TYPE;
        v_mpt_code                  lms_pol_payment_vouchers.ppv_mpt_code%TYPE;
        v_clnt_id_passport_no       lms_pol_payment_vouchers.ppv_clnt_id_passport_no%TYPE;
        v_id_type                   VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_to_prem                   VARCHAR2 (1);
        v_trans_no                  NUMBER;
        v_opr_code                  NUMBER;
        v_policy_no                 VARCHAR2 (200);
        v_rct_code1                 VARCHAR2 (100);
        v_opr_receipt_trans_code    VARCHAR2 (100);
        v_act_code                  NUMBER;
        v_bal_amt                   NUMBER;
        v_pmt_type                  VARCHAR2 (10);
        v_processing_brn_code       NUMBER;
        v_processing_fee1           NUMBER := v_processing_fee;
        v_refund_from_receipts      VARCHAR2 (5);
        v_drcr                      VARCHAR2 (1);
        v_tot_rct_amt               NUMBER;
        v_phcf_ded_amt              NUMBER;
        v_pol_fee_ded_amt           NUMBER;
        v_ded_phcf_to_agn           VARCHAR2 (5);
        v_ded_pfee_to_agn           VARCHAR2 (5);

        CURSOR c_tax IS
            SELECT pptx_tt_code,
                   pptx_tax_amt,
                   tt_sht_desc,
                   tt_desc
              FROM lms_pol_pension_taxes,
                   lms_pol_ord_pension_dtls,
                   lms_tax_types
             WHERE     pptx_popns_code = popns_code
                   AND popns_pol_code = v_pol_code
                   AND pptx_endr_code = v_endr_code
                   AND pptx_tt_code = tt_code;

        CURSOR endr_constr (
            v_endr_type        VARCHAR2,
            v_cancl_type       VARCHAR2,
            v_trans_eff_date   DATE
        )
        IS
            SELECT lep_allow_trans,
                   lep_ded_rate,
                   lep_ded_rate_div,
                   lep_apply_to,
                   lpi_type,
                   lpi_name,
                   (NVL (lep_ded_rate, 0) / NVL (lep_ded_rate_div, 1))    rate
              FROM lms_endr_provisions, lms_provision_items, lms_endorsements
             WHERE     lep_len_code = len_code
                   AND lep_lpi_code = lpi_code
                   AND len_type = v_endr_type
                   AND len_sub_type = v_cancl_type
                   AND NVL (v_trans_eff_date, SYSDATE) BETWEEN lep_wef
                                                           AND NVL (
                                                                   lep_wet,
                                                                   NVL (
                                                                       v_trans_eff_date,
                                                                       SYSDATE));

        CURSOR rcpt_dtls IS
            SELECT lcad_sht_desc,
                   lcad_amt,
                   lcad_prem_item,
                   lcad_apply_on,
                   lcad_drcr
              FROM lms_cancellation_amt_dtls
             WHERE     lcad_endr_code = v_endr_code
                   AND lcad_trans_no = v_trans_no
                   AND lcad_prem_item = 'Y'
                   AND NVL (lcad_sht_desc, 'X') NOT IN
                           ('CHKOFF_COMM', 'TOT_RCPT_AMT');
    BEGIN
        --      BEGIN
        --         lms_ord_misc.system_param_val ('RECOVER_ADMINCOSTS_FROM_AGENT',
        --                                        v_adcost_param
        --                                       );
        --      EXCEPTION
        --         WHEN OTHERS
        --         THEN
        ---   raise_error ('v_amount..'||v_amount);
        --      END;
        BEGIN
            lms_ord_misc.system_param_val ('REFUND_CHK_OFF_COMM_CHRG',
                                           v_refund_chk_chrg);
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                raise_error ('Param Error... REFUND_CHK_OFF_COMM_CHRG');
        END;

        SELECT pol_bra_code,
               endr_payee,
               DECODE (pol_type, 'PR', pol_proposal_no, pol_policy_no),
               pol_prod_code,
               endr_pay_method,
               endr_to_pol_code,
               endr_to_prp_code,
               'CANC' || pol_policy_no,
               endr_checkoff_agen_code,
               endr_checkoff_rate,
               endr_agen_code,
               endr_type,
               endr_cancellation_type,
               endr_effective_date,
               endr_prepared_by,
               lms_ord_mis.check_renewal_paymnt (pol_code,
                                                 endr_effective_date),
               endr_pw_to_premium,
               endr_ltr_trans_no,
               endr_pol_policy_no,
               'PARTIAL_WITH' || pol_policy_no,
               agn_act_code
          INTO v_brh_code,
               v_payee,
               v_pol_number,
               v_prod_code,
               v_pay_mthd,
               v_to_pol_code,
               v_to_ppr_code,
               v_rct_code,
               v_chkoff_agen_code,
               v_chkoff_rate,
               v_agn_code,
               v_endr_type,
               v_cancl_type,
               v_endr_effective_date,
               v_prepared_by,
               v_renewal,
               v_to_prem,
               v_trans_no,
               v_policy_no,
               v_rct_code1,
               v_act_code
          FROM lms_policies,
               lms_proposers,
               lms_policy_endorsements,
               lms_agencies
         WHERE     pol_code = endr_pol_code
               AND prp_code = pol_prp_code
               AND endr_agen_code = agn_code
               AND pol_code = v_pol_code
               AND endr_type = 'CN'
               AND endr_status = 'D';


        BEGIN
            lms_ord_misc.system_param_val ('REFUND_FROM_RECEIPT_AT_POL_CANC',
                                           v_refund_from_receipts,
                                           v_prod_code);
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                raise_error ('Param Error...');
        END;

        SELECT    TO_NUMBER (TO_CHAR (SYSDATE, 'RRRR'))
               || lms_transaction_seq.NEXTVAL
          INTO v_trans_code
          FROM DUAL;

        BEGIN
            SELECT pcl_but_pay_amt, pcl_processing_brn_code
              INTO v_but_pay_amt, v_processing_brn_code
              FROM lms_pol_canc_log
             WHERE pcl_endr_code = v_endr_code;
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                v_but_pay_amt := 0;
        END;

        v_brh_code := NVL(v_processing_brn_code, v_brh_code);

        IF v_voucher_no IS NOT NULL
        THEN
            SELECT ppv_penalty_amt,
                   ppv_bo_spread_amt,
                   ppv_raise_by,
                   NVL (ppv_bbr_code, lms_api.bnk_bbr_code (ppv_pol_code)),
                   ppv_payee_bank_acc_no
              INTO v_penalty_amt,
                   v_bo_spread_amt,
                   v_ppv_raise_by,
                   v_bbr_code,
                   v_payee_bank_acc_no
              FROM lms_pol_payment_vouchers
             WHERE ppv_voucher_no = v_voucher_no;

            BEGIN
                SELECT NVL (ppvd_amount, 0)
                  INTO v_admin_amt
                  FROM lms_pol_payment_voucher_dtls
                 WHERE     ppvd_narrative = 'ADMIN. CHARGE'
                       AND ppvd_ppv_voucher_no = v_voucher_no;
            EXCEPTION
                WHEN OTHERS
                THEN
                    v_admin_amt := 0;
            END;

            IF NVL (v_pay_method, 'CHQ') = 'MFT'
            THEN
                SELECT ppv_clnt_mob_no,
                       ppv_mpt_code,
                       ppv_clnt_id_passport_no,
                       DECODE (ppv_identity_type,
                               'I', 'NATIONAL ID',
                               'P', 'PASSPORT')
                  INTO v_clnt_mob_no,
                       v_mpt_code,
                       v_clnt_id_passport_no,
                       v_id_type
                  FROM lms_pol_payment_vouchers
                 WHERE ppv_voucher_no = v_voucher_no;
            END IF;
        END IF;

        v_penalty_amt1 := v_penalty_amt;

        --               v_phcf_ded_amt := 0;
        --               v_pol_fee_ded_amt := 0;
        BEGIN
            SELECT NVL (pcl_phcf_ded_amt, 0), NVL (pcl_pol_fee_ded_amt, 0)
              INTO v_phcf_ded_amt, v_pol_fee_ded_amt
              FROM lms_pol_canc_log
             WHERE pcl_endr_code = v_endr_code;
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                v_phcf_ded_amt := 0;
                v_pol_fee_ded_amt := 0;
        END;

        IF NVL (v_refund_chk_chrg, 'N') = 'Y'
        THEN
            v_tot_dedctions :=
                  NVL (v_med_amt, 0)
                + NVL (v_pens_tax, 0)
                + NVL (v_penalty_amt, 0)
                + NVL (v_stamp_duty, 0)
                + NVL (v_admin_amt, 0)
                + NVL (v_loan_amt, 0)
                + NVL (v_processing_fee, 0)
                + NVL (v_phcf_ded_amt, 0)
                + NVL (v_pol_fee_ded_amt, 0);
        ELSE
            v_tot_dedctions :=
                  NVL (v_commission_amt, 0)
                + NVL (v_med_amt, 0)
                + NVL (v_pens_tax, 0)
                + NVL (v_penalty_amt, 0)
                + NVL (v_stamp_duty, 0)
                + NVL (v_admin_amt, 0)
                + NVL (v_loan_amt, 0)
                + NVL (v_processing_fee, 0)
                + NVL (v_phcf_ded_amt, 0)
                + NVL (v_pol_fee_ded_amt, 0);
        END IF;

        ------------------------------------------------------------------------
        v_penalty_amt1 := v_penalty_amt;

        -------------------------------------------------------------------------
        FOR pr
            IN endr_constr (v_endr_type, v_cancl_type, v_endr_effective_date)
        LOOP
            IF pr.lep_apply_to = 'AG' AND v_agn_code IS NOT NULL
            THEN
                IF pr.lpi_type = 'MED'
                THEN
                    BEGIN
                        lms_process_receipts.cancelchargesclwbk (v_pol_code,
                                                                 v_amount,
                                                                 v_med_amt,
                                                                 0,
                                                                 0);
                    EXCEPTION
                        WHEN OTHERS
                        THEN
                            raise_error (
                                'Unable to debit the agent with medical cost.');
                    END;

                    v_ded_med_to_agn := 'Y';
                    v_tot_dedctions :=
                        NVL (v_tot_dedctions, 0) - NVL (v_med_amt, 0);
                ELSIF pr.lpi_type = 'STMDTY'
                THEN
                    BEGIN
                        lms_process_receipts.cancelchargesclwbk (
                            v_pol_code,
                            v_amount,
                            0,
                            0,
                            v_stamp_duty);
                    EXCEPTION
                        WHEN OTHERS
                        THEN
                            raise_error (
                                'Unable to debit the agent with stamp duty cost.');
                    END;

                    v_ded_stampdty_to_agn := 'Y';
                    v_tot_dedctions :=
                        NVL (v_tot_dedctions, 0) - NVL (v_stamp_duty, 0);
                ELSIF pr.lpi_type = 'ADMCHRG'
                THEN
                    BEGIN
                        lms_process_receipts.cancelchargesclwbk (v_pol_code,
                                                                 v_amount,
                                                                 0,
                                                                 v_admin_amt,
                                                                 0);
                    EXCEPTION
                        WHEN OTHERS
                        THEN
                            raise_error (
                                'Unable to debit the agent with administrative cost.');
                    END;

                    v_ded_adminc_to_agn := 'Y';
                    v_tot_dedctions :=
                        NVL (v_tot_dedctions, 0) - NVL (v_admin_amt, 0);
                ELSIF pr.lpi_type = 'PHCF'
                THEN
                    BEGIN
                        lms_process_receipts.cancelchargesclwbk (
                            v_pol_code,
                            v_amount,
                            0,
                            0,
                            0,
                            0,
                            0,
                            'REFUND_PHCF_CLWBK',            --v_misc_narrative
                            v_phcf_ded_amt                        --v_misc_amt
                                          );
                    EXCEPTION
                        WHEN OTHERS
                        THEN
                            raise_error (
                                'Unable to debit the agent with PHCF cost.');
                    END;

                    v_ded_phcf_to_agn := 'Y';
                    v_tot_dedctions :=
                        NVL (v_tot_dedctions, 0) - NVL (v_phcf_ded_amt, 0);
                ELSIF pr.lpi_type = 'POLFEE'
                THEN
                    BEGIN
                        lms_process_receipts.cancelchargesclwbk (
                            v_pol_code,
                            v_amount,
                            0,
                            0,
                            0,
                            0,
                            0,
                            'REFUND_POL_FEE_CLWBK',         --v_misc_narrative
                            v_pol_fee_ded_amt                     --v_misc_amt
                                             );
                    EXCEPTION
                        WHEN OTHERS
                        THEN
                            raise_error (
                                'Unable to debit the agent with POLFEE cost.');
                    END;

                    v_ded_pfee_to_agn := 'Y';
                    v_tot_dedctions :=
                        NVL (v_tot_dedctions, 0) - NVL (v_pol_fee_ded_amt, 0);
                ELSIF pr.lpi_type = 'CHKCOM'
                THEN
                    BEGIN
                        lms_process_receipts.cancelchargesclwbk (
                            v_pol_code,
                            v_amount,
                            0,
                            0,
                            0,
                            v_commission_amt);
                    EXCEPTION
                        WHEN OTHERS
                        THEN
                            raise_error (
                                'Unable to debit the agent with Check-off Commission Costs..');
                    END;

                    v_ded_chkcomm_to_agn := 'Y';
                    v_tot_dedctions :=
                        NVL (v_tot_dedctions, 0) - NVL (v_commission_amt, 0);
                END IF;
            ELSIF pr.lep_apply_to = 'CO' AND v_chkoff_agen_code IS NOT NULL
            THEN
                v_ded_chkcomm_to_agn := 'N';
                v_tot_dedctions :=
                    NVL (v_tot_dedctions, 0) - NVL (v_commission_amt, 0);
            ELSIF pr.lep_apply_to = 'CL'
            THEN
                IF pr.lpi_type = 'PHCF'
                THEN
                    v_tot_dedctions :=
                        NVL (v_tot_dedctions, 0) - NVL (v_phcf_ded_amt, 0);
                ELSIF pr.lpi_type = 'POLFEE'
                THEN
                    v_tot_dedctions :=
                        NVL (v_tot_dedctions, 0) - NVL (v_pol_fee_ded_amt, 0);
                END IF;
            END IF;
        END LOOP;

        v_net_amt := NVL (v_amount, 0) - NVL (v_tot_dedctions, 0);

        --raise_error('v_ded_chkcomm_to_agn = '||v_ded_chkcomm_to_agn||'; v_net_amt = '||v_net_amt);
        IF NVL (v_but_pay_amt, 0) != 0
        THEN
            IF (NVL (v_but_pay_amt, 0) - NVL (v_net_amt, 0)) <= 0
            THEN
                v_gross_amt := NVL (v_but_pay_amt, 0);

                IF     NVL (v_med_amt1, 0) != 0
                   AND NVL (v_ded_med_to_agn, 'N') <> 'Y'
                THEN
                    v_med_amt1 := 0;
                END IF;

                IF     NVL (v_admin_amt, 0) != 0
                   AND NVL (v_ded_adminc_to_agn, 'N') <> 'Y'
                THEN
                    v_admin_amt := 0;
                END IF;

                IF     NVL (v_phcf_ded_amt, 0) != 0
                   AND NVL (v_ded_phcf_to_agn, 'N') <> 'Y'
                THEN
                    v_phcf_ded_amt := 0;
                END IF;

                IF     NVL (v_pol_fee_ded_amt, 0) != 0
                   AND NVL (v_ded_pfee_to_agn, 'N') <> 'Y'
                THEN
                    v_pol_fee_ded_amt := 0;
                END IF;

                v_pens_tax1 := 0;

                IF     NVL (v_stamp_duty1, 0) != 0
                   AND NVL (v_ded_stampdty_to_agn, 'N') <> 'Y'
                THEN
                    v_stamp_duty1 := 0;
                END IF;

                v_penalty_amt1 := 0;
                v_loan_amt1 := 0;
                v_bo_spread_amt1 := 0;
                v_client_contr1 := 0;
                v_company_contr1 := 0;
                v_processing_fee1 := 0;
            ELSE
                v_gross_amt :=
                      v_gross_amt
                    + (NVL (v_but_pay_amt, 0) - NVL (v_net_amt, 0));
            END IF;

            v_net_amt := v_but_pay_amt;
        END IF;

        v_org_code := fms_interfaces_pkg.get_org (v_brh_code);

        IF v_payee IS NULL
        THEN
            raise_error ('PAYEE IS NULL...');
        END IF;

        IF NVL (v_refund_from_receipts, 'N') = 'Y'
        THEN
            FOR r IN rcpt_dtls
            LOOP
                IF r.lcad_sht_desc = 'PREMIUM'
                THEN
                    get_gl_code ('UP',
                                 v_prod_code,
                                 v_trnt_code,
                                 v_trnt_gl_code,
                                 v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                 NULL,
                                 v_renewal);
                    valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                               v_org_code,
                               v_brh_code,
                               'UP');
                ELSIF r.lcad_sht_desc = 'UNPROCESSED_AMT'
                THEN
                    get_gl_code ('UNP_PR',
                                 v_prod_code,
                                 v_trnt_code,
                                 v_trnt_gl_code,
                                 v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                 NULL,
                                 v_renewal);
                    valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                               v_org_code,
                               v_brh_code,
                               'UNP_PR');
                ELSIF r.lcad_sht_desc = 'POLICY_FEE'
                THEN
                    get_gl_code ('INVFEE',
                                 v_prod_code,
                                 v_trnt_code,
                                 v_trnt_gl_code,
                                 v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                 NULL,
                                 v_renewal);
                    valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                               v_org_code,
                               v_brh_code,
                               'INVFEE');
                ELSIF r.lcad_sht_desc = 'INVESTMENT_CONTRI'
                THEN
                    get_gl_code ('INVPREM',
                                 v_prod_code,
                                 v_trnt_code,
                                 v_trnt_gl_code,
                                 v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                 NULL,
                                 v_renewal);
                    valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                               v_org_code,
                               v_brh_code,
                               'INVPREM');
                ELSIF r.lcad_sht_desc = 'INVESTMENT_ADMIN'
                THEN
                    get_gl_code ('INVADM',
                                 v_prod_code,
                                 v_trnt_code,
                                 v_trnt_gl_code,
                                 v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                 NULL,
                                 v_renewal);
                    valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                               v_org_code,
                               v_brh_code,
                               'INVADM');
                ELSIF r.lcad_sht_desc = 'PHCF'
                THEN
                    get_gl_code ('CMPFND',
                                 v_prod_code,
                                 v_trnt_code,
                                 v_trnt_gl_code,
                                 v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                 NULL,
                                 v_renewal);
                    valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                               v_org_code,
                               v_brh_code,
                               'CMPFND');
                ELSE
                    raise_error (
                        r.lcad_sht_desc || ' has not been handled..');
                END IF;

                IF NVL (r.lcad_amt, 0) > 0
                THEN
                    v_drcr := r.lcad_drcr;
                ELSE
                    SELECT DECODE (r.lcad_drcr, 'D', 'C', 'D')
                      INTO v_drcr
                      FROM DUAL;
                END IF;

                v_gl_count := v_gl_count + 1;
                interface_append_gl (v_trans_code, --v_trans_code         NUMBER,
                                     v_ppv_raise_by, --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                                     v_pol_code, --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                                     v_prod_code, --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                                     v_voucher_no, --v_vchr_no            VARCHAR2,
                                     NULL,       --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                                     NULL,       --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                                     NULL,    --v_rcpt_no            VARCHAR2,
                                     v_gl_count, --v_count             NUMBER,
                                     r.lcad_sht_desc, --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                                     NVL (r.lcad_amt, 0), --v_amount            NUMBER,
                                     v_drcr,   --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                                     v_trnt_gl_code, --v_acc_number          VARCHAR2,
                                     v_brh_code, --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                                     v_gl_trans,
                                     --v_trn_rec   IN OUT Fms_Vouchers_Pkg.Tgl_rec_type,
                                     NULL,
                                     NULL,
                                     NULL,
                                     NULL,
                                     NULL);
                v_tot_rct_amt := NVL (v_tot_rct_amt, 0) + NVL (r.lcad_amt, 0);
            END LOOP;

            IF v_tot_rct_amt <> 0
            THEN
                get_gl_code ('PLREF',
                             v_prod_code,
                             v_trnt_code,
                             v_trnt_gl_code,
                             v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                             NULL,
                             v_renewal);
                valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                           v_org_code,
                           v_brh_code,
                           'PLREF');
                v_gl_count := v_gl_count + 1;
                interface_append_gl (v_trans_code, --v_trans_code         NUMBER,
                                     v_ppv_raise_by, --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                                     v_pol_code, --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                                     v_prod_code, --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                                     v_voucher_no, --v_vchr_no            VARCHAR2,
                                     NULL,       --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                                     NULL,       --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                                     NULL,    --v_rcpt_no            VARCHAR2,
                                     v_gl_count, --v_count             NUMBER,
                                     'TOTAL REFUNDABLE RECEIPT AMT', --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                                     NVL (v_tot_rct_amt, 0), --v_amount            NUMBER,
                                     'C',      --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                                     v_trnt_gl_code, --v_acc_number          VARCHAR2,
                                     v_brh_code, --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                                     v_gl_trans, --v_trn_rec   IN OUT Fms_Vouchers_Pkg.Tgl_rec_type,
                                     NULL,
                                     NULL,
                                     NULL,
                                     NULL,
                                     NULL);
            END IF;
        END IF;

        IF NVL (v_net_amt, 0) > 0
        THEN
            IF NVL (v_gross_amt, 0) != 0
            THEN
                IF    v_to_pol_code IS NOT NULL
                   OR v_to_ppr_code IS NOT NULL
                   OR v_to_prem = 'Y'
                THEN
                    v_pay_method_code := pay_method_code ('VOUCHER');

                    IF NVL (v_to_prem, 'N') <> 'Y'
                    THEN
                        BEGIN
                            SELECT pol_proposal_no, pol_bra_code
                              INTO v_proposal_no, v_rct_branch_to
                              FROM lms_policies
                             WHERE pol_code = v_to_pol_code;
                        EXCEPTION
                            WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND
                            THEN
                                BEGIN
                                    SELECT ppr_proposal_no, ppr_brn_code
                                      INTO v_proposal_no, v_rct_branch_to
                                      FROM lms_pol_proposals
                                     WHERE ppr_code = v_to_ppr_code;
                                EXCEPTION
                                    WHEN OTHERS
                                    THEN
                                        raise_error (
                                            'Proposal to alloc. funds to not found.....');
                                END;
                        END;

                        BEGIN
                            SELECT    TO_NUMBER (TO_CHAR (SYSDATE, 'RRRR'))
                                   || lms_oppr_code_seq.NEXTVAL
                              INTO v_oppr_code
                              FROM DUAL;

                            SELECT    v_rct_code
                                   || '/'
                                   || lms_oppr_receipt_trans_seq.NEXTVAL
                              INTO v_oppr_receipt_trans_code
                              FROM DUAL;

                            v_cur_code :=
                                lms_interfaces_pkg.lms_def_cur (
                                    v_rct_branch_to);
                            v_ann_chk :=
                                NVL (annuity_check (v_to_pol_code, NULL),
                                     'N');

                            INSERT INTO lms_ord_proposal_rcpts (
                                            oppr_code,
                                            oppr_ltr_trans_no,
                                            oppr_date,
                                            oppr_cheque_no,
                                            oppr_amt,
                                            oppr_pol_code,
                                            oppr_pol_proposal_no,
                                            oppr_receipt_no,
                                            oppr_receipt_date,
                                            oppr_pmth_code,
                                            opr_chk_agen_code,
                                            opri_chk_comm_rate,
                                            opri_chk_comm_amt,
                                            oppr_done_by,
                                            oppr_drcr,
                                            oppr_receipt_trans_code,
                                            oppr_ann_code,
                                            oppr_fms_receipt_pk,
                                            oppr_from_pol_code,
                                            oppr_ppv_voucher_no)
                                     VALUES (
                                         v_oppr_code,
                                         NULL,
                                         TRUNC (SYSDATE),
                                         NULL,
                                         v_net_amt,
                                         DECODE (v_ann_chk,
                                                 'Y', NULL,
                                                 v_to_pol_code),
                                         v_proposal_no,
                                         --v_recpt_rec(i).POL_POLICY_NO,
                                         'CANCELLED_POL',
                                         TRUNC (SYSDATE),
                                         v_pay_method_code,
                                         v_chkoff_agen_code,
                                         v_chkoff_rate,
                                         ROUND (
                                               NVL (v_chkoff_rate, 0)
                                             / 100
                                             * v_net_amt),
                                         v_ppv_raise_by,
                                         DECODE (SIGN (v_net_amt),
                                                 1, 'C',
                                                 'D'),
                                         v_oppr_receipt_trans_code,
                                         DECODE (v_ann_chk,
                                                 'Y', v_to_pol_code,
                                                 NULL),
                                         NULL,
                                         v_pol_code,
                                         v_voucher_no);
                        EXCEPTION
                            WHEN OTHERS
                            THEN
                                raise_error (
                                    'Error creating proposal receipt.....');
                        END;
                    ELSE
                        BEGIN
                            SELECT    TO_NUMBER (TO_CHAR (SYSDATE, 'RRRR'))
                                   || lms_opr_code_seq.NEXTVAL
                              INTO v_opr_code
                              FROM DUAL;

                            SELECT    v_rct_code1
                                   || '/'
                                   || lms_opr_receipt_trans_seq.NEXTVAL
                              INTO v_opr_receipt_trans_code
                              FROM DUAL;

                            v_pay_method_code := pay_method_code ('VOUCHER');

                            INSERT INTO lms_ord_prem_receipts (
                                            opr_code,
                                            opr_ltr_trans_no,
                                            opr_date,
                                            opr_cheque_no,
                                            opr_amt,
                                            opr_pol_code,
                                            opr_pol_policy_no,
                                            opr_receipt_no,
                                            opr_receipt_date,
                                            opr_pmth_code,
                                            opr_done_by,
                                            opr_drcr,
                                            opr_source,
                                            opr_receipt_trans_code,
                                            opr_fms_receipt_pk,
                                            opr_origin,
                                            opr_alloc_to,
                                            opr_capital_injectn,
                                            opr_chk_comm,
                                            opr_chk_comm_rate)
                                 VALUES (v_opr_code,
                                         v_trans_no,
                                         TRUNC (SYSDATE),
                                         'PARTIAL WITHDRAWAL',
                                         NVL (v_net_amt, 0),
                                         v_pol_code,
                                         v_policy_no,
                                         v_rct_code1,
                                         TRUNC (SYSDATE),
                                         v_pay_method_code,
                                         v_ppv_raise_by,
                                         'C',
                                         v_rct_code1,
                                         v_opr_receipt_trans_code,
                                         NULL,
                                         'I',
                                         'PR',
                                         'N',
                                         NULL,
                                         NULL);
                        EXCEPTION
                            WHEN OTHERS
                            THEN
                                raise_error ('PREM RCPT DTLS...');
                        END;

                        BEGIN
                            lms_process_receipts.lms_ord_premium_receipts (
                                v_pol_code,
                                v_opr_code,
                                'Y',
                                'N',
                                v_trans_no,
                                v_act_code,
                                v_bal_amt,
                                'N',
                                v_endr_code);
                        EXCEPTION
                            WHEN OTHERS
                            THEN
                                raise_application_error (
                                    -20001,
                                    'Processing premium insts..2..');
                        END;
                    END IF;

                    IF v_cancl_type = 'PW'
                    THEN
                        get_gl_code ('PW',
                                     v_prod_code,
                                     v_trnt_code,
                                     v_trnt_gl_code,
                                     v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                     NULL,
                                     v_renewal);
                        valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                                   v_org_code,
                                   v_brh_code,
                                   'PW');
                    ELSE
                        get_gl_code ('PLREF',
                                     v_prod_code,
                                     v_trnt_code,
                                     v_trnt_gl_code,
                                     v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                     NULL,
                                     v_renewal);
                        valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                                   v_org_code,
                                   v_brh_code,
                                   'PLREF');
                    END IF;

                    v_gl_count := v_gl_count + 1;
                    interface_append_gl (
                        v_trans_code,
                        --v_trans_code         NUMBER,
                        v_ppv_raise_by,
                        --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                        v_pol_code,              --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                        v_prod_code,             --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                        v_voucher_no,
                        --v_vchr_no            VARCHAR2,
                        NULL,                    --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                        NULL,                    --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                        NULL,                 --v_rcpt_no            VARCHAR2,
                        v_gl_count,              --v_count             NUMBER,
                        v_narrative || 'TO PROP ' || v_proposal_no,
                        --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                        NVL (v_gross_amt, 0) + NVL (v_bo_spread_amt, 0),
                        --v_amount            NUMBER,
                        'D',                   --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                        v_trnt_gl_code,
                        --v_acc_number          VARCHAR2,
                        v_brh_code,              --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                        v_gl_trans,
                        --v_trn_rec   IN OUT Fms_Vouchers_Pkg.Tgl_rec_type,
                        NULL,
                        NULL,
                        NULL,
                        NULL,
                        v_oppr_code);

                    IF NVL (v_to_prem, 'N') = 'Y'
                    THEN
                        get_gl_code ('UP',
                                     v_prod_code,
                                     v_trnt_code,
                                     v_trnt_gl_code,
                                     v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                     NULL,
                                     v_renewal);
                        valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                                   v_org_code,
                                   v_brh_code,
                                   'UP');
                    ELSE
                        get_gl_code ('PRRCT',
                                     v_prod_code,
                                     v_trnt_code,
                                     v_trnt_gl_code,
                                     v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                     NULL,
                                     v_renewal);
                        valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                                   v_org_code,
                                   v_brh_code,
                                   'PRRCT');
                    END IF;

                    v_gl_count := v_gl_count + 1;
                    interface_append_gl (
                        v_trans_code,
                        --v_trans_code         NUMBER,
                        v_ppv_raise_by,
                        --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                        v_pol_code,              --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                        v_prod_code,             --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                        v_voucher_no,
                        --v_vchr_no            VARCHAR2,
                        NULL,                    --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                        NULL,                    --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                        NULL,                 --v_rcpt_no            VARCHAR2,
                        v_gl_count,              --v_count             NUMBER,
                        v_narrative || 'TO PROP ' || v_proposal_no,
                        --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                        NVL (v_net_amt, 0),
                        --v_amount            NUMBER,
                        'C',                   --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                        v_trnt_gl_code,
                        --v_acc_number          VARCHAR2,
                        v_brh_code,              --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                        v_gl_trans,
                        --v_trn_rec   IN OUT Fms_Vouchers_Pkg.Tgl_rec_type,
                        NULL,
                        NULL,
                        NULL,
                        NULL,
                        v_oppr_code);

                    --raise_error('v_ded_chkcomm_to_agn: '||v_ded_chkcomm_to_agn||'; v_refund_chk_chrg: '||v_refund_chk_chrg||'; v_commission_amt: '||v_commission_amt);
                    IF     NVL (v_commission_amt, 0) != 0
                       AND NVL (v_ded_chkcomm_to_agn, 'N') <> 'Y'
                       AND v_refund_chk_chrg <> 'Y'
                    THEN
                        get_gl_code ('CHKC',
                                     v_prod_code,
                                     v_trnt_code,
                                     v_trnt_gl_code,
                                     v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                     NULL,
                                     v_renewal);
                        valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                                   v_org_code,
                                   v_brh_code,
                                   'CHKC');
                        v_gl_count := v_gl_count + 1;
                        interface_append_gl (
                            v_trans_code,
                            --v_trans_code         NUMBER,
                            v_ppv_raise_by,
                            --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                            v_pol_code,
                            --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                            v_prod_code,
                            --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                            v_voucher_no,
                            --v_vchr_no            VARCHAR2,
                            NULL,                --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                            NULL,                --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                            NULL,             --v_rcpt_no            VARCHAR2,
                            v_gl_count,
                            --v_count             NUMBER,
                            'COMMISSION RECOVERY - ' || v_pol_number,
                            --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                            NVL (v_commission_amt, 0),
                            --v_amount            NUMBER,
                            'C',               --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                            v_trnt_gl_code,
                            --v_acc_number          VARCHAR2,
                            v_brh_code,
                            --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                            v_gl_trans --v_trn_rec   IN OUT Fms_Vouchers_Pkg.Tgl_rec_type,
                                      );
                    END IF;

                    --Post the check off commission as a clawback to the Company
                    IF     NVL (v_commission_amt, 0) != 0
                       AND v_refund_chk_chrg = 'Y'
                    THEN
                        get_gl_code ('MNGEX',
                                     v_prod_code,
                                     v_trnt_code,
                                     v_trnt_gl_code,
                                     v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                     NULL,
                                     v_renewal);
                        valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                                   v_org_code,
                                   v_brh_code,
                                   'MNGEX');
                        v_gl_count := v_gl_count + 1;
                        interface_append_gl (
                            v_trans_code,
                            --v_trans_code         NUMBER,
                            v_ppv_raise_by,
                            --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                            v_pol_code,
                            --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                            v_prod_code,
                            --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                            v_voucher_no,
                            --v_vchr_no            VARCHAR2,
                            NULL,                --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                            NULL,                --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                            NULL,             --v_rcpt_no            VARCHAR2,
                            v_gl_count,
                            --v_count             NUMBER,
                            'COMMISSION RECOVERY - ' || v_pol_number,
                            --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                            NVL (v_commission_amt, 0),
                            --v_amount            NUMBER,
                            'D',               --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                            v_trnt_gl_code,
                            --v_acc_number          VARCHAR2,
                            v_brh_code,
                            --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                            v_gl_trans --v_trn_rec   IN OUT Fms_Vouchers_Pkg.Tgl_rec_type,
                                      );
                    END IF;

                    IF     NVL (v_med_amt1, 0) != 0
                       AND NVL (v_ded_med_to_agn, 'N') <> 'Y'
                    THEN
                        get_gl_code ('MED',
                                     v_prod_code,
                                     v_trnt_code,
                                     v_trnt_gl_code,
                                     v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                     NULL,
                                     v_renewal);
                        valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                                   v_org_code,
                                   v_brh_code,
                                   'MED');
                        v_gl_count := v_gl_count + 1;
                        interface_append_gl (
                            v_trans_code,
                            --v_trans_code         NUMBER,
                            v_ppv_raise_by,
                            --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                            v_pol_code,
                            --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                            v_prod_code,
                            --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                            v_voucher_no,
                            --v_vchr_no            VARCHAR2,
                            NULL,                --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                            NULL,                --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                            NULL,             --v_rcpt_no            VARCHAR2,
                            v_gl_count,
                            --v_count             NUMBER,
                            'MEDICALS RECOVERY - ' || v_pol_number,
                            --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                            NVL (v_med_amt1, 0),
                            --v_amount            NUMBER,
                            'C',               --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                            v_trnt_gl_code,
                            --v_acc_number          VARCHAR2,
                            v_brh_code,
                            --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                            v_gl_trans --v_trn_rec   IN OUT Fms_Vouchers_Pkg.Tgl_rec_type,
                                      );
                    END IF;

                    IF     NVL (v_admin_amt, 0) != 0
                       AND NVL (v_ded_adminc_to_agn, 'N') <> 'Y'
                    THEN
                        get_gl_code ('ADMN_AMT',
                                     v_prod_code,
                                     v_trnt_code,
                                     v_trnt_gl_code,
                                     v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                     NULL,
                                     v_renewal);
                        valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                                   v_org_code,
                                   v_brh_code,
                                   'ADMN_AMT');
                        v_gl_count := v_gl_count + 1;
                        interface_append_gl (
                            v_trans_code,
                            --v_trans_code         NUMBER,
                            v_ppv_raise_by,
                            --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                            v_pol_code,
                            --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                            v_prod_code,
                            --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                            v_voucher_no,
                            --v_vchr_no            VARCHAR2,
                            NULL,                --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                            NULL,                --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                            NULL,             --v_rcpt_no            VARCHAR2,
                            v_gl_count,
                            --v_count             NUMBER,
                            'ADMINISTRATION CHARGE - ' || v_pol_number,
                            --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                            NVL (v_admin_amt, 0),
                            --v_amount            NUMBER,
                            'C',               --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                            v_trnt_gl_code,
                            --v_acc_number          VARCHAR2,
                            v_brh_code,
                            --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                            v_gl_trans --v_trn_rec   IN OUT Fms_Vouchers_Pkg.Tgl_rec_type,
                                      );
                    END IF;

                    IF NVL (v_pens_tax1, 0) != 0
                    THEN
                        FOR t IN c_tax
                        LOOP
                            v_tx_type :=
                                get_tax_type (t.tt_sht_desc, v_tx_narrative);

                            IF NVL (t.pptx_tax_amt, 0) > 0
                            THEN
                                v_tax := t.pptx_tax_amt;
                                get_gl_code ('UPTAX',
                                             v_prod_code,
                                             v_trnt_code,
                                             v_trnt_gl_code,
                                             v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                             t.pptx_tt_code,
                                             v_renewal);
                                valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                                           v_org_code,
                                           v_brh_code,
                                           'UPTAX');
                                v_gl_count := v_gl_count + 1;
                                interface_append_gl (
                                    v_trans_code,
                                    --v_trans_code         NUMBER,
                                    v_ppv_raise_by,
                                    --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                                    v_pol_code,
                                    --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                                    v_prod_code,
                                    --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                                    v_voucher_no,
                                    --v_vchr_no            VARCHAR2,
                                    NULL,
                                    --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                                    NULL,
                                    --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                                    NULL,
                                    --v_rcpt_no            VARCHAR2,
                                    v_gl_count,
                                       --v_count             NUMBER,
                                       t.tt_desc
                                    || ' RECOVERY - '
                                    || v_pol_number,
                                    --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                                    NVL (v_tax, 0),
                                    --v_amount            NUMBER,
                                    'C',
                                    --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                                    v_trnt_gl_code,
                                    --v_acc_number          VARCHAR2,

                                     v_renewal);
                        valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                                   v_org_code,
                                   v_brh_code,
                                   'SD');
                        v_count := v_count + 1;
                        interface_append_chq (
                            v_trans_code,
                            v_ppv_raise_by,
                            v_pol_code,
                            v_prod_code,
                            v_voucher_no,
                            v_count,
                            NVL (v_stamp_duty1, 0),
                            'STAMP DUTY RECOVERY - ' || v_pol_number,
                            --v_narrative
                            v_trnt_gl_code,
                            v_org_code,
                            v_brh_code,
                            'C',
                            v_chq_dtls_rec);
                    END IF;

                    IF NVL (v_client_contr1, 0) + NVL (v_company_contr1, 0) <>
                       0
                    THEN
                        --Compensation fund...
                        get_gl_code ('CMPFND',
                                     v_prod_code,                      --NULL,
                                     v_trnt_code,
                                     v_trnt_gl_code,
                                     v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                     NULL,
                                     v_renewal);
                        valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                                   v_org_code,
                                   v_brh_code,
                                   'CMPFND');
                        v_count := v_count + 1;
                        interface_append_chq (
                            v_trans_code,
                            v_ppv_raise_by,
                            v_pol_code,
                            v_prod_code,
                            v_voucher_no,
                            v_count,
                              NVL (v_client_contr1, 0)
                            + NVL (v_company_contr1, 0),
                               'CONSOLIDATED COMPENSATION FUND - '
                            || v_pol_number,
                            --v_narrative
                            v_trnt_gl_code,
                            v_org_code,
                            v_brh_code,
                            'D',
                            v_chq_dtls_rec);
                        --PHCF(company contribution recovery)
                        get_gl_code ('UP',
                                     v_prod_code,                      --NULL,
                                     v_trnt_code,
                                     v_trnt_gl_code,
                                     v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                     NULL,
                                     v_renewal);
                        valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                                   v_org_code,
                                   v_brh_code,
                                   'UP');
                        v_count := v_count + 1;
                        interface_append_chq (
                            v_trans_code,
                            v_ppv_raise_by,
                            v_pol_code,
                            v_prod_code,
                            v_voucher_no,
                            v_count,
                            NVL (v_client_contr1, 0),
                            'COMP. FUND - CLIENT REFUNDS - ' || v_pol_number,
                            --v_narrative
                            v_trnt_gl_code,
                            v_org_code,
                            v_brh_code,
                            'C',
                            v_chq_dtls_rec);
                        --PHCF(company contribution recovery)
                        get_gl_code ('MNGEX',
                                     v_prod_code,                      --NULL,
                                     v_trnt_code,
                                     v_trnt_gl_code,
                                     v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                     NULL,
                                     v_renewal);
                        valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                                   v_org_code,
                                   v_brh_code,
                                   'MNGEX');
                        v_count := v_count + 1;
                        interface_append_chq (
                            v_trans_code,
                            v_ppv_raise_by,
                            v_pol_code,
                            v_prod_code,
                            v_voucher_no,
                            v_count,
                            NVL (v_company_contr1, 0),
                            'COMP. FUND - COMPANY REFUNDS - ' || v_pol_number,
                            --v_narrative
                            v_trnt_gl_code,
                            v_org_code,
                            v_brh_code,
                            'C',
                            v_chq_dtls_rec);
                    END IF;

                    IF NVL (v_penalty_amt1, 0) <> 0
                    THEN
                        get_gl_code ('INVPEN',
                                     v_prod_code,
                                     v_trnt_code,
                                     v_trnt_gl_code,
                                     v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                     NULL,
                                     v_renewal);
                        valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                                   v_org_code,
                                   v_brh_code,
                                   'INVPEN');
                        v_count := v_count + 1;
                        interface_append_chq (
                            v_trans_code,
                            v_ppv_raise_by,
                            v_pol_code,
                            v_prod_code,
                            v_voucher_no,
                            v_count,
                            NVL (v_penalty_amt1, 0),
                            'INV. PENALTY - ' || v_pol_number,
                            --v_narrative
                            v_trnt_gl_code,
                            v_org_code,
                            v_brh_code,
                            'C',
                            v_chq_dtls_rec);
                    END IF;

                    IF NVL (v_loan_amt1, 0) <> 0
                    THEN
                        get_gl_code ('POL_LOAN',
                                     v_prod_code,
                                     v_trnt_code,
                                     v_trnt_gl_code,
                                     v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                     NULL,
                                     v_renewal);
                        valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                                   v_org_code,
                                   v_brh_code,
                                   'POL_LOAN');
                        v_gl_count := v_gl_count + 1;
                        interface_append_gl (
                            v_trans_code,
                            --v_trans_code         NUMBER,
                            v_ppv_raise_by,
                            --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                            v_pol_code,
                            --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                            v_prod_code,
                            --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                            v_voucher_no,
                            --v_vchr_no            VARCHAR2,
                            NULL,                --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                            NULL,                --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                            NULL,             --v_rcpt_no            VARCHAR2,
                            v_gl_count,
