                            --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                            NVL (v_loan_amt1, 0),
                            --v_amount            NUMBER,
                            'C',               --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                            v_trnt_gl_code,
                            --v_acc_number          VARCHAR2,
                            v_brh_code,
                            --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                            v_gl_trans --v_trn_rec   IN OUT Fms_Vouchers_Pkg.Tgl_rec_type,
                                      );
                    END IF;

                    IF NVL (v_bo_spread_amt1, 0) <> 0
                    THEN
                        get_gl_code ('INVBO',
                                     v_prod_code,
                                     v_trnt_code,
                                     v_trnt_gl_code,
                                     v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                     NULL,
                                     v_renewal);
                        valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                                   v_org_code,
                                   v_brh_code,
                                   'INVBO');
                        v_count := v_count + 1;
                        interface_append_chq (
                            v_trans_code,
                            v_ppv_raise_by,
                            v_pol_code,
                            v_prod_code,
                            v_voucher_no,
                            v_count,
                            NVL (v_bo_spread_amt1, 0),
                            'INV. BO SPREAD - ' || v_pol_number,
                            --v_narrative
                            v_trnt_gl_code,
                            v_org_code,
                            v_brh_code,
                            'C',
                            v_chq_dtls_rec);
                    /*get_gl_code ('INVPREM',
                                 v_prod_code,
                                 v_trnt_code,
                                 v_trnt_gl_code,
                                 v_trnt_contra_gl_code
                                );
                    --valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code, v_org_code, v_brh_code, 'INVPREM');
                    valid_acc (v_trnt_contra_gl_code, v_org_code, v_brh_code, 'INVBO');
                    v_count := v_count + 1;
                    interface_append_chq (v_trans_code,
                                          v_ppv_raise_by,
                                          v_pol_code,
                                          v_prod_code,
                                          v_voucher_no,
                                          v_count,
                                          NVL (v_bo_spread_amt, 0),
                                          'INV. BO SPREAD',              --v_narrative
                                          v_trnt_contra_gl_code,--v_trnt_gl_code,
                                          v_org_code,
                                          v_brh_code,
                                          'D',
                                          v_chq_dtls_rec
                                         );*/
                    END IF;



                    IF NVL (v_processing_fee1, 0) <> 0
                    THEN
                        get_gl_code ('PROFEE',
                                     v_prod_code,
                                     v_trnt_code,
                                     v_trnt_gl_code,
                                     v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                     201964,
                                     v_renewal);
                        valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                                   v_org_code,
                                   v_brh_code,
                                   'PROFEE');
                        v_count := v_count + 1;

                        interface_append_chq (
                            v_trans_code,
                            v_ppv_raise_by,
                            v_pol_code,
                            v_prod_code,
                            v_voucher_no,
                            v_count,
                            NVL (v_processing_fee1, 0),
                            'PROCESSING FEE - ' || v_pol_number,
                            --v_narrative
                            v_trnt_gl_code,
                            v_org_code,
                            v_brh_code,
                            'C',
                            v_chq_dtls_rec);
                    END IF;



                    --raise_error('v_net_amt='||v_net_amt);
                    IF NVL (v_pay_method, 'CHQ') = 'MFT'
                    THEN
                        v_payee_bank_acc_no := v_clnt_mob_no;
                    END IF;

                    IF v_cancl_type = 'PW'
                    THEN
                        v_pmt_type := 'PW_REF';
                    ELSE
                        v_pmt_type := 'POL_REF';
                    END IF;

                    IF v_count != 0
                    THEN
                        interface_create_reqn (
                            v_trans_code,
                            v_ref,                                     --v_ref
                            v_pol_code,                               --v_ref2
                            TRUNC (SYSDATE),                      --v_ref_date
                            v_narrative,                         --v_narrative
                            v_net_amt,                              --v_amount
                            v_payee,                                 --v_payee
                            NVL (v_pay_method, 'CHQ'),          --v_pay_method
                            v_payee_bank_acc_no,         --v_payee_bank_acc_no
                            v_bbr_code,             --v_payee_bank_branch_code
                            v_ppv_raise_by,                 --v_source_auth_by
                            TRUNC (SYSDATE),                --v_source_auth_dt
                            NVL (v_prepared_by, v_ppv_raise_by),
                            --v_raise_by
                            v_pmt_type,                           --v_pmt_type
                            v_brh_code,                       --v_branch_code,
                            v_pol_code,                          --v_pol_code,
                            v_chq_dtls_rec,                     --v_dtls_table
                            NULL,
                            NULL,
                            v_trans_no,
                            NULL,
                            NULL,
                            v_mpt_code,
                            v_clnt_id_passport_no,
                            v_id_type);
                    ELSIF v_count = 0
                    THEN
                        raise_application_error (
                            -20001,
                            'REFUND PAYMENT NOT PROCESSED TO FINANCE');
                    END IF;
                END IF;
            END IF;

            IF v_gl_count != 0
            THEN
                interface_update_vgl (v_trans_code,             --v_trans_code
                                      v_ppv_raise_by,             --v_raise_by
                                      v_pol_code,                 --v_pol_code
                                      TRUNC (SYSDATE),                --v_date
                                      NULL,                       --v_opr_code
                                      NULL,                      --v_oppr_code
                                      'LMS POL_REFUND BATCH', --v_btc_description
                                      'JV',                       --v_btc_type
                                      v_brh_code,              --v_branch_code
                                      'LMS REFUND VOUCHER',    --v_description
                                      NULL,                        --v_rcpt_no
                                      v_gl_trans,                 --v_gl_trans
                                      NULL, --v_cad_code    NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                      NULL, --v_otop_code   NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                      NULL, --v_fpmt_code   NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                      NULL, --v_ort_code    NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                      NULL, --v_btr_no      NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                      NULL, --v_ppr_code    NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                      NULL, --v_ocl_code    NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                      NULL, --v_agn_code    NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                      v_trans_no, --v_trans_no    NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                      NULL --v_curr_code   NUMBER DEFAULT NULL
                                          );
            END IF;
        ELSE
            IF NVL (v_gross_amt, 0) > 0
            THEN
                IF v_cancl_type = 'PW'
                THEN
                    get_gl_code ('PW',
                                 v_prod_code,
                                 v_trnt_code,
                                 v_trnt_gl_code,
                                 v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                 NULL,
                                 v_renewal);
                    valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                               v_org_code,
                               v_brh_code,
                               'PW');
                ELSE
                    get_gl_code ('PLREF',
                                 v_prod_code,
                                 v_trnt_code,
                                 v_trnt_gl_code,
                                 v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                 NULL,
                                 v_renewal);
                    valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                               v_org_code,
                               v_brh_code,
                               'PLREF');
                END IF;

                v_count := v_count + 1;
                interface_append_gl (v_trans_code,              --v_trans_code
                                     v_ppv_raise_by,              --v_raise_by
                                     v_pol_code,                  --v_pol_code
                                     v_prod_code,                --v_prod_code
                                     v_voucher_no,                 --v_vchr_no
                                     NULL,       --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                                     NULL,       --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                                     NULL,    --v_rcpt_no            VARCHAR2,
                                     v_count,                        --v_count
                                     v_narrative,                --v_narrative
                                     v_gross_amt,                   --v_amount
                                     'D',                             --v_drcr
                                     v_trnt_gl_code,            --v_acc_number
                                     v_brh_code,               --v_branch_code
                                     v_gl_trans);                  --v_trn_rec

                IF NVL (v_penalty_amt1, 0) <> 0
                THEN
                    get_gl_code ('INVPEN',
                                 v_prod_code,
                                 v_trnt_code,
                                 v_trnt_gl_code,
                                 v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                 NULL,
                                 v_renewal);
                    valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                               v_org_code,
                               v_brh_code,
                               'INVPEN');
                    v_count := v_count + 1;
                    interface_append_gl (v_trans_code,          --v_trans_code
                                         v_ppv_raise_by,          --v_raise_by
                                         v_pol_code,              --v_pol_code
                                         v_prod_code,            --v_prod_code
                                         v_voucher_no,             --v_vchr_no
                                         NULL,   --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                                         NULL,   --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                                         NULL, --v_rcpt_no            VARCHAR2,
                                         v_count,                    --v_count
                                         'INV. PENALTY - ' || v_pol_number,
                                         --v_narrative
                                         NVL (v_penalty_amt1, 0),   --v_amount
                                         'C',                         --v_drcr
                                         v_trnt_gl_code,
                                         v_trnt_gl_code,        --v_acc_number
                                         v_brh_code,           --v_branch_code
                                         v_gl_trans);              --v_trn_rec
                END IF;

                IF NVL (v_bo_spread_amt1, 0) <> 0
                THEN
                    get_gl_code ('INVBO',
                                 v_prod_code,
                                 v_trnt_code,
                                 v_trnt_gl_code,
                                 v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                 NULL,
                                 v_renewal);
                    valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                               v_org_code,
                               v_brh_code,
                               'INVBO');
                    v_count := v_count + 1;
                    interface_append_gl (v_trans_code,          --v_trans_code
                                         v_ppv_raise_by,          --v_raise_by
                                         v_pol_code,              --v_pol_code
                                         v_prod_code,            --v_prod_code
                                         v_voucher_no,             --v_vchr_no
                                         NULL,   --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                                         NULL,   --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                                         NULL, --v_rcpt_no            VARCHAR2,
                                         v_count,
                                         'INV. BO SPREAD - ' || v_pol_number,
                                         --v_narrative
                                         NVL (v_bo_spread_amt1, 0),
                                         'C',
                                         v_trnt_gl_code,
                                         v_brh_code,
                                         v_gl_trans);
                /*get_gl_code ('INVPREM',
                             v_prod_code,
                             v_trnt_code,
                             v_trnt_gl_code,
                             v_trnt_contra_gl_code
                            );
                valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code, v_org_code, v_brh_code, 'INVPREM');
                valid_acc (v_trnt_contra_gl_code, v_org_code, v_brh_code, 'INVBO');
                v_count := v_count + 1;
                interface_append_gl (v_trans_code,               --v_trans_code
                                     v_ppv_raise_by,               --v_raise_by
                                     v_pol_code,                   --v_pol_code
                                     v_prod_code,                 --v_prod_code
                                     v_voucher_no,                  --v_vchr_no
                                     NULL,        --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                                     NULL,        --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                                     NULL,     --v_rcpt_no            VARCHAR2,
                                     v_count,
                                     'INV. BO SPREAD',            --v_narrative
                                     NVL (v_bo_spread_amt, 0),
                                     'D',
                                     v_trnt_contra_gl_code,--v_trnt_gl_code,
                                     v_brh_code,
                                     v_gl_trans
                                    );*/
                END IF;

                interface_update_vgl (v_trans_code,             --v_trans_code
                                      v_ppv_raise_by,             --v_raise_by
                                      v_pol_code,                 --v_pol_code
                                      TRUNC (SYSDATE),                --v_date
                                      NULL,                       --v_opr_code
                                      NULL,                      --v_oppr_code
                                      'LMS POL_REFUND BATCH', --v_btc_description
                                      'JV',                       --v_btc_type
                                      v_brh_code,              --v_branch_code
                                      'LMS REFUND VOUCHER',    --v_description
                                      NULL,                        --v_rcpt_no
                                      v_gl_trans,                 --v_gl_trans
                                      NULL, --v_cad_code    NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                      NULL, --v_otop_code   NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                      NULL, --v_fpmt_code   NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                      NULL, --v_ort_code    NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                      NULL, --v_btr_no      NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                      NULL, --v_ppr_code    NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                      NULL, --v_ocl_code    NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                      NULL, --v_agn_code    NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                      v_trans_no, --v_trans_no    NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                      NULL --v_curr_code   NUMBER DEFAULT NULL
                                          );
            END IF;
        END IF;
    --   EXCEPTION
    --      WHEN OTHERS
    --      THEN                                         --Error processing refund..
    --         raise_error ('POL REF - ');
    END process_pol_refund;

    PROCEDURE process_inv_overpay_ref (
        v_pol_code               NUMBER,
        v_prod_code              NUMBER,
        v_refnd_amt              NUMBER,
        v_prem_amt        IN OUT NUMBER,
        v_admin_amt       IN OUT NUMBER,
        v_inv_amt         IN OUT NUMBER,
        v_polfee_amt      IN OUT NUMBER,
        v_comp_fund_amt   IN OUT NUMBER,
        v_vchr_no                VARCHAR,
        v_pay_method             VARCHAR2 DEFAULT 'CHQ',
        v_comm_amount            NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
        v_bank_acc_no            VARCHAR2 DEFAULT NULL,
        v_bbrcode                NUMBER DEFAULT NULL
    )
    IS
        v_brh_code              NUMBER;
        v_bct_brh_code          NUMBER;
        v_trnt_code             VARCHAR2 (10);
        v_trnt_gl_code          VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_trnt_contra_gl_code   VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_count                 NUMBER := 0;
        v_org_code              NUMBER;
        v_sys_code              NUMBER;
        v_bct_code              NUMBER;
        v_cur_code              NUMBER;
        v_auth_by               NUMBER;
        v_payee                 VARCHAR2 (100);
        v_chq_dtls_rec          fms_cheques_pkg.type_rqn_dtls_table;
        v_payee_eft_rec         fms_cheques_pkg.type_payee_eft_table;
        v_policy_no             VARCHAR2 (30);
        v_eft_enabled           VARCHAR2 (1) := 'N';
        v_bbr_code              NUMBER;
        v_account_number        VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_trans_code            NUMBER;
        v_user_name             VARCHAR2 (50);
        v_user                  VARCHAR2 (30)
            := pkg_global_vars.get_pvarchar2 ('PKG_GLOBAL_VARS.PVG_USERNAME');
        vgl_code                NUMBER;
        v_gl_trans              fms_vouchers_pkg.tgl_rec_type;
        v_gl_count              NUMBER := 0;
        v_net                   NUMBER
            := NVL (v_refnd_amt, 0) - NVL (v_comm_amount, 0);
        v_raise_by              VARCHAR2 (30);
        v_incl_pfee_on_val      VARCHAR2 (5);
        v_refund_chk_chrg       VARCHAR2 (5);
        v_clnt_mob_no           lms_pol_payment_vouchers.ppv_clnt_mob_no%TYPE
                                    := NULL;
        v_mpt_code              lms_pol_payment_vouchers.ppv_mpt_code%TYPE
                                    := NULL;
        v_clnt_id_passport_no   lms_pol_payment_vouchers.ppv_clnt_id_passport_no%TYPE
            := NULL;
        v_id_type               VARCHAR2 (20) := NULL;
        v_cont_acc_param        VARCHAR2 (1);
        v_trans_no              NUMBER;
        v_processing_brn_code   NUMBER;
    BEGIN
        SELECT    TO_NUMBER (TO_CHAR (SYSDATE, 'RRRR'))
               || lms_transaction_seq.NEXTVAL
          INTO v_trans_code
          FROM DUAL;

        v_auth_by :=
            fms_interfaces_pkg.get_usercode (
                pkg_global_vars.get_pvarchar2 (
                    'PKG_GLOBAL_VARS.PVG_USERNAME'));
        v_user_name := tqc_interfaces_pkg.username (v_auth_by);

        BEGIN
            SELECT NVL (ltr_done_by, v_user), ltr_trans_no
              INTO v_raise_by, v_trans_no
              FROM lms_pol_payment_vouchers, lms_transactions
             WHERE ppv_voucher_no = v_vchr_no AND ppv_trans_no = ltr_trans_no;
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                NULL;
                v_raise_by := v_user;
        END;

        IF v_trans_no IS NOT NULL
        THEN
            BEGIN
                SELECT rpd_proc_brn_code
                  INTO v_processing_brn_code
                  FROM lms_refund_pymt_dtls
                 WHERE rpd_ltr_trans_no = v_trans_no;
            EXCEPTION
                WHEN OTHERS
                THEN
                    v_processing_brn_code := NULL;
            END;
        END IF;

        IF NVL (v_pay_method, 'CHQ') = 'MFT'
        THEN
            SELECT ppv_clnt_mob_no,
                   ppv_mpt_code,
                   ppv_clnt_id_passport_no,
                   DECODE (ppv_identity_type,
                           'I', 'NATIONAL ID',
                           'P', 'PASSPORT')
              INTO v_clnt_mob_no,
                   v_mpt_code,
                   v_clnt_id_passport_no,
                   v_id_type
              FROM lms_pol_payment_vouchers
             WHERE ppv_voucher_no = v_vchr_no;

            v_account_number := v_clnt_mob_no;
        END IF;

        BEGIN
            SELECT pol_bra_code, ppv_payee, pol_policy_no
              INTO v_brh_code, v_payee, v_policy_no
              FROM lms_proposers,
                   lms_policies,
                   lms_policy_endorsements,
                   lms_pol_payment_vouchers
             WHERE     pol_prp_code = prp_code
                   AND pol_current_endr_code = endr_code
                   AND pol_code = v_pol_code
                   AND ppv_pol_code = pol_code
                   AND ppv_voucher_no = v_vchr_no;
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                raise_error ('UNABLE TO RETRIEVE POLICY DTLS....');
        END;

        v_brh_code := NVL(v_processing_brn_code, v_brh_code);

        v_org_code := fms_interfaces_pkg.get_org (v_brh_code);

        BEGIN
            lms_ord_misc.system_param_val ('INCLUDE_PFEE_ON_INVESTMENT',
                                           v_incl_pfee_on_val,
                                           v_prod_code);
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                raise_error (
                       'parameter error: INCLUDE_PFEE_ON_INVESTMENT. prod_code: '
                    || v_prod_code);
        END;

        BEGIN
            lms_ord_misc.system_param_val ('USE_CONTRAL_ACCOUNT_AT_CLAIMS',
                                           v_cont_acc_param);
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                raise_error ('PARAM ERROR...USE_CONTRAL_ACCOUNT_AT_CLAIMS');
        END;

        BEGIN
            lms_ord_misc.system_param_val ('REFUND_CHK_OFF_COMM_CHRG',
                                           v_refund_chk_chrg);
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                raise_error ('Param Error... REFUND_CHK_OFF_COMM_CHRG');
        END;

        IF NVL (v_refund_chk_chrg, 'N') = 'Y'
        THEN
            v_net := NVL (v_refnd_amt, 0);
        ELSE
            v_net := NVL (v_refnd_amt, 0) - NVL (v_comm_amount, 0);
        END IF;

        IF NVL (v_refnd_amt, 0) = 0
        THEN
            raise_error ('THE REFUND AMOUNT IS NULL OR ZERO....');
        ELSIF   /*NVL (v_prem_amt, 0)
              + NVL (v_admin_amt, 0)
              + NVL (v_inv_amt, 0)
              + CASE WHEN v_incl_pfee_on_val = 'Y' THEN 0 ELSE NVL (v_polfee_amt, 0) END
              + ROUND (NVL (v_comp_fund_amt, 0)) <> NVL (v_refnd_amt, 0)*/
                NVL (v_prem_amt, 0)
              + NVL (v_admin_amt, 0)
              + NVL (v_inv_amt, 0)
              + CASE
                    WHEN v_incl_pfee_on_val = 'Y' THEN 0
                    ELSE NVL (v_polfee_amt, 0)
                END <>
              NVL (v_refnd_amt, 0)
        THEN
            raise_error (
                   'REFUND AMOUNTS DO NOT ADD UP....**'
                || v_prem_amt
                || ';'
                || v_admin_amt
                || ';'
                || v_inv_amt
                || ';'
                || v_polfee_amt
                || ';'
                || v_comp_fund_amt
                || ';'
                || v_refnd_amt
                || '**');
        ELSIF NOT v_pay_method IN ('CHQ',
                                   'EFT',
                                   'E-PAY',
                                   'CASH')
        THEN
            raise_error (
                   'PAYMENT METHOD '
                || v_pay_method
                || ' UNDER DEVELOPMENT FOR INVESTMENT....');
        ELSE
            get_gl_code ('PLREF',
                         v_prod_code,
                         v_trnt_code,
                         v_trnt_gl_code,
                         v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
            valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                       v_org_code,
                       v_brh_code,
                       'PLREF');

            IF NVL (v_cont_acc_param, 'Y') = 'Y'
            THEN
                v_gl_count := v_gl_count + 1;
                interface_append_gl (
                    v_trans_code,              --v_trans_code          NUMBER,
                    v_user,                    --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                    v_pol_code,                  --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                    v_prod_code,                 --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                    v_vchr_no,                --v_vchr_no            VARCHAR2,
                    NULL,                        --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                    NULL,                        --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                    NULL,                      --v_rcpt_no           VARCHAR2,
                    v_gl_count,                  --v_count             NUMBER,
                    'POLICY RECEIPTS REFUND - ' || v_policy_no,
                    --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                    v_net,
                    --v_refnd_amt,--v_amount            NUMBER,
                    'C',                       --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                    v_trnt_gl_code,           --v_acc_number         VARCHAR2,
                    v_brh_code,                  --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                    v_gl_trans);                  --v_trn_rec   IN OUT fms_tes
            END IF;

            v_count := v_count + 1;
            interface_append_chq (v_trans_code,    --v_trans_code      NUMBER,
                                  v_user,      --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                                  v_pol_code,   --v_pol_code           NUMBER,
                                  v_prod_code,  --v_prod_code          NUMBER,
                                  v_vchr_no, --v_vchr_no             VARCHAR2,
                                  v_count,      --v_count              NUMBER,
                                  v_net,
                                  --v_refnd_amt,--v_amount             NUMBER,
                                  'POLICY RECEIPTS REFUND - ' || v_policy_no,
                                  --v_narrative          VARCHAR2,
                                  v_trnt_gl_code,
                                  --v_acc_number          VARCHAR2,
                                  v_org_code,  --v_acc_org_code        NUMBER,
                                  v_brh_code,   --v_branch_code        NUMBER,
                                  'D',        --v_drcr               VARCHAR2,
                                  v_chq_dtls_rec);
        --         v_gl_count := v_gl_count + 1;
        --      Interface_append_gl(v_trans_code,--v_trans_code          NUMBER,
        --                         v_user,--v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
        --                        v_pol_code ,--v_pol_code          NUMBER,
        --                        v_prod_code,--v_prod_code         NUMBER,
        --                        v_vchr_no,--v_vchr_no            VARCHAR2,
        --                        NULL,--v_opr_code          NUMBER,
        --                        NULL,--v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
        --                        NULL,--v_rcpt_no           VARCHAR2,
        --                        v_gl_count,--v_count             NUMBER,
        --                         'POLICY RECEIPTS REFUND - '
        --                                || v_policy_no,--v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
        --                         v_comm_amount,--v_amount            NUMBER,
        --                         'D',--v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
        --                         v_trnt_gl_code,--v_acc_number         VARCHAR2,
        --                          v_brh_code,--v_branch_code       NUMBER,
        --                           v_gl_trans);--v_trn_rec   IN OUT fms_tes
        END IF;

        --Dont do any recoveries
        IF NVL (v_cont_acc_param, 'Y') = 'N'
        THEN
            v_prem_amt := 0;
            v_admin_amt := 0;
            v_inv_amt := 0;
            v_polfee_amt := 0;
            v_comp_fund_amt := 0;
        END IF;

        IF NVL (v_prem_amt, 0) != 0
        THEN
            get_gl_code ('UP',
                         v_prod_code,
                         v_trnt_code,
                         v_trnt_gl_code,
                         v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
            v_count := v_count + 1;
            valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                       v_org_code,
                       v_brh_code,
                       'UP');
            interface_append_gl (v_trans_code,   --v_trans_code        NUMBER,
                                 v_user,       --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                                 v_pol_code,     --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                                 v_prod_code,    --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                                 v_vchr_no,     --v_vchr_no          VARCHAR2,
                                 NULL,           --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                                 NULL,           --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                                 NULL,        --v_rcpt_no            VARCHAR2,
                                 v_count,        --v_count             NUMBER,
                                 'PREMIUM INCOME - ' || v_policy_no,
                                 --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                                 v_prem_amt,     --v_amount            NUMBER,
                                 'D',          --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                                 v_trnt_gl_code,
                                 --v_acc_number          VARCHAR2,
                                 v_brh_code,     --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                                 v_gl_trans);     --v_trn_rec   IN OUT fms_tes
        END IF;

        IF NVL (v_admin_amt, 0) != 0
        THEN
            get_gl_code ('INVADM',
                         v_prod_code,
                         v_trnt_code,
                         v_trnt_gl_code,
                         v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
            valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                       v_org_code,
                       v_brh_code,
                       'INVADM');
            v_count := v_count + 1;
            interface_append_gl (v_trans_code,  --v_trans_code         NUMBER,
                                 v_user,       --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                                 v_pol_code,     --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                                 v_prod_code,    --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                                 v_vchr_no,     --v_vchr_no          VARCHAR2,
                                 NULL,           --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                                 NULL,           --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                                 NULL,        --v_rcpt_no            VARCHAR2,
                                 v_count,        --v_count             NUMBER,
                                 'INVESTMENT ADMIN. - ' || v_policy_no,
                                 --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                                 v_admin_amt,    --v_amount            NUMBER,
                                 'D',          --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                                 v_trnt_gl_code,
                                 --v_acc_number          VARCHAR2,
                                 v_brh_code,     --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                                 v_gl_trans);
        END IF;

        IF NVL (v_inv_amt, 0) != 0
        THEN
            get_gl_code ('INVPREM',
                         v_prod_code,
                         v_trnt_code,
                         v_trnt_gl_code,
                         v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
            valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                       v_org_code,
                       v_brh_code,
                       'INVPREM');
            v_count := v_count + 1;
            interface_append_gl (v_trans_code,  --v_trans_code         NUMBER,
                                 v_user,       --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                                 v_pol_code,     --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                                 v_prod_code,    --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                                 v_vchr_no,     --v_vchr_no          VARCHAR2,
                                 NULL,           --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                                 NULL,           --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                                 NULL,        --v_rcpt_no            VARCHAR2,
                                 v_count,        --v_count             NUMBER,
                                 'INVESTMENT PREMIUM - ' || v_policy_no,
                                 --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                                 v_inv_amt,      --v_amount            NUMBER,
                                 'D',          --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                                 v_trnt_gl_code,
                                 --v_acc_number          VARCHAR2,
                                 v_brh_code,     --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                                 v_gl_trans);
        END IF;

        IF v_incl_pfee_on_val <> 'Y'
        THEN
            IF NVL (v_polfee_amt, 0) != 0
            THEN
                get_gl_code ('INVFEE',
                             v_prod_code,
                             v_trnt_code,
                             v_trnt_gl_code,
                             v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
                valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                           v_org_code,
                           v_brh_code,
                           'INVFEE');
                v_count := v_count + 1;
                interface_append_gl (v_trans_code, --v_trans_code         NUMBER,
                                     v_user,   --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                                     v_pol_code, --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                                     v_prod_code, --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                                     v_vchr_no, --v_vchr_no          VARCHAR2,
                                     NULL,       --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                                     NULL,       --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                                     NULL,    --v_rcpt_no            VARCHAR2,
                                     v_count,    --v_count             NUMBER,
                                     'INVESTMENT FEE - ' || v_policy_no,
                                     --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                                     v_polfee_amt, --v_amount            NUMBER,
                                     'D',      --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                                     v_trnt_gl_code,
                                     --v_acc_number          VARCHAR2,
                                     v_brh_code, --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                                     v_gl_trans);
            END IF;
        END IF;

        IF ROUND (NVL (v_comp_fund_amt, 0)) != 0
        THEN
            get_gl_code ('CMPFND',
                         v_prod_code,
                         v_trnt_code,
                         v_trnt_gl_code,
                         v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
            valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                       v_org_code,
                       v_brh_code,
                       'CMPFND');
            v_count := v_count + 1;
            interface_append_gl (v_trans_code,  --v_trans_code         NUMBER,
                                 v_user,       --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                                 v_pol_code,     --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                                 v_prod_code,    --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                                 v_vchr_no,     --v_vchr_no          VARCHAR2,
                                 NULL,           --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                                 NULL,           --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                                 NULL,        --v_rcpt_no            VARCHAR2,
                                 v_count,        --v_count             NUMBER,
                                 'COMPENSATION FUND  - ' || v_policy_no,
                                 --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                                 ROUND (v_comp_fund_amt),
                                 --v_amount            NUMBER,
                                 'D',          --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                                 v_trnt_gl_code,
                                 --v_acc_number          VARCHAR2,
                                 v_brh_code,     --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                                 v_gl_trans);
        END IF;

        IF NVL (v_comm_amount, 0) != 0 AND NVL (v_refund_chk_chrg, 'N') = 'N'
        THEN
            get_gl_code ('CHKC',
                         v_prod_code,
                         v_trnt_code,
                         v_trnt_gl_code,
                         v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
            valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                       v_org_code,
                       v_brh_code,
                       'CHKC');
            v_count := v_count + 1;
            interface_append_gl (v_trans_code,  --v_trans_code         NUMBER,
                                 v_user,       --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                                 v_pol_code,     --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                                 v_prod_code,    --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                                 v_vchr_no,   --v_vchr_no            VARCHAR2,
                                 NULL,           --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                                 NULL,           --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                                 NULL,         --v_rcpt_no           VARCHAR2,
                                 v_count,        --v_count             NUMBER,
                                 'CHECK OFF  RECOVERY  - ' || v_policy_no,
                                 --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                                 v_comm_amount,  --v_amount            NUMBER,
                                 'C',          --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                                 v_trnt_gl_code, --v_acc_number         VARCHAR2,
                                 v_brh_code,     --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                                 v_gl_trans);
        END IF;

        IF v_count != 0
        THEN
            IF v_pay_method = 'EFT'
            THEN
                --Raise_error('v_pay_method-'||v_pay_method||'v_bbr_code-'||v_bbr_code);
                BEGIN
                    v_bbr_code := NVL (v_bbrcode, bnk_bbr_code (v_pol_code));
                    v_account_number :=
                        NVL (v_bank_acc_no, bnk_account (v_pol_code));
                EXCEPTION
                    WHEN OTHERS
                    THEN
                        raise_error ('GETTING BANK ACC INFO... ');
                END;
            END IF;

            --Raise_error('v_pay_method-'||v_pay_method||'v_bbr_code-'||v_bbr_code);
            interface_create_reqn (
                v_trans_code,                   --v_trais_code         NUMBER,
                v_vchr_no,                 --v_ref                   VARCHAR2,
                v_pol_code,
                --v_ref2                  VARCHAR2,
                TRUNC (SYSDATE),
                --v_ref_date              DATE,
                'POLICY RECEIPTS REFUND - ' || v_policy_no,
                --v_narrative             VARCHAR2,
                v_net,
                --v_refnd_amt,    --v_amount                NUMBER,
                v_payee,                   --v_payee                 VARCHAR2,
                v_pay_method,
                --v_pay_method            VARCHAR2, --CHQ, EFT
                v_account_number,
                --v_payee_bank_acc_no        VARCHAR2,
                v_bbr_code,
                --v_payee_bank_branch_code   NUMBER,
                v_user_name,
                --v_source_auth_by        VARCHAR2,
                TRUNC (SYSDATE),
                --v_source_auth_dt        DATE,
                v_raise_by,
                --v_raise_by                VARCHAR2,
                'REFUND',                  --v_pmt_type              VARCHAR2,
                v_brh_code,                    --v_branch_code         NUMBER,
                v_pol_code,                              --v_pol_code  NUMBER,
                v_chq_dtls_rec,
                NULL,
                NULL,
                NULL,
                NULL,
                NULL,
                v_mpt_code,
                v_clnt_id_passport_no,
                v_id_type);
        --v_dtls_table  IN OUT  Fms_Cheques_Pkg.Type_rqn_dtls_table
        END IF;

        --END IF;
        IF v_gl_trans.COUNT <> 0
        THEN
            interface_update_vgl (v_trans_code,     --v_trans_code     NUMBER,
                                  v_user,      --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                                  v_pol_code,    --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                                  TRUNC (SYSDATE),    --v_date           DATE,
                                  NULL,          --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                                  NULL,          --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                                  'RECEIPTS REFUND -', --v_btc_description   VARCHAR2,
                                  'JV',       --v_btc_type           VARCHAR2,
                                  v_brh_code,    --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                                  'RECEIPTS REFUND - ' || v_policy_no,
                                  --v_description       VARCHAR2,
                                  v_vchr_no,        --v_ref          VARCHAR2,
                                  v_gl_trans);
        --v_gl_trans  IN OUT  Fms_Vouchers_Pkg.Tgl_rec_type,
        END IF;
    EXCEPTION
        WHEN OTHERS
        THEN
            raise_error ('INV. REF..');
    END process_inv_overpay_ref;

    PROCEDURE process_overpay_ref (
        v_pol_code       NUMBER,
        v_prod_code      NUMBER,
        v_gross_amount   NUMBER,
        v_comm_amount    NUMBER,
        v_ptax_amount    NUMBER,
        v_ref_type       VARCHAR,                         --(POLICY/PROPOSAL),
        v_ref            NUMBER,
        v_pay_method     VARCHAR2 DEFAULT 'CHQ',
        v_unp_type       VARCHAR2 DEFAULT NULL,
        v_loan_no        VARCHAR2 DEFAULT NULL,
        v_bank_acc_no    VARCHAR2 DEFAULT NULL,
        v_bbr_code       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL
    )
    IS
        v_brh_code              NUMBER;
        v_bct_brh_code          NUMBER;
        v_trnt_code             VARCHAR2 (10);
        v_trnt_gl_code          VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_trnt_contra_gl_code   VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_count                 NUMBER := 0;
        v_org_code              NUMBER;
        v_sys_code              NUMBER;
        v_bct_code              NUMBER;
        v_cur_code              NUMBER;
        v_auth_by               NUMBER;
        v_payee                 VARCHAR2 (100);
        v_ref2                  VARCHAR2 (50);
        v_prop_no               VARCHAR2 (50);
        v_chq_dtls_rec          fms_cheques_pkg.type_rqn_dtls_table;
        v_trnt_type             VARCHAR2 (10);
        v_narrative             VARCHAR2 (100);
        v_policy_no             VARCHAR2 (50);
        v_net                   NUMBER
            := NVL (v_gross_amount, 0) - NVL (v_comm_amount, 0);
        vgl_code                NUMBER;
        v_gl_trans              fms_vouchers_pkg.tgl_rec_type;
        v_gl_count              NUMBER := 0;
        v_jv_narrative          VARCHAR2 (100);
        v_trans_code            NUMBER;
        v_user                  VARCHAR2 (30)
            := pkg_global_vars.get_pvarchar2 ('PKG_GLOBAL_VARS.PVG_USERNAME');
        v_raise_by              VARCHAR2 (30);
        v_refund_chk_chrg       VARCHAR2 (1) := 'N';
        v_clnt_mob_no           lms_pol_payment_vouchers.ppv_clnt_mob_no%TYPE
                                    := NULL;
        v_mpt_code              lms_pol_payment_vouchers.ppv_mpt_code%TYPE
                                    := NULL;
        v_clnt_id_passport_no   lms_pol_payment_vouchers.ppv_clnt_id_passport_no%TYPE
            := NULL;
        v_id_type               VARCHAR2 (20) := NULL;
        v_cont_acc_param        VARCHAR2 (1) := 'Y';
        v_trans_no              NUMBER;
        v_processing_brn_code   NUMBER;
        v_account_number        VARCHAR2 (30) := v_bank_acc_no;
        v_prem_amt              NUMBER;
        v_invadmin_amt          NUMBER;
        v_invprem_amt           NUMBER;
        v_invfee_amt            NUMBER;
        v_compfnd_amt           NUMBER;
        v_loan_amt              NUMBER;
        v_unproc_amt            NUMBER;
        v_contra_acc            VARCHAR2 (50);
        v_use_refund_glcode     VARCHAR2 (1);
    BEGIN
        BEGIN
            lms_ord_misc.system_param_val ('REFUND_CHK_OFF_COMM_CHRG',
                                           v_refund_chk_chrg);
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                raise_error ('Param Error... REFUND_CHK_OFF_COMM_CHRG');
        END;

        BEGIN
            lms_ord_misc.system_param_val ('USE_CONTRAL_ACCOUNT_AT_CLAIMS',
                                           v_cont_acc_param);
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                raise_error ('PARAM ERROR...USE_CONTRAL_ACCOUNT_AT_CLAIMS');
        END;

        BEGIN
            lms_ord_misc.system_param_val (
                'USE_REFUND_PREMIUM_RECOVERY_GL_CODE',
                v_use_refund_glcode);
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                raise_error (
                    'Param Error... USE_REFUND_PREMIUM_RECOVERY_GL_CODE');
        END;

        IF v_refund_chk_chrg <> 'Y'
        THEN
            v_net := NVL (v_gross_amount, 0) - NVL (v_comm_amount, 0);
        ELSE
            v_net := NVL (v_gross_amount, 0);
        --refund inclusive of the checkoff commission
        END IF;

        SELECT    TO_NUMBER (TO_CHAR (SYSDATE, 'RRRR'))
               || lms_transaction_seq.NEXTVAL
          INTO v_trans_code
          FROM DUAL;

        SELECT pol_bra_code,
               endr_payee,
               pol_proposal_no,
               pol_policy_no
          INTO v_brh_code,
               v_payee,
               v_prop_no,
               v_policy_no
          FROM lms_proposers, lms_policies, lms_policy_endorsements
         WHERE     pol_prp_code = prp_code
               AND pol_current_endr_code = endr_code
               AND pol_code = v_pol_code;

        v_org_code := fms_interfaces_pkg.get_org (v_brh_code);

        BEGIN
            SELECT NVL (ltr_done_by, v_user), ltr_trans_no
              INTO v_raise_by, v_trans_no
              FROM lms_pol_payment_vouchers, lms_transactions
             WHERE ppv_voucher_no = v_ref AND ppv_trans_no = ltr_trans_no;
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                NULL;
                v_raise_by := v_user;
        END;

        IF v_trans_no IS NOT NULL
        THEN
            BEGIN
                SELECT rpd_proc_brn_code
                  INTO v_processing_brn_code
                  FROM lms_refund_pymt_dtls
                 WHERE rpd_ltr_trans_no = v_trans_no;
            EXCEPTION
                WHEN OTHERS
                THEN
                    v_processing_brn_code := NULL;
            END;
        END IF;


        BEGIN
              SELECT ppv_clnt_mob_no,
                     ppv_mpt_code,
                     ppv_clnt_id_passport_no,
                     DECODE (ppv_identity_type,
                             'I', 'NATIONAL ID',
                             'P', 'PASSPORT'),
                     SUM (ppvd_prem_amt)
                         ppvd_prem_amt,
                     SUM (ppvd_invadmin_amt)
                         ppvd_invadmin_amt,
                     SUM (ppvd_invprem_amt)
                         ppvd_invprem_amt,
                     SUM (ppvd_invfee_amt)
                         ppvd_invfee_amt,
                     SUM (ppvd_compfnd_amt)
                         ppvd_compfnd_amt,
                     SUM (ppvd_loan_amt)
                         ppvd_loan_amt,
                     SUM (ppvd_unproc_amt)
                         ppvd_unproc_amt
                INTO v_clnt_mob_no,
                     v_mpt_code,
                     v_clnt_id_passport_no,
                     v_id_type,
                     v_prem_amt,
                     v_invadmin_amt,
                     v_invprem_amt,
                     v_invfee_amt,
                     v_compfnd_amt,
                     v_loan_amt,
                     v_unproc_amt
                FROM lms_pol_payment_vouchers, lms_pol_payment_voucher_dtls
               WHERE     ppv_voucher_no = v_ref
                     AND ppvd_ppv_voucher_no = ppv_voucher_no
            GROUP BY ppv_clnt_mob_no,
                     ppv_mpt_code,
                     ppv_clnt_id_passport_no,
                     DECODE (ppv_identity_type,
                             'I', 'NATIONAL ID',
                             'P', 'PASSPORT');
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                raise_error ('Error fetching refund details..');
        END;

        --        raise_error('v_prem_amt='||v_prem_amt
        --                    ||'v_invadmin_amt='||v_invadmin_amt
        --                    ||'v_invfee_amt='||v_invfee_amt
        --                    ||'v_compfnd_amt='||v_compfnd_amt
        --                    ||'v_loan_amt='||v_loan_amt
        --                    ||'v_unproc_amt='||v_unproc_amt
        --                    ||'v_invprem_amt='||v_invprem_amt
        --                    ||'v_net='||v_net
        --                    );

        IF NVL (v_pay_method, 'CHQ') = 'MFT'
        THEN
            v_account_number := v_clnt_mob_no;
        END IF;

        IF NVL (v_gross_amount, 0) != 0
        THEN
            SELECT DECODE (v_ref_type,
                           'PR', 'PRREF',
                           'PL', 'PLREF',
                           'NL', 'NL',
                           'OM', 'PLREF'),
                   DECODE (
                       v_ref_type,
                       'PR', 'Proposal Receipts Refund - ' || v_prop_no,
                       'PL', 'Policy Receipts Refund - ' || v_policy_no,
                       'NL',    'Policy Loan Refund - '
                             || v_policy_no
                             || ' - '
                             || v_loan_no,
                       'OM', 'Policy Receipts Refund - ' || v_policy_no),
                   DECODE (v_ref_type,
                           'PR', 'Proposal Receipts Refund - ',
                           'PL', 'Policy Receipts Refund - ',
                           'NL', 'Policy Loan Refund - ',
                           'OM', 'Policy Receipts Refund - ' || v_policy_no)
              INTO v_trnt_type, v_narrative, v_jv_narrative
              FROM DUAL;

            --Thi is to cater for refund for unalloacted
            IF v_unp_type IS NOT NULL
            THEN
                v_trnt_type := v_unp_type;
            END IF;

            get_gl_code (v_trnt_type,
                         v_prod_code,
                         v_trnt_code,
                         v_trnt_gl_code,
                         v_trnt_contra_gl_code);

            valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                       v_org_code,
                       NVL (v_processing_brn_code, v_brh_code),
                       v_trnt_type);

            IF NVL (v_cont_acc_param, 'Y') = 'Y'
            THEN
                valid_acc (v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                           v_org_code,
                           NVL (v_processing_brn_code, v_brh_code),
                           v_trnt_type);
                v_contra_acc := v_trnt_contra_gl_code;
            END IF;

            IF NVL (v_cont_acc_param, 'Y') = 'Y'
            THEN
                --APPEND CHEQUE
                v_count := v_count + 1;
                interface_append_chq (v_trans_code, --v_trans_code       NUMBER,
                                      v_user,  --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                                      v_pol_code, --v_pol_code           NUMBER,
                                      v_prod_code, --v_prod_code          NUMBER,
                                      v_ref,   --v_vchr_no           VARCHAR2,
                                      v_count,  --v_count              NUMBER,
                                      v_net,    --v_amount             NUMBER,
                                      v_narrative, --v_narrative          VARCHAR2,
                                      v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                      --v_acc_number         VARCHAR2,
                                      v_org_code, --v_acc_org_code        NUMBER,
                                      v_brh_code, --v_branch_code        NUMBER,
                                      'D',    --v_drcr               VARCHAR2,
                                      v_chq_dtls_rec);
            END IF;

            IF v_ref_type <> 'PL' OR v_unp_type IS NOT NULL
            THEN
                IF NVL (v_cont_acc_param, 'Y') = 'Y'
                THEN
                    v_gl_count := v_gl_count + 1;
                    interface_append_gl (v_trans_code, --v_trans_code        NUMBER,
                                         v_user, --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                                         v_pol_code, --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                                         v_prod_code, --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                                         v_ref, --v_vchr_no          VARCHAR2,
                                         NULL,   --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                                         NULL,   --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                                         NULL, --v_rcpt_no            VARCHAR2,
                                         v_gl_count, --v_gl_count             NUMBER,
                                         v_narrative,
                                         --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                                         v_net,  --v_amount            NUMBER,
                                         'D',  --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                                         v_trnt_gl_code,
                                         --v_acc_number          VARCHAR2,
                                         v_brh_code, --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                                         v_gl_trans); --v_trn_rec   IN OUT fms_tes
                ELSE
                    v_count := v_count + 1;
                    interface_append_chq (v_trans_code, --v_trans_code       NUMBER,
                                          v_user, --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                                          v_pol_code, --v_pol_code           NUMBER,
                                          v_prod_code, --v_prod_code          NUMBER,
                                          v_ref, --v_vchr_no           VARCHAR2,
                                          v_count, --v_count              NUMBER,
                                          v_net, --v_amount             NUMBER,
                                          v_narrative, --v_narrative          VARCHAR2,
                                          v_trnt_gl_code,
                                          --v_acc_number         VARCHAR2,
                                          v_org_code, --v_acc_org_code        NUMBER,
                                          v_brh_code, --v_branch_code        NUMBER,

            ELSE
                IF NVL (v_prem_amt, 0) != 0
                THEN

                            v_pol_code,          --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                            v_prod_code,         --v_prod_code         NUMBER,

                            NULL,                --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                            NULL,                --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,

                            'PREMIUM INCOME REFUND - ' || v_policy_no,
                            --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                            v_prem_amt,          --v_amount            NUMBER,
                            'D',               --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                            v_trnt_gl_code,
                            --v_acc_number          VARCHAR2,
                            v_brh_code,          --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                            v_gl_trans);          --v_trn_rec   IN OUT fms_tes
                    ELSE
                        v_count := v_count + 1;
                        interface_append_chq (
                            v_trans_code,         --v_trans_code       NUMBER,
                            v_user,            --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                            v_pol_code,         --v_pol_code           NUMBER,
                            v_prod_code,        --v_prod_code          NUMBER,
                            v_ref,             --v_vchr_no           VARCHAR2,
                            v_count,            --v_count              NUMBER,
                            v_prem_amt,         --v_amount             NUMBER,
                            'PREMIUM INCOME REFUND - ' || v_policy_no, --v_narrative          VARCHAR2,
                            v_trnt_gl_code,
                            --v_acc_number         VARCHAR2,
                            v_org_code,        --v_acc_org_code        NUMBER,
                            v_brh_code,         --v_branch_code        NUMBER,
                            'D',              --v_drcr               VARCHAR2,

                    END IF;
                END IF;

                IF NVL (v_invadmin_amt, 0) != 0
                THEN
                    get_gl_code ('INVADM',

                            v_trans_code,         --v_trans_code       NUMBER,
                            v_user,            --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                            v_pol_code,         --v_pol_code           NUMBER,
                            v_prod_code,        --v_prod_code          NUMBER,

                                     v_prod_code,
                                     v_trnt_code,
                                     v_trnt_gl_code,
                                     v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
                        valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                                   v_org_code,
                                   v_brh_code,
                                   'INVPREM');
                    END IF;

                    IF NVL (v_cont_acc_param, 'Y') = 'Y'
                    THEN

                        interface_append_gl (
                            v_trans_code,       --v_trans_code         NUMBER,
                            v_user,            --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                            v_pol_code,          --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                            v_prod_code,         --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                            v_ref,              --v_vchr_no          VARCHAR2,
                            NULL,                --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                            NULL,                --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                            NULL,             --v_rcpt_no            VARCHAR2,
                            v_gl_count,       --v_gl_count             NUMBER,
                            'INVESTMENT PREMIUM REFUND - ' || v_policy_no,
                            --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                            v_invprem_amt,       --v_amount            NUMBER,
                            'D',               --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,

                            v_pol_code,         --v_pol_code           NUMBER,
                            v_prod_code,        --v_prod_code          NUMBER,
                            v_ref,             --v_vchr_no           VARCHAR2,
                            v_count,            --v_count              NUMBER,
                            v_invprem_amt,      --v_amount             NUMBER,
                            'INVESTMENT PREMIUM REFUND - ' || v_policy_no, --v_narrative          VARCHAR2,

                THEN

                    THEN

                        interface_append_gl (
                            v_trans_code,       --v_trans_code         NUMBER,
                            v_user,            --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                            v_pol_code,          --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                            v_prod_code,         --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                            v_ref,              --v_vchr_no          VARCHAR2,
                            NULL,                --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                            NULL,                --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                            NULL,             --v_rcpt_no            VARCHAR2,
                            v_gl_count,       --v_gl_count             NUMBER,
                            'INVESTMENT FEE REFUND - ' || v_policy_no,
                            --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                            v_invfee_amt,        --v_amount            NUMBER,

                            v_user,            --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                            v_pol_code,         --v_pol_code           NUMBER,
                            v_prod_code,        --v_prod_code          NUMBER,
                            v_ref,             --v_vchr_no           VARCHAR2,
                            v_count,            --v_count              NUMBER,
                            v_invfee_amt,       --v_amount             NUMBER,
                            'INVESTMENT FEE REFUND  - ' || v_policy_no, --v_narrative          VARCHAR2,
