                            v_pol_code,         --v_pol_code           NUMBER,
                            v_prod_code,        --v_prod_code          NUMBER,
                            v_ref,             --v_vchr_no           VARCHAR2,
                            v_count,            --v_count              NUMBER,
                            v_compfnd_amt,      --v_amount             NUMBER,
                            'COMPENSATION FUND REFUND - ' || v_policy_no, --v_narrative          VARCHAR2,
                            v_trnt_gl_code,
                            --v_acc_number         VARCHAR2,
                            v_org_code,        --v_acc_org_code        NUMBER,
                            v_brh_code,         --v_branch_code        NUMBER,
                            'D',              --v_drcr               VARCHAR2,
                            v_chq_dtls_rec);
                    END IF;
                END IF;
            END IF;

            IF NVL (v_comm_amount, 0) != 0 AND v_refund_chk_chrg <> 'Y'
            THEN
                get_gl_code ('CHKC',
                             v_prod_code,
                             v_trnt_code,
                             v_trnt_gl_code,
                             v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
                valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                           v_org_code,
                           v_brh_code,
                           'CHKC');
                v_gl_count := v_gl_count + 1;
                interface_append_gl (
                    v_trans_code,               --v_trans_code         NUMBER,
                    v_user,                    --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                    v_pol_code,                  --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                    v_prod_code,                 --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                    v_ref,                      --v_vchr_no          VARCHAR2,
                    NULL,                        --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                    NULL,                        --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                    NULL,                      --v_rcpt_no           VARCHAR2,
                    v_gl_count,                  --v_count             NUMBER,
                    'CHECK OFF  RECOVERY  - ' || v_policy_no,
                    --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                    v_comm_amount,               --v_amount            NUMBER,
                    'C',                       --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                    v_trnt_gl_code,           --v_acc_number         VARCHAR2,
                    v_brh_code,                  --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                    v_gl_trans);
            END IF;
        END IF;

        IF NVL (v_gl_count, 0) > 0
        THEN
            v_gl_count := v_gl_count + 1;
            interface_append_gl (v_trans_code,  --v_trans_code         NUMBER,
                                 v_user,       --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                                 v_pol_code,     --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                                 v_prod_code,    --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                                 v_ref,         --v_vchr_no          VARCHAR2,
                                 NULL,           --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                                 NULL,           --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                                 NULL,         --v_rcpt_no           VARCHAR2,
                                 v_gl_count,     --v_count             NUMBER,
                                 v_narrative,  --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                                 v_net,          --v_amount            NUMBER,
                                 'C',          --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                                 v_contra_acc,
                                 --v_acc_number        VARCHAR2,
                                 v_brh_code,     --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                                 v_gl_trans);
        END IF;



        IF v_count != 0
        THEN
            interface_create_reqn (v_trans_code, --v_trans_code         NUMBER,
                                   v_ref,  --v_ref                   VARCHAR2,
                                   v_pol_code, --v_ref2                  VARCHAR2,
                                   TRUNC (SYSDATE), --v_ref_date              DATE,
                                   v_narrative, --v_narrative             VARCHAR2,
                                   v_net,    --v_amount                NUMBER,
                                   v_payee, --v_payee                 VARCHAR2,
                                   NVL (v_pay_method, 'CHQ'),
                                   --v_pay_method   VARCHAR2, --CHQ, EFT
                                   v_account_number, --v_payee_bank_acc_no        VARCHAR2,
                                   v_bbr_code, --v_payee_bank_branch_code   NUMBER,
                                   v_user, --v_source_auth_by        VARCHAR2,
                                   TRUNC (SYSDATE), --v_source_auth_dt        DATE,
                                   v_user, --v_raise_by                VARCHAR2,
                                   'REFUND', --v_pmt_type              VARCHAR2,
                                   NVL (v_processing_brn_code, v_brh_code),
                                   v_pol_code,                   --v_pol_code,
                                   v_chq_dtls_rec,
                                   NULL,
                                   NULL,
                                   NULL,
                                   NULL,
                                   NULL,
                                   v_mpt_code,
                                   v_clnt_id_passport_no,
                                   v_id_type);
        --v_dtls_table  IN OUT    Fms_Cheques_Pkg.type_rqn_dtls_table)
        END IF;

        --CREATE GL VOUCHER
        IF v_gl_trans.COUNT <> 0
        THEN
            --RAISE_ERROR('AM HERE=======');
            interface_update_vgl (v_trans_code,     --v_trans_code     NUMBER,
                                  v_user,      --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                                  v_pol_code,    --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                                  TRUNC (SYSDATE),    --v_date           DATE,
                                  NULL,          --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                                  NULL,          --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                                  v_jv_narrative, --v_btc_description   VARCHAR2,
                                  'JV',       --v_btc_type           VARCHAR2,
                                  v_brh_code,    --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                                  v_narrative, --v_description       VARCHAR2,
                                  NULL,        --v_rcpt_no           VARCHAR2,
                                  v_gl_trans);
        --v_gl_trans  IN OUT  TQ_FMS.Fms_Vouchers_Pkg.Tgl_rec_type,
        END IF;
    --   EXCEPTION
    --      WHEN OTHERS
    --      THEN
    --         raise_error ('Error processing refund..');
    END process_overpay_ref;

    PROCEDURE process_pension_pymt (
        v_clm_no           VARCHAR2,
        v_cpv_voucher_no   NUMBER,
        v_gross_amount     NUMBER,
        v_pay_method       VARCHAR2 DEFAULT 'CHQ'
    )
    IS
        v_chq_dtls_rec          fms_cheques_pkg.type_rqn_dtls_table;

        CURSOR c_clm_vch IS
            SELECT cpv_voucher_no,
                   cpv_date,
                   cpv_clm_no,
                   cpv_pol_code,
                   ROUND (cpv_amount, 2)     net_amount,
                   cpv_payee,
                   cpv_tran_type,
                   cpv_raise_by,
                   cpv_authorised_by,
                   cpv_authorised_dt,
                   clm_pol_policy_no,
                   cpv_payment_mode,
                   cpv_bbr_code,
                   cpv_bbr_acc_no,
                   cpv_tax_amt
              FROM lms_claims, lms_clm_payment_vouchers
             WHERE     cpv_clm_no = clm_no
                   AND cpv_clm_no = v_clm_no
                   AND cpv_voucher_no = v_cpv_voucher_no
                   AND cpv_authorised = 'N';

        v_brh_code              NUMBER;
        v_count                 NUMBER := 0;
        v_org_code              NUMBER;
        v_crt_acc_no            VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_sys_code              NUMBER;
        v_bct_code              NUMBER;
        v_bct_brh_code          NUMBER;
        v_cur_code              NUMBER;
        v_auth_by               NUMBER;
        v_trnt_type             VARCHAR2 (5);
        v_prod_code             NUMBER;
        v_trnt_code             VARCHAR2 (10);
        v_trnt_gl_code          VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_trnt_contra_gl_code   VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_raised_by             NUMBER;
        v_cla_type              VARCHAR2 (2);
        nparticipantamt         NUMBER := 0;
        v_claim_amt             NUMBER := 0;
        v_prem_drcr             VARCHAR2 (5) := 'C';
        v_narrative             VARCHAR2 (30);
        v_payee_eft_rec         fms_cheques_pkg.type_payee_eft_table;
        v_eft_enabled           VARCHAR2 (1) := 'N';
        v_bbr_code              NUMBER;
        v_account_number        VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_tax_amt               NUMBER;
        v_tot_amount            NUMBER;
        v_tax_param             VARCHAR2 (5);
        v_pol_code              NUMBER;
        v_trans_code            NUMBER;
        v_class                 VARCHAR2 (10);
    BEGIN
        BEGIN
            SELECT pol_bra_code,
                   cla_type,
                   pol_prod_code,
                   pol_code
              INTO v_brh_code,
                   v_cla_type,
                   v_prod_code,
                   v_pol_code
              FROM lms_policies, lms_classes
             WHERE     pol_code =
                       (SELECT DISTINCT clm_pol_code
                          FROM lms_clm_payment_vouchers, lms_claims
                         WHERE     cpv_clm_no = clm_no
                               AND cpv_clm_no = v_clm_no
                               AND cpv_voucher_no = v_cpv_voucher_no
                               AND cpv_authorised = 'N')
                   AND pol_cla_code = cla_code;
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND
            THEN
                raise_error ('POLICY REC NOT FOUND ' || v_clm_no);
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                raise_error ('GETTING POLICY REC');
        END;

        BEGIN
            lms_ord_misc.system_param_val ('CONSOLIDATE_CLAIM_TAX',
                                           v_tax_param);
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                raise_error ('PARAM ERROR...');
        END;

        SELECT    TO_NUMBER (TO_CHAR (SYSDATE, 'RRRR'))
               || lms_transaction_seq.NEXTVAL
          INTO v_trans_code
          FROM DUAL;

        FOR i IN c_clm_vch
        LOOP
            IF NVL (v_tax_param, 'N') <> 'Y'
            THEN
                v_tax_amt := i.cpv_tax_amt;
            END IF;

            IF NVL (v_gross_amount, 0) <> (NVL (i.net_amount, 0))
            THEN
                raise_error (
                       'GROSS AMT('
                    || NVL (v_gross_amount, 0)
                    || ') NOT EQUAL TO BREAKDOWN. NET '
                    || NVL (i.net_amount, 0));
            END IF;

            IF NVL (v_gross_amount, 0) = 0
            THEN
                raise_error ('NO AMOUNT TO PAY SPECIFIED..');
            END IF;

            v_org_code := fms_interfaces_pkg.get_org (v_brh_code);
            v_tot_amount := NVL (v_gross_amount, 0) + NVL (i.cpv_tax_amt, 0);

            IF NVL (v_tot_amount, 0) <> 0
            THEN
                get_gl_code ('CP_DA',
                             v_prod_code,
                             v_trnt_code,
                             v_crt_acc_no,
                             v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
                valid_acc (v_crt_acc_no,
                           v_org_code,
                           v_brh_code,
                           'CP_DA');
                v_count := v_count + 1;
                interface_append_chq (
                    v_trans_code,                  --v_trans_code      NUMBER,
                    i.cpv_raise_by,            --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                    v_pol_code,                 --v_pol_code           NUMBER,
                    v_prod_code,                --v_prod_code          NUMBER,
                    v_cpv_voucher_no,         --v_vchr_no            VARCHAR2,
                    v_count,                    --v_count              NUMBER,
                    v_tot_amount,               --v_amount             NUMBER,
                       'PENSION WITHDRAWAL ON '
                    || i.clm_pol_policy_no
                    || '-'
                    || v_clm_no,              --v_narrative          VARCHAR2,
                    v_crt_acc_no,             --v_acc_number         VARCHAR2,
                    v_org_code,               --v_acc_org_code         NUMBER,
                    v_brh_code,                 --v_branch_code        NUMBER,
                    'D',                      --v_drcr               VARCHAR2,
                    v_chq_dtls_rec);
            --v_trn_rec   IN OUT   Fms_Cheques_Pkg.Type_rqn_dtls_table)
            END IF;

            IF NVL (i.cpv_tax_amt, 0) <> 0
            THEN
                get_gl_code ('CLMTX',
                             v_prod_code,
                             v_trnt_code,
                             v_crt_acc_no,
                             v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
                valid_acc (v_crt_acc_no,
                           v_org_code,
                           v_brh_code,
                           'CLMTX');
                v_count := v_count + 1;
                interface_append_chq (
                    v_trans_code,                  --v_trans_code      NUMBER,
                    i.cpv_raise_by,            --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                    v_pol_code,                 --v_pol_code           NUMBER,
                    v_prod_code,                --v_prod_code          NUMBER,
                    v_cpv_voucher_no,         --v_vchr_no            VARCHAR2,
                    v_count,                    --v_count              NUMBER,
                    i.cpv_tax_amt,              --v_amount             NUMBER,
                    'PENSION TAX ' || i.clm_pol_policy_no || '-' || v_clm_no, --v_narrative          VARCHAR2,
                    v_crt_acc_no,             --v_acc_number         VARCHAR2,
                    v_org_code,               --v_acc_org_code         NUMBER,
                    v_brh_code,                 --v_branch_code        NUMBER,
                    'C',                      --v_drcr               VARCHAR2,
                    v_chq_dtls_rec);
            --v_trn_rec   IN OUT   Fms_Cheques_Pkg.Type_rqn_dtls_table)
            END IF;

            IF NVL (v_count, 0) <> 0
            THEN
                IF v_cla_type = 'O'
                THEN
                    v_class := 'CLM';
                ELSIF v_cla_type = 'G'
                THEN
                    v_class := 'CLMG';
                END IF;

                interface_create_reqn (v_trans_code,
                                       --v_trans_code         NUMBER,
                                       i.cpv_voucher_no,
                                       --v_ref                   VARCHAR2,
                                       i.cpv_clm_no,
                                       --v_ref2                  VARCHAR2,
                                       i.cpv_date, --v_ref_date              DATE,
                                       'PENSION PAYMENT',
                                       --v_narrative             VARCHAR2,
                                       i.net_amount,
                                       --v_amount                NUMBER,
                                       i.cpv_payee,
                                       --v_payee                 VARCHAR2,
                                       NVL (v_pay_method, 'CHQ'),
                                       --v_pay_method            VARCHAR2, --CHQ, EFT
                                       i.cpv_bbr_acc_no,
                                       --v_payee_bank_acc_no        VARCHAR2,
                                       i.cpv_bbr_code,
                                       --v_payee_bank_branch_code   NUMBER,
                                       i.cpv_authorised_by,
                                       --v_source_auth_by        VARCHAR2,
                                       i.cpv_authorised_dt,
                                       --v_source_auth_dt        DATE,
                                       i.cpv_raise_by,
                                       --v_raise_by                VARCHAR2,
                                       v_class,
                                       --v_pmt_type              VARCHAR2,
                                       v_brh_code,            --v_branch_code,
                                       v_pol_code,               --v_pol_code,
                                       v_chq_dtls_rec);
            --v_dtls_table  IN OUT Fms_Cheques_Pkg.Type_rqn_dtls_table);
            END IF;
        END LOOP;
    EXCEPTION
        WHEN OTHERS
        THEN
            raise_application_error (
                -20001,
                'CREATING CLAIM REQN. ' || SQLERRM (SQLCODE));
    END process_pension_pymt;

    PROCEDURE post_transfers (
        v_scenario             VARCHAR2,
        v_pol_code_from        NUMBER,
        v_pol_code_to          NUMBER,
        v_lna_no_from          NUMBER,
        v_lna_no_to            NUMBER,
        v_loan_interest_from   NUMBER,
        v_loan_interest_to     NUMBER,
        v_user_name            VARCHAR2,
        v_trans_from           VARCHAR2 DEFAULT 'UND',
        v_trans_to             VARCHAR2 DEFAULT 'UND',
        v_orig_opr_code        NUMBER,
        v_orig_oppr_code       NUMBER,
        v_opr_from             NUMBER,
        v_opr_to               NUMBER,
        v_oppr_from            NUMBER,
        v_oppr_to              NUMBER,
        v_ort_code             NUMBER,
        v_date                 DATE DEFAULT NULL,
        v_transfer_to_grp      VARCHAR2 DEFAULT NULL,
        v_grp_premium_to       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
        v_grp_pension_to       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
        v_trns_unproc_amt      NUMBER DEFAULT NULL
    )
    IS
        --    CURSOR Rcptfrom IS SELECT * FROM LMS_ORD_PREM_RECEIPTS
        --        WHERE OPR_CODE = v_opr_from;
        v_transfer            VARCHAR2 (1) := 'N';
        v_pol_from_brh_code   NUMBER;
        v_pol_to_brh_code     NUMBER;
        v_from_prod_code      NUMBER;
        v_to_prod_code        NUMBER;
        v_acc_type            VARCHAR2 (2) := 'D';
        v_count               NUMBER := 0;
        v_trnt_gl_code        VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_gl_acc_from         VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_gl_acc_to           VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_gl_trans            fms_vouchers_pkg.tgl_rec_type;
        v_trnt_code           VARCHAR2 (10);
        v_org_code            NUMBER;
        v_contra_acc          VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_description         VARCHAR2 (100);
        v_narration           VARCHAR2 (100);
        v_pol_no_from         VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_pol_no_to           VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_vgl_no              NUMBER;
        v_usercode            NUMBER;
        v_cur_code            NUMBER;
        v_itb_amount          NUMBER;
        v_loan_account_from   VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_loan_account_to     VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_premium_amt_from    NUMBER;
        v_premium_amt_to      NUMBER;
        v_loan_amt_from       NUMBER;
        v_loan_amt_to         NUMBER;
        v_loan_int_to         NUMBER := v_loan_interest_to;
        v_pension_amt_from    NUMBER;
        v_pension_amt_to      NUMBER;
        v_inv_fee_from        NUMBER;
        v_inv_fee_to          NUMBER;
        v_inv_contri_from     NUMBER;
        v_inv_contri_to       NUMBER;
        v_inv_admin_from      NUMBER;
        v_inv_admin_to        NUMBER;
        v_prod_type_from      VARCHAR2 (5);
        v_prod_type_to        VARCHAR2 (5);
        v_comfnd_from         NUMBER;
        v_comfnd_to           NUMBER;
        v_tot_from_inv        NUMBER;
        v_tot_to_inv          NUMBER;
        v_tot_from_rcpt       NUMBER;
        v_opr_amt             NUMBER;
        v_pol_status          VARCHAR2 (5);
        v_unprocessed_rcpts   NUMBER;
        v_alloc_from          VARCHAR2 (5);
        v_alloc_to            VARCHAR2 (5);
        v_trans_code          NUMBER;
        v_passpolcode         NUMBER;
        v_ppr_code_to         NUMBER;
        v_ppr_code_from       NUMBER;
        v_to_pol_code         NUMBER;
        v_from_pol_code       NUMBER;
        v_user                VARCHAR2 (30)
            := pkg_global_vars.get_pvarchar2 ('pkg_global_vars.pvg_username');
        v_post_param1         VARCHAR2 (5);
        v_post_param2         NUMBER;
        v_rct_code            VARCHAR2 (100);
    BEGIN
        IF v_user_name IS NULL
        THEN
            raise_error ('SESSION INACTIVE. PLEASE RE-LOG INTO SYSTEM');
        END IF;

        BEGIN
            SELECT param_value, INSTR (param_value2, v_scenario)
              INTO v_post_param1, v_post_param2
              FROM lms_parameters
             WHERE param_name = 'BLOCK_TRANSFERS_POSTING_TO_GL';
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                raise_error (
                    'Parameter error... "BLOCK_TRANSFERS_POSTING_TO_GL"....');
        END;

        IF NVL (v_post_param1, 'N') <> 'Y' AND NVL (v_post_param2, 0) > 0
        THEN
            IF v_opr_from IS NOT NULL
            THEN
                  --FOR R IN Rcptfrom LOOP
                  SELECT NVL (SUM (opr_loan_pymt_amt), 0),
                         NVL (SUM (premium_amt), 0),
                         NVL (SUM (pension_contr), 0),
                         NVL (SUM (investment_fee), 0),
                         NVL (SUM (investment_contri), 0),
                         NVL (SUM (investment_admin), 0),
                         NVL (SUM (opr_fund_client_contr), 0),
                         NVL (SUM (opr_amt), 0),
                         pol_prod_type,
                         MAX (opr_alloc_to),
                         MAX (opr_receipt_no)
                    INTO v_loan_amt_from,
                         v_premium_amt_from,
                         v_pension_amt_from,
                         v_inv_fee_from,
                         v_inv_contri_from,
                         v_inv_admin_from,
                         v_comfnd_from,
                         v_tot_from_rcpt,
                         v_prod_type_from,
                         v_alloc_from,
                         v_rct_code
                    FROM lms_ord_prem_receipts,
                         lms_policies,
                         (  SELECT opri_opr_code,
                                   NVL (SUM (opri_amt), 0)     premium_amt
                              FROM lms_ord_receipt_instlmnts
                          GROUP BY opri_opr_code),
                         (  SELECT pndpo_opr_code,
                                   NVL (SUM (pndpo_tot_amt), 0)
                                       pension_contr,
                                   NVL (SUM (pndpo_admin_fee), 0)
                                       investment_fee,
                                   NVL (SUM (pndpo_empye_amt), 0)
                                       investment_contri,
                                   NVL (SUM (pndpo_empyr_amt), 0)
                                       investment_admin
                              FROM lms_pension_deposits_ord
                          GROUP BY pndpo_opr_code)
                   WHERE     pol_code = opr_pol_code
                         AND opr_code = v_opr_from
                         AND opri_opr_code(+) = opr_code
                         AND pndpo_opr_code(+) = opr_code
                         AND opr_source = 'TRANSFER'
                GROUP BY pol_prod_type, pol_grp_life_rider;

                IF v_scenario LIKE 'UR_%'
                THEN
                    v_premium_amt_from := v_tot_from_rcpt;
                END IF;

                IF     v_scenario LIKE 'PL_%'
                   AND NVL (v_tot_from_rcpt, 0) >
                       (  NVL (v_premium_amt_from, 0)
                        + NVL (v_pension_amt_from, 0))
                THEN
                    IF     v_premium_amt_from > 0
                       AND NVL (v_pension_amt_from, 0) = 0
                    THEN
                        v_premium_amt_from := v_tot_from_rcpt;
                    ELSIF     NVL (v_pension_amt_from, 0) > 0
                          AND NVL (v_premium_amt_from, 0) = 0
                    THEN
                        v_pension_amt_from := v_tot_from_rcpt;
                        v_inv_contri_from :=
                              v_pension_amt_from
                            - NVL (v_inv_admin_from, 0)
                            - NVL (v_inv_fee_from, 0);
                    ELSIF v_premium_amt_from > 0 AND v_pension_amt_from > 0
                    THEN
                        IF v_prod_type_from IN ('IN', 'PN', 'AN')
                        THEN
                            v_pension_amt_from :=
                                v_tot_from_rcpt - v_premium_amt_from;
                            v_inv_contri_from :=
                                  v_pension_amt_from
                                - NVL (v_inv_admin_from, 0)
                                - NVL (v_inv_fee_from, 0);
                        ELSE
                            v_premium_amt_from :=
                                v_tot_from_rcpt - v_pension_amt_from;
                        END IF;
                    ELSIF v_prod_type_from IN ('IN', 'PN', 'AN')
                    THEN
                        v_pension_amt_from := v_tot_from_rcpt;
                        v_inv_contri_from :=
                              v_pension_amt_from
                            - NVL (v_inv_admin_from, 0)
                            - NVL (v_inv_fee_from, 0);
                    ELSE
                        v_premium_amt_from := v_tot_from_rcpt;
                    END IF;
                END IF;
            --END LOOP;
            END IF;

            v_alloc_from := NVL (v_alloc_from, 'PR');

            IF v_opr_to IS NOT NULL
            THEN
                  SELECT NVL (SUM (opr_loan_pymt_amt), 0),
                         NVL (SUM (premium_amt), 0),
                         NVL (SUM (pension_contr), 0),
                         DECODE (pol_prod_type,
                                 'IN', NVL (SUM (investment_fee), 0),
                                 'PN', NVL (SUM (investment_fee), 0),
                                 'AN', NVL (SUM (investment_fee), 0),
                                 NVL (opr_policy_fee, 0))    investment_fee,
                         NVL (SUM (investment_contri), 0),
                         NVL (SUM (investment_admin), 0),
                         NVL (SUM (opr_fund_client_contr), 0),
                         pol_prod_type,
                         pol_status,
                         opr_amt,
                         opr_alloc_to
                    INTO v_loan_amt_to,
                         v_premium_amt_to,
                         v_pension_amt_to,
                         v_inv_fee_to,
                         v_inv_contri_to,
                         v_inv_admin_to,
                         v_comfnd_to,
                         v_prod_type_to,
                         v_pol_status,
                         v_opr_amt,
                         v_alloc_to
                    FROM lms_ord_prem_receipts,
                         lms_policies,
                         (  SELECT opri_opr_code,
                                   NVL (SUM (opri_amt), 0)     premium_amt
                              FROM lms_ord_receipt_instlmnts
                          GROUP BY opri_opr_code),
                         (  SELECT pndpo_opr_code,
                                   NVL (SUM (pndpo_tot_amt), 0)
                                       pension_contr,
                                   NVL (SUM (pndpo_admin_fee), 0)
                                       investment_fee,
                                   NVL (SUM (pndpo_empye_amt), 0)
                                       investment_contri,
                                   NVL (SUM (pndpo_empyr_amt), 0)
                                       investment_admin
                              FROM lms_pension_deposits_ord
                          GROUP BY pndpo_opr_code)
                   WHERE     pol_code = opr_pol_code
                         AND opr_code = v_opr_to
                         AND opri_opr_code(+) = opr_code
                         AND pndpo_opr_code(+) = opr_code
                GROUP BY pol_prod_type,
                         pol_status,
                         opr_amt,
                         opr_alloc_to,
                         opr_policy_fee;
            END IF;

            v_tot_from_inv :=
                  NVL (v_loan_amt_from, 0)
                + NVL (v_premium_amt_from, 0)
                + NVL (v_inv_fee_from, 0)
                + NVL (v_inv_contri_from, 0)
                + NVL (v_inv_admin_from, 0)
                + NVL (v_comfnd_from, 0)
                + NVL (v_loan_interest_from, 0);
            v_tot_to_inv :=
                  NVL (v_loan_amt_to, 0)
                + NVL (v_premium_amt_to, 0)
                + NVL (v_inv_fee_to, 0)
                + NVL (v_inv_contri_to, 0)
                + NVL (v_inv_admin_to, 0)
                + NVL (v_comfnd_to, 0)
                + NVL (v_loan_int_to, 0);

            IF v_oppr_from IS NOT NULL
            THEN
                SELECT NVL (SUM (oppr_amt), 0)
                  INTO v_premium_amt_from
                  FROM lms_ord_proposal_rcpts
                 WHERE oppr_code = v_oppr_from;
            END IF;

            IF v_oppr_to IS NOT NULL
            THEN
                SELECT NVL (SUM (oppr_amt), 0)
                  INTO v_premium_amt_to
                  FROM lms_ord_proposal_rcpts
                 WHERE oppr_code = v_oppr_to;
            END IF;


            -- RAISE_ERROR('v_oppr_to='||v_oppr_to||';v_opr_FROM='||v_oppr_FROM||';v_pol_code_from='||v_pol_code_from||';v_pol_code_TO='||v_pol_code_TO);
            --raise_error('**'||v_scenario||'; FROM='||v_loan_amt_from||';'||v_premium_amt_from||';'||v_pension_amt_from||';'||v_inv_fee_from||';'||v_inv_contri_from||';'||v_inv_admin_from||';'||v_comfnd_from||';'||v_prod_type_from||';'||v_loan_interest_from||'; TO='||v_loan_amt_to||';'||v_premium_amt_to||';'||v_pension_amt_to||';'||v_inv_fee_to||';'||v_inv_contri_to||';'||v_inv_admin_to||';'||v_comfnd_to||';'||v_prod_type_to||';'||v_loan_int_to||';'||v_pol_status||';'||v_opr_amt);
            SELECT    TO_NUMBER (TO_CHAR (SYSDATE, 'RRRR'))
                   || lms_transaction_seq.NEXTVAL
              INTO v_trans_code
              FROM DUAL;

            IF NVL (v_trans_from, 'UND') != 'MKT'
            THEN
                BEGIN
                    IF v_lna_no_from IS NULL
                    THEN
                        SELECT pol_bra_code,
                               pol_prod_code,
                               DECODE (pol_type,
                                       'PL', pol_policy_no,
                                       'PR', pol_proposal_no),
                               NULL
                                   loan_acc_no,
                               pol_code
                          INTO v_pol_from_brh_code,
                               v_from_prod_code,
                               v_pol_no_from,
                               v_loan_account_from,
                               v_from_pol_code
                          FROM lms_policies, lms_proposers
                         WHERE     prp_code = pol_client_prp_code
                               AND pol_code = v_pol_code_from;
                    ELSE
                        SELECT pol_bra_code,
                               pol_prod_code,
                               DECODE (pol_type,
                                       'PL', pol_policy_no,
                                       'PR', pol_proposal_no),
                               DECODE (pln_loan_acc_no,
                                       NULL, NULL,
                                       ' (' || pln_loan_acc_no || ') ')
                                   loan_acc_no,
                               pol_code
                          INTO v_pol_from_brh_code,
                               v_from_prod_code,
                               v_pol_no_from,
                               v_loan_account_from,
                               v_from_pol_code
                          FROM lms_policies, lms_proposers, lms_policy_loans
                         WHERE     prp_code = pol_client_prp_code
                               AND pln_pol_code(+) = pol_code
                               AND pln_lna_no = v_lna_no_from
                               AND pol_code = v_pol_code_from;
                    END IF;

                    IF v_pol_no_from IS NULL
                    THEN
                        raise_error (
                               'UND FROM POL NO IS NULL ['
                            || v_pol_no_from
                            || ']['
                            || v_pol_code_from
                            || '].');
                    END IF;
                EXCEPTION
                    WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND
                    THEN
                        raise_error (
                               'UND POLICY FROM REC NOT FOUND '
                            || v_pol_code_from);
                    WHEN OTHERS
                    THEN
                        raise_error (
                            'GETTING UND POLICY FROM REC ' || v_pol_code_from);
                END;
            ELSE
                BEGIN
                    SELECT ppr_brn_code,
                           ppr_prod_code,
                           ppr_proposal_no,
                           NULL,
                           ppr_code
                      INTO v_pol_from_brh_code,
                           v_from_prod_code,
                           v_pol_no_from,
                           v_loan_account_from,
                           v_ppr_code_from
                      FROM lms_pol_proposals, lms_proposers
                     WHERE     prp_code = ppr_prp_code
                           AND ppr_code = v_pol_code_from;

                    IF v_pol_no_from IS NULL
                    THEN
                        raise_error (
                               'MKT FROM POL NO IS NULL ['
                            || v_pol_no_from
                            || ']['
                            || v_pol_code_from
                            || '].');
                    END IF;
                EXCEPTION
                    WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND
                    THEN
                        raise_error (
                               'MKT POLICY FROM REC NOT FOUND '
                            || v_pol_code_from);
                    WHEN OTHERS
                    THEN
                        raise_error (
                            'GETTING MKT POLICY FROM REC ' || v_pol_code_from);
                END;
            END IF;

            IF v_scenario NOT IN ('PL_UN', 'PR_UN')
            THEN
                IF NVL (v_trans_to, 'UND') != 'MKT'
                THEN
                    BEGIN
                        IF v_lna_no_to IS NULL
                        THEN
                            SELECT pol_bra_code,
                                   pol_prod_code,
                                   DECODE (pol_type,
                                           'PL', pol_policy_no,
                                           'PR', pol_proposal_no),
                                   NULL
                                       loan_acc_no,
                                   pol_code
                              INTO v_pol_to_brh_code,
                                   v_to_prod_code,
                                   v_pol_no_to,
                                   v_loan_account_to,
                                   v_to_pol_code
                              FROM lms_policies, lms_proposers
                             WHERE     prp_code = pol_client_prp_code
                                   AND pol_code = v_pol_code_to;
                        ELSE
                            SELECT pol_bra_code,
                                   pol_prod_code,
                                   DECODE (pol_type,
                                           'PL', pol_policy_no,
                                           'PR', pol_proposal_no),
                                   DECODE (pln_loan_acc_no,
                                           NULL, NULL,
                                           ' (' || pln_loan_acc_no || ') ')
                                       loan_acc_no,
                                   pol_code
                              INTO v_pol_to_brh_code,
                                   v_to_prod_code,
                                   v_pol_no_to,
                                   v_loan_account_to,
                                   v_to_pol_code
                              FROM lms_policies,
                                   lms_proposers,
                                   lms_policy_loans
                             WHERE     prp_code = pol_client_prp_code
                                   AND pln_pol_code(+) = pol_code
                                   AND pln_lna_no = v_lna_no_to
                                   AND pol_code = v_pol_code_to;
                        END IF;

                        IF v_pol_no_to IS NULL
                        THEN
                            raise_error (
                                   'UND TO POL NO IS NULL ['
                                || v_pol_no_to
                                || ']['
                                || v_pol_code_to
                                || '].');
                        END IF;
                    EXCEPTION
                        WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND
                        THEN
                            raise_error (
                                   'UND POLICY TO REC NOT FOUND '
                                || v_pol_code_to);
                        WHEN OTHERS
                        THEN
                            raise_error (
                                'GETTING UND POLICY TO REC ' || v_pol_code_to);
                    END;
                ELSE
                    BEGIN
                        SELECT ppr_brn_code,
                               ppr_prod_code,
                               ppr_proposal_no,
                               NULL,
                               ppr_code
                          INTO v_pol_to_brh_code,
                               v_to_prod_code,
                               v_pol_no_to,
                               v_loan_account_to,
                               v_ppr_code_to
                          FROM lms_pol_proposals, lms_proposers
                         WHERE     prp_code = ppr_prp_code
                               AND ppr_code = v_pol_code_to;

                        IF v_pol_no_to IS NULL
                        THEN
                            raise_error (
                                   'MKT TO POL NO IS NULL ['
                                || v_pol_no_to
                                || ']['
                                || v_pol_code_to
                                || '].');
                        END IF;
                    EXCEPTION
                        WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND
                        THEN
                            raise_error (
                                   'MKT POLICY TO REC NOT FOUND '
                                || v_pol_code_to);
                        WHEN OTHERS
                        THEN
                            raise_error (
                                'GETTING MKT POLICY TO REC ' || v_pol_code_to);
                    END;
                END IF;
            END IF;

            IF v_scenario IN ('PL_PL', 'PL_PR')
            THEN
                -- POLICY TO POLICY; PROPOSAL TO POLICY; POLICY TO PROPOSAL; PROPOSAL TO PROPOSAL; UNALLOCATED RECEIPT TO POLICY
                v_org_code :=
                    fms_interfaces_pkg.get_org (v_pol_from_brh_code);

                IF v_scenario = 'PL_PL'
                THEN
                    v_description := 'PREMIUM TRANSFER  POLICY TO POLICY';
                    v_narration := 'PREMIUM FROM ';
                ELSIF v_scenario = 'UR_PL'
                THEN
                    v_description :=
                        'PREMIUM TRANSFER  UNALLOCATED RCPT TO POLICY';
                    v_narration := 'UNPROCESSED PREM FROM ';
                ELSIF v_scenario = 'PR_PL'
                THEN
                    v_description := 'PREMIUM TRANSFER  PROPOSAL TO POLICY';
                    v_narration := 'PROPOSAL PREM FROM ';
                ELSIF v_scenario = 'PL_PR'
                THEN
                    v_description := 'PREMIUM TRANSFER  POLICY TO PROPOSAL';
                    v_narration := 'PREMIUM FROM ';
                ELSIF v_scenario = 'PR_PR'
                THEN
                    v_description := 'PREMIUM TRANSFER  PROPOSAL TO PROPOSAL';
                    v_narration := 'PROPOSAL PREM FROM ';
                END IF;


                IF v_scenario LIKE 'PL_%'
                THEN
                    get_gl_code ('UP',
                                 v_from_prod_code,
                                 v_trnt_code,
                                 v_gl_acc_from,
                                 v_contra_acc);
                    valid_acc (v_gl_acc_from,
                               v_org_code,
                               v_pol_from_brh_code,
                               v_scenario || ' FROM UP A/C');
                ELSIF v_scenario LIKE 'UR_%'
                THEN
                    get_gl_code ('UNP_' || v_alloc_from,
                                 v_from_prod_code,
                                 v_trnt_code,
                                 v_gl_acc_from,
                                 v_contra_acc);
                    valid_acc (
                        v_gl_acc_from,
                        v_org_code,
                        v_pol_from_brh_code,
                        v_scenario || ' FROM UNP_' || v_alloc_from || ' A/C');
                ELSIF v_scenario LIKE 'PR_%'
                THEN
                    get_gl_code ('PRRCT',
                                 v_from_prod_code,
                                 v_trnt_code,
                                 v_gl_acc_from,
                                 v_contra_acc);
                    valid_acc (v_gl_acc_from,
                               v_org_code,
                               v_pol_from_brh_code,
                               v_scenario || ' FROM PRRCT A/C');
                END IF;

                IF v_orig_opr_code IS NOT NULL
                THEN
                    SELECT SUM (
                                 NVL (
                                     DECODE (
                                         itb_acc_number,
                                         v_gl_acc_from,   DECODE (itb_drcr,
                                                                  'C', 1,
                                                                  -1)
                                                        * itb_amount),
                                     0)
                               + NVL (
                                     DECODE (
                                         itb_acc_number2,
                                         v_gl_acc_from,   DECODE (itb_drcr,
                                                                  'D', 1,
                                                                  -1)
                                                        * itb_amount),
                                     0))
                      INTO v_itb_amount
                      FROM lms_interface_table
                     WHERE itb_opr_code = v_orig_opr_code;
                ELSE
                    SELECT SUM (
                                 NVL (
                                     DECODE (
                                         itb_acc_number,
                                         v_gl_acc_from,   DECODE (itb_drcr,
                                                                  'C', 1,
                                                                  -1)
                                                        * itb_amount),
                                     0)
                               + NVL (
                                     DECODE (
                                         itb_acc_number2,
                                         v_gl_acc_from,   DECODE (itb_drcr,
                                                                  'D', 1,
                                                                  -1)
                                                        * itb_amount),
                                     0))
                      INTO v_itb_amount
                      FROM lms_interface_table
                     WHERE itb_oppr_code = v_orig_oppr_code;
                END IF;

                IF v_premium_amt_from > v_itb_amount
                THEN
                    IF v_scenario LIKE 'UR_%' AND v_itb_amount > 0.1
                    THEN
                        raise_error (
                               'Unallocate Premium amount  '
                            || v_premium_amt_from
                            || ' is more than the posting balance of '
                            || v_itb_amount
                            || ' for account '
                            || v_gl_acc_from);
                    ELSIF v_scenario LIKE 'PR_%' AND v_itb_amount > 0.1
                    THEN
                        raise_error (
                               'Proposal  amount  '
                            || v_premium_amt_from
                            || ' is more than the posting balance of '
                            || v_itb_amount
                            || ' for account '
                            || v_gl_acc_from);
                    ELSE
                        RETURN;
                    END IF;
                END IF;

                IF v_scenario LIKE '%_PL'
                THEN
                    v_unprocessed_rcpts :=
                        lms_process_receipts.rcpt_balance (v_opr_to);

                    IF NVL (v_unprocessed_rcpts, 0) <> 0
                    THEN
                        IF NVL (v_alloc_to, 'PR') = 'PR'
                        THEN
                            get_gl_code ('UNP_PR',
                                         v_to_prod_code,
                                         v_trnt_code,
                                         v_gl_acc_to,
                                         v_contra_acc);
                            valid_acc (v_gl_acc_to,
                                       v_org_code,
                                       v_pol_to_brh_code,
                                       v_scenario || ' TO UNP_PR A/C');
                        ELSIF v_alloc_to = 'LN'
                        THEN
                            get_gl_code ('UNP_LN',
                                         v_to_prod_code,
                                         v_trnt_code,
                                         v_gl_acc_to,
                                         v_contra_acc);
                            valid_acc (v_gl_acc_to,
                                       v_org_code,
                                       v_pol_to_brh_code,
                                       v_scenario || ' TO UNP_LN A/C');
                        ELSIF v_alloc_to = 'PN'
                        THEN
                            get_gl_code ('UNP_PN',
                                         v_to_prod_code,
                                         v_trnt_code,
                                         v_gl_acc_to,
                                         v_contra_acc);
                            valid_acc (v_gl_acc_to,
                                       v_org_code,
                                       v_pol_to_brh_code,
                                       v_scenario || ' TO UNP_PN A/C');
                        END IF;

                        v_count := v_count + 1;
                        interface_append_gl (
                            v_trans_code,     --v_trans_code           NUMBER,
                            v_user_name,       --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                            v_to_pol_code,       --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                            v_to_prod_code,      --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                            v_scenario,      --v_vchr_no             VARCHAR2,
                            v_opr_to,            --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                            v_oppr_to,           --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                            v_rct_code,      --v_rcpt_no             VARCHAR2,
                            v_count,             --v_count             NUMBER,
                               'UNPROCESSED PREM FROM '
                            || v_pol_no_from
                            || ' TO '
                            || v_pol_no_to,    --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                            v_unprocessed_rcpts, --v_amount            NUMBER,
                            'C',               --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                            v_gl_acc_to,    --v_acc_number           VARCHAR2,
                            v_pol_to_brh_code,   --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                            v_gl_trans,
                            --v_trn_rec   IN OUT Fms_Vouchers_Pkg.Tgl_rec_type
                            NULL,      --v_cad_code       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                            NULL,     --v_otop_code       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                            NULL,     --v_fpmt_code       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                            v_ort_code, --v_ort_code        NUMBER DEFAULT NULL)
                            NULL,        --  v_btr_no     NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                            v_ppr_code_to --v_ppr_code---    NUMBER DEFAULT NULL
                                         );
                    END IF;
                END IF;

                IF NVL (v_premium_amt_from, 0) <> 0
                THEN
                    IF v_scenario LIKE 'PL_%'
                    THEN
                        get_gl_code ('UP',
                                     v_from_prod_code,
                                     v_trnt_code,
                                     v_gl_acc_from,
                                     v_contra_acc);
                        valid_acc (v_gl_acc_from,
                                   v_org_code,
                                   v_pol_from_brh_code,
                                   v_scenario || ' FROM UP A/C');
                    ELSIF v_scenario LIKE 'UR_%'
                    THEN
                        get_gl_code ('UNP_PR',
                                     v_from_prod_code,
                                     v_trnt_code,
                                     v_gl_acc_from,
                                     v_contra_acc);
                        valid_acc (v_gl_acc_from,
                                   v_org_code,
                                   v_pol_from_brh_code,
                                   v_scenario || ' FROM UNP_PR A/C');
                    ELSIF v_scenario LIKE 'PR_%'
                    THEN
                        get_gl_code ('PRRCT',
                                     v_from_prod_code,
                                     v_trnt_code,
                                     v_gl_acc_from,
                                     v_contra_acc);
                        valid_acc (v_gl_acc_from,
                                   v_org_code,
                                   v_pol_from_brh_code,
                                   v_scenario || ' FROM PRRCT A/C');
                    END IF;

                    v_count := v_count + 1;

                    SELECT DECODE (NVL (v_trans_from, 'UND'),
                                   'MKT', NULL,
                                   v_pol_code_from)
                      INTO v_passpolcode
                      FROM DUAL;

                    interface_append_gl (
                        v_trans_code,
                        --v_trans_code           NUMBER,
                        v_user_name,
                        --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                        v_from_pol_code,
                        --v_pol_code_from, --v_pol_code
                        v_from_prod_code,
                        --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                        v_scenario,
                        --v_vchr_no             VARCHAR2,
                        v_opr_from,              --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                        v_oppr_from,             --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                        v_rct_code,          --v_rcpt_no             VARCHAR2,
                        v_count,                 --v_count             NUMBER,
                        v_narration || v_pol_no_from || ' TO ' || v_pol_no_to,
                        --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                        v_premium_amt_from,
                        --v_amount            NUMBER,
                        'D',                   --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                        v_gl_acc_from,
                        --v_acc_number           VARCHAR2,
                        v_pol_from_brh_code,
                        --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                        v_gl_trans,
                        --v_trn_rec   IN OUT Fms_Vouchers_Pkg.Tgl_rec_type
                        NULL,
                        --v_cad_code       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                        NULL,
                        --v_otop_code       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                        NULL,
                        --v_fpmt_code       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                        v_ort_code,
                        --v_ort_code        NUMBER DEFAULT NULL)
                        NULL,
                        v_ppr_code_from);                      -- v_ppr_code);
                END IF;

                IF NVL (v_premium_amt_to, 0) <> 0
                THEN
                    IF v_scenario LIKE '%_PL'
                    THEN
                        get_gl_code ('UP',
                                     v_to_prod_code,
                                     v_trnt_code,
                                     v_gl_acc_to,
                                     v_contra_acc);
                        valid_acc (v_gl_acc_to,
                                   v_org_code,
                                   v_pol_to_brh_code,
                                   v_scenario || ' TO UP A/C');
                    ELSIF v_scenario LIKE '%_PR'
                    THEN
                        get_gl_code ('PRRCT',
                                     v_to_prod_code,
                                     v_trnt_code,
                                     v_gl_acc_to,
                                     v_contra_acc);
                        valid_acc (v_gl_acc_to,
                                   v_org_code,
                                   v_pol_to_brh_code,
                                   v_scenario || ' TO PRRCT A/C');
                    END IF;

                    v_count := v_count + 1;

                    SELECT DECODE (NVL (v_trans_to, 'UND'),
                                   'MKT', NULL,
                                   v_pol_code_to)
                      INTO v_passpolcode
                      FROM DUAL;

                    interface_append_gl (
                        v_trans_code,
                        --v_trans_code           NUMBER,
                        v_user_name,
                        --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                        v_to_pol_code,
                        --v_passpolcode, --v_pol_code_to, --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                        v_to_prod_code,
                        --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                        v_scenario,
                        --v_vchr_no             VARCHAR2,
                        v_opr_to,                --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                        v_oppr_to,               --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                        v_rct_code,          --v_rcpt_no             VARCHAR2,
                        v_count,                 --v_count             NUMBER,
                           'PREMIUM FROM '
                        || v_pol_no_from
                        || ' TO '
                        || v_pol_no_to,
                        --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                        v_premium_amt_to,
                        --v_amount            NUMBER,
                        'C',                   --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                        v_gl_acc_to,
                        --v_acc_number           VARCHAR2,
                        v_pol_to_brh_code,
                        --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                        v_gl_trans,
                        --v_trn_rec   IN OUT Fms_Vouchers_Pkg.Tgl_rec_type
                        NULL,
                        --v_cad_code       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                        NULL,
                        --v_otop_code       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                        NULL,
                        --v_fpmt_code       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                        v_ort_code,
                        NULL,
                        v_ppr_code_to); --v_ort_code        NUMBER DEFAULT NULL)
                END IF;

                IF NVL (v_comfnd_from, 0) <> 0
                THEN
                    get_gl_code ('CMPFND',
                                 v_from_prod_code,
                                 v_trnt_code,
                                 v_gl_acc_from,
                                 v_contra_acc);
                    valid_acc (v_gl_acc_from,
                               v_org_code,
