                                v_pol_to_brh_code, --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                                v_gl_trans,
                                --v_trn_rec   IN OUT Fms_Vouchers_Pkg.Tgl_rec_type
                                NULL,  --v_cad_code       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                NULL, --v_otop_code       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                NULL, --v_fpmt_code       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                v_ort_code, --v_ort_code        NUMBER DEFAULT NULL)
                                NULL,
                                v_ppr_code_to);                   --v_ppr_code
                        END IF;
                    ELSE
                        get_gl_code ('PN',
                                     v_to_prod_code,
                                     v_trnt_code,
                                     v_gl_acc_to,
                                     v_contra_acc);
                        valid_acc (v_gl_acc_to,
                                   v_org_code,
                                   v_pol_to_brh_code,
                                   v_scenario || ' TO PN A/C');
                        v_count := v_count + 1;
                        interface_append_gl (
                            v_trans_code,     --v_trans_code           NUMBER,
                            v_user_name,       --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                            v_to_pol_code,       --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                            v_to_prod_code,      --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                            v_scenario,      --v_vchr_no             VARCHAR2,
                            v_opr_to,            --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                            v_oppr_to,           --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                            v_rct_code,      --v_rcpt_no             VARCHAR2,
                            v_count,             --v_count             NUMBER,
                               'PENSION PREM. FROM '
                            || v_pol_no_from
                            || ' TO '
                            || v_pol_no_to,    --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                            v_pension_amt_to,    --v_amount            NUMBER,
                            'C',               --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                            v_gl_acc_to,    --v_acc_number           VARCHAR2,
                            v_pol_to_brh_code,   --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                            v_gl_trans,
                            --v_trn_rec   IN OUT Fms_Vouchers_Pkg.Tgl_rec_type
                            NULL,      --v_cad_code       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                            NULL,     --v_otop_code       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                            NULL,     --v_fpmt_code       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                            v_ort_code, --v_ort_code        NUMBER DEFAULT NULL)
                            NULL,
                            v_ppr_code_to);                       --v_ppr_code
                    END IF;
                END IF;

                --Investment Fee
                IF NVL (v_inv_fee_to, 0) <> 0
                THEN
                    get_gl_code ('INVFEE',
                                 v_to_prod_code,
                                 v_trnt_code,
                                 v_gl_acc_to,
                                 v_contra_acc);
                    valid_acc (v_gl_acc_to,
                               v_org_code,
                               v_pol_to_brh_code,
                               v_scenario || ' TO INVFEE A/C');
                    v_count := v_count + 1;
                    interface_append_gl (
                        v_trans_code,         --v_trans_code           NUMBER,
                        v_user_name,           --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                        v_to_pol_code,           --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                        v_to_prod_code,          --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                        v_scenario,          --v_vchr_no             VARCHAR2,
                        v_opr_to,                --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                        v_oppr_to,               --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                        v_rct_code,          --v_rcpt_no             VARCHAR2,
                        v_count,                 --v_count             NUMBER,
                           'INV. FEE FROM '
                        || v_pol_no_from
                        || ' TO '
                        || v_pol_no_to,        --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                        NVL (v_inv_fee_to, 0),
                        --v_amount            NUMBER,
                        'C',                   --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                        v_gl_acc_to,        --v_acc_number           VARCHAR2,
                        v_pol_to_brh_code,       --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                        v_gl_trans,
                        --v_trn_rec   IN OUT Fms_Vouchers_Pkg.Tgl_rec_type
                        NULL,          --v_cad_code       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                        NULL,         --v_otop_code       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                        NULL,         --v_fpmt_code       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                        v_ort_code,
                        --v_ort_code        NUMBER DEFAULT NULL)
                        NULL,
                        v_ppr_code_to);                           --v_ppr_code
                END IF;


                IF v_count <= 1
                THEN
                    raise_error (
                           v_count
                        || ' TRANS NOT CREATED. P1 '
                        || NVL (v_premium_amt_from, 0)
                        || ' P2 '
                        || NVL (v_premium_amt_to, 0)
                        || ' L1 '
                        || NVL (v_loan_amt_from, 0)
                        || ' L2 '
                        || NVL (v_loan_amt_to, 0)
                        || ' PN1 '
                        || NVL (v_pension_amt_from, 0)
                        || ' PN2 '
                        || NVL (v_pension_amt_to, 0)
                        || ' UNP2 '
                        || NVL (v_unprocessed_rcpts, 0));
                END IF;
            ELSIF v_scenario IN ('PR_UN', 'PL_UN')
            THEN
                v_count := -1;
                v_org_code :=
                    fms_interfaces_pkg.get_org (v_pol_from_brh_code);

                IF v_scenario = 'PR_UN'
                THEN
                    v_description := 'PREMIUM TRANSFER  PROPOSAL TO UNALLOC';
                ELSIF v_scenario = 'PL_UN'
                THEN
                    v_description := 'PREMIUM TRANSFER  POLICY TO UNALLOC';
                END IF;

                v_gl_acc_to :=
                    fms_interfaces_pkg.sl_control_acc ('LMS',
                                                       'D',
                                                       'OLIFE-UA');
                valid_acc (v_gl_acc_to,
                           v_org_code,
                           v_pol_from_brh_code,
                           v_scenario || ' TO A/C');

                IF NVL (v_premium_amt_from, 0) <> 0
                THEN
                    IF v_scenario = 'PL_UN'
                    THEN
                        get_gl_code ('UP',
                                     v_from_prod_code,
                                     v_trnt_code,
                                     v_gl_acc_from,
                                     v_contra_acc);
                        valid_acc (v_gl_acc_from,
                                   v_org_code,
                                   v_pol_from_brh_code,
                                   v_scenario || ' FROM UP A/C');
                    ELSIF v_scenario = 'PR_UN'
                    THEN
                        get_gl_code ('PRRCT',
                                     v_from_prod_code,
                                     v_trnt_code,
                                     v_gl_acc_from,
                                     v_contra_acc);
                        valid_acc (v_gl_acc_from,
                                   v_org_code,
                                   v_pol_from_brh_code,
                                   v_scenario || ' FROM PRRCT A/C');
                    END IF;

                    v_count := v_count + 2;
                    interface_append_gl (
                        v_trans_code,
                        --v_trans_code           NUMBER,
                        v_user_name,
                        --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                        v_from_pol_code,
                        --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                        v_from_prod_code,
                        --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                        v_scenario,
                        --v_vchr_no             VARCHAR2,
                        v_opr_from,              --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                        v_oppr_from,             --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                        v_rct_code,          --v_rcpt_no             VARCHAR2,
                        v_count,                 --v_count             NUMBER,
                        'PREMIUM FROM ' || v_pol_no_from || ' TO UNALLOC',
                        --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                        v_premium_amt_from,
                        --v_amount            NUMBER,
                        'D',                   --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                        v_gl_acc_from,
                        --v_acc_number1           VARCHAR2,
                        v_gl_acc_to,
                        --v_acc_number2           VARCHAR2,
                        v_pol_from_brh_code,
                        --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                        v_gl_trans,
                        --v_trn_rec   IN OUT Fms_Vouchers_Pkg.Tgl_rec_type
                        NULL,
                        --v_cad_code       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                        NULL,
                        --v_otop_code       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                        NULL,
                        --v_fpmt_code       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                        v_ort_code,
                        --v_ort_code        NUMBER DEFAULT NULL)
                        NULL,
                        v_ppr_code_from);                         --v_ppr_code
                END IF;

                IF NVL (v_comfnd_from, 0) <> 0
                THEN
                    get_gl_code ('CMPFND',
                                 v_from_prod_code,
                                 v_trnt_code,
                                 v_gl_acc_from,
                                 v_contra_acc);
                    valid_acc (v_gl_acc_from,
                               v_org_code,
                               v_pol_from_brh_code,
                               v_scenario || ' FROM CMPFND A/C');
                    v_count := v_count + 2;
                    interface_append_gl (
                        v_trans_code,
                        --v_trans_code           NUMBER,
                        v_user_name,
                        --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                        v_from_pol_code,
                        --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                        v_from_prod_code,
                        --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                        v_scenario,
                        --v_vchr_no             VARCHAR2,
                        v_opr_from,              --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                        v_oppr_from,             --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                        v_rct_code,          --v_rcpt_no             VARCHAR2,
                        v_count,                 --v_count             NUMBER,
                        'PHCF FROM ' || v_pol_no_from || ' TO UNALLOC',
                        --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                        v_comfnd_from,
                        --v_amount            NUMBER,
                        'D',                   --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                        v_gl_acc_from,
                        --v_acc_number1           VARCHAR2,
                        v_gl_acc_to,
                        --v_acc_number2           VARCHAR2,
                        v_pol_from_brh_code,
                        --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                        v_gl_trans,
                        --v_trn_rec   IN OUT Fms_Vouchers_Pkg.Tgl_rec_type
                        NULL,
                        --v_cad_code       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                        NULL,
                        --v_otop_code       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                        NULL,
                        --v_fpmt_code       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                        v_ort_code,
                        --v_ort_code        NUMBER DEFAULT NULL)
                        NULL,
                        v_ppr_code_from);                         --v_ppr_code
                END IF;

                IF NVL (v_loan_amt_from, 0) <> 0
                THEN
                    get_gl_code ('NL',
                                 v_from_prod_code,
                                 v_trnt_code,
                                 v_gl_acc_from,
                                 v_contra_acc);
                    valid_acc (v_gl_acc_from,
                               v_org_code,
                               v_pol_from_brh_code,
                               v_scenario || ' FROM NL A/C');
                    v_count := v_count + 2;
                    interface_append_gl (
                        v_trans_code,
                        --v_trans_code           NUMBER,
                        v_user_name,
                        --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                        v_from_pol_code,
                        --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                        v_from_prod_code,
                        --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                        v_scenario,
                        --v_vchr_no             VARCHAR2,
                        v_opr_from,              --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                        v_oppr_from,             --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                        v_rct_code,          --v_rcpt_no             VARCHAR2,
                        v_count,                 --v_count             NUMBER,
                        'LOAN FROM ' || v_pol_no_from || ' TO UNALLOC',
                        --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                        v_loan_amt_from,
                        --v_amount            NUMBER,
                        'D',                   --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                        v_gl_acc_from,
                        --v_acc_number1           VARCHAR2,
                        v_gl_acc_to,
                        --v_acc_number2           VARCHAR2,
                        v_pol_from_brh_code,
                        --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                        v_gl_trans,
                        --v_trn_rec   IN OUT Fms_Vouchers_Pkg.Tgl_rec_type
                        NULL,
                        --v_cad_code       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                        NULL,
                        --v_otop_code       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                        NULL,
                        --v_fpmt_code       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                        v_ort_code,
                        --v_ort_code        NUMBER DEFAULT NULL)
                        NULL,
                        v_ppr_code_from);                         --v_ppr_code
                END IF;

                IF NVL (v_pension_amt_from, 0) <> 0
                THEN
                    IF NVL (v_prod_type_from, 'PN') IN ('IN', 'AN')
                    THEN
                        --Investment Administration
                        IF NVL (v_inv_admin_from, 0) <> 0
                        THEN
                            get_gl_code ('INVADM',
                                         v_from_prod_code,
                                         v_trnt_code,
                                         v_gl_acc_from,
                                         v_contra_acc);
                            valid_acc (v_gl_acc_from,
                                       v_org_code,
                                       v_pol_from_brh_code,
                                       v_scenario || ' FROM INVADM A/C');
                            v_count := v_count + 2;
                            interface_append_gl (
                                v_trans_code,
                                --v_trans_code           NUMBER,
                                v_user_name,
                                --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                                v_from_pol_code,
                                --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                                v_from_prod_code,
                                --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                                v_scenario,
                                --v_vchr_no             VARCHAR2,
                                v_opr_from,      --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                                v_oppr_from,     --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                                v_rct_code,
                                --v_rcpt_no             VARCHAR2,
                                v_count,
                                   --v_count             NUMBER,
                                   'INV. ADM. FROM '
                                || v_pol_no_from
                                || ' TO UNALLOC',
                                --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                                NVL (v_inv_admin_from, 0),
                                --v_amount            NUMBER,
                                'D',           --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                                v_gl_acc_from,
                                --v_acc_number1           VARCHAR2,
                                v_gl_acc_to,
                                --v_acc_number2           VARCHAR2,
                                v_pol_from_brh_code,
                                --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                                v_gl_trans,
                                --v_trn_rec   IN OUT Fms_Vouchers_Pkg.Tgl_rec_type
                                NULL,
                                --v_cad_code       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                NULL,
                                --v_otop_code       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                NULL,
                                --v_fpmt_code       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                v_ort_code,
                                --v_ort_code        NUMBER DEFAULT NULL)
                                NULL,
                                v_ppr_code_from);                 --v_ppr_code
                        END IF;

                        --Investment Fee
                        IF NVL (v_inv_fee_from, 0) <> 0
                        THEN
                            get_gl_code ('INVFEE',
                                         v_from_prod_code,
                                         v_trnt_code,
                                         v_gl_acc_from,
                                         v_contra_acc);
                            valid_acc (v_gl_acc_from,
                                       v_org_code,
                                       v_pol_from_brh_code,
                                       v_scenario || ' FROM INVFEE A/C');
                            v_count := v_count + 2;
                            interface_append_gl (
                                v_trans_code,
                                --v_trans_code           NUMBER,
                                v_user_name,
                                --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                                v_from_pol_code,
                                --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                                v_from_prod_code,
                                --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                                v_scenario,
                                --v_vchr_no             VARCHAR2,
                                v_opr_from,      --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                                v_oppr_from,     --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                                v_rct_code,
                                --v_rcpt_no             VARCHAR2,
                                v_count,
                                   --v_count             NUMBER,
                                   'INV. FEE FROM '
                                || v_pol_no_from
                                || ' TO UNALLOC',
                                --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                                NVL (v_inv_fee_from, 0),
                                --v_amount            NUMBER,
                                'D',           --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                                v_gl_acc_from,
                                --v_acc_number1           VARCHAR2,
                                v_gl_acc_to,
                                --v_acc_number2           VARCHAR2,
                                v_pol_from_brh_code,
                                --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                                v_gl_trans,
                                --v_trn_rec   IN OUT Fms_Vouchers_Pkg.Tgl_rec_type
                                NULL,
                                --v_cad_code       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                NULL,
                                --v_otop_code       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                NULL,
                                --v_fpmt_code       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                v_ort_code,
                                --v_ort_code        NUMBER DEFAULT NULL)
                                NULL,
                                v_ppr_code_from);
                        END IF;

                        --Investment Premium
                        IF NVL (v_inv_contri_from, 0) <> 0
                        THEN
                            get_gl_code ('INVPREM',
                                         v_from_prod_code,
                                         v_trnt_code,
                                         v_gl_acc_from,
                                         v_contra_acc);
                            valid_acc (v_gl_acc_from,
                                       v_org_code,
                                       v_pol_from_brh_code,
                                       v_scenario || ' FROM INVPREM A/C');
                            v_count := v_count + 2;
                            interface_append_gl (
                                v_trans_code, --v_trans_code           NUMBER,
                                v_user_name,   --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                                v_from_pol_code, --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                                v_from_prod_code, --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                                v_scenario,  --v_vchr_no             VARCHAR2,
                                v_opr_from,      --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                                v_oppr_from,     --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                                v_rct_code,  --v_rcpt_no             VARCHAR2,
                                v_count,         --v_count             NUMBER,
                                   'INV. CONTRI. FROM '
                                || v_pol_no_from
                                || ' TO UNALLOC', --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                                NVL (v_inv_contri_from, 0),
                                --v_amount            NUMBER,
                                'D',           --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                                v_gl_acc_from, --v_acc_number1           VARCHAR2,
                                v_gl_acc_to, --v_acc_number2           VARCHAR2,
                                v_pol_from_brh_code, --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                                v_gl_trans,
                                --v_trn_rec   IN OUT Fms_Vouchers_Pkg.Tgl_rec_type
                                NULL,  --v_cad_code       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                NULL, --v_otop_code       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                NULL, --v_fpmt_code       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                v_ort_code, --v_ort_code        NUMBER DEFAULT NULL)
                                NULL,
                                v_ppr_code_from);
                        END IF;
                    ELSE
                        get_gl_code ('PN',
                                     v_from_prod_code,
                                     v_trnt_code,
                                     v_gl_acc_from,
                                     v_contra_acc);
                        valid_acc (v_gl_acc_from,
                                   v_org_code,
                                   v_pol_from_brh_code,
                                   v_scenario || ' FROM PN A/C');
                        v_count := v_count + 1;
                        interface_append_gl (
                            v_trans_code,
                            --v_trans_code           NUMBER,
                            v_user_name,
                            --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                            v_from_pol_code,
                            --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                            v_from_prod_code,
                            --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                            v_scenario,
                            --v_vchr_no             VARCHAR2,
                            v_opr_from,          --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                            v_oppr_from,         --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                            v_rct_code,      --v_rcpt_no             VARCHAR2,
                            v_count,             --v_count             NUMBER,
                               'PENSION PREM. FROM '
                            || v_pol_no_from
                            || ' TO UNALLOC',
                            --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                            v_pension_amt_from,
                            --v_amount            NUMBER,
                            'D',               --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                            v_gl_acc_from,
                            --v_acc_number1           VARCHAR2,
                            v_gl_acc_to,
                            --v_acc_number2           VARCHAR2,
                            v_pol_from_brh_code,
                            --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                            v_gl_trans,
                            --v_trn_rec   IN OUT Fms_Vouchers_Pkg.Tgl_rec_type
                            NULL,
                            --v_cad_code       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                            NULL,
                            --v_otop_code       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                            NULL,
                            --v_fpmt_code       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                            v_ort_code,
                            --v_ort_code        NUMBER DEFAULT NULL)
                            NULL,
                            v_ppr_code_from);
                    END IF;
                END IF;
            ELSIF v_scenario IN ('UR_PL',
                                 'UR_PR',
                                 'PR_PL',
                                 'PR_PR')
            THEN
                IF v_scenario LIKE 'UR_%'
                THEN
                    get_gl_code ('UNP_' || v_alloc_from,
                                 v_from_prod_code,
                                 v_trnt_code,
                                 v_gl_acc_from,
                                 v_contra_acc);
                    valid_acc (
                        v_gl_acc_from,
                        v_org_code,
                        v_pol_from_brh_code,
                        v_scenario || ' FROM UNP_' || v_alloc_from || ' A/C');
                ELSIF v_scenario LIKE 'PR_%'
                THEN
                    get_gl_code ('PRRCT',
                                 v_from_prod_code,
                                 v_trnt_code,
                                 v_gl_acc_from,
                                 v_contra_acc);
                    valid_acc (v_gl_acc_from,
                               v_org_code,
                               v_pol_from_brh_code,
                               v_scenario || ' FROM PRRCT A/C');
                END IF;

                IF v_orig_opr_code IS NOT NULL
                THEN
                    SELECT SUM (
                                 NVL (
                                     DECODE (
                                         itb_acc_number,
                                         v_gl_acc_from,   DECODE (itb_drcr,
                                                                  'C', 1,
                                                                  -1)
                                                        * itb_amount),
                                     0)
                               + NVL (
                                     DECODE (
                                         itb_acc_number2,
                                         v_gl_acc_from,   DECODE (itb_drcr,
                                                                  'D', 1,
                                                                  -1)
                                                        * itb_amount),
                                     0))
                      INTO v_itb_amount
                      FROM lms_interface_table
                     WHERE itb_opr_code = v_orig_opr_code;
                ELSE
                    SELECT SUM (
                                 NVL (
                                     DECODE (
                                         itb_acc_number,
                                         v_gl_acc_from,   DECODE (itb_drcr,
                                                                  'C', 1,
                                                                  -1)
                                                        * itb_amount),
                                     0)
                               + NVL (
                                     DECODE (
                                         itb_acc_number2,
                                         v_gl_acc_from,   DECODE (itb_drcr,
                                                                  'D', 1,
                                                                  -1)
                                                        * itb_amount),
                                     0))
                      INTO v_itb_amount
                      FROM lms_interface_table
                     WHERE itb_oppr_code = v_orig_oppr_code;
                END IF;

                v_unprocessed_rcpts :=
                    lms_process_receipts.rcpt_balance (v_opr_to);

                IF     v_oppr_to IS NOT NULL
                   AND v_premium_amt_from > v_premium_amt_to
                THEN
                    v_premium_amt_from := v_premium_amt_to;
                ELSIF v_opr_amt > 0 AND v_premium_amt_from > v_opr_amt
                THEN
                    v_premium_amt_from := v_opr_amt;
                END IF;

                IF v_premium_amt_from > v_itb_amount
                THEN
                    v_itb_amount := ROUND (v_itb_amount, 2);

                    IF v_itb_amount < 0.1
                    THEN
                        RETURN;
                    ELSIF v_premium_amt_from = v_premium_amt_to
                    THEN
                        v_premium_amt_from := v_itb_amount;
                        v_premium_amt_to := v_itb_amount;
                    ELSIF v_premium_amt_from = v_unprocessed_rcpts
                    THEN
                        v_premium_amt_from := v_itb_amount;
                        v_unprocessed_rcpts := v_itb_amount;
                        v_premium_amt_to := 0;
                        v_inv_contri_to := 0;
                        v_inv_admin_to := 0;
                        v_inv_fee_to := 0;
                        v_loan_int_to := 0;
                        v_loan_amt_to := 0;
                    ELSE
                        v_premium_amt_from := v_itb_amount;

                        IF v_unprocessed_rcpts > 0
                        THEN
                            v_unprocessed_rcpts :=
                                ROUND (
                                    LEAST (v_unprocessed_rcpts, v_itb_amount),
                                    2);
                            v_itb_amount :=
                                v_itb_amount - v_unprocessed_rcpts;
                            v_premium_amt_to := 0;
                            v_inv_contri_to := 0;
                            v_inv_admin_to := 0;
                            v_inv_fee_to := 0;
                            v_loan_int_to := 0;
                            v_loan_amt_to := 0;
                        END IF;

                        IF v_premium_amt_to > 0
                        THEN
                            v_premium_amt_to :=
                                ROUND (
                                    LEAST (v_premium_amt_to, v_itb_amount),
                                    2);
                            v_itb_amount := v_itb_amount - v_premium_amt_to;
                            v_inv_contri_to := 0;
                            v_inv_admin_to := 0;
                            v_inv_fee_to := 0;
                            v_loan_int_to := 0;
                            v_loan_amt_to := 0;
                        END IF;

                        IF v_itb_amount > 0 AND v_inv_contri_to > 0
                        THEN
                            v_inv_contri_to :=
                                ROUND (LEAST (v_inv_contri_to, v_itb_amount),
                                       2);
                            v_itb_amount := v_itb_amount - v_inv_contri_to;
                            v_loan_amt_to := 0;
                            v_inv_fee_to := 0;
                            v_inv_admin_to := 0;
                            v_loan_int_to := 0;
                        END IF;

                        IF v_itb_amount > 0 AND v_inv_admin_to > 0
                        THEN
                            v_inv_admin_to :=
                                ROUND (LEAST (v_inv_admin_to, v_itb_amount),
                                       2);
                            v_itb_amount := v_itb_amount - v_inv_admin_to;
                            v_loan_amt_to := 0;
                            v_inv_fee_to := 0;
                            v_loan_int_to := 0;
                        END IF;

                        IF v_itb_amount > 0 AND v_inv_fee_to > 0
                        THEN
                            v_inv_fee_to :=
                                ROUND (LEAST (v_inv_fee_to, v_itb_amount), 2);
                            v_itb_amount := v_itb_amount - v_inv_fee_to;
                            v_loan_amt_to := 0;
                            v_loan_int_to := 0;
                        END IF;

                        IF v_itb_amount > 0 AND v_loan_int_to > 0
                        THEN
                            v_loan_int_to :=
                                ROUND (LEAST (v_loan_int_to, v_itb_amount),
                                       2);
                            v_itb_amount := v_itb_amount - v_loan_int_to;
                            v_loan_amt_to := 0;
                        END IF;

                        IF v_itb_amount > 0 AND v_loan_amt_to > 0
                        THEN
                            v_loan_amt_to :=
                                ROUND (LEAST (v_loan_amt_to, v_itb_amount),
                                       2);
                            v_itb_amount := v_itb_amount - v_loan_amt_to;
                        END IF;

                        IF v_scenario LIKE 'UR_%' AND v_itb_amount > 0
                        THEN
                            raise_error (
                                   'Unallocate Premium amount  '
                                || v_premium_amt_from
                                || ' is more than the posting balance of '
                                || v_itb_amount
                                || ' for account '
                                || v_gl_acc_from);
                        ELSIF v_scenario LIKE 'PR_%' AND v_itb_amount > 0
                        THEN
                            raise_error (
                                   'Proposal  amount  '
                                || v_premium_amt_from
                                || ' is more than the posting balance of '
                                || v_itb_amount
                                || ' for account '
                                || v_gl_acc_from);
                        END IF;
                    END IF;
                END IF;

                IF v_scenario = 'UR_PL'
                THEN
                    v_description :=
                        'PREMIUM TRANSFER  UNALLOCATED RCPT TO POLICY';
                    v_narration := 'UNPROCESSED PREM FROM ';
                ELSIF v_scenario = 'UR_PR'
                THEN
                    v_description :=
                        'PREMIUM TRANSFER  UNALLOCATED RCPT TO PROPOSAL';
                    v_narration := 'UNPROCESSED PREM FROM ';
                ELSIF v_scenario = 'PR_PL'
                THEN
                    v_description := 'PREMIUM TRANSFER  PROPOSAL TO POLICY';
                    v_narration := 'PROPOSAL PREM FROM ';
                ELSIF v_scenario = 'PR_PR'
                THEN
                    v_description := 'PREMIUM TRANSFER  PROPOSAL TO PROPOSAL';
                    v_narration := 'PROPOSAL PREM FROM ';
                END IF;

                v_org_code :=
                    fms_interfaces_pkg.get_org (v_pol_from_brh_code);



                IF NVL (v_premium_amt_from, 0) <> 0
                THEN
                    get_gl_code ('UNP_PR',
                                 v_from_prod_code,
                                 v_trnt_code,
                                 v_gl_acc_from,
                                 v_contra_acc);
                    valid_acc (v_gl_acc_from,
                               v_org_code,
                               v_pol_from_brh_code,
                               v_scenario || ' FROM UNP_PR A/C');
                    v_count := v_count + 1;
                    interface_append_gl (
                        v_trans_code,         --v_trans_code           NUMBER,
                        v_user_name,           --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                        v_from_pol_code,         --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                        v_from_prod_code,        --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                        v_scenario,          --v_vchr_no             VARCHAR2,
                        v_opr_from,              --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                        v_oppr_from,             --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                        v_rct_code,          --v_rcpt_no             VARCHAR2,
                        v_count,                 --v_count             NUMBER,
                        v_narration || v_pol_no_from || ' TO ' || v_pol_no_to, --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                        v_premium_amt_from,      --v_amount            NUMBER,
                        'D',                   --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                        v_gl_acc_from,      --v_acc_number           VARCHAR2,
                        v_pol_from_brh_code,     --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                        v_gl_trans,
                        --v_trn_rec   IN OUT Fms_Vouchers_Pkg.Tgl_rec_type
                        NULL,          --v_cad_code       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                        NULL,         --v_otop_code       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                        NULL,         --v_fpmt_code       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                        v_ort_code,   --v_ort_code        NUMBER DEFAULT NULL)
                        NULL,            --  v_btr_no     NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                        v_ppr_code_from --v_ppr_code---    NUMBER DEFAULT NULL
                                       );
                END IF;

                --raise_error(v_alloc_to);
                IF NVL (v_unprocessed_rcpts, 0) <> 0
                THEN
                    IF NVL (v_alloc_to, 'PR') = 'PR'
                    THEN
                        get_gl_code ('UNP_PR',
                                     v_to_prod_code,
                                     v_trnt_code,
                                     v_gl_acc_to,
                                     v_contra_acc);
                        valid_acc (v_gl_acc_to,
                                   v_org_code,
                                   v_pol_to_brh_code,
                                   v_scenario || ' TO UNP_PR A/C');
                    ELSIF v_alloc_to = 'LN'
                    THEN
                        get_gl_code ('UNP_LN',
                                     v_to_prod_code,
                                     v_trnt_code,
                                     v_gl_acc_to,
                                     v_contra_acc);
                        valid_acc (v_gl_acc_to,
                                   v_org_code,
                                   v_pol_to_brh_code,
                                   v_scenario || ' TO UNP_LN A/C');
                    ELSIF v_alloc_to = 'PN'
                    THEN
                        get_gl_code ('UNP_PN',
                                     v_to_prod_code,
                                     v_trnt_code,
                                     v_gl_acc_to,
                                     v_contra_acc);
                        valid_acc (v_gl_acc_to,
                                   v_org_code,
                                   v_pol_to_brh_code,
                                   v_scenario || ' TO UNP_PN A/C');
                    END IF;

                    v_count := v_count + 1;
                    interface_append_gl (
                        v_trans_code,         --v_trans_code           NUMBER,
                        v_user_name,           --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                        v_to_pol_code,           --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                        v_to_prod_code,          --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                        v_scenario,          --v_vchr_no             VARCHAR2,
                        v_opr_to,                --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                        v_oppr_to,               --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                        v_rct_code,          --v_rcpt_no             VARCHAR2,
                        v_count,                 --v_count             NUMBER,
                           'UNPROCESSED PREM FROM '
                        || v_pol_no_from
                        || ' TO '
                        || v_pol_no_to,        --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                        v_unprocessed_rcpts,     --v_amount            NUMBER,
                        'C',                   --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                        v_gl_acc_to,        --v_acc_number           VARCHAR2,
                        v_pol_to_brh_code,       --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                        v_gl_trans,
                        --v_trn_rec   IN OUT Fms_Vouchers_Pkg.Tgl_rec_type
                        NULL,          --v_cad_code       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                        NULL,         --v_otop_code       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                        NULL,         --v_fpmt_code       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                        v_ort_code,   --v_ort_code        NUMBER DEFAULT NULL)
                        NULL,            --  v_btr_no     NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                        v_ppr_code_to   --v_ppr_code---    NUMBER DEFAULT NULL
                                     );
                END IF;

                IF NVL (v_premium_amt_to, 0) <> 0
                THEN
                    get_gl_code ('UP',
                                 v_to_prod_code,
                                 v_trnt_code,
                                 v_gl_acc_to,
                                 v_contra_acc);
                    valid_acc (v_gl_acc_to,
                               v_org_code,
                               v_pol_to_brh_code,
                               v_scenario || ' TO UP A/C');

                        v_trans_code,
                        --v_trans_code           NUMBER,

                        v_ppr_code_to);
                END IF;

                THEN
                    get_gl_code ('CMPFND',

                               v_scenario || ' TO CMPFND A/C');
                    v_count := v_count + 1;
                    interface_append_gl (
                        v_trans_code,
                        --v_trans_code           NUMBER,

                        --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                        v_to_pol_code,
                        --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                        v_to_prod_code,
                        --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                        v_scenario,
                        --v_vchr_no             VARCHAR2,
                        v_opr_to,                --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                        v_oppr_to,               --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                        v_rct_code,          --v_rcpt_no             VARCHAR2,
                        v_count,                 --v_count             NUMBER,
                           'PHCF FROM '
                        || v_pol_no_from
                        || ' TO '
                        || v_pol_no_to,
                        --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                        v_comfnd_to,             --v_amount            NUMBER,
                        'C',                   --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                        v_gl_acc_to,
                        --v_acc_number           VARCHAR2,
                        v_pol_to_brh_code,
                        --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                        v_gl_trans,
                        --v_trn_rec   IN OUT Fms_Vouchers_Pkg.Tgl_rec_type
                        NULL,
                        --v_cad_code       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                        NULL,
                        --v_otop_code       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                        NULL,
                        --v_fpmt_code       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                        v_ort_code,
                        --v_ort_code        NUMBER DEFAULT NULL)
                        NULL,
                        v_ppr_code_to);                          -- v_ppr_code
                END IF;

                IF NVL (v_loan_amt_to, 0) <> 0
                THEN
                    get_gl_code ('NL',
                                 v_to_prod_code,
                                 v_trnt_code,
                                 v_gl_acc_to,
                                 v_contra_acc);
                    valid_acc (v_gl_acc_to,
                               v_org_code,
                               v_pol_to_brh_code,
                               v_scenario || ' TO NL A/C');
                    v_count := v_count + 1;
                    interface_append_gl (
                        v_trans_code,         --v_trans_code           NUMBER,
                        v_user_name,           --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                        v_to_pol_code,           --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                        v_to_prod_code,          --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                        v_scenario,          --v_vchr_no             VARCHAR2,
                        v_opr_to,                --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                        v_oppr_to,               --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                        v_rct_code,          --v_rcpt_no             VARCHAR2,
                        v_count,                 --v_count             NUMBER,
                           'LOAN FROM '
                        || v_pol_no_from
                        || v_loan_account_from
                        || ' TO '
                        || v_pol_no_to
                        || v_loan_account_to,  --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                        v_loan_amt_to,           --v_amount            NUMBER,
                        'C',                   --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                        v_gl_acc_to,        --v_acc_number           VARCHAR2,
                        v_pol_to_brh_code,       --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                        v_gl_trans,
                        --v_trn_rec   IN OUT Fms_Vouchers_Pkg.Tgl_rec_type
                        NULL,          --v_cad_code       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                        NULL,         --v_otop_code       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                        NULL,         --v_fpmt_code       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                        v_ort_code,   --v_ort_code        NUMBER DEFAULT NULL)
                        NULL,
                        v_ppr_code_to                            -- v_ppr_code
                                     );
                END IF;

                IF NVL (v_loan_int_to, 0) <> 0
                THEN
                    get_gl_code ('LOAN_INT',
                                 v_to_prod_code,
                                 v_trnt_code,
                                 v_gl_acc_from,
                                 v_contra_acc);
                    valid_acc (v_gl_acc_from,
                               v_org_code,
                               v_pol_to_brh_code,
                               v_scenario || ' TO A/C (LOAN_INT)');
                    get_gl_code ('POL_LOAN',
                                 v_to_prod_code,
                                 v_trnt_code,
                                 v_gl_acc_to,
                                 v_contra_acc);
                    valid_acc (v_gl_acc_to,
                               v_org_code,
                               v_pol_to_brh_code,
                               v_scenario || ' TO A/C (POL_LOAN)');
                    v_count := v_count + 1;
                    interface_append_gl (
                        v_trans_code,
                        --v_trans_code           NUMBER,
                        v_user_name,
                        --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                        v_to_pol_code,
                        --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                        v_to_prod_code,
                        --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                        v_scenario,
                        --v_vchr_no             VARCHAR2,
                        v_opr_to,                --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                        v_oppr_to,               --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                        v_rct_code,          --v_rcpt_no             VARCHAR2,
                        v_count,                 --v_count             NUMBER,
                           'INTEREST FROM '
                        || v_pol_no_from
                        || ' TO '
                        || v_pol_no_to,
                        --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                        ROUND (v_loan_int_to),
                        --v_amount            NUMBER,
                        'C',                   --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                        v_gl_acc_from,
                        --v_acc_number1           VARCHAR2,
                        v_gl_acc_to,
                        --v_acc_number2           VARCHAR2,
                        v_pol_to_brh_code,
                        --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                        v_gl_trans,
                        --v_trn_rec   IN OUT Fms_Vouchers_Pkg.Tgl_rec_type
                        NULL,
                        --v_cad_code       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                        NULL,
                        --v_otop_code       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                        NULL,
                        --v_fpmt_code       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                        v_ort_code,
                        --v_ort_code        NUMBER DEFAULT NULL)
                        NULL,
                        v_ppr_code_to);
                END IF;

                IF NVL (v_pension_amt_to, 0) <> 0
                THEN
                    IF    NVL (v_prod_type_to, 'PN') IN ('IN', 'AN', 'SP')
                       OR inv_all_prem_valid (v_pol_code_to) = 'Y'
                    THEN
                        --Investment Administration
                        IF NVL (v_inv_admin_to, 0) <> 0
                        THEN
                            get_gl_code ('INVADM',
                                         v_to_prod_code,
                                         v_trnt_code,
                                         v_gl_acc_to,
                                         v_contra_acc);
                            valid_acc (v_gl_acc_to,
                                       v_org_code,
                                       v_pol_to_brh_code,
                                       v_scenario || ' TO INVADM A/C');
                            v_count := v_count + 1;
                            interface_append_gl (
                                v_trans_code, --v_trans_code           NUMBER,
                                v_user_name,   --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                                v_to_pol_code,   --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                                v_to_prod_code,  --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                                v_scenario,  --v_vchr_no             VARCHAR2,
                                v_opr_to,        --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                                v_oppr_to,       --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                                v_rct_code,  --v_rcpt_no             VARCHAR2,
                                v_count,         --v_count             NUMBER,
                                   'INV. ADM. FROM '
                                || v_pol_no_from
                                || ' TO '
                                || v_pol_no_to, --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                                NVL (v_inv_admin_to, 0),
                                --v_amount            NUMBER,
                                'C',           --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                                v_gl_acc_to, --v_acc_number           VARCHAR2,
                                v_pol_to_brh_code, --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                                v_gl_trans,
                                --v_trn_rec   IN OUT Fms_Vouchers_Pkg.Tgl_rec_type
                                NULL,  --v_cad_code       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                NULL, --v_otop_code       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                NULL, --v_fpmt_code       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                v_ort_code, --v_ort_code        NUMBER DEFAULT NULL)
                                NULL,
                                v_ppr_code_to);                   --v_ppr_code
                        END IF;

                        --Investment Fee
                        IF NVL (v_inv_fee_to, 0) <> 0
                        THEN
                            get_gl_code ('INVFEE',
                                         v_to_prod_code,
                                         v_trnt_code,
                                         v_gl_acc_to,
                                         v_contra_acc);
                            valid_acc (v_gl_acc_to,
                                       v_org_code,
                                       v_pol_to_brh_code,
                                       v_scenario || ' TO INVFEE A/C');
                            v_count := v_count + 1;
                            interface_append_gl (
                                v_trans_code, --v_trans_code           NUMBER,
                                v_user_name,   --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,

                                v_to_prod_code,  --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                                v_scenario,  --v_vchr_no             VARCHAR2,
                                v_opr_to,        --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                                v_oppr_to,       --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                                v_rct_code,  --v_rcpt_no             VARCHAR2,
                                v_count,         --v_count             NUMBER,
                                   'INV. FEE FROM '
                                || v_pol_no_from
                                || ' TO '
                                || v_pol_no_to, --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                                NVL (v_inv_fee_to, 0),
                                --v_amount            NUMBER,
                                'C',           --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                                v_gl_acc_to, --v_acc_number           VARCHAR2,
                                v_pol_to_brh_code, --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                                v_gl_trans,
                                --v_trn_rec   IN OUT Fms_Vouchers_Pkg.Tgl_rec_type
                                NULL,  --v_cad_code       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                NULL, --v_otop_code       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                NULL, --v_fpmt_code       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,

                                NULL,

                        END IF;

                        --Investment Premium
                        IF NVL (v_inv_contri_to, 0) <> 0
                        THEN
                            get_gl_code ('INVPREM',
                                         v_to_prod_code,
                                         v_trnt_code,
                                         v_gl_acc_to,
                                         v_contra_acc);
                            valid_acc (v_gl_acc_to,
                                       v_org_code,
                                       v_pol_to_brh_code,

                                v_opr_to,        --v_opr_code          NUMBER,

                                v_pol_to_brh_code, --v_branch_code       NUMBER,

                                v_ppr_code_to);                   --v_ppr_code
                        END IF;
                    --raise_error('IN to='||v_premium_amt_to||';'||v_pension_amt_to||';'||v_inv_admin_to||';'||v_inv_fee_to||';'||v_inv_contri_to);
                    ELSE
                        get_gl_code ('PN',
                                     v_to_prod_code,
                                     v_trnt_code,
                                     v_gl_acc_to,
                                     v_contra_acc);
                        valid_acc (v_gl_acc_to,
                                   v_org_code,
                                   v_pol_to_brh_code,
                                   v_scenario || ' TO PN A/C');
                        v_count := v_count + 1;
                        interface_append_gl (
                            v_trans_code,     --v_trans_code           NUMBER,
                            v_user_name,       --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                            v_to_pol_code,       --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                            v_to_prod_code,      --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                            v_scenario,      --v_vchr_no             VARCHAR2,
                            v_opr_to,            --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                            v_oppr_to,           --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                            v_rct_code,      --v_rcpt_no             VARCHAR2,
                            v_count,             --v_count             NUMBER,
                               'PENSION PREM. FROM '
                            || v_pol_no_from
                            || ' TO '
                            || v_pol_no_to,    --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                            v_pension_amt_to,    --v_amount            NUMBER,
                            'C',               --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                            v_gl_acc_to,    --v_acc_number           VARCHAR2,
                            v_pol_to_brh_code,   --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                            v_gl_trans,
                            --v_trn_rec   IN OUT Fms_Vouchers_Pkg.Tgl_rec_type
                            NULL,      --v_cad_code       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                            NULL,     --v_otop_code       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                            NULL,     --v_fpmt_code       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                            v_ort_code, --v_ort_code        NUMBER DEFAULT NULL)
                            NULL,
                            v_ppr_code_to);                       --v_ppr_code
                    END IF;
                END IF;
            ELSE
                raise_error (v_scenario || ' NOT HANDLED.');
            END IF;

            IF v_count <> 0
            THEN
                --- RAISE_ERROR('AM HERE=======');
                --SELECT DECODE(NVL (v_trans_from,'UND'),'MKT',NULL,v_pol_code_from) INTO v_passpolcode FROM dual;
                interface_update_vgl (v_trans_code, --v_trans_code     NUMBER,
                                      v_user_name, --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                                      v_from_pol_code, --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                                      NVL (v_date, TRUNC (SYSDATE)),
                                      --v_date              DATE,
                                      v_opr_from, --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                                      v_oppr_from, --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                                      'LMS TRANSFER BATCH', --v_btc_description   VARCHAR2,
                                      'JV', --v_btc_type             VARCHAR2,
                                      v_pol_from_brh_code, --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                                      NVL (v_description, 'CORRECTIONS'),
                                      --v_description       VARCHAR2,
                                      NVL (v_rct_code, v_scenario), --v_ref             VARCHAR2,
                                      v_gl_trans,
                                      --v_gl_trans  IN OUT  Fms_Vouchers_Pkg.Tgl_rec_type,
                                      NULL, --v_cad_code       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                      NULL, --v_otop_code       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                      NULL, --v_fpmt_code       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                      v_ort_code, --v_ort_code        NUMBER DEFAULT NULL)
                                      NULL,
                                      v_ppr_code_from);

                UPDATE lms_ord_recpt_transfer
                   SET ort_posted = 'Y'
                 WHERE ort_code = v_ort_code;
            ELSE
                raise_error (
                       v_scenario
                    || ' JV NOT CREATED. P1 '
                    || v_premium_amt_from
                    || ' P2 '
                    || v_premium_amt_to
                    || ' L1 '
                    || v_loan_amt_from
                    || ' L2 '
                    || v_loan_amt_to
                    || ' PN1 '
                    || v_pension_amt_from
                    || ' PN2 '
                    || v_pension_amt_to);
            END IF;
        END IF;
    --      raise_error('v_scenario='||v_scenario||'v_pol_code_from='||v_pol_code_from||'v_pol_code_to='|| v_pol_code_to||
    --      'v_trans_from='||v_trans_from||'v_lna_no_to='||v_lna_no_to||'v_opr_pens_from='||v_opr_pens_from||'v_opr_to='||v_opr_to
    --      ||'v_oppr_from='||v_oppr_from||'v_oppr_to='||v_oppr_to||'v_ort_code='||v_ort_code);
    EXCEPTION
        WHEN OTHERS
        THEN
            raise_error (
                   'POSTING TRANSFERS...v_premium_amt_from='
                || v_premium_amt_from
                || ';v_pension_amt_from='
                || v_pension_amt_from
                || ';v_inv_fee_from='
                || v_inv_fee_from
                || ';v_inv_contri_from='
                || v_inv_contri_from
                || ';v_inv_admin_from='
                || v_inv_admin_from
                || ';v_comfnd_from='
                || v_comfnd_from
                || ';v_prod_type_from='
                || v_prod_type_from
                || ';v_tot_from_rcpt='
                || v_tot_from_rcpt
                || ';v_unprocessed_rcpts='
                || v_unprocessed_rcpts
                || '  TRANSFERED TO '
                || 'v_loan_amt_to='
                || v_loan_amt_to
                || ';v_premium_amt_to='
                || v_premium_amt_to
                || ';v_pension_amt_to='
                || v_pension_amt_to
                || ';v_inv_fee_to='
                || v_inv_fee_to
                || ';v_inv_contri_to='
                || v_inv_contri_to
                || ';v_inv_admin_to='
                || v_inv_admin_to
                || ';v_comfnd_to='
                || v_comfnd_to
                || ';v_prod_type_to='
                || v_prod_type_to
                || ';v_opr_amt='
                || v_opr_amt);
    END post_transfers;

    PROCEDURE post_lms_rct (
        v_rct_rec               fms_interfaces_pkg.type_receipts_table,
        v_tran_mapping   IN OUT fms_interfaces_pkg.tran_mapping_type
    )
    IS
        v_count          NUMBER := 0;
        v_mtran_code     NUMBER;
        v_amount         NUMBER := 0;
        v_tran_type      VARCHAR2 (10);
        v_ltr_trans_no   NUMBER;
        v_user_name      VARCHAR2 (20);
    BEGIN
        NULL;
    /*
     BEGIN
       select  BTR_DEBIT_CODE
       INTO v_tran_type
       FROM LMS_BUSINESS_TRANSACTIONS
       WHERE BTR_TRANS_CODE = 'RC';
    EXCEPTION
    WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND  THEN
       raise_application_error(-20001,'LMS TRANSACTION TYPE codes have NOT been defined IN the setup transactions parameters...');
    END;
    select LMS_LTR_TRANS_NO_SEQ.NEXTVAL INTO v_ltr_trans_no FROM DUAL;
    INSERT INTO LMS_TRANSACTIONS
       (
       LTR_TRANS_NO, LTR_BTR_TRANS_CODE,
        LTR_DONE_BY, LTR_DONE_DATE,
       LTR_UW_CLM_TRAN, LTR_TRANS_DATE,
       LTR_TRANS_AUTHORISED, LTR_EFFECTIVE_DATE
       )
    VALUES
       (
       v_ltr_trans_no, 'RC',
       FMS_INTERFACES_PKG.GET_USERNAME, TRUNC(SYSDATE),
       'A', TRUNC(SYSDATE),
       'N',TRUNC(SYSDATE)
       );
     for j in 1..v_rct_rec.count loop
       SELECT TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'RRRR')||LMS_MTRAN_CODE_SEQ.NEXTVAL)
       INTO v_mtran_code  FROM DUAL;
       INSERT INTO LMS_MASTER_TRANSACTIONS
       (
       MTRAN_CODE, MTRAN_DOC_DATE,MTRAN_DATE,
       MTRAN_REF_NO, MTRAN_OTHER_REF,
       MTRAN_TRAN_TYPE, MTRAN_DC,
       MTRAN_CONTROL_ACC, MTRAN_CLIENT_TYPE,
       MTRAN_CLIENT_CODE, MTRAN_AMOUNT,
       MTRAN_BALANCE, MTRAN_AUTHORISED,
       MTRAN_NET_AMT, MTRAN_POSTING_DATE,
       MTRAN_LTR_TRANS_NO,MTRAN_PRP_CODE,
       MTRAN_BTR_TRANS_CODE,MTRAN_ORIGIN,MTRAN_AGEN_CODE,MTRAN_CLA_TYPE,
       MTRAN_NARRATIONS,MTRAN_BRN_CODE
       )
       VALUES
       (
       v_mtran_code,v_rct_rec(j).RCT_DATE,TRUNC(SYSDATE),
       v_rct_rec(j).RCT_BRH_RCT_CODE,v_rct_rec(j).RCT_PAYMT_MEMO,
       v_tran_type,'C',
       v_rct_rec(j).RCT_ACT_CODE, v_rct_rec(j).RCT_ACCT_TYPE_ID,--NVL( v_rct_rec(j).RCT_ACCT_TYPE_ID,'D'),
       v_rct_rec(j).RCT_ACT_CODE,v_rct_rec(j).RCT_AMOUNT,
       v_rct_rec(j).RCT_AMOUNT,'N',
       v_rct_rec(j).RCT_AMOUNT,TRUNC(SYSDATE),
       v_ltr_trans_no,   DECODE(v_rct_rec(j).RCT_ACCT_TYPE_ID ,'D',v_rct_rec(j).RCT_ACT_CODE,NULL),
       'RC','U',v_rct_rec(j).RCT_ACT_CODE,'O',
       v_rct_rec(j).RCT_DESC,v_rct_rec(j).RCT_BRH_CODE
       );
    END LOOP;
     for i in 1..V_TRAN_MAPPING.count loop
       UPDATE   LMS_MASTER_TRANSACTIONS
       SET MTRAN_BALANCE = MTRAN_BALANCE - V_TRAN_MAPPING(i).TMAP_AMOUNT
       WHERE MTRAN_CODE = V_TRAN_MAPPING(i).TMAP_MTRAN_NO;
       INSERT INTO LMS_TRAN_MAPPING
          (
          TMAP_MTRAN_CODE,
          TMAP_MTRAN_REF_NO,
          TMAP_CHECK_MTRAN_CODE ,
          TMAP_AMOUNT,
          TMAP_DRCR,
          TMAP_CHECK_MTRAN_REF_NO,
          TMAP_POSTING_DATE
          )
       VALUES
          (
          v_mtran_code,
          V_TRAN_MAPPING(i).TMAP_MTRAN_REF_NO,--rct code
          V_TRAN_MAPPING(i).TMAP_MTRAN_NO,
          V_TRAN_MAPPING(i).TMAP_AMOUNT,
          'C',
          V_TRAN_MAPPING(i).TMAP_CHECK_MTRAN_REF_NO,--****
          trunc(sysdate)
          );
          v_amount := v_amount + V_TRAN_MAPPING(i).TMAP_AMOUNT;
     end loop;
    UPDATE   LMS_MASTER_TRANSACTIONS
    SET MTRAN_BALANCE = MTRAN_BALANCE - v_amount
    WHERE MTRAN_CODE = v_mtran_code;
    */
    EXCEPTION
        WHEN OTHERS
        THEN
            raise_application_error (
                -20001,
                'POSTING LMS RECEIPT:- ' || SQLERRM (SQLCODE));
    END post_lms_rct;

    PROCEDURE update_med_chq_pymt (
        v_vchr_no     VARCHAR2,
        v_fpmt_code   NUMBER,
        v_chq_no      VARCHAR2,
        v_chq_dt      DATE,
        v_user_name   VARCHAR2,
        v_chq_amt     NUMBER
    )
    IS
        CURSOR facil IS
            SELECT fpmt_code, fpmt_pay_trans_no
              FROM lms_facilitator_payments
             WHERE fpmt_pymt_vchr_no = v_vchr_no AND fpmt_code = v_fpmt_code;
    BEGIN
        BEGIN
            UPDATE lms_facilitator_payments
               SET fpmt_chq_no = v_chq_no,
                   fpmt_chq_date = v_chq_dt,
                   fpmt_chq_update_date = SYSDATE,
                   fpmt_chq_updated_by = v_user_name,
                   fpmt_chq_amt = v_chq_amt
             WHERE fpmt_pymt_vchr_no = v_vchr_no AND fpmt_code = v_fpmt_code;
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                raise_error ('ERROR UPDATING FACILITATOR DETAILS....');
        END;

        FOR facil_rec IN facil
        LOOP
            BEGIN
                UPDATE lms_client_medicals
                   SET cml_paid = 'P',
                       cml_cheque_no = v_chq_no,
                       cml_cheque_date = v_chq_dt
                 WHERE     cml_fpmt_code = facil_rec.fpmt_code
                       AND cml_pay_trans_no = facil_rec.fpmt_pay_trans_no;
            EXCEPTION
                WHEN OTHERS
                THEN
                    raise_error ('ERROR UPDATING CLIENT MEDICAL DETAILS....');
            END;
        END LOOP;
    END update_med_chq_pymt;

    PROCEDURE update_matuities (
        v_vchr_no    VARCHAR2,
        v_ppm_code   NUMBER,
        v_chq_no     VARCHAR2,
        v_chq_date   DATE,
        v_chq_amt    NUMBER,
        v_user       VARCHAR2,
        v_type       VARCHAR2 DEFAULT NULL
    )
    IS
        v_pol_code   NUMBER;
        v_ben_cnt    NUMBER;
    BEGIN
        IF v_type IN ('P_MTR', 'F_MTR', 'AN_MTR')
        THEN
            BEGIN
                UPDATE lms_policy_prtl_maturities
                   SET ppm_paid_date = TRUNC (SYSDATE), ppm_paid = 'Y'
                 WHERE ppm_code IN
                           (SELECT pmpmt_ppm_code
                              FROM lms_prtl_maturity_payments
                             WHERE     pmpmt_ppm_code = v_ppm_code
                                   AND pmpmt_vchr_no = v_vchr_no);
            EXCEPTION
                WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND
                THEN
                    NULL;
                WHEN OTHERS
                THEN
                    raise_error (
                           'Unable TO UPDATE maturity details....v_ppm_code='
                        || v_ppm_code
                        || ';v_vchr_no='
                        || v_vchr_no);
            END;
        ELSIF v_type IN ('TPD_MTR')
        THEN
            BEGIN
                UPDATE lms_clm_inst_payment
                   SET cip_paid_date = TRUNC (SYSDATE),
                       cip_paid = 'Y',
                       cip_chq_no = v_chq_no,
                       cip_chq_date = v_chq_date
                 WHERE cip_code IN
                           (SELECT pmpmt_cip_code
                              FROM lms_prtl_maturity_payments
                             WHERE     pmpmt_cip_code = v_ppm_code
                                   AND pmpmt_vchr_no = v_vchr_no);
            EXCEPTION
                WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND
                THEN
                    NULL;
                WHEN OTHERS
                THEN
                    raise_error (
                           'Unable TO UPDATE TPD Instalment details....v_ppm_code='
                        || v_ppm_code
                        || ';v_vchr_no='
                        || v_vchr_no);
            END;
        ELSIF v_type = 'ANN'
        THEN
            BEGIN
                UPDATE lms_annuity_pymt_schedule
                   SET aps_paid_date = TRUNC (SYSDATE),
                       aps_paid = 'Y',
                       aps_chq_no = v_chq_no,
                       aps_chq_date = v_chq_date
                 WHERE aps_code IN
                           (SELECT pmpmt_aps_code
                              FROM lms_prtl_maturity_payments
                             WHERE     pmpmt_aps_code = v_ppm_code
                                   AND pmpmt_vchr_no = v_vchr_no);
            EXCEPTION
                WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND
                THEN
                    NULL;
                WHEN OTHERS
                THEN
                    raise_error (
                        'Unable TO UPDATE Annuity Instalment details....');
            END;
        ELSIF v_type IN ('NCD')
        THEN
            BEGIN
                UPDATE lms_no_claim_disc
                   SET ncd_cheque_no = v_chq_no,
                       ncd_cheque_date = v_chq_date,
                       ncd_chq_update_by = v_user,
                       ncd_chq_update_date = SYSDATE,
                       ncd_chq_amt = v_chq_amt
                 WHERE ncd_code = v_ppm_code AND ncd_voucher_no = v_vchr_no;
            EXCEPTION
                WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND
                THEN
                    NULL;
                WHEN OTHERS
                THEN
                    raise_error (
                           'Unable TO UPDATE NCD Instalment details....v_ppm_code='
                        || v_ppm_code
                        || ';v_vchr_no='
                        || v_vchr_no);
            END;
        END IF;

        BEGIN
            UPDATE lms_prtl_maturity_payments
               SET pmpmt_chq_no = v_chq_no,
                   pmpmt_chq_date = v_chq_date,
                   pmpt_chq_update_by = v_user,
                   pmpt_chq_update_date = SYSDATE,
                   pmpt_chq_amt = v_chq_amt
             WHERE     NVL (pmpmt_ppm_code,
                            NVL (pmpmt_cip_code, pmpmt_aps_code)) =
                       v_ppm_code
                   AND pmpmt_vchr_no = v_vchr_no;
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                raise_error ('Unable TO UPDATE maturity payment details....');
        END;

        IF v_chq_no != 'NO CHEQUE ISSUED'
        THEN
            BEGIN
                lms_ord_trans.update_cheque_incidence (v_pol_code,
                                                       v_chq_date,
                                                       v_chq_no,
                                                       v_user,
                                                       v_type);
            EXCEPTION
                WHEN OTHERS
                THEN
                    raise_error ('E');
            END;
        ELSE
            BEGIN
                lms_process_alerts.pol_dets_event_alert (v_pol_code,
                                                         v_type || '_MSG',
                                                         v_type || '_MSG');
            EXCEPTION
                WHEN OTHERS
                THEN
                    NULL;
            END;
        END IF;
    EXCEPTION
        WHEN OTHERS
        THEN
            raise_error ('UPDATING LMS Maturities..');
    END update_matuities;

    PROCEDURE update_surrender (
        v_vchr_no    VARCHAR2,
        v_chq_no     VARCHAR2,
        v_chq_date   DATE,
        v_chq_amt    NUMBER,
        v_user       VARCHAR2,
        v_pol_code   NUMBER
    )
    IS
    BEGIN
        BEGIN
            UPDATE lms_policy_surrenders
               SET psur_chq_no = v_chq_no,
                   psur_chq_date = v_chq_date,
                   psur_refunded = 'Y',
                   psur_chq_update_by = v_user,
                   psur_chq_update_date = SYSDATE,
                   psur_chq_amt = v_chq_amt
             WHERE psur_pol_code = v_pol_code AND psur_vchr_no = v_vchr_no;
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                raise_error ('Error UPDATING Surrenders details....');
        END;

        BEGIN
            lms_ord_trans.update_cheque_incidence (v_pol_code,
                                                   v_chq_date,
                                                   v_chq_no,
                                                   v_user,
                                                   'SURR');
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                raise_error ('Error updating Surrender Cheque Incidence..');
        END;

        IF v_chq_no != 'NO CHEQUE ISSUED'
        THEN
            BEGIN
                lms_process_alerts.pol_dets_event_alert (v_pol_code,
                                                         'SURR_MSG',
                                                         'SURR_MSG');
            EXCEPTION
                WHEN OTHERS
                THEN
                    NULL;
            END;
        END IF;
    END update_surrender;

        v_po_amt                NUMBER;
        v_chq_cnt               NUMBER;
        v_tot_loan_intr         NUMBER;
        v_pens_amt              NUMBER;
        v_unalloc_amt           NUMBER;
        v_inv_fee               NUMBER;
        v_inv_contri            NUMBER;
        v_inv_admin             NUMBER;
        v_comfnd                NUMBER;
        v_comp_param            VARCHAR2 (5);
        v_alloc_osamt_to        VARCHAR2 (5);

        v_temp                  NUMBER;

        v_processing_fee        NUMBER;
