                   lma_ppm_code,
                   lma_pol_code,
                   lma_alloc_to,
                   lma_amt,
                   lma_to_ppr_code,
                   lma_to_pol_code,
                   lma_to_policy_no,
                   lma_to_proposal_no,
                   lma_lna_no,
                   lma_rnwl_term,
                   lma_fund_value,
                   lma_bo_spread,
                   lma_bo_spread_amt
              FROM lms_matr_allocations
             WHERE     lma_ppm_code = v_ppm_code
                   AND lma_pol_code = v_pol_code
                   --disabled because posting is done at LMS_MATURITIES_PKG.authmaturites
                   -- LMS_API.post_update_recpt_pyment is called and the maturity account is
                   --debited
                   AND 1 = 2;

        CURSOR matr_alloc_payouts IS
            SELECT lma_code,
                   lma_ppm_code,
                   lma_pol_code,
                   lma_alloc_to,
                   lma_amt,
                   lma_to_ppr_code,
                   lma_to_pol_code,
                   lma_to_policy_no,
                   lma_to_proposal_no,
                   lma_lna_no,
                   lma_rnwl_term,
                   lma_fund_value,
                   lma_bo_spread,
                   lma_bo_spread_amt,
                   lma_payee
              FROM lms_matr_allocations
             WHERE     lma_ppm_code = v_ppm_code
                   AND lma_pol_code = v_pol_code
                   AND lma_amt > 0
                   AND lma_alloc_to = 'PO';
    BEGIN
        /*
        1. - Raise CHQ
            CR bank
            DR O/S  Maturity claims
        2. - Raise VGL
             DR Maturity claims expense ac
            CR O/S  Maturity claims
        */
        SELECT    TO_NUMBER (TO_CHAR (SYSDATE, 'RRRR'))
               || lms_transaction_seq.NEXTVAL
          INTO v_trans_code
          FROM DUAL;

        BEGIN
            lms_ord_misc.system_param_val ('CONSOLIDATE_COMP_FUND',
                                           v_comp_param);
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                raise_error ('PARAM ERROR...');
        END;

        BEGIN
            lms_ord_misc.system_param_val ('USE_CONTRAL_ACCOUNT_AT_CLAIMS',
                                           v_cont_acc_param);
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                raise_error ('PARAM ERROR...USE_CONTRAL_ACCOUNT_AT_CLAIMS');
        END;

        BEGIN
            SELECT pol_code,
                   pol_bra_code,
                   pol_policy_no,
                   pol_prod_code,
                   pm_payee,
                   DECODE (pm_maturity_type,
                           'P', 'P_MTR',
                           'RV', 'P_MTR',
                           'F', 'F_MTR',
                           'TPD', 'TPD_MTR',
                           'NCD', 'CP_NCD',
                           pm_maturity_type)
                       pm_maturity_type,
                   pm_debt_recovery,
                   pm_maturity_amount,
                   pm_net_amount,
                   pm_bonuses,
                   pm_prem_amt_alloc,
                   pm_loan_amt_alloc,
                   pm_alloc_to,
                   pm_to_ppr_code,
                   pm_to_pol_code,
                   pm_to_policy_no,
                   pm_to_proposal_no,
                   pm_reinvestment_amt,
                   pm_reinv_intr,
                   pm_bbr_code,
                   pm_paymt_acc_no,
                   pm_prepared_by,
                   pm_but_pay_amt,
                   lms_ord_mis.check_renewal_paymnt (pol_code, pm_date),
                   pm_maturity_no,
                   pm_pay_at_claim,
                   pol_prod_type,
                   pm_fee_alloc,
                   pm_contri_alloc,
                   pm_admin_alloc,
                   pm_comfnd_alloc,
                   pm_unalloc_rcpt_amt,
                   pm_tot_loan_intr,
                   'PR',
                   pm_os_prem_interest,
                   NVL (pm_processing_brn_code, pm_bra_code),
                   pm_mpt_code,
                   pm_clnt_mob_no,
                   pm_clnt_id_passport_no,
                   DECODE (pm_identity_type,
                           'I', 'NATIONAL ID',
                           'P', 'PASSPORT'),
                   NVL (pm_processing_fee, 0),
                   pm_unpro_ref_amt,
                   pm_consl_mats_amt,
                   pm_tbonus,
                   pm_mat_chrg_amt,
                   pm_interest_whtx,
                   pm_interest_amt,
                   pm_paid_partial_mat
              INTO v_pol_code,
                   v_brh_code,
                   v_policy_no,
                   v_prod_code,
                   v_payee,
                   v_pm_maturity_type,
                   v_debt_recovery,
                   v_matrty_amt,
                   v_net_amount,
                   v_bonuses,
                   v_os_premiums,
                   v_os_loans,
                   v_alloc_to,
                   v_to_ppr_code,
                   v_to_pol_code,
                   v_to_policy_no,
                   v_to_proposal_no,
                   v_reinvestment_amt,
                   v_reinv_intr,
                   v_bbr_code,
                   v_account_number,
                   v_prepared_by,
                   v_pm_but_pay_amt,
                   v_renewal,
                   v_maturity_no,
                   v_pay_at_claim,
                   v_prod_type,
                   v_inv_fee,
                   v_inv_contri,
                   v_inv_admin,
                   v_comfnd,
                   v_unalloc_amt,
                   v_tot_loan_intr,
                   v_alloc_osamt_to,
                   v_os_prem_int,
                   v_processing_brn_code,
                   v_mpt_code,
                   v_clnt_mob_no,
                   v_clnt_id_passport_no,
                   v_id_type,
                   v_processing_fee,
                   v_pm_unpro_ref_amt,
                   v_pm_consl_mats_amt,
                   v_tbonus,
                   v_mat_charge,
                   v_intr_whtx,
                   v_intr,
                   v_paid_partial_mat
              FROM lms_policies, lms_proposers, lms_policy_maturities
             WHERE     pol_client_prp_code = prp_code
                   AND pol_code = pm_pol_code
                   AND NOT pm_maturity_type LIKE ('%C')
                   AND NOT pm_maturity_type = 'ANN'
                   AND DECODE (v_trans_type,
                               'NCD', pm_ncd_code,
                               'TPD', pm_cip_code,
                               pm_ppm_code) =
                       v_ppm_code;
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND
            THEN
                raise_error ('POLICY MATURITY DETAILS ERROR..1... ');

                BEGIN
                    SELECT ann_code,
                           NVL (pm_processing_brn_code, NVL(pm_bra_code, ann_brn_code)),
                           ann_annuity_no,
                           ann_prod_code,
                           pm_payee,
                           'ANN_MTR'     pm_maturity_type,
                           pm_debt_recovery,
                           pm_maturity_amount,
                           pm_net_amount,
                           pm_bonuses,
                           pm_os_premiums,
                           pm_os_loans,
                           pm_alloc_to,
                           pm_to_ppr_code,
                           pm_to_pol_code,
                           pm_to_policy_no,
                           pm_to_proposal_no,
                           pm_reinvestment_amt,
                           pm_reinv_intr,
                           pm_bbr_code,
                           pm_paymt_acc_no,
                           pm_prepared_by,
                           pm_but_pay_amt,
                           NULL,
                           pm_maturity_no,
                           pm_pay_at_claim,
                           'AN',
                           pm_fee_alloc,
                           pm_contri_alloc,
                           pm_admin_alloc,
                           pm_comfnd_alloc,
                           pm_unalloc_rcpt_amt,
                           pm_tot_loan_intr,
                           'PR', --DECODE (NVL (pm_os_premiums, 0), 0, 'LN', 'PR'),
                           pm_os_prem_interest,
                           pm_mpt_code,
                           pm_clnt_mob_no,
                           pm_clnt_id_passport_no,
                           DECODE (pm_identity_type,
                                   'I', 'NATIONAL ID',
                                   'P', 'PASSPORT'),
                           NVL (pm_processing_fee, 0),
                           pm_unpro_ref_amt,
                           pm_consl_mats_amt,
                           pm_tbonus,
                           pm_mat_chrg_amt,
                           pm_interest_whtx,
                           pm_interest_amt,
                           pm_paid_partial_mat
                      INTO v_pol_code,
                           v_brh_code,
                           v_policy_no,
                           v_prod_code,
                           v_payee,
                           v_pm_maturity_type,
                           v_debt_recovery,
                           v_matrty_amt,
                           v_net_amount,
                           v_bonuses,
                           v_os_premiums,
                           v_os_loans,
                           v_alloc_to,
                           v_to_ppr_code,
                           v_to_pol_code,
                           v_to_policy_no,
                           v_to_proposal_no,
                           v_reinvestment_amt,
                           v_reinv_intr,
                           v_bbr_code,
                           v_account_number,
                           v_prepared_by,
                           v_pm_but_pay_amt,
                           v_renewal,
                           v_maturity_no,
                           v_pay_at_claim,
                           v_prod_type,
                           v_inv_fee,
                           v_inv_contri,
                           v_inv_admin,
                           v_comfnd,
                           v_unalloc_amt,
                           v_tot_loan_intr,
                           v_alloc_osamt_to,
                           v_os_prem_int,
                           v_mpt_code,
                           v_clnt_mob_no,
                           v_clnt_id_passport_no,
                           v_id_type,
                           v_processing_fee,
                           v_pm_unpro_ref_amt,
                           v_pm_consl_mats_amt,
                           v_tbonus,
                           v_mat_charge,
                           v_intr_whtx,
                           v_intr,
                           v_paid_partial_mat
                      FROM lms_annuities,
                           lms_proposers,
                           lms_policy_maturities
                     WHERE     ann_prp_code = prp_code
                           AND ann_code = pm_ann_code
                           AND NOT pm_maturity_type LIKE ('%C')
                           AND pm_maturity_type = 'ANN'
                           AND pm_ppm_code = v_ppm_code;
                EXCEPTION
                    WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND
                    THEN
                        raise_error ('ANNUITY INFO NOT FOUND... ');
                    WHEN OTHERS
                    THEN
                        raise_error ('ANNUITY DETAILS ERROR... ');
                END;
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                raise_error ('POLICY MATURITY DETAILS ERROR... ');
        END;

        IF v_pay_method = 'MFT'
        THEN
            v_account_number := v_clnt_mob_no;
        END IF;

        SELECT SUM (lma_amt)
          INTO v_prem_n_loan_amt
          FROM lms_matr_allocations
         WHERE     lma_ppm_code = v_ppm_code
               AND lma_pol_code = v_pol_code
               AND NVL (lma_alloc_to, 'XX') IN ('PP', 'LN', 'UP');

        SELECT SUM (lma_amt)
          INTO v_reinvestment_amt
          FROM lms_matr_allocations
         WHERE     lma_ppm_code = v_ppm_code
               AND lma_pol_code = v_pol_code
               AND NVL (lma_alloc_to, 'XX') IN ('RV');

        SELECT SUM (lma_amt)
          INTO v_po_amt
          FROM lms_matr_allocations
         WHERE     lma_ppm_code = v_ppm_code
               AND lma_pol_code = v_pol_code
               AND NVL (lma_alloc_to, 'XX') IN ('PO');

        IF NVL (v_deduct, 'Y') = 'N' AND v_pm_maturity_type = 'P_MTR'
        THEN
            v_os_premiums := 0;
        END IF;

        BEGIN
            lms_ord_misc.system_param_val ('POST_BONUS',
                                           v_post_bonus,
                                           v_prod_code);
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                raise_error ('Parameter Error...POST_BONUS');
        END;

        BEGIN
            lms_ord_misc.system_param_val ('POST_GUARNTD_POL_INTR',
                                           v_param_intr,
                                           v_prod_code);
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                raise_error ('Parameter Error...');
        END;

        IF v_param_intr = 'Y'
        THEN
            v_intr := ROUND (v_intr, 2);
        ELSE
            v_intr := 0;
        END IF;

        v_temp :=
              NVL (v_matrty_amt, 0)
            + NVL (v_bonuses, 0)
            + NVL (v_reinv_intr, 0)
            - NVL (v_os_premiums, 0)
            - NVL (v_os_prem_int, 0)
            - NVL (v_os_loans, 0)
            - NVL (v_inv_fee, 0)
            - NVL (v_inv_contri, 0)
            - NVL (v_inv_admin, 0)
            - NVL (v_comfnd, 0)
            - NVL (v_unalloc_amt, 0)
            - NVL (v_debt_recovery, 0)
            - NVL (v_processing_fee, 0)
            - NVL (v_prem_n_loan_amt, 0)
            - NVL (v_reinvestment_amt, 0)
            - NVL (v_mat_charge, 0)
            - NVL (v_intr_whtx, 0)
            - NVL (v_paid_partial_mat, 0)
            + NVL (v_pm_unpro_ref_amt, 0)
            + NVL (v_pm_consl_mats_amt, 0);

        IF   NVL (v_matrty_amt, 0)
           + NVL (v_bonuses, 0)
           + NVL (v_tbonus, 0)
           + NVL (v_reinv_intr, 0)
           - NVL (v_os_premiums, 0)
           - NVL (v_os_prem_int, 0)
           - NVL (v_os_loans, 0)
           - NVL (v_inv_fee, 0)
           - NVL (v_inv_contri, 0)
           - NVL (v_inv_admin, 0)
           - NVL (v_comfnd, 0)
           - NVL (v_unalloc_amt, 0)
           - NVL (v_processing_fee, 0)
           - NVL (v_debt_recovery, 0)
           - NVL (v_prem_n_loan_amt, 0)
           - NVL (v_reinvestment_amt, 0)
           - NVL (v_mat_charge, 0)
           - NVL (v_intr_whtx, 0)
           - NVL (v_paid_partial_mat, 0)
           + NVL (v_pm_unpro_ref_amt, 0)
           + NVL (v_pm_consl_mats_amt, 0) !=
           NVL (v_net_amount, 0)
        THEN
            raise_error (
                   'MATURITY CALCULATION AMOUNTS DO NOT ADD UP...'
                || 'v_matrty_amt='
                || v_matrty_amt
                || ';v_bonuses='
                || v_bonuses
                || ' v_tbonus== '
                || NVL (v_tbonus, 0)
                || ';v_os_premiums='
                || v_os_premiums
                || ';v_os_loans='
                || v_os_loans
                || ';v_debt_recovery='
                || v_debt_recovery
                || ';v_net_amount='
                || v_net_amount
                || ';v_reinvestment_amt='
                || NVL (v_reinvestment_amt, 0)
                || ';v_reinv_intr='
                || NVL (v_reinv_intr, 0)
                || ' ;v_os_prem_interest= '
                || v_os_prem_int
                || ' v_intr = '
                || v_intr
                || ' v_temp= '
                || v_temp
                || ' v_inv_fee= '
                || v_inv_fee
                || ' v_inv_contri= '
                || v_inv_contri
                || ' v_inv_admin= '
                || v_inv_admin
                || ' v_comfnd= '
                || v_comfnd
                || ' v_unalloc_amt= '
                || v_unalloc_amt
                || ' v_pm_unpro_ref_amt= '
                || v_pm_unpro_ref_amt
                || ' v_pm_consl_mats_amt= '
                || v_pm_consl_mats_amt
                || ' v_prem_n_loan_amt== '
                || v_prem_n_loan_amt
                || ' v_mat_charge= '
                || v_mat_charge
                || ' v_intr_whtx= '
                || v_intr_whtx);
        END IF;

        v_net_amount := NVL (v_net_amount, 0)-- NVL (v_prem_n_loan_amt, 0)
                                             --- NVL (v_reinvestment_amt, 0)
                                             ;

        -- RAISE_ERROR('Waititu testing.....');
        SELECT DECODE (
                   v_prod_type,
                   'AN', 'ANNUITY INSTALMENT ',
                   DECODE (v_pm_maturity_type,
                           'TPD_MTR', 'TPD CLAIM INSTALMENT ',
                           'ANN', 'ANNUITY INSTALMENT ',
                           'P_MTR', 'PARTIAL MATURITY ',
                           'POLICY MATURITY '))
          INTO v_matr_desc
          FROM DUAL;

        IF v_trans_type = 'NCD'
        THEN
            lms_ord_misc.system_param_val ('NCD_DESCRIPTION', v_matr_desc);
            v_matr_desc := v_matr_desc||' FOR ';
        END IF;

        v_gross_matu_amt :=
              NVL (v_matrty_amt, 0)
            + NVL (v_bonuses, 0)
            + NVL (v_tbonus, 0)
            + NVL (v_reinv_intr, 0)
            - NVL (v_reinvestment_amt, 0)
            - NVL (v_prem_n_loan_amt, 0)
            - NVL (v_paid_partial_mat, 0);
        v_org_code := fms_interfaces_pkg.get_org (v_brh_code);

        IF NVL (v_pm_but_pay_amt, 0) != 0
        THEN
            v_pm_but_pay_amt := v_pm_but_pay_amt - NVL (v_prem_n_loan_amt, 0);

            v_gross_matu_amt :=
                  v_gross_matu_amt
                + (NVL (v_pm_but_pay_amt, 0) - NVL (v_net_amount, 0));
            v_net_amount := NVL (v_pm_but_pay_amt, 0);
        END IF;

        /*If the control account is not in use, reduce the gross amount by the payable amount so that only the deductibles
        are posted to the GL. Jim 23/04/2018.
        */
        --      IF NVL (v_cont_acc_param, 'Y') = 'N'
        --      THEN
        --         IF NVL (v_net_amount, 0) <> 0
        --         THEN
        --            IF SIGN (NVL (v_net_amount, 0)) != -1
        --            THEN
        --               v_gross_matu_amt := v_gross_matu_amt - v_net_amount;
        --            END IF;
        --         END IF;
        --      END IF;

        --RAISE_ERROR(v_gross_matu_amt||' Waititu testing.....'||v_net_amount);
        IF v_pm_maturity_type = 'F_MTR'
        THEN
            v_trnt_type := 'POL_MTRF';
        ELSIF v_pm_maturity_type = 'CP_NCD'
        THEN
            v_trnt_type := 'CP_NCD';
        ELSIF v_pm_maturity_type = 'TPD_MTR'
        THEN
            v_trnt_type := 'CP_DTH';
        ELSE
            v_trnt_type := 'POL_MTR';
        END IF;

        IF v_gross_matu_amt != 0
        THEN
            SELECT DECODE (SIGN (v_gross_matu_amt), -1, 'C', 'D')
              INTO v_drcr
              FROM DUAL;

            get_gl_code (v_trnt_type,
                         v_prod_code,
                         v_trnt_code,
                         v_trnt_gl_code,
                         v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                         NULL,
                         v_renewal);
            valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                       v_org_code,
                       v_brh_code,
                       v_trnt_type);

            IF NVL (v_cont_acc_param, 'Y') = 'Y'
            THEN
                v_gl_count := v_gl_count + 1;

                interface_append_gl (v_trans_code, --v_trans_code        NUMBER,
                                     v_user_name, --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                                     v_pol_code, --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                                     v_prod_code, --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                                     v_vchr_no, --v_vchr_no            VARCHAR2,
                                     NULL,       --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                                     NULL,       --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                                     NULL,     --v_rcpt_no           VARCHAR2,
                                     v_gl_count,    --v_count             NUMBER,
                                     v_matr_desc || v_policy_no,
                                     --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                                     ABS (v_gross_matu_amt),
                                     --v_amount            NUMBER,
                                     v_drcr,   --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                                     v_trnt_gl_code, --v_acc_number         VARCHAR2,
                                     v_brh_code, --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                                     v_gl_trans,
                                     --v_trn_rec   IN OUT Fms_Vouchers_Pkg.Tgl_rec_type,
                                     NULL, --v_cad_code       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                     NULL); --v_otop_code       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL)
            ELSE
                v_count := v_count + 1;

                interface_append_chq (v_trans_code,
                                      v_user_name,
                                      v_pol_code,
                                      v_prod_code,
                                      v_vchr_no,
                                      v_count,
                                     ABS (v_gross_matu_amt),
                                      v_matr_desc || v_policy_no, --v_narrative
                                      v_trnt_gl_code,
                                      v_org_code,
                                      v_brh_code,
                                      v_drcr,
                                      v_chq_dtls_rec);
            END IF;
        END IF;

        IF NVL (v_intr, 0) != 0
        THEN
            get_gl_code ('INTR_WTH',
                         v_prod_code,
                         v_trnt_code,
                         v_trnt_gl_code,
                         v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                         NULL,
                         v_renewal);
            valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                       v_org_code,
                       v_brh_code,
                       'INTR_WTH');
            valid_acc (v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                       v_org_code,
                       v_brh_code,
                       'INTR_WTH CONTRA');

            IF NVL (v_cont_acc_param, 'Y') = 'Y'
            THEN
                v_gl_count := v_gl_count + 1;
                interface_append_gl (
                    v_trans_code,                --v_trans_code        NUMBER,
                    v_user_name,               --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                    v_pol_code,                  --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                    v_prod_code,                 --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                    v_vchr_no,                --v_vchr_no            VARCHAR2,
                    NULL,                        --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                    NULL,                        --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                    NULL,                      --v_rcpt_no           VARCHAR2,
                    v_gl_count,                     --v_count             NUMBER,
                    'GUARANTEED INTEREST MATURITIES- ' || v_policy_no,
                    --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                    NVL (v_intr, 0),             --v_amount            NUMBER,
                    'D',                       --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                    v_trnt_gl_code,           --v_acc_number         VARCHAR2,
                    v_brh_code,                  --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                    v_gl_trans,
                    --v_trn_rec   IN OUT Fms_Vouchers_Pkg.Tgl_rec_type,
                    NULL,              --v_cad_code       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                    NULL);            --v_otop_code       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL)

                v_gl_count := v_gl_count + 1;
                interface_append_gl (
                    v_trans_code,                --v_trans_code        NUMBER,
                    v_user_name,               --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                    v_pol_code,                  --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                    v_prod_code,                 --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                    v_vchr_no,                --v_vchr_no            VARCHAR2,
                    NULL,                        --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                    NULL,                        --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                    NULL,                      --v_rcpt_no           VARCHAR2,
                    v_gl_count,                     --v_count             NUMBER,
                    'GUARANTEED INTEREST MATURITIES- ' || v_policy_no,
                    --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                    NVL (v_intr, 0),             --v_amount            NUMBER,
                    'C',                       --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                    v_trnt_contra_gl_code,           --v_acc_number         VARCHAR2,
                    v_brh_code,                  --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                    v_gl_trans,
                    --v_trn_rec   IN OUT Fms_Vouchers_Pkg.Tgl_rec_type,
                    NULL,              --v_cad_code       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                    NULL);            --v_otop_code       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL)
            ELSE

        --LMS_MATR_ALLOCATIONS

            THEN

                THEN
                    BEGIN
                        SELECT pol_policy_no, pol_proposal_no
                          INTO v_to_policy_no, v_to_proposal_no
                          FROM lms_policies,

                         WHERE     pol_code = alloc.lma_to_pol_code
                               AND pol_current_endr_code = endr_code
                               AND endr_agen_code = agn_code(+);
                    EXCEPTION
                        WHEN OTHERS
                        THEN
                            raise_error (
                                'Error fetching policy/proposal to allocate funds to.');
                    END;
                ELSIF alloc.lma_to_ppr_code IS NOT NULL
                THEN
                    BEGIN
                        SELECT ppr_proposal_no
                          INTO v_to_proposal_no
                          FROM lms_pol_proposals, lms_agencies
                         WHERE     ppr_code = alloc.lma_to_ppr_code
                               AND ppr_agn_code = agn_code;
                    EXCEPTION
                        WHEN OTHERS

                                'Error fetching proposal to allocate funds to.');

                THEN

                ELSE
                    v_pp_desc := 'MATRTY TOWARDS PROP - ' || v_to_proposal_no;

                get_gl_code ('DR_RCT',
                             v_prod_code,
                             v_trnt_code,
                             v_trnt_gl_code,
                             v_trnt_contra_gl_code,

        END LOOP;

        IF NVL (v_net_amount, 0) != 0
        THEN
            IF SIGN (NVL (v_net_amount, 0)) = -1
            THEN
                get_gl_code ('UNRC',
                             v_prod_code,
                             v_trnt_code,
                             v_trnt_gl_code,
                             v_trnt_contra_gl_code,

                    v_trans_code,               --v_trans_code         NUMBER,

                    v_vchr_no,                --v_vchr_no            VARCHAR2,
                    NULL,                        --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                    NULL,                        --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                    NULL,                      --v_rcpt_no           VARCHAR2,
                    v_gl_count,                     --v_count             NUMBER,
                    'MATURITY NEGATIVE EXCESS - ' || v_policy_no,
                    --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                    ABS (NVL (v_net_amount, 0)),
                    --v_amount            NUMBER,
                    'D',                       --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                    v_trnt_gl_code,
                    --v_acc_number         VARCHAR2,
                    v_brh_code,                  --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                    v_gl_trans,
                    --v_trn_rec   IN OUT Fms_Vouchers_Pkg.Tgl_rec_type,
                    NULL,              --v_cad_code       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                    NULL);            --v_otop_code       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL)
                ELSE
                    IF NVL (v_cont_acc_param, 'Y') = 'Y'
                    THEN
                        get_gl_code (v_trnt_type,
                                     v_prod_code,
                                     v_trnt_code,
                                     v_trnt_gl_code,
                                     v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                     NULL,
                                     v_renewal);
                        valid_acc (v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                   v_org_code,
                                   v_brh_code,
                                   v_trnt_type || ' CONTRA');
                        v_gl_count := v_gl_count + 1;
                        interface_append_gl (v_trans_code,
                                             --v_trans_code         NUMBER,
                                             v_user_name,
                                             --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                                             v_pol_code, --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                                             v_prod_code, --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                                             v_vchr_no,
                                             --v_vchr_no            VARCHAR2,
                                             NULL, --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                                             NULL, --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                                             NULL, --v_rcpt_no           VARCHAR2,
                                             v_gl_count, --v_count             NUMBER,
                                             'MATURITY - ' || v_policy_no,
                                             --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                                             ABS (NVL (v_net_amount, 0)),
                                             --v_amount            NUMBER,
                                             'C', --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                                             v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                             --v_acc_number        VARCHAR2,
                                             v_brh_code, --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                                             v_gl_trans,
                                             --v_trn_rec   IN OUT Fms_Vouchers_Pkg.Tgl_rec_type,
                                             NULL,
                                             --v_cad_code       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                             NULL); --v_otop_code       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL)
                    END IF;
                END IF;
            END IF;

            IF NVL (v_net_amount, 0) > 0
            THEN
                IF NVL (v_pay_at_claim, 'I') = 'A'
                THEN
                    SELECT COUNT (1)
                      INTO v_log_cnt
                      FROM lms_process_maturity_log
                     WHERE     prmat_pol_code = v_pol_code
                           AND prmat_ppm_code = v_ppm_code;

                    IF v_log_cnt = 0
                    THEN
                        SELECT TO_NUMBER (
                                      TO_CHAR (SYSDATE, 'YYYY')
                                   || lms_prmat_code_seq.NEXTVAL)
                          INTO v_prmat_code
                          FROM DUAL;

                        INSERT INTO lms_process_maturity_log (
                                        prmat_code,
                                        prmat_pol_code,
                                        prmat_policy_no,
                                        prmat_status,
                                        prmat_mat_amnt,
                                        prmat_ppm_code,
                                        prmat_maturity_no)
                             VALUES (v_prmat_code,
                                     v_pol_code,
                                     v_policy_no,
                                     'A',
                                     v_net_amount,
                                     v_ppm_code,
                                     v_maturity_no);
                    ELSE
                        UPDATE lms_process_maturity_log
                           SET prmat_status = 'A',
                               prmat_mat_amnt = v_net_amount
                         WHERE     prmat_pol_code = v_pol_code
                               AND prmat_ppm_code = v_ppm_code;
                    END IF;

                    UPDATE lms_policy_prtl_maturities
                       SET ppm_paid = 'Y'
                     WHERE     ppm_pol_code = v_pol_code
                           AND ppm_code = v_ppm_code;
                ELSIF NVL (v_consldtd_pymt, 'N') = 'Y'
                THEN
                    get_gl_code ('POL_MTRF',
                                 v_prod_code,
                                 v_trnt_code,
                                 v_trnt_gl_code,
                                 v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                 NULL,
                                 v_renewal);
                    valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                               v_org_code,
                               v_brh_code,
                               'POL_MTRF');
                    IF NVL (v_cont_acc_param, 'Y') = 'Y'
                    THEN
                        v_gl_count := v_gl_count + 1;
                        interface_append_gl (
                            v_trans_code,               --v_trans_code         NUMBER,
                            v_user_name,               --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                            v_pol_code,                  --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                            v_prod_code,                 --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                            v_vchr_no,                --v_vchr_no            VARCHAR2,
                            NULL,                        --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                            NULL,                        --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                            NULL,                      --v_rcpt_no           VARCHAR2,
                            v_gl_count,                     --v_count             NUMBER,
                            'CONSOLIDATED PARTIAL MATURITY - ' || v_policy_no,
                            --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                            ABS (NVL (v_net_amount, 0)),
                            --v_amount            NUMBER,
                            'C',                       --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                            v_trnt_gl_code,
                            --v_acc_number         VARCHAR2,
                            v_brh_code,                  --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                            v_gl_trans,
                            --v_trn_rec   IN OUT Fms_Vouchers_Pkg.Tgl_rec_type,
                            NULL,              --v_cad_code       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                            NULL);            --v_otop_code       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL)
                    ELSE
                        v_count := v_count + 1;
                        interface_append_chq (v_trans_code,
                                              v_user_name,
                                              v_pol_code,
                                              v_prod_code,
                                              v_vchr_no,
                                              v_count,
                                              ABS (NVL (v_debt_recovery, 0)),
                                              'CONSOLIDATED PARTIAL MATURITY - ' || v_policy_no,
                                              v_trnt_gl_code,
                                              v_org_code,
                                              v_brh_code,
                                              v_drcr,
                                              v_chq_dtls_rec);

                    END IF;
                ELSE
                    /* IF  v_pm_maturity_type=  'TPD_MTR' THEN
                         BEGIN
                             SELECT CIP_PAY_BEN
                             INTO  v_cip_pay_ben
                             FROM  LMS_CLM_INST_PAYMENT
                             WHERE CIP_CODE = v_ppm_code;
                         EXCEPTION
                             WHEN  OTHERS   THEN
                                 NULL;
                         END ;
                         IF  NVL(v_cip_pay_ben,'N') = 'Y' THEN
                             SELECT COUNT(1),SUM(NVL(BEN_PCT_BENEFIT,0))
                             INTO  v_ben_cnt,v_ben_pct_benefit
                             FROM  LMS_POLICY_BENEFICIARIES,LMS_CLM_INST_PAYMENT,LMS_POLICIES
                             WHERE  CIP_CODE = v_ppm_code
                             AND  CIP_POL_CODE = POL_CODE
                             AND  BEN_ENDR_CODE = POL_CURRENT_ENDR_CODE;
                         END  IF;
                      END  IF;
                    --  RAISE_ERROR(v_cip_pay_ben||';;'||v_ben_pct_benefit);
                      IF  v_ben_cnt <>0 AND  NVL(v_cip_pay_ben,'N') = 'Y' THEN
                         IF  NVL(v_ben_pct_benefit,0)<> 100 THEN
                             RAISE_ERROR('The total  percentages  for  the  beneficiaries  does  not  add up  to  100%....');
                         END  IF;
                         get_gl_code (v_trnt_type,
                                           v_prod_code,
                                           v_trnt_code,
                                           v_crt_acc_no,
                                           v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                           null,
                                           v_renewal
                                          );
                              v_org_code := fms_interfaces_pkg.get_org (v_brh_code);
                              valid_acc (v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                         v_org_code,
                                         v_brh_code,
                                         v_trnt_type||' CONTRA'
                                        );
                         FOR  B  IN  BEN LOOP
                             BEGIN
                                 INSERT  INTO  LMS_BEN_MATURITY_PAYMENTS(BMPMT_CODE,BMPMT_BEN_CODE,
                                  BMPMT_MATURITY_AMT,      BMPMT_PMPMT_CODE,BMPMT_VCHR_NO)
                                 VALUES (TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'RRRR')||LMS_BMPMT_CODE_SEQ.NEXTVAL,B.BEN_CODE,
                                 NVL(v_net_amount,0)*(B.BEN_PCT_BENEFIT/100),B.PMPMT_CODE,v_vchr_no||'-'||B.BEN_CODE);
                             EXCEPTION
                                 WHEN  OTHERS  THEN
                                     RAISE_ERROR('Error creating  beneficiary  maturity  details......');

                             END;
                              v_trans_no := NVL (v_trans_no, 0) + 1;
                              interface_append_chq (v_trans_code,       --v_trans_code      NUMBER,
                                                    v_user_name,    --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                                                    v_pol_code,      --v_pol_code           NUMBER,
                                                    v_prod_code,     --v_prod_code          NUMBER,
                                                    v_vchr_no||'-'||B.BEN_CODE,    --v_vchr_no             VARCHAR2,
                                                    v_trans_no,      --v_count              NUMBER,
                                                    NVL(v_net_amount,0)*(B.BEN_PCT_BENEFIT/100),    --v_amount             NUMBER,
                                                    v_matr_desc || '- ' || v_policy_no,
                                                    --v_narrative          VARCHAR2,
                                                    v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                                    --v_acc_number         VARCHAR2,
                                                    v_org_code,    --v_acc_org_code         NUMBER,
                                                    v_brh_code,      --v_branch_code        NUMBER,
                                                    'D',           --v_drcr               VARCHAR2,
                                                    v_chq_dtls_rec
                                                   );
                              --v_trn_rec   IN OUT   Fms_Cheques_Pkg.Type_rqn_dtls_table)
                              v_bbr_code := NVL(v_bbr_code,bnk_bbr_code (v_pol_code));
                              v_account_number := NVL(v_account_number,bnk_account (v_pol_code));
                              interface_create_reqn
                                          (v_trans_code,            --v_trans_code          NUMBER,
                                           v_vchr_no||'-'||B.BEN_CODE,           --v_ref                   VARCHAR2,
                                           v_ppm_code,          --v_ref2                  VARCHAR2,
                                           TRUNC (SYSDATE),         --v_ref_date              DATE,
                                              v_matr_desc
                                           || v_policy_no
                                           || '('
                                           || NVL (v_pay_method, 'CHQ')
                                           || ')',              --v_narrative             VARCHAR2,
                                           NVL(v_net_amount,0)*(B.BEN_PCT_BENEFIT/100), --v_amount                NUMBER,
                                           B.BEN_FIRST_NAME||' '||B.BEN_OTHER_NAMES,             --v_payee                 VARCHAR2,
                                           NVL (v_pay_method, 'CHQ'),
                                           --v_pay_method            VARCHAR2, --CHQ, EFT
                                           v_account_number, --v_payee_bank_acc_no        VARCHAR2,
                                           v_bbr_code,         --v_payee_bank_branch_code   NUMBER,
                                           v_user_name,         --v_source_auth_by        VARCHAR2,
                                           TRUNC (SYSDATE),         --v_source_auth_dt        DATE,
                                           v_prepared_by,       --v_raise_by                VARCHAR2,
                                           v_pm_maturity_type,  --v_pmt_type              VARCHAR2,
                                           v_brh_code,             --v_branch_code          NUMBER,
                                           v_pol_code,                                --v_pol_code,
                                           v_chq_dtls_rec
                                          );
                         END  LOOP;
                      ELSE */
                    v_trans_no := NVL (v_trans_no, 0) + 1;
                    get_gl_code (v_trnt_type,
                                 v_prod_code,
                                 v_trnt_code,
                                 v_crt_acc_no,
                                 v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                 NULL,
                                 v_renewal);
                    v_org_code := fms_interfaces_pkg.get_org (v_brh_code);

                    IF NVL (v_cont_acc_param, 'Y') = 'Y'
                    THEN
                        valid_acc (v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                   v_org_code,
                                   v_brh_code,
                                   v_trnt_type || ' CONTRA');
                        v_credit_acc := v_trnt_contra_gl_code;
                    ELSE
                        valid_acc (v_crt_acc_no,
                                   v_org_code,
                                   v_brh_code,
                                   v_trnt_type);
                        v_credit_acc := v_crt_acc_no;
                    END IF;

                    --v_trn_rec   IN OUT   Fms_Cheques_Pkg.Type_rqn_dtls_table)
                    v_bbr_code := NVL (v_bbr_code, bnk_bbr_code (v_pol_code));
                    v_account_number :=
                        NVL (v_account_number, bnk_account (v_pol_code));

                    --CASHBACK  is a claim payment Type
                    IF v_pm_maturity_type = 'CP_NCD'
                    THEN
                        v_pm_maturity_type := 'NCD';
                    ELSIF v_prod_type = 'AN'
                    THEN
                        v_pm_maturity_type := 'AN_MTR';
                    END IF;
                    
                    v_chq_cnt := 0;
                    IF NVL (v_po_amt, 0) > 0
                    THEN
                        IF NVL (v_net_amount, 0) - NVL (v_po_amt, 0) > 0
                        THEN
                            v_chq_cnt := v_chq_cnt + 1;
                            IF NVL (v_cont_acc_param, 'Y') = 'Y'
                            THEN
                                interface_append_chq (
                                    v_trans_code,  --v_trans_code      NUMBER,
                                    v_user_name, --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                                    v_pol_code, --v_pol_code           NUMBER,
                                    v_prod_code, --v_prod_code          NUMBER,
                                    v_vchr_no || '-' || v_chq_cnt,
                                    --v_vchr_no             VARCHAR2,
                                    v_trans_no, --v_count              NUMBER,
                                    (  NVL (v_net_amount, 0)
                                     - NVL (v_po_amt, 0)), --v_amount             NUMBER,
                                    v_matr_desc || '- ' || v_policy_no,
                                    --v_narrative          VARCHAR2,
                                    v_credit_acc,     --v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                    --v_acc_number         VARCHAR2,
                                    v_org_code, --v_acc_org_code         NUMBER,
                                    v_brh_code, --v_branch_code        NUMBER,
                                    'D',      --v_drcr               VARCHAR2,
                                    v_chq_dtls_rec);
                            END IF;

                            interface_create_reqn (
                                v_trans_code,  --v_trans_code          NUMBER,
                                v_vchr_no || '-' || v_chq_cnt,
                                --v_ref                   VARCHAR2,
                                v_ppm_code, --v_ref2                  VARCHAR2,
                                TRUNC (SYSDATE), --v_ref_date              DATE,
                                   v_matr_desc
                                || v_policy_no
                                || '('
                                || NVL (v_pay_method, 'CHQ')
                                || ')',    --v_narrative             VARCHAR2,
                                (NVL (v_net_amount, 0) - NVL (v_po_amt, 0)), --v_amount                NUMBER,
                                v_payee,   --v_payee                 VARCHAR2,
                                NVL (v_pay_method, 'CHQ'),
                                --v_pay_method            VARCHAR2, --CHQ, EFT
                                v_account_number, --v_payee_bank_acc_no        VARCHAR2,
                                v_bbr_code, --v_payee_bank_branch_code   NUMBER,
                                v_user_name, --v_source_auth_by        VARCHAR2,
                                TRUNC (SYSDATE), --v_source_auth_dt        DATE,
                                v_prepared_by, --v_raise_by                VARCHAR2,
                                v_pm_maturity_type, --v_pmt_type              VARCHAR2,
                            v_brh_code,       --v_branch_code          NUMBER,
                                v_pol_code,                      --v_pol_code,
                                v_chq_dtls_rec,
                                NULL,
                                NULL,
                                NULL,
                                NULL,
                                NULL,
                                v_mpt_code,
                                v_clnt_id_passport_no,
                                v_id_type);
                        END IF;

                        IF NVL (v_po_amt, 0) > 0
                        THEN
                            FOR m IN matr_alloc_payouts
                            LOOP
                                IF m.lma_amt > 0
                                THEN
                                    v_chq_cnt := v_chq_cnt + 1;
                                    interface_append_chq (
                                        v_trans_code, --v_trans_code      NUMBER,
                                        v_user_name, --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                                        v_pol_code, --v_pol_code           NUMBER,
                                        v_prod_code, --v_prod_code          NUMBER,
                                        v_vchr_no || '-' || v_chq_cnt,
                                        --v_vchr_no             VARCHAR2,
                                        v_trans_no, --v_count              NUMBER,
                                        m.lma_amt, --v_amount             NUMBER,
                                        v_matr_desc || '- ' || v_policy_no,
                                        --v_narrative          VARCHAR2,
                                    v_credit_acc,     --v_acc_number         VARCHAR2,
                                        v_org_code, --v_acc_org_code         NUMBER,
                                        v_brh_code, --v_branch_code        NUMBER,
                                        'D',  --v_drcr               VARCHAR2,
                                        v_chq_dtls_rec);
                                    interface_create_reqn (
                                        v_trans_code, --v_trans_code          NUMBER,
                                        v_vchr_no || '-' || v_chq_cnt,
                                        --v_ref                   VARCHAR2,
                                        v_ppm_code, --v_ref2                  VARCHAR2,
                                        TRUNC (SYSDATE), --v_ref_date              DATE,
                                           v_matr_desc
                                        || v_policy_no
                                        || '('
                                        || NVL (v_pay_method, 'CHQ')
                                        || ')', --v_narrative             VARCHAR2,
                                        m.lma_amt, --v_amount                NUMBER,
                                        NVL (m.lma_payee, v_payee),
                                        --v_payee                 VARCHAR2,
                                        NVL (v_pay_method, 'CHQ'),
                                        --v_pay_method            VARCHAR2, --CHQ, EFT
                                        v_account_number,
                                        --v_payee_bank_acc_no        VARCHAR2,
                                        v_bbr_code, --v_payee_bank_branch_code   NUMBER,
                                        v_user_name, --v_source_auth_by        VARCHAR2,
                                        TRUNC (SYSDATE), --v_source_auth_dt        DATE,
                                        v_prepared_by,
                                        --v_raise_by                VARCHAR2,
                                        v_pm_maturity_type,
                                        --v_pmt_type              VARCHAR2,
                                    v_brh_code, --v_branch_code          NUMBER,
                                        v_pol_code,              --v_pol_code,
                                        v_chq_dtls_rec,
                                        NULL,
                                        NULL,
                                        NULL,
                                        NULL,
                                        NULL,
                                        v_mpt_code,
                                        v_clnt_id_passport_no,
                                        v_id_type);
                                END IF;
                            END LOOP;
                        END IF;
                    ELSE
                        IF NVL (v_net_amount, 0) > 0
                        THEN
                            IF NVL (v_cont_acc_param, 'Y') = 'Y'
                            THEN
                                interface_append_chq (
                                    v_trans_code,  --v_trans_code      NUMBER,
                                    v_user_name, --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                                    v_pol_code, --v_pol_code           NUMBER,
                                    v_prod_code, --v_prod_code          NUMBER,
                                    v_vchr_no, --v_vchr_no             VARCHAR2,
                                    v_trans_no, --v_count              NUMBER,
                                    NVL (v_net_amount, 0), --v_amount             NUMBER,
                                    v_matr_desc || '- ' || v_policy_no,
                                    --v_narrative          VARCHAR2,
                                    v_credit_acc,
                                    --v_acc_number         VARCHAR2,
                                    v_org_code, --v_acc_org_code         NUMBER,
                                    v_brh_code, --v_branch_code        NUMBER,
                                    'D',      --v_drcr               VARCHAR2,
                                    v_chq_dtls_rec);
                            END IF;

                            interface_create_reqn (
                                v_trans_code,  --v_trans_code          NUMBER,
                                v_vchr_no, --v_ref                   VARCHAR2,
                                v_ppm_code, --v_ref2                  VARCHAR2,
                                TRUNC (SYSDATE), --v_ref_date              DATE,
                                   v_matr_desc
                                || v_policy_no
                                || '('
                                || NVL (v_pay_method, 'CHQ')
                                || ')',    --v_narrative             VARCHAR2,
                            NVL (v_net_amount, 0), --v_amount                NUMBER,
                                v_payee,   --v_payee                 VARCHAR2,
                                NVL (v_pay_method, 'CHQ'),
                                --v_pay_method            VARCHAR2, --CHQ, EFT
                                v_account_number, --v_payee_bank_acc_no        VARCHAR2,
                                v_bbr_code, --v_payee_bank_branch_code   NUMBER,
                                v_user_name, --v_source_auth_by        VARCHAR2,
                                TRUNC (SYSDATE), --v_source_auth_dt        DATE,
                                v_prepared_by, --v_raise_by                VARCHAR2,
                                v_pm_maturity_type, --v_pmt_type              VARCHAR2,
                            v_brh_code,       --v_branch_code          NUMBER,
                                v_pol_code,                      --v_pol_code,
                                v_chq_dtls_rec,
                                NULL,
                                NULL,
                                NULL,
                                NULL,
                                NULL,
                                v_mpt_code,
                                v_clnt_id_passport_no,
                                v_id_type);
                        END IF;
                    END IF;
                -- END  IF;
                END IF;
            --v_dtls_table  IN OUT Fms_Cheques_Pkg.Type_rqn_dtls_table)
            ELSE
                -- ENABLE TO TAKE CARE OF UPDATES WHEN NET AMT IS ZERO THUS NO CHQ RAISED.........
                lms_api.update_matuities (v_vchr_no,
                                          v_ppm_code,
                                          'NO CHEQUE ISSUED',
                                          TRUNC (SYSDATE),
                                          0,
                                          v_user_name);

            IF v_trnt_type IN ('POL_MTRF', 'POL_MTR')
            THEN
                UPDATE lms_policy_prtl_maturities
                   SET ppm_paid = 'Y'
                 WHERE ppm_code = v_ppm_code;
            END IF;
        END IF;

        IF NVL (v_cont_acc_param, 'Y') = 'Y' AND v_gl_count > 0
        THEN
            interface_update_vgl (v_trans_code,     --v_trans_code     NUMBER,
                                  v_user_name, -- v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                                  v_pol_code,   -- v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                                  TRUNC (SYSDATE),    --  v_date         DATE,
                                  NULL,        --  v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                                  NULL,        --  v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                                  'LMS MATURITY BATCH',
                                  --  v_btc_description   VARCHAR2,
                                  'JV',      -- v_btc_type           VARCHAR2,
                                  v_brh_code,   -- v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                                  'LMS MATURITY VOUCHER',
                                  -- v_description       VARCHAR2,
                                  v_vchr_no,   --v_rcpt_no           VARCHAR2,
                                  v_gl_trans);
        END IF;

        IF NVL (v_net_amount, 0) > 0
        THEN
            BEGIN
                lms_process_alerts.pol_dets_event_alert (
                    v_pol_code,
                    v_pm_maturity_type || '_MSG',
                    v_pm_maturity_type || '_MSG');
            EXCEPTION
                WHEN OTHERS
                THEN
                    NULL;
            END;
        END IF;
    --v_gl_trans  IN OUT  Fms_Vouchers_Pkg.Tgl_rec_type,
    --   EXCEPTION
    --      WHEN OTHERS
    --      THEN
    --         raise_error (   'MATURITIES FOR POL. NO.'
    --                      || v_policy_no
    --                      || ', TYPE - '
    --                      || v_pm_maturity_type
    --                      || ', VCHR. NO.'
    --                      || v_vchr_no
    --                      || '....'
    --                         || 'v_ppm_code - '
    --                         || v_ppm_code
    --                     );
    END process_maturities;

    PROCEDURE process_surrenders (
        v_vchr_no       VARCHAR2,
        v_pol_code      NUMBER,
        v_surr_amount   NUMBER,
        v_surr_date     DATE,
        v_user_name     VARCHAR2,
        v_pay_method    VARCHAR2 DEFAULT 'CHQ',
        v_nfl_alloc     NUMBER DEFAULT 0
    )
    IS
        v_payee_eft_rec             fms_cheques_pkg.type_payee_eft_table;
        v_chq_dtls_rec              fms_cheques_pkg.type_rqn_dtls_table;
        v_bbr_code                  NUMBER;
        v_account_number            VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_eft_enabled               VARCHAR2 (1) := 'N';
        v_policy_no                 VARCHAR2 (30);
        v_brh_code                  NUMBER;
        v_trnt_type                 VARCHAR2 (5);
        v_prod_code                 NUMBER;
        v_trnt_code                 VARCHAR2 (10);
        v_trnt_gl_code              VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_trnt_contra_gl_code       VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_org_code                  NUMBER;
        v_crt_acc_no                VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_payee                     VARCHAR2 (100);
        v_surr_amt                  NUMBER;
        v_os_prem                   NUMBER;
        v_os_loan                   NUMBER;
        v_net_amt                   NUMBER;
        v_ref_prem                  NUMBER;
        v_tot_matrty_paid           NUMBER;
        v_basic_surr_amt            NUMBER;
        v_trans_no                  NUMBER := 0;
        v_count                     NUMBER := 0;
        v_gl_trans                  fms_vouchers_pkg.tgl_rec_type;
        v_vgl_no                    NUMBER;
        v_gl_count                  NUMBER := 0;
        v_unrecoverable             NUMBER;
        v_less_pd_mat               VARCHAR2 (5);
        v_drcr                      VARCHAR2 (5);
        v_trans_code                NUMBER;
        v_psur_alloc_to             VARCHAR2 (15);
        v_psur_alloc_to_ref         NUMBER;
        v_oppr_code                 NUMBER;
        v_proposal_no               VARCHAR2 (30);
        v_prod_code_to              NUMBER;
        v_rct_branch_to             NUMBER;
        v_oppr_receipt_trans_code   VARCHAR2 (50);
        v_cur_code                  NUMBER;
        v_chkoff_agen_code          NUMBER := NULL;
        v_chkoff_rate               NUMBER := NULL;
        v_ann_chk                   VARCHAR2 (10);
        v_psur_pol_code             NUMBER;
        v_pol_type                  VARCHAR2 (10);
        v_rct_code                  VARCHAR2 (50);
        v_contra_acc                VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_pay_method_code           NUMBER;
        v_alloc_to_pol_code         NUMBER;
        v_bonuses                   NUMBER;
        v_trans_type                VARCHAR2 (5);
        v_psur_offset_prem          VARCHAR2 (5);
        v_btc_description           VARCHAR2 (100);
        v_description               VARCHAR2 (100);
        v_narrative                 VARCHAR2 (100);
        v_surr_desc                 VARCHAR2 (100);
        v_refund_narrative          VARCHAR2 (100);
        v_mpt_code                  lms_policy_surrenders.psur_mpt_code%TYPE;
        v_clnt_mob_no               lms_policy_surrenders.psur_clnt_mob_no%TYPE;
        v_clnt_id_passport_no       lms_policy_surrenders.psur_clnt_id_passport_no%TYPE;
        v_id_type                   VARCHAR2 (50);
        v_tbonus                    lms_policy_surrenders.psur_tbonus%TYPE;
        v_matr_reinv_intr           lms_policy_surrenders.psur_matr_reinv_intr%TYPE;
        v_unpaid_matr_amt           lms_policy_surrenders.psur_unpaid_matr_amt%TYPE;
        v_done_by                   lms_policy_surrenders.psur_done_by%TYPE;
        v_psur_but_pay_amt          lms_policy_surrenders.psur_but_pay_amt%TYPE;
        v_renewal                   VARCHAR2 (5);
        v_tot_loan_intr             NUMBER;
        v_ln_intr_trnt_gl_code      VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_pens_amt                  NUMBER;
        v_unalloc_amt               NUMBER;
        v_inv_fee                   NUMBER;
        v_inv_contri                NUMBER;
        v_inv_admin                 NUMBER;
        v_comfnd                    NUMBER;
        v_comp_param                VARCHAR2 (5);
        v_alloc_to                  VARCHAR2 (5);
        v_prod_type                 VARCHAR2 (5);
        v_to_policy_no              VARCHAR2 (100);
        v_opr_drcr                  VARCHAR2 (5);
        v_opr_code                  NUMBER;
        v_act_code                  NUMBER;
        v_endr_code                 NUMBER;
        v_bal_amt                   NUMBER;
        v_prem_amt                  NUMBER;
        v_chkoff_comm               NUMBER;
        v_loan_amt                  NUMBER;
        v_unprocessed_rcpts_total   NUMBER;
        v_unprocessed_rcpts         NUMBER;
        v_separate_posting          VARCHAR2 (5);
        v_msg                       VARCHAR2 (50);
        v_prem_amt1                 NUMBER;
        v_chkoff_comm1              NUMBER;
        v_loan_amt1                 NUMBER;
        v_pens_amt1                 NUMBER;
        v_inv_admin1                NUMBER;
        v_inv_fee1                  NUMBER;
        v_inv_contri1               NUMBER;
        v_comfnd1                   NUMBER;
        v_cont_acc_param            VARCHAR2 (1) := 'Y';
        v_surr_charges              NUMBER;
        v_penalty_amt               NUMBER;
        v_prem_n_loan_amt           NUMBER;
        v_debit_penalty_amt         NUMBER := 0;
        v_penalty_param             VARCHAR2 (1);
        v_en_charge                 NUMBER;
        v_credit_surrcharge_amt     NUMBER;
        v_param_intr                VARCHAR2 (1);
        v_intr                      NUMBER := 0;
        v_os_prem_int               NUMBER;
        v_processing_fee            NUMBER;

        CURSOR cur_pol_cb_amt IS
              SELECT SUM (NVL (opr_loan_pymt_amt, 0))
                         loan_amt,
                     NVL (SUM (opr_refund_amt), 0)
                         suspense_amt,
                     -- OPR_PMTH_CODE,
                     NVL (SUM (premium_amt), 0)
                         premium_amt,
                     NVL (SUM (pension_contr), 0)
                         pension_contr,
                     DECODE (prod_type,
                             'IN', NVL (SUM (investment_fee), 0),
                             'PN', NVL (SUM (investment_fee), 0),
                             'AN', NVL (SUM (investment_fee), 0),
                             NVL (SUM (opr_policy_fee), 0))
                         investment_fee,
                     NVL (SUM (investment_contri), 0)
                         investment_contri,
                     NVL (SUM (investment_admin), 0)
                         investment_admin,
                     NVL (SUM (opr_fund_client_contr), 0)
                         comfnd,
                     (NVL (SUM (prem_comm), 0) + NVL (SUM (pens_comm), 0))
                         prem_comm,
                     NVL (SUM (pens_comm), 0)
                         pens_comm,
                     NVL (SUM (prem_tax), 0)
                         prem_tax,
                     --NVL(SUM(OPR_CHK_COMM),0) chkoff_comm,
                     0
                         chkoff_comm,
                     pol_bra_code,
                     pol_prod_code,
                     pol_type,
                     pol_prod_type,
                     NVL (opr_alloc_to, 'PR')
                         alloc_to,
                     NVL (inv_all_prem_valid (pol_code), 'N')
                         inv_all_prem,
                     DECODE (NVL (endr_pay_method, 'C'),
                             'K', 'CK',
                             NVL (endr_pay_method, 'C'))
                         acc_type,
                     opr_code,
                     pol_policy_no,
                     pol_code,
                     prod_calc_inv_from_sa,
                     'N'
                         renewal
                FROM lms_ord_prem_receipts,
                     lms_policies,
                     lms_policy_endorsements,
                     lms_products,
                     (  SELECT opri_opr_code,
                               NVL (SUM (opri_amt), 0)              premium_amt,
                               NVL (SUM (opri_prem_tax_amt), 0)     prem_tax,
                               NVL (SUM (opri_chk_comm_amt), 0)     chkoff_comm,
                               NVL (SUM (opri_comm_amt), 0)         prem_comm
                          FROM lms_ord_receipt_instlmnts, lms_ord_prem_receipts
                         WHERE     NVL (inv_all_prem_valid (opri_pol_code), 'N') =
                                   'N'
                               AND opri_opr_code = opr_code
                               AND opr_code = v_opr_code
                      --AND OPR_RECEIPT_TRANS_CODE = NVL(v_opr_rct_trans_code,OPR_RECEIPT_TRANS_CODE)
                      GROUP BY opri_opr_code
                      UNION
                        SELECT opri_opr_code,
                               SUM (
                                     NVL (opri_amt, 0)
                                   - lms_investments.basic_prem_ratio (
                                         opri_pol_code,
                                         NVL (opri_amt, 0)))       premium_amt,
                               SUM (NVL (opri_prem_tax_amt, 0))    prem_tax,
                               --   -Lms_Investments.Basic_prem_ratio(OPRI_POL_CODE,NVL(OPRI_PREM_TAX_AMT,0)) prem_tax,
                               SUM (NVL (opri_chk_comm_amt, 0))    chkoff_comm,
                               --  -Lms_Investments.Basic_prem_ratio(OPRI_POL_CODE,NVL(OPRI_CHK_COMM_AMT,0))
                               SUM (NVL (opri_comm_amt, 0))        prem_comm
                          --   -Lms_Investments.Basic_prem_ratio(OPRI_POL_CODE,NVL(OPRI_COMM_AMT,0)) prem_comm
                          FROM lms_ord_receipt_instlmnts, lms_ord_prem_receipts
                         WHERE     NVL (inv_all_prem_valid (opri_pol_code), 'N') =
                                   'Y'
                               AND NVL (inv_basic_prem_valid, 'N') = 'Y'
                               AND opri_opr_code = opr_code
                               AND opr_code = v_opr_code
                      --AND OPR_RECEIPT_TRANS_CODE = NVL(v_opr_rct_trans_code, OPR_RECEIPT_TRANS_CODE)
                      GROUP BY opri_opr_code),
                     (  SELECT pndpo_opr_code,
                               NVL (SUM (pndpo_tot_amt), 0)
                                   pension_contr,
                               NVL (SUM (pndpo_admin_fee), 0)
                                   investment_fee,
                               NVL (SUM (pndpo_empye_amt), 0)
                                   investment_contri,
                               NVL (SUM (pndpo_empyr_amt), 0)
                                   investment_admin,
                               NVL (SUM (pndpo_comm_amt), 0)
                                   pens_comm
                          FROM lms_pension_deposits_ord, lms_ord_prem_receipts
                         WHERE     pndpo_opr_code = opr_code
                               AND opr_code = v_opr_code
                      --AND OPR_RECEIPT_TRANS_CODE = NVL(v_opr_rct_trans_code,OPR_RECEIPT_TRANS_CODE)
                      GROUP BY pndpo_opr_code)
               WHERE     pol_code = opr_pol_code
                     AND pol_current_endr_code = endr_code
                     AND opr_code = v_opr_code
                     AND opri_opr_code(+) = opr_code
                     AND pndpo_opr_code(+) = opr_code
                     AND NVL (v_separate_posting, 'N') = 'N'
                     AND pol_prod_code = prod_code
            GROUP BY opr_code,
                     pol_bra_code,
                     pol_prod_code,
                     pol_type,
                     pol_prod_type,
                     opr_alloc_to,
                     endr_pay_method,
                     NVL (inv_all_prem_valid (pol_code), 'N'),
                     DECODE (NVL (endr_pay_method, 'C'),
                             'K', 'CK',
                             NVL (endr_pay_method, 'C')),
                     pol_policy_no,
                     pol_code,
                     prod_calc_inv_from_sa,
                     prod_type
            UNION ALL
              SELECT SUM (NVL (opr_loan_pymt_amt, 0))
                         loan_amt,
                     NVL (SUM (opr_refund_amt), 0)
                         suspense_amt,
                     -- OPR_PMTH_CODE,
                     NVL (SUM (premium_amt), 0)
                         premium_amt,
                     NVL (SUM (pension_contr), 0)
                         pension_contr,
                     DECODE (prod_type,
                             'IN', NVL (SUM (investment_fee), 0),
                             'PN', NVL (SUM (investment_fee), 0),
                             'AN', NVL (SUM (investment_fee), 0),
                             NVL (SUM (opr_policy_fee), 0))
                         investment_fee,
                     NVL (SUM (investment_contri), 0)
                         investment_contri,
                     NVL (SUM (investment_admin), 0)
                         investment_admin,
                     NVL (SUM (opr_fund_client_contr), 0)
                         comfnd,
                     (NVL (SUM (prem_comm), 0) + NVL (SUM (pens_comm), 0))
                         prem_comm,
                     NVL (SUM (pens_comm), 0)
                         pens_comm,
                     NVL (SUM (prem_tax), 0)
                         prem_tax,
                     --NVL(SUM(OPR_CHK_COMM),0) chkoff_comm,
                     0
                         chkoff_comm,
                     pol_bra_code,
                     pol_prod_code,
                     pol_type,
                     pol_prod_type,
                     NVL (opr_alloc_to, 'PR')
                         alloc_to,
                     NVL (inv_all_prem_valid (pol_code), 'N')
                         inv_all_prem,
                     DECODE (NVL (endr_pay_method, 'C'),
                             'K', 'CK',
                             NVL (endr_pay_method, 'C'))
                         acc_type,
                     opr_code,
                     pol_policy_no,
                     pol_code,
                     prod_calc_inv_from_sa,
                     NVL (renewal, pensrenewal)
                         renewal
                FROM lms_ord_prem_receipts,
                     lms_policies,
                     lms_policy_endorsements,
                     lms_products,
                     (  SELECT opri_opr_code,
                               NVL (SUM (opri_amt), 0)                        premium_amt,
                               NVL (SUM (opri_prem_tax_amt), 0)               prem_tax,
                               NVL (SUM (opri_chk_comm_amt), 0)               chkoff_comm,
                               NVL (SUM (opri_comm_amt), 0)                   prem_comm,
                               lms_ord_mis.check_renewal (opri_pol_code,
                                                          opri_instlmt_no)    renewal
                          FROM lms_ord_receipt_instlmnts, lms_ord_prem_receipts
                         WHERE     NVL (inv_all_prem_valid (opri_pol_code), 'N') =
                                   'N'
                               AND opri_opr_code = opr_code
                               AND opr_code = v_opr_code
                      GROUP BY opri_opr_code,
                               lms_ord_mis.check_renewal (opri_pol_code,
                                                          opri_instlmt_no)
                      UNION
                        SELECT opri_opr_code,
                               SUM (
                                     NVL (opri_amt, 0)
                                   - lms_investments.basic_prem_ratio (
                                         opri_pol_code,
                                         NVL (opri_amt, 0)))                  premium_amt,
                               SUM (NVL (opri_prem_tax_amt, 0))               prem_tax,
                               --   -Lms_Investments.Basic_prem_ratio(OPRI_POL_CODE,NVL(OPRI_PREM_TAX_AMT,0)) prem_tax,
                               SUM (NVL (opri_chk_comm_amt, 0))               chkoff_comm,
                               --  -Lms_Investments.Basic_prem_ratio(OPRI_POL_CODE,NVL(OPRI_CHK_COMM_AMT,0))
                               SUM (NVL (opri_comm_amt, 0))                   prem_comm --   -Lms_Investments.Basic_prem_ratio(OPRI_POL_CODE,NVL(OPRI_COMM_AMT,0)) prem_comm
                                                                                       ,
                               lms_ord_mis.check_renewal (opri_pol_code,
                                                          opri_instlmt_no)    renewal
                          FROM lms_ord_receipt_instlmnts, lms_ord_prem_receipts
                         WHERE     NVL (inv_all_prem_valid (opri_pol_code), 'N') =
                                   'Y'
                               AND NVL (inv_basic_prem_valid, 'N') = 'Y'
                               AND opri_opr_code = opr_code
                               AND opr_code = v_opr_code
                      GROUP BY opri_opr_code,
                               lms_ord_mis.check_renewal (opri_pol_code,
                                                          opri_instlmt_no)),
                     (  SELECT pndpo_opr_code,
                               NVL (SUM (pndpo_tot_amt), 0)
                                   pension_contr,
                               NVL (SUM (pndpo_admin_fee), 0)
                                   investment_fee,
                               NVL (SUM (pndpo_empye_amt), 0)
                                   investment_contri,
                               NVL (SUM (pndpo_empyr_amt), 0)
                                   investment_admin,
                               NVL (SUM (pndpo_comm_amt), 0)
                                   pens_comm,
                               lms_ord_mis.check_renewal (pndpo_pol_code,
                                                          pndpo_instlmnt_no)
                                   pensrenewal
                          FROM lms_pension_deposits_ord, lms_ord_prem_receipts
                         WHERE     pndpo_opr_code = opr_code
                               AND opr_code = v_opr_code
                      GROUP BY pndpo_opr_code,
                               lms_ord_mis.check_renewal (pndpo_pol_code,
                                                          pndpo_instlmnt_no))
               WHERE     pol_code = opr_pol_code
                     AND pol_current_endr_code = endr_code
                     AND opr_code = v_opr_code
                     AND opri_opr_code(+) = opr_code
                     AND pndpo_opr_code(+) = opr_code
                     AND NVL (v_separate_posting, 'N') = 'Y'
                     AND pol_prod_code = prod_code
            GROUP BY opr_code,
                     pol_bra_code,
                     pol_prod_code,
                     pol_type,
                     pol_prod_type,
                     opr_alloc_to,
                     endr_pay_method,
