                     NVL (inv_all_prem_valid (pol_code), 'N'),
                     DECODE (NVL (endr_pay_method, 'C'),
                             'K', 'CK',
                             NVL (endr_pay_method, 'C')),
                     pol_policy_no,
                     pol_code,
                     prod_calc_inv_from_sa,
                     prod_type,
                     NVL (renewal, pensrenewal);
    BEGIN
        /*
           1. - Raise CHQ
               CR bank
               DR O/S  Maturity claims
           2. - Raise VGL
                DR Maturity claims expense ac
               CR O/S  Maturity claims
        */
        BEGIN
            lms_ord_misc.system_param_val (
                'ALLOW_FIRSTYR_RENEWAL_SEPARATION',
                v_separate_posting);
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                raise_error (
                    'PARAMETER ERROR...ALLOW_FIRSTYR_RENEWAL_SEPARATION...');
        END;

        BEGIN
            lms_ord_misc.system_param_val ('CONSOLIDATE_COMP_FUND',
                                           v_comp_param);
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                raise_error ('PARAM ERROR...');
        END;

        BEGIN
            lms_ord_misc.system_param_val ('USE_CONTRAL_ACCOUNT_AT_CLAIMS',
                                           v_cont_acc_param);
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                raise_error ('PARAM ERROR...');
        END;

        BEGIN
            lms_ord_misc.system_param_val (
                'SEPARATE_SURRENDER_PENALTY_POSTING',
                v_penalty_param);
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                raise_error ('PARAM ERROR...');
        END;


        BEGIN
            SELECT NVL(psur_processing_brn_code, pol_bra_code),
                   pol_policy_no,
                   pol_prod_code,
                   NVL (
                       psur_payee,
                       TRIM (
                              prp_first_name
                           || ' '
                           || TRIM (prp_other_names || ' ' || prp_surname))),
                   psur_surr_amount,
                   psur_os_premiums,
                   (NVL (psur_os_loans, 0) - NVL (psur_tot_loan_intr, 0))
                       psur_loan_amt_alloc,
                   psur_net_amount,
                   psur_ref_premiums,
                   psur_tot_matrty_paid,
                   psur_basic_surr_amt,
                   psur_bbr_code,
                   psur_bbr_acc_no,
                   psur_alloc_to,
                   psur_alloc_to_ref,
                   psur_alloc_to_ref2,
                   psur_pol_code,
                   'SURR' || pol_policy_no,
                   endr_checkoff_agen_code,
                   endr_checkoff_rate,
                   ltr_btr_trans_code,
                   psur_bonuses,
                   psur_offset_prem,
                   psur_mpt_code,
                   psur_clnt_mob_no,
                   psur_clnt_id_passport_no,
                   DECODE (psur_identity_type,
                           'I', 'NATIONAL ID',
                           'P', 'PASSPORT'),
                   psur_tbonus,
                   psur_matr_reinv_intr,
                   psur_unpaid_matr_amt,
                   psur_done_by,
                   psur_but_pay_amt,
                   lms_ord_mis.check_renewal_paymnt (pol_code,
                                                     psur_surr_date),
                   psur_tot_loan_intr,
                   psur_pens_amt_alloc,
                   psur_fee_alloc,
                   psur_contri_alloc,
                   psur_admin_alloc,
                   psur_comfnd_alloc,
                   psur_unalloc_rcpt_amt,
                   DECODE (NVL (psur_os_premiums, 0), 0, 'LN', 'PR'),
                   NVL ((SELECT SUM (scr_amt)
                           FROM lms_surrender_charges
                          WHERE scr_pol_code = pol_code),
                        0),
                   psur_penalty_amt,
                   psur_en_charge_amt,
                   psur_interest_amt,
                   NVL (psur_os_prem_charge, 0),
                   NVL (psur_processing_fee, 0)
              INTO v_brh_code,
                   v_policy_no,
                   v_prod_code,
                   v_payee,
                   v_surr_amt,
                   v_os_prem,
                   v_os_loan,
                   v_net_amt,
                   v_ref_prem,
                   v_tot_matrty_paid,
                   v_basic_surr_amt,
                   v_bbr_code,
                   v_account_number,
                   v_psur_alloc_to,
                   v_psur_alloc_to_ref,
                   v_proposal_no,
                   v_psur_pol_code,
                   v_rct_code,
                   v_chkoff_agen_code,
                   v_chkoff_rate,
                   v_trans_type,
                   v_bonuses,
                   v_psur_offset_prem,
                   v_mpt_code,
                   v_clnt_mob_no,
                   v_clnt_id_passport_no,
                   v_id_type,
                   v_tbonus,
                   v_matr_reinv_intr,
                   v_unpaid_matr_amt,
                   v_done_by,
                   v_psur_but_pay_amt,
                   v_renewal,
                   v_tot_loan_intr,
                   v_pens_amt,
                   v_inv_fee,
                   v_inv_contri,
                   v_inv_admin,
                   v_comfnd,
                   v_unalloc_amt,
                   v_alloc_to,
                   v_surr_charges,
                   v_penalty_amt,
                   v_en_charge,
                   v_intr,
                   v_os_prem_int,
                   v_processing_fee
              FROM lms_policies,
                   lms_proposers,
                   lms_policy_surrenders,
                   lms_policy_endorsements,
                   lms_transactions
             WHERE     pol_client_prp_code = prp_code
                   AND pol_code = v_pol_code
                   AND psur_pol_code = pol_code
                   AND psur_vchr_no = v_vchr_no
                   AND psur_ltr_trans_no = ltr_trans_no
                   AND pol_current_endr_code = endr_code;
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND
            THEN
                raise_error (
                       'SURRENDER POLICY NOT FOUND... '
                    || v_pol_code
                    || ';'
                    || v_vchr_no);
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                raise_error ('Error Fetching Surrender Policy Details... ');
        END;

        IF NVL (v_trans_type, 'SR') = 'BE'
        THEN
            v_btc_description := 'LMS BONUS SURRENDER BATCH';
            v_description := 'LMS BONUS SURRENDER VOUCHER';
            v_narrative := 'POLICY BONUS SURRENDER ';
            v_surr_desc := 'POLICY BONUS SURRENDER ';
        ELSE
            v_btc_description := 'LMS SURRENDER BATCH';
            v_description := 'LMS SURRENDER VOUCHER';
            v_narrative := 'POLICY SURRENDER ';
            v_surr_desc := 'POLICY SURRENDER ';
        END IF;

        BEGIN
            lms_ord_misc.system_param_val ('SURRENDER_LESS_PAID_MATURITY',
                                           v_less_pd_mat);

            SELECT DECODE (NVL (v_less_pd_mat, 'N'),
                           'Y', v_tot_matrty_paid,
                           0)
              INTO v_tot_matrty_paid
              FROM DUAL;
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                raise_error ('PARAMETER ERROR....');
        END;

        SELECT SUM (lsa_amt)
          INTO v_prem_n_loan_amt
          FROM lms_surr_allocations
         WHERE     lsa_pol_code = v_pol_code
               AND NVL (lsa_alloc_to, 'XX') IN ('PP',
                                                'LN',
                                                'UR',
                                                'RV');

        --raise_error ('xv_surr_amt='||v_surr_amt||'v_os_prem;'||v_os_prem||'v_os_loan;'||v_os_loan||'v_tot_matrty_paid;'||v_tot_matrty_paid||'v_ref_prem;'||v_ref_prem||'v_net_amt;'||
        --v_net_amt||'v_tbonus='||v_tbonus||'v_unpaid_matr_amt='||v_unpaid_matr_amt||'v_net_amt='||v_net_amt);
        IF NVL (v_psur_but_pay_amt, 0) != 0 
        THEN
            v_psur_but_pay_amt :=
                v_psur_but_pay_amt - NVL (v_prem_n_loan_amt, 0);
            v_net_amt := NVL (v_psur_but_pay_amt, 0);
            v_surr_amt :=
                  NVL (v_net_amt, 0)
                + NVL (v_os_prem, 0)
                + NVL (v_os_prem_int, 0)
                + NVL (v_os_loan, 0)
                + NVL (v_tot_loan_intr, 0)
                + NVL (v_unalloc_amt, 0)
                + NVL (v_inv_fee, 0)
                + NVL (v_inv_contri, 0)
                + NVL (v_inv_admin, 0)
                + NVL (v_comfnd, 0)
                + NVL (v_tot_matrty_paid, 0)
                + NVL (v_surr_charges, 0)
                + NVL (v_penalty_amt, 0)
                + NVL (v_prem_n_loan_amt, 0)
                + NVL (v_processing_fee, 0)
                - NVL (v_ref_prem, 0)
                - NVL (v_tbonus, 0)
                - NVL (v_matr_reinv_intr, 0)
                - NVL (v_unpaid_matr_amt, 0);
        END IF;

        IF   NVL (v_surr_amt, 0)
           - NVL (v_os_prem, 0)
           - NVL (v_os_prem_int, 0)
           - NVL (v_os_loan, 0)
           - NVL (v_tot_loan_intr, 0)
           - NVL (v_unalloc_amt, 0)
           - NVL (v_inv_fee, 0)
           - NVL (v_inv_contri, 0)
           - NVL (v_inv_admin, 0)
           - NVL (v_comfnd, 0)
           - NVL (v_tot_matrty_paid, 0)
           - NVL (v_surr_charges, 0)
           - NVL (v_penalty_amt, 0)
           - NVL (v_prem_n_loan_amt, 0)
           - NVL (v_processing_fee, 0)
           + NVL (v_ref_prem, 0)
           + NVL (v_tbonus, 0)
           + NVL (v_matr_reinv_intr, 0)
           + NVL (v_unpaid_matr_amt, 0) !=
           NVL (v_net_amt, 0)
        THEN
            raise_error (
                   'THE SURRENDER CALCULATION AMOUNT DO NOT ADD UP.2...'
                || ';v_surr_amt='
                || v_surr_amt
                || ';v_os_prem='
                || v_os_prem
                || ';v_os_prem_int='
                || v_os_prem_int
                || ';v_os_loan='
                || v_os_loan
                || ';v_unalloc_amt='
                || v_unalloc_amt
                || ';v_penalty_amt='
                || v_penalty_amt
                || ';v_ref_prem='
                || v_ref_prem
                || ';v_inv_contri='
                || v_inv_contri
                || ';v_net_amt='
                || v_net_amt
                || '; v_prem_n_loan_amt='
                || v_prem_n_loan_amt);
        END IF;


        BEGIN
            lms_ord_misc.system_param_val ('POST_GUARNTD_POL_INTR',
                                           v_param_intr,
                                           v_prod_code);
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                raise_error ('Parameter Error...');
        END;

        IF v_param_intr = 'Y'
        THEN
            v_intr := ROUND (v_intr, 2);
        ELSE
            v_intr := 0;
        END IF;

        v_surr_amt := v_surr_amt - NVL (v_prem_n_loan_amt, 0);

        IF NVL (v_penalty_amt, 0) <> 0 AND v_penalty_param = 'Y'
        THEN
            v_debit_penalty_amt := v_penalty_amt;
        END IF;

        IF NVL (v_en_charge, 0) <> 0 AND v_penalty_param <> 'Y'
        THEN
            v_credit_surrcharge_amt := NVL (v_en_charge, 0);
        END IF;

        SELECT    TO_NUMBER (TO_CHAR (SYSDATE, 'RRRR'))
               || lms_transaction_seq.NEXTVAL
          INTO v_trans_code
          FROM DUAL;

        v_org_code := fms_interfaces_pkg.get_org (v_brh_code);

        /*IF NVL (v_psur_but_pay_amt, 0) != 0
        THEN
            v_psur_but_pay_amt :=
                v_psur_but_pay_amt - NVL (v_prem_n_loan_amt, 0);
            v_surr_amt :=
                  v_surr_amt
                + (NVL (v_psur_but_pay_amt, 0) - NVL (v_net_amt, 0));
            v_net_amt := NVL (v_psur_but_pay_amt, 0);
        END IF;*/

        IF NVL (v_net_amt, 0) > 0
        THEN
            v_surr_amt :=
                  NVL (v_surr_amt, 0)
                - NVL (v_debit_penalty_amt, 0)
                + NVL (v_credit_surrcharge_amt, 0);


            IF NVL (v_trans_type, 'SR') = 'BE'
            THEN
                get_gl_code ('POL_BSUR',
                             v_prod_code,
                             v_trnt_code,
                             v_trnt_gl_code,
                             v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                             NULL,
                             v_renewal);
                valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                           v_org_code,
                           v_brh_code,
                           'POL_BSUR');
                valid_acc (v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                           v_org_code,
                           v_brh_code,
                           'POL_BSUR CONTRA');
            ELSE
                get_gl_code ('POL_SURR',
                             v_prod_code,
                             v_trnt_code,
                             v_trnt_gl_code,
                             v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                             NULL,
                             v_renewal);
                valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                           v_org_code,
                           v_brh_code,
                           'POL_SURR');

               IF NVL (v_cont_acc_param, 'Y') = 'Y'
               THEN
                   valid_acc (v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                             v_org_code,
                              v_brh_code,
                             'POL_SURR CONTRA');
               END IF;
            END IF;

            IF v_surr_amt <> 0
                THEN
                SELECT DECODE (SIGN (v_surr_amt), -1, 'C', 'D')
                      INTO v_drcr
                      FROM DUAL;

                    IF NVL (v_cont_acc_param, 'Y') = 'Y'
                    THEN
                        v_gl_count := v_gl_count + 1;
                        interface_append_gl (
                            v_trans_code,       --v_trans_code         NUMBER,
                            v_user_name,       --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                            v_pol_code,          --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                            v_prod_code,         --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                            v_vchr_no,        --v_vchr_no            VARCHAR2,
                            NULL,                --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                            NULL,                --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                            NULL,             --v_rcpt_no            VARCHAR2,
                            v_gl_count,             --v_count             NUMBER,
                            v_surr_desc || v_policy_no,
                            --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                            ABS (NVL (v_surr_amt, 0)),
                            --v_amount            NUMBER,
                            v_drcr,            --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                            v_trnt_gl_code,
                            --v_acc_number          VARCHAR2,
                            v_brh_code,
                            --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                            v_gl_trans);
                    ELSE
                        v_count := v_count + 1;
                        interface_append_chq (
                            v_trans_code,
                            v_user_name,
                            v_pol_code,
                            v_prod_code,
                            v_vchr_no,
                            v_count,
                            ABS (NVL (v_surr_amt, 0)),
                            v_surr_desc || v_policy_no,          --v_narrative
                            v_trnt_gl_code,
                            v_org_code,
                            v_brh_code,
                            v_drcr,
                            v_chq_dtls_rec);
                    END IF;
                END IF;

            --          raise_error('vD_psur_alloc_to=='||v_psur_alloc_to);
            --v_trn_rec   IN OUT Fms_Vouchers_Pkg.Tgl_rec_type,
            IF NVL (v_psur_alloc_to, 'PO') <> 'PO'
            THEN
                v_pay_method_code := pay_method_code ('VOUCHER');

                --===================================================================================================
                IF NVL (v_psur_alloc_to, 'PO') IN ('PL')
                THEN
                    BEGIN
                        SELECT pol_bra_code,
                               pol_prod_code,
                               pol_type,
                               pol_code,
                               DECODE (pol_prod_type,
                                       'IN', 'PN',
                                       'PN', 'PN',
                                       'PR'),
                               pol_prod_type,
                               agn_act_code,
                               endr_code,
                               pol_policy_no
                          INTO v_rct_branch_to,
                               v_prod_code_to,
                               v_pol_type,
                               v_alloc_to_pol_code,
                               v_alloc_to,
                               v_prod_type,
                               v_act_code,
                               v_endr_code,
                               v_to_policy_no
                          FROM lms_policies,
                               lms_policy_endorsements,
                               lms_agencies
                         WHERE     pol_proposal_no = v_proposal_no
                               AND pol_current_endr_code = endr_code
                               AND endr_agen_code = agn_code;
                    EXCEPTION
                        WHEN OTHERS
                        THEN
                            raise_error ('Error fetching policy dtls....');
                    END;

                    BEGIN
                        SELECT    TO_NUMBER (TO_CHAR (SYSDATE, 'RRRR'))
                               || lms_opr_code_seq.NEXTVAL
                          INTO v_opr_code
                          FROM DUAL;

                        v_cur_code :=
                            lms_interfaces_pkg.lms_def_cur (v_rct_branch_to);
                        v_ann_chk :=
                            NVL (annuity_check (v_psur_pol_code, NULL), 'N');

                        INSERT INTO lms_ord_prem_receipts (
                                        opr_code,
                                        opr_ltr_trans_no,
                                        opr_date,
                                        opr_cheque_no,
                                        opr_amt,
                                        opr_pol_code,
                                        opr_pol_policy_no,
                                        opr_receipt_no,
                                        opr_receipt_date,
                                        opr_pmth_code,
                                        opr_chk_agen_code,
                                        opr_chk_comm_rate,
                                        opr_chk_comm,
                                        opr_done_by,
                                        opr_drcr,
                                        opr_receipt_trans_code,
                                        opr_ann_code,
                                        opr_fms_receipt_pk,
                                        opr_from_pol_code,
                                        opr_alloc_to,
                                        opr_source)
                                 VALUES (
                                     v_opr_code,
                                     NULL,
                                     TRUNC (SYSDATE),
                                     NULL,
                                     v_net_amt,
                                     DECODE (v_ann_chk,
                                             'Y', NULL,
                                             v_alloc_to_pol_code),
                                     v_to_policy_no,
                                     'FROM SURRENDER',
                                     TRUNC (SYSDATE),
                                     v_pay_method_code,
                                     v_chkoff_agen_code,
                                     NULL,
                                     NULL,
                                     v_user_name,
                                     DECODE (SIGN (v_net_amt), 1, 'C', 'D'),
                                     NULL,
                                     DECODE (v_ann_chk,
                                             'Y', v_psur_pol_code,
                                             NULL),
                                     NULL,
                                     v_pol_code,
                                     v_alloc_to,
                                     'SURRENDER');
                    EXCEPTION
                        WHEN OTHERS
                        THEN
                            raise_error (
                                'Error creating policy receipt.....');
                    END;

                    IF NVL (v_prod_type, 'ED') IN ('IN',
                                                   'SP',
                                                   'PN',
                                                   'AN')
                    THEN
                        BEGIN
                            lms_investments.process_receipt (
                                v_alloc_to_pol_code,
                                v_opr_code,
                                NULL);
                        EXCEPTION
                            WHEN OTHERS
                            THEN
                                raise_error (
                                    'Processing Inv. add/ref prem..1..');
                        END;
                    ELSE
                        BEGIN
                            lms_process_receipts.lms_ord_premium_receipts (
                                v_alloc_to_pol_code,
                                v_opr_code,
                                'Y',
                                'N',
                                NULL,
                                v_act_code,
                                v_bal_amt,
                                'Y',
                                v_endr_code);
                        EXCEPTION
                            WHEN OTHERS
                            THEN
                                raise_application_error (
                                    -20001,
                                    'Processing add/ref prem insts..2..');
                        END;
                    END IF;

                    FOR pl IN cur_pol_cb_amt
                    LOOP
                        IF pl.pol_prod_code IS NULL
                        THEN
                            raise_error (
                                   'Define product for Policy No.'
                                || pl.pol_policy_no
                                || '...');
                        END IF;

                        v_alloc_to := NVL (pl.alloc_to, 'PR');

                        BEGIN
                            SELECT NVL (opr_drcr, 'C')
                              INTO v_opr_drcr
                              FROM lms_ord_prem_receipts
                             WHERE opr_code = v_opr_code;
                        EXCEPTION
                            WHEN OTHERS
                            THEN
                                raise_error (
                                    'ERROR RETRIEVING RCPT DTLS....');
                        END;

                        v_prem_amt1 :=
                            NVL (pl.premium_amt, 0) + NVL (v_nfl_alloc, 0);
                        v_chkoff_comm1 := NVL (pl.chkoff_comm, 0);
                        v_loan_amt1 :=
                            NVL (pl.loan_amt, 0) - NVL (v_nfl_alloc, 0);
                        v_pens_amt1 := NVL (pl.pension_contr, 0);
                        v_inv_admin1 := NVL (pl.investment_admin, 0);
                        v_inv_fee1 := NVL (pl.investment_fee, 0);
                        v_inv_contri1 := NVL (pl.investment_contri, 0);
                        v_comfnd1 := NVL (pl.comfnd, 0);

                        --premium
                        IF NVL (v_prem_amt1, 0) <> 0
                        THEN
                            get_gl_code ('UP',
                                         pl.pol_prod_code,
                                         v_trnt_code,
                                         v_contra_acc,
                                         v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                         NULL,
                                         pl.renewal);
                            valid_acc (v_contra_acc,
                                       v_org_code,
                                       pl.pol_bra_code,
                                       'UP');
                            v_gl_count := v_gl_count + 1;
                            interface_append_gl (v_trans_code,
                                                 --v_trans_code         NUMBER,
                                                 v_user_name,
                                                 --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                                                 pl.pol_code,
                                                 --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                                                 pl.pol_prod_code,
                                                 --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                                                 v_vchr_no,
                                                 --v_vchr_no            VARCHAR2,
                                                 pl.opr_code,
                                                 --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                                                 NULL,
                                                 --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                                                 NULL,
                                                 --v_rcpt_no            VARCHAR2,
                                                 v_gl_count,
                                                 --v_count             NUMBER,
                                                 'ALLOCATED PREMIUM',
                                                 --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                                                 NVL (v_prem_amt1, 0),
                                                 --v_amount            NUMBER,
                                                 v_opr_drcr,
                                                 --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                                                 v_contra_acc,
                                                 --v_acc_number         VARCHAR2,
                                                 pl.pol_bra_code,
                                                 v_gl_trans);
                        END IF;

                        IF NVL (v_loan_amt1, 0) <> 0
                        THEN
                            get_gl_code ('NL',
                                         pl.pol_prod_code,
                                         v_trnt_code,
                                         v_contra_acc,
                                         v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                         NULL,
                                         pl.renewal);
                            valid_acc (v_contra_acc,
                                       v_org_code,
                                       pl.pol_bra_code,
                                       'NL');
                            v_gl_count := v_gl_count + 1;
                            interface_append_gl (v_trans_code,
                                                 --v_trans_code         NUMBER,
                                                 v_user_name,
                                                 --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                                                 pl.pol_code,
                                                 --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                                                 pl.pol_prod_code,
                                                 --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                                                 v_vchr_no,
                                                 --v_vchr_no            VARCHAR2,
                                                 pl.opr_code,
                                                 --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                                                 NULL,
                                                 --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                                                 NULL,
                                                 --v_rcpt_no            VARCHAR2,
                                                 v_gl_count,
                                                 --v_count             NUMBER,
                                                 'ALLOCATED LOAN',
                                                 --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                                                 NVL (v_loan_amt1, 0),
                                                 --v_amount            NUMBER,
                                                 v_opr_drcr,
                                                 --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                                                 v_contra_acc,
                                                 --v_acc_number         VARCHAR2,
                                                 pl.pol_bra_code,
                                                 v_gl_trans);
                        END IF;

                        --Investment Fee
                        IF NVL (v_inv_fee1, 0) <> 0
                        THEN
                            get_gl_code ('INVFEE',
                                         pl.pol_prod_code,
                                         v_trnt_code,
                                         v_contra_acc,
                                         v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                         NULL,
                                         pl.renewal);
                            valid_acc (v_contra_acc,
                                       v_org_code,
                                       pl.pol_bra_code,
                                       'INVFEE ');
                            v_gl_count := v_gl_count + 1;
                            interface_append_gl (v_trans_code,
                                                 --v_trans_code         NUMBER,
                                                 v_user_name,
                                                 --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                                                 pl.pol_code,
                                                 --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                                                 pl.pol_prod_code,
                                                 --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                                                 v_vchr_no,
                                                 --v_vchr_no            VARCHAR2,
                                                 pl.opr_code,
                                                 --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                                                 NULL,
                                                 --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                                                 NULL,
                                                 --v_rcpt_no            VARCHAR2,
                                                 v_gl_count,
                                                 --v_count             NUMBER,
                                                 'INVESTMENT FEE',
                                                 --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                                                 NVL (v_inv_fee1, 0),
                                                 --v_amount            NUMBER,
                                                 v_opr_drcr,
                                                 --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                                                 v_contra_acc,
                                                 --v_acc_number         VARCHAR2,
                                                 pl.pol_bra_code,
                                                 v_gl_trans);
                        END IF;

                        IF NVL (v_pens_amt1, 0) <> 0
                        THEN
                            IF    NVL (pl.pol_prod_type, 'PN') = 'IN'
                               OR NVL (pl.inv_all_prem, 'N') = 'Y'
                            THEN
                                --Investment Administration
                                IF NVL (v_inv_admin1, 0) <> 0
                                THEN
                                    get_gl_code ('INVADM',
                                                 pl.pol_prod_code,
                                                 v_trnt_code,
                                                 v_contra_acc,
                                                 v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                                 NULL,
                                                 pl.renewal);
                                    valid_acc (v_contra_acc,
                                               v_org_code,
                                               pl.pol_bra_code,
                                               'INVADM');
                                    v_gl_count := v_gl_count + 1;
                                    interface_append_gl (
                                        v_trans_code,
                                        --v_trans_code         NUMBER,
                                        v_user_name,
                                        --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                                        pl.pol_code,
                                        --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                                        pl.pol_prod_code,
                                        --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                                        v_vchr_no,
                                        --v_vchr_no            VARCHAR2,
                                        pl.opr_code,
                                        --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                                        NULL,
                                        --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                                        NULL,
                                        --v_rcpt_no            VARCHAR2,
                                        v_gl_count,
                                        --v_count             NUMBER,
                                        'INVESTMENT ADMINISTRATION',
                                        --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                                        NVL (v_inv_admin1, 0),
                                        --v_amount            NUMBER,
                                        v_opr_drcr,
                                        --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                                        v_contra_acc,
                                        --v_acc_number         VARCHAR2,
                                        pl.pol_bra_code,
                                        v_gl_trans);
                                END IF;

                                --Investment Premium
                                IF NVL (v_inv_contri1, 0) <> 0
                                THEN
                                    get_gl_code ('INVPREM',
                                                 pl.pol_prod_code,
                                                 v_trnt_code,
                                                 v_contra_acc,
                                                 v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                                 NULL,
                                                 pl.renewal);
                                    valid_acc (v_contra_acc,
                                               v_org_code,
                                               pl.pol_bra_code,
                                               'INVPREM');
                                    v_gl_count := v_gl_count + 1;
                                    interface_append_gl (
                                        v_trans_code,
                                        --v_trans_code         NUMBER,
                                        v_user_name,
                                        --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                                        pl.pol_code,
                                        --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                                        pl.pol_prod_code,
                                        --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                                        v_vchr_no,
                                        --v_vchr_no            VARCHAR2,
                                        pl.opr_code,
                                        --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                                        NULL,
                                        --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                                        NULL,
                                        --v_rcpt_no            VARCHAR2,
                                        v_gl_count,
                                        --v_count             NUMBER,
                                        'INVESTMENT PREMIUM',
                                        --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                                        NVL (v_inv_contri1, 0),
                                        --v_amount            NUMBER,
                                        v_opr_drcr,
                                        --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                                        v_contra_acc,
                                        --v_acc_number         VARCHAR2,
                                        pl.pol_bra_code,
                                        v_gl_trans);
                                END IF;
                            ELSE
                                --Deposit Administration Contribution
                                get_gl_code ('PN',
                                             pl.pol_prod_code,
                                             v_trnt_code,
                                             v_contra_acc,
                                             v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                             NULL,
                                             pl.renewal);
                                valid_acc (v_contra_acc,
                                           v_org_code,
                                           pl.pol_bra_code,
                                           'PN');
                                v_gl_count := v_gl_count + 1;
                                interface_append_gl (
                                        v_trans_code,
                                        --v_trans_code         NUMBER,
                                        v_user_name,
                                        --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                                        pl.pol_code,
                                        --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                                        pl.pol_prod_code,
                                        --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                                        v_vchr_no,
                                        --v_vchr_no            VARCHAR2,
                                        pl.opr_code,
                                        --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                                        NULL,
                                        --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                                        NULL,
                                        --v_rcpt_no            VARCHAR2,
                                        v_gl_count,
                                        --v_count             NUMBER,
                                        'PENSION CONTRIBUTION',
                                        --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                                        NVL (v_pens_amt1, 0),
                                        --v_amount            NUMBER,
                                        v_opr_drcr,
                                        --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                                        v_contra_acc,
                                        --v_acc_number         VARCHAR2,
                                        pl.pol_bra_code,
                                        v_gl_trans);
                            END IF;
                        END IF;

                        IF NVL (v_comfnd1, 0) <> 0
                        THEN
                            BEGIN
                                lms_ord_misc.system_param_val (
                                    'CONSOLIDATE_COMP_FUND',
                                    v_comp_param);
                            EXCEPTION
                                WHEN OTHERS
                                THEN
                                    raise_error ('PARAM ERROR...');
                            END;

                            IF NOT NVL (v_comp_param, 'N') = 'Y'
                            THEN
                                --Compensation fund...
                                get_gl_code ('CMPFND',
                                             pl.pol_prod_code,
                                             v_trnt_code,
                                             v_contra_acc,
                                             v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                             NULL,
                                             pl.renewal);
                                valid_acc (v_contra_acc,
                                           v_org_code,
                                           pl.pol_bra_code,
                                           'CMPFND');
                                v_gl_count := v_gl_count + 1;
                                interface_append_gl (v_trans_code,
                                                     --v_trans_code         NUMBER,
                                                     v_user_name,
                                                     --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                                                     pl.pol_code,
                                                     --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                                                     pl.pol_prod_code,
                                                     --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                                                     v_vchr_no,
                                                     --v_vchr_no            VARCHAR2,
                                                     pl.opr_code,
                                                     --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                                                     NULL,
                                                     --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                                                     NULL,
                                                     --v_rcpt_no            VARCHAR2,
                                                     v_gl_count,
                                                     --v_count             NUMBER,
                                                     'COMPENSATION FUND',
                                                     --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                                                     NVL (v_comfnd1, 0),
                                                     --v_amount            NUMBER,
                                                     v_opr_drcr,
                                                     --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                                                     v_contra_acc,
                                                     --v_acc_number         VARCHAR2,
                                                     pl.pol_bra_code,
                                                     v_gl_trans);
                            END IF;
                        END IF;
                    END LOOP;

                    v_unprocessed_rcpts_total := 0;

                    FOR pl IN cur_pol_cb_amt
                    LOOP
                        --FOR P IN Prod LOOP
                        v_unprocessed_rcpts := 0;
                        v_unprocessed_rcpts :=
                            get_unprocessed_rcpt ('FROM SURRENDER',
                                                  SYSDATE,
                                                  pl.pol_prod_code,
                                                  NULL,
                                                  NULL,
                                                  NULL,
                                                  pl.pol_code,
                                                  pl.opr_code);
                        v_unprocessed_rcpts_total :=
                              NVL (v_unprocessed_rcpts_total, 0)
                            + NVL (v_unprocessed_rcpts, 0);

                        IF ABS (NVL (v_unprocessed_rcpts, 0)) > 0
                        THEN
                            v_alloc_to := NVL (pl.alloc_to, 'PR');

                            IF v_alloc_to = 'LN'
                            THEN
                                raise_error (
                                       'POSTING TO UNP_LN BLOCKED.....Policy No.'
                                    || pl.pol_policy_no);
                            END IF;

                            IF v_alloc_to = 'PR'
                            THEN
                                get_gl_code ('UNP_PR',
                                             pl.pol_prod_code,
                                             v_trnt_code,
                                             v_contra_acc,
                                             v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                             NULL,
                                             pl.renewal);
                                valid_acc (v_contra_acc,
                                           v_org_code,
                                           pl.pol_bra_code,
                                           'UNP_PR');
                                v_msg := 'UNP_PR';
                            ELSIF v_alloc_to = 'LN'
                            THEN
                                get_gl_code ('UNP_LN',
                                             pl.pol_prod_code,
                                             v_trnt_code,
                                             v_contra_acc,
                                             v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                             NULL,
                                             pl.renewal);
                                valid_acc (v_contra_acc,
                                           v_org_code,
                                           pl.pol_bra_code,
                                           'UNP_LN');
                                v_msg := 'UNP_LN';
                            ELSIF v_alloc_to = 'PN'
                            THEN
                                get_gl_code ('UNP_PN',
                                             pl.pol_prod_code,
                                             v_trnt_code,
                                             v_contra_acc,
                                             v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                             NULL,
                                             pl.renewal);
                                valid_acc (v_contra_acc,
                                           v_org_code,
                                           pl.pol_bra_code,
                                           'UNP_PN');
                                v_msg := 'UNP_PN';
                            END IF;

                            v_gl_count := v_gl_count + 1;
                            interface_append_gl (
                                v_trans_code,
                                --v_trans_code         NUMBER,
                                v_user_name,
                                --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                                pl.pol_code,
                                --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                                pl.pol_prod_code,
                                --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                                v_vchr_no,
                                --v_vchr_no            VARCHAR2,
                                pl.opr_code,
                                --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                                NULL,            --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                                NULL,
                                --v_rcpt_no            VARCHAR2,
                                v_gl_count,
                                   --v_count             NUMBER,
                                   'UNPROCESSED RCPTS - DR_RCT TO '
                                || v_msg
                                || '-'
                                || pl.pol_policy_no,
                                --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                                NVL (ABS (NVL (v_unprocessed_rcpts, 0)), 0),
                                --v_amount            NUMBER,
                                v_opr_drcr,
                                --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                                v_contra_acc,
                                --v_acc_number         VARCHAR2,
                                pl.pol_bra_code,
                                v_gl_trans);
                        END IF;
                    --END LOOP;
                    END LOOP;
                --                     raise_error(v_prem_amt ||';a;'||
                --                       v_chkoff_comm ||';b;'||
                --                       v_loan_amt ||';c;'||
                --                       v_pens_amt ||';d;'||
                --                       v_inv_admin ||';e;'||
                --                       v_inv_fee ||';f;'||
                --                       v_inv_contri ||';g;'||
                --                       v_comfnd ||';h;'||
                --                       v_unprocessed_rcpts);
                ELSE
                    BEGIN
                        SELECT pol_bra_code,
                               pol_prod_code,
                               pol_type,
                               pol_code
                          INTO v_rct_branch_to,
                               v_prod_code_to,
                               v_pol_type,
                               v_alloc_to_pol_code
                          FROM lms_policies
                         WHERE pol_proposal_no = v_proposal_no;
                    EXCEPTION
                        WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND
                        THEN
                            BEGIN
                                SELECT ppr_brn_code, ppr_prod_code, 'MPR'
                                  INTO v_rct_branch_to,
                                       v_prod_code_to,
                                       v_pol_type
                                  FROM lms_pol_proposals
                                 WHERE ppr_proposal_no = v_proposal_no;
                            EXCEPTION
                                WHEN OTHERS
                                THEN
                                    raise_error (
                                        'Error fetching proposal dtls..1..');
                            END;
                        WHEN OTHERS
                        THEN
                            raise_error ('Error fetching proposal dtls..2..');
                    END;

                    BEGIN
                        SELECT    TO_NUMBER (TO_CHAR (SYSDATE, 'RRRR'))
                               || lms_oppr_code_seq.NEXTVAL
                          INTO v_oppr_code
                          FROM DUAL;

                        SELECT    v_rct_code
                               || '/'
                               || lms_oppr_receipt_trans_seq.NEXTVAL
                          INTO v_oppr_receipt_trans_code
                          FROM DUAL;

                        v_cur_code :=
                            lms_interfaces_pkg.lms_def_cur (v_rct_branch_to);
                        v_ann_chk :=
                            NVL (annuity_check (v_psur_pol_code, NULL), 'N');

                        INSERT INTO lms_ord_proposal_rcpts (
                                        oppr_code,
                                        oppr_ltr_trans_no,
                                        oppr_date,
                                        oppr_cheque_no,
                                        oppr_amt,
                                        oppr_pol_code,
                                        oppr_pol_proposal_no,
                                        oppr_receipt_no,
                                        oppr_receipt_date,
                                        oppr_pmth_code,
                                        opr_chk_agen_code,
                                        opri_chk_comm_rate,
                                        opri_chk_comm_amt,
                                        oppr_done_by,
                                        oppr_drcr,
                                        oppr_receipt_trans_code,
                                        oppr_ann_code,
                                        oppr_fms_receipt_pk,
                                        oppr_from_pol_code,
                                        oppr_source)
                                 VALUES (
                                     v_oppr_code,
                                     NULL,
                                     TRUNC (SYSDATE),
                                     NULL,
                                     v_net_amt,
                                     DECODE (v_ann_chk,
                                             'Y', NULL,
                                             v_alloc_to_pol_code),
                                     v_proposal_no,
                                     v_vchr_no,
                                     TRUNC (SYSDATE),
                                     v_pay_method_code,
                                     v_chkoff_agen_code,
                                     v_chkoff_rate,
                                     ROUND (
                                           NVL (v_chkoff_rate, 0)
                                         / 100
                                         * v_net_amt),
                                     v_user_name,
                                     DECODE (SIGN (v_net_amt), 1, 'C', 'D'),
                                     v_oppr_receipt_trans_code,
                                     DECODE (v_ann_chk,
                                             'Y', v_psur_pol_code,
                                             NULL),
                                     NULL,
                                     v_pol_code,
                                     v_narrative);
                    EXCEPTION
                        WHEN OTHERS
                        THEN
                            raise_error (
                                'Error creating proposal receipt.....');
                    END;

                    v_contra_acc :=
                        get_receipting_acc ('D',                 --v_acc_type,
                                            v_prod_code_to,
                                            v_org_code,
                                            v_rct_branch_to,
                                            'N');
                    valid_acc (v_contra_acc,
                               v_org_code,
                               v_rct_branch_to,
                               'PRRCT');
                    v_gl_count := v_gl_count + 1;
                    interface_append_gl (
                        v_trans_code,
                        --v_trans_code         NUMBER,
                        v_user_name,
                        --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                        v_pol_code,
                        --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                        v_prod_code,
                        --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                        v_vchr_no,
                        --v_vchr_no            VARCHAR2,
                        NULL,                    --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                        NULL,                    --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                        NULL,                 --v_rcpt_no            VARCHAR2,
                        v_gl_count,                 --v_count             NUMBER,
                        'PROPOSAL PREMIUM FROM SURR ' || v_policy_no,
                        --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                        NVL (v_net_amt, 0),
                        --v_amount            NUMBER,
                        'C',                   --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                        v_contra_acc,
                        --v_acc_number         VARCHAR2,
                        v_rct_branch_to,
                        v_gl_trans,
                        NULL,
                        NULL,
                        NULL,
                        NULL,
                        v_oppr_code);
                END IF;
            --===================================================================================================
            ELSE
                IF NVL (v_cont_acc_param, 'Y') = 'Y'
                THEN
                    v_gl_count := v_gl_count + 1;
                    interface_append_gl (v_trans_code, --v_trans_code         NUMBER,
                                         v_user_name, --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                                         v_pol_code, --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                                         v_prod_code, --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                                         v_vchr_no, --v_vchr_no            VARCHAR2,
                                         NULL,       --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                                         NULL,       --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                                         NULL,    --v_rcpt_no            VARCHAR2,
                                         v_gl_count,    --v_count             NUMBER,
                                         v_narrative || v_policy_no,
                                         --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                                         NVL (v_net_amt, 0), --v_amount            NUMBER,
                                         'C',      --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                                         v_trnt_contra_gl_code, --v_acc_number         VARCHAR2,
                                         v_brh_code, --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                                         v_gl_trans);
                    v_trans_no := NVL (v_trans_no, 0) + 1;
                    interface_append_chq (v_trans_code,
                                          --v_trans_code       NUMBER,
                                          v_user_name,
                                          --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                                          v_pol_code,
                                          --v_pol_code           NUMBER,
                                          v_prod_code,
                                          --v_prod_code          NUMBER,
                                          v_vchr_no,
                                          --v_vchr_no             VARCHAR2,
                                          v_trans_no,
                                          --v_count              NUMBER,
                                          v_net_amt, --v_amount             NUMBER,
                                          v_narrative || v_policy_no,
                                          --v_narrative          VARCHAR2,
                                          v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                          --v_acc_number          VARCHAR2,
                                          v_org_code,
                                          --v_acc_org_code        NUMBER,
                                          v_brh_code,
                                          --v_branch_code        NUMBER,
                                          'D',    --v_drcr               VARCHAR2,
                                          v_chq_dtls_rec);
                END IF;
            END IF;

            IF NVL (v_ref_prem, 0) <> 0
            THEN
                SELECT DECODE (SIGN (NVL (v_ref_prem, 0)), -1, 'C', 'D')
                  INTO v_drcr
                  FROM DUAL;

                get_gl_code ('UNP_PR',
                             v_prod_code,
                             v_trnt_code,
                             v_trnt_gl_code,
                             v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                             NULL,
                             v_renewal);
                valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                           v_org_code,
                           v_brh_code,
                           'UNP_PR');


                IF NVL (v_cont_acc_param, 'Y') = 'Y'
                THEN
                    v_gl_count := v_gl_count + 1;
                    interface_append_gl (v_trans_code, --v_trans_code         NUMBER,
                                         v_user_name, --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                                         v_pol_code, --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                                         v_prod_code, --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                                         v_vchr_no, --v_vchr_no            VARCHAR2,
                                         NULL,   --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                                         NULL,   --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                                         NULL, --v_rcpt_no           VARCHAR2,
                                         v_gl_count, --v_count             NUMBER,
                                         'UNPROCESSED PREMIUM REFUND SURRENDER - ' || v_policy_no,
                                         --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                                         ABS (NVL (v_ref_prem, 0)),
                                         --v_amount            NUMBER,
                                         v_drcr, --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                                         v_trnt_gl_code, --v_acc_number         VARCHAR2,
                                         v_brh_code, --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                                         v_gl_trans,
                                         --v_trn_rec   IN OUT Fms_Vouchers_Pkg.Tgl_rec_type,
                                         NULL, --v_cad_code       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                         NULL); --v_otop_code       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL)
                ELSE
                    v_count := v_count + 1;
                    interface_append_chq (v_trans_code,
                                          v_user_name,
                                          v_pol_code,
                                          v_prod_code,
                                          v_vchr_no,
                                          v_count,
                                          ABS (NVL (v_ref_prem, 0)), --'Premium Refund',
                                          'UNPROCESSED PREMIUM REFUND SURRENDER - ' || v_policy_no,
                                          v_trnt_gl_code,
                                          v_org_code,
                                          v_brh_code,
                                          v_drcr,
                                          v_chq_dtls_rec);
                END IF;
            END IF;

            IF (NVL (v_os_prem, 0) + NVL (v_nfl_alloc, 0)) <> 0
            THEN
                v_trans_no := NVL (v_trans_no, 0) + 1;

                IF SIGN (NVL (v_os_prem, 0) + NVL (v_nfl_alloc, 0)) = -1
                THEN
                    v_drcr := 'D';
                    v_refund_narrative :=
                        'UNEARNED PREMIUM REFUND SURRENDER - ';


                    get_gl_code ('POL_SURR',
                                 v_prod_code,
                                 v_trnt_code,
                                 v_trnt_gl_code,
                                 v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                 NULL,
                                 v_renewal);
                    valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                               v_org_code,
                               v_brh_code,
                               'POL_SURR');
                ELSE
                    v_refund_narrative := 'O/S PREM RECOVERY SURRENDER - ';
                    v_drcr := 'C';


                    get_gl_code ('OS_PREC',
                                 v_prod_code,
                                 v_trnt_code,
                                 v_trnt_gl_code,
                                 v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                 NULL,
                                 v_renewal);
                    valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                               v_org_code,
                               v_brh_code,
                               'OS_PREC');

                    valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                               v_org_code,
                               v_brh_code,
                               'OS_PREC');
                END IF;


                IF NVL (v_cont_acc_param, 'Y') = 'Y'
                THEN
                    v_gl_count := v_gl_count + 1;
                    interface_append_gl (
                        v_trans_code,           --v_trans_code         NUMBER,
                        v_user_name,           --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                        v_pol_code,              --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                        v_prod_code,             --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                        v_vchr_no,            --v_vchr_no            VARCHAR2,
                        NULL,                    --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                        NULL,                    --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                        NULL,                 --v_rcpt_no            VARCHAR2,
                        v_gl_count,                 --v_count             NUMBER,
                        v_refund_narrative || v_policy_no,
                        --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                       ABS (NVL (v_os_prem, 0)), --v_amount            NUMBER,
                        v_drcr,                --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                        v_trnt_gl_code,       --v_acc_number         VARCHAR2,
                        v_brh_code,              --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                        v_gl_trans);
                ELSE
                    v_count := v_count + 1;
                    interface_append_chq (
                        v_trans_code,
                        v_user_name,
                        v_pol_code,
                        v_prod_code,
                        v_vchr_no,
                        v_count,
                        ABS (NVL (v_os_prem, 0)), --'Premium Refund',
                        v_refund_narrative || v_policy_no,
                        v_trnt_gl_code,
                        v_org_code,
                        v_brh_code,
                        v_drcr,
                        v_chq_dtls_rec);
                END IF;

                --RAISE_ERROR('v_os_prem=='||v_os_prem||';;'||v_os_prem_int||';;'||v_nfl_alloc);
                --RAISE_ERROR('AM HERE....1='||v_os_prem_int);
                IF NVL (v_os_prem_int, 0) <> 0
                THEN
                    get_gl_code ('REIN_INT',
                                 v_prod_code,
                                 v_trnt_code,
                                 v_trnt_gl_code,
                                 v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                 NULL,
                                 v_renewal);
                    valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                               v_org_code,
                               v_brh_code,
                               'REIN_INT');

                    IF SIGN (NVL (v_os_prem_int, 0)) = -1
                    THEN
                        v_drcr := 'D';
                    ELSE
                        v_drcr := 'C';
                    END IF;

                    IF NVL (v_cont_acc_param, 'Y') = 'Y'
                    THEN
                        v_gl_count := v_gl_count + 1;
                        interface_append_gl (
                            v_trans_code,
                            --v_trans_code         NUMBER,
                            v_user_name,
                            --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                            v_pol_code,          --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                            v_prod_code,         --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                            v_vchr_no,
                            --v_vchr_no            VARCHAR2,
                            NULL,                --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                            NULL,                --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                            NULL,             --v_rcpt_no            VARCHAR2,
                            v_gl_count,             --v_count             NUMBER,
                               'O/S PREM INTEREST CHARGE SURRENDER - '
                            || v_policy_no,
                            --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                            ABS (NVL (v_os_prem_int, 0)),
                            --v_amount            NUMBER,
                            v_drcr,            --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                            v_trnt_gl_code,
                            --v_acc_number         VARCHAR2,
                            v_brh_code,          --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                            v_gl_trans);
                    ELSE
                        v_count := v_count + 1;
                        interface_append_chq (
                            v_trans_code,
                            v_user_name,
                            v_pol_code,
                            v_prod_code,
                            v_vchr_no,
                            v_count,
                            ABS (NVL (v_os_prem_int, 0)),
                               'O/S PREM INTEREST CHARGE SURRENDER -'
                            || v_policy_no,                      --v_narrative
                            v_trnt_gl_code,
                            v_org_code,
                            v_brh_code,
                            v_drcr,
                            v_chq_dtls_rec);
                    END IF;
                END IF;
            END IF;

            IF (NVL (v_os_loan, 0)) <> 0
            THEN
                    IF SIGN (NVL (v_os_loan, 0)) =
                       -1
                    THEN
                        v_drcr := 'D';
                        v_narrative := 'LOAN OVERPAY REFUND SURRENDER - ';

                        get_gl_code ('POL_LOAN',
                                     v_prod_code,
                                     v_trnt_code,
                                     v_trnt_gl_code,
                                     v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                     NULL,
                                     v_renewal);
                        valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                                   v_org_code,
                                   v_brh_code,
                                   'POL_LOAN');
                    ELSE
                        v_drcr := 'C';
                        v_narrative := 'O/S LOAN RECOVERY SURRENDER - ';

                        get_gl_code ('OS_LNREC',
                                     v_prod_code,
                                     v_trnt_code,
                                     v_trnt_gl_code,
                                     v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                     NULL,
                                     v_renewal);
                        valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                                   v_org_code,
                                   v_brh_code,
                                   'OS_LNREC');
                    END IF;


                    IF NVL (v_cont_acc_param, 'Y') = 'Y'
                    THEN
                        v_gl_count := v_gl_count + 1;
                        interface_append_gl (
                            v_trans_code,       --v_trans_code         NUMBER,
                            v_user_name,       --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                            v_pol_code,          --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                            v_prod_code,         --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                            v_vchr_no,        --v_vchr_no            VARCHAR2,
                            NULL,                --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                            NULL,                --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                            NULL,             --v_rcpt_no            VARCHAR2,
                            v_gl_count,             --v_count             NUMBER,
                            v_narrative || v_policy_no,
                            --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                            ABS (
                                  NVL (v_os_loan, 0)
                                - NVL (v_nfl_alloc, 0)
                                - NVL (v_tot_loan_intr, 0)),
                            --v_amount            NUMBER,
                            v_drcr,            --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                            v_trnt_gl_code,
                            --v_acc_number         VARCHAR2,
                            v_brh_code,          --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                            v_gl_trans);
                    ELSE
                        v_count := v_count + 1;
                        interface_append_chq (
                            v_trans_code,
                            v_user_name,
                            v_pol_code,
                            v_prod_code,
                            v_vchr_no,
                            v_count,
                            ABS (
                                  NVL (v_os_loan, 0)
                                - NVL (v_nfl_alloc, 0)

                        v_trans_code,
                        --v_trans_code         NUMBER,

                        --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,

                        v_prod_code,             --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                        v_vchr_no,            --v_vchr_no            VARCHAR2,
                        NULL,                    --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                        NULL,                    --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                        NULL,                 --v_rcpt_no            VARCHAR2,
                        v_gl_count,                 --v_count             NUMBER,
                           'INVESTMENT ADMINISTRATION SURRENDER-'
                        || v_policy_no,
                        --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                        ABS (NVL (v_inv_admin, 0)),
                        --v_amount            NUMBER,
                        v_drcr,                --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                        v_trnt_gl_code,
                        --v_acc_number         VARCHAR2,
                        v_brh_code,              --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                        v_gl_trans);
                ELSE
                    v_count := v_count + 1;
                    interface_append_chq (
                        v_trans_code,
                        v_user_name,
                        v_pol_code,
                        v_prod_code,
                        v_vchr_no,
                        v_count,
                        ABS (NVL (v_inv_admin, 0)),
                           'INVESTMENT ADMINISTRATION SURRENDER - '
                        || v_policy_no,
                        v_trnt_gl_code,
                        v_org_code,
                        v_brh_code,
                        v_drcr,
                        v_chq_dtls_rec);
                END IF;
            END IF;

            IF NVL (v_comfnd, 0) <> 0 AND NOT NVL (v_comp_param, 'N') = 'Y'
            THEN
                SELECT DECODE (SIGN (NVL (v_comfnd, 0)), -1, 'D', 'C')

                THEN

                        v_trans_code,
                        --v_trans_code         NUMBER,
                        v_user_name,
                        --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                        v_pol_code,              --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                        v_prod_code,             --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                        v_vchr_no,            --v_vchr_no            VARCHAR2,
                        NULL,                    --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                        NULL,                    --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                        NULL,                 --v_rcpt_no            VARCHAR2,
                        v_count,                 --v_count             NUMBER,

                           'COMPENSATION FUND CLIENT SURRENDER - '

                               v_brh_code,

                THEN
                    v_gl_count := v_gl_count + 1;
                    interface_append_gl (
                        v_trans_code,
                        --v_trans_code         NUMBER,
                        v_user_name,
                        --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                        v_pol_code,              --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                        v_prod_code,             --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                        v_vchr_no,            --v_vchr_no            VARCHAR2,
                        NULL,                    --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                        NULL,                    --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                        NULL,                 --v_rcpt_no            VARCHAR2,
                        v_gl_count,                 --v_count             NUMBER,
                        'UNPROCESSED RCPTS SURRENDER-' || v_policy_no,
                        --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                        ABS (NVL (v_unalloc_amt, 0)),
                        --v_amount            NUMBER,
                        v_drcr,                --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                        v_trnt_gl_code,
                        --v_acc_number         VARCHAR2,
                        v_brh_code,              --v_branch_code       NUMBER,

                ELSE
