                        v_trans_code,
                        v_user_name,
                        v_pol_code,
                        v_prod_code,
                        v_vchr_no,
                        v_count,

                        'UNPROCESSED RCPTS SURRENDER - ' || v_policy_no,

            IF NVL (v_tot_matrty_paid, 0) > 0
            THEN

                             v_trnt_contra_gl_code,

                           v_org_code,
                           v_brh_code,
                           'POL_MTR');

                THEN
                    v_gl_count := v_gl_count + 1;
                    interface_append_gl (v_trans_code, --v_trans_code         NUMBER,
                                         v_user_name, --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                                         v_pol_code, --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                                         v_prod_code, --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                                         v_vchr_no, --v_vchr_no            VARCHAR2,
                                         NULL,   --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                                         NULL,   --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                                         NULL, --v_rcpt_no            VARCHAR2,

                                         --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                                         NVL (v_tot_matrty_paid, 0),
                                         --v_amount            NUMBER,
                                         'C',  --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                                         v_trnt_gl_code,
                                         --v_acc_number        VARCHAR2,

                                          v_user_name,
                                          v_pol_code,

            IF NVL (v_unpaid_matr_amt, 0) > 0
            THEN

                        v_trans_code,           --v_trans_code         NUMBER,
                        v_user_name,           --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,

                        NULL,                    --v_opr_code          NUMBER,

                        --v_amount            NUMBER,
                        'D',                   --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,

                        --v_acc_number        VARCHAR2,

                        v_chq_dtls_rec);

            IF NVL (v_matr_reinv_intr, 0) > 0
            THEN
                get_gl_code ('POL_MTR',
                             v_prod_code,

                        v_prod_code,             --v_prod_code         NUMBER,

                        v_brh_code,              --v_branch_code       NUMBER,

                        v_trans_code,
                        v_user_name,
                        v_pol_code,
                        v_prod_code,
                        v_vchr_no,

                        v_trnt_gl_code,
                        v_org_code,
                        v_brh_code,
                        'D',
                        v_chq_dtls_rec);
                END IF;
            END IF;

            IF NVL (v_psur_alloc_to, 'PO') = 'PO'
            THEN
                IF v_pay_method = 'EFT'
                THEN
                    BEGIN
                        --                   v_bbr_code := BNK_BBR_CODE(v_pol_code);
                        --                     v_account_number := BNK_ACCOUNT(v_pol_code);
                        v_eft_enabled := 'N';

                        IF v_account_number IS NOT NULL
                        THEN
                            v_eft_enabled := account_enabled (v_bbr_code);
                        END IF;
                    EXCEPTION
                        WHEN OTHERS
                        THEN
                            raise_error ('GETTING BANK ACC INFO... ');
                    END;
                ELSIF v_pay_method = 'MFT'
                THEN
                    v_account_number := v_clnt_mob_no;
                END IF;

                IF v_pay_method IN ('EFT', 'MFT')
                THEN
                    IF v_pay_method = 'EFT'
                    THEN
                        IF v_eft_enabled = 'N'
                        THEN
                            raise_application_error (
                                -20001,
                                'BANK BRANCH NOT ENABLED TO TRANSACT EFT PAYMENTS');
                        END IF;
                    END IF;

                    interface_create_reqn (
                        v_trans_code,
                        --v_trans_code         NUMBER,
                        v_vchr_no,
                        --v_ref                   VARCHAR2,
                        v_pol_code,
                        --v_ref2                  VARCHAR2,
                        SYSDATE,               --v_ref_date              DATE,
                           v_surr_desc
                        || '('
                        || v_policy_no
                        || ' )'
                        || '('
                        || v_pay_method
                        || ')',
                        --v_narrative             VARCHAR2,

                        --v_amount                NUMBER,

                        --v_payee                 VARCHAR2,

                        --v_payee_bank_acc_no        VARCHAR2,

                        --v_payee_bank_branch_code   NUMBER,

                        --v_source_auth_by        VARCHAR2,
                        v_surr_date,
                        --v_source_auth_dt        DATE,
                        v_done_by,
                        --v_raise_by                VARCHAR2,
                        'POL_SURR',
                        --v_pmt_type              VARCHAR2,
                        v_brh_code,
                        --v_branch_code         NUMBER,
                        v_pol_code,                    --v_pol_code    NUMBER,
                        v_chq_dtls_rec,
                        NULL,
                        NULL,
                        NULL,
                        NULL,
                        NULL,

                        v_id_type);
                --v_dtls_table  IN OUT  Fms_Cheques_Pkg.Type_rqn_dtls_table
                ELSE
                    interface_create_reqn (
                        v_trans_code,           --v_trans_code         NUMBER,
                        v_vchr_no,         --v_ref                   VARCHAR2,

                        SYSDATE,               --v_ref_date              DATE,
                           v_surr_desc
                        || '('
                        || v_policy_no
                        || ' )'
                        || '('
                        || v_pay_method
                        || ')',
                        --v_narrative             VARCHAR2,
                        NVL (v_net_amt, 0),
                        --v_amount                NUMBER,

                        'POL_SURR',        --v_pmt_type              VARCHAR2,

                        v_pol_code,                    --v_pol_code    NUMBER,
                        v_chq_dtls_rec);
                --v_dtls_table  IN OUT  Fms_Cheques_Pkg.Type_rqn_dtls_table
                END IF;

            IF v_gl_count > 0 AND NVL (v_cont_acc_param, 'Y') = 'Y'
            THEN
                --create gl voucher
                interface_update_vgl (v_trans_code, --v_trans_code     NUMBER,
                                      v_user_name, --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                                      v_pol_code, --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                                      TRUNC (SYSDATE), --v_date           DATE,
                                      NULL,      --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                                      NULL,      --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,

                                      --v_btc_description   VARCHAR2,

        --v_gl_trans  IN OUT  Fms_Vouchers_Pkg.Tgl_rec_type,
        ELSE
            v_org_code := fms_interfaces_pkg.get_org (v_brh_code);

            IF (  NVL (v_surr_amt, 0)
                + NVL (v_ref_prem, 0)
                - NVL (v_tot_matrty_paid, 0)) <
               (NVL (v_os_prem, 0) + NVL (v_os_loan, 0))
            THEN
                v_unrecoverable :=
                      NVL (v_os_prem, 0)
                    + NVL (v_os_loan, 0)
                    - (  NVL (v_surr_amt, 0)
                       + NVL (v_ref_prem, 0)
                       - NVL (v_tot_matrty_paid, 0));
            END IF;

            v_surr_amt :=
                  NVL (v_surr_amt, 0)
                - NVL (v_debit_penalty_amt, 0)
                + NVL (v_credit_surrcharge_amt, 0);

            IF NVL (v_surr_amt, 0) <> 0
            THEN
                SELECT DECODE (SIGN (NVL (v_surr_amt, 0)), -1, 'C', 'D')
                  INTO v_drcr
                  FROM DUAL;

                IF NVL (v_trans_type, 'SR') = 'BE'
                THEN
                    get_gl_code ('POL_BSUR',
                                 v_prod_code,
                                 v_trnt_code,

                               v_org_code,
                               v_brh_code,

                                 v_prod_code,
                                 v_trnt_code,
                                 v_trnt_gl_code,
                                 v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                 NULL,

                interface_append_gl (v_trans_code, --v_trans_code         NUMBER,
                                     v_user_name, --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,

                                     v_prod_code, --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                                     v_vchr_no, --v_vchr_no            VARCHAR2,

                                     NULL,       --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,

            IF (NVL (v_os_prem, 0) + NVL (v_nfl_alloc, 0)) > 0
            THEN
                get_gl_code ('OS_PREC',
                             v_prod_code,
                             v_trnt_code,
                             v_trnt_gl_code,
                             v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                             NULL,
                             v_renewal);
                valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,

                v_gl_count := v_gl_count + 1;

                    v_user_name,               --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,

                    v_vchr_no,                --v_vchr_no            VARCHAR2,
                    NULL,                        --v_opr_code          NUMBER,

                    NULL,                     --v_rcpt_no            VARCHAR2,
                    v_gl_count,                     --v_count             NUMBER,
                    'POLICY OS PREMIUM' || v_policy_no,
                    --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                    (NVL (v_os_prem, 0) + NVL (v_nfl_alloc, 0)), --v_amount            NUMBER,
                    'C',                       --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                    v_trnt_gl_code,            --v_acc_number        VARCHAR2,
                    v_brh_code,                  --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                    v_gl_trans);

                IF NVL (v_os_prem_int, 0) > 0
                THEN
                    get_gl_code ('REIN_INT',
                                 v_prod_code,
                                 v_trnt_code,
                                 v_trnt_gl_code,
                                 v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                 NULL,
                                 v_renewal);
                    valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                               v_org_code,
                               v_brh_code,
                               'REIN_INT');
                    v_gl_count := v_gl_count + 1;
                    interface_append_gl (
                        v_trans_code,
                        --v_trans_code         NUMBER,
                        v_user_name,
                        --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                        v_pol_code,              --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                        v_prod_code,             --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                        v_vchr_no,
                        --v_vchr_no            VARCHAR2,
                        NULL,                    --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                        NULL,                    --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                        NULL,                 --v_rcpt_no            VARCHAR2,
                        v_gl_count,                 --v_count             NUMBER,
                        'O/S PREM INTEREST CHARGE - ' || v_policy_no,
                        --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                        NVL (v_os_prem_int, 0),
                        --v_amount            NUMBER,
                        'C',                   --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                        v_trnt_gl_code,

                                      NULL,      --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                                      NULL,     -- v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                                      v_btc_description,
                                      --v_btc_description   VARCHAR2,
                                      'JV',    --v_btc_type          VARCHAR2,
                                      v_brh_code, --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                                      v_description,
                                      --v_description       VARCHAR2,
                                      v_pol_code,   --v_ref          VARCHAR2,
                                      v_gl_trans);
            END IF;

            -- ENABLE TO TAKE CARE OF UPDATES WHEN NET AMT IS ZERO THUS NO CHQ RAISED.........
            lms_api.update_surrender (v_vchr_no,
                                      'NO CHEQUE ISSUED',
                                      TRUNC (SYSDATE),
                                      0,
                                      v_user_name,
                                      v_pol_code);
        END IF;
    --   EXCEPTION
    --      WHEN OTHERS
    --      THEN
    --         raise_error ('PROCESSING SURRENDER....');
    END process_surrenders;

    PROCEDURE update_commissions (
        v_vchr_no    VARCHAR2,
        v_cop_code   NUMBER,
        v_chq_no     VARCHAR2,
        v_chq_date   DATE,
        v_chq_amt    NUMBER,
        v_user       VARCHAR2
    )
    IS
        v_transno    NUMBER;
        v_agn_code   NUMBER;
    BEGIN
        BEGIN
            UPDATE lms_commission_pymts
               SET cop_paid_chq_no = v_chq_no,
                   cop_paid_chq_date = v_chq_date,
                   cop_paid = 'Y',
                   cop_chq_update_by = v_user,
                   cop_chq_update_date = SYSDATE,
                   cop_chq_amt = v_chq_amt
             WHERE cop_paid_vchr_no = v_vchr_no; -- AND cop_code = v_cop_code;
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                raise_error ('ERROR UPDATING COMMISSION DETAILS....');
        END;

        BEGIN
            SELECT MAX (cop_trans_no), MAX (cop_agn_code)
              INTO v_transno, v_agn_code
              FROM lms_commission_pymts
             WHERE cop_paid_vchr_no = v_vchr_no;
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                raise_error ('ERROR GETTING COMMISSION DETAILS....');
        END;

        BEGIN
            UPDATE lms_grp_prem_receipts
               SET grct_comm_paid = 'A'
             WHERE     grct_pay_trans_no = v_transno
                   AND grct_comm_paid = 'R'
                   AND grct_agen_code = v_agn_code;
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                tqc_error_manager.raise_error (
                    276203942,
                    text_in   =>
                        'Error updating group business commisssion records....');
        END;

        BEGIN
            UPDATE lms_policy_commission_pymts
               SET pcp_paid = 'A',
                   pcp_paid_chq_date = v_chq_date,
                   pcp_paid_chq_no = v_chq_no
             WHERE     pcp_paid_vchr_no = v_vchr_no
                   AND pcp_paid = 'R'
                   AND pcp_agn_code = v_agn_code
                   AND pcp_trans_no = v_transno;
        --AND GRCT_BRN_CODE = cur_brn_rec.COP_BRN_CODE;
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                tqc_error_manager.raise_error (
                    276203942,
                    text_in   =>
                        'Error updating group business commisssion records....');
        END;

        BEGIN
            lms_process_alerts.process_commauth_msg ('OCOMMAUTH',
                                                     v_transno,
                                                     v_agn_code,
                                                     v_chq_amt);
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                NULL;
        END;
    END update_commissions;

    PROCEDURE update_bonus (
        v_vchr_no    VARCHAR2,
        v_cop_code   NUMBER,
        v_chq_no     VARCHAR2,
        v_chq_date   DATE,
        v_chq_amt    NUMBER,
        v_user       VARCHAR2
    )
    IS
        v_transno    NUMBER;
        v_agn_code   NUMBER;
    BEGIN
        BEGIN
            UPDATE lms_bonus_pymts
               SET bop_paid_chq_no = v_chq_no,
                   bop_paid_chq_date = v_chq_date,
                   bop_pay = 'Y',
                   bop_chq_update_by = v_user,
                   bop_chq_update_date = SYSDATE,
                   bop_chq_amt = v_chq_amt
             WHERE bop_paid_vchr_no = v_vchr_no; -- AND cop_code = v_cop_code;;
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                raise_error ('ERROR UPDATING COMMISSION DETAILS....');
        END;

        BEGIN
            SELECT MAX (bop_trans_no), MAX (bop_agn_code)
              INTO v_transno, v_agn_code
              FROM lms_bonus_pymts
             WHERE bop_paid_vchr_no = v_vchr_no;
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                raise_error ('ERROR GETTING COMMISSION DETAILS....');
        END;

        BEGIN
            lms_process_alerts.process_commauth_msg ('OCOMMAUTH',
                                                     v_transno,
                                                     v_agn_code,
                                                     v_chq_amt);
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                NULL;
        END;
    END update_bonus;

    PROCEDURE process_loan (
        v_loan_no          NUMBER,
        v_pol_code         NUMBER,
        v_gross_amount     NUMBER,
        v_service_charge   NUMBER,
        v_pay_method       VARCHAR2 DEFAULT 'CHQ'
    )
    IS
        CURSOR c_loan IS
            SELECT lna_no,
                   pol_policy_no,
                   lna_prepared_by,
                   lna_date_issued,
                   lna_payee
                       payee,
                   NVL(lna_processing_brn_code,pol_bra_code) pol_bra_code,
                   pol_prod_code,
                   lna_alloc_amt,
                   NVL (lna_bbr_code, lms_api.bnk_bbr_code (pol_code))
                       lna_bbr_code,
                   lna_acc_no,
                   lna_authorized_by,
                   lms_ord_mis.check_renewal_paymnt (pol_code,
                                                     lna_date_issued)
                       renewal,
                   lna_opr_code,
                   lna_oppr_code,
                   lna_total_interest_amt,
                   lna_processing_fee,
                   lna_previous_tot_os_loan
              FROM lms_loan_applications, lms_policies
             WHERE     lna_pol_code = pol_code
                   AND lna_no = v_loan_no
                   AND pol_code = v_pol_code;

        v_ltx_rate_desc         VARCHAR2 (30);
        v_ltx_tax_amt           NUMBER;
        v_loan_acc_no           VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_svc_charge_acc_no     VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_tax_acc_no            VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_trnt_contra_gl_code   VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_brh_code              NUMBER;
        v_org_code              NUMBER;
        v_count                 NUMBER := 0;
        v_cur_code              NUMBER;
        v_sys_code              NUMBER;
        v_chq_dtls_rec          fms_cheques_pkg.type_rqn_dtls_table;
        v_trnt_code             VARCHAR2 (10);
        v_trnt_gl_code          VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_gl_trans              fms_vouchers_pkg.tgl_rec_type;
        v_gl_count              NUMBER := 0;
        vgl_code                NUMBER;
        v_trans_code            NUMBER;
        v_clnt_mob_no           lms_loan_applications.lna_clnt_mob_no%TYPE;
        v_mpt_code              lms_loan_applications.lna_mpt_code%TYPE;
        v_clnt_id_passport_no   lms_loan_applications.lna_clnt_id_passport_no%TYPE;
        v_id_type               VARCHAR (30);
        v_exd_rate_desc         VARCHAR2 (30);
        v_exd_tax_amt           NUMBER;
        v_exd_acc_no            VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_exd_contra_gl_code    VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_excise_duty_on_loan   VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_ctrl_param_val        VARCHAR2 (5);
        v_prem_amt              NUMBER;
        v_loan_amt              NUMBER;
        v_pens_amt              NUMBER;
        v_unalloc_amt           NUMBER;
        v_inv_fee               NUMBER;
        v_inv_contri            NUMBER;
        v_inv_admin             NUMBER;
        v_comfnd                NUMBER;
        v_chkoff_comm           NUMBER;
        v_cont_acc_param        VARCHAR2 (1);
        v_credit_acc            VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_post_interest_param   VARCHAR2 (1);
        v_interest              NUMBER;
        v_os_ln_acc_no           VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_os_ln_contra_gl_code   VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_net_amt               NUMBER;
    BEGIN
        FOR i IN c_loan
        LOOP
            v_brh_code := i.pol_bra_code;
            v_org_code := fms_interfaces_pkg.get_org (v_brh_code);

            BEGIN
                lms_ord_misc.system_param_val ('EXCISE_DUTY_ON_LOAN',
                                               v_excise_duty_on_loan);
            EXCEPTION
                WHEN OTHERS
                THEN
                    raise_error ('PARAMETER ERROR....EXCISE_DUTY_ON_LOAN');
            END;

            BEGIN
                lms_ord_misc.system_param_val (
                    'USE_CONTRAL_ACCOUNT_AT_CLAIMS',
                    v_cont_acc_param);
            EXCEPTION
                WHEN OTHERS
                THEN
                    raise_error (
                        'PARAMETER ERROR....USE_CONTRAL_ACCOUNT_AT_CLAIMS');
            END;

            BEGIN
                lms_ord_misc.system_param_val ('ALLOW_POSTING_LOAN_INTREST',
                                               v_post_interest_param);
            EXCEPTION
                WHEN OTHERS
                THEN
                    v_post_interest_param := 'N';
            END;

            IF v_post_interest_param = 'Y'
            THEN
                v_interest := i.lna_total_interest_amt;
            END IF;


            IF v_excise_duty_on_loan = 'Y'
            THEN
                BEGIN
                    SELECT ltx_rate_desc, NVL (ltx_tax_amt, 0)
                      INTO v_ltx_rate_desc, v_ltx_tax_amt
                      FROM lms_loan_taxes
                     WHERE     ltx_lna_no = v_loan_no
                           AND ltx_pol_code = v_pol_code
                           AND ltx_rate_type = 'RCU';
                EXCEPTION
                    WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND
                    THEN
                        raise_error (
                            'UNABLE TO COMPUTE LOAN TAXES..STAMP DUTY');
                    WHEN OTHERS
                    THEN
                        raise_error (
                            'UNABLE TO GET LOAN TAXES....STAMP DUTY');
                END;
            END IF;

            BEGIN
                fms_settings_pkg.system_param_val ('USE_CONTROL_ACCOUNT',
                                                   v_ctrl_param_val);
            EXCEPTION
                WHEN OTHERS
                THEN
                    v_ctrl_param_val := 'Y';
            END;

            IF v_excise_duty_on_loan = 'Y'
            THEN
                BEGIN
                    SELECT ltx_rate_desc, NVL (ltx_tax_amt, 0)
                      INTO v_exd_rate_desc, v_exd_tax_amt
                      FROM lms_loan_taxes
                     WHERE     ltx_lna_no = v_loan_no
                           AND ltx_pol_code = v_pol_code
                           AND ltx_rate_type = 'EXD';
                EXCEPTION
                    WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND
                    THEN
                        raise_error (
                            'UNABLE TO COMPUTE LOAN TAXES....EXCISE DUTY');
                    WHEN OTHERS
                    THEN
                        raise_error ('UNABLE TO GET LOAN TAXES..EXCISE DUTY');
                END;
            END IF;

            IF NVL (v_pay_method, 'CHQ') = 'MFT'
            THEN
                BEGIN
                    SELECT lna_clnt_mob_no,
                           lna_mpt_code,
                           lna_clnt_id_passport_no,
                           DECODE (lna_identity_type,
                                   'I', 'NATIONAL ID',
                                   'P', 'PASSPORT')
                      INTO v_clnt_mob_no,
                           v_mpt_code,
                           v_clnt_id_passport_no,
                           v_id_type
                      FROM lms_loan_applications
                     WHERE lna_no = v_loan_no;
                EXCEPTION
                    WHEN OTHERS
                    THEN
                        raise_error ('Error getting MFT client details.....');
                END;
            END IF;

            SELECT    TO_NUMBER (TO_CHAR (SYSDATE, 'RRRR'))
                   || lms_transaction_seq.NEXTVAL
              INTO v_trans_code
              FROM DUAL;

            get_gl_code ('POL_LOAN',
                         i.pol_prod_code,
                         v_trnt_code,
                         v_loan_acc_no,
                         v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                         NULL,
                         i.renewal);
            --check if accounts exist in policy branch
            valid_acc (v_loan_acc_no,
                       v_org_code,
                       v_brh_code,
                       'POL_LOAN');

            --RAISE_ERROR('v_gross_amount=='||v_gross_amount||';;'||v_ltx_tax_amt||';;'||v_service_charge||';;'||i.lna_alloc_amt||';;'||v_cont_acc_param||';;'||i.lna_opr_code);
            IF NVL (v_cont_acc_param, 'Y') = 'Y'
            THEN
                valid_acc (v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                           v_org_code,
                           v_brh_code,
                           'POL_LOAN CONTRA');
                v_gl_count := v_gl_count + 1;
                interface_append_gl (
                    v_trans_code,               --v_trans_code         NUMBER,
                    i.lna_prepared_by,         --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                    v_pol_code,                  --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                    i.pol_prod_code,             --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                    i.lna_no,                 --v_vchr_no            VARCHAR2,
                    NULL,                        --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                    NULL,                        --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                    NULL,                     --v_rcpt_no            VARCHAR2,
                    v_gl_count,                  --v_count             NUMBER,
                       'LOAN PAYMENT. - '
                    || i.lna_no
                    || ' - '
                    || i.pol_policy_no,        --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                    v_gross_amount + NVL (v_interest, 0),              --v_amount            NUMBER,
                    'D',                       --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                    v_loan_acc_no,           --v_acc_number          VARCHAR2,
                    v_brh_code,                  --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                    v_gl_trans);
                    
                v_gl_count := v_gl_count + 1;
                interface_append_gl (
                    v_trans_code,               --v_trans_code         NUMBER,
                    i.lna_prepared_by,         --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                    v_pol_code,                  --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                    i.pol_prod_code,             --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                    i.lna_no,                 --v_vchr_no            VARCHAR2,
                    NULL,                        --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                    NULL,                        --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                    NULL,                     --v_rcpt_no            VARCHAR2,
                    v_gl_count,                  --v_count             NUMBER,
                       'LOAN PAYMENT. - '
                    || i.lna_no
                    || ' - '
                    || i.pol_policy_no,        --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                    v_net_amt, --v_amount            NUMBER,
                    'C',                       --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                    v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                    --v_acc_number        VARCHAR2,
                    v_brh_code,                  --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                    v_gl_trans);

                v_count := v_count + 1;
                interface_append_chq (
                    v_trans_code,                     --v_trans_code       NUMBER,
                    i.lna_prepared_by,
                    --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                    v_pol_code,                     --v_pol_code           NUMBER,
                    i.pol_prod_code,                --v_prod_code          NUMBER,
                    i.lna_no,                    --v_vchr_no             VARCHAR2,
                    v_count,                        --v_count              NUMBER,
                    v_net_amt,
                    --v_amount             NUMBER,
                    'LOAN PAYMENT. - ' || i.lna_no || ' - ' || i.pol_policy_no, --v_narrative          VARCHAR2,
                    v_trnt_contra_gl_code,                         --v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                    --v_acc_number          VARCHAR2,
                    v_org_code,                    --v_acc_org_code        NUMBER,
                    v_brh_code,                     --v_branch_code        NUMBER,
                    'D',                          --v_drcr               VARCHAR2,
                    v_chq_dtls_rec);
            ELSE
                v_count := v_count + 1;
                interface_append_chq (
                    v_trans_code,                     --v_trans_code       NUMBER,
                    i.lna_prepared_by,
                    --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                    v_pol_code,                     --v_pol_code           NUMBER,
                    i.pol_prod_code,                --v_prod_code          NUMBER,
                    i.lna_no,                    --v_vchr_no             VARCHAR2,
                    v_count,                        --v_count              NUMBER,
                    v_gross_amount + NVL (v_interest, 0),
                    --v_amount             NUMBER,
                    'LOAN PAYMENT. - ' || i.lna_no || ' - ' || i.pol_policy_no, --v_narrative          VARCHAR2,
                    v_loan_acc_no,                         --v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                    --v_acc_number          VARCHAR2,
                    v_org_code,                    --v_acc_org_code        NUMBER,
                    v_brh_code,                     --v_branch_code        NUMBER,
                    'D',                          --v_drcr               VARCHAR2,
                    v_chq_dtls_rec);
            END IF;

           

            IF NVL (v_ltx_tax_amt, 0) <> 0
            THEN
                get_gl_code ('LSD',                          --loan stamp duty
                             i.pol_prod_code,
                             v_trnt_code,
                             v_tax_acc_no,
                             v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                             NULL,
                             i.renewal);
                --check if accounts exist in policy branch
                valid_acc (v_tax_acc_no,
                           v_org_code,
                           v_brh_code,
                           'LSD');
                IF NVL (v_cont_acc_param, 'Y') = 'Y'
                THEN
                    v_gl_count := v_gl_count + 1;
                    interface_append_gl (
                        v_trans_code,               --v_trans_code         NUMBER,
                        i.lna_prepared_by,
                        --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                        v_pol_code,                  --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                        i.pol_prod_code,
                        --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                        i.lna_no,                 --v_vchr_no            VARCHAR2,
                        NULL,                        --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                        NULL,                        --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                        NULL,                     --v_rcpt_no            VARCHAR2,
                        v_gl_count,                  --v_count             NUMBER,
                           v_ltx_rate_desc
                        || ' - '
                        || i.lna_no
                        || ' - '
                        || 'Policy ('
                        || i.pol_policy_no
                        || ')',
                        --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                        v_ltx_tax_amt,               --v_amount            NUMBER,
                        'C',                       --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                        v_tax_acc_no,              --v_acc_number        VARCHAR2,
                        v_brh_code,                  --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                        v_gl_trans);
                ELSE
                    v_count := v_count + 1;
                    interface_append_chq (
                        v_trans_code,                     --v_trans_code       NUMBER,
                        i.lna_prepared_by,
                        --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                        v_pol_code,                     --v_pol_code           NUMBER,
                        i.pol_prod_code,                --v_prod_code          NUMBER,
                        i.lna_no,                    --v_vchr_no             VARCHAR2,
                        v_count,                        --v_count              NUMBER,
                        v_ltx_tax_amt,
                        --v_amount             NUMBER,
                        v_ltx_rate_desc
                        || ' - '
                        || i.lna_no
                        || ' - '
                        || 'Policy ('
                        || i.pol_policy_no
                        || ')',
                        v_tax_acc_no,                         --v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                        --v_acc_number          VARCHAR2,
                        v_org_code,                    --v_acc_org_code        NUMBER,
                        v_brh_code,                     --v_branch_code        NUMBER,
                        'C',                          --v_drcr               VARCHAR2,
                        v_chq_dtls_rec);
                END IF;

            END IF;

            IF NVL (v_exd_tax_amt, 0) <> 0
            THEN
                get_gl_code ('LED',                         --loan excise duty
                             i.pol_prod_code,
                             v_trnt_code,
                             v_exd_acc_no,
                             v_exd_contra_gl_code,
                             NULL,
                             i.renewal);
                --check if accounts exist in policy branch
                valid_acc (v_exd_acc_no,
                           v_org_code,
                           v_brh_code,
                           'LED');
                IF NVL (v_cont_acc_param, 'Y') = 'Y'
                THEN
                    v_gl_count := v_gl_count + 1;
                    interface_append_gl (
                        v_trans_code,               --v_trans_code         NUMBER,
                        i.lna_prepared_by,
                        --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                        v_pol_code,                  --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                        i.pol_prod_code,
                        --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                        i.lna_no,                 --v_vchr_no            VARCHAR2,
                        NULL,                        --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                        NULL,                        --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                        NULL,                     --v_rcpt_no            VARCHAR2,
                        v_gl_count,                  --v_count             NUMBER,
                        v_exd_rate_desc
                        || ' - '
                        || i.lna_no
                        || ' - '
                        || 'Policy ('
                        || i.pol_policy_no
                        || ')',                   --v_narrative          VARCHAR2,
                        v_exd_tax_amt,               --v_amount            NUMBER,
                        'C',                       --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                        v_exd_acc_no,              --v_acc_number        VARCHAR2,
                        v_brh_code,                  --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                        v_gl_trans);
                ELSE
                    v_count := v_count + 1;
                    interface_append_chq (
                        v_trans_code,                 --v_trans_code       NUMBER,
                        i.lna_prepared_by,
                        --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                        v_pol_code,                 --v_pol_code           NUMBER,
                        i.pol_prod_code,            --v_prod_code          NUMBER,
                        i.lna_no,                --v_vchr_no             VARCHAR2,
                        v_count,                    --v_count              NUMBER,
                        v_exd_tax_amt,
                           --v_amount             NUMBER,
                           v_exd_rate_desc
                        || ' - '
                        || i.lna_no
                        || ' - '
                        || 'Policy ('
                        || i.pol_policy_no
                        || ')',                   --v_narrative          VARCHAR2,
                        v_exd_acc_no,
                        --v_acc_number          VARCHAR2,
                        v_org_code,                --v_acc_org_code        NUMBER,
                        v_brh_code,                 --v_branch_code        NUMBER,
                        'C',                      --v_drcr               VARCHAR2,
                        v_chq_dtls_rec);
                END IF;
            END IF;

            IF NVL (v_service_charge, 0) <> 0
            THEN
                get_gl_code ('LSC',                      --loan service charge
                             i.pol_prod_code,
                             v_trnt_code,
                             v_svc_charge_acc_no,
                             v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                             NULL,
                             i.renewal);
                --check if accounts exist in policy branch
                valid_acc (v_svc_charge_acc_no,
                           v_org_code,
                           v_brh_code,
                           'LSC');
                IF NVL (v_cont_acc_param, 'Y') = 'Y'
                THEN
                    v_gl_count := v_gl_count + 1;
                    interface_append_gl (
                        v_trans_code,               --v_trans_code         NUMBER,
                        i.lna_prepared_by,
                        --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                        v_pol_code,                  --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                        i.pol_prod_code,
                        --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                        i.lna_no,                 --v_vchr_no            VARCHAR2,
                        NULL,                        --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                        NULL,                        --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                        NULL,                     --v_rcpt_no            VARCHAR2,
                        v_gl_count,                  --v_count             NUMBER,
                           'LOAN SERVICE CHARGE -'
                        || i.lna_no
                        || ' - '
                        || 'Policy ('
                        || i.pol_policy_no
                        || ')',
                        --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                        v_service_charge,              --v_amount          NUMBER,
                        'C',                       --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                        v_svc_charge_acc_no,
                        --v_acc_number          VARCHAR2,
                        v_brh_code,                  --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                        v_gl_trans);
                ELSE
                    v_count := v_count + 1;
                    interface_append_chq (

                    --                        FROM LMS_ORD_RECEIPT_INSTLMNTS

                        i.lna_prepared_by,
                        --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                        v_pol_code,                 --v_pol_code           NUMBER,

                        || ' - '
                        || i.pol_policy_no,

                        v_org_code,
                        v_brh_code,
                        'C',
                        v_chq_dtls_rec);
                END IF;                    
            END IF;



            IF NVL (v_pay_method, 'CHQ') = 'MFT'
            THEN
                i.lna_acc_no := v_clnt_mob_no;
            END IF;

            --Raise_error('v_ltx_tax_amt='||v_ltx_tax_amt  ||';' || v_service_charge||';lna_alloc_amt='||i.lna_alloc_amt||';gross='||v_gross_amount
            --         ||' i.lna_previous_tot_os_loan== '||i.lna_previous_tot_os_loan);
            interface_create_reqn (
                v_trans_code,                   --v_trans_code         NUMBER,
                i.lna_no,                  --v_ref                   VARCHAR2,
                i.pol_policy_no,
                --v_ref2                  VARCHAR2,

                || i.lna_no
                || ' - '

                || i.pol_policy_no
                || ')',

                --v_pay_method            VARCHAR2, --CHQ, EFT
                i.lna_acc_no,
                --v_payee_bank_acc_no        VARCHAR2,
                i.lna_bbr_code,
                --v_payee_bank_branch_code   NUMBER,
                i.lna_authorized_by,
                --v_source_auth_by        VARCHAR2,
                i.lna_date_issued,
                --v_source_auth_dt        DATE,
                i.lna_prepared_by,
                --v_raise_by                VARCHAR2,
                'LOAN',                    --v_pmt_type              VARCHAR2,
                v_brh_code,                    --v_branch_code         NUMBER,
                v_pol_code,                      --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                v_chq_dtls_rec,
                NULL,
                NULL,
                NULL,
                NULL,
                NULL,
                v_mpt_code,
                v_clnt_id_passport_no,

            IF v_gl_count > 0

                v_trans_code,                       --v_trans_code     NUMBER,

                --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                v_pol_code,                      --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                TRUNC (SYSDATE),                        --v_date         DATE,
                NULL,                            --v_opr_code          NUMBER,

                || ' - '
                || 'Policy ('
                || i.pol_policy_no
                || ')',
                --v_description       VARCHAR2,
                i.lna_no,                           --v_ref          VARCHAR2,
                v_gl_trans);
        --v_gl_trans  IN OUT  Fms_Vouchers_Pkg.Tgl_rec_type,
            END IF;
        END LOOP;

        IF v_count = 0
        THEN
            raise_error (
                'LOAN ' || v_loan_no || ' NOT POSTED TO FINANCE' || SQLERRM);
        END IF;
    --    EXCEPTION
    --        WHEN OTHERS
    --        THEN
    --            raise_error ('PROCESSING LOAN. ' || SQLERRM (SQLCODE));
    END process_loan;

    PROCEDURE process_nf_loan (
        v_loan_no     NUMBER,
        v_bra_code    NUMBER,
        v_amt         NUMBER,
        v_username    VARCHAR2,
        v_prod_code   NUMBER
    )
    IS
        v_count                 NUMBER;
        v_desc1                 VARCHAR2 (40);
        v_desc2                 VARCHAR2 (40);
        v_desc3                 VARCHAR2 (40);
        v_desc4                 VARCHAR2 (40);
        v_desc5                 VARCHAR2 (60);
        v_vgl_no                NUMBER;
        v_brh_code              NUMBER;
        v_org_code              NUMBER;
        v_cur_code              NUMBER;
        v_sys_code              NUMBER;
        v_bct_code              NUMBER;
        v_raised_by             NUMBER;
        v_trnt_code             VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_policy_no             VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_bct_brh_code          NUMBER;
        v_trnt_gl_code          VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_trnt_contra_gl_code   VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_gl_trans              fms_vouchers_pkg.tgl_rec_type;
        v_trans_code            NUMBER;
        v_pol_code              NUMBER;
        v_renewal               VARCHAR2 (5);
    BEGIN
        IF NVL (v_amt, 0) <= 0
        THEN
            raise_error ('THE NF LOAN AMT IS UNSPECIFIED....');
        END IF;

        v_brh_code := v_bra_code;
        v_org_code := fms_interfaces_pkg.get_org (v_brh_code);
        v_sys_code := fms_interfaces_pkg.systemcode ('LMS');
        v_cur_code := lms_interfaces_pkg.lms_def_cur (v_brh_code);
        v_raised_by := fms_interfaces_pkg.get_usercode (v_username);
        --Get bank a/c for loan payments
        fms_interfaces_pkg.trans_bct ('LOANS',
                                      v_sys_code,
                                      v_brh_code,
                                      v_cur_code,
                                      v_bct_code,
                                      v_bct_brh_code,
                                      'CHQ');

        BEGIN
            SELECT pol_policy_no,
                   pol_code,
                   lms_ord_mis.check_renewal_paymnt (pol_code,
                                                     pol_paid_to_date)
              INTO v_policy_no, v_pol_code, v_renewal
              FROM lms_policies
             WHERE pol_code IN
                       (SELECT pln_pol_code
                          FROM lms_policy_loans
                         WHERE     pln_pol_code = pol_code
                               AND pln_lna_no = v_loan_no);
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                raise_error ('ERROR RETRIEVING POLICY DETAILS....');
        END;

        SELECT    TO_NUMBER (TO_CHAR (SYSDATE, 'RRRR'))
               || lms_transaction_seq.NEXTVAL
          INTO v_trans_code
          FROM DUAL;

        v_desc1 := 'NF LOAN - ';
        v_desc2 := 'LMS NF LOAN BATCH';
        v_desc3 := 'NF LOAN ';
        v_desc4 := 'POLICY NO ';
        v_desc5 := v_policy_no;
        get_gl_code ('NF',
                     v_prod_code,
                     v_trnt_code,
                     v_trnt_gl_code,
                     v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                     NULL,
                     v_renewal);
        --check if accounts exist in policy branch
        valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                   v_org_code,
                   v_brh_code,
                   'NF');
        v_count := NVL (v_count, 0) + 1;
        interface_append_gl (v_trans_code,      --v_trans_code         NUMBER,
                             v_username,       --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                             v_pol_code,         --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                             v_prod_code,        --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                             v_loan_no,       --v_vchr_no            VARCHAR2,
                             NULL,               --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                             NULL,               --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                             NULL,            --v_rcpt_no            VARCHAR2,
                             v_count,            --v_count             NUMBER,
                             v_desc1 || v_loan_no || '-' || v_desc5,
                             --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                             v_amt,              --v_amount            NUMBER,
                             'D',              --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                             v_trnt_gl_code,  --v_acc_number         VARCHAR2,
                             v_brh_code,         --v_brance_code       NUMBER,
                             v_gl_trans);
        get_gl_code ('NFINC',
                     v_prod_code,
                     v_trnt_code,
                     v_trnt_gl_code,
                     v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                     NULL,
                     v_renewal);
        --check if accounts exist in policy branch
        valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                   v_org_code,
                   v_brh_code,
                   'NFINC');
        v_count := NVL (v_count, 0) + 1;
        v_count := NVL (v_count, 0) + 1;
        interface_append_gl (v_trans_code,      --v_trans_code         NUMBER,
                             v_username,       --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                             v_pol_code,         --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                             v_prod_code,        --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                             v_loan_no,       --v_vchr_no            VARCHAR2,
                             NULL,               --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                             NULL,               --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                             NULL,            --v_rcpt_no            VARCHAR2,
                             v_count,            --v_count             NUMBER,
                             v_desc1 || v_loan_no || '-' || v_desc5,
                             --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                             v_amt,              --v_amount            NUMBER,
                             'C',              --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                             v_trnt_gl_code,  --v_acc_number         VARCHAR2,
                             v_brh_code,         --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                             v_gl_trans);
        interface_update_vgl (v_trans_code,         --v_trans_code     NUMBER,
                              v_username,      --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                              v_pol_code,        --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                              TRUNC (SYSDATE),          --v_date         DATE,
                              NULL,              --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                              NULL,             -- v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                              v_desc2,         --v_btc_description   VARCHAR2,
                              'JV',            --v_btc_type          VARCHAR2,
                              v_brh_code,        --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                              v_desc3,         --v_description       VARCHAR2,
                              v_loan_no,            --v_ref          VARCHAR2,
                              v_gl_trans);
    --v_gl_trans  IN OUT  Fms_Vouchers_Pkg.Tgl_rec_type,
    EXCEPTION
        WHEN OTHERS
        THEN
            raise_error ('PROCESSING NF LOAN....');
    END process_nf_loan;

    PROCEDURE create_shortage_rct (
        v_pol_code    NUMBER,
        v_endr_code   NUMBER,
        v_tot_amt     NUMBER,
        v_user        VARCHAR2
    )
    IS
        v_grct_code             NUMBER;
        v_policy_no             VARCHAR2 (30);
        v_bra_code              NUMBER;
        v_agen_code             NUMBER;
        v_rct_code              VARCHAR2 (30);
        v_mtran_code            NUMBER;
        v_pol_prp_code          NUMBER;
        v_prod_sht_desc         VARCHAR2 (15);
        v_prod_code             NUMBER;
        v_endr_no               VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_endr_type             VARCHAR2 (10);
        v_client_type           VARCHAR2 (100);
        v_client_acc            VARCHAR2 (100);
        v_count                 NUMBER := 0;
        v_trnt_code             VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_trnt_gl_code          VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_trnt_contra_gl_code   VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_shtg_gl_code          VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_shtg_contra_gl_code   VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_gl_trans              fms_vouchers_pkg.tgl_rec_type;
        v_org_code              NUMBER;
        v_trans_code            NUMBER;
        v_agn_act_code          NUMBER;

        CURSOR cur_rcpt IS
            SELECT *
              FROM lms_grp_prem_receipts
             WHERE grct_code = v_grct_code;
    BEGIN
        BEGIN
            SELECT pol_policy_no,
                   pol_bra_code,
                   endr_agen_code,
                   pol_prp_code,
                   prod_sht_desc,
                   prod_code,
                   endr_no,
                   endr_type,
                   agn_act_code
              INTO v_policy_no,
                   v_bra_code,
                   v_agen_code,
                   v_pol_prp_code,
                   v_prod_sht_desc,
                   v_prod_code,
                   v_endr_no,
                   v_endr_type,
                   v_agn_act_code
              FROM lms_policies,
                   lms_policy_endorsements,
                   lms_products,
                   lms_agencies
             WHERE     endr_pol_code = pol_code
                   AND pol_prod_code = prod_code
                   AND endr_agen_code = agn_code
                   AND pol_code = v_pol_code
                   AND endr_code = v_endr_code;
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                raise_error ('Error Determining Policy Details.');
        END;

        BEGIN
            SELECT act_type_id, NVL (agn_acc_no, agn_sht_desc)
              INTO v_client_type, v_client_acc
              FROM lms_agencies, tqc_account_types
             WHERE agn_act_code = act_code AND agn_code = v_agen_code;
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                raise_error ('Error Determining client account Details.');
        END;

        BEGIN
            SELECT    TO_NUMBER (TO_CHAR (SYSDATE, 'RRRR'))
                   || lms_grct_code_seq.NEXTVAL
              INTO v_grct_code
              FROM DUAL;
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                raise_error (
                    'ERROR POPULATING POLICY RECEIPT SEQUENCE......');
        END;

        BEGIN
            SELECT    'SHTG'
                   || TO_NUMBER (TO_CHAR (SYSDATE, 'RRRR'))
                   || lms_shtg_code_seq.NEXTVAL
              INTO v_rct_code
              FROM DUAL;
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                raise_error (
                    'ERROR POPULATING POLICY RECEIPT SHORTAGE SEQUENCE......');
        END;

        --CREATE RECEIPT DETAILS.
        BEGIN
            INSERT INTO lms_grp_prem_receipts (grct_code,
                                               grct_ltr_trans_no,
                                               grct_date,
                                               grct_cheque_no,
                                               grct_amt,
                                               grct_gross_amnt,
                                               grct_pol_code,
                                               grct_pol_policy_no,
                                               grct_receipt_no,
                                               grct_receipt_date,
                                               grct_prem_allocate,
                                               grct_pens_allocate,
                                               grct_comm_inclusive,
                                               grct_agen_code,
                                               grct_brn_code,
                                               grct_drcr,
                                               grct_status,
                                               grct_fms_receipt_pk,
                                               grct_done_by)
                 VALUES (v_grct_code,
                         NULL,
                         TRUNC (SYSDATE),
                         NULL,
                         v_tot_amt,
                         v_tot_amt,
                         v_pol_code,
                         v_policy_no,
                         v_rct_code,
                         TRUNC (SYSDATE),
                         v_tot_amt,
                         0,
                         'Y',
                         v_agen_code,
                         v_bra_code,
                         'C',
                         'A',
                         NULL,
                         v_user);
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                raise_error ('ERROR INSERTING POLICY RECEIPT DETAILS......');
        END;

        BEGIN
            SELECT TO_NUMBER (
                          TO_CHAR (SYSDATE, 'YYYY')
                       || lms_mtran_code_seq.NEXTVAL)
              INTO v_mtran_code
              FROM DUAL;
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                raise_error (
                    'Error Populating Master records next Sequence......');
        END;

        BEGIN
            INSERT INTO lms_master_transactions (mtran_code,
                                                 mtran_date,
                                                 mtran_ref_no,
                                                 mtran_other_ref,
                                                 mtran_tran_type,
                                                 mtran_dc,
                                                 mtran_control_acc,
                                                 mtran_client_type,
                                                 mtran_client_code,
                                                 mtran_amount,
                                                 mtran_balance,
                                                 mtran_pol_code,
                                                 mtran_narrations,
                                                 mtran_prp_code,
                                                 mtran_pol_polcy_no,
                                                 mtran_endr_no,
                                                 mtran_ltr_trans_no,
                                                 mtran_acct_code,
                                                 mtran_prod_sht_desc,
                                                 mtran_prod_code,
                                                 mtran_authorised,
                                                 mtran_date_authorized,
                                                 mtran_authorised_by,
                                                 mtran_posting_date,
                                                 mtran_net_amt,
                                                 mtran_origin,
                                                 mtran_btr_trans_code,
                                                 mtran_sd,
                                                 mtran_whtx,
                                                 mtran_extras,
                                                 mtran_commission,
                                                 mtran_trans_effective_date,
                                                 mtran_agen_code,
                                                 mtran_cla_type,
                                                 mtran_fms_receipt_pk,
                                                 mtran_rcpt_status,
                                                 mtran_comm_inclusive,
                                                 mtran_brn_code,
                                                 mtran_lms_receipt_pk)
                 VALUES (v_mtran_code,
                         TRUNC (SYSDATE),
                         v_rct_code,
                         NULL,
                         'RC',
                         'C',
                         v_client_acc,
                         v_client_type,
                         NVL (v_agen_code, v_pol_prp_code),
                         -v_tot_amt,
                         -v_tot_amt,
                         v_pol_code,
                         'Receipt',
                         v_pol_prp_code,
                         v_policy_no,
                         v_endr_no,
                         NULL,
                         NULL,
                         v_prod_sht_desc,
                         v_prod_code,
                         'Y',
                         TRUNC (SYSDATE),
                         v_user,
                         TRUNC (SYSDATE),
                         -v_tot_amt,
                         'U',
                         v_endr_type,
                         NULL,
                         NULL,
                         NULL,
                         NULL,
                         TRUNC (SYSDATE),
                         v_agen_code,
                         'G',
                         NULL,
                         'A',
                         'Y',
                         v_bra_code,
                         v_grct_code);
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                raise_error ('Error inserting Rcpt dtls in master trans...');
        END;

        --POST ACCOUNT DETAILS.
        BEGIN
            BEGIN
                SELECT    TO_NUMBER (TO_CHAR (SYSDATE, 'RRRR'))
                       || lms_transaction_seq.NEXTVAL
                  INTO v_trans_code
                  FROM DUAL;
            EXCEPTION
                WHEN OTHERS
                THEN
                    raise_error ('ERROR ON TRANSACTION SEQUENCE.');
            END;

            v_org_code := fms_interfaces_pkg.get_org (v_bra_code);
            get_gl_code ('UP_GB',
                         v_prod_code,
                         v_trnt_code,
                         v_trnt_gl_code,
                         v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                         NULL,
                         -- v_tt_code                        NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                         NULL,
                         -- v_renewal                        VARCHAR2 DEFAULT 'N',
                         v_agn_act_code,
                         -- v_act_code                       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                         v_bra_code);
            valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                       v_org_code,
                       v_bra_code,
                       'UP_GB');
            get_gl_code ('SHT_OVG_GB',
                         v_prod_code,
                         v_trnt_code,
                         v_shtg_gl_code,
                         v_shtg_contra_gl_code);
            valid_acc (v_shtg_gl_code,
                       v_org_code,
                       v_bra_code,
                       'SHT_OVG_GB');
            -- RAISE_ERROR('v_trnt_gl_code='||v_trnt_gl_code||'v_trnt_contra_gl_code='||v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
            v_count := v_count + 1;
            interface_append_gl (v_trans_code, --v_trans_code           NUMBER,
                                 v_user,       --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                                 v_pol_code,     --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                                 v_prod_code,    --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                                 v_rct_code, --v_vchr_no             VARCHAR2,
                                 NULL,           --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                                 NULL,           --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                                 v_rct_code, --v_rcpt_no             VARCHAR2,
                                 v_count,        --v_count             NUMBER,
                                 'PREMIUM -' || v_rct_code,
                                 --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                                 NVL (v_tot_amt, 0),
                                 --v_amount            NUMBER,
                                 'D',          --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                                 v_shtg_gl_code,
                                 --v_acc_number2          VARCHAR2,
                                 v_bra_code,     --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                                 v_gl_trans);
            --v_trn_rec   IN OUT  fms_test.Fms_Vouchers_Pkg.Tgl_rec_type,
            interface_append_gl (v_trans_code, --v_trans_code           NUMBER,
                                 v_user,       --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                                 v_pol_code,     --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                                 v_prod_code,    --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                                 v_rct_code, --v_vchr_no             VARCHAR2,
                                 NULL,           --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                                 NULL,           --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                                 v_rct_code, --v_rcpt_no             VARCHAR2,
                                 v_count,        --v_count             NUMBER,
                                 'PREMIUM -' || v_rct_code,
                                 --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                                 NVL (v_tot_amt, 0),
                                 --v_amount            NUMBER,
                                 'C',          --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                                 v_trnt_gl_code,
                                 --v_acc_number2          VARCHAR2,
                                 v_bra_code,     --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                                 v_gl_trans);

            IF v_count > 0
            THEN
                interface_update_vgl (v_trans_code, --v_trans_code     NUMBER,
                                      v_user,  --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                                      v_pol_code, --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                                      TRUNC (SYSDATE), --v_date              DATE,
                                      NULL,      --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                                      NULL,      --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                                      'LMS GB RECEIPTS BATCH', --v_btc_description   VARCHAR2,
                                      'JV', --v_btc_type             VARCHAR2,
                                      v_bra_code, --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                                      'GRP LIFE RECEIPT ALLOCATIONS',
                                      --v_description       VARCHAR2,
                                      v_rct_code, --v_ref_no             VARCHAR2,
                                      v_gl_trans);
            --v_gl_trans  IN OUT  fms_test.Fms_Vouchers_Pkg.Tgl_rec_type,
            END IF;
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                raise_application_error (
                    -20001,
                    'POSTING G. RECT. ' || SQLERRM (SQLCODE));
        END;
    END create_shortage_rct;

    PROCEDURE post_grp_rcpt_alloc (
        v_alloc_amt       NUMBER,
        v_pol_code        NUMBER,
        v_grct_code       NUMBER,
        v_pol_prod_code   NUMBER,
        v_rct_code        fms_receipts.rct_brh_rct_code%TYPE,
        v_user            VARCHAR2,
        v_drcr            VARCHAR2 DEFAULT 'D'
    )
    IS
        v_gl_trans                  fms_vouchers_pkg.tgl_rec_type;
        v_trnt_code                 VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_trnt_gl_code              VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_trnt_contra_gl_code       VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_dr_trnt_gl_code           VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_cr_trnt_contra_gl_code    VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_trans_code                NUMBER;
        v_count                     NUMBER := 0;
        v_org_code                  NUMBER;
        v_rct_branch                NUMBER;
        v_prod_type                 VARCHAR2 (5);
        v_currency_code             NUMBER;
        v_drcr_rev                  VARCHAR2 (5) := 'C';
        v_crn_trnt_code             VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_crn_trnt_gl_code          VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_crn_trnt_contra_gl_code   VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_cr_note_grct_code         NUMBER;
        v_cr_note_bal               NUMBER;
        v_amt_to_alloc              NUMBER;

        CURSOR cur_rcpt IS
            SELECT agn_act_code, lms_grp_prem_receipts.*
              FROM lms_grp_prem_receipts, lms_agencies
             WHERE grct_code = v_grct_code AND grct_agen_code = agn_code;
    BEGIN
        ----RAISE_ERROR('HERE...............');
        SELECT    TO_NUMBER (TO_CHAR (SYSDATE, 'RRRR'))
               || lms_transaction_seq.NEXTVAL
          INTO v_trans_code
          FROM DUAL;

        SELECT pol_prod_type
          INTO v_prod_type
          FROM lms_policies
         WHERE pol_code = v_pol_code;

        IF v_drcr = 'C'
        THEN
            v_drcr_rev := 'D';
        END IF;

        FOR pr IN cur_rcpt
        LOOP
            v_rct_branch := pr.grct_brn_code;
            v_org_code := fms_interfaces_pkg.get_org (pr.grct_brn_code);
            v_currency_code := pr.grct_cur_code;

            BEGIN
                SELECT (NVL (grct_amt, 0) - NVL (grct_credit_amt_settled, 0)),
                       grct_code
                  INTO v_cr_note_bal, v_cr_note_grct_code
                  FROM lms_grp_prem_receipts
                 WHERE     grct_endr_code = pr.grct_endr_code
                       AND grct_credit_note = 'Y'
                       AND NVL (grct_credit_amt_settled, 0) <
                           NVL (grct_amt, 0);
            EXCEPTION
                WHEN OTHERS
                THEN
                    v_cr_note_bal := 0;
            END;

            v_amt_to_alloc := NVL (v_alloc_amt, 0) - NVL (v_cr_note_bal, 0);

            IF NVL (v_amt_to_alloc, 0) <> 0 AND v_prod_type NOT IN ('PENS')
            THEN
                get_gl_code ('UP_GB',
                             v_pol_prod_code,
                             v_trnt_code,
                             v_trnt_gl_code,
                             v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                             NULL,
                             -- v_tt_code                        NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                             NULL,
                             -- v_renewal                        VARCHAR2 DEFAULT 'N',
                             pr.agn_act_code,
                             -- v_act_code                       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                             pr.grct_brn_code);
                valid_acc (v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                           v_org_code,
                           pr.grct_brn_code,
                           'UP_GB CONTRA');
                get_gl_code ('DR_RCTGB',
                             v_pol_prod_code,
                             v_trnt_code,
                             v_dr_trnt_gl_code,
                             v_cr_trnt_contra_gl_code);
                valid_acc (v_dr_trnt_gl_code,
                           v_org_code,
                           pr.grct_brn_code,
                           'DR_RCTGB');

                v_count := v_count + 1;

                interface_append_gl (v_trans_code,
                                     --v_trans_code           NUMBER,
                                     v_user,   --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                                     v_pol_code, --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                                     v_pol_prod_code, --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                                     v_rct_code, --v_vchr_no             VARCHAR2,
                                     NULL,       --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                                     NULL,       --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                                     v_rct_code, --v_rcpt_no             VARCHAR2,
                                     v_count,    --v_count             NUMBER,
                                     'PREMIUM -' || v_rct_code, --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                                     NVL (v_amt_to_alloc, 0), --v_amount            NUMBER,
                                     v_drcr,   --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                                     v_dr_trnt_gl_code, --v_acc_number1         VARCHAR2,
                                     v_trnt_contra_gl_code, --v_acc_number2         VARCHAR2,
                                     pr.grct_brn_code, --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                                     v_gl_trans);
            END IF;
        END LOOP;

        IF v_count > 0
        THEN
            interface_update_vgl (v_trans_code,     --v_trans_code     NUMBER,
                                  v_user,      --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                                  v_pol_code,    --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                                  TRUNC (SYSDATE), --v_date              DATE,
                                  NULL,          --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                                  NULL,          --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                                  'LMS GB RECEIPTS BATCH', --v_btc_description   VARCHAR2,
                                  'JV',     --v_btc_type             VARCHAR2,
                                  v_rct_branch,  --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                                  'GRP LIFE RECEIPT ALLOCATIONS', --v_description       VARCHAR2,
                                  v_rct_code, --v_ref_no             VARCHAR2,
                                  v_gl_trans,
                                  NULL,
                                  NULL,
                                  NULL,
                                  NULL,
                                  NULL,
                                  NULL,
                                  NULL,
                                  NULL,
                                  NULL,
                                  v_currency_code); --v_gl_trans  IN OUT  fms_test.Fms_Vouchers_Pkg.Tgl_rec_type,

            UPDATE lms_grp_prem_receipts
               SET grct_prem_unallocated_amt =
                         (  grct_amt
                          - (  NVL (grct_prem_comm, 0)
                             + NVL (grct_prem_bonus, 0)))
                       - NVL (v_alloc_amt, 0)
             WHERE grct_code = v_grct_code;
        END IF;
    END post_grp_rcpt_alloc;

    PROCEDURE post_update_grp_gross_prem (
        v_pol_code    NUMBER,
        v_prod_code   NUMBER,
        v_brn_code    NUMBER,
        v_grct_code   NUMBER,
        v_user        VARCHAR2 DEFAULT NULL,
        v_drcr        VARCHAR2 DEFAULT 'D'
    )
    IS
        v_agn_code              lms_agencies.agn_code%TYPE;
        v_agn_sht_desc          lms_policy_endorsements.endr_agen_sht_desc%TYPE;
        v_vat_rate              tqc_account_types.act_vat_rate%TYPE;
        v_override_rate         tqc_account_types.act_overide_rate%TYPE;
        v_endr_comm_amt         NUMBER;
        v_override_comm_amt     NUMBER;
        v_vat_amount            NUMBER;
        v_prem_paid             NUMBER;
        v_comm_rate             NUMBER;
        v_endr_vat_rate         NUMBER;
        v_endr_comm_rate        NUMBER;
        v_comm_amt              NUMBER;
        v_act_vat_rate          NUMBER;
        v_adm_param_val         VARCHAR2 (1);
        v_endr_ov_comm_rate     NUMBER;
        v_override_comm_rate    NUMBER;
        v_site_param            lms_parameters.param_name%TYPE;
        v_count                 NUMBER := -1;
        v_org_code              NUMBER;
        v_vgl_no                NUMBER;
        v_trnt_code             VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_trnt_gl_code          VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_acc_gl_code           VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_trnt_contra_gl_code   VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_trans_code            NUMBER;
        v_gl_trans              tq_fms.fms_vouchers_pkg.tgl_rec_type;
        v_admin_fee_inclusive   VARCHAR2 (1);
        v_comm_inclusive        VARCHAR2 (1);
        v_curr_code             NUMBER;
        v_receipt_no            lms_grp_prem_receipts.grct_receipt_no%TYPE;

        CURSOR cur_rcpt IS
            SELECT agn_act_code, lms_grp_prem_receipts.*
              FROM lms_grp_prem_receipts, lms_agencies
             WHERE grct_code = v_grct_code AND grct_agen_code = agn_code;
    BEGIN
        v_org_code := fms_interfaces_pkg.get_org (v_brn_code);
        v_gl_trans.delete;

        FOR cur_rcpt_rec IN cur_rcpt
        LOOP
            SELECT    TO_NUMBER (TO_CHAR (SYSDATE, 'RRRR'))
                   || lms_transaction_seq.NEXTVAL
              INTO v_trans_code
              FROM DUAL;

            IF NVL (cur_rcpt_rec.grct_prem_orc_comm, 0) <> 0
            THEN
                get_gl_code ('ADM_GB',
                             v_prod_code,
                             v_trnt_code,
                             v_trnt_gl_code,
                             v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
                get_gl_code ('UP_GB',
                             v_prod_code,
                             v_trnt_code,
                             v_acc_gl_code,
                             v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                             NULL,
                             -- v_tt_code                        NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                             NULL,
                             -- v_renewal                        VARCHAR2 DEFAULT 'N',
                             cur_rcpt_rec.agn_act_code,
                             -- v_act_code                       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                             v_brn_code);
                --check if accounts exist in policy branch
                valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                           v_org_code,
                           v_brn_code,
                           'ADM_GB');
                valid_acc (v_acc_gl_code,
                           v_org_code,
                           v_brn_code,
                           'UP_GB');
                v_count := NVL (v_count, 0) + 2;
                interface_append_gl (
                    v_trans_code,                --v_trans_code        NUMBER,
                    v_user,                    --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                    v_pol_code,                  --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                    v_prod_code,                 --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
