                    v_pol_code,                 --v_vchr_no          VARCHAR2,
                    NULL,                        --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                    NULL,                        --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                    NULL,                       --v_rcpt_no          VARCHAR2,
                    v_count,                     --v_count             NUMBER,
                    'NET COMM_ADMIN CHARGE -' || cur_rcpt_rec.grct_receipt_no,
                    --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                    cur_rcpt_rec.grct_prem_orc_comm,
                    --v_amount            NUMBER,
                    v_drcr,
                    --'D',          --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                    v_trnt_gl_code,
                    --v_acc_number1       VARCHAR2,
                    v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                    --v_acc_number2        VARCHAR2,
                    v_brn_code,                  --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                    v_gl_trans);
            END IF;

            IF NVL (cur_rcpt_rec.grct_prem_comm, 0) <> 0
            THEN
                get_gl_code ('UC_GB',
                             v_prod_code,
                             v_trnt_code,
                             v_trnt_gl_code,
                             v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                             NULL,
                             -- v_tt_code                        NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                             NULL,
                             -- v_renewal                        VARCHAR2 DEFAULT 'N',
                             cur_rcpt_rec.agn_act_code,
                             -- v_act_code                       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                             v_brn_code);
                get_gl_code ('UP_GB',
                             v_prod_code,
                             v_trnt_code,
                             v_acc_gl_code,
                             v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                             NULL,
                             -- v_tt_code                        NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                             NULL,
                             -- v_renewal                        VARCHAR2 DEFAULT 'N',
                             cur_rcpt_rec.agn_act_code,
                             -- v_act_code                       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                             v_brn_code);
                --check if accounts exist in policy branch
                valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                           v_org_code,
                           v_brn_code,
                           'UC_GB');
                valid_acc (v_acc_gl_code,
                           v_org_code,
                           v_brn_code,
                           'UP_GB');
                v_count := NVL (v_count, 0) + 2;
                interface_append_gl (
                    v_trans_code,                --v_trans_code        NUMBER,
                    v_user,                    --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                    v_pol_code,                  --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                    v_prod_code,                 --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                    v_pol_code,                 --v_vchr_no          VARCHAR2,
                    NULL,                        --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                    NULL,                        --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                    NULL,                       --v_rcpt_no          VARCHAR2,
                    v_count,                     --v_count             NUMBER,
                    'NET COMM_ADMIN ' || cur_rcpt_rec.grct_receipt_no,
                    --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                    cur_rcpt_rec.grct_prem_comm,
                    --v_amount            NUMBER,
                    v_drcr,
                    --'D',          --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                    v_trnt_gl_code,
                    --v_acc_number1       VARCHAR2,
                    v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                    --v_acc_number2        VARCHAR2,
                    v_brn_code,                  --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                    v_gl_trans);
            END IF;

            IF v_count <> 0
            THEN
                interface_update_vgl (
                    v_trans_code,                   --v_trans_code     NUMBER,
                    v_user,                    --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                    v_pol_code,                  --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                    TRUNC (SYSDATE),                    --v_date         DATE,
                    NULL,                        --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                    NULL,                        --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                    'NET COMM_ADMIN CHARGE.',  --v_btc_description   VARCHAR2,
                    'JV',                     --v_btc_type           VARCHAR2,
                    v_brn_code,                  --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                       'NET ADMIN CHARGE POSTING '
                    || cur_rcpt_rec.grct_receipt_no,
                    --v_description       VARCHAR2,
                    v_pol_code,                 --v_ref_no           VARCHAR2,
                    v_gl_trans,
                    NULL,
                    NULL,
                    NULL,
                    NULL,
                    NULL,
                    NULL,
                    NULL,
                    NULL,
                    NULL,
                    v_curr_code);
            END IF;
        END LOOP;
    END post_update_grp_gross_prem;

    PROCEDURE post_update_grp_recpt_pymt (
        v_grct_code               NUMBER,
        v_prod_code               NUMBER,
        v_brn_code                NUMBER,
        v_user                    VARCHAR2,
        v_cla_gl_interface_type   VARCHAR2
    )
    IS
        v_prod_type   VARCHAR2 (10);
        v_endr_type   VARCHAR2 (10);

        CURSOR cur_rcpt IS
            SELECT *
              FROM lms_grp_prem_receipts
             WHERE grct_code = v_grct_code;
    BEGIN
        BEGIN
            SELECT prod_type
              INTO v_prod_type
              FROM lms_products
             WHERE prod_code = v_prod_code;
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                raise_error ('Error Determining Product Details.');
        END;

        FOR cur_rcpt_rec IN cur_rcpt
        LOOP
            BEGIN
                SELECT endr_type
                  INTO v_endr_type
                  FROM lms_policy_endorsements
                 WHERE endr_code = cur_rcpt_rec.grct_endr_code;
            EXCEPTION
                WHEN OTHERS
                THEN
                    NULL;
            END;

            IF v_prod_type != 'PENS'
            THEN
                IF v_cla_gl_interface_type <> 'C'
                THEN
                    BEGIN
                        post_grp_rcpt_alloc (cur_rcpt_rec.grct_amt,
                                             cur_rcpt_rec.grct_pol_code,
                                             v_grct_code,
                                             v_prod_code,
                                             cur_rcpt_rec.grct_receipt_no,
                                             v_user);
                    EXCEPTION
                        WHEN OTHERS
                        THEN
                            raise_error (
                                   'ERROR POSTING RECEIPT DETAILS FOR RECEIPT '
                                || cur_rcpt_rec.grct_receipt_no);
                    END;
                -- IF NVL(v_endr_type,'NB') NOT IN ('TP','RP')
                -- THEN
                --      BEGIN
                --          post_grp_credit_note_setlmnt (cur_rcpt_rec.grct_pol_code,
                --                                      v_grct_code,
                --                                      v_prod_code,
                --                                      cur_rcpt_rec.grct_receipt_no,
                --                                      v_user);
                --      EXCEPTION
                --          WHEN OTHERS
                --         THEN
                --             raise_error (
                --                 'ERROR POSTING RECEIPT SETTLEMENT DETAILS FOR RECEIPT '
                --                  || cur_rcpt_rec.grct_receipt_no);
                --    END;
                --  END IF;
                END IF;

                IF     (   cur_rcpt_rec.grct_comm_inclusive = 'N'
                        OR cur_rcpt_rec.grct_admin_charge_inclusive = 'N')
                   AND NVL (v_endr_type, 'NB') NOT IN ('TP', 'RP')
                THEN
                    BEGIN
                        post_update_grp_gross_prem (
                            cur_rcpt_rec.grct_pol_code,
                            v_prod_code,
                            v_brn_code,
                            cur_rcpt_rec.grct_code,
                            v_user);
                    EXCEPTION
                        WHEN OTHERS
                        THEN
                            raise_error (
                                   'ERROR POSTING RECEIPT COMMISSION DETAILS FOR RECEIPT '
                                || cur_rcpt_rec.grct_receipt_no);
                    END;
                END IF;
            ELSE
                BEGIN
                    update_gl_da_contri (cur_rcpt_rec.grct_pol_code,
                                         cur_rcpt_rec.grct_code,
                                         v_brn_code,
                                         'C');
                EXCEPTION
                    WHEN OTHERS
                    THEN
                        raise_error (
                               'ERROR POSTING RECEIPT CONTRIBUTION DETAILS FOR RECEIPT '
                            || cur_rcpt_rec.grct_receipt_no);
                END;
            END IF;

            UPDATE lms_grp_prem_receipts
               SET grct_posted = 'Y',
                   grct_posted_date = SYSDATE,
                   grct_posted_by = v_user
             WHERE grct_code = cur_rcpt_rec.grct_code;

            UPDATE lms_master_transactions
               SET mtran_posted = 'Y',
                   mtran_posting_date = SYSDATE,
                   mtran_posted_by = v_user
             WHERE mtran_lms_receipt_pk = cur_rcpt_rec.grct_code;
        END LOOP;
    END post_update_grp_recpt_pymt;

    PROCEDURE update_grp_recpt_pymt (
        v_rct_code                 VARCHAR2,
        v_acc_type                 VARCHAR2,
        v_amt                      NUMBER,           --total for the receipt .
        v_prp_code                 NUMBER,
        v_chq_no                   VARCHAR2,
        v_chq_dt                   DATE,
        v_date                     DATE,
        v_pmt_type                 VARCHAR2,
        v_rct_branch               NUMBER,
        v_description              VARCHAR2,
        v_raised_by                NUMBER,
        v_cur_code                 NUMBER,
        v_mode                     VARCHAR2,                  --cheque/cash...
        v_paid_by                  VARCHAR2,
        v_bnk_account              NUMBER,
        v_grp_recpt_rec     IN     type_grp_recpt_table,
        v_net_gross                VARCHAR2,
        v_receipt_pk               NUMBER,
        v_rev_recpt_code           NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
        v_rev_mtran_code           NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
        v_admin_gross_net          VARCHAR2 DEFAULT 'G',
        v_curr_grct_code       OUT NUMBER,
        v_post_rcpt                VARCHAR2 DEFAULT 'Y',
        v_wtx_gross_net            VARCHAR2 DEFAULT 'G',
        v_vat_gross_net            VARCHAR2 DEFAULT 'G'
    )
    IS
        v_count                     NUMBER := 0;
        v_oppr_code                 NUMBER;
        v_tot_amt                   NUMBER;
        v_grct_code                 NUMBER;
        v_ac_type                   NUMBER;
        v_only_due_inst             VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_multiple_inst             VARCHAR2 (20) := 'Y';
        v_tran_no                   NUMBER;
        v_bal_amt                   NUMBER;
        v_alloc_amt                 NUMBER := 0;
        v_credit                    NUMBER := 0;
        v_chq_rcpt_no               VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_gl_trans                  fms_vouchers_pkg.tgl_rec_type;
        v_vgl_no                    NUMBER;
        v_trnt_code                 VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_trnt_gl_code              VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_trnt_contra_gl_code       VARCHAR2 (20);
        os_prem_dummy               NUMBER;
        v_os_inst                   NUMBER;
        v_inst_prem                 NUMBER;
        v_contra_acc                VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_policy_no                 VARCHAR2 (30);
        v_prod_code                 NUMBER;
        v_pol_bra_code              NUMBER;
        v_org_code                  NUMBER;
        v_prod_type                 VARCHAR2 (5);
        v_grp_life_rider            VARCHAR2 (2);
        v_comm_inclusive            VARCHAR2 (1);
        v_agen_code                 NUMBER;
        v_bra_code                  NUMBER;
        v_cla_gl_interface_type     VARCHAR2 (10);
        v_mtran_code                NUMBER;
        v_endr_no                   VARCHAR2 (30);
        v_prod_sht_desc             VARCHAR2 (10);
        v_pol_prp_code              NUMBER;
        v_endr_type                 VARCHAR2 (5);
        v_endr_type2                VARCHAR2 (5);
        v_client_acc                VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_client_type               VARCHAR2 (4);
        v_user                      VARCHAR2 (30);
        v_param                     VARCHAR2 (4);
        v_descriptn                 VARCHAR2 (50);
        v_gtop_code                 NUMBER;
        v_gtop_receipt_trans_code   VARCHAR2 (100);
        v_rcpt_mode                 VARCHAR2 (1);
        v_outs_tax_amt              NUMBER;
        v_rcpt_bal                  NUMBER;
        v_admin_charge_inclusive    VARCHAR2 (1);
        v_currency_rate             NUMBER;
        v_recs                      NUMBER := 0;
        v_product                   VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_trans                     VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_trans_code                NUMBER;
        v_calc_gross_prem_param     VARCHAR2 (2);
        v_trans_auth                VARCHAR2 (1) := 'N';
        v_debit_mtran_code          NUMBER;
        v_curr_endr_code            NUMBER;
        v_paid_to_date              DATE;
        v_instlmt_prem              NUMBER;
        v_pens_inst_amt             NUMBER;
        v_inst_policy_fee           NUMBER;
        v_init_client_contr         NUMBER;
        v_pay_freq                  VARCHAR2 (5);
        v_tot_pol_fee               NUMBER;
        v_pol_cur_code              NUMBER;
        v_round                     NUMBER;
        v_round_base_cur            NUMBER;
        v_base_currency             NUMBER;
        v_pension_amt               NUMBER;
        v_premium_amt               NUMBER;
        v_currency_factor           NUMBER := 1;
        v_prod_umbrella             VARCHAR2 (10);
        v_master_pol_code           NUMBER;
        v_post_rcpt_param           VARCHAR2 (10);
        v_inv_rider_allowed         VARCHAR2 (3);
        v_cash_acrual               VARCHAR2 (1);
        v_alloc_mode                VARCHAR2 (1);

        CURSOR cur_pol_cb_amt IS
              SELECT NVL (SUM (grct_refund_amt), 0)
                         suspense_amt,
                     NVL (SUM (grct_prem_pymnt_amt), grct_prem_allocate)
                         premium_amt,
                     NVL (SUM (grct_pens_pymt_amt), grct_pens_allocate)
                         pension_contr,
                     NVL (SUM (grct_prem_comm), 0)
                         prem_comm,
                     NVL (SUM (grct_pens_comm), 0)
                         pens_comm,
                     NVL (SUM (grct_prem_tax), 0)
                         prem_tax,
                     NVL (SUM (grct_prem_comm_paid), 0)
                         prem_comm_paid,
                     pol_bra_code,
                     pol_prod_code,
                     pol_type,
                     lms_interfaces_pkg.pol_product (pol_code)
                         product,
                     pol_code,
                     prod_gl_control_code
                FROM lms_grp_prem_receipts, lms_policies, lms_products
               WHERE     pol_prod_code = prod_code
                     AND pol_code = grct_pol_code
                     AND grct_receipt_no = v_rct_code
                     AND grct_fms_receipt_pk = v_receipt_pk
                     AND grct_status != 'C'
            GROUP BY pol_bra_code,
                     pol_prod_code,
                     pol_type,
                     lms_interfaces_pkg.pol_product (pol_code),
                     pol_code,
                     prod_gl_control_code,
                     grct_prem_allocate,
                     grct_pens_allocate;

        CURSOR cur_policies (v_pol_code IN NUMBER)
        IS
            SELECT pol_code,
                   pol_policy_no,
                   pol_term,
                   pol_anb,
                   pol_prod_sht_desc,
                   pol_freq_of_payment,
                   pol_freq_days,
                   pol_status,
                   pol_type,
                   pol_cla_code,
                   pol_bra_code,
                   pol_prp_code,
                   pol_prod_code,
                   pol_current_endr_code,
                   pol_paid_to_date,
                   pol_os_instlmt_no,
                   pol_os_prem_bal_amt,
                   pol_overpayment_amt,
                   pol_tot_loan_os_amt,
                   pol_proposal_no,
                   pol_grp_life_rider
              FROM lms_policies
             WHERE pol_code = v_pol_code;

        CURSOR cur_taxes (v_pol_code IN NUMBER)
        IS
            SELECT *
              FROM lms_policy_taxes, lms_tax_types, lms_tax_rates
             WHERE     ptx_trt_code = trt_code
                   AND ptx_tt_code = tt_code
                   AND ptx_applied_to = 'CL'
                   AND trt_application_freq = 'O'
                   AND NVL (ptx_tax_amt, 0) > NVL (ptx_tax_paid_amt, 0)
                   AND v_prod_umbrella = 'N'
                   AND ptx_pol_code = v_pol_code;

        CURSOR cur_ind_taxes (v_pol_code IN NUMBER)
        IS
            SELECT *
              FROM lms_policy_member_taxes, lms_tax_types, lms_tax_rates
             WHERE     pmtx_trt_code = trt_code
                   AND pmtx_tt_code = tt_code
                   AND pmtx_applied_to = 'CL'
                   AND trt_application_freq = 'O'
                   AND NVL (pmtx_tax_amt, 0) > NVL (pmtx_tax_paid_amt, 0)
                   AND v_prod_umbrella = 'Y'
                   AND pmtx_ipol_code = v_pol_code;
    BEGIN
        --       raise_error('v_acc_type='||v_admin_gross_net);

        --raise_error('AM HERE=====');
        SELECT    TO_NUMBER (TO_CHAR (SYSDATE, 'RRRR'))
               || lms_transaction_seq.NEXTVAL
          INTO v_trans_code
          FROM DUAL;

        IF NVL (v_amt, 0) <= 0
        THEN
            raise_error ('THERE IS NO AMOUNT TO PROCESS PAYMENT WITH...');
        END IF;

        SELECT DECODE (TRIM (v_net_gross),  'N', 'N',  'G', 'Y')
          INTO v_comm_inclusive
          FROM DUAL;

        --raise_error('v_admin_gross_net = '||v_admin_gross_net);
        SELECT DECODE (TRIM (v_admin_gross_net),  'N', 'N',  'G', 'Y',  'Y')
          INTO v_admin_charge_inclusive
          FROM DUAL;

        --raise_error('v_net_gross = '||v_net_gross||', v_admin_gross_net = '||v_admin_gross_net);
        v_user := fms_interfaces_pkg.get_username (v_raised_by);
        v_org_code := fms_interfaces_pkg.get_org (v_rct_branch);
        v_currency_rate :=
            lms_grp_misc.get_currexch_rate (v_cur_code,
                                            v_round,
                                            v_round_base_cur);
        v_base_currency := lms_grp_misc.get_base_currency (v_org_code);

        BEGIN
            lms_grp_misc.system_param_val (
                'POST_GRP_RCPT_AFTER_VERIFICATION',
                v_post_rcpt_param);
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                raise_error ('POST_GRP_RCPT_AFTER_VERIFICATION Param Error');
        END;


        BEGIN
            lms_grp_misc.system_param_val ('ACRUAL_OR_CASH_BASIS_PAYMENT',
                                           v_cash_acrual);
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                raise_error (
                    'GENERATE_CLM_NO_ON_SPECIED_FORMATS Param Error');
        END;


        --Check to see if the receipting is on Policy or Account.
        --raise_error('AM HERE==='||v_grp_recpt_rec.COUNT);
        IF v_grp_recpt_rec.COUNT > 0
        THEN
            /*Handles normal receipts and recoveries. Receipting On Policy.*/
            FOR i IN 1 .. v_grp_recpt_rec.COUNT
            LOOP
                --Check if the Product is umbrella and address the tables accordingly. Hardcoded for now since FMS have not completed.
                BEGIN
                    SELECT NVL (prod_umbrella, 'N')
                      INTO v_prod_umbrella
                      FROM lms_products, lms_individual_policies
                     WHERE     ipol_code = v_grp_recpt_rec (i).pol_code
                           AND ipol_prod_code = prod_code;
                EXCEPTION
                    WHEN OTHERS
                    THEN
                        v_prod_umbrella := 'N';
                END;

                IF v_prod_umbrella = 'Y'
                THEN
                    BEGIN
                        SELECT agn_act_code,
                               ipol_prod_type,
                               ipol_grp_life_rider,
                               mendr_agen_code,
                               NVL (ipol_bra_code, pol_bra_code),
                               ipol_prod_code,
                               --cla_gl_interface_type,
                               mendr_no,
                               prod_sht_desc,
                               ipol_prp_code,
                               mendr_type,
                               NVL (agn_acc_no, agn_sht_desc),
                               act_type_id,
                               NVL (
                                   ipol_cur_code,
                                   lms_grp_misc.get_base_currency (
                                       v_org_code)),
                               prod_fms_receipting,
                               NVL (prod_umbrella, 'N'),
                               ipol_pol_code
                          INTO v_ac_type,
                               v_prod_type,
                               v_grp_life_rider,
                               v_agen_code,
                               v_bra_code,
                               v_prod_code,
                               -- v_cla_gl_interface_type,
                               v_endr_no,
                               v_prod_sht_desc,
                               v_pol_prp_code,
                               v_endr_type,
                               v_client_acc,
                               v_client_type,
                               v_pol_cur_code,
                               v_rcpt_mode,
                               v_prod_umbrella,
                               v_master_pol_code
                          FROM lms_agencies,
                               lms_policy_member_endorsements,
                               lms_individual_policies,
                               lms_products,
                               lms_classes,
                               lms_policies,
                               tqc_account_types
                         WHERE     mendr_code = ipol_current_mendr_code
                               AND mendr_ipol_code = ipol_code
                               AND ipol_pol_code = pol_code
                               AND ipol_prod_code = prod_code
                               AND prod_cla_code = cla_code
                               AND agn_code = mendr_agen_code
                               AND agn_act_code = act_code
                               AND ipol_code = v_grp_recpt_rec (i).pol_code;
                    EXCEPTION
                        WHEN OTHERS
                        THEN
                            IF NVL (v_grp_recpt_rec (i).pol_type, 'PL') IN
                                   ('CLMR',
                                    'CLMRF',
                                    'CLMRR',
                                    'CLMFACR')
                            THEN
                                SELECT agn_act_code,
                                       ipol_prod_type,
                                       ipol_grp_life_rider,
                                       mendr_agen_code,
                                       NVL (ipol_bra_code, pol_bra_code),
                                       ipol_prod_code,
                                       --cla_gl_interface_type,
                                       mendr_no,
                                       prod_sht_desc,
                                       ipol_prp_code,
                                       mendr_type,
                                       NVL (agn_acc_no, agn_sht_desc),
                                       act_type_id,
                                       NVL (
                                           ipol_cur_code,
                                           lms_grp_misc.get_base_currency (
                                               v_org_code)),
                                       prod_fms_receipting,
                                       NVL (prod_umbrella, 'N'),
                                       ipol_pol_code
                                  INTO v_ac_type,
                                       v_prod_type,
                                       v_grp_life_rider,
                                       v_agen_code,
                                       v_bra_code,
                                       v_prod_code,
                                       -- v_cla_gl_interface_type,
                                       v_endr_no,
                                       v_prod_sht_desc,
                                       v_pol_prp_code,
                                       v_endr_type,
                                       v_client_acc,
                                       v_client_type,
                                       v_pol_cur_code,
                                       v_rcpt_mode,
                                       v_prod_umbrella,
                                       v_master_pol_code
                                  FROM lms_agencies,
                                       lms_policy_member_endorsements,
                                       lms_individual_policies,
                                       lms_products,
                                       lms_classes,
                                       lms_policies,
                                       tqc_account_types,
                                       lms_claims
                                 WHERE     mendr_code =
                                           ipol_current_mendr_code
                                       AND mendr_ipol_code = ipol_code
                                       AND ipol_pol_code = pol_code
                                       AND ipol_prod_code = prod_code
                                       AND prod_cla_code = cla_code
                                       AND agn_code = mendr_agen_code
                                       AND agn_act_code = act_code
                                       AND clm_ipol_code = ipol_code
                                       AND clm_no =
                                           v_grp_recpt_rec (i).pol_policy_no;
                            ELSE
                                raise_error (
                                       'SYSTEM UNABLE TO DETERMINE POLICY DETAILS FOR '
                                    || v_grp_recpt_rec (i).pol_policy_no
                                    || '.....');
                            END IF;
                    END;
                ELSE
                    BEGIN
                        SELECT agn_act_code,
                               pol_prod_type,
                               pol_grp_life_rider,
                               endr_agen_code,
                               pol_bra_code,
                               pol_prod_code,
                               --cla_gl_interface_type,
                               endr_no,
                               prod_sht_desc,
                               pol_prp_code,
                               endr_type,
                               NVL (agn_acc_no, agn_sht_desc),
                               act_type_id,
                               NVL (
                                   pol_cur_code,
                                   lms_grp_misc.get_base_currency (
                                       v_org_code)),
                               prod_fms_receipting,
                               NVL (prod_umbrella, 'N'),
                               pol_code,
                               prod_inv_rider_allowed
                          INTO v_ac_type,
                               v_prod_type,
                               v_grp_life_rider,
                               v_agen_code,
                               v_bra_code,
                               v_prod_code,
                               -- v_cla_gl_interface_type,
                               v_endr_no,
                               v_prod_sht_desc,
                               v_pol_prp_code,
                               v_endr_type,
                               v_client_acc,
                               v_client_type,
                               v_pol_cur_code,
                               v_rcpt_mode,
                               v_prod_umbrella,
                               v_master_pol_code,
                               v_inv_rider_allowed
                          FROM lms_agencies,
                               lms_policy_endorsements,
                               lms_policies,
                               lms_products,
                               lms_classes,
                               tqc_account_types
                         WHERE     endr_code = pol_current_endr_code
                               AND endr_pol_code = pol_code
                               AND pol_prod_code = prod_code
                               AND prod_cla_code = cla_code
                               AND agn_code = endr_agen_code
                               AND agn_act_code = act_code
                               AND pol_code = v_grp_recpt_rec (i).pol_code;
                    EXCEPTION
                        WHEN OTHERS
                        THEN
                            IF NVL (v_grp_recpt_rec (i).pol_type, 'PL') IN
                                   ('CLMR',
                                    'CLMRF',
                                    'CLMRR',
                                    'CLMFACR')
                            THEN
                                SELECT agn_act_code,
                                       pol_prod_type,
                                       pol_grp_life_rider,
                                       endr_agen_code,
                                       pol_bra_code,
                                       pol_prod_code,
                                       --cla_gl_interface_type,
                                       endr_no,
                                       prod_sht_desc,
                                       pol_prp_code,
                                       endr_type,
                                       NVL (agn_acc_no, agn_sht_desc),
                                       act_type_id,
                                       NVL (
                                           pol_cur_code,
                                           lms_grp_misc.get_base_currency (
                                               v_org_code)),
                                       prod_fms_receipting,
                                       NVL (prod_umbrella, 'N'),
                                       pol_code,
                                       prod_inv_rider_allowed
                                  INTO v_ac_type,
                                       v_prod_type,
                                       v_grp_life_rider,
                                       v_agen_code,
                                       v_bra_code,
                                       v_prod_code,
                                       -- v_cla_gl_interface_type,
                                       v_endr_no,
                                       v_prod_sht_desc,
                                       v_pol_prp_code,
                                       v_endr_type,
                                       v_client_acc,
                                       v_client_type,
                                       v_pol_cur_code,
                                       v_rcpt_mode,
                                       v_prod_umbrella,
                                       v_master_pol_code,
                                       v_inv_rider_allowed
                                  FROM lms_agencies,
                                       lms_policy_endorsements,
                                       lms_policies,
                                       lms_products,
                                       lms_classes,
                                       tqc_account_types,
                                       lms_claims
                                 WHERE     endr_code = pol_current_endr_code
                                       AND endr_pol_code = pol_code
                                       AND pol_prod_code = prod_code
                                       AND prod_cla_code = cla_code
                                       AND agn_code = endr_agen_code
                                       AND agn_act_code = act_code
                                       AND clm_pol_code = pol_code
                                       AND clm_no =
                                           v_grp_recpt_rec (i).pol_policy_no;
                            ELSE
                                raise_error (
                                       'SYSTEM UNABLE TO DETERMINE POLICY DETAILS FOR '
                                    || v_grp_recpt_rec (i).pol_policy_no
                                    || ' pol_code ='
                                    || v_grp_recpt_rec (i).pol_code
                                    || '.....');
                            END IF;
                    END;
                END IF;

                v_tot_amt :=
                    (  NVL (v_grp_recpt_rec (i).pol_prem_amt, 0)
                     + NVL (v_grp_recpt_rec (i).pol_pension_amt, 0)
                     + NVL (v_grp_recpt_rec (i).misc_amt, 0));
                v_premium_amt := NVL (v_grp_recpt_rec (i).pol_prem_amt, 0);
                v_pension_amt := NVL (v_grp_recpt_rec (i).pol_pension_amt, 0);

                IF     v_base_currency = v_pol_cur_code
                   AND v_pol_cur_code != v_cur_code
                THEN
                    v_currency_factor := v_currency_rate;
                ELSE
                    v_currency_factor := 1;
                END IF;

                IF NVL (v_tot_amt, 0) != 0
                THEN
                    BEGIN
                        SELECT    TO_NUMBER (TO_CHAR (SYSDATE, 'YYYY'))
                               || lms_grct_code_seq.NEXTVAL
                          INTO v_grct_code
                          FROM DUAL;
                    EXCEPTION
                        WHEN OTHERS
                        THEN
                            raise_error (
                                'ERROR POPULATING POLICY RECEIPT SEQUENCE......');
                    END;

                    BEGIN
                        SELECT TO_NUMBER (
                                      TO_CHAR (SYSDATE, 'YYYY')
                                   || lms_mtran_code_seq.NEXTVAL)
                          INTO v_mtran_code
                          FROM DUAL;
                    EXCEPTION
                        WHEN OTHERS
                        THEN
                            raise_error (
                                'Error Populating Master records next Sequence......');
                    END;

                    --CHECK IF ITS CASH BASIS OR ACRUAL BASIS.
                    BEGIN
                        lms_grp_misc.system_param_val (
                            'ACRUAL_OR_CASH_BASIS_PAYMENT',
                            v_cla_gl_interface_type,
                            v_grp_recpt_rec (i).pol_code);
                    EXCEPTION
                        WHEN OTHERS
                        THEN
                            raise_error (
                                'ACRUAL_OR_CASH_BASIS_PAYMENT Param Error');
                    END;

                    --RAISE_ERROR('NOW HERE========'||v_cla_gl_interface_type);
                    IF NVL (v_grp_recpt_rec (i).pol_type, 'PL') IN
                           ('CLMR',
                            'RIR',
                            'CLMRF',
                            'CLMRR',
                            'CLMFACR')
                    --CLAIM RECOVERY RECEIPTING AND RI-RECOVERIES
                    THEN
                        --RAISE_ERROR('CLM RECVRY RECEIPTING. IN DEVELOPMENT..');
                        v_cla_gl_interface_type := 'XXXX';

                        IF v_grp_recpt_rec (i).pol_type = 'CLMR'
                        THEN
                            IF NVL (
                                   lms_grp_misc.coin_rcvry_bal (
                                       v_grp_recpt_rec (i).pol_code),
                                   0) <
                               v_grp_recpt_rec (i).misc_amt
                            THEN
                                raise_error ('OVERPAYMENTS NOT ALLOWED!!!');
                            END IF;

                            v_descriptn := 'CLAIM RECOVERIES';
                        ELSIF v_grp_recpt_rec (i).pol_type = 'RIR'
                        THEN
                            v_descriptn := 'RI RECOVERIES';
                        END IF;

                        IF v_grp_recpt_rec (i).pol_type = 'CLMRR'
                        THEN
                            IF NVL (
                                   lms_grp_misc.rein_rcvry_bal (
                                       v_grp_recpt_rec (i).pol_code),
                                   0) <
                               v_grp_recpt_rec (i).misc_amt
                            THEN
                                raise_error ('OVERPAYMENTS NOT ALLOWED!!!');
                            END IF;

                            v_descriptn := 'CLAIM REINSURANCE RECOVERIES';
                        END IF;

                        IF v_grp_recpt_rec (i).pol_type = 'CLMRF'
                        THEN
                            IF NVL (
                                   lms_grp_misc.facre_rcvry_bal (
                                       v_grp_recpt_rec (i).pol_code),
                                   0) <
                               v_grp_recpt_rec (i).misc_amt
                            THEN
                                raise_error ('OVERPAYMENTS NOT ALLOWED!!!');
                            END IF;

                            v_descriptn :=
                                'CLAIM FACRE REINSURANCE RECOVERIES';
                        END IF;

                        IF v_grp_recpt_rec (i).pol_type = 'CLMFACR'
                        THEN
                            IF NVL (
                                   lms_grp_misc.facultative_rcvry_bal (
                                       v_grp_recpt_rec (i).pol_code),
                                   0) <
                               v_grp_recpt_rec (i).misc_amt
                            THEN
                                raise_error ('OVERPAYMENTS NOT ALLOWED!!!');
                            END IF;

                            v_descriptn :=
                                'CLAIM FACULTATIVE CEDING RECOVERIES';
                        END IF;

                        BEGIN
                            SELECT    TO_NUMBER (TO_CHAR (SYSDATE, 'RRRR'))
                                   || lms_gtop_code_seq.NEXTVAL
                              INTO v_gtop_code
                              FROM DUAL;
                        EXCEPTION
                            WHEN OTHERS
                            THEN
                                raise_error (
                                    'ERROR FETCHING OTHER PAYMENTS RECEIPT SEQUENCE...');
                        END;

                        SELECT    v_rct_code
                               || '/'
                               || lms_gtop_receipt_trans_seq.NEXTVAL
                          INTO v_gtop_receipt_trans_code
                          FROM DUAL;

                        IF v_grp_recpt_rec (i).misc_amt <> 0
                        THEN
                            BEGIN
                                INSERT INTO lms_grp_other_pymts (
                                                gtop_code,
                                                gtop_date,
                                                gtop_cheque_no,
                                                gtop_receipt_no,
                                                gtop_receipt_date,
                                                gtop_done_by,
                                                gtop_drcr,
                                                gtop_amt,
                                                gtop_pol_code,
                                                gtop_source,
                                                gtop_fms_receipt_pk,
                                                gtop_desc,
                                                gtop_ccr_code,
                                                gtop_btr_no,
                                                gtop_type,
                                                gtop_receipt_trans_code,
                                                gtop_reprint_code,
                                                gtop_ts_code,
                                                gtop_cfc_code,
                                                gtop_crctd_code,
                                                gtop_cfr_code)
                                         VALUES (
                                             v_gtop_code,
                                             TRUNC (SYSDATE),
                                             v_chq_no,
                                             v_rct_code,
                                             v_date,
                                             v_user,
                                             DECODE (
                                                 SIGN (
                                                     v_grp_recpt_rec (i).misc_amt),
                                                 -1, 'D',
                                                 'C'),
                                             v_grp_recpt_rec (i).misc_amt,
                                             NULL,
                                             'RECEIPT',
                                             v_receipt_pk,
                                             v_descriptn,
                                             DECODE (
                                                 v_grp_recpt_rec (i).pol_type,
                                                 'CLMR', v_grp_recpt_rec (i).pol_code),
                                             NULL,
                                             --DECODE (v_pol_type, 'RPT', v_pol_code),
                                             v_grp_recpt_rec (i).pol_type,
                                             v_gtop_receipt_trans_code,
                                             DECODE (
                                                 v_grp_recpt_rec (i).pol_type,
                                                 'RPT', v_grp_recpt_rec (i).pol_code),
                                             DECODE (
                                                 v_grp_recpt_rec (i).pol_type,
                                                 'RIR', v_grp_recpt_rec (i).pol_code),
                                             DECODE (
                                                 v_grp_recpt_rec (i).pol_type,
                                                 'CLMRF', v_grp_recpt_rec (i).pol_code,
                                                 NULL),
                                             DECODE (
                                                 v_grp_recpt_rec (i).pol_type,
                                                 'CLMRR', v_grp_recpt_rec (i).pol_code,
                                                 NULL),
                                             DECODE (
                                                 v_grp_recpt_rec (i).pol_type,
                                                 'CLMFACR', v_grp_recpt_rec (
                                                                i).pol_code,
                                                 NULL));
                            EXCEPTION
                                WHEN OTHERS
                                THEN
                                    raise_error (
                                        'ERROR CREATING OTHER PAYMENTS RECEIPTS DTLS...');
                            END;

                            IF v_grp_recpt_rec (i).pol_type = 'CLMR'
                            THEN
                                BEGIN
                                    lms_grp_misc.process_coin_rcvry_receipt (
                                        v_gtop_code,
                                        v_grp_recpt_rec (i).pol_code,
                                        v_grp_recpt_rec (i).pol_type);
                                EXCEPTION
                                    WHEN OTHERS
                                    THEN
                                        raise_error (
                                            'ERROR PROCESSING MISC. RCPT...');
                                END;
                            ELSIF v_grp_recpt_rec (i).pol_type = 'CLMRR'
                            THEN
                                BEGIN
                                    lms_grp_misc.process_ri_rcvry_receipt (
                                        v_gtop_code,
                                        v_grp_recpt_rec (i).pol_code,
                                        v_grp_recpt_rec (i).pol_type);
                                EXCEPTION
                                    WHEN OTHERS
                                    THEN
                                        raise_error (
                                            'ERROR PROCESSING MISC. RCPT...');
                                END;
                            ELSIF v_grp_recpt_rec (i).pol_type = 'CLMRF'
                            THEN
                                BEGIN
                                    lms_grp_misc.process_facre_rcvry_receipt (
                                        v_gtop_code,
                                        v_grp_recpt_rec (i).pol_code,
                                        v_grp_recpt_rec (i).pol_type);
                                EXCEPTION
                                    WHEN OTHERS
                                    THEN
                                        raise_error (
                                            'ERROR PROCESSING MISC. RCPT...');
                                END;
                            ELSIF v_grp_recpt_rec (i).pol_type = 'CLMFACR'
                            THEN
                                BEGIN
                                    lms_grp_misc.process_facul_rcvry_receipt (
                                        v_gtop_code,
                                        v_grp_recpt_rec (i).pol_code,
                                        v_grp_recpt_rec (i).pol_type);
                                EXCEPTION
                                    WHEN OTHERS
                                    THEN
                                        raise_error (
                                            'ERROR PROCESSING MISC. RCPT...');
                                END;
                            ELSE
                                BEGIN
                                    lms_grp_misc.process_ri_rcvry_receipt (
                                        v_gtop_code,
                                        v_grp_recpt_rec (i).pol_code,
                                        v_grp_recpt_rec (i).pol_type);
                                EXCEPTION
                                    WHEN OTHERS
                                    THEN
                                        raise_error (
                                            'ERROR PROCESSING  RI-RECOVERY MISC. RCPT...');
                                END;
                            END IF;
                        END IF;
                    ELSE
                        --UNDERWRITING DEBIT RECEIPTING...
                        IF v_prod_type IN ('PENS', 'GRAT')
                        THEN
                            IF NVL (v_grp_life_rider, 0) = 'N'
                            THEN
                                IF NVL (v_grp_recpt_rec (i).pol_prem_amt, 0) !=
                                   0
                                THEN
                                    raise_error (
                                        'YOU HAVE ALLOCATED TO PREMIUM WHILE THIS IS A PENSION PRODUCT WITHOUT A LIFE RIDER.. ');
                                END IF;
                            END IF;
                        ELSIF v_prod_type IN ('LOAN',
                                              'EARN',
                                              'FUNE',
                                              'LVLT')
                        THEN
                            IF NVL (v_inv_rider_allowed, 'N') = 'N'
                            THEN
                                IF NVL (v_grp_recpt_rec (i).pol_pension_amt,
                                        0) !=
                                   0
                                THEN
                                    raise_error (
                                        'YOU HAVE ALLOCATED TO PENSION WHILE THIS IS NOT A PENSION PRODUCT. ');
                                END IF;
                            END IF;
                        ELSIF v_prod_type IN ('IN',
                                              'TM',
                                              'EDUC',
                                              'ANN')
                        THEN
                            NULL;
                        ELSE
                            raise_error (
                                   'PRODUCT TYPE X'
                                || v_prod_type
                                || '  NOT DEFINED..');
                        END IF;

                        -- RAISE_ERROR('HERE11111111111111111111111111');
                        IF v_rcpt_mode = 'D'
                        THEN
                            IF v_prod_umbrella = 'Y'
                            THEN
                                BEGIN
                                    SELECT NVL (mendr_authorized, 'N')
                                      INTO v_trans_auth
                                      FROM lms_policy_member_endorsements
                                     WHERE mendr_code =
                                           v_grp_recpt_rec (i).endr_code;
                                EXCEPTION
                                    WHEN OTHERS
                                    THEN
                                        raise_error (
                                            'ERROR RETRIEVING DEBIT TRANSACTION DETAILS...');
                                END;
                            ELSE
                                --                     RAISE_ERROR('v_grp_recpt_rec (i).endr_code=='||v_grp_recpt_rec (i).endr_code);
                                BEGIN
                                    SELECT NVL (endr_authorized, 'N')
                                      INTO v_trans_auth
                                      FROM lms_policy_endorsements
                                     WHERE endr_code =
                                           v_grp_recpt_rec (i).endr_code;
                                EXCEPTION
                                    WHEN OTHERS
                                    THEN
                                        raise_error (
                                               'ERROR RETRIEVING DEBIT TRANSACTION DETAILS...'
                                            || v_grp_recpt_rec (i).endr_code);
                                END;
                            END IF;
                        END IF;

                        --RAISE_ERROR('v_rev_recpt_code='||v_rev_recpt_code||'v_rev_mtran_code='||v_rev_mtran_code);
                        IF     v_rev_recpt_code IS NULL
                           AND v_rev_mtran_code IS NULL
                        THEN
                            BEGIN
                                INSERT INTO lms_grp_prem_receipts (
                                                grct_code,
                                                grct_ltr_trans_no,
                                                grct_date,
                                                grct_cheque_no,
                                                grct_amt,
                                                grct_gross_amnt,
                                                grct_pol_code,
                                                grct_pol_policy_no,
                                                grct_receipt_no,
                                                grct_receipt_date,
                                                grct_prem_allocate,
                                                grct_pens_allocate,
                                                grct_comm_inclusive,
                                                grct_agen_code,
                                                grct_brn_code,
                                                grct_drcr,
                                                grct_status,
                                                grct_fms_receipt_pk,
                                                grct_done_by,
                                                grct_endr_code,
                                                grct_drcr_no,
                                                grct_admin_charge_inclusive,
                                                grct_cur_code,
                                                grct_currate,
                                                grct_mendr_code,
                                                grct_ipol_code,
                                                grct_umbrella)
                                         VALUES (
                                             v_grct_code,
                                             NULL,
                                             TRUNC (SYSDATE),
                                             v_chq_no,
                                             v_tot_amt,
                                             v_tot_amt,
                                             v_master_pol_code,
                                             v_grp_recpt_rec (i).pol_policy_no,
                                             v_rct_code,
                                             v_date,
                                             NVL (v_premium_amt, 0),
                                             NVL (v_pension_amt, 0),
                                             v_comm_inclusive,
                                             v_agen_code,
                                             v_bra_code,
                                             'C',
                                             'A',
                                             v_receipt_pk,
                                             v_user,
                                             DECODE (
                                                 v_prod_umbrella,
                                                 'Y', NULL,
                                                 v_grp_recpt_rec (i).endr_code),
                                             v_grp_recpt_rec (i).endr_drcr_no,
                                             v_admin_charge_inclusive,
                                             v_cur_code,
                                             v_currency_rate,
                                             DECODE (
                                                 v_prod_umbrella,
                                                 'N', NULL,
                                                 v_grp_recpt_rec (i).endr_code),
                                             v_grp_recpt_rec (i).pol_code,
                                             v_prod_umbrella);
                            EXCEPTION
                                WHEN OTHERS
                                THEN
                                    raise_error (
                                        'ERROR INSERTING POLICY RECEIPT DETAILS......');
                            END;

                            IF     (   v_prod_type != 'PENS'
                                    OR (    v_prod_type = 'PENS'
                                        AND NVL (v_grp_life_rider, 0) = 'Y'))
                               AND NVL (v_grp_recpt_rec (i).pol_prem_amt, 0) !=
                                   0
                            THEN
                                /********************Deduct any Taxes applied on the client.*************************************/
                                FOR cur_taxes_rec
                                    IN cur_taxes (v_master_pol_code)
                                LOOP
                                    --Determine Current Receipt Balance.
                                    BEGIN
                                        SELECT NVL (grct_prem_allocate, 0)
                                          INTO v_rcpt_bal
                                          FROM lms_grp_prem_receipts
                                         WHERE grct_code = v_grct_code;
                                    EXCEPTION
                                        WHEN OTHERS
                                        THEN
                                            v_rcpt_bal := 0;
                                    END;

                                    v_outs_tax_amt :=
                                          NVL (cur_taxes_rec.ptx_tax_amt, 0)
                                        - NVL (
                                              cur_taxes_rec.ptx_tax_paid_amt,
                                              0);

                                    IF     v_rcpt_bal >= v_outs_tax_amt
                                       AND v_rcpt_bal > 0
                                    THEN
                                        UPDATE lms_policy_taxes
                                           SET ptx_tax_paid_amt =
                                                   v_outs_tax_amt
                                         WHERE ptx_code =
                                               cur_taxes_rec.ptx_code;

                                        UPDATE lms_grp_prem_receipts
                                           SET grct_client_taxes_amt =
                                                     NVL (
                                                         grct_client_taxes_amt,
                                                         0)
                                                   + v_outs_tax_amt,
                                               grct_prem_allocate =
                                                     NVL (grct_prem_allocate,
                                                          0)
                                                   - NVL (v_outs_tax_amt, 0)
                                         WHERE grct_code = v_grct_code;
                                    ELSIF     v_rcpt_bal < v_outs_tax_amt
                                          AND v_rcpt_bal > 0
                                    THEN
                                        UPDATE lms_policy_taxes
                                           SET ptx_tax_paid_amt = v_rcpt_bal
                                         WHERE ptx_code =
                                               cur_taxes_rec.ptx_code;

                                        UPDATE lms_grp_prem_receipts
                                           SET grct_client_taxes_amt =
                                                     NVL (
                                                         grct_client_taxes_amt,
                                                         0)
                                                   + v_rcpt_bal,
                                               grct_prem_allocate =
                                                     NVL (grct_prem_allocate,
                                                          0)
                                                   - NVL (v_rcpt_bal, 0)
                                         WHERE grct_code = v_grct_code;
                                    END IF;
                                END LOOP;

                                FOR cur_taxes_rec
                                    IN cur_ind_taxes (v_master_pol_code)
                                LOOP
                                    --Determine Current Receipt Balance.
                                    BEGIN
                                        SELECT NVL (grct_prem_allocate, 0)
                                          INTO v_rcpt_bal
                                          FROM lms_grp_prem_receipts
                                         WHERE grct_code = v_grct_code;
                                    EXCEPTION
                                        WHEN OTHERS
                                        THEN
                                            v_rcpt_bal := 0;
                                    END;

                                    v_outs_tax_amt :=
                                          NVL (cur_taxes_rec.pmtx_tax_amt, 0)
                                        - NVL (
                                              cur_taxes_rec.pmtx_tax_paid_amt,
                                              0);

                                    IF     v_rcpt_bal >= v_outs_tax_amt
                                       AND v_rcpt_bal > 0
                                    THEN
                                        UPDATE lms_policy_member_taxes
                                           SET pmtx_tax_paid_amt =
                                                   v_outs_tax_amt
                                         WHERE pmtx_code =
                                               cur_taxes_rec.pmtx_code;

                                        UPDATE lms_grp_prem_receipts
                                           SET grct_client_taxes_amt =
                                                     NVL (
                                                         grct_client_taxes_amt,
                                                         0)
                                                   + v_outs_tax_amt,
                                               grct_prem_allocate =
                                                     NVL (grct_prem_allocate,
                                                          0)
                                                   - NVL (v_outs_tax_amt, 0)
                                         WHERE grct_code = v_grct_code;
                                    ELSIF     v_rcpt_bal < v_outs_tax_amt
                                          AND v_rcpt_bal > 0
                                    THEN
                                        UPDATE lms_policy_member_taxes
                                           SET pmtx_tax_paid_amt = v_rcpt_bal
                                         WHERE pmtx_code =
                                               cur_taxes_rec.pmtx_code;

                                        UPDATE lms_grp_prem_receipts
                                           SET grct_client_taxes_amt =
                                                     NVL (
                                                         grct_client_taxes_amt,
                                                         0)
                                                   + v_rcpt_bal,
                                               grct_prem_allocate =
                                                     NVL (grct_prem_allocate,
                                                          0)
                                                   - NVL (v_rcpt_bal, 0)
                                         WHERE grct_code = v_grct_code;
                                    END IF;
                                END LOOP;

                                IF v_prod_umbrella = 'Y'
                                THEN
                                    NULL;
                                --Computation of Paid to date for Umbrella policies not currently needed.
                                ELSE
                                    BEGIN
                                        SELECT pol_current_endr_code,
                                               NVL (pol_paid_to_date,
                                                    pol_effective_date)
                                          INTO v_curr_endr_code,
                                               v_paid_to_date
                                          FROM lms_policies,
                                               lms_policy_endorsements
                                         WHERE     pol_code =
                                                   v_grp_recpt_rec (i).pol_code
                                               AND pol_current_endr_code =
                                                   endr_code;
                                    EXCEPTION
                                        WHEN OTHERS
                                        THEN
                                            raise_error (
                                                'Error Retrieving Paid to date.');
                                    END;

                                    --Determine Current Receipt Balance.
                                    BEGIN
                                        SELECT NVL (grct_prem_allocate, 0)
                                          INTO v_rcpt_bal
                                          FROM lms_grp_prem_receipts
                                         WHERE grct_code = v_grct_code;
                                    EXCEPTION
                                        WHEN OTHERS
                                        THEN
                                            v_rcpt_bal := 0;
                                    END;

                                    /******************Deduct any Policy fee Incurred on the receipt.**********************************/
                                    lms_grp_misc.get_premium (
                                        v_curr_endr_code,
                                        v_paid_to_date + 1,
                                        v_instlmt_prem,
                                        v_pens_inst_amt,
                                        v_inst_policy_fee,
                                        v_init_client_contr,
                                        v_pay_freq);

                                    --RAISE_ERROR('v_inst_policy_fee=='||v_inst_policy_fee);
                                    IF NVL (v_inst_policy_fee, 0) > 0
                                    THEN
                                        v_tot_pol_fee :=
                                            ROUND (
                                                  (  NVL (/*v_grp_recpt_rec (i).pol_prem_amt*/
                                                          v_rcpt_bal, 0)
                                                   / NVL (
                                                           v_instlmt_prem
                                                         + v_inst_policy_fee,
                                                         1))
                                                * v_inst_policy_fee,
                                                2);

                                        UPDATE lms_grp_prem_receipts
                                           SET grct_policy_fee =
                                                   v_tot_pol_fee,
                                               grct_prem_allocate =
                                                     grct_prem_allocate
                                                   - NVL (v_tot_pol_fee, 0)
                                         WHERE grct_code = v_grct_code;
                                    END IF;
                                END IF;
                            END IF;


                            --GET DEBIT TRANSACTION..
                            BEGIN
                                SELECT mtran_code, mtran_alloc_mode
                                  INTO v_debit_mtran_code, v_alloc_mode
                                  FROM lms_master_transactions
                                 WHERE mtran_ref_no =
                                       v_grp_recpt_rec (i).endr_drcr_no;
                            EXCEPTION
                                WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND
                                THEN
                                    NULL;
                                WHEN OTHERS
                                THEN
                                    raise_error (
                                           'ERROR DETERMINING DEBIT RECORD..endr_drcr_no=='
                                        || v_grp_recpt_rec (i).endr_drcr_no
                                        || ' pol_prem_amt='
                                        || v_grp_recpt_rec (i).pol_prem_amt
                                        || ' v_endr_type '
                                        || v_endr_type);
                            END;

                            BEGIN
                                INSERT INTO lms_master_transactions (
                                                mtran_code,
                                                mtran_date,
                                                mtran_ref_no,
                                                mtran_other_ref,
                                                mtran_tran_type,
                                                mtran_dc,
                                                mtran_control_acc,
                                                mtran_client_type,
                                                mtran_client_code,
                                                mtran_amount,
                                                mtran_balance,
                                                mtran_pol_code,
                                                mtran_narrations,
                                                mtran_prp_code,
                                                mtran_pol_polcy_no,
                                                mtran_endr_no,
                                                mtran_ltr_trans_no,
                                                mtran_acct_code,
                                                mtran_prod_sht_desc,
                                                mtran_prod_code,
                                                mtran_authorised,
                                                mtran_date_authorized,
                                                mtran_authorised_by,
                                                mtran_posting_date,
                                                mtran_net_amt,
                                                mtran_origin,
                                                mtran_btr_trans_code,
                                                mtran_sd,
                                                mtran_whtx,
                                                mtran_extras,
                                                mtran_commission,
                                                mtran_trans_effective_date,
                                                mtran_agen_code,
                                                mtran_cla_type,
                                                mtran_fms_receipt_pk,
                                                mtran_rcpt_status,
                                                mtran_comm_inclusive,
                                                mtran_brn_code,
                                                mtran_lms_receipt_pk,
                                                mtran_admin_charge_inclusive,
                                                mtran_endr_code,
                                                mtran_mendr_code,
                                                mtran_ipol_code,
                                                mtran_alloc_mode)
                                         VALUES (
                                             v_mtran_code,
                                             TRUNC (SYSDATE),
                                             v_rct_code,
                                             v_grp_recpt_rec (i).endr_drcr_no,
                                             'RC',
                                             'C',
                                             v_client_acc,
                                             v_client_type,
                                             NVL (v_agen_code,
                                                  v_pol_prp_code),
                                             -v_tot_amt * v_currency_factor,
                                             -v_tot_amt * v_currency_factor,
                                             v_master_pol_code,
                                             'Receipt',
                                             v_pol_prp_code,
                                             v_grp_recpt_rec (i).pol_policy_no,
                                             v_endr_no,
                                             NULL,
                                             NULL,
                                             v_prod_sht_desc,
                                             v_prod_code,
                                             'Y',
                                             TRUNC (SYSDATE),
                                             v_user,
                                             TRUNC (SYSDATE),
                                             -v_tot_amt * v_currency_factor,
                                             'U',
                                             v_endr_type,
                                             NULL,
                                             NULL,
                                             NULL,
                                             NULL,
                                             TRUNC (SYSDATE),
                                             v_agen_code,
                                             'G',
                                             v_receipt_pk,
                                             'A',
                                             v_comm_inclusive,
                                             v_bra_code,
                                             v_grct_code,
                                             v_admin_charge_inclusive,
                                             DECODE (
                                                 v_prod_umbrella,
                                                 'N', v_grp_recpt_rec (i).endr_code,
                                                 NULL),
                                             DECODE (
                                                 v_prod_umbrella,
                                                 'N', NULL,
                                                 v_grp_recpt_rec (i).endr_code),
                                             DECODE (
                                                 v_prod_umbrella,
                                                 'N', NULL,
                                                 v_grp_recpt_rec (i).pol_code),
                                             v_alloc_mode);
                            EXCEPTION
                                WHEN OTHERS
                                THEN
                                    raise_error (
                                        'Error inserting Rcpt dtls in master trans...');
                            END;

                            BEGIN
                                lms_ord_misc.system_param_val (
                                    'CALC_GROSS_PREM',
                                    v_calc_gross_prem_param);
                            EXCEPTION
                                WHEN OTHERS
                                THEN
                                    raise_error (
                                        'v_calc_gross_prem_param param value');
                            END;

                            IF v_calc_gross_prem_param = 'Y'
                            THEN
                                --IF NET, RECALCULATE THE GROSS AMOUNT...
                                IF (   v_comm_inclusive = 'N'
                                    OR v_admin_charge_inclusive = 'N')
                                -- AND v_rcpt_mode = 'D'
                                THEN
                                    -- raise_error('here....'||v_comm_inclusive||';'||v_admin_charge_inclusive);



                                    IF v_prod_umbrella = 'Y'
                                    THEN
                                        BEGIN
                                            calc_ind_gross_prem (
                                                v_grp_recpt_rec (i).pol_code,
                                                v_grct_code,
                                                v_grp_recpt_rec (i).endr_code,
                                                v_mtran_code,
                                                v_user);
                                        EXCEPTION
                                            WHEN OTHERS
                                            THEN
                                                raise_error (
                                                    'Error Updating Gross Premium Amount');
                                        END;
                                    ELSE
                                        BEGIN
                                            calc_gross_prem (
