                                                v_grp_recpt_rec (i).pol_code,
                                                v_grct_code,
                                                v_grp_recpt_rec (i).endr_code,
                                                v_mtran_code,
                                                v_user);
                                        EXCEPTION
                                            WHEN OTHERS
                                            THEN
                                                raise_error (
                                                    'Error Updating Gross Premium Amount');
                                        END;
                                    END IF;
                                END IF;

                                BEGIN
                                    calc_grp_admin_fee (
                                        v_grp_recpt_rec (i).pol_code,
                                        v_grct_code,
                                        v_grp_recpt_rec (i).endr_code,
                                        v_admin_charge_inclusive,
                                        v_mtran_code,
                                        v_user,
                                        v_prod_umbrella);
                                --                     EXCEPTION
                                --                        WHEN OTHERS
                                --                        THEN
                                --                           raise_error
                                --                                     ('Error Updating Gross Admin Fee Amount');
                                END;
                            END IF;

                            --AUTO ALLOCATE RECEIPT TO DEBIT...
                            BEGIN
                                SELECT endr_type
                                  INTO v_endr_type2
                                  FROM lms_policy_endorsements
                                 WHERE endr_code =
                                       v_grp_recpt_rec (i).endr_code;
                            EXCEPTION
                                WHEN OTHERS
                                THEN
                                    v_endr_type2 := v_endr_type;
                            END;

                            IF     (   v_prod_type != 'PENS'
                                    OR (    v_prod_type = 'PENS'
                                        AND NVL (v_grp_life_rider, 0) = 'Y'))
                               AND NVL (v_grp_recpt_rec (i).pol_prem_amt, 0) >
                                   0
                               AND v_endr_type2 NOT IN ('FAC')
                               AND v_trans_auth = 'A'
                            THEN
                                BEGIN
                                    lms_ord_misc.system_param_val (
                                        'AUTO_ALLOCATE_GROUP_RCPT',
                                        v_param);
                                EXCEPTION
                                    WHEN OTHERS
                                    THEN
                                        raise_error ('Parameter Error...');
                                END;

                                --AUTO ALLOCATE...
                                IF v_cla_gl_interface_type != 'C'     --'CASH'
                                THEN
                                    IF NVL (v_param, 'N') = 'Y'
                                    THEN
                                        IF v_prod_umbrella = 'Y'
                                        THEN
                                            BEGIN
                                                tq_lms.lms_web_pkg_grp_uw.knock_off_transactions (
                                                    v_grp_recpt_rec (i).pol_code,
                                                    v_mtran_code,
                                                    v_rct_code,
                                                    v_tot_amt,
                                                    0,
                                                    v_debit_mtran_code,
                                                    'Y');
                                            /*lms_web_pkg_grp_uw.knock_off_ind_transactions
                                                        (v_grp_recpt_rec (i).pol_code,
                                                         v_mtran_code,
                                                         v_rct_code,
                                                         v_tot_amt,
                                                         0,
                                                         v_debit_mtran_code,
                                                         'Y'
                                                        );*/
                                            /*EXCEPTION
                                               WHEN OTHERS
                                               THEN
                                                  raise_error
                                                     ('ERROR AT AUTO ALLOCATION OF RECEIPT...'
                                                     );*/
                                            END;
                                        ELSE
                                            BEGIN
                                                tq_lms.lms_web_pkg_grp_uw.knock_off_transactions (
                                                    v_grp_recpt_rec (i).pol_code,
                                                    v_mtran_code,
                                                    v_rct_code,
                                                    v_tot_amt,
                                                    0,
                                                    v_debit_mtran_code,
                                                    'Y');
                                            --EXCEPTION
                                            --   WHEN OTHERS
                                            --   THEN
                                            --      raise_error
                                            --         ('ERROR AT AUTO ALLOCATION OF RECEIPT...'
                                            --         );
                                            END;
                                        END IF;
                                    END IF;
                                END IF;
                            END IF;
                        ELSIF v_rev_recpt_code IS NOT NULL
                        THEN
                            BEGIN
                                INSERT INTO lms_grp_prem_receipts (
                                                grct_code,
                                                grct_ltr_trans_no,
                                                grct_date,
                                                grct_cheque_no,
                                                grct_amt,
                                                grct_gross_amnt,
                                                grct_pol_code,
                                                grct_pol_policy_no,
                                                grct_receipt_no,
                                                grct_receipt_date,
                                                grct_prem_allocate,
                                                grct_pens_allocate,
                                                grct_comm_inclusive,
                                                grct_agen_code,
                                                grct_brn_code,
                                                grct_drcr,
                                                grct_status,
                                                grct_fms_receipt_pk,
                                                grct_done_by,
                                                grct_trans_from_code,
                                                grct_endr_code,
                                                grct_drcr_no,
                                                grct_cur_code,
                                                grct_currate,
                                                grct_mendr_code,
                                                grct_ipol_code,
                                                grct_umbrella)
                                         VALUES (
                                             v_grct_code,
                                             NULL,
                                             TRUNC (SYSDATE),
                                             v_chq_no,
                                             v_tot_amt,
                                             v_tot_amt,
                                             v_grp_recpt_rec (i).pol_code,
                                             v_grp_recpt_rec (i).pol_policy_no,
                                             v_rct_code,
                                             v_date,
                                             NVL (v_premium_amt, 0),
                                             NVL (v_pension_amt, 0),
                                             v_comm_inclusive,
                                             v_agen_code,
                                             v_bra_code,
                                             'C',
                                             'A',
                                             v_receipt_pk,
                                             v_user,
                                             v_rev_recpt_code,
                                             v_grp_recpt_rec (i).endr_code,
                                             v_grp_recpt_rec (i).endr_drcr_no,
                                             v_cur_code,
                                             v_currency_rate,
                                             DECODE (
                                                 v_prod_umbrella,
                                                 'N', NULL,
                                                 v_grp_recpt_rec (i).endr_code),
                                             v_grp_recpt_rec (i).pol_code,
                                             v_prod_umbrella); --,'C');--,v_loan_alloc
                            --v_prem_alloc);
                            EXCEPTION
                                WHEN OTHERS
                                THEN
                                    raise_error (
                                        'ERROR INSERTING POLICY RECEIPT DETAILS......2');
                            END;

                            IF     (   v_prod_type != 'PENS'
                                    OR (    v_prod_type = 'PENS'
                                        AND NVL (v_grp_life_rider, 0) = 'Y'))
                               AND NVL (v_grp_recpt_rec (i).pol_prem_amt, 0) !=
                                   0
                            THEN
                                BEGIN
                                    SELECT pol_current_endr_code,
                                           NVL (pol_paid_to_date,
                                                pol_effective_date)
                                      INTO v_curr_endr_code, v_paid_to_date
                                      FROM lms_policies,
                                           lms_policy_endorsements
                                     WHERE     pol_code =
                                               v_grp_recpt_rec (i).pol_code
                                           AND pol_current_endr_code =
                                               endr_code;
                                EXCEPTION
                                    WHEN OTHERS
                                    THEN
                                        raise_error (
                                            'Error Retrieving Paid to date.');
                                END;

                                --Deduct any Policy fee Incurred on the receipt.
                                lms_grp_misc.get_premium (
                                    v_curr_endr_code,
                                    v_paid_to_date + 1,
                                    v_instlmt_prem,
                                    v_pens_inst_amt,
                                    v_inst_policy_fee,
                                    v_init_client_contr,
                                    v_pay_freq);

                                IF NVL (v_inst_policy_fee, 0) > 0
                                THEN
                                    v_tot_pol_fee :=
                                          (  NVL (
                                                 v_grp_recpt_rec (i).pol_prem_amt,
                                                 0)
                                           / NVL (v_instlmt_prem, 1))
                                        * v_inst_policy_fee;

                                    UPDATE lms_grp_prem_receipts
                                       SET grct_policy_fee = v_tot_pol_fee,
                                           grct_prem_allocate =
                                                 grct_prem_allocate
                                               - NVL (v_tot_pol_fee, 0)
                                     WHERE grct_code = v_grct_code;
                                END IF;
                            END IF;
                        ELSE
                            BEGIN
                                INSERT INTO lms_master_transactions (
                                                mtran_code,
                                                mtran_date,
                                                mtran_ref_no,
                                                mtran_other_ref,
                                                mtran_tran_type,
                                                mtran_dc,
                                                mtran_control_acc,
                                                mtran_client_type,
                                                mtran_client_code,
                                                mtran_amount,
                                                mtran_balance,
                                                mtran_pol_code,
                                                mtran_narrations,
                                                mtran_prp_code,
                                                mtran_pol_polcy_no,
                                                mtran_endr_no,
                                                mtran_ltr_trans_no,
                                                mtran_acct_code,
                                                mtran_prod_sht_desc,
                                                mtran_prod_code,
                                                mtran_authorised,
                                                mtran_date_authorized,
                                                mtran_authorised_by,
                                                mtran_posting_date,
                                                mtran_net_amt,
                                                mtran_origin,
                                                mtran_btr_trans_code,
                                                mtran_sd,
                                                mtran_whtx,
                                                mtran_extras,
                                                mtran_commission,
                                                mtran_trans_effective_date,
                                                mtran_agen_code,
                                                mtran_cla_type,
                                                mtran_fms_receipt_pk,
                                                mtran_rcpt_status,
                                                mtran_comm_inclusive,
                                                mtran_brn_code,
                                                mtran_trans_from_code,
                                                mtran_lms_receipt_pk,
                                                mtran_mendr_code,
                                                mtran_ipol_code)
                                         VALUES (
                                             v_mtran_code,
                                             TRUNC (SYSDATE),
                                             v_rct_code,
                                             NULL,
                                             'RC',
                                             'C',
                                             v_client_acc,
                                             v_client_type,
                                             NVL (v_agen_code,
                                                  v_pol_prp_code),
                                             -v_tot_amt * v_currency_factor,
                                             -v_tot_amt * v_currency_factor,
                                             v_grp_recpt_rec (i).pol_code,
                                             'Receipt Transfer/Refund',
                                             v_pol_prp_code,
                                             v_grp_recpt_rec (i).pol_policy_no,
                                             v_endr_no,
                                             NULL,
                                             NULL,
                                             v_prod_sht_desc,
                                             v_prod_code,
                                             'Y',
                                             TRUNC (SYSDATE),
                                             v_user,
                                             TRUNC (SYSDATE),
                                             -v_tot_amt * v_currency_factor,
                                             'U',
                                             v_endr_type,
                                             NULL,
                                             NULL,
                                             NULL,
                                             NULL,
                                             TRUNC (SYSDATE),
                                             v_agen_code,
                                             'G',
                                             v_receipt_pk,
                                             'A',
                                             v_comm_inclusive,
                                             v_bra_code,
                                             v_rev_mtran_code,
                                             v_grct_code,
                                             DECODE (
                                                 v_prod_umbrella,
                                                 'N', NULL,
                                                 v_grp_recpt_rec (i).endr_code),
                                             DECODE (
                                                 v_prod_umbrella,
                                                 'N', NULL,
                                                 v_grp_recpt_rec (i).pol_code));
                            EXCEPTION
                                WHEN OTHERS
                                THEN
                                    raise_error (
                                        'Error inserting Rcpt dtls in master trans...2');
                            END;
                        END IF;

                        --RAISE_ERROR('v_prod_type'||v_prod_type||';'||'v_grp_life_ride'||v_grp_life_rider||';'||'v_cla_gl_interface_type'||v_cla_gl_interface_type);
                        IF     (   v_prod_type != 'PENS'
                                OR (    v_prod_type = 'PENS'
                                    AND NVL (v_grp_life_rider, 0) = 'Y'))
                           AND NVL (v_grp_recpt_rec (i).pol_prem_amt, 0) != 0
                        --AND v_cla_gl_interface_type = 'C'--'CASH'
                        /*This parameter was put to ensure that allocation only happens for Cash, why, acural should also be subjected to installment computation.
                        Settling should be treated as a separate process. To review as we go forward. JIM 28052014.
                        */
                        THEN
                            BEGIN
                                lms_grp_misc.lms_grp_premium_receipts (
                                    v_grp_recpt_rec (i).pol_code,
                                    v_grct_code,
                                    'Y',
                                    'N',
                                    NULL,
                                    v_ac_type,
                                    v_bal_amt,
                                    v_comm_inclusive,
                                    v_prod_umbrella);
                            --                     EXCEPTION
                            --                        WHEN OTHERS
                            --                        THEN
                            --                           raise_error ('Grp misc');
                            END;
                        ELSIF     (   v_prod_type != 'PENS'
                                   OR (    v_prod_type = 'PENS'
                                       AND NVL (v_grp_life_rider, 0) = 'Y'))
                              AND NVL (v_grp_recpt_rec (i).pol_prem_amt, 0) !=
                                  0
                              AND v_cla_gl_interface_type != 'C'      --'CASH'
                        THEN
                            BEGIN
                                lms_ord_misc.system_param_val (
                                    'AUTO_ALLOCATE_GROUP_RCPT',
                                    v_param);
                            EXCEPTION
                                WHEN OTHERS
                                THEN
                                    raise_error ('Parameter Error...');
                            END;

                            IF NVL (v_param, 'N') = 'Y'
                            THEN
                                BEGIN
                                    lms_subledger_utilities.auto_allocate_trans (
                                        v_mtran_code, --v_cr_MTRAN_CODE NUMBER,
                                        v_rct_code,    --v_cr_ref_no VARCHAR2,
                                        v_grp_recpt_rec (i).pol_code,
                                        --v_pol_code NUMBER,
                                        v_comm_inclusive,
                                        v_tot_amt);  --v_include_comm VARCHAR2
                                EXCEPTION
                                    WHEN OTHERS
                                    THEN
                                        raise_error (
                                            'Error allocating Rcpt...');
                                END;

                                UPDATE lms_master_transactions
                                   SET mtran_alloc_mode = 'C'
                                 WHERE mtran_code = v_mtran_code;
                            END IF;
                        END IF;

                        IF     (   v_prod_type = 'PENS'
                                OR NVL (v_inv_rider_allowed, 'N') = 'Y')
                           AND NVL (v_grp_recpt_rec (i).pol_pension_amt, 0) !=
                               0
                        THEN
                            --RAISE_ERROR('AM HERE==='||v_grct_code||';;'||v_comm_inclusive);
                            lms_pensions.process_pens_rcpt (v_grct_code,
                                                            v_comm_inclusive,
                                                            v_prod_umbrella);
                        /* update_gl_da_contri (v_grp_recpt_rec (i).pol_code,
                                              v_grct_code,
                                              v_rct_branch,
                                              'C'
                                             );*/
                        END IF;
                    END IF;
                END IF;

                IF     NVL (v_post_rcpt_param, 'N') = 'N'
                   AND NVL (v_cash_acrual, 'N') <> 'A'
                THEN
                    BEGIN
                        post_update_grp_recpt_pymt (v_grct_code,
                                                    v_prod_code,
                                                    v_bra_code,
                                                    v_user,
                                                    v_cla_gl_interface_type);
                    --               EXCEPTION
                    --                  WHEN OTHERS
                    --                  THEN
                    --                     raise_error ('ERROR POSTING RECEIPT..');
                    END;
                END IF;
            END LOOP;
        ELSE
            /**Receipting on Account. Insert the Record into the Receipting Account Table.*/
            BEGIN
                INSERT INTO lms_grp_receipts_on_accnt (groa_code,
                                                       groa_acc_type,
                                                       groa_reference_code,
                                                       groa_receipt_no,
                                                       groa_receipt_date,
                                                       groa_date,
                                                       groa_amt,
                                                       groa_alloc_amt,
                                                       groa_bal_amt,
                                                       groa_fms_receipt_pk,
                                                       groa_brn_code,
                                                       groa_cheque_no,
                                                       groa_comm_inclusive,
                                                       groa_done_by,
                                                       groa_drcr,
                                                       groa_status,
                                                       groa_pay_method,
                                                       groa_remarks)
                         VALUES (
                                TO_NUMBER (TO_CHAR (SYSDATE, 'YYYY'))
                             || lms_grct_code_seq.NEXTVAL,
                             v_acc_type,
                             v_prp_code,
                             v_rct_code,
                             v_date,
                             TRUNC (SYSDATE),
                             v_amt,
                             0,
                             v_amt,
                             v_receipt_pk,
                             v_rct_branch,
                             v_chq_no,
                             v_comm_inclusive,
                             v_raised_by,
                             'C',
                             'A',
                             v_mode,
                             v_description);
            EXCEPTION
                WHEN OTHERS
                THEN
                    raise_error ('ERROR CREATING RECEIPT ON ACCOUNT');
            END;
        END IF;

        --      END IF;
        v_curr_grct_code := v_grct_code;
    --raise_error('v_gl_trans22=='||v_gl_trans.count);
    --RAISE_ERROR('FINALY HERE======..................................');
    --   EXCEPTION
    --      WHEN OTHERS
    --      THEN
    --         raise_application_error (-20001,
    --                                  'POSTING G. RECTS. ' || SQLERRM (SQLCODE)
    --                                 );
    END update_grp_recpt_pymt;

    PROCEDURE update_grp_rein_recpt_pymt (
        v_rct_code             VARCHAR2,
        v_acc_type             VARCHAR2,
        v_amt                  NUMBER,               --total for the receipt .
        v_prp_code             NUMBER,
        v_chq_no               VARCHAR2,
        v_chq_dt               DATE,
        v_date                 DATE,
        v_pmt_type             VARCHAR2,
        v_rct_branch           NUMBER,
        v_description          VARCHAR2,
        v_user                 VARCHAR2,
        v_cur_code             NUMBER,
        v_mode                 VARCHAR2,                      --cheque/cash...
        v_paid_by              VARCHAR2,
        v_bnk_account          NUMBER,
        v_grp_recpt_rec     IN type_grp_recpt_table,
        v_net_gross            VARCHAR2,
        v_receipt_pk           NUMBER,
        v_rev_recpt_code       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
        v_rev_mtran_code       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
        v_admin_gross_net      VARCHAR2 DEFAULT 'G'
    )
    IS
        v_descriptn                 VARCHAR2 (100);
        v_gtop_code                 NUMBER;
        v_gtop_receipt_trans_code   lms_grp_other_pymts.gtop_receipt_trans_code%TYPE;
    BEGIN
        FOR i IN 1 .. v_grp_recpt_rec.COUNT
        LOOP
            v_descriptn := 'RI RECOVERIES';

            BEGIN
                SELECT    TO_NUMBER (TO_CHAR (SYSDATE, 'RRRR'))
                       || lms_gtop_code_seq.NEXTVAL
                  INTO v_gtop_code
                  FROM DUAL;
            EXCEPTION
                WHEN OTHERS
                THEN
                    raise_error (
                        'ERROR FETCHING OTHER PAYMENTS RECEIPT SEQUENCE...');
            END;

            SELECT v_rct_code || '/' || lms_gtop_receipt_trans_seq.NEXTVAL
              INTO v_gtop_receipt_trans_code
              FROM DUAL;

            IF v_grp_recpt_rec (i).misc_amt <> 0
            THEN
                BEGIN
                    INSERT INTO lms_grp_other_pymts (gtop_code,
                                                     gtop_date,
                                                     gtop_cheque_no,
                                                     gtop_receipt_no,
                                                     gtop_receipt_date,
                                                     gtop_done_by,
                                                     gtop_drcr,
                                                     gtop_amt,
                                                     gtop_pol_code,
                                                     gtop_source,
                                                     gtop_fms_receipt_pk,
                                                     gtop_desc,
                                                     gtop_ccr_code,
                                                     gtop_btr_no,
                                                     gtop_type,
                                                     gtop_receipt_trans_code,
                                                     gtop_reprint_code,
                                                     gtop_ts_code)
                             VALUES (
                                 v_gtop_code,
                                 TRUNC (SYSDATE),
                                 v_chq_no,
                                 v_rct_code,
                                 v_date,
                                 v_user,
                                 DECODE (SIGN (v_grp_recpt_rec (i).misc_amt),
                                         -1, 'D',
                                         'C'),
                                 v_grp_recpt_rec (i).misc_amt,
                                 NULL,
                                 'RECEIPT',
                                 v_receipt_pk,
                                 v_descriptn,
                                 NULL,
                                 NULL,
                                 --DECODE (v_pol_type, 'RPT', v_pol_code),
                                 'RIR_G',
                                 v_gtop_receipt_trans_code,
                                 DECODE (v_grp_recpt_rec (i).pol_type,
                                         'RPT', v_grp_recpt_rec (i).pol_code),
                                 v_grp_recpt_rec (i).pol_code);
                EXCEPTION
                    WHEN OTHERS
                    THEN
                        raise_error (
                            'ERROR CREATING OTHER PAYMENTS RECEIPTS DTLS...');
                END;

                BEGIN
                    lms_grp_misc.process_ri_rcvry_receipt (
                        v_gtop_code,
                        v_grp_recpt_rec (i).pol_code,
                        'RIR_G');
                EXCEPTION
                    WHEN OTHERS
                    THEN
                        raise_error ('Error Allocation Recovery receipts');
                END;
            END IF;
        END LOOP;
    EXCEPTION
        WHEN OTHERS
        THEN
            raise_application_error (
                -20001,
                'POSTING G. RECT. ' || SQLERRM (SQLCODE));
    END update_grp_rein_recpt_pymt;

    PROCEDURE cancel_grp_recpt_pymt (
        v_rct_code      VARCHAR2,
        v_acc_type      VARCHAR2,
        v_date          DATE,
        v_rct_branch    NUMBER,
        v_description   VARCHAR2,
        v_raised_by     NUMBER,
        v_cur_code      NUMBER,
        v_net_gross     VARCHAR2,
        v_receipt_pk    NUMBER
    )
    IS
        v_count                    NUMBER := 0;
        v_grct_code                NUMBER;
        v_gl_trans                 fms_vouchers_pkg.tgl_rec_type;
        v_vgl_no                   NUMBER;
        v_trnt_code                VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_trnt_gl_code             VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_trnt_contra_gl_code      VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_contra_acc               VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_org_code                 NUMBER;
        v_cnt                      NUMBER := 0;
        v_pndp_code                NUMBER := 0;
        v_inv_rider_allowed        VARCHAR2 (3);
        v_dr_trnt_gl_code          VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_cr_trnt_contra_gl_code   VARCHAR2 (20);

        CURSOR cur_pol_cb_amt (v_grctcode NUMBER)
        IS
              SELECT NVL (SUM (grct_refund_amt), 0)
                         suspense_amt,
                     -- GRCT_PMTH_CODE,
                     NVL (SUM (grct_prem_pymnt_amt), 0)
                         premium_amt,
                     NVL (SUM (grct_pens_pymt_amt), 0)
                         pension_contr,
                     NVL (SUM (grct_prem_comm), 0)
                         prem_comm,
                     NVL (SUM (grct_prem_bonus), 0)
                         prem_bonus,
                     NVL (SUM (grct_pens_comm), 0)
                         pens_comm,
                     NVL (SUM (grct_prem_tax), 0)
                         prem_tax,
                     NVL (SUM (grct_prem_comm_paid), 0)
                         prem_comm_paid,
                     NVL (SUM (grct_prem_bonus_paid), 0)
                         prem_bonus_paid,
                     NVL (SUM (grct_prem_unallocated_amt), 0)
                         unprocessed_prem_amt,
                     NVL (SUM (grct_amt), 0)
                         tot_rcpt_amt,
                     pol_bra_code,
                     pol_prod_code,
                     pol_type,
                     lms_interfaces_pkg.pol_product (pol_code)
                         product,
                     prod_gl_control_code,
                     pol_code,
                     agn_act_code,
                     grct_comm_inclusive,
                     SUM (NVL (grct_amt, 0))
                         grct_amt
                FROM lms_grp_prem_receipts,
                     lms_policies,
                     lms_products,
                     lms_agencies
               WHERE     pol_code = grct_pol_code
                     AND pol_prod_code = prod_code
                     AND grct_code = v_grctcode
                     AND grct_agen_code = agn_code
            GROUP BY pol_bra_code,
                     pol_prod_code,
                     pol_type,
                     lms_interfaces_pkg.pol_product (pol_code),
                     prod_gl_control_code,
                     pol_code,
                     agn_act_code,
                     grct_comm_inclusive;

        CURSOR cur_policies (v_pol_code IN NUMBER)
        IS
            SELECT pol_code,
                   pol_policy_no,
                   pol_term,
                   pol_anb,
                   pol_prod_sht_desc,
                   pol_freq_of_payment,
                   pol_freq_days,
                   pol_status,
                   pol_type,
                   pol_cla_code,
                   pol_bra_code,
                   pol_prp_code,
                   pol_prod_code,
                   pol_current_endr_code,
                   pol_paid_to_date,
                   pol_os_instlmt_no,
                   pol_os_prem_bal_amt,
                   pol_overpayment_amt,
                   pol_tot_loan_os_amt,
                   pol_proposal_no,
                   pol_grp_life_rider
              FROM lms_policies
             WHERE pol_code = v_pol_code;

        CURSOR cur_rcpts IS
            SELECT *
              FROM lms_grp_prem_receipts, lms_agencies
             WHERE     grct_receipt_no = v_rct_code
                   AND grct_agen_code = agn_code
                   AND grct_status = 'A';

        --AND grct_fms_receipt_pk = v_receipt_pk;
        CURSOR allocations (v_pol_code IN NUMBER, v_grct_code IN NUMBER)
        IS
            SELECT *
              FROM lms_pension_deposits
             WHERE     pndp_pol_code = v_pol_code
                   AND pndp_grct_code = v_grct_code
                   AND pndp_trans_type != 'PR'
                   AND pndp_status = 'C';

        CURSOR debit_allocations (
            v_pol_code    IN NUMBER,
            v_grct_code   IN NUMBER
        )
        IS
            SELECT *
              FROM lms_tran_mapping, lms_master_transactions
             WHERE     tmap_cr_mtran_code = mtran_code
                   AND mtran_lms_receipt_pk = v_grct_code
                   AND mtran_pol_code = v_pol_code;

        v_recs                     NUMBER := 0;
        v_product                  VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_ac_type                  VARCHAR2 (5);
        v_to_prod_type             VARCHAR2 (5);
        v_no                       NUMBER;
        v_trans_code               NUMBER;
        v_mtran_code               NUMBER;
        v_user                     VARCHAR2 (30)
            := fms_interfaces_pkg.get_username (v_raised_by);
    BEGIN
        v_count := 0;

        SELECT    TO_NUMBER (TO_CHAR (SYSDATE, 'RRRR'))
               || lms_transaction_seq.NEXTVAL
          INTO v_trans_code
          FROM DUAL;

        FOR cur_rct_rec IN cur_rcpts
        LOOP
            BEGIN
                SELECT COUNT (1)
                  INTO v_cnt
                  FROM lms_grp_prem_receipts
                 WHERE     grct_receipt_no = v_rct_code
                       AND grct_pol_code = cur_rct_rec.grct_pol_code
                       AND grct_fms_receipt_pk = v_receipt_pk;
            EXCEPTION
                WHEN OTHERS
                THEN
                    raise_error ('ERROR GETTING RECEIPT DETAILS..');
            END;

            IF NVL (v_cnt, 0) = 0
            THEN
                BEGIN
                    SELECT COUNT (1)
                      INTO v_cnt
                      FROM lms_grp_prem_receipts
                     WHERE     grct_receipt_no = v_rct_code
                           AND grct_pol_code = cur_rct_rec.grct_pol_code
                           AND grct_status = 'A';
                EXCEPTION
                    WHEN OTHERS
                    THEN
                        raise_error ('ERROR GETTING RECEIPT DETAILS..');
                END;

                IF NVL (v_cnt, 0) = 0
                THEN
                    raise_error (
                           'THIS RECEIPT '
                        || v_rct_code
                        || ' DOES NOT EXIST IN GROUP/PENSION PAYMENTS..'
                        || cur_rct_rec.grct_pol_code
                        || ';;'
                        || v_cnt);
                END IF;
            --RAISE_ERROR('v_cnt='||v_cnt);
            END IF;

            --reversing allocated receipts
            BEGIN
                SELECT pol_prod_type, prod_inv_rider_allowed
                  INTO v_to_prod_type, v_inv_rider_allowed
                  FROM lms_policies, lms_products
                 WHERE     pol_code = cur_rct_rec.grct_pol_code
                       AND pol_prod_code = prod_code;
            EXCEPTION
                WHEN OTHERS
                THEN
                    raise_error (
                        'Error retrieving policy details for the policy to transfer to..');
            END;

            IF    v_to_prod_type = 'PENS'
               OR NVL (v_inv_rider_allowed, 'N') = 'Y'
            THEN
                FOR allocations_rec
                    IN allocations (cur_rct_rec.grct_pol_code,
                                    cur_rct_rec.grct_code)
                LOOP
                    BEGIN
                        SELECT COUNT (1)
                          INTO v_no
                          FROM lms_pension_mem_deposits
                         WHERE     pnmdp_pndp_code =
                                   allocations_rec.pndp_code
                               AND pnmdp_status != 'C';
                    EXCEPTION
                        WHEN OTHERS
                        THEN
                            raise_error (
                                'Error counting member allocations to reverse.');
                    END;

                    IF NVL (v_no, 0) != 0
                    THEN
                        BEGIN
                            lms_pensions.undo_pension_mem_alloc (
                                allocations_rec.pndp_code);
                        EXCEPTION
                            WHEN OTHERS
                            THEN
                                raise_error (
                                    'Error reversing member allocations..');
                        END;
                    END IF;

                    BEGIN
                        lms_pensions.undo_allocate_to_pens (
                            allocations_rec.pndp_code);
                    EXCEPTION
                        WHEN OTHERS
                        THEN
                            raise_error (
                                'Error reversing pension allocation..');
                    END;
                END LOOP;
            ELSE
                FOR debit_allocations_rec
                    IN debit_allocations (cur_rct_rec.grct_pol_code,
                                          cur_rct_rec.grct_code)
                LOOP
                    BEGIN
                        lms_web_pkg_grp_uw.undo_transaction_allocation (
                            debit_allocations_rec.tmap_dr_mtran_code,
                            debit_allocations_rec.tmap_code,
                            debit_allocations_rec.tmap_cr_mtran_code);
                    --                    EXCEPTION
                    --                        WHEN OTHERS
                    --                        THEN
                    --                            raise_error ('Error undoing allocations');
                    END;
                END LOOP;
            END IF;

            BEGIN
                SELECT    TO_NUMBER (TO_CHAR (SYSDATE, 'RRRR'))
                       || lms_grct_code_seq.NEXTVAL
                  INTO v_grct_code
                  FROM DUAL;
            EXCEPTION
                WHEN OTHERS
                THEN
                    raise_error (
                        'ERROR POPULATING POLICY RECEIPT SEQUENCE......');
            END;

            BEGIN
                INSERT INTO lms_grp_prem_receipts (grct_code,
                                                   grct_ltr_trans_no,
                                                   grct_date,
                                                   grct_cheque_no,
                                                   grct_amt,
                                                   grct_pol_code,
                                                   grct_pol_policy_no,
                                                   grct_receipt_no,
                                                   grct_receipt_date,
                                                   grct_prem_allocate,
                                                   grct_prem_pymnt_amt,
                                                   grct_prem_comm,
                                                   grct_prem_comm_paid,
                                                   grct_pens_allocate,
                                                   grct_pens_pymt_amt,
                                                   grct_pens_comm,
                                                   grct_pens_comm_paid,
                                                   grct_drcr,
                                                   grct_comm_inclusive,
                                                   grct_agen_code,
                                                   grct_brn_code,
                                                   grct_status,
                                                   grct_gross_amnt,
                                                   grct_fms_receipt_pk,
                                                   grct_done_by,
                                                   grct_prem_unallocated_amt,
                                                   grct_prem_bonus,
                                                   grct_prem_bonus_paid,
                                                   grct_pens_bonus)
                    SELECT v_grct_code,
                           grct_ltr_trans_no,
                           TRUNC (SYSDATE),
                           grct_cheque_no,
                           NVL (grct_amt, 0),
                           grct_pol_code,
                           grct_pol_policy_no,
                           grct_receipt_no || '-CN',
                           grct_receipt_date,
                           NVL (grct_prem_allocate, 0),
                           NULL,
                           NULL,                    --NVL (grct_prem_comm, 0),
                           NULL,               --NVL (grct_prem_comm_paid, 0),
                           NVL (grct_pens_allocate, 0),
                           NULL,
                           NULL,
                           --NVL (grct_pens_comm, 0),
                           NULL,               --NVL (grct_pens_comm_paid, 0),
                           DECODE (grct_drcr, 'D', 'C', 'D'),
                           NVL (grct_comm_inclusive, 'N'),
                           grct_agen_code,
                           grct_brn_code,
                           'A',
                           NVL (grct_gross_amnt, 0),
                           v_receipt_pk,
                           v_user,
                           grct_prem_unallocated_amt,
                           NVL (grct_prem_bonus, 0),
                           NVL (grct_prem_bonus_paid, 0),
                           NVL (grct_pens_bonus, 0)
                      FROM lms_grp_prem_receipts
                     WHERE grct_code = cur_rct_rec.grct_code;
            EXCEPTION
                WHEN OTHERS
                THEN
                    raise_error (
                           'ERROR INSERTING RECEIPT CANCELLATION RECORD..'
                        || cur_rct_rec.grct_code);
            END;

            BEGIN
                SELECT TO_NUMBER (
                              TO_CHAR (SYSDATE, 'YYYY')
                           || lms_mtran_code_seq.NEXTVAL)
                  INTO v_mtran_code
                  FROM DUAL;
            EXCEPTION
                WHEN OTHERS
                THEN
                    raise_error (
                        'Error Populating Master records next Sequence......');
            END;

            BEGIN
                INSERT INTO lms_master_transactions (
                                mtran_code,
                                mtran_date,
                                mtran_ref_no,
                                mtran_other_ref,
                                mtran_tran_type,
                                mtran_dc,
                                mtran_control_acc,
                                mtran_client_type,
                                mtran_client_code,
                                mtran_amount,
                                mtran_balance,
                                mtran_pol_code,
                                mtran_narrations,
                                mtran_prp_code,
                                mtran_pol_polcy_no,
                                mtran_endr_no,
                                mtran_ltr_trans_no,
                                mtran_acct_code,
                                mtran_prod_sht_desc,
                                mtran_prod_code,
                                mtran_authorised,
                                mtran_date_authorized,
                                mtran_authorised_by,
                                mtran_posting_date,
                                mtran_net_amt,
                                mtran_origin,
                                mtran_btr_trans_code,
                                mtran_sd,
                                mtran_whtx,
                                mtran_extras,
                                mtran_commission,
                                mtran_trans_effective_date,
                                mtran_agen_code,
                                mtran_cla_type,
                                mtran_fms_receipt_pk,
                                mtran_rcpt_status,
                                mtran_comm_inclusive,
                                mtran_brn_code,
                                mtran_lms_receipt_pk)
                    SELECT v_mtran_code,
                           TRUNC (SYSDATE),
                           grct_receipt_no || '-CN',
                           NULL,
                           'RC',
                           'D',
                           NVL (agn_acc_no, agn_sht_desc),
                           act_type_id,
                           grct_agen_code,
                           -NVL (grct_amt, 0),
                           -NVL (grct_amt, 0),
                           grct_pol_code,
                           'Receipt',
                           pol_prp_code,
                           grct_pol_policy_no,
                           endr_no,
                           NULL,
                           NULL,
                           pol_prod_sht_desc,
                           pol_prod_code,
                           'Y',
                           TRUNC (SYSDATE),
                           v_user,
                           TRUNC (SYSDATE),
                           -NVL (grct_amt, 0),
                           'U',
                           endr_type,
                           NULL,
                           NULL,
                           NULL,
                           NULL,
                           TRUNC (SYSDATE),
                           grct_agen_code,
                           'G',
                           v_receipt_pk,
                           'A',
                           NVL (grct_comm_inclusive, 'N'),
                           pol_bra_code,
                           v_grct_code
                      FROM lms_grp_prem_receipts,
                           lms_policies,
                           lms_policy_endorsements,
                           lms_agencies,
                           tqc_account_types
                     WHERE     grct_pol_code = pol_code
                           AND pol_current_endr_code = endr_code
                           AND endr_agen_code = agn_code
                           AND agn_act_code = act_code
                           AND grct_code = cur_rct_rec.grct_code;
            EXCEPTION
                WHEN OTHERS
                THEN
                    raise_error (
                        'Error inserting Rcpt dtls in master trans...');
            END;

            IF NVL (cur_rct_rec.grct_pens_pymt_amt, 0) != 0
            THEN
                update_gl_da_contri (cur_rct_rec.grct_pol_code,
                                     v_grct_code,
                                     v_rct_branch,
                                     'D');
            END IF;

            v_count := -1;

            FOR pr IN cur_pol_cb_amt (cur_rct_rec.grct_code)
            LOOP
                v_ac_type := 'D';
                v_org_code := fms_interfaces_pkg.get_org (v_rct_branch);

                IF NVL (pr.premium_amt, 0) <> 0
                THEN
                    get_gl_code ('UP_GB',
                                 pr.pol_prod_code,
                                 v_trnt_code,
                                 v_trnt_gl_code,
                                 v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                 NULL,
                                 NULL,
                                 pr.agn_act_code,
                                 pr.pol_bra_code);
                    valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                               v_org_code,
                               pr.pol_bra_code,
                               'UP_GB');
                    valid_acc (v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                               v_org_code,
                               pr.pol_bra_code,
                               'UP_GB');
                    get_gl_code ('DR_RCTGB',
                                 pr.pol_prod_code,
                                 v_trnt_code,
                                 v_dr_trnt_gl_code,
                                 v_cr_trnt_contra_gl_code);
                    valid_acc (v_dr_trnt_gl_code,
                               v_org_code,
                               pr.pol_bra_code,
                               'DR_RCTGB');
                    valid_acc (v_cr_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                               v_org_code,
                               pr.pol_bra_code,
                               'DR_RCTGB CONTRA');
                    v_count := v_count + 2;
                    -- raise_error('Receipt amount='||pr.premium_amt);
                    interface_append_gl (
                        v_trans_code,
                        --v_trans_code           NUMBER,
                        v_user,                --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                        pr.pol_code,             --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                        pr.pol_prod_code,
                        --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                        v_receipt_pk,
                        --v_vchr_no             VARCHAR2,
                        NULL,                    --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                        NULL,                    --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                        v_rct_code,
                        --v_rcpt_no             VARCHAR2,
                        v_count,                 --v_count             NUMBER,
                        'RECEIPT CANCELLATION - ' || v_rct_code,
                        --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                        --                                      NVL (pr.premium_amt, 0)
                        --                                    - NVL (pr.prem_comm_paid, 0),
                        NVL (pr.grct_amt, 0),
                        --v_amount            NUMBER,
                        'C',                   --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                        NVL (v_trnt_contra_gl_code, v_dr_trnt_gl_code),
                        --v_acc_number1           VARCHAR2,
                        v_trnt_gl_code,
                        --v_acc_number2           VARCHAR2,
                        pr.pol_bra_code,
                        --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                        v_gl_trans,
                        NULL,
                        --  v_cad_code               NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                        NULL,
                        --v_otop_code              NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                        NULL,
                        --v_fpmt_code              NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                        NULL,
                        --v_ort_code               NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                        NULL,
                        --v_btr_no                 NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                        NULL,
                        --v_ppr_code               NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                        NULL,
                        -- v_ocl_code               NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                        NULL,
                        --v_agn_code               NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                        NULL,
                        --v_trans_no               NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                        cur_rct_rec.grct_code);
                --v_trn_rec   IN OUT TQ_FMS.Fms_Vouchers_Pkg.Tgl_rec_type
                END IF;

                IF     NVL (pr.prem_comm_paid, 0) <> 0
                   AND NVL (pr.grct_comm_inclusive, 'Y') = 'N'
                THEN
                    get_gl_code ('UC_GB',
                                 pr.pol_prod_code,
                                 v_trnt_code,
                                 v_trnt_gl_code,
                                 v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                 NULL,
                                 NULL,
                                 pr.agn_act_code,
                                 pr.pol_bra_code);

                    valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                               v_org_code,
                               pr.pol_bra_code,
                               'UC_GB');
                    get_gl_code ('UP_GB',
                                 pr.pol_prod_code,
                                 v_trnt_code,
                                 v_dr_trnt_gl_code,
                                 v_cr_trnt_contra_gl_code);
                    v_count := v_count + 2;
                    interface_append_gl (v_trans_code,
                                         --v_trans_code           NUMBER,
                                         v_user, --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                                         pr.pol_code, --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                                         pr.pol_prod_code,
                                         --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                                         v_receipt_pk,
                                         --v_vchr_no             VARCHAR2,
                                         NULL,   --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                                         NULL,   --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                                         v_rct_code,
                                         --v_rcpt_no             VARCHAR2,
                                         v_count, --v_count             NUMBER,
                                         'COMM WITHHELD - ' || v_rct_code,
                                         --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                                         pr.prem_comm_paid,
                                         --v_amount            NUMBER,
                                         'C',  --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                                         v_trnt_gl_code,
                                         --v_acc_number1           VARCHAR2,
                                         v_dr_trnt_gl_code,
                                         --v_acc_number2           VARCHAR2,
                                         pr.pol_bra_code,
                                         --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                                         v_gl_trans,
                                         NULL,
                                         --  v_cad_code               NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                         NULL,
                                         --v_otop_code              NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                         NULL,
                                         --v_fpmt_code              NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                         NULL,
                                         --v_ort_code               NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                         NULL,
                                         --v_btr_no                 NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                         NULL,
                                         --v_ppr_code               NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                         NULL,
                                         -- v_ocl_code               NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                         NULL,
                                         --v_agn_code               NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                         NULL,
                                         --v_trans_no               NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                         cur_rct_rec.grct_code);
                --v_trn_rec   IN OUT TQ_FMS.Fms_Vouchers_Pkg.Tgl_rec_type
                END IF;

                IF NVL (pr.prem_tax, 0) <> 0
                THEN
                    get_gl_code ('UPTAX',
                                 pr.pol_prod_code,
                                 v_trnt_code,
                                 v_trnt_gl_code,
                                 v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
                    valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                               v_org_code,
                               pr.pol_bra_code,
                               'UPTAX');
                    valid_acc (v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                               v_org_code,
                               pr.pol_bra_code,
                               'UPTAX');
                    v_count := v_count + 2;
                    interface_append_gl (v_trans_code,
                                         --v_trans_code           NUMBER,
                                         v_user, --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                                         pr.pol_code, --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                                         pr.pol_prod_code,
                                         --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                                         v_receipt_pk,
                                         --v_vchr_no             VARCHAR2,
                                         NULL,   --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                                         NULL,   --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                                         v_rct_code,
                                         --v_rcpt_no             VARCHAR2,
                                         v_count, --v_count             NUMBER,
                                         'PTAX - ' || v_rct_code,
                                         --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                                         pr.prem_tax, --v_amount            NUMBER,
                                         'D',  --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                                         v_trnt_gl_code,
                                         --v_acc_number1           VARCHAR2,
                                         v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                         --v_acc_number2           VARCHAR2,
                                         pr.pol_bra_code,
                                         --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                                         v_gl_trans,
                                         NULL,
                                         --  v_cad_code               NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                         NULL,
                                         --v_otop_code              NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                         NULL,
                                         --v_fpmt_code              NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                         NULL,
                                         --v_ort_code               NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                         NULL,
                                         --v_btr_no                 NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                         NULL,
                                         --v_ppr_code               NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                         NULL,
                                         -- v_ocl_code               NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                         NULL,
                                         --v_agn_code               NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                         NULL,
                                         --v_trans_no               NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                         cur_rct_rec.grct_code);
                --v_trn_rec   IN OUT TQ_FMS.Fms_Vouchers_Pkg.Tgl_rec_type
                END IF;
            END LOOP;

            UPDATE lms_grp_prem_receipts
               SET grct_status = 'C'
             WHERE grct_code = cur_rct_rec.grct_code;
        END LOOP;

        IF v_count > 0
        THEN
            interface_update_vgl (v_trans_code,     --v_trans_code     NUMBER,
                                  v_user,      --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                                  NULL,          --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                                  SYSDATE,         --v_date              DATE,
                                  NULL,          --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                                  NULL,          --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                                  'LMS GB RECEIPTS BATCH', --v_btc_description   VARCHAR2,
                                  'JV',     --v_btc_type             VARCHAR2,
                                  v_rct_branch,  --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                                  NVL (v_description, 'GLIFE RCT'),
                                  --v_description       VARCHAR2,
                                  v_rct_code,    --v_ref             VARCHAR2,
                                  v_gl_trans);
        --v_gl_trans  IN OUT  TQ_FMS.Fms_Vouchers_Pkg.Tgl_rec_type,
        END IF;
    --   EXCEPTION
    --      WHEN OTHERS
    --      THEN
    --         raise_error ('Posting G. Rect..');
    END cancel_grp_recpt_pymt;

    PROCEDURE update_gl_da_contri (
        v_pol_code     IN NUMBER,
        v_grct_code    IN NUMBER,
        v_rct_branch   IN NUMBER,
        v_drcr         IN VARCHAR2
    )
    IS
        CURSOR cur_pend IS
            SELECT pol_policy_no,
                   pol_prod_code,
                   pol_bra_code,
                   grct_receipt_no,
                   grct_receipt_date,
                   grct_pens_pymt_amt,
                   grct_pens_comm,
                   grct_pens_comm_paid,
                   grct_done_by
              FROM lms_grp_prem_receipts, lms_policies
             WHERE     pol_code = grct_pol_code
                   AND pol_code = v_pol_code
                   AND grct_code = v_grct_code;
    BEGIN
        FOR p IN cur_pend
        LOOP
            update_gl_da_contri (v_pol_code,
                                 p.pol_policy_no,
                                 p.pol_prod_code,
                                 p.pol_bra_code,
                                 p.grct_receipt_no,
                                 p.grct_receipt_date,
                                 v_rct_branch,
                                 p.grct_pens_pymt_amt,
                                 p.grct_pens_comm,
                                 p.grct_pens_comm_paid,
                                 v_drcr,
                                 p.grct_done_by);
        END LOOP;
    END update_gl_da_contri;

    PROCEDURE update_gl_da_contri (
        v_pol_code         IN NUMBER,
        v_policy_no        IN VARCHAR2,
        v_pol_prod_code    IN NUMBER,
        v_pol_bra_code     IN NUMBER,
        v_rcpt_no          IN VARCHAR2,
        v_rct_date         IN DATE,
        v_rct_branch       IN NUMBER,
        v_contri_amt       IN NUMBER,
        v_comm_amt_alloc   IN NUMBER,
        v_comm_amt_paid    IN NUMBER,
        v_drcr             IN VARCHAR2,
        v_done_by          IN VARCHAR2
    )
    IS
        v_count                 NUMBER;
        v_gl_trans              fms_vouchers_pkg.tgl_rec_type;
        v_vgl_no                NUMBER;
        v_trnt_code             VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_trnt_gl_code          VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_trnt_contra_gl_code   VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_org_code              NUMBER;
        v_contra_acc            VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_acc_type              VARCHAR2 (5) := 'D';
        v_user_code             NUMBER;
        exc_user_error          EXCEPTION;
        v_user_name             VARCHAR2 (30)
            := pkg_global_vars.get_pvarchar2 ('PKG_GLOBAL_VARS.PVG_USERNAME');
        --v_done_by;--used during cleanup in datacleaning
        --:= Pkg_Global_Vars.get_pvarchar2 ('PKG_GLOBAL_VARS.PVG_USERNAME');
        v_trans_code            NUMBER;
    BEGIN
        v_user_code := fms_interfaces_pkg.get_usercode (UPPER (v_user_name));

        IF v_user_code IS NULL
        THEN
            raise_error (
                'USER LOGGED IN NOT KNOWN. PLEASE LOGOUT AND LOGIN AGAIN..');
        END IF;

        --raise_error('User'||v_user_name);
        SELECT    TO_NUMBER (TO_CHAR (SYSDATE, 'RRRR'))
               || lms_transaction_seq.NEXTVAL
          INTO v_trans_code
          FROM DUAL;

        v_count := -1;
        v_contra_acc :=
            fms_interfaces_pkg.sl_brh_control_acc ('LMS',
                                                   v_acc_type,
                                                   v_pol_bra_code,
                                                   'GB-DA');
        v_org_code := fms_interfaces_pkg.get_org (v_pol_bra_code);

        IF NVL (v_contri_amt, 0) != 0
        THEN
            get_gl_code ('DA',
                         v_pol_prod_code,
                         v_trnt_code,
                         v_trnt_gl_code,
                         v_contra_acc);
            valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                       v_org_code,
                       v_pol_bra_code,
                       'DA');
            valid_acc (v_contra_acc,
                       v_org_code,
                       v_pol_bra_code,
                       'DA CONTRA');
            v_count := v_count + 2;
            interface_append_gl (v_trans_code,   --v_trans_code        NUMBER,
                                 v_done_by,
                                 --v_user_name,                 --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                                 v_pol_code,     --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                                 v_pol_prod_code, --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                                 NULL,        --v_vchr_no            VARCHAR2,
                                 NULL,           --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                                 NULL,           --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                                 v_rcpt_no,   --v_rcpt_no            VARCHAR2,
                                 v_count,        --v_count             NUMBER,
                                 'PENSION ALLOCATION - ' || v_policy_no,
                                 --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                                 NVL (v_contri_amt, 0),
                                 --v_amount            NUMBER,
                                 v_drcr,       --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                                 v_trnt_gl_code, --v_acc_number1        VARCHAR2,
                                 v_contra_acc, --v_acc_number2        VARCHAR2,
                                 v_pol_bra_code, --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                                 v_gl_trans);
        --v_trn_rec   IN OUT  Fms_Vouchers_Pkg.Tgl_rec_type,
        END IF;

        IF NVL (v_comm_amt_alloc, 0) != 0
        THEN
            get_gl_code ('DC',
                         v_pol_prod_code,
                         v_trnt_code,
                         v_trnt_gl_code,
                         v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
            valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                       v_org_code,
                       v_pol_bra_code,
                       'DC');
            valid_acc (v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                       v_org_code,
                       v_pol_bra_code,
                       'DC CONTRA');
            v_count := v_count + 2;
            interface_append_gl (v_trans_code,   --v_trans_code        NUMBER,
                                 v_done_by,
                                 --v_user_name,                 --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                                 v_pol_code,     --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                                 v_pol_prod_code, --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                                 NULL,        --v_vchr_no            VARCHAR2,
                                 NULL,           --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                                 NULL,           --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                                 v_rcpt_no,   --v_rcpt_no            VARCHAR2,
                                 v_count,        --v_count             NUMBER,
                                 'PENSION COMMISSION - ' || v_policy_no,
                                 --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                                 NVL (v_comm_amt_alloc, 0),
                                 --v_amount            NUMBER,
                                 v_drcr,       --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                                 v_trnt_gl_code, --v_acc_number1        VARCHAR2,
                                 v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                 --v_acc_number2        VARCHAR2,
                                 v_pol_bra_code, --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                                 v_gl_trans);
        --v_trn_rec   IN OUT  Fms_Vouchers_Pkg.Tgl_rec_type,
        END IF;

        IF NVL (v_comm_amt_paid, 0) != 0
        THEN
            get_gl_code ('DC_P',
                         v_pol_prod_code,
                         v_trnt_code,
                         v_trnt_gl_code,
                         v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
            valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                       v_org_code,
                       v_pol_bra_code,
                       'DC_P');
            valid_acc (v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                       v_org_code,
                       v_pol_bra_code,
                       'DC_P CONTRA');
            v_count := v_count + 2;
            interface_append_gl (v_trans_code,   --v_trans_code        NUMBER,
                                 v_done_by,
                                 --v_user_name,                 --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                                 v_pol_code,     --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                                 v_pol_prod_code, --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                                 NULL,        --v_vchr_no            VARCHAR2,
                                 NULL,           --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                                 NULL,           --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                                 v_rcpt_no,   --v_rcpt_no            VARCHAR2,
                                 v_count,        --v_count             NUMBER,
                                 'PENSION COMM WITHHELD- ' || v_policy_no,
                                 --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                                 NVL (v_comm_amt_paid, 0),
                                 --v_amount            NUMBER,
                                 v_drcr,       --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                                 v_trnt_gl_code, --v_acc_number1        VARCHAR2,
                                 v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                 --v_acc_number2        VARCHAR2,
                                 v_pol_bra_code, --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                                 v_gl_trans);
        --v_trn_rec   IN OUT  Fms_Vouchers_Pkg.Tgl_rec_type,
        END IF;

        IF v_count > 0
        THEN
            interface_update_vgl (v_trans_code,   --  v_trans_code     NUMBER,
                                  v_done_by,
                                  --v_user_name,              --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                                  v_pol_code,    --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                                  TRUNC (v_rct_date),  --v_date          DATE,
                                  NULL,          --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                                  NULL,          --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                                  'LMS DA RECEIPTS BATCH', --v_btc_description   VARCHAR2,
                                  'JV',         --v_btc_type         VARCHAR2,
                                  v_rct_branch,  --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                                  'DA ALLOCATION', --v_description       VARCHAR2,
                                  v_rcpt_no,       --v_ref           VARCHAR2,
                                  v_gl_trans);
        --v_gl_trans  IN OUT  Fms_Vouchers_Pkg.Tgl_rec_type,
        END IF;
    END update_gl_da_contri;

    PROCEDURE process_grp_pol_refund (
        v_pol_code    NUMBER,
        v_endr_code   NUMBER,
        v_amount      NUMBER,
        v_narrative   VARCHAR2,
        v_ref         VARCHAR2,
        v_umbrella    VARCHAR2 DEFAULT NULL
    )
    IS
        v_brh_code              NUMBER;
        v_trnt_code             VARCHAR2 (10);
        v_trans_code            NUMBER;
        v_trnt_gl_code          VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_trnt_contra_gl_code   VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_count                 NUMBER := 0;
        v_org_code              NUMBER;
        v_payee                 VARCHAR2 (100);
        v_chq_dtls_rec          fms_cheques_pkg.type_rqn_dtls_table;
        v_prod_code             NUMBER;
        v_pol_number            VARCHAR2 (30);
        v_pay_mthd              VARCHAR2 (10);
        v_pol_type              VARCHAR2 (30);
        v_product               VARCHAR2 (30);
        v_user                  VARCHAR2 (30)
            := fms_interfaces_pkg.get_usercode (
                   pkg_global_vars.get_pvarchar2 (
                       'PKG_GLOBAL_VARS.PVG_USERNAME'));
        v_endr_comm_amt         lms_policy_endorsements.endr_comm_amt%TYPE;
        v_comm_clawback         NUMBER;
        v_clwabck_param         VARCHAR2 (3);
        v_refund_amount         NUMBER;
        v_prepared_by           lms_policy_endorsements.endr_prepared_by%TYPE;
        v_bank_acc_no           lms_policy_endorsements.endr_bank_acc_no%TYPE;
        v_bbr_code              lms_policy_endorsements.endr_bbr_code%TYPE;
        v_act_code              NUMBER;
    BEGIN
        IF NVL (v_umbrella, 'N') = 'Y'
        THEN
            SELECT ipol_bra_code,
                   NVL (mendr_payee,
                        TRIM (mem_other_names || ' ' || mem_surname)),
                   ipol_policy_no,
                   pol_prod_code,
                   mendr_pay_method,
                   pol_prod_code,
