                   pol_type,
                   lms_interfaces_pkg.pol_product (pol_code)
                       product,
                   mendr_comm_amt,
                   mendr_prepared_by,
                   mendr_bank_acc_no,
                   mendr_bbr_code,
                   agn_act_code
              INTO v_brh_code,
                   v_payee,
                   v_pol_number,
                   v_prod_code,
                   v_pay_mthd,
                   v_prod_code,
                   v_pol_type,
                   v_product,
                   v_endr_comm_amt,
                   v_prepared_by,
                   v_bank_acc_no,
                   v_bbr_code,
                   v_act_code
              FROM lms_policies,
                   lms_individual_policies,
                   lms_members,
                   lms_policy_member_endorsements,
                   lms_agencies
             WHERE     ipol_code = mendr_ipol_code
                   AND ipol_pol_code = pol_code
                   AND mendr_code = v_endr_code
                   AND mem_code = ipol_mem_code
                   AND agn_code = mendr_agen_code
                   AND ipol_code = v_pol_code;
        ELSE
            SELECT pol_bra_code,
                   NVL (
                   endr_payee,
                   TRIM (
                          prp_first_name
                       || ' '
                       || TRIM (prp_other_names || ' ' || prp_surname))),
                   DECODE (pol_type, 'PR', pol_proposal_no, pol_policy_no),
                   pol_prod_code,
                    DECODE (endr_pay_method,
                       'Q', 'CHQ',
                       'E', 'EFT',
                       endr_pay_method),
                   pol_prod_code,
                   pol_type,
                   lms_interfaces_pkg.pol_product (pol_code)
                   product,
                   endr_comm_amt,
                   endr_prepared_by,
                   endr_bank_acc_no,
                   endr_bbr_code,
                   agn_act_code
              INTO v_brh_code,
                   v_payee,
                   v_pol_number,
                   v_prod_code,
                   v_pay_mthd,
                   v_prod_code,
                   v_pol_type,
                   v_product,
                   v_endr_comm_amt,
                   v_prepared_by,
                   v_bank_acc_no,
                   v_bbr_code,
                   v_act_code
          FROM lms_policies,
               lms_proposers,
               lms_policy_endorsements,
               lms_agencies
             WHERE     pol_code = endr_pol_code
               AND endr_code = v_endr_code
               AND prp_code = pol_prp_code
               AND agn_code = endr_agen_code
               AND pol_code = v_pol_code;
        END IF;


        v_org_code := fms_interfaces_pkg.get_org (v_brh_code);

        SELECT    TO_NUMBER (TO_CHAR (SYSDATE, 'RRRR'))
               || lms_transaction_seq.NEXTVAL
          INTO v_trans_code
          FROM DUAL;

        IF v_payee IS NULL
        THEN
            raise_error ('PAYEE IS NULL...');
        END IF;

        /***COMMENTED BY JIM. PARAMETER MISSING. CLAWBACK FUNCTIONALITY MUST BE REVIEWED
        BEGIN
           lms_ord_misc.system_param_val ('CLAWBACK_COMM_ON_REFUND_PREMIUM',
                                          v_clwabck_param
                                         );
        EXCEPTION
           WHEN OTHERS
           THEN
              raise_error ('CLAWBACK_COMM_ON_REFUND_PREMIUM PARAM ERROR');
        END;
        */
        v_clwabck_param := 'N';
        v_comm_clawback := v_amount * (NVL (v_endr_comm_amt, 0) / 100);

        IF NVL (v_clwabck_param, 'N') = 'Y'
        THEN
            v_refund_amount := v_amount - v_comm_clawback;

            BEGIN
                UPDATE lms_policy_endorsements
                   SET endr_ref_prem_comm_clwbk = v_comm_clawback
                 WHERE endr_code = v_endr_code;
            EXCEPTION
                WHEN OTHERS
                THEN
                    raise_error ('Error Updating Commission Clawback Amount');
            END;
        ELSE
            v_refund_amount := v_amount;
        END IF;

        IF NVL (v_refund_amount, 0) != 0
        THEN
            get_gl_code ('UP_GB',
                         v_prod_code,
                         v_trnt_code,
                         v_trnt_gl_code,
                         v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                         NULL,                                   -- v_tt_code,
                         NULL,                                   -- v_renewal,
                         v_act_code,
                         v_brh_code);
            valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                       v_org_code,
                       v_brh_code,
                       'UP_GB');
            v_count := v_count + 1;
            interface_append_chq (v_trans_code,  --v_trans_code        NUMBER,
                                  v_user,      --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                                  v_pol_code,   --v_pol_code           NUMBER,
                                  v_prod_code,  --v_prod_code          NUMBER,
                                  v_ref,      --v_vchr_no            VARCHAR2,
                                  v_count,      --v_count              NUMBER,
                                  v_refund_amount, --v_amount             NUMBER,
                                  v_narrative, --v_narrative          VARCHAR2,
                                  v_trnt_gl_code,
                                  --v_acc_number         VARCHAR2,
                                  v_org_code,  --v_acc_org_code        NUMBER,
                                  v_brh_code,   --v_branch_code        NUMBER,
                                  'D',        --v_drcr               VARCHAR2,
                                  v_chq_dtls_rec);
        --v_trn_rec   IN OUT   Fms_Cheques_Pkg.Type_rqn_dtls_table)
        END IF;

        IF v_count != 0
        THEN
            interface_create_reqn (v_trans_code, --v_trans_code         NUMBER,
                                   v_ref,  --v_ref                   VARCHAR2,
                                   v_pol_code, --v_ref2                  VARCHAR2,
                                   TRUNC (SYSDATE), --v_ref_date              DATE,
                                   v_narrative, --v_narrative             VARCHAR2,
                                   v_refund_amount, --v_amount                NUMBER,
                                   v_payee, --v_payee                 VARCHAR2,
                                   v_pay_mthd, --v_pay_method            VARCHAR2, --CHQ, EFT
                                   v_bank_acc_no, --v_payee_bank_acc_no        VARCHAR2,
                                   v_bbr_code, --v_payee_bank_branch_code   NUMBER,
                                   v_user, --v_source_auth_by        VARCHAR2,
                                   TRUNC (SYSDATE), --v_source_auth_dt        DATE,
                                   v_prepared_by, --v_raise_by                VARCHAR2,
                                   'POL_REF', --v_pmt_type              VARCHAR2,
                                   v_brh_code, --v_branch_code         NUMBER,
                                   v_pol_code,                   --v_pol_code,
                                   v_chq_dtls_rec);
        --v_dtls_table  IN OUT   Fms_Cheques_Pkg.Type_rqn_dtls_table)
        ELSIF v_count = 0
        THEN
            raise_application_error (
                -20001,
                'REFUND PAYMENT NOT PROCESSED TO FINANCE');
        END IF;
    --   EXCEPTION
    --      WHEN OTHERS
    --      THEN                                         --Error processing refund..
    --         raise_application_error (-20001,
    --                                  'POLICY REFUND' || SQLERRM (SQLCODE)
    --                                );
    END process_grp_pol_refund;

    PROCEDURE process_commission_pymt (
        v_cop_paid_vchr_tab   type_comm_vchr_table,
        v_vchr_brn_code       NUMBER,
        v_username            VARCHAR2,
        v_date_to             DATE DEFAULT NULL,
        v_in_pay_method       VARCHAR2 DEFAULT NULL
    )
    IS
        v_user                   VARCHAR2 (30)
            := pkg_global_vars.get_pvarchar2 ('pkg_global_vars.pvg_username');
        v_interest_param         VARCHAR2 (5);
        v_allow_comm_param       VARCHAR (1) := 'Y';
        v_narrative              VARCHAR2 (30);
        v_post_per_prod          VARCHAR2 (1);

        CURSOR c_comm (
            v_cop_paid_vchr_no    VARCHAR2,
            v_wht_posting_param   VARCHAR2 DEFAULT 'Y'
        )
        IS
              SELECT cop_paid_vchr_no,
                     cop_agn_code,
                     TRUNC (cop_date)
                         cop_date,
                     cop_trans_no,
                     SUM (
                           DECODE (cop_drcr, 'D', -1, 1)
                         * (  NVL (cop_comm_amt, 0)
                            + NVL (cop_ovride_comm_amt, 0)
                            + NVL (cop_bonus_amt, 0)
                            + NVL (cop_ov_bonus_amt, 0)
                            + NVL (cop_termination_benefits, 0)))
                         gross_amt,
                     SUM (
                           DECODE (cop_drcr, 'D', -1, 1)
                         * (NVL (cop_comm_amt, 0) + NVL (cop_ov_bonus_amt, 0)))
                         cop_comm_amt,
                     SUM (
                           DECODE (cop_drcr, 'D', -1, 1)
                         * (NVL (cop_ovride_comm_amt, 0)))
                         cop_ovride_comm_amt,
                     SUM (
                           DECODE (cop_drcr, 'D', -1, 1)
                         * (NVL (cop_bonus_amt, 0)))
                         cop_bonus_amt,
                     SUM (
                           DECODE (cop_drcr, 'D', -1, 1)
                         * NVL (cop_termination_benefits, 0))
                         cop_termination_benefits,
                     SUM (
                           DECODE (cop_drcr, 'D', -1, 1)
                         * (  NVL (cop_whdtax_amt, 0)
                            + NVL (cop_ovride_whdtax_amt, 0)
                            + NVL (cop_bonus_whdtax_amt, 0)))
                         whdtx,
                     SUM (
                           DECODE (cop_drcr, 'D', -1, 1)
                         * (DECODE (
                                lms_ord_misc.pay_adv_within_sys (cop_trans_no,
                                                                 cop_agn_code),
                                'Y', NVL (cop_advance_pymt, 0),
                                0)))
                         advance,
                     SUM (
                             DECODE (cop_drcr, 'D', -1, 1)
                           * (  NVL (cop_comm_amt, 0)
                              + NVL (cop_ovride_comm_amt, 0)
                              + NVL (cop_bonus_amt, 0)
                              + NVL (cop_termination_benefits, 0)
                              + NVL (cop_ov_bonus_amt, 0)
                              - NVL (cop_whdtax_amt, 0)
                              - NVL (cop_ovride_whdtax_amt, 0)
                              - NVL (cop_bonus_whdtax_amt, 0))
                         - (NVL (cop_advance_pymt, 0))
                         - NVL (cop_deductions, 0))
                         amount,
                     SUM (DECODE (cop_drcr, 'D', -1, 1) * cop_prem_ded)
                         agn_prem,
                     NVL (v_vchr_brn_code, NVL (agn_brn_code, cop_brn_code))
                         cop_brn_code,
                     NVL (
                         agn_bank_acc_name,
                         TRIM (
                                agn_other_names
                             || ' '
                             || TRIM (agn_md_name || ' ' || agn_name)))
                         agn_name,
                     MAX (cop_code)
                         cop_code,
                     cop_prepared_by,
                     NVL (cop_authorized_by, v_user)
                         cop_authorized_by,
                     TRUNC (NVL (cop_authorize_date, SYSDATE))
                         cop_authorize_date,
                     agn_sht_desc,
                     --                   lms_process_commissions.pay_com_to_agent
                     --                                                      (agn_code,
                     --                                                       v_date_to
                     --                                                      ) pay_com_to_agent,
                     DECODE(agn_status,'ACTIVE','Y','N')
                         pay_com_to_agent,
                     agn_bank_acc_no,
                     agn_bbr_code,
                     SUM (
                           DECODE (cop_drcr, 'D', -1, 1)
                         * NVL (cop_deductions, 0))
                         cop_deductions,
                     cop_prod_code,
                     cop_business,
                     cop_cur_code,
                     cop_cur_symbol,
                     cop_mpt_code,
                     agn_tel1,
                     cop_payment_mode,
                     MAX (NVL (cop_pay_agent_intermediary, 'N'))
                         cop_pay_agent_intermediary
                FROM lms_commission_pymts, lms_agencies
               WHERE     cop_paid_vchr_no = v_cop_paid_vchr_no
                     AND cop_agn_code = agn_code
            GROUP BY cop_paid_vchr_no,
                     cop_agn_code,
                     TRUNC (cop_date),
                     cop_trans_no,
                     agn_brn_code,
                     agn_name,
                     agn_md_name,
                     agn_other_names,
                     cop_prepared_by,
                     cop_authorized_by,
                     TRUNC (NVL (cop_authorize_date, SYSDATE)),
                     agn_sht_desc,
                     agn_bank_acc_no,
                     agn_bank_acc_name,
                     agn_bbr_code,
                     cop_prod_code,
                     cop_business,
                     cop_cur_code,
                     cop_cur_symbol,
                     cop_brn_code,
                     cop_mpt_code,
                     agn_tel1,
                     cop_payment_mode,
                     agn_status,
                     agn_sub_status;

        CURSOR payelmnts_ded (v_cop_paid_vchr_no VARCHAR2, v_agn_code NUMBER)
        IS
            SELECT cpe_acc_no,
                   cpe_contra_acc_no,
                   cpe_pay_element,
                   ocl_tot_comm_amt                        agd_amount,
                   ocl_pol_code,
                   cpe_type,
                   ocl_pay_trans_no,
                   ocl_source,
                   NVL (pol_policy_no, pol_proposal_no)    ocl_pol_policy_no,
                   ocl_lna_no,
                   ocl_acpe_code
              FROM lms_other_comm_clawbck,
                   lms_comm_pay_elements,
                   lms_policies,
                   lms_agencies
             WHERE     cpe_code = ocl_cpe_code
                   AND agn_code = ocl_agn_code
                   AND ocl_pol_code = pol_code(+)
                   AND ocl_pay_trans_no IN
                           (SELECT cop_trans_no
                              FROM lms_commission_pymts
                             WHERE cop_paid_vchr_no = v_cop_paid_vchr_no)
                   AND ocl_agn_code = v_agn_code
                   --AND agn_status='ACTIVE' AND NVL(agn_sub_status,'C') NOT IN ('PS','Z')
                   AND v_narrative <> 'OVERRIDER';

        CURSOR agent_debits (v_cop_paid_vchr_no VARCHAR2, v_agn_code NUMBER)
        IS
            SELECT ldt_account_no, ocl_tot_comm_amt, ldt_reason
              FROM lms_debit_trans,
                   lms_other_comm_clawbck,
                   lms_agent_other_debits
             WHERE     ocl_aodb_code = aodb_code
                   AND ldt_code = aodb_ldt_code
                   AND aodb_agn_code = ocl_agn_code
                   AND ocl_pay_trans_no IN
                           (SELECT cop_trans_no
                              FROM lms_commission_pymts
                             WHERE cop_paid_vchr_no = v_cop_paid_vchr_no)
                   AND ocl_agn_code = v_agn_code;

        CURSOR advance (v_cop_paid_vchr_no VARCHAR2, v_agn_code NUMBER)
        IS
              SELECT   SUM (car_amt_repaid)
                     - DECODE (NVL (v_interest_param, 'S'),
                               'M', NVL (car_intr_amnt, 0),
                               ROUND (NVL (cad_intr_amt, 0) / tot_insts_no, 2))
                         car_amt_repaid,
                     UPPER (lalt_description)
                         lalt_description,
                     lalt_gl_code,
                     lalt_contra_gl_code,
                     lalt_intr_gl_code,
                     lalt_intr_contra_gl_code,
                     DECODE (NVL (v_interest_param, 'S'),
                             'M', NVL (car_intr_amnt, 0),
                             ROUND (NVL (cad_intr_amt, 0) / tot_insts_no, 2))
                         intr_amt
                FROM lms_comm_adv_rpymt,
                     lms_comm_advances,
                     lms_commission_pymts,
                     lms_agent_loan_types,
                     lms_agencies,
                     (  SELECT COUNT (1) tot_insts_no, car_cad_code cadcode
                          FROM lms_comm_adv_rpymt
                      GROUP BY car_cad_code)
               WHERE     cad_agn_code = v_agn_code
                     AND cad_agn_code = agn_code
                     AND car_cop_code = cop_code
                     AND cop_paid_vchr_no = v_cop_paid_vchr_no
                     AND cad_lalt_code = lalt_code
                     AND car_cad_code = cad_code
                     AND cadcode = cad_code
                     AND NVL (lalt_paid_within_sys, 'Y') IN ('Y')
                     AND v_narrative <> 'OVERRIDER'
            GROUP BY lalt_description,
                     lalt_gl_code,
                     lalt_contra_gl_code,
                     lalt_intr_gl_code,
                     lalt_intr_contra_gl_code,
                     DECODE (NVL (v_interest_param, 'S'),
                             'M', NVL (car_intr_amnt, 0),
                             ROUND (NVL (cad_intr_amt, 0) / tot_insts_no, 2));

        CURSOR debit_negative_comm (v_trans_no VARCHAR2, v_agn_code NUMBER)
        IS
              SELECT SUM (agd_amount) agd_amount, agd_agn_code
                FROM lms_agent_deductions, lms_agencies
               WHERE     agd_source IN ('NEGATIVE COMMISSIONS')
                     AND agd_agn_code = v_agn_code
                     AND agd_pay_trans_no = v_trans_no
                     AND agn_code = agd_agn_code
                     AND v_narrative <> 'OVERRIDER'
            GROUP BY agd_agn_code;

        CURSOR intermediaries (v_bbr_code NUMBER)
        IS
            SELECT *
              FROM tqc_banks, tqc_bank_branches
             WHERE bnk_code = bbr_bnk_code AND bbr_code = v_bbr_code;

        v_org_code               NUMBER;
        v_crt_acc_no             VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_chq_dtls_rec           fms_cheques_pkg.type_rqn_dtls_table;
        v_prod_code              NUMBER;
        v_trnt_prod_applicable   VARCHAR2 (3);
        v_trnt_contra_gl_code    VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_count                  NUMBER := 0;
        v_gl_count               NUMBER := 0;
        v_cur_code               NUMBER;
        v_brh_code               NUMBER := v_vchr_brn_code;
        v_trnt_code              VARCHAR2 (10);
        v_gl_trans               tq_fms.fms_vouchers_pkg.tgl_rec_type;
        v_gl_acc                 VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_gl_acc2                VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_vgl_no                 NUMBER;
        v_contra_gl_code         VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_cnt                    NUMBER := 0;
        v_trans_code             NUMBER;
        v_eft_enabled            VARCHAR2 (5);
        v_pay_method             VARCHAR2 (5) := v_in_pay_method;
        v_trans_no               NUMBER;
        v_adv_cnt                NUMBER;
        v_currency_code          NUMBER;
        v_wht_posting_param      VARCHAR2 (5);
        v_account_no             VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_bool                   BOOLEAN := FALSE;
        v_ccnt                   NUMBER := 0;
        v_opr_code               NUMBER;
        v_oppr_code              NUMBER;
        v_amt                    NUMBER;
        v_control_param          VARCHAR2 (1);
        v_rnd                    NUMBER;
        v_batch_no               VARCHAR2 (50);
        v_tax_narrative          VARCHAR2 (30);
        v_trans_desc             VARCHAR2 (30);
    BEGIN
        v_gl_trans.delete;
        v_gl_count := -1;

        --RAISE_ERROR('v_prod_code:'||v_prod_code);
        SELECT    TO_NUMBER (TO_CHAR (SYSDATE, 'RRRR'))
               || lms_transaction_seq.NEXTVAL
          INTO v_trans_code
          FROM DUAL;

        BEGIN
            lms_ord_misc.system_param_val ('AGENT_LOAN_INTR_COMP_FOMULAR',
                                           v_interest_param);
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                tqc_error_manager.raise_error (
                    276205501,
                    text_in     => 'Parameter error.',
                    name1_in    => 'param name',
                    value1_in   => 'LOAN_INTR_COMP_FOMULAR');
        END;

        BEGIN
            lms_ord_misc.system_param_val ('POST_WHT_AT_ALLOCATIONS',
                                           v_wht_posting_param);
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                raise_error ('Parameter error.' || 'POST_WHT_AT_ALLOCATIONS');
        END;

        BEGIN
            lms_ord_misc.system_param_val ('ALLOW_ALL_COMM_POSTING',
                                           v_allow_comm_param);
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                tqc_error_manager.raise_error (
                    276203907,
                    text_in     => 'Parameter error.',
                    name1_in    => 'param name',
                    value1_in   => 'ALLOW_ALL_COMM_POSTING');
        END;

        BEGIN
            lms_ord_misc.system_param_val ('USE_CONTRAL_ACCOUNT_AT_CLAIMS',
                                           v_control_param);
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                raise_error (
                    'Parameter Error...USE_CONTRAL_ACCOUNT_AT_CLAIMS');
        END;

        BEGIN
            lms_ord_misc.system_param_val ('ALLOW_COMM_POSTING_PER_PRODUCT',
                                           v_post_per_prod);
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                raise_error (
                    'Parameter Error...ALLOW_COMM_POSTING_PER_PRODUCT');
        END;

        BEGIN
            v_rnd := tqc_parameters_pkg.get_param_number ('SYSMINDEC');
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                v_rnd := 0;
        END;



        FOR v_com_rec IN 1 .. v_cop_paid_vchr_tab.COUNT
        LOOP
            -- RAISE_ERROR('HAPA...=='||v_cop_paid_vchr_tab (v_com_rec).comm_option);
            -- raise_error('net comm=='||i.net_comm||';business=='||i.cop_business||';cop drcr=='||i.cop_drcr );
            v_cnt := v_com_rec;

            --         raise_error('v_cop_paid_vchr_tab (v_com_rec).comm_option'||v_cop_paid_vchr_tab (v_com_rec).comm_option);
            IF v_cop_paid_vchr_tab (v_com_rec).comm_option = 'CHQ'
            THEN
                v_chq_dtls_rec.delete;
                v_count := 0;

                --    RAISE_ERROR('v_cop_paid_vchr_tab (v_com_rec).comm_voucher'||v_cop_paid_vchr_tab (v_com_rec).comm_voucher||';v_wht_posting_param='||v_wht_posting_param);
                FOR i
                    IN c_comm (v_cop_paid_vchr_tab (v_com_rec).comm_voucher,
                               v_wht_posting_param)
                LOOP
                    --             raise_error('v_count='||v_count);
                    --                RAISE_ERROR('v_cop_paid_vchr_tab (v_com_rec).comm_voucher1111'||v_cop_paid_vchr_tab (v_com_rec).comm_voucher);
                    v_ccnt := v_ccnt + 1;
                    v_trans_no := i.cop_trans_no;
                    v_prod_code := i.cop_prod_code;
                    v_pay_method := i.cop_payment_mode;

                    IF v_trans_desc IS NULL
                    THEN
                        SELECT    ' -'
                               || ltr_cla_sht_desc
                               || ' ['
                               || ltr_comm_month
                               || '] '
                               || ltr_trans_no
                          INTO v_trans_desc
                          FROM lms_transactions
                         WHERE ltr_trans_no = v_trans_no;
                    END IF;

                    IF v_prod_code IS NULL
                    THEN
                        BEGIN
                            SELECT prod_code
                              INTO v_prod_code
                              FROM lms_products
                             WHERE prod_default = 'Y';
                        EXCEPTION
                            WHEN OTHERS
                            THEN
                                NULL;
                        END;
                    END IF;

                    IF v_cop_paid_vchr_tab (v_com_rec).post_overrider = 'Y'
                    THEN
                        v_narrative := 'OVERRIDER';
                        v_tax_narrative := 'WITHOLDING TAX- OVERRIDER';
                    ELSIF i.cop_bonus_amt = i.gross_amt
                    THEN
                        v_narrative := 'ALLOWANCE';
                        v_tax_narrative := 'WITHOLDING TAX RECOVERY';
                    ELSE
                        v_narrative := 'COMMISSION';
                        v_tax_narrative := 'WITHOLDING TAX RECOVERY';
                    END IF;

                    v_count := 0;


                    --                raise_error('net comm=='||i.amount||';business=='||i.cop_business||'; pay_com_to_agent=='||i.pay_com_to_agent ||';;prod code=='||i.cop_prod_code);

                    -- ADDED BY WAIYAKI ON DEC 15TH TO PREVENT -VE AMOUNTS FROM BEING POSTED TO FMS
                    ---VE AMOUNTS ARE INSERTED INTO TABLE BELOW

                    IF i.amount < 0 AND NVL (i.pay_com_to_agent, 'Y') != 'N'
                    THEN
                        IF i.amount < 0
                        THEN
                            INSERT INTO lms_negative_comm (
                                            nc_code,
                                            nc_cop_paid_vchr_no,
                                            nc_cop_code,
                                            nc_brn_code,
                                            nc_amount,
                                            nc_agn_code,
                                            nc_raised_by)
                                     VALUES (
                                            TO_NUMBER (
                                                TO_CHAR (SYSDATE, 'RRRR'))
                                         || lms_nc_code_seq.NEXTVAL,
                                         i.cop_paid_vchr_no,
                                         i.cop_code,
                                         i.cop_brn_code,
                                         ABS (i.amount),
                                         i.cop_agn_code,
                                         i.cop_authorized_by);
                        END IF;

                        IF NVL (i.gross_amt, 0) <> 0
                        THEN
                            IF NVL (i.cop_comm_amt, 0) <> 0
                            THEN
                                    get_gl_code ('UC',
                                                 v_prod_code,
                                                 v_trnt_code,
                                                 v_gl_acc,
                                                 v_gl_acc2);


                                    IF v_post_per_prod <> 'Y'
                                    THEN
                                        v_gl_acc := v_gl_acc2;
                                    END IF;

                                    valid_acc (v_gl_acc,
                                               v_org_code,
                                               i.cop_brn_code,
                                               'UC');

                                v_gl_count := v_gl_count + 1;

                                interface_append_gl (
                                    v_trans_code,
                                    --v_trans_code          NUMBER,
                                    v_username, --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                                    NULL,        --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                                    v_prod_code, --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                                    v_cop_paid_vchr_tab (v_com_rec).comm_voucher,
                                    --v_vchr_no          VARCHAR2,
                                    NULL,        --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                                    NULL,        --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                                    NULL,      --v_rcpt_no           VARCHAR2,
                                    v_gl_count,  --v_count             NUMBER,
                                    v_narrative || v_trans_desc,
                                    --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                                    ABS (i.cop_comm_amt),
                                    --v_amount            NUMBER,
                                    (CASE
                                         WHEN i.cop_comm_amt < 0 THEN 'C'
                                         ELSE 'D'
                                     END),     --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                                    v_gl_acc, --v_acc_number1          VARCHAR2,
                                    --v_acc_number2            VARCHAR2
                                    i.cop_brn_code,
                                    --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                                    v_gl_trans,
                                    --IN OUT   tq_fms.fms_vouchers_pkg.tgl_rec_type,
                                    NULL,   --v_cad_code  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                    NULL,  --v_otop_code  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                    NULL,  --v_fpmt_code  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                    NULL,   --v_ort_code  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                    NULL,     --v_btr_no  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                    NULL,   --v_ppr_code  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                    NULL,   --v_ocl_code  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                    i.cop_agn_code,
                                    --v_agn_code  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                    i.cop_trans_no --v_trans_no  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL
                                                  );
                            END IF;

                            IF NVL (i.cop_termination_benefits, 0) <> 0
                            THEN
                                get_gl_code ('UC',
                                                 v_prod_code,
                                                 v_trnt_code,
                                                 v_gl_acc,
                                                 v_gl_acc2);


                                    IF v_post_per_prod <> 'Y'
                                    THEN
                                        v_gl_acc := v_gl_acc2;
                                    END IF;

                                    valid_acc (v_gl_acc,
                                               v_org_code,
                                               i.cop_brn_code,
                                               'UC');

                                v_gl_count := v_gl_count + 1;

                                interface_append_gl (
                                    v_trans_code,
                                    --v_trans_code          NUMBER,
                                    v_username, --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                                    NULL,        --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                                    v_prod_code, --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                                    v_cop_paid_vchr_tab (v_com_rec).comm_voucher,
                                    --v_vchr_no          VARCHAR2,
                                    NULL,        --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                                    NULL,        --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                                    NULL,      --v_rcpt_no           VARCHAR2,
                                    v_gl_count,  --v_count             NUMBER,
                                    'TERMINATION BENEFIT' || v_trans_desc,
                                    --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                                    ABS (i.cop_termination_benefits),
                                    --v_amount            NUMBER,
                                    (CASE
                                         WHEN i.cop_termination_benefits < 0 THEN 'C'
                                         ELSE 'D'
                                     END),     --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                                    v_gl_acc, --v_acc_number1          VARCHAR2,
                                    --v_acc_number2            VARCHAR2
                                    i.cop_brn_code,
                                    --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                                    v_gl_trans,
                                    --IN OUT   tq_fms.fms_vouchers_pkg.tgl_rec_type,
                                    NULL,   --v_cad_code  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                    NULL,  --v_otop_code  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                    NULL,  --v_fpmt_code  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                    NULL,   --v_ort_code  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                    NULL,     --v_btr_no  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                    NULL,   --v_ppr_code  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                    NULL,   --v_ocl_code  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                    i.cop_agn_code,
                                    --v_agn_code  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                    i.cop_trans_no --v_trans_no  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL
                                                  );
                            END IF;

                            IF NVL (i.cop_ovride_comm_amt, 0) <> 0
                            THEN
                                IF v_post_per_prod <> 'Y'
                                THEN
                                    get_gl_code ('OVR_GC',
                                                 v_prod_code,
                                                 v_trnt_code,
                                                 v_gl_acc,
                                                 v_gl_acc2);

                                    valid_acc (v_gl_acc,
                                               v_org_code,
                                               i.cop_brn_code,
                                               'OVR_GC');
                                ELSE
                                    get_gl_code ('UC',
                                                 v_prod_code,
                                                 v_trnt_code,
                                                 v_gl_acc,
                                                 v_gl_acc2);

                                    NULL,   --v_ocl_code  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,

                                    --v_agn_code  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                    i.cop_trans_no --v_trans_no  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL
                                                  );
                            END IF;

                            IF NVL (i.cop_bonus_amt, 0) <> 0
                            THEN
                                IF v_post_per_prod <> 'Y'

                                    get_gl_code ('BONUS_GC',
                                                 v_prod_code,

                                               v_org_code,
                                               i.cop_brn_code,
                                               'UC');
                                END IF;

                                    --v_trans_code          NUMBER,

                                    v_cop_paid_vchr_tab (v_com_rec).comm_voucher,
                                    --v_vchr_no          VARCHAR2,
                                    NULL,        --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                                    NULL,        --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                                    NULL,      --v_rcpt_no           VARCHAR2,

                                         WHEN i.cop_bonus_amt < 0 THEN 'C'
                                         ELSE 'D'

                                    --v_acc_number2            VARCHAR2
                                    i.cop_brn_code,
                                    --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                                    v_gl_trans,
                                    --IN OUT   tq_fms.fms_vouchers_pkg.tgl_rec_type,
                                    NULL,   --v_cad_code  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                    NULL,  --v_otop_code  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                    NULL,  --v_fpmt_code  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                    NULL,   --v_ort_code  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                    NULL,     --v_btr_no  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                    NULL,   --v_ppr_code  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,

                                    i.cop_trans_no --v_trans_no  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL

                                                 v_prod_code,
                                                 v_trnt_code,
                                                 v_gl_acc,
                                                 v_gl_acc2);
                                    valid_acc (v_gl_acc,
                                               v_org_code,
                                               i.cop_brn_code,
                                               'UC');

                                    v_trans_code,
                                    --v_trans_code          NUMBER,

                                    --v_amount            NUMBER,

                                    --v_acc_number2            VARCHAR2

                                    --v_agn_code  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                    i.cop_trans_no --v_trans_no  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL
                                                  );

                            IF NVL (i.whdtx, 0) <> 0
                            THEN
                                get_gl_code ('WTHTX1',
                                             v_prod_code,
                                             v_trnt_code,
                                             v_gl_acc,
                                             v_gl_acc2);
                                valid_acc (v_gl_acc,
                                           v_org_code,

                                         WHEN i.whdtx < 0 THEN 'D'
                                         ELSE 'C'
                                     END),     --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                                    v_gl_acc, --v_acc_number1        VARCHAR2,
                                    --v_acc_number2            VARCHAR2
                                    i.cop_brn_code,

                                    NULL,  --v_otop_code  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                    NULL,  --v_fpmt_code  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                    NULL,   --v_ort_code  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                    NULL,     --v_btr_no  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                    NULL,   --v_ppr_code  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,

                                        NULL, --v_fpmt_code  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                        NULL, --v_ort_code  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                        NULL, --v_btr_no  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                        NULL, --v_ppr_code  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                        NULL, --v_ocl_code  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                        i.cop_agn_code,
                                        --v_agn_code  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                        i.cop_trans_no --v_trans_no  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL
                                                      );
                                END IF;

                                IF NVL (adv.intr_amt, 0) <> 0
                                THEN
                                    v_crt_acc_no := adv.lalt_intr_gl_code;

                                IF d.cpe_type = 'PREM'
                                THEN

                                    THEN
                                        BEGIN

                                            WHEN OTHERS
                                            THEN

                                                    'Error settling Agent Premiums');
                                        END;

                                        --raise_error('fbdfbdsb');
                                        BEGIN
                                            post_agn_premiums (

                                            --v_acc_number1        VARCHAR2,
                                            --v_acc_number2            VARCHAR2

                                            NULL, --v_otop_code  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                            NULL, --v_fpmt_code  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                            NULL, --v_ort_code  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                            NULL, --v_btr_no  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                            NULL, --v_ppr_code  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                            NULL, --v_ocl_code  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                            i.cop_agn_code,
                                            --v_agn_code  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                            i.cop_trans_no --v_trans_no  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL
                                                          );

                                        UPDATE lms_agents_comm_pay_elements
                                           SET acpe_balance =
                                               acpe_balance - d.agd_amount
                                        WHERE     acpe_code = d.ocl_acpe_code
                                              AND acpe_balance > 0;

                            FOR d
                                IN debit_negative_comm (i.cop_trans_no,
                                                        i.cop_agn_code)

                                get_gl_code ('UC',
                                             v_prod_code,
                                             v_trnt_code,
                                             v_crt_acc_no,
                                             v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
                                valid_acc (v_crt_acc_no,
                                           v_org_code,
                                           i.cop_brn_code,
                                           'UC');

                                interface_append_gl (
                                    v_trans_code, --v_trans_code         NUMBER,
                                    v_username, --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                                    NULL,        --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                                    v_prod_code, --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                                    v_cop_paid_vchr_tab (v_com_rec).comm_voucher,
                                    --v_vchr_no          VARCHAR2,
                                    NULL,        --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                                    NULL,        --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                                    NULL,      --v_rcpt_no           VARCHAR2,
                                    v_gl_count,  --v_count             NUMBER,
                                       'NEGATIVE COMMISSIONS CLAWBACK'
                                    || v_trans_desc,
                                    --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                                    d.agd_amount,
                                    --v_amount            NUMBER,
                                    'C',       --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                                    v_gl_acc, --v_acc_number1        VARCHAR2,
                                    --v_acc_number2            VARCHAR2
                                    i.cop_brn_code,
                                    --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                                    v_gl_trans,
                                    --IN OUT   tq_fms.fms_vouchers_pkg.tgl_rec_type,
                                    NULL,   --v_cad_code  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                    NULL,  --v_otop_code  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                    NULL,  --v_fpmt_code  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                    NULL,   --v_ort_code  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                    NULL,     --v_btr_no  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                    NULL,   --v_ppr_code  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                    NULL,   --v_ocl_code  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                    i.cop_agn_code,
                                    --v_agn_code  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                    i.cop_trans_no --v_trans_no  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL
                                                  );
                            END LOOP;
                        END IF;
                    ELSIF     i.amount = 0
                          AND NVL (i.pay_com_to_agent, 'Y') != 'N'
                    THEN
                        IF    NVL (i.cop_comm_amt, 0) <> 0
                           OR NVL (i.cop_ovride_comm_amt, 0) <> 0
                           OR NVL (i.cop_bonus_amt, 0) <> 0
                           OR NVL (i.cop_termination_benefits, 0) <> 0
                        THEN
                            IF NVL (i.cop_comm_amt, 0) <> 0
                            THEN
                                IF i.cop_business = 'G'
                                THEN                   --Group Life Commission
                                    get_gl_code (
                                        'UC_GB',
                                        NVL (i.cop_prod_code, v_prod_code),
                                        v_trnt_code,
                                        v_gl_acc,
                                        v_gl_acc2);
                                ELSE
                                    get_gl_code ('UC',
                                                 v_prod_code,
                                                 v_trnt_code,
                                                 v_gl_acc,
                                                 v_gl_acc2);

                                    IF v_post_per_prod <> 'Y'
                                    THEN
                                        v_gl_acc := v_gl_acc2;
                                    END IF;

                                    valid_acc (v_gl_acc,
                                               v_org_code,
                                               i.cop_brn_code,
                                               'UC CONTRA');
                                END IF;


                                v_gl_count := v_gl_count + 1;
                                interface_append_gl (
                                    v_trans_code,
                                    --v_trans_code          NUMBER,
                                    v_username, --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                                    NULL,        --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                                    v_prod_code, --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                                    v_cop_paid_vchr_tab (v_com_rec).comm_voucher,
                                    --v_vchr_no          VARCHAR2,
                                    NULL,        --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                                    NULL,        --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                                    NULL,      --v_rcpt_no           VARCHAR2,
                                    v_gl_count,  --v_count             NUMBER,
                                    v_narrative || v_trans_desc,
                                    --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                                    ABS (i.cop_comm_amt),
                                    --v_amount            NUMBER,
                                    (CASE
                                         WHEN i.cop_comm_amt < 0 THEN 'C'
                                         ELSE 'D'
                                     END),     --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                                    v_gl_acc, --v_acc_number1          VARCHAR2,
                                    --v_acc_number2            VARCHAR2
                                    i.cop_brn_code,
                                    --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                                    v_gl_trans,
                                    --IN OUT   tq_fms.fms_vouchers_pkg.tgl_rec_type,
                                    NULL,   --v_cad_code  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                    NULL,  --v_otop_code  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                    NULL,  --v_fpmt_code  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                    NULL,   --v_ort_code  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                    NULL,     --v_btr_no  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                    NULL,   --v_ppr_code  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                    NULL,   --v_ocl_code  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                    i.cop_agn_code,
                                    --v_agn_code  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                    i.cop_trans_no --v_trans_no  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL
                                                  );
                            END IF;

                            IF NVL (i.cop_termination_benefits, 0) <> 0
                            THEN
                                IF i.cop_business = 'G'
                                THEN                   --Group Life Commission
                                    get_gl_code (
                                        'UC_GB',
                                        NVL (i.cop_prod_code, v_prod_code),
                                        v_trnt_code,
                                        v_gl_acc,
                                        v_gl_acc2);
                                ELSE
                                    get_gl_code ('UC',
                                                 v_prod_code,
                                                 v_trnt_code,
                                                 v_gl_acc,
                                                 v_gl_acc2);

                                    IF v_post_per_prod <> 'Y'
                                    THEN
                                        v_gl_acc := v_gl_acc2;
                                    END IF;

                                    valid_acc (v_gl_acc,
                                               v_org_code,
                                               i.cop_brn_code,
                                               'UC CONTRA');

                IF v_cnt = 0
                THEN
                    raise_error (
                           'NO TRANSACTIONS POSTED TO FINANCE '
                        || v_cop_paid_vchr_tab (v_com_rec).comm_voucher);
                END IF;
            END IF;
        END LOOP;

        -- raise_error('done......'||v_gl_count);
        BEGIN
            IF v_gl_count > 0
            THEN
                interface_update_vgl (
                    v_trans_code,                   --v_trans_code     NUMBER,
                    v_username,                --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                    NULL,                        --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                    SYSDATE,                          --v_date           DATE,
                    NULL,                        --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                    NULL,                        --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                    'LMS COMM/PTAX RECOVERIES', --v_btc_description   VARCHAR2,
                    'JV',                       --v_btc_type         VARCHAR2,
                    v_vchr_brn_code,             --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                       'COMM PMT'
                    || v_cop_paid_vchr_tab (1).comm_voucher
                    || ' - '
                    || v_cop_paid_vchr_tab (v_cop_paid_vchr_tab.COUNT).comm_voucher
                    || v_trans_desc,
                    NULL,                      --v_rcpt_no           VARCHAR2,
                    v_gl_trans,
                    --v_gl_trans  IN OUT  Fms_Vouchers_Pkg.Tgl_rec_type,
                    NULL,              --v_cad_code       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                    NULL,             --v_otop_code       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL)
                    NULL,                   --v_fpmt_code NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                    NULL,                   --v_ort_code  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                    NULL,                   --v_btr_no    NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                    NULL,                   --v_ppr_code  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                    NULL,                    --v_ocl_code NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                    NULL,                    --v_agn_code NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                    v_trans_no,              --v_trans_no NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                    v_currency_code);
            END IF;
        /*EXCEPTION
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                raise_error (
                       'CREATING/POSTING COMMISSION VOUCHER  '
                    || v_cop_paid_vchr_tab (v_cnt).comm_voucher
                    || ';  v_vchr_brn_code='
                    || v_vchr_brn_code
                    || '; cop_agn_code='
                    || v_cop_paid_vchr_tab (v_cnt).comm_agn_code);*/
        END;
    --   EXCEPTION
    --      WHEN OTHERS
    --      THEN
    --         raise_error ('PROCESSING COMMISSION ' || SQLERRM);
    END process_commission_pymt;

    PROCEDURE process_inactive_comm_pymt (
        v_cop_paid_vchr_no   VARCHAR2,
        v_vchr_brn_code      NUMBER,
        v_username           VARCHAR2,
        v_date_to            DATE DEFAULT NULL,
        v_post_overrider     VARCHAR2
    )
    IS
        CURSOR c_comm IS
              SELECT cop_paid_vchr_no,
                     cop_agn_code,
                     TRUNC (cop_date)
                         cop_date,
                     cop_trans_no,
                     SUM (
                           DECODE (cop_drcr, 'D', -1, 1)
                         * (NVL (cop_bonus_amt, 0)))
                         cop_bonus_amt,
                     SUM (
                           DECODE (cop_drcr, 'D', -1, 1)
                         * (  NVL (cop_comm_amt, 0)
                            + NVL (cop_ovride_comm_amt, 0)
                            + NVL (cop_bonus_amt, 0)
                            + NVL (cop_ov_bonus_amt, 0)))
                         gross_amt,
                     SUM (
                             DECODE (cop_drcr, 'D', -1, 1)
                           * (  NVL (cop_comm_amt, 0)
                              + NVL (cop_ovride_comm_amt, 0)
                              + NVL (cop_bonus_amt, 0)
                              + NVL (cop_ov_bonus_amt, 0)
                              - NVL (cop_whdtax_amt, 0)
                              - NVL (cop_ovride_whdtax_amt, 0)
                              - NVL (cop_bonus_whdtax_amt, 0)
                              - NVL (cop_capin_amt, 0)
                              - NVL (cop_ovride_capin_amt, 0))
                         - (NVL (cop_advance_pymt, 0))
                         - NVL (cop_deductions, 0))
                         amount,
                     NVL (v_vchr_brn_code, NVL (agn_brn_code, cop_brn_code))
                         cop_brn_code,
                     NVL (
                         agn_bank_acc_name,
                         TRIM (
                                agn_other_names
                             || ' '
                             || TRIM (agn_md_name || ' ' || agn_name)))
                         agn_name,
                     cop_prepared_by,
                     TRUNC (NVL (cop_authorize_date, SYSDATE))
                         cop_authorize_date,
                     agn_sht_desc,
                     agn_bank_acc_no,
                     agn_bbr_code,
                     cop_prod_code,
                     cop_business,
                     cop_cur_code,
                     cop_cur_symbol,
                     cop_mpt_code,
                     agn_tel1,
                     cop_payment_mode,
                     MAX (NVL (cop_pay_agent_intermediary, 'N'))
                         cop_pay_agent_intermediary
                FROM lms_commission_pymts, lms_agencies
               WHERE     cop_paid_vchr_no = v_cop_paid_vchr_no
                     AND cop_agn_code = agn_code
                     AND agn_status = 'ACTIVE'
                     AND NVL (agn_comm_payable, 'Y') = 'Y'
            GROUP BY cop_paid_vchr_no,
                     cop_agn_code,
                     TRUNC (cop_date),
                     cop_trans_no,
                     agn_brn_code,
                     agn_name,
                     agn_md_name,
                     agn_other_names,
                     cop_prepared_by,
                     TRUNC (NVL (cop_authorize_date, SYSDATE)),
                     agn_sht_desc,
                     agn_bank_acc_no,
                     agn_bank_acc_name,
                     agn_bbr_code,
                     cop_prod_code,
                     cop_business,
                     cop_cur_code,
                     cop_cur_symbol,
                     cop_brn_code,
                     cop_mpt_code,
                     agn_tel1,
                     cop_payment_mode;

        CURSOR intermediaries (v_bbr_code NUMBER)
        IS
            SELECT *
              FROM tqc_banks, tqc_bank_branches
             WHERE bnk_code = bbr_bnk_code AND bbr_code = v_bbr_code;

        v_narrative             VARCHAR2 (30);
        v_org_code              NUMBER;
        v_crt_acc_no            VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_chq_dtls_rec          fms_cheques_pkg.type_rqn_dtls_table;
        v_prod_code             NUMBER;
        v_trnt_contra_gl_code   VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_count                 NUMBER := 0;
        v_gl_count              NUMBER := 0;
        v_cur_code              NUMBER;
        v_brh_code              NUMBER := v_vchr_brn_code;
        v_trnt_code             VARCHAR2 (10);
        v_gl_trans              tq_fms.fms_vouchers_pkg.tgl_rec_type;
        v_gl_acc                VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_gl_acc2               VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_vgl_no                NUMBER;
        v_contra_gl_code        VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_cnt                   NUMBER := 0;
        v_trans_code            NUMBER;
        v_eft_enabled           VARCHAR2 (5);
        v_pay_method            VARCHAR2 (5);
        v_trans_no              NUMBER;
        v_currency_code         NUMBER;
        v_account_no            VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_ccnt                  NUMBER := 0;
        v_control_param         VARCHAR2 (1);
        v_rnd                   NUMBER;
        v_batch_no              VARCHAR2 (50);
        v_trans_desc            VARCHAR2 (30);
    BEGIN
        SELECT    TO_NUMBER (TO_CHAR (SYSDATE, 'RRRR'))
               || lms_transaction_seq.NEXTVAL
          INTO v_trans_code
          FROM DUAL;

        BEGIN
            lms_ord_misc.system_param_val ('USE_CONTRAL_ACCOUNT_AT_CLAIMS',
                                           v_control_param);
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                raise_error (
                    'Parameter Error...USE_CONTRAL_ACCOUNT_AT_CLAIMS');
        END;

        v_chq_dtls_rec.delete;
        v_count := 0;

        FOR i IN c_comm
        LOOP
            v_ccnt := v_ccnt + 1;
            v_trans_no := i.cop_trans_no;
            v_prod_code := i.cop_prod_code;
            v_pay_method := i.cop_payment_mode;

            IF v_trans_desc IS NULL
            THEN
                SELECT    ' -'
                       || ltr_cla_sht_desc
                       || ' ['
                       || ltr_comm_month
                       || '] '
                       || ltr_trans_no
                  INTO v_trans_desc
                  FROM lms_transactions
                 WHERE ltr_trans_no = v_trans_no;
            END IF;

            IF v_pay_method IN ('EFT', 'E-PAY')
            THEN
                IF i.agn_bbr_code IS NULL
                THEN
                    raise_error (
                           ' Agent '
                        || i.agn_name
                        || ' with ID '
                        || i.agn_sht_desc
                        || ' does not have bank branch');
                END IF;

                IF i.agn_bank_acc_no IS NULL
                THEN
                    raise_error (
                           ' Agent '
                        || i.agn_name
                        || ' with ID '
                        || i.agn_sht_desc
                        || ' does not have bank account number');
                END IF;
            ELSIF v_pay_method IN ('MFT')
            THEN
                IF i.agn_tel1 IS NULL
                THEN
                    raise_error (
                           ' Agent '
                        || i.agn_name
                        || ' with ID '
                        || i.agn_sht_desc
                        || ' does not have a mobile phone number');
                END IF;
            END IF;

            IF v_prod_code IS NULL
            THEN
                BEGIN
                    SELECT prod_code
                      INTO v_prod_code
                      FROM lms_products
                     WHERE prod_default = 'Y';
                EXCEPTION
                    WHEN OTHERS
                    THEN
                        NULL;
                END;
            END IF;

            IF v_post_overrider = 'Y'
            THEN
                v_narrative := 'OVERRIDER REINSTATEMENT';
            ELSIF i.cop_bonus_amt = i.gross_amt
            THEN
                v_narrative := 'ALLOWANCE REINSTATEMENT';
            ELSE
                v_narrative := 'COMMISSION REINSTATEMENT';
            END IF;

            v_count := 0;

            get_gl_code ('MNGTRSV',
                         v_prod_code,
                         v_trnt_code,
                         v_crt_acc_no,
                         v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
            valid_acc (v_crt_acc_no,
                       v_org_code,
                       i.cop_brn_code,
                       'MNGTRSV');


            IF NVL (v_control_param, 'N') = 'Y'
            THEN
                v_gl_count := v_gl_count + 1;
                interface_append_gl (v_trans_code,
                                     --v_trans_code          NUMBER,
                                     v_username, --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                                     NULL,       --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                                     v_prod_code, --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                                     v_cop_paid_vchr_no,
                                     --v_vchr_no          VARCHAR2,
                                     NULL,       --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                                     NULL,       --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                                     NULL,     --v_rcpt_no           VARCHAR2,
                                     v_gl_count, --v_count             NUMBER,
                                     v_narrative || v_trans_desc,
                                     --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                                     i.amount,
                                     --v_amount            NUMBER,
                                     'D',      --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                                     v_crt_acc_no, --v_acc_number1          VARCHAR2,
                                     --v_acc_number2            VARCHAR2
                                     i.cop_brn_code,
                                     --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                                     v_gl_trans,
                                     --IN OUT   tq_fms.fms_vouchers_pkg.tgl_rec_type,
                                     NULL,  --v_cad_code  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                     NULL, --v_otop_code  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                     NULL, --v_fpmt_code  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                     NULL,  --v_ort_code  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                     NULL,    --v_btr_no  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                     NULL,  --v_ppr_code  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                     NULL,  --v_ocl_code  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                     i.cop_agn_code,
                                     --v_agn_code  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                     i.cop_trans_no --v_trans_no  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL
                                                   );

                get_gl_code ('UC',
                             v_prod_code,
                             v_trnt_code,
                             v_crt_acc_no,
                             v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
                valid_acc (v_crt_acc_no,
                           v_org_code,
                           i.cop_brn_code,
                           'UC');

                v_gl_count := v_gl_count + 1;
                interface_append_gl (
                    v_trans_code,
                    --v_trans_code          NUMBER,
                    v_username,                --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                    NULL,                        --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                    v_prod_code,                 --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                    v_cop_paid_vchr_no,
                    --v_vchr_no          VARCHAR2,
                    NULL,                        --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                    NULL,                        --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                    NULL,                      --v_rcpt_no           VARCHAR2,
                    v_gl_count,                  --v_count             NUMBER,
                    'NET COMMISSION PAYABLE REINSTATEMENT' || v_trans_desc,
                    --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                    i.amount,
                    --v_amount            NUMBER,
                    'C',                       --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                    v_crt_acc_no,           --v_acc_number1          VARCHAR2,
                    --v_acc_number2            VARCHAR2
                    i.cop_brn_code,
                    --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                    v_gl_trans,
                    --IN OUT   tq_fms.fms_vouchers_pkg.tgl_rec_type,
                    NULL,                   --v_cad_code  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                    NULL,                  --v_otop_code  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                    NULL,                  --v_fpmt_code  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                    NULL,                   --v_ort_code  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                    NULL,                     --v_btr_no  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                    NULL,                   --v_ppr_code  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                    NULL,                   --v_ocl_code  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                    i.cop_agn_code,
                    --v_agn_code  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                    i.cop_trans_no           --v_trans_no  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL
                                  );
            END IF;

            v_count := v_count + 1;

            interface_append_chq (
                v_trans_code,                    --v_trans_code        NUMBER,
                v_username,                    --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                NULL,                           --v_pol_code           NUMBER,
                v_prod_code,                    --v_prod_code          NUMBER,
                v_cop_paid_vchr_no,
                --v_vchr_no           VARCHAR2,
                v_count,                        --v_count              NUMBER,
                i.amount,
                --v_amount             NUMBER,
                'NET COMMISSION PAYMENT REINSTATEMENT' || v_trans_desc,
                --v_narrative          VARCHAR2,
                v_crt_acc_no,
                --v_acc_number         VARCHAR2,
                v_org_code,                   --v_acc_org_code         NUMBER,
                i.cop_brn_code,
                --v_branch_code        NUMBER,
                'D',                          --v_drcr               VARCHAR2,
                v_chq_dtls_rec,
                -- IN OUT   fms_cheques_pkg.type_rqn_dtls_table
                NULL,                      --v_fpmt_code  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                NULL,                       --v_ocl_code  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                i.cop_agn_code,
                --v_agn_code NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                i.cop_trans_no                --v_trans_no NUMBER DEFAULT NULL
                              );

            --************************************************************************************************************************************************
            --                    RAISE_ERROR('v_pay_method'||v_pay_method);
            IF v_pay_method IN ('EFT', 'E-PAY')
            THEN
                --                         RAISE_ERROR('v_pay_method'||v_pay_method);
                v_eft_enabled := 'N';

                IF     i.agn_bank_acc_no IS NOT NULL
                   AND i.agn_bbr_code IS NOT NULL
                THEN
                    v_account_no := i.agn_bank_acc_no;

                    BEGIN
                        v_eft_enabled := account_enabled (i.agn_bbr_code);
                    END;
                END IF;
            ELSIF v_pay_method = 'MFT'
            THEN
                v_account_no := i.agn_tel1;
            END IF;

            IF v_pay_method IN ('EFT', 'MFT', 'E-PAY')
            THEN
                IF v_pay_method IN ('EFT', 'E-PAY')
                THEN
                    IF v_eft_enabled = 'N'
                    THEN
                        raise_error (
                               'BANK BRANCH NOT ENABLED TO TRANSACT EFT PAYMENTS  for AGN_CODE='
                            || i.cop_agn_code
                            || ';bbr_code='
                            || i.agn_bbr_code);
                        --                              raise_error('||i.agn_bbr_code=='||i.agn_bbr_code||'i.cop_agn_code'||i.cop_agn_code);
                        raise_application_error (
                            -20001,
                               'BANK BRANCH NOT ENABLED TO TRANSACT EFT PAYMENTS  for AGN_CODE='
                            || i.cop_agn_code
                            || ';bbr_code='
                            || i.agn_bbr_code);
                    END IF;
                END IF;

                --                        raise_error('EFT Amount '||i.amount);
                BEGIN
                    interface_create_reqn (
                        v_trans_code,
                        --v_trans_code        NUMBER,
                        i.cop_paid_vchr_no,
                        --v_ref                   VARCHAR2,
                        i.cop_agn_code,
                        --v_ref2                  VARCHAR2,
                        i.cop_date,
                           --v_ref_date              DATE,
                           v_narrative
                        || ' PAYMENT ( '
                        || i.agn_name
                        || v_pay_method
                        || ')'
                        || v_trans_desc,
                        --v_narrative             VARCHAR2,
                        i.amount,
                        --v_amount                NUMBER,
                        i.agn_name,
                        --v_payee                 VARCHAR2,
                        v_pay_method,
                        --'CHQ', --v_pay_method            VARCHAR2, --CHQ, EFT
                        v_account_no,
                        --v_payee_bank_acc_no        VARCHAR2,
                        i.agn_bbr_code,
                        --v_payee_bank_branch_code   NUMBER,
                        v_username,
                        --v_source_auth_by        VARCHAR2,
                        NVL (v_date_to, i.cop_authorize_date),
                        --v_source_auth_dt        DATE,
                        i.cop_prepared_by,
                        --v_raise_by                VARCHAR2,
                        'COMM',
                        --v_pmt_type              VARCHAR2,
                        v_vchr_brn_code,
                        --v_branch_code          NUMBER,
                        NULL,                                    --v_pol_code,
                        v_chq_dtls_rec,
                        -- IN OUT   fms_cheques_pkg.type_rqn_dtls_table,
                        NULL,
                        i.cop_agn_code,
                        --v_agn_code NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                        i.cop_trans_no,
                        --v_trans_no NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                        NULL,
                        i.cop_cur_code,
                        i.cop_mpt_code);
                EXCEPTION
                    WHEN OTHERS
                    THEN
                        raise_error (
                               ' voucher no. '
                            || i.cop_paid_vchr_no
                            || ';cop_agn_code='
                            || i.cop_agn_code
                            || '; agn_sht_desc='
                            || i.agn_sht_desc);
                END;
            ELSE
                IF v_count != 0 AND i.amount > 0
                THEN
                    v_batch_no := NULL;

                    IF     i.cop_pay_agent_intermediary = 'Y'
                       AND i.agn_bbr_code IS NOT NULL
                       AND i.agn_bank_acc_no IS NOT NULL
                    THEN
                        FOR t IN intermediaries (i.agn_bbr_code)
                        LOOP
                            v_batch_no :=
                                TO_NUMBER (t.bnk_code || i.cop_trans_no);
                        END LOOP;
                    END IF;

                    BEGIN
                        interface_create_reqn (
                            v_trans_code,        --v_trans_code        NUMBER,
                            i.cop_paid_vchr_no,
                            --v_ref                   VARCHAR2,
                            i.cop_agn_code,
                            --v_ref2                  VARCHAR2,
                            i.cop_date,        --v_ref_date              DATE,
                            v_narrative || ' PAYMENT ( ' || i.agn_name || ')',
                            --v_narrative             VARCHAR2,
                            i.amount,        --v_amount                NUMBER,
                            i.agn_name,
                            --v_payee                 VARCHAR2,
                            v_pay_method,
                            --'CHQ', --v_pay_method            VARCHAR2, --CHQ, EFT
                            i.agn_bank_acc_no,
                            --v_payee_bank_acc_no        VARCHAR2,
                            i.agn_bbr_code,
                            --v_payee_bank_branch_code   NUMBER,
                            v_username,
                            --v_source_auth_by        VARCHAR2,
                            NVL (v_date_to, i.cop_authorize_date),
                            --v_source_auth_dt        DATE,
                            i.cop_prepared_by,
                            --v_raise_by                VARCHAR2,
                            'COMM',        --v_pmt_type              VARCHAR2,
                            v_vchr_brn_code,  --v_branch_code          NUMBER,
                            NULL,                                --v_pol_code,
                            v_chq_dtls_rec,
                            -- IN OUT   fms_cheques_pkg.type_rqn_dtls_table,
                            NULL,
                            i.cop_agn_code,
                            --v_agn_code NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                            i.cop_trans_no,
                            --v_trans_no NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                            NULL,
                            i.cop_cur_code,
                            i.cop_mpt_code,
                            NULL,
                            v_batch_no);
                    EXCEPTION
                        WHEN OTHERS
                        THEN
                            raise_error (
                                   ' voucher no. '
                                || i.cop_paid_vchr_no
                                || ';'
                                || i.cop_agn_code);
                    END;
                END IF;
            END IF;
        END LOOP;
    END process_inactive_comm_pymt;

    PROCEDURE process_deffered_comm_pymt (

        v_vchr_brn_code       NUMBER,
        v_username            VARCHAR2
    )
    IS
    BEGIN
        NULL;
    END process_deffered_comm_pymt;

    PROCEDURE post_gross_comm_gl (
        v_trans_no    NUMBER,
        v_brn_code    NUMBER,
        v_auth_date   DATE,
        v_user        VARCHAR2
    )
    IS
        CURSOR comm IS
            SELECT SUM (
                         DECODE (NVL (cop_drcr, 'C'), 'C', 1, -1)
                       * (NVL (cop_amt_to_post, 0)))    comm_amt
              --SUM(DECODE(NVL(cop_drcr,'C'),'C',1,-1) * (NVL(cop_comm_amt,0) + NVL(cop_ovride_comm_amt,0))) comm_amt
              FROM lms_commission_pymts, lms_agencies
             WHERE     agn_brn_code = v_brn_code
                   AND agn_code = cop_agn_code
                   AND cop_trans_no = v_trans_no
                   AND cop_authorized_by = v_user
                   AND cop_authorized = 'Y'
                   AND TRUNC (cop_authorize_date) = TRUNC (v_auth_date);

        v_org_code              NUMBER;
        v_trnt_code             VARCHAR2 (20);
