        v_trnt_gl_code          VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_trnt_contra_gl_code   VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_gl_count              NUMBER := -1;
        v_vgl_no                NUMBER;
        v_trans_code            NUMBER;
        v_gl_trans              fms_vouchers_pkg.tgl_rec_type;
    BEGIN
        v_gl_trans.delete;
        v_org_code := fms_interfaces_pkg.get_org (v_brn_code);

        SELECT    TO_NUMBER (TO_CHAR (SYSDATE, 'RRRR'))
               || lms_transaction_seq.NEXTVAL
          INTO v_trans_code
          FROM DUAL;

        FOR c IN comm
        LOOP
            IF NVL (c.comm_amt, 0) > 0
            THEN
                get_gl_code ('UC',
                             NULL,
                             v_trnt_code,
                             v_trnt_gl_code,
                             v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
                valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                           v_org_code,
                           v_brn_code,
                           'UC');
                valid_acc (v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                           v_org_code,
                           v_brn_code,
                           'UC contra');
                v_gl_count := v_gl_count + 2;
                interface_append_gl (v_trans_code, --v_trans_code        NUMBER,
                                     v_user,   --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                                     NULL,       --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                                     NULL,       --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                                     v_trans_no, --v_vchr_no          VARCHAR2,
                                     NULL,       --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                                     NULL,       --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                                     NULL,      --v_rcpt_no          VARCHAR2,
                                     v_gl_count, --v_count             NUMBER,
                                     'HRMS GROSS COMM',
                                     --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                                     NVL (c.comm_amt, 0),
                                     --v_amount            NUMBER,
                                     'D',      --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                                     v_trnt_gl_code,
                                     --v_acc_number1       VARCHAR2,
                                     v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                     --v_acc_number2         VARCHAR2,
                                     v_brn_code, --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                                     v_gl_trans);

                IF v_gl_count > 0
                THEN
                    interface_update_vgl (v_trans_code, --v_trans_code     NUMBER,
                                          v_user, --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                                          NULL,  --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                                          TRUNC (v_auth_date), --v_date         DATE,
                                          NULL,  --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                                          NULL,  --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                                          'LMS GL COMMISSION BATCH', --v_btc_description   VARCHAR2,
                                          'JV', --v_btc_type           VARCHAR2,
                                          v_brn_code, --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                                          'HRMS GROSS COMM', --v_description       VARCHAR2,
                                          v_trans_no, --v_ref_no           VARCHAR2,
                                          v_gl_trans);
                END IF;
            END IF;
        END LOOP;
    EXCEPTION
        WHEN OTHERS
        THEN
            raise_error ('Com. Api....');
    END post_gross_comm_gl;

    PROCEDURE post_gross_comm_contra_gl (v_trans_no NUMBER, v_user VARCHAR2)
    IS
        CURSOR contra_vgl IS
            SELECT itb_transaction_code,
                   itb_batch_desc,
                   itb_batch_type,
                   itb_branch_code,
                   itb_narrative,
                   itb_ref
              FROM lms_interface_table
             WHERE     itb_transaction_type = 'UPDATE_VGL'
                   AND itb_ref = v_trans_no
                   AND itb_narrative = 'HRMS GROSS COMM';

        CURSOR contra (v_transno NUMBER)
        IS
            SELECT itb_drcr,
                   itb_transaction_code,
                   itb_count,
                   itb_narrative,
                   itb_amount,
                   itb_acc_number,
                   itb_acc_number2,
                   itb_branch_code
              FROM lms_interface_table
             WHERE     itb_transaction_type = 'APPEND_GL'
                   AND itb_transaction_code = v_transno;

        v_gl_trans   fms_vouchers_pkg.tgl_rec_type;
        v_drcr       VARCHAR2 (1);
    BEGIN
        FOR c IN contra_vgl
        LOOP
            v_gl_trans.delete;

            FOR b IN contra (c.itb_transaction_code)
            LOOP
                SELECT DECODE (NVL (b.itb_drcr, 'C'), 'C', 'D', 'C')
                  INTO v_drcr
                  FROM DUAL;

                interface_append_gl (b.itb_transaction_code,
                                     --v_trans_code        NUMBER,
                                     v_user,   --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                                     NULL,       --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                                     NULL,       --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                                     NULL,     --v_vchr_no           VARCHAR2,
                                     NULL,       --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                                     NULL,       --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                                     NULL,     --v_rcpt_no           VARCHAR2,
                                     b.itb_count, --v_count             NUMBER,
                                     b.itb_narrative || '-CONTRA',
                                     --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                                     NVL (b.itb_amount, 0),
                                     --v_amount            NUMBER,
                                     v_drcr,   --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                                     b.itb_acc_number,
                                     --v_acc_number1       VARCHAR2,
                                     b.itb_acc_number2,
                                     --v_acc_number2        VARCHAR2,
                                     b.itb_branch_code,
                                     --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                                     v_gl_trans);
            --v_trn_rec   IN OUT  fms_test.Fms_Vouchers_Pkg.Tgl_rec_type,
            END LOOP;

            interface_update_vgl (c.itb_transaction_code,
                                  --v_trans_code     NUMBER,
                                  v_user,      --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                                  NULL,          --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                                  SYSDATE,               --v_date        DATE,
                                  NULL,          --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                                  NULL,          --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                                  c.itb_batch_desc || '-CONTRA',
                                  --v_btc_description   VARCHAR2,
                                  c.itb_batch_type,
                                  --v_btc_type         VARCHAR2,
                                  c.itb_branch_code,
                                  --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                                  c.itb_narrative || '-CONTRA',
                                  --v_description       VARCHAR2,
                                  c.itb_ref,        --v_ref          VARCHAR2,
                                  v_gl_trans);
        --v_gl_trans  IN OUT  fms_test.Fms_Vouchers_Pkg.Tgl_rec_type,
        END LOOP;
    EXCEPTION
        WHEN OTHERS
        THEN
            raise_error ('COM CONTRA. API....');
    END post_gross_comm_contra_gl;

    PROCEDURE process_loan_interest (
        v_pli_pln_lna_no   NUMBER,
        v_intr_type        VARCHAR2,
        v_brh_code         NUMBER,
        v_interest_amt     NUMBER,
        v_username         VARCHAR2,
        v_prod_code        NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
        v_date             DATE DEFAULT TRUNC (SYSDATE)
    )
    IS
        v_gl_trans                fms_vouchers_pkg.tgl_rec_type;
        v_vgl_no                  NUMBER;
        v_cur_code                NUMBER;
        v_trnt_code               VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_trnt_gl_code            VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_trnt_gl_interest_code   VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_trnt_contra_gl_code     VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_count                   NUMBER := 0;
        v_org_code                NUMBER;
        v_raised_by               NUMBER;
        v_policy_no               VARCHAR2 (50);
        v_branch                  VARCHAR2 (60);
        v_drcr                    VARCHAR2 (2) := 'D';
        v_desc1                   VARCHAR2 (40);
        v_desc2                   VARCHAR2 (40);
        v_desc3                   VARCHAR2 (40);
        v_desc4                   VARCHAR2 (40);
        v_desc5                   VARCHAR2 (60);
        v_trans_code              NUMBER;
        v_loan_param              VARCHAR2 (10);
        v_pol_code                NUMBER;
    BEGIN
        v_count := -1;

        BEGIN
            lms_ord_misc.system_param_val ('USE_SINGLE_LOAN_ACCOUNT',
                                           v_loan_param);
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                raise_error ('PARAMETER ERROR...USE_SINGLE_LOAN_ACCOUNT...');
        END;

        IF NVL (v_interest_amt, 0) <> 0
        THEN
            v_org_code := fms_interfaces_pkg.get_org (v_brh_code);

            IF v_intr_type IN ('NORMAL', 'CONTRA_INT')
            THEN
                IF NVL (v_loan_param, 'Y') = 'Y'
                THEN
                    -- DR LOAN CTRL CR INTEREST INCOME
                    --GET LOAN INT A/C
                    get_gl_code ('POL_LOAN',
                                 v_prod_code,
                                 v_trnt_code,
                                 v_trnt_gl_code,
                                 v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
                    valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                               v_org_code,
                               v_brh_code,
                               'POL_LOAN');
                    --GET INTEREST INC A/C
                    get_gl_code ('LOAN_INT',
                                 v_prod_code,
                                 v_trnt_code,
                                 v_trnt_gl_interest_code,
                                 v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
                    valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_interest_code,
                               v_org_code,
                               v_brh_code,
                               'LOAN_INT');
                ELSE
                    get_gl_code ('LOAN_INT',
                                 v_prod_code,
                                 v_trnt_code,
                                 v_trnt_gl_interest_code,
                                 v_trnt_gl_code);

                    valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_interest_code,
                               v_org_code,
                               v_brh_code,
                               'LOAN_INT');

                    valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                               v_org_code,
                               v_brh_code,
                               'LOAN_INT');
                END IF;

                IF v_intr_type = 'CONTRA_INT'
                THEN
                    v_drcr := 'C';
                END IF;
            ELSIF v_intr_type = 'OVERAISED'
            THEN
                IF NVL (v_loan_param, 'Y') = 'Y'
                THEN
                    -- DR SURRENDERS CR LOANS CTRL
                    --GET SURRENDERS
                    get_gl_code ('LOAN_INT',
                                 v_prod_code,
                                 v_trnt_code,
                                 v_trnt_gl_code,
                                 v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
                    valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                               v_org_code,
                               v_brh_code,
                               'LOAN_INT');
                    --GET LOANS CTRL
                    get_gl_code ('POL_LOAN',
                                 v_prod_code,
                                 v_trnt_code,
                                 v_trnt_gl_interest_code,
                                 v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
                    valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_interest_code,
                               v_org_code,
                               v_brh_code,
                               'POL_LOAN');
                ELSE
                    -- DR SURRENDERS CR LOANS CTRL
                    --GET SURRENDERS
                    get_gl_code ('LOAN_INT',
                                 v_prod_code,
                                 v_trnt_code,
                                 v_trnt_gl_code,
                                 v_trnt_gl_interest_code);
                    valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                               v_org_code,
                               v_brh_code,
                               'LOAN_INT');

                    valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_interest_code,
                               v_org_code,
                               v_brh_code,
                               'LOAN_INT');
                END IF;
            ELSIF v_intr_type = 'UNDERAISED'
            THEN
                IF NVL (v_loan_param, 'Y') = 'Y'
                THEN
                    -- DR LOAN CTRL CR INTEREST INCOME
                    --GET LOAN INT A/C
                    get_gl_code ('POL_LOAN',
                                 v_prod_code,
                                 v_trnt_code,
                                 v_trnt_gl_code,
                                 v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
                    valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                               v_org_code,
                               v_brh_code,
                               'POL_LOAN');
                    --GET INTEREST INC A/C
                    get_gl_code ('LOAN_INT',
                                 v_prod_code,
                                 v_trnt_code,
                                 v_trnt_gl_interest_code,
                                 v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
                    valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_interest_code,
                               v_org_code,
                               v_brh_code,
                               'LOAN_INT');
                ELSE
                    get_gl_code ('LOAN_INT',
                                 v_prod_code,
                                 v_trnt_code,
                                 v_trnt_gl_interest_code,
                                 v_trnt_gl_code);
                    valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_interest_code,
                               v_org_code,
                               v_brh_code,
                               'LOAN_INT');

                    valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                               v_org_code,
                               v_brh_code,
                               'LOAN_INT');
                END IF;
            ELSIF v_intr_type = 'MATURITY'
            THEN
                -- DR MATURITY
                --CR POL  LOAN A/C
                get_gl_code ('POL_MTR',
                             v_prod_code,
                             v_trnt_code,
                             v_trnt_gl_code,
                             v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
                valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                           v_org_code,
                           v_brh_code,
                           'POL_MTR');
                --GET INTEREST INC A/C
                get_gl_code ('POL_LOAN',
                             v_prod_code,
                             v_trnt_code,
                             v_trnt_gl_interest_code,
                             v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
                valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_interest_code,
                           v_org_code,
                           v_brh_code,
                           'POL_LOAN');
            ELSIF v_intr_type = 'SURRENDER'
            THEN
                -- DR SURRENDER
                --CR POL  LOAN A/C
                get_gl_code ('POL_SURR',
                             v_prod_code,
                             v_trnt_code,
                             v_trnt_gl_code,
                             v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
                valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                           v_org_code,
                           v_brh_code,
                           'POL_SURR');
                --GET INTEREST INC A/C
                get_gl_code ('POL_LOAN',
                             v_prod_code,
                             v_trnt_code,
                             v_trnt_gl_interest_code,
                             v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
                valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_interest_code,
                           v_org_code,
                           v_brh_code,
                           'POL_LOAN');
            ELSIF v_intr_type = 'REINST_INT'
            THEN
                --DR PREMIUM
                --CR INTEREST INCOME
                get_gl_code ('UP',
                             v_prod_code,
                             v_trnt_code,
                             v_trnt_gl_code,
                             v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
                valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                           v_org_code,
                           v_brh_code,
                           'UP');
                --GET INTEREST INC A/C
                get_gl_code ('LOAN_INT',
                             v_prod_code,
                             v_trnt_code,
                             v_trnt_gl_interest_code,
                             v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
                valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_interest_code,
                           v_org_code,
                           v_brh_code,
                           'LOAN_INT');
            ELSIF v_intr_type = 'OMITTED'
            THEN
                --DR PREMIUM
                --CR LOANS CTRL
                get_gl_code ('CHKCTL',
                             v_prod_code,
                             v_trnt_code,
                             v_trnt_gl_code,
                             v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
                valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                           v_org_code,
                           v_brh_code,
                           'CHKCTL');
                --GET INTEREST INC A/C
                get_gl_code ('POL_LOAN',
                             v_prod_code,
                             v_trnt_code,
                             v_trnt_gl_interest_code,
                             v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
                valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_interest_code,
                           v_org_code,
                           v_brh_code,
                           'POL_LOAN');
            ELSIF v_intr_type = 'IN_WO'               --- interest  write- off
            THEN
                -- CR LOAN CTRL DR INTEREST WRITE OFF
                --GET LOAN INT A/C
                get_gl_code ('IN_WO',
                             v_prod_code,
                             v_trnt_code,
                             v_trnt_gl_code,
                             v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
                valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                           v_org_code,
                           v_brh_code,
                           'IN_WO');
                --GET INTEREST INC A/C
                get_gl_code ('POL_LOAN',
                             v_prod_code,
                             v_trnt_code,
                             v_trnt_gl_interest_code,
                             v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
                valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_interest_code,
                           v_org_code,
                           v_brh_code,
                           'POL_LOAN');
            ELSE
                raise_error (
                       'INTEREST CALCULATION TYPE '
                    || v_intr_type
                    || ' NOT PROVIDED FOR...');
            END IF;

            v_cur_code := lms_interfaces_pkg.lms_def_cur (v_brh_code);
            v_raised_by := fms_interfaces_pkg.get_usercode (v_username);
            v_count := v_count + 2;

            BEGIN
                SELECT pol_policy_no, pol_code
                  INTO v_policy_no, v_pol_code
                  FROM lms_policies
                 WHERE pol_code =
                       (SELECT lna_pol_code
                          FROM lms_loan_applications
                         WHERE lna_no = v_pli_pln_lna_no AND ROWNUM = 1);
            EXCEPTION
                WHEN OTHERS
                THEN
                    raise_error ('ERROR RETRIEVING POLICY DETAILS....');
            END;

            IF v_intr_type <> 'REINST_INT'
            THEN
                BEGIN
                    SELECT SUBSTR (brn_name, 0, 18)
                      INTO v_branch
                      FROM tqc_branches
                     WHERE brn_code = v_brh_code;
                EXCEPTION
                    WHEN OTHERS
                    THEN
                        raise_error ('ERROR RETIREVING BRANCH DETAILS....');
                END;

                IF v_intr_type = 'CONTRA_INT'
                THEN
                    v_desc1 := 'CONTRA INTR.- ';
                    v_desc2 := 'LMS LOAN INTEREST CONTRA BATCH';
                    v_desc3 := 'CONTRA INTEREST';
                    v_desc4 := 'CONTRA INTR.- ';
                ELSIF v_intr_type = 'IN_WO'
                THEN
                    v_desc1 := 'LOAN INTR.- ';
                    v_desc2 := 'LMS LOAN INTEREST WRITE-OFF BATCH';
                    v_desc3 := 'LOAN INTEREST';
                    v_desc4 := 'LOAN INTR.- ';
                ELSE
                    v_desc1 := 'LOAN INTR.- ';
                    v_desc2 := 'LMS LOAN INTEREST BATCH';
                    v_desc3 := 'LOAN INTEREST';
                    v_desc4 := 'LOANINTR';
                END IF;

                v_desc5 := v_policy_no;
            ELSE
                v_desc1 := 'REINST. INTR.- ';
                v_desc2 := 'LMS REINSTATEMENT INTR. BATCH';
                v_desc3 := 'REINSTATEMENT INTR.';
                v_desc4 := 'POLICY NO ';
                v_desc5 := v_policy_no;
            END IF;

            SELECT    TO_NUMBER (TO_CHAR (SYSDATE, 'RRRR'))
                   || lms_transaction_seq.NEXTVAL
              INTO v_trans_code
              FROM DUAL;

            interface_append_gl (
                v_trans_code,                   --v_trans_code         NUMBER,
                v_username,                    --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                v_pol_code,                      --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                v_prod_code,                     --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                v_policy_no,                  --v_vchr_no            VARCHAR2,
                NULL,                            --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                NULL,                            --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                NULL,                           --v_rcpt_no          VARCHAR2,
                v_count,                         --v_count             NUMBER,
                v_desc1 || v_policy_no || '-' || v_pli_pln_lna_no,
                --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                v_interest_amt,                  --v_amount            NUMBER,
                v_drcr,                        --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                v_trnt_gl_code,                --v_acc_number1       VARCHAR2,
                v_trnt_gl_interest_code,
                --v_acc_number2       VARCHAR2,
                v_brh_code,                      --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                v_gl_trans);
            --v_trn_rec   IN OUT  Fms_Vouchers_Pkg.Tgl_rec_type,
            interface_update_vgl (
                v_trans_code,                       --v_trans_code     NUMBER,
                v_username,                    --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                v_pol_code,                      --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                NVL (v_date, TRUNC (SYSDATE)),          --v_date         DATE,
                NULL,                            --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                NULL,                            --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                v_desc2,                       --v_btc_description   VARCHAR2,
                'JV',                         --v_btc_type           VARCHAR2,
                v_brh_code,                      --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                v_desc3,                       --v_description       VARCHAR2,
                v_desc4 || v_desc5 || '-' || v_pli_pln_lna_no,
                --v_ref_no             VARCHAR2,
                v_gl_trans);

            UPDATE lms_interface_table
               SET itb_ref2 = v_pli_pln_lna_no
             WHERE itb_transaction_code = v_trans_code;
        --v_gl_trans  IN OUT  Fms_Vouchers_Pkg.Tgl_rec_type,
        END IF;
    --    EXCEPTION
    --        WHEN OTHERS
    --        THEN
    --            raise_error ('PROCESSING INTEREST....v_pli_pln_lna_no='||v_pli_pln_lna_no||' v_trnt_gl_interest_code= '||v_trnt_gl_interest_code||' v_trnt_gl_code='||v_trnt_gl_code||' v_prod_code='||v_prod_code||' '||SQLERRM(SQLCODE));
    END process_loan_interest;

    PROCEDURE policy_conversion_rcpts (
        v_pol_code        IN NUMBER,
        v_pol_policy_no   IN VARCHAR2,
        v_inst_prem       IN NUMBER,
        v_pol_bra_code    IN NUMBER,
        v_oppr_code       IN NUMBER,
        v_user_name          VARCHAR2,
        v_prodctn_date    IN DATE DEFAULT NULL,
        v_prod_type       IN VARCHAR2 DEFAULT 'ED',
        v_agn_dbt_amt        NUMBER DEFAULT 0,
        v_gross_up_amt       NUMBER DEFAULT 0
    )
    IS
        os_prem_dummy               NUMBER;
        v_os_inst                   NUMBER;
        v_opr_code                  NUMBER;
        v_cur_code                  NUMBER;
        v_gl_count                  NUMBER;
        v_acc_type                  NUMBER;
        v_only_due_inst             VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_multiple_inst             VARCHAR2 (20) := 'Y';
        v_tran_no                   NUMBER;
        v_bal_amt                   NUMBER;
        v_credit                    NUMBER := 0;
        v_chq_rcpt_no               VARCHAR2 (100);
        v_gl_trans                  fms_vouchers_pkg.tgl_rec_type;
        v_vgl_no                    NUMBER;
        v_trnt_code                 VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_trnt_gl_code              VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_trnt_contra_gl_code       VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_contra_acc                VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_chkoff_agen_code          NUMBER;
        v_chkoff_rate               NUMBER;
        v_ee_contri                 NUMBER;
        v_er_contri                 NUMBER;
        v_tot_contri                NUMBER;
        v_balance                   NUMBER;
        v_amt                       NUMBER := 0;
        v_raised_by                 NUMBER;
        v_post                      VARCHAR2 (1) := 'N';
        v_ann_opr_code              NUMBER;
        v_trans_code                NUMBER;
        v_polcode                   NUMBER := v_pol_code;
        v_separate_posting          VARCHAR2 (5);
        v_compute_comm              VARCHAR2 (5);
        v_cvrg_area                 NUMBER;
        v_spoke_code                NUMBER;
        v_sbu_code                  NUMBER;
        v_location_code             NUMBER;
        v_direct_comm_param         VARCHAR2 (5);

        CURSOR prp_rcpts IS
              SELECT oppr_code,
                     oppr_ltr_trans_no,
                     oppr_date,
                     oppr_cheque_no,
                     oppr_amt,
                     oppr_pol_code,
                     oppr_pol_proposal_no,
                     oppr_receipt_no,
                     oppr_receipt_date,
                     oppr_pmth_code,
                     oppr_posted,
                     opr_chk_agen_code,
                     opri_chk_comm_rate,
                     opri_chk_comm_amt,
                     oppr_total_ref_amt,
                     oppr_to_ref,
                     oppr_done_by,
                     oppr_pens_amt,
                     oppr_drcr,
                     pol_prod_type,
                     endr_grp_life_rider,
                     oppr_within_system,
                     endr_add_prem_int,
                     endr_checkoff_agen_code,
                     oppr_pay_comm,
                     DECODE (
                         NVL (endr_pay_method, 'C'),
                         'K', lms_interfaces_pkg.agent_commission (
                                  endr_checkoff_agen_code,
                                  'CK'),
                         NULL)    chkoff_rate,
                     oppr_source,
                     endr_inv_rider,
                     oppr_fms_receipt_pk,
                     endr_agen_code,
                     oppr_deduction_date,
                     oppr_rad_code
                FROM lms_ord_proposal_rcpts,
                     lms_policies,
                     lms_policy_endorsements,
                     (  SELECT oppr_receipt_no               rcptno,
                               oppr_pol_code                 polcode,
                               SUM (
                                     DECODE (NVL (oppr_drcr, 'C'), 'C', 1, -1)
                                   * (NVL (oppr_amt, 0)))    amt
                          FROM lms_ord_proposal_rcpts
                      GROUP BY oppr_receipt_no, oppr_pol_code)
               WHERE     oppr_pol_code = pol_code
                     AND polcode = pol_code
                     AND NVL (rcptno, 'XYZ') = NVL (oppr_receipt_no, 'XYZ')
                     AND pol_current_endr_code = endr_code
                     AND NVL (oppr_drcr, 'C') <> 'D'
                     AND pol_code = v_pol_code
                     AND amt > 0
                     AND NOT NVL (oppr_receipt_no, 'XYZ') IN
                                 (SELECT NVL (opr_receipt_no, 'XYZ')
                                    FROM lms_ord_prem_receipts
                                   WHERE     opr_pol_code = pol_code
                                         AND opr_amt = oppr_amt
                                         AND NVL (opr_receipt_no, 'XYZ') =
                                             NVL (oppr_receipt_no, 'XYZ')
                                         AND opr_receipt_date =
                                             oppr_receipt_date)
            ORDER BY oppr_receipt_date, oppr_code;

        CURSOR cur_pol_cb_amt IS
              SELECT NVL (SUM (opr_loan_pymt_amt), 0)
                         loan_amt,
                     NVL (SUM (lms_process_receipts.rcpt_balance (opr_code)),
                          0)
                         un_allocated_amt,
                     NVL (SUM (opr_refund_amt), 0)
                         suspense_amt,
                     -- OPR_PMTH_CODE,
                     NVL (SUM (premium_amt), 0)
                         premium_amt,
                     NVL (SUM (pension_contr), 0)
                         pension_contr,
                     --NVL(SUM(investment_fee),0) investment_fee,
                     DECODE (pol_prod_type,
                             'IN', NVL (SUM (investment_fee), 0),
                             'PN', NVL (SUM (investment_fee), 0),
                             'AN', NVL (SUM (investment_fee), 0),
                             NVL (SUM (opr_policy_fee), 0))
                         investment_fee,
                     NVL (SUM (investment_contri), 0)
                         investment_contri,
                     NVL (SUM (investment_admin), 0)
                         investment_admin,
                     NVL (SUM (opr_fund_client_contr), 0)
                         comfnd,
                     (NVL (SUM (prem_comm), 0) + NVL (SUM (pens_comm), 0))
                         prem_comm,
                     NVL (SUM (pens_comm), 0)
                         pens_comm,
                     NVL (SUM (prem_tax), 0)
                         prem_tax,
                     NVL (SUM (chkoff_comm), 0)
                         chkoff_comm,
                     pol_bra_code,
                     pol_prod_code,
                     pol_type,
                     pol_prod_type,
                     pol_policy_no,
                     opr_code,
                     NVL (opr_alloc_to, 'PR')
                         alloc_to,
                     NVL (inv_all_prem_valid (pol_code), 'N')
                         inv_all_prem,
                     'N'
                         renewal,
                     SUM (opr_amt)
                         opr_amt,
                     endr_agen_code,
                     opr_source,
                     opr_receipt_no,
                     endr_inv_rider
                FROM lms_ord_prem_receipts,
                     lms_policies,
                     lms_policy_endorsements,
                     (  SELECT opri_opr_code,
                               NVL (SUM (opri_amt), 0)              premium_amt,
                               NVL (SUM (opri_prem_tax_amt), 0)     prem_tax,
                               NVL (SUM (opri_chk_comm_amt), 0)     chkoff_comm,
                               NVL (SUM (opri_comm_amt), 0)         prem_comm
                          FROM lms_ord_receipt_instlmnts
                         WHERE     NVL (inv_all_prem_valid (opri_pol_code), 'N') =
                                   'N'
                               AND opri_pol_code = v_pol_code
                      GROUP BY opri_opr_code
                      UNION
                        SELECT opri_opr_code,
                               SUM (
                                     NVL (opri_amt, 0)
                                   - lms_investments.basic_prem_ratio (
                                         opri_pol_code,
                                         NVL (opri_amt, 0)))         premium_amt,
                               SUM (NVL (opri_prem_tax_amt, 0))      prem_tax,
                               --   -Lms_Investments.Basic_prem_ratio(OPRI_POL_CODE,NVL(OPRI_PREM_TAX_AMT,0))) prem_tax,
                               SUM (NVL (opri_chk_comm_amt, 0))      chkoff_comm,
                               --  - Lms_Investments.Basic_prem_ratio(OPRI_POL_CODE,NVL(OPRI_CHK_COMM_AMT,0))) chkoff_comm,  --CK commision not correct
                               SUM (
                                     NVL (opri_comm_amt, 0)
                                   - lms_investments.basic_prem_ratio (
                                         opri_pol_code,
                                         NVL (opri_comm_amt, 0)))    prem_comm
                          FROM lms_ord_receipt_instlmnts
                         WHERE     NVL (inv_all_prem_valid (opri_pol_code), 'N') =
                                   'Y'
                               AND opri_pol_code = v_pol_code
                      GROUP BY opri_opr_code),
                     (  SELECT pndpo_opr_code,
                               NVL (SUM (pndpo_tot_amt), 0)
                                   pension_contr,
                               NVL (SUM (pndpo_admin_fee), 0)
                                   investment_fee,
                               NVL (SUM (pndpo_empye_amt), 0)
                                   investment_contri,
                               NVL (SUM (pndpo_empyr_amt), 0)
                                   investment_admin,
                               NVL (SUM (pndpo_comm_amt), 0)
                                   pens_comm
                          FROM lms_pension_deposits_ord
                         WHERE pndpo_pol_code = v_pol_code
                      GROUP BY pndpo_opr_code)
               WHERE     pol_code = opr_pol_code
                     AND pol_code = v_pol_code
                     AND opri_opr_code(+) = opr_code
                     AND pndpo_opr_code(+) = opr_code
                     AND endr_code = pol_current_endr_code
                     AND opr_drcr = 'C'
                     AND opr_oppr_code IS NOT NULL
                     AND (   opr_fms_receipt_pk IS NOT NULL
                          OR NVL (opr_source, '-1') IN
                                 ('SURRENDER ALLOCATION', 'MATURITY ALLOCATION'))
                     AND NVL (v_separate_posting, 'N') = 'N'
            GROUP BY pol_bra_code,
                     pol_prod_code,
                     pol_type,
                     pol_prod_type,
                     pol_policy_no,
                     opr_alloc_to,
                     inv_all_prem_valid (pol_code),
                     opr_code,
                     endr_agen_code,
                     opr_source,
                     opr_receipt_no,
                     endr_inv_rider
            UNION ALL
              SELECT NVL (SUM (opr_loan_pymt_amt), 0)
                         loan_amt,
                     NVL (SUM (lms_process_receipts.rcpt_balance (opr_code)),
                          0)
                         un_allocated_amt,
                     NVL (SUM (opr_refund_amt), 0)
                         suspense_amt,
                     -- OPR_PMTH_CODE,
                     NVL (SUM (premium_amt), 0)
                         premium_amt,
                     NVL (SUM (pension_contr), 0)
                         pension_contr,
                     --NVL(SUM(investment_fee),0) investment_fee,
                     DECODE (pol_prod_type,
                             'IN', NVL (SUM (investment_fee), 0),
                             'PN', NVL (SUM (investment_fee), 0),
                             'AN', NVL (SUM (investment_fee), 0),
                             NVL (SUM (opr_policy_fee), 0))
                         investment_fee,
                     NVL (SUM (investment_contri), 0)
                         investment_contri,
                     NVL (SUM (investment_admin), 0)
                         investment_admin,
                     NVL (SUM (opr_fund_client_contr), 0)
                         comfnd,
                     (NVL (SUM (prem_comm), 0) + NVL (SUM (pens_comm), 0))
                         prem_comm,
                     NVL (SUM (pens_comm), 0)
                         pens_comm,
                     NVL (SUM (prem_tax), 0)
                         prem_tax,
                     NVL (SUM (chkoff_comm), 0)
                         chkoff_comm,
                     pol_bra_code,
                     pol_prod_code,
                     pol_type,
                     pol_prod_type,
                     pol_policy_no,
                     opr_code,
                     NVL (opr_alloc_to, 'PR')
                         alloc_to,
                     NVL (inv_all_prem_valid (pol_code), 'N')
                         inv_all_prem,
                     NVL (renewal, pensrenewal)
                         renewal,
                     SUM (opr_amt)
                         opr_amt,
                     endr_agen_code,
                     opr_source,
                     opr_receipt_no,
                     endr_inv_rider
                FROM lms_ord_prem_receipts,
                     lms_policies,
                     lms_policy_endorsements,
                     (  SELECT opri_opr_code,
                               NVL (SUM (opri_amt), 0)                        premium_amt,
                               NVL (SUM (opri_prem_tax_amt), 0)               prem_tax,
                               NVL (SUM (opri_chk_comm_amt), 0)               chkoff_comm,
                               NVL (SUM (opri_comm_amt), 0)                   prem_comm,
                               lms_ord_mis.check_renewal (opri_pol_code,
                                                          opri_instlmt_no)    renewal
                          FROM lms_ord_receipt_instlmnts
                         WHERE     NVL (inv_all_prem_valid (opri_pol_code), 'N') =
                                   'N'
                               AND opri_pol_code = v_pol_code
                      GROUP BY opri_opr_code,
                               lms_ord_mis.check_renewal (opri_pol_code,
                                                          opri_instlmt_no)
                      UNION
                        SELECT opri_opr_code,
                               SUM (
                                     NVL (opri_amt, 0)
                                   - lms_investments.basic_prem_ratio (
                                         opri_pol_code,
                                         NVL (opri_amt, 0)))                  premium_amt,
                               SUM (NVL (opri_prem_tax_amt, 0))               prem_tax,
                               --   -Lms_Investments.Basic_prem_ratio(OPRI_POL_CODE,NVL(OPRI_PREM_TAX_AMT,0))) prem_tax,
                               SUM (NVL (opri_chk_comm_amt, 0))               chkoff_comm,
                               --  - Lms_Investments.Basic_prem_ratio(OPRI_POL_CODE,NVL(OPRI_CHK_COMM_AMT,0))) chkoff_comm,  --CK commision not correct
                               SUM (
                                     NVL (opri_comm_amt, 0)
                                   - lms_investments.basic_prem_ratio (
                                         opri_pol_code,
                                         NVL (opri_comm_amt, 0)))             prem_comm,
                               lms_ord_mis.check_renewal (opri_pol_code,
                                                          opri_instlmt_no)    renewal
                          FROM lms_ord_receipt_instlmnts
                         WHERE     NVL (inv_all_prem_valid (opri_pol_code), 'N') =
                                   'Y'
                               AND opri_pol_code = v_pol_code
                      GROUP BY opri_opr_code,
                               lms_ord_mis.check_renewal (opri_pol_code,
                                                          opri_instlmt_no)),
                     (  SELECT pndpo_opr_code,
                               NVL (SUM (pndpo_tot_amt), 0)
                                   pension_contr,
                               NVL (SUM (pndpo_admin_fee), 0)
                                   investment_fee,
                               NVL (SUM (pndpo_empye_amt), 0)
                                   investment_contri,
                               NVL (SUM (pndpo_empyr_amt), 0)
                                   investment_admin,
                               NVL (SUM (pndpo_comm_amt), 0)
                                   pens_comm,
                               lms_ord_mis.check_renewal (pndpo_pol_code,
                                                          pndpo_instlmnt_no)
                                   pensrenewal
                          FROM lms_pension_deposits_ord
                         WHERE pndpo_pol_code = v_pol_code
                      GROUP BY pndpo_opr_code,
                               lms_ord_mis.check_renewal (pndpo_pol_code,
                                                          pndpo_instlmnt_no))
               WHERE     pol_code = opr_pol_code
                     AND pol_code = v_pol_code
                     AND opri_opr_code(+) = opr_code
                     AND pndpo_opr_code(+) = opr_code
                     AND endr_code = pol_current_endr_code
                     AND opr_drcr = 'C'
                     AND opr_oppr_code IS NOT NULL
                     AND (   opr_fms_receipt_pk IS NOT NULL
                          OR opr_source IN
                                 ('SURRENDER ALLOCATION', 'MATURITY ALLOCATION'))
                     AND NVL (v_separate_posting, 'N') = 'Y'
            GROUP BY pol_bra_code,
                     pol_prod_code,
                     pol_type,
                     pol_prod_type,
                     pol_policy_no,
                     opr_alloc_to,
                     inv_all_prem_valid (pol_code),
                     opr_code,
                     endr_agen_code,
                     NVL (renewal, pensrenewal),
                     opr_source,
                     opr_receipt_no,
                     endr_inv_rider;

        CURSOR cur_ann_amt IS
            SELECT ann_agn_code, ann_brn_code, ann_prod_code
              FROM lms_annuities
             WHERE ann_code = v_pol_code;

        CURSOR tax_types (v_opr_code NUMBER)
        IS
              SELECT orts_opr_code,
                     orts_add_to_receipts,
                     SUM (orts_amount)                       orts_amount,
                     NVL (ptt_acc_no, tt_acc_no)             acc_no,
                     NVL (ptt_contra_acc, tt_contra_acc)     contra_acc_no,
                     tt_code,
                     trt_code,
                     tt_desc
                FROM lms_ord_receipt_taxes,
                     lms_tax_rates,
                     lms_tax_types,
                     lms_prod_tax_types
               WHERE     orts_trt_code = trt_code
                     AND trt_tt_code = tt_code
                     AND ptt_tt_code = tt_code
                     AND ptt_prod_code = trt_prod_code
                     AND orts_opr_code = v_opr_code
                     AND tt_applicable_at_prod = 'Y'
                     AND (    tt_application_level = 'RP'
                          AND tt_type NOT IN ('FE', 'CL')
                          AND trt_applied_to = 'CL')
                     AND orts_posted = 'N'
            GROUP BY orts_opr_code,
                     orts_add_to_receipts,
                     NVL (ptt_acc_no, tt_acc_no),
                     NVL (ptt_contra_acc, tt_contra_acc),
                     tt_code,
                     trt_code,
                     tt_desc
            UNION
              SELECT orts_opr_code,
                     orts_add_to_receipts,
                     SUM (orts_amount)     orts_amount,
                     tt_acc_no             acc_no,
                     tt_contra_acc         contra_acc_no,
                     tt_code,
                     trt_code,
                     tt_desc
                FROM lms_ord_receipt_taxes, lms_tax_rates, lms_tax_types
               WHERE     orts_trt_code = trt_code
                     AND trt_tt_code = tt_code
                     AND orts_opr_code = v_opr_code
                     AND tt_applicable_at_prod = 'N'
                     AND (    tt_application_level = 'RP'
                          AND tt_type NOT IN ('FE', 'CL')
                          AND trt_applied_to = 'CL')
                     AND orts_posted = 'N'
            GROUP BY orts_opr_code,
                     orts_add_to_receipts,
                     tt_acc_no,
                     tt_contra_acc,
                     tt_code,
                     trt_code,
                     tt_desc;

        v_org_code                  NUMBER;
        v_alloc_to                  VARCHAR2 (5);
        v_unalloc_amt               NUMBER := 0;
        v_double_sure_amt           NUMBER := 0;
        v_comp_param                VARCHAR2 (5);
        v_comp_param_status         VARCHAR2 (5);
        v_pol_instlmt_prem          NUMBER;
        v_endr_tot_premium          NUMBER;
        v_rct_code                  VARCHAR2 (100) := 'FROM_AGENT';
        v_gross_rct_code            VARCHAR2 (100) := 'FROM_GROSS_UP';
        v_apay_method_code          NUMBER;
        v_oppr_receipt_trans_code   VARCHAR2 (100);
        v_agn_oppr_code             NUMBER;
        v_proposal_no               lms_policies.pol_proposal_no%TYPE;
        v_ann_chk                   VARCHAR2 (100);
        v_agn_sht_desc              lms_agencies.agn_sht_desc%TYPE;
        v_prod_code                 lms_policies.pol_prod_code%TYPE;
        v_endr_add_prem_int         NUMBER;
        v_updated_amt               NUMBER;
        v_update_amt                NUMBER;
        v_paid_instlmt_no           NUMBER;
        v_loop_cnt                  NUMBER := 0;
        v_post_fees_sep             VARCHAR2 (1);
        v_pfee                      NUMBER
            := lms_process_receipts.pol_holder_alloc (v_pol_code, 'INST');
        v_lc_prem                   NUMBER;
        v_prem                      NUMBER;
        v_full_inst_param           VARCHAR2 (1);
        v_include_fee               VARCHAR2 (1);
        v_endr_code                 NUMBER;
        v_receipt_date              DATE;
    BEGIN
        IF v_user_name IS NULL
        THEN
            raise_error ('USER NAME NOT SPECIFIED');
        END IF;

        BEGIN
            lms_ord_misc.system_param_val (
                'ALLOW_FIRSTYR_RENEWAL_SEPARATION',
                v_separate_posting);
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                raise_error (
                    'PARAMETER ERROR...ALLOW_FIRSTYR_RENEWAL_SEPARATION...');
        END;

        BEGIN
            lms_ord_misc.system_param_val ('POST_DIRECT_COMMISSION_INCOME',
                                           v_direct_comm_param);
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                raise_error (
                    'PARAMETER ERROR...POST_DIRECT_COMMISSION_INCOME...');
        END;

        BEGIN
            SELECT pol_paid_instlmt_no,
                   endr_tot_premium,
                   pol_prod_code,
                   endr_sbu_code,
                   endr_spoke_code,
                   endr_coverage_area_code,
                   endr_location_code,
                   endr_code
              INTO v_paid_instlmt_no,
                   v_endr_tot_premium,
                   v_prod_code,
                   v_sbu_code,
                   v_spoke_code,
                   v_cvrg_area,
                   v_location_code,
                   v_endr_code
              FROM lms_policies, lms_policy_endorsements, lms_products
             WHERE     pol_code = v_pol_code
                   AND pol_current_endr_code = endr_code
                   AND pol_prod_code = prod_code;
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                raise_error ('Error fetching policy details....');
        END;

        lms_ord_trans.update_prem_tracking (v_pol_code, v_endr_code);


        BEGIN
            lms_ord_misc.system_param_val ('POST_FEES_SEPARATELY',
                                           v_post_fees_sep,
                                           v_prod_code);
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                raise_error ('PARAMETER ERROR...POST_FEES_SEPARATELY...');
        END;

        BEGIN
            lms_ord_misc.system_param_val ('ALLOCATE_FULL_INSTALMENT_ONLY',
                                           v_full_inst_param);
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                raise_error (
                    'PARAMETER ERROR ALLOCATE_FULL_INSTALMENT_ONLY..');
        END;

        BEGIN
            lms_ord_misc.system_param_val ('PROCESS_COMM_WITH_POL_FEE',
                                           v_include_fee,
                                           v_prod_code);
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                raise_error ('Parameter Error.PROCESS_COMM_WITH_POL_FEE...');
        END;


        IF NVL (v_paid_instlmt_no, 0) = 0
        THEN
            IF NVL (v_include_fee, 'N') = 'N'
            THEN
                UPDATE lms_policies
                   SET pol_os_prem_bal_amt = v_endr_tot_premium
                 WHERE pol_code = v_pol_code;
            ELSE
                UPDATE lms_policies
                   SET pol_os_prem_bal_amt =
                           v_endr_tot_premium + NVL (v_pfee, 0)
                 WHERE pol_code = v_pol_code;
            END IF;
        END IF;

        IF NVL (v_agn_dbt_amt, 0) > 0
        THEN
            v_apay_method_code := pay_method_code ('VOUCHER');
            v_ann_chk := 'N';

            SELECT v_rct_code || '/' || lms_oppr_receipt_trans_seq.NEXTVAL
              INTO v_oppr_receipt_trans_code
              FROM DUAL;

            BEGIN
                SELECT pol_proposal_no, agn_sht_desc, pol_prod_code
                  INTO v_proposal_no, v_agn_sht_desc, v_prod_code
                  FROM lms_policies, lms_policy_endorsements, lms_agencies
                 WHERE     pol_code = v_pol_code
                       AND pol_current_endr_code = endr_code
                       AND endr_agen_code = agn_code;
            EXCEPTION
                WHEN OTHERS
                THEN
                    raise_error ('Error fetching proposal details......');
            END;

            SELECT    TO_NUMBER (TO_CHAR (SYSDATE, 'RRRR'))
                   || lms_oppr_code_seq.NEXTVAL
              INTO v_agn_oppr_code
              FROM DUAL;

            BEGIN
                INSERT INTO lms_ord_proposal_rcpts (oppr_code,
                                                    oppr_ltr_trans_no,
                                                    oppr_date,
                                                    oppr_cheque_no,
                                                    oppr_amt,
                                                    oppr_pol_code,
                                                    oppr_pol_proposal_no,
                                                    oppr_receipt_no,
                                                    oppr_receipt_date,
                                                    oppr_pmth_code,
                                                    opr_chk_agen_code,
                                                    opri_chk_comm_rate,
                                                    opri_chk_comm_amt,
                                                    oppr_done_by,
                                                    oppr_source,
                                                    oppr_drcr,
                                                    oppr_receipt_trans_code,
                                                    oppr_ann_code,
                                                    oppr_fms_receipt_pk,
                                                    oppr_deduction_date)
                     VALUES (v_agn_oppr_code,
                             NULL,
                             TRUNC (SYSDATE),
                             'FROM_AGENT',
                             v_agn_dbt_amt,
                             v_pol_code,
                             v_proposal_no,
                             v_rct_code,
                             TRUNC (SYSDATE),
                             v_apay_method_code,
                             NULL,
                             NULL,
                             0,
                             v_user_name,
                             'FROM_AGENT',
                             DECODE (SIGN (v_agn_dbt_amt), 1, 'C', 'D'),
                             v_oppr_receipt_trans_code,
                             NULL,
                             NULL,
                             TRUNC (SYSDATE));                --v_pay_method);
            EXCEPTION
                WHEN OTHERS
                THEN
                    raise_error (
                        'ERROR INSERTING PROPOSAL RECEIPT DETAILS......');
            END;

            BEGIN
                lms_process_receipts.agent_debiting (v_pol_code,
                                                     v_user_name,
                                                     TRUNC (SYSDATE),
                                                     v_agn_dbt_amt);
            EXCEPTION
                WHEN OTHERS
                THEN
                    raise_error ('Agent Debit');
            END;
        END IF;

        IF NVL (v_gross_up_amt, 0) > 0
        THEN
            v_apay_method_code := pay_method_code ('VOUCHER');
            v_ann_chk := 'N';

            SELECT    v_gross_rct_code
                   || '/'
                   || lms_oppr_receipt_trans_seq.NEXTVAL
              INTO v_oppr_receipt_trans_code
              FROM DUAL;

            BEGIN
                SELECT pol_proposal_no, agn_sht_desc, pol_prod_code
                  INTO v_proposal_no, v_agn_sht_desc, v_prod_code
                  FROM lms_policies, lms_policy_endorsements, lms_agencies
                 WHERE     pol_code = v_pol_code
                       AND pol_current_endr_code = endr_code
                       AND endr_agen_code = agn_code;
            EXCEPTION
                WHEN OTHERS
                THEN
                    raise_error ('Error fetching proposal details......');
            END;

            SELECT    TO_NUMBER (TO_CHAR (SYSDATE, 'RRRR'))
                   || lms_oppr_code_seq.NEXTVAL
              INTO v_agn_oppr_code
              FROM DUAL;

            BEGIN
                INSERT INTO lms_ord_proposal_rcpts (oppr_code,
                                                    oppr_ltr_trans_no,
                                                    oppr_date,
                                                    oppr_cheque_no,
                                                    oppr_amt,
                                                    oppr_pol_code,
                                                    oppr_pol_proposal_no,
                                                    oppr_receipt_no,
                                                    oppr_receipt_date,
                                                    oppr_pmth_code,
                                                    opr_chk_agen_code,
                                                    opri_chk_comm_rate,
                                                    opri_chk_comm_amt,
                                                    oppr_done_by,
                                                    oppr_source,
                                                    oppr_drcr,
                                                    oppr_receipt_trans_code,
                                                    oppr_ann_code,
                                                    oppr_fms_receipt_pk)
                     VALUES (v_agn_oppr_code,
                             NULL,
                             TRUNC (SYSDATE),
                             'FROM_GROSS_UP',
                             v_gross_up_amt,
                             v_pol_code,
                             v_proposal_no,
                             v_gross_rct_code,
                             TRUNC (SYSDATE),
                             v_apay_method_code,
                             NULL,
                             NULL,
                             0,
                             v_user_name,
                             'FROM_GROSS_UP',
                             'C',
                             v_oppr_receipt_trans_code,
                             NULL,
                             NULL);                           --v_pay_method);
            EXCEPTION
                WHEN OTHERS
                THEN
                    raise_error (
                        'ERROR INSERTING PROPOSAL RECEIPT DETAILS......');
            END;
        END IF;

        IF NVL (v_prod_type, 'ED') = 'AN' AND 1 = 2                  --BLOCKED
        THEN
            BEGIN
                SELECT agn_act_code
                  INTO v_acc_type
                  FROM lms_agencies, lms_annuities
                 WHERE agn_code = ann_agn_code AND ann_code = v_pol_code;
            EXCEPTION
                WHEN OTHERS
                THEN
                    raise_error (
                           'SYSTEM UNABLE TO DETERMINE AGENCY TYPE FOR ANNUITY NO. '
                        || v_pol_policy_no
                        || '... ');
            END;

            IF NVL (v_acc_type, 0) NOT IN (1, 13)
            THEN
                v_acc_type := 1;
            END IF;

            v_post := 'Y';

            BEGIN
                SELECT    TO_NUMBER (TO_CHAR (SYSDATE, 'RRRR'))
                       || lms_opr_code_seq.NEXTVAL
                  INTO v_ann_opr_code
                  FROM DUAL;

                INSERT INTO lms_ord_prem_receipts (opr_code,
                                                   opr_ltr_trans_no,
                                                   opr_date,
                                                   opr_cheque_no,
                                                   opr_amt,
                                                   opr_ann_code,
                                                   opr_receipt_no,
                                                   opr_pol_policy_no,
                                                   opr_receipt_date,
                                                   opr_done_by,
                                                   opr_drcr,
                                                   opr_origin,
                                                   opr_alloc_to,
                                                   opr_source,
                                                   opr_deduction_date,
                                                   opr_rad_code,
                                                   opr_oppr_code,
                                                   opr_pay_comm)
                    SELECT v_ann_opr_code,
                           oppr_ltr_trans_no,
                           TRUNC (SYSDATE),
                           oppr_cheque_no,
                           v_inst_prem,
                           oppr_ann_code,
                           oppr_receipt_no,
                           v_pol_policy_no,
                           oppr_receipt_date,
                           oppr_done_by,
                           NVL (oppr_drcr, 'C'),
                           'I',
                           'PR',
                           'POLICY_CONVERSION',
                           oppr_deduction_date,
                           oppr_rad_code,
                           oppr_code,
                           oppr_pay_comm
                      FROM lms_ord_proposal_rcpts
                     WHERE oppr_code = v_oppr_code;
            EXCEPTION
                WHEN OTHERS
                THEN
                    raise_error (
                           'ERROR INSERTING ANNUITY RECEIPT DETAILS FOR '
                        || v_pol_policy_no
                        || '......');
            END;

            BEGIN
                lms_process_receipts.process_annuity_pymt (v_pol_code,
                                                           v_ann_opr_code,
                                                           v_pol_policy_no,
                                                           v_acc_type,
                                                           'Y');
            EXCEPTION
                WHEN OTHERS
                THEN
                    raise_error ('PROCESSING LMS ANNUITY PAYMENTS....');
            END;
        ELSE
            BEGIN
                SELECT pol_instlmt_prem, endr_tot_premium
                  INTO v_pol_instlmt_prem, v_endr_tot_premium
                  FROM lms_policies, lms_policy_endorsements
                 WHERE     pol_current_endr_code = endr_code
                       AND pol_code = v_pol_code;
            EXCEPTION
                WHEN OTHERS
                THEN
                    raise_error ('ERROR checking policy dtls..');
            END;

            IF v_endr_tot_premium != v_pol_instlmt_prem
            THEN
                raise_error (
                    'THE POLICY INSTLMT PREMIUM SHOULD BE EQUAL TO ENDORSEMENT TOT PREMIUM');
            END IF;

            BEGIN
                UPDATE lms_ord_proposal_rcpts
                   SET oppr_pol_code = v_pol_code
                 WHERE     oppr_pol_code IS NULL
                       AND oppr_pol_proposal_no IN
                               (SELECT pol_proposal_no
                                  FROM lms_policies
                                 WHERE     pol_proposal_no =
                                           oppr_pol_proposal_no
                                       AND pol_code = v_pol_code);
            EXCEPTION
                WHEN OTHERS
                THEN
                    raise_error ('ERROR UPDATING PROPOSAL RECEIPT DTLS..1..');
            END;

            BEGIN
                UPDATE lms_ord_proposal_rcpts
                   SET oppr_pol_code = v_pol_code
                 WHERE     oppr_pol_code IS NULL
                       AND oppr_pol_proposal_no IN
                               (SELECT pol_policy_no
                                  FROM lms_policies
                                 WHERE     pol_policy_no =
                                           oppr_pol_proposal_no
                                       AND pol_code = v_pol_code);
            EXCEPTION
                WHEN OTHERS
                THEN
                    raise_error ('ERROR UPDATING PROPOSAL RECEIPT DTLS..2..');
            END;

            v_updated_amt := 0;

            FOR prcts IN prp_rcpts
            LOOP
                v_update_amt := 0;
                v_receipt_date := prcts.oppr_receipt_date;

                BEGIN
                    SELECT    TO_NUMBER (TO_CHAR (SYSDATE, 'RRRR'))
                           || lms_opr_code_seq.NEXTVAL
                      INTO v_opr_code
                      FROM DUAL;
                EXCEPTION
                    WHEN OTHERS
                    THEN
                        raise_error (
                            'ERROR POPULATING POLICY RECEIPT SEQUENCE......');
                END;

                IF     prcts.pol_prod_type IN ('PN', 'IN', 'AN')
                   AND prcts.endr_grp_life_rider = 'N'
                THEN
                    v_alloc_to := 'PN';
                ELSE
                    v_alloc_to := 'PR';
                END IF;

                BEGIN
                    v_balance :=
                          NVL (prcts.oppr_amt, 0)
                        - NVL (prcts.oppr_total_ref_amt, 0);

                    INSERT INTO lms_ord_prem_receipts (opr_code,
                                                       opr_ltr_trans_no,
                                                       opr_date,
                                                       opr_cheque_no,
                                                       opr_amt,
                                                       opr_pol_code,
                                                       opr_pol_policy_no,
                                                       opr_receipt_no,
                                                       opr_receipt_date,
                                                       opr_pmth_code,
                                                       opr_done_by,
                                                       opr_drcr,
                                                       opr_production_date,
                                                       opr_within_system,
                                                       opr_origin,
                                                       opr_alloc_to,
                                                       opr_source,
                                                       opr_chk_agen_code,
                                                       opr_chk_comm_rate,
                                                       opr_chk_comm,
                                                       opr_fms_receipt_pk,
                                                       opr_deduction_date,
                                                       opr_rad_code,
                                                       opr_oppr_code,
                                                       opr_pay_comm)
                             VALUES (
                                 v_opr_code,
                                 prcts.oppr_ltr_trans_no,
                                 TRUNC (SYSDATE),
                                 prcts.oppr_cheque_no,
                                 v_balance,
                                 prcts.oppr_pol_code,
                                 v_pol_policy_no,
                                 prcts.oppr_receipt_no,
                                 prcts.oppr_receipt_date,
                                 prcts.oppr_pmth_code,
                                 prcts.oppr_done_by,
                                 NVL (prcts.oppr_drcr, 'C'),
                                 v_prodctn_date,
                                 NVL (prcts.oppr_within_system, 'Y'),
                                 'I',
                                 v_alloc_to,
                                 'POLICY_CONVERSION',
                                 prcts.endr_checkoff_agen_code,
                                 prcts.chkoff_rate,
                                 ((prcts.chkoff_rate / 100) * v_balance),
                                 prcts.oppr_fms_receipt_pk,
                                 prcts.oppr_deduction_date,
                                 prcts.oppr_rad_code,
                                 prcts.oppr_code,
                                 prcts.oppr_pay_comm);
                EXCEPTION
                    WHEN OTHERS
                    THEN
                        raise_error (
                            'ERROR INSERTING POLICY RECEIPT DETAILS......');
                END;

                --Process any exceptions related to allocations.
                /*BEGIN
                    lms_process_receipts.check_alloc_exception (
                        prcts.oppr_pol_code,
                        v_opr_code);
                EXCEPTION
                    WHEN OTHERS
                    THEN
                        raise_error ('Error Processing Receipt Exceptions.');
                END;*/

                IF NOT (   prcts.endr_grp_life_rider = 'N'
                        OR prcts.pol_prod_type IN ('IN', 'AN', 'PN'))
                THEN
                    SELECT DECODE (NVL (prcts.oppr_amt, 0),
                                   0, prcts.oppr_pens_amt,
                                   prcts.oppr_amt)
                      INTO v_bal_amt
                      FROM DUAL;
                ELSE
                    SELECT DECODE (NVL (prcts.oppr_pens_amt, 0),
                                   0, prcts.oppr_amt,
                                   prcts.oppr_pens_amt)
                      INTO v_bal_amt
                      FROM DUAL;
                END IF;



                --**************************** PENSION RECEIPTS *************************************
                IF (   prcts.pol_prod_type IN ('PN', 'IN', 'AN')
                    OR NVL (prcts.endr_inv_rider, 'N') = 'Y')
                THEN
                    --            RAISE_ERROR ('AM HERE'||v_chq_rcpt_no||'OOO'||prcts.oppr_receipt_no);
                    IF     prcts.oppr_cheque_no IS NULL
                       AND prcts.oppr_receipt_no IS NULL
                    THEN
                        v_chq_rcpt_no := ' ';
                    ELSIF prcts.oppr_receipt_no IS NULL
                    THEN
                        v_chq_rcpt_no := prcts.oppr_cheque_no;
                    ELSIF prcts.oppr_cheque_no IS NULL
                    THEN
                        v_chq_rcpt_no := prcts.oppr_receipt_no;
                    ELSE
                        v_chq_rcpt_no := prcts.oppr_receipt_no;
                    END IF;

                    BEGIN
                        SELECT popns_employer_contr,
                               popns_employee_contr,
                               popns_total_contr
                          INTO v_er_contri, v_ee_contri, v_tot_contri
                          FROM lms_policy_endorsements,
                               lms_policies,
                               lms_pol_ord_pension_dtls,
                               lms_pol_ord_active_pensions
                         WHERE     endr_code = pol_current_endr_code
                               AND popns_pol_code = pol_code
                               AND pol_code = v_pol_code
                               AND poapn_pol_code = popns_pol_code
                               AND poapn_endr_code = endr_code
                               AND poapn_popns_code = popns_code
                               AND popns_status = 'A';
                    EXCEPTION
                        WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND
                        THEN
                            NULL;
                        WHEN TOO_MANY_ROWS
                        THEN
                            raise_error (
                                'MORE THAN ONE ACTIVE PENSION RECORD FOUND');
                        WHEN OTHERS
                        THEN
                            raise_error (
                                'COULD NOT DETERMINE MONTHLY PENSION PAYMENTS..');
                    END;

                    --**************PROCESS INTEREST ACCRUED******************
                    IF NVL (prcts.endr_add_prem_int, 0) >
                       NVL (v_updated_amt, 0)
                    THEN
                        IF NVL (v_bal_amt, 0) >=
                             NVL (prcts.endr_add_prem_int, 0)
                           - NVL (v_updated_amt, 0)
                        THEN
                            v_update_amt :=
                                  NVL (prcts.endr_add_prem_int, 0)
                                - NVL (v_updated_amt, 0);
                        ELSE
                            v_update_amt := v_bal_amt;
                        END IF;

                        v_updated_amt :=
                            NVL (v_updated_amt, 0) + NVL (v_update_amt, 0);
                        v_bal_amt :=
                            NVL (v_bal_amt, 0) - NVL (v_update_amt, 0);

                        BEGIN
                            UPDATE lms_ord_prem_receipts
                               SET opr_reinst_int_amt =
                                         NVL (opr_reinst_int_amt, 0)
                                       + NVL (v_update_amt, 0)
                             WHERE opr_code = v_opr_code;
                        EXCEPTION
                            WHEN OTHERS
                            THEN
                                raise_error (
                                    'UNABLE TO UPDATE ALLOCATION TO INTEREST..1..');
                        END;

                        v_endr_add_prem_int :=
                              NVL (v_endr_add_prem_int, 0)
                            + NVL (v_update_amt, 0);
                    END IF;

                    --***********************************************************

                    --               IF prcts.pol_prod_type IN ('PN')
                    --               THEN
                    --                  BEGIN
                    --                     lms_ord_pensions.process_pension_payments
                    --                                                    (v_pol_code,
                    --                                                     v_opr_code,
                    --                                                     v_chq_rcpt_no,
                    --                                                     v_amt,     --v_er_contri,
                    --                                                     v_bal_amt, --v_ee_contri,
                    --                                                     v_bal_amt
                    --                                                    );        --v_tot_contri);
                    --                  EXCEPTION
                    --                     WHEN OTHERS
                    --                     THEN
                    --                        raise_error ('PROCESS PENS. CONTRI...');
                    --                  END;
                    --               ELSE
                    BEGIN
                        lms_investments.process_receipt (v_pol_code,
                                                         v_opr_code,
                                                         v_tran_no);
                    --               EXCEPTION
                    --                  WHEN OTHERS
                    --                  THEN
                    --                     raise_error ('PROCESS INV. CONTRI...');
                    END;
                --             END IF;
                END IF;

                BEGIN
                    SELECT agn_act_code
                      INTO v_acc_type
                      FROM lms_agencies,
                           lms_policy_endorsements,
                           lms_policies
                     WHERE     endr_code = pol_current_endr_code
                           AND agn_code = endr_agen_code
                           AND pol_code = v_pol_code;
                ---BY WAIYAKI******************
                --FMS HAS DEFINED   DIRECT AND CK OFF CONTROL ACTS ONLY
                --OTHERS eg in hse agents SHOULD THUS DEFAULT TO DIRECT
                -- 1 = DIRECT 13  = CHECK OFF
                EXCEPTION
                    WHEN OTHERS
                    THEN
                        raise_error (
                            'SYSTEM UNABLE TO DETERMINE AGENCY TYPE FOR ');
                END;

                --******************************** PREMIUM RECEIPTS *******************************
                IF     NVL (v_balance, 0) > 0
                   AND NOT (   (prcts.pol_prod_type IN ('IN', 'AN', 'PN'))
                            OR (NVL (prcts.endr_inv_rider, 'N') = 'Y'))
                THEN
                    v_only_due_inst := 'N';

                    --**************PROCESS INTEREST ACCRUED******************
                    IF NVL (prcts.endr_add_prem_int, 0) >
                       NVL (v_updated_amt, 0)
                    THEN
                        IF NVL (v_bal_amt, 0) >=
                             NVL (prcts.endr_add_prem_int, 0)
                           - NVL (v_updated_amt, 0)
                        THEN
                            v_update_amt :=
                                  NVL (prcts.endr_add_prem_int, 0)
                                - NVL (v_updated_amt, 0);
                        ELSE
                            v_update_amt := v_bal_amt;
                        END IF;

                        v_updated_amt :=
                            NVL (v_updated_amt, 0) + NVL (v_update_amt, 0);
                        v_bal_amt :=
                            NVL (v_bal_amt, 0) - NVL (v_update_amt, 0);

                        BEGIN
                            UPDATE lms_ord_prem_receipts
                               SET opr_reinst_int_amt =
                                         NVL (opr_reinst_int_amt, 0)
                                       + NVL (v_update_amt, 0)
                             WHERE opr_code = v_opr_code;
                        EXCEPTION
                            WHEN OTHERS
                            THEN
                                raise_error (
                                    'UNABLE TO UPDATE ALLOCATION TO INTEREST..2..');
                        END;

                        v_endr_add_prem_int :=
                              NVL (v_endr_add_prem_int, 0)
                            + NVL (v_update_amt, 0);
                    END IF;
