                    --*****************************************************

                    BEGIN
                        IF NVL (v_full_inst_param, 'N') = 'Y'
                        THEN
                            lms_process_receipts.clear_partial_installments (
                                v_pol_code,
                                v_opr_code,
                                NULL,
                                'N');
                        ELSE
                            lms_process_receipts.lms_ord_premium_receipts (
                                v_pol_code,
                                v_opr_code,
                                v_multiple_inst,
                                v_only_due_inst,
                                v_tran_no,
                                v_acc_type,
                                v_bal_amt,
                                NVL (v_compute_comm, 'Y'));
                        END IF;
                    --               EXCEPTION
                    --                  WHEN OTHERS
                    --                  THEN
                    --                     raise_error ('PROCESS LMS PREM PYMTS...');
                    END;
                END IF;

                IF NVL (v_acc_type, 0) NOT IN (1, 13)
                THEN
                    v_acc_type := 1;
                END IF;

                v_post := 'Y';
            END LOOP;
        END IF;

        IF     lms_api.interface_enabled ('POLCONV') = TRUE
           AND NVL (v_post, 'N') = 'Y'
        THEN
            v_gl_count := -1;
            v_credit := 0;

            SELECT    TO_NUMBER (TO_CHAR (SYSDATE, 'RRRR'))
                   || lms_transaction_seq.NEXTVAL
              INTO v_trans_code
              FROM DUAL;

            IF v_acc_type IS NULL
            THEN
                raise_error ('ACC TYPE IS NULL');
            END IF;

            IF NVL (v_prod_type, 'ED') = 'AN' AND 1 = 2              --BLOCKED
            THEN
                FOR an IN cur_ann_amt
                LOOP
                    v_org_code :=
                        fms_interfaces_pkg.get_org (an.ann_brn_code);
                    v_polcode := NULL;

                    IF NVL (v_inst_prem, 0) <> 0
                    THEN
                        get_gl_code ('UP',
                                     an.ann_prod_code,
                                     v_trnt_code,
                                     v_trnt_gl_code,
                                     v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
                        valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                                   v_org_code,
                                   an.ann_brn_code,
                                   'UP');
                        get_gl_code ('PRRCT',
                                     an.ann_prod_code,
                                     v_trnt_code,
                                     v_contra_acc,
                                     v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
                        valid_acc (v_contra_acc,
                                   v_org_code,
                                   an.ann_brn_code,
                                   'PRRCT');
                        v_gl_count := v_gl_count + 2;
                        interface_append_gl (
                            v_trans_code,
                            --v_trans_code         NUMBER,
                            v_user_name,
                            --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                            NULL,                --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                            an.ann_prod_code,
                            --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                            v_pol_policy_no,
                            --v_vchr_no           VARCHAR2,
                            v_ann_opr_code,
                            --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                            NULL,                --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                            NULL,               --v_rcpt_no          VARCHAR2,
                            v_gl_count,
                            --v_count             NUMBER,
                            'PREMIUM INCOME-' || v_pol_policy_no,
                            --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                            v_inst_prem,
                            --v_amount            NUMBER,
                            'C',               --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                            v_trnt_gl_code,
                            --v_acc_1          VARCHAR2,
                            v_contra_acc,
                            --v_acc_2          VARCHAR2,
                            an.ann_brn_code,
                            --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                            v_gl_trans,
                            NULL,
                            --v_cad_code       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                            NULL,
                            --v_otop_code              NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                            NULL,
                            --v_fpmt_code              NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                            NULL,
                            --v_ort_code               NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                            NULL,
                            --v_btr_no                 NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                            NULL,
                            --v_ppr_code               NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                            NULL,
                            --v_ocl_code                NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                            NULL,
                            --v_agn_code                NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                            NULL,
                            --v_trans_no                NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                            v_cvrg_area,
                            --v_covrg_area_code                NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                            v_spoke_code,
                            --v_spoke_code                NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                            v_sbu_code,
                            --v_sbu_code                NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                            v_location_code--v_loc_code                NUMBER DEFAULT NULL
                                           );
                    --v_trn_rec   IN OUT Fms_Vouchers_Pkg.Tgl_rec_type,
                    END IF;
                END LOOP;
            ELSE
                FOR pl IN cur_pol_cb_amt
                LOOP
                    --               raise_error('pl.premium_amt=='||pl.premium_amt||' pl.comfnd=='||pl.comfnd||
                    --                            ' pl.investment_fee=='||pl.investment_fee);
                    v_loop_cnt := v_loop_cnt + 1;
                    v_org_code :=
                        fms_interfaces_pkg.get_org (pl.pol_bra_code);

                    IF pl.opr_receipt_no = 'FROM_GROSS_UP'
                    THEN
                        get_gl_code ('SHT_OVG',
                                     pl.pol_prod_code,
                                     v_trnt_code,
                                     v_contra_acc,
                                     v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                     NULL,
                                     pl.renewal);
                        valid_acc (v_contra_acc,
                                   v_org_code,
                                   pl.pol_bra_code,
                                   'SHT_OVG');
                    ELSE
                        get_gl_code ('PRRCT',
                                     pl.pol_prod_code,
                                     v_trnt_code,
                                     v_contra_acc,
                                     v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                     NULL,
                                     pl.renewal);
                        valid_acc (v_contra_acc,
                                   v_org_code,
                                   pl.pol_bra_code,
                                   'PRRCT');
                    END IF;

                    --premium
                    IF NVL (pl.premium_amt, 0) <> 0
                    THEN
                        --IF we do not post fees separately Then wee add it to the life cover Prem
                        IF NVL (v_post_fees_sep, 'Y') = 'N'
                           AND NVL (v_include_fee, 'N') = 'N'
                        THEN
                            v_prem :=
                                  NVL (pl.premium_amt, 0)
                                + NVL (
                                      lms_process_receipts.pol_holder_alloc (
                                          v_pol_code,
                                          'INST'),
                                      0);
                        ELSE
                            v_prem := pl.premium_amt;
                        END IF;

                        get_gl_code ('UP',
                                     pl.pol_prod_code,
                                     v_trnt_code,
                                     v_trnt_gl_code,
                                     v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                     NULL,
                                     pl.renewal);
                        valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                                   v_org_code,
                                   pl.pol_bra_code,
                                   'UP');
                        v_gl_count := v_gl_count + 2;
                        interface_append_gl (
                            v_trans_code,
                            --v_trans_code         NUMBER,
                            v_user_name,
                            --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                            v_pol_code,
                            --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                            pl.pol_prod_code,
                            --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                            pl.pol_policy_no,
                            --v_vchr_no          VARCHAR2,
                            pl.opr_code,                   --          NUMBER,
                            NULL,                --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                            pl.opr_receipt_no,  --v_rcpt_no          VARCHAR2,
                            v_gl_count,
                            --v_count             NUMBER,
                            'PREMIUM INCOME-' || pl.pol_policy_no,
                            --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                            --pl.premium_amt,
                            v_prem,
                            --v_amount            NUMBER,
                            'C',               --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                            v_trnt_gl_code,
                            --v_acc_1          VARCHAR2,
                            v_contra_acc,
                            --v_acc_2          VARCHAR2,
                            pl.pol_bra_code,
                            --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                            v_gl_trans,
                            NULL,
                            --v_cad_code       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                            NULL,
                            --v_otop_code              NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                            NULL,
                            --v_fpmt_code              NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                            NULL,
                            --v_ort_code               NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                            NULL,
                            --v_btr_no                 NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                            NULL,
                            --v_ppr_code               NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                            NULL,
                            --v_ocl_code                NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                            NULL,
                            --v_agn_code                NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                            NULL,
                            --v_trans_no                NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                            v_cvrg_area,
                            --v_covrg_area_code                NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                            v_spoke_code,
                            --v_spoke_code                NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                            v_sbu_code,
                            --v_sbu_code                NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                            v_location_code--v_loc_code                NUMBER DEFAULT NULL
                                           );

                get_gl_code ('PRRCT',
                             v_prod_code,
                             v_trnt_code,
                             v_contra_acc,
                             v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
                valid_acc (v_contra_acc,
                           v_org_code,
                           v_pol_bra_code,
                           'AGNT_DBT CONTRA');
                v_gl_count := v_gl_count + 2;
                interface_append_gl (
                    v_trans_code,                --v_trans_code        NUMBER,
                    v_user_name,               --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                    v_pol_code,                  --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                    v_prod_code,
                    --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                    v_pol_policy_no,
                    --v_vchr_no          VARCHAR2,
                    NULL,                        --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                    v_agn_oppr_code,
                    --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                    v_rct_code,                 --v_rcpt_no          VARCHAR2,
                    v_gl_count,                  --v_count             NUMBER,
                       'DEBITING AGENT: '
                    || v_agn_sht_desc
                    || ' - '
                    || v_pol_policy_no,
                    --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                    v_agn_dbt_amt,               --v_amount            NUMBER,
                    'C',                       --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                    v_contra_acc,                 --v_acc_1          VARCHAR2,
                    v_trnt_gl_code,                --v_acc_2         VARCHAR2,
                    v_pol_bra_code,              --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                    v_gl_trans,
                    --v_trn_rec   IN OUT Fms_Vouchers_Pkg.Tgl_rec_type,
                    NULL,
                    --v_cad_code       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                    NULL,
                    --v_otop_code              NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                    NULL,
                    --v_fpmt_code              NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                    NULL,
                    --v_ort_code               NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                    NULL,
                    --v_btr_no                 NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                    NULL,
                    --v_ppr_code               NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                    NULL,
                    --v_ocl_code                NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                    NULL,
                    --v_agn_code                NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                    NULL,
                    --v_trans_no                NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                    v_cvrg_area,
                    --v_covrg_area_code                NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                    v_spoke_code,
                    --v_spoke_code                NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                    v_sbu_code,
                    --v_sbu_code                NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                    v_location_code--v_loc_code                NUMBER DEFAULT NULL
                                   );
            END IF;

            v_unalloc_amt := 0;
            interface_update_vgl (v_trans_code,     --v_trans_code     NUMBER,
                                  v_user_name, --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                                  v_polcode,     --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                                  NVL (v_receipt_date, TRUNC (SYSDATE)), --v_date              DATE,
                                  NULL,          --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                                  NULL,          --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                                  'LMS PROPOSAL CONVERSION',
                                  --v_btc_description   VARCHAR2,
                                  'JV',     --v_btc_type             VARCHAR2,
                                  v_pol_bra_code, --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                                  'PROPOSAL CONVERSION VOUCHER',
                                  --v_description       VARCHAR2,
                                  v_pol_policy_no, --v_ref             VARCHAR2,
                                  v_gl_trans);
        --v_gl_trans  IN OUT  Fms_Vouchers_Pkg.Tgl_rec_type,
        END IF;

        --raise_error('am here now...');
        IF v_gl_count = 0
        THEN
            raise_application_error (-20001, 'JV NOT CREATED');
        END IF;
    --   EXCEPTION
    --      WHEN OTHERS
    --      THEN
    --         raise_application_error (-20001,
    --                                  'POL CONVERSION . ' || SQLERRM (SQLCODE)
    --                                 );
    END policy_conversion_rcpts;

    PROCEDURE cancel_receipt (v_rct_code VARCHAR2)
    IS
        v_cnt   NUMBER;

        CURSOR recpl IS
            SELECT opr_code,
                   opr_amt,
                   opr_pol_code,
                   opr_receipt_no,
                   opr_tracking_no
              FROM lms_ord_prem_receipts
             WHERE opr_receipt_no = v_rct_code;

        CURSOR recpr IS
            SELECT oppr_code,
                   oppr_amt,
                   oppr_pol_code,
                   oppr_receipt_no
              FROM lms_ord_proposal_rcpts
             WHERE oppr_receipt_no = v_rct_code;
    BEGIN
        raise_error (
            'REFER TO SYSTEM ADMIN.....(CALL THE CANCELLATION PROCEDURE IN LMS_INTERFACES_PKG FOR THIS TRANSACTION...)');
    END cancel_receipt;

    PROCEDURE update_loan_appl (
        v_loan_no    VARCHAR2,
        v_chq_no     VARCHAR2,
        v_chq_date   DATE,
        v_chq_amt    NUMBER,
        v_user       VARCHAR2
    )
    IS
        v_pol_code   NUMBER;
    BEGIN
        BEGIN
            SELECT lna_pol_code
              INTO v_pol_code
              FROM lms_loan_applications
             WHERE lna_no = v_loan_no;
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND
            THEN
                raise_error (
                       'Error retrieving loan details related to loan number'
                    || v_loan_no);
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                raise_error ('Error retrieving loan  details');
        END;

        BEGIN
            UPDATE lms_loan_applications
               SET lna_chq_no = v_chq_no,
                   lna_chq_date = v_chq_date,
                   lna_chq_update_date = SYSDATE,
                   lna_chq_update_by = v_user,
                   lna_chq_amt = v_chq_amt
             WHERE lna_no = v_loan_no;
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                raise_error ('Unable to update loan application details....');
        END;

        BEGIN
            lms_ord_trans.update_cheque_incidence (v_pol_code,
                                                   v_chq_date,
                                                   v_chq_no,
                                                   v_user,
                                                   'LN',
                                                   v_loan_no);
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                raise_error ('Error updating loan cheque incidence');
        END;

        BEGIN
            lms_process_alerts.pol_dets_event_alert (v_pol_code,
                                                     'LOAN_MSG',
                                                     'LOAN_MSG');
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                NULL;
        END;
    END update_loan_appl;

    PROCEDURE update_vchr_pymt (
        v_vchr_no    VARCHAR2,
        v_pol_code   NUMBER,
        v_chq_no     VARCHAR2,
        v_chq_date   DATE,
        v_done_by    VARCHAR2,
        v_chq_amt    NUMBER,
        v_type       VARCHAR2 DEFAULT NULL
    )
    IS
        v_cla_type                     VARCHAR2 (5);
        v_pol_prop_no                  VARCHAR2 (50);
        v_mtran_code                   NUMBER (22);
        v_mtran_date                   DATE;
        v_mtran_ref_no                 VARCHAR2 (100);
        v_mtran_other_ref              VARCHAR2 (30);
        v_mtran_tran_type              VARCHAR2 (4);
        v_mtran_dc                     VARCHAR2 (1);
        v_mtran_control_acc            VARCHAR2 (15);
        v_mtran_client_type            VARCHAR2 (3);
        v_mtran_client_code            NUMBER (22);
        v_mtran_amount                 NUMBER (27, 5);
        v_mtran_balance                NUMBER (27, 5);
        v_mtran_pol_code               NUMBER (22);
        v_mtran_cmb_claim_no           VARCHAR2 (25);
        v_mtran_narrations             VARCHAR2 (60);
        v_mtran_doc_date               DATE;
        v_mtran_pol_polcy_no           VARCHAR2 (26);
        v_mtran_endr_no                VARCHAR2 (26);
        v_mtran_prp_code               NUMBER (22);
        v_mtran_ltr_trans_no           NUMBER (22);
        v_mtran_authorised             VARCHAR2 (1);
        v_mtran_date_authorized        DATE;
        v_mtran_authorised_by          VARCHAR2 (30);
        v_mtran_acct_code              VARCHAR2 (15);
        v_mtran_prod_sht_desc          VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_mtran_prod_code              NUMBER (22);
        v_mtran_net_amt                NUMBER (30, 5);
        v_mtran_posting_date           DATE;
        v_mtran_origin                 VARCHAR2 (1);
        v_mtran_btr_trans_code         VARCHAR2 (15);
        v_mtran_sd                     NUMBER (25, 5);
        v_mtran_whtx                   NUMBER (25, 5);
        v_mtran_extras                 NUMBER (25, 5);
        v_mtran_commission             NUMBER (25, 5);
        v_mtran_rei_code               NUMBER (22);
        v_mtran_brn_code               NUMBER (15);
        v_mtran_trans_effective_date   DATE;
        v_mtran_agen_code              NUMBER (15);
        v_mtran_cla_type               VARCHAR2 (3);
    BEGIN
        BEGIN
            SELECT NVL (pol_policy_no, pol_proposal_no), cla_type
              INTO v_pol_prop_no, v_cla_type
              FROM lms_policies, lms_classes
             WHERE pol_cla_code = cla_code AND pol_code = v_pol_code;
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                raise_error ('Unable to retrieve policy details....');
        END;

        IF v_cla_type = 'O'
        THEN
            BEGIN
                UPDATE lms_pol_payment_vouchers
                   SET ppv_cheque_no = v_chq_no,
                       ppv_cheque_date = v_chq_date,
                       ppv_cheque_updated_by = v_done_by,
                       ppv_cheque_update_dt = SYSDATE,
                       ppv_cheque_amt = v_chq_amt
                 WHERE     ppv_voucher_no = v_vchr_no
                       AND ppv_pol_code = v_pol_code;
            EXCEPTION
                WHEN OTHERS
                THEN
                    raise_error (
                           'Unable to update voucher cheque details for Policy/Proposal No. '
                        || v_pol_prop_no
                        || '....');
            END;

            BEGIN
                lms_ord_trans.update_cheque_incidence (v_pol_code,
                                                       v_chq_date,
                                                       v_chq_no,
                                                       v_done_by,
                                                       'PL');
            EXCEPTION
                WHEN OTHERS
                THEN
                    raise_error (
                        'Err updating Ord Pol Cancellation cheque incidence');
            END;

            BEGIN
                lms_process_alerts.pol_dets_event_alert (v_pol_code,
                                                         v_type || '_MSG',
                                                         v_type || '_MSG');
            EXCEPTION
                WHEN OTHERS
                THEN
                    NULL;
            END;
        ELSIF v_cla_type = 'G'
        THEN
            /*BEGIN
               UPDATE LMS_POLICY_ENDORSEMENTS
               SET ENDR_CHEQUE_NO = v_chq_no,
                     ENDR_CHEQUE_DATE = v_chq_date,
                     ENDR_CHEQUE_UPDATED_BY = v_done_by,
                     ENDR_CHEQUE_UPDATE_DT = SYSDATE,
                     ENDR_CHEQUE_AMT = v_chq_amt
               WHERE ENDR_CODE = v_vchr_no
               AND ENDR_POL_CODE = v_pol_code;
            EXCEPTION
               WHEN OTHERS THEN
                  Raise_error('Unable to update voucher cheque details for Policy/Proposal No. '||v_pol_prop_no||'....');
            END;*/
            --fred marked
            BEGIN
                SELECT mtran_code,
                       mtran_date,
                       mtran_ref_no,
                       mtran_other_ref,
                       mtran_tran_type,
                       mtran_dc,
                       mtran_control_acc,
                       mtran_client_type,
                       mtran_client_code,
                       mtran_amount,
                       mtran_balance,
                       mtran_pol_code,
                       mtran_cmb_claim_no,
                       mtran_narrations,
                       mtran_doc_date,
                       mtran_pol_polcy_no,
                       mtran_endr_no,
                       mtran_prp_code,
                       mtran_ltr_trans_no,
                       mtran_authorised,
                       mtran_date_authorized,
                       mtran_authorised_by,
                       mtran_acct_code,
                       mtran_prod_sht_desc,
                       mtran_prod_code,
                       mtran_net_amt,
                       mtran_posting_date,
                       mtran_origin,
                       mtran_btr_trans_code,
                       mtran_sd,
                       mtran_whtx,
                       mtran_extras,
                       mtran_commission,
                       mtran_rei_code,
                       mtran_brn_code,
                       mtran_trans_effective_date,
                       mtran_agen_code,
                       mtran_cla_type
                  INTO v_mtran_code,
                       v_mtran_date,
                       v_mtran_ref_no,
                       v_mtran_other_ref,
                       v_mtran_tran_type,
                       v_mtran_dc,
                       v_mtran_control_acc,
                       v_mtran_client_type,
                       v_mtran_client_code,
                       v_mtran_amount,
                       v_mtran_balance,
                       v_mtran_pol_code,
                       v_mtran_cmb_claim_no,
                       v_mtran_narrations,
                       v_mtran_doc_date,
                       v_mtran_pol_polcy_no,
                       v_mtran_endr_no,
                       v_mtran_prp_code,
                       v_mtran_ltr_trans_no,
                       v_mtran_authorised,
                       v_mtran_date_authorized,
                       v_mtran_authorised_by,
                       v_mtran_acct_code,
                       v_mtran_prod_sht_desc,
                       v_mtran_prod_code,
                       v_mtran_net_amt,
                       v_mtran_posting_date,
                       v_mtran_origin,
                       v_mtran_btr_trans_code,
                       v_mtran_sd,
                       v_mtran_whtx,
                       v_mtran_extras,
                       v_mtran_commission,
                       v_mtran_rei_code,
                       v_mtran_brn_code,
                       v_mtran_trans_effective_date,
                       v_mtran_agen_code,
                       v_mtran_cla_type
                  FROM lms_master_transactions, lms_policy_endorsements
                 WHERE     mtran_pol_code = endr_pol_code
                       AND mtran_endr_code = endr_code
                       AND NVL (mtran_tran_type, 'X') IN ('RP','RPC')
                       AND mtran_pol_code = v_pol_code
                       AND endr_code = v_vchr_no;
            EXCEPTION
                WHEN OTHERS
                THEN
                    raise_error (
                           'Unable to retrieve endorsement Master Details....v_vchr_no='||v_vchr_no||'; v_pol_code='||v_pol_code||'  --'
                        || SQLERRM (SQLCODE));
            END;

            BEGIN
                v_mtran_code := NULL;

                SELECT    TO_NUMBER (TO_CHAR (SYSDATE, 'YYYY'))
                       || lms_mtran_code_seq.NEXTVAL
                  INTO v_mtran_code
                  FROM DUAL;

                INSERT INTO lms_master_transactions (
                                mtran_code,
                                mtran_date,
                                mtran_ref_no,
                                mtran_other_ref,
                                mtran_tran_type,
                                mtran_dc,
                                mtran_control_acc,
                                mtran_client_type,
                                mtran_client_code,
                                mtran_amount,
                                mtran_balance,
                                mtran_pol_code,
                                mtran_narrations,
                                mtran_prp_code,
                                mtran_pol_polcy_no,
                                mtran_endr_no,
                                mtran_ltr_trans_no,
                                mtran_acct_code,
                                mtran_prod_sht_desc,
                                mtran_prod_code,
                                mtran_authorised,
                                mtran_date_authorized,
                                mtran_authorised_by,
                                mtran_posting_date,
                                mtran_net_amt,
                                mtran_origin,
                                mtran_btr_trans_code,
                                mtran_sd,
                                mtran_whtx,
                                mtran_extras,
                                mtran_commission,
                                mtran_trans_effective_date,
                                mtran_agen_code,
                                mtran_cla_type)
                     VALUES (v_mtran_code,
                             TRUNC (v_chq_date),
                             'CHQ/' || v_chq_no,
                             NULL,
                             'CHQ',
                             DECODE (SIGN (NVL (v_chq_amt, 0)), 1, 'D', 'C'),
                             v_mtran_control_acc,
                             v_mtran_client_type,
                             v_mtran_client_code,
                             ABS (ROUND (NVL (v_chq_amt, 0))),
                             ABS (ROUND (NVL (v_chq_amt, 0))),
                             v_mtran_pol_code,
                             'Cheque For - ' || v_mtran_ref_no,
                             v_mtran_prp_code,
                             v_mtran_pol_polcy_no,
                             v_mtran_endr_no,
                             v_mtran_ltr_trans_no,
                             v_mtran_acct_code,
                             v_mtran_prod_sht_desc,
                             v_mtran_prod_code,
                             'Y',
                             TRUNC (SYSDATE),
                             v_done_by,
                             TRUNC (SYSDATE),
                             ABS (ROUND (NVL (v_chq_amt, 0))),
                             'F',
                             'CHQ',
                             0,
                             0,
                             0,
                             0,
                             TRUNC (SYSDATE),
                             v_mtran_agen_code,
                             v_mtran_cla_type);
            EXCEPTION
                WHEN OTHERS
                THEN
                    raise_error (
                           'Unable to update voucher cheque details for Policy/Proposal No. '
                        || v_pol_prop_no
                        || '....');
            END;
        ELSE
            raise_error (
                   'Class of life undefined for Policy/Proposal No. '
                || v_pol_prop_no
                || '....');

            BEGIN
                lms_ord_trans.update_cheque_incidence (v_pol_code,
                                                       v_chq_date,
                                                       v_chq_no,
                                                       v_done_by,
                                                       'PL');
            EXCEPTION
                WHEN OTHERS
                THEN
                    raise_error ('Error updating Grp pol cheque incidence');
            END;
        END IF;
    END update_vchr_pymt;

    PROCEDURE update_claims (
        v_clm_no     VARCHAR2,
        v_chq_no     VARCHAR2,
        v_chq_date   DATE,
        v_vchr_no    VARCHAR2,
        v_chq_amt    NUMBER,
        v_user       VARCHAR2
    )
    IS
        v_vchr_amt        NUMBER;
        v_pol_code        VARCHAR2 (30);
        v_pol_prod_type   lms_policies.pol_prod_type%TYPE;
        v_cla_code        NUMBER;
        v_dty_code        NUMBER;
        v_caus_type       VARCHAR2 (10);
    BEGIN
        BEGIN
            SELECT clm_pol_code,
                   pol_prod_type,
                   pol_cla_code,
                   clm_dty_code,
                   clm_caus_type
              INTO v_pol_code,
                   v_pol_prod_type,
                   v_cla_code,
                   v_dty_code,
                   v_caus_type
              FROM lms_claims, lms_policies
             WHERE clm_no = v_clm_no AND clm_pol_code = pol_code;
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND
            THEN
                NULL;
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                raise_error (
                       'Unable to retrieve Policy Code Related To Claim No'
                    || v_clm_no);
        END;


        BEGIN
            UPDATE lms_clm_payment_vouchers
               SET cpv_cheque_no = v_chq_no,
                   cpv_cheque_date = v_chq_date,
                   cpv_chq_update_by = v_user,
                   cpv_chq_update_date = SYSDATE,
                   cpv_chq_amt = v_chq_amt
             WHERE     cpv_voucher_no || cpv_ben_code = v_vchr_no
                   AND cpv_clm_no = v_clm_no;
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                raise_error ('Unable to update claims voucher details....');
        END;

        --If we do it via maturities screen
        BEGIN
            UPDATE lms_no_claim_disc
               SET ncd_cheque_no = v_chq_no,
                   ncd_cheque_date = v_chq_date,
                   ncd_chq_update_by = v_user,
                   ncd_chq_update_date = SYSDATE,
                   ncd_chq_amt = v_chq_amt
             WHERE TO_CHAR (ncd_code) = v_clm_no;
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                raise_error ('Unable to update claims voucher details....');
        END;

        BEGIN
            lms_ord_trans.update_cheque_incidence (v_pol_code,
                                                   v_chq_date,
                                                   v_chq_no,
                                                   v_user,
                                                   'CLM',
                                                   NULL,
                                                   v_clm_no);
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                raise_error ('Error updating claim cheque incidence');
        END;

        IF v_pol_prod_type IN ('EDUC')
        THEN
            UPDATE lms_beneficiary_payments
               SET bpy_paid = 'Y'
             WHERE bpy_voucher_no = v_vchr_no;
        END IF;

        IF     v_cla_code = 20021
           AND v_dty_code IS NOT NULL
           AND NOT (v_dty_code = 1000 AND v_caus_type = 'DTH')
        THEN
            BEGIN
                lms_process_alerts.pol_dets_event_alert (
                    v_pol_code,
                    v_caus_type || '_MSG',
                    v_caus_type || '_MSG');
            EXCEPTION
                WHEN OTHERS
                THEN
                    NULL;
            END;
        END IF;
    END update_claims;

    PROCEDURE create_gl_voucher (
        v_gltran_tran_no   NUMBER,
        v_description      VARCHAR2,
        v_user_name        VARCHAR2,
        v_agent_code       NUMBER,
        v_uw_or_clm        VARCHAR2:= 'U',
        v_posting_date     DATE DEFAULT NULL
    )
    IS
        vgl_trans               fms_vouchers_pkg.tgl_rec_type;
        v_gl_cur_code           NUMBER;
        v_gl_brn_code           NUMBER;

        CURSOR c_gl_brh IS
              SELECT gltran_brn_code,
                     gltran_cur_code,
                     gltran_cur_symbol,
                     gltran_cur_rate,
                     gltran_debit_note_no,
                     gltran_pol_code
                FROM lms_gl_transactions
               WHERE     gltran_tran_no = v_gltran_tran_no
                     AND NVL (gltran_posted, 'N') = 'N'
            GROUP BY gltran_brn_code,
                     gltran_cur_code,
                     gltran_cur_symbol,
                     gltran_cur_rate,
                     gltran_debit_note_no,
                     gltran_pol_code;

        CURSOR c_gl_trans IS
            SELECT gltran_tran_no,
                   gltran_pol_code,
                   gltran_dc,
                   gltran_trnt_code,
                   gltran_amount,
                   gltran_gltran_acc,
                   gltran_contra_acc,
                   gltran_brn_code,
                   gltran_posted,
                   gltran_pro_code,
                   gltran_level,
                   gltran_debit_note_no,
                   NVL (gltran_claim_no, gltran_pol_policy_no)     narration
              FROM lms_gl_transactions
             WHERE     gltran_tran_no = v_gltran_tran_no
                   AND NVL (gltran_posted, 'N') = 'N'
                   AND gltran_brn_code = v_gl_brn_code;

        v_no                    NUMBER := 0;
        v_brh_code              NUMBER;
        vgl_code                NUMBER;
        v_cur_code              NUMBER;
        v_user_code             NUMBER;
        exc_user_error          EXCEPTION;
        v_control_acc           VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_pol_agnt_agent_code   NUMBER;
        v_client_type           VARCHAR2 (10);
        v_act_code              NUMBER;
        v_org_code              NUMBER;
        v_brh_name              VARCHAR2 (100);
        v_contra_acc            VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_product               VARCHAR2 (20);
        retval                  BOOLEAN;
        v_agnt_sht_desc         VARCHAR2 (15);
        v_trans_code            NUMBER;
        v_trans_batch           VARCHAR2 (30);
    BEGIN
        --raise_error('v_gltran_tran_no = '||v_gltran_tran_no);
        v_user_code := fms_interfaces_pkg.get_usercode (UPPER (v_user_name));
        v_trans_batch := 'LMS RI TRANS';

        SELECT    TO_NUMBER (TO_CHAR (SYSDATE, 'RRRR'))
               || lms_transaction_seq.NEXTVAL
          INTO v_trans_code
          FROM DUAL;

        BEGIN
            IF v_user_code IS NULL
            THEN
                RAISE exc_user_error;
            END IF;
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                raise_error (
                       'THE SPECIFIED USERNAME ( '
                    || v_user_name
                    || ' )  DOES NOT EXIST. CONTACT SYSTEM ADMIN.');
        END;

        FOR b IN c_gl_brh
        LOOP
            v_gl_brn_code := b.gltran_brn_code;
            v_gl_cur_code := lms_interfaces_pkg.lms_def_cur (v_gl_brn_code);
            v_org_code := fms_interfaces_pkg.get_org (b.gltran_brn_code);
            v_cur_code := b.gltran_cur_code;
            v_no := 0;
            vgl_trans.delete;


            FOR i IN c_gl_trans
            LOOP
                BEGIN
                    SELECT prod_sht_desc
                      INTO v_product
                      FROM lms_products
                     WHERE prod_code = i.gltran_pro_code;
                EXCEPTION
                    WHEN OTHERS
                    THEN
                        raise_error (
                            'UNABLE TO RETRIEVE PRODUCT DETAILS....');
                END;

                IF v_uw_or_clm = 'U'
                THEN
                    IF i.gltran_level = 'U'
                    THEN
                        IF NVL (v_agent_code, 0) = 0
                        THEN
                            v_client_type := 'D';
                        ELSE
                            -- RAISE_ERROR('v_act_code='||v_agent_code);
                            BEGIN
                                BEGIN
                                    SELECT agn_act_code, agn_sht_desc
                                      INTO v_act_code, v_agnt_sht_desc
                                      FROM tqc_agencies
                                     WHERE agn_code = v_agent_code;
                                EXCEPTION
                                    WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND
                                    THEN
                                        SELECT agn_act_code, agn_sht_desc
                                          INTO v_act_code, v_agnt_sht_desc
                                          FROM lms_agencies
                                         WHERE agn_code = v_agent_code;
                                END;

                                IF v_act_code IN (1,
                                                  2,
                                                  3,
                                                  9,
                                                  10,
                                                  15,
                                                  16,
                                                  67)
                                THEN
                                    v_client_type := 'A';
                                ELSIF v_act_code = 4
                                THEN
                                    v_client_type := 'FI';
                                ELSIF v_act_code = 5
                                THEN
                                    v_client_type := 'I';
                                ELSIF v_act_code = 6
                                THEN
                                    v_client_type := 'R';
                                ELSIF v_act_code = 7
                                THEN
                                    v_client_type := 'FO';
                                ELSE
                                    raise_application_error (
                                        -20001,
                                           'UNDEFINED ACCOUNT TYPE - '
                                        || v_act_code
                                        || ' - FOR AGENT '
                                        || v_agnt_sht_desc);
                                END IF;
                            EXCEPTION
                                WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND
                                THEN
                                    raise_application_error (
                                        -20001,
                                           'AGENT - '
                                        || v_agent_code
                                        || ' NOT FOUND ');
                                WHEN OTHERS
                                THEN
                                    raise_application_error (
                                        -20001,
                                        'AGENT INFO ' || SQLERRM (SQLCODE));
                            END;
                        END IF;

                        IF v_client_type IS NULL
                        THEN
                            raise_application_error (
                                -20001,
                                'CANNOT POST NULL CLIENT TYPE');
                        ELSE
                            v_control_acc := i.gltran_gltran_acc;
                        END IF;

                        v_contra_acc := i.gltran_contra_acc;
                    ELSIF i.gltran_level IN ('MAN',
                                             'FSTSUP',
                                             'SECSUP',
                                             'QST',
                                             'QUOTA')
                    THEN                               --QST  ADDED BY WAIYAKI
                        v_control_acc := i.gltran_gltran_acc;

                        IF v_control_acc IS NULL
                        THEN
                            v_control_acc :=
                                fms_interfaces_pkg.sl_control_acc (
                                    'LMS',
                                    'R',
                                    i.gltran_level);
                        END IF;

                        v_contra_acc := i.gltran_contra_acc;
                    ELSIF i.gltran_level = 'FO'
                    THEN                                 --FI ADDED BY WAIYAKI
                        v_control_acc := i.gltran_gltran_acc;

                        IF v_control_acc IS NULL
                        THEN
                            v_control_acc :=
                                fms_interfaces_pkg.sl_control_acc (
                                    'LMS',
                                    i.gltran_level);
                        END IF;

                        v_contra_acc := i.gltran_contra_acc;
                    ELSE
                        raise_application_error (
                            -20001,
                               'TRANSACTION LEVEL '
                            || i.gltran_level
                            || 'NOT KNOWN BY THE SYSTEM..');
                    END IF;
                ELSE
                    v_contra_acc := i.gltran_gltran_acc;

                    --raise_error('v_contra_acc = '|| i.gltran_gltran_acc);
                    IF i.gltran_level IN ('U')
                    THEN
                        v_control_acc := i.gltran_contra_acc;
                    ELSIF i.gltran_level IN ('MAN',
                                             'FSTSUP',
                                             'SECSUP',
                                             'QST')
                    THEN                               --QST  ADDED BY WAIYAKI
                        v_control_acc := i.gltran_contra_acc;

                        IF v_control_acc IS NULL
                        THEN
                            v_control_acc :=
                                fms_interfaces_pkg.sl_control_acc (
                                    'LMS',
                                    'R',
                                    i.gltran_level);
                        END IF;
                    ELSIF i.gltran_level IN ('FO')
                    THEN
                        v_control_acc :=
                            fms_interfaces_pkg.sl_control_acc (
                                'LMS',
                                i.gltran_level);
                    ELSIF i.gltran_level = 'C'
                    THEN
                        v_trans_batch := 'LMS CLAIM TRANS';
                        v_control_acc := i.gltran_contra_acc;
                    ELSE
                        raise_application_error (
                            -20001,
                               'TRANSACTION LEVEL '
                            || i.gltran_level
                            || 'NOT KNOWN BY THE SYSTEM..');
                    END IF;
                END IF;

                v_contra_acc := TRIM (v_contra_acc);
                v_control_acc := TRIM (v_control_acc);

                IF fms_interfaces_pkg.valid_trns_acc (v_contra_acc,
                                                      v_org_code,
                                                      b.gltran_brn_code) =
                   FALSE
                THEN
                    v_brh_name :=
                        fms_interfaces_pkg.brh_name (b.gltran_brn_code);
                    raise_application_error (
                        -20001,
                           ' GL A/C - '
                        || v_contra_acc
                        || ' UNDEFINED IN '
                        || v_brh_name
                        || ' CODE '
                        || i.gltran_trnt_code
                        || ' PRODUCT - '
                        || v_product
                        || ' LVL -'
                        || i.gltran_level
                        || ' CLIENT TYPE - '
                        || v_client_type);
                END IF;

                IF fms_interfaces_pkg.valid_trns_acc (v_control_acc,
                                                      v_org_code,
                                                      b.gltran_brn_code) =
                   FALSE
                THEN
                    v_brh_name :=
                        fms_interfaces_pkg.brh_name (b.gltran_brn_code);
                    raise_application_error (
                        -20001,
                           'CTRL A/C -'
                        || v_control_acc
                        || ' UNDEFINED IN '
                        || v_brh_name
                        || ' CODE '
                        || i.gltran_trnt_code
                        || ' PRODUCT - '
                        || v_product
                        || ' LVL -'
                        || i.gltran_level
                        || ' CLIENT TYPE - '
                        || v_client_type);
                END IF;

                BEGIN

                    v_no := v_no + 1;

                    interface_append_gl (
                        v_trans_code,            --v_trans_code        NUMBER,
                        v_user_name,           --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                        i.gltran_pol_code,       --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                        i.gltran_pro_code,       --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                        v_gltran_tran_no,     --v_vchr_no            VARCHAR2,
                        NULL,                    --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                        NULL,                    --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                        NULL,                  --v_rcpt_no           VARCHAR2,
                        v_no,                    --v_count             NUMBER,
                           'GL TRANS '
                        || i.gltran_trnt_code
                        || ' - '
                        || i.narration,
                        --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                        ABS (i.gltran_amount),
                        --v_amount            NUMBER,
                        i.gltran_dc,           --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                        v_contra_acc,         --v_acc_number         VARCHAR2,
                        i.gltran_brn_code,       --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                        vgl_trans,
                        --v_trn_rec   IN OUT Fms_Vouchers_Pkg.Tgl_rec_type,
                        NULL,          --v_cad_code       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                        NULL);

                    v_no := v_no + 1;

                    interface_append_gl (
                        v_trans_code,            --v_trans_code        NUMBER,
                        v_user_name,           --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                        i.gltran_pol_code,       --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                        i.gltran_pro_code,       --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                        v_gltran_tran_no,     --v_vchr_no            VARCHAR2,
                        NULL,                    --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                        NULL,                    --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                        NULL,                  --v_rcpt_no           VARCHAR2,
                        v_no,                    --v_count             NUMBER,
                           'GL TRANS '
                        || i.gltran_trnt_code
                        || ' - '
                        || i.narration,
                        --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                        ABS (i.gltran_amount),
                        --v_amount            NUMBER,
                        (CASE
                             WHEN i.gltran_dc = 'D' THEN 'C'
                             WHEN i.gltran_dc = 'C' THEN 'D'
                         END),                 --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                        v_control_acc,        --v_acc_number         VARCHAR2,
                        i.gltran_brn_code,       --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                        vgl_trans,
                        --v_trn_rec   IN OUT Fms_Vouchers_Pkg.Tgl_rec_type,
                        NULL,          --v_cad_code       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                        NULL);
                EXCEPTION
                    WHEN OTHERS
                    THEN
                        raise_error (
                               'ERROR POSTING GL TRANS FOR '
                            || i.gltran_trnt_code);
                END;
            END LOOP;

            interface_update_vgl (
                v_trans_code,                       --v_trans_code     NUMBER,
                v_user_name,                   --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                b.gltran_pol_code,               --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                TRUNC (NVL (v_posting_date, SYSDATE)),
                --v_date         DATE,
                NULL,                            --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                NULL,                            --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                v_trans_batch,                 --v_btc_description   VARCHAR2,
                'JV',                         --v_btc_type           VARCHAR2,
                b.gltran_brn_code,
                --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                NVL (v_description, 'LMS TRANSACTIONS VOUCHER'),
                --v_description       VARCHAR2,
                NVL (b.gltran_debit_note_no, v_gltran_tran_no),
                --v_ref_no           VARCHAR2,
                vgl_trans,
                NULL,
                NULL,
                NULL,
                NULL,
                NULL,
                NULL,
                NULL,
                NULL,
                NULL,
                NVL (v_cur_code, v_gl_cur_code));

            UPDATE lms_gl_transactions
               SET gltran_posted = 'Y'
             WHERE     gltran_tran_no = v_gltran_tran_no
                   AND NVL (gltran_posted, 'N') = 'N'
                   AND gltran_brn_code = b.gltran_brn_code;

        END LOOP;
    END create_gl_voucher;

    PROCEDURE update_payment (
        v_pmt_type          VARCHAR2,
        v_cqr_ref           VARCHAR2,
        v_cqr_ref2          VARCHAR2,
        v_cqr_chq_no        VARCHAR2,
        v_cqr_chq_dt        DATE,
        v_user_name         VARCHAR2,
        v_cqr_amount        NUMBER,
        v_cqr_itfc_ref3     NUMBER,
        v_cqr_chq_prnt_dt   DATE
    )
    IS
    BEGIN
        /***** CHECK FOR UPDATES TO LMS FROM 15/12/2004 (date bugs corrected) ONWARDS. FOR PREVIOUS RECORDS, DISREGARD...****/
        --raise_error('v_pmt_type='||v_pmt_type||';'||v_cqr_ref||';'||v_cqr_ref2||';'||v_cqr_chq_no||';'||v_cqr_chq_dt);
        IF v_pmt_type = 'MED'
        THEN
            lms_api.update_med_chq_pymt (v_cqr_ref,
                                         v_cqr_ref2,
                                         v_cqr_chq_no,
                                         v_cqr_chq_dt,
                                         v_user_name,
                                         v_cqr_amount);
        ELSIF v_pmt_type = 'POL_SURR'
        THEN
            lms_api.update_surrender (v_cqr_ref,
                                      v_cqr_chq_no,
                                      v_cqr_chq_dt,
                                      v_cqr_amount,
                                      v_user_name,
                                      TO_NUMBER (v_cqr_ref2)        --pol_code
                                                            );
        ELSIF v_pmt_type = 'COMM'
        THEN
            lms_api.update_commissions (v_cqr_ref,
                                        v_cqr_ref2,
                                        v_cqr_chq_no,
                                        v_cqr_chq_dt,
                                        v_cqr_amount,
                                        v_user_name);
        ELSIF v_pmt_type = 'AGN_BONUS'
        THEN
            lms_api.update_commissions (v_cqr_ref,
                                        v_cqr_ref2,
                                        v_cqr_chq_no,
                                        v_cqr_chq_dt,
                                        v_cqr_amount,
                                        v_user_name);
        ELSIF v_pmt_type IN ('CLM', 'CLMG', 'CLM_ANN')
        THEN
            lms_api.update_claims (v_cqr_ref2,                      --claim no
                                   v_cqr_chq_no,
                                   v_cqr_chq_dt,
                                   v_cqr_ref,
                                   v_cqr_amount,
                                   v_user_name);
        ELSIF v_pmt_type IN ('P_MTR',
                             'F_MTR',
                             'TPD_MTR',
                             'AN_MTR',
                             'NCD')
        THEN
            lms_api.update_matuities (v_cqr_ref,
                                      v_cqr_ref2,
                                      v_cqr_chq_no,
                                      v_cqr_chq_dt,
                                      v_cqr_amount,
                                      v_user_name,
                                      v_pmt_type);
        ELSIF v_pmt_type IN ('REFUND',
                             'POL_REF',
                             'PRRCT',
                             'PRREF',
                             'PW_REF')
        THEN
            lms_api.update_vchr_pymt (v_cqr_ref,
                                      v_cqr_ref2,
                                      v_cqr_chq_no,
                                      v_cqr_chq_dt,
                                      v_user_name,
                                      v_cqr_amount,
                                      v_pmt_type);
        ELSIF v_pmt_type IN ('LOAN')
        THEN
            lms_api.update_loan_appl (v_cqr_ref,
                                      v_cqr_chq_no,
                                      v_cqr_chq_dt,
                                      v_cqr_amount,
                                      v_user_name);
        ELSIF v_pmt_type IN ('AGNADV')
        THEN
            lms_api.update_agent_adv (v_cqr_ref,
                                      v_cqr_chq_no,
                                      v_cqr_chq_dt,
                                      v_user_name);
        ELSIF v_pmt_type IN ('REIN_PYMT')
        THEN
            NULL;
        ELSIF v_pmt_type IN ('AGNLNRP')
        THEN
            UPDATE lms_agent_lender_payments
               SET aglp_paid = 'Y', aglp_date_paid = SYSDATE
             WHERE aglp_code = v_cqr_ref;
        ELSIF v_pmt_type IN ('PROF')
        THEN
            lms_api.update_profit_payments (v_cqr_ref,
                                            v_cqr_chq_no,
                                            v_cqr_chq_dt,
                                            v_cqr_amount,
                                            v_user_name);
        ELSIF v_pmt_type IN ('REFUNDG')
        THEN
            lms_api.update_coin_refunds (v_cqr_ref,
                                         v_cqr_chq_no,
                                         v_cqr_chq_dt,
                                         v_cqr_amount,
                                         v_user_name);
        ELSIF v_pmt_type IN ('FAC_REF')
        THEN
            lms_api.update_fac_refunds (v_cqr_ref,
                                        v_cqr_chq_no,
                                        v_cqr_chq_dt,
                                        v_cqr_amount,
                                        v_user_name);
        ELSIF v_pmt_type IN ('RCT_REF_GB')
        THEN
            lms_api.update_grp_receipt_refunds (v_cqr_ref,
                                                v_cqr_chq_no,
                                                v_cqr_chq_dt,
                                                v_cqr_amount,
                                                v_user_name);
        ELSIF v_pmt_type IN ('CLMSVC')
        THEN
            lms_api.update_clm_service_providers (v_cqr_ref,
                                                  v_cqr_ref2,
                                                  v_cqr_chq_no,
                                                  v_cqr_chq_dt,
                                                  v_cqr_amount,
                                                  v_user_name);
        ELSE
            raise_error (
                'UPDATE PROC FOR ' || v_pmt_type || ' NOT EFFECTED....');
        END IF;

        UPDATE lms_interface_table
           SET itb_chq_no = v_cqr_chq_no,
               itb_chq_prn_dt = v_cqr_chq_dt,
               itb_chq_prn_by = v_user_name,
               itb_chq_update_dt = v_cqr_chq_prnt_dt,
               itb_chq_amount = v_cqr_amount
         WHERE itb_ref3 = v_cqr_itfc_ref3;
    EXCEPTION
        WHEN OTHERS
        THEN
            raise_error (' Updating  ' || v_pmt_type || ' pmt');
    END update_payment;

    PROCEDURE lapse_gl_update (
        v_pol_code       NUMBER,
        v_surr_amt       NUMBER,
        v_os_prem        NUMBER,
        v_os_loan        NUMBER,
        v_os_unsettled   NUMBER,
        v_user           VARCHAR2
    )
    IS
        CURSOR loans IS
            SELECT pln_lna_no, pln_os_bal_amount
              FROM lms_policy_loans
             WHERE     pln_pol_code = v_pol_code
                   AND NVL (pln_os_bal_amount, 0) > 0;

        v_policy_no             VARCHAR2 (30);
        v_brh_code              NUMBER;
        v_prod_code             NUMBER;
        v_trnt_code             VARCHAR2 (10);
        v_trnt_gl_code          VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_trnt_contra_gl_code   VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_org_code              NUMBER;
        v_cur_code              NUMBER;
        v_authorized_by         NUMBER;
        v_count                 NUMBER := 0;
        v_vgl_no                NUMBER;
        v_bal_amt               NUMBER;
        v_act_code              NUMBER;
        v_endr_code             NUMBER;
        v_loan_repaid           NUMBER;
        v_loan_amt              NUMBER;
        v_prem_opr_code         NUMBER;
        v_loan_opr_code         NUMBER;
        v_gl_trans              fms_vouchers_pkg.tgl_rec_type;
        v_trans_code            NUMBER;
    BEGIN
        BEGIN
            SELECT pol_bra_code,
                   pol_policy_no,
                   pol_prod_code,
                   agn_act_code,
                   endr_code
              INTO v_brh_code,
                   v_policy_no,
                   v_prod_code,
                   v_act_code,
                   v_endr_code
              FROM lms_policies, lms_policy_endorsements, lms_agencies
             WHERE     pol_current_endr_code = endr_code
                   AND endr_agen_code = agn_code
                   AND pol_code = v_pol_code;
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND
            THEN
                raise_error ('POLICY DETAILS NOT FOUND... ');
        END;

        IF NVL (v_surr_amt, 0) - NVL (v_os_prem, 0) - NVL (v_os_loan, 0) != 0
        THEN
            raise_error ('THE GL LAPSATION AMOUNTS DO NOT ADD UP..');
        END IF;

        v_org_code := fms_interfaces_pkg.get_org (v_brh_code);

        SELECT    TO_NUMBER (TO_CHAR (SYSDATE, 'RRRR'))
               || lms_transaction_seq.NEXTVAL
          INTO v_trans_code
          FROM DUAL;

        IF NVL (v_surr_amt, 0) > 0
        THEN
            get_gl_code ('POL_SURR',
                         v_prod_code,
                         v_trnt_code,
                         v_trnt_gl_code,
                         v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
            valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                       v_org_code,
                       v_brh_code,
                       'POL_SURR');
            v_count := v_count + 1;
            interface_append_gl (v_trans_code,   --v_trans_code        NUMBER,
                                 v_user,       --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                                 v_pol_code,     --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                                 v_prod_code,    --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                                 v_policy_no, --v_vchr_no            VARCHAR2,
                                 NULL,           --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                                 NULL,           --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                                 NULL,          --v_rcpt_no          VARCHAR2,
                                 v_count,        --v_count             NUMBER,
                                 'POLICY SURRENDER - ' || v_policy_no,
                                 --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                                 NVL (v_surr_amt, 0),
                                 --v_amount            NUMBER,
                                 'D',          --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                                 v_trnt_gl_code, --v_acc_number        VARCHAR2,
                                 v_brh_code,     --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                                 v_gl_trans);
        --v_trn_rec   IN OUT  Fms_Vouchers_Pkg.Tgl_rec_type,
        END IF;

        IF NVL (v_os_prem, 0) > 0
        THEN
            -- PROCESSING ALLOCATED PREMIUM RECEIPT
            BEGIN
                SELECT    TO_NUMBER (TO_CHAR (SYSDATE, 'RRRR'))
                       || lms_opr_code_seq.NEXTVAL
                  INTO v_prem_opr_code
                  FROM DUAL;

                INSERT INTO lms_ord_prem_receipts (opr_code,
                                                   opr_ltr_trans_no,
                                                   opr_date,
                                                   opr_cheque_no,
                                                   opr_amt,
                                                   opr_pol_code,
                                                   opr_pol_policy_no,
                                                   opr_receipt_no,
                                                   opr_receipt_date,
                                                   opr_source)
                     VALUES (v_prem_opr_code,
                             NULL,
                             SYSDATE,
                             'FROM LAPSE',
                             v_os_prem,
                             v_pol_code,
                             v_policy_no,
                             'FROM LAPSE',
                             TRUNC (SYSDATE),
                             'LAPSE_SV_AMT');
            EXCEPTION
                WHEN OTHERS
                THEN
                    raise_error (
                        'UNABLE TO CREATE O/S PREMIUM RECEIPT RECORD...');
            END;

            IF v_act_code IS NULL
            THEN
                raise_error ('SYSTEM UNABLE TO DETERMINE AGENCY TYPE..');
            END IF;

            BEGIN
                lms_process_receipts.lms_ord_premium_receipts (
                    v_pol_code,
                    v_prem_opr_code,
                    'Y',
                    'N',
                    NULL,
                    v_act_code,
                    v_bal_amt);
            EXCEPTION
                WHEN OTHERS
                THEN
                    raise_error (
                        'ERROR PROCESSING O/S PREMIUM RECEIPT RECORD....');
            END;

            get_gl_code ('NFINC',
                         v_prod_code,
                         v_trnt_code,
                         v_trnt_gl_code,
                         v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
            valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                       v_org_code,
                       v_brh_code,
                       'NFINC');
            v_count := v_count + 1;
            interface_append_gl (v_trans_code,   --v_trans_code        NUMBER,
                                 v_user,       --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                                 v_pol_code,     --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                                 v_prod_code,    --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                                 v_policy_no, --v_vchr_no            VARCHAR2,
                                 NULL,           --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                                 NULL,           --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                                 NULL,          --v_rcpt_no          VARCHAR2,
                                 v_count,        --v_count             NUMBER,
                                 'NF PREMIUM INCOME - ' || v_policy_no,
                                 --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                                 NVL (v_os_prem, 0),
                                 --v_amount            NUMBER,
                                 'C',          --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                                 v_trnt_gl_code, --v_acc_number        VARCHAR2,
                                 v_brh_code,     --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                                 v_gl_trans);
        --v_trn_rec   IN OUT  Fms_Vouchers_Pkg.Tgl_rec_type,
        END IF;

        IF NVL (v_os_loan, 0) > 0
        THEN
            -- PROCESSING O/S LOAN ALLOCATION
            BEGIN
                SELECT    TO_NUMBER (TO_CHAR (SYSDATE, 'RRRR'))
                       || lms_opr_code_seq.NEXTVAL
                  INTO v_loan_opr_code
                  FROM DUAL;

                INSERT INTO lms_ord_prem_receipts (opr_code,
                                                   opr_ltr_trans_no,
                                                   opr_date,
                                                   opr_cheque_no,
                                                   opr_amt,
                                                   opr_pol_code,
                                                   opr_pol_policy_no,
                                                   opr_receipt_no,
                                                   opr_receipt_date,
                                                   opr_source)
                     VALUES (v_loan_opr_code,
                             NULL,
                             SYSDATE,
                             'FROM LAPSE',
                             v_os_loan,
                             v_pol_code,
                             v_policy_no,
                             'FROM LAPSE',
                             TRUNC (SYSDATE),
                             'LAPSE_SV_AMT');
            EXCEPTION
                WHEN OTHERS
                THEN
                    raise_error (
                        'UNABLE TO CREATE O/S LOAN RECEIPT RECORD...');
            END;

            v_loan_repaid := 0;

            FOR l IN loans
            LOOP
                IF l.pln_os_bal_amount <=
                   (NVL (v_os_loan, 0) - v_loan_repaid)
                THEN
                    v_loan_amt := l.pln_os_bal_amount;
                ELSE
                    v_loan_amt :=
                        (NVL (v_os_loan, 0) - NVL (v_loan_repaid, 0));
                END IF;

                v_loan_repaid := NVL (v_loan_repaid, 0) + NVL (v_loan_amt, 0);

                BEGIN
                    lms_process_receipts.process_loan_pymt (
                        NVL (v_loan_amt, 0),
                        l.pln_lna_no,
                        TRUNC (SYSDATE),
                        'FROM LAPSE',
                        v_loan_opr_code,
                        v_endr_code,
                        v_user);
                EXCEPTION
                    WHEN OTHERS
                    THEN
                        raise_error (
                            'ERROR PROCESSING O/S LOAN RECEIPT RECORD....');
                END;

                EXIT WHEN NVL (v_os_loan, 0) <= NVL (v_loan_repaid, 0);
            END LOOP;

            get_gl_code ('POL_LOAN',
                         v_prod_code,
                         v_trnt_code,
                         v_trnt_gl_code,
                         v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
            valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                       v_org_code,
                       v_brh_code,
                       'POL_LOAN');
            v_count := v_count + 1;
            interface_append_gl (v_trans_code,   --v_trans_code        NUMBER,
                                 v_user,       --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                                 v_pol_code,     --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                                 v_prod_code,    --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                                 v_policy_no, --v_vchr_no            VARCHAR2,
                                 NULL,           --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                                 NULL,           --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                                 NULL,          --v_rcpt_no          VARCHAR2,
                                 v_count,        --v_count             NUMBER,
                                 'POLICY OS LOANS - ' || v_policy_no,
                                 --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                                 NVL (v_os_loan, 0),
                                 --v_amount            NUMBER,
                                 'C',          --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                                 v_trnt_gl_code, --v_acc_number        VARCHAR2,
                                 v_brh_code,     --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                                 v_gl_trans);
        --v_trn_rec   IN OUT  Fms_Vouchers_Pkg.Tgl_rec_type,
        END IF;

        IF NVL (v_os_unsettled, 0) > 0
        THEN
            -- PROCESSING UNSETTLED O/S LOAN ALLOCATION
            BEGIN
                v_loan_opr_code := NULL;

                SELECT    TO_NUMBER (TO_CHAR (SYSDATE, 'RRRR'))
                       || lms_opr_code_seq.NEXTVAL
                  INTO v_loan_opr_code
                  FROM DUAL;

                INSERT INTO lms_ord_prem_receipts (opr_code,
                                                   opr_ltr_trans_no,
                                                   opr_date,
                                                   opr_cheque_no,
                                                   opr_amt,
                                                   opr_pol_code,
                                                   opr_pol_policy_no,
                                                   opr_receipt_no,
                                                   opr_receipt_date,
                                                   opr_source)
                     VALUES (v_loan_opr_code,
                             NULL,
                             SYSDATE,
                             'FROM LAPSE',
                             v_os_unsettled,
                             v_pol_code,
                             v_policy_no,
                             'O/S UNSETTLED LOAN',
                             TRUNC (SYSDATE),
                             'LAPSE_SV_AMT');
            EXCEPTION
                WHEN OTHERS
                THEN
                    raise_error (
                        'UNABLE TO CREATE O/S LOAN RECEIPT RECORD...');
            END;

            v_loan_repaid := 0;

            FOR l IN loans
            LOOP
                IF l.pln_os_bal_amount <=
                   (NVL (v_os_unsettled, 0) - v_loan_repaid)
                THEN
                    v_loan_amt := l.pln_os_bal_amount;
                ELSE
                    v_loan_amt :=
                        (NVL (v_os_unsettled, 0) - NVL (v_loan_repaid, 0));
                END IF;

                v_loan_repaid := NVL (v_loan_repaid, 0) + NVL (v_loan_amt, 0);

                BEGIN
                    lms_process_receipts.process_loan_pymt (
                        NVL (v_loan_amt, 0),
                        l.pln_lna_no,
                        TRUNC (SYSDATE),
                        'FROM LAPSE',
                        v_loan_opr_code,
                        v_endr_code,
                        v_user);
                EXCEPTION
                    WHEN OTHERS
                    THEN
                        raise_error (
                            'ERROR PROCESSING O/S LOAN RECEIPT RECORD....');
                END;

                EXIT WHEN NVL (v_os_unsettled, 0) <= NVL (v_loan_repaid, 0);
            END LOOP;

            get_gl_code ('POL_LOAN',
                         v_prod_code,
                         v_trnt_code,
                         v_trnt_gl_code,
                         v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
            valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                       v_org_code,
                       v_brh_code,
                       'POL_LOAN');
            v_count := v_count + 1;
            interface_append_gl (v_trans_code,   --v_trans_code        NUMBER,
                                 v_user,       --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                                 v_pol_code,     --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                                 v_prod_code,    --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                                 v_policy_no, --v_vchr_no            VARCHAR2,
                                 NULL,           --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                                 NULL,           --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                                 NULL,          --v_rcpt_no          VARCHAR2,
                                 v_count,        --v_count             NUMBER,
                                 'POL_LAPSE OS UNSETTLED - ' || v_policy_no,
                                 --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                                 NVL (v_os_unsettled, 0),
                                 --v_amount            NUMBER,
                                 'C',          --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                                 v_trnt_gl_code, --v_acc_number        VARCHAR2,
                                 v_brh_code,     --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                                 v_gl_trans);
            --v_trn_rec   IN OUT  Fms_Vouchers_Pkg.Tgl_rec_type,
            --Get_Gl_Code('SNINC',v_prod_code,v_trnt_code,v_trnt_gl_code,v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
            get_gl_code ('POL_SURR',
                         v_prod_code,
                         v_trnt_code,
                         v_trnt_gl_code,
