                         v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
            valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                       v_org_code,
                       v_brh_code,
                       'POL_SURR');
            v_count := v_count + 1;
            interface_append_gl (v_trans_code,   --v_trans_code        NUMBER,
                                 v_user,       --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                                 v_pol_code,     --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                                 v_prod_code,    --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                                 v_policy_no, --v_vchr_no            VARCHAR2,
                                 NULL,           --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                                 NULL,           --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                                 NULL,          --v_rcpt_no          VARCHAR2,
                                 v_count,        --v_count             NUMBER,
                                 'POL_LAPSE OS UNSETTLED - ' || v_policy_no,
                                 --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                                 NVL (v_os_unsettled, 0),
                                 --v_amount            NUMBER,
                                 'D',          --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                                 v_trnt_gl_code, --v_acc_number        VARCHAR2,
                                 v_brh_code,     --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                                 v_gl_trans);
        --v_trn_rec   IN OUT  Fms_Vouchers_Pkg.Tgl_rec_type,
        END IF;

        interface_update_vgl (v_trans_code,         --v_trans_code     NUMBER,
                              v_user,          --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                              v_pol_code,        --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                              TRUNC (SYSDATE),          --v_date         DATE,
                              NULL,              --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                              NULL,              --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                              'LMS LAPSATION BATCH',
                              --v_btc_description   VARCHAR2,
                              'JV',           --v_btc_type           VARCHAR2,
                              v_brh_code,        --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                              'LMS LAPSATION VOUCHER',
                              --v_description       VARCHAR2,
                              v_policy_no,       --v_ref_no          VARCHAR2,
                              v_gl_trans);
    --v_gl_trans  IN OUT  Fms_Vouchers_Pkg.Tgl_rec_type,
    EXCEPTION
        WHEN OTHERS
        THEN
            raise_error ('PROCESSING LAPSATION GL....');
    END lapse_gl_update;

    PROCEDURE post_compensation_fund (
        v_date_from   DATE,
        v_date_to     DATE,
        v_option      VARCHAR2,
        v_brn_code    NUMBER,
        v_user        VARCHAR2,
        v_payee       VARCHAR2
    )
    IS
        CURSOR rcpts IS
              SELECT SUM (
                           NVL (opr_fund_client_contr, 0)
                         * DECODE (NVL (opr_drcr, 'C'), 'D', -1, 1))
                         client_contri,
                     SUM (
                           NVL (opr_fund_company_contr, 0)
                         * DECODE (NVL (opr_drcr, 'C'), 'D', -1, 1))
                         company_contri,
                     pol_prod_code,
                     lms_api.get_rct_act_id (opr_fms_receipt_pk)
                         rct_type
                FROM lms_ord_prem_receipts, lms_policies
               WHERE     TRUNC (opr_receipt_date) BETWEEN v_date_from
                                                      AND v_date_to
                     AND   NVL (opr_fund_client_contr, 0)
                         + NVL (opr_fund_company_contr, 0) >
                         0
                     AND opr_pol_code = pol_code
                     AND NVL (opr_fund_posted, 'N') = 'N'
                     AND NVL (lms_ord_misc.check_rcpt_bal (opr_code), 0) = 0
                     AND pol_bra_code =
                         DECODE (NVL (v_option, 'CB'),
                                 'CB', pol_bra_code,
                                 v_brn_code)
            GROUP BY pol_prod_code,
                     lms_api.get_rct_act_id (opr_fms_receipt_pk);

        v_acc_type              VARCHAR2 (10) := 'D';
        v_gl_trans              tq_fms.fms_vouchers_pkg.tgl_rec_type;
        v_chq_dtls_rec          fms_cheques_pkg.type_rqn_dtls_table;
        v_vgl_no                NUMBER;
        v_trnt_code             VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_crt_acc_no            VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_trnt_gl_code          VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_trnt_contra_gl_code   VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_contra_acc            VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_raised_by             NUMBER;
        v_count                 NUMBER := 0;
        v_gl_count              NUMBER := 0;
        v_org_code              NUMBER;
        v_cur_code              NUMBER;
        v_cfp_code              NUMBER;
        v_amt                   NUMBER;
        v_prod_code             NUMBER;
        v_vchr_no               VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_auth_by               NUMBER;
        v_sys_code              NUMBER;
        v_bct_code              NUMBER;
        v_bct_brh_code          NUMBER;
        v_comp_param            VARCHAR2 (5);
        v_comp_param_status     VARCHAR2 (5);
        v_trans_code            NUMBER;
        v_done_by               VARCHAR2 (30);
    BEGIN
        BEGIN
            lms_ord_misc.system_param_val ('CONSOLIDATE_COMP_FUND',
                                           v_comp_param);
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                raise_error ('PARAM. ERROR...');
        END;

        IF NOT NVL (v_comp_param, 'N') = 'Y'
        THEN
            raise_error (
                'SYSTEM PARAMETER "CONSOLIDATE_COMP_FUND" SETTING DOES NOT ALLOW THIS TRANSACTION....');
        END IF;

        BEGIN
            SELECT DISTINCT ltr_done_by
              INTO v_done_by
              FROM lms_transactions
             WHERE     ltr_btr_trans_code = 'PHCF'
                   AND ltr_uw_clm_tran = 'A'
                   AND NVL (ltr_trans_authorised, 'N') NOT IN ('A', 'Y');
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                raise_error ('Unable to fetch transation details..');
        END;

        SELECT    TO_NUMBER (TO_CHAR (SYSDATE, 'RRRR'))
               || lms_transaction_seq.NEXTVAL
          INTO v_trans_code
          FROM DUAL;

        FOR r IN rcpts
        LOOP
            v_gl_trans.delete;
            v_chq_dtls_rec.delete;
            v_amt := NVL (r.client_contri, 0) + NVL (r.company_contri, 0);

            BEGIN
                v_vchr_no := lms_api.trans_voucher ('PHCF');

                SELECT    TO_NUMBER (TO_CHAR (SYSDATE, 'RRRR'))
                       || lms_cfp_code_seq.NEXTVAL
                  INTO v_cfp_code
                  FROM DUAL;

                INSERT INTO lms_compensation_fund_pymt (cfp_code,
                                                        cfp_amount,
                                                        cfp_payee,
                                                        cfp_done_by,
                                                        cfp_done_date,
                                                        cfp_brn_code,
                                                        cfp_vchr_no,
                                                        cfp_date_from,
                                                        cfp_date_to)
                     VALUES (v_cfp_code,
                             v_amt,
                             v_payee,
                             v_user,
                             SYSDATE,
                             v_brn_code,
                             v_vchr_no,
                             v_date_from,
                             v_date_to);
            EXCEPTION
                WHEN OTHERS
                THEN
                    raise_error ('COMP. FUND ERROR....');
            END;

            v_count := 0;
            v_org_code := fms_interfaces_pkg.get_org (v_brn_code);

            --RAISE_ERROR('v_amt='||v_amt);
            IF NVL (v_amt, 0) <> 0
            THEN
                -- POSTING GL VOUCHERS....
                IF NVL (r.company_contri, 0) <> 0
                THEN
                    --premium(company contribution)
                    get_gl_code ('MNGEX',
                                 NULL,
                                 v_trnt_code,
                                 v_trnt_gl_code,
                                 v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
                    valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                               v_org_code,
                               v_brn_code,
                               'MNGEX');
                    v_gl_count := v_gl_count + 1;
                    interface_append_gl (
                        v_trans_code,
                        --v_trans_code         NUMBER,
                        v_user,                --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                        NULL,                    --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                        NULL,                    --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                        v_vchr_no,
                        --v_vchr_no            VARCHAR2,
                        NULL,                    --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                        NULL,                    --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                        NULL,                  --v_rcpt_no           VARCHAR2,
                        v_gl_count,              --v_count             NUMBER,
                        'COMP. FUND - COMPANY CONTRI - ' || v_vchr_no,
                        --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                        r.company_contri,
                        --v_amount            NUMBER,
                        'D',                   --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                        v_trnt_gl_code,
                        --v_acc_number          VARCHAR2,
                        v_brn_code,              --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                        v_gl_trans);
                END IF;

                IF NVL (r.client_contri, 0) <> 0
                THEN
                    --premium(client contribution)z
                    v_contra_acc :=
                        get_receipting_acc (NVL (r.rct_type, 'O'),
                                            r.pol_prod_code,
                                            v_org_code,
                                            v_brn_code,
                                            'N');
                    v_gl_count := v_gl_count + 1;
                    interface_append_gl (
                        v_trans_code,
                        --v_trans_code        NUMBER,
                        v_user,                --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                        NULL,                    --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                        NULL,                    --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                        v_vchr_no,              --v_vchr_no          VARCHAR2,
                        NULL,                    --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                        NULL,                    --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                        NULL,                 --v_rcpt_no            VARCHAR2,
                        v_gl_count,              --v_count             NUMBER,
                        'COMP. FUND - CLIENT CONTRI - ' || v_vchr_no,
                        --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                        r.client_contri,
                        --v_amount            NUMBER,
                        'D',                   --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                        v_contra_acc,
                        --v_acc_number         VARCHAR2,
                        v_brn_code,              --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                        v_gl_trans);
                END IF;

                --Compensation fund...
                get_gl_code ('CMPFND',
                             NULL,
                             v_trnt_code,
                             v_trnt_gl_code,
                             v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
                valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                           v_org_code,
                           v_brn_code,
                           'CMPFND');
                v_gl_count := v_gl_count + 1;
                interface_append_gl (
                    v_trans_code,              --v_trans_code          NUMBER,
                    v_user,                    --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                    NULL,                        --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                    NULL,                        --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                    v_vchr_no,                  --v_vchr_no          VARCHAR2,
                    NULL,                        --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                    NULL,                        --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                    NULL,                     --v_rcpt_no            VARCHAR2,
                    v_gl_count,                  --v_count             NUMBER,
                    'CONSOLIDATED COMPENSATION FUND - ' || v_vchr_no,
                    --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                    v_amt,                       --v_amount            NUMBER,
                    'C',                       --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                    v_trnt_gl_code,
                    --v_acc_number          VARCHAR2,
                    v_brn_code,                  --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                    v_gl_trans);
                interface_update_vgl (v_trans_code, --v_trans_code     NUMBER,
                                      v_user,  --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                                      NULL,      --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                                      TRUNC (SYSDATE),  --v_date         DATE,
                                      NULL,      --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                                      NULL,      --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                                      'LMS COMP. FUND POSTING',
                                      --v_btc_description   VARCHAR2,
                                      'JV',   --v_btc_type           VARCHAR2,
                                      v_brn_code, --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                                      'COMPENSATION FUND VOUCHER',
                                      --v_description       VARCHAR2,
                                      v_vchr_no, --v_ref_no            VARCHAR2,
                                      v_gl_trans);

                IF v_gl_count = 0
                THEN
                    raise_error ('JV NOT CREATED....');
                END IF;

                v_count := 0;
                -- MAKING CHEQUE REQUISITION FROM CONTROL A/C....
                get_gl_code ('CMPFND',
                             v_prod_code,
                             v_trnt_code,
                             v_crt_acc_no,
                             v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
                valid_acc (v_crt_acc_no,
                           v_org_code,
                           v_brn_code,
                           'CMPFND');
                v_count := v_count + 1;
                interface_append_chq (
                    v_trans_code,                --v_trans_code        NUMBER,
                    v_user,                    --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                    NULL,                       --v_pol_code           NUMBER,
                    NULL,                       --v_prod_code          NUMBER,
                    v_vchr_no,
                    --v_vchr_no              VARCHAR2,
                    v_count,                    --v_count              NUMBER,
                    v_amt,                      --v_amount             NUMBER,
                    'CONSOLIDATED COMPENSATION FUND - ' || v_vchr_no,
                    --v_narrative          VARCHAR2,
                    v_crt_acc_no,
                    --v_acc_number            VARCHAR2,
                    v_org_code,
                    --v_acc_org_code          NUMBER,
                    v_brn_code,                 --v_branch_code        NUMBER,
                    'D',                      --v_drcr               VARCHAR2,
                    v_chq_dtls_rec);

                IF v_count != 0
                THEN
                    BEGIN
                        interface_create_reqn (v_trans_code, --v_trans_code           NUMBER,
                                               v_vchr_no, --v_ref                   VARCHAR2,
                                               v_cfp_code, --v_ref2                  VARCHAR2,
                                               TRUNC (SYSDATE), --v_ref_date              DATE,
                                               'LMS PHCF POSTING ( CHQ )',
                                               --v_narrative             VARCHAR2,
                                               v_amt, --v_amount                NUMBER,
                                               v_payee, --v_payee                 VARCHAR2,
                                               'CHQ', --v_pay_method            VARCHAR2, --CHQ, EFT
                                               NULL, --v_payee_bank_acc_no        VARCHAR2,
                                               NULL, --v_payee_bank_branch_code   NUMBER,
                                               v_user, --v_source_auth_by        VARCHAR2,
                                               TRUNC (SYSDATE), --v_source_auth_dt        DATE,
                                               v_done_by, --v_raise_by                VARCHAR2,
                                               'CMPFND', --v_pmt_type              VARCHAR2,
                                               v_brn_code, --v_branch_code           NUMBER,
                                               NULL,             --v_pol_code,
                                               v_chq_dtls_rec);
                    EXCEPTION
                        WHEN OTHERS
                        THEN
                            raise_error ('POST COMPNSN FUND');
                    END;
                END IF;
            END IF;

            IF v_count = 0
            THEN
                raise_error ('NO TRANSACTIONS POSTED TO FINANCE ');
            END IF;

            --Updating records as posted....
            BEGIN
                UPDATE lms_ord_prem_receipts
                   SET opr_fund_posted = 'Y',
                       opr_fund_post_date = SYSDATE,
                       opr_fund_posted_by = v_user,
                       opr_cfp_code = v_cfp_code
                 WHERE     TRUNC (opr_receipt_date) BETWEEN v_date_from
                                                        AND v_date_to
                       AND   NVL (opr_fund_client_contr, 0)
                           + NVL (opr_fund_company_contr, 0) >
                           0
                       AND NVL (opr_fund_posted, 'N') = 'N'
                       AND NVL (lms_ord_misc.check_rcpt_bal (opr_code), 0) =
                           0
                       AND opr_pol_code IN
                               (SELECT pol_code
                                  FROM lms_policies
                                 WHERE     pol_code = opr_pol_code
                                       AND pol_bra_code =
                                           DECODE (NVL (v_option, 'CB'),
                                                   'CB', pol_bra_code,
                                                   v_brn_code));
            EXCEPTION
                WHEN OTHERS
                THEN
                    raise_error ('ERROR UPDATING RECEIPT RECORDS....');
            END;
        END LOOP;
    EXCEPTION
        WHEN OTHERS
        THEN
            raise_error ('COMP. FUND...');
    END post_compensation_fund;

    PROCEDURE post_compensation_fund_gl (
        v_date_from   DATE,
        v_date_to     DATE,
        v_option      VARCHAR2,
        v_brn_code    NUMBER,
        v_user        VARCHAR2,
        v_payee       VARCHAR2
    )
    IS
        CURSOR rcpts IS
              SELECT SUM (
                           NVL (opr_fund_client_contr, 0)
                         * DECODE (NVL (opr_drcr, 'C'), 'D', -1, 1))
                         client_contri,
                     SUM (
                           NVL (opr_fund_company_contr, 0)
                         * DECODE (NVL (opr_drcr, 'C'), 'D', -1, 1))
                         company_contri,
                     pol_prod_code,
                     lms_api.get_rct_act_id (opr_fms_receipt_pk)
                         rct_type
                FROM lms_ord_prem_receipts, lms_policies
               WHERE     TRUNC (opr_receipt_date) BETWEEN v_date_from
                                                      AND v_date_to
                     AND   NVL (opr_fund_client_contr, 0)
                         + NVL (opr_fund_company_contr, 0) >
                         0
                     AND opr_pol_code = pol_code
                     AND NVL (opr_fund_posted, 'N') = 'N'
                     AND NVL (lms_ord_misc.check_rcpt_bal (opr_code), 0) = 0
                     AND pol_bra_code =
                         DECODE (NVL (v_option, 'CB'),
                                 'CB', pol_bra_code,
                                 v_brn_code)
            GROUP BY pol_prod_code,
                     lms_api.get_rct_act_id (opr_fms_receipt_pk);

        v_acc_type              VARCHAR2 (10) := 'D';
        v_gl_trans              tq_fms.fms_vouchers_pkg.tgl_rec_type;
        v_vgl_no                NUMBER;
        v_trnt_code             VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_trnt_gl_code          VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_trnt_contra_gl_code   VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_contra_acc            VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_raised_by             NUMBER;
        v_count                 NUMBER := 0;
        v_org_code              NUMBER;
        v_cur_code              NUMBER;
        v_cfp_code              NUMBER;
        v_amt                   NUMBER;
        v_trans_code            NUMBER;
        v_vchr_no               VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_comp_param            VARCHAR2 (5);
        v_comp_param_status     VARCHAR2 (5);
    BEGIN
        BEGIN
            lms_ord_misc.system_param_val ('CONSOLIDATE_COMP_FUND',
                                           v_comp_param);
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                raise_error ('PARAM. ERROR...');
        END;

        IF NOT NVL (v_comp_param, 'N') = 'Y'
        THEN
            raise_error (
                'SYSTEM PARAMETER "CONSOLIDATE_COMP_FUND" SETTING DOES NOT ALLOW THIS TRANSACTION....');
        END IF;

        SELECT    TO_NUMBER (TO_CHAR (SYSDATE, 'RRRR'))
               || lms_transaction_seq.NEXTVAL
          INTO v_trans_code
          FROM DUAL;

        v_org_code := fms_interfaces_pkg.get_org (v_brn_code);

        FOR r IN rcpts
        LOOP
            v_gl_trans.delete;
            v_amt := NVL (r.client_contri, 0) + NVL (r.company_contri, 0);

            BEGIN
                v_vchr_no := lms_api.trans_voucher ('PHCF');

                SELECT    TO_NUMBER (TO_CHAR (SYSDATE, 'RRRR'))
                       || lms_cfp_code_seq.NEXTVAL
                  INTO v_cfp_code
                  FROM DUAL;

                INSERT INTO lms_compensation_fund_pymt (cfp_code,
                                                        cfp_amount,
                                                        cfp_payee,
                                                        cfp_done_by,
                                                        cfp_done_date,
                                                        cfp_brn_code,
                                                        cfp_vchr_no,
                                                        cfp_date_from,
                                                        cfp_date_to)
                     VALUES (v_cfp_code,
                             v_amt,
                             v_payee,
                             v_user,
                             SYSDATE,
                             v_brn_code,
                             v_vchr_no,
                             v_date_from,
                             v_date_to);
            EXCEPTION
                WHEN OTHERS
                THEN
                    raise_error ('COMP. FUND ERROR.2..');
            END;

            IF NVL (v_amt, 0) <> 0
            THEN
                IF NVL (r.company_contri, 0) <> 0
                THEN
                    --premium(company contribution)
                    get_gl_code ('MNGEX',
                                 NULL,
                                 v_trnt_code,
                                 v_trnt_gl_code,
                                 v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
                    valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                               v_org_code,
                               v_brn_code,
                               'MNGEX');
                    interface_append_gl (
                        v_trans_code,
                        --v_trans_code         NUMBER,
                        v_user,                --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                        NULL,                    --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                        NULL,                    --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                        v_vchr_no,              --v_vchr_no          VARCHAR2,
                        NULL,                    --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                        NULL,                    --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                        NULL,                 --v_rcpt_no            VARCHAR2,
                        v_count,                 --v_count             NUMBER,
                        'MANAGEMENT EXPENSE - ' || v_vchr_no,
                        --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                        r.company_contri,
                        --v_amount            NUMBER,
                        'D',                   --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                        v_trnt_gl_code,
                        --v_acc_number          VARCHAR2,
                        v_brn_code,              --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                        v_gl_trans);
                END IF;

                IF NVL (r.client_contri, 0) <> 0
                THEN
                    --premium(client contribution)
                    v_contra_acc :=
                        get_receipting_acc (NVL (r.rct_type, 'O'),
                                            r.pol_prod_code,
                                            v_org_code,
                                            v_brn_code,
                                            'N');
                    v_count := v_count + 1;
                    interface_append_gl (v_trans_code,
                                         --v_trans_code          NUMBER,
                                         v_user, --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                                         NULL,   --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                                         NULL,   --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                                         v_vchr_no, --v_vchr_no          VARCHAR2,
                                         NULL,   --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                                         NULL,   --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                                         NULL, --v_rcpt_no            VARCHAR2,
                                         v_count, --v_count             NUMBER,
                                         'PREMIUM INCOME - ' || v_vchr_no,
                                         --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                                         r.client_contri,
                                         --v_amount            NUMBER,
                                         'D',  --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                                         v_contra_acc,
                                         --v_acc_number         VARCHAR2,
                                         v_brn_code, --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                                         v_gl_trans);
                END IF;

                --Compensation fund...
                get_gl_code ('CMPFND',
                             NULL,
                             v_trnt_code,
                             v_trnt_gl_code,
                             v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
                valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                           v_org_code,
                           v_brn_code,
                           'CMPFND');
                v_count := v_count + 1;
                interface_append_gl (
                    v_trans_code,              --v_trans_code          NUMBER,
                    v_user,                    --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                    NULL,                        --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                    NULL,                        --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                    v_vchr_no,                  --v_vchr_no          VARCHAR2,
                    NULL,                        --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                    NULL,                        --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                    NULL,                     --v_rcpt_no            VARCHAR2,
                    v_count,                     --v_count             NUMBER,
                    'CONSOLIDATED COMPENSATION FUND - ' || v_vchr_no,
                    --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                    v_amt,                       --v_amount            NUMBER,
                    'C',                       --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                    v_trnt_gl_code,
                    --v_acc_number          VARCHAR2,
                    v_brn_code,                  --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                    v_gl_trans);
            END IF;

            interface_update_vgl (v_trans_code,     --v_trans_code     NUMBER,
                                  v_user,      --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                                  NULL,          --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                                  TRUNC (SYSDATE),      --v_date         DATE,
                                  NULL,          --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                                  NULL,          --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                                  'LMS COMP. FUND POSTING',
                                  --v_btc_description   VARCHAR2,
                                  'JV',       --v_btc_type           VARCHAR2,
                                  v_brn_code,    --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                                  'COMPENSATION FUND VOUCHER',
                                  --v_description       VARCHAR2,
                                  v_vchr_no,   --v_ref_no            VARCHAR2,
                                  v_gl_trans);

            IF v_count = 0
            THEN
                raise_application_error (-20001, 'JV NOT CREATED');
            END IF;

            --Updating records as posted....
            BEGIN
                UPDATE lms_ord_prem_receipts
                   SET opr_fund_posted = 'Y',
                       opr_fund_post_date = SYSDATE,
                       opr_fund_posted_by = v_user,
                       opr_cfp_code = v_cfp_code
                 WHERE     TRUNC (opr_date) BETWEEN v_date_from AND v_date_to
                       AND   NVL (opr_fund_client_contr, 0)
                           + NVL (opr_fund_company_contr, 0) >
                           0
                       AND NVL (opr_fund_posted, 'N') = 'N'
                       AND NVL (lms_ord_misc.check_rcpt_bal (opr_code), 0) =
                           0
                       AND opr_pol_code IN
                               (SELECT pol_code
                                  FROM lms_policies
                                 WHERE     pol_code = opr_pol_code
                                       AND pol_bra_code =
                                           DECODE (NVL (v_option, 'CB'),
                                                   'CB', pol_bra_code,
                                                   v_brn_code));
            EXCEPTION
                WHEN OTHERS
                THEN
                    raise_error ('ERROR UPDATING RECEIPT RECORDS....');
            END;
        END LOOP;
    EXCEPTION
        WHEN OTHERS
        THEN
            raise_error ('GL COMP. FUND...');
    END post_compensation_fund_gl;

    PROCEDURE post_premium_tax (
        v_date_from   DATE,
        v_date_to     DATE,
        v_option      VARCHAR2,
        v_brn_code    NUMBER,
        v_user        VARCHAR2,
        v_payee       VARCHAR2
    )
    IS
        CURSOR rcpts IS
              SELECT SUM (
                           NVL (opr_prem_tax, 0)
                         * DECODE (NVL (opr_drcr, 'C'), 'D', -1, 1))
                         prem_tax,
                     lms_ord_mis.check_renewal_paymnt (pol_code,
                                                       opr_receipt_date)
                         renewal
                FROM lms_ord_prem_receipts, lms_policies
               WHERE     TRUNC (opr_receipt_date) BETWEEN v_date_from
                                                      AND v_date_to
                     AND NVL (opr_prem_tax, 0) > 0
                     AND opr_pol_code = pol_code
                     AND NVL (opr_prem_tax_posted, 'N') = 'N'
                     AND NVL (lms_ord_misc.check_rcpt_bal (opr_code), 0) = 0
                     AND pol_bra_code =
                         DECODE (NVL (v_option, 'CB'),
                                 'CB', pol_bra_code,
                                 v_brn_code)
            GROUP BY lms_ord_mis.check_renewal_paymnt (pol_code,
                                                       opr_receipt_date);

        v_acc_type              VARCHAR2 (10) := 'D';
        v_gl_trans              tq_fms.fms_vouchers_pkg.tgl_rec_type;
        v_chq_dtls_rec          tq_fms.fms_cheques_pkg.type_rqn_dtls_table;
        v_vgl_no                NUMBER;
        v_trnt_code             VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_crt_acc_no            VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_trnt_gl_code          VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_trnt_contra_gl_code   VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_contra_acc            VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_count                 NUMBER := 0;
        v_gl_count              NUMBER := 0;
        v_org_code              NUMBER;
        v_prod_code             NUMBER;
        v_branch_code           NUMBER;
        v_vchr_no               VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_drcr                  VARCHAR2 (1);
        v_ptp_code              NUMBER;
        v_trans_code            NUMBER;
        v_done_by               VARCHAR2 (30);
    BEGIN
        BEGIN
            SELECT DISTINCT ltr_done_by
              INTO v_done_by
              FROM lms_transactions
             WHERE     ltr_btr_trans_code = 'PTX'
                   AND ltr_uw_clm_tran = 'A'
                   AND NVL (ltr_trans_authorised, 'N') NOT IN ('A', 'Y');
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                raise_error ('Unable to fetch transation details..');
        END;

        FOR r IN rcpts
        LOOP
            BEGIN
                v_vchr_no := lms_api.trans_voucher ('PTX');
                v_org_code := tq_fms.fms_interfaces_pkg.get_org (v_brn_code);

                SELECT    TO_NUMBER (TO_CHAR (SYSDATE, 'RRRR'))
                       || lms_ptp_code_seq.NEXTVAL
                  INTO v_ptp_code
                  FROM DUAL;

                INSERT INTO lms_policy_tax_pymt (ptp_code,
                                                 ptp_amount,
                                                 ptp_payee,
                                                 ptp_done_by,
                                                 ptp_done_date,
                                                 ptp_brn_code,
                                                 ptp_vchr_no,
                                                 ptp_date_from,
                                                 ptp_date_to)
                     VALUES (v_ptp_code,
                             r.prem_tax,
                             v_payee,
                             v_user,
                             SYSDATE,
                             v_brn_code,
                             v_vchr_no,
                             v_date_from,
                             v_date_to);
            EXCEPTION
                WHEN OTHERS
                THEN
                    raise_error (
                        'Error creating premium tax payment record....');
            END;

            v_count := 0;

            SELECT    TO_NUMBER (TO_CHAR (SYSDATE, 'RRRR'))
                   || lms_transaction_seq.NEXTVAL
              INTO v_trans_code
              FROM DUAL;

            IF NVL (r.prem_tax, 0) <> 0
            THEN
                -- POSTING GL VOUCHERS....
                get_gl_code ('UPTAX',
                             NULL,
                             v_trnt_code,
                             v_trnt_gl_code,
                             v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                             NULL,
                             r.renewal);
                valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                           v_org_code,
                           v_brn_code,
                           'UPTAX');
                v_gl_count := v_gl_count + 1;
                interface_append_gl (
                    v_trans_code,                --v_trans_code        NUMBER,
                    v_user,                    --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                    NULL,                        --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                    NULL,                        --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                    v_vchr_no,                 --v_vchr_no           VARCHAR2,
                    NULL,                        --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                    NULL,                        --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                    NULL,                       --v_rcpt_no          VARCHAR2,
                    v_gl_count,                  --v_count             NUMBER,
                    'PREMIUM TAX - ' || v_vchr_no || ';' || v_payee,
                    --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                    r.prem_tax,                  --v_amount            NUMBER,
                    'C',                       --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                    v_trnt_gl_code,
                    --v_acc_number        VARCHAR2,
                    v_brn_code,                  --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                    v_gl_trans);
                get_gl_code ('MNGEX',
                             NULL,
                             v_trnt_code,
                             v_trnt_gl_code,
                             v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                             NULL,
                             r.renewal);
                valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                           v_org_code,
                           v_brn_code,
                           'MNGEX');
                v_gl_count := v_gl_count + 1;
                interface_append_gl (
                    v_trans_code,                --v_trans_code        NUMBER,
                    v_user,                    --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                    NULL,                        --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                    NULL,                        --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                    v_vchr_no,                 --v_vchr_no           VARCHAR2,
                    NULL,                        --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                    NULL,                        --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                    NULL,                       --v_rcpt_no          VARCHAR2,
                    v_gl_count,                  --v_count             NUMBER,
                    'PREMIUM TAX - ' || v_vchr_no || ';' || v_payee,
                    --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                    r.prem_tax,                  --v_amount            NUMBER,
                    'D',                       --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                    v_trnt_gl_code,
                    --v_acc_number        VARCHAR2,
                    v_brn_code,                  --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                    v_gl_trans);
                interface_update_vgl (
                    v_trans_code,                   --v_trans_code     NUMBER,
                    v_user,                    --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                    NULL,                        --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                    TRUNC (SYSDATE),                    --v_date         DATE,
                    NULL,                        --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                    NULL,                        --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                    'PREMIUM TAX POSTING',
                    --v_btc_description   VARCHAR2,
                    'JV',                     --v_btc_type           VARCHAR2,
                    v_brn_code,                  --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                    'PREMIUM TAX VOUCHER - ' || v_vchr_no || ';' || v_payee,
                    --v_description       VARCHAR2,
                    v_vchr_no,                 --v_ref_no            VARCHAR2,
                    v_gl_trans);

                IF v_gl_count = 0
                THEN
                    raise_error ('JV NOT CREATED....');
                END IF;

                v_count := 0;
                -- MAKING CHEQUE REQUISITION FROM CONTROL A/C....
                get_gl_code ('UPTAX',
                             NULL,
                             v_trnt_code,
                             v_crt_acc_no,
                             v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                             NULL,
                             r.renewal);
                valid_acc (v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                           v_org_code,
                           v_brn_code,
                           'UPTAX');
                v_count := v_count + 1;
                interface_append_chq (
                    v_trans_code,                --v_trans_code        NUMBER,
                    v_user,                    --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                    NULL,                       --v_pol_code           NUMBER,
                    NULL,                       --v_prod_code          NUMBER,
                    v_vchr_no,                 --v_vchr_no           VARCHAR2,
                    v_count,                    --v_count              NUMBER,
                    r.prem_tax,                 --v_amount             NUMBER,
                       'CONSOLIDATED PREMIUM TAX - '
                    || v_vchr_no
                    || ';'
                    || v_payee,
                    --v_narrative          VARCHAR2,
                    v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                    --v_acc_number           VARCHAR2,
                    v_org_code,                --v_acc_org_code        NUMBER,
                    v_brn_code,                 --v_branch_code        NUMBER,
                    'D',                      --v_drcr               VARCHAR2,
                    v_chq_dtls_rec);

                IF v_count != 0
                THEN
                    BEGIN
                        IF NVL (v_option, 'CB') = 'CB'
                        THEN
                            v_branch_code := v_brn_code;
                        ELSE
                            v_branch_code :=
                                fms_interfaces_pkg.head_office (v_org_code);
                        END IF;

                        interface_create_reqn (v_trans_code,
                                               --v_trans_code         NUMBER,
                                               v_vchr_no,
                                               --v_ref                   VARCHAR2,
                                               v_ptp_code,
                                               --v_ref2                  VARCHAR2,
                                               TRUNC (SYSDATE),
                                               --v_ref_date              DATE,
                                               'PREMIUM TAX POSTING ( CHQ )',
                                               --v_narrative             VARCHAR2,
                                               r.prem_tax,
                                               --v_amount                NUMBER,
                                               v_payee,
                                               --v_payee                 VARCHAR2,
                                               'CHQ',
                                               --v_pay_method            VARCHAR2, --CHQ, EFT
                                               NULL,
                                               --v_payee_bank_acc_no        VARCHAR2,
                                               NULL,
                                               --v_payee_bank_branch_code   NUMBER,
                                               v_user,
                                               --v_source_auth_by        VARCHAR2,
                                               TRUNC (SYSDATE),
                                               --v_source_auth_dt        DATE,
                                               v_done_by,
                                               --v_raise_by                VARCHAR2,
                                               'UPTAX',
                                               --v_pmt_type              VARCHAR2,
                                               v_branch_code,
                                               --v_branch_code         NUMBER,
                                               NULL,             --v_pol_code,
                                               v_chq_dtls_rec);
                    EXCEPTION
                        WHEN OTHERS
                        THEN
                            raise_error ('POST PREMIUM TAX..');
                    END;
                END IF;
            END IF;

            IF v_count = 0
            THEN
                raise_error ('NO TRANSACTIONS POSTED TO FINANCE ');
            END IF;

            --Updating records as posted....
            BEGIN
                UPDATE lms_ord_prem_receipts
                   SET opr_prem_tax_posted = 'Y',
                       opr_prem_tax_posted_date = SYSDATE,
                       opr_prem_tax_posted_by = v_user,
                       opr_ptp_code = v_ptp_code
                 WHERE     TRUNC (opr_receipt_date) BETWEEN v_date_from
                                                        AND v_date_to
                       AND NVL (opr_prem_tax, 0) > 0
                       AND NVL (opr_prem_tax_posted, 'N') = 'N'
                       AND NVL (lms_ord_misc.check_rcpt_bal (opr_code), 0) =
                           0
                       AND opr_pol_code IN
                               (SELECT pol_code
                                  FROM lms_policies
                                 WHERE     pol_code = opr_pol_code
                                       AND pol_bra_code =
                                           DECODE (NVL (v_option, 'CB'),
                                                   'CB', pol_bra_code,
                                                   v_brn_code));
            EXCEPTION
                WHEN OTHERS
                THEN
                    raise_error ('Error updating receipt records....');
            END;
        END LOOP;
    EXCEPTION
        WHEN OTHERS
        THEN
            raise_error ('PREMTAX....');
    END post_premium_tax;

    PROCEDURE post_policy_taxes (
        v_date_from   DATE,
        v_date_to     DATE,
        v_option      VARCHAR2,
        v_brn_code    NUMBER,
        v_tt_code     NUMBER,
        v_user        VARCHAR2,
        v_payee       VARCHAR2,
        v_type        VARCHAR2
    )
    IS
        --v_type IN (PL - Policy Tax, LN - Loan Tax, PN - Pension / Investment Tax)
        CURSOR tax IS
              SELECT tt_type,
                     tt_desc,
                     SUM (NVL (ptx_tax_amt, 0))                                    tax_amt,
                     lms_ord_mis.check_renewal_paymnt (pol_code,
                                                       endr_authorization_date)    renewal
                FROM lms_policy_taxes,
                     lms_policies,
                     lms_policy_endorsements,
                     lms_tax_types
               WHERE     NVL (ptx_tax_amt, 0) > 0
                     AND endr_code = ptx_endr_code
                     AND endr_pol_code = pol_code
                     AND NVL (endr_authorized, 'N') IN ('Y', 'A')
                     AND NOT NVL (ptx_tax_posted, 'N') = 'Y'
                     AND ptx_tt_code = tt_code
                     AND tt_code = v_tt_code
                     AND TRUNC (endr_authorization_date) BETWEEN v_date_from
                                                             AND v_date_to
                     AND pol_bra_code =
                         DECODE (NVL (v_option, 'CB'),
                                 'CB', pol_bra_code,
                                 v_brn_code)
                     AND v_type = 'PL'
                     AND NVL (ptx_pay_tax, 'N') = 'Y'
            GROUP BY tt_type,
                     tt_desc,
                     lms_ord_mis.check_renewal_paymnt (
                         pol_code,
                         endr_authorization_date)
            UNION
              SELECT tt_type,
                     tt_desc,
                     SUM (NVL (ltx_tax_amt, 0))                            tax_amt,
                     lms_ord_mis.check_renewal_paymnt (pol_code,
                                                       pln_date_issued)    renewal
                FROM lms_loan_taxes,
                     lms_policies,
                     lms_policy_loans,
                     lms_tax_types
               WHERE     NVL (ltx_tax_amt, 0) > 0
                     AND pln_lna_no = ltx_lna_no
                     AND pln_pol_code = pol_code
                     AND NOT NVL (ltx_tax_posted, 'N') = 'Y'
                     AND ltx_tt_code = tt_code
                     AND tt_code = v_tt_code
                     AND TRUNC (pln_date_issued) BETWEEN v_date_from
                                                     AND v_date_to
                     AND pol_bra_code =
                         DECODE (NVL (v_option, 'CB'),
                                 'CB', pol_bra_code,
                                 v_brn_code)
                     AND v_type = 'LN'
            GROUP BY tt_type,
                     tt_desc,
                     lms_ord_mis.check_renewal_paymnt (pol_code,
                                                       pln_date_issued)
            UNION
              SELECT tt_type,
                     tt_desc,
                     SUM (NVL (pptx_tax_amt, 0))                                   tax_amt,
                     lms_ord_mis.check_renewal_paymnt (pol_code,
                                                       endr_authorization_date)    renewal
                FROM lms_pol_pension_taxes,
                     lms_policies,
                     lms_policy_endorsements,
                     lms_tax_types
               WHERE     NVL (pptx_tax_amt, 0) > 0
                     AND endr_code = pptx_endr_code
                     AND endr_pol_code = pol_code
                     AND NVL (endr_authorized, 'N') IN ('Y', 'A')
                     AND NOT NVL (pptx_tax_posted, 'N') = 'Y'
                     AND pptx_tt_code = tt_code
                     AND tt_code = v_tt_code
                     AND TRUNC (endr_authorization_date) BETWEEN v_date_from
                                                             AND v_date_to
                     AND pol_bra_code =
                         DECODE (NVL (v_option, 'CB'),
                                 'CB', pol_bra_code,
                                 v_brn_code)
                     AND v_type = 'PN'
            GROUP BY tt_type,
                     tt_desc,
                     lms_ord_mis.check_renewal_paymnt (
                         pol_code,
                         endr_authorization_date)
            UNION
              SELECT tt_type,
                     tt_desc,
                     SUM (NVL (pded_tax_amt, 0))                                tax_amt,
                     lms_ord_mis.check_renewal_paymnt (pol_code,
                                                       pded_authorized_date)    renewal
                FROM lms_pension_deductions, lms_policies, lms_tax_types
               WHERE     NVL (pded_tax_amt, 0) > 0
                     AND pded_pol_code = pol_code
                     AND NVL (pded_authorized, 'N') = 'Y'
                     AND pded_tt_code = tt_code
                     AND tt_code = v_tt_code
                     AND NVL (pded_tax_posted, 'N') = 'N'
                     AND TRUNC (pded_authorized_date) BETWEEN v_date_from
                                                          AND v_date_to
                     AND pol_bra_code =
                         DECODE (NVL (v_option, 'CB'),
                                 'CB', pol_bra_code,
                                 v_brn_code)
                     AND v_type = 'PNV'
            GROUP BY tt_type,
                     tt_desc,
                     lms_ord_mis.check_renewal_paymnt (pol_code,
                                                       pded_authorized_date);

        v_acc_type              VARCHAR2 (10) := 'D';
        v_gl_trans              tq_fms.fms_vouchers_pkg.tgl_rec_type;
        v_chq_dtls_rec          fms_cheques_pkg.type_rqn_dtls_table;
        v_vgl_no                NUMBER;
        v_trnt_code             VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_trnt_gl_code          VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_trnt_contra_gl_code   VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_contra_acc            VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_raised_by             NUMBER;
        v_count                 NUMBER := 0;
        v_gl_cnt                NUMBER := -1;
        v_org_code              NUMBER;
        v_cur_code              NUMBER;
        v_ptp_code              NUMBER;
        v_amt                   NUMBER;
        v_prod_code             NUMBER;
        v_branch_code           NUMBER;
        v_vchr_no               VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_auth_by               NUMBER;
        v_sys_code              NUMBER;
        v_bct_code              NUMBER;
        v_bct_brh_code          NUMBER;
        v_ptax_param            VARCHAR2 (5);
        v_ptax_param_status     VARCHAR2 (5);
        v_tx_type               VARCHAR2 (5);
        v_narrative             VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_posted                VARCHAR2 (1) := 'N';
        v_trans_code            NUMBER;
        v_raise_chq             VARCHAR2 (1) := 'Y';
        v_acc_bal               NUMBER;
        v_stamp_duty_limit      VARCHAR2 (1);
        v_stt_duty_amount       NUMBER;
        v_system                NUMBER;
        v_done_by               VARCHAR2 (30);
    BEGIN
        BEGIN
            lms_ord_misc.system_param_val ('CONSOLIDATE_POLICY_TAX',
                                           v_ptax_param);
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                raise_error ('Param Error...');
        END;

        IF NOT NVL (v_ptax_param, 'N') = 'Y'
        THEN
            raise_error (
                'SYSTEM PARAMETER "CONSOLIDATE_POLICY_TAX" SETTING DOES NOT ALLOW THIS TRANSACTION....');
        END IF;

        SELECT    TO_NUMBER (TO_CHAR (SYSDATE, 'RRRR'))
               || lms_transaction_seq.NEXTVAL
          INTO v_trans_code
          FROM DUAL;

        BEGIN
            SELECT DISTINCT ltr_done_by
              INTO v_done_by
              FROM lms_transactions
             WHERE     ltr_uw_clm_tran = 'A'
                   AND ltr_tt_code = v_tt_code
                   AND NVL (ltr_trans_authorised, 'N') NOT IN ('A', 'Y');
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                raise_error ('Unable to fetch transation details..');
        END;

        FOR t IN tax
        LOOP
            v_tx_type := get_tax_type (t.tt_type, v_narrative);

            IF t.tt_type = 'CWTX'
            THEN                                             --Commission Whtx
                v_tx_type := 'WTHTX1';
                v_narrative := 'COMM WHTX';
            ELSIF t.tt_type = 'UPTX'
            THEN                                             --U/W Premium Tax
                v_tx_type := 'UPTAX';
                v_narrative := 'PREM TAX';
            ELSIF t.tt_type = 'SD'
            THEN                                                  --Stamp Duty
                v_tx_type := 'SD';
                v_narrative := 'STAMP DUTY';
                v_raise_chq := 'N';
            --RAISE_ERROR('RAISE_CHQ'||v_raise_chq);
            ELSIF t.tt_type = 'TL'
            THEN                                               --Training Levy
                v_tx_type := 'TL';
                v_narrative := 'TRAINING LEVY';
            ELSIF t.tt_type IN ('PT', 'OT')
            THEN                   --Pension Taxes AND Pension valuation taxes
                v_tx_type := 'MNGEX';
                v_narrative := 'PENS TAX';
            ELSIF t.tt_type = 'PE'
            THEN                                            --Pension Expenses
                v_tx_type := 'MNGEX';
                v_narrative := 'PENS EXP';
            ELSIF t.tt_type = 'PATX'
            THEN                                                      --PA Tax
                v_tx_type := 'UPTAX';
                v_narrative := 'PA TAX';
            ELSIF t.tt_type = 'CL'
            THEN                                           --Compensation Levy
                v_tx_type := 'CMPFND';
                v_narrative := 'COMP FUND';
            ELSIF t.tt_type = 'PAYE'
            THEN                                                        --PAYE
                v_tx_type := 'PAYE';
                v_narrative := 'PAYE TAX';
            ELSE
                raise_error (
                       'TAX TYPE '
                    || t.tt_type
                    || ' FOR '
                    || t.tt_desc
                    || ' HAS NOT BEEN PROVIDED FOR....');
            END IF;

            v_amt := NVL (t.tax_amt, 0);

            --RAISE_ERROR(v_amt||';'||v_raise_chq);
            BEGIN
                v_vchr_no := lms_api.trans_voucher ('PTX');

                SELECT    TO_NUMBER (TO_CHAR (SYSDATE, 'RRRR'))
                       || lms_ptp_code_seq.NEXTVAL
                  INTO v_ptp_code
                  FROM DUAL;

                INSERT INTO lms_policy_tax_pymt (ptp_code,
                                                 ptp_amount,
                                                 ptp_payee,
                                                 ptp_done_by,
                                                 ptp_done_date,
                                                 ptp_brn_code,
                                                 ptp_vchr_no,
                                                 ptp_tt_code,
                                                 ptp_date_from,
                                                 ptp_date_to)
                     VALUES (v_ptp_code,
                             v_amt,
                             v_payee,
                             v_user,
                             SYSDATE,
                             v_brn_code,
                             v_vchr_no,
                             v_tt_code,
                             v_date_from,
                             v_date_to);
            EXCEPTION
                WHEN OTHERS
                THEN
                    raise_error ('ERROR CREATING TAX PAYMENT RECORD....');
            END;

            v_count := 0;
            v_org_code := fms_interfaces_pkg.get_org (v_brn_code);

            IF NVL (v_amt, 0) <> 0
            THEN
                get_gl_code (v_tx_type,
                             v_prod_code,
                             v_trnt_code,
                             v_trnt_gl_code,
                             v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                             NULL,
                             t.renewal);
                valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                           v_org_code,
                           v_brn_code,
                           v_tx_type);
                valid_acc (v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                           v_org_code,
                           v_brn_code,
                           v_tx_type || ' CONTRA');
                v_gl_cnt := v_gl_cnt + 2;

                IF t.tt_type = 'SD'
                THEN
                    v_acc_bal :=
                        tq_fms.fms_gen_pkg.get_acc_balance (
                            v_trnt_gl_code,
                            TO_NUMBER (TO_CHAR (SYSDATE, 'RRRR')),
                            v_org_code);

                    BEGIN
                        tq_fms.fms_settings_pkg.system_param_val2 (
                            'STAMP_DUTY_LIMIT',
                            v_stamp_duty_limit,
                            v_stt_duty_amount,
                            v_system);
                    EXCEPTION
                        WHEN OTHERS
                        THEN
                            raise_error (
                                'Please Set Up The Stamp Duty Float in FMS..');
                    END;

                    IF v_stamp_duty_limit = 'Y'
                    THEN
                        IF v_acc_bal < TO_NUMBER (v_stt_duty_amount)
                        THEN
                            lms_tracking.create_incidence (v_user,
                                                           'PURSDTY',
                                                           'PURSDTY',
                                                           NULL,
                                                           NULL,
                                                           NULL,
                                                           NULL,
                                                           NULL,
                                                           'PURCHASE STAMPS');
                            raise_error (
                                   'Purchase More Stamps.Minimum Account Balance Reached'
                                || v_acc_bal);
                        END IF;
                    ELSE
                        v_raise_chq := 'Y';
                    END IF;
                END IF;

                interface_append_gl (v_trans_code,
                                     --v_trans_code           NUMBER,
                                     v_user,   --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                                     NULL,       --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                                     v_prod_code, --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                                     v_vchr_no, --v_vchr_no             VARCHAR2,
                                     NULL,       --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                                     NULL,       --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                                     NULL,   --v_rcpt_no             VARCHAR2,
                                     v_gl_cnt,   --v_count             NUMBER,
                                     v_narrative || ' - ' || v_vchr_no,
                                     --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                                     v_amt,      --v_amount            NUMBER,
                                     'D',      --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                                     v_trnt_gl_code,
                                     --v_acc_number1          VARCHAR2,
                                     v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                     --v_acc_number2          VARCHAR2,
                                     v_brn_code, --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                                     v_gl_trans);
                v_count := v_count + 1;

                IF v_raise_chq = 'Y'
                THEN
                    interface_append_chq (v_trans_code, --v_trans_code         NUMBER,
                                          v_user, --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                                          NULL, --v_pol_code           NUMBER,
                                          v_prod_code, --v_prod_code          NUMBER,
                                          v_vchr_no, --v_vchr_no              VARCHAR2,
                                          v_count, --v_count              NUMBER,
                                          v_amt, --v_amount             NUMBER,
                                          v_narrative || ' - ' || v_vchr_no,
                                          --v_narrative          VARCHAR2,
                                          v_trnt_contra_gl_code, --v_acc_number            VARCHAR2,
                                          v_org_code, --v_acc_org_code          NUMBER,
                                          v_brn_code, --v_branch_code        NUMBER,
                                          'D', --v_drcr               VARCHAR2,
                                          v_chq_dtls_rec);

                    IF v_count != 0
                    THEN
                        BEGIN
                            IF NVL (v_option, 'CB') = 'CB'
                            THEN
                                v_branch_code := v_brn_code;
                            ELSE
                                v_branch_code :=
                                    fms_interfaces_pkg.head_office (
                                        v_org_code);
                            END IF;

                            interface_create_reqn (
                                v_trans_code,
                                --v_trans_code           NUMBER,
                                v_vchr_no,
                                --v_ref                   VARCHAR2,
                                v_ptp_code,
                                --v_ref2                  VARCHAR2,
                                TRUNC (SYSDATE),
                                --v_ref_date              DATE,
                                v_narrative || ' - ' || v_vchr_no,
                                --v_narrative             VARCHAR2,
                                v_amt,
                                --v_amount                NUMBER,
                                v_payee,
                                --v_payee                 VARCHAR2,
                                'CHQ',
                                --v_pay_method            VARCHAR2, --CHQ, EFT
                                NULL,
                                --v_payee_bank_acc_no        VARCHAR2,
                                NULL,
                                --v_payee_bank_branch_code   NUMBER,
                                v_user,
                                --v_source_auth_by        VARCHAR2,
                                TRUNC (SYSDATE),
                                --v_source_auth_dt        DATE,
                                v_done_by,
                                --v_raise_by                VARCHAR2,
                                v_tx_type,
                                --v_pmt_type              VARCHAR2,
                                v_branch_code,
                                --v_branch_code           NUMBER,
                                NULL,                            --v_pol_code,
                                v_chq_dtls_rec);
                        EXCEPTION
                            WHEN OTHERS
                            THEN
                                raise_error ('POST TAX..');
                        END;
                    END IF;
                END IF;
            END IF;

            IF v_gl_cnt <> 0
            THEN
                interface_update_vgl (v_trans_code, --v_trans_code     NUMBER,
                                      v_user,  --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                                      NULL,      --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                                      TRUNC (SYSDATE), --v_date              DATE,
                                      NULL,      --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                                      NULL,      --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                                      'LMS TAX BATCH', --v_btc_description   VARCHAR2,
                                      'JV', --v_btc_type             VARCHAR2,
                                      v_brn_code, --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                                      v_narrative, --v_description       VARCHAR2,
                                      v_vchr_no, --v_ref_no             VARCHAR2,
                                      v_gl_trans);
            END IF;

            IF v_count = 0
            THEN
                raise_error ('NO TRANSACTIONS POSTED TO FINANCE....');
            END IF;

            --Updating records as posted....
            IF v_type = 'PL'
            THEN
                BEGIN
                    UPDATE lms_policy_taxes
                       SET ptx_tax_posted = 'Y',
                           ptx_tax_post_date = SYSDATE,
                           ptx_tax_posted_by = v_user,
                           ptx_ptp_code = v_ptp_code
                     WHERE     NVL (ptx_tax_amt, 0) > 0
                           AND NOT NVL (ptx_tax_posted, 'N') = 'Y'
                           AND ptx_tt_code = v_tt_code
                           AND NVL (ptx_pay_tax, 'N') = 'Y'
                           AND ptx_endr_code IN
                                   (SELECT endr_code
                                      FROM lms_policies,
                                           lms_policy_endorsements
                                     WHERE     endr_pol_code = pol_code
                                           AND NVL (endr_authorized, 'N') IN
                                                   ('Y', 'A')
                                           AND TRUNC (
                                                   endr_authorization_date) BETWEEN v_date_from
                                                                                AND v_date_to
                                           AND pol_bra_code =
                                               DECODE (NVL (v_option, 'CB'),
                                                       'CB', pol_bra_code,
                                                       v_brn_code));
                EXCEPTION
                    WHEN OTHERS
                    THEN
                        raise_error ('ERROR UPDATING POLICY TAX RECORDS....');
                END;
            ELSIF v_type = 'LN'
            THEN
                BEGIN
                    UPDATE lms_loan_taxes
                       SET ltx_tax_posted = 'Y',
                           ltx_tax_post_date = SYSDATE,
                           ltx_tax_posted_by = v_user,
                           ltx_ptp_code = v_ptp_code
                     WHERE     NVL (ltx_tax_amt, 0) > 0
                           AND NOT NVL (ltx_tax_posted, 'N') = 'Y'
                           AND ltx_tt_code = v_tt_code
                           AND ltx_lna_no IN
                                   (SELECT pln_lna_no
                                      FROM lms_policy_loans
                                     WHERE     ltx_lna_no = pln_lna_no
                                           AND TRUNC (pln_date_issued) BETWEEN v_date_from
                                                                           AND v_date_to);
                EXCEPTION
                    WHEN OTHERS
                    THEN
                        raise_error ('ERROR UPDATING LOAN TAX RECORDS....');
                END;
            ELSIF v_type = 'PN'
            THEN
                BEGIN
                    UPDATE lms_pol_pension_taxes
                       SET pptx_tax_posted = 'Y',
                           pptx_tax_post_date = SYSDATE,
                           pptx_tax_posted_by = v_user,
                           pptx_ptp_code = v_ptp_code
                     WHERE     NVL (pptx_tax_amt, 0) > 0
                           AND pptx_tax_posted = 'N'
                           AND pptx_tt_code = v_tt_code
                           AND pptx_endr_code IN
                                   (SELECT endr_code
                                      FROM lms_policy_endorsements
                                     WHERE     endr_code = pptx_endr_code
                                           AND NVL (endr_authorized, 'N') IN
                                                   ('Y', 'A')
                                           AND TRUNC (
                                                   endr_authorization_date) BETWEEN v_date_from
                                                                                AND v_date_to);
                EXCEPTION
                    WHEN OTHERS
                    THEN
                        raise_error (
                            'ERROR UPDATING PENSION TAX RECORDS....');
                END;
            ELSIF v_type = 'PNV'
            THEN
                -- RAISE_ERROR('NO GO ZONE PLEASE...');
                BEGIN
                    UPDATE lms_pension_deductions
                       SET pded_tax_posted = 'Y',
                           pded_tax_post_date = SYSDATE,
                           pded_tax_posted_by = v_user,
                           pded_ptp_code = v_ptp_code
                     WHERE     NVL (pded_tax_amt, 0) > 0
                           AND pded_tax_posted = 'N'
                           AND pded_tt_code = v_tt_code
                           AND NVL (pded_authorized, 'N') = 'Y'
                           AND TRUNC (pded_authorized_date) BETWEEN v_date_from
                                                                AND v_date_to;
                EXCEPTION
                    WHEN OTHERS
                    THEN
                        raise_error (
                            'ERROR UPDATING PENSION TAX RECORDS....');
                END;
            END IF;

            v_posted := 'Y';
        END LOOP;

        IF NVL (v_posted, 'N') = 'N'
        THEN
            raise_error ('NO RECORDS POSTED TO ACCOUNTS....');
        END IF;
    EXCEPTION
        WHEN OTHERS
        THEN
            raise_error ('POLTAX...');
    END post_policy_taxes;

    PROCEDURE update_comp_fund (
        v_vchr_no    VARCHAR2,
        v_chq_no     VARCHAR2,
        v_chq_date   DATE,
        v_cfp_code   NUMBER,
        v_user       VARCHAR2
    )
    IS
    BEGIN
        UPDATE lms_compensation_fund_pymt
           SET cfp_chq_date = v_chq_date,
               cfp_chq_no = v_chq_no,
               cfp_chq_update_by = v_user,
               cfp_chq_update_date = SYSDATE
         WHERE cfp_code = v_cfp_code AND cfp_vchr_no = v_vchr_no;
    EXCEPTION
        WHEN OTHERS
        THEN
            raise_error ('UNABLE TO UPDATE COMPENSATION FUND DETAILS....');
    END update_comp_fund;

    PROCEDURE post_agent_adv (
        v_cad_code                  NUMBER,
        v_user                      VARCHAR2,
        v_adv_type                  VARCHAR2 DEFAULT NULL,
        v_otop_receipt_trans_code   VARCHAR2 DEFAULT NULL,
        v_receipt_pk                NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
        v_rct_code                  VARCHAR2 DEFAULT NULL,
        v_curr_trans_no             NUMBER DEFAULT NULL
    )
    IS
        v_chq_dtls_rec          fms_cheques_pkg.type_rqn_dtls_table;
        v_gl_trans              tq_fms.fms_vouchers_pkg.tgl_rec_type;
        vgl_code                NUMBER;
        v_gl_count              NUMBER := 0;
        v_trnt_code             VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_contra_acc            VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_trnt_gl_code          VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_trnt_contra_gl_code   VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_count                 NUMBER := 0;
        v_org_code              NUMBER;
        v_amt                   NUMBER;
        v_prod_code             NUMBER;
        v_payee                 VARCHAR2 (50);
        v_brn_code              NUMBER;
        v_desc                  VARCHAR2 (200);
        v_desc1                 VARCHAR2 (200);
        v_trans_code            NUMBER;
        v_otop_code             NUMBER;
        v_ref                   VARCHAR2 (200);
        v_done_by               lms_comm_advances.cad_done_by%TYPE;
        v_lalt_code             NUMBER;
        v_lalt_description      lms_agent_loan_types.lalt_description%TYPE;
        v_lalt_type             lms_agent_loan_types.lalt_type%TYPE;
        v_desc2                 VARCHAR2 (200);
        v_ref_date              DATE;
        v_acc_no                VARCHAR2 (50);
        v_bank                  VARCHAR2 (100);
        v_bbr_code              NUMBER;
        v_pymt_method           VARCHAR2 (10);
    BEGIN
        /*
        step 1
        CREATE cheq requisition
               CR Bank
              DR Adv suspense a/c
        step 2
        CREATE gl voucher
              DR Comm adv a/c
              CR Adv suspense a/c
        */
        --raise_error(v_cad_code||';'||v_user||';'||v_adv_type||';'||v_otop_receipt_trans_code||';'||v_receipt_pk||';'||v_rct_code);
        SELECT    TO_NUMBER (TO_CHAR (SYSDATE, 'RRRR'))
               || lms_transaction_seq.NEXTVAL
          INTO v_trans_code
          FROM DUAL;

        IF v_adv_type IS NOT NULL
        THEN
            v_desc := 'DIRECT AGENT ADV.PYMT.';
            v_desc1 := 'AGENT ADVANCE';
            v_desc2 := 'LMS AGNT ADV POSTING ( CHQ )';

            BEGIN
                SELECT cad_brn_code,
                       otop_code,
                       NVL (otop_alloc_amt, otop_amt),
                       otop_done_by,
                       cad_date
                  INTO v_brn_code,
                       v_otop_code,
                       v_amt,
                       v_done_by,
                       v_ref_date
                  FROM lms_ord_other_pymts, lms_comm_advances
                 WHERE     otop_cad_code = cad_code
                       AND cad_code = v_cad_code
                       AND otop_receipt_no = v_rct_code
                       AND otop_fms_receipt_pk = v_receipt_pk
                       AND otop_receipt_trans_code =
                           v_otop_receipt_trans_code;
            EXCEPTION
                WHEN OTHERS
                THEN
                    tqc_error_manager.raise_error (
                        270104901,
                        text_in     =>
                            'Unable to fetch agent loan receipt details. ',
                        name1_in    => 'adv code',
                        value1_in   => TO_CHAR (v_cad_code));
            END;
        ELSE
            IF v_curr_trans_no IS NOT NULL AND v_cad_code IS NULL
            THEN
                BEGIN
                      SELECT cad_brn_code,
                             TRIM (
                                    agn_other_names
                                 || ' '
                                 || TRIM (agn_md_name || ' ' || agn_name))
                                 agn_name,
