                             SUM (cad_comm_adv_amt),
                             cad_done_by,
                             cad_date,
                             NVL (cad_bank_acc_no, agn_bank_acc_no),
                             NVL (cad_bank_name, agn_bank),
                             NVL (cad_bbr_code, agn_bbr_code),
                             NVL (cad_pymt_method, 'CHQ')
                        INTO v_brn_code,
                             v_payee,
                             v_amt,
                             v_done_by,
                             v_ref_date,
                             v_acc_no,
                             v_bank,
                             v_bbr_code,
                             v_pymt_method
                        FROM lms_comm_advances, lms_agencies
                       WHERE     cad_agn_code = agn_code
                             AND cad_trans_no = v_curr_trans_no
                    GROUP BY cad_brn_code,
                             agn_name,
                             cad_done_by,
                             cad_date;
                EXCEPTION
                    WHEN OTHERS
                    THEN
                        tqc_error_manager.raise_error (
                            270104902,
                            text_in     =>
                                'Unable to fetch agent loan details. ',
                            name1_in    => 'adv code',
                            value1_in   => TO_CHAR (v_cad_code));
                END;
            ELSE
                BEGIN
                    SELECT cad_brn_code,
                           TRIM (
                                  agn_other_names
                               || ' '
                               || TRIM (agn_md_name || ' ' || agn_name))
                               agn_name,
                           cad_comm_adv_amt,
                           cad_done_by,
                           cad_lalt_code,
                           cad_date,
                           NVL (cad_bank_acc_no, agn_bank_acc_no),
                           NVL (cad_bank_name, agn_bank),
                           NVL (cad_bbr_code, agn_bbr_code),
                           NVL (cad_pymt_method, 'CHQ')
                      INTO v_brn_code,
                           v_payee,
                           v_amt,
                           v_done_by,
                           v_lalt_code,
                           v_ref_date,
                           v_acc_no,
                           v_bank,
                           v_bbr_code,
                           v_pymt_method
                      FROM lms_comm_advances, lms_agencies
                     WHERE cad_agn_code = agn_code AND cad_code = v_cad_code;
                EXCEPTION
                    WHEN OTHERS
                    THEN
                        tqc_error_manager.raise_error (
                            270104903,
                            text_in   => 'ERROR RETRIEVING ADVANCE DTLS....');
                END;

                IF v_lalt_code IS NOT NULL
                THEN
                    BEGIN
                        SELECT lalt_gl_code,
                               lalt_contra_gl_code,
                               lalt_description,
                               lalt_type
                          INTO v_trnt_gl_code,
                               v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                               v_lalt_description,
                               v_lalt_type
                          FROM lms_agent_loan_types
                         WHERE lalt_code = v_lalt_code;
                    EXCEPTION
                        WHEN OTHERS
                        THEN
                            tqc_error_manager.raise_error (
                                270104903,
                                text_in   =>
                                    'ERROR RETRIEVING LOAN TYPE DTLS....');
                    END;
                END IF;
            END IF;

            IF v_lalt_description IS NOT NULL
            THEN
                v_desc1 := v_lalt_description;

                IF NVL (v_lalt_type, 'ADV') IN ('ADV')
                THEN
                    v_desc := 'PAYMENT FOR AGENT ADV.';

                    IF NVL (v_pymt_method, 'CHQ') = 'EFT'
                    THEN
                        v_desc2 := 'LMS AGNT ADV POSTING ( EFT )';
                    ELSE
                        v_desc2 := 'LMS AGNT LOAN POSTING ( CHQ )';
                    END IF;
                ELSE
                    v_desc := 'PAYMENT FOR AGENT LOAN.';

                    IF NVL (v_pymt_method, 'CHQ') = 'EFT'
                    THEN
                        v_desc2 := 'LMS AGNT ADV POSTING ( EFT )';
                    ELSE
                        v_desc2 := 'LMS AGNT LOAN POSTING ( CHQ )';
                    END IF;
                END IF;
            ELSE
                v_desc1 := 'AGENT ADVANCE';
                v_desc := 'PAYMENT FOR AGENT ADV.';

                IF NVL (v_pymt_method, 'CHQ') = 'EFT'
                THEN
                    v_desc2 := 'LMS AGNT ADV POSTING ( EFT )';
                ELSE
                    v_desc2 := 'LMS AGNT LOAN POSTING ( CHQ )';
                END IF;
            END IF;
        END IF;

        v_org_code := fms_interfaces_pkg.get_org (v_brn_code);

        IF NVL (v_amt, 0) <> 0
        THEN
            IF v_trnt_gl_code IS NOT NULL
            THEN
                valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                           v_org_code,
                           v_brn_code,
                           v_lalt_description);
                valid_acc (v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                           v_org_code,
                           v_brn_code,
                           v_lalt_description || ' CONTRA');
            ELSE
                get_gl_code ('AGNADV',
                             v_prod_code,
                             v_trnt_code,
                             v_trnt_gl_code,
                             v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
                valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                           v_org_code,
                           v_brn_code,
                           'AGNADV');
                valid_acc (v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                           v_org_code,
                           v_brn_code,
                           'AGNADV CONTRA');
            END IF;

            IF v_adv_type IS NULL
            THEN
                IF NVL (v_lalt_type, '-1') = 'NMO'
                THEN
                    v_gl_count := v_gl_count + 1;
                    interface_append_gl (v_trans_code,        -- v_trans_code,
                                         v_user,                -- v_raise_by,
                                         NULL,                  -- v_pol_code,
                                         NULL,                 -- v_prod_code,
                                         NULL,                   -- v_vchr_no,
                                         NULL,                  -- v_opr_code,
                                         NULL,                 -- v_oppr_code,
                                         NULL,                    --v_rcpt_no,
                                         v_gl_count,               -- v_count,
                                         v_desc1,              -- v_narrative,
                                         NVL (v_amt, 0),          -- v_amount,
                                         'D',                       -- v_drcr,
                                         v_trnt_gl_code,     -- v_acc_number1,
                                         v_brn_code,         -- v_branch_code,
                                         v_gl_trans,
                                         v_cad_code,            --v_otop_code,
                                         v_otop_code);

                    v_gl_count := v_gl_count + 1;

                    interface_append_gl (v_trans_code,        -- v_trans_code,
                                         v_user,                -- v_raise_by,
                                         NULL,                  -- v_pol_code,
                                         NULL,                 -- v_prod_code,
                                         NULL,                   -- v_vchr_no,
                                         NULL,                  -- v_opr_code,
                                         NULL,                 -- v_oppr_code,
                                         NULL,                    --v_rcpt_no,
                                         v_gl_count,               -- v_count,
                                         v_desc1,              -- v_narrative,
                                         NVL (v_amt, 0),          -- v_amount,
                                         'C',                       -- v_drcr,
                                         v_trnt_contra_gl_code, -- v_acc_number2,
                                         v_brn_code,         -- v_branch_code,
                                         v_gl_trans,
                                         v_cad_code,            --v_otop_code,
                                         v_otop_code);
                ELSE
                    v_count := v_count + 1;
                    interface_append_chq (v_trans_code,
                                          v_user,
                                          NULL,
                                          --v_pol_code,find out how to fetch policy code for the medicals.
                                          v_prod_code,
                                          NULL,                   --v_vchr_no,
                                          v_count,
                                          v_amt,
                                          v_desc1,          --'AGENT ADVANCE',
                                          v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                          v_org_code,
                                          v_brn_code,
                                          'D',
                                          v_chq_dtls_rec);
                    v_gl_count := v_gl_count + 1;
                    interface_append_gl (v_trans_code,        -- v_trans_code,
                                         v_user,                -- v_raise_by,
                                         NULL,                  -- v_pol_code,
                                         NULL,                 -- v_prod_code,
                                         NULL,                   -- v_vchr_no,
                                         NULL,                  -- v_opr_code,
                                         NULL,                 -- v_oppr_code,
                                         NULL,                    --v_rcpt_no,
                                         v_gl_count,               -- v_count,
                                         v_desc1,              -- v_narrative,
                                         NVL (v_amt, 0),          -- v_amount,
                                         'C',                       -- v_drcr,
                                         v_trnt_contra_gl_code, -- v_acc_number1,
                                         v_trnt_gl_code,     -- v_acc_number2,
                                         v_brn_code,         -- v_branch_code,
                                         v_gl_trans,
                                         v_cad_code,            --v_otop_code,
                                         v_otop_code);          --v_otop_code,
                END IF;
            ELSE
                get_gl_code ('MISC_RCT',
                             v_prod_code,
                             v_trnt_code,
                             v_contra_acc,
                             v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
                valid_acc (v_contra_acc,
                           v_org_code,
                           v_brn_code,
                           'MISC_RCT');
                --v_gl_count := NVL (v_gl_count, 0) + 2;
                v_gl_count := v_gl_count + 2;
                interface_append_gl (v_trans_code,            -- v_trans_code,
                                     v_user,                    -- v_raise_by,
                                     NULL,                      -- v_pol_code,
                                     NULL,                     -- v_prod_code,
                                     NULL,                       -- v_vchr_no,
                                     NULL,                      -- v_opr_code,
                                     NULL,                     -- v_oppr_code,
                                     NULL,                        --v_rcpt_no,
                                     v_gl_count,                   -- v_count,
                                     v_desc1,                  -- v_narrative,
                                     NVL (v_amt, 0),              -- v_amount,
                                     'D',                           -- v_drcr,
                                     v_contra_acc,           -- v_acc_number1,
                                     v_trnt_gl_code,         -- v_acc_number2,
                                     v_brn_code,             -- v_branch_code,
                                     v_gl_trans,
                                     v_cad_code,                --v_otop_code,
                                     v_otop_code);              --v_otop_code,
            END IF;
        END IF;

        IF v_count != 0
        THEN
            IF v_curr_trans_no IS NOT NULL AND v_cad_code IS NULL
            THEN
                IF NVL (v_pymt_method, 'CHQ') = 'EFT'
                THEN
                    BEGIN
                        interface_create_reqn (
                            v_trans_code,       --v_trans_code         NUMBER,
                            v_curr_trans_no, --v_ref                   VARCHAR2,
                            v_curr_trans_no, --v_ref2                  VARCHAR2,
                            NVL (v_ref_date, TRUNC (SYSDATE)),
                            --v_ref_date              DATE,
                            v_desc2,         --'LMS AGNT ADV POSTING ( CHQ )',
                            --v_narrative             VARCHAR2,
                            v_amt,           --v_amount                NUMBER,
                            v_payee,       --v_payee                 VARCHAR2,
                            NVL (v_pymt_method, 'CHQ'),
                            --'CHQ', --v_pay_method            VARCHAR2, --CHQ, EFT
                            v_acc_no,
                            --NULL,          --v_payee_bank_acc_no        VARCHAR2,
                            v_bbr_code,
                            --NULL,            --v_payee_bank_branch_code   NUMBER,
                            v_user,        --v_source_auth_by        VARCHAR2,
                            TRUNC (SYSDATE),   --v_source_auth_dt        DATE,
                            v_done_by,   --v_raise_by                VARCHAR2,
                            'AGNADV',      --v_pmt_type              VARCHAR2,
                            v_brn_code,
                            NULL,                                --v_pol_code,
                            v_chq_dtls_rec);
                    EXCEPTION
                        WHEN OTHERS
                        THEN
                            tqc_error_manager.raise_error (
                                270104904,
                                text_in   =>
                                    'POSTING BACK AGENT. ADVANCE REPAYMENT 1...');
                    END;
                ELSE
                    BEGIN
                        interface_create_reqn (
                            v_trans_code,       --v_trans_code         NUMBER,
                            v_curr_trans_no, --v_ref                   VARCHAR2,
                            v_curr_trans_no, --v_ref2                  VARCHAR2,
                            NVL (v_ref_date, TRUNC (SYSDATE)),
                            --v_ref_date              DATE,
                            v_desc2,         --'LMS AGNT ADV POSTING ( CHQ )',
                            --v_narrative             VARCHAR2,
                            v_amt,           --v_amount                NUMBER,
                            v_payee,       --v_payee                 VARCHAR2,
                            'CHQ', --v_pay_method            VARCHAR2, --CHQ, EFT
                            NULL,       --v_payee_bank_acc_no        VARCHAR2,
                            NULL,         --v_payee_bank_branch_code   NUMBER,
                            v_user,        --v_source_auth_by        VARCHAR2,
                            TRUNC (SYSDATE),   --v_source_auth_dt        DATE,
                            v_done_by,   --v_raise_by                VARCHAR2,
                            'AGNADV',      --v_pmt_type              VARCHAR2,
                            v_brn_code,
                            NULL,                                --v_pol_code,
                            v_chq_dtls_rec);
                    EXCEPTION
                        WHEN OTHERS
                        THEN
                            tqc_error_manager.raise_error (
                                270104904,
                                text_in   =>
                                    'POSTING BACK AGENT. ADVANCE REPAYMENT 2...');
                    END;
                END IF;
            ELSE
                IF NVL (v_pymt_method, 'CHQ') = 'EFT'
                THEN
                    BEGIN
                        interface_create_reqn (
                            v_trans_code,      --v_trans_code          NUMBER,
                            v_cad_code,    --v_ref                   VARCHAR2,
                            v_cad_code,    --v_ref2                  VARCHAR2,
                            NVL (v_ref_date, TRUNC (SYSDATE)),
                            --v_ref_date              DATE,
                            v_desc2,         --'LMS AGNT ADV POSTING ( CHQ )',
                            --v_narrative             VARCHAR2,
                            v_amt,           --v_amount                NUMBER,
                            v_payee,       --v_payee                 VARCHAR2,
                            NVL (v_pymt_method, 'CHQ'),
                            --'CHQ', --v_pay_method            VARCHAR2, --CHQ, EFT
                            v_acc_no,
                            --NULL,          --v_payee_bank_acc_no        VARCHAR2,
                            v_bbr_code,
                            --NULL,             --v_payee_bank_branch_code   NUMBER,
                            v_user,        --v_source_auth_by        VARCHAR2,
                            TRUNC (SYSDATE),   --v_source_auth_dt        DATE,
                            v_done_by,   --v_raise_by                VARCHAR2,
                            'AGNADV',      --v_pmt_type              VARCHAR2,
                            v_brn_code,
                            NULL,                                --v_pol_code,
                            v_chq_dtls_rec);
                    EXCEPTION
                        WHEN OTHERS
                        THEN
                            raise_error ('POST AGNT. ADV .1..');
                    END;
                ELSE
                    BEGIN
                        interface_create_reqn (
                            v_trans_code,      --v_trans_code          NUMBER,
                            v_cad_code,    --v_ref                   VARCHAR2,
                            v_cad_code,    --v_ref2                  VARCHAR2,
                            NVL (v_ref_date, TRUNC (SYSDATE)),
                            --v_ref_date              DATE,
                            v_desc2,         --'LMS AGNT ADV POSTING ( CHQ )',
                            --v_narrative             VARCHAR2,
                            v_amt,           --v_amount                NUMBER,
                            v_payee,       --v_payee                 VARCHAR2,
                            'CHQ', --v_pay_method            VARCHAR2, --CHQ, EFT
                            NULL,       --v_payee_bank_acc_no        VARCHAR2,
                            NULL,         --v_payee_bank_branch_code   NUMBER,
                            v_user,        --v_source_auth_by        VARCHAR2,
                            TRUNC (SYSDATE),   --v_source_auth_dt        DATE,
                            v_done_by,   --v_raise_by                VARCHAR2,
                            'AGNADV',      --v_pmt_type              VARCHAR2,
                            v_brn_code,
                            NULL,                                --v_pol_code,
                            v_chq_dtls_rec);
                    EXCEPTION
                        WHEN OTHERS
                        THEN
                            raise_error ('POST AGNT. ADV .2..');
                    END;
                END IF;
            END IF;
        END IF;

        --step 2 create GL voucher
        IF v_gl_count != 0
        THEN
            BEGIN
                SELECT DECODE (NVL (v_rct_code, TO_CHAR (-200)),
                               TO_CHAR (-200), TO_CHAR (v_cad_code),
                               v_rct_code)
                  INTO v_ref
                  FROM DUAL;

                interface_update_vgl (v_trans_code,            --v_trans_code,
                                      v_user,                    --v_raise_by,
                                      NULL,                      --v_pol_code,
                                      NVL (v_ref_date, TRUNC (SYSDATE)), --v_date,
                                      NULL,                      --v_opr_code,
                                      NULL,                     --v_oppr_code,
                                      v_desc1,
                                      -- 'AGENT ADVANCE',  --v_btc_description,
                                      'JV',                      --v_btc_type,
                                      v_brn_code,             --v_branch_code,
                                      v_desc,                 --v_description,
                                      v_ref,                      --v_rcpt_no,
                                      v_gl_trans,
                                      v_cad_code,               --v_otop_code,
                                      v_otop_code); --v_otop_code,  --v_gl_trans);
            EXCEPTION
                WHEN OTHERS
                THEN
                    raise_error ('POPULATING GL DETAILS');
            END;
        END IF;

        IF v_adv_type IS NULL
        THEN
            IF v_gl_count = 0
            THEN
                raise_error ('NO TRANSACTIONS POSTED TO FINANCE ');
            END IF;
        END IF;
    --   EXCEPTION
    --      WHEN OTHERS
    --      THEN
    --         raise_application_error (-20001,
    --                                  'AGNT. ADV . ' || SQLERRM (SQLCODE));
    END post_agent_adv;

    PROCEDURE post_report_rcpt (
        v_reprint_code              NUMBER,
        v_user                      VARCHAR2,
        v_type                      VARCHAR2 DEFAULT NULL,
        v_otop_receipt_trans_code   VARCHAR2 DEFAULT NULL,
        v_receipt_pk                NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
        v_rct_code                  VARCHAR2 DEFAULT NULL
    )
    IS
        v_gl_trans              tq_fms.fms_vouchers_pkg.tgl_rec_type;
        vgl_code                NUMBER;
        v_gl_count              NUMBER := -1;
        v_trnt_code             VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_contra_acc            VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_trnt_gl_code          VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_trnt_contra_gl_code   VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_org_code              NUMBER;
        v_count                 NUMBER;
        v_amt                   NUMBER;
        v_payee                 VARCHAR2 (50);
        v_brn_code              NUMBER;
        v_desc                  VARCHAR2 (50);
        v_desc1                 VARCHAR2 (50);
        v_trans_code            NUMBER;
        v_otop_code             NUMBER;
        v_polno                 VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_renewal               VARCHAR2 (5);
    BEGIN
        /*
         step 1
         CREATE cheq requisition
                CR Bank
               DR Adv suspense a/c
         step 2
         CREATE gl voucher
               DR Comm adv a/c
               CR Adv suspense a/c
         */
        --raise_error(v_cad_code||';'||v_user||';'||v_adv_type||';'||v_otop_receipt_trans_code||';'||v_receipt_pk||';'||v_rct_code);
        SELECT    TO_NUMBER (TO_CHAR (SYSDATE, 'RRRR'))
               || lms_transaction_seq.NEXTVAL
          INTO v_trans_code
          FROM DUAL;

        BEGIN
            SELECT pol_bra_code,
                   otop_code,
                   NVL (otop_alloc_amt, otop_amt),
                   pol_policy_no,
                   lms_ord_mis.check_renewal_paymnt (pol_code, brr_date)
              INTO v_brn_code,
                   v_otop_code,
                   v_amt,
                   v_polno,
                   v_renewal
              FROM lms_ord_other_pymts, lms_policies, lms_batch_reprints
             WHERE     otop_reprint_code = brr_reprint_code
                   AND pol_code =
                       (SELECT DISTINCT btr_pol_code
                          FROM lms_batch_reports
                         WHERE btr_reprint_code = brr_reprint_code)
                   AND brr_reprint_code = v_reprint_code
                   AND otop_receipt_no = v_rct_code
                   AND otop_fms_receipt_pk = v_receipt_pk
                   AND otop_receipt_trans_code = v_otop_receipt_trans_code;
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                raise_error (
                       'REPORT RCPT DTLS...'
                    || v_reprint_code
                    || ';'
                    || v_rct_code
                    || ';'
                    || v_receipt_pk
                    || ';'
                    || v_otop_receipt_trans_code);
        END;

        v_gl_trans.delete;
        v_org_code := fms_interfaces_pkg.get_org (v_brn_code);

        IF NVL (v_amt, 0) <> 0
        THEN
            get_gl_code ('MISC_RCT',
                         NULL,
                         v_trnt_code,
                         v_contra_acc,
                         v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                         NULL,
                         v_renewal);
            valid_acc (v_contra_acc,
                       v_org_code,
                       v_brn_code,
                       'MISC_RCT');
            get_gl_code ('RPNT_CHG',
                         NULL,
                         v_trnt_code,
                         v_trnt_gl_code,
                         v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                         NULL,
                         v_renewal);
            valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                       v_org_code,
                       v_brn_code,
                       'RPNT_CHG');
            --v_gl_count := NVL (v_gl_count, 0) + 2;
            v_gl_count := v_gl_count + 2;
            interface_append_gl (v_trans_code,                -- v_trans_code,
                                 v_user,                        -- v_raise_by,
                                 NULL,                          -- v_pol_code,
                                 NULL,                         -- v_prod_code,
                                 NULL,                           -- v_vchr_no,
                                 NULL,                          -- v_opr_code,
                                 NULL,                         -- v_oppr_code,
                                 NULL,                            --v_rcpt_no,
                                 v_gl_count,                       -- v_count,
                                 'REPORT REPRINTING',          -- v_narrative,
                                 NVL (v_amt, 0),                  -- v_amount,
                                 'D',                               -- v_drcr,
                                 v_contra_acc,               -- v_acc_number1,
                                 v_trnt_gl_code,             -- v_acc_number2,
                                 v_brn_code,                 -- v_branch_code,
                                 v_gl_trans,
                                 NULL,                           --v_cad_code,
                                 v_otop_code,                   --v_otop_code,
                                 NULL,                          --v_fpmt_code,
                                 NULL,                           --v_ort_code,
                                 v_reprint_code);                 --v_btr_no);
        END IF;

        --step 2 create GL voucher
        IF v_gl_count != 0
        THEN
            BEGIN
                interface_update_vgl (v_trans_code,            --v_trans_code,
                                      v_user,                    --v_raise_by,
                                      NULL,                      --v_pol_code,
                                      TRUNC (SYSDATE),               --v_date,
                                      NULL,                      --v_opr_code,
                                      NULL,                     --v_oppr_code,
                                      'REPORT REPRINTING - ' || v_polno,
                                      -- 'AGENT ADVANCE',  --v_btc_description,
                                      'JV',                      --v_btc_type,
                                      v_brn_code,             --v_branch_code,
                                      'REPORT REPRINTING',    --v_description,
                                      v_rct_code,                 --v_rcpt_no,
                                      v_gl_trans,
                                      NULL,                      --v_cad_code,
                                      v_otop_code,              --v_otop_code,
                                      NULL,                     --v_fpmt_code,
                                      NULL,                      --v_ort_code,
                                      v_reprint_code);            --v_btr_no);
            EXCEPTION
                WHEN OTHERS
                THEN
                    raise_error ('GL..');
            END;
        END IF;

        IF v_gl_count = 0
        THEN
            raise_error ('NO TRANSACTIONS POSTED TO FINANCE ');
        END IF;
    EXCEPTION
        WHEN OTHERS
        THEN
            raise_error ('RPT RCT...');
    END post_report_rcpt;

    PROCEDURE post_add_ref_intr (
        v_pol_code    NUMBER,
        v_prod_code   NUMBER,
        v_brn_code    NUMBER,
        v_int_amt     NUMBER,
        v_drcr        VARCHAR2,
        v_user        VARCHAR2
    )
    IS
        v_count                 NUMBER := -1;
        v_org_code              NUMBER;
        v_vgl_no                NUMBER;
        v_trnt_code             VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_trnt_gl_code          VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_acc_gl_code           VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_trnt_contra_gl_code   VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_trans_code            NUMBER;
        v_gl_trans              tq_fms.fms_vouchers_pkg.tgl_rec_type;
    BEGIN
        IF NVL (v_int_amt, 0) <> 0
        THEN
            v_org_code := fms_interfaces_pkg.get_org (v_brn_code);

            SELECT    TO_NUMBER (TO_CHAR (SYSDATE, 'RRRR'))
                   || lms_transaction_seq.NEXTVAL
              INTO v_trans_code
              FROM DUAL;

            get_gl_code ('REIN_INT',
                         v_prod_code,
                         v_trnt_code,
                         v_trnt_gl_code,
                         v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
            get_gl_code ('UP',
                         v_prod_code,
                         v_trnt_code,
                         v_acc_gl_code,
                         v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
            --check if accounts exist in policy branch
            valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                       v_org_code,
                       v_brn_code,
                       'REIN_INT');
            valid_acc (v_acc_gl_code,
                       v_org_code,
                       v_brn_code,
                       'UP');
            v_count := NVL (v_count, 0) + 2;
            interface_append_gl (v_trans_code,   --v_trans_code        NUMBER,
                                 v_user,       --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                                 v_pol_code,     --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                                 v_prod_code,    --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                                 v_pol_code,    --v_vchr_no          VARCHAR2,
                                 NULL,           --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                                 NULL,           --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                                 NULL,          --v_rcpt_no          VARCHAR2,
                                 v_count,        --v_count             NUMBER,
                                 'ADD/REF INT.', --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                                 v_int_amt,      --v_amount            NUMBER,
                                 v_drcr,       --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                                 v_trnt_gl_code, --v_acc_number1       VARCHAR2,
                                 v_acc_gl_code, --v_acc_number2        VARCHAR2,
                                 v_brn_code,     --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                                 v_gl_trans);
        END IF;

        IF v_count <> 0
        THEN
            interface_update_vgl (v_trans_code,     --v_trans_code     NUMBER,
                                  v_user,      --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                                  v_pol_code,    --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                                  TRUNC (SYSDATE),      --v_date         DATE,
                                  NULL,          --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                                  NULL,          --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                                  'ADD/REF INTR.', --v_btc_description   VARCHAR2,
                                  'JV',       --v_btc_type           VARCHAR2,
                                  v_brn_code,    --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                                  'ENDORSEMENT ADD/REF INTEREST', --v_description       VARCHAR2,
                                  v_pol_code,   --v_ref_no           VARCHAR2,
                                  v_gl_trans);
        END IF;

        IF v_count = 0
        THEN
            raise_error ('NO TRANSACTIONS POSTED TO FINANCE....');
        END IF;
    EXCEPTION
        WHEN OTHERS
        THEN
            raise_error ('ADD/REF PREM....');
    END post_add_ref_intr;

    PROCEDURE post_add_ref_refund (
        v_pol_code    NUMBER,
        v_prod_code   NUMBER,
        v_brn_code    NUMBER,
        v_int_amt     NUMBER,
        v_drcr        VARCHAR2,
        v_user        VARCHAR2,
        v_endr_code   NUMBER
    )
    IS
        v_chq_dtls_rec          fms_cheques_pkg.type_rqn_dtls_table;
        v_payee_eft_rec         fms_cheques_pkg.type_payee_eft_table;
        v_bbr_code              NUMBER;
        v_eft_enabled           VARCHAR2 (1);
        v_cla_type              VARCHAR2 (1) := 'O';
        v_brh_code              NUMBER;
        v_count                 NUMBER := 0;
        v_org_code              NUMBER;
        v_crt_acc_no            VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_trnt_type             VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_trnt_code             VARCHAR2 (50);
        v_trnt_gl_code          VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_trnt_contra_gl_code   VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_cla_type              VARCHAR2 (2);
        nparticipantamt         NUMBER := 0;
        v_claim_amt             NUMBER := 0;
        v_prem_drcr             VARCHAR2 (5) := 'C';
        v_narrative             VARCHAR2 (30);
        grp_amt                 NUMBER := 0;
        v_trans_code            NUMBER;
        v_class                 VARCHAR2 (10);
        v_pay_method            VARCHAR2 (10);
        v_user_name             VARCHAR2 (100)
            := pkg_global_vars.get_pvarchar2 ('PKG_GLOBAL_VARS.PVG_USERNAME');
        v_pay_mthd              VARCHAR2 (10) := 'CHQ';
        v_policy_no             VARCHAR2 (100);
        v_clnt_id_passport_no   VARCHAR2 (100);
        v_id_type               VARCHAR2 (50);
        v_payee                 VARCHAR2 (100);
        v_acc_gl_code           VARCHAR2 (50);
        v_prepared_by           VARCHAR2 (150);
        v_gl_trans              tq_fms.fms_vouchers_pkg.tgl_rec_type;
        v_payee_bank_acc_no     VARCHAR2 (100);
    BEGIN
        IF NVL (v_int_amt, 0) <> 0
        THEN
            SELECT    TO_NUMBER (TO_CHAR (SYSDATE, 'RRRR'))
                   || lms_transaction_seq.NEXTVAL
              INTO v_trans_code
              FROM DUAL;

            BEGIN
                SELECT prp_other_names || ' ' || prp_surname,
                       pol_policy_no,
                       endr_prepared_by,
                       prp_bank_acc_no,
                       prp_bbr_code,
                       prp_id_reg_no,
                       prp_idntf_doc_used
                  INTO v_payee,
                       v_policy_no,
                       v_prepared_by,
                       v_payee_bank_acc_no,
                       v_bbr_code,
                       v_clnt_id_passport_no,
                       v_id_type
                  FROM lms_policies, lms_proposers, lms_policy_endorsements
                 WHERE     pol_code = endr_pol_code
                       AND prp_code = pol_prp_code
                       AND pol_code = v_pol_code
                       AND endr_code = v_endr_code;
            EXCEPTION
                WHEN OTHERS
                THEN
                    raise_error ('Error Getting Policy Details');
            END;

            v_count := v_count + 1;
            v_org_code := fms_interfaces_pkg.get_org (v_brn_code);
            get_gl_code ('PLREF',
                         v_prod_code,
                         v_trnt_code,
                         v_trnt_gl_code,
                         v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
            get_gl_code ('UP',
                         v_prod_code,
                         v_trnt_code,
                         v_acc_gl_code,
                         v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
            raise_error (
                   'v_acc_gl_code =='
                || v_acc_gl_code
                || ' v_trnt_gl_code== '
                || v_trnt_gl_code);
            --check if accounts exist in policy branch
            valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                       v_org_code,
                       v_brn_code,
                       'PLREF');
            valid_acc (v_acc_gl_code,
                       v_org_code,
                       v_brn_code,
                       'UP');
            interface_append_gl (v_trans_code,   --v_trans_code        NUMBER,
                                 v_user,       --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                                 v_pol_code,     --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                                 v_prod_code,    --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                                 v_pol_code,    --v_vchr_no          VARCHAR2,
                                 NULL,           --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                                 NULL,           --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                                 NULL,          --v_rcpt_no          VARCHAR2,
                                 v_count,        --v_count             NUMBER,
                                 'ENDR ADD REF REFUND ',
                                 --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                                 NVL (v_int_amt, 0),
                                 --v_amount            NUMBER,
                                 v_drcr,       --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                                 v_trnt_gl_code, --v_acc_number1       VARCHAR2,
                                 v_acc_gl_code, --v_acc_number2        VARCHAR2,
                                 v_brn_code,     --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                                 v_gl_trans);

            IF v_drcr NOT IN ('D')
            THEN
                interface_append_chq (v_trans_code,
                                      v_payee,
                                      v_pol_code,              --  v_pol_code,
                                      v_prod_code,              --v_prod_code,
                                      v_policy_no,
                                      --v_vchr_no,           --            VARCHAR2,
                                      v_count,  --v_count              NUMBER,
                                      NVL (v_int_amt, 0),
                                      'ENDR ADD REF REFUND ' || v_payee,
                                      v_trnt_gl_code,
                                      v_org_code,
                                      --v_acc_org_code         NUMBER,
                                      v_brn_code,
                                      --v_branch_code        NUMBER,
                                      'D',    --v_drcr               VARCHAR2,
                                      v_chq_dtls_rec);
                interface_create_reqn (v_trans_code,
                                       v_policy_no,                    --v_ref
                                       v_pol_code,                    --v_ref2
                                       TRUNC (SYSDATE),           --v_ref_date
                                       'ENDR ADD REF REFUND ' || v_payee,
                                       --v_narrative
                                       NVL (v_int_amt, 0),          --v_amount
                                       v_payee,                      --v_payee
                                       'CHQ',                   --v_pay_method
                                       v_payee_bank_acc_no, --v_payee_bank_acc_no
                                       v_bbr_code,  --v_payee_bank_branch_code
                                       v_user_name,         --v_source_auth_by
                                       TRUNC (SYSDATE),     --v_source_auth_dt
                                       v_prepared_by,
                                       --v_raise_by
                                       'POL_REF',                 --v_pmt_type
                                       v_brn_code,            --v_branch_code,
                                       v_pol_code,               --v_pol_code,
                                       v_chq_dtls_rec,
                                       NULL,
                                       NULL,
                                       NULL,
                                       NULL,
                                       NULL,
                                       NULL,
                                       v_clnt_id_passport_no,
                                       v_id_type);
            END IF;
        END IF;
    END post_add_ref_refund;

    PROCEDURE post_investment_batch (v_batch_no NUMBER, v_user VARCHAR2)
    IS
        CURSOR batch IS
            SELECT inb_batch_no,
                   inb_amount,
                   inb_payee,
                   inb_brn_code,
                   inb_prod_code
              FROM lms_investment_batches
             WHERE     inb_batch_no = v_batch_no
                   AND NVL (inb_authorised, 'N') = 'N';

        v_bct_code                 NUMBER;
        v_bct_brh_code             NUMBER;
        v_auth_by                  NUMBER;
        v_trnt_contra_gl_code      VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_trnt_gl_code             VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_brh_code                 NUMBER;
        v_org_code                 NUMBER;
        v_count                    NUMBER := 0;
        v_cur_code                 NUMBER;
        v_sys_code                 NUMBER;
        v_chq_dtls_rec             fms_cheques_pkg.type_rqn_dtls_table;
        v_trnt_code                VARCHAR2 (10);
        v_gl_trans                 tq_fms.fms_vouchers_pkg.tgl_rec_type;
        v_gl_count                 NUMBER := 0;
        vgl_code                   NUMBER;
        v_sl_rqn_dtls              fms_cheques_pkg.type_sl_rqn_dtls_table;
        v_dr_trnt_code             VARCHAR2 (100);
        v_dr_trnt_gl_code          VARCHAR2 (100);
        v_dr_trnt_contra_gl_code   VARCHAR2 (100);
        v_trans_code               NUMBER;
    BEGIN
        FOR b IN batch
        LOOP
            IF v_user IS NULL
            THEN
                raise_error ('CONNECTED USER UNDEFINED...');
            ELSIF b.inb_payee IS NULL
            THEN
                raise_error ('SPECIFY THE PAYEE TO PROCEED...');
            ELSE
                v_brh_code := b.inb_brn_code;
                v_org_code := fms_interfaces_pkg.get_org (v_brh_code);
                v_sys_code := fms_interfaces_pkg.systemcode ('LMS');
                v_cur_code := lms_interfaces_pkg.lms_def_cur (v_brh_code);
                v_auth_by := fms_interfaces_pkg.get_usercode (v_user);

                SELECT    TO_NUMBER (TO_CHAR (SYSDATE, 'RRRR'))
                       || lms_transaction_seq.NEXTVAL
                  INTO v_trans_code
                  FROM DUAL;

                /*tq_fms.fms_interfaces_pkg.trans_bct ('INVBCH',
                                                     v_sys_code,
                                                     v_brh_code,
                                                     v_cur_code,
                                                     v_bct_code,
                                                     v_bct_brh_code,
                                                     'CHQ'
                                                    );*/
                get_gl_code ('INVPREM',
                             NULL,
                             v_trnt_code,
                             v_trnt_gl_code,
                             v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
                valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                           v_org_code,
                           v_brh_code,
                           'INVBCH');
                get_gl_code ('INVBCH',
                             NULL,
                             v_dr_trnt_code,
                             v_dr_trnt_gl_code,
                             v_dr_trnt_contra_gl_code);
                valid_acc (v_dr_trnt_gl_code,
                           v_org_code,
                           v_brh_code,
                           'INVBCH');
                v_gl_count := v_gl_count + 2;
                interface_append_gl (v_trans_code, --v_trans_code        NUMBER,
                                     v_user,   --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                                     NULL,       --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                                     b.inb_prod_code,
                                     --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                                     v_batch_no, --v_vchr_no           VARCHAR2,
                                     NULL,       --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                                     NULL,       --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                                     NULL,      --v_rcpt_no          VARCHAR2,
                                     v_gl_count, --v_count             NUMBER,
                                     'INV. BATCH - ' || v_batch_no,
                                     --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                                     NVL (b.inb_amount, 0),
                                     --v_amount            NUMBER,
                                     'D',      --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                                     v_trnt_gl_code,
                                     --v_acc_number1         VARCHAR2,
                                     v_dr_trnt_gl_code,
                                     --v_acc_number2         VARCHAR2,
                                     v_brh_code, --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                                     v_gl_trans,
                                     --v_trn_rec   IN OUT  fms_test.Fms_Vouchers_Pkg.Tgl_rec_type,
                                     NULL, --v_cad_code       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                     NULL,
                                     --v_otop_code       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                     NULL);
                /*tq_fms.fms_vouchers_pkg.append_gl_trans (v_gl_count,
                                                            'INV. BATCH - '
                                                         || v_batch_no,
                                                         b.inb_amount,
                                                         'D',
                                                         v_trnt_gl_code,
                                                         v_brh_code,
                                                         v_gl_trans

    PROCEDURE post_grp_commissions (
        v_pol_code   NUMBER,
        v_username   VARCHAR2,
        v_trans_no   NUMBER
    )
    IS
        CURSOR c_comm IS
              SELECT pcp_agn_code,
                     TRUNC (pcp_date)
                         pcp_date,
                     SUM (NVL (pcp_comm_amt, 0) + NVL (pcp_ovride_comm_amt, 0))
                         comm_amt,
                     SUM (
                           NVL (pcp_whdtax_amt, 0)
                         + NVL (pcp_ovride_whdtax_amt, 0))
                         whdtx,
                     SUM (pcp_advance_pymt)
                         advance,
                     SUM (
                           NVL (pcp_comm_amt, 0)
                         + NVL (pcp_ovride_comm_amt, 0)
                         - NVL (pcp_whdtax_amt, 0)
                         - NVL (pcp_ovride_whdtax_amt, 0)
                         - NVL (pcp_advance_pymt, 0)
                         - NVL (pcp_deductions, 0))
                         amount,
                     SUM (pcp_net_comm)
                         net_amt,
                     pcp_brn_code,
                     TRIM (
                            agn_other_names
                         || ' '
                         || TRIM (agn_md_name || ' ' || agn_name))
                     agn_name,
                     pcp_prepared_by,
                     pcp_pol_policy_no
                FROM lms_policy_commission_pymts, lms_agencies
               WHERE     pcp_agn_code = agn_code
                     AND pcp_pol_code = v_pol_code
                     AND NVL (pcp_authorized, 'N') = 'N'
                     AND pcp_checked = 'Y'
                     AND pcp_paid = 'N'
                     --and agn_name not like ('DIRECT%')
                     AND pcp_authorize_date IS NULL
            GROUP BY pcp_paid_vchr_no,
                     pcp_agn_code,
                     pcp_date,
                     pcp_brn_code,
                     agn_name,
                     agn_md_name,
                     agn_other_names,
                     pcp_prepared_by,
                     pcp_pol_policy_no;

        v_org_code               NUMBER;
        v_crt_acc_no             VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_sys_code               NUMBER;
        v_bct_code               NUMBER;
        v_bct_brh_code           NUMBER;
        v_chq_dtls_rec           fms_cheques_pkg.type_rqn_dtls_table;
        v_prod_code              NUMBER;
        v_trnt_prod_applicable   VARCHAR2 (3);
        v_trnt_contra_gl_code    VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_count                  NUMBER := 0;
        v_cont                   NUMBER := -1;
        v_cnt                    NUMBER := 0;
        v_gl_count               NUMBER := 0;
        v_cur_code               NUMBER;
        v_brh_code               NUMBER;
        v_raised_by              NUMBER;
        v_auth_by                NUMBER;
        v_trnt_code              VARCHAR2 (10);
        v_gl_trans               fms_vouchers_pkg.tgl_rec_type;
        v_gl_acc                 VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_gl_acc2                VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_vgl_no                 NUMBER;
        v_contra_gl_code         VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_drcr                   VARCHAR2 (2);
        v_trans_code             NUMBER;
        v_agn_name               VARCHAR (100);
    BEGIN
        SELECT    TO_NUMBER (TO_CHAR (SYSDATE, 'RRRR'))
               || lms_transaction_seq.NEXTVAL
          INTO v_trans_code
          FROM DUAL;

        --raise_error('agn =');
        FOR r IN c_comm
        LOOP
            IF r.agn_name LIKE ('DIRECT%')
            THEN
                raise_error (
                    'YOU CANNOT POST COMMISSIONS FOR DIRECT BUSINESS...');
            END IF;

            v_org_code := fms_interfaces_pkg.get_org (r.pcp_brn_code);

            IF r.amount < 0
            THEN
                NULL;
            ELSIF r.amount >= 0
            THEN
                IF NVL (r.comm_amt, 0) <> 0
                THEN
                    --create GL voucher
                    get_gl_code ('UC',
                                 v_prod_code,
                                 v_trnt_code,
                                 v_crt_acc_no,
                                 v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
                    valid_acc (v_crt_acc_no,
                               v_org_code,
                               r.pcp_brn_code,
                               'UC');
                    valid_acc (v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                               v_org_code,
                               r.pcp_brn_code,
                               'UC CONTRA');
                    v_gl_count := 0;
                    v_gl_count := v_gl_count + 1;
                    interface_append_gl (
                        v_trans_code,
                        --v_trans_code           NUMBER,
                        v_username,
                        --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                        v_pol_code,              --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                        NULL,                    --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                        NULL,                --v_vchr_no             VARCHAR2,
                        NULL,                    --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                        NULL,                    --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                        NULL,                --v_rcpt_no             VARCHAR2,
                        v_gl_count,              --v_count             NUMBER,
                        'GROUP COMMISSION - ' || r.pcp_pol_policy_no,
                        --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                        r.comm_amt,              --v_amount            NUMBER,
                        'D',                   --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                        v_crt_acc_no,
                        --v_acc_number           VARCHAR2,
                        r.pcp_brn_code,
                        --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                        v_gl_trans);
                    v_gl_count := v_gl_count + 1;
                    interface_append_gl (
                        v_trans_code,
                        --v_trans_code           NUMBER,
                        v_username,
                        --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                        v_pol_code,              --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                        NULL,                    --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                        NULL,                --v_vchr_no             VARCHAR2,
                        NULL,                    --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                        NULL,                    --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                        NULL,                --v_rcpt_no             VARCHAR2,
                        v_gl_count,              --v_count             NUMBER,
                        'GROUP COMMISSION - ' || r.pcp_pol_policy_no,
                        --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                        r.amount,                --v_amount            NUMBER,
                        'C',                   --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                        v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                        --v_acc_number           VARCHAR2,
                        r.pcp_brn_code,
                        --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                        v_gl_trans);
                    v_count := v_count + 1;
                    --raise_error('amount ='||r.amount||';'||v_count);
                    interface_append_chq (v_trans_code,
                                          --v_trans_code         NUMBER,
                                          v_username,
                                          --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                                          v_pol_code,
                                          --v_pol_code           NUMBER,
                                          NULL, --v_prod_code          NUMBER,
                                          NULL, --v_vchr_no              VARCHAR2,
                                          v_count, --v_count              NUMBER,
                                          r.amount, --v_amount             NUMBER,
                                          'GROUP COMMISSION PAYMENT',
                                          --v_narrative          VARCHAR2,
                                          v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                          --v_acc_number            VARCHAR2,
                                          v_org_code,
                                          --v_acc_org_code          NUMBER,
                                          r.pcp_brn_code,
                                          --v_branch_code        NUMBER,
                                          'D', --v_drcr               VARCHAR2,
                                          v_chq_dtls_rec);
                END IF;

                IF NVL (r.whdtx, 0) <> 0
                THEN
                    get_gl_code ('WTHTX1_GB',
                                 v_prod_code,
                                 v_trnt_code,
                                 v_crt_acc_no,
                                 v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
                    valid_acc (v_crt_acc_no,
                               v_org_code,
                               r.pcp_brn_code,
                               'WTHTX1_GB');
                    v_gl_count := v_gl_count + 1;
                    interface_append_gl (
                        v_trans_code,
                        --v_trans_code           NUMBER,
                        v_username,
                        --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                        v_pol_code,              --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                        NULL,                    --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                        NULL,                --v_vchr_no             VARCHAR2,
                        NULL,                    --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                        NULL,                    --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                        NULL,                --v_rcpt_no             VARCHAR2,
                        v_gl_count,              --v_count             NUMBER,
                           'GROUP WITHOLDING TAX RECOVERY - '
                        || r.pcp_pol_policy_no,
                        --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                        r.whdtx,                 --v_amount            NUMBER,
                        'C',                   --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                        v_crt_acc_no,
                        --v_acc_number           VARCHAR2,
                        r.pcp_brn_code,
                        --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                        v_gl_trans);
                END IF;

                IF NVL (r.advance, 0) <> 0
                THEN
                    get_gl_code ('AGNADV',
                                 v_prod_code,
                                 v_trnt_code,
                                 v_crt_acc_no,
                                 v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
                    valid_acc (v_crt_acc_no,
                               v_org_code,
                               r.pcp_brn_code,
                               'AGNADV');
                    v_gl_count := v_gl_count + 1;
                    interface_append_gl (
                        v_trans_code,
                        --v_trans_code           NUMBER,
                        v_username,
                        --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                        v_pol_code,              --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                        NULL,                    --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                        NULL,                --v_vchr_no             VARCHAR2,
                        NULL,                    --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                        NULL,                    --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                        NULL,                --v_rcpt_no             VARCHAR2,
                        v_gl_count,              --v_count             NUMBER,
                           'GROUP AGENT ADVANCE RECOVERY - '
                        || r.pcp_pol_policy_no,
                        --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                        r.advance,               --v_amount            NUMBER,
                        'C',                   --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                        v_crt_acc_no,
                        --v_acc_number           VARCHAR2,
                        r.pcp_brn_code,
                        --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                        v_gl_trans);
                END IF;

                IF v_count != 0
                THEN
                    v_agn_name := r.agn_name;
                    v_brh_code := r.pcp_brn_code;
                    interface_create_reqn (
                        v_trans_code,         --v_trans_code           NUMBER,
                        v_trans_no,        --v_ref                   VARCHAR2,
                        r.pcp_agn_code,    --v_ref2                  VARCHAR2,
                        r.pcp_date,            --v_ref_date              DATE,
                        'GROUP COMMISSION PAYMENT ( ' || r.agn_name || ')',
                        --v_narrative             VARCHAR2,
                        r.amount,            --v_amount                NUMBER,
                        r.agn_name,        --v_payee                 VARCHAR2,
                        'CHQ',  --v_pay_method            VARCHAR2, --CHQ, EFT
                        v_bct_code,     --v_payee_bank_acc_no        VARCHAR2,
                        v_bct_brh_code,   --v_payee_bank_branch_code   NUMBER,
                        v_username,        --v_source_auth_by        VARCHAR2,
                        TRUNC (SYSDATE),       --v_source_auth_dt        DATE,
                        NVL (r.pcp_prepared_by, v_username),
                        --v_raise_by                VARCHAR2,
                        'G_COMM',          --v_pmt_type              VARCHAR2,
                        v_brh_code,                    --v_branch_code NUMBER,
                        NULL,
                        --v_pol_code,                                   --v_branch_code           NUMBER,
                        v_chq_dtls_rec);
                END IF;
            END IF;
        END LOOP;

        IF v_count != 0
        THEN
            interface_update_vgl (
                v_trans_code,                     --  v_trans_code     NUMBER,
                v_username,                    --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                v_pol_code,                      --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                SYSDATE,                           --v_date              DATE,
                NULL,                            --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                NULL,                            --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                'LMS GROUP COMMISSION PAYMENT', --v_btc_description   VARCHAR2,
                'JV',                       --v_btc_type             VARCHAR2,
                v_brh_code,                      --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                'GROUP COMMISSION PAYMENT ( ' || v_agn_name || ')',
                v_trans_no,                      --v_ref             VARCHAR2,
                v_gl_trans);
        END IF;

        UPDATE lms_policy_commission_pymts
           SET pcp_authorized = 'Y',
               pcp_paid = 'Y',
               pcp_authorized_by = v_username,
               pcp_authorize_date = TRUNC (SYSDATE),
               pcp_trans_no = v_trans_no
         WHERE     pcp_pol_code = v_pol_code
               AND NVL (pcp_authorized, 'N') = 'N'
               AND pcp_checked = 'Y'
               AND pcp_paid = 'N'
               AND pcp_authorize_date IS NULL;
    EXCEPTION
        WHEN OTHERS
        THEN
            raise_error ('POSTING COMM PYMNT...');
    END post_grp_commissions;

    PROCEDURE post_pu_charge (
        v_trans_no   NUMBER,
        v_user       VARCHAR2,
        v_brn_code   NUMBER
    )
    IS
        CURSOR pol IS
              SELECT SUM (ppc_amount)                                          ppc_amount,
                     pol_prod_code,
                     prod_desc,
                     lms_ord_mis.check_renewal_paymnt (pol_code,
                                                       ppc_authorised_date)    renewal
                FROM lms_policy_paidup_charge, lms_policies, lms_products
               WHERE     ppc_trans_no = v_trans_no
                     AND pol_code = ppc_pol_code
                     AND pol_prod_code = prod_code
            GROUP BY pol_prod_code,
                     pol_bra_code,
                     prod_desc,
                     lms_ord_mis.check_renewal_paymnt (pol_code,
                                                       ppc_authorised_date);

        v_trans_code            NUMBER;
        v_org_code              NUMBER;
        v_trnt_code             VARCHAR2 (10);
        v_trnt_gl_code          VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_trnt_contra_gl_code   VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_gl_count              NUMBER := 0;
        v_raised_by             NUMBER;
        v_cur_code              NUMBER;
        v_vchr_no               VARCHAR2 (30);
        v_gl_trans              fms_vouchers_pkg.tgl_rec_type;
        v_err                   VARCHAR2 (1000);
        v_brh_code              NUMBER := 15;
        v_vgl_no                NUMBER;
    BEGIN
        FOR p IN pol
        LOOP
            SELECT    TO_NUMBER (TO_CHAR (SYSDATE, 'RRRR'))
                   || lms_transaction_seq.NEXTVAL
              INTO v_trans_code
              FROM DUAL;

            v_vchr_no := lms_api.trans_voucher ('PUCHRG');
            v_org_code := fms_interfaces_pkg.get_org (v_brn_code);

            IF NVL (p.ppc_amount, 0) <> 0
            THEN
                -- POSTING GL VOUCHERS....
                get_gl_code ('PUCHRG',
                             p.pol_prod_code,
                             v_trnt_code,
                             v_trnt_gl_code,
                             v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                             NULL,
                             p.renewal);
                valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                           v_org_code,
                           v_brn_code,
                           'PUCHRG');
                v_gl_count := v_gl_count + 1;
                fms_vouchers_pkg.append_gl_trans (
                    v_gl_count,
                    'PAIDUP CHARGE - ' || p.prod_desc,
                    NVL (p.ppc_amount, 0),
                    'C',
                    v_trnt_gl_code,
                    v_brn_code,
                    v_gl_trans);
                get_gl_code ('INVPREM',
                             p.pol_prod_code,
                             v_trnt_code,
                             v_trnt_gl_code,
                             v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                             NULL,
                             p.renewal);
                valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                           v_org_code,
                           v_brn_code,
                           'INVPREM');
                v_gl_count := v_gl_count + 1;
                fms_vouchers_pkg.append_gl_trans (
                    v_gl_count,
                    'PAIDUP CHARGE - ' || p.prod_desc,
                    NVL (p.ppc_amount, 0),
                    'D',
                    v_trnt_gl_code,
                    v_brn_code,
                    v_gl_trans);
            END IF;
        END LOOP;

        v_raised_by := fms_interfaces_pkg.get_usercode (v_user);
        v_cur_code := lms_interfaces_pkg.lms_def_cur (v_brn_code);

        IF v_gl_count > 0
        THEN
            v_vgl_no :=
                fms_vouchers_pkg.update_vgl ('LMS PAID-UP CHARGE BATCH',
                                             'JV',
                                             v_brn_code,
                                             TRUNC (SYSDATE),
                                             'PAID-UP CHARGE VOUCHER',
                                             v_trans_no,
                                             v_raised_by,
                                             v_cur_code,
                                             v_gl_trans);
            fms_interfaces_pkg.post_je (v_vgl_no, v_raised_by);
        END IF;

        IF v_gl_count = 0
        THEN
            raise_error ('JV NOT CREATED....');
        END IF;

        --Updating records as posted.... CREATE FIELDS FOR UPDATING IN THE RECEIPTS TAHBLE
        BEGIN
            UPDATE lms_policy_paidup_charge
               SET ppc_posted = 'Y'
             WHERE ppc_trans_no = v_trans_no;
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                raise_error ('Error updating PU. records....');
        END;
    EXCEPTION
        WHEN OTHERS
        THEN
            raise_error (
                'Error Posting Paid-up Charge...' || SQLERRM (SQLCODE));
    END post_pu_charge;

    PROCEDURE cancel_grp_recpt_partially (
        v_rct_code           VARCHAR2,
        v_acc_type           VARCHAR2,
        v_date               DATE,
        v_rct_branch         NUMBER,
        v_description        VARCHAR2,
        v_raised_by          NUMBER,
        v_cur_code           NUMBER,
        v_net_gross          VARCHAR2,
        v_receipt_pk         NUMBER,
        v_amt                NUMBER,
        v_ac_type            VARCHAR2,
        v_chq_no             VARCHAR2,
        v_recpt_date         DATE,
        v_branch_code        NUMBER,
        v_user_code          NUMBER,
        v_base_cur_code      NUMBER,
        v_grp_recpt_rec   IN type_grp_recpt_table,
        v_amt_refund         NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
        v_payee              VARCHAR2 DEFAULT NULL
    )
    IS
        v_count                  NUMBER := 0;
        v_chq_cnt                NUMBER := 0;
        v_grct_code              NUMBER;
        v_gl_trans               fms_vouchers_pkg.tgl_rec_type;
        v_chq_dtls_rec           fms_cheques_pkg.type_rqn_dtls_table;
        v_vgl_no                 NUMBER;
        v_trnt_code              VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_trnt_gl_code           VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_trnt_contra_gl_code    VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_contra_acc             VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_org_code               NUMBER;
        v_cnt                    NUMBER := 0;
        v_pndp_code              NUMBER := 0;
        v_mtran_code             NUMBER;
        v_user                   VARCHAR2 (30);

        CURSOR cur_pol_cb_amt (v_grctcode NUMBER)
        IS
              SELECT NVL (SUM (grct_refund_amt), 0)
                         suspense_amt,
                     NVL (SUM (grct_prem_pymnt_amt), grct_amt)
                         premium_amt,
                     NVL (SUM (grct_pens_pymt_amt), 0)
                         pension_contr,
                     NVL (SUM (grct_prem_comm), 0)
                         prem_comm,
                     NVL (SUM (grct_prem_bonus), 0)
                         prem_bonus,
                     NVL (SUM (grct_pens_comm), 0)
                         pens_comm,
                     NVL (SUM (grct_prem_tax), 0)
                         prem_tax,
                     NVL (SUM (grct_prem_comm_paid), 0)
                         prem_comm_paid,
                     NVL (SUM (grct_prem_bonus_paid), 0)
                         prem_bonus_paid,
                     pol_bra_code,
                     pol_prod_code,
                     pol_type,
                     pol_code,
                     lms_interfaces_pkg.pol_product (pol_code)
                         product,
                     prod_gl_control_code,
                     agn_act_code
                FROM lms_grp_prem_receipts,
                     lms_policies,
                     lms_products,
                     lms_agencies
               WHERE     pol_code = grct_pol_code
                     AND pol_prod_code = prod_code
                     AND grct_code = v_grctcode
                     AND grct_agen_code = agn_code
            GROUP BY pol_bra_code,
                     pol_code,
                     grct_amt,
                     pol_prod_code,
                     pol_type,
                     lms_interfaces_pkg.pol_product (pol_code),
                     prod_gl_control_code,
                     agn_act_code;

        CURSOR cur_master_pol_cb_amt (v_mtran_code IN NUMBER)
        IS
              SELECT NVL (SUM (mtran_balance), 0)         balance,
                     NVL (SUM (mtran_net_amt), 0)         premium_amt,
                     NVL (SUM (pcp_comm_amt), 0)          prem_comm,
                     NVL (SUM (pcp_net_comm), 0)          prem_comm_paid,
                     NVL (SUM (mtran_settled_amt), 0)     prem_settled_amt,
                     NVL (SUM (pcp_prem_tax_amt), 0)      prem_tax,
                     NVL (SUM (mtran_whtx), 0)            whtx_amt,
                     NVL (SUM (mtran_extras), 0)          extras,
                     agn_act_code
                FROM lms_master_transactions,
                     lms_policy_commission_pymts,
                     lms_agencies
               WHERE     mtran_code = v_mtran_code
                     AND pcp_agn_code = agn_code
                     AND (   pcp_cr_mtran_code = v_mtran_code
                          OR pcp_dr_mtran_code = v_mtran_code)
            GROUP BY pcp_comm_amt,
                     pcp_prem_tax_amt,
                     pcp_net_comm,
                     agn_act_code;

        CURSOR cur_policies (v_pol_code IN NUMBER)
        IS
            SELECT pol_code,
                   pol_policy_no,
                   pol_term,
                   pol_anb,
                   pol_prod_sht_desc,
                   pol_freq_of_payment,
                   pol_freq_days,
                   pol_status,
                   pol_type,
                   pol_cla_code,
                   pol_bra_code,
                   pol_prp_code,
                   pol_prod_code,
                   pol_current_endr_code,
                   pol_paid_to_date,
                   pol_os_instlmt_no,
                   pol_os_prem_bal_amt,
                   pol_overpayment_amt,
                   pol_tot_loan_os_amt,
                   pol_proposal_no,
                   pol_grp_life_rider
              FROM lms_policies
             WHERE pol_code = v_pol_code;

        CURSOR cur_rcpts IS
            SELECT *
              FROM lms_grp_prem_receipts, lms_agencies
             WHERE     grct_receipt_no = v_rct_code
                   AND grct_agen_code = agn_code
                   AND (   (grct_fms_receipt_pk = v_receipt_pk)
                        OR (v_receipt_pk IS NULL));

        CURSOR master_rcpts IS
            SELECT *
              FROM lms_master_transactions, lms_agencies
             WHERE     mtran_ref_no = v_rct_code
                   AND mtran_agen_code = agn_code
                   AND (   (mtran_fms_receipt_pk = v_receipt_pk)
                        OR (v_receipt_pk IS NULL));

        CURSOR cur_pol_new_amt (v_code NUMBER)
        IS
              SELECT NVL (SUM (grct_refund_amt), 0)
                         suspense_amt,
                     NVL (SUM (grct_prem_pymnt_amt), grct_amt)
                         premium_amt,
                     NVL (SUM (grct_pens_pymt_amt), 0)
                         pension_contr,
                     NVL (SUM (grct_prem_comm), 0)
                         prem_comm,
                     NVL (SUM (grct_pens_comm), 0)
                         pens_comm,
                     NVL (SUM (grct_prem_tax), 0)
                         prem_tax,
                     NVL (SUM (grct_prem_comm_paid), 0)
                         prem_comm_paid,
                     pol_bra_code,
                     pol_prod_code,
                     pol_type,
                     pol_code,
                     lms_interfaces_pkg.pol_product (pol_code)
                         product,
                     prod_gl_control_code,
                     agn_act_code
                FROM lms_grp_prem_receipts,
                     lms_policies,
                     lms_products,
                     lms_agencies
               WHERE     pol_code = grct_pol_code
                     AND pol_prod_code = prod_code
                     AND grct_agen_code = agn_code
                     AND grct_trans_from_code = v_code
            GROUP BY pol_bra_code,
                     pol_code,
                     grct_amt,
                     pol_prod_code,
                     pol_type,
                     lms_interfaces_pkg.pol_product (pol_code),
                     prod_gl_control_code,
                     agn_act_code;

        v_recs                   NUMBER := 0;
        v_product                VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_trans_code             NUMBER;
        v_prod_type              VARCHAR2 (5);
        v_pol_code               NUMBER;
        v_pol_bra_code           NUMBER;
        v_pol_prod_code          NUMBER;
        v_prod_gl_control_code   VARCHAR2 (10);
        v_grr_code               NUMBER;
        v_vchr_no                VARCHAR2 (50);
        v_curr_grct_code         NUMBER;
    BEGIN
        v_user := fms_interfaces_pkg.get_username (v_raised_by);

        SELECT    TO_NUMBER (TO_CHAR (SYSDATE, 'RRRR'))
               || lms_transaction_seq.NEXTVAL
          INTO v_trans_code
          FROM DUAL;

        BEGIN
            SELECT COUNT (1)
              INTO v_cnt
              FROM lms_grp_prem_receipts
             WHERE     grct_receipt_no = v_rct_code
                   AND (   (grct_fms_receipt_pk = v_receipt_pk)
                        OR (v_receipt_pk IS NULL));
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                raise_error ('ERROR GETTING RECEIPT DETAILS..');
        END;

        IF NVL (v_cnt, 0) = 0
        THEN
            raise_error (
                   'THIS RECEIPT '
                || v_rct_code
                || ' DOES NOT EXIST IN GROUP/PENSION PAYMENTS..');
        END IF;

        v_cnt := 0;

        BEGIN
            SELECT COUNT (1)
              INTO v_cnt
              FROM lms_grp_prem_receipts
             WHERE     grct_receipt_no = v_rct_code || '-CN'
                   AND (   (grct_fms_receipt_pk = v_receipt_pk)
                        OR (v_receipt_pk IS NULL))
                   AND grct_status = 'C';
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                raise_error (
                    'ERROR DETERMINING IF RECEIPT IS ALREADY CANCELLED..');
