        END;

        IF NVL (v_cnt, 0) != 0
        THEN
            raise_error (
                   'THIS RECEIPT '
                || v_rct_code
                || ' HAS ALREADY BEEN CANCELLED..');
        END IF;

        v_count := 0;

        FOR cur_rct_rec IN cur_rcpts
        LOOP
            BEGIN
                SELECT    TO_NUMBER (TO_CHAR (SYSDATE, 'YYYY'))
                       || lms_grct_code_seq.NEXTVAL
                  INTO v_grct_code
                  FROM DUAL;
            EXCEPTION
                WHEN OTHERS
                THEN
                    raise_error (
                        'ERROR POPULATING POLICY RECEIPT SEQUENCE......');
            END;

            --RAISE_ERROR('grct_comm_inclusive='||grct_comm_inclusive);
            BEGIN
                INSERT INTO lms_grp_prem_receipts (grct_code,
                                                   grct_ltr_trans_no,
                                                   grct_date,
                                                   grct_cheque_no,
                                                   grct_amt,
                                                   grct_gross_amnt,
                                                   grct_pol_code,
                                                   grct_pol_policy_no,
                                                   grct_receipt_no,
                                                   grct_receipt_date,
                                                   grct_prem_allocate,
                                                   grct_prem_pymnt_amt,
                                                   grct_prem_comm,
                                                   grct_prem_comm_paid,
                                                   grct_pens_allocate,
                                                   grct_pens_pymt_amt,
                                                   grct_pens_comm,
                                                   grct_pens_comm_paid,
                                                   grct_drcr,
                                                   grct_comm_inclusive,
                                                   grct_agen_code,
                                                   grct_brn_code,
                                                   grct_status,
                                                   grct_fms_receipt_pk,
                                                   grct_prem_bonus,
                                                   grct_prem_bonus_paid,
                                                   grct_pens_bonus,
                                                   grct_pens_bonus_paid)
                    SELECT v_grct_code,
                           grct_ltr_trans_no,
                           TRUNC (SYSDATE),
                           grct_cheque_no,
                           NVL (grct_amt, 0),
                           NVL (grct_gross_amnt, 0),
                           grct_pol_code,
                           grct_pol_policy_no,
                           grct_receipt_no || '-CN',
                           grct_receipt_date,
                           NVL (grct_prem_allocate, 0),
                           NVL (grct_prem_pymnt_amt, 0),
                           NVL (grct_prem_comm, 0),
                           NVL (grct_prem_comm_paid, 0),
                           NVL (grct_pens_allocate, 0),
                           NVL (grct_pens_pymt_amt, 0),
                           NVL (grct_pens_comm, 0),
                           NVL (grct_pens_comm_paid, 0),
                           DECODE (grct_drcr, 'D', 'C', 'D'),
                           NVL (grct_comm_inclusive, 'N'),
                           grct_agen_code,
                           grct_brn_code,
                           'C',
                           v_receipt_pk,
                           NVL (grct_prem_bonus, 0),
                           NVL (grct_prem_bonus_paid, 0),
                           NVL (grct_pens_bonus, 0),
                           NVL (grct_pens_bonus_paid, 0)
                      FROM lms_grp_prem_receipts
                     WHERE     grct_code = cur_rct_rec.grct_code
                           AND (   (grct_fms_receipt_pk = v_receipt_pk)
                                OR (v_receipt_pk IS NULL));
            EXCEPTION
                WHEN OTHERS
                THEN
                    raise_error (
                        'Error inserting receipt cancellation record..');
            END;

            -- IF NVL(v_trans_type,'XXX') != 'REFUND' AND .POL_PREM_AMT
            BEGIN
                lms_api.update_grp_recpt_pymt (v_rct_code,
                                               v_ac_type,
                                               v_amt, --total for the receipt .
                                               NULL,
                                               v_chq_no,
                                               NULL,
                                               v_date,
                                               NULL,
                                               v_rct_branch,
                                               v_description,
                                               v_user_code,
                                               v_base_cur_code,
                                               NULL,          --cheque/cash...
                                               NULL,
                                               NULL,
                                               v_grp_recpt_rec,
                                               v_net_gross,
                                               v_receipt_pk,
                                               cur_rct_rec.grct_code,
                                               NULL,
                                               NULL,
                                               v_curr_grct_code);
            EXCEPTION
                WHEN OTHERS
                THEN
                    raise_error ('Error creating the new receipt record...');
            END;

            IF NVL (cur_rct_rec.grct_pens_pymt_amt, 0) != 0
            THEN
                update_gl_da_contri (cur_rct_rec.grct_pol_code,
                                     cur_rct_rec.grct_code,
                                     v_rct_branch,
                                     'D');
            END IF;

            v_count := 0;
            v_org_code := fms_interfaces_pkg.get_org (v_rct_branch);

            FOR pr IN cur_pol_cb_amt (cur_rct_rec.grct_code)
            LOOP
                v_pol_code := pr.pol_code;

                IF pr.prod_gl_control_code IS NULL
                THEN        --cur_endors_rec.PROD_GL_CONTROL_CODE IS NULL THEN
                    raise_error (
                        'THE GL CONTROL ACCOUNT DEFINITION CODE FOR THIS PRODUCT HAS NOT BEEN DEFINED IN PRODUCT SETUPS. PLEASE DEFINE AND TRY AGAIN.');
                END IF;

                FOR rec IN cur_pol_new_amt (cur_rct_rec.grct_code)
                LOOP
                    -- RAISE_ERROR('REC.premium_amt='||REC.premium_amt);
                    IF NVL (rec.premium_amt, 0) <> 0
                    THEN
                        get_gl_code ('UP_GB',
                                     rec.pol_prod_code,
                                     v_trnt_code,
                                     v_trnt_gl_code,
                                     v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                     NULL,
                                     -- v_tt_code                        NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                     NULL,
                                     -- v_renewal                        VARCHAR2 DEFAULT 'N',
                                     rec.agn_act_code,
                                     -- v_act_code                       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                     pr.pol_bra_code);
                        valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                                   v_org_code,
                                   rec.pol_bra_code);
                        valid_acc (v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                   v_org_code,
                                   rec.pol_bra_code);
                        v_count := v_count + 1;
                        --RAISE_ERROR('REC.premium_amt='||REC.premium_amt);
                        interface_append_gl (v_trans_code,
                                             --v_trans_code        NUMBER,
                                             v_user, --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                                             rec.pol_code,
                                             --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                                             rec.pol_prod_code,
                                             --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                                             v_receipt_pk,
                                             --v_vchr_no           VARCHAR2,
                                             NULL, --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                                             NULL, --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                                             v_rct_code,
                                             --v_rcpt_no          VARCHAR2,
                                             v_count, --v_count             NUMBER,
                                             'PREMIUM -' || v_rct_code,
                                             --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                                             rec.premium_amt,
                                             --v_amount            NUMBER,
                                             'C', --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                                             v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                             --v_contra_acc, --v_acc_number2        VARCHAR2,
                                             rec.pol_bra_code,
                                             --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                                             v_gl_trans,
                                             --v_trn_rec   IN OUT Fms_Vouchers_Pkg.Tgl_rec_type
                                             NULL,
                                             --v_cad_code       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                             NULL);               --v_ort_code
                    END IF;
                END LOOP;

                v_org_code := fms_interfaces_pkg.get_org (v_rct_branch);

                IF NVL (pr.premium_amt, 0) <> 0
                THEN
                    get_gl_code ('UP_GB',
                                 pr.pol_prod_code,
                                 v_trnt_code,
                                 v_trnt_gl_code,
                                 v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                 NULL,
                                 -- v_tt_code                        NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                 NULL,
                                 -- v_renewal                        VARCHAR2 DEFAULT 'N',
                                 pr.agn_act_code,
                                 -- v_act_code                       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                 pr.pol_bra_code);
                    valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code, v_org_code, pr.pol_bra_code);
                    valid_acc (v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                               v_org_code,
                               pr.pol_bra_code);
                    v_count := v_count + 1;
                    --RAISE_ERROR('pr.premium_amt='||pr.premium_amt);
                    interface_append_gl (v_trans_code,
                                         --v_trans_code        NUMBER,
                                         v_user, --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                                         pr.pol_code, --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                                         pr.pol_prod_code,
                                         --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                                         v_receipt_pk,
                                         --v_vchr_no           VARCHAR2,
                                         NULL,   --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                                         NULL,   --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                                         v_rct_code, --v_rcpt_no          VARCHAR2,
                                         v_count, --v_count             NUMBER,
                                         'PREMIUM -' || v_rct_code,
                                         --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                                         pr.premium_amt,
                                         --v_amount            NUMBER,
                                         'D',  --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                                         v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                         --v_contra_acc, --v_acc_number2        VARCHAR2,
                                         pr.pol_bra_code,
                                         --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                                         v_gl_trans,
                                         --v_trn_rec   IN OUT Fms_Vouchers_Pkg.Tgl_rec_type
                                         NULL,
                                         --v_cad_code       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                         NULL);                   --v_ort_code
                END IF;

                IF v_amt_refund IS NOT NULL
                THEN
                    --v_chq_dtls_rec.DELETE;
                    BEGIN
                        v_vchr_no := lms_api.trans_voucher ('RFD');

                        SELECT    TO_NUMBER (TO_CHAR (SYSDATE, 'RRRR'))
                               || lms_grr_code_seq.NEXTVAL
                          INTO v_grr_code
                          FROM DUAL;

                        INSERT INTO lms_grp_recpt_refunds (
                                        grr_code,
                                        grr_amount,
                                        grr_payee,
                                        grr_done_by,
                                        grr_done_date,
                                        grr_brn_code,
                                        grr_grct_receipt_no,
                                        grr_vchr_no,
                                        grr_pol_code)
                             VALUES (v_grr_code,
                                     v_amt_refund,
                                     v_payee,
                                     v_user,
                                     SYSDATE,
                                     pr.pol_bra_code,
                                     v_rct_code,
                                     v_vchr_no,
                                     pr.pol_code);
                    EXCEPTION
                        WHEN OTHERS
                        THEN
                            raise_error ('Error creating refund record....');
                    END;

                    interface_append_gl (v_trans_code,
                                         --v_trans_code        NUMBER,
                                         v_user, --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                                         pr.pol_code, --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                                         pr.pol_prod_code,
                                         --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                                         v_vchr_no,
                                         --v_vchr_no, --v_vchr_no           VARCHAR2,
                                         NULL,   --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                                         NULL,   --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                                         v_rct_code, --v_rcpt_no          VARCHAR2,
                                         v_count, --v_count             NUMBER,
                                         'PREMIUM -' || v_rct_code,
                                         --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                                         v_amt_refund,
                                         --v_amount            NUMBER,
                                         'C',  --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                                         v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                         --v_contra_acc, --v_acc_number2        VARCHAR2,
                                         pr.pol_bra_code,
                                         --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                                         v_gl_trans,
                                         --v_trn_rec   IN OUT Fms_Vouchers_Pkg.Tgl_rec_type
                                         NULL,
                                         --v_cad_code       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                         NULL);                   --v_ort_code
                    v_chq_cnt := v_chq_cnt + 1;
                    interface_append_chq (
                        v_trans_code,              --v_trans_code      NUMBER,
                        v_user,                --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                        pr.pol_code,
                        --v_pol_code           NUMBER,
                        pr.pol_prod_code,
                        --v_prod_code          NUMBER,
                        v_vchr_no,
                        --v_vchr_no,--v_vchr_no             VARCHAR2,
                        v_chq_cnt,              --v_count              NUMBER,
                        v_amt_refund,
                        --v_amount             NUMBER,
                        'GRP POLICY RECEIPTS REFUND - ' || v_rct_code,
                        --v_narrative          VARCHAR2,
                        v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                        --v_acc_number         VARCHAR2,
                        v_org_code,
                        --v_acc_org_code        NUMBER,
                        pr.pol_bra_code,
                        --v_branch_code        NUMBER,
                        'D',                  --v_drcr               VARCHAR2,
                        v_chq_dtls_rec);

                    IF v_chq_cnt != 0
                    THEN
                        interface_create_reqn (
                            v_trans_code,       --v_trans_code         NUMBER,
                            v_vchr_no,     --v_ref                   VARCHAR2,
                            pr.pol_code,   --v_ref2                  VARCHAR2,
                            TRUNC (SYSDATE),   --v_ref_date              DATE,
                            'GRP POLICY RECEIPTS REFUND - ' || v_rct_code,
                            --v_narrative             VARCHAR2,
                            v_amt_refund,    --v_amount                NUMBER,
                            v_payee,       --v_payee                 VARCHAR2,
                            'CHQ', --v_pay_method            VARCHAR2, --CHQ, EFT
                            NULL,       --v_payee_bank_acc_no        VARCHAR2,
                            NULL,         --v_payee_bank_branch_code   NUMBER,
                            v_user,        --v_source_auth_by        VARCHAR2,
                            TRUNC (SYSDATE),   --v_source_auth_dt        DATE,
                            v_user,      --v_raise_by                VARCHAR2,
                            'REFUND',      --v_pmt_type              VARCHAR2,
                            pr.pol_bra_code,   --v_branch_code         NUMBER,
                            pr.pol_code,
                            v_chq_dtls_rec);
                    END IF;
                END IF;
            END LOOP;

            UPDATE lms_grp_prem_receipts
               SET grct_status = 'C'
             WHERE     grct_code = cur_rct_rec.grct_code
                   AND (   (grct_fms_receipt_pk = v_receipt_pk)
                        OR (v_receipt_pk IS NULL));

            IF v_count > 0
            THEN
                interface_update_vgl (v_trans_code, --v_trans_code     NUMBER,
                                      v_user,  --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                                      v_pol_code, --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                                      TRUNC (SYSDATE), --v_date           DATE,
                                      NULL,      --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                                      NULL,      --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                                      'LMS GB RECEIPTS CANCELLATION BATCH',
                                      --v_btc_description   VARCHAR2,
                                      'JV',   --v_btc_type           VARCHAR2,
                                      v_rct_branch, --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                                      NVL (v_description, 'GLIFE RCT'),
                                      --v_description       VARCHAR2,
                                      v_rct_code,  --v_ref           VARCHAR2,
                                      v_gl_trans,
                                      --v_gl_trans  IN OUT  Fms_Vouchers_Pkg.Tgl_rec_type,
                                      NULL, --v_cad_code       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                      NULL, --v_otop_code       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                      NULL, --v_fpmt_code       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                      NULL);                      --v_ort_code
            END IF;
        END LOOP;

        v_cnt := 0;

        BEGIN
            SELECT COUNT (1)
              INTO v_cnt
              FROM lms_master_transactions
             WHERE     mtran_ref_no = v_rct_code
                   AND (   (mtran_fms_receipt_pk = v_receipt_pk)
                        OR (v_receipt_pk IS NULL));
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                raise_error (
                    'Error getting master transaction receipt details..');
        END;

        IF NVL (v_cnt, 0) = 0
        THEN
            raise_error (
                   'This master transaction receipt '
                || v_rct_code
                || ' Does not exist in group/pension payments..');
        END IF;

        v_cnt := 0;

        BEGIN
            SELECT COUNT (1)
              INTO v_cnt
              FROM lms_master_transactions
             WHERE     mtran_ref_no = v_rct_code || '-CN'
                   AND (   (mtran_fms_receipt_pk = v_receipt_pk)
                        OR (v_receipt_pk IS NULL))
                   AND mtran_rcpt_status = 'C';
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                raise_error (
                    'Error determining if master transation receipt is already cancelled..');
        END;

        IF NVL (v_cnt, 0) != 0
        THEN
            NULL;
        END IF;

        IF NVL (v_cnt, 0) = 0
        THEN
            v_count := 0;

            FOR master_rcpts_rec IN master_rcpts
            LOOP
                BEGIN
                    SELECT TO_NUMBER (
                                  TO_CHAR (SYSDATE, 'RRRR')
                               || lms_mtran_code_seq.NEXTVAL)
                      INTO v_mtran_code
                      FROM DUAL;
                EXCEPTION
                    WHEN OTHERS
                    THEN
                        raise_error (
                            'Error Populating Master Transaction Records Next Sequence...');
                END;

                BEGIN
                    INSERT INTO lms_master_transactions (
                                    mtran_code,
                                    mtran_date,
                                    mtran_ref_no,
                                    mtran_other_ref,
                                    mtran_tran_type,
                                    mtran_dc,
                                    mtran_control_acc,
                                    mtran_client_type,
                                    mtran_client_code,
                                    mtran_amount,
                                    mtran_balance,
                                    mtran_pol_code,
                                    mtran_brn_code,
                                    mtran_narrations,
                                    mtran_prp_code,
                                    mtran_pol_polcy_no,
                                    mtran_endr_no,
                                    mtran_ltr_trans_no,
                                    mtran_acct_code,
                                    mtran_prod_sht_desc,
                                    mtran_prod_code,
                                    mtran_authorised,
                                    mtran_date_authorized,
                                    mtran_authorised_by,
                                    mtran_posting_date,
                                    mtran_net_amt,
                                    mtran_origin,
                                    mtran_btr_trans_code,
                                    mtran_sd,
                                    mtran_whtx,
                                    mtran_extras,
                                    mtran_commission,
                                    mtran_trans_effective_date,
                                    mtran_agen_code,
                                    mtran_cla_type,
                                    mtran_settled_amt,
                                    mtran_fms_receipt_pk)
                        SELECT v_mtran_code,
                               v_date,
                               mtran_ref_no || '-CN',
                               mtran_other_ref,
                               mtran_tran_type,
                               'D',
                               mtran_control_acc,
                               mtran_client_type,
                               mtran_client_code,
                               mtran_amount * (-1),
                               mtran_balance * (-1),
                               mtran_pol_code,
                               mtran_brn_code,
                               mtran_narrations || '- CANCELLATION',
                               mtran_prp_code,
                               mtran_pol_polcy_no,
                               mtran_endr_no,
                               mtran_ltr_trans_no,
                               mtran_acct_code,
                               mtran_prod_sht_desc,
                               mtran_prod_code,
                               'Y',
                               v_date,
                               v_user,
                               v_date,
                               mtran_net_amt * (-1),
                               mtran_origin,
                               mtran_btr_trans_code,
                               mtran_sd,
                               mtran_whtx,
                               mtran_extras,
                               -NVL (mtran_commission, 0),
                               v_date,
                               mtran_agen_code,
                               'G',
                               NVL (mtran_settled_amt, 0) * (-1),
                               v_receipt_pk
                          FROM lms_master_transactions
                         WHERE     mtran_code = master_rcpts_rec.mtran_code
                               AND (   (mtran_fms_receipt_pk = v_receipt_pk)
                                    OR (v_receipt_pk IS NULL));
                EXCEPTION
                    WHEN OTHERS
                    THEN
                        raise_error (
                            'Error Updating Rcpt Dtls In Master Trans...');
                END;

                lms_subledger_utilities.undo_trans_allocation (
                    master_rcpts_rec.mtran_code);

                UPDATE lms_master_transactions
                   SET mtran_rcpt_status = 'C'
                 WHERE     mtran_code = master_rcpts_rec.mtran_code
                       AND (   (mtran_fms_receipt_pk = v_receipt_pk)
                            OR (v_receipt_pk IS NULL));

                -- RAISE_ERROR('STOP HERE');
                BEGIN
                    lms_api.update_grp_recpt_pymt (
                        v_rct_code,
                        v_ac_type,
                        v_amt,                       --total for the receipt .
                        NULL,
                        v_chq_no,
                        NULL,
                        v_date,
                        NULL,
                        v_rct_branch,
                        v_description,
                        v_user_code,
                        v_base_cur_code,
                        NULL,                                 --cheque/cash...
                        NULL,
                        NULL,
                        v_grp_recpt_rec,
                        v_net_gross,
                        v_receipt_pk,
                        NULL,
                        master_rcpts_rec.mtran_code,
                        NULL,
                        v_curr_grct_code);
                EXCEPTION
                    WHEN OTHERS
                    THEN
                        raise_error (
                            'Error creating the new receipt record...1');
                END;
            END LOOP;
        END IF;
    EXCEPTION
        WHEN OTHERS
        THEN
            raise_application_error (
                -20001,
                'Posting G. Rect. ' || SQLERRM (SQLCODE));
    END cancel_grp_recpt_partially;

    FUNCTION get_tax_type (tt_type IN VARCHAR2, v_narrative OUT VARCHAR2)
        RETURN VARCHAR2
    IS
        v_tx_type   VARCHAR2 (30);
    BEGIN
        IF tt_type = 'VAT'
        THEN                                                 --Commission Whtx
            v_tx_type := 'VAT';
            v_narrative := 'VALUE ADDED TAX';
        --     ELSIF tt_type = 'UPTX' THEN --U/W Premium Tax  LMS_TAX_TYPES
        --       v_tx_type := 'UPTAX';
        --       v_narrative := 'PREM TAX';
        --
        --     ELSIF tt_type = 'TL' THEN --Training Levy
        --       v_tx_type := 'TL';
        --       v_narrative := 'TRAINING LEVY';
        --     ELSIF tt_type IN ('PT','OT') THEN --Pension Taxes AND Pension valuation taxes
        --       v_tx_type := 'MNGEX';
        --       v_narrative := 'PENS TAX';
        --     ELSIF tt_type = 'PE' THEN --Pension Expenses
        --       v_tx_type := 'MNGEX';
        --       v_narrative := 'PENS EXP';
        --     ELSIF tt_type = 'PATX' THEN --PA Tax
        --       v_tx_type := 'UPTAX';
        --       v_narrative := 'PA TAX';
        --     ELSIF tt_type = 'CL' THEN --Compensation Levy
        --       v_tx_type := 'CMPFND';
        --       v_narrative := 'COMP FUND';
        ELSIF tt_type IN ('WHTX',
                          'WHTX2',
                          'WHT',
                          'WHTXPW',
                          'WTHX')
        THEN                                                  --witholding tax
            v_tx_type := 'WHTX';
            v_narrative := 'WHTX TAX';
        ELSIF tt_type = 'PFV'
        THEN                                                            --FEES
            v_tx_type := 'POLICY FEE';
            v_narrative := 'INV FEES';
        ELSIF tt_type = 'SDOL' OR tt_type = 'SD'
        THEN                                                      --STAMP DUTY
            v_tx_type := 'SD';
            v_narrative := 'STAMP DUTY';
        ELSIF tt_type IN ('ADMIN', 'ADM')
        THEN                                           --ADMNISTRATION CHARGES
            v_tx_type := 'ADMIN';
            v_narrative := 'ADMINISTRATION CHARGES';
        ELSIF tt_type = 'DISCO'
        THEN                                              --DISCONTINUANCE TAX
            v_tx_type := 'DISCO';
            v_narrative := 'DISCONTINUANCE TAX';
        ELSIF tt_type = 'PAYE'
        THEN                                                        --PAYE TAX
            v_tx_type := 'PAYE';
            v_narrative := 'PAYE TAX';
        ELSE
            raise_error (
                'TAX TYPE ' || tt_type || ' HAS NOT BEEN PROVIDED FOR....');
        END IF;

        --lms_tax_types LMS_TRANSACTION_TYPES
        RETURN v_tx_type;
    END get_tax_type;

    PROCEDURE post_agent_comm_wdthdrwl (v_csw_code NUMBER, v_user VARCHAR2)
    IS
        v_chq_dtls_rec          fms_cheques_pkg.type_rqn_dtls_table;
        v_gl_trans              fms_vouchers_pkg.tgl_rec_type;
        vgl_code                NUMBER;
        v_gl_count              NUMBER;
        v_trnt_code             VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_trnt_gl_code          VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_trnt_contra_gl_code   VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_raised_by             NUMBER;
        v_count                 NUMBER := 0;
        v_org_code              NUMBER;
        v_cur_code              NUMBER;
        v_vchr_no               VARCHAR2 (50);
        v_amt                   NUMBER;
        v_prod_code             NUMBER;
        v_auth_by               NUMBER;
        v_bct_code              NUMBER;
        v_bct_brh_code          NUMBER;
        v_payee                 VARCHAR2 (50);
        v_brn_code              NUMBER;
        v_bbr_code              NUMBER;
        v_agent_acc_no          VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_trans_code            NUMBER;
        v_done_by               lms_comm_sav_withdrwls.csw_done_by%TYPE;
    BEGIN
        SELECT    TO_NUMBER (TO_CHAR (SYSDATE, 'RRRR'))
               || lms_transaction_seq.NEXTVAL
          INTO v_trans_code
          FROM DUAL;

        v_vchr_no := lms_api.trans_voucher ('COMWDRL');

        IF v_csw_code IS NULL
        THEN
            raise_error ('ERROR RETRIEVING WITHDRWAL DTLS....');
        ELSE
            BEGIN
                SELECT csw_brn_code,
                       NVL (csw_withdrwl_amt, 0),
                       csw_bbr_code,
                       csw_acc_no,
                       TRIM (
                              agn_other_names
                           || ' '
                           || TRIM (agn_md_name || ' ' || agn_name))
                       agn_name,
                       csw_done_by
                  INTO v_brn_code,
                       v_amt,
                       v_bbr_code,
                       v_agent_acc_no,
                       v_payee,
                       v_done_by
                  FROM lms_comm_sav_withdrwls, lms_agencies
                 WHERE csw_code = v_csw_code AND agn_code = csw_agn_code;
            EXCEPTION
                WHEN OTHERS
                THEN
                    raise_error ('COMM. SAVINGS DTLS...');
            END;
        END IF;

        v_org_code := fms_interfaces_pkg.get_org (v_brn_code);

        IF NVL (v_amt, 0) <> 0
        THEN
            get_gl_code ('COMWDRL',
                         v_prod_code,
                         v_trnt_code,
                         v_trnt_gl_code,
                         v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
            valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                       v_org_code,
                       v_brn_code,
                       'COMWDRL');
            v_count := v_count + 1;
            interface_append_chq (v_trans_code,
                                  v_user,
                                  NULL,
                                  --v_pol_code,find out how to fetch policy code for the medicals.
                                  v_prod_code,
                                  v_vchr_no,
                                  v_count,
                                  v_amt,
                                  'AGENT COMM. WTHDRAWAL - ' || v_payee,
                                  v_trnt_gl_code,
                                  v_org_code,
                                  v_brn_code,
                                  'D',
                                  v_chq_dtls_rec);
        END IF;

        IF v_count != 0
        THEN
            BEGIN
                interface_create_reqn (
                    v_trans_code,              --v_trans_code          NUMBER,
                    v_vchr_no,             --v_ref                   VARCHAR2,
                    v_csw_code,            --v_ref2                  VARCHAR2,
                    TRUNC (SYSDATE),           --v_ref_date              DATE,
                    'LMS AGNT COMM. WTHDRAWAL POSTING ( CHQ ) - ' || v_payee,
                    --v_narrative             VARCHAR2,
                    v_amt,                   --v_amount                NUMBER,
                    v_payee,               --v_payee                 VARCHAR2,
                    'CHQ',      --v_pay_method            VARCHAR2, --CHQ, EFT
                    v_agent_acc_no,     --v_payee_bank_acc_no        VARCHAR2,
                    v_bbr_code,           --v_payee_bank_branch_code   NUMBER,
                    v_user,                --v_source_auth_by        VARCHAR2,
                    TRUNC (SYSDATE),           --v_source_auth_dt        DATE,
                    v_done_by,           --v_raise_by                VARCHAR2,
                    'COMWDRL',             --v_pmt_type              VARCHAR2,
                    v_brn_code,                --v_branch_code         NUMBER,
                    NULL,                                        --v_pol_code,
                    v_chq_dtls_rec);
            EXCEPTION
                WHEN OTHERS
                THEN
                    raise_error ('POST AGNT. COMM. WTHDRWL ...');
            END;
        END IF;
    EXCEPTION
        WHEN OTHERS
        THEN
            raise_error (-20001, '');  --'AGNT. COM . ' || SQLERRM (SQLCODE));
    END post_agent_comm_wdthdrwl;

    PROCEDURE post_lq_units (
        v_pol_code   NUMBER,
        v_amount     NUMBER,
        v_user       VARCHAR2
    )
    IS
        CURSOR pol IS
            SELECT pol_bra_code,
                   pol_prod_code,
                   prod_desc,
                   lms_ord_mis.check_renewal_paymnt (pol_code, SYSDATE)    renewal
              FROM lms_policies, lms_products
             WHERE pol_code = v_pol_code AND pol_prod_code = prod_code;

        v_trans_code            NUMBER;
        v_org_code              NUMBER;
        v_trnt_code             VARCHAR2 (10);
        v_trnt_gl_code          VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_trnt_contra_gl_code   VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_gl_count              NUMBER := 0;
        v_vchr_no               VARCHAR2 (30);
        v_gl_trans              fms_vouchers_pkg.tgl_rec_type;
        v_err                   VARCHAR2 (1000);
        v_brh_code              NUMBER := 15;
        v_vgl_no                NUMBER;
    BEGIN
        FOR p IN pol
        LOOP
            SELECT    TO_NUMBER (TO_CHAR (SYSDATE, 'RRRR'))
                   || lms_transaction_seq.NEXTVAL
              INTO v_trans_code
              FROM DUAL;

            v_vchr_no := lms_api.trans_voucher ('LQUNITS');
            v_org_code := fms_interfaces_pkg.get_org (p.pol_bra_code);
            v_brh_code := p.pol_bra_code;

            IF NVL (v_amount, 0) <> 0
            THEN
                -- POSTING GL VOUCHERS....
                get_gl_code ('LQUNITS',
                             p.pol_prod_code,
                             v_trnt_code,
                             v_trnt_gl_code,
                             v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                             NULL,
                             p.renewal);
                valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                           v_org_code,
                           p.pol_bra_code,
                           'LQUNITS');
                v_gl_count := v_gl_count + 1;
                interface_append_gl (v_trans_code, --v_trans_code          NUMBER,
                                     v_user,   --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                                     v_pol_code, --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                                     p.pol_prod_code,
                                     --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                                     v_vchr_no, --v_vchr_no          VARCHAR2,
                                     NULL,       --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                                     NULL,       --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                                     NULL,    --v_rcpt_no            VARCHAR2,
                                     v_gl_count, --v_count             NUMBER,
                                     'LIQUIDATED UNITS - ' || p.prod_desc,
                                     --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                                     NVL (v_amount, 0),
                                     --v_amount            NUMBER,
                                     'C',      --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                                     v_trnt_gl_code,
                                     --v_acc_number          VARCHAR2,
                                     p.pol_bra_code, --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                                     v_gl_trans);
                get_gl_code ('INVPREM',
                             p.pol_prod_code,
                             v_trnt_code,
                             v_trnt_gl_code,
                             v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                             NULL,
                             p.renewal);
                valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                           v_org_code,
                           p.pol_bra_code,
                           'INVPREM');
                v_gl_count := v_gl_count + 1;
                interface_append_gl (v_trans_code, --v_trans_code          NUMBER,
                                     v_user,   --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                                     v_pol_code, --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                                     p.pol_prod_code,
                                     --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                                     v_vchr_no, --v_vchr_no          VARCHAR2,
                                     NULL,       --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                                     NULL,       --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                                     NULL,    --v_rcpt_no            VARCHAR2,
                                     v_gl_count, --v_count             NUMBER,
                                     'LIQUIDATED UNITS - ' || p.prod_desc,
                                     --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                                     NVL (v_amount, 0),
                                     --v_amount            NUMBER,
                                     'D',      --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                                     v_trnt_gl_code,
                                     --v_acc_number          VARCHAR2,
                                     p.pol_bra_code, --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                                     v_gl_trans);
            END IF;
        END LOOP;

        IF v_gl_count > 0
        THEN
            interface_update_vgl (v_trans_code,     --v_trans_code     NUMBER,
                                  v_user,      --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                                  NULL,          --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                                  TRUNC (SYSDATE),    --v_date           DATE,
                                  NULL,          --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                                  NULL,          --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                                  'LIQUIDATED UNITS BATCH', --v_btc_description   VARCHAR2,
                                  'JV',       --v_btc_type           VARCHAR2,
                                  v_brh_code,    --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                                  'LIQUIDATED UNITS VOUCHER', --v_description       VARCHAR2,
                                  v_pol_code,     --v_ref            VARCHAR2,
                                  v_gl_trans);
        --v_gl_trans  IN OUT  tq_fms.Fms_Vouchers_Pkg.Tgl_rec_type,
        END IF;

        IF v_gl_count = 0
        THEN
            raise_error ('JV NOT CREATED....');
        END IF;
    EXCEPTION
        WHEN OTHERS
        THEN
            raise_error ('ERROR POSTING LQ Units...' || SQLERRM (SQLCODE));
    END post_lq_units;

    PROCEDURE update_agent_adv (
        v_ref        NUMBER,
        v_chq_no     VARCHAR2,
        v_chq_date   DATE,
        v_user       VARCHAR2
    )
    IS
        v_adv_proc_rate_param   VARCHAR2 (5);
    BEGIN
        BEGIN
            lms_ord_misc.system_param_val ('USE_ADVANCE_PROC_RATES',
                                           v_adv_proc_rate_param);
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                raise_error ('Param Error..use_advance_proc_rates...');
        END;

        IF NVL (v_adv_proc_rate_param, 'N') = 'Y'
        THEN
            BEGIN
                UPDATE lms_comm_advances
                   SET cad_chq_no = v_chq_no,
                       cad_chq_date = v_chq_date,
                       cad_chq_updated_by = v_user,
                       cad_chq_update_date = SYSDATE
                 WHERE     cad_trans_no = v_ref
                       AND cad_authorized = 'Y'
                       AND cad_checked = 'Y';
            EXCEPTION
                WHEN OTHERS
                THEN
                    raise_error ('ERROR UPDATING AGENT ADVANCE DETAILS....');
            END;
        ELSE
            BEGIN
                UPDATE lms_comm_advances
                   SET cad_chq_no = v_chq_no,
                       cad_chq_date = v_chq_date,
                       cad_chq_updated_by = v_user,
                       cad_chq_update_date = SYSDATE
                 WHERE cad_code = v_ref;
            EXCEPTION
                WHEN OTHERS
                THEN
                    raise_error ('ERROR UPDATING AGENT ADVANCE DETAILS....');
            END;
        END IF;
    END update_agent_adv;

    PROCEDURE calc_ind_gross_prem (
        v_pol_code     NUMBER,
        v_grct_code    NUMBER,
        v_endr_code    NUMBER,
        v_mtran_code   NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
        v_user         VARCHAR2 DEFAULT NULL
    )
    IS
        v_agn_code              lms_agencies.agn_code%TYPE;
        v_agn_sht_desc          lms_policy_endorsements.endr_agen_sht_desc%TYPE;
        v_vat_rate              tqc_account_types.act_vat_rate%TYPE;
        v_override_rate         tqc_account_types.act_overide_rate%TYPE;
        v_endr_comm_amt         NUMBER;
        v_override_comm_amt     NUMBER;
        v_vat_amount            NUMBER;
        v_prem_paid             NUMBER;
        v_comm_rate             NUMBER;
        v_endr_vat_rate         NUMBER;
        v_endr_comm_rate        NUMBER;
        v_comm_amt              NUMBER;
        v_act_vat_rate          NUMBER;
        v_adm_param_val         VARCHAR2 (1);
        v_endr_ov_comm_rate     NUMBER;
        v_override_comm_rate    NUMBER;
        v_site_param            lms_parameters.param_name%TYPE;
        v_count                 NUMBER := -1;
        v_org_code              NUMBER;
        v_vgl_no                NUMBER;
        v_trnt_code             VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_trnt_gl_code          VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_acc_gl_code           VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_trnt_contra_gl_code   VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_trans_code            NUMBER;
        v_gl_trans              tq_fms.fms_vouchers_pkg.tgl_rec_type;
        v_brn_code              NUMBER;
        v_prod_code             NUMBER;
        v_admin_fee_inclusive   VARCHAR2 (1);
        v_comm_inclusive        VARCHAR2 (1);
        v_curr_code             NUMBER;
        v_receipt_no            lms_grp_prem_receipts.grct_receipt_no%TYPE;
    BEGIN
        BEGIN
            lms_ord_misc.system_param_val ('SITE_PARAM', v_site_param);
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                raise_error ('SITE_PARAM');
        END;

        BEGIN
            SELECT mendr_agen_code,
                   mendr_agen_sht_desc,
                   mendr_vat_rate,
                   mendr_override_comm,
                   mendr_comm_rate,
                   mendr_ov_comm_rate,
                   ipol_bra_code,
                   ipol_prod_code,
                   ipol_cur_code
              INTO v_agn_code,
                   v_agn_sht_desc,
                   v_endr_vat_rate,
                   v_override_comm_amt,
                   v_endr_comm_rate,
                   v_endr_ov_comm_rate,
                   v_brn_code,
                   v_prod_code,
                   v_curr_code
              FROM lms_policy_member_endorsements, lms_individual_policies
             WHERE     mendr_ipol_code = ipol_code
                   AND mendr_code = v_endr_code
                   AND ipol_code = v_pol_code;
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                raise_error ('Error Accessing Agent/Broker Details');
        END;

        SELECT    TO_NUMBER (TO_CHAR (SYSDATE, 'RRRR'))
               || lms_transaction_seq.NEXTVAL
          INTO v_trans_code
          FROM DUAL;

        v_org_code := fms_interfaces_pkg.get_org (v_brn_code);

        BEGIN
            SELECT grct_gross_amnt,
                   NVL (grct_admin_charge_inclusive, 'Y'),
                   NVL (grct_comm_inclusive, 'Y'),
                   grct_receipt_no
              INTO v_prem_paid,
                   v_admin_fee_inclusive,
                   v_comm_inclusive,
                   v_receipt_no
              FROM lms_grp_prem_receipts
             WHERE grct_code = v_grct_code;
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                raise_error ('Error Accessing Receipt Details');
        END;

        --RAISE_ERROR('v_comm_inclusive = '||v_comm_inclusive||'v_endr_comm_rate = '||v_endr_comm_rate||', v_endr_ov_comm_rate = '||v_endr_ov_comm_rate||'v_admin_fee_inclusive='||v_admin_fee_inclusive);
        IF NVL (v_admin_fee_inclusive, 'N') = 'N' AND v_comm_inclusive = 'N'
        THEN
            v_comm_rate := NVL (v_endr_comm_rate, 0) / 100;
            v_override_comm_rate := NVL (v_endr_ov_comm_rate, 0) / 100;
        ELSIF     NVL (v_admin_fee_inclusive, 'N') = 'Y'
              AND v_comm_inclusive = 'N'
        THEN
            v_comm_rate := NVL (v_endr_comm_rate, 0) / 100;
            v_override_comm_rate := 0;
        ELSE
            v_comm_rate := 0;
            v_override_comm_rate := NVL (v_endr_ov_comm_rate, 0) / 100;
        END IF;

        IF     NVL (v_admin_fee_inclusive, 'N') = 'N'
           AND NVL (v_endr_ov_comm_rate, 0) > 0
        THEN
            --CALCULATE THE COMMISSION PERCENTAGE AMOUNT...
            v_override_comm_amt :=
                ROUND (
                      (v_prem_paid * v_override_comm_rate)
                    / (1 - (v_override_comm_rate + NVL (v_comm_rate, 0))),
                    2);
            v_comm_amt := 0;
        /*****Postings moved to proc. post_update_grp_gross_prem to separate computation from Posting.
        get_gl_code ('ADM_GB',
                     v_prod_code,
                     v_trnt_code,
                     v_trnt_gl_code,
                     v_trnt_contra_gl_code
                    );
        get_gl_code ('UP_GB',
                     v_prod_code,
                     v_trnt_code,
                     v_acc_gl_code,
                     v_trnt_contra_gl_code
                    );
        --check if accounts exist in policy branch
        valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code, v_org_code, v_brn_code, 'ADM_GB');
        valid_acc (v_acc_gl_code, v_org_code, v_brn_code, 'UP_GB');
        v_count := NVL (v_count, 0) + 2;
        interface_append_gl
                           (v_trans_code,       --v_trans_code        NUMBER,
                            v_user,           --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                            v_pol_code,         --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                            v_prod_code,        --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                            v_pol_code,        --v_vchr_no          VARCHAR2,
                            NULL,               --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                            NULL,               --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                            NULL,              --v_rcpt_no          VARCHAR2,
                            v_count,            --v_count             NUMBER,
                            'NET COMM_ADMIN CHARGE -'||v_receipt_no,
                            --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                            v_override_comm_amt,
                                                --v_amount            NUMBER,
                            'D',              --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                            v_trnt_gl_code,
                            --v_acc_number1       VARCHAR2,
                            v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                            --v_acc_number2        VARCHAR2,
                            v_brn_code,         --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                            v_gl_trans
                           );
             *******/
        END IF;

        IF v_comm_inclusive = 'N' AND v_endr_comm_rate != 0
        THEN
            IF v_agn_sht_desc != 'DIRECT'
            THEN
                --CALCULATE THE COMMISSION PERCENTAGE AMOUNT...
                /*
                commented by Josphat since this formula is based on the net premium and cannot gross up the premium
                  v_comm_amt :=
                         (v_endr_comm_rate / 100)
                       * (v_prem_paid);
                       */
                v_comm_amt :=
                    ROUND (
                          (v_prem_paid * v_comm_rate)
                        / (  1
                           - (  NVL (v_override_comm_rate, 0)
                              + NVL (v_comm_rate, 0))),
                        2);
            --raise_error('v_comm_amt = '||v_comm_amt);
            /*****Postings moved to proc. post_update_grp_gross_prem to separate computation from Posting.
            get_gl_code ('UC_GB',
                         v_prod_code,
                         v_trnt_code,
                         v_trnt_gl_code,
                         v_trnt_contra_gl_code
                        );
            get_gl_code ('UP_GB',
                         v_prod_code,
                         v_trnt_code,
                         v_acc_gl_code,
                         v_trnt_contra_gl_code
                        );
            --check if accounts exist in policy branch
            valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code, v_org_code, v_brn_code, 'UC_GB');
            valid_acc (v_acc_gl_code, v_org_code, v_brn_code, 'UP_GB');
            v_count := NVL (v_count, 0) + 2;
            interface_append_gl (v_trans_code,   --v_trans_code        NUMBER,
                                 v_user,       --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                                 v_pol_code,     --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                                 v_prod_code,    --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                                 v_pol_code,    --v_vchr_no          VARCHAR2,
                                 NULL,           --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                                 NULL,           --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                                 NULL,          --v_rcpt_no          VARCHAR2,
                                 v_count,        --v_count             NUMBER,
                                 'NET COMM_ADMIN '||v_receipt_no,   --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                                 v_comm_amt,     --v_amount            NUMBER,
                                 'D',          --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                                 v_trnt_gl_code,
                                 --v_acc_number1       VARCHAR2,
                                 v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                 --v_acc_number2        VARCHAR2,
                                 v_brn_code,     --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                                 v_gl_trans
                                );
               *******/
            END IF;

            --CALCULATE THE VAT PERCENTAGE AMOUNT...
            BEGIN
                SELECT NVL (act_vat_rate, 0), NVL (act_overide_rate, 0)
                  INTO v_act_vat_rate, v_override_rate
                  FROM lms_agencies, tqc_account_types
                 WHERE agn_code = v_agn_code AND agn_act_code = act_code;
            EXCEPTION
                WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND
                THEN
                    v_act_vat_rate := NULL;
                WHEN OTHERS
                THEN
                    raise_error ('System unable to determine Agency Type..');
            END;

            IF v_site_param = '13'
            THEN
                v_override_comm_amt :=
                    ROUND (
                          (v_prem_paid * v_override_comm_rate)
                        / (  1
                           - (  NVL (v_override_comm_rate, 0)
                              + NVL (v_comm_rate, 0))),
                        2);
            ELSE
                v_vat_amount :=
                      (NVL (v_endr_vat_rate, v_act_vat_rate) / 100)
                    * (v_comm_amt);
                v_override_comm_amt :=
                      (v_prem_paid - (v_comm_amt + v_vat_amount))
                    * (NVL (v_override_rate, 0) / 100);
            END IF;
        END IF;

        --      raise_error (   'v_comm_amt = '
        --                   || v_comm_amt
        --                   || ', v_override_comm_amt = '
        --                   || v_override_comm_amt
        --                   || ', v_vat_amount = '
        --                   || v_vat_amount
        --                  );
        BEGIN
            UPDATE lms_grp_prem_receipts
               SET grct_gross_amnt =
                         grct_gross_amnt
                       + NVL (v_vat_amount, 0)
                       + NVL (v_override_comm_amt, 0)
                       + NVL (v_comm_amt, 0),
                   grct_prem_comm = NVL (v_comm_amt, 0),
                   grct_prem_comm_paid = NVL (v_comm_amt, 0),
                   grct_prem_orc_comm = NVL (v_override_comm_amt, 0),
                   grct_prem_orc_comm_paid = NVL (v_override_comm_amt, 0)
             WHERE grct_code = v_grct_code;
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                raise_error ('Error Updating Gross Receipt Amount');
        END;

        BEGIN
            UPDATE lms_master_transactions
               SET mtran_amount =
                         mtran_amount
                       - (  NVL (v_vat_amount, 0)
                          + NVL (v_override_comm_amt, 0)
                          + NVL (v_comm_amt, 0)),
                   mtran_balance =
                         mtran_balance
                       - (  NVL (v_vat_amount, 0)
                          + NVL (v_override_comm_amt, 0)
                          + NVL (v_comm_amt, 0)),
                   mtran_net_amt =
                         mtran_net_amt
                       - (  NVL (v_vat_amount, 0)
                          + NVL (v_override_comm_amt, 0)
                          + NVL (v_comm_amt, 0))
             WHERE mtran_code = v_mtran_code;
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                raise_error ('Error Updating Gross Receipt Amount');
        END;
    /*****Postings moved to proc. post_update_grp_gross_prem to separate computation from Posting.
     IF v_count <> 0
     THEN
        interface_update_vgl
              (v_trans_code,                    --v_trans_code     NUMBER,
               v_user,                     --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
               v_pol_code,                   --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
               TRUNC (SYSDATE),                     --v_date         DATE,
               NULL,                         --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
               NULL,                         --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
               'NET COMM_ADMIN CHARGE.',        --v_btc_description   VARCHAR2,
               'JV',                      --v_btc_type           VARCHAR2,
               v_brn_code,                   --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
               'NET ADMIN CHARGE POSTING '||v_receipt_no, --v_description       VARCHAR2,
               v_pol_code,                  --v_ref_no           VARCHAR2,
               v_gl_trans,
               NULL,
               NULL,
               NULL,
               NULL,
               NULL,
               NULL,
               NULL,
               NULL,
               NULL,
               v_curr_code
              );
     END IF;
     ********/
    END calc_ind_gross_prem;

    PROCEDURE calc_gross_prem (
        v_pol_code     NUMBER,
        v_grct_code    NUMBER,
        v_endr_code    NUMBER,
        v_mtran_code   NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
        v_user         VARCHAR2 DEFAULT NULL
    )
    IS
        v_agn_code                    lms_agencies.agn_code%TYPE;
        v_agn_sht_desc                lms_policy_endorsements.endr_agen_sht_desc%TYPE;
        v_vat_rate                    tqc_account_types.act_vat_rate%TYPE;
        v_override_rate               tqc_account_types.act_overide_rate%TYPE;
        v_endr_comm_amt               NUMBER;
        v_override_comm_amt           NUMBER;
        v_vat_amount                  NUMBER;
        v_prem_paid                   NUMBER;
        v_comm_rate                   NUMBER;
        v_endr_vat_rate               NUMBER;
        v_endr_comm_rate              NUMBER;
        v_comm_amt                    NUMBER;
        v_act_vat_rate                NUMBER;
        v_adm_param_val               VARCHAR2 (1);
        v_endr_ov_comm_rate           NUMBER;
        v_override_comm_rate          NUMBER;
        v_site_param                  lms_parameters.param_name%TYPE;
        v_count                       NUMBER := -1;
        v_org_code                    NUMBER;
        v_vgl_no                      NUMBER;
        v_trnt_code                   VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_trnt_gl_code                VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_acc_gl_code                 VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_trnt_contra_gl_code         VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_trans_code                  NUMBER;
        v_gl_trans                    tq_fms.fms_vouchers_pkg.tgl_rec_type;
        v_brn_code                    NUMBER;
        v_prod_code                   NUMBER;
        v_admin_fee_inclusive         VARCHAR2 (1);
        v_comm_inclusive              VARCHAR2 (1);
        v_curr_code                   NUMBER;
        v_receipt_no                  lms_grp_prem_receipts.grct_receipt_no%TYPE;
        v_computation_param           VARCHAR2 (10);
        v_pol_policy_no               VARCHAR2 (25);
        v_endr_bonus_rate             NUMBER;
        v_bonus_rate                  NUMBER;
        v_bonus_amt                   NUMBER;
        v_agn_act_code                NUMBER;
        v_ovr_comm_amt                NUMBER := 0;
        v_gross_calc_formula_normal   VARCHAR2 (5) DEFAULT 'N';
        v_calc_admin_gross_prem       VARCHAR2 (5) DEFAULT 'N';
        v_temp_comm_amt               NUMBER := 0;
        v_temp_bonus_amt              NUMBER := 0;
        v_temp_vat_amt                NUMBER := 0;
        v_temp_ov_comm_amt            NUMBER := 0;
    BEGIN
        BEGIN
            lms_ord_misc.system_param_val ('SITE_PARAM', v_site_param);
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                raise_error ('SITE_PARAM');
        END;

        BEGIN
            lms_ord_misc.system_param_val (
                'CALC_GROSS_PREM_ON_NORMAL_FORMULA',
                v_gross_calc_formula_normal);
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                v_gross_calc_formula_normal := 'N';
        END;

        BEGIN
            lms_grp_misc.system_param_val (
                'CALCULATE_ADMIN_FEE_ON_GROSS_PREMIUM',
                v_calc_admin_gross_prem);
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                raise_error (
                    'CALCULATE_ADMIN_FEE_ON_GROSS_PREMIUM PARAMETER ERROR');
        END;

        BEGIN
            SELECT endr_agen_code,
                   endr_agen_sht_desc,
                   endr_vat_rate,
                   endr_override_comm,
                   endr_comm_rate,
                   endr_bonus_rate,
                   endr_ov_comm_rate,
                   pol_bra_code,
                   pol_prod_code,
                   pol_cur_code,
                   pol_policy_no,
                   agn_act_code
              INTO v_agn_code,
                   v_agn_sht_desc,
                   v_endr_vat_rate,
                   v_override_comm_amt,
                   v_endr_comm_rate,
                   v_endr_bonus_rate,
                   v_endr_ov_comm_rate,
                   v_brn_code,
                   v_prod_code,
                   v_curr_code,
                   v_pol_policy_no,
                   v_agn_act_code
              FROM lms_policy_endorsements, lms_policies, lms_agencies
             WHERE     endr_pol_code = pol_code
                   AND endr_code = v_endr_code
                   AND pol_code = v_pol_code
                   AND endr_agen_code = agn_code;
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                raise_error ('Error Accessing Agent/Broker Details');
        END;

        SELECT    TO_NUMBER (TO_CHAR (SYSDATE, 'RRRR'))
               || lms_transaction_seq.NEXTVAL
          INTO v_trans_code
          FROM DUAL;

        v_org_code := fms_interfaces_pkg.get_org (v_brn_code);

        BEGIN
            SELECT grct_gross_amnt,
                   NVL (grct_admin_charge_inclusive, 'Y'),
                   NVL (grct_comm_inclusive, 'Y'),
                   grct_receipt_no
              INTO v_prem_paid,
                   v_admin_fee_inclusive,
                   v_comm_inclusive,
                   v_receipt_no
              FROM lms_grp_prem_receipts
             WHERE grct_code = v_grct_code;
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                raise_error ('Error Accessing Receipt Details');
        END;

        v_comm_rate := NVL (v_endr_comm_rate, 0) / 100;
        v_bonus_rate := NVL (v_endr_bonus_rate, 0) / 100;

        IF NVL (v_admin_fee_inclusive, 'N') = 'N' AND v_comm_inclusive = 'N'
        THEN
            v_comm_rate := NVL (v_endr_comm_rate, 0) / 100;
            v_override_comm_rate := NVL (v_endr_ov_comm_rate, 0) / 100;
        ELSIF     NVL (v_admin_fee_inclusive, 'N') = 'Y'
              AND v_comm_inclusive = 'N'
        THEN
            v_comm_rate := NVL (v_endr_comm_rate, 0) / 100;
            v_override_comm_rate := 0;
        ELSE
            v_comm_rate := 0;
            v_override_comm_rate := NVL (v_endr_ov_comm_rate, 0) / 100;
        END IF;

        v_ovr_comm_amt := NVL (v_override_comm_amt, 0);

        IF NVL (v_admin_fee_inclusive, 'Y') = 'Y'
        THEN
            v_override_comm_amt := 0;
        END IF;

        --CALCULATE THE VAT PERCENTAGE AMOUNT...
        BEGIN
            SELECT NVL (act_vat_rate, 0), NVL (act_overide_rate, 0)
              INTO v_act_vat_rate, v_override_rate
              FROM lms_agencies, tqc_account_types
             WHERE agn_code = v_agn_code AND agn_act_code = act_code;
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND
            THEN
                v_act_vat_rate := NULL;
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                raise_error ('System unable to determine Agency Type..');
        END;


        v_temp_comm_amt := ROUND ((v_prem_paid * v_comm_rate), 2);
        v_temp_bonus_amt := ROUND ((v_prem_paid * v_bonus_rate), 2);
        v_temp_vat_amt :=
            ROUND (
                  (NVL (v_endr_vat_rate, v_act_vat_rate) / 100)
                * (v_temp_comm_amt),
                2);
        v_temp_ov_comm_amt :=
            ROUND (NVL (v_prem_paid, 0) * (NVL (v_override_comm_rate, 0)), 2);

        IF     NVL (v_admin_fee_inclusive, 'N') = 'N'
           AND NVL (v_endr_ov_comm_rate, 0) > 0
        THEN
            --CALCULATE THE COMMISSION PERCENTAGE AMOUNT...
            IF v_gross_calc_formula_normal = 'Y'
            THEN
                IF v_site_param = '13'
                THEN
                    v_override_comm_amt :=
                        ROUND (
                              NVL (v_prem_paid, 0)
                            * (NVL (v_override_comm_rate, 0)),
                            2);
                ELSE
                    IF NVL (v_calc_admin_gross_prem, 'N') = 'Y'
                    THEN
                        v_override_comm_amt := ROUND (v_temp_ov_comm_amt, 2);
                    ELSE
                        v_override_comm_amt :=
                            ROUND (
                                  (  NVL (v_prem_paid, 0)
                                   - (  NVL (v_temp_comm_amt, 0)
                                      + NVL (v_temp_vat_amt, 0)))
                                * NVL (v_override_comm_rate, 2),
                                2);
                    END IF;
                END IF;

                v_comm_amt := 0;
            ELSE
                v_override_comm_amt :=
                    ROUND (
                          (v_prem_paid * v_override_comm_rate)
                        / (1 - (v_override_comm_rate + NVL (v_comm_rate, 0))),
                        2);
                v_comm_amt := 0;
            END IF;
        /* get_gl_code ('ADM_GB',
                      v_prod_code,
                      v_trnt_code,
                      v_trnt_gl_code,
                      v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
         get_gl_code ('UP_GB',
                      v_prod_code,
                      v_trnt_code,
                      v_acc_gl_code,
                      v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                      NULL,
                      -- v_tt_code                        NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                      NULL,
                      -- v_renewal                        VARCHAR2 DEFAULT 'N',
                      v_agn_act_code,
                      -- v_act_code                       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                      v_brn_code);
         --check if accounts exist in policy branch
         valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                    v_org_code,
                    v_brn_code,
                    'ADM_GB');
         valid_acc (v_acc_gl_code,
                    v_org_code,
                    v_brn_code,
                    'UP_GB');
         v_count := NVL (v_count, 0) + 2;
         interface_append_gl (
            v_trans_code,                        --v_trans_code        NUMBER,
            v_user,                            --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
            v_pol_code,                          --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
            v_prod_code,                         --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
            v_pol_code,                         --v_vchr_no          VARCHAR2,
            NULL,                                --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
            NULL,                                --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
            NULL,                               --v_rcpt_no          VARCHAR2,
            v_count,                             --v_count             NUMBER,
               'NET COMM_ADMIN CHARGE - '
            || v_receipt_no
            || ' ; '
            || v_pol_policy_no,
            --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
            v_override_comm_amt,
            --v_amount            NUMBER,
            'D',                               --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
            v_trnt_gl_code,
            --v_acc_number1       VARCHAR2,
            v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
            --v_acc_number2        VARCHAR2,
            v_brn_code,                          --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
            v_gl_trans);*/
        END IF;

        --RAISE_ERROR('v_comm_inclusive = '||v_comm_inclusive||'v_endr_comm_rate = '||v_endr_comm_rate||', v_endr_ov_comm_rate = '||v_endr_ov_comm_rate||'v_admin_fee_inclusive='||v_admin_fee_inclusive);
        IF v_comm_inclusive = 'N' AND v_endr_comm_rate != 0
        THEN
            IF v_agn_sht_desc != 'DIRECT'
            THEN
                --CALCULATE THE COMMISSION PERCENTAGE AMOUNT...
                /*
                commented by Josphat since this formula is based on the net premium and cannot gross up the premium
                  v_comm_amt :=
                         (v_endr_comm_rate / 100)
                       * (v_prem_paid);
                       */

                --If statement Added by Micah due to wrong computation of Commission and gross premium on refunds at FBN
                -- and to avoid messup at sites where the computation could be correct
                IF v_gross_calc_formula_normal = 'Y'
                THEN
                    v_comm_amt := NVL (v_temp_comm_amt, 2);
                    v_bonus_amt := NVL (v_temp_bonus_amt, 2);
                ELSE
                    v_comm_amt :=
                        ROUND (
                              (v_prem_paid * v_comm_rate)
                            / (  1
                               - (  NVL (v_override_comm_rate, 0)
                                  + NVL (v_comm_rate, 0))),
                            2);
                    v_bonus_amt :=
                        ROUND (
                              (v_prem_paid * v_bonus_rate)
                            / (  1
                               - (  NVL (v_override_comm_rate, 0)
                                  + NVL (v_bonus_rate, 0))),
                            2);
                END IF;
            /* get_gl_code ('UC_GB',
                          v_prod_code,
                          v_trnt_code,
                          v_trnt_gl_code,
                          v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                          NULL,
                          -- v_tt_code                        NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                          NULL,
                          -- v_renewal                        VARCHAR2 DEFAULT 'N',
                          v_agn_act_code,
                          -- v_act_code                       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                          v_brn_code);
             get_gl_code ('UP_GB',
                          v_prod_code,
                          v_trnt_code,
                          v_acc_gl_code,
                          v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                          NULL,
                          -- v_tt_code                        NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                          NULL,
                          -- v_renewal                        VARCHAR2 DEFAULT 'N',
                          v_agn_act_code,
                          -- v_act_code                       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                          v_brn_code);
             --raise_error('v_comm_amt = > '||v_comm_amt);
             --check if accounts exist in policy branch
             valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                        v_org_code,
                        v_brn_code,
                        'UC_GB');
             valid_acc (v_acc_gl_code,
                        v_org_code,
                        v_brn_code,
                        'UP_GB');
             v_count := NVL (v_count, 0) + 2;
             interface_append_gl (
                v_trans_code,                     --v_trans_code        NUMBER,
                v_user,                         --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                v_pol_code,                       --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                v_prod_code,                      --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                v_pol_code,                      --v_vchr_no          VARCHAR2,
                NULL,                             --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                NULL,                             --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                NULL,                            --v_rcpt_no          VARCHAR2,
                v_count,                          --v_count             NUMBER,
                'NET COMM_ADMIN ' || v_receipt_no || ' ; ' || v_pol_policy_no, --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                NVL (v_comm_amt, 0) + NVL (v_bonus_amt, 0),
                --v_amount            NUMBER,
                'D',                            --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                v_trnt_gl_code,
                --v_acc_number1       VARCHAR2,
                v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                --v_acc_number2        VARCHAR2,
                v_brn_code,                       --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                v_gl_trans);*/
            END IF;

            --CALCULATE THE VAT PERCENTAGE AMOUNT... --Moved to start of procedure
            --         BEGIN
            --            SELECT NVL (act_vat_rate, 0), NVL (act_overide_rate, 0)
            --              INTO v_act_vat_rate, v_override_rate
            --              FROM lms_agencies, tqc_account_types
            --             WHERE agn_code = v_agn_code AND agn_act_code = act_code;
            --         EXCEPTION
            --            WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND
            --            THEN
            --               v_act_vat_rate := NULL;
            --            WHEN OTHERS
            --            THEN
            --               raise_error ('System unable to determine Agency Type..');
            --         END;

            IF v_site_param = '13'
            THEN
                IF v_gross_calc_formula_normal = 'Y'
                THEN
                    v_override_comm_amt :=
                        ROUND (
                              NVL (v_prem_paid, 0)
                            * (NVL (v_override_comm_rate, 0)),
                            2);
                ELSE
                    v_override_comm_amt :=
                        ROUND (
                              (v_prem_paid * v_override_comm_rate)
                            / (  1
                               - (  NVL (v_override_comm_rate, 0)
                                  + NVL (v_comm_rate, 0))),
                            2);
                END IF;

                v_vat_amount := NVL (v_temp_vat_amt, 0);
            ELSE
                v_vat_amount := NVL (v_temp_vat_amt, 0);

                IF NVL (v_calc_admin_gross_prem, 'N') = 'Y'
                THEN
                    v_override_comm_amt := ROUND (v_temp_ov_comm_amt, 2);
                ELSE
                    v_override_comm_amt :=
                        ROUND (
                              (  NVL (v_prem_paid, 0)
                               - (  NVL (v_temp_comm_amt, 0)
                                  + NVL (v_temp_vat_amt, 0)))
                            * NVL (v_override_comm_rate, 2),
                            2);
                END IF;
            --               (NVL (v_endr_vat_rate, v_act_vat_rate) / 100) * (v_comm_amt);
            /*v_override_comm_amt :=
                 (v_prem_paid - (v_comm_amt + v_vat_amount)
                 )
               * (NVL (v_override_rate, 0) / 100);*/
            --Why is this computed again and it is already computed above?
            END IF;
        END IF;

        --            raise_error (  'v_prem_paid='||v_prem_paid||
        --                            ', v_comm_amt = '|| v_comm_amt||
        --                            ', v_override_comm_amt = '|| v_override_comm_amt||
        --                             ', v_vat_amount = '|| v_vat_amount
        --                        );
        BEGIN
            UPDATE lms_grp_prem_receipts
               SET grct_gross_amnt =
                         grct_gross_amnt
