                       + NVL (v_vat_amount, 0)
                       + NVL (v_override_comm_amt, 0)
                       + NVL (v_comm_amt, 0)
                       + NVL (v_bonus_amt, 0),
                   grct_prem_comm = NVL (v_comm_amt, 0),
                   grct_prem_comm_paid = NVL (v_comm_amt, 0),
                   grct_prem_bonus = NVL (v_bonus_amt, 0),
                   grct_prem_bonus_paid = NVL (v_bonus_amt, 0),
                   grct_prem_orc_comm = NVL (v_ovr_comm_amt, 0),
                   grct_prem_orc_comm_paid = NVL (v_override_comm_amt, 0),
                   grct_prem_tax = NVL (v_vat_amount, 0)
             WHERE grct_code = v_grct_code;
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                raise_error ('Error Updating Gross Receipt Amount');
        END;

        BEGIN
            UPDATE lms_master_transactions
               SET mtran_amount =
                         mtran_amount
                       - (  NVL (v_vat_amount, 0)
                          + NVL (v_override_comm_amt, 0)
                          + NVL (v_comm_amt, 0)
                          + NVL (v_bonus_amt, 0)),
                   mtran_balance =
                         mtran_balance
                       - (  NVL (v_vat_amount, 0)
                          + NVL (v_override_comm_amt, 0)
                          + NVL (v_comm_amt, 0)
                          + NVL (v_bonus_amt, 0)),
                   mtran_net_amt =
                         mtran_net_amt
                       - (  NVL (v_vat_amount, 0)
                          + NVL (v_override_comm_amt, 0)
                          + NVL (v_comm_amt, 0)
                          + NVL (v_bonus_amt, 0))
             WHERE mtran_code = v_mtran_code;
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                raise_error ('Error Updating Gross Receipt Amount');
        END;
    /* IF v_count NOT IN (-1, 0)
     THEN
        interface_update_vgl (
           v_trans_code,                           --v_trans_code     NUMBER,
           v_user,                            --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
           v_pol_code,                          --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
           TRUNC (SYSDATE),                            --v_date         DATE,
           NULL,                                --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
           NULL,                                --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
           'NET COMM_ADMIN CHARGE.',          --v_btc_description   VARCHAR2,
           'JV',                             --v_btc_type           VARCHAR2,
           v_brn_code,                          --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
              'NET ADMIN CHARGE POSTING '
           || v_receipt_no
           || ' ; '
           || v_pol_policy_no,                --v_description       VARCHAR2,
           v_pol_code,                         --v_ref_no           VARCHAR2,
           v_gl_trans,
           NULL,
           NULL,
           NULL,
           NULL,
           NULL,
           NULL,
           NULL,
           NULL,
           NULL,
           v_curr_code);
     END IF;*/
    END calc_gross_prem;

    PROCEDURE calc_grp_admin_fee (
        v_pol_code     NUMBER,
        v_grct_code    NUMBER,
        v_endr_code    NUMBER,
        v_fee_incl     VARCHAR2,
        v_mtran_code   NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
        v_user         VARCHAR2 DEFAULT NULL,
        v_umbrella     VARCHAR2 DEFAULT NULL
    )
    IS
        v_agn_code              lms_agencies.agn_code%TYPE;
        v_agn_sht_desc          lms_policy_endorsements.endr_agen_sht_desc%TYPE;
        v_vat_rate              tqc_account_types.act_vat_rate%TYPE;
        v_override_rate         tqc_account_types.act_overide_rate%TYPE;
        v_endr_comm_amt         NUMBER;
        v_override_comm_amt     NUMBER;
        v_vat_amount            NUMBER;
        v_prem_paid             NUMBER;
        v_comm_rate             NUMBER;
        v_endr_vat_rate         NUMBER;
        v_endr_comm_rate        NUMBER;
        v_comm_amt              NUMBER;
        v_act_vat_rate          NUMBER;
        v_adm_param_val         VARCHAR2 (1);
        v_endr_ov_comm_rate     NUMBER;
        v_override_comm_rate    NUMBER;
        v_site_param            lms_parameters.param_name%TYPE;
        v_count                 NUMBER := -1;
        v_org_code              NUMBER;
        v_vgl_no                NUMBER;
        v_trnt_code             VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_trnt_gl_code          VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_acc_gl_code           VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_trnt_contra_gl_code   VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_trans_code            NUMBER;
        v_gl_trans              tq_fms.fms_vouchers_pkg.tgl_rec_type;
        v_brn_code              NUMBER;
        v_prod_code             NUMBER;
        v_admin_fee_inclusive   VARCHAR2 (1);
        v_comm_inclusive        VARCHAR2 (1);
        v_curr_code             NUMBER;
        v_receipt_no            lms_grp_prem_receipts.grct_receipt_no%TYPE;
        v_computation_param     VARCHAR2 (10);
        v_endr_tot_prem         NUMBER;
        v_endr_tot_prem_ratio   NUMBER;
        v_admin_fee_settled     NUMBER;
        v_agn_act_code          NUMBER;
        v_ovr_comm_amt          NUMBER := 0;
    BEGIN
        BEGIN
            lms_ord_misc.system_param_val ('SITE_PARAM', v_site_param);
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                raise_error ('SITE_PARAM');
        END;

        BEGIN
            lms_ord_misc.system_param_val ('ADMIN_CHARGE_COMPUTATION',
                                           v_computation_param);
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                raise_error ('ADMIN_CHARGE_COMPUTATION');
        END;

        IF NVL (v_umbrella, 'N') = 'N'
        THEN
            BEGIN
                SELECT endr_agen_code,
                       endr_agen_sht_desc,
                       endr_vat_rate,
                       endr_override_comm,
                       endr_comm_rate,
                       endr_ov_comm_rate,
                       pol_bra_code,
                       pol_prod_code,
                       pol_cur_code,
                       agn_act_code
                  INTO v_agn_code,
                       v_agn_sht_desc,
                       v_endr_vat_rate,
                       v_override_comm_amt,
                       v_endr_comm_rate,
                       v_endr_ov_comm_rate,
                       v_brn_code,
                       v_prod_code,
                       v_curr_code,
                       v_agn_act_code
                  FROM lms_policy_endorsements, lms_policies, lms_agencies
                 WHERE     endr_pol_code = pol_code
                       AND endr_code = v_endr_code
                       AND pol_code = v_pol_code
                       AND endr_agen_code = agn_code;
            EXCEPTION
                WHEN OTHERS
                THEN
                    BEGIN
                        SELECT endr_agen_code,
                               endr_agen_sht_desc,
                               endr_vat_rate,
                               endr_override_comm,
                               endr_comm_rate,
                               endr_ov_comm_rate,
                               pol_bra_code,
                               pol_prod_code,
                               pol_cur_code
                          INTO v_agn_code,
                               v_agn_sht_desc,
                               v_endr_vat_rate,
                               v_override_comm_amt,
                               v_endr_comm_rate,
                               v_endr_ov_comm_rate,
                               v_brn_code,
                               v_prod_code,
                               v_curr_code
                          FROM lms_policy_endorsements, lms_policies
                         WHERE     endr_pol_code = pol_code
                               AND pol_current_endr_code = endr_code
                               AND pol_code = v_pol_code;
                    EXCEPTION
                        WHEN OTHERS
                        THEN
                            raise_error (
                                   'Error Accessing Agent/Broker Details '
                                || v_endr_code
                                || ';;'
                                || v_pol_code);
                    END;
            END;
        ELSE
            BEGIN
                SELECT mendr_agen_code,
                       mendr_agen_sht_desc,
                       mendr_vat_rate,
                       mendr_override_comm,
                       mendr_comm_rate,
                       mendr_ov_comm_rate,
                       ipol_bra_code,
                       ipol_prod_code,
                       ipol_cur_code
                  INTO v_agn_code,
                       v_agn_sht_desc,
                       v_endr_vat_rate,
                       v_override_comm_amt,
                       v_endr_comm_rate,
                       v_endr_ov_comm_rate,
                       v_brn_code,
                       v_prod_code,
                       v_curr_code
                  FROM lms_policy_member_endorsements,
                       lms_individual_policies
                 WHERE     mendr_ipol_code = ipol_code
                       AND mendr_code = v_endr_code
                       AND ipol_code = v_pol_code;
            EXCEPTION
                WHEN OTHERS
                THEN
                    BEGIN
                        SELECT mendr_agen_code,
                               mendr_agen_sht_desc,
                               mendr_vat_rate,
                               mendr_override_comm,
                               mendr_comm_rate,
                               mendr_ov_comm_rate,
                               ipol_bra_code,
                               ipol_prod_code,
                               ipol_cur_code
                          INTO v_agn_code,
                               v_agn_sht_desc,
                               v_endr_vat_rate,
                               v_override_comm_amt,
                               v_endr_comm_rate,
                               v_endr_ov_comm_rate,
                               v_brn_code,
                               v_prod_code,
                               v_curr_code
                          FROM lms_policy_member_endorsements,
                               lms_individual_policies
                         WHERE     mendr_ipol_code = ipol_code
                               AND ipol_current_mendr_code = mendr_code
                               AND ipol_code = v_pol_code;
                    EXCEPTION
                        WHEN OTHERS
                        THEN
                            raise_error (
                                   'Error Accessing Agent/Broker Details '
                                || v_endr_code
                                || ';;'
                                || v_pol_code);
                    END;
            END;
        END IF;

        SELECT    TO_NUMBER (TO_CHAR (SYSDATE, 'RRRR'))
               || lms_transaction_seq.NEXTVAL
          INTO v_trans_code
          FROM DUAL;

        v_org_code := fms_interfaces_pkg.get_org (v_brn_code);

        BEGIN
            SELECT grct_gross_amnt,
                   NVL (grct_admin_charge_inclusive, 'Y'),
                   NVL (grct_comm_inclusive, 'Y'),
                   grct_receipt_no
              INTO v_prem_paid,
                   v_admin_fee_inclusive,
                   v_comm_inclusive,
                   v_receipt_no
              FROM lms_grp_prem_receipts
             WHERE grct_code = v_grct_code;
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                raise_error ('Error Accessing Receipt Details');
        END;

        --If Coinsurers, Get the Leaders Admin Fee.
        IF     NVL (v_computation_param, 'P') = 'C'
           AND NVL (v_umbrella, 'N') = 'N'
        THEN
            BEGIN
                SELECT NVL (pol_coin_admin_fee, 0),
                       (NVL (endr_tot_premium, 0) - NVL (endr_comm_amt, 0)),
                       NVL (pol_coin_settled, 0)
                  INTO v_endr_ov_comm_rate,
                       v_endr_tot_prem,
                       v_admin_fee_settled
                  FROM lms_policy_coinsurers, lms_policy_endorsements
                 WHERE     pol_coin_endr_code = endr_code
                       AND pol_coin_pol_code = v_pol_code
                       AND pol_coin_endr_code = v_endr_code
                       AND NVL (pol_coin_follower_leader, 'F') = 'L';
            EXCEPTION
                WHEN OTHERS
                THEN
                    v_endr_ov_comm_rate := 0;
            END;

            v_override_comm_rate := NVL (v_endr_ov_comm_rate, 0) / 100;

            IF NVL (v_endr_ov_comm_rate, 0) > 0
            THEN
                --CALCULATE THE COMMISSION PERCENTAGE AMOUNT...
                v_override_comm_amt :=
                    ROUND ((v_prem_paid * v_override_comm_rate), 2);
                v_override_comm_amt :=
                    v_override_comm_amt - v_admin_fee_settled;

                IF v_override_comm_amt > 0
                THEN
                    v_endr_tot_prem_ratio :=
                        ROUND ((v_endr_tot_prem * v_override_comm_rate), 2);

                    IF v_override_comm_amt > v_endr_tot_prem_ratio
                    THEN
                        v_override_comm_amt := v_endr_tot_prem_ratio;
                    END IF;
                END IF;
            /*Commented for Now as we setup the ADM_GB account.
            get_gl_code ('ADM_GB',
                         v_prod_code,
                         v_trnt_code,
                         v_trnt_gl_code,
                         v_trnt_contra_gl_code
                        );
            get_gl_code ('UP_GB',
                         v_prod_code,
                         v_trnt_code,
                         v_acc_gl_code,
                         v_trnt_contra_gl_code
                        );
            --check if accounts exist in policy branch
            valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code, v_org_code, v_brn_code, 'ADM_GB');
            valid_acc (v_acc_gl_code, v_org_code, v_brn_code, 'UP_GB');
            v_count := NVL (v_count, 0) + 2;
            interface_append_gl
                               (v_trans_code,       --v_trans_code        NUMBER,
                                v_user,           --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                                v_pol_code,         --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                                v_prod_code,        --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                                v_pol_code,        --v_vchr_no          VARCHAR2,
                                NULL,               --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                                NULL,               --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                                NULL,              --v_rcpt_no          VARCHAR2,
                                v_count,            --v_count             NUMBER,
                                'NET COMM_ADMIN CHARGE -'||v_receipt_no,
                                --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                                v_override_comm_amt,
                                                    --v_amount            NUMBER,
                                'D',              --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                                v_trnt_gl_code,
                                --v_acc_number1       VARCHAR2,
                                v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                --v_acc_number2        VARCHAR2,
                                v_brn_code,         --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                                v_gl_trans
                               );*/
            END IF;
        ELSE
            IF NVL (v_admin_fee_inclusive, 'N') = 'N'
            THEN
                v_override_comm_rate := NVL (v_endr_ov_comm_rate, 0) / 100;
            ELSIF NVL (v_admin_fee_inclusive, 'N') = 'Y'
            THEN
                v_override_comm_rate := 0;
            ELSE
                v_override_comm_rate := NVL (v_endr_ov_comm_rate, 0) / 100;
            END IF;

            IF     NVL (v_admin_fee_inclusive, 'N') = 'N'
               AND NVL (v_endr_ov_comm_rate, 0) > 0
            THEN
                --CALCULATE THE COMMISSION PERCENTAGE AMOUNT...
                v_override_comm_amt :=
                    ROUND (
                          (v_prem_paid * v_override_comm_rate)
                        / (1 - (v_override_comm_rate + NVL (v_comm_rate, 0))),
                        2);
                v_comm_amt := 0;
            /*get_gl_code ('ADM_GB',
                         v_prod_code,
                         v_trnt_code,
                         v_trnt_gl_code,
                         v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
            get_gl_code ('UP_GB',
                         v_prod_code,
                         v_trnt_code,
                         v_acc_gl_code,
                         v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                         NULL,
                         -- v_tt_code                        NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                         NULL,
                         -- v_renewal                        VARCHAR2 DEFAULT 'N',
                         v_agn_act_code,
                         -- v_act_code                       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                         v_brn_code);
            --check if accounts exist in policy branch
            valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                       v_org_code,
                       v_brn_code,
                       'ADM_GB');
            valid_acc (v_acc_gl_code,
                       v_org_code,
                       v_brn_code,
                       'UP_GB');
            v_count := NVL (v_count, 0) + 2;
            interface_append_gl (v_trans_code,   --v_trans_code        NUMBER,
                                 v_user,       --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                                 v_pol_code,     --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                                 v_prod_code,    --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                                 v_pol_code,    --v_vchr_no          VARCHAR2,
                                 NULL,           --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                                 NULL,           --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                                 NULL,          --v_rcpt_no          VARCHAR2,
                                 v_count,        --v_count             NUMBER,
                                 'NET COMM_ADMIN CHARGE -' || v_receipt_no,
                                 --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                                 v_override_comm_amt,
                                 --v_amount            NUMBER,
                                 'D',          --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                                 v_trnt_gl_code,
                                 --v_acc_number1       VARCHAR2,
                                 v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                 --v_acc_number2        VARCHAR2,
                                 v_brn_code,     --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                                 v_gl_trans);*/
            END IF;
        END IF;

        --RAISE_ERROR('v_comm_inclusive = '||v_comm_inclusive||'v_endr_comm_rate = '||v_endr_comm_rate||', v_endr_ov_comm_rate = '||v_endr_ov_comm_rate||'v_admin_fee_inclusive='||v_admin_fee_inclusive);

        --      raise_error (   'v_comm_amt = '
        --                   || v_comm_amt
        --                   || ', v_override_comm_amt = '
        --                   || v_override_comm_amt
        --                   || ', v_vat_amount = '
        --                   || v_vat_amount
        --                  );
        --RAISE_ERROR('v_fee_incl='||v_fee_incl||';;'||v_override_comm_amt||';;'||v_computation_param);
        v_ovr_comm_amt := NVL (v_override_comm_amt, 0);

        IF NVL (v_admin_fee_inclusive, 'Y') = 'Y'
        THEN
            v_override_comm_amt := 0;
        END IF;

        IF NVL (v_fee_incl, 'N') = 'Y'
        THEN
            BEGIN
                UPDATE lms_grp_prem_receipts
                   SET grct_gross_amnt =
                             NVL (grct_gross_amnt, 0)
                           + NVL (v_vat_amount, 0)
                           + NVL (v_override_comm_amt, 0),
                       grct_prem_orc_comm = NVL (v_ovr_comm_amt, 0),
                       grct_prem_orc_comm_paid = NVL (v_override_comm_amt, 0)
                 WHERE grct_code = v_grct_code;
            EXCEPTION
                WHEN OTHERS
                THEN
                    raise_error ('Error Updating Gross Receipt Amount');
            END;

            BEGIN
                UPDATE lms_master_transactions
                   SET mtran_amount =
                             NVL (mtran_amount, 0)
                           - (  NVL (v_vat_amount, 0)
                              + NVL (v_override_comm_amt, 0)),
                       mtran_balance =
                             NVL (mtran_balance, 0)
                           - (  NVL (v_vat_amount, 0)
                              + NVL (v_override_comm_amt, 0)),
                       mtran_net_amt =
                             NVL (mtran_net_amt, 0)
                           - (  NVL (v_vat_amount, 0)
                              + NVL (v_override_comm_amt, 0)),
                       mtran_admin_charge =
                           (  NVL (mtran_admin_charge, 0)
                            + DECODE (NVL (v_computation_param, 'P'),
                                      'C', NVL (v_override_comm_amt, 0),
                                      0)),
                       mtran_admin_charge_payable =
                           (  NVL (mtran_admin_charge_payable, 0)
                            + DECODE (NVL (v_computation_param, 'P'),
                                      'C', NVL (v_override_comm_amt, 0),
                                      0))
                 WHERE mtran_code = v_mtran_code;
            EXCEPTION
                WHEN OTHERS
                THEN
                    raise_error ('Error Updating Gross Receipt Amount');
            END;
        ELSE
            BEGIN
                UPDATE lms_grp_prem_receipts
                   SET grct_prem_orc_comm = NVL (v_ovr_comm_amt, 0),
                       grct_prem_orc_comm_paid = NVL (v_override_comm_amt, 0)
                 WHERE grct_code = v_grct_code;
            EXCEPTION
                WHEN OTHERS
                THEN
                    raise_error ('Error Updating Gross Receipt Amount');
            END;

            BEGIN
                UPDATE lms_master_transactions
                   SET mtran_admin_charge =
                           (  NVL (mtran_admin_charge, 0)
                            + DECODE (NVL (v_computation_param, 'P'),
                                      'C', NVL (v_override_comm_amt, 0),
                                      0)),
                       mtran_admin_charge_payable =
                           (  NVL (mtran_admin_charge_payable, 0)
                            + DECODE (NVL (v_computation_param, 'P'),
                                      'C', NVL (v_override_comm_amt, 0),
                                      0))
                 WHERE mtran_code = v_mtran_code;
            EXCEPTION
                WHEN OTHERS
                THEN
                    raise_error ('Error Updating Gross Receipt Amount');
            END;
        END IF;
    /* IF v_count <> 0
     THEN
        interface_update_vgl (v_trans_code,        --v_trans_code     NUMBER,
                              v_user,         --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                              v_pol_code,       --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                              TRUNC (SYSDATE),         --v_date         DATE,
                              NULL,             --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                              NULL,             --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                              'NET COMM_ADMIN CHARGE.', --v_btc_description   VARCHAR2,
                              'JV',          --v_btc_type           VARCHAR2,
                              v_brn_code,       --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                              'NET ADMIN CHARGE POSTING ' || v_receipt_no,
                              --v_description       VARCHAR2,
                              v_pol_code,      --v_ref_no           VARCHAR2,
                              v_gl_trans,
                              NULL,
                              NULL,
                              NULL,
                              NULL,
                              NULL,
                              NULL,
                              NULL,
                              NULL,
                              NULL,
                              v_curr_code);
     END IF;*/
    END calc_grp_admin_fee;

    PROCEDURE process_trustee_payment (
        v_pol_code     NUMBER,
        v_amt_to_pay   NUMBER,
        v_raised_by    VARCHAR2
    )
    IS
        v_trans_code            NUMBER;
        v_trnt_code             VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_trnt_gl_code          VARCHAR2 (50);
        v_trnt_contra_gl_code   VARCHAR2 (50);
        v_org_code              NUMBER;
        v_branch                NUMBER;
        v_vchr_no               lms_interface_table.itb_vchr_no%TYPE;
        v_count                 NUMBER := 0;
        v_chq_cnt               NUMBER := 0;
        v_grct_code             NUMBER;
        v_gl_trans              fms_vouchers_pkg.tgl_rec_type;
        v_chq_dtls_rec          fms_cheques_pkg.type_rqn_dtls_table;
        v_pol_prod_code         lms_policies.pol_prod_code%TYPE;
        v_user                  VARCHAR2 (30);
        v_payee                 VARCHAR2 (200);
        v_pol_policy_no         lms_policies.pol_policy_no%TYPE;
    BEGIN
        BEGIN
            SELECT pol_bra_code,
                   pol_prod_code,
                   TRIM (
                          prp_first_name
                       || ' '
                       || TRIM (prp_other_names || ' ' || prp_surname)),
                   pol_policy_no
              INTO v_branch,
                   v_pol_prod_code,
                   v_payee,
                   v_pol_policy_no
              FROM lms_policies, lms_proposers
             WHERE pol_code = v_pol_code AND pol_client_prp_code = prp_code;
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                raise_error ('Error Accessing Policy Details');
        END;

        --v_user := fms_interfaces_pkg.get_username (v_raised_by);
        SELECT    TO_NUMBER (TO_CHAR (SYSDATE, 'RRRR'))
               || lms_transaction_seq.NEXTVAL
          INTO v_trans_code
          FROM DUAL;

        v_org_code := fms_interfaces_pkg.get_org (v_branch);
        v_vchr_no := lms_api.trans_voucher ('RFD');

        IF v_amt_to_pay > 0
        THEN
            get_gl_code ('VA_GB',
                         v_pol_prod_code,
                         v_trnt_code,
                         v_trnt_gl_code,
                         v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
            valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code, v_org_code, v_branch);
            valid_acc (v_trnt_contra_gl_code, v_org_code, v_branch);
            v_chq_cnt := v_chq_cnt + 1;
            interface_append_chq (
                v_trans_code,                      --v_trans_code      NUMBER,
                v_raised_by,                   --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                v_pol_code,                     --v_pol_code           NUMBER,
                v_pol_prod_code,
                --v_prod_code          NUMBER,
                v_vchr_no,
                --v_vchr_no,--v_vchr_no             VARCHAR2,
                v_chq_cnt,                      --v_count              NUMBER,
                v_amt_to_pay,
                --v_amount             NUMBER,
                'TRUSTEES ADMIN CHARGE - ' || v_pol_policy_no,
                --v_narrative          VARCHAR2,
                v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                --v_acc_number         VARCHAR2,
                v_org_code,
                --v_acc_org_code        NUMBER,
                v_branch,                       --v_branch_code        NUMBER,
                'D',                          --v_drcr               VARCHAR2,
                v_chq_dtls_rec);

            IF v_chq_cnt != 0
            THEN
                interface_create_reqn (
                    v_trans_code,               --v_trans_code         NUMBER,
                    v_vchr_no,             --v_ref                   VARCHAR2,
                    v_pol_code,            --v_ref2                  VARCHAR2,
                    TRUNC (SYSDATE),           --v_ref_date              DATE,
                    'TRUSTEES ADMIN CHARGE - ' || v_pol_policy_no,
                    --v_narrative             VARCHAR2,
                    v_amt_to_pay,            --v_amount                NUMBER,
                    v_payee,               --v_payee                 VARCHAR2,
                    'CHQ',      --v_pay_method            VARCHAR2, --CHQ, EFT
                    NULL,               --v_payee_bank_acc_no        VARCHAR2,
                    NULL,                 --v_payee_bank_branch_code   NUMBER,
                    v_raised_by,           --v_source_auth_by        VARCHAR2,
                    TRUNC (SYSDATE),           --v_source_auth_dt        DATE,
                    v_raised_by,         --v_raise_by                VARCHAR2,
                    'REFUND',              --v_pmt_type              VARCHAR2,
                    v_branch,                  --v_branch_code         NUMBER,
                    v_pol_code,
                    v_chq_dtls_rec);
            END IF;
        END IF;
    END;

    PROCEDURE post_agent_debit (
        v_trans_no   NUMBER,
        v_user       VARCHAR2,
        v_adb_code   NUMBER
    )
    IS
        v_chq_dtls_rec              fms_cheques_pkg.type_rqn_dtls_table;
        v_gl_trans                  tq_fms.fms_vouchers_pkg.tgl_rec_type;
        vgl_code                    NUMBER;
        v_gl_count                  NUMBER := -1;
        v_trnt_code                 VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_contra_acc                VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_trnt_gl_code              VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_trnt_contra_gl_code       VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_count                     NUMBER := 0;
        v_org_code                  NUMBER;
        v_payee                     VARCHAR2 (50);
        v_brn_code                  NUMBER;
        v_desc                      VARCHAR2 (200);
        v_desc1                     VARCHAR2 (200);
        v_trans_code                NUMBER;
        v_ref                       NUMBER;
        v_ocl_code                  NUMBER;
        v_amount                    NUMBER;
        v_pay_method_code           NUMBER;
        v_pol_type                  VARCHAR2 (5);
        v_ann_chk                   VARCHAR2 (5) := 'N';
        v_rct_code                  VARCHAR2 (50);
        v_oppr_receipt_trans_code   VARCHAR2 (100);
        v_opr_receipt_trans_code    VARCHAR2 (100);
        v_ppr_code                  lms_pol_proposals.ppr_code%TYPE;
        v_pol_code                  lms_policies.pol_code%TYPE;
        v_pol_status                lms_policies.pol_status%TYPE;
        v_policy_no                 lms_policies.pol_policy_no%TYPE;
        v_proposal_no               lms_policies.pol_proposal_no%TYPE;
        v_prod_type                 lms_policies.pol_prod_type%TYPE;
        v_prod_code                 lms_policies.pol_prod_code%TYPE;
        v_opr_code                  NUMBER;
        v_oppr_code                 NUMBER;
        v_tran_no                   NUMBER;
        v_ac_type                   NUMBER;
        v_bal_amt                   NUMBER;
        v_raised_by                 NUMBER;
        v_cur_code                  NUMBER;
        v_only_due_inst             VARCHAR2 (20) := 'N';
        v_multiple_inst             VARCHAR2 (20) := 'Y';
        v_nfl_alloc                 NUMBER := 0;
        v_acc_type                  VARCHAR2 (20) := 'AGN_DBT';
        v_date                      DATE;
        v_vchr_no                   VARCHAR2 (100);
        v_prapared_by               lms_agent_debits.adb_prapared_by%TYPE;
        v_source                    VARCHAR2 (100);
        v_agn_code                  NUMBER;
        v_loop_cnt                  NUMBER := 0;

        CURSOR drcr IS
            SELECT ocl_code,
                   agn_code,
                   ocl_refnd_amt,
                   ocl_tot_comm_amt,
                   ocl_tot_wht_amt,
                   adb_payee,
                   agn_sht_desc,
                   TRIM (
                          agn_other_names
                       || ' '
                       || TRIM (agn_md_name || ' ' || agn_name))          agn_name,
                   ocl_brn_code,
                   ldr_payout,
                   adb_pol_status,
                   adb_pol_code,
                   adb_pol_policy_no,
                   adb_ppr_code,
                   adb_proposal_no,
                   adb_drcr_date,
                   NVL (adb_drcr, 'D')                                    adb_drcr,
                   adb_prapared_by,
                   DECODE (adb_drcr,
                           'D', DECODE (SIGN (ocl_refnd_amt), 1, 'C', 'D'),
                           DECODE (SIGN (ocl_refnd_amt), 1, 'D', 'C'))    rcpt_drcr
              FROM lms_other_comm_clawbck,
                   lms_agent_debits,
                   lms_agencies,
                   lms_debit_reason
             WHERE     ocl_adb_code = adb_code
                   AND adb_agn_code = agn_code
                   AND adb_ltr_trans_no = v_trans_no
                   AND adb_code = v_adb_code
                   AND adb_ldr_code = ldr_code;
    BEGIN
        /*
        step 1
        CREATE cheq requisition
               CR Bank
              DR Agnt_dbt suspense a/c
        step 2
        CREATE gl voucher
              DR Agnt_dbt a/c
              CR Agnt_dbt suspense a/c
        */
        --raise_error(v_cad_code||';'||v_user||';'||v_adv_type||';'||v_otop_receipt_trans_code||';'||v_receipt_pk||';'||v_rct_code);
        FOR d IN drcr
        LOOP
            v_count := 0;
            v_gl_count := -1;
            v_loop_cnt := NVL (v_loop_cnt, 0) + 1;
            v_brn_code := d.ocl_brn_code;
            v_payee := d.adb_payee;
            v_ocl_code := d.ocl_code;
            v_amount := d.ocl_tot_comm_amt;
            v_ref := d.ocl_code;
            v_raised_by := fms_gen_pkg.get_usercode (v_user);
            v_cur_code := lms_interfaces_pkg.lms_def_cur (v_brn_code);
            v_pol_code := d.adb_pol_code;
            v_ppr_code := d.adb_ppr_code;
            v_date := d.adb_drcr_date;
            v_vchr_no := lms_api.trans_voucher ('AD');
            v_prapared_by := d.adb_prapared_by;
            v_agn_code := d.agn_code;

            SELECT    TO_NUMBER (TO_CHAR (SYSDATE, 'RRRR'))
                   || lms_transaction_seq.NEXTVAL
              INTO v_trans_code
              FROM DUAL;

            v_desc :=
                   'PAYMENT FROM AGENT '
                || d.agn_sht_desc
                || ' ; '
                || d.agn_name;
            v_desc1 :=
                'DEBITING AGENT ' || d.agn_sht_desc || ' ; ' || d.agn_name;
            v_org_code := fms_interfaces_pkg.get_org (v_brn_code);

            IF NVL (d.ocl_tot_comm_amt, 0) <> 0
            THEN
                IF d.ldr_payout = 'PP'
                THEN
                    v_rct_code := 'FROM_AGENT';
                    v_pay_method_code := pay_method_code ('VOUCHER');

                    IF d.adb_drcr = 'C'
                    THEN
                        v_source := 'TO_AGENT';
                    ELSE
                        v_source := 'FROM_AGENT';
                    END IF;

                    IF d.adb_pol_code IS NOT NULL
                    THEN
                        BEGIN
                            SELECT pol_policy_no,
                                   pol_proposal_no,
                                   pol_status,
                                   pol_type,
                                   NVL (agn_act_code, 16),
                                   pol_prod_type,
                                   pol_prod_code
                              INTO v_policy_no,
                                   v_proposal_no,
                                   v_pol_status,
                                   v_pol_type,
                                   v_ac_type,
                                   v_prod_type,
                                   v_prod_code
                              FROM lms_policies,
                                   lms_policy_endorsements,
                                   lms_agencies
                             WHERE     pol_code = d.adb_pol_code
                                   AND pol_current_endr_code = endr_code
                                   AND endr_agen_code = agn_code;
                        EXCEPTION
                            WHEN OTHERS
                            THEN
                                raise_error (
                                    'Error fetching policy details.');
                        END;

                        SELECT    v_rct_code
                               || '/'
                               || lms_opr_receipt_trans_seq.NEXTVAL
                          INTO v_opr_receipt_trans_code
                          FROM DUAL;

                        --RAISE_ERROR('XXXXXDDDDD v_pol_status='||v_pol_status||';v_prod_type='||v_prod_type);
                        IF NOT v_pol_status IN ('D', 'V')
                        THEN
                            SELECT    TO_NUMBER (TO_CHAR (SYSDATE, 'RRRR'))
                                   || lms_opr_code_seq.NEXTVAL
                              INTO v_opr_code
                              FROM DUAL;

                            IF NOT v_prod_type IN ('IN',
                                                   'PN',
                                                   'SP',
                                                   'AN')
                            THEN
                                BEGIN
                                    INSERT INTO lms_ord_prem_receipts (
                                                    opr_code,
                                                    opr_ltr_trans_no,
                                                    opr_date,
                                                    opr_cheque_no,
                                                    opr_amt,
                                                    opr_pol_code,
                                                    opr_pol_policy_no,
                                                    opr_receipt_no,
                                                    opr_receipt_date,
                                                    opr_pmth_code,
                                                    opr_done_by,
                                                    opr_drcr,
                                                    opr_source,
                                                    opr_receipt_trans_code,
                                                    opr_fms_receipt_pk,
                                                    opr_origin,
                                                    opr_alloc_to,
                                                    opr_capital_injectn,
                                                    opr_chk_comm,
                                                    opr_chk_comm_rate)
                                         VALUES (v_opr_code,
                                                 v_trans_no,
                                                 TRUNC (SYSDATE),
                                                 SUBSTR (v_source, 1, 20),
                                                 d.ocl_refnd_amt,
                                                 d.adb_pol_code,
                                                 v_policy_no,
                                                 v_rct_code,
                                                 d.adb_drcr_date,
                                                 v_pay_method_code,
                                                 v_user,
                                                 d.rcpt_drcr,
                                                 v_source,
                                                 v_opr_receipt_trans_code,
                                                 NULL,
                                                 'I',
                                                 'PR',
                                                 'N',
                                                 NULL,
                                                 NULL);
                                EXCEPTION
                                    WHEN OTHERS
                                    THEN
                                        raise_error ('PREM RCPT DTLS...');
                                END;
                            ELSE
                                BEGIN
                                    INSERT INTO lms_ord_prem_receipts (
                                                    opr_code,
                                                    opr_ltr_trans_no,
                                                    opr_date,
                                                    opr_cheque_no,
                                                    opr_amt,
                                                    opr_pol_code,
                                                    opr_pol_policy_no,
                                                    opr_receipt_no,
                                                    opr_receipt_date,
                                                    opr_pmth_code,
                                                    opr_done_by,
                                                    opr_drcr,
                                                    opr_source,
                                                    opr_receipt_trans_code,
                                                    opr_fms_receipt_pk,
                                                    opr_origin,
                                                    opr_alloc_to,
                                                    opr_capital_injectn,
                                                    opr_chk_comm,
                                                    opr_chk_comm_rate)
                                         VALUES (v_opr_code,
                                                 NULL,
                                                 TRUNC (SYSDATE),
                                                 v_source,
                                                 d.ocl_refnd_amt,
                                                 d.adb_pol_code,
                                                 v_policy_no,
                                                 v_rct_code,
                                                 d.adb_drcr_date,
                                                 v_pay_method_code,
                                                 v_user,
                                                 d.rcpt_drcr,
                                                 v_source,
                                                 v_opr_receipt_trans_code,
                                                 NULL,
                                                 'I',
                                                 'PN',
                                                 'N',
                                                 NULL,
                                                 NULL);
                                EXCEPTION
                                    WHEN OTHERS
                                    THEN
                                        raise_error ('PENS/INV RCPT DTLS...');
                                END;
                            END IF;
                        ELSE
                            SELECT    v_rct_code
                                   || '/'
                                   || lms_oppr_receipt_trans_seq.NEXTVAL
                              INTO v_oppr_receipt_trans_code
                              FROM DUAL;

                            SELECT    TO_NUMBER (TO_CHAR (SYSDATE, 'RRRR'))
                                   || lms_oppr_code_seq.NEXTVAL
                              INTO v_oppr_code
                              FROM DUAL;

                            BEGIN
                                INSERT INTO lms_ord_proposal_rcpts (
                                                oppr_code,
                                                oppr_ltr_trans_no,
                                                oppr_date,
                                                oppr_cheque_no,
                                                oppr_amt,
                                                oppr_pol_code,
                                                oppr_pol_proposal_no,
                                                oppr_receipt_no,
                                                oppr_receipt_date,
                                                oppr_pmth_code,
                                                opr_chk_agen_code,
                                                opri_chk_comm_rate,
                                                opri_chk_comm_amt,
                                                oppr_done_by,
                                                oppr_source,
                                                oppr_drcr,
                                                oppr_receipt_trans_code,
                                                oppr_ann_code,
                                                oppr_fms_receipt_pk)
                                         VALUES (
                                             v_oppr_code,
                                             NULL,
                                             TRUNC (SYSDATE),
                                             v_source,
                                             d.ocl_refnd_amt,
                                             DECODE (
                                                 v_ann_chk,
                                                 'Y', NULL,
                                                 DECODE (
                                                     v_pol_type,
                                                     'PR', d.adb_pol_code,
                                                     'PL', d.adb_pol_code,
                                                     NULL)),
                                             v_proposal_no,
                                             --v_recpt_rec(i).POL_POLICY_NO,
                                             v_rct_code,
                                             d.adb_drcr_date,
                                             v_pay_method_code,
                                             NULL,
                                             NULL,
                                             0,
                                             v_user,
                                             v_source,
                                             d.rcpt_drcr,
                                             v_oppr_receipt_trans_code,
                                             DECODE (v_ann_chk,
                                                     'Y', d.adb_pol_code,
                                                     NULL),
                                             NULL);           --v_pay_method);
                            EXCEPTION
                                WHEN OTHERS
                                THEN
                                    raise_error (
                                        'ERROR INSERTING PROPOSAL RECEIPT DETAILS......');
                            END;
                        --RAISE_ERROR('XXXXXDDDDD v_pol_status='||v_pol_status||';v_prod_type='||v_prod_type);
                        END IF;
                    ELSIF d.adb_ppr_code IS NOT NULL
                    THEN
                        BEGIN
                            SELECT ppr_proposal_no,
                                   'MKT',
                                   ppr_prod_code,
                                   NVL (agn_act_code, 16),
                                   prod_code,
                                   prod_type
                              INTO v_proposal_no,
                                   v_pol_type,

                                            oppr_pol_proposal_no,
                                            oppr_receipt_no,
                                            oppr_receipt_date,

                                            opri_chk_comm_rate,

                                            oppr_done_by,
                                            oppr_source,
                                            oppr_drcr,
                                            oppr_receipt_trans_code,
                                            oppr_ann_code,
                                            oppr_fms_receipt_pk)
                                     VALUES (
                                         v_oppr_code,
                                         NULL,
                                         TRUNC (SYSDATE),

                                             v_ann_chk,
                                             'Y', NULL,

                                         v_rct_code,
                                         d.adb_drcr_date,
                                         v_pay_method_code,
                                         NULL,
                                         NULL,
                                         0,
                                         v_user,
                                         v_source,
                                         d.rcpt_drcr,
                                         v_oppr_receipt_trans_code,
                                         DECODE (v_ann_chk,
                                                 'Y', d.adb_pol_code,
                                                 NULL),
                                         NULL);               --v_pay_method);
                        EXCEPTION
                            WHEN OTHERS
                            THEN
                                raise_error (
                                    'ERROR INSERTING PROPOSAL RECEIPT DETAILS..2....');
                        END;
                    ELSE
                        raise_error (
                            'A policy or proposal to allocate funds to is not valid.');
                    END IF;

                    IF NOT NVL (v_pol_status, 'D') IN ('D', 'V')
                    THEN
                        IF NOT NVL (v_prod_type, 'ED') IN ('IN',
                                                           'PN',
                                                           'SP',
                                                           'AN')
                        THEN
                            BEGIN
                                lms_process_receipts.lms_ord_premium_receipts (
                                    d.adb_pol_code,
                                    v_opr_code,
                                    v_multiple_inst,
                                    v_only_due_inst,
                                    v_tran_no,
                                    v_ac_type,
                                    v_bal_amt);
                            EXCEPTION
                                WHEN OTHERS
                                THEN
                                    raise_error (
                                           'PROCESSING LMS PREM PYMT FOR '
                                        || v_policy_no
                                        || '....');
                            END;
                        ELSE
                            BEGIN
                                lms_investments.process_receipt (
                                    d.adb_pol_code,
                                    v_opr_code,
                                    NULL);
                            EXCEPTION
                                WHEN OTHERS
                                THEN
                                    raise_error (
                                           'PROCESSING INV. FOR POL NO. '
                                        || v_policy_no
                                        || '...');
                            END;
                        END IF;
                    END IF;

                    --raise_error('rceipt balance='||lms_process_receipts.rcpt_balance(v_opr_code));
                    get_gl_code ('DR_RCT',
                                 v_prod_code,
                                 v_trnt_code,
                                 v_contra_acc,
                                 v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
                    valid_acc (v_contra_acc,
                               v_org_code,
                               v_brn_code,
                               'DR_RCT');
                    get_gl_code ('AGNT_DBT',
                                 NULL,                          --v_prod_code,
                                 v_trnt_code,
                                 v_trnt_gl_code,
                                 v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
                    valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                               v_org_code,
                               v_brn_code,
                               'AGNT_DBT');
                    valid_acc (v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                               v_org_code,
                               v_brn_code,
                               'AGNT_DBT CONTRA');

                    IF v_oppr_code IS NOT NULL
                    THEN
                        v_gl_count := v_gl_count + 2;
                        interface_append_gl (
                            v_trans_code,                     -- v_trans_code,
                            v_user,                             -- v_raise_by,
                            d.adb_pol_code,                     -- v_pol_code,
                            v_prod_code,                       -- v_prod_code,
                            NULL,                                -- v_vchr_no,
                            NULL,                              -- v_opr_code,,
                            v_oppr_code,                       -- v_oppr_code,
                            v_rct_code,                           --v_rcpt_no,
                            v_gl_count,                            -- v_count,
                            'PROPOSAL PREMIUM - ' || v_proposal_no,
                            -- v_narrative,
                            d.ocl_refnd_amt,                      -- v_amount,
                            'C',                                    -- v_drcr,
                            v_contra_acc,                    -- v_acc_number1,
                            v_trnt_gl_code,                  -- v_acc_number2,
                            v_brn_code,                      -- v_branch_code,
                            v_gl_trans,
                            NULL,     ---v_cad_code       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                            NULL,    ---v_otop_code       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                            NULL,     --v_fpmt_code       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                            NULL,     --v_ort_code        NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                            NULL,       --v_btr_no        NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                            d.adb_ppr_code,          --- NUMBER DEFAULT NULL);
                            v_ocl_code,     --v_ocl_code   NUMBER DEFAULT NULL
                            v_agn_code,      --v_agn_code NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                            v_trans_no        --v_trans_no NUMBER DEFAULT NULL
                                      );
                    ELSIF v_opr_code IS NOT NULL
                    THEN
                        v_gl_count := v_gl_count + 2;
                        interface_append_gl (
                            v_trans_code,       --v_trans_code         NUMBER,
                            v_user,            --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                            d.adb_pol_code,      --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                            v_prod_code,
                            --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                            v_policy_no,
                            --v_vchr_no           VARCHAR2,
                            v_opr_code,          --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                            NULL,                --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                            NULL,               --v_rcpt_no          VARCHAR2,
                            v_gl_count,          --v_count             NUMBER,
                            'PREMIUM INCOME-' || v_policy_no,
                            --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                            d.ocl_refnd_amt,     --v_amount            NUMBER,
                            'C',               --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                            v_contra_acc,         --v_acc_1          VARCHAR2,
                            v_trnt_gl_code,       --v_acc_2          VARCHAR2,
                            v_brn_code,
                            --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                            v_gl_trans,
                            NULL,            --v_cad_code NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                            NULL,          --v_otop_code  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                            NULL,         --v_fpmt_code   NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                            NULL,         --v_ort_code    NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                            NULL,          --v_btr_no     NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                            d.adb_ppr_code, -- v_ppr_code   NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                            v_ocl_code,     --v_ocl_code   NUMBER DEFAULT NULL
                            v_agn_code,      --v_agn_code NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                            v_trans_no        --v_trans_no NUMBER DEFAULT NULL
                                      );

                    BEGIN
                        post_update_recpt_pymt (v_rct_code,
                                                v_opr_receipt_trans_code,
                                                v_oppr_receipt_trans_code,

                                                v_brn_code,
                                                v_acc_type,

                                                'RECEIPT FROM AGENT DEBIT', --v_description,
                                                d.adb_drcr_date,

                                                v_cur_code,
                                                v_opr_code, --v_opr_code NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                                NULL, --v_prm_amt NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                                NULL, --v_chk_com NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,

                                                NULL, --v_pn_amt NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,

                                                NULL, --v_fee_inv NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                                NULL, --v_contri_inv NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                                NULL, --v_compfund NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                                NULL,          --v_receipt_pk,
                                                'N', --v_fms_unknown_reposting,
                                                v_oppr_code, --v_oppr_code NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                                'Y', --v_reverse_alloc VARCHAR2 DEFAULT 'N',
                                                'N', --v_prem_waiver     VARCHAR2 DEFAULT 'N',
                                                v_trans_no --v_trans_no NUMBER DEFAULT NULL
                                                          );
                    EXCEPTION
                        WHEN OTHERS
                        THEN
                            raise_error ('AGNDBT INTERFACE..,');
                    END;
                ELSE
                    get_gl_code ('AGNT_DBT',
                                 NULL,                          --v_prod_code,
                                 v_trnt_code,
                                 v_trnt_gl_code,
                                 v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
                    valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                               v_org_code,
                               v_brn_code,
                               'AGNT_DBT');
                    valid_acc (v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                               v_org_code,
                               v_brn_code,
                               'AGNT_DBT CONTRA');
                    v_count := v_count + 1;
                    interface_append_chq (v_trans_code,
                                          v_user,
                                          NULL,
                                          --v_pol_code,find out how to fetch policy code for the medicals.
                                          NULL,                 --v_prod_code,
                                          v_vchr_no,              --v_vchr_no,
                                          v_count,
                                          d.ocl_refnd_amt,
                                          v_desc1,         --'AGENT DEBITING',
                                          v_trnt_contra_gl_code,

                                          v_ocl_code,

                                          v_trans_no --v_trans_no NUMBER DEFAULT NULL

                    v_gl_count := v_gl_count + 2;
                    interface_append_gl (v_trans_code,        -- v_trans_code,
                                         v_user,                -- v_raise_by,
                                         v_pol_code,            -- v_pol_code,
                                         v_prod_code,          -- v_prod_code,
                                         v_vchr_no,              -- v_vchr_no,
                                         NULL,                  -- v_opr_code,
                                         NULL,                 -- v_oppr_code,
                                         NULL,                    --v_rcpt_no,
                                         v_gl_count,               -- v_count,
                                         v_desc1,              -- v_narrative,
                                         NVL (d.ocl_tot_comm_amt, 0), -- v_amount,
                                         'C',                       -- v_drcr,
                                         v_trnt_contra_gl_code, -- v_acc_number1,
                                         v_trnt_gl_code,     -- v_acc_number2,
                                         v_brn_code,         -- v_branch_code,

                                         NULL,

                                         NULL,                  -- v_ort_code,

                                         v_trans_no --v_trans_no NUMBER DEFAULT NULL

                    IF NVL (d.ocl_tot_wht_amt, 0) <> 0
                    THEN

                        interface_append_gl (v_trans_code,    -- v_trans_code,
                                             v_user,            -- v_raise_by,
                                             v_pol_code,        -- v_pol_code,
                                             v_prod_code,      -- v_prod_code,
                                             NULL,               -- v_vchr_no,
                                             NULL,              -- v_opr_code,
                                             NULL,             -- v_oppr_code,

                                             v_gl_count,           -- v_count,
                                             v_desc1,          -- v_narrative,
                                             NVL (d.ocl_tot_wht_amt, 0), -- v_amount,
                                             'C',                   -- v_drcr,
                                             v_trnt_contra_gl_code, -- v_acc_number1,
                                             v_trnt_gl_code, -- v_acc_number2,
