                                             v_agn_code, --v_agn_code NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                             v_trans_no --v_trans_no NUMBER DEFAULT NULL
                                                       );
                    END IF;
                END IF;
            END IF;
        END LOOP;

        IF v_count != 0
        THEN
            BEGIN
                interface_create_reqn (v_trans_code, --v_trans_code          NUMBER,
                                       v_vchr_no, --v_ref                   VARCHAR2,
                                       v_ocl_code, --v_ref2                  VARCHAR2,
                                       TRUNC (SYSDATE), --v_ref_date              DATE,
                                       'LMS AGNT DEBIT POSTING ( CHQ )',
                                       --v_narrative             VARCHAR2,
                                       v_amount, --v_amount                NUMBER,
                                       v_payee, --v_payee                 VARCHAR2,
                                       'CHQ', --v_pay_method            VARCHAR2, --CHQ, EFT
                                       NULL, --v_payee_bank_acc_no        VARCHAR2,
                                       NULL, --v_payee_bank_branch_code   NUMBER,
                                       v_user, --v_source_auth_by        VARCHAR2,
                                       TRUNC (SYSDATE), --v_source_auth_dt        DATE,
                                       v_prapared_by, --v_raise_by                VARCHAR2,
                                       'AGNT_DBT', --v_pmt_type              VARCHAR2,
                                       v_brn_code,
                                       v_pol_code,               --v_pol_code,
                                       v_chq_dtls_rec,
                                       -- IN OUT   fms_cheques_pkg.type_rqn_dtls_table,
                                       NULL,       --fmtp NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                       v_agn_code, --v_agn_code NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                       v_trans_no, --v_trans_no NUMBER DEFAULT NULL
                                       v_ocl_code --v_ocl_code NUMBER DEFAULT NULL
                                                 );
            EXCEPTION
                WHEN OTHERS
                THEN
                    raise_error ('POST AGNT. DEBIT ...');
            END;
        END IF;

        --step 2 create GL voucher
        IF v_gl_count != 0
        THEN
            BEGIN
                interface_update_vgl (v_trans_code, --v_trans_code     NUMBER,
                                      v_user,  --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                                      v_pol_code, --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                                      v_date,      --v_date              DATE,
                                      v_opr_code, --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                                      v_oppr_code, --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                                      'LMS PROPOSAL RECEIPT DEBIT',
                                      --v_btc_description   VARCHAR2,
                                      'JV', --v_btc_type             VARCHAR2,
                                      v_brn_code, --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                                      'PROPOSAL RECEIPT DEBIT VOUCHER',
                                      --v_description       VARCHAR2,
                                      NVL (v_policy_no, v_proposal_no),
                                      --v_ref             VARCHAR2,
                                      v_gl_trans,               --v_gl_trans);
                                      NULL,                     --v_otop_code,
                                      NULL,                     --v_otop_code,
                                      NULL,                      --v_fpmt_code
                                      NULL,                       --v_ort_code
                                      NULL,                         --v_btr_no
                                      v_ppr_code,                 --v_ppr_code
                                      v_ocl_code, --v_ocl_code NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                      v_agn_code, --v_agn_code NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                      v_trans_no --v_trans_no NUMBER DEFAULT NULL
                                                );
            EXCEPTION
                WHEN OTHERS
                THEN
                    raise_error ('POPULATING GL DETAILS');
            END;
        END IF;
    --raise_error ('zzzz. DEBIT. ');
    EXCEPTION
        WHEN OTHERS
        THEN
            raise_error ('AGNT. DEBIT. ');
    END post_agent_debit;

    PROCEDURE process_withdrwl_intr (v_lpw_code NUMBER, v_user_name VARCHAR2)
    IS
        v_chq_dtls_rec          fms_cheques_pkg.type_rqn_dtls_table;
        v_policy_no             VARCHAR2 (30);
        v_brh_code              NUMBER;
        v_trnt_type             VARCHAR2 (5);
        v_prod_code             NUMBER;
        v_trnt_code             VARCHAR2 (10);
        v_trnt_gl_code          VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_trnt_contra_gl_code   VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_org_code              NUMBER;
        v_crt_acc_no            VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_payee                 VARCHAR2 (100);
        v_drcr                  VARCHAR2 (1);
        v_gl_trans              fms_vouchers_pkg.tgl_rec_type;
        v_count                 NUMBER := 0;
        v_vgl_no                NUMBER;
        v_pm_maturity_type      VARCHAR2 (10);
        v_narrative             VARCHAR2 (30);
        v_matr_desc             VARCHAR2 (30);
        v_pol_code              NUMBER;
        v_eft_enabled           VARCHAR2 (1) := 'N';
        v_bbr_code              NUMBER;
        v_account_number        VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_gl_count              NUMBER := 1;
        v_trans_code            NUMBER;
        v_vchr_no               VARCHAR2 (50);

        CURSOR intr IS
            SELECT lpw_code,
                   lpw_pol_code,
                   lpw_endr_code,
                   lpw_ltr_trans_no,
                   lpw_amt,
                   lpw_done_date,
                   lpw_type,
                   lpw_account_no,
                   lpw_bbr_code,
                   ltr_done_by,
                   pol_bra_code,
                   pol_policy_no,
                   pol_prod_code,
                   lpw_payee
              FROM lms_pen_withdrwls, lms_transactions, lms_policies
             WHERE     lpw_code = v_lpw_code
                   AND lpw_pol_code = pol_code
                   AND lpw_ltr_trans_no = ltr_trans_no;
    BEGIN
        FOR i IN intr
        LOOP
            v_bbr_code := i.lpw_bbr_code;
            v_account_number := i.lpw_account_no;
            v_brh_code := i.pol_bra_code;
            v_payee := i.lpw_payee;
            v_policy_no := i.pol_policy_no;
            v_vchr_no := lms_api.trans_voucher ('IW');

            SELECT    TO_NUMBER (TO_CHAR (SYSDATE, 'RRRR'))
                   || lms_transaction_seq.NEXTVAL
              INTO v_trans_code
              FROM DUAL;

            IF NVL (i.lpw_amt, 0) > 0
            THEN
                v_count := NVL (v_count, 0) + 1;
                get_gl_code ('INTR_WTH',
                             v_prod_code,
                             v_trnt_code,
                             v_crt_acc_no,
                             v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
                v_org_code := fms_interfaces_pkg.get_org (v_brh_code);
                valid_acc (v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                           v_org_code,
                           v_brh_code,
                           'INTR_WTH CONTRA');
                interface_append_chq (
                    v_trans_code,                  --v_trans_code      NUMBER,
                    v_user_name,               --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                    i.lpw_pol_code,
                    --v_pol_code           NUMBER,
                    i.pol_prod_code,
                    --v_prod_code          NUMBER,
                    v_vchr_no,               --v_vchr_no             VARCHAR2,
                    v_count,                    --v_count              NUMBER,
                    NVL (i.lpw_amt, 0),
                    --v_amount             NUMBER,
                    'INTR. WITHDRAWAL - ' || i.pol_policy_no,
                    --v_narrative          VARCHAR2,
                    v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                    --v_acc_number         VARCHAR2,
                    v_org_code,               --v_acc_org_code         NUMBER,
                    i.pol_bra_code,
                    --v_branch_code        NUMBER,
                    'D',                      --v_drcr               VARCHAR2,
                    v_chq_dtls_rec);

                --v_trn_rec   IN OUT   Fms_Cheques_Pkg.Type_rqn_dtls_table)
                IF i.lpw_bbr_code IS NULL
                THEN
                    v_bbr_code := bnk_bbr_code (i.lpw_pol_code);
                END IF;

                IF i.lpw_account_no IS NULL
                THEN
                    v_account_number := bnk_account (i.lpw_pol_code);
                END IF;

                interface_create_reqn (
                    v_trans_code,
                    --v_trans_code          NUMBER,
                    v_vchr_no,
                    --v_ref                   VARCHAR2,
                    i.lpw_pol_code,
                    --v_ref2                  VARCHAR2,
                    TRUNC (SYSDATE),
                    --v_ref_date              DATE,
                    'INTR. WITHDRAWAL - ' || v_policy_no || '(CHQ)',
                    --v_narrative             VARCHAR2,
                    NVL (i.lpw_amt, 0),
                    --v_amount                NUMBER,
                    v_payee,
                    --v_payee                 VARCHAR2,
                    'CHQ',
                    --v_pay_method      VARCHAR2, --CHQ, EFT
                    v_account_number,
                    --v_payee_bank_acc_no        VARCHAR2,
                    v_bbr_code,
                    --v_payee_bank_branch_code   NUMBER,
                    v_user_name,
                    --v_source_auth_by        VARCHAR2,
                    TRUNC (SYSDATE),
                    --v_source_auth_dt        DATE,
                    i.ltr_done_by,
                    --v_raise_by                VARCHAR2,
                    'INTR_WTH',
                    --v_pmt_type              VARCHAR2,
                    v_brh_code,
                    --v_branch_code          NUMBER,
                    v_pol_code,                                  --v_pol_code,
                    v_chq_dtls_rec);
            END IF;
        --          interface_update_vgl (v_trans_code,           --v_trans_code     NUMBER,
        --                                v_user_name,      -- v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
        --                                I.LPW_POL_CODE,         -- v_pol_code          NUMBER,
        --                                TRUNC (SYSDATE),          --  v_date         DATE,
        --                                NULL,              --  v_opr_code          NUMBER,
        --                                NULL,              --  v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
        --                                'LMS INTR. WITHDRAWAL BATCH',
        --
        --                                --  v_btc_description   VARCHAR2,
        --                                'JV',            -- v_btc_type           VARCHAR2,
        --                                v_brh_code,         -- v_branch_code       NUMBER,
        --                                'LMS INTR. WITHDRAWAL  VOUCHER',
        --                                -- v_description       VARCHAR2,
        --                                v_vchr_no,         --v_rcpt_no           VARCHAR2,
        --                                v_gl_trans
        --                               );
        END LOOP;
    EXCEPTION
        WHEN OTHERS
        THEN
            raise_error ('INTR. POSTING..');
    END process_withdrwl_intr;

    PROCEDURE post_pa_alloc (
        v_date_from   DATE,
        v_date_to     DATE,
        v_option      VARCHAR2,
        v_brn_code    NUMBER,
        v_user        VARCHAR2
    )
    IS
        v_param_val             VARCHAR2 (5);

        CURSOR rcpts IS
              SELECT pol_code,
                     pol_prod_code,
                     DECODE (NVL (v_option, 'CB'),
                             'CB', v_brn_code,
                             pol_bra_code)
                         post_to_brn_code,
                     SUM (
                           lms_ord_misc.pa_alloc (opr_pol_code,
                                                  opr_allocated_amt)
                         * DECODE (NVL (opr_drcr, 'C'), 'D', -1, 1))
                         pa_alloc_amt,
                     lms_ord_mis.check_renewal_paymnt (pol_code,
                                                       opr_receipt_date)
                         renewal
                FROM lms_ord_prem_receipts, lms_policies
               WHERE     TRUNC (opr_receipt_date) BETWEEN v_date_from
                                                      AND v_date_to
                     AND opr_pol_code = pol_code
                     AND opr_source <> 'PREM_BAL_CF'
                     AND NVL (opr_pa_alloc_posted, 'N') = 'N'
                     AND NVL (lms_ord_misc.check_rcpt_bal (opr_code), 0) = 0
                     AND NVL (
                               lms_ord_misc.pa_alloc (opr_pol_code,
                                                      opr_allocated_amt)
                             * DECODE (NVL (opr_drcr, 'C'), 'D', -1, 1),
                             0) <>
                         0
                     AND pol_bra_code =
                         DECODE (NVL (v_option, 'CB'),
                                 'CB', v_brn_code,
                                 pol_bra_code)
                     AND NVL (v_param_val, 'Y') != 'N'
            GROUP BY pol_code,
                     pol_prod_code,
                     DECODE (NVL (v_option, 'CB'),
                             'CB', v_brn_code,
                             pol_bra_code),
                     lms_ord_mis.check_renewal_paymnt (pol_code,
                                                       opr_receipt_date)
            UNION
              SELECT pol_code,
                     pol_prod_code,
                     DECODE (NVL (v_option, 'CB'),
                             'CB', v_brn_code,
                             pol_bra_code)
                         post_to_brn_code,
                     SUM (
                           NVL (opri_pa_alloc_amt, 0)
                         * DECODE (NVL (opr_drcr, 'C'), 'D', -1, 1))
                         pa_alloc_amt,
                     lms_ord_mis.check_renewal_paymnt (pol_code, opri_date)
                         renewal
                FROM lms_ord_prem_receipts,
                     lms_policies,
                     lms_ord_receipt_instlmnts
               WHERE     TRUNC (opri_date) BETWEEN v_date_from AND v_date_to
                     AND opr_pol_code = pol_code
                     AND opri_opr_code = opr_code
                     AND opr_source <> 'PREM_BAL_CF'
                     AND NVL (opri_pa_alloc_posted, 'N') = 'N'
                     AND NVL (
                               NVL (opri_pa_alloc_amt, 0)
                             * DECODE (NVL (opr_drcr, 'C'), 'D', -1, 1),
                             0) <>
                         0
                     AND pol_bra_code =
                         DECODE (NVL (v_option, 'CB'),
                                 'CB', v_brn_code,
                                 pol_bra_code)
                     AND NVL (v_param_val, 'Y') = 'N'
            GROUP BY pol_code,
                     pol_prod_code,
                     DECODE (NVL (v_option, 'CB'),
                             'CB', v_brn_code,
                             pol_bra_code),
                     lms_ord_mis.check_renewal_paymnt (pol_code, opri_date);

        v_acc_type              VARCHAR2 (10) := 'D';
        v_gl_trans              fms_vouchers_pkg.tgl_rec_type;
        v_vgl_no                NUMBER;
        v_trnt_code             VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_crt_acc_no            VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_trnt_gl_code          VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_trnt_contra_gl_code   VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_contra_acc            VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_raised_by             NUMBER;
        v_count                 NUMBER := 0;
        v_gl_count              NUMBER := 0;
        v_org_code              NUMBER;
        v_cur_code              NUMBER;
        v_pap_code              NUMBER;
        v_amt                   NUMBER;
        v_prod_code             NUMBER;
        v_vchr_no               VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_auth_by               NUMBER;
        v_sys_code              NUMBER;
        v_bct_code              NUMBER;
        v_bct_brh_code          NUMBER;
        v_trans_code            NUMBER;
        v_amt2                  NUMBER;
        v_drcr                  VARCHAR2 (5);
    BEGIN
        BEGIN
            lms_ord_misc.system_param_val (
                'POST_RECEIPT_TAXES_AFTER_FULLALLOCATION',
                v_param_val);
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                raise_error ('Parameter error...');
        END;

        FOR r IN rcpts
        LOOP
            v_amt := NVL (r.pa_alloc_amt, 0);

            SELECT    TO_NUMBER (TO_CHAR (SYSDATE, 'RRRR'))
                   || lms_transaction_seq.NEXTVAL
              INTO v_trans_code
              FROM DUAL;

            BEGIN
                v_vchr_no := lms_api.trans_voucher ('PAPREM');

                SELECT    TO_NUMBER (TO_CHAR (SYSDATE, 'RRRR'))
                       || lms_pap_code_seq.NEXTVAL
                  INTO v_pap_code
                  FROM DUAL;

                INSERT INTO lms__pa_alloc_posting (pap_code,
                                                   pap_amount,
                                                   pap_done_by,
                                                   pap_done_date,
                                                   pap_brn_code,
                                                   pap_pol_code,
                                                   pap_date_from,
                                                   pap_date_to,
                                                   pap_vchr_no)
                     VALUES (v_pap_code,
                             v_amt,
                             v_user,
                             SYSDATE,
                             r.post_to_brn_code,
                             r.pol_code,
                             v_date_from,
                             v_date_to,
                             v_vchr_no);
            EXCEPTION
                WHEN OTHERS
                THEN
                    raise_error ('PA. PREM ALLOC ERROR....');
            END;

            v_org_code := fms_interfaces_pkg.get_org (r.post_to_brn_code);

            --RAISE_ERROR('v_amt ='||v_amt);
            IF NVL (v_amt, 0) <> 0
            THEN
                -- POSTING GL VOUCHERS....
                -- pa premium acc
                SELECT DECODE (SIGN (NVL (v_amt, 0)), -1, 'D', 'C')
                  INTO v_drcr
                  FROM DUAL;

                get_gl_code ('PAPREM',
                             r.pol_prod_code,
                             v_trnt_code,
                             v_trnt_gl_code,
                             v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                             NULL,
                             r.renewal);
                valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                           v_org_code,
                           r.post_to_brn_code,
                           'PAPREM');
                valid_acc (v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                           v_org_code,
                           r.post_to_brn_code,
                           'PAPREM CONTRA'); -- SHOULD ATTACHE UP FOR THE PRODUCT
                v_gl_count := NVL (v_gl_count, 0) + 1;
                interface_append_gl (v_trans_code,            -- v_trans_code,
                                     v_user,                    -- v_raise_by,
                                     r.pol_code,                -- v_pol_code,
                                     r.pol_prod_code,          -- v_prod_code,
                                     v_vchr_no,                  -- v_vchr_no,
                                     NULL,                      -- v_opr_code,
                                     NULL,                     -- v_oppr_code,
                                     NULL,                        --v_rcpt_no,
                                     v_gl_count,                   -- v_count,
                                     'PA. PREMIUM - ' || v_vchr_no,
                                     -- v_narrative,
                                     ABS (NVL (v_amt, 0)),        -- v_amount,
                                     v_drcr,                        -- v_drcr,
                                     v_trnt_gl_code,         -- v_acc_number1,
                                     v_trnt_contra_gl_code,  -- v_acc_number2,
                                     r.post_to_brn_code,     -- v_branch_code,
                                     v_gl_trans);
                --               --policy premium
                --                   Get_Gl_Code ('UP',
                --                                     r.pol_prod_code,
                --                                     v_trnt_code,
                --                                     v_trnt_gl_code,
                --                                     v_trnt_contra_gl_code
                --                                    );
                --                 valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code, v_org_code, r.post_to_brn_code, 'UP');
                --                   v_gl_count := v_gl_count + 1;
                -- --                   Fms_Vouchers_Pkg.append_gl_trans
                -- --                                                         (v_gl_count,
                -- --                                                          'PA. PREMIUM - '|| v_vchr_no,
                -- --                                                          v_amt,
                -- --                                                          'D',
                -- --                                                          v_trnt_gl_code,
                -- --                                                          r.post_to_brn_code,
                -- --                                                          v_gl_trans
                -- --                                                         );
                --                Interface_append_gl(v_trans_code,    -- v_trans_code,
                --                                           v_user,    -- v_raise_by,
                --                                             r.pol_code,    -- v_pol_code,
                --                                           r.pol_prod_code,    -- v_prod_code,
                --                                           NULL,    -- v_vchr_no,
                --                                           r.Opr_Code,--vv_pap_code,    -- v_opr_code,
                --                                           NULL,    -- v_oppr_code,
                --                                             NULL, --v_rcpt_no,
                --                                           v_gl_count,    -- v_count,
                --                                           'PA. PREMIUM - '|| v_vchr_no,    -- v_narrative,
                --                                           NVL(v_amt,0),    -- v_amount,
                --                                           'D',    -- v_drcr,
                --                                           v_trnt_gl_code,    -- v_acc_number1,
                --                                           v_trnt_contra_gl_code,    -- v_acc_number2,
                --                                           r.post_to_brn_code,    -- v_branch_code,
                --                                           v_gl_trans);
                v_raised_by := fms_interfaces_pkg.get_usercode (v_user);
                v_cur_code :=
                    lms_interfaces_pkg.lms_def_cur (r.post_to_brn_code);
                interface_update_vgl (v_trans_code,            --v_trans_code,
                                      v_user,                    --v_raise_by,
                                      r.pol_code,                --v_pol_code,
                                      TRUNC (v_date_to),             --v_date,
                                      NULL,      --vv_pap_code,  --v_opr_code,
                                      NULL,                     --v_oppr_code,
                                      'LMS PA. PREMIUM POSTING',
                                      --v_btc_description,
                                      'JV',                      --v_btc_type,
                                      r.post_to_brn_code,     --v_branch_code,
                                      'PA. PREMIUM VOUCHER',  --v_description,
                                      v_vchr_no,                  --v_rcpt_no,
                                      v_gl_trans);              --v_gl_trans);

                IF v_gl_count = 0
                THEN
                    raise_error ('JV NOT CREATED....');
                END IF;

                --Updating records as posted.... CREATE FIELDS FOR UPDATING IN THE RECEIPTS TAHBLE
                BEGIN
                    UPDATE lms_ord_prem_receipts
                       SET opr_pa_alloc_posted = 'Y',
                           opr_pa_alloc_posted_by = v_user,
                           opr_pa_alloc_posted_date = SYSDATE,
                           opr_pap_code = v_pap_code
                     WHERE     TRUNC (opr_receipt_date) BETWEEN v_date_from
                                                            AND v_date_to
                           AND NVL (lms_ord_misc.check_rcpt_bal (opr_code),
                                    0) =
                               0
                           AND opr_source <> 'PREM_BAL_CF'
                           AND NVL (opr_pa_alloc_posted, 'N') = 'N'
                           AND NVL (
                                     lms_ord_misc.pa_alloc (
                                         opr_pol_code,
                                         opr_allocated_amt)
                                   * DECODE (NVL (opr_drcr, 'C'), 'D', -1, 1),
                                   0) <>
                               0
                           AND opr_pol_code IN
                                   (SELECT pol_code
                                      FROM lms_policies
                                     WHERE     pol_code = opr_pol_code
                                           AND pol_bra_code =
                                               DECODE (NVL (v_option, 'CB'),
                                                       'CB', pol_bra_code,
                                                       v_brn_code));
                EXCEPTION
                    WHEN OTHERS
                    THEN
                        raise_error ('ERROR UPDATING RECEIPT RECORDS....');
                END;

                IF NVL (v_param_val, 'Y') = 'N'
                THEN
                    BEGIN
                        UPDATE lms_ord_receipt_instlmnts
                           SET opri_pa_alloc_posted = 'Y',
                               opri_pa_alloc_posted_by = v_user,
                               opri_pa_alloc_posted_date = SYSDATE,
                               opri_pap_code = v_pap_code
                         WHERE     TRUNC (opri_date) BETWEEN v_date_from
                                                         AND v_date_to
                               AND opri_source <> 'PREM_BAL_CF'
                               AND NVL (opri_pa_alloc_posted, 'N') = 'N'
                               AND NVL (
                                         NVL (opri_pa_alloc_amt, 0)
                                       * DECODE (NVL (opri_drcr, 'C'),
                                                 'D', -1,
                                                 1),
                                       0) <>
                                   0
                               AND opri_pol_code IN
                                       (SELECT pol_code
                                          FROM lms_policies
                                         WHERE     pol_code = opri_pol_code
                                               AND pol_bra_code =
                                                   DECODE (
                                                       NVL (v_option, 'CB'),
                                                       'CB', pol_bra_code,
                                                       v_brn_code));
                    EXCEPTION
                        WHEN OTHERS
                        THEN
                            raise_error (
                                'ERROR UPDATING RECEIPT INSTALLMENT RECORDS....');
                    END;
                END IF;
            END IF;

            v_gl_count := 0;
        END LOOP;
    EXCEPTION
        WHEN OTHERS
        THEN
            raise_error ('PA. PREM....');
    END post_pa_alloc;

    PROCEDURE process_coin_ref_posting (v_lpr_code NUMBER)
    IS
        CURSOR cur_refunds IS
            SELECT c.*,
                   pol_code,
                   agn_act_code,
                   pol_policy_no,
                   NVL (mtran_cur_code, pol_cur_code)       pol_cur_code,
                   NVL (mtran_brn_code, pol_bra_code)       pol_bra_code,
                   NVL (mtran_prod_code, pol_prod_code)     pol_prod_code
              FROM lms_policy_coinsurers_refunds  c,
                   lms_policies,
                   lms_master_transactions,
                   lms_agencies
             WHERE     lpr_code = v_lpr_code
                   AND lpr_pol_code = pol_code
                   AND lpr_cr_mtran_code = mtran_code
                   AND mtran_agen_code = agn_code;

        v_trans_code             NUMBER;
        v_trnt_code              VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_trnt_gl_code           VARCHAR2 (50);
        v_trnt_contra_gl_code    VARCHAR2 (50);
        v_trnt_gl_code2          VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_trnt_contra_gl_code2   VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_org_code               NUMBER;
        v_count                  NUMBER := 0;
        v_chq_cnt                NUMBER := 0;
        v_grct_code              NUMBER;
        v_gl_trans               fms_vouchers_pkg.tgl_rec_type;
        v_chq_dtls_rec           fms_cheques_pkg.type_rqn_dtls_table;
        -- v_user                  VARCHAR2 (30);
        --v_payee                 VARCHAR2 (200);
        v_payee                  VARCHAR2 (200);
        v_user                   VARCHAR2 (30)
            := pkg_global_vars.get_pvarchar2 ('PKG_GLOBAL_VARS.PVG_USERNAME');
        v_gl_count               NUMBER := -1;
        v_sbu_code               NUMBER := NULL;
        v_spoke_code             NUMBER := NULL;
        v_cvrg_area              NUMBER := NULL;
        v_location_code          NUMBER := NULL;
        v_acc_no                 VARCHAR2 (30);
    BEGIN
        SELECT    TO_NUMBER (TO_CHAR (SYSDATE, 'RRRR'))
               || lms_transaction_seq.NEXTVAL
          INTO v_trans_code
          FROM DUAL;

        FOR cur_refund_rec IN cur_refunds
        LOOP
            v_chq_cnt := 0;

            IF cur_refund_rec.lpr_paid = 'Y'
            THEN
                raise_error ('The Transaction has already been authorised.');
            END IF;

            IF cur_refund_rec.lpr_pay_mode = 'EFT'
            THEN
                v_acc_no := cur_refund_rec.lpr_acc_no;
            ELSIF cur_refund_rec.lpr_pay_mode = 'MFT'
            THEN
                v_acc_no := cur_refund_rec.lpr_mobile_no;
            ELSE
                v_acc_no := NULL;
            END IF;

            v_org_code :=
                fms_interfaces_pkg.get_org (cur_refund_rec.pol_bra_code);

            --If they are any clawbacks to be made, Post them to the relevant GL Accounts.
            IF NVL (cur_refund_rec.lpr_comm_to_pay, 0) <> 0
            THEN
                get_gl_code ('COIN_PR_EX',

                -- RAISE_ERROR('v_trnt_gl_code='||v_trnt_gl_code||'v_trnt_contra_gl_code='||v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
                v_gl_count := v_gl_count + 2;
                interface_append_gl (
                    v_trans_code,
                    --v_trans_code           NUMBER,
                    v_user,                    --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                    cur_refund_rec.pol_code,
                    --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                    cur_refund_rec.pol_prod_code,
                    --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                    cur_refund_rec.lpr_voucher_no,
                    --v_vchr_no             VARCHAR2,
                    NULL,                        --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                    NULL,                        --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                    NULL,                    --v_rcpt_no             VARCHAR2,

                    || cur_refund_rec.lpr_voucher_no,

                    NULL,
                    --v_agn_code                NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                    NULL,
                    --v_trans_no                NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                    v_cvrg_area,
                    --v_covrg_area_code                NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                    v_spoke_code,
                    --v_spoke_code                NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                    v_sbu_code,
                    --v_sbu_code                NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                    v_location_code --v_loc_code                NUMBER DEFAULT NULL
                                   );
            END IF;

            IF NVL (cur_refund_rec.lpr_vat_clwbk_amt, 0) <> 0
            THEN

                             NULL,                               -- v_tt_code,
                             NULL,                               -- v_renewal,
                             cur_refund_rec.agn_act_code,       -- v_act_code,

                valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code2,

                valid_acc (v_trnt_contra_gl_code,

                v_gl_count := v_gl_count + 2;

                           cur_refund_rec.pol_bra_code);
                v_gl_count := v_gl_count + 2;
                interface_append_gl (
                    v_trans_code,
                    --v_trans_code           NUMBER,
                    v_user,                    --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                    cur_refund_rec.pol_code,
                    --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                    cur_refund_rec.pol_prod_code,
                    --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                    cur_refund_rec.lpr_voucher_no,
                    --v_vchr_no             VARCHAR2,

                    NULL,                    --v_rcpt_no             VARCHAR2,
                    v_gl_count,                  --v_count             NUMBER,

                    --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,

                    --v_amount            NUMBER,
                    'C',                       --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                    v_trnt_gl_code,
                    --v_acc_number1          VARCHAR2,
                    v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                    --v_acc_number2          VARCHAR2,
                    cur_refund_rec.pol_bra_code,

                    NULL,
                    --v_agn_code                NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                    NULL,
                    --v_trans_no                NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                    v_cvrg_area,
                    --v_covrg_area_code                NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                    v_spoke_code,
                    --v_spoke_code                NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,

                                   );

                    v_user,                    --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                    cur_refund_rec.pol_code,
                    --v_pol_code           NUMBER,
                    cur_refund_rec.pol_prod_code,
                    --v_prod_code          NUMBER,
                    cur_refund_rec.lpr_voucher_no,
                    --v_vchr_no,--v_vchr_no             VARCHAR2,
                    v_chq_cnt,                  --v_count              NUMBER,
                    (NVL (cur_refund_rec.lpr_amount_to_pay, 0)),
                    'COINSURER REFUNDS - ' || cur_refund_rec.pol_policy_no,
                    v_trnt_gl_code,
                    v_org_code,
                    cur_refund_rec.pol_bra_code,
                    --v_branch_code        NUMBER,
                    'D',                      --v_drcr               VARCHAR2,
                    v_chq_dtls_rec);

                BEGIN
                    SELECT TRIM (
                                  agn_other_names

                               || TRIM (agn_md_name || ' ' || agn_name))
                      INTO v_payee

                     WHERE agn_code = cur_refund_rec.lpr_agn_code;
                EXCEPTION
                    WHEN OTHERS
                    THEN
                        BEGIN
                            SELECT TRIM (
                                          agn_other_names
                                       || ' '
                                       || TRIM (
                                              agn_md_name || ' ' || agn_name))
                              INTO v_payee
                              FROM lms_agencies
                             WHERE agn_code = cur_refund_rec.lpr_agn_code;
                        EXCEPTION
                            WHEN OTHERS
                            THEN
                                raise_error ('Error accessing coinsurer');
                        END;
                END;
            END IF;

            IF v_gl_count > 0
            THEN
                interface_update_vgl (
                    v_trans_code,                   --v_trans_code     NUMBER,
                    v_user,                    --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                    cur_refund_rec.pol_code,     --v_pol_code          NUMBER,

                    --v_description       VARCHAR2,
                    cur_refund_rec.pol_policy_no, --v_ref_no             VARCHAR2,
                    v_gl_trans,
                    NULL,
                    NULL,
                    NULL,
                    NULL,
                    NULL,
                    NULL,
                    NULL,
                    NULL,
                    NULL,
                    cur_refund_rec.pol_cur_code);
            --v_gl_trans  IN OUT  Fms_Vouchers_Pkg.Tgl_rec_type,
            END IF;

            IF v_chq_cnt != 0
            THEN
                interface_create_reqn (
                    v_trans_code,               --v_trans_code         NUMBER,
                    cur_refund_rec.lpr_voucher_no,
                    --v_ref                   VARCHAR2,
                    cur_refund_rec.pol_code,
                    --v_ref2                  VARCHAR2,
                    SYSDATE,                   --v_ref_date              DATE,
                    'COINSURER REFUNDS -  ' || cur_refund_rec.pol_policy_no,
                    --v_narrative             VARCHAR2,
                    (NVL (cur_refund_rec.lpr_amount_to_pay, 0) -- NVL (cur_refund_rec.lpr_admin_fee_amt, 0)
                                                              ),
                    --v_amount                NUMBER,
                    v_payee,               --v_payee                 VARCHAR2,
                    cur_refund_rec.lpr_pay_mode, --v_pay_method            VARCHAR2, --CHQ, EFT
                    v_acc_no,           --v_payee_bank_acc_no        VARCHAR2,
                    cur_refund_rec.lpr_bbr_code, --v_payee_bank_branch_code   NUMBER,
                    v_user,                --v_source_auth_by        VARCHAR2,
                    SYSDATE,                   --v_source_auth_dt        DATE,
                    cur_refund_rec.lpr_raised_by,
                    --v_raise_by                VARCHAR2,
                    'REFUNDG',             --v_pmt_type              VARCHAR2,
                    cur_refund_rec.pol_bra_code,
                    --v_branch_code         NUMBER,
                    cur_refund_rec.pol_code,
                    v_chq_dtls_rec);
            END IF;

            UPDATE lms_policy_coinsurers_refunds
               SET lpr_paid = 'Y',
                   lpr_authorised_by = v_user,
                   lpr_authorised_date = SYSDATE
             WHERE lpr_code = cur_refund_rec.lpr_code;
        END LOOP;
    END process_coin_ref_posting;

    PROCEDURE post_ln_liquidated_amt (
        v_loan_no          NUMBER,
        v_liquidated_amt   NUMBER,
        v_trans_no         NUMBER
    )
    IS
        CURSOR loan IS
            SELECT pol_prod_code,
                   pol_code,
                   pol_bra_code,
                   pln_loan_acc_no,
                   pln_lna_no,
                   lms_ord_mis.check_renewal_paymnt (pol_code, SYSDATE)    renewal
              FROM lms_policy_loans, lms_policies
             WHERE pln_lna_no = v_loan_no AND pln_pol_code = pol_code;

        v_username                VARCHAR2 (30)
            := pkg_global_vars.get_pvarchar2 ('pkg_global_vars.pvg_username');
        v_liq_trnt_gl_code        VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_gl_trans                fms_vouchers_pkg.tgl_rec_type;
        v_vgl_no                  NUMBER;
        v_cur_code                NUMBER;
        v_trnt_code               VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_trnt_gl_code            VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_trnt_gl_interest_code   VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_trnt_contra_gl_code     VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_count                   NUMBER := 0;
        v_org_code                NUMBER;
        v_trans_code              NUMBER;
    BEGIN
        FOR l IN loan
        LOOP
            SELECT    TO_NUMBER (TO_CHAR (SYSDATE, 'RRRR'))
                   || lms_transaction_seq.NEXTVAL
              INTO v_trans_code
              FROM DUAL;

            IF NVL (v_liquidated_amt, 0) <> 0
            THEN
                v_org_code := fms_interfaces_pkg.get_org (l.pol_bra_code);
                get_gl_code ('POL_SURR',
                             l.pol_prod_code,
                             v_trnt_code,
                             v_trnt_gl_code,
                             v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                             NULL,
                             l.renewal);
                valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                           v_org_code,
                           l.pol_bra_code,
                           'POL_SURR');
                get_gl_code ('NL',
                             l.pol_prod_code,
                             v_trnt_code,
                             v_liq_trnt_gl_code,
                             v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                             NULL,
                             l.renewal);
                valid_acc (v_liq_trnt_gl_code,
                           v_org_code,
                           l.pol_bra_code,
                           'NL');
                v_count := v_count + 1;
                interface_append_gl (
                    v_trans_code,
                    --v_trans_code           NUMBER,
                    v_username,                --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                    l.pol_code,                  --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                    l.pol_prod_code,
                    --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                    'LOAN_LIQ' || TO_CHAR (v_trans_no),
                    --v_vchr_no             VARCHAR2,
                    NULL,                        --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                    NULL,                        --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                    NULL,                    --v_rcpt_no             VARCHAR2,
                    v_count,                     --v_count             NUMBER,
                       'LOAN LIQUIDATION -'
                    || NVL (l.pln_loan_acc_no, l.pln_lna_no),
                    --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                    v_liquidated_amt,
                    --v_amount            NUMBER,
                    'D',                       --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                    v_trnt_gl_code,
                    --v_acc_number1          VARCHAR2,
                    v_liq_trnt_gl_code,
                    --v_acc_number2          VARCHAR2,
                    l.pol_bra_code,              --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                    v_gl_trans);
                --v_trn_rec   IN OUT  Fms_Vouchers_Pkg.Tgl_rec_type,
                interface_update_vgl (v_trans_code, --v_trans_code     NUMBER,
                                      v_username, --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                                      NULL,      --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                                      TRUNC (SYSDATE), --v_date              DATE,
                                      NULL,      --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                                      NULL,      --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                                      'LMS POLICY LOAN LIQUIDATION.',
                                      --v_btc_description   VARCHAR2,
                                      'JV', --v_btc_type             VARCHAR2,
                                      l.pol_bra_code,
                                      --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                                      'LOAN LIQUIDATION',
                                      --v_description       VARCHAR2,
                                      'LOAN_LIQ' || TO_CHAR (v_trans_no),
                                      --v_desc4 || v_desc5, --v_ref_no             VARCHAR2,
                                      v_gl_trans);
            --v_gl_trans  IN OUT  Fms_Vouchers_Pkg.Tgl_rec_type,
            END IF;
        END LOOP;
    --RAISE_ERROR('COMMIT');
    EXCEPTION
        WHEN OTHERS
        THEN
            raise_error ('LOAN LIQUIDATION. API....');
    END post_ln_liquidated_amt;

    PROCEDURE post_deffered_comm (v_endr_code NUMBER)
    IS
        CURSOR deff IS
            SELECT dofc_code,
                   dofc_deffered_date,
                   dofc_posted,
                   dofc_posted_date,
                   dofc_posted_by,
                   dofc_agn_code,
                   dofc_pol_code,
                   dofc_duration,
                   dofc_comm_amt,
                   dofc_endr_code,
                   pol_prod_code,
                   pol_code,
                   pol_policy_no,
                   pol_bra_code,
                   agn_sht_desc,
                   agn_name
              FROM lms_other_deffered_commissions,
                   lms_policies,
                   lms_policy_endorsements,
                   lms_agencies
             WHERE     dofc_endr_code = endr_code
                   AND endr_code = v_endr_code
                   AND pol_code = endr_pol_code
                   AND agn_code = dofc_agn_code;

        v_username              VARCHAR2 (30)
            := pkg_global_vars.get_pvarchar2 ('pkg_global_vars.pvg_username');
        v_trnt_gl_code          VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_trnt_contra_gl_code   VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_trnt_code             VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_trans_code            NUMBER;
        v_count                 NUMBER := 0;
        v_org_code              NUMBER;
        v_gl_trans              fms_vouchers_pkg.tgl_rec_type;
    BEGIN
        FOR d IN deff
        LOOP
            SELECT    TO_NUMBER (TO_CHAR (SYSDATE, 'RRRR'))
                   || lms_transaction_seq.NEXTVAL
              INTO v_trans_code
              FROM DUAL;

            IF NVL (d.dofc_comm_amt, 0) <> 0
            THEN
                v_org_code := fms_interfaces_pkg.get_org (d.pol_bra_code);
                get_gl_code ('DEF_COMM',
                             d.pol_prod_code,
                             v_trnt_code,
                             v_trnt_gl_code,
                             v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
                valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                           v_org_code,
                           d.pol_bra_code,
                           'DEF_COMM');
                valid_acc (v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                           v_org_code,
                           d.pol_bra_code,
                           'DEF_COMM CONTRA');
                v_count := v_count + 1;
                interface_append_gl (
                    v_trans_code,             --v_trans_code           NUMBER,
                    v_username,                --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                    d.pol_code,                  --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                    d.pol_prod_code,             --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                       'DEFFERED COMM '
                    || d.agn_name
                    || ' ; '
                    || d.pol_policy_no,      --v_vchr_no             VARCHAR2,
                    NULL,                        --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                    NULL,                        --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                    NULL,                    --v_rcpt_no             VARCHAR2,
                    v_count,                     --v_count             NUMBER,
                    'DEF COMM - ' || d.agn_name || ' ; ' || d.pol_policy_no,
                    --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                    d.dofc_comm_amt,             --v_amount            NUMBER,
                    'C',                       --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                    v_trnt_gl_code,         --v_acc_number1          VARCHAR2,
                    v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                    --v_acc_number2          VARCHAR2,
                    d.pol_bra_code,              --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                    v_gl_trans);
                --v_trn_rec   IN OUT  Fms_Vouchers_Pkg.Tgl_rec_type,
                interface_update_vgl (v_trans_code, --v_trans_code     NUMBER,
                                      v_username, --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                                      d.pol_code, --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                                      TRUNC (SYSDATE), --v_date              DATE,
                                      NULL,      --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                                      NULL,      --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                                      'LMS DEFFERED COMM.',
                                      --v_btc_description   VARCHAR2,
                                      'JV', --v_btc_type             VARCHAR2,
                                      d.pol_bra_code,
                                      --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                                      'DEFFERED COMM',
                                      --v_description       VARCHAR2,
                                      d.pol_policy_no,
                                      --v_desc4 || v_desc5, --v_ref_no             VARCHAR2,
                                      v_gl_trans);
            --v_gl_trans  IN OUT  Fms_Vouchers_Pkg.Tgl_rec_type,
            END IF;

            BEGIN
                UPDATE lms_other_deffered_comm_dtls
                   SET dofcd_posted = 'Y',
                       dofcd_posted_date = SYSDATE,
                       dofcd_posted_by = v_username
                 WHERE dofcd_dofc_code = d.dofc_code;

                UPDATE lms_other_deffered_commissions
                   SET dofc_posted = 'Y',
                       dofc_posted_date = SYSDATE,
                       dofc_posted_by = v_username
                 WHERE dofc_code = d.dofc_code;
            EXCEPTION
                WHEN OTHERS
                THEN
                    raise_error ('Error updating deffered comm record....');
            END;
        END LOOP;
    END post_deffered_comm;

    PROCEDURE post_prod_gross_comm (v_trans_no NUMBER, v_username VARCHAR2)
    IS
        v_date_to               DATE;

        CURSOR brn IS
            SELECT DISTINCT pcp_prod_code, pcp_brn_code
              FROM lms_product_comm_pymt
             WHERE pcp_trans_code = v_trans_no;



        CURSOR prod_comm (
            v_brn_code           NUMBER,
            v_post_sep_param     VARCHAR2,
            v_date_from          DATE,
            v_allow_comm_param   VARCHAR2
        )
        IS
              SELECT prod_code,
                     prod_desc,
                     prod_sht_desc,
                     pcp_brn_code
                         brn_code,
                     DECODE (pcp_prem_type, 'I', 'INV', 'RISK')
                         pcp_prem_type,
                       SUM (NVL (pcp_comm_amt, 0))
                     + DECODE (v_post_sep_param,
                               'N', SUM (NVL (pcp_ovcom_amt, 0)),
                               0)
                         comm_amt,
                     DECODE (v_post_sep_param,
                             'Y', SUM (NVL (pcp_ovcom_amt, 0)),
                             0)
                         ovcom_amt,
                     SUM (NVL (pcp_bonus_amt, 0))
                         bonus_amt
                FROM lms_products, lms_product_comm_pymt
               WHERE     prod_code(+) = pcp_prod_code
                     AND pcp_trans_code = v_trans_no
                     AND pcp_brn_code = NVL (v_brn_code, pcp_brn_code)
                     AND NVL (pcp_posted, 'N') = 'N'
            GROUP BY prod_code,
                     prod_desc,
                     prod_sht_desc,
                     pcp_brn_code,
                     pcp_prem_type;


        v_drcr                  VARCHAR2 (5);
        v_gl_acc                VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_gl_acc2               VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_org_code              NUMBER;
        v_gl_count              NUMBER := 0;
        v_trans_code            NUMBER;
        v_gl_trans              tq_fms.fms_vouchers_pkg.tgl_rec_type;
        v_trnt_code             VARCHAR2 (10);
        v_crt_acc_no            VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_trnt_contra_gl_code   VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_com_amt               NUMBER;
        v_post_sep_param        VARCHAR2 (5);
        v_date_from             DATE;
        v_allow_comm_param      VARCHAR2 (1);
    BEGIN
        BEGIN
            SELECT ltr_comm_date_to, ltr_comm_date_from
              INTO v_date_to, v_date_from
              FROM lms_transactions
             WHERE ltr_trans_no = v_trans_no;
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                raise_error ('Error fetching comm. transaction details..');
        END;

        BEGIN
            lms_ord_misc.system_param_val ('POST_GROSS_OVERRIDE_SEPARATELY',
                                           v_post_sep_param);
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                --tqc_error_manager.raise_error (276203704, text_in => 'Parameter Error.', name1_in => 'param name', value1_in => 'COMPUTE_WTHX_ON_AGENT_DEBITING');
                raise_error ('Parameter Error.');
        END;

        BEGIN
            lms_ord_misc.system_param_val ('ALLOW_ALL_COMM_POSTING',
                                           v_allow_comm_param);
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                tqc_error_manager.raise_error (
                    276203907,
                    text_in     => 'Parameter error.',
                    name1_in    => 'param name',
                    value1_in   => 'ALLOW_ALL_COMM_POSTING');
        END;

        --      FOR b IN brn
        --      LOOP
        FOR p IN prod_comm (NULL,
                            v_post_sep_param,
                            v_date_from,
                            v_allow_comm_param)
        LOOP
            v_gl_trans.delete;
            v_gl_count := 0;

            SELECT    TO_NUMBER (TO_CHAR (SYSDATE, 'RRRR'))
                   || lms_transaction_seq.NEXTVAL
              INTO v_trans_code
              FROM DUAL;

            v_org_code := fms_interfaces_pkg.get_org (p.brn_code);

            get_gl_code ('PROD_GC',
                         p.prod_code,
                         v_trnt_code,
                         v_gl_acc,
                         v_gl_acc2);
            valid_acc (v_gl_acc,
                       v_org_code,
                       p.brn_code,
                       'PROD_GC');

            get_gl_code ('UC',
                         p.prod_code,
                         v_trnt_code,
                         v_crt_acc_no,
                         v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
            valid_acc (v_crt_acc_no,
                       v_org_code,
                       p.brn_code,
                       'UC');
            v_com_amt := p.comm_amt;

            IF NVL (p.comm_amt, 0) <> 0
            THEN
                SELECT DECODE (SIGN (p.comm_amt), -1, 'D', 'C')
                  INTO v_drcr
                  FROM DUAL;

                v_gl_count := v_gl_count + 1;
                interface_append_gl (
                    v_trans_code,
                    --v_trans_code          NUMBER,
                    v_username,
                    --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                    NULL,                        --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                    p.prod_code,                 --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                    p.prod_sht_desc || ' ' || v_trans_no,
                    --v_vchr_no          VARCHAR2,
                    NULL,                        --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                    NULL,                        --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                    NULL,                      --v_rcpt_no           VARCHAR2,
                    v_gl_count,                  --v_count             NUMBER,
                       'COMMISSION - '
                    || p.prod_sht_desc
                    || ' '
                    || p.pcp_prem_type
                    || ' '
                    || v_trans_no,
                    --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                    p.comm_amt,                  --v_amount            NUMBER,
                    v_drcr,                             --           VARCHAR2,
                    v_crt_acc_no,
                    --v_acc_number1          VARCHAR2,
                    v_gl_acc,                                     --v_gl_acc2,
                    --v_acc_number2            VARCHAR2
                    p.brn_code,
                    --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                    v_gl_trans,
                    --IN OUT   tq_fms.fms_vouchers_pkg.tgl_rec_type,
                    NULL,                    --v_cad_code NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                    NULL,                   --v_otop_code NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                    NULL,                   --v_fpmt_code NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                    NULL,                    --v_ort_code NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                    NULL,                      --v_btr_no NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                    NULL,                    --v_ppr_code NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                    NULL,                    --v_ocl_code NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                    NULL,                    --v_agn_code NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                    v_trans_no                --v_trans_no NUMBER DEFAULT NULL
                              );
            END IF;

            IF NVL (p.ovcom_amt, 0) <> 0
            THEN
                get_gl_code ('PROD_GC_OV',
                             p.prod_code,
                             v_trnt_code,
                             v_gl_acc,
                             v_gl_acc2);
                valid_acc (v_gl_acc,
                           v_org_code,
                           p.brn_code,
                           'PROD_GC_OV');



                SELECT DECODE (SIGN (p.ovcom_amt), -1, 'D', 'C')
                  INTO v_drcr
                  FROM DUAL;

                v_gl_count := v_gl_count + 1;
                interface_append_gl (
                    v_trans_code,
                    --v_trans_code          NUMBER,
                    v_username,
                    --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                    NULL,                        --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                    p.prod_code,                 --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                    p.prod_sht_desc || ' ' || v_trans_no,
                    --v_vchr_no          VARCHAR2,
                    NULL,                        --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                    NULL,                        --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                    NULL,                      --v_rcpt_no           VARCHAR2,
                    v_gl_count,                  --v_count             NUMBER,
                       'OVERRIDE COMMISSION - '
                    || p.prod_sht_desc
                    || ' '
                    || p.pcp_prem_type
                    || ' '
                    || v_trans_no,
                    --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                    p.ovcom_amt,                 --v_amount            NUMBER,
                    v_drcr,                             --           VARCHAR2,
                    v_crt_acc_no,
                    --v_acc_number1          VARCHAR2,
                    v_gl_acc,                                     --v_gl_acc2,
                    --v_acc_number2            VARCHAR2
                    p.brn_code,
                    --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                    v_gl_trans,
                    --IN OUT   tq_fms.fms_vouchers_pkg.tgl_rec_type,
                    NULL,                    --v_cad_code NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                    NULL,                   --v_otop_code NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                    NULL,                   --v_fpmt_code NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                    NULL,                    --v_ort_code NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                    NULL,                      --v_btr_no NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                    NULL,                    --v_ppr_code NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                    NULL,                    --v_ocl_code NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                    NULL,                    --v_agn_code NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                    v_trans_no                --v_trans_no NUMBER DEFAULT NULL
                              );
            END IF;


            IF NVL (p.bonus_amt, 0) <> 0
            THEN
                get_gl_code ('AGN_BONUS',
                             p.prod_code,
                             v_trnt_code,
                             v_gl_acc,
                             v_gl_acc2);
                valid_acc (v_gl_acc,
                           v_org_code,
                           p.brn_code,
                           'AGN_BONUS');



                SELECT DECODE (SIGN (p.bonus_amt), -1, 'D', 'C')
                  INTO v_drcr
                  FROM DUAL;

                v_gl_count := v_gl_count + 1;
                interface_append_gl (
                    v_trans_code,
                    --v_trans_code          NUMBER,
                    v_username,
                    --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                    NULL,                        --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                    NULL,                        --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                    'AGENT ALLOWANCE' || ' ' || v_trans_no,
                    --v_vchr_no          VARCHAR2,
                    NULL,                        --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                    NULL,                        --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                    NULL,                      --v_rcpt_no           VARCHAR2,
                    v_gl_count,                  --v_count             NUMBER,
                    'AGENT ALLOWANCE PAYMENT - ' || ' ' || v_trans_no,
                    --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                    p.bonus_amt,                 --v_amount            NUMBER,
                    v_drcr,                             --           VARCHAR2,
                    v_crt_acc_no,
                    --v_acc_number1          VARCHAR2,
                    v_gl_acc,                                     --v_gl_acc2,
                    --v_acc_number2            VARCHAR2
                    p.brn_code,
                    --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                    v_gl_trans,
                    --IN OUT   tq_fms.fms_vouchers_pkg.tgl_rec_type,
                    NULL,                    --v_cad_code NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                    NULL,                   --v_otop_code NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                    NULL,                   --v_fpmt_code NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                    NULL,                    --v_ort_code NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                    NULL,                      --v_btr_no NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                    NULL,                    --v_ppr_code NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                    NULL,                    --v_ocl_code NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                    NULL,                    --v_agn_code NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                    v_trans_no                --v_trans_no NUMBER DEFAULT NULL
                              );
            END IF;

            BEGIN
                IF v_gl_count > 0
                THEN
                    --raise_error('v_gl_count  '|| v_gl_count);
                    interface_update_vgl (v_trans_code, --v_trans_code     NUMBER,
                                          v_username, --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                                          NULL,  --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                                          SYSDATE,
                                          --v_date           DATE,
                                          NULL,  --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                                          NULL,  --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                                          'LMS GROSS COMM', --v_btc_description   VARCHAR2,
                                          'JV', --v_btc_type         VARCHAR2,
                                          p.brn_code, --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                                          'COMM PMT ' || v_trans_no,
                                          NULL, --v_rcpt_no           VARCHAR2,
                                          v_gl_trans,
                                          --v_gl_trans  IN OUT  Fms_Vouchers_Pkg.Tgl_rec_type,
                                          NULL, --v_cad_code       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                          NULL); --v_otop_code       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL)
                END IF;
            EXCEPTION
                WHEN OTHERS
                THEN
                    raise_error (
                        'CREATING/POSTING GROSS COMMISSION VOUCHER  ');
            END;
        END LOOP;

        UPDATE lms_product_comm_pymt
           SET pcp_posted = 'Y'
         WHERE pcp_trans_code = v_trans_no;
    --   EXCEPTION
    --      WHEN OTHERS
    --      THEN
    --         raise_error ('POSTING GROSS COMM ..');
    END post_prod_gross_comm;

    PROCEDURE post_update_recpt_pymt_clnp (
        v_rct_code                VARCHAR2,
        v_opr_rct_trans_code      VARCHAR2,
        v_oppr_rct_trans_code     VARCHAR2,
        v_nfl_alloc               NUMBER,
        v_rct_branch              NUMBER,
        v_acc_type                VARCHAR2,
        v_amt                     NUMBER,
        v_description             VARCHAR2,
        v_date                    DATE,
        v_raised_by               NUMBER,
        v_currency_code           NUMBER,
        v_opr_code                NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
        v_prm_amt                 NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
        v_chk_com                 NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
        v_ln_amt                  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
        v_pn_amt                  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
        v_adm_inv                 NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
        v_fee_inv                 NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
        v_contri_inv              NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
        v_compfund                NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
        v_receipt_pk              NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
        v_fms_unknown_reposting   VARCHAR2 DEFAULT NULL,
        v_oppr_code               NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
        v_reverse_alloc           VARCHAR2 DEFAULT 'N',
        v_prem_waiver             VARCHAR2 DEFAULT 'N'
    )
    IS
        v_count                     NUMBER;
        v_gl_trans                  fms_vouchers_pkg.tgl_rec_type;
        v_vgl_no                    NUMBER;
        v_trnt_code                 VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_trnt_gl_code              VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_unp_trnt_gl_code          VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_trnt_contra_gl_code       VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_contra_acc                VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_msg                       VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_org_code                  NUMBER;
        v_user_name                 VARCHAR2 (30);
        v_unknown_amt               NUMBER := 0;
        --      v_double_sure_amt           NUMBER                        := 0;
        v_prod_code                 NUMBER;
        v_unprocessed_rcpts         NUMBER;
        v_unprocessed_rcpts_total   NUMBER;
        v_comp_param                VARCHAR2 (5);
        v_alloc_to                  VARCHAR2 (2);
        v_opr_receipt_trans_code    VARCHAR2 (50);
        v_oppr_receipt_trans_code   VARCHAR2 (50);
        v_origin                    VARCHAR2 (5);
        v_rcpt_bal                  NUMBER;
        v_opr_drcr                  VARCHAR2 (5) := 'C';
        v_cur_code                  NUMBER;
        v_prem_amt                  NUMBER;
        v_chkoff_comm               NUMBER;
        v_loan_amt                  NUMBER;
        v_pens_amt                  NUMBER;
        v_inv_admin                 NUMBER;
        v_inv_fee                   NUMBER;
        v_inv_contri                NUMBER;
        v_comfnd                    NUMBER;
        v_oppr_drcr                 VARCHAR2 (5) := 'C';
        v_oppr_chk_drcr             VARCHAR2 (5) := 'D';
        v_trans_code                NUMBER;
        v_ppr_code_to               NUMBER;
        v_ppr_code_from             NUMBER;
        v_user                      VARCHAR2 (30)
            := pkg_global_vars.get_pvarchar2 ('PKG_GLOBAL_VARS.PVG_USERNAME');
        v_separate_posting          VARCHAR2 (5);

        CURSOR cur_pol_cb_amt IS
              SELECT SUM (NVL (opr_loan_pymt_amt, 0))
                         loan_amt,
                     NVL (SUM (opr_refund_amt), 0)
                         suspense_amt,
                     -- OPR_PMTH_CODE,
                     NVL (SUM (premium_amt), 0)
                         premium_amt,
                     NVL (SUM (pension_contr), 0)
                         pension_contr,
                     DECODE (prod_type,
                             'IN', NVL (SUM (investment_fee), 0),
                             'PN', NVL (SUM (investment_fee), 0),
                             'AN', NVL (SUM (investment_fee), 0),
                             NVL (SUM (opr_policy_fee), 0))
                         investment_fee,
                     NVL (SUM (investment_contri), 0)
                         investment_contri,
                     NVL (SUM (investment_admin), 0)
                         investment_admin,
                     NVL (SUM (opr_fund_client_contr), 0)
                         comfnd,
                     (NVL (SUM (prem_comm), 0) + NVL (SUM (pens_comm), 0))
                         prem_comm,
                     NVL (SUM (pens_comm), 0)
                         pens_comm,
                     NVL (SUM (prem_tax), 0)
                         prem_tax,
                     --NVL(SUM(OPR_CHK_COMM),0) chkoff_comm,
                     0
                         chkoff_comm,
                     pol_bra_code,
                     pol_prod_code,
                     pol_type,
                     pol_prod_type,
                     NVL (opr_alloc_to, 'PR')
                         alloc_to,
                     NVL (inv_all_prem_valid (pol_code), 'N')
                         inv_all_prem,
                     DECODE (NVL (endr_pay_method, 'C'),
                             'K', 'CK',
                             NVL (endr_pay_method, 'C'))
                         acc_type,
                     opr_code,
                     pol_policy_no,
                     pol_code,
                     prod_calc_inv_from_sa,
                     'N'
                         renewal,
                     opr_source
                FROM lms_ord_prem_receipts,
                     lms_policies,
                     lms_policy_endorsements,
                     lms_products,
                     (  SELECT opri_opr_code,
                               NVL (SUM (opri_amt), 0)              premium_amt,
                               NVL (SUM (opri_prem_tax_amt), 0)     prem_tax,
                               NVL (SUM (opri_chk_comm_amt), 0)     chkoff_comm,
                               NVL (SUM (opri_comm_amt), 0)         prem_comm
                          FROM lms_ord_receipt_instlmnts, lms_ord_prem_receipts
                         WHERE     NVL (inv_all_prem_valid (opri_pol_code), 'N') =
                                   'N'
                               AND opri_opr_code = opr_code
                               AND NVL (opr_receipt_trans_code, 'XX') =
                                   NVL (v_opr_rct_trans_code,
                                        NVL (opr_receipt_trans_code, 'XX'))
                      --AND OPR_RECEIPT_TRANS_CODE = NVL(v_opr_rct_trans_code,OPR_RECEIPT_TRANS_CODE)
                      GROUP BY opri_opr_code
                      UNION
                        SELECT opri_opr_code,
                               SUM (
                                     NVL (opri_amt, 0)
                                   - lms_investments.basic_prem_ratio (
                                         opri_pol_code,
                                         NVL (opri_amt, 0)))       premium_amt,
                               SUM (NVL (opri_prem_tax_amt, 0))    prem_tax,
                               --   -Lms_Investments.Basic_prem_ratio(OPRI_POL_CODE,NVL(OPRI_PREM_TAX_AMT,0)) prem_tax,
                               SUM (NVL (opri_chk_comm_amt, 0))    chkoff_comm,
                               --  -Lms_Investments.Basic_prem_ratio(OPRI_POL_CODE,NVL(OPRI_CHK_COMM_AMT,0))
                               SUM (NVL (opri_comm_amt, 0))        prem_comm
                          --   -Lms_Investments.Basic_prem_ratio(OPRI_POL_CODE,NVL(OPRI_COMM_AMT,0)) prem_comm
                          FROM lms_ord_receipt_instlmnts, lms_ord_prem_receipts
                         WHERE     NVL (inv_all_prem_valid (opri_pol_code), 'N') =
                                   'Y'
                               AND NVL (inv_basic_prem_valid, 'N') = 'Y'
                               AND opri_opr_code = opr_code
                               AND NVL (opr_receipt_trans_code, 'XX') =
                                   NVL (v_opr_rct_trans_code,
                                        NVL (opr_receipt_trans_code, 'XX'))
                      --AND OPR_RECEIPT_TRANS_CODE = NVL(v_opr_rct_trans_code, OPR_RECEIPT_TRANS_CODE)
                      GROUP BY opri_opr_code),
                     (  SELECT pndpo_opr_code,
                               NVL (SUM (pndpo_tot_amt), 0)
                                   pension_contr,
                               NVL (SUM (pndpo_admin_fee), 0)
                                   investment_fee,
                               NVL (SUM (pndpo_empye_amt), 0)
                                   investment_contri,
                               NVL (SUM (pndpo_empyr_amt), 0)
                                   investment_admin,
                               NVL (SUM (pndpo_comm_amt), 0)
                                   pens_comm
                          FROM lms_pension_deposits_ord, lms_ord_prem_receipts
                         WHERE     pndpo_opr_code = opr_code
                               AND NVL (opr_receipt_trans_code, 'XX') =
                                   NVL (v_opr_rct_trans_code,
                                        NVL (opr_receipt_trans_code, 'XX'))
                      --AND OPR_RECEIPT_TRANS_CODE = NVL(v_opr_rct_trans_code,OPR_RECEIPT_TRANS_CODE)
                      GROUP BY pndpo_opr_code)
               WHERE     pol_code = opr_pol_code
                     AND pol_current_endr_code = endr_code
                     AND opr_receipt_no = v_rct_code
                     AND opr_code = NVL (v_opr_code, opr_code)
                     AND opri_opr_code(+) = opr_code
                     AND pndpo_opr_code(+) = opr_code
                     AND NVL (v_separate_posting, 'N') = 'N'
                     AND pol_prod_code = prod_code
                     AND NVL (opr_receipt_trans_code, 'XX') =
                         NVL (v_opr_rct_trans_code,
                              NVL (opr_receipt_trans_code, 'XX'))
                     --AND OPR_RECEIPT_TRANS_CODE = NVL(v_opr_rct_trans_code,OPR_RECEIPT_TRANS_CODE)
                     AND v_oppr_code IS NULL
            GROUP BY opr_code,
                     pol_bra_code,
                     pol_prod_code,
                     pol_type,
                     pol_prod_type,
                     opr_alloc_to,
                     endr_pay_method,
                     NVL (inv_all_prem_valid (pol_code), 'N'),
                     DECODE (NVL (endr_pay_method, 'C'),
                             'K', 'CK',
                             NVL (endr_pay_method, 'C')),
                     pol_policy_no,
                     pol_code,
                     prod_calc_inv_from_sa,
                     prod_type,
                     opr_source
            UNION ALL
              SELECT SUM (NVL (opr_loan_pymt_amt, 0))
                         loan_amt,
                     NVL (SUM (opr_refund_amt), 0)
                         suspense_amt,
                     -- OPR_PMTH_CODE,
                     NVL (SUM (premium_amt), 0)
                         premium_amt,
                     NVL (SUM (pension_contr), 0)
                         pension_contr,
                     DECODE (prod_type,
                             'IN', NVL (SUM (investment_fee), 0),
                             'PN', NVL (SUM (investment_fee), 0),
                             'AN', NVL (SUM (investment_fee), 0),
                             NVL (SUM (opr_policy_fee), 0))
                         investment_fee,
                     NVL (SUM (investment_contri), 0)
                         investment_contri,
                     NVL (SUM (investment_admin), 0)
                         investment_admin,
                     NVL (SUM (opr_fund_client_contr), 0)
                         comfnd,
                     (NVL (SUM (prem_comm), 0) + NVL (SUM (pens_comm), 0))
                         prem_comm,
                     NVL (SUM (pens_comm), 0)
                         pens_comm,
                     NVL (SUM (prem_tax), 0)
                         prem_tax,
                     --NVL(SUM(OPR_CHK_COMM),0) chkoff_comm,
                     0
                         chkoff_comm,
