                     pol_bra_code,
                     pol_prod_code,
                     pol_type,
                     pol_prod_type,
                     NVL (opr_alloc_to, 'PR')
                         alloc_to,
                     NVL (inv_all_prem_valid (pol_code), 'N')
                         inv_all_prem,
                     DECODE (NVL (endr_pay_method, 'C'),
                             'K', 'CK',
                             NVL (endr_pay_method, 'C'))
                         acc_type,
                     opr_code,
                     pol_policy_no,
                     pol_code,
                     prod_calc_inv_from_sa,
                     NVL (renewal, pensrenewal)
                         renewal,
                     opr_source
                FROM lms_ord_prem_receipts,
                     lms_policies,
                     lms_policy_endorsements,
                     lms_products,
                     (  SELECT opri_opr_code,
                               NVL (SUM (opri_amt), 0)                        premium_amt,
                               NVL (SUM (opri_prem_tax_amt), 0)               prem_tax,
                               NVL (SUM (opri_chk_comm_amt), 0)               chkoff_comm,
                               NVL (SUM (opri_comm_amt), 0)                   prem_comm,
                               lms_ord_mis.check_renewal (opri_pol_code,
                                                          opri_instlmt_no)    renewal
                          FROM lms_ord_receipt_instlmnts, lms_ord_prem_receipts
                         WHERE     NVL (inv_all_prem_valid (opri_pol_code), 'N') =
                                   'N'
                               AND opri_opr_code = opr_code
                               AND NVL (opr_receipt_trans_code, 'XX') =
                                   NVL (v_opr_rct_trans_code,
                                        NVL (opr_receipt_trans_code, 'XX'))
                      --AND OPR_RECEIPT_TRANS_CODE = NVL(v_opr_rct_trans_code,OPR_RECEIPT_TRANS_CODE)
                      GROUP BY opri_opr_code,
                               lms_ord_mis.check_renewal (opri_pol_code,
                                                          opri_instlmt_no)
                      UNION
                        SELECT opri_opr_code,
                               SUM (
                                     NVL (opri_amt, 0)
                                   - lms_investments.basic_prem_ratio (
                                         opri_pol_code,
                                         NVL (opri_amt, 0)))                  premium_amt,
                               SUM (NVL (opri_prem_tax_amt, 0))               prem_tax,
                               --   -Lms_Investments.Basic_prem_ratio(OPRI_POL_CODE,NVL(OPRI_PREM_TAX_AMT,0)) prem_tax,
                               SUM (NVL (opri_chk_comm_amt, 0))               chkoff_comm,
                               --  -Lms_Investments.Basic_prem_ratio(OPRI_POL_CODE,NVL(OPRI_CHK_COMM_AMT,0))
                               SUM (NVL (opri_comm_amt, 0))                   prem_comm --   -Lms_Investments.Basic_prem_ratio(OPRI_POL_CODE,NVL(OPRI_COMM_AMT,0)) prem_comm
                                                                                       ,
                               lms_ord_mis.check_renewal (opri_pol_code,
                                                          opri_instlmt_no)    renewal
                          FROM lms_ord_receipt_instlmnts, lms_ord_prem_receipts
                         WHERE     NVL (inv_all_prem_valid (opri_pol_code), 'N') =
                                   'Y'
                               AND NVL (inv_basic_prem_valid, 'N') = 'Y'
                               AND opri_opr_code = opr_code
                               AND NVL (opr_receipt_trans_code, 'XX') =
                                   NVL (v_opr_rct_trans_code,
                                        NVL (opr_receipt_trans_code, 'XX'))
                      --AND OPR_RECEIPT_TRANS_CODE = NVL(v_opr_rct_trans_code, OPR_RECEIPT_TRANS_CODE)
                      GROUP BY opri_opr_code,
                               lms_ord_mis.check_renewal (opri_pol_code,
                                                          opri_instlmt_no)),
                     (  SELECT pndpo_opr_code,
                               NVL (SUM (pndpo_tot_amt), 0)
                                   pension_contr,
                               NVL (SUM (pndpo_admin_fee), 0)
                                   investment_fee,
                               NVL (SUM (pndpo_empye_amt), 0)
                                   investment_contri,
                               NVL (SUM (pndpo_empyr_amt), 0)
                                   investment_admin,
                               NVL (SUM (pndpo_comm_amt), 0)
                                   pens_comm,
                               lms_ord_mis.check_renewal (pndpo_pol_code,
                                                          pndpo_instlmnt_no)
                                   pensrenewal
                          FROM lms_pension_deposits_ord, lms_ord_prem_receipts
                         WHERE     pndpo_opr_code = opr_code
                               AND NVL (opr_receipt_trans_code, 'XX') =
                                   NVL (v_opr_rct_trans_code,
                                        NVL (opr_receipt_trans_code, 'XX'))
                      --AND OPR_RECEIPT_TRANS_CODE = NVL(v_opr_rct_trans_code,OPR_RECEIPT_TRANS_CODE)
                      GROUP BY pndpo_opr_code,
                               lms_ord_mis.check_renewal (pndpo_pol_code,
                                                          pndpo_instlmnt_no))
               WHERE     pol_code = opr_pol_code
                     AND pol_current_endr_code = endr_code
                     AND opr_receipt_no = v_rct_code
                     AND opr_code = NVL (v_opr_code, opr_code)
                     AND opri_opr_code(+) = opr_code
                     AND pndpo_opr_code(+) = opr_code
                     AND NVL (v_separate_posting, 'N') = 'Y'
                     AND pol_prod_code = prod_code
                     AND NVL (opr_receipt_trans_code, 'XX') =
                         NVL (v_opr_rct_trans_code,
                              NVL (opr_receipt_trans_code, 'XX'))
                     --AND OPR_RECEIPT_TRANS_CODE = NVL(v_opr_rct_trans_code,OPR_RECEIPT_TRANS_CODE)
                     AND v_oppr_code IS NULL
            GROUP BY opr_code,
                     pol_bra_code,
                     pol_prod_code,
                     pol_type,
                     pol_prod_type,
                     opr_alloc_to,
                     endr_pay_method,
                     NVL (inv_all_prem_valid (pol_code), 'N'),
                     DECODE (NVL (endr_pay_method, 'C'),
                             'K', 'CK',
                             NVL (endr_pay_method, 'C')),
                     pol_policy_no,
                     pol_code,
                     prod_calc_inv_from_sa,
                     prod_type,
                     NVL (renewal, pensrenewal),
                     opr_source;

        CURSOR cur_prop_cb_amt IS
              SELECT NVL (SUM (oppr_amt), 0)              paid_amt,
                     NVL (SUM (opri_chk_comm_amt), 0)     prop_chk_amt,
                     pol_bra_code,
                     pol_prod_code,
                     oppr_code,
                     pol_proposal_no,
                     NULL                                 ppr_code
                FROM lms_ord_proposal_rcpts, lms_policies
               WHERE     pol_code = oppr_pol_code
                     AND oppr_pol_proposal_no = pol_proposal_no
                     AND oppr_receipt_no = v_rct_code
                     AND NVL (oppr_receipt_trans_code, 'XX') =
                         NVL (v_oppr_rct_trans_code, 'XX')
                     AND v_opr_code IS NULL
                     AND oppr_code = NVL (v_oppr_code, oppr_code)
            GROUP BY pol_bra_code,
                     pol_prod_code,
                     oppr_code,
                     pol_proposal_no,
                     pol_code
            UNION ALL
              SELECT NVL (SUM (oppr_amt), 0)              paid_amt,
                     NVL (SUM (opri_chk_comm_amt), 0)     prop_chk_amt,
                     ppr_brn_code,
                     ppr_prod_code,
                     oppr_code,
                     ppr_proposal_no,
                     ppr_code
                FROM lms_ord_proposal_rcpts, lms_pol_proposals
               WHERE     oppr_pol_proposal_no = ppr_proposal_no
                     AND oppr_pol_code IS NULL
                     AND oppr_receipt_no = v_rct_code
                     AND NVL (oppr_receipt_trans_code, 'XX') =
                         NVL (v_oppr_rct_trans_code, 'XX')
                     AND v_opr_code IS NULL
                     AND oppr_code = NVL (v_oppr_code, oppr_code)
            GROUP BY ppr_prod_code,
                     ppr_brn_code,
                     oppr_code,
                     ppr_proposal_no,
                     ppr_code
            UNION ALL
              SELECT NVL (SUM (oppr_amt), 0)              paid_amt,
                     NVL (SUM (opri_chk_comm_amt), 0)     prop_chk_amt,
                     ann_brn_code,
                     ann_prod_code,
                     oppr_code,
                     ann_annuity_no,
                     NULL
                FROM lms_ord_proposal_rcpts, lms_annuities
               WHERE     oppr_pol_proposal_no = ann_annuity_no
                     AND oppr_ann_code = ann_code
                     AND oppr_pol_code IS NULL
                     AND oppr_receipt_no = v_rct_code
                     AND NVL (oppr_receipt_trans_code, 'XX') =
                         NVL (v_oppr_rct_trans_code, 'XX')
                     AND v_opr_code IS NULL
                     AND oppr_code = NVL (v_oppr_code, oppr_code)
            GROUP BY ann_prod_code,
                     ann_brn_code,
                     oppr_code,
                     ann_annuity_no,
                     ann_code;
    --CURSOR Prod IS SELECT PROD_CODE FROM LMS_PRODUCTS;
    BEGIN
        --    RAISE_ERROR('Post Acc Type:'||v_acc_type);
        BEGIN
            lms_ord_misc.system_param_val (
                'ALLOW_FIRSTYR_RENEWAL_SEPARATION',
                v_separate_posting);
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                raise_error (
                    'PARAMETER ERROR...ALLOW_FIRSTYR_RENEWAL_SEPARATION...');
        END;

        v_gl_trans.delete;
        v_count := -1;
        v_org_code := fms_interfaces_pkg.get_org (v_rct_branch);
        v_cur_code :=
            NVL (v_currency_code,
                 lms_interfaces_pkg.lms_def_cur (v_rct_branch));

        IF v_raised_by IS NOT NULL
        THEN
            v_user := tqc_interfaces_pkg.username (v_raised_by);
        END IF;

        SELECT    TO_NUMBER (TO_CHAR (SYSDATE, 'RRRR'))
               || lms_transaction_seq.NEXTVAL
          INTO v_trans_code
          FROM DUAL;

        FOR pr IN cur_prop_cb_amt
        LOOP
            IF pr.pol_bra_code IS NULL
            THEN
                raise_error ('BRANCH NOT DEFINED FOR THIS RECORD....');
            ELSIF pr.pol_prod_code IS NULL
            THEN
                IF pr.ppr_code IS NULL
                THEN
                    raise_error (
                           'Define product for Annuity No.'
                        || pr.pol_proposal_no
                        || '...');
                ELSE
                    raise_error (
                           'Define product for Proposal No.'
                        || pr.pol_proposal_no
                        || '...');
                END IF;
            END IF;

            IF v_oppr_code IS NOT NULL
            THEN
                BEGIN
                    SELECT NVL (oppr_drcr, 'C'),
                           DECODE (NVL (oppr_drcr, 'C'), 'C', 'D', 'C')
                      INTO v_oppr_drcr, v_oppr_chk_drcr
                      FROM lms_ord_proposal_rcpts
                     WHERE oppr_code = v_oppr_code;
                EXCEPTION
                    WHEN OTHERS
                    THEN
                        raise_error (
                            'ERROR RETRIEVING PROPOSAL RCPT DTLS...');
                END;
            END IF;

            v_contra_acc :=
                get_receipting_acc (v_acc_type,
                                    pr.pol_prod_code,
                                    v_org_code,
                                    v_rct_branch,
                                    NVL (v_fms_unknown_reposting, 'N'));

            IF NVL (pr.paid_amt, 0) <> 0
            THEN
                get_gl_code ('PRRCT',
                             pr.pol_prod_code,
                             v_trnt_code,
                             v_trnt_gl_code,
                             v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
                valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                           v_org_code,
                           pr.pol_bra_code,
                           'PRRCT');
                v_count := v_count + 2;
                interface_append_gl (
                    v_trans_code,                             -- v_trans_code,
                    v_user,                                     -- v_raise_by,
                    NULL,                                       -- v_pol_code,
                    pr.pol_prod_code,                          -- v_prod_code,
                    NULL,                                        -- v_vchr_no,
                    NULL,                                      -- v_opr_code,,
                    pr.oppr_code,                              -- v_oppr_code,
                    v_rct_code,                                   --v_rcpt_no,
                    v_count,                                       -- v_count,
                    'PROPOSAL PREMIUM - ' || pr.pol_proposal_no,
                    -- v_narrative,
                    pr.paid_amt,                                  -- v_amount,
                    v_oppr_drcr,                                    -- v_drcr,
                    v_trnt_gl_code,                          -- v_acc_number1,
                    v_contra_acc,                            -- v_acc_number2,
                    pr.pol_bra_code,                         -- v_branch_code,
                    v_gl_trans,
                    NULL,
                    ---v_cad_code       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                    NULL,
                    ---v_otop_code       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                    NULL,
                    --v_fpmt_code       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                    NULL,
                    --v_ort_code        NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                    NULL,               --v_btr_no        NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                    pr.ppr_code);                    --- NUMBER DEFAULT NULL);
            END IF;
        --            IF NVL (pr.prop_chk_amt, 0) <> 0 THEN
        --                Get_Gl_Code ('CHKC',
        --                            pr.pol_prod_code,
        --                            v_trnt_code,
        --                            v_trnt_gl_code,
        --                            v_trnt_contra_gl_code
        --                           );
        --                valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code, v_org_code, pr.pol_bra_code, 'CHKC');
        --                v_count := v_count + 2;
        --                Interface_append_gl(v_trans_code,    -- v_trans_code,
        --                                  v_user,    -- v_raise_by,
        --                                    NULL,    -- v_pol_code,
        --                                  pr.pol_prod_code,    -- v_prod_code,
        --                                  NULL,    -- v_vchr_no,
        --                                  NULL,    -- v_opr_code,
        --                                  pr.oppr_code,    -- v_oppr_code,
        --                                    v_rct_code, --v_rcpt_no,
        --                                  v_count,    -- v_count,
        --                                  'CHECK OFF COMMISSION '||pr.pol_proposal_no,    -- v_narrative,
        --                                  pr.prop_chk_amt,    -- v_amount,
        --                                  v_oppr_chk_drcr,    -- v_drcr,
        --                                  v_trnt_gl_code,    -- v_acc_number1,
        --                                  v_contra_acc,    -- v_acc_number2,
        --                                  pr.pol_bra_code,    -- v_branch_code,
        --                                  v_gl_trans);
        --            END IF;
        END LOOP;

        FOR pl IN cur_pol_cb_amt
        LOOP
            IF pl.pol_prod_code IS NULL
            THEN
                raise_error (
                       'Define product for Policy No.'
                    || pl.pol_policy_no
                    || '...');
            END IF;

            v_alloc_to := NVL (pl.alloc_to, 'PR');

            --            IF v_alloc_to = 'PR' THEN
            --                Get_Gl_Code ('UNP_PR',
            --                                      pl.pol_prod_code,
            --                                      v_trnt_code,
            --                                      v_unp_trnt_gl_code,
            --                                      v_trnt_contra_gl_code
            --                                     );
            --                valid_acc (v_unp_trnt_gl_code, v_org_code, v_rct_branch, 'UNP_PR');
            --                v_msg := 'UNP_PR';
            --            ELSIF v_alloc_to = 'LN' THEN
            --                Get_Gl_Code ('UNP_LN',
            --                                     pl.pol_prod_code,
            --                                     v_trnt_code,
            --                                     v_unp_trnt_gl_code,
            --                                     v_trnt_contra_gl_code
            --                                    );
            --                valid_acc (v_unp_trnt_gl_code, v_org_code, v_rct_branch, 'UNP_LN');
            --                v_msg := 'UNP_LN';
            --            ELSIF v_alloc_to = 'PN' THEN
            --                Get_Gl_Code ('UNP_PN',
            --                                     pl.pol_prod_code,
            --                                     v_trnt_code,
            --                                     v_unp_trnt_gl_code,
            --                                     v_trnt_contra_gl_code
            --                                    );
            --                valid_acc (v_unp_trnt_gl_code, v_org_code, v_rct_branch, 'UNP_PN');
            --                v_msg := 'UNP_PN';
            --            END IF;
            IF v_opr_code IS NULL
            THEN
                IF pl.opr_source = 'POLICY_CONVERSION'
                THEN
                    get_gl_code ('PRRCT',
                                 pl.pol_prod_code,
                                 v_trnt_code,
                                 v_contra_acc,
                                 v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                 NULL,
                                 pl.renewal);
                    valid_acc (v_contra_acc,
                               v_org_code,
                               pl.pol_bra_code,
                               'PRRCT');
                ELSE
                    v_contra_acc :=
                        get_receipting_acc (
                            v_acc_type,
                            pl.pol_prod_code,
                            v_org_code,
                            v_rct_branch,
                            NVL (v_fms_unknown_reposting, 'N'));
                END IF;

                v_prem_amt := NVL (pl.premium_amt, 0) + NVL (v_nfl_alloc, 0);
                v_chkoff_comm := NVL (pl.chkoff_comm, 0);
                v_loan_amt := NVL (pl.loan_amt, 0) - NVL (v_nfl_alloc, 0);
                v_pens_amt := NVL (pl.pension_contr, 0);
                v_inv_admin := NVL (pl.investment_admin, 0);
                v_inv_fee := NVL (pl.investment_fee, 0);
                v_inv_contri := NVL (pl.investment_contri, 0);
                v_comfnd := NVL (pl.comfnd, 0);
            ELSE
                BEGIN
                    SELECT opr_origin, NVL (opr_drcr, 'C')
                      INTO v_origin, v_opr_drcr
                      FROM lms_ord_prem_receipts
                     WHERE opr_code = v_opr_code;
                EXCEPTION
                    WHEN OTHERS
                    THEN
                        raise_error ('ERROR RETRIEVING RCPT DTLS....');
                END;

                IF     NOT NVL (v_origin, 'M') = 'I'
                   AND NVL (v_prem_waiver, 'N') <> 'Y'
                THEN
                    raise_error (
                        'INTERFACE PROCESSING ALLOWED ONLY FOR RCPTS ORIGINATING FROM FMS....');
                END IF;

                IF NVL (v_reverse_alloc, 'N') = 'N'
                THEN
                    v_contra_acc := v_unp_trnt_gl_code;
                    v_prem_amt := NVL (v_prm_amt, 0);
                    v_chkoff_comm := NVL (v_chk_com, 0);
                    v_loan_amt := NVL (v_ln_amt, 0);
                    v_pens_amt := NVL (v_pn_amt, 0);
                    v_inv_admin := NVL (v_adm_inv, 0);
                    v_inv_fee := NVL (v_fee_inv, 0);
                    v_inv_contri := NVL (v_contri_inv, 0);
                    v_comfnd := NVL (v_compfund, 0);
                ELSE
                    IF NVL (v_prem_waiver, 'N') = 'Y'
                    THEN
                        get_gl_code ('PRWAIV',
                                     pl.pol_prod_code,
                                     v_trnt_code,
                                     v_trnt_gl_code,
                                     v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                     NULL,
                                     pl.renewal);
                        valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                                   v_org_code,
                                   pl.pol_bra_code,
                                   'PRWAIV');
                        v_contra_acc := v_trnt_gl_code;
                    ELSE
                        IF pl.opr_source = 'POLICY_CONVERSION'
                        THEN
                            get_gl_code ('PRRCT',
                                         pl.pol_prod_code,
                                         v_trnt_code,
                                         v_contra_acc,
                                         v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                         NULL,
                                         pl.renewal);
                            valid_acc (v_contra_acc,
                                       v_org_code,
                                       pl.pol_bra_code,
                                       'PRRCT');
                        ELSE
                            v_contra_acc :=
                                get_receipting_acc (v_acc_type,
                                                    pl.pol_prod_code,
                                                    v_org_code,
                                                    v_rct_branch,
                                                    'N');
                        END IF;
                    END IF;

                    v_prem_amt :=
                        NVL (pl.premium_amt, 0) + NVL (v_nfl_alloc, 0);
                    v_chkoff_comm := NVL (pl.chkoff_comm, 0);
                    v_loan_amt := NVL (pl.loan_amt, 0) - NVL (v_nfl_alloc, 0);
                    v_pens_amt := NVL (pl.pension_contr, 0);
                    v_inv_admin := NVL (pl.investment_admin, 0);
                    v_inv_fee := NVL (pl.investment_fee, 0);
                    v_inv_contri := NVL (pl.investment_contri, 0);
                    v_comfnd := NVL (pl.comfnd, 0);
                END IF;
            END IF;

            --premium
            IF NVL (v_prem_amt, 0) <> 0
            THEN
                get_gl_code ('UP',
                             pl.pol_prod_code,
                             v_trnt_code,
                             v_trnt_gl_code,
                             v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                             NULL,
                             pl.renewal);
                valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                           v_org_code,
                           pl.pol_bra_code,
                           'UP');
                v_count := v_count + 2;
                interface_append_gl (v_trans_code,            -- v_trans_code,
                                     v_user,                    -- v_raise_by,
                                     pl.pol_code,               -- v_pol_code,
                                     pl.pol_prod_code,         -- v_prod_code,
                                     NULL,                       -- v_vchr_no,
                                     pl.opr_code,               -- v_opr_code,
                                     NULL,                     -- v_oppr_code,
                                     v_rct_code,                  --v_rcpt_no,
                                     v_count,                      -- v_count,
                                     'ALLOCATED PREMIUM',      -- v_narrative,
                                     NVL (v_prem_amt, 0),         -- v_amount,
                                     v_opr_drcr,                    -- v_drcr,
                                     v_trnt_gl_code,         -- v_acc_number1,
                                     v_contra_acc,           -- v_acc_number2,
                                     pl.pol_bra_code,        -- v_branch_code,
                                     v_gl_trans);
            -- raise_error('herere');
            END IF;

            --Check Off Commission chkoff_comm   taken care of in FMS
            --            IF NVL(v_chkoff_comm,0) <> 0 THEN
            --                Get_Gl_Code ('CHKC',
            --                                     pl.pol_prod_code,
            --                                     v_trnt_code,
            --                                     v_trnt_gl_code,
            --                                     v_trnt_contra_gl_code
            --                                    );
            --                valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code, v_org_code, pl.pol_bra_code, 'CHKC');
            --                v_count := v_count + 2;
            --                IF v_opr_drcr = 'C' THEN
            --                    Interface_append_gl(v_trans_code,    -- v_trans_code,
            --                                      v_user,    -- v_raise_by,
            --                                        pl.pol_code,    -- v_pol_code,
            --                                      pl.pol_prod_code,    -- v_prod_code,
            --                                      NULL,    -- v_vchr_no,
            --                                      pl.opr_code,    -- v_opr_code,
            --                                        NULL,    -- v_oppr_code,
            --                                        v_rct_code, --v_rcpt_no,
            --                                      v_count,    -- v_count,
            --                                      'CK OFF COMMISSION',    -- v_narrative,
            --                                      NVL(v_chkoff_comm,0),    -- v_amount,
            --                                      'D',    -- v_drcr,
            --                                      v_trnt_gl_code,    -- v_acc_number1,
            --                                      v_contra_acc,    -- v_acc_number2,
            --                                      pl.pol_bra_code,    -- v_branch_code,
            --                                      v_gl_trans);
            --                ELSE
            --                    Interface_append_gl(v_trans_code,    -- v_trans_code,
            --                                      v_user,    -- v_raise_by,
            --                                        pl.pol_code,    -- v_pol_code,
            --                                      pl.pol_prod_code,    -- v_prod_code,
            --                                      NULL,    -- v_vchr_no,
            --                                      pl.opr_code,    -- v_opr_code,
            --                                      NULL,    -- v_oppr_code,
            --                                        v_rct_code, --v_rcpt_no,
            --                                      v_count,    -- v_count,
            --                                      'CK OFF COMMISSION',    -- v_narrative,
            --                                      NVL(v_chkoff_comm,0),    -- v_amount,
            --                                      'C',    -- v_drcr,
            --                                      v_trnt_gl_code,    -- v_acc_number1,
            --                                      v_contra_acc,    -- v_acc_number2,
            --                                      pl.pol_bra_code,    -- v_branch_code,
            --                                      v_gl_trans);
            --                END IF;
            --            END IF;

            --loan repayment
            IF NVL (v_loan_amt, 0) <> 0
            THEN
                get_gl_code ('NL',
                             pl.pol_prod_code,
                             v_trnt_code,
                             v_trnt_gl_code,
                             v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                             NULL,
                             pl.renewal);
                valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                           v_org_code,
                           pl.pol_bra_code,
                           'NL');
                v_count := v_count + 2;
                interface_append_gl (v_trans_code,            -- v_trans_code,
                                     v_user,                    -- v_raise_by,
                                     pl.pol_code,               -- v_pol_code,
                                     pl.pol_prod_code,         -- v_prod_code,
                                     NULL,                       -- v_vchr_no,
                                     pl.opr_code,               -- v_opr_code,
                                     NULL,                     -- v_oppr_code,
                                     v_rct_code,                  --v_rcpt_no,
                                     v_count,                      -- v_count,
                                     'ALLOCATED LOAN',         -- v_narrative,
                                     NVL (v_loan_amt, 0),         -- v_amount,
                                     v_opr_drcr,                    -- v_drcr,
                                     v_trnt_gl_code,         -- v_acc_number1,
                                     v_contra_acc,           -- v_acc_number2,
                                     pl.pol_bra_code,        -- v_branch_code,
                                     v_gl_trans);
            END IF;

            --Investment Fee
            IF NVL (v_inv_fee, 0) <> 0
            THEN
                get_gl_code ('INVFEE',
                             pl.pol_prod_code,
                             v_trnt_code,
                             v_trnt_gl_code,
                             v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                             NULL,
                             pl.renewal);
                valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                           v_org_code,
                           pl.pol_bra_code,
                           'INVFEE ');
                v_count := v_count + 2;
                interface_append_gl (v_trans_code,            -- v_trans_code,
                                     v_user,                    -- v_raise_by,
                                     pl.pol_code,               -- v_pol_code,
                                     pl.pol_prod_code,         -- v_prod_code,
                                     NULL,                       -- v_vchr_no,
                                     pl.opr_code,               -- v_opr_code,
                                     NULL,                     -- v_oppr_code,
                                     v_rct_code,                  --v_rcpt_no,
                                     v_count,                      -- v_count,
                                     'INVESTMENT/POLICY FEE',  -- v_narrative,
                                     NVL (v_inv_fee, 0),          -- v_amount,
                                     v_opr_drcr,                    -- v_drcr,
                                     v_trnt_gl_code,         -- v_acc_number1,
                                     v_contra_acc,           -- v_acc_number2,
                                     pl.pol_bra_code,        -- v_branch_code,
                                     v_gl_trans);
            END IF;

            IF NVL (v_pens_amt, 0) <> 0
            THEN
                IF    NVL (pl.pol_prod_type, 'PN') = 'IN'
                   OR NVL (pl.inv_all_prem, 'N') = 'Y'
                THEN
                    --Investment Administration
                    IF NVL (v_inv_admin, 0) <> 0
                    THEN
                        get_gl_code ('INVADM',
                                     pl.pol_prod_code,
                                     v_trnt_code,
                                     v_trnt_gl_code,
                                     v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                     NULL,
                                     pl.renewal);
                        valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                                   v_org_code,
                                   pl.pol_bra_code,
                                   'INVADM');
                        v_count := v_count + 2;
                        interface_append_gl (v_trans_code,    -- v_trans_code,
                                             v_user,            -- v_raise_by,
                                             pl.pol_code,       -- v_pol_code,
                                             pl.pol_prod_code, -- v_prod_code,
                                             NULL,               -- v_vchr_no,
                                             pl.opr_code,       -- v_opr_code,
                                             NULL,             -- v_oppr_code,
                                             v_rct_code,          --v_rcpt_no,
                                             v_count,              -- v_count,
                                             'INVESTMENT ADMINISTRATION',
                                             -- v_narrative,
                                             NVL (v_inv_admin, 0), -- v_amount,
                                             v_opr_drcr,            -- v_drcr,
                                             v_trnt_gl_code, -- v_acc_number1,
                                             v_contra_acc,   -- v_acc_number2,
                                             pl.pol_bra_code, -- v_branch_code,
                                             v_gl_trans);
                    END IF;

                    --Investment Premium
                    IF NVL (v_inv_contri, 0) <> 0
                    THEN
                        get_gl_code ('INVPREM',
                                     pl.pol_prod_code,
                                     v_trnt_code,
                                     v_trnt_gl_code,
                                     v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                     NULL,
                                     pl.renewal);
                        valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                                   v_org_code,
                                   pl.pol_bra_code,
                                   'INVPREM');
                        v_count := v_count + 2;
                        interface_append_gl (v_trans_code,    -- v_trans_code,
                                             v_user,            -- v_raise_by,
                                             pl.pol_code,       -- v_pol_code,
                                             pl.pol_prod_code, -- v_prod_code,
                                             NULL,               -- v_vchr_no,
                                             pl.opr_code,       -- v_opr_code,
                                             NULL,             -- v_oppr_code,
                                             v_rct_code,          --v_rcpt_no,
                                             v_count,              -- v_count,
                                             'INVESTMENT PREMIUM', -- v_narrative,
                                             NVL (v_inv_contri, 0), -- v_amount,
                                             v_opr_drcr,            -- v_drcr,
                                             v_trnt_gl_code, -- v_acc_number1,
                                             v_contra_acc,   -- v_acc_number2,
                                             pl.pol_bra_code, -- v_branch_code,
                                             v_gl_trans);
                    END IF;
                ELSE
                    --Deposit Administration Contribution
                    get_gl_code ('PN',
                                 pl.pol_prod_code,
                                 v_trnt_code,
                                 v_trnt_gl_code,
                                 v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                 NULL,
                                 pl.renewal);
                    valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                               v_org_code,
                               pl.pol_bra_code,
                               'PN');
                    v_count := v_count + 2;
                    interface_append_gl (v_trans_code,        -- v_trans_code,
                                         v_user,                -- v_raise_by,
                                         pl.pol_code,           -- v_pol_code,
                                         pl.pol_prod_code,     -- v_prod_code,
                                         NULL,                   -- v_vchr_no,
                                         pl.opr_code,           -- v_opr_code,
                                         NULL,                 -- v_oppr_code,
                                         v_rct_code,              --v_rcpt_no,
                                         v_count,                  -- v_count,
                                         'PENSION CONTRIBUTION', -- v_narrative,
                                         NVL (v_pens_amt, 0),     -- v_amount,
                                         v_opr_drcr,                -- v_drcr,
                                         v_trnt_gl_code,     -- v_acc_number1,
                                         v_contra_acc,       -- v_acc_number2,
                                         pl.pol_bra_code,    -- v_branch_code,
                                         v_gl_trans);
                END IF;
            END IF;

            IF NVL (v_comfnd, 0) <> 0
            THEN
                BEGIN
                    lms_ord_misc.system_param_val ('CONSOLIDATE_COMP_FUND',
                                                   v_comp_param);
                EXCEPTION
                    WHEN OTHERS
                    THEN
                        raise_error ('PARAM ERROR...');
                END;

                IF NOT NVL (v_comp_param, 'N') = 'Y'
                THEN
                    --Compensation fund...
                    get_gl_code ('CMPFND',
                                 pl.pol_prod_code,
                                 v_trnt_code,
                                 v_trnt_gl_code,
                                 v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                 NULL,
                                 pl.renewal);
                    valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                               v_org_code,
                               pl.pol_bra_code,
                               'CMPFND');
                    v_count := v_count + 2;
                    interface_append_gl (v_trans_code,        -- v_trans_code,
                                         v_user,                -- v_raise_by,
                                         pl.pol_code,           -- v_pol_code,
                                         pl.pol_prod_code,     -- v_prod_code,
                                         NULL,                   -- v_vchr_no,
                                         pl.opr_code,           -- v_opr_code,
                                         NULL,                 -- v_oppr_code,
                                         v_rct_code,              --v_rcpt_no,
                                         v_count,                  -- v_count,
                                         'COMPENSATION FUND',  -- v_narrative,
                                         NVL (v_comfnd, 0),       -- v_amount,
                                         v_opr_drcr,                -- v_drcr,
                                         v_trnt_gl_code,     -- v_acc_number1,
                                         v_contra_acc,       -- v_acc_number2,
                                         pl.pol_bra_code,    -- v_branch_code,
                                         v_gl_trans);
                END IF;
            END IF;
        END LOOP;

        -- V_OPR_CODE IS NULL AND V_OPPR_RCT_TRANS_CODE  ARE NULL IF CALLED FROM FMS.....
        IF v_opr_code IS NULL OR v_oppr_code IS NULL
        THEN
            IF NVL (v_fms_unknown_reposting, 'N') = 'N'
            THEN
                v_unknown_amt :=
                    fms_interfaces_pkg.rct_unknown_amt (v_receipt_pk);
            END IF;

            IF NVL (v_unknown_amt, 0) <> 0
            THEN
                IF v_acc_type = 'CK'
                THEN
                    get_gl_code ('UNK_CHKC',
                                 NULL,
                                 v_trnt_code,
                                 v_trnt_gl_code,
                                 v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
                    valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                               v_org_code,
                               v_rct_branch,
                               'UNK_CHKC');
                ELSE
                    get_gl_code ('UNK',
                                 NULL,
                                 v_trnt_code,
                                 v_trnt_gl_code,
                                 v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
                    valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                               v_org_code,
                               v_rct_branch,
                               'UNK');
                END IF;

                v_count := v_count + 2;

                IF v_opr_drcr = 'C'
                THEN
                    interface_append_gl (v_trans_code,        -- v_trans_code,
                                         v_user,                -- v_raise_by,
                                         NULL,                  -- v_pol_code,
                                         NULL,                 -- v_prod_code,
                                         NULL,                   -- v_vchr_no,
                                         v_opr_code,            -- v_opr_code,
                                         v_oppr_code,          -- v_oppr_code,
                                         v_rct_code,              --v_rcpt_no,
                                         v_count,                  -- v_count,
                                         'ERRONEOUS CHK-OFF DEDUCTIONS', -- v_narrative,
                                         NVL (v_unknown_amt, 0),  -- v_amount,
                                         'D',                       -- v_drcr,
                                         v_contra_acc,       -- v_acc_number1,
                                         v_trnt_gl_code,     -- v_acc_number2,
                                         v_rct_branch,       -- v_branch_code,
                                         v_gl_trans);
                ELSE
                    interface_append_gl (v_trans_code,        -- v_trans_code,
                                         v_user,                -- v_raise_by,
                                         NULL,                  -- v_pol_code,
                                         NULL,                 -- v_prod_code,
                                         NULL,                   -- v_vchr_no,
                                         v_opr_code,            -- v_opr_code,
                                         v_oppr_code,          -- v_oppr_code,
                                         v_rct_code,              --v_rcpt_no,
                                         v_count,                  -- v_count,
                                         'ERRONEOUS CHK-OFF DEDUCTIONS', -- v_narrative,
                                         NVL (v_unknown_amt, 0),  -- v_amount,
                                         'C',                       -- v_drcr,
                                         v_contra_acc,       -- v_acc_number1,
                                         v_trnt_gl_code,     -- v_acc_number2,
                                         v_rct_branch,       -- v_branch_code,
                                         v_gl_trans);
                END IF;
            END IF;
        END IF;

        --             IF NVL (v_double_sure_amt, 0) <> 0 THEN
        --                 v_count := v_count + 2;
        --                 fms_vouchers_pkg.append_gl_trans (v_count,
        --                                                                      'DOUBLE SURE',
        --                                                                      NVL (v_double_sure_amt, 0),
        --                                                                      'D',
        --                                                                      v_contra_acc,
        --                                                                      v_trnt_gl_code,
        --                                                                      v_rct_branch,
        --                                                                      v_gl_trans
        --                                                                     );
        --             END IF;
        IF v_oppr_code IS NULL
        THEN
            v_unprocessed_rcpts_total := 0;

            FOR pl IN cur_pol_cb_amt
            LOOP
                --FOR P IN Prod LOOP
                v_unprocessed_rcpts := 0;
                v_unprocessed_rcpts :=
                    get_unprocessed_rcpt (v_rct_code,
                                          v_date,
                                          pl.pol_prod_code,
                                          NULL,
                                          v_receipt_pk,
                                          v_opr_rct_trans_code,
                                          pl.pol_code,
                                          pl.opr_code);
                v_unprocessed_rcpts_total :=
                      NVL (v_unprocessed_rcpts_total, 0)
                    + NVL (v_unprocessed_rcpts, 0);

                IF NVL (v_unprocessed_rcpts, 0) > 0
                THEN
                    v_alloc_to := NVL (pl.alloc_to, 'PR');

                    IF v_alloc_to = 'LN'
                    THEN
                        raise_error (
                               'POSTING TO UNP_LN BLOCKED.....Policy No.'
                            || pl.pol_policy_no);
                    END IF;

                    IF v_alloc_to = 'PR'
                    THEN
                        get_gl_code ('UNP_PR',
                                     pl.pol_prod_code,
                                     v_trnt_code,
                                     v_unp_trnt_gl_code,
                                     v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                     NULL,
                                     pl.renewal);
                        valid_acc (v_unp_trnt_gl_code,
                                   v_org_code,
                                   v_rct_branch,
                                   'UNP_PR');
                        v_msg := 'UNP_PR';
                    ELSIF v_alloc_to = 'LN'
                    THEN
                        get_gl_code ('UNP_LN',
                                     pl.pol_prod_code,
                                     v_trnt_code,
                                     v_unp_trnt_gl_code,
                                     v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                     NULL,
                                     pl.renewal);
                        valid_acc (v_unp_trnt_gl_code,
                                   v_org_code,
                                   v_rct_branch,
                                   'UNP_LN');
                        v_msg := 'UNP_LN';
                    ELSIF v_alloc_to = 'PN'
                    THEN
                        get_gl_code ('UNP_PN',
                                     pl.pol_prod_code,
                                     v_trnt_code,
                                     v_unp_trnt_gl_code,
                                     v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                     NULL,
                                     pl.renewal);
                        valid_acc (v_unp_trnt_gl_code,
                                   v_org_code,
                                   v_rct_branch,
                                   'UNP_PN');
                        v_msg := 'UNP_PN';
                    END IF;

                    IF NVL (v_acc_type, 'D') = 'CK'
                    THEN
                        get_gl_code ('CHKC',
                                     pl.pol_prod_code,
                                     v_trnt_code,
                                     v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                     v_contra_acc,
                                     NULL,
                                     pl.renewal);
                        valid_acc (v_contra_acc,
                                   v_org_code,
                                   v_rct_branch,
                                   'CHKC');
                    ELSE
                        get_gl_code ('DR_RCT',
                                     pl.pol_prod_code,
                                     v_trnt_code,
                                     v_contra_acc,
                                     v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                     NULL,
                                     pl.renewal);
                        valid_acc (v_contra_acc,
                                   v_org_code,
                                   v_rct_branch,
                                   'DR_RCT');
                    END IF;

                    v_count := v_count + 2;
                    interface_append_gl (
                        v_trans_code,                         -- v_trans_code,
                        v_user,                                 -- v_raise_by,
                        pl.pol_code,                            -- v_pol_code,
                        pl.pol_prod_code,                      -- v_prod_code,
                        NULL,                                    -- v_vchr_no,
                        pl.opr_code,                            -- v_opr_code,
                        v_oppr_code,                           -- v_oppr_code,
                        v_rct_code,                               --v_rcpt_no,
                        v_count,                                   -- v_count,
                        'UNPROCESSED RCPTS - DR_RCT TO ' || v_msg,
                        -- v_narrative,
                        NVL (v_unprocessed_rcpts, 0),             -- v_amount,
                        v_opr_drcr,                                 -- v_drcr,
                        v_unp_trnt_gl_code,                  -- v_acc_number1,
                        v_contra_acc,                        -- v_acc_number2,
                        v_rct_branch,                        -- v_branch_code,
                        v_gl_trans);
                END IF;
            --END LOOP;
            END LOOP;
        END IF;

        interface_update_vgl (v_trans_code,                    --v_trans_code,
                              v_user,                            --v_raise_by,
                              NULL,                              --v_pol_code,
                              v_date,                                --v_date,
                              v_opr_code,                        --v_opr_code,
                              v_oppr_code,                      --v_oppr_code,
                              'LMS RECEIPTS BATCH',       --v_btc_description,
                              'JV',                              --v_btc_type,
                              v_rct_branch,                   --v_branch_code,
                              NVL (v_description, 'LMS RECEIPT'),
                              --v_description,
                              v_rct_code,                         --v_rcpt_no,
                              v_gl_trans);                      --v_gl_trans);
    EXCEPTION
        WHEN OTHERS
        THEN
            raise_error ('PAP.' || SQLERRM (SQLCODE));
    END post_update_recpt_pymt_clnp;

    PROCEDURE process_agent_termination (
        v_transno           NUMBER,
        v_savings_bal       NUMBER,
        v_excess_amt        NUMBER,
        v_agn_code          NUMBER,
        v_agn_bbr_code      NUMBER,
        v_agn_bank_acc_no   VARCHAR2,
        v_username          VARCHAR2,
        v_vchr_no           VARCHAR2,
        v_cop_brn_code      NUMBER,
        v_agn_name          VARCHAR2,
        v_debt_amnt         NUMBER
    )
    IS
        v_prod_code             NUMBER;
        v_count                 NUMBER;
        v_chq_dtls_rec          fms_cheques_pkg.type_rqn_dtls_table;
        v_trnt_code             VARCHAR2 (30);
        v_crt_acc_no            VARCHAR2 (30);
        v_trnt_contra_gl_code   NUMBER;
        v_org_code              NUMBER;
        v_trans_code            VARCHAR2 (30);
        v_eft_enabled           VARCHAR2 (5);
        v_pay_method            VARCHAR2 (10);
        v_deductions            NUMBER;
        v_payee                 NUMBER;
        v_adv                   NUMBER;

        CURSOR deduct IS
              SELECT 'PAYE'             descp,
                     cpe_pay_element    elements,
                     SUM (
                         NVL (
                               DECODE (NVL (ocl_drcr, 'D'), 'C', 1, -1)
                             * ocl_tot_comm_amt,
                             0))        commisssion,
                     ocl_drcr           drcr
                FROM lms_other_comm_clawbck,
                     lms_agencies,
                     lms_comm_pay_elements,
                     lms_agents_comm_pay_elements
               WHERE     ocl_agn_code = agn_code
                     AND ocl_comm_paid IN ('Y', 'A')
                     AND ocl_pay_trans_no = v_transno
                     AND acpe_agn_code = agn_code
                     AND cpe_code = ocl_cpe_code
            GROUP BY cpe_pay_element, ocl_drcr
            UNION ALL
              SELECT 'DED'                          descp,
                     NULL                           elements,
                     SUM (
                           DECODE (NVL (drcr, 'D'), 'D', -1, 1)
                         * NVL (commisssion, 0))    commisssion,
                     drcr
                FROM lms_agencies,
                     (  SELECT agn_code            agncode2,
                               ABS (
                                   SUM (
                                       NVL (
                                             DECODE (NVL (aodb_drcr, 'D'),
                                                     'C', 1,
                                                     -1)
                                           * aodb_amt,
                                           0)))    commisssion,
                               ocl_drcr            drcr
                          FROM lms_debit_trans,
                               lms_other_comm_clawbck,
                               lms_agent_other_debits,
                               lms_agencies
                         WHERE     ocl_aodb_code = aodb_code
                               AND ldt_code = aodb_ldt_code
                               AND ocl_comm_paid IN ('Y', 'A')
                               AND aodb_agn_code = ocl_agn_code
                               AND agn_code = ocl_agn_code
                               AND ocl_pay_trans_no = v_transno
                      GROUP BY agn_code, ocl_drcr
                      UNION ALL
                        SELECT ocl_agn_code        agncode2,
                               ABS (
                                   SUM (
                                       NVL (
                                             DECODE (NVL (ocl_drcr, 'D'),
                                                     'C', 1,
                                                     -1)
                                           * ocl_tot_comm_amt,
                                           0)))    commisssion,
                               ocl_drcr            drcr
                          FROM lms_other_comm_clawbck,
                               lms_agencies,
                               lms_agent_debits,
                               lms_debit_reason
                         WHERE     ocl_agn_code = agn_code
                               AND ocl_comm_paid IN ('Y', 'A')
                               AND ocl_pay_trans_no = v_transno
                               AND adb_code = ocl_adb_code
                               AND ldr_code = adb_ldr_code
                      GROUP BY ocl_agn_code, ocl_drcr
                      UNION ALL
                        SELECT ccl_agn_code        agncode2,
                               ABS (
                                   SUM (
                                       NVL (
                                             DECODE (NVL (ccl_drcr, 'D'),
                                                     'C', 1,
                                                     -1)
                                           * ccl_tot_comm_amt,
                                           0)))    commisssion,
                               ccl_drcr            drcr
                          FROM lms_comm_clawbck, lms_agencies
                         WHERE     ccl_agn_code = agn_code
                               AND ccl_comm_paid IN ('Y', 'A')
                               AND ccl_pay_trans_no = v_transno
                      GROUP BY ccl_agn_code, ccl_drcr)
               WHERE agncode2(+) = agn_code
            --AND COMMISSSION>0
            GROUP BY drcr
            UNION ALL
            SELECT 'ADV'                         descp,
                   NULL                          elements,
                   SUM (
                       NVL (
                           (NVL (car_rpymt_amt, 0) - NVL (car_amt_repaid, 0)),
                           cad_comm_adv_amt))    commisssion,
                   'D'                           drcr
              FROM lms_comm_advances,
                   lms_agencies,
                   lms_agent_loan_types,
                   lms_comm_adv_rpymt
             WHERE     cad_agn_code = agn_code
                   AND car_repaid IN ('A', 'Y')
                   AND car_repay_trans_no = v_transno
                   AND car_cad_code = cad_code
                   AND cad_lalt_code = lalt_code
                   AND car_agn_code(+) = agn_code;
    BEGIN
        BEGIN
            v_org_code := fms_interfaces_pkg.get_org (v_cop_brn_code);
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                raise_error ('Org details error one...' || v_cop_brn_code);
        END;

        v_count := 0;

        BEGIN
            SELECT    TO_NUMBER (TO_CHAR (SYSDATE, 'RRRR'))
                   || lms_transaction_seq.NEXTVAL
              INTO v_trans_code
              FROM DUAL;

            IF NVL (v_savings_bal, 0) <> 0
            THEN
                SELECT cpe_acc_no
                  INTO v_crt_acc_no
                  FROM lms_comm_pay_elements
                 WHERE cpe_pay_element = 'CAP';

                valid_acc (v_crt_acc_no,
                           v_org_code,
                           v_cop_brn_code,
                           'CAP');
                v_count := v_count + 1;
                interface_append_chq (v_trans_code, --v_trans_code        NUMBER,
                                      v_username, --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                                      NULL,     --v_pol_code           NUMBER,
                                      v_prod_code, --v_prod_code          NUMBER,
                                      v_vchr_no,
                                      --v_vchr_no           VARCHAR2,
                                      v_count,  --v_count              NUMBER,
                                      ABS (NVL (v_savings_bal, 0)),
                                      --v_amount             NUMBER,
                                      'SAVINGS PLAN - ' || v_agn_name,
                                      --v_narrative          VARCHAR2,
                                      v_crt_acc_no,
                                      --v_acc_number         VARCHAR2,
                                      v_org_code, --v_acc_org_code         NUMBER,
                                      v_cop_brn_code,
                                      --v_branch_code        NUMBER,
                                      'D',    --v_drcr               VARCHAR2,
                                      v_chq_dtls_rec,
                                      -- IN OUT   fms_cheques_pkg.type_rqn_dtls_table
                                      NULL, --v_fpmt_code  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                      NULL, --v_ocl_code  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                      v_agn_code,
                                      --v_agn_code NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                      v_transno --v_trans_no NUMBER DEFAULT NULL
                                               );
            END IF;
        END;

        FOR d IN deduct
        LOOP
            IF d.descp = 'DED'
            THEN
                IF NVL (d.commisssion, 0) <> 0
                THEN
                    v_deductions := NVL (v_deductions, 0) + d.commisssion;

                    IF (d.drcr = 'D')
                    THEN
                        get_gl_code ('COMMDED',
                                     v_prod_code,
                                     v_trnt_code,
                                     v_crt_acc_no,
                                     v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
                        valid_acc (v_crt_acc_no,
                                   v_org_code,
                                   v_cop_brn_code,
                                   'COMMDED');
                        v_count := v_count + 1;
                        interface_append_chq (
                            v_trans_code,
                            --v_trans_code        NUMBER,
                            v_username,
                            --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                            NULL,               --v_pol_code           NUMBER,
                            v_prod_code,
                            --v_prod_code          NUMBER,
                            v_vchr_no,
                            --v_vchr_no           VARCHAR2,
                            v_count,
                            --v_count              NUMBER,
                            ABS (NVL (d.commisssion, 0)),
                            --v_amount             NUMBER,
                            'COMMISSION DEDUCTIONS - ' || v_agn_name,
                            --v_narrative          VARCHAR2,
                            v_crt_acc_no,
                            --v_acc_number         VARCHAR2,
                            v_org_code,
                            --v_acc_org_code         NUMBER,
                            v_cop_brn_code,
                            --v_branch_code        NUMBER,
                            'C',              --v_drcr               VARCHAR2,
                            v_chq_dtls_rec,
                            -- IN OUT   fms_cheques_pkg.type_rqn_dtls_table
                            NULL,
                            --v_fpmt_code  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                            NULL,
                            --v_ocl_code  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                            v_agn_code,
                            --v_agn_code NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                            v_transno         --v_trans_no NUMBER DEFAULT NULL
                                     );
                    ELSE
                        ----RAISE_ERROR('XXXXXXXXX');
                        get_gl_code ('COMMDED',
                                     v_prod_code,
                                     v_trnt_code,
                                     v_crt_acc_no,
                                     v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
                        valid_acc (v_crt_acc_no,
                                   v_org_code,
                                   v_cop_brn_code,
                                   'COMMDED');
                        v_count := v_count + 1;
                        interface_append_chq (
                            v_trans_code,
                            --v_trans_code        NUMBER,
                            v_username,
                            --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                            NULL,               --v_pol_code           NUMBER,
                            v_prod_code,
                            --v_prod_code          NUMBER,
                            v_vchr_no,
                            --v_vchr_no           VARCHAR2,
                            v_count,
                            --v_count              NUMBER,
                            ABS (NVL (d.commisssion, 0)),
                            --v_amount             NUMBER,
                            'COMMISSION DEDUCTIONS - ' || v_agn_name,
                            --v_narrative          VARCHAR2,
                            v_crt_acc_no,
                            --v_acc_number         VARCHAR2,
                            v_org_code,
                            --v_acc_org_code         NUMBER,
                            v_cop_brn_code,
                            --v_branch_code        NUMBER,
                            'D',              --v_drcr               VARCHAR2,
                            v_chq_dtls_rec,
                            -- IN OUT   fms_cheques_pkg.type_rqn_dtls_table
                            NULL,
                            --v_fpmt_code  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                            NULL,
                            --v_ocl_code  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                            v_agn_code,
                            --v_agn_code NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                            v_transno         --v_trans_no NUMBER DEFAULT NULL
                                     );
                    END IF;
                END IF;
            END IF;

            --         SELECT distinct
            --                CAD_PAID
            --                INTO V_AMT
            --                FROM LMS_COMM_ADVANCES,LMS_AGENCIES,LMS_AGENT_LOAN_TYPES,LMS_COMM_ADV_RPYMT
            --                WHERE
            --                CAD_AGN_CODE=AGN_CODE
            --                AND CAR_REPAID IN ('A','Y')
            --                AND CAR_REPAY_TRANS_NO=v_transno
            --                AND CAD_LALT_CODE=LALT_CODE
            --                AND AGN_CODE = v_agn_code
            --                AND CAR_CAD_CODE = CAD_CODE
            --                AND CAR_AGN_CODE(+)=AGN_CODE;
            --                --RAISE_ERROR('V_AMT='||V_AMT);
            IF d.descp = 'ADV'
            THEN
                IF NVL (d.commisssion, 0) <> 0
                THEN
                    v_adv := NVL (v_adv, 0) + d.commisssion;
                    get_gl_code ('AGNADV',
                                 v_prod_code,
                                 v_trnt_code,
                                 v_crt_acc_no,
                                 v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
                    valid_acc (v_crt_acc_no,
                               v_org_code,
                               v_cop_brn_code,
                               'AGNADV');
                    v_count := v_count + 1;
                    interface_append_chq (
                        v_trans_code,
                        --v_trans_code        NUMBER,
                        v_username,
                        --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                        NULL,                   --v_pol_code           NUMBER,
                        v_prod_code,
                        --v_prod_code          NUMBER,
                        v_vchr_no,
                        --v_vchr_no           VARCHAR2,
                        v_count,                --v_count              NUMBER,
                        ABS (NVL (d.commisssion, 0)),
                        --v_amount             NUMBER,
                        'AGENT ADVANCE RECOVERY - ' || v_agn_name,
                        --v_narrative          VARCHAR2,
                        v_crt_acc_no,
                        --v_acc_number         VARCHAR2,
                        v_org_code,
                        --v_acc_org_code         NUMBER,
                        v_cop_brn_code,
                        --v_branch_code        NUMBER,
                        'C',                  --v_drcr               VARCHAR2,
                        v_chq_dtls_rec,
                        -- IN OUT   fms_cheques_pkg.type_rqn_dtls_table
                        NULL,              --v_fpmt_code  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                        NULL,               --v_ocl_code  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                        v_agn_code,
                        --v_agn_code NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                        v_transno             --v_trans_no NUMBER DEFAULT NULL
                                 );
                END IF;
            END IF;

            IF d.descp = 'PAYE'
            THEN
                IF NVL (d.commisssion, 0) <> 0
                THEN
                    v_payee := NVL (v_payee, 0) + d.commisssion;
                    get_gl_code ('UC',
                                 v_prod_code,
                                 v_trnt_code,
                                 v_crt_acc_no,
                                 v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
                    valid_acc (v_crt_acc_no,
                               v_org_code,
                               v_cop_brn_code,
                               'UC');
                    v_count := v_count + 1;
                    interface_append_chq (v_trans_code,
                                          --v_trans_code        NUMBER,
                                          v_username,
                                          --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                                          NULL, --v_pol_code           NUMBER,
                                          v_prod_code,
                                          --v_prod_code          NUMBER,
                                          v_vchr_no,
                                          --v_vchr_no           VARCHAR2,
                                          v_count, --v_count              NUMBER,
                                          ABS (NVL (d.commisssion, 0)),
                                          --v_amount             NUMBER,
                                          d.elements,
                                          --v_narrative          VARCHAR2,
                                          v_crt_acc_no,
                                          --v_acc_number         VARCHAR2,
                                          v_org_code,
                                          --v_acc_org_code         NUMBER,
                                          v_cop_brn_code,
                                          --v_branch_code        NUMBER,
                                          'C', --v_drcr               VARCHAR2,
                                          v_chq_dtls_rec,
                                          -- IN OUT   fms_cheques_pkg.type_rqn_dtls_table
                                          NULL, --v_fpmt_code  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                          NULL, --v_ocl_code  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                          v_agn_code,
                                          --v_agn_code NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                          v_transno --v_trans_no NUMBER DEFAULT NULL
                                                   );
                END IF;
            END IF;

            v_eft_enabled := 'N';

            IF v_agn_bank_acc_no IS NOT NULL AND v_agn_bbr_code IS NOT NULL
            THEN
                BEGIN
                    v_eft_enabled := account_enabled (v_agn_bbr_code);
                EXCEPTION
                    WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND
                    THEN
                        v_eft_enabled := 'N';
                    WHEN OTHERS
                    THEN
                        v_eft_enabled := 'N';
                END;
            END IF;
        END LOOP;

        IF v_eft_enabled = 'Y'
        THEN
            v_pay_method := 'EFT';
        ELSE
            v_pay_method := 'CHQ';
        END IF;

        ---RAISE_ERROR('PAYE='||v_payee||'ADV='||v_adv||'v_deductions='||v_deductions||'='||v_excess_amt);
        IF NVL (v_excess_amt, 0) > 0
        THEN
            BEGIN
                interface_create_reqn (
                    v_trans_code,                --v_trans_code        NUMBER,
                    v_vchr_no,
                    --v_ref                   VARCHAR2,
                    v_agn_code,            --v_ref2                  VARCHAR2,
                    SYSDATE,                   --v_ref_date              DATE,
                    'SAVINGS PAYMENT ( ' || v_agn_name || ')',
                    --v_narrative             VARCHAR2,
                    ABS (NVL (v_excess_amt, 0)),
                    --v_amount                NUMBER,
                    v_agn_name,            --v_payee                 VARCHAR2,
                    v_pay_method,
                    --'CHQ', --v_pay_method            VARCHAR2, --CHQ, EFT
                    v_agn_bank_acc_no,  --v_payee_bank_acc_no        VARCHAR2,
                    v_agn_bbr_code,       --v_payee_bank_branch_code   NUMBER,
                    v_username,            --v_source_auth_by        VARCHAR2,
                    SYSDATE,                   --v_source_auth_dt        DATE,
                    v_username,
                    --v_raise_by                VARCHAR2,
                    'COMM',                --v_pmt_type              VARCHAR2,
                    v_cop_brn_code,           --v_branch_code          NUMBER,
                    NULL,                                        --v_pol_code,
                    v_chq_dtls_rec,
                    -- IN OUT   fms_cheques_pkg.type_rqn_dtls_table,
                    NULL,
                    v_agn_code,              --v_agn_code NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                    v_transno                 --v_trans_no NUMBER DEFAULT NULL
                             );
            EXCEPTION
                WHEN OTHERS
                THEN
                    raise_error (
                        ' voucher no. ' || v_vchr_no || ';' || v_agn_code);
            END;
        END IF;
    -- raise_error('xxxx='||v_eft_enabled||';'||i.AGN_BANK_ACC_NO||';'||i.AGN_BBR_CODE);
    END process_agent_termination;

    PROCEDURE post_agent_contra_gl (v_transno NUMBER, v_user VARCHAR2)
    IS
        CURSOR contra (v_transno NUMBER)
        IS
            SELECT itb_drcr,
                   itb_transaction_code,
                   itb_count,
                   itb_narrative,
                   itb_amount,
                   itb_acc_number,
                   itb_acc_number2,
                   itb_branch_code
              FROM lms_interface_table
             WHERE     itb_transaction_type = 'APPEND_CHQ'
                   AND itb_transaction_code = v_transno;

        v_gl_trans   fms_vouchers_pkg.tgl_rec_type;
        v_drcr       VARCHAR2 (1);
    BEGIN
        v_gl_trans.delete;

        FOR b IN contra (v_transno)
        LOOP
            SELECT DECODE (NVL (b.itb_drcr, 'C'), 'C', 'D', 'C')
              INTO v_drcr
              FROM DUAL;

            interface_append_gl (b.itb_transaction_code,
                                 --v_trans_code        NUMBER,
                                 v_user,       --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                                 NULL,           --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                                 NULL,           --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                                 NULL,         --v_vchr_no           VARCHAR2,
                                 NULL,           --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                                 NULL,           --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                                 NULL,         --v_rcpt_no           VARCHAR2,
                                 b.itb_count,    --v_count             NUMBER,
                                 b.itb_narrative || '-CONTRA',
                                 --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                                 NVL (b.itb_amount, 0),
                                 --v_amount            NUMBER,
                                 v_drcr,       --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                                 b.itb_acc_number,
                                 --v_acc_number1       VARCHAR2,
                                 b.itb_acc_number2,
                                 --v_acc_number2        VARCHAR2,
                                 b.itb_branch_code, --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                                 v_gl_trans);
        --v_trn_rec   IN OUT  fms_test.Fms_Vouchers_Pkg.Tgl_rec_type,
        END LOOP;
    EXCEPTION
        WHEN OTHERS
        THEN
            raise_error ('COM CONTRA. API....');
    END post_agent_contra_gl;

    PROCEDURE policy_conversion_rcpts_clnup (
        v_pol_code        IN NUMBER,
        v_pol_policy_no   IN VARCHAR2,
        v_inst_prem       IN NUMBER,
        v_pol_bra_code    IN NUMBER,
        v_oppr_code       IN NUMBER,
        v_user_name          VARCHAR2,
        v_prodctn_date    IN DATE DEFAULT NULL,
        v_prod_type       IN VARCHAR2 DEFAULT 'ED',
        v_agn_dbt_amt        NUMBER DEFAULT 0
    )
    IS
        os_prem_dummy               NUMBER;
        v_os_inst                   NUMBER;
        v_opr_code                  NUMBER;
        v_cur_code                  NUMBER;
        v_gl_count                  NUMBER;
        v_acc_type                  NUMBER;
        v_only_due_inst             VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_multiple_inst             VARCHAR2 (20) := 'Y';
        v_tran_no                   NUMBER;
        v_bal_amt                   NUMBER;
        v_credit                    NUMBER := 0;
