        v_chq_rcpt_no               VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_gl_trans                  fms_vouchers_pkg.tgl_rec_type;
        v_vgl_no                    NUMBER;
        v_trnt_code                 VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_trnt_gl_code              VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_trnt_contra_gl_code       VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_contra_acc                VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_chkoff_agen_code          NUMBER;
        v_chkoff_rate               NUMBER;
        v_ee_contri                 NUMBER;
        v_er_contri                 NUMBER;
        v_tot_contri                NUMBER;
        v_balance                   NUMBER;
        v_amt                       NUMBER := 0;
        v_raised_by                 NUMBER;
        v_post                      VARCHAR2 (1) := 'N';
        v_ann_opr_code              NUMBER;
        v_trans_code                NUMBER;
        v_polcode                   NUMBER := v_pol_code;
        v_separate_posting          VARCHAR2 (5);
        v_compute_comm              VARCHAR2 (5);

        CURSOR prp_rcpts IS
            SELECT oppr_code,
                   oppr_ltr_trans_no,
                   oppr_date,
                   oppr_cheque_no,
                   oppr_amt,
                   oppr_pol_code,
                   oppr_pol_proposal_no,
                   oppr_receipt_no,
                   oppr_receipt_date,
                   oppr_pmth_code,
                   oppr_posted,
                   opr_chk_agen_code,
                   opri_chk_comm_rate,
                   opri_chk_comm_amt,
                   oppr_total_ref_amt,
                   oppr_to_ref,
                   oppr_done_by,
                   oppr_pens_amt,
                   oppr_drcr,
                   pol_prod_type,
                   endr_grp_life_rider,
                   oppr_within_system,
                   endr_add_prem_int,
                   endr_checkoff_agen_code,
                   oppr_pay_comm,
                   DECODE (
                       NVL (endr_pay_method, 'C'),
                       'K', lms_interfaces_pkg.agent_commission (
                                endr_checkoff_agen_code,
                                'CK'),
                       NULL)    chkoff_rate,
                   oppr_source
              FROM lms_ord_proposal_rcpts,
                   lms_policies,
                   lms_policy_endorsements,
                   (  SELECT oppr_receipt_no               rcptno,
                             oppr_pol_code                 polcode,
                             SUM (
                                   DECODE (NVL (oppr_drcr, 'C'), 'C', 1, -1)
                                 * (NVL (oppr_amt, 0)))    amt
                        FROM lms_ord_proposal_rcpts
                    GROUP BY oppr_receipt_no, oppr_pol_code)
             WHERE     oppr_pol_code = pol_code
                   AND polcode = pol_code
                   AND NVL (rcptno, 'XYZ') = NVL (oppr_receipt_no, 'XYZ')
                   AND pol_current_endr_code = endr_code
                   AND NVL (oppr_drcr, 'C') <> 'D'
                   AND pol_code = v_pol_code
                   AND amt > 0
                   AND NOT NVL (oppr_receipt_no, 'XYZ') IN
                               (SELECT NVL (opr_receipt_no, 'XYZ')
                                  FROM lms_ord_prem_receipts
                                 WHERE     opr_pol_code = pol_code
                                       AND opr_amt = oppr_amt
                                       AND NVL (opr_receipt_no, 'XYZ') =
                                           NVL (oppr_receipt_no, 'XYZ')
                                       AND opr_receipt_date =
                                           oppr_receipt_date);

        CURSOR cur_pol_cb_amt IS
              SELECT NVL (SUM (opr_loan_pymt_amt), 0)
                         loan_amt,
                     NVL (SUM (lms_process_receipts.rcpt_balance (opr_code)),
                          0)
                         un_allocated_amt,
                     NVL (SUM (opr_refund_amt), 0)
                         suspense_amt,
                     -- OPR_PMTH_CODE,
                     NVL (SUM (premium_amt), 0)
                         premium_amt,
                     NVL (SUM (pension_contr), 0)
                         pension_contr,
                     --NVL(SUM(investment_fee),0) investment_fee,
                     DECODE (pol_prod_type,
                             'IN', NVL (SUM (investment_fee), 0),
                             'PN', NVL (SUM (investment_fee), 0),
                             'AN', NVL (SUM (investment_fee), 0),
                             NVL (SUM (opr_policy_fee), 0))
                         investment_fee,
                     NVL (SUM (investment_contri), 0)
                         investment_contri,
                     NVL (SUM (investment_admin), 0)
                         investment_admin,
                     NVL (SUM (opr_fund_client_contr), 0)
                         comfnd,
                     (NVL (SUM (prem_comm), 0) + NVL (SUM (pens_comm), 0))
                         prem_comm,
                     NVL (SUM (pens_comm), 0)
                         pens_comm,
                     NVL (SUM (prem_tax), 0)
                         prem_tax,
                     NVL (SUM (chkoff_comm), 0)
                         chkoff_comm,
                     pol_bra_code,
                     pol_prod_code,
                     pol_type,
                     pol_prod_type,
                     pol_policy_no,
                     opr_code,
                     NVL (opr_alloc_to, 'PR')
                         alloc_to,
                     NVL (inv_all_prem_valid (pol_code), 'N')
                         inv_all_prem,
                     'N'
                         renewal
                FROM lms_ord_prem_receipts,
                     lms_policies,
                     (  SELECT opri_opr_code,
                               NVL (SUM (opri_amt), 0)              premium_amt,
                               NVL (SUM (opri_prem_tax_amt), 0)     prem_tax,
                               NVL (SUM (opri_chk_comm_amt), 0)     chkoff_comm,
                               NVL (SUM (opri_comm_amt), 0)         prem_comm
                          FROM lms_ord_receipt_instlmnts
                         WHERE NVL (inv_all_prem_valid (opri_pol_code), 'N') =
                               'N'
                      GROUP BY opri_opr_code
                      UNION
                        SELECT opri_opr_code,
                               SUM (
                                     NVL (opri_amt, 0)
                                   - lms_investments.basic_prem_ratio (
                                         opri_pol_code,
                                         NVL (opri_amt, 0)))         premium_amt,
                               SUM (NVL (opri_prem_tax_amt, 0))      prem_tax,
                               --   -Lms_Investments.Basic_prem_ratio(OPRI_POL_CODE,NVL(OPRI_PREM_TAX_AMT,0))) prem_tax,
                               SUM (NVL (opri_chk_comm_amt, 0))      chkoff_comm,
                               --  - Lms_Investments.Basic_prem_ratio(OPRI_POL_CODE,NVL(OPRI_CHK_COMM_AMT,0))) chkoff_comm,  --CK commision not correct
                               SUM (
                                     NVL (opri_comm_amt, 0)
                                   - lms_investments.basic_prem_ratio (
                                         opri_pol_code,
                                         NVL (opri_comm_amt, 0)))    prem_comm
                          FROM lms_ord_receipt_instlmnts
                         WHERE NVL (inv_all_prem_valid (opri_pol_code), 'N') =
                               'Y'
                      GROUP BY opri_opr_code),
                     (  SELECT pndpo_opr_code,
                               NVL (SUM (pndpo_tot_amt), 0)
                                   pension_contr,
                               NVL (SUM (pndpo_admin_fee), 0)
                                   investment_fee,
                               NVL (SUM (pndpo_empye_amt), 0)
                                   investment_contri,
                               NVL (SUM (pndpo_empyr_amt), 0)
                                   investment_admin,
                               NVL (SUM (pndpo_comm_amt), 0)
                                   pens_comm
                          FROM lms_pension_deposits_ord
                      GROUP BY pndpo_opr_code)
               WHERE     pol_code = opr_pol_code
                     AND pol_code = v_pol_code
                     AND opri_opr_code(+) = opr_code
                     AND pndpo_opr_code(+) = opr_code
                     AND NVL (v_separate_posting, 'N') = 'N'
            GROUP BY pol_bra_code,
                     pol_prod_code,
                     pol_type,
                     pol_prod_type,
                     pol_policy_no,
                     opr_alloc_to,
                     inv_all_prem_valid (pol_code),
                     opr_code
            UNION ALL
              SELECT NVL (SUM (opr_loan_pymt_amt), 0)
                         loan_amt,
                     NVL (SUM (lms_process_receipts.rcpt_balance (opr_code)),
                          0)
                         un_allocated_amt,
                     NVL (SUM (opr_refund_amt), 0)
                         suspense_amt,
                     -- OPR_PMTH_CODE,
                     NVL (SUM (premium_amt), 0)
                         premium_amt,
                     NVL (SUM (pension_contr), 0)
                         pension_contr,
                     --NVL(SUM(investment_fee),0) investment_fee,
                     DECODE (pol_prod_type,
                             'IN', NVL (SUM (investment_fee), 0),
                             'PN', NVL (SUM (investment_fee), 0),
                             'AN', NVL (SUM (investment_fee), 0),
                             NVL (SUM (opr_policy_fee), 0))
                         investment_fee,
                     NVL (SUM (investment_contri), 0)
                         investment_contri,
                     NVL (SUM (investment_admin), 0)
                         investment_admin,
                     NVL (SUM (opr_fund_client_contr), 0)
                         comfnd,
                     (NVL (SUM (prem_comm), 0) + NVL (SUM (pens_comm), 0))
                         prem_comm,
                     NVL (SUM (pens_comm), 0)
                         pens_comm,
                     NVL (SUM (prem_tax), 0)
                         prem_tax,
                     NVL (SUM (chkoff_comm), 0)
                         chkoff_comm,
                     pol_bra_code,
                     pol_prod_code,
                     pol_type,
                     pol_prod_type,
                     pol_policy_no,
                     opr_code,
                     NVL (opr_alloc_to, 'PR')
                         alloc_to,
                     NVL (inv_all_prem_valid (pol_code), 'N')
                         inv_all_prem,
                     NVL (renewal, pensrenewal)
                         renewal
                FROM lms_ord_prem_receipts,
                     lms_policies,
                     (  SELECT opri_opr_code,
                               NVL (SUM (opri_amt), 0)                        premium_amt,
                               NVL (SUM (opri_prem_tax_amt), 0)               prem_tax,
                               NVL (SUM (opri_chk_comm_amt), 0)               chkoff_comm,
                               NVL (SUM (opri_comm_amt), 0)                   prem_comm,
                               lms_ord_mis.check_renewal (opri_pol_code,
                                                          opri_instlmt_no)    renewal
                          FROM lms_ord_receipt_instlmnts
                         WHERE NVL (inv_all_prem_valid (opri_pol_code), 'N') =
                               'N'
                      GROUP BY opri_opr_code,
                               lms_ord_mis.check_renewal (opri_pol_code,
                                                          opri_instlmt_no)
                      UNION
                        SELECT opri_opr_code,
                               SUM (
                                     NVL (opri_amt, 0)
                                   - lms_investments.basic_prem_ratio (
                                         opri_pol_code,
                                         NVL (opri_amt, 0)))                  premium_amt,
                               SUM (NVL (opri_prem_tax_amt, 0))               prem_tax,
                               --   -Lms_Investments.Basic_prem_ratio(OPRI_POL_CODE,NVL(OPRI_PREM_TAX_AMT,0))) prem_tax,
                               SUM (NVL (opri_chk_comm_amt, 0))               chkoff_comm,
                               --  - Lms_Investments.Basic_prem_ratio(OPRI_POL_CODE,NVL(OPRI_CHK_COMM_AMT,0))) chkoff_comm,  --CK commision not correct
                               SUM (
                                     NVL (opri_comm_amt, 0)
                                   - lms_investments.basic_prem_ratio (
                                         opri_pol_code,
                                         NVL (opri_comm_amt, 0)))             prem_comm,
                               lms_ord_mis.check_renewal (opri_pol_code,
                                                          opri_instlmt_no)    renewal
                          FROM lms_ord_receipt_instlmnts
                         WHERE NVL (inv_all_prem_valid (opri_pol_code), 'N') =
                               'Y'
                      GROUP BY opri_opr_code,
                               lms_ord_mis.check_renewal (opri_pol_code,
                                                          opri_instlmt_no)),
                     (  SELECT pndpo_opr_code,
                               NVL (SUM (pndpo_tot_amt), 0)
                                   pension_contr,
                               NVL (SUM (pndpo_admin_fee), 0)
                                   investment_fee,
                               NVL (SUM (pndpo_empye_amt), 0)
                                   investment_contri,
                               NVL (SUM (pndpo_empyr_amt), 0)
                                   investment_admin,
                               NVL (SUM (pndpo_comm_amt), 0)
                                   pens_comm,
                               lms_ord_mis.check_renewal (pndpo_pol_code,
                                                          pndpo_instlmnt_no)
                                   pensrenewal
                          FROM lms_pension_deposits_ord
                      GROUP BY pndpo_opr_code,
                               lms_ord_mis.check_renewal (pndpo_pol_code,
                                                          pndpo_instlmnt_no))
               WHERE     pol_code = opr_pol_code
                     AND pol_code = v_pol_code
                     AND opri_opr_code(+) = opr_code
                     AND pndpo_opr_code(+) = opr_code
                     AND NVL (v_separate_posting, 'N') = 'Y'
            GROUP BY pol_bra_code,
                     pol_prod_code,
                     pol_type,
                     pol_prod_type,
                     pol_policy_no,
                     opr_alloc_to,
                     inv_all_prem_valid (pol_code),
                     opr_code,
                     NVL (renewal, pensrenewal);

        CURSOR cur_ann_amt IS
            SELECT ann_agn_code, ann_brn_code, ann_prod_code
              FROM lms_annuities
             WHERE ann_code = v_pol_code;

        v_org_code                  NUMBER;
        v_alloc_to                  VARCHAR2 (5);
        v_unalloc_amt               NUMBER := 0;
        v_double_sure_amt           NUMBER := 0;
        v_comp_param                VARCHAR2 (5);
        v_comp_param_status         VARCHAR2 (5);
        v_pol_instlmt_prem          NUMBER;
        v_endr_tot_premium          NUMBER;
        v_rct_code                  VARCHAR2 (100) := 'FROM_AGENT';
        v_apay_method_code          NUMBER;
        v_oppr_receipt_trans_code   VARCHAR2 (100);
        v_agn_oppr_code             NUMBER;
        v_proposal_no               lms_policies.pol_proposal_no%TYPE;
        v_ann_chk                   VARCHAR2 (100);
        v_agn_sht_desc              lms_agencies.agn_sht_desc%TYPE;
        v_prod_code                 lms_policies.pol_prod_code%TYPE;
        v_endr_add_prem_int         NUMBER;
        v_updated_amt               NUMBER;
        v_update_amt                NUMBER;
    BEGIN
        IF v_user_name IS NULL
        THEN
            raise_error ('USER NAME NOT SPECIFIED');
        END IF;

        BEGIN
            lms_ord_misc.system_param_val (
                'ALLOW_FIRSTYR_RENEWAL_SEPARATION',
                v_separate_posting);
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                raise_error (
                    'PARAMETER ERROR...ALLOW_FIRSTYR_RENEWAL_SEPARATION...');
        END;

        IF NVL (v_agn_dbt_amt, 0) > 0
        THEN
            v_apay_method_code := pay_method_code ('VOUCHER');
            v_ann_chk := 'N';

            SELECT v_rct_code || '/' || lms_oppr_receipt_trans_seq.NEXTVAL
              INTO v_oppr_receipt_trans_code
              FROM DUAL;

            BEGIN
                SELECT pol_proposal_no, agn_sht_desc, pol_prod_code
                  INTO v_proposal_no, v_agn_sht_desc, v_prod_code
                  FROM lms_policies, lms_policy_endorsements, lms_agencies
                 WHERE     pol_code = v_pol_code
                       AND pol_current_endr_code = endr_code
                       AND endr_agen_code = agn_code;
            EXCEPTION
                WHEN OTHERS
                THEN
                    raise_error ('Error fetching proposal details......');
            END;

            SELECT    TO_NUMBER (TO_CHAR (SYSDATE, 'RRRR'))
                   || lms_oppr_code_seq.NEXTVAL
              INTO v_agn_oppr_code
              FROM DUAL;

            BEGIN
                INSERT INTO lms_ord_proposal_rcpts (oppr_code,
                                                    oppr_ltr_trans_no,
                                                    oppr_date,
                                                    oppr_cheque_no,
                                                    oppr_amt,
                                                    oppr_pol_code,
                                                    oppr_pol_proposal_no,
                                                    oppr_receipt_no,
                                                    oppr_receipt_date,
                                                    oppr_pmth_code,
                                                    opr_chk_agen_code,
                                                    opri_chk_comm_rate,
                                                    opri_chk_comm_amt,
                                                    oppr_done_by,
                                                    oppr_source,
                                                    oppr_drcr,
                                                    oppr_receipt_trans_code,
                                                    oppr_ann_code,
                                                    oppr_fms_receipt_pk)
                     VALUES (v_agn_oppr_code,
                             NULL,
                             TRUNC (SYSDATE),
                             'FROM_AGENT',
                             v_agn_dbt_amt,
                             v_pol_code,
                             v_proposal_no,
                             v_rct_code,
                             TRUNC (SYSDATE),
                             v_apay_method_code,
                             NULL,
                             NULL,
                             0,
                             v_user_name,
                             'FROM_AGENT',
                             DECODE (SIGN (v_agn_dbt_amt), 1, 'C', 'D'),
                             v_oppr_receipt_trans_code,
                             NULL,
                             NULL);                           --v_pay_method);
            EXCEPTION
                WHEN OTHERS
                THEN
                    raise_error (
                        'ERROR INSERTING PROPOSAL RECEIPT DETAILS......');
            END;

            BEGIN
                lms_process_receipts.agent_debiting (v_pol_code,
                                                     v_user_name,
                                                     TRUNC (SYSDATE),
                                                     v_agn_dbt_amt);
            EXCEPTION
                WHEN OTHERS
                THEN
                    raise_error ('Agent Debit');
            END;
        END IF;

        IF NVL (v_prod_type, 'ED') = 'AN' AND 1 = 2                  --BLOCKED
        THEN
            BEGIN
                SELECT agn_act_code
                  INTO v_acc_type
                  FROM lms_agencies, lms_annuities
                 WHERE agn_code = ann_agn_code AND ann_code = v_pol_code;
            EXCEPTION
                WHEN OTHERS
                THEN
                    raise_error (
                           'SYSTEM UNABLE TO DETERMINE AGENCY TYPE FOR ANNUITY NO. '
                        || v_pol_policy_no
                        || '... ');
            END;

            IF NVL (v_acc_type, 0) NOT IN (1, 13)
            THEN
                v_acc_type := 1;
            END IF;

            v_post := 'Y';

            BEGIN
                SELECT    TO_NUMBER (TO_CHAR (SYSDATE, 'RRRR'))
                       || lms_opr_code_seq.NEXTVAL
                  INTO v_ann_opr_code
                  FROM DUAL;

                INSERT INTO lms_ord_prem_receipts (opr_code,
                                                   opr_ltr_trans_no,
                                                   opr_date,
                                                   opr_cheque_no,
                                                   opr_amt,
                                                   opr_ann_code,
                                                   opr_receipt_no,
                                                   opr_pol_policy_no,
                                                   opr_receipt_date,
                                                   opr_done_by,
                                                   opr_drcr,
                                                   opr_origin,
                                                   opr_alloc_to,
                                                   opr_source)
                    SELECT v_ann_opr_code,
                           oppr_ltr_trans_no,
                           TRUNC (SYSDATE),
                           oppr_cheque_no,
                           v_inst_prem,
                           oppr_ann_code,
                           oppr_receipt_no,
                           v_pol_policy_no,
                           oppr_receipt_date,
                           oppr_done_by,
                           NVL (oppr_drcr, 'C'),
                           'I',
                           'PR',
                           'POLICY_CONVERSION'
                      FROM lms_ord_proposal_rcpts
                     WHERE oppr_code = v_oppr_code;
            EXCEPTION
                WHEN OTHERS
                THEN
                    raise_error (
                           'ERROR INSERTING ANNUITY RECEIPT DETAILS FOR '
                        || v_pol_policy_no
                        || '......');
            END;

            BEGIN
                lms_process_receipts.process_annuity_pymt (v_pol_code,
                                                           v_ann_opr_code,
                                                           v_pol_policy_no,
                                                           v_acc_type,
                                                           'Y');
            EXCEPTION
                WHEN OTHERS
                THEN
                    raise_error ('PROCESSING LMS ANNUITY PAYMENTS....');
            END;
        ELSE
            BEGIN
                SELECT pol_instlmt_prem, endr_tot_premium
                  INTO v_pol_instlmt_prem, v_endr_tot_premium
                  FROM lms_policies, lms_policy_endorsements
                 WHERE     pol_current_endr_code = endr_code
                       AND pol_code = v_pol_code;
            EXCEPTION
                WHEN OTHERS
                THEN
                    raise_error ('ERROR checking policy dtls..');
            END;

            --         IF v_endr_tot_premium != v_pol_instlmt_prem
            --         THEN
            --            raise_error
            --               ('THE POLICY INSTLMT PREMIUM SHOULD BE EQUAL TO ENDORSEMENT TOT PREMIUM=='||v_pol_code
            --               );
            --         END IF;
            BEGIN
                UPDATE lms_ord_proposal_rcpts
                   SET oppr_pol_code = v_pol_code
                 WHERE     oppr_pol_code IS NULL
                       AND oppr_pol_proposal_no IN
                               (SELECT pol_proposal_no
                                  FROM lms_policies
                                 WHERE     pol_proposal_no =
                                           oppr_pol_proposal_no
                                       AND pol_code = v_pol_code);
            EXCEPTION
                WHEN OTHERS
                THEN
                    raise_error ('ERROR UPDATING PROPOSAL RECEIPT DTLS..1..');
            END;

            BEGIN
                UPDATE lms_ord_proposal_rcpts
                   SET oppr_pol_code = v_pol_code
                 WHERE     oppr_pol_code IS NULL
                       AND oppr_pol_proposal_no IN
                               (SELECT pol_policy_no
                                  FROM lms_policies
                                 WHERE     pol_policy_no =
                                           oppr_pol_proposal_no
                                       AND pol_code = v_pol_code);
            EXCEPTION
                WHEN OTHERS
                THEN
                    raise_error ('ERROR UPDATING PROPOSAL RECEIPT DTLS..2..');
            END;

            v_updated_amt := 0;

            FOR prcts IN prp_rcpts
            LOOP
                v_update_amt := 0;

                BEGIN
                    SELECT    TO_NUMBER (TO_CHAR (SYSDATE, 'RRRR'))
                           || lms_opr_code_seq.NEXTVAL
                      INTO v_opr_code
                      FROM DUAL;
                EXCEPTION
                    WHEN OTHERS
                    THEN
                        raise_error (
                            'ERROR POPULATING POLICY RECEIPT SEQUENCE......');
                END;

                IF     prcts.pol_prod_type IN ('PN', 'IN', 'AN')
                   AND prcts.endr_grp_life_rider = 'N'
                THEN
                    v_alloc_to := 'PN';
                ELSE
                    v_alloc_to := 'PR';
                END IF;

                BEGIN
                    v_balance :=
                          NVL (prcts.oppr_amt, 0)
                        - NVL (prcts.oppr_total_ref_amt, 0);

                    INSERT INTO lms_ord_prem_receipts (opr_code,
                                                       opr_ltr_trans_no,
                                                       opr_date,
                                                       opr_cheque_no,
                                                       opr_amt,
                                                       opr_pol_code,
                                                       opr_pol_policy_no,
                                                       opr_receipt_no,
                                                       opr_receipt_date,
                                                       opr_pmth_code,
                                                       opr_done_by,
                                                       opr_drcr,
                                                       opr_production_date,
                                                       opr_within_system,
                                                       opr_origin,
                                                       opr_alloc_to,
                                                       opr_source,
                                                       opr_chk_agen_code,
                                                       opr_chk_comm_rate,
                                                       opr_chk_comm)
                         VALUES (v_opr_code,
                                 prcts.oppr_ltr_trans_no,
                                 TRUNC (SYSDATE),
                                 prcts.oppr_cheque_no,
                                 v_balance,
                                 prcts.oppr_pol_code,
                                 v_pol_policy_no,
                                 prcts.oppr_receipt_no,
                                 prcts.oppr_receipt_date,
                                 prcts.oppr_pmth_code,
                                 prcts.oppr_done_by,
                                 NVL (prcts.oppr_drcr, 'C'),
                                 v_prodctn_date,
                                 NVL (prcts.oppr_within_system, 'Y'),
                                 'I',
                                 v_alloc_to,
                                 'RECEIPTS',
                                 prcts.endr_checkoff_agen_code,
                                 prcts.chkoff_rate,
                                 ((prcts.chkoff_rate / 100) * v_balance));
                EXCEPTION
                    WHEN OTHERS
                    THEN
                        raise_error (
                            'ERROR INSERTING POLICY RECEIPT DETAILS......');
                END;

                IF NOT (   prcts.endr_grp_life_rider = 'N'
                        OR prcts.pol_prod_type IN ('IN', 'AN', 'PN'))
                THEN
                    SELECT DECODE (NVL (prcts.oppr_amt, 0),
                                   0, prcts.oppr_pens_amt,
                                   prcts.oppr_amt)
                      INTO v_bal_amt
                      FROM DUAL;
                ELSE
                    SELECT DECODE (NVL (prcts.oppr_pens_amt, 0),
                                   0, prcts.oppr_amt,
                                   prcts.oppr_pens_amt)
                      INTO v_bal_amt
                      FROM DUAL;
                END IF;

                IF     NVL (prcts.oppr_pay_comm, 'N') = 'N'
                   AND prcts.oppr_source IN ('PREM_BAL_REC')
                THEN
                    v_compute_comm := 'N';
                END IF;

                --**************************** PENSION RECEIPTS *************************************
                IF prcts.pol_prod_type IN ('PN', 'IN', 'AN')
                THEN
                    IF     prcts.oppr_cheque_no IS NULL
                       AND prcts.oppr_receipt_no IS NULL
                    THEN
                        v_chq_rcpt_no := ' ';
                    ELSIF prcts.oppr_receipt_no IS NULL
                    THEN
                        v_chq_rcpt_no := prcts.oppr_cheque_no;
                    ELSIF prcts.oppr_cheque_no IS NULL
                    THEN
                        v_chq_rcpt_no := prcts.oppr_receipt_no;
                    ELSE
                        v_chq_rcpt_no := prcts.oppr_receipt_no;
                    END IF;

                    BEGIN
                        SELECT popns_employer_contr,
                               popns_employee_contr,
                               popns_total_contr
                          INTO v_er_contri, v_ee_contri, v_tot_contri
                          FROM lms_policy_endorsements,
                               lms_policies,
                               lms_pol_ord_pension_dtls,
                               lms_pol_ord_active_pensions
                         WHERE     endr_code = pol_current_endr_code
                               AND popns_pol_code = pol_code
                               AND pol_code = v_pol_code
                               AND poapn_pol_code = popns_pol_code
                               AND poapn_endr_code = endr_code
                               AND poapn_popns_code = popns_code
                               AND popns_status = 'A';
                    EXCEPTION
                        WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND
                        THEN
                            NULL;
                        WHEN TOO_MANY_ROWS
                        THEN
                            raise_error (
                                'MORE THAN ONE ACTIVE PENSION RECORD FOUND');
                        WHEN OTHERS
                        THEN
                            raise_error (
                                'COULD NOT DETERMINE MONTHLY PENSION PAYMENTS..');
                    END;

                    --**************PROCESS INTEREST ACCRUED******************
                    IF NVL (prcts.endr_add_prem_int, 0) >
                       NVL (v_updated_amt, 0)
                    THEN
                        IF NVL (v_bal_amt, 0) >=
                             NVL (prcts.endr_add_prem_int, 0)
                           - NVL (v_updated_amt, 0)
                        THEN
                            v_update_amt :=
                                  NVL (prcts.endr_add_prem_int, 0)
                                - NVL (v_updated_amt, 0);
                        ELSE
                            v_update_amt := v_bal_amt;
                        END IF;

                        v_updated_amt :=
                            NVL (v_updated_amt, 0) + NVL (v_update_amt, 0);
                        v_bal_amt :=
                            NVL (v_bal_amt, 0) - NVL (v_update_amt, 0);

                        BEGIN
                            UPDATE lms_ord_prem_receipts
                               SET opr_reinst_int_amt =
                                         NVL (opr_reinst_int_amt, 0)
                                       + NVL (v_update_amt, 0)
                             WHERE opr_code = v_opr_code;
                        EXCEPTION
                            WHEN OTHERS
                            THEN
                                raise_error (
                                    'UNABLE TO UPDATE ALLOCATION TO INTEREST..1..');
                        END;

                        v_endr_add_prem_int :=
                              NVL (v_endr_add_prem_int, 0)
                            + NVL (v_update_amt, 0);
                    END IF;

                    --***********************************************************

                    --               IF prcts.pol_prod_type IN ('PN')
                    --               THEN
                    --                  BEGIN
                    --                     lms_ord_pensions.process_pension_payments
                    --                                                    (v_pol_code,
                    --                                                     v_opr_code,
                    --                                                     v_chq_rcpt_no,
                    --                                                     v_amt,     --v_er_contri,
                    --                                                     v_bal_amt, --v_ee_contri,
                    --                                                     v_bal_amt
                    --                                                    );        --v_tot_contri);
                    --                  EXCEPTION
                    --                     WHEN OTHERS
                    --                     THEN
                    --                        raise_error ('PROCESS PENS. CONTRI...');
                    --                  END;
                    --               ELSE
                    BEGIN
                        lms_investments.process_receipt (v_pol_code,
                                                         v_opr_code,
                                                         v_tran_no);
                    EXCEPTION
                        WHEN OTHERS
                        THEN
                            raise_error ('PROCESS INV. CONTRI...');
                    END;
                --               END IF;
                END IF;

                BEGIN
                    SELECT agn_act_code
                      INTO v_acc_type
                      FROM lms_agencies,
                           lms_policy_endorsements,
                           lms_policies
                     WHERE     endr_code = pol_current_endr_code
                           AND agn_code = endr_agen_code
                           AND pol_code = v_pol_code;
                ---BY WAIYAKI******************
                --FMS HAS DEFINED   DIRECT AND CK OFF CONTROL ACTS ONLY
                --OTHERS eg in hse agents SHOULD THUS DEFAULT TO DIRECT
                -- 1 = DIRECT 13  = CHECK OFF
                EXCEPTION
                    WHEN OTHERS
                    THEN
                        raise_error (
                               'SYSTEM UNABLE TO DETERMINE AGENCY TYPE FOR=='
                            || v_pol_code);
                END;

                --******************************** PREMIUM RECEIPTS *******************************
                IF     NVL (v_balance, 0) > 0
                   AND NOT (   (    prcts.pol_prod_type IN ('PN')
                                AND prcts.endr_grp_life_rider = 'N')
                            OR (prcts.pol_prod_type IN ('IN', 'AN')))
                THEN
                    v_only_due_inst := 'N';

                    --**************PROCESS INTEREST ACCRUED******************
                    IF NVL (prcts.endr_add_prem_int, 0) >
                       NVL (v_updated_amt, 0)
                    THEN
                        IF NVL (v_bal_amt, 0) >=
                             NVL (prcts.endr_add_prem_int, 0)
                           - NVL (v_updated_amt, 0)
                        THEN
                            v_update_amt :=
                                  NVL (prcts.endr_add_prem_int, 0)
                                - NVL (v_updated_amt, 0);
                        ELSE
                            v_update_amt := v_bal_amt;
                        END IF;

                        v_updated_amt :=
                            NVL (v_updated_amt, 0) + NVL (v_update_amt, 0);
                        v_bal_amt :=
                            NVL (v_bal_amt, 0) - NVL (v_update_amt, 0);

                        BEGIN
                            UPDATE lms_ord_prem_receipts
                               SET opr_reinst_int_amt =
                                         NVL (opr_reinst_int_amt, 0)
                                       + NVL (v_update_amt, 0)
                             WHERE opr_code = v_opr_code;
                        EXCEPTION
                            WHEN OTHERS
                            THEN
                                raise_error (
                                    'UNABLE TO UPDATE ALLOCATION TO INTEREST..2..');
                        END;

                        v_endr_add_prem_int :=
                              NVL (v_endr_add_prem_int, 0)
                            + NVL (v_update_amt, 0);
                    END IF;

                    --***********************************************************
                    BEGIN
                        lms_process_receipts.lms_ord_premium_receipts (
                            v_pol_code,
                            v_opr_code,
                            v_multiple_inst,
                            v_only_due_inst,
                            v_tran_no,
                            v_acc_type,
                            v_bal_amt,
                            NVL (v_compute_comm, 'Y'));
                    EXCEPTION
                        WHEN OTHERS
                        THEN
                            raise_error ('PROCESS LMS PREM PYMTS...');
                    END;
                END IF;

                IF NVL (v_acc_type, 0) NOT IN (1, 13)
                THEN
                    v_acc_type := 1;
                END IF;

                v_post := 'Y';
            END LOOP;
        END IF;

        IF     lms_api.interface_enabled ('POLCONV') = TRUE
           AND NVL (v_post, 'N') = 'Y'
        THEN
            v_gl_count := -1;
            v_credit := 0;

            SELECT    TO_NUMBER (TO_CHAR (SYSDATE, 'RRRR'))
                   || lms_transaction_seq.NEXTVAL
              INTO v_trans_code
              FROM DUAL;

            IF v_acc_type IS NULL
            THEN
                raise_error ('ACC TYPE IS NULL');
            END IF;

            IF NVL (v_prod_type, 'ED') = 'AN' AND 1 = 2              --BLOCKED
            THEN
                FOR an IN cur_ann_amt
                LOOP
                    v_org_code :=
                        fms_interfaces_pkg.get_org (an.ann_brn_code);
                    v_polcode := NULL;

                    IF NVL (v_inst_prem, 0) <> 0
                    THEN
                        get_gl_code ('UP',
                                     an.ann_prod_code,
                                     v_trnt_code,
                                     v_trnt_gl_code,
                                     v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
                        valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                                   v_org_code,
                                   an.ann_brn_code,
                                   'UP');
                        get_gl_code ('PRRCT',
                                     an.ann_prod_code,
                                     v_trnt_code,
                                     v_contra_acc,
                                     v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
                        valid_acc (v_contra_acc,
                                   v_org_code,
                                   an.ann_brn_code,
                                   'PRRCT');
                        v_gl_count := v_gl_count + 2;
                        interface_append_gl (
                            v_trans_code,
                            --v_trans_code         NUMBER,
                            v_user_name,
                            --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                            NULL,                --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                            an.ann_prod_code,
                            --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                            v_pol_policy_no,
                            --v_vchr_no           VARCHAR2,
                            v_ann_opr_code,
                            --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                            NULL,                --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                            NULL,               --v_rcpt_no          VARCHAR2,
                            v_gl_count,
                            --v_count             NUMBER,
                            'PREMIUM INCOME-' || v_pol_policy_no,
                            --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                            v_inst_prem,
                            --v_amount            NUMBER,
                            'C',               --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                            v_trnt_gl_code,
                            --v_acc_1          VARCHAR2,
                            v_contra_acc,
                            --v_acc_2          VARCHAR2,
                            an.ann_brn_code,
                            --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                            v_gl_trans);
                    --v_trn_rec   IN OUT Fms_Vouchers_Pkg.Tgl_rec_type,
                    END IF;
                END LOOP;
            ELSE
                FOR pl IN cur_pol_cb_amt
                LOOP
                    v_org_code :=
                        fms_interfaces_pkg.get_org (pl.pol_bra_code);
                    get_gl_code ('PRRCT',
                                 pl.pol_prod_code,
                                 v_trnt_code,
                                 v_contra_acc,
                                 v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                 NULL,
                                 pl.renewal);
                    valid_acc (v_contra_acc,
                               v_org_code,
                               pl.pol_bra_code,
                               'PRRCT');

                    --premium
                    IF NVL (pl.premium_amt, 0) <> 0
                    THEN
                        get_gl_code ('UP',
                                     pl.pol_prod_code,
                                     v_trnt_code,
                                     v_trnt_gl_code,
                                     v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                     NULL,
                                     pl.renewal);
                        valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                                   v_org_code,
                                   pl.pol_bra_code,
                                   'UP');
                        v_gl_count := v_gl_count + 2;
                        interface_append_gl (
                            v_trans_code,
                            --v_trans_code         NUMBER,
                            v_user_name,
                            --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                            v_pol_code,
                            --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                            pl.pol_prod_code,
                            --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                            pl.pol_policy_no,
                            --v_vchr_no          VARCHAR2,
                            pl.opr_code,                   --          NUMBER,
                            NULL,                --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                            NULL,               --v_rcpt_no          VARCHAR2,
                            v_gl_count,
                            --v_count             NUMBER,
                            'PREMIUM INCOME-' || pl.pol_policy_no,
                            --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                            pl.premium_amt,
                            --v_amount            NUMBER,
                            'C',               --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                            v_trnt_gl_code,
                            --v_acc_1          VARCHAR2,
                            v_contra_acc,
                            --v_acc_2          VARCHAR2,
                            pl.pol_bra_code,
                            --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                            v_gl_trans);
                    --v_trn_rec   IN OUT Fms_Vouchers_Pkg.Tgl_rec_type,
                    END IF;

                    IF NVL (pl.investment_fee, 0) <> 0
                    THEN
                        --Investment Fee
                        get_gl_code ('INVFEE',
                                     pl.pol_prod_code,
                                     v_trnt_code,
                                     v_trnt_gl_code,
                                     v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                     NULL,
                                     pl.renewal);
                        valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                                   v_org_code,
                                   pl.pol_bra_code,
                                   'INVFEE');
                        v_gl_count := v_gl_count + 2;
                        interface_append_gl (
                            v_trans_code,
                            --v_trans_code          NUMBER,
                            v_user_name,
                            --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                            v_pol_code,
                            --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                            pl.pol_prod_code,
                            --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                            pl.pol_policy_no,
                            --v_vchr_no          VARCHAR2,
                            pl.opr_code,
                            --NULL, --          NUMBER,
                            NULL,                --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                            NULL,               --v_rcpt_no          VARCHAR2,
                            v_gl_count,
                            --v_count             NUMBER,
                            'INVESTMENT FEE-' || pl.pol_policy_no,
                            --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                            pl.investment_fee,
                            --v_amount            NUMBER,
                            'C',               --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                            v_trnt_gl_code,
                            --v_acc_1          VARCHAR2,
                            v_contra_acc,
                            --v_acc_2        VARCHAR2,
                            pl.pol_bra_code,
                            --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                            v_gl_trans);
                    --v_trn_rec   IN OUT Fms_Vouchers_Pkg.Tgl_rec_type,
                    END IF;

                    IF NVL (pl.pension_contr, 0) <> 0
                    THEN
                        IF    NVL (pl.pol_prod_type, 'PN') IN ('IN', 'AN')
                           OR NVL (pl.inv_all_prem, 'N') = 'Y'
                        THEN
                            IF NVL (pl.investment_admin, 0) <> 0
                            THEN
                                --Investment Administration
                                get_gl_code ('INVADM',
                                             pl.pol_prod_code,
                                             v_trnt_code,
                                             v_trnt_gl_code,
                                             v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                             NULL,
                                             pl.renewal);
                                valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                                           v_org_code,
                                           pl.pol_bra_code,
                                           'INVADM');
                                v_gl_count := v_gl_count + 2;
                                interface_append_gl (
                                    v_trans_code,
                                    --v_trans_code          NUMBER,
                                    v_user_name,
                                    --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                                    v_pol_code,
                                    --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                                    pl.pol_prod_code,
                                    --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                                    pl.pol_policy_no,
                                    --v_vchr_no          VARCHAR2,
                                    pl.opr_code,           --          NUMBER,
                                    NULL,
                                    --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                                    NULL,
                                    --v_rcpt_no          VARCHAR2,
                                    v_gl_count,
                                       --v_count             NUMBER,
                                       'INVESTMENT ADMINISTRATION-'
                                    || pl.pol_policy_no,
                                    --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                                    pl.investment_admin,
                                    --v_amount            NUMBER,
                                    'C',
                                    --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                                    v_trnt_gl_code,
                                    --v_acc_1          VARCHAR2,
                                    v_contra_acc,
                                    --v_acc_2        VARCHAR2,
                                    pl.pol_bra_code,
                                    --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                                    v_gl_trans);
                            --v_trn_rec   IN OUT Fms_Vouchers_Pkg.Tgl_rec_type,
                            END IF;

                            IF NVL (pl.investment_contri, 0) <> 0
                            THEN
                                --Investment Premium
                                get_gl_code ('INVPREM',
                                             pl.pol_prod_code,
                                             v_trnt_code,
                                             v_trnt_gl_code,
                                             v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                             NULL,
                                             pl.renewal);
                                valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                                           v_org_code,
                                           pl.pol_bra_code,
                                           'INVPREM');
                                v_gl_count := v_gl_count + 2;
                                interface_append_gl (
                                    v_trans_code,
                                    --v_trans_code          NUMBER,
                                    v_user_name,
                                    --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                                    v_pol_code,
                                    --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                                    pl.pol_prod_code,
                                    --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                                    pl.pol_policy_no,
                                    --v_vchr_no          VARCHAR2,
                                    pl.opr_code,
                                    --NULL, --          NUMBER,
                                    NULL,
                                    --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                                    NULL,
                                    --v_rcpt_no          VARCHAR2,
                                    v_gl_count,
                                    --v_count             NUMBER,
                                    'INVESTMENT PREMIUM-' || pl.pol_policy_no,
                                    --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                                    pl.investment_contri,
                                    --v_amount            NUMBER,
                                    'C',
                                    --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                                    v_trnt_gl_code,
                                    --v_acc_1          VARCHAR2,
                                    v_contra_acc,
                                    --v_acc_2        VARCHAR2,
                                    pl.pol_bra_code,
                                    --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                                    v_gl_trans);
                            --v_trn_rec   IN OUT Fms_Vouchers_Pkg.Tgl_rec_type,
                            END IF;
                        ELSE
                            --Pension Contribution
                            get_gl_code ('PN',
                                         pl.pol_prod_code,
                                         v_trnt_code,
                                         v_trnt_gl_code,
                                         v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                         NULL,
                                         pl.renewal);
                            valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                                       v_org_code,
                                       pl.pol_bra_code,
                                       'PN');
                            v_gl_count := v_gl_count + 2;
                            interface_append_gl (
                                v_trans_code,
                                --v_trans_code        NUMBER,
                                v_user_name,
                                --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                                v_pol_code,
                                --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                                pl.pol_prod_code,
                                --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                                pl.pol_policy_no,
                                --v_vchr_no          VARCHAR2,
                                pl.opr_code,
                                --NULL, --  v_opr_code        NUMBER,
                                NULL,            --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                                NULL,           --v_rcpt_no          VARCHAR2,
                                v_gl_count,
                                --v_count             NUMBER,
                                'PENSION CONTRIBUTION-' || pl.pol_policy_no,
                                --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                                pl.pension_contr,
                                --v_amount            NUMBER,
                                'C',           --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                                v_trnt_gl_code,
                                --v_acc_1          VARCHAR2,
                                v_contra_acc,
                                --v_acc_2         VARCHAR2,
                                pl.pol_bra_code,
                                --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                                v_gl_trans);
                        --v_trn_rec   IN OUT Fms_Vouchers_Pkg.Tgl_rec_type,
                        END IF;
                    END IF;

                    IF NVL (pl.comfnd, 0) <> 0
                    THEN
                        BEGIN
                            SELECT param_value, param_status
                              INTO v_comp_param, v_comp_param_status
                              FROM lms_parameters
                             WHERE param_name = 'CONSOLIDATE_COMP_FUND';
                        EXCEPTION
                            WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND
                            THEN
                                raise_error (
                                    'SYSTEM PARAMETER "CONSOLIDATE_COMP_FUND" NOT DEFINED....CONSULT THE SYSTEM ADMIN....');
                            WHEN OTHERS
                            THEN
                                raise_error (
                                    'SYSTEM PARAMETER "CONSOLIDATE_COMP_FUND" ERROR...');
                        END;

                        IF NOT (    NVL (v_comp_param, 'N') = 'Y'
                                AND NVL (v_comp_param_status, 'N') = 'A')
                        THEN
                            --Compensation fund...
                            get_gl_code ('CMPFND',
                                         pl.pol_prod_code,
                                         v_trnt_code,
                                         v_trnt_gl_code,
                                         v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                         NULL,
                                         pl.renewal);
                            valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                                       v_org_code,
                                       pl.pol_bra_code,
                                       'CMPFND');
                            v_gl_count := v_gl_count + 2;
                            interface_append_gl (
                                v_trans_code,
                                --v_trans_code        NUMBER,
                                v_user_name,
                                --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                                v_pol_code,
                                --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                                pl.pol_prod_code,
                                --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                                pl.pol_policy_no,
                                --v_vchr_no          VARCHAR2,
                                pl.opr_code,
                                --NULL, --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                                NULL,            --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                                NULL,           --v_rcpt_no          VARCHAR2,
                                v_gl_count,
                                --v_count             NUMBER,
                                'COMPENSATION FUND-' || pl.pol_policy_no,
                                --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                                pl.comfnd,
                                --v_amount            NUMBER,
                                'C',           --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                                v_trnt_gl_code,
                                --v_acc_1          VARCHAR2,
                                v_contra_acc,
                                --v_acc_2         VARCHAR2,
                                pl.pol_bra_code,
                                --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                                v_gl_trans);
                        --v_trn_rec   IN OUT Fms_Vouchers_Pkg.Tgl_rec_type,
                        END IF;
                    END IF;
                END LOOP;
            END IF;

            IF NVL (v_endr_add_prem_int, 0) <> 0
            THEN
                get_gl_code ('REIN_INT',
                             v_prod_code,
                             v_trnt_code,
                             v_trnt_gl_code,
                             v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
                --check if accounts exist in policy branch
                valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                           v_org_code,
                           v_pol_bra_code,
                           'REIN_INT');
                v_gl_count := NVL (v_gl_count, 0) + 2;
                interface_append_gl (v_trans_code, --v_trans_code        NUMBER,
                                     v_user_name, --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                                     v_pol_code, --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                                     v_prod_code, --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                                     v_pol_policy_no,
                                     --v_vchr_no          VARCHAR2,
                                     NULL,       --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                                     NULL,       --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                                     NULL,      --v_rcpt_no          VARCHAR2,
                                     v_gl_count, --v_count             NUMBER,
                                     'ADD/REF INT.',
                                     --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                                     v_endr_add_prem_int,
                                     --v_amount            NUMBER,
                                     'C',      --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                                     v_trnt_gl_code,
                                     --v_acc_number1       VARCHAR2,
                                     v_contra_acc,
                                     --v_acc_number2        VARCHAR2,
                                     v_pol_bra_code, --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                                     v_gl_trans);
            END IF;

            IF NVL (v_agn_dbt_amt, 0) > 0
            THEN
                --Agent debiting..
                get_gl_code ('AGNT_DBT',
                             v_prod_code,
                             v_trnt_code,
                             v_trnt_gl_code,
                             v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
                valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                           v_org_code,
                           v_pol_bra_code,
                           'AGNT_DBT');
                get_gl_code ('PRRCT',
                             v_prod_code,
                             v_trnt_code,
                             v_contra_acc,
                             v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
                valid_acc (v_contra_acc,
                           v_org_code,
                           v_pol_bra_code,
                           'AGNT_DBT CONTRA');
                v_gl_count := v_gl_count + 2;
                interface_append_gl (
                    v_trans_code,                --v_trans_code        NUMBER,
                    v_user_name,               --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                    v_pol_code,                  --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                    v_prod_code,
                    --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                    v_pol_policy_no,
                    --v_vchr_no          VARCHAR2,
                    NULL,                        --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                    v_agn_oppr_code,
                    --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                    v_rct_code,                 --v_rcpt_no          VARCHAR2,
                    v_gl_count,                  --v_count             NUMBER,
                       'DEBITING AGENT: '
                    || v_agn_sht_desc
                    || ' - '
                    || v_pol_policy_no,
                    --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                    v_agn_dbt_amt,               --v_amount            NUMBER,
                    'C',                       --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                    v_contra_acc,                 --v_acc_1          VARCHAR2,
                    v_trnt_gl_code,                --v_acc_2         VARCHAR2,
                    v_pol_bra_code,              --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                    v_gl_trans --v_trn_rec   IN OUT Fms_Vouchers_Pkg.Tgl_rec_type,
                              );
            END IF;

            v_unalloc_amt := 0;
            interface_update_vgl (v_trans_code,     --v_trans_code     NUMBER,
                                  v_user_name, --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                                  v_polcode,     --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                                  NVL (v_prodctn_date, TRUNC (SYSDATE)),
                                  --v_date              DATE,
                                  NULL,          --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                                  NULL,          --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                                  'LMS PROPOSAL CONVERSION',
                                  --v_btc_description   VARCHAR2,
                                  'JV',     --v_btc_type             VARCHAR2,
                                  v_pol_bra_code, --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                                  'PROPOSAL CONVERSION VOUCHER',
                                  --v_description       VARCHAR2,
                                  v_pol_policy_no, --v_ref             VARCHAR2,
                                  v_gl_trans);
        --v_gl_trans  IN OUT  Fms_Vouchers_Pkg.Tgl_rec_type,
        END IF;

        IF v_gl_count = 0
        THEN
            raise_application_error (-20001, 'JV NOT CREATED');
        END IF;
    EXCEPTION
        WHEN OTHERS
        THEN
            raise_application_error (
                -20001,
                'POL CONVERSION . ' || SQLERRM (SQLCODE));
    END policy_conversion_rcpts_clnup;

    PROCEDURE post_agent_dbf (
        v_nc_code                   NUMBER,
        v_user                      VARCHAR2,
        v_dbf_type                  VARCHAR2 DEFAULT NULL,
        v_otop_receipt_trans_code   VARCHAR2 DEFAULT NULL,
        v_receipt_pk                NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
        v_rct_code                  VARCHAR2 DEFAULT NULL,
        v_curr_trans_no             NUMBER DEFAULT NULL
    )
    IS
        v_chq_dtls_rec          fms_cheques_pkg.type_rqn_dtls_table;
        v_gl_trans              tq_fms.fms_vouchers_pkg.tgl_rec_type;
        vgl_code                NUMBER;
        v_gl_count              NUMBER := -1;
        v_trnt_code             VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_contra_acc            VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_trnt_gl_code          VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_trnt_contra_gl_code   VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_count                 NUMBER := 0;
        v_org_code              NUMBER;
        v_amt                   NUMBER;
        v_prod_code             NUMBER;
        v_payee                 VARCHAR2 (50);
        v_brn_code              NUMBER;
        v_desc                  VARCHAR2 (50);
        v_desc1                 VARCHAR2 (50);
        v_trans_code            NUMBER;
        v_otop_code             NUMBER;
        v_ref                   VARCHAR2 (200);
        v_done_by               lms_comm_advances.cad_done_by%TYPE;
        v_lalt_code             NUMBER;
        v_lalt_description      lms_agent_loan_types.lalt_description%TYPE;
        v_lalt_type             lms_agent_loan_types.lalt_type%TYPE;
        v_desc2                 VARCHAR2 (50);
    BEGIN
        SELECT    TO_NUMBER (TO_CHAR (SYSDATE, 'RRRR'))
               || lms_transaction_seq.NEXTVAL
          INTO v_trans_code
          FROM DUAL;

        IF v_dbf_type IS NOT NULL
        THEN
            v_desc := 'DIRECT AGENT DBF.PYMT.';
            v_desc1 := 'AGENT DEBIT BROUGHT FORWARD';

            BEGIN
                SELECT nc_brn_code,
                       otop_code,
                       NVL (otop_alloc_amt, otop_amt),
                       otop_done_by,
                       TRIM (
                              agn_other_names
                           || ' '
                           || TRIM (agn_md_name || ' ' || agn_name))
                  INTO v_brn_code,
                       v_otop_code,
                       v_amt,
                       v_done_by,
                       v_payee
                  FROM lms_ord_other_pymts, lms_negative_comm, lms_agencies
                 WHERE     otop_nc_code = nc_code
                       AND nc_code = v_nc_code
                       AND otop_receipt_no = v_rct_code
                       AND otop_fms_receipt_pk = v_receipt_pk
                       AND agn_code = nc_agn_code
                       AND otop_receipt_trans_code =
                           v_otop_receipt_trans_code;
            EXCEPTION
                WHEN OTHERS
                THEN
                    tqc_error_manager.raise_error (
                        270104901,
                        text_in     =>
                            'Unable to fetch agent Debit BF receipt details. ',
                        name1_in    => 'v_nc_code',
                        value1_in   => TO_CHAR (v_nc_code));
            END;
        END IF;

        v_org_code := fms_interfaces_pkg.get_org (v_brn_code);

        IF NVL (v_amt, 0) <> 0
        THEN
            get_gl_code ('AGNDBF',
                         v_prod_code,
                         v_trnt_code,
                         v_trnt_gl_code,
                         v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
            valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                       v_org_code,
                       v_brn_code,
                       'AGNADV');
            valid_acc (v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                       v_org_code,
                       v_brn_code,
                       'AGNDBF CONTRA');
            get_gl_code ('MISC_RCT',
                         v_prod_code,
                         v_trnt_code,
                         v_contra_acc,
                         v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
            valid_acc (v_contra_acc,
                       v_org_code,
                       v_brn_code,
                       'MISC_RCT');
            --v_gl_count := NVL (v_gl_count, 0) + 2;
            v_gl_count := v_gl_count + 2;
            interface_append_gl (v_trans_code,                -- v_trans_code,
                                 v_user,                        -- v_raise_by,
                                 NULL,                          -- v_pol_code,
                                 NULL,                         -- v_prod_code,
                                 NULL,                           -- v_vchr_no,
                                 NULL,                          -- v_opr_code,
                                 NULL,                         -- v_oppr_code,
                                 NULL,                            --v_rcpt_no,
                                 v_gl_count,                       -- v_count,
                                 v_desc1,                      -- v_narrative,
                                 NVL (v_amt, 0),                  -- v_amount,
                                 'D',                               -- v_drcr,
                                 v_contra_acc,               -- v_acc_number1,
                                 v_trnt_gl_code,             -- v_acc_number2,
                                 v_brn_code,                 -- v_branch_code,
                                 v_gl_trans,
                                 NULL,                          --v_otop_code,
                                 v_otop_code);                  --v_otop_code,
        END IF;

        --step 2 create GL voucher
        IF v_gl_count != 0
        THEN
            BEGIN
                SELECT DECODE (NVL (v_rct_code, TO_CHAR (-200)),
                               TO_CHAR (-200), TO_CHAR (v_nc_code),
                               v_rct_code)
                  INTO v_ref
                  FROM DUAL;

                interface_update_vgl (v_trans_code,            --v_trans_code,
                                      v_user,                    --v_raise_by,
                                      NULL,                      --v_pol_code,
                                      TRUNC (SYSDATE),               --v_date,
                                      NULL,                      --v_opr_code,
                                      NULL,                     --v_oppr_code,
                                      v_desc1,
                                      -- 'AGENT ADVANCE',  --v_btc_description,
                                      'JV',                      --v_btc_type,
                                      v_brn_code,             --v_branch_code,
                                      v_desc,                 --v_description,
                                      v_ref,                      --v_rcpt_no,
                                      v_gl_trans,
                                      NULL,                     --v_otop_code,
                                      v_otop_code); --v_otop_code,  --v_gl_trans);
            EXCEPTION
                WHEN OTHERS
                THEN
                    raise_error ('POPULATING GL DETAILS');
            END;
        END IF;
    EXCEPTION
        WHEN OTHERS
        THEN
            raise_application_error (-20067,
                                     'AGNT. DBF . ' || SQLERRM (SQLCODE));
    END post_agent_dbf;

    PROCEDURE postclientupaidbonuses1452013 (
        v_amount             NUMBER,
        v_prod_code          NUMBER,
        v_pol_code           NUMBER,
        v_brh_code           NUMBER,
        v_policy_no          VARCHAR2,
        v_user_name          VARCHAR2,
        v_transaction_type   VARCHAR2,
        vpayee               VARCHAR2
    )
    IS
        v_narrative             VARCHAR2 (50) := 'UNDERRAISED BONUSES';
        v_trnt_code             VARCHAR2 (10);
        v_trnt_gl_code          VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_trnt_contra_gl_code   VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_renewal               VARCHAR2 (2);
        v_count                 NUMBER;
        v_gl_trans              fms_vouchers_pkg.tgl_rec_type;
        v_chq_dtls_rec          fms_cheques_pkg.type_rqn_dtls_table;
        v_trans_no              NUMBER;
        v_trans_code            NUMBER;
        v_org_code              NUMBER;
        v_vchr_no               VARCHAR2 (100);
        v_payee                 VARCHAR2 (100);
        v_prepared_by           VARCHAR2 (100);
        v_bbr_code              NUMBER;
        v_account_number        VARCHAR2 (100);
        v_trans_desc            VARCHAR2 (100);
    BEGIN
        SELECT    TO_NUMBER (TO_CHAR (SYSDATE, 'RRRR'))
               || lms_transaction_seq.NEXTVAL
          INTO v_trans_code
          FROM DUAL;

        v_org_code := fms_interfaces_pkg.get_org (v_brh_code);
        v_vchr_no := lms_api.trans_voucher ('SUR');
        v_prepared_by := v_user_name;

        SELECT DECODE (v_transaction_type, 'RVB', 'BONUS', 'INTREST')
          INTO v_trans_desc
          FROM DUAL;

        BEGIN
            SELECT psur_payee, psur_bbr_code, psur_bbr_acc_no
              INTO v_payee, v_bbr_code, v_account_number
              FROM lms_policy_surrenders
             WHERE psur_pol_code = v_pol_code;
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND
            THEN
                NULL;
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                raise_error ('Error fetching payee details...........');
        END;

        IF vpayee IS NOT NULL
        THEN
            v_payee := vpayee;
        END IF;

        IF NVL (v_amount, 0) > 0
        THEN
            get_gl_code ('POL_SURR',
                         v_prod_code,
                         v_trnt_code,
                         v_trnt_gl_code,
                         v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                         NULL,
                         v_renewal);
            valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                       v_org_code,
                       v_brh_code,
                       'POL_SURR');
            valid_acc (v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                       v_org_code,
                       v_brh_code,
                       'POL_SURR CONTRA');
            v_count := v_count + 1;
            interface_append_gl (v_trans_code,  --v_trans_code         NUMBER,
                                 v_user_name,  --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                                 v_pol_code,     --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                                 v_prod_code,    --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                                 v_vchr_no,   --v_vchr_no            VARCHAR2,
                                 NULL,           --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                                 NULL,           --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                                 NULL,        --v_rcpt_no            VARCHAR2,
                                 v_count,        --v_count             NUMBER,
                                 v_narrative || v_policy_no,
                                 --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                                 NVL (v_amount, 0),
                                 --v_amount            NUMBER,
                                 'D',          --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                                 v_trnt_gl_code,
                                 --v_acc_number          VARCHAR2,
                                 v_brh_code,     --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                                 v_gl_trans);
            v_trans_no := NVL (v_trans_no, 0) + 1;
            interface_append_chq (v_trans_code,   --v_trans_code       NUMBER,
                                  v_user_name,
                                  --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                                  v_pol_code,   --v_pol_code           NUMBER,
                                  v_prod_code,
                                  --v_prod_code          NUMBER,
                                  v_vchr_no,
                                  --v_vchr_no             VARCHAR2,
                                  v_trans_no,   --v_count              NUMBER,
