                                  v_amount,     --v_amount             NUMBER,
                                  v_narrative || v_policy_no,
                                  --v_narrative          VARCHAR2,
                                  v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                  --v_acc_number          VARCHAR2,
                                  v_org_code,
                                  --v_acc_org_code        NUMBER,
                                  v_brh_code,   --v_branch_code        NUMBER,
                                  'D',        --v_drcr               VARCHAR2,
                                  v_chq_dtls_rec);
            interface_create_reqn (
                v_trans_code,                  --v_trans_code          NUMBER,
                v_vchr_no,                 --v_ref                   VARCHAR2,
                v_vchr_no,                 --v_ref2                  VARCHAR2,
                TRUNC (SYSDATE),               --v_ref_date              DATE,
                   'UNDERRAISED'
                || ' '
                || v_trans_desc
                || v_policy_no
                || '('
                || 'CHQ'
                || ')',                    --v_narrative             VARCHAR2,
                NVL (v_amount, 0),           --v_amount                NUMBER,
                v_payee,                   --v_payee                 VARCHAR2,
                'CHQ',
                --v_pay_method            VARCHAR2, --CHQ, EFT
                v_account_number,
                --v_payee_bank_acc_no        VARCHAR2,
                v_bbr_code,               --v_payee_bank_branch_code   NUMBER,
                v_user_name,               --v_source_auth_by        VARCHAR2,
                TRUNC (SYSDATE),               --v_source_auth_dt        DATE,
                v_prepared_by,           --v_raise_by                VARCHAR2,
                'POL_SURR',                --v_pmt_type              VARCHAR2,
                v_brh_code,                   --v_branch_code          NUMBER,
                v_pol_code,                                      --v_pol_code,
                v_chq_dtls_rec);
        END IF;
    END postclientupaidbonuses1452013;

    PROCEDURE postclientupaidbonuses (
        v_amount             NUMBER,

        v_user_name          VARCHAR2,

    )
    IS
        v_narrative             VARCHAR2 (50) := 'UNDERRAISED BONUSES';
        v_trnt_code             VARCHAR2 (10);
        v_trnt_gl_code          VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_trnt_contra_gl_code   VARCHAR2 (20);

        v_count                 NUMBER := 0;
        v_gl_count              NUMBER := 0;
        v_gl_trans              fms_vouchers_pkg.tgl_rec_type;
        v_chq_dtls_rec          fms_cheques_pkg.type_rqn_dtls_table;
        v_trans_no              NUMBER;
        v_trans_code            NUMBER;
        v_org_code              NUMBER;
        v_vchr_no               VARCHAR2 (100);
        v_payee                 VARCHAR2 (100);
        v_prepared_by           VARCHAR2 (100);
        v_bbr_code              NUMBER;
        v_account_number        VARCHAR2 (100);
        v_trans_desc            VARCHAR2 (100);
        v_pay_method            VARCHAR2 (10);
    BEGIN
        SELECT    TO_NUMBER (TO_CHAR (SYSDATE, 'RRRR'))
               || lms_transaction_seq.NEXTVAL
          INTO v_trans_code
          FROM DUAL;

        v_vchr_no := lms_api.trans_voucher ('SUR');
        v_prepared_by := v_user_name;

        SELECT DECODE (v_transaction_type, 'RVB', 'BONUS', 'INTREST')
          INTO v_trans_desc
          FROM DUAL;

        BEGIN
            SELECT cuc_pay_method,
                   cuc_bbr_code,
                   cuc_bank_acc_no,
                   cuc_ltr_trans_no
              INTO v_pay_method,
                   v_bbr_code,
                   v_account_number,
                   v_trans_no
              FROM lms_client_underraised_claim
             WHERE cuc_code = v_cuc_code;
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND
            THEN
                NULL;
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                raise_error ('Error fetching payment details....');
        END;

        BEGIN
            UPDATE lms_client_underraised_claim
               SET cuc_voucher_no = v_vchr_no
             WHERE cuc_code = v_cuc_code;
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND
            THEN
                NULL;
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                raise_error ('Error updating payment details..1..');
        END;

        IF v_bbr_code IS NULL OR v_account_number IS NULL
        THEN
            BEGIN
                SELECT psur_payee, psur_bbr_code, psur_bbr_acc_no
                  INTO v_payee, v_bbr_code, v_account_number
                  FROM lms_policy_surrenders
                 WHERE psur_pol_code = v_pol_code;
            EXCEPTION
                WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND
                THEN
                    NULL;
                WHEN OTHERS
                THEN
                    raise_error ('Error fetching payee details...........');
            END;
        END IF;

        IF vpayee IS NOT NULL
        THEN
            v_payee := vpayee;
        END IF;

        IF NVL (v_amount, 0) > 0
        THEN
            get_gl_code ('POL_SURR',
                         v_prod_code,
                         v_trnt_code,
                         v_trnt_gl_code,
                         v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                         NULL,
                         v_renewal);
            valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                       v_org_code,
                       v_brh_code,
                       'POL_SURR');
            valid_acc (v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                       v_org_code,
                       v_brh_code,
                       'POL_SURR CONTRA');
            v_gl_count := v_gl_count + 1;
            interface_append_gl (v_trans_code,  --v_trans_code         NUMBER,

    PROCEDURE postclientupaidinterests13513 (
        v_intr        NUMBER,
        v_prod_code   NUMBER,
        v_pol_code    NUMBER,
        v_brh_code    NUMBER,
        v_policy_no   VARCHAR2,
        v_user_name   VARCHAR2,
        vpayee        VARCHAR2,
        v_cuc_code    NUMBER DEFAULT NULL
    )
    IS
        v_narrative             VARCHAR2 (50) := 'INTR. WITHDRAWAL -';
        v_trnt_code             VARCHAR2 (10);
        v_trnt_gl_code          VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_trnt_contra_gl_code   VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_renewal               VARCHAR2 (2);
        v_count                 NUMBER;
        v_gl_trans              fms_vouchers_pkg.tgl_rec_type;
        v_chq_dtls_rec          fms_cheques_pkg.type_rqn_dtls_table;
        v_trans_no              NUMBER;
        v_trans_code            NUMBER;
        v_org_code              NUMBER;
        v_vchr_no               VARCHAR2 (100);
        v_payee                 VARCHAR2 (100);
        v_prepared_by           VARCHAR2 (100);
        v_bbr_code              NUMBER;
        v_account_number        VARCHAR2 (100);
        v_pay_method            VARCHAR2 (10);
    BEGIN
        v_prepared_by := v_user_name;
        v_org_code := fms_interfaces_pkg.get_org (v_brh_code);
        v_vchr_no := lms_api.trans_voucher ('MTR');

        BEGIN
            SELECT cuc_pay_method, cuc_bbr_code, cuc_bank_acc_no
              INTO v_pay_method, v_bbr_code, v_account_number
              FROM lms_client_underraised_claim
             WHERE cuc_code = v_cuc_code;
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND
            THEN
                NULL;
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                raise_error ('Error fetching payment details....');
        END;

        IF v_bbr_code IS NULL OR v_account_number IS NULL
        THEN
            v_bbr_code := NVL (v_bbr_code, bnk_bbr_code (v_pol_code));
            v_account_number :=
                NVL (v_account_number, bnk_account (v_pol_code));
        END IF;

        SELECT    TO_NUMBER (TO_CHAR (SYSDATE, 'RRRR'))
               || lms_transaction_seq.NEXTVAL
          INTO v_trans_code
          FROM DUAL;

        IF vpayee IS NOT NULL
        THEN
            v_payee := vpayee;
        END IF;

        IF NVL (v_intr, 0) > 0
        THEN
            get_gl_code ('INTR_WTH',
                         v_prod_code,
                         v_trnt_code,
                         v_trnt_gl_code,
                         v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                         NULL,
                         v_renewal);
            valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                       v_org_code,
                       v_brh_code,
                       'INTR_WTH');
            v_count := v_count + 1;
            interface_append_gl (v_trans_code,   --v_trans_code        NUMBER,
                                 v_user_name,  --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                                 v_pol_code,     --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                                 v_prod_code,    --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                                 v_vchr_no,   --v_vchr_no            VARCHAR2,
                                 NULL,           --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                                 NULL,           --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                                 NULL,         --v_rcpt_no           VARCHAR2,
                                 v_count,        --v_count             NUMBER,
                                 'INTR. WITHDRAWAL - ' || v_policy_no,
                                 --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                                 NVL (v_intr, 0), --v_amount            NUMBER,
                                 'D',          --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                                 v_trnt_gl_code, --v_acc_number         VARCHAR2,
                                 v_brh_code,     --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                                 v_gl_trans,
                                 --v_trn_rec   IN OUT Fms_Vouchers_Pkg.Tgl_rec_type,
                                 NULL, --v_cad_code       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                 NULL);
            v_count := v_count + 1;
            interface_append_gl (v_trans_code,   --v_trans_code        NUMBER,
                                 v_user_name,  --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                                 v_pol_code,     --v_pol_code          NUMBER,

    PROCEDURE postclientupaidinterests (
        v_intr        NUMBER,
        v_prod_code   NUMBER,
        v_pol_code    NUMBER,
        v_brh_code    NUMBER,
        v_policy_no   VARCHAR2,
        v_user_name   VARCHAR2,
        vpayee        VARCHAR2,
        v_cuc_code    NUMBER DEFAULT NULL
    )
    IS
        v_narrative             VARCHAR2 (50) := 'INTR. WITHDRAWAL -';
        v_trnt_code             VARCHAR2 (10);
        v_trnt_gl_code          VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_trnt_contra_gl_code   VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_renewal               VARCHAR2 (2);
        v_count                 NUMBER := 0;
        v_gl_count              NUMBER := 0;
        v_gl_trans              fms_vouchers_pkg.tgl_rec_type;
        v_chq_dtls_rec          fms_cheques_pkg.type_rqn_dtls_table;
        v_trans_no              NUMBER;
        v_trans_code            NUMBER;
        v_org_code              NUMBER;
        v_vchr_no               VARCHAR2 (100);
        v_payee                 VARCHAR2 (100);
        v_prepared_by           VARCHAR2 (100);
        v_bbr_code              NUMBER;
        v_account_number        VARCHAR2 (100);
        v_pay_method            VARCHAR2 (10);
    BEGIN
        v_prepared_by := v_user_name;
        v_org_code := fms_interfaces_pkg.get_org (v_brh_code);
        v_vchr_no := lms_api.trans_voucher ('MTR');

        BEGIN
            SELECT cuc_pay_method,
                   cuc_bbr_code,
                   cuc_bank_acc_no,
                   cuc_ltr_trans_no
              INTO v_pay_method,
                   v_bbr_code,
                   v_account_number,
                   v_trans_no
              FROM lms_client_underraised_claim
             WHERE cuc_code = v_cuc_code;
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND
            THEN
                NULL;
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                raise_error ('Error fetching payment details....');
        END;

        BEGIN
            UPDATE lms_client_underraised_claim
               SET cuc_voucher_no = v_vchr_no
             WHERE cuc_code = v_cuc_code;
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND
            THEN
                NULL;
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                raise_error ('Error updating payment details..2..');
        END;

        IF v_bbr_code IS NULL OR v_account_number IS NULL
        THEN
            v_bbr_code := NVL (v_bbr_code, bnk_bbr_code (v_pol_code));
            v_account_number :=
                NVL (v_account_number, bnk_account (v_pol_code));
        END IF;

        SELECT    TO_NUMBER (TO_CHAR (SYSDATE, 'RRRR'))
               || lms_transaction_seq.NEXTVAL
          INTO v_trans_code
          FROM DUAL;

        IF vpayee IS NOT NULL
        THEN
            v_payee := vpayee;
        END IF;

        IF NVL (v_intr, 0) > 0
        THEN
            get_gl_code ('INTR_WTH',
                         v_prod_code,
                         v_trnt_code,
                         v_trnt_gl_code,
                         v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                         NULL,
                         v_renewal);
            valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                       v_org_code,
                       v_brh_code,
                       'INTR_WTH');
            v_gl_count := v_gl_count + 1;
            interface_append_gl (v_trans_code,   --v_trans_code        NUMBER,
                                 v_user_name,  --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                                 v_pol_code,     --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                                 v_prod_code,    --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                                 v_vchr_no,   --v_vchr_no            VARCHAR2,
                                 NULL,           --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                                 NULL,           --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                                 NULL,         --v_rcpt_no           VARCHAR2,
                                 v_gl_count,     --v_count             NUMBER,
                                 'INTR. WITHDRAWAL - ' || v_policy_no,
                                 --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                                 NVL (v_intr, 0), --v_amount            NUMBER,
                                 'D',          --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                                 v_trnt_gl_code, --v_acc_number         VARCHAR2,

    PROCEDURE postupaidclminterests17513 (
        v_intr        NUMBER,
        v_prod_code   NUMBER,
        v_pol_code    NUMBER,
        v_brh_code    NUMBER,
        v_policy_no   VARCHAR2,
        v_user_name   VARCHAR2,
        vpayee        VARCHAR2,
        v_cuc_code    NUMBER DEFAULT NULL
    )
    IS
        v_narrative             VARCHAR2 (50) := 'INTR. WITHDRAWAL -';
        v_trnt_code             VARCHAR2 (10);
        v_trnt_gl_code          VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_trnt_contra_gl_code   VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_renewal               VARCHAR2 (2);
        v_count                 NUMBER;
        v_gl_trans              fms_vouchers_pkg.tgl_rec_type;
        v_chq_dtls_rec          fms_cheques_pkg.type_rqn_dtls_table;
        v_trans_no              NUMBER;
        v_trans_code            NUMBER;
        v_org_code              NUMBER;
        v_vchr_no               VARCHAR2 (100);
        v_payee                 VARCHAR2 (100);
        v_prepared_by           VARCHAR2 (100);
        v_bbr_code              NUMBER;
        v_account_number        VARCHAR2 (100);
        v_pay_method            VARCHAR2 (10);
    BEGIN
        v_org_code := fms_interfaces_pkg.get_org (v_brh_code);
        v_prepared_by := v_user_name;

        BEGIN
            SELECT cuc_pay_method, cuc_bbr_code, cuc_bank_acc_no
              INTO v_pay_method, v_bbr_code, v_account_number
              FROM lms_client_underraised_claim
             WHERE cuc_code = v_cuc_code;
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND
            THEN
                NULL;
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                raise_error ('Error fetching payment details....');
        END;

        IF v_bbr_code IS NULL OR v_account_number IS NULL
        THEN
            v_bbr_code := NVL (v_bbr_code, bnk_bbr_code (v_pol_code));
            v_account_number :=
                NVL (v_account_number, bnk_account (v_pol_code));
        END IF;

        SELECT    TO_NUMBER (TO_CHAR (SYSDATE, 'RRRR'))
               || lms_transaction_seq.NEXTVAL
          INTO v_trans_code
          FROM DUAL;

        SELECT    TO_NUMBER (TO_CHAR (SYSDATE, 'RRRR'))
               || lms_vchr_no_seq.NEXTVAL
          INTO v_vchr_no
          FROM DUAL;

        IF NVL (v_intr, 0) > 0
        THEN
            get_gl_code ('CP_DTH',
                         v_prod_code,
                         v_trnt_code,
                         v_trnt_gl_code,
                         v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                         NULL,
                         v_renewal);
            valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                       v_org_code,
                       v_brh_code,
                       'CP_DTH');
            v_count := v_count + 1;
            interface_append_gl (
                v_trans_code,                    --v_trans_code        NUMBER,
                v_user_name,                   --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                v_pol_code,                      --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                v_prod_code,                     --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                v_vchr_no,                    --v_vchr_no            VARCHAR2,
                NULL,                            --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                NULL,                            --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                NULL,                          --v_rcpt_no           VARCHAR2,
                v_count,                         --v_count             NUMBER,
                'UNPAID CLAIM INTEREST ON - ' || v_policy_no,
                --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                NVL (v_intr, 0),                 --v_amount            NUMBER,
                'D',                           --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                v_trnt_gl_code,               --v_acc_number         VARCHAR2,
                v_brh_code,                      --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                v_gl_trans,
                --v_trn_rec   IN OUT Fms_Vouchers_Pkg.Tgl_rec_type,
                NULL,                  --v_cad_code       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                NULL);
            v_count := v_count + 1;
            interface_append_gl (

                                 NULL, --v_cad_code       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                 NULL);
            v_trans_no := NVL (v_trans_no, 0) + 1;
            interface_append_chq (v_trans_code,   --v_trans_code       NUMBER,
                                  v_user_name,
                                  --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                                  v_pol_code,   --v_pol_code           NUMBER,

                                  v_vchr_no,
                                  --v_vchr_no             VARCHAR2,
                                  v_trans_no,   --v_count              NUMBER,
                                  NVL (v_intr, 0), --v_amount             NUMBER,
                                  'INTR. WITHDRAWAL -' || v_policy_no,
                                  --v_narrative          VARCHAR2,
                                  v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                  --v_acc_number          VARCHAR2,
                                  v_org_code,
                                  --v_acc_org_code        NUMBER,
                                  v_brh_code,   --v_branch_code        NUMBER,
                                  'D',        --v_drcr               VARCHAR2,

            interface_create_reqn (
                v_trans_code,                  --v_trans_code          NUMBER,
                v_vchr_no,                 --v_ref                   VARCHAR2,
                v_vchr_no,                 --v_ref2                  VARCHAR2,
                TRUNC (SYSDATE),
                --v_ref_date              DATE,
                'INTR. WITHDRAWAL -' || v_policy_no || '(' || 'CHQ' || ')',
                --v_narrative             VARCHAR2,
                NVL (v_intr, 0),
                --v_amount                NUMBER,
                v_payee,                   --v_payee                 VARCHAR2,
                'CHQ',
                --v_pay_method            VARCHAR2, --CHQ, EFT
                v_account_number,
                --v_payee_bank_acc_no        VARCHAR2,
                v_bbr_code,
                --v_payee_bank_branch_code   NUMBER,
                v_user_name,
                --v_source_auth_by        VARCHAR2,
                TRUNC (SYSDATE),
                --v_source_auth_dt        DATE,
                v_prepared_by,
                --v_raise_by                VARCHAR2,
                'POLICY MATURITY',
                --v_pmt_type              VARCHAR2,
                v_brh_code,                   --v_branch_code          NUMBER,
                v_pol_code,                                      --v_pol_code,
                v_chq_dtls_rec);
        END IF;
    END postclientupaidinterests;

    PROCEDURE postupaidclminterests (
        v_intr        NUMBER,

        v_brh_code    NUMBER,

        v_user_name   VARCHAR2,

    )
    IS
        v_narrative             VARCHAR2 (50) := 'INTR. WITHDRAWAL -';
        v_trnt_code             VARCHAR2 (10);

        v_trnt_contra_gl_code   VARCHAR2 (20);

                --v_trn_rec   IN OUT Fms_Vouchers_Pkg.Tgl_rec_type,
                NULL,                  --v_cad_code       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                NULL);
            v_trans_no := NVL (v_trans_no, 0) + 1;
            interface_append_chq (
                v_trans_code,                     --v_trans_code       NUMBER,
                v_user_name,
                --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                v_pol_code,                     --v_pol_code           NUMBER,
                v_prod_code,
                --v_prod_code          NUMBER,
                v_vchr_no,
                --v_vchr_no             VARCHAR2,
                v_trans_no,                     --v_count              NUMBER,
                NVL (v_intr, 0),                --v_amount             NUMBER,
                'UNPAID CLAIM INTEREST ON - ' || v_policy_no,
                --v_narrative          VARCHAR2,
                v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                --v_acc_number          VARCHAR2,
                v_org_code,
                --v_acc_org_code        NUMBER,
