    PROCEDURE post_risk_prem_amt (
        v_rp_code     NUMBER,
        v_brn_code    NUMBER,
        v_auth_date   DATE,
        v_user        VARCHAR2
    )
    IS
        /*CURSOR RiskAmt IS SELECT RP_CODE, RP_RISK_PREM,POL_BRA_CODE,POL_NEXT_RISK_PREM_DATE,RP_DATE,POL_PROD_CODE
                FROM LMS_RISK_PREMIUM_CHARGES,LMS_POLICIES
                WHERE POL_BRA_CODE = v_brn_code
                AND RP_CODE = v_rp_code
                AND POL_CODE = RP_POL_CODE
                --AND COP_AUTHORIZED_BY = v_user
                AND TRUNC(RP_DATE) = TRUNC(v_auth_date);*/
        v_org_code              NUMBER;
        v_raised_by             NUMBER;
        v_cur_code              NUMBER;
        v_trnt_code             VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_trnt_gl_code          VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_trnt_contra_gl_code   VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_gl_count              NUMBER := 0;
        v_vgl_no                NUMBER;
        v_gl_trans              fms_vouchers_pkg.tgl_rec_type;
        v_risk_prem             NUMBER;
        v_pol_prod_code         NUMBER;
        v_client_status         VARCHAR2 (10);
        v_vchr_no               VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_trans_code            NUMBER;
        v_policy_no             VARCHAR2 (30);
        v_pol_code              NUMBER;
        v_prod_code             NUMBER;
        v_rp_date               DATE;
    BEGIN
        SELECT    TO_NUMBER (TO_CHAR (SYSDATE, 'RRRR'))
               || lms_transaction_seq.NEXTVAL
          INTO v_trans_code
          FROM DUAL;

        v_gl_trans.delete;
        v_org_code := fms_interfaces_pkg.get_org (v_brn_code);
        v_cur_code := lms_interfaces_pkg.lms_def_cur (v_brn_code);
        v_raised_by := fms_interfaces_pkg.get_usercode (v_user);
        v_vchr_no := 'RISKPREM' || v_policy_no;

        BEGIN
            SELECT rp_risk_prem,
                   pol_prod_code,
                   pol_client_status,
                   pol_code,
                   pol_prod_code,
                   pol_policy_no,
                   rp_date
              INTO v_risk_prem,
                   v_pol_prod_code,
                   v_client_status,
                   v_pol_code,
                   v_prod_code,
                   v_policy_no,
                   v_rp_date
              FROM lms_risk_premium_charges, lms_policies
             WHERE     pol_bra_code = v_brn_code
                   AND rp_code = v_rp_code
                   AND pol_code = rp_pol_code
                   AND TRUNC (rp_posting_date) = TRUNC (v_auth_date)
                   AND TRUNC (rp_done_date) = TRUNC (SYSDATE);
        END;

        IF NVL (v_risk_prem, 0) > 0
        THEN
            get_gl_code ('RSKPRM',
                         v_pol_prod_code,
                         v_trnt_code,
                         v_trnt_gl_code,
                         v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
            valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                       v_org_code,
                       v_brn_code,
                       'RSKPRM');
            v_gl_count := NVL (v_gl_count, 0) + 1;
            interface_append_gl (v_trans_code, --v_trans_code           NUMBER,
                                 v_user,       --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                                 v_pol_code,     --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                                 v_prod_code,    --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                                 v_vchr_no,  --v_vchr_no             VARCHAR2,
                                 NULL,           --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                                 NULL,           --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                                 NULL,       --v_rcpt_no             VARCHAR2,
                                 v_gl_count,     --v_count             NUMBER,
                                 'RISK PREMIUM CHARGE -  ' || v_policy_no,
                                 --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                                 NVL (v_risk_prem, 0),
                                 --v_amount            NUMBER,
                                 'D',          --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                                 v_trnt_gl_code,
                                 --v_acc_number           VARCHAR2,
                                 v_brn_code,     --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                                 v_gl_trans);

            IF NVL (v_client_status, '1') IN ('12')
            THEN
                get_gl_code ('UP',
                             v_pol_prod_code,
                             v_trnt_code,
                             v_trnt_gl_code,
                             v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
            ELSE
                get_gl_code ('INVPREM',
                             v_pol_prod_code,
                             v_trnt_code,
                             v_trnt_gl_code,
                             v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
            END IF;

            valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                       v_org_code,
                       v_brn_code,
                       'INVPREM');
            v_gl_count := NVL (v_gl_count, 0) + 1;
            interface_append_gl (v_trans_code, --v_trans_code           NUMBER,
                                 v_user,       --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                                 NULL,           --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                                 NULL,           --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                                 v_vchr_no,  --v_vchr_no             VARCHAR2,
                                 NULL,           --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                                 NULL,           --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                                 NULL,       --v_rcpt_no             VARCHAR2,
                                 v_gl_count,     --v_count             NUMBER,
                                 'RISK PREMIUM CHARGE -  ' || v_policy_no,
                                 --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                                 NVL (v_risk_prem, 0),
                                 --v_amount            NUMBER,
                                 'C',          --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                                 v_trnt_gl_code,
                                 --v_acc_number           VARCHAR2,
                                 v_brn_code,     --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                                 v_gl_trans);

            IF v_gl_count > 0
            THEN
                IF TRUNC (NVL (v_rp_date, SYSDATE)) >=
                   TO_DATE ('01/01/2011', 'DD/MM/RRRR')
                THEN
                    interface_update_vgl (
                        v_trans_code,               --v_trans_code     NUMBER,
                        v_user,                --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                        NULL,                    --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                        TRUNC (v_auth_date),       --v_date              DATE,
                        NULL,                    --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                        NULL,                    --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                        'LMS RISK PREMIUM CHARGE', --v_btc_description   VARCHAR2,
                        'JV',               --v_btc_type             VARCHAR2,
                        v_brn_code,              --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                        'RISK PREMIUM CHARGES -  ' || v_policy_no,
                        --v_description       VARCHAR2,
                        v_vchr_no,            --v_ref_no             VARCHAR2,
                        v_gl_trans);
                END IF;
            --                 v_vgl_no := Fms_Vouchers_Pkg.update_vgl ('LMS RISK PREMIUM CHARGE',
            --                                                      'JV',
            --                                                      v_brn_code,
            --                                                      TRUNC(v_auth_date),
            --                                                      'RISK PREMIUM CHARGES',
            --                                                      v_rp_code,
            --                                                      v_raised_by,
            --                                                      v_cur_code,
            --                                                      v_gl_trans
            --                                                     );
            --                 Fms_Interfaces_Pkg.post_je (v_vgl_no, v_raised_by);
            END IF;
        END IF;
    EXCEPTION
        WHEN OTHERS
        THEN
            raise_error ('RISK PREM API....');
    END post_risk_prem_amt;

    PROCEDURE post_at_knockoff (
        v_settle_amt   NUMBER,
        v_prod_code    NUMBER,
        v_pol_code     NUMBER,
        v_brn_code     NUMBER,
        v_undo         VARCHAR2 DEFAULT 'N'
    )
    IS
        v_org_code                 NUMBER;
        v_trnt_code                VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_trnt_gl_code             VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_trnt_contra_gl_code      VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_dr_trnt_gl_code          VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_cr_trnt_contra_gl_code   VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_trans_code               NUMBER;
        v_user                     VARCHAR2 (30)
            := pkg_global_vars.get_pvarchar2 ('pkg_global_vars.pvg_username');
        --v_gl_trans               fms_vouchers_pkg.tgl_rec_type;
        v_count                    NUMBER := 0;
        v_gl_trans                 tq_fms.fms_vouchers_pkg.tgl_rec_type;
        v_agn_act_code             NUMBER;
    BEGIN
        v_org_code := fms_interfaces_pkg.get_org (v_brn_code);

        SELECT agn_act_code
          INTO v_agn_act_code
          FROM lms_policy_endorsements, lms_policies, lms_agencies
         WHERE     pol_current_endr_code = endr_code
               AND endr_agen_code = agn_code
               AND pol_code = v_pol_code;

        SELECT    TO_NUMBER (TO_CHAR (SYSDATE, 'RRRR'))
               || lms_transaction_seq.NEXTVAL
          INTO v_trans_code
          FROM DUAL;

        get_gl_code ('DR_RCTGB',
                     v_prod_code,
                     v_trnt_code,
                     v_dr_trnt_gl_code,
                     v_cr_trnt_contra_gl_code);
        valid_acc (v_dr_trnt_gl_code,
                   v_org_code,
                   v_brn_code,
                   'DR_RCTGB');
        get_gl_code ('UP_GB',
                     v_prod_code,
                     v_trnt_code,
                     v_trnt_gl_code,
                     v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                     NULL,
                     -- v_tt_code                        NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                     NULL,
                     -- v_renewal                        VARCHAR2 DEFAULT 'N',
                     v_agn_act_code,
                     -- v_act_code                       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                     v_brn_code);
        valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                   v_org_code,
                   v_brn_code,
                   'UP_GB');
        v_count := v_count + 1;

        IF NVL (v_undo, 'N') = 'Y'
        THEN
            IF v_settle_amt <> 0
            THEN
                interface_append_gl (v_trans_code, --v_trans_code           NUMBER,
                                     v_user,   --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                                     v_pol_code, --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                                     v_prod_code, --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                                     NULL,   --v_vchr_no             VARCHAR2,
                                     NULL,       --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                                     NULL,       --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                                     NULL,   --v_rcpt_no             VARCHAR2,
                                     v_count,    --v_count             NUMBER,
                                     'PREMIUM ALLOCATION -', --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                                     NVL (v_settle_amt, 0), --v_amount            NUMBER,
                                     'C',      --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                                     v_cr_trnt_contra_gl_code, --v_acc_number2          VARCHAR2,
                                     v_brn_code, --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                                     v_gl_trans);
                --v_trn_rec   IN OUT  fms_test.Fms_Vouchers_Pkg.Tgl_rec_type,
                interface_append_gl (v_trans_code,
                                     --v_trans_code           NUMBER,
                                     v_user,   --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                                     v_pol_code, --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                                     v_prod_code, --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                                     NULL,   --v_vchr_no             VARCHAR2,
                                     NULL,       --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                                     NULL,       --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                                     NULL,   --v_rcpt_no             VARCHAR2,
                                     v_count,    --v_count             NUMBER,
                                     'PREMIUM ALLOCATION',
                                     --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                                     NVL (v_settle_amt, 0),
                                     --v_amount            NUMBER,
                                     'D',      --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                                     v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                     --v_acc_number2          VARCHAR2,
                                     v_brn_code, --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                                     v_gl_trans);
            END IF;
        ELSE
            IF v_settle_amt <> 0
            THEN
                interface_append_gl (v_trans_code, --v_trans_code           NUMBER,
                                     v_user,   --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                                     v_pol_code, --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                                     v_prod_code, --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                                     NULL,   --v_vchr_no             VARCHAR2,
                                     NULL,       --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                                     NULL,       --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                                     NULL,   --v_rcpt_no             VARCHAR2,
                                     v_count,    --v_count             NUMBER,
                                     'PREMIUM ALLOCATION -', --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                                     NVL (v_settle_amt, 0), --v_amount            NUMBER,
                                     'D',      --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                                     v_cr_trnt_contra_gl_code, --v_acc_number2          VARCHAR2,
                                     v_brn_code, --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                                     v_gl_trans);
                --v_trn_rec   IN OUT  fms_test.Fms_Vouchers_Pkg.Tgl_rec_type,
                interface_append_gl (v_trans_code,
                                     --v_trans_code           NUMBER,
                                     v_user,   --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                                     v_pol_code, --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                                     v_prod_code, --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                                     NULL,   --v_vchr_no             VARCHAR2,
                                     NULL,       --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                                     NULL,       --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                                     NULL,   --v_rcpt_no             VARCHAR2,
                                     v_count,    --v_count             NUMBER,
                                     'PREMIUM ALLOCATION',
                                     --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                                     NVL (v_settle_amt, 0),
                                     --v_amount            NUMBER,
                                     'C',      --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                                     v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                     --v_acc_number2          VARCHAR2,
                                     v_brn_code, --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                                     v_gl_trans);
            END IF;
        END IF;
    END;

    PROCEDURE post_full_waiver_amts (
        v_clm_no        VARCHAR2,
        v_pol_code      NUMBER,
        v_branch_code   NUMBER,
        v_user          VARCHAR2,
        v_count         NUMBER,
        v_trans_no      NUMBER
    )
    IS
        v_trnt_gl_code          VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_trnt_contra_gl_code   VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_contra_acc            VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_prod_code             NUMBER;
        v_trans_code            NUMBER;
        v_waiver_amt            NUMBER;
        v_trnt_code             VARCHAR2 (20) := 'PRWAIV';
        v_trnt_code_2           VARCHAR2 (20) := 'CP_WAIV';
        v_inst_prem             NUMBER;
        v_endr_code             NUMBER;
        v_post_full_waiver      VARCHAR2 (5);
        v_pol_policy_no         VARCHAR2 (50);
        v_vchr_no               VARCHAR2 (50);
        v_org_code              NUMBER;
        v_gl_count              NUMBER := -1;
        v_gl_trans              fms_vouchers_pkg.tgl_rec_type;
        v_user_name             VARCHAR2 (30)
            := pkg_global_vars.get_pvarchar2 ('PKG_GLOBAL_VARS.PVG_USERNAME');
    BEGIN
        BEGIN
            lms_ord_misc.system_param_val ('POST_FULL_WAIVER_AMOUNT_ON_CLM',
                                           v_post_full_waiver);
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                tqc_error_manager.raise_error (
                    276400302,
                    text_in     => 'Parameter Error.',
                    name1_in    => 'param name',
                    value1_in   => 'POST_FULL_WAIVER_AMOUNT_ON_CLM');
        END;

        IF NVL (v_post_full_waiver, 'N') = 'N'
        THEN
            RETURN;
        END IF;

        v_gl_trans.delete;

        BEGIN
            SELECT endr_code, pol_policy_no
              INTO v_endr_code, v_pol_policy_no
              FROM lms_policies, lms_policy_endorsements
             WHERE     pol_current_endr_code = endr_code
                   AND endr_pol_code = v_pol_code;
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                raise_error (
                    'Unable to get policy details for waiver processing');
        END;

        /*BEGIN
           SELECT cpvd_voucher_no
             INTO v_vchr_no
             FROM lms_clm_payment_voucher_dtls
            WHERE cpvd_clm_no = v_clm_no AND cpvd_tran_type = 'CP';
        EXCEPTION
           WHEN OTHERS
           THEN
              raise_error ('Unable to get claim details for waiver processing');
        END;*/
        v_org_code := fms_interfaces_pkg.get_org (v_branch_code);

        BEGIN
            v_inst_prem :=
                  lms_ord_misc.inst_prem (v_pol_code, v_endr_code)
                + NVL (
                      lms_process_receipts.pol_holder_alloc (v_pol_code,
                                                             'INST',
                                                             v_endr_code),
                      0);

            SELECT pol_prod_code,
                   v_inst_prem * NVL (pol_max_waiver_instlmts, 0)
              INTO v_prod_code, v_waiver_amt
              FROM lms_policies
             WHERE pol_code = v_pol_code;
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                raise_error ('Error Determining Waived Amount');
        END;

        --raise_error('v_waiver_amt = '||v_waiver_amt);
        get_gl_code ('PRWAIV',
                     v_prod_code,
                     v_trnt_code,
                     v_trnt_gl_code,
                     v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
        valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                   v_org_code,
                   v_branch_code,
                   'PRWAIV');
        get_gl_code ('CP_WAIV',
                     v_prod_code,
                     v_trnt_code_2,
                     v_contra_acc,
                     v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
        valid_acc (v_contra_acc,
                   v_org_code,
                   v_branch_code,
                   'CP_WAIV');

        --IF v_trans_no IS NULL
        --THEN
        SELECT    TO_NUMBER (TO_CHAR (SYSDATE, 'RRRR'))
               || lms_transaction_seq.NEXTVAL
          INTO v_trans_code
          FROM DUAL;

        --END IF;
        v_gl_count := v_gl_count + 2;
        interface_append_gl (v_trans_code,                    -- v_trans_code,
                             v_user,                            -- v_raise_by,
                             v_pol_code,                        -- v_pol_code,
                             v_prod_code,                      -- v_prod_code,
                             NULL,                               -- v_vchr_no,
                             NULL,                              -- v_opr_code,
                             NULL,                             -- v_oppr_code,
                             NULL,                                --v_rcpt_no,
                             v_gl_count,                           -- v_count,
                             'WAIVER ACCOUNT CREDIT',          -- v_narrative,
                             NVL (v_waiver_amt, 0),               -- v_amount,
                             'C',                                   -- v_drcr,
                             v_trnt_gl_code,                 -- v_acc_number1,
                             v_contra_acc,                   -- v_acc_number2,
                             v_branch_code,                  -- v_branch_code,
                             v_gl_trans);

        /*interface_append_gl (v_trans_code,                           -- v_trans_code,
                             v_user,                                 -- v_raise_by,
                             v_pol_code,                             -- v_pol_code,
                             v_prod_code,                           -- v_prod_code,
                             v_vchr_no,                               -- v_vchr_no,
                             NULL,                                  -- v_opr_code,,
                             NULL,                                  -- v_oppr_code,
                             'FOR FULL WAIVER',          --v_rct_code, --v_rcpt_no,
                             v_gl_count,                                   -- v_count,
                             'WAIVER ACCOUNT CREDIT',               -- v_narrative,
                             v_waiver_amt,                             -- v_amount,
                             'C',                                        -- v_drcr,
                             v_trnt_gl_code,                      -- v_acc_number1,
                             v_contra_acc,                        -- v_acc_number2,
                             v_branch_code,                       -- v_branch_code,
                             v_gl_trans/*,
                             NULL,         ---v_cad_code       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                             NULL,        ---v_otop_code       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                             NULL,         --v_fpmt_code       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                             NULL,         --v_ort_code        NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                             NULL,           --v_btr_no        NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                             NULL,                                       --ppr_code
                             NULL,
                             NULL,
                             v_trans_no
                            );*/
        --raise_error('v_trans_no='||v_trans_no||'; v_waiver_amt='||v_waiver_amt);

        --create GL voucher
        IF v_gl_count != 0
        THEN
            interface_update_vgl (
                v_trans_code,                       --v_trans_code     NUMBER,
                v_user_name,                   --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                v_pol_code,                      --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                TRUNC (SYSDATE),                   --v_date              DATE,
                NULL,                            --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                NULL,                            --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                'FOR FULL WAIVER',             --v_btc_description   VARCHAR2,
                'JV',                       --v_btc_type             VARCHAR2,
                v_branch_code,                   --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                'WAIVER ACCOUNT CREDIT : ' || v_pol_policy_no,
                --v_description       VARCHAR2,
                v_vchr_no,                    --v_ref_no             VARCHAR2,
                v_gl_trans);
        --v_gl_trans  IN OUT  Fms_Vouchers_Pkg.Tgl_rec_type,
        END IF;
    EXCEPTION
        WHEN OTHERS
        THEN
            raise_error ('Error While post_full_waiver_amts...');
    END post_full_waiver_amts;

    PROCEDURE refund_over_tax (
        v_pol_code     NUMBER,
        v_refund_amt   NUMBER,
        v_trans_no     NUMBER
    )
    IS
        v_trnt_gl_code          VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_trnt_contra_gl_code   VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_contra_acc            VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_prod_code             NUMBER;
        v_trans_code            NUMBER;
        v_waiver_amt            NUMBER;
        v_trnt_code             VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_trnt_code_2           VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_inst_prem             NUMBER;
        v_endr_code             NUMBER;
        v_post_full_waiver      VARCHAR2 (5);
        v_pol_policy_no         VARCHAR2 (50);
        v_vchr_no               VARCHAR2 (50);
        v_org_code              NUMBER;
        v_gl_count              NUMBER := -1;
        v_gl_trans              fms_vouchers_pkg.tgl_rec_type;
        v_user                  VARCHAR2 (30)
            := pkg_global_vars.get_pvarchar2 ('PKG_GLOBAL_VARS.PVG_USERNAME');
        v_branch_code           NUMBER;
    BEGIN
        v_gl_trans.delete;

        BEGIN
            SELECT endr_code,
                   pol_policy_no,
                   pol_prod_code,
                   pol_bra_code
              INTO v_endr_code,
                   v_pol_policy_no,
                   v_prod_code,
                   v_branch_code
              FROM lms_policies, lms_policy_endorsements
             WHERE     pol_current_endr_code = endr_code
                   AND endr_pol_code = v_pol_code;
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                raise_error ('Unable to get policy details');
        END;

        v_org_code := fms_interfaces_pkg.get_org (v_branch_code);
        get_gl_code ('INVPREM',
                     v_prod_code,
                     v_trnt_code,
                     v_trnt_gl_code,
                     v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
        valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                   v_org_code,
                   v_branch_code,
                   'INVPREM');
        get_gl_code ('MNGEX',
                     v_prod_code,
                     v_trnt_code_2,
                     v_contra_acc,
                     v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
        valid_acc (v_contra_acc,
                   v_org_code,
                   v_branch_code,
                   'MNGEX');

        --IF v_trans_no IS NULL
        --THEN
        SELECT    TO_NUMBER (TO_CHAR (SYSDATE, 'RRRR'))
               || lms_transaction_seq.NEXTVAL
          INTO v_trans_code
          FROM DUAL;

        --END IF;
        v_gl_count := v_gl_count + 2;
        interface_append_gl (v_trans_code,                    -- v_trans_code,
                             v_user,                            -- v_raise_by,
                             v_pol_code,                        -- v_pol_code,
                             v_prod_code,                      -- v_prod_code,
                             NULL,                               -- v_vchr_no,
                             NULL,                              -- v_opr_code,
                             NULL,                             -- v_oppr_code,
                             NULL,                                --v_rcpt_no,
                             v_gl_count,                           -- v_count,
                             'CORP(TAX) REFUND',               -- v_narrative,
                             NVL (v_waiver_amt, 0),               -- v_amount,
                             'C',                                   -- v_drcr,
                             v_trnt_gl_code,                 -- v_acc_number1,
                             v_contra_acc,                   -- v_acc_number2,
                             v_branch_code,                  -- v_branch_code,
                             v_gl_trans);

        --create GL voucher
        IF v_gl_count != 0
        THEN
            interface_update_vgl (v_trans_code,     --v_trans_code     NUMBER,
                                  v_user,      --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                                  v_pol_code,    --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                                  TRUNC (SYSDATE), --v_date              DATE,
                                  NULL,          --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                                  NULL,          --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                                  'CORP(TAX) REFUND', --v_btc_description   VARCHAR2,
                                  'JV',     --v_btc_type             VARCHAR2,
                                  v_branch_code, --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                                  'CORP(TAX) : ' || v_pol_policy_no,
                                  --v_description       VARCHAR2,
                                  v_vchr_no,  --v_ref_no             VARCHAR2,
                                  v_gl_trans);
        --v_gl_trans  IN OUT  Fms_Vouchers_Pkg.Tgl_rec_type,
        END IF;
    EXCEPTION
        WHEN OTHERS
        THEN
            raise_error ('Error While processing refund_over_tax...');
    END refund_over_tax;

    PROCEDURE rcpt_count (
        v_cnt         NUMBER,
        v_policy_no   VARCHAR2 DEFAULT NULL,
        v_rcpt_amt    NUMBER DEFAULT NULL
    )
    IS
        PRAGMA AUTONOMOUS_TRANSACTION;
    BEGIN
        UPDATE cont
           SET conts = v_cnt, policy_no = v_policy_no, rcpt_amt = v_rcpt_amt;

        COMMIT;
    END rcpt_count;

    PROCEDURE post_contra (
        v_orig_trans_code   NUMBER,
        v_user_name         VARCHAR2,
        v_dt                DATE DEFAULT NULL
    )
    IS
        CURSOR trans IS
            SELECT itb_pol_code,
                   itb_prod_code,
                   itb_vchr_no,
                   itb_branch_code,
                   itb_acc_number,
                   itb_acc_number2,
                   itb_opr_code,
                   itb_oppr_code,
                   itb_rcpt_no,
                   itb_narrative,
                   itb_amount,
                   DECODE (itb_drcr,  'D', 'C',  'C', 'D')
                       itb_drcr_contra,
                   itb_cad_code,
                   itb_otop_code,
                   itb_fpmt_code,
                   itb_ort_code,
                   itb_brr_reprint_code,
                   itb_ppr_code,
                   itb_ocl_code,
                   itb_agn_code,
                   itb_trans_no,
                   itb_transaction_type,
                   itb_vgl_post_date,
                   itb_date,
                   itb_vgl_no
              FROM lms_interface_table
             WHERE     itb_transaction_type IN ('APPEND_GL', 'APPEND_CB')
                   AND itb_transaction_code = v_orig_trans_code;

        CURSOR update_trans IS
            SELECT itb_pol_code,
                   itb_prod_code,
                   itb_vchr_no,
                   itb_branch_code,
                   itb_acc_number,
                   itb_acc_number2,
                   itb_opr_code,
                   itb_oppr_code,
                   itb_rcpt_no,
                   itb_narrative,
                   itb_amount,
                   itb_cad_code,
                   DECODE (itb_drcr,  'D', 'C',  'C', 'D')
                       itb_drcr_contra,
                   itb_batch_desc,
                   itb_batch_type,
                   itb_ref,
                   itb_otop_code,
                   itb_ort_code,
                   itb_ppr_code,
                   itb_brr_reprint_code,
                   itb_ocl_code,
                   itb_agn_code,
                   itb_trans_no,
                   itb_fpmt_code,
                   itb_transaction_type,
                   itb_vgl_post_date,
                   itb_date,
                   itb_vgl_no
              FROM lms_interface_table
             WHERE     itb_transaction_type IN ('UPDATE_VGL', 'UPDATE_VCB')
                   AND itb_transaction_code = v_orig_trans_code;

        v_gl_trans        fms_vouchers_pkg.tgl_rec_type;
        v_trans_code      NUMBER;
        v_org_code        NUMBER;
        v_count           NUMBER := 0;
        v_tcg_rec         fms_vouchers_pkg.tcg_rec_type;
        v_cb_count        NUMBER := 1;
        v_cb_rec          fms_vouchers_pkg.tcb_rec_type;
        v_date            DATE := SYSDATE;
        v_cnt             NUMBER := 0;
        v_sbu_code        NUMBER := NULL;
        v_spoke_code      NUMBER := NULL;
        v_cvrg_area       NUMBER := NULL;
        v_location_code   NUMBER := NULL;
        v_paymt_mode      fms_voucb.vcb_mode%TYPE;
        v_vcb_no          NUMBER;
        v_opr_code        NUMBER;
        v_oppr_code       NUMBER;
        v_bct_code        NUMBER;
    BEGIN
        FOR t IN trans
        LOOP
            v_cnt := v_cnt + 1;

            IF v_cnt = 1
            THEN
                SELECT    TO_NUMBER (TO_CHAR (SYSDATE, 'RRRR'))
                       || lms_transaction_seq.NEXTVAL
                  INTO v_trans_code
                  FROM DUAL;
            END IF;

            v_org_code := fms_interfaces_pkg.get_org (t.itb_branch_code);

            IF t.itb_acc_number2 IS NULL
            THEN
                v_count := v_count + 1;

                IF t.itb_transaction_type = 'APPEND_GL'
                THEN
                    interface_append_gl (v_trans_code, --v_trans_code         NUMBER,
                                         v_user_name, --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                                         t.itb_pol_code, --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                                         t.itb_prod_code, --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                                         t.itb_vchr_no, --v_vchr_no            VARCHAR2,
                                         t.itb_opr_code, --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                                         t.itb_oppr_code, --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                                         t.itb_rcpt_no, --v_rcpt_no            VARCHAR2,
                                         v_count, --v_count             NUMBER,
                                         t.itb_narrative || ' - CONTRA',
                                         --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                                         NVL (t.itb_amount, 0),
                                         --v_amount            NUMBER,
                                         t.itb_drcr_contra, --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                                         t.itb_acc_number,
                                         --v_acc_number        VARCHAR2,
                                         t.itb_branch_code, --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                                         v_gl_trans,
                                         t.itb_cad_code,
                                         --v_cad_code               NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                         t.itb_otop_code,
                                         -- v_otop_code              NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                         t.itb_fpmt_code,
                                         --v_fpmt_code              NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                         t.itb_ort_code,
                                         --v_ort_code               NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                         t.itb_brr_reprint_code,
                                         --v_btr_no                 NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                         t.itb_ppr_code,
                                         --v_ppr_code               NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                         t.itb_ocl_code,
                                         --v_ocl_code                NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                         t.itb_agn_code,
                                         --v_agn_code                NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                         t.itb_trans_no --v_trans_no                NUMBER DEFAULT NULL
                                                       );
                ELSE
                    IF t.itb_narrative = 'RECEIPT ALLOCATION'
                    THEN
                        SELECT vcb_mode
                          INTO v_paymt_mode
                          FROM fms_voucb
                         WHERE vcb_no = t.itb_vgl_no;

                        IF t.itb_opr_code IS NULL AND t.itb_oppr_code IS NULL
                        THEN
                            SELECT MAX (itb_opr_code), MAX (itb_oppr_code)
                              INTO v_opr_code, v_oppr_code
                              FROM lms_interface_table
                             WHERE itb_transaction_code = v_orig_trans_code;
                        ELSE
                            v_opr_code := t.itb_opr_code;
                            v_oppr_code := t.itb_oppr_code;
                        END IF;


                        IF v_opr_code IS NOT NULL
                        THEN
                            SELECT rct_bct_code
                              INTO v_bct_code
                              FROM lms_ord_prem_receipts, fms_receipts
                             WHERE     opr_fms_receipt_pk = rct_no
                                   AND opr_code = v_opr_code;
                        ELSE
                            SELECT rct_bct_code
                              INTO v_bct_code
                              FROM lms_ord_proposal_rcpts, fms_receipts
                             WHERE     oppr_fms_receipt_pk = rct_no
                                   AND oppr_code = v_opr_code;
                        END IF;

                        interface_append_cb_trans (
                            v_trans_code,              --v_trans_code  NUMBER,
                            v_user_name, --v_raise_by                   VARCHAR2,
                            t.itb_pol_code,       --                   NUMBER,
                            t.itb_prod_code,       --v_prod_code       NUMBER,
                            t.itb_vchr_no,
                            t.itb_opr_code, --v_opr_code                   NUMBER,
                            t.itb_oppr_code, --v_oppr_code                  NUMBER,
                            t.itb_rcpt_no,                        --v_rcpt_no,
                            v_cb_count,                            -- v_count,
                            t.itb_narrative || ' - CONTRA', --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                            NVL (t.itb_amount, 0), --v_amount            NUMBER,
                            t.itb_drcr_contra,                      -- v_drcr,
                            fms_gen_pkg.bnk_acct_no (v_bct_code),
                            -- v_acc_number1,
                            fms_gen_pkg.bct_brh (v_bct_code),
                            --v_branch_code,      -- v_branch_code,
                            v_cb_rec,
                            NVL (t.itb_vgl_post_date,
                                 NVL (t.itb_date, v_date)),
                            v_bct_code,
                            t.itb_cad_code,
                            --v_cad_code                   NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                            t.itb_otop_code,
                            --v_otop_code                  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                            t.itb_fpmt_code,
                            --v_fpmt_code                  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                            t.itb_ort_code,
                            --v_ort_code                   NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                            t.itb_brr_reprint_code,
                            --v_btr_no                     NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                            t.itb_ppr_code,
                            --v_ppr_code                   NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                            t.itb_ocl_code,
                            --v_ocl_code                NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                            t.itb_agn_code,
                            --v_agn_code                NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                            t.itb_trans_no --v_trans_no                NUMBER DEFAULT NULL
                                          );
                    ELSE
                        interface_append_cb_gl_trans (
                            v_trans_code,       --v_trans_code         NUMBER,
                            v_user_name,       --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                            t.itb_pol_code,      --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                            t.itb_prod_code,     --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                            t.itb_vchr_no,    --v_vchr_no            VARCHAR2,
                            t.itb_opr_code,      --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                            t.itb_oppr_code,     --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                            t.itb_rcpt_no,    --v_rcpt_no            VARCHAR2,
                            v_count,             --v_count             NUMBER,
                            v_cb_count,         --v_cb_count           NUMBER,
                            t.itb_narrative || ' - CONTRA',
                            --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                            NVL (t.itb_amount, 0),
                            --v_amount            NUMBER,
                            t.itb_drcr_contra, --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                            t.itb_acc_number,
                            --v_acc_number        VARCHAR2,
                            t.itb_branch_code,   --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                            v_tcg_rec,
                            t.itb_cad_code,
                            --v_cad_code               NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                            t.itb_otop_code,
                            -- v_otop_code              NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                            t.itb_fpmt_code,
                            --v_fpmt_code              NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                            t.itb_ort_code,
                            --v_ort_code               NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                            t.itb_brr_reprint_code,
                            --v_btr_no                 NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                            t.itb_ppr_code,
                            --v_ppr_code               NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                            t.itb_ocl_code,
                            --v_ocl_code                NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                            t.itb_agn_code,
                            --v_agn_code                NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                            t.itb_trans_no --v_trans_no                NUMBER DEFAULT NULL
                                          );
                    END IF;
                END IF;
            ELSE
                v_count := v_count + 2;

                IF t.itb_transaction_type = 'APPEND_GL'
                THEN
                    interface_append_gl (v_trans_code, --v_trans_code         NUMBER,
                                         v_user_name, --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                                         t.itb_pol_code, --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                                         t.itb_prod_code,
                                         --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                                         t.itb_vchr_no,
                                         --v_vchr_no          VARCHAR2,
                                         t.itb_opr_code,   --          NUMBER,
                                         t.itb_oppr_code, --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                                         t.itb_rcpt_no, --v_rcpt_no          VARCHAR2,
                                         v_count, --v_count             NUMBER,
                                         t.itb_narrative || ' - CONTRA',
                                         --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                                         t.itb_amount, --v_amount            NUMBER,
                                         t.itb_drcr_contra, --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                                         t.itb_acc_number, --v_acc_1          VARCHAR2,
                                         t.itb_acc_number2, --v_acc_2          VARCHAR2,
                                         t.itb_branch_code,
                                         --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                                         v_gl_trans,
                                         t.itb_cad_code,
                                         --v_cad_code               NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                         t.itb_otop_code,
                                         -- v_otop_code              NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                         t.itb_fpmt_code,
                                         --v_fpmt_code              NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                         t.itb_ort_code,
                                         --v_ort_code               NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                         t.itb_brr_reprint_code,
                                         --v_btr_no                 NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                         t.itb_ppr_code,
                                         --v_ppr_code               NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                         t.itb_ocl_code,
                                         --v_ocl_code                NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                         t.itb_agn_code,
                                         --v_agn_code                NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                         t.itb_trans_no --v_trans_no                NUMBER DEFAULT NULL
                                                       );
                ELSE
                    raise_error ('NOT IMPLEMENTED');
                END IF;
            END IF;
        END LOOP;

        IF v_trans_code IS NOT NULL
        THEN
            FOR v IN update_trans
            LOOP
                IF v.itb_transaction_type = 'UPDATE_VGL'
                THEN
                    interface_update_vgl (
                        v_trans_code,                  --v_trans_code  NUMBER,
                        v_user_name,  --v_raise_by                   VARCHAR2,
                        v.itb_pol_code,           --                   NUMBER,
                        NVL (v.itb_vgl_post_date, NVL (v.itb_date, v_date)), --v_date                       DATE,
                        v.itb_opr_code, --v_opr_code                   NUMBER,
                        v.itb_oppr_code, --v_oppr_code                  NUMBER,
                        v.itb_batch_desc || ' - CONTRA',
                        --v_btc_description            VARCHAR2,
                        v.itb_batch_type, --v_btc_type                   VARCHAR2,
                        v.itb_branch_code, --v_branch_code                NUMBER,
                        v.itb_narrative || ' - CONTRA',
                        --v_description                VARCHAR2,
                        v.itb_ref,    --v_ref                        VARCHAR2,
                        v_gl_trans,
                        --v_gl_trans          IN OUT   tq_fms.fms_vouchers_pkg.tgl_rec_type,
                        v.itb_cad_code,
                        --v_cad_code                   NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                        v.itb_otop_code,
                        --v_otop_code                  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                        v.itb_fpmt_code,
                        --v_fpmt_code                  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                        v.itb_ort_code,
                        --v_ort_code                   NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                        v.itb_brr_reprint_code,
                        --v_btr_no                     NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                        v.itb_ppr_code,
                        --v_ppr_code                   NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                        v.itb_ocl_code,
                        --v_ocl_code                NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                        v.itb_agn_code,
                        --v_agn_code                NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                        v.itb_trans_no --v_trans_no                NUMBER DEFAULT NULL
                                      );
                ELSE
                    interface_update_vcb (
                        v_trans_code,                  --v_trans_code  NUMBER,
                        v_user_name,  --v_raise_by                   VARCHAR2,
                        v.itb_pol_code,           --                   NUMBER,
                        NVL (v.itb_vgl_post_date, NVL (v.itb_date, v_date)), --v_date                       DATE,
                        NVL (v.itb_opr_code, v_opr_code), --v_opr_code                   NUMBER,
                        NVL (v.itb_oppr_code, v_oppr_code), --v_oppr_code                  NUMBER,
                        v.itb_batch_desc || ' - CONTRA',
                        --v_btc_description            VARCHAR2,
                        v.itb_batch_type, --v_btc_type                   VARCHAR2,
                        v.itb_branch_code, --v_branch_code                NUMBER,
                        v.itb_narrative || ' - CONTRA',
                        --v_description                VARCHAR2,
                        v.itb_ref,    --v_ref                        VARCHAR2,
                        v_tcg_rec,
                        --v_tcg_rec          IN OUT   tq_fms.fms_vouchers_pkg.tcg_rec_type,
                        v_cb_rec,
                        --v_cb_rec          IN OUT   tq_fms.fms_vouchers_pkg.tcb_rec_type,
                        v.itb_rcpt_no,
                        --v_cad_code                   NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                        v_paymt_mode,
                        --v_paymt_mode                  VARCHAR2 DEFAULT NULL,
                        v_vcb_no,
                        v.itb_cad_code,
                        --v_cad_code                   NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                        v.itb_otop_code,
                        --v_otop_code                  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                        v.itb_fpmt_code,
                        --v_fpmt_code                  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                        v.itb_ort_code,
                        --v_ort_code                   NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                        v.itb_brr_reprint_code,
                        --v_btr_no                     NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                        v.itb_ppr_code --v_ppr_code                   NUMBER DEFAULT NULL
                                      );
                END IF;
            END LOOP;
        END IF;
    END post_contra;

    PROCEDURE post_prof_paymt (
        v_tran_no      NUMBER,
        v_facil_name   VARCHAR2,
        v_facil_code   NUMBER,
        v_user         VARCHAR2,
        v_sys_code     NUMBER,
        v_vchr_no      VARCHAR2
    )
    IS
        CURSOR cur_prof_pymt IS
            SELECT *
              FROM lms_profit_payments
             WHERE     lprof_pay_trans_no = v_tran_no
                   AND lprof_code = v_facil_code
                   AND lprof_brn_code IS NOT NULL;

        v_payee_eft_rec         fms_cheques_pkg.type_payee_eft_table;
        v_trns_rec              fms_cheques_pkg.type_rqn_dtls_table;
        v_eft_enabled           VARCHAR2 (1) := 'N';
        v_crt_acc_no            VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_org_code              NUMBER;
        v_cur_code              NUMBER;
        v_bct_code              NUMBER;
        v_bct_brh_code          NUMBER;
        v_authorized_by         NUMBER;
        v_no                    NUMBER := 0;
        v_prod_code             NUMBER;
        v_trnt_code             VARCHAR2 (10);
        v_trnt_gl_code          VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_trnt_contra_gl_code   VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_gl_trans              fms_vouchers_pkg.tgl_rec_type;
        v_gl_count              NUMBER := -1;
        vgl_code                NUMBER;
        v_trans_code            NUMBER;
    BEGIN
        v_trns_rec.delete;
        v_no := 0;

        FOR f IN cur_prof_pymt
        LOOP
            SELECT    TO_NUMBER (TO_CHAR (SYSDATE, 'RRRR'))
                   || lms_transaction_seq.NEXTVAL
              INTO v_trans_code
              FROM DUAL;

            SELECT pol_prod_code
              INTO v_prod_code
              FROM lms_policies
             WHERE pol_code = f.lprof_pol_code;

            v_org_code := fms_interfaces_pkg.get_org (f.lprof_brn_code);
            v_no := v_no + 1;
            --raise_error(v_org_code||';'||v_prod_code);
            get_gl_code ('PROF',
                         v_prod_code,
                         v_trnt_code,
                         v_crt_acc_no,
                         v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
            valid_acc (v_crt_acc_no,
                       v_org_code,
                       f.lprof_brn_code,
                       'PROF');
            valid_acc (v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                       v_org_code,
                       f.lprof_brn_code,
                       'PROF CONTRA');

            BEGIN
                interface_append_chq (v_trans_code, --v_trans_code        NUMBER,
                                      v_user,  --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                                      f.lprof_pol_code, --v_pol_code           NUMBER,
                                      v_prod_code, --v_prod_code          NUMBER,
                                      v_vchr_no, --v_vchr_no           VARCHAR2,
                                      v_no,     --v_count              NUMBER,
                                      f.lprof_amount, --v_amount             NUMBER,
                                      'PAYMENT FOR PROFIT', --v_narrative          VARCHAR2,
                                      v_trnt_contra_gl_code, --v_acc_number           VARCHAR2,
                                      v_org_code, --v_acc_org_code        NUMBER,
                                      f.lprof_brn_code, --v_branch_code        NUMBER,
                                      'D',    --v_drcr               VARCHAR2,
                                      v_trns_rec,
                                      --v_trn_rec   IN OUT   Fms_Cheques_Pkg.Type_rqn_dtls_table)
                                      NULL); --v_fpmt_code       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL
            EXCEPTION
                WHEN OTHERS
                THEN
                    tqc_error_manager.raise_error (
                        270102501,
                        text_in   => 'Error appending cheque details.');
            END;

            IF v_no <> 0
            THEN
                --RAISE_ERROR('PROFIT AMT='||f.lprof_amount);
                BEGIN
                    interface_create_reqn (
                        v_trans_code,           --v_trans_code         NUMBER,
                        v_vchr_no,         --v_ref                   VARCHAR2,
                        f.lprof_code,      --v_ref2                  VARCHAR2,
                        TRUNC (SYSDATE),       --v_ref_date              DATE,
                        'PAYMENT FOR PROFIT (' || f.lprof_pymt_type || ')',
                        --v_narrative             VARCHAR2,
                        NVL (f.lprof_amount, 0), --v_amount                NUMBER,
                        v_facil_name,      --v_payee                 VARCHAR2,
                        NVL (f.lprof_pymt_type, 'CHQ'),
                        --v_pay_method            VARCHAR2, --CHQ, EFT
                        f.lprof_bbr_acc_no, --v_payee_bank_acc_no        VARCHAR2,
                        f.lprof_bbr_code, --v_payee_bank_branch_code   NUMBER,
                        v_user,            --v_source_auth_by        VARCHAR2,
                        TRUNC (SYSDATE),       --v_source_auth_dt        DATE,
                        v_user,          --v_raise_by                VARCHAR2,
                        'PROF',            --v_pmt_type              VARCHAR2,
                        f.lprof_brn_code,     --v_branch_code          NUMBER,
                        NULL,                                    --v_pol_code,
                        v_trns_rec,
                        --v_dtls_table  IN OUT  Fms_Cheques_Pkg.Type_rqn_dtls_table)
                        NULL);
                --v_dtls_table  IN OUT    Fms_Cheques_Pkg.Type_rqn_dtls_table)
                EXCEPTION
                    WHEN OTHERS
                    THEN
                        tqc_error_manager.raise_error (
                            270102502,
                            text_in   =>
                                'Error creating Medicl cheque details.');
                END;

                BEGIN
                    v_gl_count := v_gl_count + 2;
                    interface_append_gl (v_trans_code, --v_trans_code        NUMBER,
                                         v_user, --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                                         NULL,   --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                                         v_prod_code, --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                                         v_vchr_no, --v_vchr_no           VARCHAR2,
                                         NULL,   --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                                         NULL,   --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                                         NULL,  --v_rcpt_no          VARCHAR2,
                                         v_gl_count, --v_count             NUMBER,
                                         'PAYMENT FOR PROF: ' || v_vchr_no,
                                         --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                                         NVL (f.lprof_amount, 0), --v_amount            NUMBER,
                                         'D',  --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                                         v_crt_acc_no, --v_acc_number1         VARCHAR2,
                                         v_trnt_contra_gl_code, --v_acc_number2         VARCHAR2,
                                         f.lprof_brn_code, --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                                         v_gl_trans,
                                         --v_trn_rec   IN OUT  fms_test.Fms_Vouchers_Pkg.Tgl_rec_type,
                                         NULL, --v_cad_code       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                         NULL, --v_otop_code       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                         NULL); --v_fpmt_code       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL)
                    interface_update_vgl (
                        v_trans_code,               --v_trans_code     NUMBER,
                        v_user,                --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                        NULL,                    --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                        TRUNC (SYSDATE),                --v_date         DATE,
                        NULL,                    --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                        NULL,                    --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                        'LMS PROFIT SHARE',
                        --v_btc_description   VARCHAR2,
                        'JV',                 --v_btc_type           VARCHAR2,
                        f.lprof_brn_code,
                        --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                        'PAYMENT FOR PROFIT SHARE: ' || v_vchr_no,
                        --v_description       VARCHAR2,
                        v_vchr_no,
                        --v_ref_no            VARCHAR2,
                        v_gl_trans,
                        --v_gl_trans  IN OUT  fms_test.Fms_Vouchers_Pkg.Tgl_rec_type,
                        NULL,
                        --v_cad_code       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                        NULL,
                        --v_otop_code       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                        NULL);
                --v_fpmt_code       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL)
                EXCEPTION
                    WHEN OTHERS
                    THEN
                        tqc_error_manager.raise_error (
                            270102503,
                            text_in   => 'Error populating GL details.');
                END;
            END IF;
        END LOOP;
    EXCEPTION
        WHEN OTHERS
        THEN
            tqc_error_manager.raise_error (
                270102504,
                text_in   => 'Error posting profit payment.');
    END post_prof_paymt;

    PROCEDURE post_grp_loan_repayment_gl (
        v_trans_no    NUMBER,
        v_brn_code    NUMBER,
        v_auth_date   DATE,
        v_user        VARCHAR2,
        v_amount      NUMBER,
        v_prod_code   NUMBER,
        v_curr_code   NUMBER
    )
    IS
        v_org_code              NUMBER;
        v_trnt_code             VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_trnt_gl_code          VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_trnt_contra_gl_code   VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_gl_count              NUMBER := -1;
        v_vgl_no                NUMBER;
        v_trans_code            NUMBER;
        v_gl_trans              fms_vouchers_pkg.tgl_rec_type;
    BEGIN
        v_gl_trans.delete;
        v_org_code := fms_interfaces_pkg.get_org (v_brn_code);

        SELECT    TO_NUMBER (TO_CHAR (SYSDATE, 'RRRR'))
               || lms_transaction_seq.NEXTVAL
          INTO v_trans_code
          FROM DUAL;

        get_gl_code ('NL_G',
                     v_prod_code,
                     v_trnt_code,
                     v_trnt_gl_code,
                     v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
        valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                   v_org_code,
                   v_brn_code,
                   'NL_G');
        valid_acc (v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                   v_org_code,
                   v_brn_code,
                   'NL_G contra');
        v_gl_count := v_gl_count + 2;

        IF NVL (v_amount, 0) > 0
        THEN
            interface_append_gl (v_trans_code,   --v_trans_code        NUMBER,
                                 v_user,       --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                                 NULL,           --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                                 v_prod_code,    --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                                 v_trans_no,    --v_vchr_no          VARCHAR2,
                                 NULL,           --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                                 NULL,           --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                                 NULL,          --v_rcpt_no          VARCHAR2,
                                 v_gl_count,     --v_count             NUMBER,
                                 'GRP LOAN REPAYMENT',
                                 --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                                 v_amount,
                                 --v_amount            NUMBER,
                                 'D',          --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                                 v_trnt_contra_gl_code, --v_acc_number1       VARCHAR2,
                                 v_trnt_gl_code,
                                 --v_acc_number2         VARCHAR2,
                                 v_brn_code,     --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                                 v_gl_trans);
            interface_append_gl (v_trans_code,   --v_trans_code        NUMBER,
                                 v_user,       --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                                 NULL,           --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                                 v_prod_code,    --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                                 v_trans_no,    --v_vchr_no          VARCHAR2,
                                 NULL,           --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                                 NULL,           --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                                 NULL,          --v_rcpt_no          VARCHAR2,
                                 v_gl_count,     --v_count             NUMBER,
                                 'GRP LOAN REPAYMENT',
                                 --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                                 v_amount,
                                 --v_amount            NUMBER,
                                 'C',          --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                                 v_trnt_gl_code, --v_acc_number1       VARCHAR2,
                                 v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                 --v_acc_number2         VARCHAR2,
                                 v_brn_code,     --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                                 v_gl_trans);
        ELSIF NVL (v_amount, 0) < 0
        THEN
            interface_append_gl (v_trans_code,   --v_trans_code        NUMBER,
                                 v_user,       --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                                 NULL,           --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                                 v_prod_code,    --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                                 v_trans_no,    --v_vchr_no          VARCHAR2,
                                 NULL,           --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                                 NULL,           --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                                 NULL,          --v_rcpt_no          VARCHAR2,
                                 v_gl_count,     --v_count             NUMBER,
                                 'GRP LOAN REPAYMENT',
                                 --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                                 ABS (v_amount),
                                 --v_amount            NUMBER,
                                 'C',          --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                                 v_trnt_contra_gl_code, --v_acc_number1       VARCHAR2,
                                 v_trnt_gl_code,
                                 --v_acc_number2         VARCHAR2,
                                 v_brn_code,     --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                                 v_gl_trans);
            interface_append_gl (v_trans_code,   --v_trans_code        NUMBER,
                                 v_user,       --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                                 NULL,           --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                                 v_prod_code,    --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                                 v_trans_no,    --v_vchr_no          VARCHAR2,
                                 NULL,           --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                                 NULL,           --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                                 NULL,          --v_rcpt_no          VARCHAR2,
                                 v_gl_count,     --v_count             NUMBER,
                                 'GRP LOAN REPAYMENT',
                                 --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                                 ABS (v_amount),
                                 --v_amount            NUMBER,
                                 'D',          --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                                 v_trnt_gl_code, --v_acc_number1       VARCHAR2,
                                 v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                 --v_acc_number2         VARCHAR2,
                                 v_brn_code,     --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                                 v_gl_trans);
        END IF;

        IF v_gl_count > 0
        THEN
            interface_update_vgl (v_trans_code,     --v_trans_code     NUMBER,
                                  v_user,      --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                                  NULL,          --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                                  TRUNC (v_auth_date),  --v_date         DATE,
                                  NULL,          --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                                  NULL,          --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                                  'GRP LOAN REPAYMENT BATCH', --v_btc_description   VARCHAR2,
                                  'JV',       --v_btc_type           VARCHAR2,
                                  v_brn_code,    --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                                  'GRP LOAN REPAYMENT', --v_description       VARCHAR2,
                                  v_trans_no,   --v_ref_no           VARCHAR2,
                                  v_gl_trans,
                                  NULL,
                                  NULL,
                                  NULL,
                                  NULL,
                                  NULL,
                                  NULL,
                                  NULL,
                                  NULL,
                                  NULL,
                                  v_curr_code);
        END IF;
    EXCEPTION
        WHEN OTHERS
        THEN
            raise_error ('Error posting loan repayments');
    END post_grp_loan_repayment_gl;

    PROCEDURE post_grp_pens_charges (
        v_trans_no           NUMBER,
        v_brn_code           NUMBER,
        v_auth_date          DATE,
        v_user               VARCHAR2,
        v_admin_fee          NUMBER,
        v_vat_amt            NUMBER,
        v_pndp_chq_rcpt_no   VARCHAR2,
        v_prod_code          NUMBER,
        v_curr_code          NUMBER
    )
    IS
        v_org_code              NUMBER;
        v_trnt_code             VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_trnt_gl_code          VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_trnt_contra_gl_code   VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_gl_count              NUMBER := -1;
        v_vgl_no                NUMBER;
        v_trans_code            NUMBER;
        v_gl_trans              fms_vouchers_pkg.tgl_rec_type;
    BEGIN
        v_gl_trans.delete;
        v_org_code := fms_interfaces_pkg.get_org (v_brn_code);

        SELECT    TO_NUMBER (TO_CHAR (SYSDATE, 'RRRR'))
               || lms_transaction_seq.NEXTVAL
          INTO v_trans_code
          FROM DUAL;

        get_gl_code ('ADMFEE_GB',
                     v_prod_code,
                     v_trnt_code,
                     v_trnt_gl_code,
                     v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
        valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                   v_org_code,
                   v_brn_code,
                   'ADMFEE_GB');
        valid_acc (v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                   v_org_code,
                   v_brn_code,
                   'ADMFEE_GB contra');
        v_gl_count := v_gl_count + 2;

        IF NVL (v_admin_fee, 0) > 0
        THEN
            interface_append_gl (v_trans_code,   --v_trans_code        NUMBER,
                                 v_user,       --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                                 NULL,           --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                                 v_prod_code,    --v_prod_code         NUMBER,

                                 NULL,           --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                                 NULL,           --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                                 NULL,          --v_rcpt_no          VARCHAR2,
                                 v_gl_count,     --v_count             NUMBER,
                                 'GRP PENSION ADMIN FEE',
                                 --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                                 v_admin_fee,
                                 --v_amount            NUMBER,
                                 'D',          --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                                 v_trnt_contra_gl_code, --v_acc_number1       VARCHAR2,
                                 v_trnt_gl_code,
                                 --v_acc_number2         VARCHAR2,
                                 v_brn_code,     --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                                 v_gl_trans);
            interface_append_gl (
                v_trans_code,                    --v_trans_code        NUMBER,
                v_user,                        --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                NULL,                            --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                v_prod_code,                     --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                v_trans_no,                     --v_vchr_no          VARCHAR2,
                NULL,                            --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                NULL,                            --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                NULL,                           --v_rcpt_no          VARCHAR2,
                v_gl_count,                      --v_count             NUMBER,
                'GROUP PENSION ADMIN FEE' || ' - ' || v_pndp_chq_rcpt_no,
                --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                v_admin_fee,
                --v_amount            NUMBER,
                'C',                           --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                v_trnt_gl_code,                --v_acc_number1       VARCHAR2,
                v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                --v_acc_number2         VARCHAR2,
                v_brn_code,                      --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                v_gl_trans);
        ELSIF NVL (v_admin_fee, 0) < 0
        THEN
            interface_append_gl (
                v_trans_code,                    --v_trans_code        NUMBER,
                v_user,                        --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                NULL,                            --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                v_prod_code,                     --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                v_trans_no,                     --v_vchr_no          VARCHAR2,
                NULL,                            --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                NULL,                            --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                NULL,                           --v_rcpt_no          VARCHAR2,
                v_gl_count,                      --v_count             NUMBER,
                'GROUP PENSION ADMIN FEE' || ' - ' || v_pndp_chq_rcpt_no,
                --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                ABS (v_admin_fee),
                --v_amount            NUMBER,
                'C',                           --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                v_trnt_contra_gl_code,         --v_acc_number1       VARCHAR2,
                v_trnt_gl_code,
                --v_acc_number2         VARCHAR2,
                v_brn_code,                      --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                v_gl_trans);
            interface_append_gl (
                v_trans_code,                    --v_trans_code        NUMBER,
                v_user,                        --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                NULL,                            --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                v_prod_code,                     --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                v_trans_no,                     --v_vchr_no          VARCHAR2,
                NULL,                            --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                NULL,                            --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                NULL,                           --v_rcpt_no          VARCHAR2,
                v_gl_count,                      --v_count             NUMBER,
                'GROUP PENSION ADMIN FEE' || ' - ' || v_pndp_chq_rcpt_no,
                --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                ABS (v_admin_fee),
                --v_amount            NUMBER,
                'D',                           --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                v_trnt_gl_code,                --v_acc_number1       VARCHAR2,
                v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                --v_acc_number2         VARCHAR2,
                v_brn_code,                      --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                v_gl_trans);
        END IF;

        get_gl_code ('VAT_GB',
                     v_prod_code,
                     v_trnt_code,
                     v_trnt_gl_code,
                     v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
        valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                   v_org_code,
                   v_brn_code,
                   'VAT_GB');
        valid_acc (v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                   v_org_code,
                   v_brn_code,
                   'VAT_GB contra');
        v_gl_count := v_gl_count + 2;

        IF NVL (v_vat_amt, 0) > 0
        THEN
            interface_append_gl (
                v_trans_code,                    --v_trans_code        NUMBER,
                v_user,                        --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                NULL,                            --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                v_prod_code,                     --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                v_trans_no,                     --v_vchr_no          VARCHAR2,
                NULL,                            --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                NULL,                            --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                NULL,                           --v_rcpt_no          VARCHAR2,
                v_gl_count,                      --v_count             NUMBER,
                'GROUP PENSION VAT' || ' - ' || v_pndp_chq_rcpt_no,
                --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                v_vat_amt,
                --v_amount            NUMBER,
                'D',                           --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                v_trnt_contra_gl_code,         --v_acc_number1       VARCHAR2,
                v_trnt_gl_code,
                --v_acc_number2         VARCHAR2,
                v_brn_code,                      --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                v_gl_trans);
            interface_append_gl (
                v_trans_code,                    --v_trans_code        NUMBER,
                v_user,                        --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                NULL,                            --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                v_prod_code,                     --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                v_trans_no,                     --v_vchr_no          VARCHAR2,
                NULL,                            --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                NULL,                            --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                NULL,                           --v_rcpt_no          VARCHAR2,
                v_gl_count,                      --v_count             NUMBER,
                'GROUP PENSION VAT' || ' - ' || v_pndp_chq_rcpt_no,
                --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                v_vat_amt,
                --v_amount            NUMBER,
                'C',                           --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                v_trnt_gl_code,                --v_acc_number1       VARCHAR2,
                v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
