                --v_acc_number2         VARCHAR2,
                v_brn_code,                      --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                v_gl_trans);
        ELSIF NVL (v_vat_amt, 0) < 0
        THEN
            interface_append_gl (
                v_trans_code,                    --v_trans_code        NUMBER,
                v_user,                        --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                NULL,                            --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                v_prod_code,                     --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                v_trans_no,                     --v_vchr_no          VARCHAR2,
                NULL,                            --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                NULL,                            --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                NULL,                           --v_rcpt_no          VARCHAR2,
                v_gl_count,                      --v_count             NUMBER,
                'GROUP PENSION VAT' || ' - ' || v_pndp_chq_rcpt_no,
                --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                ABS (v_vat_amt),
                --v_amount            NUMBER,
                'C',                           --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                v_trnt_contra_gl_code,         --v_acc_number1       VARCHAR2,
                v_trnt_gl_code,
                --v_acc_number2         VARCHAR2,
                v_brn_code,                      --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                v_gl_trans);
            interface_append_gl (
                v_trans_code,                    --v_trans_code        NUMBER,
                v_user,                        --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                NULL,                            --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                v_prod_code,                     --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                v_trans_no,                     --v_vchr_no          VARCHAR2,
                NULL,                            --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                NULL,                            --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                NULL,                           --v_rcpt_no          VARCHAR2,
                v_gl_count,                      --v_count             NUMBER,
                'GROUP PENSION VAT' || ' - ' || v_pndp_chq_rcpt_no,
                --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                ABS (v_vat_amt),
                --v_amount            NUMBER,
                'D',                           --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                v_trnt_gl_code,                --v_acc_number1       VARCHAR2,
                v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                --v_acc_number2         VARCHAR2,
                v_brn_code,                      --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                v_gl_trans);
        END IF;

        IF v_gl_count > 0
        THEN
            interface_update_vgl (
                v_trans_code,                       --v_trans_code     NUMBER,
                v_user,                        --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                NULL,                            --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                TRUNC (v_auth_date),                    --v_date         DATE,
                NULL,                            --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                NULL,                            --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                'GRP ADMIN FEE BATCH',         --v_btc_description   VARCHAR2,
                'JV',                         --v_btc_type           VARCHAR2,
                v_brn_code,                      --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                'GROUP PENSION ADMIN FEE' || ' - ' || v_pndp_chq_rcpt_no,
                --v_description       VARCHAR2,
                v_trans_no,                     --v_ref_no           VARCHAR2,
                v_gl_trans,
                NULL,
                NULL,
                NULL,
                NULL,
                NULL,
                NULL,
                NULL,
                NULL,
                NULL,
                v_curr_code);
        END IF;
    EXCEPTION
        WHEN OTHERS
        THEN
            raise_error ('Error posting pension admin fee');
    END post_grp_pens_charges;

    PROCEDURE grp_process_loan (
        v_loan_no          NUMBER,
        v_pol_code         NUMBER,
        v_gross_amount     NUMBER,
        v_service_charge   NUMBER,
        v_pay_method       VARCHAR2 DEFAULT 'CHQ'
    )
    IS
        CURSOR c_loan IS
            SELECT gpln_no                                                   lna_no,
                   pol_policy_no,
                   gpln_prepared_by                                          lna_prepared_by,
                   gpln_date                                                 lna_date_issued,
                   gpln_payee                                                payee,
                   pol_bra_code,
                   pol_prod_code,
                   gpln_amt_issued                                           lna_alloc_amt,
                   lms_api.bnk_bbr_code (pol_code)                           lna_bbr_code,
                   NULL                                                      lna_acc_no,
                   gpln_authorised_by                                        lna_authorized_by,
                   lms_ord_mis.check_renewal_paymnt (pol_code, gpln_date)    renewal
              FROM lms_grp_pens_loans, lms_policies
             WHERE     gpln_pol_code = pol_code
                   AND gpln_no = v_loan_no
                   AND pol_code = v_pol_code;

        v_ltx_rate_desc         VARCHAR2 (30);
        v_ltx_tax_amt           NUMBER;
        v_loan_acc_no           VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_svc_charge_acc_no     VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_tax_acc_no            VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_trnt_contra_gl_code   VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_brh_code              NUMBER;
        v_org_code              NUMBER;
        v_count                 NUMBER := 0;
        v_cur_code              NUMBER;
        v_sys_code              NUMBER;
        v_chq_dtls_rec          fms_cheques_pkg.type_rqn_dtls_table;
        v_trnt_code             VARCHAR2 (10);
        v_trnt_gl_code          VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_gl_trans              fms_vouchers_pkg.tgl_rec_type;
        v_gl_count              NUMBER := 0;
        vgl_code                NUMBER;
        v_trans_code            NUMBER;
    BEGIN
        FOR i IN c_loan
        LOOP
            v_brh_code := i.pol_bra_code;
            v_org_code := fms_interfaces_pkg.get_org (v_brh_code);

            /* BEGIN
                SELECT ltx_rate_desc, NVL (ltx_tax_amt, 0)
                  INTO v_ltx_rate_desc, v_ltx_tax_amt
                  FROM lms_loan_taxes
                 WHERE ltx_lna_no = v_loan_no AND ltx_pol_code = v_pol_code;
             EXCEPTION
                WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND
                THEN
                   raise_error ('UNABLE TO COMPUTE LOAN TAXES..');
                WHEN OTHERS
                THEN
                   raise_error ('UNABLE TO GET LOAN TAXES..');
             END;*/
            SELECT    TO_NUMBER (TO_CHAR (SYSDATE, 'RRRR'))
                   || lms_transaction_seq.NEXTVAL
              INTO v_trans_code
              FROM DUAL;

            get_gl_code ('POL_LOAN',
                         i.pol_prod_code,
                         v_trnt_code,
                         v_loan_acc_no,
                         v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                         NULL,
                         i.renewal);
            --check if accounts exist in policy branch
            valid_acc (v_loan_acc_no,
                       v_org_code,
                       v_brh_code,
                       'POL_LOAN');
            valid_acc (v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                       v_org_code,
                       v_brh_code,
                       'POL_LOAN CONTRA');
            v_gl_count := v_gl_count + 1;
            interface_append_gl (v_trans_code,  --v_trans_code         NUMBER,
                                 i.lna_prepared_by,
                                 --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                                 v_pol_code,     --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                                 i.pol_prod_code, --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                                 i.lna_no,    --v_vchr_no            VARCHAR2,
                                 NULL,           --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                                 NULL,           --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                                 NULL,        --v_rcpt_no            VARCHAR2,
                                 v_gl_count,     --v_count             NUMBER,
                                 'LOAN PAYMENT. - ',
                                 --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                                 i.lna_alloc_amt, --v_amount            NUMBER,
                                 'D',          --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                                 v_loan_acc_no, --v_acc_number          VARCHAR2,
                                 v_brh_code,     --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                                 v_gl_trans);
            v_gl_count := v_gl_count + 1;
            interface_append_gl (v_trans_code,  --v_trans_code         NUMBER,
                                 i.lna_prepared_by,
                                 --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                                 v_pol_code,     --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                                 i.pol_prod_code, --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                                 i.lna_no,    --v_vchr_no            VARCHAR2,
                                 NULL,           --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                                 NULL,           --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                                 NULL,        --v_rcpt_no            VARCHAR2,
                                 v_gl_count,     --v_count             NUMBER,
                                 'LOAN PAYMENT. - ',
                                 i.lna_alloc_amt, --v_amount            NUMBER,
                                 'C',          --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                                 v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                 --v_acc_number        VARCHAR2,
                                 v_brh_code,     --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                                 v_gl_trans);
            --raise_error('here....');
            v_count := v_count + 1;
            interface_append_chq (v_trans_code,   --v_trans_code       NUMBER,
                                  i.lna_prepared_by,
                                  --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                                  v_pol_code,   --v_pol_code           NUMBER,
                                  i.pol_prod_code, --v_prod_code          NUMBER,
                                  i.lna_no,  --v_vchr_no             VARCHAR2,
                                  v_count,      --v_count              NUMBER,
                                  i.lna_alloc_amt,
                                  --v_amount             NUMBER,
                                  'LOAN PAYMENT. - ',
                                  --v_narrative          VARCHAR2,
                                  v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                  --v_acc_number          VARCHAR2,
                                  v_org_code,  --v_acc_org_code        NUMBER,
                                  v_brh_code,   --v_branch_code        NUMBER,
                                  'D',        --v_drcr               VARCHAR2,
                                  v_chq_dtls_rec);
            --Raise_error('v_ltx_tax_amt='||v_ltx_tax_amt  ||';' || v_service_charge||';lna_alloc_amt='||i.lna_alloc_amt||';gross='||v_gross_amount);
            interface_create_reqn (v_trans_code, --v_trans_code         NUMBER,
                                   i.lna_no, --v_ref                   VARCHAR2,
                                   i.pol_policy_no,
                                   --v_ref2                  VARCHAR2,
                                   i.lna_date_issued,
                                   --v_ref_date              DATE,
                                   'LOAN PAYMENT.',
                                   --v_narrative             VARCHAR2,
                                   i.lna_alloc_amt,
                                   --v_amount                NUMBER,
                                   i.payee, --v_payee                 VARCHAR2,
                                   NVL (v_pay_method, 'CHQ'),
                                   --v_pay_method            VARCHAR2, --CHQ, EFT
                                   i.lna_acc_no,
                                   --v_payee_bank_acc_no        VARCHAR2,
                                   i.lna_bbr_code,
                                   --v_payee_bank_branch_code   NUMBER,
                                   i.lna_authorized_by,
                                   --v_source_auth_by        VARCHAR2,
                                   i.lna_date_issued,
                                   --v_source_auth_dt        DATE,
                                   i.lna_prepared_by,
                                   --v_raise_by                VARCHAR2,
                                   'LOAN', --v_pmt_type              VARCHAR2,
                                   v_brh_code, --v_branch_code         NUMBER,
                                   v_pol_code,   --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                                   v_chq_dtls_rec);
        /*interface_update_vgl (v_trans_code,        --v_trans_code     NUMBER,
                              i.lna_prepared_by,
                              --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                              v_pol_code,       --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                              TRUNC (SYSDATE),         --v_date         DATE,
                              NULL,             --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                              NULL,            -- v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                              'LOAN PAYMENTS ',
                              --v_btc_description   VARCHAR2,
                              'JV',           --v_btc_type          VARCHAR2,
                              v_brh_code,       --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                              'LOAN PAYMENT. - ' || i.lna_no|| ' - '
                                || 'Policy ('||i.pol_policy_no||')',
                              --v_description       VARCHAR2,
                              i.lna_no,            --v_ref          VARCHAR2,
                              v_gl_trans
                             );*/
        --RAISE_ERROR('HERE....');
        --v_gl_trans  IN OUT  Fms_Vouchers_Pkg.Tgl_rec_type,
        END LOOP;

        IF v_count = 0
        THEN
            raise_error (
                'LOAN ' || v_loan_no || ' NOT POSTED TO FINANCE' || SQLERRM);
        END IF;
    EXCEPTION
        WHEN OTHERS
        THEN
            raise_error ('PROCESSING LOAN. ' || SQLERRM (SQLCODE));
    END grp_process_loan;

    PROCEDURE post_grp_admin_charge (
        v_pol_code   NUMBER,
        v_username   VARCHAR2,
        v_trans_no   NUMBER
    )
    IS
        CURSOR c_admin_fee IS
              SELECT pacp_prp_code,
                     TRUNC (pacp_date)
                         pacp_date,
                     SUM (NVL (pacp_amt, 0))
                         amount,
                     pacp_brn_code,
                     TRIM (
                            prp_first_name
                         || ' '
                         || TRIM (prp_other_names || ' ' || prp_surname))
                         client,
                     pacp_prepared_by,
                     pol_policy_no,
                     pacp_pay_method,
                     pacp_bbr_code,
                     pacp_bbr_acc_no,
                     pacp_agn_payee,
                     pacp_agn_code
                FROM lms_policy_admin_charge_pymts, lms_proposers, lms_policies
               WHERE     pacp_prp_code = prp_code
                     AND pacp_pol_code = v_pol_code
                     AND NVL (pacp_authorized, 'N') = 'N'
                     AND pacp_paid IN ('N', 'R')
                     AND pacp_pol_code = pol_code
                     --and agn_name not like ('DIRECT%')
                     AND pacp_authorized_date IS NULL
            GROUP BY pacp_prp_code,
                     pacp_date,
                     pacp_brn_code,
                     TRIM (
                            prp_first_name
                         || ' '
                         || TRIM (prp_other_names || ' ' || prp_surname)),
                     pacp_prepared_by,
                     pol_policy_no,
                     pacp_pay_method,
                     pacp_bbr_code,
                     pacp_bbr_acc_no,
                     pacp_agn_payee,
                     pacp_agn_code;

        v_org_code               NUMBER;
        v_crt_acc_no             VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_sys_code               NUMBER;
        v_bct_code               NUMBER;
        v_bct_brh_code           NUMBER;
        v_chq_dtls_rec           fms_cheques_pkg.type_rqn_dtls_table;
        v_prod_code              NUMBER;
        v_trnt_prod_applicable   VARCHAR2 (3);
        v_trnt_contra_gl_code    VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_count                  NUMBER := 0;
        v_cont                   NUMBER := -1;
        v_cnt                    NUMBER := 0;
        v_gl_count               NUMBER := 0;
        v_cur_code               NUMBER;
        v_brh_code               NUMBER;
        v_raised_by              NUMBER;
        v_auth_by                NUMBER;
        v_trnt_code              VARCHAR2 (10);
        v_gl_trans               fms_vouchers_pkg.tgl_rec_type;
        v_gl_acc                 VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_gl_acc2                VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_vgl_no                 NUMBER;
        v_contra_gl_code         VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_drcr                   VARCHAR2 (2);
        v_trans_code             NUMBER;
        v_agn_name               VARCHAR (100);
        v_currency_code          NUMBER;
    BEGIN
        SELECT    TO_NUMBER (TO_CHAR (SYSDATE, 'RRRR'))
               || lms_transaction_seq.NEXTVAL
          INTO v_trans_code
          FROM DUAL;

        BEGIN
            SELECT pol_prod_code, pol_cur_code
              INTO v_prod_code, v_currency_code
              FROM lms_policies
             WHERE pol_code = v_pol_code;
        END;

        FOR r IN c_admin_fee
        LOOP
            v_org_code := fms_interfaces_pkg.get_org (r.pacp_brn_code);

            IF r.amount < 0
            THEN
                NULL;
            ELSIF r.amount >= 0
            THEN
                IF NVL (r.amount, 0) <> 0
                THEN
                    get_gl_code ('ADM_GB',
                                 v_prod_code,
                                 v_trnt_code,
                                 v_crt_acc_no,
                                 v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
                    valid_acc (v_crt_acc_no,
                               v_org_code,
                               r.pacp_brn_code,
                               'ADM_GB');
                    valid_acc (v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                               v_org_code,
                               r.pacp_brn_code,
                               'ADM_GB CONTRA');
                    v_gl_count := 0;
                    v_gl_count := v_gl_count + 1;
                    interface_append_gl (
                        v_trans_code,
                        --v_trans_code           NUMBER,
                        v_username,
                        --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                        v_pol_code,              --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                        v_prod_code,             --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                        NULL,                --v_vchr_no             VARCHAR2,
                        NULL,                    --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                        NULL,                    --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                        NULL,                --v_rcpt_no             VARCHAR2,
                        v_gl_count,              --v_count             NUMBER,
                        'GROUP ADMIN CHARGE - ' || r.pol_policy_no,
                        --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                        r.amount,                --v_amount            NUMBER,
                        'D',                   --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                        v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                        v_crt_acc_no,
                        r.pacp_brn_code,
                        --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                        v_gl_trans);
                    v_count := v_count + 1;
                    --raise_error('amount ='||r.amount||';'||v_count);
                    interface_append_chq (v_trans_code,
                                          --v_trans_code         NUMBER,
                                          v_username,
                                          --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                                          v_pol_code,
                                          --v_pol_code           NUMBER,
                                          v_prod_code,
                                          --v_prod_code          NUMBER,
                                          NULL, --v_vchr_no              VARCHAR2,
                                          v_count, --v_count              NUMBER,
                                          r.amount, --v_amount             NUMBER,
                                          'GROUP ADMIN CHARGE PAYMENT',
                                          --v_narrative          VARCHAR2,
                                          v_crt_acc_no,
                                          --v_acc_number            VARCHAR2,
                                          v_org_code,
                                          --v_acc_org_code          NUMBER,
                                          r.pacp_brn_code,
                                          --v_branch_code        NUMBER,
                                          'D', --v_drcr               VARCHAR2,
                                          v_chq_dtls_rec);
                END IF;

                v_brh_code := r.pacp_brn_code;
                interface_create_reqn (
                    v_trans_code,
                    --v_trans_code           NUMBER,
                    v_trans_no,
                    --v_ref                   VARCHAR2,
                    NVL (r.pacp_agn_code, r.pacp_prp_code),
                    --v_ref2                  VARCHAR2,
                    r.pacp_date,
                    --v_ref_date              DATE,
                    'GROUP ADMIN CHARGE PYMT( ' || r.pacp_agn_payee || ')',
                    --v_narrative             VARCHAR2,
                    r.amount,                --v_amount                NUMBER,
                    r.pacp_agn_payee,                              --r.client,
                    --v_payee                 VARCHAR2,
                    NVL (r.pacp_pay_method, 'CHQ'),
                    --v_pay_method            VARCHAR2, --CHQ, EFT
                    NVL (v_bct_code, r.pacp_bbr_acc_no),
                    --v_payee_bank_acc_no        VARCHAR2,
                    NVL (v_bct_brh_code, r.pacp_bbr_code),
                    --v_payee_bank_branch_code   NUMBER,
                    v_username,
                    --v_source_auth_by        VARCHAR2,
                    TRUNC (SYSDATE),
                    --v_source_auth_dt        DATE,
                    NVL (r.pacp_prepared_by, v_username),
                    --v_raise_by                VARCHAR2,
                    'ADM_CHARGE',
                    --v_pmt_type              VARCHAR2,
                    v_brh_code,                        --v_branch_code NUMBER,
                    NULL,
                    --v_pol_code,                                   --v_branch_code           NUMBER,
                    v_chq_dtls_rec);
            END IF;
        END LOOP;

        IF v_count != 0
        THEN
            interface_update_vgl (
                v_trans_code,                     --  v_trans_code     NUMBER,
                v_username,                    --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                v_pol_code,                      --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                SYSDATE,                           --v_date              DATE,
                NULL,                            --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                NULL,                            --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                'LMS GROUP ADMIN CHARGE PAYMENT', --v_btc_description   VARCHAR2,
                'JV',                       --v_btc_type             VARCHAR2,
                v_brh_code,                      --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                'GROUP COMMISSION PAYMENT ( ' || v_agn_name || ')',
                v_trans_no,                      --v_ref             VARCHAR2,
                v_gl_trans,
                NULL,
                NULL,
                NULL,
                NULL,
                NULL,
                NULL,
                NULL,
                NULL,
                NULL,
                v_currency_code);
        END IF;

        UPDATE lms_policy_admin_charge_pymts
           SET pacp_authorized = 'Y',
               pacp_paid = 'Y',
               pacp_authorized_by = v_username,
               pacp_authorized_date = TRUNC (SYSDATE),
               pacp_trans_no = v_trans_no
         WHERE     pacp_pol_code = v_pol_code
               AND NVL (pacp_authorized, 'N') = 'N'
               AND pacp_paid = 'N'
               AND pacp_authorized_date IS NULL;
    EXCEPTION
        WHEN OTHERS
        THEN
            raise_error ('POSTING ADMIN CHARGE PYMNT...');
    END post_grp_admin_charge;

    PROCEDURE update_grp_admin_charge_pymt (
        v_voucher_no   VARCHAR2,
        v_chq_no       VARCHAR2,
        v_chq_date     DATE,
        v_chq_amt      NUMBER,
        v_user         VARCHAR2
    )
    IS
    BEGIN
        --RAISE_ERROR('v_voucher_no='||v_voucher_no);
        BEGIN
            UPDATE lms_policy_admin_charge_pymts
               SET pacp_chq_no = v_chq_no,
                   pacp_chq_date = v_chq_date,
                   pacp_chq_amt = v_chq_amt
             WHERE pacp_trans_no = v_voucher_no;
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                raise_error ('Unable to update tax requisition....');
        END;
    END update_grp_admin_charge_pymt;

    PROCEDURE raise_reinsurance_cheque (
        v_voucher_no   VARCHAR2,
        v_amt          NUMBER,
        v_payee        VARCHAR2,
        v_user         VARCHAR2,
        v_account_no   VARCHAR2,
        v_brn_code     NUMBER,
        v_prod_code    NUMBER,
        v_curr_code    NUMBER,
        v_drcr         VARCHAR2 DEFAULT 'C',
        v_agn_code     NUMBER DEFAULT NULL
    )
    IS
        v_chq_dtls_rec           fms_cheques_pkg.type_rqn_dtls_table;
        v_trnt_gl_code           VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_count                  NUMBER := 0;
        v_org_code               NUMBER;
        v_crt_acc_no             VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_trnt_prod_applicable   VARCHAR2 (3);
        v_trnt_contra_gl_code    VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_gl_count               NUMBER := 0;
        v_cur_code               NUMBER;
        v_brh_code               NUMBER;
        v_trnt_code              VARCHAR2 (10);
        v_gl_trans               tq_fms.fms_vouchers_pkg.tgl_rec_type;
        v_gl_acc                 VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_gl_acc2                VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_vgl_no                 NUMBER;
        v_contra_gl_code         VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_cnt                    NUMBER := 0;
        v_trans_code             NUMBER;
        v_eft_enabled            VARCHAR2 (5);
        v_pay_method             VARCHAR2 (5);
        v_trans_no               NUMBER;
        v_adv_cnt                NUMBER;
        v_currency_code          NUMBER;
        v_bank_acc_no            VARCHAR2 (30);
        v_bbr_code               NUMBER;
    BEGIN
        v_gl_trans.delete;
        v_org_code := tq_fms.fms_interfaces_pkg.get_org (v_brn_code);

        IF NVL (v_drcr, 'C') = 'D'
        THEN
            BEGIN
                SELECT    TO_NUMBER (TO_CHAR (SYSDATE, 'RRRR'))
                       || lms_transaction_seq.NEXTVAL
                  INTO v_trans_code
                  FROM DUAL;

                v_count := v_count + 2;
            --            interface_append_gl
            --                              (v_trans_code,
            --                               --v_trans_code          NUMBER,
            --                               v_user,         --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
            --                               NULL,             --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
            --                               v_prod_code,
            --                               --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
            --                               v_voucher_no,
            --                               --v_vchr_no          VARCHAR2,
            --                               NULL,             --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
            --                               NULL,             --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
            --                               NULL,           --v_rcpt_no           VARCHAR2,
            --                               v_count,          --v_count             NUMBER,
            --                               'REINSURER PAYMENT',
            --                               --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
            --                               v_amt,            --v_amount            NUMBER,
            --                               'D',            --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
            --                               v_account_no,
            --                                            --v_acc_number1          VARCHAR2,
            --                               v_account_no,
            --                               --v_acc_number2            VARCHAR2
            --                               v_brn_code,
            --                               --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
            --                               v_gl_trans
            --                              );
            EXCEPTION
                WHEN OTHERS
                THEN
                    raise_error ('POST GROUP REINSURER AMT');
            END;
        ELSE
            SELECT agn_bank_acc_no, agn_bbr_code
              INTO v_bank_acc_no, v_bbr_code
              FROM lms_agencies
             WHERE agn_code = v_agn_code;

            IF v_bank_acc_no IS NULL
            THEN
                raise_error (
                       'The bank account number for '
                    || v_payee
                    || ' has not been defined');
            END IF;

            IF v_bbr_code IS NULL
            THEN
                raise_error (v_payee || ' bank has not been defined');
            END IF;

            BEGIN
                SELECT    TO_NUMBER (TO_CHAR (SYSDATE, 'RRRR'))
                       || lms_transaction_seq.NEXTVAL
                  INTO v_trans_code
                  FROM DUAL;

                v_count := v_count + 1;
                interface_append_chq (v_trans_code, --v_trans_code       NUMBER,
                                      v_user,
                                      --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                                      NULL,     --v_pol_code           NUMBER,
                                      v_prod_code, --v_prod_code          NUMBER,
                                      v_voucher_no,
                                      --v_vchr_no             VARCHAR2,
                                      v_count,  --v_count              NUMBER,
                                      v_amt,
                                      --v_amount             NUMBER,
                                      'REINSURER PAYMENT',
                                      --v_narrative          VARCHAR2,
                                      v_account_no,
                                      --v_acc_number          VARCHAR2,
                                      NULL,    --v_acc_org_code        NUMBER,
                                      v_brn_code, --v_branch_code        NUMBER,
                                      'D',    --v_drcr               VARCHAR2,
                                      v_chq_dtls_rec);
                interface_create_reqn (v_trans_code,
                                       --v_trans_code         NUMBER,
                                       v_voucher_no,
                                       --v_ref                   VARCHAR2,
                                       NULL,
                                       --v_ref2                  VARCHAR2,
                                       TRUNC (SYSDATE),
                                       --v_ref_date              DATE,
                                       'REINSURER PAYMENT( CHQ )',
                                       --v_narrative             VARCHAR2,
                                       v_amt, --v_amount                NUMBER,
                                       v_payee,
                                       --v_payee                 VARCHAR2,
                                       'EFT',
                                       --v_pay_method            VARCHAR2, --CHQ, EFT
                                       v_bank_acc_no,
                                       --v_payee_bank_acc_no        VARCHAR2,
                                       v_bbr_code, --v_payee_bank_branch_code   NUMBER,
                                       v_user, --v_source_auth_by        VARCHAR2,
                                       TRUNC (SYSDATE),
                                       --v_source_auth_dt        DATE,
                                       v_user,
                                       --v_raise_by                VARCHAR2,
                                       'REIN_PYMT',
                                       --v_pmt_type              VARCHAR2,
                                       v_brn_code,
                                       --v_branch_code         NUMBER,
                                       NULL,                     --v_pol_code,
                                       v_chq_dtls_rec,
                                       NULL,
                                       NULL,
                                       NULL,
                                       NULL,
                                       NULL,
                                       NULL,
                                       NULL,
                                       NULL,
                                       v_curr_code);
            EXCEPTION
                WHEN OTHERS
                THEN
                    raise_error ('POST GROUP REINSURER AMT');
            END;
        END IF;
    END;

    PROCEDURE update_ref3 (v_trans_code NUMBER)
    IS
        CURSOR trans_cur IS
            SELECT *
              FROM lms_interface_table
             WHERE     itb_transaction_code = v_trans_code
                   AND itb_transaction_type <> 'UPDATE_VCB';
    BEGIN
        --This is not right coz if the amounts cannot be used as a foregn key column
        --Coz they will not always be unique
        FOR trans_cur_rec IN trans_cur
        LOOP
            UPDATE fms_trngl
               SET tgl_itfc_ref3 = trans_cur_rec.itb_ref3
             WHERE     tgl_vgl_no IN
                           (SELECT vgl_no
                              FROM fms_vougl
                             WHERE vgl_itfc_trans_code = v_trans_code)
                   AND tgl_itfc_ref3 IS NULL
                   AND tgl_bcamt = trans_cur_rec.itb_amount;
        END LOOP;
    END update_ref3;

    PROCEDURE process_grp_rcpt_refund (
        v_pol_code    NUMBER,
        v_grr_code    NUMBER,
        v_raised_by   VARCHAR2
    )
    IS
        v_count                  NUMBER := 0;
        v_chq_cnt                NUMBER := 0;
        v_grct_code              NUMBER;
        v_gl_trans               fms_vouchers_pkg.tgl_rec_type;
        v_chq_dtls_rec           fms_cheques_pkg.type_rqn_dtls_table;
        v_vgl_no                 NUMBER;
        v_trnt_code              VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_trnt_gl_code           VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_trnt_contra_gl_code    VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_contra_acc             VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_org_code               NUMBER;
        v_cnt                    NUMBER := 0;
        v_pndp_code              NUMBER := 0;
        v_mtran_code             NUMBER;
        v_user                   VARCHAR2 (30);

        CURSOR cur_rcpt_refunds IS
            SELECT *
              FROM lms_grp_prem_receipts, lms_grp_recpt_refunds, lms_policies
             WHERE     grct_code = grr_grct_code
                   AND pol_code = grct_pol_code
                   AND grr_code = v_grr_code;

        CURSOR master_rcpts (v_grct_code NUMBER)
        IS
            SELECT *
              FROM lms_master_transactions
             WHERE mtran_lms_receipt_pk = v_grct_code;

        v_recs                   NUMBER := 0;
        v_product                VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_trans_code             NUMBER;
        v_prod_type              VARCHAR2 (5);
        v_pol_bra_code           NUMBER;
        v_pol_prod_code          NUMBER;
        v_prod_gl_control_code   VARCHAR2 (10);
        v_vchr_no                VARCHAR2 (50);
        v_amt                    NUMBER;
        v_reversed               VARCHAR2 (5);
    BEGIN
        v_user := v_raised_by; --fms_interfaces_pkg.get_username (v_raised_by);

        --RAISE_ERROR('AM HERE='||v_raised_by);
        SELECT    TO_NUMBER (TO_CHAR (SYSDATE, 'RRRR'))
               || lms_transaction_seq.NEXTVAL
          INTO v_trans_code
          FROM DUAL;

        FOR r IN cur_rcpt_refunds
        LOOP
            v_gl_trans.delete;
            v_chq_dtls_rec.delete;
            v_amt := NVL (r.grr_total_ref_amt, 0);
            v_vchr_no := r.grr_vchr_no;
            v_count := 0;
            v_org_code := fms_interfaces_pkg.get_org (r.pol_bra_code);

            IF NVL (v_amt, 0) <> 0
            THEN
                v_count := 0;
                -- MAKING CHEQUE REQUISITION FROM CONTROL A/C....
                get_gl_code ('PLREF_GB',
                             r.pol_prod_code,
                             v_trnt_code,
                             v_trnt_gl_code,
                             v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
                valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                           v_org_code,
                           r.pol_bra_code,
                           'PLREF_GB');
                v_count := v_count + 1;
                interface_append_chq (v_trans_code, --v_trans_code        NUMBER,
                                      v_user,  --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                                      NULL,     --v_pol_code           NUMBER,
                                      NULL,     --v_prod_code          NUMBER,
                                      v_vchr_no,
                                      --v_vchr_no              VARCHAR2,
                                      v_count,  --v_count              NUMBER,
                                      v_amt,    --v_amount             NUMBER,
                                      'GROUP RECEIPT REFUND - ' || v_vchr_no,
                                      --v_narrative          VARCHAR2,
                                      v_trnt_gl_code,
                                      --v_acc_number            VARCHAR2,
                                      v_org_code,
                                      --v_acc_org_code          NUMBER,
                                      r.pol_bra_code,
                                      --v_branch_code        NUMBER,
                                      'D',    --v_drcr               VARCHAR2,
                                      v_chq_dtls_rec);

                IF v_count != 0
                THEN
                    BEGIN
                        interface_create_reqn (
                            v_trans_code,     --v_trans_code           NUMBER,
                            v_vchr_no,     --v_ref                   VARCHAR2,
                            v_grr_code,    --v_ref2                  VARCHAR2,
                            TRUNC (SYSDATE),   --v_ref_date              DATE,
                            'LMS GROUP RECEIPT REFUND POSTING ( CHQ )',
                            --v_narrative             VARCHAR2,
                            v_amt,           --v_amount                NUMBER,
                            r.grr_payee,   --v_payee                 VARCHAR2,
                            'CHQ', --v_pay_method            VARCHAR2, --CHQ, EFT
                            NULL,       --v_payee_bank_acc_no        VARCHAR2,
                            NULL,         --v_payee_bank_branch_code   NUMBER,
                            v_user,        --v_source_auth_by        VARCHAR2,
                            TRUNC (SYSDATE),   --v_source_auth_dt        DATE,
                            v_user,      --v_raise_by                VARCHAR2,
                            'CLMG',        --v_pmt_type              VARCHAR2,
                            r.pol_bra_code,  --v_branch_code           NUMBER,
                            NULL,                                --v_pol_code,
                            v_chq_dtls_rec);
                    EXCEPTION
                        WHEN OTHERS
                        THEN
                            raise_error ('POST GROUP RECEIPT REFUND');
                    END;
                END IF;
            END IF;

            IF v_count = 0
            THEN
                raise_error ('NO TRANSACTIONS POSTED TO FINANCE ');
            END IF;

            --Updating records as posted....
            BEGIN
                UPDATE lms_grp_recpt_refunds
                   SET grr_authorised = 'Y',
                       grr_authorised_by = v_user,
                       grr_authorised_date = SYSDATE
                 WHERE grr_code = v_grr_code;
            EXCEPTION
                WHEN OTHERS
                THEN
                    raise_error ('Error updating refund details');
            END;

            FOR mt IN master_rcpts (r.grct_code)
            LOOP
                BEGIN
                    SELECT tmap_reversed
                      INTO v_reversed
                      FROM lms_tran_mapping, lms_master_transactions
                     WHERE     tmap_cr_mtran_code = mtran_code
                           AND mtran_code = mt.mtran_code
                           AND ROWNUM <= 1;
                EXCEPTION
                    WHEN OTHERS
                    THEN
                        NULL;
                END;

                -- raise_error ('AM HERE NPW=' || mt.mtran_code || ' v_amt=' || v_amt||' v_reversed='||v_reversed);
                IF NVL (v_reversed, 'N') <> 'Y'
                THEN
                    lms_subledger_utilities.undo_trans_allocation (
                        mt.mtran_code);
                END IF;

                BEGIN
                    UPDATE lms_master_transactions
                       SET mtran_refunded_amt =
                               NVL (mtran_refunded_amt, 0) + NVL (v_amt, 0)
                     WHERE mtran_code = mt.mtran_code;
                EXCEPTION
                    WHEN OTHERS
                    THEN
                        raise_error (
                            'Error updating Master Transaction details');
                END;
            END LOOP;
        END LOOP;
    --   EXCEPTION
    --      WHEN OTHERS
    --      THEN
    --         raise_application_error (-20001,
    --                                  'Posting G. Rect. ' || SQLERRM (SQLCODE)
    --                                 );
    END process_grp_rcpt_refund;

    PROCEDURE get_ri_gl_code (
        v_act_type       IN     VARCHAR2,
        v_crctd_code     IN     NUMBER,
        v_trnt_gl_code      OUT VARCHAR2
    )
    IS
        v_agn_name   VARCHAR2 (100);
    BEGIN
        BEGIN
            SELECT trpa_gl_ctrl_account,
                   TRIM (
                          agn_other_names
                       || ' '
                       || TRIM (agn_md_name || ' ' || agn_name))
              INTO v_trnt_gl_code, v_agn_name
              FROM lms_claims_ri_co_trt_dtls,
                   lms_treaty_participants,
                   lms_agencies
             WHERE     crctd_agn_code = agn_code
                   AND crctd_rei_code = trpa_rei_code
                   AND trpa_agen_code = agn_code
                   AND crctd_code = v_crctd_code;

            IF NVL (v_trnt_gl_code, 'DEF') = 'DEF'
            THEN
                tqc_error_manager.raise_error (
                    270104306,
                    text_in   =>
                        ' GL A/C NOT DEFINED FOR REINSURER ' || v_agn_name);
            END IF;
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND
            THEN
                tqc_error_manager.raise_error (
                    270104308,
                    text_in   =>
                        'Error fetching GL code for transaction type for Reinsurer');
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                tqc_error_manager.raise_error (
                    270104308,
                    text_in   =>
                        'Error fetching GL code for transaction type for Reinsurer');
        END;
    END get_ri_gl_code;

    PROCEDURE process_grp_surrenders (
        v_vchr_no       VARCHAR2,
        v_polm_code     NUMBER,
        v_pol_code      NUMBER,
        v_surr_amount   NUMBER,
        v_surr_date     DATE,
        v_user_name     VARCHAR2,
        v_pay_method    VARCHAR2 DEFAULT 'CHQ',
        v_nfl_alloc     NUMBER DEFAULT 0
    )
    IS
        v_payee_eft_rec             fms_cheques_pkg.type_payee_eft_table;
        v_chq_dtls_rec              fms_cheques_pkg.type_rqn_dtls_table;
        v_bbr_code                  NUMBER;
        v_account_number            VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_eft_enabled               VARCHAR2 (1) := 'N';
        v_policy_no                 VARCHAR2 (30);
        v_brh_code                  NUMBER;
        v_trnt_type                 VARCHAR2 (5);
        v_prod_code                 NUMBER;
        v_trnt_code                 VARCHAR2 (10);
        v_trnt_gl_code              VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_trnt_contra_gl_code       VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_org_code                  NUMBER;
        v_crt_acc_no                VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_payee                     VARCHAR2 (100);
        v_surr_amt                  NUMBER;
        v_os_prem                   NUMBER;
        v_os_loan                   NUMBER;
        v_net_amt                   NUMBER;
        v_ref_prem                  NUMBER;
        v_tot_matrty_paid           NUMBER;
        v_basic_surr_amt            NUMBER;
        v_trans_no                  NUMBER := 0;
        v_count                     NUMBER := 0;
        v_gl_trans                  fms_vouchers_pkg.tgl_rec_type;
        v_vgl_no                    NUMBER;
        v_gl_count                  NUMBER := 0;
        v_unrecoverable             NUMBER;
        v_less_pd_mat               VARCHAR2 (5);
        v_drcr                      VARCHAR2 (5);
        v_trans_code                NUMBER;
        v_msur_alloc_to             VARCHAR2 (15);
        v_msur_alloc_to_ref         NUMBER;
        v_oppr_code                 NUMBER;
        v_proposal_no               VARCHAR2 (30);
        v_prod_code_to              NUMBER;
        v_rct_branch_to             NUMBER;
        v_oppr_receipt_trans_code   VARCHAR2 (50);
        v_cur_code                  NUMBER;
        v_chkoff_agen_code          NUMBER := NULL;
        v_chkoff_rate               NUMBER := NULL;
        v_ann_chk                   VARCHAR2 (10);
        v_msur_pol_code             NUMBER;
        v_pol_type                  VARCHAR2 (10);
        v_rct_code                  VARCHAR2 (50);
        v_contra_acc                VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_pay_method_code           NUMBER;
        v_alloc_to_pol_code         NUMBER;
        v_bonuses                   NUMBER;
        v_trans_type                VARCHAR2 (5);
        v_msur_offset_prem          VARCHAR2 (5);
        v_btc_description           VARCHAR2 (100);
        v_description               VARCHAR2 (100);
        v_narrative                 VARCHAR2 (100);
        v_mpt_code                  lms_policy_mem_surrenders.msur_mpt_code%TYPE;
        v_clnt_mob_no               lms_policy_mem_surrenders.msur_clnt_mob_no%TYPE;
        v_clnt_id_passport_no       lms_policy_mem_surrenders.msur_clnt_id_passport_no%TYPE;
        v_id_type                   VARCHAR2 (50);
        v_matr_reinv_intr           lms_policy_mem_surrenders.msur_matr_reinv_intr%TYPE;
        v_unpaid_matr_amt           lms_policy_mem_surrenders.msur_unpaid_matr_amt%TYPE;
        v_done_by                   lms_policy_mem_surrenders.msur_done_by%TYPE;
        v_msur_but_pay_amt          lms_policy_mem_surrenders.msur_but_pay_amt%TYPE;
        v_renewal                   VARCHAR2 (5);
        v_tot_loan_intr             NUMBER;
        v_ln_intr_trnt_gl_code      VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_pens_amt                  NUMBER;
        v_unalloc_amt               NUMBER;
        v_inv_fee                   NUMBER;
        v_inv_contri                NUMBER;
        v_inv_admin                 NUMBER;
        v_comfnd                    NUMBER;
        v_comp_param                VARCHAR2 (5);
        v_alloc_to                  VARCHAR2 (5);
        v_prod_type                 VARCHAR2 (5);
        v_to_policy_no              VARCHAR2 (100);
        v_grct_drcr                 VARCHAR2 (5);
        v_grct_code                 NUMBER;
        v_act_code                  NUMBER;
        v_endr_code                 NUMBER;
        v_bal_amt                   NUMBER;
        v_prem_amt                  NUMBER;
        v_chkoff_comm               NUMBER;
        v_loan_amt                  NUMBER;
        v_unprocessed_rcpts_total   NUMBER;
        v_unprocessed_rcpts         NUMBER;
        v_separate_posting          VARCHAR2 (5);
        v_msg                       VARCHAR2 (50);
        v_prem_amt1                 NUMBER;
        v_chkoff_comm1              NUMBER;
        v_loan_amt1                 NUMBER;
        v_pens_amt1                 NUMBER;
        v_inv_admin1                NUMBER;
        v_inv_fee1                  NUMBER;
        v_inv_contri1               NUMBER;
        v_comfnd1                   NUMBER;

        CURSOR cur_pol_cb_amt IS
              SELECT 0                                      loan_amt,
                     0                                      suspense_amt,
                     0                                      premium_amt,
                     0                                      pension_contr,
                     NVL (SUM (investment_fee), 0)          investment_fee,
                     NVL (SUM (investment_contri), 0)       investment_contri,
                     NVL (SUM (investment_admin), 0)        investment_admin,
                     0                                      comfnd,
                     0                                      prem_comm,
                     0                                      pens_comm,
                     0                                      prem_tax,
                     0                                      chkoff_comm,
                     pol_bra_code,
                     pol_prod_code,
                     pol_type,
                     pol_prod_type,
                     'PR'                                   alloc_to,
                     NULL                                   inv_all_prem,
                     DECODE (NVL (endr_pay_method, 'C'),
                             'K', 'CK',
                             NVL (endr_pay_method, 'C'))    acc_type,
                     grct_code,
                     pol_policy_no,
                     pol_code,
                     prod_calc_inv_from_sa,
                     'N'                                    renewal
                FROM lms_grp_prem_receipts,
                     lms_policies,
                     lms_policy_endorsements,
                     lms_products,
                     (  SELECT pnmdp_grct_code,
                               NVL (SUM (pnmdp_tot_amt), 0)
                                   pension_contr,
                               NVL (SUM (pnmdp_admin_fee), 0)
                                   investment_fee,
                               NVL (SUM (pnmdp_empye_amt), 0)
                                   investment_contri,
                               NVL (SUM (pnmdp_empyr_amt), 0)
                                   investment_admin,
                               0
                                   pens_comm
                          FROM lms_pension_mem_deposits, lms_grp_prem_receipts
                         WHERE     pnmdp_grct_code = grct_code
                               AND grct_code = v_grct_code
                      GROUP BY pnmdp_grct_code)
               WHERE     pol_code = grct_pol_code
                     AND pol_current_endr_code = endr_code
                     AND grct_code = v_grct_code
                     AND pnmdp_grct_code = grct_code
                     AND pol_prod_code = prod_code
            GROUP BY pol_bra_code,
                     pol_prod_code,
                     pol_type,
                     pol_prod_type,
                     grct_code,
                     endr_pay_method,
                     DECODE (NVL (endr_pay_method, 'C'),
                             'K', 'CK',
                             NVL (endr_pay_method, 'C')),
                     pol_policy_no,
                     pol_code,
                     prod_calc_inv_from_sa,
                     prod_type;
    BEGIN
        /*
           1. - Raise CHQ
               CR bank
               DR O/S  Maturity claims
           2. - Raise VGL
                DR Maturity claims expense ac
               CR O/S  Maturity claims
        */
        BEGIN
            lms_ord_misc.system_param_val (
                'ALLOW_FIRSTYR_RENEWAL_SEPARATION',
                v_separate_posting);
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                raise_error (
                    'PARAMETER ERROR...ALLOW_FIRSTYR_RENEWAL_SEPARATION...');
        END;

        BEGIN
            lms_ord_misc.system_param_val ('CONSOLIDATE_COMP_FUND',
                                           v_comp_param);
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                raise_error ('PARAM ERROR...');
        END;

        BEGIN
            SELECT pol_bra_code,
                   pol_policy_no,
                   pol_prod_code,
                   NVL (
                       msur_payee,
                       TRIM (
                              prp_first_name
                           || ' '
                           || TRIM (prp_other_names || ' ' || prp_surname))),
                   msur_surr_amount,
                   msur_net_amount,
                   msur_tot_matrty_paid,
                   msur_basic_surr_amt,
                   msur_bbr_code,
                   msur_bbr_acc_no,
                   msur_alloc_to,
                   msur_alloc_to_ref,
                   msur_alloc_to_ref2,
                   msur_pol_code,
                   'SURR' || pol_policy_no,
                   endr_checkoff_agen_code,
                   endr_checkoff_rate,
                   ltr_btr_trans_code,
                   msur_mpt_code,
                   msur_clnt_mob_no,
                   msur_clnt_id_passport_no,
                   DECODE (msur_identity_type,
                           'I', 'NATIONAL ID',
                           'P', 'PASSPORT'),
                   msur_matr_reinv_intr,
                   msur_unpaid_matr_amt,
                   msur_done_by,
                   msur_but_pay_amt,
                   lms_ord_mis.check_renewal_paymnt (pol_code,
                                                     msur_surr_date),
                   msur_tot_loan_intr,
                   0
                       msur_pens_amt_alloc,
                   msur_penalty_amt,
                   msur_contri_alloc,
                   msur_admin_alloc,
                   msur_comfnd_alloc,
                   msur_unalloc_rcpt_amt
              INTO v_brh_code,
                   v_policy_no,
                   v_prod_code,
                   v_payee,
                   v_surr_amt,
                   v_net_amt,
                   v_tot_matrty_paid,
                   v_basic_surr_amt,
                   v_bbr_code,
                   v_account_number,
                   v_msur_alloc_to,
                   v_msur_alloc_to_ref,
                   v_proposal_no,
                   v_msur_pol_code,
                   v_rct_code,
                   v_chkoff_agen_code,
                   v_chkoff_rate,
                   v_trans_type,
                   v_mpt_code,
                   v_clnt_mob_no,
                   v_clnt_id_passport_no,
                   v_id_type,
                   v_matr_reinv_intr,
                   v_unpaid_matr_amt,
                   v_done_by,
                   v_msur_but_pay_amt,
                   v_renewal,
                   v_tot_loan_intr,
                   v_pens_amt,
                   v_inv_fee,
                   v_inv_contri,
                   v_inv_admin,
                   v_comfnd,
                   v_unalloc_amt
              FROM lms_policies,
                   lms_proposers,
                   lms_policy_mem_surrenders,
                   lms_policy_endorsements,
                   lms_transactions
             WHERE     pol_client_prp_code = prp_code
                   AND pol_code = v_pol_code
                   AND msur_polm_code = v_polm_code
                   AND msur_pol_code = pol_code
                   AND msur_vchr_no = v_vchr_no
                   AND msur_ltr_trans_no = ltr_trans_no
                   AND pol_current_endr_code = endr_code;
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND
            THEN
                raise_error (
                       'SURRENDER POLICY NOT FOUND... '
                    || v_pol_code
                    || ';'
                    || v_vchr_no);
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                raise_error ('Error Fetching Surrender Policy Details... ');
        END;

        IF NVL (v_trans_type, 'SR') = 'BE'
        THEN
            v_btc_description := 'LMS BONUS SURRENDER BATCH';
            v_description := 'LMS BONUS SURRENDER VOUCHER';
            v_narrative := 'POLICY BONUS SURRENDER ';
        ELSE
            v_btc_description := 'LMS_GRP SURRENDER BATCH';
            v_description := 'LMS_GRP SURRENDER VOUCHER';
            v_narrative := 'MEMBER INVESTMENT SURRENDER ON : ';
        END IF;

        BEGIN
            lms_ord_misc.system_param_val ('SURRENDER_LESS_PAID_MATURITY',
                                           v_less_pd_mat);

            SELECT DECODE (NVL (v_less_pd_mat, 'N'),
                           'Y', v_tot_matrty_paid,
                           0)
              INTO v_tot_matrty_paid
              FROM DUAL;
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                raise_error ('PARAMETER ERROR....');
        END;

        --raise_error ('xv_surr_amt='||v_surr_amt||'v_os_prem;'||v_os_prem||'v_os_loan;'||v_os_loan||'v_tot_matrty_paid;'||v_tot_matrty_paid||'v_ref_prem;'||v_ref_prem||'v_net_amt;'||
        --v_net_amt||'v_tbonus='||v_tbonus||'v_unpaid_matr_amt='||v_unpaid_matr_amt||'v_net_amt='||v_net_amt);
        IF NVL (v_basic_surr_amt, 0) - NVL (v_inv_fee, 0) !=
           NVL (v_net_amt, 0)
        THEN
            raise_error (
                   'THE SURRENDER CALCULATION AMOUNT DO NOT ADD UP....'
                || v_basic_surr_amt
                || ' v_inv_fee='
                || v_inv_fee
                || ' v_net_amt='
                || v_net_amt);
        END IF;

        SELECT    TO_NUMBER (TO_CHAR (SYSDATE, 'RRRR'))
               || lms_transaction_seq.NEXTVAL
          INTO v_trans_code
          FROM DUAL;

        v_org_code := fms_interfaces_pkg.get_org (v_brh_code);

        IF NVL (v_msur_but_pay_amt, 0) != 0
        THEN
            v_surr_amt :=
                  v_surr_amt
                + (NVL (v_msur_but_pay_amt, 0) - NVL (v_net_amt, 0));
            v_net_amt := NVL (v_msur_but_pay_amt, 0);
        END IF;

        IF NVL (v_net_amt, 0) > 0
        THEN
            IF NVL (v_surr_amt, 0) > 0
            THEN
                IF NVL (v_trans_type, 'SR') = 'BE'
                THEN
                    get_gl_code ('POL_BSUR',
                                 v_prod_code,
                                 v_trnt_code,
                                 v_trnt_gl_code,
                                 v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                 NULL,
                                 v_renewal);
                    valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                               v_org_code,
                               v_brh_code,
                               'POL_BSUR');
                    valid_acc (v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                               v_org_code,
                               v_brh_code,
                               'POL_BSUR CONTRA');
                ELSE
                    get_gl_code ('POL_SURR',
                                 v_prod_code,
                                 v_trnt_code,
                                 v_trnt_gl_code,
                                 v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                 NULL,
                                 v_renewal);
                    valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                               v_org_code,
                               v_brh_code,
                               'POL_SURR');
                    valid_acc (v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                               v_org_code,
                               v_brh_code,
                               'POL_SURR CONTRA');
                END IF;

                v_count := v_count + 1;
                interface_append_gl (
                    v_trans_code,               --v_trans_code         NUMBER,
                    v_user_name,               --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                    v_pol_code,                  --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                    v_prod_code,                 --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                    v_vchr_no,                --v_vchr_no            VARCHAR2,
                    NULL,                       --v_grct_code          NUMBER,
                    NULL,                        --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                    NULL,                     --v_rcpt_no            VARCHAR2,
                    v_count,                     --v_count             NUMBER,
                       v_narrative
                    || v_policy_no
                    || ' POLM_CODE- '
                    || v_polm_code,
                    --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                    NVL (v_surr_amt, 0),
                    --v_amount            NUMBER,
                    'D',                       --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                    v_trnt_gl_code,
                    --v_acc_number          VARCHAR2,
                    v_brh_code,                  --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                    v_gl_trans);

                --          raise_error('vD_MSUR_alloc_to=='||v_MSUR_alloc_to);
                --v_trn_rec   IN OUT Fms_Vouchers_Pkg.Tgl_rec_type,
                IF NVL (v_msur_alloc_to, 'PO') <> 'PO'
                THEN
                    v_pay_method_code := pay_method_code ('VOUCHER');

                    --===================================================================================================
                    IF NVL (v_msur_alloc_to, 'PO') IN ('PL')
                    THEN
                        BEGIN
                            SELECT pol_bra_code,
                                   pol_prod_code,
                                   pol_type,
                                   pol_code,
                                   DECODE (pol_prod_type,
                                           'IN', 'PN',
                                           'PN', 'PN',
                                           'PR'),
                                   pol_prod_type,
                                   agn_act_code,
                                   endr_code,
                                   pol_policy_no
                              INTO v_rct_branch_to,
                                   v_prod_code_to,
                                   v_pol_type,
                                   v_alloc_to_pol_code,
                                   v_alloc_to,
                                   v_prod_type,
                                   v_act_code,
                                   v_endr_code,
                                   v_to_policy_no
                              FROM lms_policies,
                                   lms_policy_endorsements,
                                   lms_agencies
                             WHERE     pol_proposal_no = v_proposal_no
                                   AND pol_current_endr_code = endr_code
                                   AND endr_agen_code = agn_code;
                        EXCEPTION
                            WHEN OTHERS
                            THEN
                                raise_error (
                                    'Error fetching policy dtls....');
                        END;

                        BEGIN
                            lms_investments.process_receipt (
                                v_alloc_to_pol_code,
                                v_grct_code,
                                NULL);
                        EXCEPTION
                            WHEN OTHERS
                            THEN
                                raise_error (
                                    'Processing Inv. add/ref prem..1..');
                        END;

                        FOR pl IN cur_pol_cb_amt
                        LOOP
                            IF pl.pol_prod_code IS NULL
                            THEN
                                raise_error (
                                       'Define product for Policy No.'
                                    || pl.pol_policy_no
                                    || '...');
                            END IF;

                            v_alloc_to := NVL (pl.alloc_to, 'PR');

                            BEGIN
                                SELECT NVL (grct_drcr, 'C')
                                  INTO v_grct_drcr
                                  FROM lms_grp_prem_receipts
                                 WHERE grct_code = v_grct_code;
                            EXCEPTION
                                WHEN OTHERS
                                THEN
                                    raise_error (
                                        'ERROR RETRIEVING RCPT DTLS....');
                            END;

                            v_prem_amt1 :=
                                  NVL (pl.premium_amt, 0)
                                + NVL (v_nfl_alloc, 0);
                            v_chkoff_comm1 := NVL (pl.chkoff_comm, 0);
                            v_loan_amt1 :=
                                NVL (pl.loan_amt, 0) - NVL (v_nfl_alloc, 0);
                            v_pens_amt1 := NVL (pl.pension_contr, 0);
                            v_inv_admin1 := NVL (pl.investment_admin, 0);
                            v_inv_fee1 := NVL (pl.investment_fee, 0);
                            v_inv_contri1 := NVL (pl.investment_contri, 0);
                            v_comfnd1 := NVL (pl.comfnd, 0);

                            --premium
                            IF NVL (v_prem_amt1, 0) <> 0
                            THEN
                                get_gl_code ('UP',
                                             pl.pol_prod_code,
                                             v_trnt_code,
                                             v_contra_acc,
                                             v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                             NULL,
                                             pl.renewal);
                                valid_acc (v_contra_acc,
                                           v_org_code,
                                           pl.pol_bra_code,
                                           'UP');
                                v_count := v_count + 1;
                                interface_append_gl (v_trans_code,
                                                     --v_trans_code         NUMBER,
                                                     v_user_name,
                                                     --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                                                     pl.pol_code,
                                                     --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                                                     pl.pol_prod_code,
                                                     --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                                                     v_vchr_no,
                                                     --v_vchr_no            VARCHAR2,
                                                     pl.grct_code,
                                                     --v_grct_code          NUMBER,
                                                     NULL,
                                                     --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                                                     NULL,
                                                     --v_rcpt_no            VARCHAR2,
                                                     v_count,
                                                     --v_count             NUMBER,
                                                     'ALLOCATED PREMIUM',
                                                     --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                                                     NVL (v_prem_amt1, 0),
                                                     --v_amount            NUMBER,
                                                     v_grct_drcr,
                                                     --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                                                     v_contra_acc,
                                                     --v_acc_number         VARCHAR2,
                                                     pl.pol_bra_code,
                                                     v_gl_trans);
                            END IF;

                            --Investment Fee
                            IF NVL (v_inv_fee1, 0) <> 0
                            THEN
                                get_gl_code ('INVFEE',
                                             pl.pol_prod_code,
                                             v_trnt_code,
                                             v_contra_acc,
                                             v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                             NULL,
                                             pl.renewal);
                                valid_acc (v_contra_acc,
                                           v_org_code,
                                           pl.pol_bra_code,
                                           'INVFEE ');
                                v_count := v_count + 1;
                                interface_append_gl (
                                    v_trans_code,
                                    --v_trans_code         NUMBER,
                                    v_user_name,
                                    --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                                    pl.pol_code,
                                    --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                                    pl.pol_prod_code,
                                    --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                                    v_vchr_no,
                                    --v_vchr_no            VARCHAR2,
                                    pl.grct_code,
                                    --v_grct_code          NUMBER,
                                    NULL,        --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                                    NULL,
                                    --v_rcpt_no            VARCHAR2,
                                    v_count,
                                       --v_count             NUMBER,
                                       'INVESTMENT FEE ON POLICY NO -'
                                    || v_policy_no
                                    || ': POLM_CODE-'
                                    || v_polm_code,
                                    --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                                    NVL (v_inv_fee1, 0),
                                    --v_amount            NUMBER,
                                    v_grct_drcr,
                                    --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                                    v_contra_acc,
                                    --v_acc_number         VARCHAR2,
                                    pl.pol_bra_code,
                                    v_gl_trans);
                            END IF;

                            IF NVL (v_pens_amt1, 0) <> 0
                            THEN
                                IF    NVL (pl.pol_prod_type, 'PN') = 'IN'
                                   OR NVL (pl.inv_all_prem, 'N') = 'Y'
                                THEN
                                    --Investment Administration
                                    IF NVL (v_inv_admin1, 0) <> 0
                                    THEN
                                        get_gl_code ('INVADM',
                                                     pl.pol_prod_code,
                                                     v_trnt_code,
                                                     v_contra_acc,
                                                     v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                                     NULL,
                                                     pl.renewal);
                                        valid_acc (v_contra_acc,
                                                   v_org_code,
                                                   pl.pol_bra_code,
                                                   'INVADM');
                                        v_count := v_count + 1;
                                        interface_append_gl (
                                            v_trans_code,
                                            --v_trans_code         NUMBER,
                                            v_user_name,
                                            --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                                            pl.pol_code,
                                            --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                                            pl.pol_prod_code,
                                            --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                                            v_vchr_no,
                                            --v_vchr_no            VARCHAR2,
                                            pl.grct_code,
                                            --v_grct_code          NUMBER,
                                            NULL, --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                                            NULL,
                                            --v_rcpt_no            VARCHAR2,
                                            v_count,
                                               --v_count             NUMBER,
                                               'INVESTMENT ADMINISTRATION: POLM_CODE-'
                                            || v_polm_code,
                                            --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                                            NVL (v_inv_admin1, 0),
                                            --v_amount            NUMBER,
                                            v_grct_drcr,
                                            --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                                            v_contra_acc,
                                            --v_acc_number         VARCHAR2,
                                            pl.pol_bra_code,
                                            v_gl_trans);
                                    END IF;

                                    --Investment Premium
                                    IF NVL (v_inv_contri1, 0) <> 0
                                    THEN
                                        get_gl_code ('INVPREM',
                                                     pl.pol_prod_code,
                                                     v_trnt_code,
                                                     v_contra_acc,
                                                     v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                                     NULL,
                                                     pl.renewal);
                                        valid_acc (v_contra_acc,
                                                   v_org_code,
                                                   pl.pol_bra_code,
                                                   'INVPREM');
                                        v_count := v_count + 1;
                                        interface_append_gl (
                                            v_trans_code,
                                            --v_trans_code         NUMBER,
                                            v_user_name,
                                            --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                                            pl.pol_code,
                                            --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                                            pl.pol_prod_code,
                                            --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                                            v_vchr_no,
                                            --v_vchr_no            VARCHAR2,
                                            pl.grct_code,
                                            --v_grct_code          NUMBER,
                                            NULL, --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                                            NULL,
                                            --v_rcpt_no            VARCHAR2,
                                            v_count,
                                               --v_count             NUMBER,
                                               'INVESTMENT PREMIUM: POLM_CODE-'
                                            || v_polm_code,
                                            --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                                            NVL (v_inv_contri1, 0),
                                            --v_amount            NUMBER,
                                            v_grct_drcr,
                                            --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
