                                            v_contra_acc,
                                            --v_acc_number         VARCHAR2,
                                            pl.pol_bra_code,
                                            v_gl_trans);
                                    END IF;
                                ELSE
                                    --Deposit Administration Contribution
                                    get_gl_code ('PN',
                                                 pl.pol_prod_code,
                                                 v_trnt_code,
                                                 v_contra_acc,
                                                 v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                                 NULL,
                                                 pl.renewal);
                                    valid_acc (v_contra_acc,
                                               v_org_code,
                                               pl.pol_bra_code,
                                               'PN');
                                    v_count := v_count + 1;
                                    interface_append_gl (
                                        v_trans_code,
                                        --v_trans_code         NUMBER,
                                        v_user_name,
                                        --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                                        pl.pol_code,
                                        --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                                        pl.pol_prod_code,
                                        --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                                        v_vchr_no,
                                        --v_vchr_no            VARCHAR2,
                                        pl.grct_code,
                                        --v_grct_code          NUMBER,
                                        NULL,
                                        --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                                        NULL,
                                        --v_rcpt_no            VARCHAR2,
                                        v_count,
                                        --v_count             NUMBER,
                                        'PENSION CONTRIBUTION',
                                        --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                                        NVL (v_pens_amt1, 0),
                                        --v_amount            NUMBER,
                                        v_grct_drcr,
                                        --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                                        v_contra_acc,
                                        --v_acc_number         VARCHAR2,
                                        pl.pol_bra_code,
                                        v_gl_trans);
                                END IF;
                            END IF;

                            IF NVL (v_comfnd1, 0) <> 0
                            THEN
                                BEGIN
                                    lms_ord_misc.system_param_val (
                                        'CONSOLIDATE_COMP_FUND',
                                        v_comp_param);
                                EXCEPTION
                                    WHEN OTHERS
                                    THEN
                                        raise_error ('PARAM ERROR...');
                                END;

                                IF NOT NVL (v_comp_param, 'N') = 'Y'
                                THEN
                                    --Compensation fund...
                                    get_gl_code ('CMPFND',
                                                 pl.pol_prod_code,
                                                 v_trnt_code,
                                                 v_contra_acc,
                                                 v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                                 NULL,
                                                 pl.renewal);
                                    valid_acc (v_contra_acc,
                                               v_org_code,
                                               pl.pol_bra_code,
                                               'CMPFND');
                                    v_count := v_count + 1;
                                    interface_append_gl (v_trans_code,
                                                         --v_trans_code         NUMBER,
                                                         v_user_name,
                                                         --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                                                         pl.pol_code,
                                                         --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                                                         pl.pol_prod_code,
                                                         --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                                                         v_vchr_no,
                                                         --v_vchr_no            VARCHAR2,
                                                         pl.grct_code,
                                                         --v_grct_code          NUMBER,
                                                         NULL,
                                                         --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                                                         NULL,
                                                         --v_rcpt_no            VARCHAR2,
                                                         v_count,
                                                         --v_count             NUMBER,
                                                         'COMPENSATION FUND',
                                                         --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                                                         NVL (v_comfnd1, 0),
                                                         --v_amount            NUMBER,
                                                         v_grct_drcr,
                                                         --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                                                         v_contra_acc,
                                                         --v_acc_number         VARCHAR2,
                                                         pl.pol_bra_code,
                                                         v_gl_trans);
                                END IF;
                            END IF;
                        END LOOP;

                        v_unprocessed_rcpts_total := 0;

                        FOR pl IN cur_pol_cb_amt
                        LOOP
                            --FOR P IN Prod LOOP
                            v_unprocessed_rcpts := 0;
                            v_unprocessed_rcpts :=
                                get_unprocessed_rcpt ('FROM SURRENDER',
                                                      SYSDATE,
                                                      pl.pol_prod_code,
                                                      NULL,
                                                      NULL,
                                                      NULL,
                                                      pl.pol_code,
                                                      pl.grct_code);
                            v_unprocessed_rcpts_total :=
                                  NVL (v_unprocessed_rcpts_total, 0)
                                + NVL (v_unprocessed_rcpts, 0);

                            IF ABS (NVL (v_unprocessed_rcpts, 0)) > 0
                            THEN
                                v_alloc_to := NVL (pl.alloc_to, 'PR');

                                IF v_alloc_to = 'LN'
                                THEN
                                    raise_error (
                                           'POSTING TO UNP_LN BLOCKED.....Policy No.'
                                        || pl.pol_policy_no);
                                END IF;

                                IF v_alloc_to = 'PR'
                                THEN
                                    get_gl_code ('UNP_PR',
                                                 pl.pol_prod_code,
                                                 v_trnt_code,
                                                 v_contra_acc,
                                                 v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                                 NULL,
                                                 pl.renewal);
                                    valid_acc (v_contra_acc,
                                               v_org_code,
                                               pl.pol_bra_code,
                                               'UNP_PR');
                                    v_msg := 'UNP_PR';
                                ELSIF v_alloc_to = 'LN'
                                THEN
                                    get_gl_code ('UNP_LN',
                                                 pl.pol_prod_code,
                                                 v_trnt_code,
                                                 v_contra_acc,
                                                 v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                                 NULL,
                                                 pl.renewal);
                                    valid_acc (v_contra_acc,
                                               v_org_code,
                                               pl.pol_bra_code,
                                               'UNP_LN');
                                    v_msg := 'UNP_LN';
                                ELSIF v_alloc_to = 'PN'
                                THEN
                                    get_gl_code ('UNP_PN',
                                                 pl.pol_prod_code,
                                                 v_trnt_code,
                                                 v_contra_acc,
                                                 v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                                 NULL,
                                                 pl.renewal);
                                    valid_acc (v_contra_acc,
                                               v_org_code,
                                               pl.pol_bra_code,
                                               'UNP_PN');
                                    v_msg := 'UNP_PN';
                                END IF;

                                v_count := v_count + 1;
                                interface_append_gl (
                                    v_trans_code,
                                    --v_trans_code         NUMBER,
                                    v_user_name,
                                    --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                                    pl.pol_code,
                                    --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                                    pl.pol_prod_code,
                                    --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                                    v_vchr_no,
                                    --v_vchr_no            VARCHAR2,
                                    pl.grct_code,
                                    --v_grct_code          NUMBER,
                                    NULL,        --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                                    NULL,
                                    --v_rcpt_no            VARCHAR2,
                                    v_count,
                                    --v_count             NUMBER,
                                    'UNPROCESSED RCPTS - DR_RCT TO ' || v_msg,
                                    --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                                    NVL (ABS (NVL (v_unprocessed_rcpts, 0)),
                                         0),
                                    --v_amount            NUMBER,
                                    v_grct_drcr,
                                    --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                                    v_contra_acc,
                                    --v_acc_number         VARCHAR2,
                                    pl.pol_bra_code,
                                    v_gl_trans);
                            END IF;
                        --END LOOP;
                        END LOOP;
                    --                     raise_error(v_prem_amt ||';a;'||
                    --                       v_chkoff_comm ||';b;'||
                    --                       v_loan_amt ||';c;'||
                    --                       v_pens_amt ||';d;'||
                    --                       v_inv_admin ||';e;'||
                    --                       v_inv_fee ||';f;'||
                    --                       v_inv_contri ||';g;'||
                    --                       v_comfnd ||';h;'||
                    --                       v_unprocessed_rcpts);
                    ELSE
                        BEGIN
                            SELECT pol_bra_code,
                                   pol_prod_code,
                                   pol_type,
                                   pol_code
                              INTO v_rct_branch_to,
                                   v_prod_code_to,
                                   v_pol_type,
                                   v_alloc_to_pol_code
                              FROM lms_policies
                             WHERE pol_proposal_no = v_proposal_no;
                        EXCEPTION
                            WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND
                            THEN
                                BEGIN
                                    SELECT ppr_brn_code, ppr_prod_code, 'MPR'
                                      INTO v_rct_branch_to,
                                           v_prod_code_to,
                                           v_pol_type
                                      FROM lms_pol_proposals
                                     WHERE ppr_proposal_no = v_proposal_no;
                                EXCEPTION
                                    WHEN OTHERS
                                    THEN
                                        raise_error (
                                            'Error fetching proposal dtls..1..');
                                END;
                            WHEN OTHERS
                            THEN
                                raise_error (
                                    'Error fetching proposal dtls..2..');
                        END;
                    END IF;
                --===================================================================================================
                ELSE
                    v_count := v_count + 1;
                    interface_append_gl (
                        v_trans_code,           --v_trans_code         NUMBER,
                        v_user_name,           --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                        v_pol_code,              --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                        v_prod_code,             --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                        v_vchr_no,            --v_vchr_no            VARCHAR2,
                        NULL,                   --v_grct_code          NUMBER,
                        NULL,                    --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                        NULL,                 --v_rcpt_no            VARCHAR2,
                        v_count,                 --v_count             NUMBER,
                           v_narrative
                        || v_policy_no
                        || ' POLM_CODE '
                        || v_polm_code,
                        --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                        NVL (v_net_amt, 0),      --v_amount            NUMBER,
                        'C',                   --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                        v_trnt_contra_gl_code, --v_acc_number         VARCHAR2,
                        v_brh_code,              --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                        v_gl_trans);
                    v_trans_no := NVL (v_trans_no, 0) + 1;
                    interface_append_chq (
                        v_trans_code,
                        --v_trans_code       NUMBER,
                        v_user_name,
                        --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                        v_pol_code,
                        --v_pol_code           NUMBER,
                        v_prod_code,
                        --v_prod_code          NUMBER,
                        v_vchr_no,
                        --v_vchr_no             VARCHAR2,
                        v_trans_no,
                        --v_count              NUMBER,
                        v_net_amt,              --v_amount             NUMBER,
                           v_narrative
                        || v_policy_no
                        || ' POLM_CODE '
                        || v_polm_code,
                        --v_narrative          VARCHAR2,
                        v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                        --v_acc_number          VARCHAR2,
                        v_org_code,
                        --v_acc_org_code        NUMBER,
                        v_brh_code,
                        --v_branch_code        NUMBER,
                        'D',                  --v_drcr               VARCHAR2,
                        v_chq_dtls_rec);
                --v_trn_rec   IN OUT   Fms_Cheques_Pkg.Type_rqn_dtls_table,
                END IF;
            END IF;

            IF NVL (v_inv_fee, 0) <> 0
            THEN
                SELECT DECODE (SIGN (NVL (v_inv_fee, 0)), -1, 'D', 'C')
                  INTO v_drcr
                  FROM DUAL;

                get_gl_code ('INVFEE',
                             v_prod_code,
                             v_trnt_code,
                             v_trnt_gl_code,
                             v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                             NULL,
                             v_renewal);
                valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                           v_org_code,
                           v_brh_code,
                           'INVFEE');
                v_count := v_count + 1;
                interface_append_gl (
                    v_trans_code,
                    --v_trans_code         NUMBER,
                    v_user_name,
                    --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                    v_pol_code,                  --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                    v_prod_code,                 --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                    v_vchr_no,                --v_vchr_no            VARCHAR2,
                    NULL,                       --v_grct_code          NUMBER,
                    NULL,                        --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                    NULL,                     --v_rcpt_no            VARCHAR2,
                    v_count,                     --v_count             NUMBER,
                    'INVESTMENT FEE SURRENDER: POLM_CODE-' || v_polm_code,
                    --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                    ABS (NVL (v_inv_fee, 0)),
                    --v_amount            NUMBER,
                    v_drcr,                    --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                    v_trnt_gl_code,
                    --v_acc_number         VARCHAR2,
                    v_brh_code,                  --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                    v_gl_trans);
            END IF;

            IF NVL (v_inv_contri, 0) <> 0
            THEN
                SELECT DECODE (SIGN (NVL (v_inv_contri, 0)), -1, 'D', 'C')
                  INTO v_drcr
                  FROM DUAL;

                get_gl_code ('INVPREM',
                             v_prod_code,
                             v_trnt_code,
                             v_trnt_gl_code,
                             v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                             NULL,
                             v_renewal);
                valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                           v_org_code,
                           v_brh_code,
                           'INVPREM');
                v_count := v_count + 1;
                interface_append_gl (
                    v_trans_code,
                    --v_trans_code         NUMBER,
                    v_user_name,
                    --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                    v_pol_code,                  --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                    v_prod_code,                 --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                    v_vchr_no,                --v_vchr_no            VARCHAR2,
                    NULL,                       --v_grct_code          NUMBER,
                    NULL,                        --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                    NULL,                     --v_rcpt_no            VARCHAR2,
                    v_count,                     --v_count             NUMBER,
                    'INVESTMENT PREMIUM SURRENDER:- POLM_CODE' || v_polm_code,
                    --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                    ABS (NVL (v_inv_contri, 0)),
                    --v_amount            NUMBER,
                    v_drcr,                    --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                    v_trnt_gl_code,
                    --v_acc_number         VARCHAR2,
                    v_brh_code,                  --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                    v_gl_trans);
            END IF;

            IF NVL (v_inv_admin, 0) <> 0
            THEN
                SELECT DECODE (SIGN (NVL (v_inv_admin, 0)), -1, 'D', 'C')
                  INTO v_drcr
                  FROM DUAL;

                get_gl_code ('INVPREM',
                             v_prod_code,
                             v_trnt_code,
                             v_trnt_gl_code,
                             v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                             NULL,
                             v_renewal);
                valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                           v_org_code,
                           v_brh_code,
                           'INVPREM');
                v_count := v_count + 1;
                interface_append_gl (
                    v_trans_code,
                    --v_trans_code         NUMBER,
                    v_user_name,
                    --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                    v_pol_code,                  --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                    v_prod_code,                 --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                    v_vchr_no,                --v_vchr_no            VARCHAR2,
                    NULL,                       --v_grct_code          NUMBER,
                    NULL,                        --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                    NULL,                     --v_rcpt_no            VARCHAR2,
                    v_count,                     --v_count             NUMBER,
                       'INVESTMENT ADMINISTRATION SURRENDER: POLM_CODE-'
                    || v_polm_code,
                    --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                    ABS (NVL (v_inv_admin, 0)),
                    --v_amount            NUMBER,
                    v_drcr,                    --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                    v_trnt_gl_code,
                    --v_acc_number         VARCHAR2,
                    v_brh_code,                  --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                    v_gl_trans);
            END IF;

            IF NVL (v_comfnd, 0) <> 0 AND NOT NVL (v_comp_param, 'N') = 'Y'
            THEN
                SELECT DECODE (SIGN (NVL (v_comfnd, 0)), -1, 'D', 'C')
                  INTO v_drcr
                  FROM DUAL;

                get_gl_code ('CMPFND',
                             v_prod_code,
                             v_trnt_code,
                             v_trnt_gl_code,
                             v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                             NULL,
                             v_renewal);
                valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                           v_org_code,
                           v_brh_code,
                           'CMPFND');
                v_count := v_count + 1;
                interface_append_gl (
                    v_trans_code,
                    --v_trans_code         NUMBER,
                    v_user_name,
                    --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                    v_pol_code,                  --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                    v_prod_code,                 --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                    v_vchr_no,                --v_vchr_no            VARCHAR2,
                    NULL,                       --v_grct_code          NUMBER,
                    NULL,                        --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                    NULL,                     --v_rcpt_no            VARCHAR2,

                    --v_amount            NUMBER,

                    v_trnt_gl_code,
                    --v_acc_number         VARCHAR2,
                    v_brh_code,                  --v_branch_code       NUMBER,

            IF NVL (v_unalloc_amt, 0) <> 0

                THEN

                THEN

                                 v_prod_code,

                                 v_trnt_gl_code,

                    v_prod_code,                 --v_prod_code         NUMBER,

                    v_gl_trans);

            IF NVL (v_tot_matrty_paid, 0) > 0
            THEN
                get_gl_code ('POL_MTR',
                             v_prod_code,
                             v_trnt_code,
                             v_trnt_gl_code,
                             v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                             NULL,

                           'POL_MTR');

                    v_trans_code,               --v_trans_code         NUMBER,
                    v_user_name,               --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                    v_pol_code,                  --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                    v_prod_code,                 --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                    v_vchr_no,                --v_vchr_no            VARCHAR2,
                    NULL,                       --v_grct_code          NUMBER,
                    NULL,                        --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                    NULL,                     --v_rcpt_no            VARCHAR2,
                    v_count,                     --v_count             NUMBER,
                    'MATURITIES : POLM_CODE- ' || v_polm_code,
                    --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                    NVL (v_tot_matrty_paid, 0),
                    --v_amount            NUMBER,
                    'C',                       --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                    v_trnt_gl_code,
                    --v_acc_number        VARCHAR2,
                    v_brh_code,                  --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                    v_gl_trans);
            END IF;

            IF NVL (v_unpaid_matr_amt, 0) > 0
            THEN
                get_gl_code ('POL_MTR',
                             v_prod_code,
                             v_trnt_code,
                             v_trnt_gl_code,
                             v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                             NULL,
                             v_renewal);
                valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                           v_org_code,
                           v_brh_code,
                           'POL_MTR');
                v_count := v_count + 1;
                interface_append_gl (
                    v_trans_code,               --v_trans_code         NUMBER,
                    v_user_name,               --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                    v_pol_code,                  --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                    v_prod_code,                 --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                    v_vchr_no,                --v_vchr_no            VARCHAR2,
                    NULL,                       --v_grct_code          NUMBER,
                    NULL,                        --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                    NULL,                     --v_rcpt_no            VARCHAR2,

                    --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,

                    --v_amount            NUMBER,

            IF NVL (v_matr_reinv_intr, 0) > 0
            THEN
                get_gl_code ('POL_MTR',
                             v_prod_code,
                             v_trnt_code,
                             v_trnt_gl_code,
                             v_trnt_contra_gl_code,

                v_count := v_count + 1;
                interface_append_gl (
                    v_trans_code,               --v_trans_code         NUMBER,
                    v_user_name,               --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,

                    v_prod_code,                 --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                    v_vchr_no,                --v_vchr_no            VARCHAR2,
                    NULL,                       --v_grct_code          NUMBER,
                    NULL,                        --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                    NULL,                     --v_rcpt_no            VARCHAR2,
                    v_count,                     --v_count             NUMBER,
                    'MATURITIES RV. INTR. - ' || v_policy_no,
                    --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                    NVL (v_matr_reinv_intr, 0),
                    --v_amount            NUMBER,
                    'D',                       --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                    v_trnt_gl_code,
                    --v_acc_number        VARCHAR2,
                    v_brh_code,                  --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                    v_gl_trans);
            END IF;

            IF NVL (v_msur_alloc_to, 'PO') = 'PO'
            THEN
                IF v_pay_method = 'EFT'
                THEN
                    BEGIN
                        --                   v_bbr_code := BNK_BBR_CODE(v_pol_code);
                        --                     v_account_number := BNK_ACCOUNT(v_pol_code);
                        v_eft_enabled := 'N';

                        IF v_account_number IS NOT NULL
                        THEN
                            v_eft_enabled := account_enabled (v_bbr_code);
                        END IF;
                    EXCEPTION
                        WHEN OTHERS
                        THEN
                            raise_error ('GETTING BANK ACC INFO... ');
                    END;
                ELSIF v_pay_method = 'MFT'
                THEN
                    v_account_number := v_clnt_mob_no;
                END IF;

                IF v_pay_method IN ('EFT', 'MFT')
                THEN
                    IF v_pay_method = 'EFT'
                    THEN
                        IF v_eft_enabled = 'N'
                        THEN
                            raise_application_error (
                                -20001,
                                'BANK BRANCH NOT ENABLED TO TRANSACT EFT PAYMENTS');
                        END IF;
                    END IF;

                    interface_create_reqn (
                        v_trans_code,
                        --v_trans_code         NUMBER,
                        v_vchr_no,
                        --v_ref                   VARCHAR2,
                        v_pol_code,
                        --v_ref2                  VARCHAR2,
                        SYSDATE,               --v_ref_date              DATE,
                           v_narrative
                        || v_policy_no
                        || ' POLM_CODE '
                        || v_polm_code,
                        --v_narrative             VARCHAR2,

                        --v_amount                NUMBER,

                        --v_source_auth_by        VARCHAR2,
                        v_surr_date,
                        --v_source_auth_dt        DATE,
                        v_done_by,
                        --v_raise_by                VARCHAR2,
                        'POL_SURR',
                        --v_pmt_type              VARCHAR2,
                        v_brh_code,
                        --v_branch_code         NUMBER,
                        v_pol_code,                    --v_pol_code    NUMBER,
                        v_chq_dtls_rec);

                        v_vchr_no,         --v_ref                   VARCHAR2,

                        SYSDATE,               --v_ref_date              DATE,
                           v_narrative
                        || v_policy_no
                        || ' POLM_CODE '
                        || v_polm_code,
                        --v_narrative             VARCHAR2,

            IF v_count > 0
            THEN
                --create gl voucher
                interface_update_vgl (v_trans_code, --v_trans_code     NUMBER,
                                      v_user_name, --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                                      v_pol_code, --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                                      TRUNC (SYSDATE), --v_date           DATE,
                                      NULL,     --v_grct_code          NUMBER,
                                      NULL,      --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                                      v_btc_description,
                                      --v_btc_description   VARCHAR2,
                                      'JV',    --v_btc_type          VARCHAR2,
                                      v_brh_code, --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                                      v_description,
                                      --v_description       VARCHAR2,
                                      v_pol_code, --v_ref            VARCHAR2,
                                      v_gl_trans);
            END IF;
        --v_gl_trans  IN OUT  Fms_Vouchers_Pkg.Tgl_rec_type,
        ELSE
            v_org_code := fms_interfaces_pkg.get_org (v_brh_code);

            IF (  NVL (v_surr_amt, 0)
                + NVL (v_ref_prem, 0)
                - NVL (v_tot_matrty_paid, 0)) <
               (NVL (v_os_prem, 0) + NVL (v_os_loan, 0))
            THEN
                v_unrecoverable :=
                      NVL (v_os_prem, 0)
                    + NVL (v_os_loan, 0)
                    - (  NVL (v_surr_amt, 0)
                       + NVL (v_ref_prem, 0)
                       - NVL (v_tot_matrty_paid, 0));
            END IF;

            IF NVL (v_surr_amt, 0) > 0
            THEN
                IF NVL (v_trans_type, 'SR') = 'BE'
                THEN
                    get_gl_code ('POL_BSUR',
                                 v_prod_code,
                                 v_trnt_code,
                                 v_trnt_gl_code,
                                 v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                 NULL,
                                 v_renewal);
                    valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                               v_org_code,
                               v_brh_code,
                               'POL_BSUR');
                ELSE
                    get_gl_code ('POL_SURR',
                                 v_prod_code,
                                 v_trnt_code,
                                 v_trnt_gl_code,
                                 v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                 NULL,
                                 v_renewal);
                    valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                               v_org_code,
                               v_brh_code,
                               'POL_SURR');
                END IF;

                v_count := v_count + 1;
                interface_append_gl (
                    v_trans_code,               --v_trans_code         NUMBER,
                    v_user_name,               --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                    v_pol_code,                  --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                    v_prod_code,                 --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                    v_vchr_no,                --v_vchr_no            VARCHAR2,
                    NULL,                       --v_grct_code          NUMBER,
                    NULL,                        --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                    NULL,                     --v_rcpt_no            VARCHAR2,
                    v_count,                     --v_count             NUMBER,
                       v_narrative
                    || v_policy_no
                    || ' POLM_CODE '
                    || v_polm_code,
                    --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                    NVL (v_surr_amt, 0),
                    --v_amount            NUMBER,
                    'D',                       --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                    v_trnt_gl_code,
                    --v_acc_number        VARCHAR2,
                    v_brh_code,                  --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                    v_gl_trans);
            END IF;

            IF NVL (v_inv_fee, 0) <> 0
            THEN
                SELECT DECODE (SIGN (NVL (v_inv_fee, 0)), -1, 'D', 'C')
                  INTO v_drcr
                  FROM DUAL;

                get_gl_code ('INVFEE',
                             v_prod_code,
                             v_trnt_code,
                             v_trnt_gl_code,
                             v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                             NULL,
                             v_renewal);
                valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                           v_org_code,
                           v_brh_code,
                           'INVFEE');
                v_count := v_count + 1;
                interface_append_gl (
                    v_trans_code,
                    --v_trans_code         NUMBER,
                    v_user_name,
                    --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                    v_pol_code,                  --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                    v_prod_code,                 --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                    v_vchr_no,                --v_vchr_no            VARCHAR2,
                    NULL,                       --v_grct_code          NUMBER,
                    NULL,                        --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                    NULL,                     --v_rcpt_no            VARCHAR2,
                    v_count,                     --v_count             NUMBER,
                    'INVESTMENT FEE SURRENDER-' || v_policy_no,
                    --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                    ABS (NVL (v_inv_fee, 0)),
                    --v_amount            NUMBER,
                    v_drcr,                    --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                    v_trnt_gl_code,
                    --v_acc_number         VARCHAR2,
                    v_brh_code,                  --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                    v_gl_trans);
            END IF;

            IF NVL (v_inv_contri, 0) <> 0
            THEN
                SELECT DECODE (SIGN (NVL (v_inv_contri, 0)), -1, 'D', 'C')
                  INTO v_drcr
                  FROM DUAL;

                get_gl_code ('INVPREM',
                             v_prod_code,
                             v_trnt_code,
                             v_trnt_gl_code,
                             v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                             NULL,
                             v_renewal);
                valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                           v_org_code,
                           v_brh_code,
                           'INVPREM');
                v_count := v_count + 1;
                interface_append_gl (
                    v_trans_code,
                    --v_trans_code         NUMBER,
                    v_user_name,
                    --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                    v_pol_code,                  --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                    v_prod_code,                 --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                    v_vchr_no,                --v_vchr_no            VARCHAR2,
                    NULL,                       --v_grct_code          NUMBER,
                    NULL,                        --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                    NULL,                     --v_rcpt_no            VARCHAR2,
                    v_count,                     --v_count             NUMBER,
                    'INVESTMENT PREMIUM SURRENDER-' || v_policy_no,
                    --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                    ABS (NVL (v_inv_contri, 0)),
                    --v_amount            NUMBER,
                    v_drcr,                    --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                    v_trnt_gl_code,
                    --v_acc_number         VARCHAR2,
                    v_brh_code,                  --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                    v_gl_trans);
            END IF;

            IF NVL (v_inv_admin, 0) <> 0
            THEN
                SELECT DECODE (SIGN (NVL (v_inv_admin, 0)), -1, 'D', 'C')
                  INTO v_drcr
                  FROM DUAL;

                get_gl_code ('INVPREM',
                             v_prod_code,
                             v_trnt_code,
                             v_trnt_gl_code,
                             v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                             NULL,
                             v_renewal);
                valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                           v_org_code,
                           v_brh_code,
                           'INVPREM');
                v_count := v_count + 1;
                interface_append_gl (
                    v_trans_code,
                    --v_trans_code         NUMBER,
                    v_user_name,
                    --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                    v_pol_code,                  --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                    v_prod_code,                 --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                    v_vchr_no,                --v_vchr_no            VARCHAR2,
                    NULL,                       --v_grct_code          NUMBER,
                    NULL,                        --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                    NULL,                     --v_rcpt_no            VARCHAR2,
                    v_count,                     --v_count             NUMBER,
                    'INVESTMENT ADMINISTRATION SURRENDER-' || v_policy_no,
                    --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                    ABS (NVL (v_inv_admin, 0)),
                    --v_amount            NUMBER,
                    v_drcr,                    --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                    v_trnt_gl_code,
                    --v_acc_number         VARCHAR2,
                    v_brh_code,                  --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                    v_gl_trans);
            END IF;

            IF NVL (v_comfnd, 0) <> 0 AND NOT NVL (v_comp_param, 'N') = 'Y'
            THEN
                SELECT DECODE (SIGN (NVL (v_comfnd, 0)), -1, 'D', 'C')
                  INTO v_drcr
                  FROM DUAL;

                get_gl_code ('CMPFND',
                             v_prod_code,
                             v_trnt_code,
                             v_trnt_gl_code,
                             v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                             NULL,
                             v_renewal);
                valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                           v_org_code,
                           v_brh_code,
                           'CMPFND');
                v_count := v_count + 1;
                interface_append_gl (
                    v_trans_code,
                    --v_trans_code         NUMBER,
                    v_user_name,
                    --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                    v_pol_code,                  --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                    v_prod_code,                 --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                    v_vchr_no,                --v_vchr_no            VARCHAR2,
                    NULL,                       --v_grct_code          NUMBER,
                    NULL,                        --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                    NULL,                     --v_rcpt_no            VARCHAR2,
                    v_count,                     --v_count             NUMBER,
                    'COMPENSATION FUND CLIENT SURRENDER-' || v_policy_no,
                    --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                    ABS (NVL (v_comfnd, 0)),
                    --v_amount            NUMBER,
                    v_drcr,                    --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                    v_trnt_gl_code,
                    --v_acc_number         VARCHAR2,
                    v_brh_code,                  --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                    v_gl_trans);
            END IF;

            IF NVL (v_unalloc_amt, 0) <> 0
            THEN
                SELECT DECODE (SIGN (NVL (v_unalloc_amt, 0)), -1, 'D', 'C')
                  INTO v_drcr
                  FROM DUAL;

                IF v_alloc_to = 'PR'
                THEN
                    get_gl_code ('UNP_PR',
                                 v_prod_code,
                                 v_trnt_code,
                                 v_trnt_gl_code,
                                 v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                 NULL,
                                 v_renewal);
                    valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                               v_org_code,
                               v_brh_code,
                               'UNP_PR');
                ELSIF v_alloc_to = 'LN'
                THEN
                    get_gl_code ('UNP_LN',
                                 v_prod_code,
                                 v_trnt_code,
                                 v_trnt_gl_code,
                                 v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                 NULL,
                                 v_renewal);
                    valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                               v_org_code,
                               v_brh_code,
                               'UNP_LN');
                END IF;

                v_count := v_count + 1;
                interface_append_gl (
                    v_trans_code,
                    --v_trans_code         NUMBER,
                    v_user_name,
                    --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                    v_pol_code,                  --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                    v_prod_code,                 --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                    v_vchr_no,                --v_vchr_no            VARCHAR2,
                    NULL,                       --v_grct_code          NUMBER,
                    NULL,                        --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                    NULL,                     --v_rcpt_no            VARCHAR2,
                    v_count,                     --v_count             NUMBER,
                    'UNPROCESSED RCPTS SURRENDER-' || v_policy_no,
                    --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                    ABS (NVL (v_unalloc_amt, 0)),
                    --v_amount            NUMBER,
                    v_drcr,                    --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                    v_trnt_gl_code,
                    --v_acc_number         VARCHAR2,
                    v_brh_code,                  --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                    v_gl_trans);
            END IF;

            IF NVL (v_tot_matrty_paid, 0) > 0
            THEN
                v_count := v_count + 1;
                get_gl_code ('POL_MTR',
                             v_prod_code,
                             v_trnt_code,
                             v_crt_acc_no,
                             v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                             NULL,
                             v_renewal);
                valid_acc (v_crt_acc_no,
                           v_org_code,
                           v_brh_code,
                           'POL_MTR');
                interface_append_gl (
                    v_trans_code,               --v_trans_code         NUMBER,
                    v_user_name,               --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                    v_pol_code,                  --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                    v_prod_code,                 --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                    v_vchr_no,                --v_vchr_no            VARCHAR2,
                    NULL,                       --v_grct_code          NUMBER,
                    NULL,                        --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                    NULL,                     --v_rcpt_no            VARCHAR2,
                    v_count,                     --v_count             NUMBER,
                    'POLICY PARTIAL MATURITIES' || v_policy_no,
                    --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                    NVL (v_tot_matrty_paid, 0),
                    --v_amount            NUMBER,
                    'C',                       --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                    v_trnt_gl_code,
                    --v_acc_number        VARCHAR2,
                    v_brh_code,                  --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                    v_gl_trans);
            END IF;

            IF NVL (v_unrecoverable, 0) > 0
            THEN
                get_gl_code ('UNRC',
                             v_prod_code,
                             v_trnt_code,
                             v_trnt_gl_code,
                             v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                             NULL,
                             v_renewal);
                valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                           v_org_code,
                           v_brh_code,
                           'UNRC');
                v_count := v_count + 1;
                interface_append_gl (
                    v_trans_code,               --v_trans_code         NUMBER,
                    v_user_name,               --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                    v_pol_code,                  --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                    v_prod_code,                 --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                    v_vchr_no,                --v_vchr_no            VARCHAR2,
                    NULL,                       --v_grct_code          NUMBER,
                    NULL,                        --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                    NULL,                     --v_rcpt_no            VARCHAR2,
                    v_count,                     --v_count             NUMBER,
                       'NEGATIVE SURRENDER - POLICY NO'
                    || v_policy_no
                    || ' POLM_CODE-'
                    || v_polm_code,
                    --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                    NVL (v_unrecoverable, 0),
                    --v_amount            NUMBER,
                    'D',                       --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                    v_trnt_gl_code,
                    --v_acc_number        VARCHAR2,
                    v_brh_code,                  --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                    v_gl_trans);
            END IF;

            IF v_count > 0
            THEN
                interface_update_vgl (v_trans_code, --v_trans_code     NUMBER,
                                      v_user_name, --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                                      v_pol_code, --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                                      TRUNC (SYSDATE),  --v_date         DATE,
                                      NULL,     --v_grct_code          NUMBER,
                                      NULL,     -- v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                                      v_btc_description,
                                      --v_btc_description   VARCHAR2,
                                      'JV',    --v_btc_type          VARCHAR2,
                                      v_brh_code, --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                                      v_description,
                                      --v_description       VARCHAR2,
                                      v_pol_code,   --v_ref          VARCHAR2,
                                      v_gl_trans);
            END IF;

            -- ENABLE TO TAKE CARE OF UPDATES WHEN NET AMT IS ZERO THUS NO CHQ RAISED.........
            lms_api.update_surrender (v_vchr_no,
                                      'NO CHEQUE ISSUED',
                                      TRUNC (SYSDATE),
                                      0,
                                      v_user_name,
                                      v_pol_code);
        END IF;
    --   EXCEPTION
    --      WHEN OTHERS
    --      THEN
    --         raise_error ('PROCESSING SURRENDER....');
    END process_grp_surrenders;

    PROCEDURE post_update_grp_recpt_pymt_rev (
        v_grct_code   NUMBER,
        v_prod_code   NUMBER,
        v_brn_code    NUMBER,
        v_user        VARCHAR2
    )
    IS
        v_prod_type   VARCHAR2 (10);

        CURSOR cur_rcpt IS
            SELECT *
              FROM lms_grp_prem_receipts
             WHERE grct_code = v_grct_code;
    BEGIN
        BEGIN
            SELECT prod_type
              INTO v_prod_type
              FROM lms_products
             WHERE prod_code = v_prod_code;
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                raise_error ('Error Determining Product Details.');
        END;

        FOR cur_rcpt_rec IN cur_rcpt
        LOOP
            IF v_prod_type != 'PENS'
            THEN
                BEGIN
                    post_grp_rcpt_alloc (cur_rcpt_rec.grct_amt,
                                         cur_rcpt_rec.grct_pol_code,
                                         v_grct_code,
                                         v_prod_code,
                                         cur_rcpt_rec.grct_receipt_no,
                                         v_user,
                                         'C');
                EXCEPTION
                    WHEN OTHERS
                    THEN
                        raise_error (
                               'ERROR POSTING RECEIPT DETAILS FOR RECEIPT '
                            || cur_rcpt_rec.grct_receipt_no);
                END;

                BEGIN
                    post_update_grp_gross_prem (cur_rcpt_rec.grct_pol_code,
                                                v_prod_code,
                                                v_brn_code,
                                                cur_rcpt_rec.grct_code,
                                                v_user,
                                                'C');
                EXCEPTION
                    WHEN OTHERS
                    THEN
                        raise_error (
                               'ERROR POSTING RECEIPT COMMISSION DETAILS FOR RECEIPT '
                            || cur_rcpt_rec.grct_receipt_no);
                END;
            ELSE
                BEGIN
                    update_gl_da_contri (cur_rcpt_rec.grct_pol_code,
                                         cur_rcpt_rec.grct_code,
                                         v_brn_code,
                                         'D');
                EXCEPTION
                    WHEN OTHERS
                    THEN
                        raise_error (
                               'ERROR POSTING RECEIPT CONTRIBUTION DETAILS FOR RECEIPT '
                            || cur_rcpt_rec.grct_receipt_no);
                END;
            END IF;
        END LOOP;
    END post_update_grp_recpt_pymt_rev;

    PROCEDURE post_grp_gross_comm_contra_gl (
        v_cop_code   NUMBER,
        v_user       VARCHAR2
    )
    IS
        CURSOR comm IS
            SELECT cop_trans_no,
                   cop_brn_code,
                     DECODE (NVL (cop_drcr, 'C'), 'C', 1, -1)
                   * (NVL (cop_comm_amt, 0))    comm_amt,
                   agn_act_code
              --SUM(DECODE(NVL(cop_drcr,'C'),'C',1,-1) * (NVL(cop_comm_amt,0) + NVL(cop_ovride_comm_amt,0))) comm_amt
              FROM lms_commission_pymts, lms_agencies
             WHERE agn_code = cop_agn_code AND cop_code = v_cop_code;

        v_org_code              NUMBER;
        v_trnt_code             VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_trnt_gl_code          VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_trnt_contra_gl_code   VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_gl_count              NUMBER := -1;
        v_vgl_no                NUMBER;
        v_trans_code            NUMBER;
        v_gl_trans              fms_vouchers_pkg.tgl_rec_type;
        v_trans_no              NUMBER;
        v_brn_code              NUMBER;
    BEGIN
        v_gl_trans.delete;

        FOR c IN comm
        LOOP
            v_brn_code := c.cop_brn_code;
            v_org_code := fms_interfaces_pkg.get_org (v_brn_code);

            SELECT    TO_NUMBER (TO_CHAR (SYSDATE, 'RRRR'))
                   || lms_transaction_seq.NEXTVAL
              INTO v_trans_code
              FROM DUAL;

            get_gl_code ('UC_GB',
                         NULL,
                         v_trnt_code,
                         v_trnt_gl_code,
                         v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                         NULL,
                         -- v_tt_code                        NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                         NULL,
                         -- v_renewal                        VARCHAR2 DEFAULT 'N',
                         c.agn_act_code,
                         -- v_act_code                       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                         c.cop_brn_code);
            valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                       v_org_code,
                       v_brn_code,
                       'UC_GB');
            valid_acc (v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                       v_org_code,
                       v_brn_code,
                       'UC_GB contra');
            v_gl_count := v_gl_count + 2;
            --RAISE_ERROR('AM HERE>...'||v_cop_code);
            interface_append_gl (v_trans_code, --v_trans_code           NUMBER,
                                 v_user,       --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                                 NULL,           --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                                 NULL,           --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                                 c.cop_trans_no,
                                 --v_vchr_no             VARCHAR2,
                                 NULL,           --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                                 NULL,           --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                                 NULL,       --v_rcpt_no             VARCHAR2,
                                 v_gl_count,     --v_count             NUMBER,
                                 'LMS GROSS COMM - CONTRA',
                                 --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                                 NVL (c.comm_amt, 0),
                                 --v_amount            NUMBER,
                                 'D',          --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                                 v_trnt_gl_code,
                                 --v_acc_number1          VARCHAR2,
                                 v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                 --v_acc_number2          VARCHAR2,
                                 v_brn_code,     --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                                 v_gl_trans);

            IF v_gl_count > 0
            THEN
                interface_update_vgl (v_trans_code, --v_trans_code     NUMBER,
                                      v_user,  --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                                      NULL,      --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                                      TRUNC (SYSDATE), --v_date              DATE,
                                      NULL,      --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                                      NULL,      --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                                      'LMS GL COMMISSION BATCH - CONTRA',
                                      --v_btc_description   VARCHAR2,
                                      'JV', --v_btc_type             VARCHAR2,
                                      v_brn_code, --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                                      'LMS GROSS COMM', --v_description       VARCHAR2,
                                      NULL,   --v_ref_no             VARCHAR2,
                                      v_gl_trans);
            END IF;
        END LOOP;
    --   EXCEPTION
    --      WHEN OTHERS
    --      THEN
    --         raise_error ('Com. Api.Contra...');
    END post_grp_gross_comm_contra_gl;

    PROCEDURE update_gl_da_contri_clnup (
        v_pol_code     IN NUMBER,
        v_grct_code    IN NUMBER,
        v_rct_branch   IN NUMBER,
        v_drcr         IN VARCHAR2
    )
    IS
        CURSOR cur_pend IS
            SELECT grct_pol_policy_no     pol_policy_no,
                   pol_prod_code,
                   pol_bra_code,
                   grct_receipt_no,
                   grct_receipt_date,
                   grct_pens_pymt_amt,
                   grct_pens_comm,
                   grct_pens_comm_paid,
                   grct_done_by,
                   grct_wht_amt
              FROM lms_grp_prem_receipts, lms_policies
             WHERE     pol_code = grct_pol_code
                   AND pol_code = v_pol_code
                   AND grct_code = v_grct_code;
    BEGIN
        FOR p IN cur_pend
        LOOP
            update_gl_da_contri_clnup (v_pol_code,
                                       p.pol_policy_no,
                                       p.pol_prod_code,
                                       p.pol_bra_code,
                                       p.grct_receipt_no,
                                       p.grct_receipt_date,
                                       v_rct_branch,
                                       p.grct_pens_pymt_amt,
                                       p.grct_pens_comm,
                                       p.grct_pens_comm_paid,
                                       v_drcr,
                                       p.grct_done_by,
                                       p.grct_wht_amt);
        END LOOP;
    END update_gl_da_contri_clnup;

    PROCEDURE update_gl_da_contri_clnup (
        v_pol_code         IN NUMBER,
        v_policy_no        IN VARCHAR2,
        v_pol_prod_code    IN NUMBER,
        v_pol_bra_code     IN NUMBER,
        v_rcpt_no          IN VARCHAR2,
        v_rct_date         IN DATE,
        v_rct_branch       IN NUMBER,
        v_contri_amt       IN NUMBER,
        v_comm_amt_alloc   IN NUMBER,
        v_comm_amt_paid    IN NUMBER,
        v_drcr             IN VARCHAR2,
        v_done_by          IN VARCHAR2,
        v_whdtx_in            NUMBER
    )
    IS
        v_count                 NUMBER;
        v_gl_trans              fms_vouchers_pkg.tgl_rec_type;
        v_vgl_no                NUMBER;
        v_trnt_code             VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_trnt_gl_code          VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_trnt_contra_gl_code   VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_org_code              NUMBER;
        v_contra_acc            VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_acc_type              VARCHAR2 (5) := 'D';
        v_user_code             NUMBER;
        exc_user_error          EXCEPTION;
        v_user_name             VARCHAR2 (30)
            := pkg_global_vars.get_pvarchar2 ('PKG_GLOBAL_VARS.PVG_USERNAME');
        --v_done_by;--used during cleanup in datacleaning
        --:= Pkg_Global_Vars.get_pvarchar2 ('PKG_GLOBAL_VARS.PVG_USERNAME');
        v_trans_code            NUMBER;
        v_admin_fee_rate        NUMBER;
        v_vat_rate              NUMBER;
        v_whdtx                 NUMBER;
        v_wht_rate              NUMBER;
        v_umbrella              VARCHAR2 (5);
    BEGIN
        v_user_code := fms_interfaces_pkg.get_usercode (UPPER (v_user_name));

        BEGIN
            SELECT prod_umbrella
              INTO v_umbrella
              FROM lms_products
             WHERE prod_code = v_pol_prod_code;
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                raise_error ('Error fetching product details..');
        END;

        IF v_user_code IS NULL
        THEN
            raise_error (
                'USER LOGGED IN NOT KNOWN. PLEASE LOGOUT AND LOGIN AGAIN..');
        END IF;

        --raise_error('User'||v_user_name);
        SELECT    TO_NUMBER (TO_CHAR (SYSDATE, 'RRRR'))
               || lms_transaction_seq.NEXTVAL
          INTO v_trans_code
          FROM DUAL;

        v_count := -1;
        v_org_code := fms_interfaces_pkg.get_org (v_pol_bra_code);

        IF NVL (v_comm_amt_alloc, 0) != 0
        THEN
            get_gl_code ('DC',
                         v_pol_prod_code,
                         v_trnt_code,
                         v_trnt_gl_code,
                         v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
            valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                       v_org_code,
                       v_pol_bra_code,
                       'DC');
            valid_acc (v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                       v_org_code,
                       v_pol_bra_code,
                       'DC CONTRA');
            v_count := v_count + 2;
            interface_append_gl (v_trans_code,   --v_trans_code        NUMBER,
                                 v_done_by,
                                 --v_user_name,                 --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                                 v_pol_code,     --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                                 v_pol_prod_code,
                                 --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                                 NULL,        --v_vchr_no            VARCHAR2,
                                 NULL,           --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                                 NULL,           --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                                 v_rcpt_no,   --v_rcpt_no            VARCHAR2,
                                 v_count,        --v_count             NUMBER,
                                 'PENSION COMMISSION - ' || v_policy_no,
                                 --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                                 NVL (v_comm_amt_alloc, 0),
                                 --v_amount            NUMBER,
                                 v_drcr,       --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                                 v_trnt_gl_code,
                                 --v_acc_number1        VARCHAR2,
                                 v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                 --v_acc_number2        VARCHAR2,
                                 v_pol_bra_code,
                                 --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                                 v_gl_trans);
            v_whdtx := v_whdtx_in;

            IF NVL (v_whdtx, 0) <> 0
            THEN
                get_gl_code ('WTHTX1',
                             v_pol_prod_code,
                             v_trnt_code,
                             v_trnt_gl_code,
                             v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
                valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                           v_org_code,
                           v_pol_bra_code,
                           'WTHTX1');
                valid_acc (v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                           v_org_code,
                           v_pol_bra_code,
                           'WTHTX1 CONTRA');
                v_count := v_count + 2;
                interface_append_gl (v_trans_code,
                                     --v_trans_code         NUMBER,
                                     v_done_by,
                                     --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                                     v_pol_code,
                                     --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                                     v_pol_prod_code,
                                     --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                                     NULL,
                                     --v_cop_paid_vchr_tab (v_com_rec).comm_voucher,
                                     --v_vchr_no          VARCHAR2,
                                     NULL,       --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                                     NULL,       --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                                     v_rcpt_no,
                                     --v_rcpt_no           VARCHAR2,
                                     v_count,    --v_count             NUMBER,
                                     'WITHOLDING TAX RECOVERY',
                                     --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                                     v_whdtx,
                                     --v_amount            NUMBER,
                                     v_drcr,   --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                                     v_trnt_gl_code,
                                     --v_acc_number1        VARCHAR2,
                                     v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                     --v_acc_number2            VARCHAR2
                                     v_pol_bra_code,
                                     --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                                     v_gl_trans);
            END IF;
        END IF;

        IF v_count > 0
        THEN
            interface_update_vgl (v_trans_code,   --  v_trans_code     NUMBER,
                                  v_done_by,
                                  --v_user_name,              --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                                  v_pol_code,    --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                                  TRUNC (v_rct_date),  --v_date          DATE,
                                  NULL,          --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                                  NULL,          --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                                  'LMS DA RECEIPTS BATCH', --v_btc_description   VARCHAR2,
                                  'JV',         --v_btc_type         VARCHAR2,
                                  v_rct_branch,  --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                                  'DA ALLOCATION', --v_description       VARCHAR2,
                                  v_rcpt_no,       --v_ref           VARCHAR2,
                                  v_gl_trans);
        END IF;
    END update_gl_da_contri_clnup;

    PROCEDURE process_agent_lenders_payments (v_aglp_codes IN number_arr)
    IS
        CURSOR payments (v_aglp_code NUMBER)
        IS
            SELECT aglp_code,
                   aglp_amount,
                   aglp_payee,
                   aglp_bnk_code,
                   aglp_brr_code,
                   aglp_posted,
                   aglp_pymt_method,
                   aglp_date_from,
                   aglp_date_to,
                   aglp_date_posted,
                   lalt_gl_code,
                   lalt_contra_gl_code
              FROM lms_agent_lender_payments, lms_agent_loan_types
             WHERE aglp_code = v_aglp_code AND aglp_lalt_code = lalt_code;

        v_chq_dtls_rec          fms_cheques_pkg.type_rqn_dtls_table;
        v_payee_eft_rec         fms_cheques_pkg.type_payee_eft_table;
        v_bbr_code              NUMBER;
        v_eft_enabled           VARCHAR2 (1);
        v_cla_type              VARCHAR2 (1) := 'O';
        v_brh_code              NUMBER;
        v_count                 NUMBER := 0;
        v_org_code              NUMBER;
        v_crt_acc_no            VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_trnt_type             VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_prod_code             NUMBER;
        v_trnt_code             VARCHAR2 (50);
        v_trnt_gl_code          VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_trnt_contra_gl_code   VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_cla_type              VARCHAR2 (2);
        nparticipantamt         NUMBER := 0;
        v_claim_amt             NUMBER := 0;
        v_prem_drcr             VARCHAR2 (5) := 'C';
        v_narrative             VARCHAR2 (30);
        grp_amt                 NUMBER := 0;
        v_trans_code            NUMBER;
        v_class                 VARCHAR2 (10);
        v_pay_method            VARCHAR2 (10);
        v_user_name             VARCHAR2 (100)
            := pkg_global_vars.get_pvarchar2 ('PKG_GLOBAL_VARS.PVG_USERNAME');
    BEGIN
        IF v_aglp_codes.COUNT = 0
        THEN
            raise_error ('No Record Selected');
        END IF;

        BEGIN
            SELECT brn_code
              INTO v_brh_code
              FROM tqc_branches
             WHERE brn_sht_desc = 'BR/HQ';
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                raise_error ('Error getting head office branch');
        END;

        SELECT    TO_NUMBER (TO_CHAR (SYSDATE, 'RRRR'))
               || lms_transaction_seq.NEXTVAL
          INTO v_trans_code
          FROM DUAL;

        FOR i IN 1 .. v_aglp_codes.COUNT
        LOOP
            FOR pay IN payments (v_aglp_codes (i))
            LOOP
                IF pay.aglp_amount > 0
                THEN
                    IF pay.aglp_payee IS NULL
                    THEN
                        raise_error ('PAYEE NOT SPECIFIED..');
                    END IF;

                    IF pay.aglp_posted = 'Y'
                    THEN
                        raise_error (
                            'Payment has already been posted to FMS..');
                    END IF;

                    v_pay_method := pay.aglp_pymt_method;
                    v_crt_acc_no := pay.lalt_gl_code;
                    v_org_code := fms_interfaces_pkg.get_org (v_brh_code);
                    v_count := v_count + 1;
                    interface_append_chq (
                        v_trans_code,
                        pay.aglp_payee,
                        NULL,                                  --  v_pol_code,
                        NULL,                                   --v_prod_code,
                        pay.aglp_code,
                        --v_vchr_no,           --            VARCHAR2,
                        v_count,                --v_count              NUMBER,
                        NVL (pay.aglp_amount, 0),
                        'AGENT LOAN PAYMENT TO PAYEE ' || pay.aglp_payee,
                        v_crt_acc_no,
                        v_org_code,
                        --v_acc_org_code         NUMBER,
                        v_brh_code,
                        --v_branch_code        NUMBER,
                        'D',                  --v_drcr               VARCHAR2,
                        v_chq_dtls_rec);
                --v_trn_rec   IN OUT   Fms_Cheques_Pkg.Type_rqn_dtls_table)
                END IF;

                --RAISE_ERROR(v_class);
                IF v_pay_method = 'CHQ'
                THEN
                    IF v_count != 0
                    THEN
                        interface_create_reqn (
                            v_trans_code,      --v_trans_code          NUMBER,
                            pay.aglp_code, --v_ref                   VARCHAR2,
                            pay.aglp_payee, --v_ref2                  VARCHAR2,
                            TRUNC (SYSDATE),
                            --i.msur_date,                --v_ref_date              DATE,
                            'AGENT LOAN PAYMENT TO PAYEE ' || pay.aglp_payee,
                            --v_narrative             VARCHAR2,
                            pay.aglp_amount, --v_amount                NUMBER,
                            pay.aglp_payee, --v_payee                 VARCHAR2,
                            'CHQ', --v_pay_method            VARCHAR2, --CHQ, EFT
                            NULL,       --v_payee_bank_acc_no        VARCHAR2,
                            NULL,         --v_payee_bank_branch_code   NUMBER,
                            v_user_name,   --v_source_auth_by        VARCHAR2,
                            TRUNC (SYSDATE),   --v_source_auth_dt        DATE,
                            v_user_name, --v_raise_by                VARCHAR2,
                            'AGNLNRP',     --v_pmt_type              VARCHAR2,
                            v_brh_code,                       --v_branch_code,
                            NULL,                                --v_pol_code,
                            v_chq_dtls_rec);
                    --v_dtls_table  IN OUT    Fms_Cheques_Pkg.type_rqn_dtls_table)
                    END IF;
                ELSIF v_pay_method = 'EFT'
                THEN
                    IF v_count != 0
                    THEN
                        interface_create_reqn (
                            v_trans_code,      --v_trans_code          NUMBER,
                            pay.aglp_code, --v_ref                   VARCHAR2,
                            pay.aglp_payee, --v_ref2                  VARCHAR2,
                            TRUNC (SYSDATE),   --v_ref_date              DATE,
                            'AGENT LOAN PAYMENT TO PAYEE ' || pay.aglp_payee,
                            --v_narrative             VARCHAR2,
                            pay.aglp_amount, --v_amount                NUMBER,
                            pay.aglp_payee, --v_payee                 VARCHAR2,
                            'EFT', --v_pay_method            VARCHAR2, --CHQ, EFT
                            pay.aglp_brr_code,
                            --v_payee_bank_acc_no        varchar2,
                            pay.aglp_brr_code, --v_payee_bank_branch_code   NUMBER,
                            v_user_name,   --v_source_auth_by        VARCHAR2,
                            TRUNC (SYSDATE),   --v_source_auth_dt        DATE,
                            v_user_name, --v_raise_by                VARCHAR2,
                            'AGNLNRP',     --v_pmt_type              VARCHAR2,
                            v_brh_code,                       --v_branch_code,
                            NULL,                                --v_pol_code,
                            v_chq_dtls_rec);
                    --v_dtls_table  IN OUT    Fms_Cheques_Pkg.type_rqn_dtls_table)
                    END IF;
                END IF;

                --Update the posted column
                BEGIN
                    UPDATE lms_agent_lender_payments
                       SET aglp_posted = 'Y'
                     WHERE aglp_code = pay.aglp_code;
                EXCEPTION
                    WHEN OTHERS
                    THEN
                        raise_error (
                            'Error Updating payment record to posted');
                END;
            END LOOP;
        END LOOP;
    END process_agent_lenders_payments;

    PROCEDURE post_cash_builder (v_lms_lpmbb_code_tab IN lms_lpmbb_code_tab)
    IS
        CURSOR policies (v_post_fees_sep VARCHAR2)
        IS
            SELECT lpmbb_code,
                   ROUND (
                       (  NVL (lpmbb_mortality_exp, 0)
                        + NVL (lpmbb_dread_expense, 0)
                        + NVL (lpmbb_pa_charge, 0)
                        + NVL (lpmbb_commission, 0)
                        + NVL (lpmbb_mnthly_prem_exp, 0)),
                       2)                             risk_prem,
                   0                                  lpmbb_commission,
