                   pol_prod_code,
                   prod_code,
                   pol_policy_no,
                   pol_bra_code,
                   pol_code,
                   --ROUND (lpmbb_mnthly_prem_exp, 2)
                   0                                  lpmbb_mnthly_prem_exp,
                   ROUND (lpmbb_mnthly_pol_exp, 2)    lpmbb_mnthly_pol_exp,
                   pnbalm_year,
                   pnbalm_mnth,
                   --                ROUND (  NVL (lpmbb_mgt_fee, 0)
                   --                       + NVL (lpmbb_shldr_entitlement, 0),
                   --                       2
                   --                      )
                   0                                  mngmt_fee,
                   pndpo_opr_code                     opr_code,
                   ROUND (
                         ROUND (
                             (  NVL (lpmbb_mortality_exp, 0)
                              + NVL (lpmbb_dread_expense, 0)
                              + NVL (lpmbb_pa_charge, 0)
                              + NVL (lpmbb_commission, 0)
                              + NVL (lpmbb_mnthly_prem_exp, 0)),
                             2)
                       + ROUND (NVL (lpmbb_mnthly_pol_exp, 0), 2) -- + ROUND (NVL (lpmbb_commission, 0), 2)
                                                                 --                    + (DECODE ('N',
                                                                 --                               'N', 0,
                                                                 --                                 ROUND (NVL (lpmbb_mnthly_prem_exp, 0), 2)
                                                                 --                               + ROUND (NVL (lpmbb_mnthly_pol_exp, 0), 2)
                                                                 --                               + ROUND (  NVL (lpmbb_mgt_fee, 0)
                                                                 --                                        + NVL (lpmbb_shldr_entitlement, 0),
                                                                 --                                        2
                                                                 --                                       )
                                                                 --                              )
                                                                 --                      )
                                                                 ,
                       2)                             total_amt
              FROM lms_pension_mnth_bal_build,
                   lms_pension_mnth_bal,
                   lms_policies,
                   lms_products,
                   lms_pension_deposits_ord
             WHERE     pnbalm_code = lpmbb_pnbalm_code
                   AND TO_CHAR (lpmbb_code) IN
                           (SELECT lpmbb_code
                              FROM TABLE (v_lms_lpmbb_code_tab))
                   AND pnbalm_pol_code = pol_code
                   AND NVL (lpmbb_unit_account, 0) > 0
                   AND NVL (lpmbb_authorized, 'N') = 'N'
                   AND pol_prod_code = prod_code
                   AND lpmbb_pndpo_code = pndpo_code(+);

        CURSOR pol_expenses (v_prod_code NUMBER)
        IS
            SELECT ptt_tt_sht_desc, ptt_acc_no
              FROM lms_prod_tax_types
             WHERE ptt_prod_code = v_prod_code;

        v_drcr                  VARCHAR2 (5);
        v_gl_acc                VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_gl_acc2               VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_org_code              NUMBER;
        v_count                 NUMBER := 0;
        v_trans_code            NUMBER;
        v_gl_trans              tq_fms.fms_vouchers_pkg.tgl_rec_type;
        v_trnt_code             VARCHAR2 (10);
        v_crt_acc_no            VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_trnt_contra_gl_code   VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_trnt_gl_code          VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_user                  VARCHAR2 (50)
            := pkg_global_vars.get_pvarchar2 ('pkg_global_vars.pvg_username');
        v_post_fees_sep         VARCHAR (1);
        v_prod_code             NUMBER;
        v_errmsg                VARCHAR (1200);
    BEGIN
        BEGIN
            SELECT pol_prod_code
              INTO v_prod_code
              FROM lms_pension_mnth_bal_build,
                   lms_pension_mnth_bal,
                   lms_policies
             WHERE     pnbalm_code = lpmbb_pnbalm_code
                   AND TO_CHAR (lpmbb_code) IN
                           (SELECT lpmbb_code
                              FROM TABLE (v_lms_lpmbb_code_tab))
                   AND pnbalm_pol_code = pol_code
                   AND ROWNUM = 1;
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                raise_error ('ERROR GETTING PRODUCT DETAILS...');
        END;

        BEGIN
            lms_ord_misc.system_param_val ('POST_FEES_SEPARATELY',
                                           v_post_fees_sep,
                                           v_prod_code);
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                raise_error ('PARAMETER ERROR...POST_FEES_SEPARATELY...');
        END;

        FOR p IN policies (v_post_fees_sep)
        LOOP
            COMMIT;

            BEGIN
                SELECT    TO_NUMBER (TO_CHAR (SYSDATE, 'RRRR'))
                       || lms_transaction_seq.NEXTVAL
                  INTO v_trans_code
                  FROM DUAL;

                v_gl_trans.delete;
                v_org_code := fms_interfaces_pkg.get_org (p.pol_bra_code);

                IF NVL (p.risk_prem, 0) > 0
                THEN
                    v_count := v_count + 1;
                    get_gl_code ('UP',
                                 p.prod_code,
                                 v_trnt_code,
                                 v_trnt_gl_code,
                                 v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
                    valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                               v_org_code,
                               p.pol_bra_code,
                               'UP');
                    interface_append_gl (
                        v_trans_code,                         -- v_trans_code,
                        v_user,                                 -- v_raise_by,
                        p.pol_code,                             -- v_pol_code,
                        p.pol_prod_code,                       -- v_prod_code,
                        NULL,                                    -- v_vchr_no,
                        p.opr_code,                             -- v_opr_code,
                        NULL,                                  -- v_oppr_code,
                        NULL,                                     --v_rcpt_no,
                        v_count,                                   -- v_count,
                           'ALLOCATED PREMIUM'
                        || ' - '
                        || p.pol_policy_no
                        || ' FOR YEAR - '
                        || p.pnbalm_year
                        || ' MONTH - '
                        || p.pnbalm_mnth,                      -- v_narrative,
                        NVL (p.risk_prem, 0),                     -- v_amount,
                        'C',                                        -- v_drcr,
                        v_trnt_gl_code,                      -- v_acc_number1,
                        p.pol_bra_code,                      -- v_branch_code,
                        v_gl_trans,
                        NULL,
                        --v_cad_code       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                        NULL,
                        --v_otop_code              NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                        NULL,
                        --v_fpmt_code              NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                        NULL,
                        --v_ort_code               NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                        NULL,
                        --v_btr_no                 NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                        NULL,
                        --v_ppr_code               NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                        NULL,
                        --v_ocl_code                NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                        NULL,
                        --v_agn_code                NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                        NULL   --v_trans_no                NUMBER DEFAULT NULL
                            );
                END IF;

                --Disbabled
                IF NVL (p.lpmbb_commission, 0) > 0 AND 1 = 2
                THEN
                    get_gl_code ('PROD_GC',
                                 p.prod_code,
                                 v_trnt_code,
                                 v_trnt_gl_code,
                                 v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
                    valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                               v_org_code,
                               p.pol_bra_code,
                               'PROD_GC');
                    v_count := v_count + 1;
                    interface_append_gl (
                        v_trans_code,                         -- v_trans_code,
                        v_user,                                 -- v_raise_by,
                        p.pol_code,                             -- v_pol_code,
                        p.pol_prod_code,                       -- v_prod_code,
                        NULL,                                    -- v_vchr_no,
                        p.opr_code,                             -- v_opr_code,
                        NULL,                                  -- v_oppr_code,
                        NULL,                                     --v_rcpt_no,
                        v_count,                                   -- v_count,
                           'COMMISSION FROM INVESTMENT CONTRIBUTION '
                        || ' - '
                        || p.pol_policy_no
                        || ' FOR YEAR - '
                        || p.pnbalm_year
                        || ' MONTH - '
                        || p.pnbalm_mnth,                      -- v_narrative,
                        NVL (p.lpmbb_commission, 0),              -- v_amount,
                        'C',                                        -- v_drcr,
                        v_trnt_gl_code,                      -- v_acc_number1,
                        p.pol_bra_code,                      -- v_branch_code,
                        v_gl_trans,
                        NULL,
                        --v_cad_code       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                        NULL,
                        --v_otop_code              NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                        NULL,
                        --v_fpmt_code              NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                        NULL,
                        --v_ort_code               NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                        NULL,
                        --v_btr_no                 NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                        NULL,
                        --v_ppr_code               NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                        NULL,
                        --v_ocl_code                NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                        NULL,
                        --v_agn_code                NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                        NULL   --v_trans_no                NUMBER DEFAULT NULL
                            );
                END IF;

                FOR expe IN pol_expenses (p.prod_code)
                LOOP
                    --Disabled
                    IF expe.ptt_tt_sht_desc IN ('PREMEXP') AND 1 = 2
                    THEN
                        IF NVL (p.lpmbb_mnthly_prem_exp, 0) > 0
                        THEN
                            v_count := v_count + 1;
                            interface_append_gl (
                                v_trans_code,                 -- v_trans_code,
                                v_user,                         -- v_raise_by,
                                p.pol_code,                     -- v_pol_code,
                                p.pol_prod_code,               -- v_prod_code,
                                NULL,                            -- v_vchr_no,
                                p.opr_code,                     -- v_opr_code,
                                NULL,                          -- v_oppr_code,
                                NULL,                             --v_rcpt_no,
                                v_count,                           -- v_count,
                                   'MONTHLY PREMIUM EXPENSE '
                                || ' - '
                                || p.pol_policy_no
                                || ' FOR YEAR - '
                                || p.pnbalm_year
                                || ' MONTH - '
                                || p.pnbalm_mnth,              -- v_narrative,
                                NVL (p.lpmbb_mnthly_prem_exp, 0), -- v_amount,
                                'C',                                -- v_drcr,
                                expe.ptt_acc_no,             -- v_acc_number1,
                                p.pol_bra_code,              -- v_branch_code,
                                v_gl_trans,
                                NULL,
                                --v_cad_code       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                NULL,
                                --v_otop_code              NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                NULL,
                                --v_fpmt_code              NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                NULL,
                                --v_ort_code               NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                NULL,
                                --v_btr_no                 NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                NULL,
                                --v_ppr_code               NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                NULL,
                                --v_ocl_code                NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                NULL,
                                --v_agn_code                NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                NULL --v_trans_no                NUMBER DEFAULT NULL
                                    );
                        END IF;
                    ELSIF expe.ptt_tt_sht_desc IN ('POLEXP')
                    THEN
                        IF NVL (p.lpmbb_mnthly_pol_exp, 0) > 0
                        THEN
                            v_count := v_count + 1;
                            interface_append_gl (
                                v_trans_code,                 -- v_trans_code,
                                v_user,                         -- v_raise_by,
                                p.pol_code,                     -- v_pol_code,
                                p.pol_prod_code,               -- v_prod_code,
                                NULL,                            -- v_vchr_no,
                                p.opr_code,                     -- v_opr_code,
                                NULL,                          -- v_oppr_code,
                                NULL,                             --v_rcpt_no,
                                v_count,                           -- v_count,
                                   'MONTHLY POLICY EXPENSE '
                                || ' - '
                                || p.pol_policy_no
                                || ' FOR YEAR - '
                                || p.pnbalm_year
                                || ' MONTH - '
                                || p.pnbalm_mnth,              -- v_narrative,
                                NVL (p.lpmbb_mnthly_pol_exp, 0),  -- v_amount,
                                'C',                                -- v_drcr,
                                expe.ptt_acc_no,             -- v_acc_number1,
                                p.pol_bra_code,              -- v_branch_code,
                                v_gl_trans,
                                NULL,
                                --v_cad_code       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                NULL,
                                --v_otop_code              NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                NULL,
                                --v_fpmt_code              NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                NULL,
                                --v_ort_code               NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                NULL,
                                --v_btr_no                 NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                NULL,
                                --v_ppr_code               NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                NULL,
                                --v_ocl_code                NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                NULL,
                                --v_agn_code                NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                NULL --v_trans_no                NUMBER DEFAULT NULL
                                    );
                        END IF;
                    END IF;
                END LOOP;

                --DISabled
                IF 1 = 2
                THEN
                    IF NVL (p.mngmt_fee, 0) > 0
                    THEN
                        get_gl_code ('INVFEE',
                                     p.prod_code,
                                     v_trnt_code,
                                     v_trnt_gl_code,
                                     v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
                        valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                                   v_org_code,
                                   p.pol_bra_code,
                                   'INVFEE');
                        v_count := v_count + 1;
                        interface_append_gl (
                            v_trans_code,                     -- v_trans_code,
                            v_user,                             -- v_raise_by,
                            p.pol_code,                         -- v_pol_code,
                            p.pol_prod_code,                   -- v_prod_code,
                            NULL,                                -- v_vchr_no,
                            p.opr_code,                         -- v_opr_code,
                            NULL,                              -- v_oppr_code,
                            NULL,                                 --v_rcpt_no,
                            v_count,                               -- v_count,
                               'SHAREHOLDER + MANAGEMENT EXPENSES'
                            || ' - '
                            || p.pol_policy_no
                            || ' FOR YEAR - '
                            || p.pnbalm_year
                            || ' MONTH - '
                            || p.pnbalm_mnth,                  -- v_narrative,
                            NVL (p.mngmt_fee, 0),                 -- v_amount,
                            'C',                                    -- v_drcr,
                            v_trnt_gl_code,                  -- v_acc_number1,
                            p.pol_bra_code,                  -- v_branch_code,
                            v_gl_trans,
                            NULL,
                            --v_cad_code       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                            NULL,
                            --v_otop_code              NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                            NULL,
                            --v_fpmt_code              NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                            NULL,
                            --v_ort_code               NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                            NULL,
                            --v_btr_no                 NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                            NULL,
                            --v_ppr_code               NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                            NULL,
                            --v_ocl_code                NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                            NULL,
                            --v_agn_code                NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                            NULL --v_trans_no                NUMBER DEFAULT NULL
                                );
                    END IF;
                END IF;

                IF NVL (p.total_amt, 0) > 0
                THEN
                    v_count := v_count + 1;
                    get_gl_code ('INVPREM',
                                 p.prod_code,
                                 v_trnt_code,
                                 v_trnt_gl_code,
                                 v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
                    valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                               v_org_code,
                               p.pol_bra_code,
                               'INVPREM');
                    interface_append_gl (
                        v_trans_code,                         -- v_trans_code,
                        v_user,                                 -- v_raise_by,
                        p.pol_code,                             -- v_pol_code,
                        p.pol_prod_code,                       -- v_prod_code,
                        NULL,                                    -- v_vchr_no,
                        p.opr_code,                             -- v_opr_code,
                        NULL,                                  -- v_oppr_code,
                        NULL,                                     --v_rcpt_no,
                        v_count,                                   -- v_count,
                           'ALLOCATED INV. CONTRIBUTION'
                        || ' - '
                        || p.pol_policy_no
                        || ' FOR YEAR - '
                        || p.pnbalm_year
                        || ' MONTH - '
                        || p.pnbalm_mnth,                      -- v_narrative,
                        NVL (p.total_amt, 0),                     -- v_amount,
                        'D',                                        -- v_drcr,
                        v_trnt_gl_code,                      -- v_acc_number1,
                        p.pol_bra_code,                      -- v_branch_code,
                        v_gl_trans,
                        NULL,
                        --v_cad_code       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                        NULL,
                        --v_otop_code              NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                        NULL,
                        --v_fpmt_code              NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                        NULL,
                        --v_ort_code               NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                        NULL,
                        --v_btr_no                 NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                        NULL,
                        --v_ppr_code               NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                        NULL,
                        --v_ocl_code                NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                        NULL,
                        --v_agn_code                NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                        NULL   --v_trans_no                NUMBER DEFAULT NULL
                            );
                END IF;

                BEGIN
                    IF v_count > 0
                    THEN
                        --raise_error('v_gl_count  '|| v_gl_count);
                        interface_update_vgl (
                            v_trans_code,           --v_trans_code     NUMBER,
                            v_user,            --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                            NULL,                --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                            SYSDATE,
                            --v_date           DATE,
                            NULL,                --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                            NULL,                --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                            'LMS VALUATION BATCH', --v_btc_description   VARCHAR2,
                            'JV',               --v_btc_type         VARCHAR2,
                            p.pol_bra_code,      --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                            'VALUATION ' || p.pol_policy_no,
                            NULL,              --v_rcpt_no           VARCHAR2,
                            v_gl_trans,
                            --v_gl_trans  IN OUT  Fms_Vouchers_Pkg.Tgl_rec_type,
                            NULL,      --v_cad_code       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                            NULL);    --v_otop_code       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL)
                    END IF;
                EXCEPTION
                    WHEN OTHERS
                    THEN
                        raise_error ('CREATING/POSTING  VALUATION VOUCHER  ');
                END;

                BEGIN
                    UPDATE lms_pension_mnth_bal_build
                       SET lpmbb_itfc_transaction_code = v_trans_code,
                           lpmbb_authorized = 'Y',
                           lpmbb_authorized_by = v_user,
                           lpmbb_authorized_date = SYSDATE
                     WHERE     lpmbb_code = p.lpmbb_code
                           AND NVL (lpmbb_authorized, 'N') = 'N';
                EXCEPTION
                    WHEN OTHERS
                    THEN
                        raise_error ('Error Updating Authorization Status');
                END;
            EXCEPTION
                WHEN OTHERS
                THEN
                    ROLLBACK;
                    v_errmsg := 'ERROR POSTING ' || SQLERRM (SQLCODE);
            END;

            COMMIT;
        END LOOP;

        IF v_errmsg IS NOT NULL
        THEN
            raise_error (v_errmsg);
        END IF;
    END post_cash_builder;

    PROCEDURE post_agn_premiums (
        v_opr_rct_trans_code           VARCHAR2,
        v_oppr_rct_trans_code          VARCHAR2,
        v_rct_branch                   NUMBER,
        v_opr_code                     NUMBER,
        v_oppr_code                    NUMBER,
        v_trans_no                     NUMBER,
        v_trans_code                   NUMBER,
        v_user                         VARCHAR2,
        v_count                 IN OUT NUMBER,
        v_chq_dtls_rec          IN OUT fms_cheques_pkg.type_rqn_dtls_table,
        v_comm_voucher                 VARCHAR2,
        v_agn_code                     NUMBER,
        v_trn_rec               IN OUT tq_fms.fms_vouchers_pkg.tgl_rec_type,
        v_post_gl                      VARCHAR2 DEFAULT 'N'
    )
    IS
        v_gl_trans                  fms_vouchers_pkg.tgl_rec_type;
        v_vgl_no                    NUMBER;
        v_trnt_code                 VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_trnt_gl_code              VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_unp_trnt_gl_code          VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_trnt_contra_gl_code       VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_contra_acc                VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_msg                       VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_org_code                  NUMBER;
        v_prod_code                 NUMBER;
        v_comp_param                VARCHAR2 (5);
        v_alloc_to                  VARCHAR2 (2);
        v_opr_receipt_trans_code    VARCHAR2 (50);
        v_oppr_receipt_trans_code   VARCHAR2 (50);
        v_origin                    VARCHAR2 (5);
        v_rcpt_bal                  NUMBER;
        v_opr_drcr                  VARCHAR2 (5) := 'C';
        v_prem_amt                  NUMBER;
        v_chkoff_comm               NUMBER;
        v_loan_amt                  NUMBER;
        v_pens_amt                  NUMBER;
        v_inv_admin                 NUMBER;
        v_inv_fee                   NUMBER;
        v_inv_contri                NUMBER;
        v_comfnd                    NUMBER;
        v_oppr_drcr                 VARCHAR2 (5) := 'C';
        v_oppr_chk_drcr             VARCHAR2 (5) := 'D';
        v_separate_posting          VARCHAR2 (5);
        v_ltr_btr_trans_code        lms_transactions.ltr_btr_trans_code%TYPE;
        v_source                    lms_ord_prem_receipts.opr_source%TYPE;
        v_post_cnt                  NUMBER;
        v_post                      VARCHAR2 (5);
        v_param_val                 VARCHAR2 (5);
        v_bct_code                  NUMBER;
        v_sbu_code                  NUMBER := NULL;
        v_spoke_code                NUMBER := NULL;
        v_cvrg_area                 NUMBER := NULL;
        v_location_code             NUMBER := NULL;
        v_vcb_no                    NUMBER;
        v_tot_amt                   NUMBER;
        v_pol_code                  NUMBER;
        v_branch_code               NUMBER;
        v_post_cb                   VARCHAR2 (5) := 'N';
        v_tcg_rec                   fms_vouchers_pkg.tcg_rec_type;
        v_cb_count                  NUMBER := 1;
        v_cb_rec                    fms_vouchers_pkg.tcb_rec_type;
        v_btc_type                  VARCHAR2 (5);
        v_opr_code1                 NUMBER;
        v_rct_paymt_mode            fms_receipts.rct_paymt_mode%TYPE;
        v_trnt_type                 VARCHAR2 (10);
        v_post_fees_sep             VARCHAR (1);
        v_prem_comm                 NUMBER;
        v_dir_count                 NUMBER;
        v_fms_unknown_reposting     VARCHAR2 (1);
        v_rct_code                  VARCHAR2 (5);
        v_nfl_alloc                 NUMBER;
        v_acc_type                  VARCHAR2 (1);
        v_narrative                 VARCHAR2 (100);

        CURSOR cur_pol_cb_amt IS
            SELECT NVL (opr_amt, 0)                                         opr_amt,
                   pol_code,
                   pol_bra_code,
                   pol_prod_type,
                   pol_prod_code,
                   opr_code,
                   pol_proposal_no,
                   pol_policy_no
              FROM lms_ord_prem_receipts,
                   lms_policies,
                   lms_policy_endorsements
             WHERE     pol_code = opr_pol_code
                   AND pol_current_endr_code = endr_code
                   AND opr_code = v_opr_code;

        CURSOR cur_prop_cb_amt IS
            SELECT NVL (oppr_amt, 0)     paid_amt,
                   pol_code,
                   pol_bra_code,
                   pol_prod_type,
                   pol_prod_code,
                   pol_proposal_no,
                   pol_policy_no,
                   oppr_code
              FROM lms_ord_proposal_rcpts, lms_policies
             WHERE pol_code = oppr_pol_code AND oppr_code = v_oppr_code;
    BEGIN
        FOR pr IN cur_prop_cb_amt
        LOOP
            v_branch_code := pr.pol_bra_code;
            v_prod_code := pr.pol_prod_code;
            v_org_code := fms_interfaces_pkg.get_org (pr.pol_bra_code);

            IF pr.pol_bra_code IS NULL
            THEN
                raise_error ('BRANCH NOT DEFINED FOR THIS RECORD....');
            ELSIF pr.pol_prod_code IS NULL
            THEN
                raise_error (
                       'Define product for Proposal No.'
                    || pr.pol_proposal_no
                    || '...');
            END IF;

            IF v_oppr_code IS NOT NULL
            THEN
                BEGIN
                    --             RAISE_ERROR('v_oppr_code===M=='||v_oppr_code);
                    SELECT NVL (oppr_drcr, 'C'),
                           DECODE (NVL (oppr_drcr, 'C'), 'C', 'D', 'C')
                      INTO v_oppr_drcr, v_oppr_chk_drcr
                      FROM lms_ord_proposal_rcpts
                     WHERE oppr_code = v_oppr_code;
                EXCEPTION
                    WHEN OTHERS
                    THEN
                        raise_error (
                            'ERROR RETRIEVING PROPOSAL RCPT DTLS...');
                END;

                v_opr_drcr := v_oppr_drcr;
            END IF;

            IF NVL (pr.paid_amt, 0) <> 0
            THEN
                get_gl_code ('PRRCT',
                             pr.pol_prod_code,
                             v_trnt_code,
                             v_trnt_gl_code,
                             v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                             NULL);
                valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                           v_org_code,
                           pr.pol_bra_code,
                           'PRRCT');
                v_count := v_count + 1;

                IF v_post_gl = 'N'
                THEN
                    interface_append_chq (
                        v_trans_code,            --v_trans_code        NUMBER,
                        v_user,                --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                        pr.pol_code,            --v_pol_code           NUMBER,
                        pr.pol_prod_code,
                        --v_prod_code          NUMBER,
                        v_comm_voucher,
                        --v_vchr_no           VARCHAR2,
                        v_count,                --v_count              NUMBER,
                        pr.paid_amt,            --v_amount             NUMBER,
                        'PROPOSAL PREMIUM' || ' - ' || pr.pol_proposal_no,
                        --v_narrative          VARCHAR2,
                        v_trnt_gl_code,
                        --v_acc_number         VARCHAR2,
                        v_org_code,           --v_acc_org_code         NUMBER,
                        v_rct_branch,
                        --v_branch_code        NUMBER,
                        'C',                  --v_drcr               VARCHAR2,
                        v_chq_dtls_rec,
                        -- IN OUT   fms_cheques_pkg.type_rqn_dtls_table
                        NULL,              --v_fpmt_code  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                        NULL,               --v_ocl_code  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                        v_agn_code,
                        --v_agn_code NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                        v_trans_no            --v_trans_no NUMBER DEFAULT NULL
                                  );
                ELSE
                    interface_append_gl (
                        v_trans_code,           --v_trans_code         NUMBER,
                        v_user,                --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                        pr.pol_code,             --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                        pr.pol_prod_code,        --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                        v_comm_voucher,
                        --v_vchr_no          VARCHAR2,
                        NULL,                    --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                        NULL,                    --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                        NULL,                  --v_rcpt_no           VARCHAR2,
                        v_count,                 --v_count             NUMBER,
                        'PROPOSAL PREMIUM' || ' - ' || pr.pol_proposal_no,
                        --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                        pr.paid_amt,
                        --v_amount            NUMBER,
                        'C',                   --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                        v_trnt_gl_code,       --v_acc_number1        VARCHAR2,
                        --v_acc_number2            VARCHAR2
                        v_rct_branch,
                        --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                        v_trn_rec,
                        --IN OUT   tq_fms.fms_vouchers_pkg.tgl_rec_type,
                        NULL,               --v_cad_code  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                        NULL,              --v_otop_code  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                        NULL,              --v_fpmt_code  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                        NULL,               --v_ort_code  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                        NULL,                 --v_btr_no  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                        NULL,               --v_ppr_code  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                        NULL,               --v_ocl_code  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                        v_agn_code,
                        --v_agn_code  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                        v_trans_no           --v_trans_no  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL
                                  );
                END IF;
            END IF;

            v_opr_drcr := v_oppr_drcr;
            v_prod_code := pr.pol_prod_code;
            v_pol_code := pr.pol_code;
            v_branch_code := pr.pol_bra_code;
            v_post_cb := 'Y';

            BEGIN
                lms_ord_misc.auto_authorize_policy (pr.pol_code);
            EXCEPTION
                WHEN OTHERS
                THEN
                    NULL;
            END;
        END LOOP;

        FOR pl IN cur_pol_cb_amt
        LOOP
            v_post_cnt := NULL;
            v_branch_code := pl.pol_bra_code;
            v_prod_code := pl.pol_prod_code;
            v_pol_code := pl.pol_code;
            v_org_code := fms_interfaces_pkg.get_org (pl.pol_bra_code);

            BEGIN
                SELECT opr_drcr
                  INTO v_opr_drcr
                  FROM lms_ord_prem_receipts
                 WHERE opr_code = pl.opr_code;
            EXCEPTION
                WHEN OTHERS
                THEN
                    v_opr_drcr := 'C';
            END;

            --            RAISE_ERROR('XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX');
            IF pl.pol_prod_code IS NULL
            THEN
                raise_error (
                       'Define product for Policy No.'
                    || pl.pol_policy_no
                    || '...');
            END IF;

            BEGIN
                SELECT endr_sbu_code,
                       endr_spoke_code,
                       endr_coverage_area_code,
                       endr_location_code
                  INTO v_sbu_code,
                       v_spoke_code,
                       v_cvrg_area,
                       v_location_code
                  FROM lms_policies, lms_policy_endorsements
                 WHERE     pol_current_endr_code = endr_code
                       AND pol_code = pl.pol_code;
            EXCEPTION
                WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND
                THEN
                    NULL;
                WHEN OTHERS
                THEN
                    NULL;
            END;

            BEGIN
                SELECT opr_origin, NVL (opr_drcr, 'C')
                  INTO v_origin, v_opr_drcr               --, v_fms_receipt_pk
                  FROM lms_ord_prem_receipts
                 WHERE opr_code = v_opr_code;
            EXCEPTION
                WHEN OTHERS
                THEN
                    raise_error ('ERROR RETRIEVING RCPT DTLS....');
            END;

            IF v_trans_no IS NOT NULL
            THEN
                BEGIN
                    SELECT ltr_btr_trans_code
                      INTO v_ltr_btr_trans_code
                      FROM lms_transactions
                     WHERE ltr_trans_no = v_trans_no;
                EXCEPTION
                    WHEN OTHERS
                    THEN
                        NULL;
                END;
            END IF;

            IF NVL (pl.opr_amt, 0) <> 0
                        THEN
                IF pl.pol_prod_type = 'IN'
                    THEN
                        get_gl_code ('INVPREM',
                                     pl.pol_prod_code,
                                     v_trnt_code,
                                     v_trnt_gl_code,
                                     v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                     NULL,
                                     NULL);
                        v_narrative :=
                               'INVESTMENT PREMIUM'
                            || ' - '
                            || NVL (pl.pol_policy_no, pl.pol_proposal_no);
                        valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                                   v_org_code,
                                   pl.pol_bra_code,
                                   'INVPREM');
                        ELSE
                    get_gl_code ('UP',
                                 pl.pol_prod_code,
                                 v_trnt_code,
                                 v_trnt_gl_code,
                                 v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                 NULL,
                                 NULL);
                    v_narrative :=
                           'ALLOCATED PREMIUM'
                        || ' - '
                        || NVL (pl.pol_policy_no, pl.pol_proposal_no);
                    valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                               v_org_code,
                               pl.pol_bra_code,
                               'UP');
                END IF;

                    v_count := v_count + 1;

                    IF v_post_gl = 'N'
                    THEN
                        interface_append_chq (v_trans_code, --v_trans_code        NUMBER,
                                              v_user, --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                                              pl.pol_code, --v_pol_code           NUMBER,
                                              pl.pol_prod_code,
                                              --v_prod_code          NUMBER,
                                              v_comm_voucher,
                                              --v_vchr_no           VARCHAR2,
                                              v_count, --v_count              NUMBER,
                                          pl.opr_amt, --v_amount             NUMBER,
                                              v_narrative,
                                              --v_narrative          VARCHAR2,
                                              v_trnt_gl_code,
                                              --v_acc_number         VARCHAR2,
                                              v_org_code, --v_acc_org_code         NUMBER,
                                              v_rct_branch,
                                              --v_branch_code        NUMBER,
                                              'C', --v_drcr               VARCHAR2,
                                              v_chq_dtls_rec,
                                              -- IN OUT   fms_cheques_pkg.type_rqn_dtls_table
                                              NULL, --v_fpmt_code  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                              NULL, --v_ocl_code  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                              v_agn_code,
                                              --v_agn_code NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                          v_trans_no --v_trans_no NUMBER DEFAULT NULL
                                                        );
                    ELSE
                    interface_append_gl (
                        v_trans_code,            --v_trans_code        NUMBER,
                        v_user,                --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                        pl.pol_code,            --v_pol_code           NUMBER,
                                         pl.pol_prod_code, --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                                         v_comm_voucher,
                                         --v_vchr_no          VARCHAR2,
                                         NULL,   --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                                         NULL,   --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                                         NULL, --v_rcpt_no           VARCHAR2,
                                         v_count, --v_count             NUMBER,
                        'PROPOSAL PREMIUM' || ' - ' || pl.pol_proposal_no,
                                         --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                        pl.opr_amt,
                                         --v_amount            NUMBER,
                                         'C',  --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                                         v_trnt_gl_code, --v_acc_number1        VARCHAR2,
                                         --v_acc_number2            VARCHAR2
                                         v_rct_branch,
                                         --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                                         v_trn_rec,
                                         --IN OUT   tq_fms.fms_vouchers_pkg.tgl_rec_type,
                                         NULL, --v_cad_code  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                         NULL, --v_otop_code  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                         NULL, --v_fpmt_code  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                         NULL, --v_ort_code  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                         NULL, --v_btr_no  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                         NULL, --v_ppr_code  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                         NULL, --v_ocl_code  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                         v_agn_code,
                                         --v_agn_code  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                        v_trans_no           --v_trans_no  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL
                                                   );
                END IF;
            END IF;
        END LOOP;
    EXCEPTION
        WHEN OTHERS
        THEN
            raise_error ('Error posting agent premiums => post_agn_premiums');
    END post_agn_premiums;

    PROCEDURE process_fac_ref_posting (v_lpfr_code NUMBER)
    IS
        CURSOR cur_refunds IS
            SELECT r.*,
                   pol_code,
                   pol_prod_code,
                   pol_bra_code,
                   pol_cur_code,
                   pol_policy_no,
                   agn_act_code
              FROM lms_pol_facultative_refunds  r,
                   lms_policies,
                   lms_master_transactions,
                   lms_agencies
             WHERE     lpfr_code = v_lpfr_code
                   AND lpfr_pol_code = pol_code
                   AND lpfr_cr_mtran_code = mtran_code
                   AND mtran_agen_code = agn_code;

        v_trans_code             NUMBER;
        v_trnt_code              VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_trnt_gl_code           VARCHAR2 (50);
        v_trnt_contra_gl_code    VARCHAR2 (50);
        v_trnt_gl_code2          VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_trnt_contra_gl_code2   VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_org_code               NUMBER;
        v_count                  NUMBER := 0;
        v_chq_cnt                NUMBER := 0;
        v_grct_code              NUMBER;
        v_gl_trans               fms_vouchers_pkg.tgl_rec_type;
        v_chq_dtls_rec           fms_cheques_pkg.type_rqn_dtls_table;
        -- v_user                  VARCHAR2 (30);
        --v_payee                 VARCHAR2 (200);
        v_payee                  VARCHAR2 (200);
        v_user                   VARCHAR2 (30)
            := pkg_global_vars.get_pvarchar2 ('PKG_GLOBAL_VARS.PVG_USERNAME');
        v_gl_count               NUMBER := -1;
        v_sbu_code               NUMBER := NULL;
        v_spoke_code             NUMBER := NULL;
        v_cvrg_area              NUMBER := NULL;
        v_location_code          NUMBER := NULL;
    BEGIN
        SELECT    TO_NUMBER (TO_CHAR (SYSDATE, 'RRRR'))
               || lms_transaction_seq.NEXTVAL
          INTO v_trans_code
          FROM DUAL;

        FOR cur_refund_rec IN cur_refunds
        LOOP
            v_chq_cnt := 0;

            IF cur_refund_rec.lpfr_paid = 'Y'
            THEN
                raise_error ('The Transaction has already been authorised.');
            END IF;

            v_org_code :=
                fms_interfaces_pkg.get_org (cur_refund_rec.pol_bra_code);

            --If they are any clawbacks to be made, Post them to the relevant GL Accounts.
            IF NVL (cur_refund_rec.lpfr_comm_to_pay, 0) <> 0
            THEN
                get_gl_code ('FAC_PR_EX',
                             cur_refund_rec.pol_prod_code,
                             v_trnt_code,
                             v_trnt_gl_code,
                             v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                             NULL,
                             NULL,
                             cur_refund_rec.agn_act_code,
                             cur_refund_rec.pol_bra_code);
                valid_acc (v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                           v_org_code,
                           cur_refund_rec.pol_bra_code,
                           'FAC_PR_EX');
                get_gl_code ('FAC_COM',
                             cur_refund_rec.pol_prod_code,
                             v_trnt_code,
                             v_trnt_gl_code2,
                             v_trnt_contra_gl_code2,
                             NULL,
                             NULL,
                             cur_refund_rec.agn_act_code,
                             cur_refund_rec.pol_bra_code);
                valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code2,
                           v_org_code,
                           cur_refund_rec.pol_bra_code,
                           'FAC_COM');
                -- RAISE_ERROR('v_trnt_gl_code='||v_trnt_gl_code||'v_trnt_contra_gl_code='||v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
                v_gl_count := v_gl_count + 2;
                interface_append_gl (
                    v_trans_code,
                    --v_trans_code           NUMBER,
                    v_user,                    --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                    cur_refund_rec.pol_code,
                    --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                    cur_refund_rec.pol_prod_code,

    PROCEDURE update_coin_refunds (
        v_voucher_no   VARCHAR2,
        v_chq_no       VARCHAR2,
        v_chq_date     DATE,
        v_chq_amt      NUMBER,
        v_user         VARCHAR2
    )
    IS
        v_vchr_amt        NUMBER;
        v_pol_code        VARCHAR2 (30);
        v_pol_prod_type   lms_policies.pol_prod_type%TYPE;
    BEGIN
        BEGIN
            UPDATE lms_policy_coinsurers_refunds
               SET lpr_chq_no = v_chq_no,
                   lpr_chq_date = v_chq_date,
                   lpr_chq_updated_by = v_user,
                   lpr_chq_update_dt = SYSDATE,
                   lpr_chq_amt = v_chq_amt
             WHERE lpr_voucher_no = v_voucher_no;
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                raise_error ('Unable to update claims voucher details....');
        END;
    END update_coin_refunds;
