    PROCEDURE update_gl_da_interest (
        v_pol_code    IN NUMBER,
        v_year        IN NUMBER,
        v_period      IN VARCHAR2 DEFAULT 'JAN - DEC',
        v_umbrella       VARCHAR2 DEFAULT 'N',
        v_ipol_code      NUMBER DEFAULT NULL
    )
    IS
        v_count                 NUMBER;
        v_policy_no             VARCHAR2 (100);
        v_gl_trans              fms_vouchers_pkg.tgl_rec_type;
        v_vgl_no                NUMBER;
        v_trnt_code             VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_trnt_gl_code          VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_trnt_contra_gl_code   VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_org_code              NUMBER;
        v_contra_acc            VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_acc_type              VARCHAR2 (5) := 'D';
        v_user_code             NUMBER;
        exc_user_error          EXCEPTION;
        v_user_name             VARCHAR2 (30)
            := pkg_global_vars.get_pvarchar2 ('PKG_GLOBAL_VARS.PVG_USERNAME');
        --v_done_by;--used during cleanup in datacleaning
        --:= Pkg_Global_Vars.get_pvarchar2 ('PKG_GLOBAL_VARS.PVG_USERNAME');
        v_trans_code            NUMBER;
        v_admin_fee_rate        NUMBER;
        v_vat_rate              NUMBER;
        v_int_amt               NUMBER;
        v_pol_bra_code          NUMBER;
        v_pol_prod_code         NUMBER;
        v_pol_policy_no         VARCHAR2 (200);

        CURSOR policy_bal IS
            SELECT *
              FROM lms_pension_balances
             WHERE     pnbal_year = v_year
                   AND pnbal_pol_code = v_pol_code
                   AND NVL (pnbal_ipol_code, 0) =
                       NVL (v_ipol_code, NVL (pnbal_ipol_code, 0))
                   AND pnbal_period = v_period;
    BEGIN
        v_user_code := fms_interfaces_pkg.get_usercode (UPPER (v_user_name));

        IF v_user_code IS NULL
        THEN
            raise_error (
                'USER LOGGED IN NOT KNOWN. PLEASE LOGOUT AND LOGIN AGAIN..');
        END IF;

        FOR pol_bal IN policy_bal
        LOOP
            --raise_error('User'||v_user_name);
            SELECT    TO_NUMBER (TO_CHAR (SYSDATE, 'RRRR'))
                   || lms_transaction_seq.NEXTVAL
              INTO v_trans_code
              FROM DUAL;

            BEGIN
                SELECT pol_bra_code, pol_prod_code, pol_policy_no
                  --NVL (ipol_policy_no, pol_policy_no)
                  INTO v_pol_bra_code, v_pol_prod_code, v_pol_policy_no
                  FROM lms_policies                --, lms_individual_policies
                 WHERE pol_code = v_pol_code; --AND ipol_pol_code = pol_code(+);
            EXCEPTION
                WHEN OTHERS
                THEN
                    raise_error ('Error Accessing Policy Details');
            END;

            v_int_amt :=
                  NVL (pol_bal.pnbal_empyr_bal_income, 0)
                + NVL (pol_bal.pnbal_empye_bal_income, 0)
                + NVL (pol_bal.pnbal_empyr_cntri_income, 0)
                + NVL (pol_bal.pnbal_empye_cntri_income, 0);
            v_count := -1;
            v_org_code := fms_interfaces_pkg.get_org (v_pol_bra_code);

            IF NVL (v_int_amt, 0) != 0
            THEN
                get_gl_code ('VAL_INTR',
                             v_pol_prod_code,
                             v_trnt_code,
                             v_trnt_gl_code,
                             v_contra_acc);
                valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                           v_org_code,
                           v_pol_bra_code,
                           'VAL_INTR');
                valid_acc (v_contra_acc,
                           v_org_code,
                           v_pol_bra_code,
                           'VAL_INTR CONTRA');
                v_count := v_count + 2;
                interface_append_gl (
                    v_trans_code,                --v_trans_code        NUMBER,
                    v_user_name,
                    --v_user_name,                 --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                    v_pol_code,                  --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                    v_pol_prod_code,
                    --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                    NULL,                     --v_vchr_no            VARCHAR2,
                    NULL,                        --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                    NULL,                        --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                    NULL,                     --v_rcpt_no            VARCHAR2,
                    v_count,                     --v_count             NUMBER,
                    'DA DECLARED INTEREST - ' || v_policy_no,
                    --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                    NVL (v_int_amt, 0),
                    --v_amount            NUMBER,
                    'D',                       --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                    v_trnt_gl_code,
                    --v_acc_number1        VARCHAR2,
                    v_contra_acc,
                    --v_acc_number2        VARCHAR2,
                    v_pol_bra_code,              --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                    v_gl_trans);
            END IF;

            IF v_count > 0
            THEN
                interface_update_vgl (v_trans_code, --  v_trans_code     NUMBER,
                                      v_user_name,
                                      --v_user_name,              --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                                      v_pol_code, --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                                      TRUNC (SYSDATE), --v_date          DATE,
                                      NULL,      --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                                      NULL,      --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                                      'LMS DA DECLARED INTEREST BATCH',
                                      --v_btc_description   VARCHAR2,
                                      'JV',     --v_btc_type         VARCHAR2,
                                      v_pol_bra_code, --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                                      'DA DECLARED INTEREST', --v_description       VARCHAR2,
                                      NULL,        --v_ref           VARCHAR2,
                                      v_gl_trans);
            --v_gl_trans  IN OUT  Fms_Vouchers_Pkg.Tgl_rec_type,
            END IF;
        END LOOP;
    END update_gl_da_interest;

    PROCEDURE post_grp_policy_taxes (
        v_brn_code     NUMBER,
        v_user         VARCHAR2,
        v_payee        VARCHAR2,
        v_type         VARCHAR2,
        v_tt_code      NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
        v_voucher_no   VARCHAR2 DEFAULT NULL,
        v_gtxp_code    NUMBER DEFAULT NULL
    )
    IS
        v_acc_type              VARCHAR2 (10) := 'D';
        v_gl_trans              tq_fms.fms_vouchers_pkg.tgl_rec_type;
        v_chq_dtls_rec          fms_cheques_pkg.type_rqn_dtls_table;
        v_vgl_no                NUMBER;
        v_trnt_code             VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_crt_acc_no            VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_trnt_gl_code          VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_trnt_contra_gl_code   VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_contra_acc            VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_count                 NUMBER := 0;
        v_gl_count              NUMBER := 0;
        v_org_code              NUMBER;
        v_prod_code             NUMBER;
        v_branch_code           NUMBER;
        v_vchr_no               VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_drcr                  VARCHAR2 (1);
        v_ptp_code              NUMBER;
        v_trans_code            NUMBER;
        v_done_by               VARCHAR2 (30);
        v_admin_fee             NUMBER;
        v_vat_amt               NUMBER;
        v_tax_amount            NUMBER;
        v_ap_chq_narrative      VARCHAR2 (100);
        v_req_narrative         VARCHAR2 (100);
        v_tt_sht_desc           VARCHAR2 (100);
        v_pmt_type              VARCHAR2 (20);

        CURSOR taxpaycur IS
              SELECT gtxp_voucher_no,
                     pol_prod_code,
                     SUM (gtxp_adm_fee_amt)     adm_fee,
                     SUM (gtxp_vat_amt)         vat_amt,
                     'PENS'                     tt_type,
                     NULL                       tt_sht_desc,
                     NULL                       tt_code
                FROM lms_grp_tax_pymt, lms_grp_prem_receipts, lms_policies
               WHERE     gtxp_ref_no = grct_code
                     AND grct_pol_code = pol_code
                     AND gtxp_paid = 'N'
                     AND gxtp_tax_type = v_type
                     AND gtxp_payee = v_payee
                     AND gtxp_voucher_no = v_voucher_no
                     AND gtxp_code = v_gtxp_code
            GROUP BY gtxp_voucher_no, pol_prod_code
            UNION
              SELECT gtxp_voucher_no,
                     pol_prod_code,
                     SUM (gtxp_adm_fee_amt)     adm_fee,
                     0                          vat_amt,
                     tt_type                    tax_type,
                     tt_sht_desc,
                     tt_code
                FROM lms_grp_tax_pymt,
                     lms_policy_taxes,
                     lms_tax_types,
                     lms_policies
               WHERE     gtxp_tt_code = tt_code
                     AND gtxp_ref_no = ptx_code
                     AND ptx_pol_code = pol_code
                     AND gtxp_paid = 'N'
                     AND gtxp_voucher_no = v_voucher_no
                     AND gtxp_code = v_gtxp_code
                     AND gtxp_payee = v_payee
                     AND tt_code = v_tt_code
            GROUP BY gtxp_voucher_no,
                     pol_prod_code,
                     tt_type,
                     tt_sht_desc,
                     tt_code
            UNION
              SELECT gtxp_voucher_no,
                     pol_prod_code,
                     SUM (gtxp_adm_fee_amt)     adm_fee,
                     0                          vat_amt,
                     tt_type                    tax_type,
                     tt_sht_desc,
                     tt_code
                FROM lms_grp_tax_pymt,
                     lms_pol_pension_taxes,
                     lms_tax_types,
                     lms_policies
               WHERE     gtxp_tt_code = tt_code
                     AND gtxp_ref_no = pptx_code
                     AND pptx_pol_code = pol_code
                     AND gtxp_paid = 'N'
                     AND gtxp_voucher_no = v_voucher_no
                     AND gtxp_code = v_gtxp_code
                     AND gtxp_payee = v_payee
                     AND tt_code = v_tt_code
            GROUP BY gtxp_voucher_no,
                     pol_prod_code,
                     tt_type,
                     tt_sht_desc,
                     tt_code;
    BEGIN
        --RAISE_ERROR('v_type='||v_type||'v_voucher_no=='||v_voucher_no||'v_gtxp_code=='||v_gtxp_code||';v_tt_code=='||v_tt_code||';v_payee=='||v_payee);
        v_org_code := tq_fms.fms_interfaces_pkg.get_org (v_brn_code);

        FOR taxpayrec IN taxpaycur
        LOOP
            v_count := 0;
            v_prod_code := taxpayrec.pol_prod_code;

            SELECT    TO_NUMBER (TO_CHAR (SYSDATE, 'RRRR'))
                   || lms_transaction_seq.NEXTVAL
              INTO v_trans_code
              FROM DUAL;

            IF taxpayrec.tt_type = 'PENS'
            THEN
                IF v_type = 'ADM'
                THEN
                    v_tt_sht_desc := 'ADMFEE_GB';
                    v_tax_amount := NVL (taxpayrec.adm_fee, 0);
                    v_pmt_type := 'PTX';
                ELSIF v_type = 'VAT'
                THEN
                    v_tt_sht_desc := 'VAT_GB';
                    v_tax_amount := NVL (taxpayrec.vat_amt, 0);
                    v_pmt_type := 'PTX';
                END IF;

                v_ap_chq_narrative := 'GRP TAX PAYMENTS';
                v_req_narrative := 'GRP TAX POSTING ( CHQ )';
            ELSIF taxpayrec.tt_type = 'SD'
            THEN
                IF taxpayrec.tt_sht_desc = 'GLEVY'
                THEN
                    v_tt_sht_desc := 'GLEVY_GB';
                ELSE
                    v_tt_sht_desc := 'UPTAX';
                END IF;

                v_tax_amount := NVL (taxpayrec.adm_fee, 0);
                v_ap_chq_narrative := 'GRP TAX PAYMENTS';
                v_req_narrative := 'PREMIUM TAX POSTING ( CHQ )';
                v_pmt_type := 'PTX';
            ELSIF taxpayrec.tt_type = 'WHTX'
            THEN
                v_tt_sht_desc := 'CLMTX';
                v_tax_amount := NVL (taxpayrec.adm_fee, 0);
                v_ap_chq_narrative := 'GRP TAX PAYMENTS';
                v_req_narrative := 'CLAIM TAX POSTING ( CHQ )';
                v_pmt_type := 'PTX';
            END IF;

            get_gl_code (v_tt_sht_desc,
                         v_prod_code,
                         v_trnt_code,
                         v_trnt_gl_code,
                         v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
            valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                       v_org_code,
                       v_brn_code,
                       v_tt_sht_desc);
            valid_acc (v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                       v_org_code,
                       v_brn_code,
                       v_tt_sht_desc || ' contra');
            v_count := v_count + 1;
            interface_append_chq (v_trans_code,
                                  --v_trans_code       NUMBER,
                                  v_user,
                                  --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                                  NULL,         --v_pol_code           NUMBER,
                                  v_prod_code,
                                  --v_prod_code          NUMBER,
                                  taxpayrec.gtxp_voucher_no,
                                  --v_vchr_no             VARCHAR2,
                                  v_count,
                                  --v_count              NUMBER,
                                  v_tax_amount,
                                  --v_amount             NUMBER,
                                  v_ap_chq_narrative,    --'GRP TAX PAYMENTS',
                                  --v_narrative          VARCHAR2,
                                  v_trnt_contra_gl_code,    -- v_trnt_gl_code,
                                  --v_acc_number          VARCHAR2,
                                  v_org_code,
                                  --v_acc_org_code        NUMBER,
                                  v_brn_code,
                                  --v_branch_code        NUMBER,
                                  'D',        --v_drcr               VARCHAR2,
                                  v_chq_dtls_rec);
            -- RAISE_ERROR('HERE...'||v_chq_dtls_rec.COUNT);
            interface_create_reqn (v_trans_code,
                                   --v_trans_code         NUMBER,
                                   taxpayrec.gtxp_voucher_no,
                                   --v_ref                   VARCHAR2,
                                   NULL,
                                   --v_ref2                  VARCHAR2,
                                   TRUNC (SYSDATE),
                                   --v_ref_date              DATE,
                                   v_req_narrative,
                                   --'PREMIUM TAX POSTING ( CHQ )',
                                   --v_narrative             VARCHAR2,
                                   v_tax_amount,
                                   --v_amount                NUMBER,
                                   v_payee,
                                   --v_payee                 VARCHAR2,
                                   'CHQ',
                                   --v_pay_method            VARCHAR2, --CHQ, EFT
                                   NULL,
                                   --v_payee_bank_acc_no        VARCHAR2,
                                   NULL,  --v_payee_bank_branch_code   NUMBER,
                                   v_user, --v_source_auth_by        VARCHAR2,
                                   TRUNC (SYSDATE),
                                   --v_source_auth_dt        DATE,
                                   v_user,
                                   --v_raise_by                VARCHAR2,
                                   v_pmt_type,
                                   --'UTX',  --v_pmt_type              VARCHAR2,
                                   v_brn_code,
                                   --v_branch_code         NUMBER,
                                   NULL,                         --v_pol_code,
                                   v_chq_dtls_rec);

            -- raise_error ('v_type=' || v_type || 'tt_type==' || taxpayrec.tt_type);
            BEGIN
                UPDATE lms_grp_tax_pymt
                   SET gtxp_paid = 'Y'
                 WHERE     gtxp_voucher_no = taxpayrec.gtxp_voucher_no
                       AND gtxp_code = v_gtxp_code;
            EXCEPTION
                WHEN OTHERS
                THEN
                    raise_error ('Error updating tax payment');
            END;
        END LOOP;
    END post_grp_policy_taxes;

    PROCEDURE process_grp_bonus_pymt (
        v_bop_paid_vchr_tab   type_comm_vchr_table,
        v_vchr_brn_code       NUMBER,
        v_username            VARCHAR2,
        v_date_to             DATE DEFAULT NULL,
        v_curr_code           NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
        v_curr_xcng_rate      NUMBER DEFAULT NULL
    )
    IS
        v_user                   VARCHAR2 (30)
            := pkg_global_vars.get_pvarchar2 ('pkg_global_vars.pvg_username');

        CURSOR c_bonus (v_bop_paid_vchr_no VARCHAR2)
        IS
              SELECT bop_paid_vchr_no,
                     bop_agn_code,
                     MIN (bop_prod_code)
                         bop_prod_code,
                     agn_act_code,
                     TRUNC (bop_date)
                         bop_date,
                     bop_trans_no,
                     bop_payment_mode,
                     agn_bank_acc_no,
                     agn_bbr_code,
                     NVL (
                         agn_bank_acc_name,
                         TRIM (
                                agn_other_names
                             || ' '
                             || TRIM (agn_md_name || ' ' || agn_name)))
                         agn_name,
                     SUM (
                           DECODE (bop_drcr, 'D', -1, 1)
                         * (  NVL (bop_bonus_amt, 0)
                            + NVL (bop_ovride_bonus_amt, 0)
                            + NVL (bop_vat_amt, 0)
                            + NVL (bop_ov_bonus_amt, 0)))
                         bop_bonus_amt,
                     SUM (
                           DECODE (bop_drcr, 'D', -1, 1)
                         * (  NVL (bop_whdtax_amt, 0)
                            + NVL (bop_ovride_whdtax_amt, 0)))
                         whdtx,
                     SUM (
                         DECODE (bop_drcr, 'D', -1, 1) * (NVL (bop_vat_amt, 0)))
                         vat_amt,
                     SUM (DECODE (bop_drcr, 'D', -1, 1) * bop_advance_pymt)
                         advance,
                     SUM (
                             DECODE (bop_drcr, 'D', -1, 1)
                           * (  NVL (bop_bonus_amt, 0)
                              + NVL (bop_ovride_bonus_amt, 0)
                              + NVL (bop_vat_amt, 0)
                              + NVL (bop_ov_bonus_amt, 0)
                              - NVL (bop_whdtax_amt, 0)
                              - NVL (bop_ovride_whdtax_amt, 0)
                              - NVL (bop_capin_amt, 0)
                              - NVL (bop_ovride_capin_amt, 0))
                         - NVL (bop_advance_pymt, 0)
                         - NVL (bop_deductions, 0)
                         - NVL (bop_prem_ded, 0))
                         amount,
                     SUM (DECODE (bop_drcr, 'D', -1, 1) * bop_prem_ded)
                         agn_prem,
                     SUM (
                           DECODE (bop_drcr, 'D', -1, 1)
                         * (  NVL (bop_capin_amt, 0)
                            + NVL (bop_ovride_capin_amt, 0)))
                         capin_amt,
                     MAX (bop_code)
                         bop_code,
                     bop_prepared_by,
                     agn_sht_desc,
                     DECODE (agn_status, 'ACTIVE', 'Y', 'N')
                         pay_bonus_to_agent,
                     SUM (
                           DECODE (bop_drcr, 'D', -1, 1)
                         * NVL (bop_deductions, 0))
                         bop_deductions,
                     SUM (
                           DECODE (bop_drcr, 'D', -1, 1)
                         * (  NVL (bop_company_capin_amt, 0)
                            + NVL (bop_company_ovride_capin_amt, 0)))
                         company_capin_amt
                FROM lms_bonus_pymts, lms_agencies
               WHERE     bop_paid_vchr_no = v_bop_paid_vchr_no
                     AND bop_agn_code = agn_code
            GROUP BY bop_paid_vchr_no,
                     bop_agn_code,
                     TRUNC (bop_date),
                     bop_trans_no,
                     agn_name,
                     agn_bank_acc_name,
                     agn_other_names,
                     agn_md_name,
                     bop_prepared_by,
                     agn_sht_desc,
                     agn_status,
                     agn_bank_acc_no,
                     agn_bbr_code,
                     agn_act_code,
                     bop_payment_mode;

        v_org_code               NUMBER;
        v_crt_acc_no             VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_chq_dtls_rec           fms_cheques_pkg.type_rqn_dtls_table;
        v_prod_code              NUMBER;
        v_trnt_prod_applicable   VARCHAR2 (3);
        v_trnt_contra_gl_code    VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_count                  NUMBER := 0;
        v_gl_count               NUMBER := 0;
        v_cur_code               NUMBER;
        v_brh_code               NUMBER := v_vchr_brn_code;
        v_trnt_code              VARCHAR2 (10);
        v_gl_trans               tq_fms.fms_vouchers_pkg.tgl_rec_type;
        v_gl_acc                 VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_gl_acc2                VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_vgl_no                 NUMBER;
        v_contra_gl_code         VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_cnt                    NUMBER := 0;
        v_trans_code             NUMBER;
        v_eft_enabled            VARCHAR2 (5);
        v_pay_method             VARCHAR2 (5);
        v_trans_no               NUMBER;
        v_adv_cnt                NUMBER := 0;
        v_drcr                   VARCHAR2 (1);
        v_agn_code               NUMBER;
        v_trans_desc             VARCHAR2 (30);
    BEGIN
        v_gl_trans.delete;
        v_gl_count := -1;

        -- RAISE_ERROR('v_prod_code:'||v_prod_code);
        SELECT    TO_NUMBER (TO_CHAR (SYSDATE, 'RRRR'))
               || lms_transaction_seq.NEXTVAL
          INTO v_trans_code
          FROM DUAL;



        BEGIN
            v_org_code := fms_interfaces_pkg.get_org (v_vchr_brn_code);
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                raise_error ('Org details error...' || v_vchr_brn_code);
        END;

        FOR v_com_rec IN 1 .. v_bop_paid_vchr_tab.COUNT
        LOOP
            v_cnt := NVL (v_cnt, 0) + 1;

            IF v_bop_paid_vchr_tab (v_com_rec).comm_option = 'CHQ'
            THEN
                v_chq_dtls_rec.delete;
                v_count := 0;

                --raise_error('v_bop_paid_vchr_no=='||v_bop_paid_vchr_tab (v_com_rec).comm_voucher||';;v_date_to=='||v_date_to||';;v_vchr_brn_code=='||v_vchr_brn_code);
                FOR i
                    IN c_bonus (v_bop_paid_vchr_tab (v_com_rec).comm_voucher)
                LOOP
                    v_trans_no := i.bop_trans_no;
                    v_agn_code := i.bop_agn_code;
                    v_pay_method := i.bop_payment_mode;

                    SELECT    ' -'
                           || ltr_cla_sht_desc
                           || ' ['
                           || TRUNC (SYSDATE)
                           || '] '
                           || ltr_trans_no
                      INTO v_trans_desc
                      FROM lms_transactions
                     WHERE ltr_trans_no = v_trans_no;

                    -- RAISE_ERROR('comm option=='||v_bop_paid_vchr_tab (v_com_rec).comm_option||';;v_cnt=='||v_cnt||';;'||i.amount);
                    -- ADDED BY WAIYAKI ON DEC 15TH TO PREVENT -VE AMOUNTS FROM BEING POSTED TO FMS
                    ---VE AMOUNTS ARE INSERTED INTO TABLE BELOW
                    -- RAISE_ERROR('i.amount=='||i.bop_bonus_amt);
                    IF i.amount < 0
                    THEN
                        INSERT INTO lms_negative_bonus (nb_code,
                                                        nb_bop_paid_vchr_no,
                                                        nb_bop_code,
                                                        nb_brn_code,
                                                        nb_amount,
                                                        nb_agn_code,
                                                        nb_raised_by)
                                 VALUES (
                                        TO_NUMBER (TO_CHAR (SYSDATE, 'RRRR'))
                                     || lms_nb_code_seq.NEXTVAL,
                                     i.bop_paid_vchr_no,
                                     i.bop_code,
                                     v_vchr_brn_code,
                                     ABS (i.amount),
                                     i.bop_agn_code,
                                     v_user);

                        IF NVL (i.bop_bonus_amt, 0) <> 0
                        THEN
                            SELECT DECODE (SIGN (NVL (i.bop_bonus_amt, 0)),
                                           -1, 'C',
                                           'D')
                              INTO v_drcr
                              FROM DUAL;

                            get_gl_code ('UB_GB',
                                         i.bop_prod_code,
                                         v_trnt_code,
                                         v_crt_acc_no,
                                         v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                         NULL,
                                         NULL,
                                         i.agn_act_code,
                                         v_vchr_brn_code);
                            valid_acc (v_crt_acc_no,
                                       v_org_code,
                                       v_vchr_brn_code,
                                       'UB_GB');
                            v_gl_count := v_gl_count + 1;
                            interface_append_gl (
                                v_trans_code,
                                --v_trans_code          NUMBER,
                                v_username,    --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                                NULL,            --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                                i.bop_prod_code, --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                                v_bop_paid_vchr_tab (v_com_rec).comm_voucher,
                                --v_vchr_no          VARCHAR2,
                                NULL,            --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                                NULL,            --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                                NULL,          --v_rcpt_no           VARCHAR2,
                                v_gl_count,      --v_count             NUMBER,
                                'BONUS PAYMENT' || v_trans_desc,
                                --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                                ABS (NVL (i.bop_bonus_amt, 0)),
                                --v_amount            NUMBER,
                                v_drcr,
                                --'D', --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                                v_crt_acc_no,
                                --v_acc_number1          VARCHAR2,
                                v_vchr_brn_code,
                                --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                                v_gl_trans,
                                --IN OUT   tq_fms.fms_vouchers_pkg.tgl_rec_type,
                                NULL,       --v_cad_code  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                NULL,      --v_otop_code  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                NULL,      --v_fpmt_code  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                NULL,       --v_ort_code  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                NULL,         --v_btr_no  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                NULL,       --v_ppr_code  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                NULL,       --v_ocl_code  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                i.bop_agn_code,
                                --v_agn_code  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                i.bop_trans_no--v_trans_no  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL
                                              );
                        END IF;

                        IF NVL (i.whdtx, 0) <> 0
                        THEN
                            SELECT DECODE (SIGN (NVL (i.whdtx, 0)),
                                           -1, 'D',
                                           'C')
                              INTO v_drcr
                              FROM DUAL;

                            get_gl_code ('WTHTX1_GB',
                                         i.bop_prod_code,
                                         v_trnt_code,
                                         v_crt_acc_no,
                                         v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                         NULL,
                                         NULL,
                                         i.agn_act_code,
                                         v_vchr_brn_code);
                            valid_acc (v_crt_acc_no,
                                       v_org_code,
                                       v_vchr_brn_code,
                                       'WTHTX1_GB');
                            v_gl_count := v_gl_count + 1;
                            interface_append_gl (
                                v_trans_code,
                                --v_trans_code          NUMBER,
                                v_username,    --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                                NULL,            --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                                i.bop_prod_code, --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                                v_bop_paid_vchr_tab (v_com_rec).comm_voucher,
                                --v_vchr_no          VARCHAR2,
                                NULL,            --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                                NULL,            --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                                NULL,          --v_rcpt_no           VARCHAR2,
                                v_gl_count,      --v_count             NUMBER,
                                'WITHOLDING TAX RECOVERY' || v_trans_desc,
                                --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                                ABS (NVL (i.whdtx, 0)),
                                --v_amount            NUMBER,
                                v_drcr,

    PROCEDURE update_dd_err_log (
        v_status           VARCHAR2,
        v_err              VARCHAR2,
        v_code             NUMBER,
        v_dd_code          NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
        v_dd_batch         NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
        v_type             VARCHAR2 DEFAULT 'DD',
        v_rad_code         NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
        v_fms_receipt_pk   NUMBER DEFAULT NULL
    )
    IS
        PRAGMA AUTONOMOUS_TRANSACTION;
    BEGIN
         IF v_rad_code IS NOT NULL
        THEN
            UPDATE lms_dd_receipt_batch
               SET lrct_success = v_status,
                   lrct_err_msg = SUBSTR (v_err, 0, 4000)
             WHERE lrct_rad_code = v_rad_code;
        ELSIF v_code IS NOT NULL
        THEN
            UPDATE lms_dd_receipt_batch
               SET lrct_success = v_status,
                   lrct_err_msg = SUBSTR (v_err, 0, 4000)
             WHERE lrct_ddd_code = v_code;
        ELSE
            UPDATE lms_dd_receipt_batch
               SET lrct_success = v_status,
                   lrct_err_msg = SUBSTR (v_err, 0, 4000)
             WHERE     lrct_fms_receipt_pk = v_fms_receipt_pk
                   AND lrct_batch_no = v_dd_batch;
        END IF;

        COMMIT;
    END update_dd_err_log;

    PROCEDURE update_dd_batch_success (
        v_dd_code              NUMBER,
        v_dd_batch             NUMBER,
        v_type                 VARCHAR2 DEFAULT 'DD',
        v_fms_receipt_pk       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
        v_success          OUT VARCHAR2
    )
    IS
        --   PRAGMA AUTONOMOUS_TRANSACTION;
        v_cnt   NUMBER := 0;
    BEGIN
        BEGIN
            SELECT COUNT (*)
              INTO v_cnt
              FROM lms_dd_receipt_batch
             WHERE     lrct_fms_receipt_pk = v_fms_receipt_pk
                   AND lrct_batch_no = v_dd_batch
                   AND lrct_success IN ('F', 'N');
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                v_cnt := 0;
        END;

        v_success := 'N';

        IF v_cnt = 0
        THEN
            UPDATE lms_dd_receipt_batch
               SET lrct_success = 'Y'
             WHERE     lrct_fms_receipt_pk = v_fms_receipt_pk
                   AND lrct_batch_no = v_dd_batch;

            v_success := 'Y';
        END IF;
    END update_dd_batch_success;

    PROCEDURE post_claim_reserve (
        v_trans_no       NUMBER,
        v_claim_no       VARCHAR2,
        v_pol_code       NUMBER,
        v_user           VARCHAR2,
        v_brn_code       NUMBER,
        v_rev_prev_amt   VARCHAR2 DEFAULT 'N'
    )
    IS
        CURSOR cur_prof_pymt IS
            SELECT clm_caus_type, cnot_reserve_amt, cnot_prev_reserve_amt
              FROM lms_claim_notifications, lms_claims
             WHERE     cnot_clm_no = v_claim_no
                   AND NVL (cnot_reserved, 'N') = 'N'
                   AND cnot_clm_no = clm_no;

        v_payee_eft_rec         fms_cheques_pkg.type_payee_eft_table;
        v_trns_rec              fms_cheques_pkg.type_rqn_dtls_table;
        v_eft_enabled           VARCHAR2 (1) := 'N';
        v_crt_acc_no            VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_org_code              NUMBER;
        v_cur_code              NUMBER;
        v_bct_code              NUMBER;
        v_bct_brh_code          NUMBER;
        v_authorized_by         NUMBER;
        v_no                    NUMBER := 0;
        v_prod_code             NUMBER;
        v_trnt_code             VARCHAR2 (10);
        v_trnt_gl_code          VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_trnt_contra_gl_code   VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_gl_trans              fms_vouchers_pkg.tgl_rec_type;
        v_gl_count              NUMBER := 0;
        vgl_code                NUMBER;
        v_trans_code            NUMBER;
        v_acnt_type             lms_claim_notifications.cnot_caus_type%TYPE;
    BEGIN
        v_trns_rec.delete;
        v_no := 0;

        FOR f IN cur_prof_pymt
        LOOP
            SELECT    TO_NUMBER (TO_CHAR (SYSDATE, 'RRRR'))
                   || lms_transaction_seq.NEXTVAL
              INTO v_trans_code
              FROM DUAL;

            v_gl_count := 0;

            SELECT pol_prod_code
              INTO v_prod_code
              FROM lms_policies
             WHERE pol_code = v_pol_code;

            v_org_code := fms_interfaces_pkg.get_org (v_brn_code);

            --OLIFFE
            IF f.clm_caus_type = 'DTH'
            THEN
                v_acnt_type := 'CP_DTH';
            ELSE
                v_acnt_type := 'CP_DIS';
            END IF;

            --If Y, reverse the previous reserved amount
            IF NVL (v_rev_prev_amt, 'N') = 'Y'
            THEN
                IF NVL (f.cnot_prev_reserve_amt, 0) > 0
                THEN
                    get_gl_code (v_acnt_type,          --claim account mapping
                                 v_prod_code,
                                 v_trnt_code,
                                 v_crt_acc_no,
                                 v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
                    valid_acc (v_crt_acc_no,
                               v_org_code,
                               v_brn_code,
                               v_acnt_type);
                    v_gl_count := v_gl_count + 1;
                    interface_append_gl (
                        v_trans_code,            --v_trans_code        NUMBER,
                        v_user,                --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                        v_pol_code,              --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                        v_prod_code,             --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                        v_claim_no,            --v_vchr_no           VARCHAR2,
                        NULL,                    --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                        NULL,                    --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                        NULL,                   --v_rcpt_no          VARCHAR2,
                        v_gl_count,              --v_count             NUMBER,
                        'CLAIM RESERVE ' || v_claim_no || ' -REVERSAL',
                        --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                        NVL (f.cnot_prev_reserve_amt, 0),
                        --v_amount            NUMBER,
                        'C',                   --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                        v_crt_acc_no,
                        --v_acc_number1         VARCHAR2,
                        v_brn_code,              --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                        v_gl_trans,
                        --v_trn_rec   IN OUT  fms_test.Fms_Vouchers_Pkg.Tgl_rec_type,
                        NULL,
                        --v_cad_code                   NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                        NULL,
                        --v_otop_code                  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                        NULL,
                        --v_fpmt_code                  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                        NULL,
                        --v_ort_code                   NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                        NULL,
                        --v_btr_no                     NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                        NULL,
                        --v_ppr_code                   NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                        NULL,
                        --v_ocl_code                   NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                        NULL,
                        --v_agn_code                   NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                        v_trans_no --v_trans_no                   NUMBER DEFAULT NULL
                                  );
                    get_gl_code ('CLMRSV_O',
                                 v_prod_code,
                                 v_trnt_code,
                                 v_crt_acc_no,
                                 v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
                    valid_acc (v_crt_acc_no,
                               v_org_code,
                               v_brn_code,
                               'CLMRSV_O');

                    v_gl_count := v_gl_count + 1;
                    interface_append_gl (
                        v_trans_code,            --v_trans_code        NUMBER,
                        v_user,                --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                        v_pol_code,              --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                        v_prod_code,             --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                        v_claim_no,            --v_vchr_no           VARCHAR2,
                        NULL,                    --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                        NULL,                    --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                        NULL,                   --v_rcpt_no          VARCHAR2,
                        v_gl_count,              --v_count             NUMBER,
                        'CLAIM RESERVE ' || v_claim_no || ' -REVERSAL',
                        --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                        NVL (f.cnot_prev_reserve_amt, 0),
                        --v_amount            NUMBER,
                        'D',                   --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                        v_crt_acc_no,
                        --v_acc_number1         VARCHAR2,
                        v_brn_code,              --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                        v_gl_trans,
                        --v_trn_rec   IN OUT  fms_test.Fms_Vouchers_Pkg.Tgl_rec_type,
                        NULL,
                        --v_cad_code                   NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                        NULL,
                        --v_otop_code                  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                        NULL,
                        --v_fpmt_code                  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                        NULL,
                        --v_ort_code                   NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                        NULL,
                        --v_btr_no                     NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                        NULL,
                        --v_ppr_code                   NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                        NULL,
                        --v_ocl_code                   NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                        NULL,
                        --v_agn_code                   NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                        v_trans_no --v_trans_no                   NUMBER DEFAULT NULL
                                  );
                END IF;
            END IF;

            IF NVL (f.cnot_reserve_amt, 0) > 0
            THEN
                get_gl_code (v_acnt_type,              --claim account mapping
                             v_prod_code,
                             v_trnt_code,
                             v_crt_acc_no,
                             v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
                valid_acc (v_crt_acc_no,
                           v_org_code,
                           v_brn_code,
                           v_acnt_type);
                v_gl_count := v_gl_count + 1;
                interface_append_gl (v_trans_code, --v_trans_code        NUMBER,
                                     v_user, --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                                     v_pol_code, --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                                     v_prod_code, --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                                     v_claim_no, --v_vchr_no           VARCHAR2,
                                     NULL,       --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                                     NULL,       --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                                     NULL,      --v_rcpt_no          VARCHAR2,
                                     v_gl_count, --v_count             NUMBER,
                                     'CLAIM RESERVE ' || v_claim_no,
                                     --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                                     NVL (f.cnot_reserve_amt, 0),
                                     --v_amount            NUMBER,
                                     'D',      --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                                     v_crt_acc_no,
                                     --v_acc_number1         VARCHAR2,
                                     v_brn_code, --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                                     v_gl_trans,
                                     --v_trn_rec   IN OUT  fms_test.Fms_Vouchers_Pkg.Tgl_rec_type,
                                     NULL,
                                     --v_cad_code                   NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                     NULL,
                                     --v_otop_code                  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                     NULL,
                                     --v_fpmt_code                  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                     NULL,
                                     --v_ort_code                   NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                     NULL,
                                     --v_btr_no                     NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                     NULL,
                                     --v_ppr_code                   NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                     NULL,
                                     --v_ocl_code                   NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                     NULL,
                                     --v_agn_code                   NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                     v_trans_no --v_trans_no                   NUMBER DEFAULT NULL
                                               );
                get_gl_code ('CLMRSV_O',
                             v_prod_code,
                             v_trnt_code,
                             v_crt_acc_no,
                             v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
                valid_acc (v_crt_acc_no,
                           v_org_code,
                           v_brn_code,
                           'CLMRSV_O');
                v_gl_count := v_gl_count + 1;
                interface_append_gl (v_trans_code, --v_trans_code        NUMBER,
                                     v_user,   --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                                     v_pol_code, --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                                     v_prod_code, --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                                     v_claim_no, --v_vchr_no           VARCHAR2,
                                     NULL,       --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                                     NULL,       --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                                     NULL,      --v_rcpt_no          VARCHAR2,
                                     v_gl_count, --v_count             NUMBER,
                                     'CLAIM RESERVE ' || v_claim_no,
                                     --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                                     NVL (f.cnot_reserve_amt, 0),
                                     --v_amount            NUMBER,
                                     'C',      --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                                     v_crt_acc_no,
                                     --v_acc_number1         VARCHAR2,
                                     v_brn_code, --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                                     v_gl_trans,
                                     --v_trn_rec   IN OUT  fms_test.Fms_Vouchers_Pkg.Tgl_rec_type,
                                     NULL,
                                     --v_cad_code                   NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                     NULL,
                                     --v_otop_code                  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                     NULL,
                                     --v_fpmt_code                  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                     NULL,
                                     --v_ort_code                   NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                     NULL,
                                     --v_btr_no                     NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                     NULL,
                                     --v_ppr_code                   NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                     NULL,
                                     --v_ocl_code                   NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                     NULL,
                                     --v_agn_code                   NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                     v_trans_no --v_trans_no                   NUMBER DEFAULT NULL
                                               );
            END IF;

            IF v_gl_count > 0
            THEN
                BEGIN                 --v_fpmt_code       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL)
                    interface_update_vgl (v_trans_code, --v_trans_code     NUMBER,
                                          v_user, --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                                          v_pol_code, --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                                          TRUNC (SYSDATE), --v_date         DATE,
                                          NULL,  --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                                          NULL,  --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                                          'LMS CLAIM RESERVE',
                                          --v_btc_description   VARCHAR2,
                                          'JV', --v_btc_type           VARCHAR2,
                                          v_brn_code,
                                          --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                                          'CLAIM RESERVE ' || v_claim_no,
                                          --v_description       VARCHAR2,
                                          v_claim_no,
                                          --v_ref_no            VARCHAR2,
                                          v_gl_trans,
                                          --v_gl_trans  IN OUT  fms_test.Fms_Vouchers_Pkg.Tgl_rec_type,
                                          NULL,
                                          --v_cad_code       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                          NULL,
                                          --v_otop_code       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                          NULL);
                --v_fpmt_code       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL)
                EXCEPTION
                    WHEN OTHERS
                    THEN
                        tqc_error_manager.raise_error (
                            270102503,
                            text_in   => 'Error populating GL details.');
                END;
            END IF;

            BEGIN
                UPDATE lms_claim_notifications
                   SET cnot_reserved = 'Y',
                       cnot_reserved_by = v_user,
                       cnot_reserved_date = SYSDATE,
                       cnot_reserved_transno = v_trans_code
                 WHERE cnot_clm_no = v_claim_no;
            EXCEPTION
                WHEN OTHERS
                THEN
                    tqc_error_manager.raise_error (
                        270102503,
                        text_in   => 'Error posting claim reserve..');
            END;
        END LOOP;
    --   EXCEPTION
    --      WHEN OTHERS
    --      THEN
    --
    --         tqc_error_manager.raise_error
    --                                  (270102504,
    --                                   text_in      => 'Error posting claim reserve.'
    --                                  );
    END post_claim_reserve;

    PROCEDURE process_grp_commission_pymt (
        v_cop_paid_vchr_tab   type_comm_vchr_table,
        v_vchr_brn_code       NUMBER,
        v_username            VARCHAR2,
        v_date_to             DATE,
        v_cur_code            VARCHAR2
    )
    IS
        v_narrative              VARCHAR2 (200);
        v_narrative2             VARCHAR2 (200);
        v_user                   VARCHAR2 (30)
            := pkg_global_vars.get_pvarchar2 ('pkg_global_vars.pvg_username');

        CURSOR c_comm (v_cop_paid_vchr_no VARCHAR2)
        IS
              SELECT cop_paid_vchr_no,
                     cop_agn_code,
                     TRUNC (cop_date)
                         cop_date,
                     cop_trans_no,
                     MIN (cop_prod_code)
                         cop_prod_code,
                     agn_act_code,
                     cop_payment_mode,
                     agn_sht_desc,
                     agn_bank_acc_no,
                     agn_bbr_code,
                     NVL (
                         agn_bank_acc_name,
                         TRIM (
                                agn_other_names
                             || ' '
                             || TRIM (agn_md_name || ' ' || agn_name)))
                         agn_name,
                     MAX (cop_code)
                         cop_code,
                     cop_prepared_by,
                     DECODE (agn_status, 'ACTIVE', 'Y', 'N')
                         pay_com_to_agent,
                       SUM (
                             DECODE (cop_drcr, 'D', -1, 1)
                           * (  NVL (cop_comm_amt, 0)
                              + NVL (cop_ovride_comm_amt, 0)))
                     + NVL (other_clawbacks, 0)
                         cop_comm_amt,
                     other_clawbacks,
                     SUM (
                           DECODE (cop_drcr, 'D', -1, 1)
                         * (  NVL (cop_whdtax_amt, 0)
                            + NVL (cop_ovride_whdtax_amt, 0)))
                         whdtx,
                     SUM (DECODE (cop_drcr, 'D', -1, 1) * NVL (cop_vat_amt, 0))
                         vat_amt,
                     SUM (DECODE (cop_drcr, 'D', -1, 1) * cop_advance_pymt)
                         advance,
                     SUM (
                             DECODE (cop_drcr, 'D', -1, 1)
                           * (  NVL (cop_comm_amt, 0)
                              + NVL (cop_ovride_comm_amt, 0)
                              + NVL (cop_ov_bonus_amt, 0)
                              + NVL (cop_vat_amt, 0)
                              - NVL (cop_whdtax_amt, 0)
                              - NVL (cop_ovride_whdtax_amt, 0)
                              - NVL (cop_capin_amt, 0)
                              - NVL (cop_ovride_capin_amt, 0))
                         - NVL (cop_advance_pymt, 0)
                         - NVL (cop_deductions, 0)
                         - NVL (cop_prem_ded, 0))
                         amount,
                     SUM (DECODE (cop_drcr, 'D', -1, 1) * cop_prem_ded)
                         agn_prem,
                     SUM (
                           DECODE (cop_drcr, 'D', -1, 1)
                         * (  NVL (cop_capin_amt, 0)
                            + NVL (cop_ovride_capin_amt, 0)))
                         capin_amt,
                     SUM (
                           DECODE (cop_drcr, 'D', -1, 1)
                         * NVL (cop_deductions, 0))
                         cop_deductions,
                     SUM (
                           DECODE (cop_drcr, 'D', -1, 1)
                         * (  NVL (cop_company_capin_amt, 0)
                            + NVL (cop_company_ovride_capin_amt, 0)))
                         company_capin_amt
                FROM lms_commission_pymts,
                     lms_agencies,
                     (  SELECT SUM (other_clawbacks)     other_clawbacks,
                               ocl_pay_trans_no,
                               ocl_agn_code
                          FROM (  SELECT SUM (
                                               DECODE (ocl_drcr, 'D', -1, 1)
                                             * ocl_tot_comm_amt)
                                             other_clawbacks,
                                         ocl_pay_trans_no,
                                         ocl_agn_code
                                    FROM lms_other_comm_clawbck
                                   WHERE ocl_cpe_code IS NULL
                                GROUP BY ocl_pay_trans_no, ocl_agn_code
                                UNION ALL
                                  SELECT SUM (
                                               DECODE (ocl_drcr, 'D', 1, -1)
                                             * ocl_tot_comm_amt)
                                             other_clawbacks,
                                         ocl_pay_trans_no,
                                         ocl_agn_code
                                    FROM lms_other_comm_clawbck
                                   WHERE ocl_cpe_code IS NOT NULL
                                GROUP BY ocl_pay_trans_no, ocl_agn_code)
                      GROUP BY ocl_pay_trans_no, ocl_agn_code)
               WHERE     cop_paid_vchr_no = v_cop_paid_vchr_no
                     AND cop_agn_code = agn_code
                     AND cop_trans_no = ocl_pay_trans_no(+)
                     AND cop_agn_code = ocl_agn_code(+)
                     AND cop_cur_code = v_cur_code
            GROUP BY cop_paid_vchr_no,
                     cop_agn_code,
                     TRUNC (cop_date),
                     cop_trans_no,
                     agn_name,
                     agn_bank_acc_name,
                     agn_other_names,
                     agn_md_name,
                     cop_prepared_by,
                     other_clawbacks,
                     agn_sht_desc,
                     agn_status,
                     agn_bank_acc_no,
                     agn_bbr_code,
                     NVL (cop_com_grouping, 'OTH'),
                     agn_act_code,
                     cop_payment_mode;

        CURSOR payelmnts_ded (v_cop_paid_vchr_no VARCHAR2, v_agn_code NUMBER)
        IS
            SELECT cpe_acc_no,
                   cpe_contra_acc_no,
                   cpe_pay_element,
                   ocl_tot_comm_amt                     agd_amount,
                   DECODE (ocl_drcr, 'D', 'C', 'D')     ocldrcr
              FROM lms_agents_comm_pay_elements,
                   lms_other_comm_clawbck,
                   lms_comm_pay_elements
             WHERE     cpe_code = acpe_cpe_code
                   AND acpe_cpe_code = ocl_cpe_code
                   AND cpe_code = ocl_cpe_code
                   AND acpe_agn_code = ocl_agn_code
                   AND ocl_pay_trans_no IN
                           (SELECT cop_trans_no
                              FROM lms_commission_pymts
                             WHERE cop_paid_vchr_no = v_cop_paid_vchr_no)
                   AND ocl_agn_code = v_agn_code;

        CURSOR agent_debits (v_cop_paid_vchr_no VARCHAR2, v_agn_code NUMBER)
        IS
            SELECT ldt_account_no, ocl_tot_comm_amt, ldt_reason
              FROM lms_debit_trans,
                   lms_other_comm_clawbck,
                   lms_agent_other_debits
             WHERE     ocl_aodb_code = aodb_code
                   AND ldt_code = aodb_ldt_code
                   AND aodb_agn_code = ocl_agn_code
                   AND ocl_pay_trans_no IN
                           (SELECT cop_trans_no
                              FROM lms_commission_pymts
                             WHERE cop_paid_vchr_no = v_cop_paid_vchr_no)
                   AND ocl_agn_code = v_agn_code;

        CURSOR agent_debit_reasons (v_trans_no NUMBER, v_agn_code NUMBER)
        IS
            SELECT ldr_gl_code,
                   ocl_tot_comm_amt,
                   ldr_desc,
                   ocl_drcr     ocldrcr,
                   ocl_code
              FROM lms_other_comm_clawbck, lms_debit_reason, lms_agent_debits
             WHERE     ocl_adb_code = adb_code
                   AND adb_ldr_code = ldr_code
                   AND ocl_cpe_code IS NULL
                   AND ocl_pay_trans_no = v_trans_no
                   AND ocl_agn_code = v_agn_code;

        CURSOR advance (v_cop_paid_vchr_no VARCHAR2, v_agn_code NUMBER)
        IS
              SELECT SUM (
                           car_amt_repaid
                         - NVL (
                               car_intr_amnt,
                               ROUND (NVL (cad_intr_amt, 0) / tot_insts_no, 2)))
                         car_amt_repaid,
                     UPPER (lalt_description)
                         lalt_description,
                     lalt_gl_code,
                     lalt_contra_gl_code,
                     lalt_intr_gl_code,
                     lalt_intr_contra_gl_code,
                     SUM (
                         NVL (car_intr_amnt,
                              ROUND (NVL (cad_intr_amt, 0) / tot_insts_no, 2)))
                         intr_amt
                FROM lms_comm_adv_rpymt,
                     lms_comm_advances,
                     lms_commission_pymts,
                     lms_agent_loan_types,
                     (  SELECT COUNT (1) tot_insts_no, car_cad_code cadcode
                          FROM lms_comm_adv_rpymt
                      GROUP BY car_cad_code)
               WHERE     cad_agn_code = v_agn_code
                     AND car_cop_code = cop_code
                     AND cop_paid_vchr_no = v_cop_paid_vchr_no
                     AND cad_lalt_code = lalt_code
                     AND car_cad_code = cad_code
                     AND cadcode = cad_code
            GROUP BY lalt_description,
                     lalt_gl_code,
                     lalt_contra_gl_code,
                     lalt_intr_gl_code,
                     lalt_intr_contra_gl_code,
                     ROUND (NVL (cad_intr_amt, 0) / tot_insts_no, 2);

        v_org_code               NUMBER;
        v_crt_acc_no             VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_chq_dtls_rec           fms_cheques_pkg.type_rqn_dtls_table;
        v_prod_code              NUMBER;
        v_trnt_prod_applicable   VARCHAR2 (3);
        v_trnt_contra_gl_code    VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_count                  NUMBER := 0;
        v_gl_count               NUMBER := 0;
        v_brh_code               NUMBER := v_vchr_brn_code;
        v_trnt_code              VARCHAR2 (10);
        v_gl_trans               tq_fms.fms_vouchers_pkg.tgl_rec_type;
        v_gl_acc                 VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_gl_acc2                VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_vgl_no                 NUMBER;
        v_contra_gl_code         VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_cnt                    NUMBER := 0;
        v_trans_code             NUMBER;
        v_eft_enabled            VARCHAR2 (5);
        v_pay_method             VARCHAR2 (5);
        v_trans_no               NUMBER;
        v_adv_cnt                NUMBER := 0;
        v_drcr                   VARCHAR2 (1);
        v_agn_code               NUMBER;
        v_comm_control           VARCHAR2 (30);
        v_pmt_type               VARCHAR2 (10);
        v_trans_desc             VARCHAR2 (30);
        v_tax_narrative          VARCHAR2 (50);
    BEGIN
        v_gl_trans.delete;
        v_gl_count := -1;

        -- RAISE_ERROR('v_prod_code:'||v_prod_code);
        SELECT    TO_NUMBER (TO_CHAR (SYSDATE, 'RRRR'))
               || lms_transaction_seq.NEXTVAL
          INTO v_trans_code
          FROM DUAL;

        BEGIN
            v_org_code := fms_interfaces_pkg.get_org (v_vchr_brn_code);
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                raise_error ('Org details error...' || v_vchr_brn_code);
        END;

        --raise_error('v_trans_code=='||v_trans_code);
        FOR v_com_rec IN 1 .. v_cop_paid_vchr_tab.COUNT
        LOOP
            v_cnt := NVL (v_cnt, 0) + 1;

            IF v_cop_paid_vchr_tab (v_com_rec).comm_option = 'CHQ'
            THEN
                v_chq_dtls_rec.delete;
                v_count := 0;

                -- raise_error('v_cop_paid_vchr_no=='||v_cop_paid_vchr_tab (v_com_rec).comm_voucher||';;v_date_to=='||v_date_to||';;v_vchr_brn_code=='||v_vchr_brn_code);
                -- raise_error('v_cop_paid_vchr_no=='||v_cop_paid_vchr_tab (v_com_rec).comm_voucher||';;v_date_to=='||v_date_to||';;v_vchr_brn_code=='||v_vchr_brn_code);
                FOR i
                    IN c_comm (v_cop_paid_vchr_tab (v_com_rec).comm_voucher)
                LOOP
                    v_trans_no := i.cop_trans_no;
                    v_agn_code := i.cop_agn_code;
