                                    i.cop_trans_no--v_trans_no  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL
                                                  );
                            END IF;

                            IF NVL (i.company_capin_amt, 0) <> 0
                            THEN
                                ----- need  to  get  the  company  account  that  will  be  debited -------
                                get_gl_code ('CAP_CMPNY',
                                             v_prod_code,
                                             v_trnt_code,
                                             v_crt_acc_no,
                                             v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
                                valid_acc (v_crt_acc_no,
                                           v_org_code,
                                           v_vchr_brn_code,
                                           'CAP_CMPNY');
                                v_gl_count := v_gl_count + 1;
                                interface_append_gl (
                                    v_trans_code,
                                    --v_trans_code          NUMBER,
                                    v_username, --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                                    NULL,        --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                                    NULL,        --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                                    v_cop_paid_vchr_tab (v_com_rec).comm_voucher,
                                    --v_vchr_no          VARCHAR2,
                                    NULL,        --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                                    NULL,        --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                                    NULL,      --v_rcpt_no           VARCHAR2,
                                    v_gl_count,  --v_count             NUMBER,
                                    'SAVINGS PLAN-COMPANY' || v_trans_desc,
                                    --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                                    i.company_capin_amt,
                                    --v_amount            NUMBER,
                                    'D',       --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                                    v_crt_acc_no,
                                    --v_acc_number1          VARCHAR2,
                                    v_vchr_brn_code,
                                    --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                                    v_gl_trans,
                                    --IN OUT   tq_fms.fms_vouchers_pkg.tgl_rec_type,
                                    NULL,   --v_cad_code  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                    NULL,  --v_otop_code  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                    NULL,  --v_fpmt_code  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                    NULL,   --v_ort_code  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                    NULL,     --v_btr_no  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                    NULL,   --v_ppr_code  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                    NULL,   --v_ocl_code  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                    i.cop_agn_code,
                                    --v_agn_code  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                    i.cop_trans_no--v_trans_no  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL
                                                  );
                            END IF;

                            IF NVL (i.cop_deductions, 0) <> 0
                            THEN
                                get_gl_code ('COMMDED',
                                             v_prod_code,
                                             v_trnt_code,
                                             v_crt_acc_no,
                                             v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
                                valid_acc (v_crt_acc_no,
                                           v_org_code,
                                           v_vchr_brn_code,
                                           'COMMDED');
                                v_gl_count := v_gl_count + 1;
                                interface_append_gl (
                                    v_trans_code,
                                    --v_trans_code          NUMBER,
                                    v_username, --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                                    NULL,        --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                                    NULL,        --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                                    v_cop_paid_vchr_tab (v_com_rec).comm_voucher,
                                    --v_vchr_no          VARCHAR2,
                                    NULL,        --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                                    NULL,        --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                                    NULL,      --v_rcpt_no           VARCHAR2,
                                    v_gl_count,  --v_count             NUMBER,
                                    'COMMISSION DEDUCTIONS' || v_trans_desc,
                                    --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                                    i.cop_deductions,
                                    --v_amount            NUMBER,
                                    'C',       --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                                    v_crt_acc_no,
                                    --v_acc_number1          VARCHAR2,
                                    v_vchr_brn_code,
                                    --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                                    v_gl_trans,
                                    --IN OUT   tq_fms.fms_vouchers_pkg.tgl_rec_type,
                                    NULL,   --v_cad_code  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                    NULL,  --v_otop_code  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                    NULL,  --v_fpmt_code  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                    NULL,   --v_ort_code  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                    NULL,     --v_btr_no  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                    NULL,   --v_ppr_code  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                    NULL,   --v_ocl_code  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                    i.cop_agn_code,
                                    --v_agn_code  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                    i.cop_trans_no--v_trans_no  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL
                                                  );
                            END IF;

                            IF NVL (i.amount, 0) <> 0
                            THEN
                                SELECT DECODE (SIGN (NVL (i.amount, 0)),
                                               -1, 'D',
                                               'C')
                                  INTO v_drcr
                                  FROM DUAL;

                                get_gl_code ('MNGTRSV',
                                             v_prod_code,
                                             v_trnt_code,
                                             v_crt_acc_no,
                                             v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
                                valid_acc (v_crt_acc_no,
                                           v_org_code,
                                           v_vchr_brn_code,
                                           'MNGTRSV');
                                v_gl_count := v_gl_count + 1;
                                interface_append_gl (
                                    v_trans_code,
                                    --v_trans_code          NUMBER,
                                    v_username, --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                                    NULL,        --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                                    NULL,        --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                                    v_cop_paid_vchr_tab (v_com_rec).comm_voucher,
                                    --v_vchr_no          VARCHAR2,
                                    NULL,        --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                                    NULL,        --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                                    NULL,      --v_rcpt_no           VARCHAR2,
                                    v_gl_count,  --v_count             NUMBER,
                                    v_narrative2 || v_trans_desc,
                                    --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                                    ABS (i.amount), --v_amount            NUMBER,
                                    v_drcr,    --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                                    v_crt_acc_no,
                                    --v_acc_number1          VARCHAR2,
                                    v_vchr_brn_code,
                                    --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                                    v_gl_trans,
                                    --IN OUT   tq_fms.fms_vouchers_pkg.tgl_rec_type,
                                    NULL,   --v_cad_code  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                    NULL,  --v_otop_code  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                    NULL,  --v_fpmt_code  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                    NULL,   --v_ort_code  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                    NULL,     --v_btr_no  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                    NULL,   --v_ppr_code  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                    NULL,   --v_ocl_code  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                    i.cop_agn_code,
                                    --v_agn_code  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                    i.cop_trans_no--v_trans_no  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL
                                                  );
                            END IF;
                        END IF;

                        UPDATE lms_commission_pymts
                           SET cop_paid = 'Y'
                         WHERE cop_code = i.cop_code;
                    END IF;

                    EXIT;
                END LOOP;

                IF v_cnt = 0
                THEN
                    raise_error (
                           'NO TRANSACTIONS POSTED TO FINANCE '
                        || v_cop_paid_vchr_tab (v_com_rec).comm_voucher);
                END IF;
            END IF;
        END LOOP;

        BEGIN
            IF v_gl_count > 0
            THEN
                interface_update_vgl (
                    v_trans_code,                   --v_trans_code     NUMBER,
                    v_username,                --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                    NULL,                        --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                    NVL (v_date_to, SYSDATE),         --v_date           DATE,
                    NULL,                        --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                    NULL,                        --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                    'LMS COMM/PTAX RECOVERIES', --v_btc_description   VARCHAR2,
                    'JV',                       --v_btc_type         VARCHAR2,
                    v_vchr_brn_code,             --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                       'COMM PMT'
                    || v_cop_paid_vchr_tab (1).comm_voucher
                    || ' - '
                    || v_cop_paid_vchr_tab (v_cop_paid_vchr_tab.COUNT).comm_voucher
                    || v_trans_desc,
                    NULL,                      --v_rcpt_no           VARCHAR2,
                    v_gl_trans,
                    --v_gl_trans  IN OUT  Fms_Vouchers_Pkg.Tgl_rec_type,
                    NULL,              --v_cad_code       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                    NULL,             --v_otop_code       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL)
                    NULL,                   --v_fpmt_code NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                    NULL,                   --v_ort_code  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                    NULL,                   --v_btr_no    NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                    NULL,                   --v_ppr_code  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                    NULL,                    --v_ocl_code NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                    NULL,
                    --v_agn_code NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                    v_trans_no                --v_trans_no NUMBER DEFAULT NULL
                              );
            END IF;

            NULL;
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                raise_error (
                       'CREATING/POSTING COMMISSION VOUCHER  '
                    || v_cop_paid_vchr_tab (1).comm_voucher
                    || ';  v_vchr_brn_code='
                    || v_vchr_brn_code);
        END;
    EXCEPTION
        WHEN OTHERS
        THEN
            raise_error (
                   'PROCESSING COMMISSION v_agn_code='
                || v_agn_code
                || ' v_trans_no='
                || v_trans_no
                || ';'
                || SQLERRM);
    END process_grp_commission_pymt;

    PROCEDURE post_grp_med_pymt (
        v_tran_no      NUMBER,
        v_facil_name   VARCHAR2,
        v_facil_code   NUMBER,
        v_user         VARCHAR2,
        v_sys_code     NUMBER,
        v_vchr_no      VARCHAR2
    )
    IS
        CURSOR cur_facil_pymt IS
            SELECT fpmt_code,
                   fpmt_spr_code,
                   fpmt_pay_trans_no,
                   fpmt_amount,
                   fpmt_brn_code,
                   fpmt_pymt_type,
                   fpmt_bbr_code,
                   fpmt_bbr_acc_no,
                   fpmt_base_amt,
                   fpmt_cur_code
              FROM lms_facilitator_payments
             WHERE     fpmt_pay_trans_no = v_tran_no
                   AND fpmt_code = v_facil_code
                   AND fpmt_brn_code IS NOT NULL;

        v_payee_eft_rec         fms_cheques_pkg.type_payee_eft_table;
        v_trns_rec              fms_cheques_pkg.type_rqn_dtls_table;
        v_eft_enabled           VARCHAR2 (1) := 'N';
        v_crt_acc_no            VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_org_code              NUMBER;
        v_cur_code              NUMBER;
        v_bct_code              NUMBER;
        v_bct_brh_code          NUMBER;
        v_authorized_by         NUMBER;
        v_no                    NUMBER := 0;
        v_prod_code             NUMBER;
        v_trnt_code             VARCHAR2 (10);
        v_trnt_gl_code          VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_trnt_contra_gl_code   VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_gl_trans              fms_vouchers_pkg.tgl_rec_type;
        v_gl_count              NUMBER := -1;
        vgl_code                NUMBER;
        v_trans_code            NUMBER;
        v_param_val             VARCHAR2 (5);
        v_param_value           VARCHAR2 (5);
        v_base_cur_code         NUMBER;
        v_posting_cur_code      NUMBER;
        v_posting_amt           NUMBER;
    BEGIN
        v_trns_rec.delete;
        v_no := 0;

        BEGIN
            lms_ord_misc.system_param_val (
                'USE_CONTRAL_ACCOUNT_AT_MEDICAL_PAYMENTS',
                v_param_val);
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                raise_error (
                    'Parameter Error...USE_CONTRAL_ACCOUNT_AT_MEDICAL_PAYMENTS');
        END;

        BEGIN
            lms_ord_misc.system_param_val (
                'FACILITATOR_PYMT_IN_BASE_CURRENCY',
                v_param_value);
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                raise_error (
                    'Parameter Error...FACILITATOR_PYMT_IN_BASE_CURRENCY');
        END;

        FOR f IN cur_facil_pymt
        LOOP
            SELECT    TO_NUMBER (TO_CHAR (SYSDATE, 'RRRR'))
                   || lms_transaction_seq.NEXTVAL
              INTO v_trans_code
              FROM DUAL;

            v_org_code := fms_interfaces_pkg.get_org (f.fpmt_brn_code);
            v_base_cur_code := lms_grp_misc.get_base_currency (v_org_code);
            v_no := v_no + 1;
            get_gl_code ('MED',
                         v_prod_code,
                         v_trnt_code,
                         v_crt_acc_no,
                         v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
            valid_acc (v_crt_acc_no,
                       v_org_code,
                       f.fpmt_brn_code,
                       'MED');

            IF NVL (v_param_value, 'N') = 'Y'
            THEN
                v_posting_cur_code := v_base_cur_code;
                v_posting_amt := f.fpmt_base_amt;
            ELSE
                v_posting_cur_code := f.fpmt_cur_code;
                v_posting_amt := f.fpmt_amount;
            END IF;

            BEGIN
                interface_append_chq (
                    v_trans_code,                --v_trans_code        NUMBER,
                    v_user,                    --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                    NULL,                       --v_pol_code           NUMBER,
                    v_prod_code,                --v_prod_code          NUMBER,
                    v_vchr_no,                 --v_vchr_no           VARCHAR2,
                    v_no,                       --v_count              NUMBER,
                    v_posting_amt,              --v_amount             NUMBER,
                    v_facil_name || ' - ' || 'PAYMENT FOR MEDICALS',
                    --v_narrative          VARCHAR2,
                    v_crt_acc_no,           --v_acc_number           VARCHAR2,
                    v_org_code,                --v_acc_org_code        NUMBER,
                    f.fpmt_brn_code,            --v_branch_code        NUMBER,
                    'D',                      --v_drcr               VARCHAR2,
                    v_trns_rec,
                    --v_trn_rec   IN OUT   Fms_Cheques_Pkg.Type_rqn_dtls_table)
                    f.fpmt_code);      --v_fpmt_code       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL
            EXCEPTION
                WHEN OTHERS
                THEN
                    tqc_error_manager.raise_error (
                        270102501,
                        text_in   => 'Error appending cheque details.');
            END;

            IF v_no <> 0
            THEN
                BEGIN
                    interface_create_reqn (
                        v_trans_code,           --v_trans_code         NUMBER,
                        v_vchr_no,         --v_ref                   VARCHAR2,
                        f.fpmt_code,       --v_ref2                  VARCHAR2,
                        TRUNC (SYSDATE),       --v_ref_date              DATE,
                           v_facil_name
                        || ' - '
                        || 'PAYMENT FOR MEDICALS ('
                        || f.fpmt_pymt_type
                        || ')',
                        --v_narrative             VARCHAR2,
                        NVL (v_posting_amt, 0), --v_amount                NUMBER,
                        v_facil_name,      --v_payee                 VARCHAR2,
                        NVL (f.fpmt_pymt_type, 'CHQ'),
                        --v_pay_method            VARCHAR2, --CHQ, EFT
                        f.fpmt_bbr_acc_no, --v_payee_bank_acc_no        VARCHAR2,
                        f.fpmt_bbr_code,  --v_payee_bank_branch_code   NUMBER,
                        v_user,            --v_source_auth_by        VARCHAR2,
                        TRUNC (SYSDATE),       --v_source_auth_dt        DATE,
                        v_user,          --v_raise_by                VARCHAR2,
                        'MED',             --v_pmt_type              VARCHAR2,
                        f.fpmt_brn_code,      --v_branch_code          NUMBER,
                        NULL,                                    --v_pol_code,
                        v_trns_rec,
                        --v_dtls_table  IN OUT  Fms_Cheques_Pkg.Type_rqn_dtls_table)
                        f.fpmt_code,
                        NULL,
                        NULL,
                        NULL,
                        NULL,
                        NULL,
                        NULL,
                        NULL,
                        v_posting_cur_code);
                --v_dtls_table  IN OUT    Fms_Cheques_Pkg.Type_rqn_dtls_table)
                EXCEPTION
                    WHEN OTHERS
                    THEN
                        tqc_error_manager.raise_error (
                            270102502,
                            text_in   =>
                                'Error creating Medicl cheque details.');
                END;

                IF NVL (v_param_val, 'N') = 'Y'
                THEN
                    get_gl_code ('MED',
                                 v_prod_code,
                                 v_trnt_code,
                                 v_crt_acc_no,
                                 v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
                    valid_acc (v_crt_acc_no,
                               v_org_code,
                               f.fpmt_brn_code,
                               'MED');
                    valid_acc (v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                               v_org_code,
                               f.fpmt_brn_code,
                               'MED CONTRA');

                    BEGIN
                        v_gl_count := v_gl_count + 2;
                        interface_append_gl (
                            v_trans_code,        --v_trans_code        NUMBER,
                            v_user,            --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                            NULL,                --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                            v_prod_code,         --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                            v_vchr_no,         --v_vchr_no           VARCHAR2,
                            NULL,                --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                            NULL,                --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                            NULL,               --v_rcpt_no          VARCHAR2,
                            v_gl_count,          --v_count             NUMBER,
                               v_facil_name
                            || ' - '
                            || 'PAYMENT FOR MEDICALS: '
                            || v_vchr_no,
                            --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                            NVL (v_posting_amt, 0), --v_amount            NUMBER,
                            'D',               --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                            v_crt_acc_no,    --v_acc_number1         VARCHAR2,
                            v_trnt_contra_gl_code, --v_acc_number2         VARCHAR2,
                            f.fpmt_brn_code,     --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                            v_gl_trans,
                            --v_trn_rec   IN OUT  fms_test.Fms_Vouchers_Pkg.Tgl_rec_type,
                            NULL,      --v_cad_code       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                            NULL,     --v_otop_code       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                            f.fpmt_code); --v_fpmt_code       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL)
                        interface_update_vgl (
                            v_trans_code,
                            --v_trans_code     NUMBER,
                            v_user,
                            --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                            NULL,                --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                            TRUNC (SYSDATE),
                            --v_date         DATE,
                            NULL,                --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                            NULL,                --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                            'LMS MEDICALS',
                            --v_btc_description   VARCHAR2,
                            'JV',             --v_btc_type           VARCHAR2,
                            f.fpmt_brn_code,
                               --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                               v_facil_name
                            || ' - '
                            || 'PAYMENT FOR MEDICALS: '
                            || v_vchr_no,
                            --v_description       VARCHAR2,
                            v_vchr_no,
                            --v_ref_no            VARCHAR2,
                            v_gl_trans,
                            --v_gl_trans  IN OUT  fms_test.Fms_Vouchers_Pkg.Tgl_rec_type,
                            NULL,
                            --v_cad_code       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                            NULL,
                            --v_otop_code       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                            f.fpmt_code);
                    --v_fpmt_code       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL)
                    EXCEPTION
                        WHEN OTHERS
                        THEN
                            tqc_error_manager.raise_error (
                                270102503,
                                text_in   => 'Error populating GL details.');
                    END;
                END IF;

                UPDATE lms_facilitator_payments
                   SET fpmt_authorised = 'Y',
                       fpmt_authorised_by = v_user,
                       fpmt_authorised_date = TRUNC (SYSDATE),
                       fpmt_pymt_vchr_no = v_vchr_no
                 WHERE fpmt_code = v_facil_code AND fpmt_authorised != 'Y';

                UPDATE lms_pol_med_group_items
                   SET pmgit_paid = 'P'
                 WHERE pmgit_fpmt_code = v_facil_code AND pmgit_paid = 'R';
            END IF;
        END LOOP;
    EXCEPTION
        WHEN OTHERS
        THEN
            tqc_error_manager.raise_error (
                270102504,
                text_in   => 'Error posting medical payment.');
    END post_grp_med_pymt;

    PROCEDURE update_uprocessed_prem (
        v_endr_code    NUMBER,
        v_pol_code     NUMBER,
        v_grct_code    NUMBER,
        v_rct_code     VARCHAR2,
        v_date         DATE,
        v_debit_amt    NUMBER,
        v_rct_branch   NUMBER,
        v_user         VARCHAR2
    )
    IS
        v_prod_type                VARCHAR2 (100);
        v_trans_code               NUMBER;
        v_count                    NUMBER := 0;
        v_gl_trans                 fms_vouchers_pkg.tgl_rec_type;
        v_vgl_no                   NUMBER;
        v_trnt_code                VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_trnt_gl_code             VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_trnt_contra_gl_code      VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_dummy_gl_code            VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_dummy_contra_gl_code     VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_dr_trnt_code             VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_dr_trnt_gl_code          VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_dr_trnt_contra_gl_code   VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_org_code                 NUMBER;
        v_sbu_code                 NUMBER := NULL;
        v_spoke_code               NUMBER := NULL;
        v_cvrg_area                NUMBER := NULL;
        v_location_code            NUMBER := NULL;
        v_os_debit_bal             NUMBER := 0;
        v_premium_amt              NUMBER := 0;
        v_unalloc_amt              NUMBER := 0;
        v_os_credit_bal            NUMBER := 0;
        v_coinsurance              VARCHAR2 (2);
        v_leader_follower          VARCHAR2 (2);
        v_lead_combined            VARCHAR2 (2);
        v_coin_prem                NUMBER;
        v_leader_share             NUMBER;
        v_tot_rcpt_amt             NUMBER;
        v_cnt                      NUMBER := 0;
        v_prem_allocate            NUMBER;
        v_endr_vat_rate            NUMBER;
        v_override_comm_amt        NUMBER;
        v_endr_comm_rate           NUMBER;
        v_coinsure_leader          VARCHAR2 (2);
        v_endr_ov_comm_rate        NUMBER;
        v_override_rate            NUMBER;
        v_act_vat_rate             NUMBER;
        v_comm_rate                NUMBER;
        v_vat_amount               NUMBER;
        v_comm_amt                 NUMBER;
        v_ov_comm_rate             NUMBER;
        v_vat_rate                 NUMBER;
        v_override_comm_rate       NUMBER;
        v_net_os_debit_bal         NUMBER := 0;
        v_prem_orc_comm_dac        NUMBER := 0;
        v_vat_amt_dac              NUMBER := 0;
        v_prem_comm_dac            NUMBER := 0;
        v_transt_gl_code           NUMBER;
        v_transt_contra_gl_code    NUMBER;

        CURSOR cur_pol_cb_amt IS
            SELECT DISTINCT
                   grct_amt,
                   grct_prem_unallocated_amt,
                   pol_bra_code,
                   pol_prod_code,
                   grct_date,
                   lms_interfaces_pkg.pol_product (pol_code)
                       product,
                   pol_code,
                   prod_gl_control_code,
                   pol_cur_code,
                   pol_curr_rate_type,
                   pol_cur_rate,
                   pol_cur_symbol,
                   grct_receipt_no,
                   grct_endr_code,
                   grct_pol_code,
                   NVL (grct_comm_inclusive, 'Y')
                       grct_comm_inclusive,
                   NVL (grct_admin_charge_inclusive, 'Y')
                       grct_admin_charge_inclusive,
                   NVL (grct_vat_inclusive, 'Y')
                       grct_vat_inclusive
              FROM lms_grp_prem_receipts,
                   lms_master_transactions,
                   lms_policies,
                   lms_products
             WHERE     grct_pol_code = v_pol_code
                   AND grct_code = v_grct_code
                   AND grct_code = mtran_lms_receipt_pk
                   AND grct_status != 'C'
                   AND grct_endr_code <> v_endr_code
                   AND NVL (grct_prem_unallocated_amt, 0) > 0
                   AND pol_prod_code = prod_code
                   AND pol_code = grct_pol_code
                   AND TO_NUMBER (TO_CHAR (grct_date, 'RRRR')) > 2017;


        v_recs                     NUMBER := 0;
        v_product                  VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_ac_type                  VARCHAR2 (5);
        v_to_prod_type             VARCHAR2 (5);
        v_no                       NUMBER;
        v_mtran_code               NUMBER;
        v_amt                      NUMBER;
        v_rcpt_amt                 NUMBER;
        v_grctcode                 NUMBER;
        v_net_v_amt                NUMBER;
    -- v_user                   VARCHAR2 (30)
    --  := fms_interfaces_pkg.get_username (v_raised_by);
    BEGIN
        --RAISE_ERROR('v_grct_code=='||v_grct_code||' v_endr_code='||v_endr_code ||' v_pol_code='||v_pol_code);

        BEGIN
            SELECT COUNT (1)
              INTO v_cnt
              FROM lms_grp_prem_receipts
             WHERE grct_receipt_no = v_rct_code;
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                raise_error ('ERROR GETTING RECEIPT DETAILS..');
        END;

        IF NVL (v_cnt, 0) = 0
        THEN
            raise_error (
                   'THIS RECEIPT '
                || v_rct_code
                || ' DOES NOT EXIST IN GROUP/PENSION PAYMENTS..');
        END IF;

        v_count := 0;

        SELECT    TO_NUMBER (TO_CHAR (SYSDATE, 'RRRR'))
               || lms_transaction_seq.NEXTVAL
          INTO v_trans_code
          FROM DUAL;

        --reversing allocated receipts

        --   raise_error(121);
        v_count := -1;

        --

        FOR pr IN cur_pol_cb_amt
        LOOP
            BEGIN
                SELECT pol_prod_type
                  INTO v_to_prod_type
                  FROM lms_policies
                 WHERE pol_code = pr.grct_pol_code;
            EXCEPTION
                WHEN OTHERS
                THEN
                    raise_error (
                        'Error retrieving policy details for the policy to transfer to..');
            END;

            BEGIN
                SELECT NVL (endr_coinsurance, 'N'),
                       NVL (endr_coinsure_leader, 'L'),
                       NVL (endr_leader_combined, 'N'),
                       NVL (endr_coin_leader_share, 0),
                       NVL (endr_vat_rate, 0) / 100,
                       NVL (endr_override_comm, 0) / 100,
                       NVL (endr_comm_rate, 0) / 100,
                       NVL (endr_ov_comm_rate, 0) / 100,
                       NVL (act_vat_rate, 0) / 100,
                       NVL (act_overide_rate, 0)
                  INTO v_coinsurance,
                       v_leader_follower,
                       v_lead_combined,
                       v_leader_share,
                       v_endr_vat_rate,
                       v_override_comm_amt,
                       v_endr_comm_rate,
                       v_ov_comm_rate,
                       v_act_vat_rate,
                       v_override_rate
                  FROM lms_policy_endorsements,
                       lms_agencies,
                       tqc_account_types
                 WHERE     endr_agen_code = agn_code
                       AND endr_code = pr.grct_endr_code
                       AND agn_act_code = act_code;
            EXCEPTION
                WHEN OTHERS
                THEN
                    v_coinsurance := 'N';
                    v_leader_follower := 'L';
                    v_lead_combined := 'N';
                    v_leader_share := 0;
            END;

            IF pr.prod_gl_control_code IS NULL
            THEN            --cur_endors_rec.PROD_GL_CONTROL_CODE IS NULL THEN
                raise_error (
                    'The GL Control Account definition code for this product has not been defined in product setups. Please define and try again.');
            END IF;

            v_ac_type := 'D';
            v_org_code := fms_interfaces_pkg.get_org (v_rct_branch);
            v_amt := NVL (v_debit_amt, 0);
            v_unalloc_amt := NVL (pr.grct_prem_unallocated_amt, 0);
            v_rcpt_amt := NVL (pr.grct_amt, 0);

            IF v_debit_amt > v_unalloc_amt
            THEN
                v_amt := v_unalloc_amt;
            END IF;

            --                  raise_error (   'v_amt=='
            --                               || v_amt
            --                               || ' v_debit_amt='
            --                               || v_debit_amt
            --                               || ' unalloc_amt='
            --                               || pr.grct_prem_unallocated_amt
            --                               ||'v_rcpt_amt='
            --                               ||v_rcpt_amt
            --                              );


            --This code has been added to take care of scenerios where a net receipt is in excess of the debit /computed premium.
            -- The premium alloatated should be equivalent to the net debit----
            -- The commission, VAT or ADMIN Charge should be computed subject to the debit amount
            --Any excess (comm, vat and admin ) that was taken at source will be posted to DAC account, and utilsed at the point of excess utilisation..

            IF NVL (v_amt, 0) <> 0 AND NVL (v_amt, 0) <= NVL (v_rcpt_amt, 0)
            THEN
                v_comm_rate := 0;
                v_vat_amount := 0;
                v_override_comm_amt := 0;

                IF NVL (pr.grct_comm_inclusive, 'Y') = 'N'
                THEN
                    BEGIN
                        SELECT NVL (pol_coin_admin_fee, 0)
                          INTO v_endr_ov_comm_rate
                          FROM lms_policy_coinsurers
                         WHERE     pol_coin_pol_code = pr.pol_code
                               AND pol_coin_endr_code = v_endr_code
                               AND NVL (pol_coin_follower_leader, 'F') = 'L';
                    EXCEPTION
                        WHEN OTHERS
                        THEN
                            v_endr_ov_comm_rate := 0;
                    END;

                    IF NVL (v_endr_vat_rate, 0) <> 0
                    THEN
                        v_act_vat_rate := v_endr_vat_rate;
                    END IF;


                    v_comm_rate := NVL (v_endr_comm_rate, 0);

                    IF     NVL (v_coinsurance, 'N') = 'Y'
                       AND NVL (pr.grct_admin_charge_inclusive, 'Y') = 'N'
                       AND v_coinsure_leader = 'F'
                    THEN
                        v_endr_ov_comm_rate := v_ov_comm_rate;
                    END IF;

                    IF     NVL (v_endr_ov_comm_rate, 0) = 0
                       AND NVL (v_override_rate, 0) > 0
                    THEN
                        v_endr_ov_comm_rate := v_override_rate;
                    END IF;

                    IF     NVL (pr.grct_admin_charge_inclusive, 'Y') = 'N'
                       AND NVL (pr.grct_comm_inclusive, 'Y') = 'N'
                    THEN
                        v_comm_rate := NVL (v_endr_comm_rate, 0);
                        v_override_comm_rate := NVL (v_endr_ov_comm_rate, 0);
                    ELSIF     NVL (pr.grct_admin_charge_inclusive, 'Y') = 'Y'
                          AND NVL (pr.grct_comm_inclusive, 'Y') = 'N'
                    THEN
                        v_comm_rate := NVL (v_endr_comm_rate, 0);
                        v_override_comm_rate := 0;
                    ELSE
                        v_comm_rate := 0;
                        v_override_comm_rate := NVL (v_endr_ov_comm_rate, 0);
                    END IF;

                    v_comm_amt :=
                        ROUND (NVL (v_amt, 0) * NVL (v_comm_rate, 0), 2);

                    v_vat_amount :=
                        ROUND (NVL (v_act_vat_rate, 0) * NVL (v_comm_amt, 0),
                               2);

                    IF     NVL (pr.grct_admin_charge_inclusive, 'Y') = 'N'
                       AND NVL (v_endr_ov_comm_rate, 0) > 0 --v_endr_ov_comm_rate
                    THEN
                        --CALCULATE THE COINSURANCE ADMIN FEE PERCENTAGE AMOUNT...



                        v_override_comm_amt :=
                            ROUND (
                                  (  NVL (v_amt, 0)
                                   - (  NVL (v_comm_amt, 0)
                                      + NVL (v_vat_amount, 0)))
                                * NVL (v_override_comm_rate, 0),
                                2);
                    END IF;

                    v_prem_allocate :=
                          NVL (v_amt, 0)
                        - (  NVL (v_comm_amt, 0)
                           + NVL (v_vat_amount, 0)
                           + NVL (v_override_comm_amt, 0));
                ELSE
                    v_comm_rate := 0;
                    v_vat_amount := 0;
                    v_override_comm_amt := 0;
                END IF;

                get_gl_code ('UNPR_GB',
                             pr.pol_prod_code,
                             v_dr_trnt_code,
                             v_dr_trnt_gl_code,
                             v_dr_trnt_contra_gl_code);
                valid_acc (v_dr_trnt_gl_code,
                           v_org_code,
                           pr.pol_bra_code,
                           'UNPR_GB');
                get_gl_code ('UP_GB',
                             pr.pol_prod_code,
                             v_trnt_code,
                             v_trnt_gl_code,
                             v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
                valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                           v_org_code,
                           pr.pol_bra_code,
                           'UP_GB');
                v_count := v_count + 2;

                lms_api.interface_append_gl (
                    v_trans_code,
                    --v_trans_code           NUMBER,
                    v_user,
                    --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                    pr.pol_code,
                    --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                    pr.pol_prod_code,
                    --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                    v_rct_code,
                    --v_vchr_no             VARCHAR2,
                    NULL,                        --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                    NULL,                        --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                    NULL,
                    --v_rcpt_no             VARCHAR2,
                    v_count,
                    --v_count             NUMBER,
                    'UNALLOCATED PREMIUM -' || v_rct_code,
                      --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                      v_amt
                    - (  NVL (v_comm_amt, 0)
                       + NVL (v_vat_amount, 0)
                       + NVL (v_override_comm_amt, 0)),
                    --v_amount            NUMBER,
                    'D',                       --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                    v_dr_trnt_gl_code,
                    --v_acc_number1          VARCHAR2,
                    v_trnt_gl_code,
                    --v_acc_number2          VARCHAR2,
                    pr.pol_bra_code,
                    --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                    v_gl_trans,
                    NULL,
                    --v_cad_code       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                    NULL,
                    --v_otop_code              NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                    NULL,
                    --v_fpmt_code              NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                    NULL,
                    --v_ort_code               NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                    NULL,
                    --v_btr_no                 NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                    NULL,
                    --v_ppr_code               NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                    NULL,
                    --v_ocl_code                NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                    NULL,
                    --v_agn_code                NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                    NULL,
                    --v_trans_no                NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                    v_cvrg_area,
                    --v_covrg_area_code                NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                    v_spoke_code,
                    --v_spoke_code                NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                    v_sbu_code,
                    --v_sbu_code                NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                    v_location_code --v_loc_code                NUMBER DEFAULT NULL
                                   );


                ------Commission Deffered Acquisition Cost------------------------

                IF NVL (v_comm_amt, 0) <> 0
                THEN
                    get_gl_code ('DAC_GB',
                                 pr.pol_prod_code,
                                 v_trnt_code,
                                 v_trnt_gl_code,
                                 v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
                    valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                               v_org_code,
                               pr.pol_bra_code,
                               'DAC_GB');

                    get_gl_code ('UNPR_GB',
                                 pr.pol_prod_code,
                                 v_trnt_code,
                                 v_transt_gl_code,
                                 v_transt_contra_gl_code);
                    valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                               v_org_code,
                               pr.pol_bra_code,
                               'UNPR_GB');

                    v_count := NVL (v_count, 0) + 2;
                    interface_append_gl (
                        v_trans_code,            --v_trans_code        NUMBER,
                        v_user,                --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                        pr.pol_code,             --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                        pr.pol_prod_code,        --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                        pr.grct_receipt_no,     --v_vchr_no          VARCHAR2,
                        NULL,                    --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                        NULL,                    --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                        pr.grct_receipt_no,     --v_rcpt_no          VARCHAR2,
                        v_count,                 --v_count             NUMBER,
                        'DAC NET COMMISSION CHARGE ' || pr.grct_receipt_no,
                        v_comm_amt,
                        'C',                   --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                        v_trnt_gl_code,        --v_acc_number1       VARCHAR2,
                        v_transt_gl_code,     --v_acc_number2        VARCHAR2,
                        pr.pol_bra_code,         --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                        v_gl_trans --               NULL,                        --v_cad_code  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                  );
                END IF;

                /*

                ------VAT Deffered Acquisition Cost----------------
                IF NVL (v_vat_amount, 0) <> 0
                THEN
                    get_gl_code ('DAC_GB',
                                 pr.pol_prod_code,
                                 v_trnt_code,
                                 v_trnt_gl_code,
                                 v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
                    valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                               v_org_code,
                               pr.pol_bra_code,
                               'DAC_GB');

                    get_gl_code ('UNPR_GB',
                                 pr.pol_prod_code,
                                 v_trnt_code,
                                 v_transt_gl_code,
                                 v_transt_contra_gl_code);
                    valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                               v_org_code,
                               pr.pol_bra_code,
                               'UNPR_GB');

                    v_count := NVL (v_count, 0) + 2;
                    interface_append_gl (
                        v_trans_code,            --v_trans_code        NUMBER,
                        v_user,                --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                        pr.pol_code,             --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                        pr.pol_prod_code,        --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                        pr.grct_receipt_no,     --v_vchr_no          VARCHAR2,
                        NULL,                    --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                        NULL,                    --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                        pr.grct_receipt_no,     --v_rcpt_no          VARCHAR2,
                        v_count,                 --v_count             NUMBER,
                        'DAC NET COMM VAT CHARGE ' || pr.grct_receipt_no, --v_narrative         VARCHAR2
                        v_vat_amount,             --v_amount            NUMBER
                        'C',                   --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                        v_trnt_gl_code,        --v_acc_number1       VARCHAR2,
                        v_transt_gl_code,     --v_acc_number2        VARCHAR2,
                        pr.pol_bra_code,         --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                        v_gl_trans);
                END IF;

                -----  Admin Charge Deffered Acquisition Cost----------

                IF NVL (v_override_comm_amt, 0) <> 0
                THEN
                    get_gl_code ('DAC_GB',
                                 pr.pol_prod_code,
                                 v_trnt_code,
                                 v_trnt_gl_code,
                                 v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
                    valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                               v_org_code,
                               pr.pol_bra_code,
                               'DAC_GB');

                    get_gl_code ('UNPR_GB',
                                 pr.pol_prod_code,
                                 v_trnt_code,
                                 v_transt_gl_code,
                                 v_transt_contra_gl_code);
                    valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                               v_org_code,
                               pr.pol_bra_code,
                               'UNPR_GB');

                    v_count := NVL (v_count, 0) + 2;
                    interface_append_gl (
                        v_trans_code,            --v_trans_code        NUMBER,
                        v_user,                --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                        pr.pol_code,             --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                        pr.pol_prod_code,        --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                        pr.grct_receipt_no,     --v_vchr_no          VARCHAR2,
                        NULL,                    --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                        NULL,                    --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                        NULL,                   --v_rcpt_no          VARCHAR2,
                        v_count,                 --v_count             NUMBER,
                        'DAC NET COMM_ADMIN CHARGE -' || pr.grct_receipt_no,
                        --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                        v_override_comm_amt,
                        --v_amount            NUMBER,
                        'C',                   --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                        v_trnt_gl_code,
                        --v_acc_number1       VARCHAR2,
                        v_transt_gl_code,
                        --v_acc_number2        VARCHAR2,
                        pr.pol_bra_code,         --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                        v_gl_trans);
                END IF;

                */

                --Create an extra receipt record with the utilized amount. This will be used for reporting purposes especially production report where
                -- the supense amount  from a previous period is posted into the current peiod and therefore a missing leg when doing comparison with FMS

                IF TO_NUMBER (TO_CHAR (pr.grct_date, 'RRRR')) !=
                   TO_NUMBER (TO_CHAR (SYSDATE, 'RRRR'))
                THEN
                    BEGIN
                        SELECT    TO_NUMBER (TO_CHAR (SYSDATE, 'YYYY'))
                               || lms_grct_code_seq.NEXTVAL
                          INTO v_grctcode
                          FROM DUAL;
                    EXCEPTION
                        WHEN OTHERS
                        THEN
                            raise_error (
                                'ERROR POPULATING POLICY RECEIPT SEQUENCE......');
                    END;

                    BEGIN
                        INSERT INTO lms_grp_prem_receipts (
                                        grct_code,
                                        grct_ltr_trans_no,
                                        grct_date,
                                        grct_cheque_no,
                                        grct_amt,
                                        grct_gross_amnt,
                                        grct_pol_code,
                                        grct_pol_policy_no,
                                        grct_credit_note,
                                        grct_receipt_no,
                                        grct_credit_note_no,
                                        grct_receipt_date,
                                        grct_prem_allocate,
                                        grct_pens_allocate,
                                        grct_comm_inclusive,
                                        grct_agen_code,
                                        grct_brn_code,
                                        grct_drcr,
                                        grct_status,
                                        grct_done_by,
                                        grct_endr_code,
                                        grct_drcr_no,
                                        grct_cur_code,
                                        grct_cur_symbol,
                                        grct_vat_inclusive,
                                        grct_admin_charge_inclusive)
                            SELECT v_grctcode,
                                   grct_ltr_trans_no,
                                   NVL (v_date, TRUNC (SYSDATE)),
                                   grct_cheque_no,
                                   ABS (NVL (v_amt, 0)),
                                   ABS (NVL (v_amt, 0)),
                                   grct_pol_code,
                                   grct_pol_policy_no,
                                   grct_credit_note,
                                   grct_receipt_no,
                                   grct_credit_note_no,
                                   NVL (v_date, TRUNC (SYSDATE)),
                                   ABS (NVL (v_amt, 0)),
                                   grct_pens_allocate,
                                   grct_comm_inclusive,
                                   grct_agen_code,
                                   grct_brn_code,
                                   grct_drcr,
                                   grct_status,
                                   grct_done_by,
                                   grct_endr_code,
                                   grct_drcr_no,
                                   grct_cur_code,
                                   grct_cur_symbol,
                                   grct_vat_inclusive,
                                   grct_admin_charge_inclusive
                              FROM lms_grp_prem_receipts
                             WHERE grct_code = v_grct_code;
                    EXCEPTION
                        WHEN OTHERS
                        THEN
                            raise_error (
                                'ERROR INSERTING POLICY RECEIPT DETAILS......');
                    END;

                    --update the new receipt record
                    BEGIN
                        UPDATE lms_grp_prem_receipts
                           SET grct_prem_allocate = v_prem_allocate,
                               grct_prem_comm = v_comm_amt,
                               grct_prem_comm_paid = v_comm_amt,
                               grct_vat_amt = v_vat_amount,
                               grct_vat_amt_paid = v_vat_amount,
                               grct_prem_orc_comm = v_override_comm_amt,
                               grct_prem_orc_comm_paid = v_override_comm_amt
                         WHERE grct_code = v_grctcode;
                    EXCEPTION
                        WHEN OTHERS
                        THEN
                            raise_error (
                                'ERROR UPDATING UN-ALLOCATED RECEIPT AMOUNT');
                    END;
                ELSE
                    ----update the old receipt record
                    BEGIN
                        UPDATE lms_grp_prem_receipts
                           SET grct_prem_unallocated_amt =
                                     NVL (grct_prem_unallocated_amt, 0)
                                   - ABS (NVL (v_amt, 0)),
                               grct_prem_allocate =
                                     NVL (grct_prem_allocate, 0)
                                   + ABS (NVL (v_amt, 0)),
                               grct_prem_pymnt_amt =
                                     NVL (grct_prem_pymnt_amt, 0)
                                   + ABS (NVL (v_amt, 0))
                         WHERE grct_code = v_grct_code;
                    EXCEPTION
                        WHEN OTHERS
                        THEN
                            raise_error (
                                'ERROR UPDATING UN-ALLOCATED RECEIPT AMOUNT');
                    END;
                END IF;
            END IF;
        END LOOP;


        raise_error (
               'v_count=='
            || v_count
            || ' v_endr_code='
            || v_endr_code
            || ' v_pol_code='
            || v_pol_code);

        IF v_count > 0
        THEN
            interface_update_vgl (v_trans_code,     --v_trans_code     NUMBER,
                                  v_user,      --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                                  v_pol_code,
                                  NVL (v_date, TRUNC (SYSDATE)),
                                  --v_date              DATE,
                                  NULL,          --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                                  NULL,          --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                                  'LMS GB RECEIPTS BATCH',
                                  --v_btc_description   VARCHAR2,
                                  'JV',     --v_btc_type             VARCHAR2,
                                  v_rct_branch,  --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                                  'UNALLOCATED PREMIUM',
                                  --v_description       VARCHAR2,
                                  v_rct_code,    --v_ref             VARCHAR2,
                                  v_gl_trans);
        --v_gl_trans  IN OUT  TQ_FMS.Fms_Vouchers_Pkg.Tgl_rec_type,
        END IF;
    EXCEPTION
        WHEN OTHERS
        THEN
            raise_error ('Posting G. Rect..');
    END update_uprocessed_prem;


    PROCEDURE get_gl_narration (
        v_trnt_type     IN     VARCHAR2,
        v_pol_code      IN     NUMBER,
        v_narration        OUT VARCHAR2,
        v_ri_agn_code   IN     NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
        v_claim_no      IN     VARCHAR2 DEFAULT NULL
    )
    IS
        v_agn_name   VARCHAR2 (200);
    BEGIN
        BEGIN
            SELECT agn_name
              INTO v_agn_name
              FROM lms_agencies
             WHERE agn_code = v_ri_agn_code;
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                v_agn_name := NULL;
        END;

        IF v_trnt_type = 'DR_RCTGB'
        THEN
            BEGIN
                SELECT    v_trnt_type
                       || '-'
                       || pol_policy_no
                       || '-'
                       || prp_surname
                  INTO v_narration
                  FROM lms_policies, lms_proposers
                 WHERE pol_prp_code = prp_code AND pol_code = v_pol_code;
            EXCEPTION
                WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND
                THEN
                    v_narration := 'PREMIUM';
                WHEN OTHERS
                THEN
                    raise_error (
                           'ERROR FETCHING THE NARRATION TYPE FOR '
                        || v_trnt_type);
            END;
        ELSIF v_trnt_type IN ('UPR_GB',
                              'UPI_GB',
                              'WHTX',
                              'ADM_GB',
                              'UP_GB',
                              'GLEVY_GB')
        THEN
            BEGIN
                SELECT    v_trnt_type
                       || '-'
                       || pol_policy_no
                       || '-'
                       || prp_surname
                       || '-'
                       || btr_trans_type
                  INTO v_narration
                  FROM lms_policies,
                       lms_proposers,
                       lms_policy_endorsements,
                       lms_business_transactions
                 WHERE     pol_prp_code = prp_code
                       AND endr_pol_code = pol_code
                       AND endr_type = btr_trans_code
                       AND endr_code = v_pol_code;
            EXCEPTION
                WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND
                THEN
                    v_narration := 'PREMIUM';
                WHEN OTHERS
                THEN
                    raise_error (
                           'ERROR FETCHING THE NARRATION TYPE FOR '
                        || v_trnt_type);
            END;
        ELSIF v_trnt_type IN ('UC_GB', 'DAC_G')
        THEN
            BEGIN
                SELECT    v_trnt_type
                       || '-'
                       || pol_policy_no
                       || '-'
                       || agn_name
                       || '-'
                       || btr_trans_type
                  INTO v_narration
                  FROM lms_policies,
                       lms_agencies,
                       lms_policy_endorsements,
                       lms_business_transactions
                 WHERE     pol_code = endr_pol_code
                       AND endr_agen_code = agn_code
                       AND endr_type = btr_trans_code
                       AND endr_code = v_pol_code;
            EXCEPTION
                WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND
                THEN
                    v_narration := 'PREMIUM';
                WHEN OTHERS
                THEN
                    raise_error (
                           'ERROR FETCHING THE NARRATION TYPE FOR '
                        || v_trnt_type);
            END;
        ELSIF v_trnt_type IN ('FS_RP',
                              'FS_RC',
                              'FAC_RP',
                              'FAC_RC')
        THEN
            BEGIN
                SELECT    v_trnt_type
                       || '-'
                       || pol_policy_no
                       || '-'
                       || v_agn_name
                       || '-'
                       || btr_trans_type
                  INTO v_narration
                  FROM lms_policies,
                       lms_policy_endorsements,
                       lms_business_transactions
                 WHERE     pol_code = endr_pol_code
                       AND endr_type = btr_trans_code
                       AND endr_code = v_pol_code;
            EXCEPTION
                WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND
                THEN
                    v_narration := 'PREMIUM';
                WHEN OTHERS
                THEN
                    raise_error (
                           'ERROR FETCHING THE NARRATION TYPE FOR '
                        || v_trnt_type);
            END;
        ELSIF v_trnt_type IN ('IBNR_GB', 'CP_GB')
        THEN
            BEGIN
                SELECT    prp_surname
                       || '-'
                       || v_trnt_type
                       || '-'
                       || clm_no
                       || '-'
                       || caus_desc
                  INTO v_narration
                  FROM lms_claims,
                       lms_causations,
                       lms_policies,
                       lms_proposers
                 WHERE     clm_no = v_claim_no
                       AND clm_caus_sht_desc = caus_sht_desc
                       AND pol_code = clm_pol_code
                       AND pol_prp_code = prp_code;
            EXCEPTION
                WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND
                THEN
                    v_narration := 'CLAIM -' || v_claim_no;
                WHEN OTHERS
                THEN
                    raise_error (
                           'ERROR FETCHING THE NARRATION TYPE FOR '
                        || v_trnt_type);
            END;
        ELSIF v_trnt_type IN ('CR_GB')
        THEN
            --RAISE_ERROR ('v_trnt_type=='||v_trnt_type);
            BEGIN
                SELECT    v_agn_name
                       || '-'
                       || prp_surname
                       || '-'
                       || v_trnt_type
                       || '-'
                       || clm_no
                       || '-'
                       || caus_desc
                  INTO v_narration
                  FROM lms_claims,
                       lms_causations,
                       lms_policies,
                       lms_proposers
                 WHERE     clm_no = v_claim_no
                       AND clm_caus_sht_desc = caus_sht_desc
                       AND pol_code = clm_pol_code
                       AND pol_prp_code = prp_code;
            EXCEPTION
                WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND
                THEN
                    v_narration := 'CLAIM -' || v_claim_no;
                WHEN OTHERS
                THEN
                    raise_error (
                           'ERROR FETCHING THE NARRATION TYPE FOR '
                        || v_trnt_type);
            END;
        END IF;
    END get_gl_narration;


    PROCEDURE post_inactive_prem_to_ref_ac (
        v_pol_code   NUMBER,
        v_trans_no   NUMBER,
        v_user       VARCHAR2,
        v_amt        NUMBER,
        v_to_ref     VARCHAR2 DEFAULT 'N'
    )
    IS
        v_gl_trans                  fms_vouchers_pkg.tgl_rec_type;
        v_vgl_no                    NUMBER;
        v_trnt_code                 VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_trnt_gl_code              VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_unp_trnt_gl_code          VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_trnt_contra_gl_code       VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_contra_acc                VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_msg                       VARCHAR2 (20);

        v_oppr_receipt_trans_code   VARCHAR2 (50);

        v_loan_amt                  NUMBER;

        v_inv_contri                NUMBER;

        v_oppr_chk_drcr             VARCHAR2 (5) := 'D';

        v_narrative                 VARCHAR2 (100);
        v_trans_code                NUMBER;
        v_count                     NUMBER := 0;
        v_trn_rec                   tq_fms.fms_vouchers_pkg.tgl_rec_type;
        v_drcr                      VARCHAR2 (1);

        CURSOR pol IS
            SELECT pol_code,
                   pol_bra_code,
                   pol_prod_type,
                   pol_prod_code,
                   pol_proposal_no,
                   pol_policy_no
              FROM lms_policies
             WHERE pol_code = v_pol_code;
    BEGIN
        FOR pr IN pol
        LOOP
            v_branch_code := pr.pol_bra_code;
            v_prod_code := pr.pol_prod_code;
            v_org_code := fms_interfaces_pkg.get_org (pr.pol_bra_code);

            IF pr.pol_bra_code IS NULL
            THEN
                raise_error ('BRANCH NOT DEFINED FOR THIS RECORD....');
            ELSIF pr.pol_prod_code IS NULL
            THEN
                raise_error (
                       'Define product for Proposal No.'
                    || pr.pol_proposal_no
                    || '...');
            END IF;

            IF NVL (v_amt, 0) > 0
            THEN
                SELECT    TO_NUMBER (TO_CHAR (SYSDATE, 'RRRR'))
                       || lms_transaction_seq.NEXTVAL
                  INTO v_trans_code
                  FROM DUAL;

                get_gl_code ('UNP_PR',
                             pr.pol_prod_code,
                             v_trnt_code,
                             v_trnt_gl_code,
                             v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                             NULL);
                valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                           v_org_code,
                           pr.pol_bra_code,
                           'UNP_PR');
                v_count := v_count + 1;

                IF NVL (v_to_ref, 'Y') = 'Y'
                THEN
                    v_drcr := 'D';
                ELSE
                    v_drcr := 'C';
                END IF;

                interface_append_gl (
                    v_trans_code,               --v_trans_code         NUMBER,
                    v_user,                    --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                    pr.pol_code,                 --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                    pr.pol_prod_code,
                    --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                    NULL,
                    --v_vchr_no          VARCHAR2,
                    NULL,                        --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                    NULL,                        --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                    NULL,                      --v_rcpt_no           VARCHAR2,
                    v_count,                     --v_count             NUMBER,
                    'UNPROCESSED RCPTS - TO REFUND ' || pr.pol_policy_no,
                    --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                    v_amt,
                    --v_amount            NUMBER,
                    v_drcr,                    --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                    v_trnt_gl_code,
                    --v_acc_number1        VARCHAR2,
                    --v_acc_number2            VARCHAR2
                    pr.pol_bra_code,
                    --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                    v_gl_trans,
                    --IN OUT   tq_fms.fms_vouchers_pkg.tgl_rec_type,
                    NULL,                   --v_cad_code  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                    NULL,                  --v_otop_code  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                    NULL,                  --v_fpmt_code  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                    NULL,                   --v_ort_code  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                    NULL,                     --v_btr_no  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                    NULL,                   --v_ppr_code  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                    NULL,                   --v_ocl_code  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                    NULL,
                    --v_agn_code  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                    v_trans_no--v_trans_no  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL
                              );

                IF NVL (v_to_ref, 'Y') = 'Y'
                THEN
                    v_drcr := 'C';
                ELSE
                    v_drcr := 'D';
                END IF;

                get_gl_code ('PLREF',
                             pr.pol_prod_code,
                             v_trnt_code,
                             v_trnt_gl_code,
                             v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                             NULL);
                valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                           v_org_code,
                           pr.pol_bra_code,
                           'PLREF');
                v_count := v_count + 1;
                interface_append_gl (
                    v_trans_code,               --v_trans_code         NUMBER,
                    v_user,                    --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                    pr.pol_code,                 --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                    pr.pol_prod_code,
                    --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                    NULL,
                    --v_vchr_no          VARCHAR2,
                    NULL,                        --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                    NULL,                        --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                    NULL,                      --v_rcpt_no           VARCHAR2,
                    v_count,                     --v_count             NUMBER,
                       'REFUND FROM UNPROCESSED AC '
                    || ' - '
                    || pr.pol_policy_no,
                    --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                    v_amt,
                    --v_amount            NUMBER,
                    v_drcr,                    --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                    v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                    --v_acc_number1        VARCHAR2,
                    --v_acc_number2            VARCHAR2
                    pr.pol_bra_code,
                    --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                    v_gl_trans,
                    --IN OUT   tq_fms.fms_vouchers_pkg.tgl_rec_type,
                    NULL,                   --v_cad_code  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                    NULL,                  --v_otop_code  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                    NULL,                  --v_fpmt_code  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                    NULL,                   --v_ort_code  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                    NULL,                     --v_btr_no  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                    NULL,                   --v_ppr_code  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                    NULL,                   --v_ocl_code  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                    NULL,
                    --v_agn_code  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                    v_trans_no--v_trans_no  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL
                              );
            END IF;

            IF v_count > 0
            THEN
                interface_update_vgl (
                    v_trans_code,                   --v_trans_code     NUMBER,
                    v_user,                    --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                    v_pol_code,                  --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                    TRUNC (SYSDATE),                  --v_date           DATE,
                    NULL,                        --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                    NULL,                        --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                    'LMS INACTIVE POLICY POSTING', --v_btc_description   VARCHAR2,
                    'JV',                       --v_btc_type         VARCHAR2,
                    pr.pol_bra_code,             --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                    'LMS INACTIVE POLICY POSTING ' || pr.pol_policy_no,
                    NULL,                      --v_rcpt_no           VARCHAR2,
                    v_gl_trans,
                    --v_gl_trans  IN OUT  Fms_Vouchers_Pkg.Tgl_rec_type,
                    NULL,              --v_cad_code       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                    NULL,             --v_otop_code       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL)
                    NULL,                   --v_fpmt_code NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                    NULL,                   --v_ort_code  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                    NULL,                   --v_btr_no    NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                    NULL,                   --v_ppr_code  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                    NULL,                    --v_ocl_code NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                    NULL,
                    --v_agn_code NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                    v_trans_no                --v_trans_no NUMBER DEFAULT NULL
                              );
            END IF;
        END LOOP;
    END post_inactive_prem_to_ref_ac;

    PROCEDURE post_grp_credit_note (v_grct_code NUMBER, v_user VARCHAR2)
    IS
        v_gl_trans                  fms_vouchers_pkg.tgl_rec_type;
        v_trnt_code                 VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_trnt_gl_code              VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_trnt_contra_gl_code       VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_dr_trnt_gl_code           VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_cr_trnt_contra_gl_code    VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_vat_trnt_gl_code          VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_vat_trnt_contra_gl_code   VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_trans_code                NUMBER;
        v_count                     NUMBER := 0;
        v_org_code                  NUMBER;
        v_rct_branch                NUMBER;
        v_prod_type                 VARCHAR2 (5);
        v_currency_code             NUMBER;
        v_drcr                      VARCHAR2 (5) := 'D';
        v_drcr_rev                  VARCHAR2 (5) := 'C';
        v_pol_prod_code             NUMBER;
        v_rct_code                  fms_receipts.rct_brh_rct_code%TYPE;
        v_pol_code                  NUMBER;

        v_exp_trnt_gl_code          VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_exp_trnt_contra_gl_code   VARCHAR2 (20);

        CURSOR cur_rcpt IS
            SELECT endr_vat_amt,
                   endr_comm_amt,
                   agn_act_code,
                   pol_prod_code,
                   pol_prod_type,
                   pol_code,
                   endr_hmo_mngnt_expense_amt,
                   endr_hmo_enabled,
                   lms_grp_prem_receipts.*
              FROM lms_grp_prem_receipts,
                   lms_agencies,
                   lms_policies,
                   lms_policy_endorsements
             WHERE     grct_code = v_grct_code
                   AND grct_agen_code = agn_code
                   AND grct_pol_code = pol_code
                   AND grct_endr_code = endr_code
                   AND endr_pol_code = pol_code;
    BEGIN
        ----RAISE_ERROR('HERE...............');
        SELECT    TO_NUMBER (TO_CHAR (SYSDATE, 'RRRR'))
               || lms_transaction_seq.NEXTVAL
          INTO v_trans_code
          FROM DUAL;


        IF v_drcr = 'C'
        THEN
            v_drcr_rev := 'D';
        END IF;

        FOR pr IN cur_rcpt
        LOOP
            v_rct_branch := pr.grct_brn_code;
            v_org_code := fms_interfaces_pkg.get_org (pr.grct_brn_code);
            v_currency_code := pr.grct_cur_code;
            v_pol_code := pr.pol_code;
            v_rct_code := pr.grct_receipt_no;

            IF pr.pol_prod_type NOT IN ('PENS')
            THEN
                IF NVL (pr.grct_amt, 0) <> 0
                THEN
                    get_gl_code ('CR_NOTE_GB',
                                 pr.pol_prod_code,
                                 v_trnt_code,
                                 v_trnt_gl_code,
                                 v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                 NULL,
                                 NULL,
                                 pr.agn_act_code,
                                 pr.grct_brn_code);
                    valid_acc (v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                               v_org_code,
                               pr.grct_brn_code,
                               'CR_NOTE_GB');
                    get_gl_code ('UP_GB',
                                 pr.pol_prod_code,
                                 v_trnt_code,
                                 v_dr_trnt_gl_code,
                                 v_cr_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                 NULL,
                                 NULL,
                                 pr.agn_act_code,
                                 pr.grct_brn_code);
                    valid_acc (v_dr_trnt_gl_code,
                               v_org_code,
                               pr.grct_brn_code,
                               'UP_GB');

                    v_count := v_count + 1;
                    -- RAISE_ERROR('wazi=='||v_dr_trnt_gl_code);

                    --v_dr_trnt_gl_code
                    interface_append_gl (
                        v_trans_code,
                        --v_trans_code           NUMBER,
                        v_user,                --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                        pr.pol_code,             --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                        pr.pol_prod_code,
                        --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                        pr.grct_receipt_no,  --v_vchr_no             VARCHAR2,
                        NULL,                    --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                        NULL,                    --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                        pr.grct_receipt_no,  --v_rcpt_no             VARCHAR2,
                        v_count,                 --v_count             NUMBER,
                        'CREDIT NOTE -' || pr.grct_receipt_no,
                        --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                        NVL (pr.grct_amt, 0),
                        --v_amount            NUMBER,
                        v_drcr,
                        --'D',          --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                        v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                        --v_acc_number2          VARCHAR2,
                        pr.grct_brn_code,
                        --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                        v_gl_trans);
                    --v_trn_rec   IN OUT  fms_test.Fms_Vouchers_Pkg.Tgl_rec_type,
                    interface_append_gl (
                        v_trans_code,
                        --v_trans_code           NUMBER,
                        v_user,                --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                        pr.pol_code,             --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                        pr.pol_prod_code,
                        --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
