                        pr.grct_receipt_no,  --v_vchr_no             VARCHAR2,
                        NULL,                    --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                        NULL,                    --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                        pr.grct_receipt_no,  --v_rcpt_no             VARCHAR2,
                        v_count,                 --v_count             NUMBER,
                        'CREDIT NOTE -' || pr.grct_receipt_no,
                        --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                        NVL (pr.grct_amt, 0),
                        --v_amount            NUMBER,
                        v_drcr_rev,
                        --'C',          --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                        v_dr_trnt_gl_code,
                        --v_acc_number2          VARCHAR2,
                        pr.grct_brn_code,
                        --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                        v_gl_trans);

                    IF NVL (pr.endr_comm_amt, 0) <> 0
                    THEN
                        lms_api.get_gl_code ('UC_GB',
                                             pr.pol_prod_code,
                                             v_trnt_code,
                                             v_dr_trnt_gl_code,
                                             v_cr_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                             NULL,
                                             NULL,
                                             pr.agn_act_code,
                                             pr.grct_brn_code);
                        lms_api.valid_acc (v_cr_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                           v_org_code,
                                           pr.grct_brn_code,
                                           'UC_GB');
                        v_count := v_count + 2;
                        interface_append_gl (
                            v_trans_code,
                            --v_trans_code           NUMBER,
                            v_user,            --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                            pr.pol_code,         --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                            pr.pol_prod_code,
                            --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                            pr.grct_receipt_no, --v_vchr_no             VARCHAR2,
                            NULL,                --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                            NULL,                --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                            pr.grct_receipt_no, --v_rcpt_no             VARCHAR2,
                            v_count,             --v_count             NUMBER,
                            'CREDIT NOTE COMMISSION-' || pr.grct_receipt_no,
                            --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                            NVL (pr.endr_comm_amt, 0),
                            --v_amount            NUMBER,
                            v_drcr,
                            v_cr_trnt_contra_gl_code, --v_acc_number1         VARCHAR2,
                            v_trnt_gl_code,  --v_acc_number2         VARCHAR2,
                            pr.grct_brn_code,    --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                            v_gl_trans);

                        IF NVL (pr.endr_vat_amt, 0) != 0
                        THEN
                            lms_api.get_gl_code ('VAT_GB',
                                                 pr.pol_prod_code,
                                                 v_trnt_code,
                                                 v_vat_trnt_gl_code,
                                                 v_vat_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                                 NULL,
                                                 NULL,
                                                 pr.agn_act_code,
                                                 pr.grct_brn_code);
                            lms_api.valid_acc (v_vat_trnt_gl_code,
                                               v_org_code,
                                               pr.grct_brn_code,
                                               'VAT_GB');
                            lms_api.valid_acc (v_vat_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                               v_org_code,
                                               pr.grct_brn_code,
                                               'VAT_GB CONTRA');

                            v_count := v_count + 2;
                            interface_append_gl (
                                v_trans_code,
                                --v_trans_code           NUMBER,
                                v_user,        --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                                pr.pol_code,     --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                                pr.pol_prod_code,
                                --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                                pr.grct_receipt_no, --v_vchr_no             VARCHAR2,
                                NULL,            --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                                NULL,            --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                                pr.grct_receipt_no, --v_rcpt_no             VARCHAR2,
                                v_count,         --v_count             NUMBER,
                                'CREDIT NOTE VAT -' || pr.grct_receipt_no,
                                --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                                NVL (pr.endr_vat_amt, 0),
                                --v_amount            NUMBER,
                                v_drcr,
                                v_vat_trnt_gl_code, --v_acc_number1         VARCHAR2,
                                v_trnt_gl_code, --v_acc_number2         VARCHAR2,
                                pr.grct_brn_code, --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                                v_gl_trans);
                        END IF;
                    END IF;

                    IF     NVL (pr.endr_hmo_mngnt_expense_amt, 0) != 0
                       AND NVL (pr.endr_hmo_enabled, 'N') = 'Y'
                    THEN
                        lms_api.get_gl_code ('MXP_GB',
                                             pr.pol_prod_code,
                                             v_trnt_code,
                                             v_exp_trnt_gl_code,
                                             v_exp_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                             NULL,
                                             NULL,
                                             pr.agn_act_code,
                                             pr.grct_brn_code);
                        lms_api.valid_acc (v_exp_trnt_gl_code,
                                           v_org_code,
                                           pr.grct_brn_code,
                                           'MXP_GB');
                        lms_api.valid_acc (v_exp_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                           v_org_code,
                                           pr.grct_brn_code,
                                           'MXP_GB CONTRA');

                        v_count := v_count + 2;
                        interface_append_gl (
                            v_trans_code,
                            --v_trans_code           NUMBER,
                            v_user,            --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                            pr.pol_code,         --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                            pr.pol_prod_code,
                            --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                            pr.grct_receipt_no, --v_vchr_no             VARCHAR2,
                            NULL,                --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                            NULL,                --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                            pr.grct_receipt_no, --v_rcpt_no             VARCHAR2,
                            v_count,             --v_count             NUMBER,
                               'CREDIT NOTE MANAGEMENT EXPENSE -'
                            || pr.grct_receipt_no,
                            --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                            NVL (pr.endr_hmo_mngnt_expense_amt, 0),
                            --v_amount            NUMBER,
                            v_drcr,
                            v_exp_trnt_gl_code, --v_acc_number1         VARCHAR2,
                            v_trnt_gl_code,  --v_acc_number2         VARCHAR2,
                            pr.grct_brn_code,    --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                            v_gl_trans);
                    END IF;
                END IF;
            END IF;
        END LOOP;

        IF v_count > 0
        THEN
            interface_update_vgl (v_trans_code,     --v_trans_code     NUMBER,
                                  v_user,      --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                                  v_pol_code,    --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                                  TRUNC (SYSDATE), --v_date              DATE,
                                  NULL,          --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                                  NULL,          --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                                  'LMS GB CREDIT NOTES BATCH', --v_btc_description   VARCHAR2,
                                  'JV',     --v_btc_type             VARCHAR2,
                                  v_rct_branch,  --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                                  'GRP LIFE CREDIT NOTES', --v_description       VARCHAR2,
                                  v_rct_code, --v_ref_no             VARCHAR2,
                                  v_gl_trans,
                                  NULL,
                                  NULL,
                                  NULL,
                                  NULL,
                                  NULL,
                                  NULL,
                                  NULL,
                                  NULL,
                                  NULL,
                                  v_currency_code); --v_gl_trans  IN OUT  fms_test.Fms_Vouchers_Pkg.Tgl_rec_type,

            UPDATE lms_grp_prem_receipts
               SET grct_credit_note_posted = 'Y'
             WHERE grct_code = v_grct_code;
        END IF;
    END post_grp_credit_note;

    PROCEDURE post_grp_credit_note_setlmnt (
        v_pol_code        NUMBER,
        v_grct_code       NUMBER,
        v_pol_prod_code   NUMBER,
        v_rct_code        fms_receipts.rct_brh_rct_code%TYPE,
        v_user            VARCHAR2,
        v_drcr            VARCHAR2 DEFAULT 'D'
    )
    IS
        v_gl_trans                  fms_vouchers_pkg.tgl_rec_type;
        v_trnt_code                 VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_trnt_gl_code              VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_trnt_contra_gl_code       VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_dr_trnt_gl_code           VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_cr_trnt_contra_gl_code    VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_vat_trnt_gl_code          VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_vat_trnt_contra_gl_code   VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_trans_code                NUMBER;
        v_count                     NUMBER := 0;
        v_org_code                  NUMBER;
        v_rct_branch                NUMBER;
        v_prod_type                 VARCHAR2 (5);
        v_currency_code             NUMBER;
        v_drcr_rev                  VARCHAR2 (5) := 'C';
        v_crn_trnt_code             VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_crn_trnt_gl_code          VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_crn_trnt_contra_gl_code   VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_cr_note_grct_code         NUMBER;
        v_cr_note_bal               NUMBER;
        v_cr_bal_to_settle          NUMBER;
        v_cr_comm_to_settle         NUMBER;
        v_cr_vat_to_settle          NUMBER;

        CURSOR cur_rcpt IS
            SELECT agn_act_code, lms_grp_prem_receipts.*
              FROM lms_grp_prem_receipts, lms_agencies
             WHERE grct_code = v_grct_code AND grct_agen_code = agn_code;

        CURSOR cur_credit_note (v_endr_code NUMBER)
        IS
            SELECT endr_vat_amt,
                   endr_comm_amt,
                   agn_act_code,
                   pol_prod_code,
                   pol_prod_type,
                   pol_code,
                   lms_grp_prem_receipts.*
              FROM lms_grp_prem_receipts,
                   lms_agencies,
                   lms_policies,
                   lms_policy_endorsements
             WHERE     grct_agen_code = agn_code
                   AND grct_pol_code = pol_code
                   AND grct_endr_code = v_endr_code
                   AND endr_pol_code = pol_code
                   AND grct_credit_note = 'Y'
                   AND NVL (grct_credit_amt_settled, 0) < NVL (grct_amt, 0);
    BEGIN
        --RAISE_ERROR('HERE...............1');
        SELECT    TO_NUMBER (TO_CHAR (SYSDATE, 'RRRR'))
               || lms_transaction_seq.NEXTVAL
          INTO v_trans_code
          FROM DUAL;

        SELECT pol_prod_type
          INTO v_prod_type
          FROM lms_policies
         WHERE pol_code = v_pol_code;

        IF v_drcr = 'C'
        THEN
            v_drcr_rev := 'D';
        END IF;

        FOR pr IN cur_rcpt
        LOOP
            v_rct_branch := pr.grct_brn_code;

            v_org_code := fms_interfaces_pkg.get_org (pr.grct_brn_code);
            v_currency_code := pr.grct_cur_code;

            --RAISE_ERROR('HERE.......2.END,v_grct_code=='||v_grct_code||';grct_endr_code=='||pr.grct_endr_code||';v_currency_code=='||v_currency_code);

            FOR cr IN cur_credit_note (pr.grct_endr_code)
            LOOP
                v_cr_note_bal :=
                      NVL (cr.grct_amt, 0)
                    - NVL (cr.grct_credit_amt_settled, 0);

                -- RAISE_ERROR('HERE.......2.END,v_cr_bal_to_settle=='||v_cr_bal_to_settle||';cr_note_grct_code=='||cr_note_grct_code);

                IF NVL (pr.grct_amt, 0) < v_cr_note_bal
                THEN
                    v_cr_bal_to_settle := NVL (pr.grct_amt, 0);
                    v_cr_comm_to_settle :=
                          NVL (cr.endr_comm_amt, 0)
                        / NVL (cr.grct_amt, 0)
                        * v_cr_bal_to_settle;
                    v_cr_vat_to_settle :=
                          NVL (cr.endr_vat_amt, 0)
                        / NVL (cr.grct_amt, 0)
                        * v_cr_bal_to_settle;
                ELSE
                    v_cr_bal_to_settle := v_cr_note_bal;
                    v_cr_comm_to_settle :=
                          NVL (cr.endr_comm_amt, 0)
                        / NVL (cr.grct_amt, 0)
                        * v_cr_bal_to_settle;
                    v_cr_vat_to_settle :=
                          NVL (cr.endr_vat_amt, 0)
                        / NVL (cr.grct_amt, 0)
                        * v_cr_bal_to_settle;
                END IF;

                --RAISE_ERROR('HERE.......3.END,v_cr_bal_to_settle=='||v_cr_bal_to_settle||';cr_note_grct_code=='||cr_note_grct_code);
                IF NVL (v_cr_bal_to_settle, 0) <> 0
                THEN
                    get_gl_code ('UP_GB',
                                 v_pol_prod_code,
                                 v_trnt_code,
                                 v_trnt_gl_code,
                                 v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                 NULL,
                                 -- v_tt_code                        NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                 NULL,
                                 -- v_renewal                        VARCHAR2 DEFAULT 'N',
                                 pr.agn_act_code,
                                 -- v_act_code                       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                                 pr.grct_brn_code);
                    valid_acc (v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                               v_org_code,
                               pr.grct_brn_code,
                               'UP_GB');

                    get_gl_code ('DR_RCTGB',
                                 v_pol_prod_code,
                                 v_crn_trnt_code,
                                 v_crn_trnt_gl_code,
                                 v_crn_trnt_contra_gl_code);
                    valid_acc (v_crn_trnt_gl_code,
                               v_org_code,
                               pr.grct_brn_code,
                               'DR_RCTGB');

                    v_count := v_count + 1;

                    interface_append_gl (v_trans_code,
                                         --v_trans_code           NUMBER,
                                         v_user, --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                                         v_pol_code, --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                                         v_pol_prod_code,
                                         --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                                         v_rct_code, --v_vchr_no             VARCHAR2,
                                         NULL,   --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                                         NULL,   --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                                         v_rct_code, --v_rcpt_no             VARCHAR2,
                                         v_count, --v_count             NUMBER,
                                         'PREMIUM -' || v_rct_code,
                                         --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                                         NVL (v_cr_bal_to_settle, 0),
                                         --v_amount            NUMBER,
                                         v_drcr, --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                                         v_crn_trnt_gl_code, --v_acc_number1         VARCHAR2,
                                         v_trnt_contra_gl_code, --v_acc_number2         VARCHAR2,
                                         pr.grct_brn_code, --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                                         v_gl_trans);


                    IF NVL (v_cr_comm_to_settle, 0) <> 0
                    THEN
                        lms_api.get_gl_code ('UC_GB',
                                             v_pol_prod_code,
                                             v_trnt_code,
                                             v_dr_trnt_gl_code,
                                             v_cr_trnt_contra_gl_code);
                        lms_api.valid_acc (v_cr_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                           v_org_code,
                                           pr.grct_brn_code,
                                           'UC_GB CONTRA');
                        v_count := v_count + 2;
                        interface_append_gl (
                            v_trans_code,
                            --v_trans_code           NUMBER,
                            v_user,            --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                            v_pol_code,          --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                            v_pol_prod_code,
                            --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                            pr.grct_receipt_no, --v_vchr_no             VARCHAR2,
                            NULL,                --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                            NULL,                --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                            pr.grct_receipt_no, --v_rcpt_no             VARCHAR2,
                            v_count,             --v_count             NUMBER,
                            'CREDIT NOTE COMMISSION-' || pr.grct_receipt_no,
                            --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                            NVL (v_cr_comm_to_settle, 0),
                            --v_amount            NUMBER,
                            v_drcr_rev,
                            v_cr_trnt_contra_gl_code, --v_acc_number1         VARCHAR2,
                            v_trnt_contra_gl_code, --v_acc_number2         VARCHAR2,
                            pr.grct_brn_code,    --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                            v_gl_trans);

                        IF NVL (v_cr_vat_to_settle, 0) != 0
                        THEN
                            lms_api.get_gl_code ('VAT_GB',
                                                 v_pol_prod_code,
                                                 v_trnt_code,
                                                 v_vat_trnt_gl_code,
                                                 v_vat_trnt_contra_gl_code);
                            lms_api.valid_acc (v_vat_trnt_gl_code,
                                               v_org_code,
                                               pr.grct_brn_code,
                                               'VAT_GB');
                            lms_api.valid_acc (v_vat_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                               v_org_code,
                                               pr.grct_brn_code,
                                               'VAT_GB CONTRA');

                            v_count := v_count + 2;
                            interface_append_gl (
                                v_trans_code,
                                --v_trans_code           NUMBER,
                                v_user,        --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                                v_pol_code,      --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                                v_pol_prod_code,
                                --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                                pr.grct_receipt_no, --v_vchr_no             VARCHAR2,
                                NULL,            --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                                NULL,            --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                                pr.grct_receipt_no, --v_rcpt_no             VARCHAR2,
                                v_count,         --v_count             NUMBER,
                                'CREDIT NOTE VAT -' || pr.grct_receipt_no,
                                --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                                NVL (v_cr_vat_to_settle, 0),
                                --v_amount            NUMBER,
                                v_drcr_rev,
                                v_vat_trnt_contra_gl_code, --v_acc_number1         VARCHAR2,
                                v_trnt_contra_gl_code, --v_acc_number2         VARCHAR2,
                                pr.grct_brn_code, --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                                v_gl_trans);
                        END IF;
                    END IF;
                END IF;

                --raise_error('v_cr_bal_to_settle=='||v_cr_bal_to_settle||';v_cr_comm_to_settle=='||v_cr_comm_to_settle||';v_cr_vat_to_settle=='||v_cr_vat_to_settle);

                IF v_count > 0 AND cr.grct_code IS NOT NULL
                THEN
                    interface_update_vgl (v_trans_code, --v_trans_code     NUMBER,
                                          v_user, --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                                          v_pol_code, --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                                          TRUNC (SYSDATE), --v_date              DATE,
                                          NULL,  --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                                          NULL,  --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                                          'LMS GB RECEIPTS BATCH', --v_btc_description   VARCHAR2,
                                          'JV', --v_btc_type             VARCHAR2,
                                          v_rct_branch, --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                                          'GRP LIFE RECEIPT ALLOCATIONS', --v_description       VARCHAR2,
                                          v_rct_code, --v_ref_no             VARCHAR2,
                                          v_gl_trans,
                                          NULL,
                                          NULL,
                                          NULL,
                                          NULL,
                                          NULL,
                                          NULL,
                                          NULL,
                                          NULL,
                                          NULL,
                                          v_currency_code); --v_gl_trans  IN OUT  fms_test.Fms_Vouchers_Pkg.Tgl_rec_type,

                    UPDATE lms_grp_prem_receipts
                       SET grct_credit_amt_settled =
                               (  NVL (grct_credit_amt_settled, 0)
                                + NVL (v_cr_bal_to_settle, 0))
                     WHERE grct_code = cr.grct_code;
                END IF;
            END LOOP;
        END LOOP;
    END post_grp_credit_note_setlmnt;

    PROCEDURE unprocess_posting_corrections (v_oprcode NUMBER DEFAULT NULL)
    IS
        v_opr_code                NUMBER;
        v_prod_specific           VARCHAR2(1);

        CURSOR all_receipts IS
            SELECT *
              FROM (SELECT opr_code,
                           opr_pol_code,
                           post_date,
                           amount,
                           opr_amt,
                           lms_process_receipts.rcpt_balance (opr_code)    unprocessed
                      FROM (  SELECT opr_code,
                                     opr_pol_code,
                                     opr_amt,
                                     SUM (
                                           NVL (
                                               DECODE (
                                                   itb_acc_number,
                                                   trnt_gl_code,   DECODE (
                                                                       itb_drcr,
                                                                       'C', 1,
                                                                       -1)
                                                                 * itb_amount),
                                               0)
                                         + NVL (
                                               DECODE (
                                                   itb_acc_number2,
                                                   trnt_gl_code,   DECODE (
                                                                       itb_drcr,
                                                                       'D', 1,
                                                                       -1)
                                                                 * itb_amount),
                                               0))              amount,
                                     MAX (itb_vgl_post_date)    post_date
                                FROM lms_interface_table,
                                     lms_ord_prem_receipts,
                                     lms_transaction_types
                               WHERE     itb_opr_code = opr_code
                                     AND trnt_code = 'UNP_PR'
                                     AND v_prod_specific = 'N'
                                     AND (   v_oprcode IS NULL
                                          OR opr_code = v_oprcode)
                                     AND (   itb_acc_number = trnt_gl_code
                                          OR itb_acc_number2 = trnt_gl_code)
                                     AND opr_fms_receipt_pk IS NOT NULL
                            GROUP BY opr_code, opr_pol_code, opr_amt

                            UNION ALL
                            
                              SELECT opr_code,
                                     opr_pol_code,
                                     opr_amt,
                                     SUM (
                                           NVL (
                                               DECODE (
                                                   itb_acc_number,
                                                   trap_acc_no,   DECODE (
                                                                       itb_drcr,
                                                                       'C', 1,
                                                                       -1)
                                                                 * itb_amount),
                                               0)
                                         + NVL (
                                               DECODE (
                                                   itb_acc_number2,
                                                   trap_acc_no,   DECODE (
                                                                       itb_drcr,
                                                                       'D', 1,
                                                                       -1)
                                                                 * itb_amount),
                                               0))              amount,
                                     MAX (itb_vgl_post_date)    post_date
                                FROM lms_interface_table,
                                     lms_ord_prem_receipts,
                                     lms_product_transactions,
                                     lms_policies
                               WHERE     itb_opr_code = opr_code
                                     AND trap_trnt_code = 'UNP_PR'
                                     AND v_prod_specific = 'Y'
                                     AND pol_code = opr_pol_code
                                     AND trap_prod_code = NVL(itb_prod_code,pol_prod_code)
                                     AND (   v_oprcode IS NULL
                                          OR opr_code = v_oprcode)
                                     AND (   itb_acc_number = trap_acc_no
                                          OR itb_acc_number2 = trap_acc_no)
                                     AND opr_fms_receipt_pk IS NOT NULL
                            GROUP BY opr_code, opr_pol_code, opr_amt
                            )
                     WHERE amount > 0)
             WHERE     opr_amt >= amount
                   AND amount > unprocessed
                   AND amount > 0.1
                   ORDER BY opr_pol_code, opr_code;


        CURSOR receipt (v_opr_code NUMBER)
        IS
              SELECT NVL (SUM (opr_loan_pymt_amt), 0)
                         loan_amt,
                     NVL (SUM (opr_refund_amt), 0)
                         suspense_amt,
                     -- OPR_PMTH_CODE,
                     NVL (SUM (premium_amt), 0)
                         premium_amt,
                     NVL (SUM (pension_contr), 0)
                         pension_contr,
                     NVL (
                         SUM (
                             DECODE (pol_prod_type,
                                     'IN', NVL (investment_fee, 0),
                                     'PN', NVL (investment_fee, 0),
                                     'AN', NVL (investment_fee, 0),
                                     NVL (opr_policy_fee, 0))),
                         0)
                         investment_fee,
                     NVL (SUM (investment_contri), 0)
                         investment_contri,
                     NVL (SUM (investment_admin), 0)
                         investment_admin,
                     NVL (SUM (opr_fund_client_contr), 0)
                         comfnd,
                     (NVL (SUM (prem_comm), 0) + NVL (SUM (pens_comm), 0))
                         prem_comm,
                     NVL (SUM (pens_comm), 0)
                         pens_comm,
                     NVL (SUM (prem_tax), 0)
                         prem_tax,
                     NVL (SUM (opr_chk_comm), 0)
                         chkoff_comm,
                     pol_bra_code,
                     pol_prod_code,
                     pol_type,
                     pol_prod_type,
                     NVL (opr_alloc_to, 'PR')
                         alloc_to,
                     NVL (
                         (SELECT rct_acct_type_id
                            FROM fms_receipts
                           WHERE rct_no = opr_fms_receipt_pk),
                         DECODE (NVL (endr_pay_method, 'C'),
                                 'K', 'CK',
                                 NVL (endr_pay_method, 'C')))
                         acc_type,
                     opr_code,
                     pol_code,
                     NVL (pol_policy_no, pol_proposal_no)
                         policy_no,
                     opr_fms_receipt_pk,
                     opr_drcr,
                     DECODE (opr_drcr, 'D', 'C', 'D')
                         opr_drcr_reverse,
                     rct_desc,
                     opr_receipt_no,
                     opr_fund_posted
                FROM lms_ord_prem_receipts,
                     fms_receipts,
                     lms_policies,
                     lms_policy_endorsements,
                     (  SELECT opri_opr_code,
                               NVL (SUM (opri_amt), 0)              premium_amt,
                               NVL (SUM (opri_prem_tax_amt), 0)     prem_tax,
                               --NVL(SUM(OPRI_CHK_COMM_AMT),0) chkoff_comm,
                               NVL (SUM (opri_comm_amt), 0)         prem_comm
                          FROM lms_ord_receipt_instlmnts
                         WHERE opri_opr_code = v_opr_code
                      GROUP BY opri_opr_code),
                     (  SELECT pndpo_opr_code,
                               NVL (SUM (pndpo_tot_amt), 0)
                                   pension_contr,
                               NVL (SUM (pndpo_admin_fee), 0)
                                   investment_fee,
                               NVL (SUM (pndpo_empye_amt), 0)
                                   investment_contri,
                               NVL (SUM (pndpo_empyr_amt), 0)
                                   investment_admin,
                               NVL (SUM (pndpo_comm_amt), 0)
                                   pens_comm
                          FROM lms_pension_deposits_ord
                         WHERE pndpo_opr_code = v_opr_code
                      GROUP BY pndpo_opr_code)
               WHERE     pol_code = opr_pol_code
                     AND pol_current_endr_code = endr_code
                     AND opr_code = v_opr_code
                     AND opr_fms_receipt_pk = rct_no(+)
                     AND opri_opr_code(+) = opr_code
                     AND pndpo_opr_code(+) = opr_code
            GROUP BY opr_code,
                     pol_bra_code,
                     pol_prod_code,
                     pol_type,
                     pol_prod_type,
                     opr_alloc_to,
                     endr_pay_method,
                     pol_code,
                     opr_fms_receipt_pk,
                     opr_drcr,
                     DECODE (opr_drcr, 'D', 'C', 'D'),
                     rct_desc,
                     opr_receipt_no,
                     opr_fund_posted,
                     pol_policy_no,
                     pol_proposal_no;

        v_rcpt_bal                NUMBER;
        v_cur_code                NUMBER;
        v_prem_amt                NUMBER;
        v_chkoff_comm             NUMBER;
        v_loan_amt                NUMBER;
        v_pens_amt                NUMBER;
        v_inv_admin               NUMBER;
        v_inv_fee                 NUMBER;
        v_inv_contri              NUMBER;
        v_comfnd                  NUMBER;
        v_tot_amt                 NUMBER;
        v_count                   NUMBER;
        v_tcg_rec                 fms_vouchers_pkg.tcg_rec_type;
        v_gl_trans                fms_vouchers_pkg.tgl_rec_type;
        v_cb_rec                  fms_vouchers_pkg.tcb_rec_type;
        v_cb_count                NUMBER := 1;
        v_description             VARCHAR2 (1000);
        v_rct_paymt_mode          fms_receipts.rct_paymt_mode%TYPE;
        v_trnt_code               VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_trnt_gl_code            VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_trnt_contra_gl_code     VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_org_code                NUMBER := 1;
        v_trans_code              NUMBER;
        v_user                    VARCHAR2 (30)
            := pkg_global_vars.get_pvarchar2 ('PKG_GLOBAL_VARS.PVG_USERNAME');
        v_tot_inv_fee             NUMBER;
        v_fms_receipt_pk          NUMBER;
        v_bct_code                NUMBER;
        v_btc_type                VARCHAR2 (5);
        v_vcb_no                  NUMBER;
        v_default_user            VARCHAR2 (50);
        v_contra_acc              VARCHAR2 (50);
        v_bank_acc                VARCHAR2 (50);
        v_itb_amount              NUMBER;
        v_loop                    NUMBER;
        v_opr_drcr                VARCHAR2 (1);
        v_opr_drcr_reverse        VARCHAR2 (1);
        v_inv_fee_clnup_amt       NUMBER;
        v_vgl_no                  NUMBER;
        v_comp_param              VARCHAR2 (5);
        v_param_val               VARCHAR2 (5);
        v_fms_unknown_reposting   VARCHAR2 (1);
        v_bank_amt                NUMBER;
    BEGIN
        BEGIN
            lms_ord_misc.system_param_val ('CONSOLIDATE_COMP_FUND',
                                           v_comp_param);
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                raise_application_error (-20001, 'PARAM ERROR...');
        END;

        BEGIN
            fms_settings_pkg.system_param_val ('USE_CONTROL_ACCOUNT',
                                               v_param_val);
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                v_param_val := 'Y';
        END;
        
        SELECT trnt_prod_applicable
        INTO v_prod_specific
        FROM lms_transaction_types
        WHERE trnt_code = 'UNP_PR';

        FOR ar IN all_receipts
        LOOP
            v_opr_code := ar.opr_code;
            v_loop := 0;

            FOR r IN receipt (ar.opr_code)
            LOOP
                v_loop := v_loop + 1;
            END LOOP;

            IF v_loop > 1
            THEN
                CONTINUE;
            END IF;

            FOR r IN receipt (ar.opr_code)
            LOOP
                BEGIN
                    v_rcpt_bal := 0;
                    v_prem_amt := 0;
                    v_chkoff_comm := 0;
                    v_loan_amt := 0;
                    v_pens_amt := 0;
                    v_inv_admin := 0;
                    v_inv_fee := 0;
                    v_inv_contri := 0;
                    v_comfnd := 0;
                    v_tot_amt := 0;
                    v_count := 0;
                    v_fms_receipt_pk := r.opr_fms_receipt_pk;
                    v_vcb_no := NULL;
                    v_opr_drcr := r.opr_drcr;
                    v_opr_drcr_reverse := r.opr_drcr_reverse;
                    v_vgl_no := NULL;
                    v_gl_trans.delete;
                    v_tcg_rec.delete;
                    v_cb_rec.delete;

                    IF v_user IS NULL
                    THEN
                        v_user := 'ADMIN';                    --r.opr_done_by;
                        pkg_global_vars.set_pvar (
                            'pkg_global_vars.pvg_username',
                            v_user);
                    END IF;

                    v_fms_receipt_pk := r.opr_fms_receipt_pk;
                    v_description := r.rct_desc;

                    IF v_user IS NOT NULL
                    THEN
                        v_default_user := v_user;
                    END IF;

                    IF v_user IS NULL
                    THEN
                        v_user := v_default_user;
                    END IF;

                    v_cur_code :=
                        lms_interfaces_pkg.lms_def_cur (r.pol_bra_code);
                    v_rct_paymt_mode :=
                        fms_rcts_pkg.rct_paymt_mode (v_fms_receipt_pk);
                    v_org_code := fms_interfaces_pkg.get_org (r.pol_bra_code);


                    --v_bct_code := fms_rcts_pkg.get_rcpt_debited_bank(v_fms_receipt_pk);
                    --v_contra_acc := fms_gen_pkg.bnk_acct_no (v_bct_code);
                    v_bank_acc :=
                        get_receipting_acc (
                            v_rct_paymt_mode,
                            r.pol_prod_code,
                            v_org_code,
                            r.pol_bra_code,
                            NVL (v_fms_unknown_reposting, 'N'),
                            v_param_val,
                            v_fms_receipt_pk);

                    IF r.alloc_to = 'PR'
                    THEN
                        get_gl_code ('UNP_PR',
                                     r.pol_prod_code,
                                     v_trnt_code,
                                     v_contra_acc,
                                     v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                     NULL);
                        valid_acc (v_contra_acc,
                                   v_org_code,
                                   r.pol_bra_code,
                                   'UNP_PR');
                    ELSIF r.alloc_to = 'LN'
                    THEN
                        get_gl_code ('UNP_LN',
                                     r.pol_prod_code,
                                     v_trnt_code,
                                     v_contra_acc,
                                     v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                     NULL);
                        valid_acc (v_contra_acc,
                                   v_org_code,
                                   r.pol_bra_code,
                                   'UNP_LN');
                    ELSIF r.alloc_to = 'PN'
                    THEN
                        get_gl_code ('UNP_PN',
                                     r.pol_prod_code,
                                     v_trnt_code,
                                     v_contra_acc,
                                     v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                     NULL);
                        valid_acc (v_contra_acc,
                                   v_org_code,
                                   r.pol_bra_code,
                                   'UNP_PN');
                    END IF;

                    SELECT    TO_NUMBER (TO_CHAR (SYSDATE, 'RRRR'))
                           || lms_transaction_seq.NEXTVAL
                      INTO v_trans_code
                      FROM DUAL;

                    IF NVL (r.loan_amt, 0) <> 0
                    THEN
                        SELECT SUM (
                                   DECODE (itb_drcr, 'D', -1, 1) * itb_amount)    itb_amount
                          INTO v_itb_amount
                          FROM lms_interface_table t, lms_ord_prem_receipts
                         WHERE     itb_opr_code = opr_code
                               AND itb_opr_code IS NOT NULL
                               AND itb_opr_code = v_opr_code      --2016738076
                               AND itb_transaction_type IN
                                       ('APPEND_GL', 'APPEND_CB')
                               AND itb_narrative LIKE 'ALLOCATED LOAN%';

                        SELECT     DECODE (r.opr_drcr, 'D', -1, 1)
                                 * NVL (r.loan_amt, 0)
                               - NVL (v_itb_amount, 0)
                          INTO v_loan_amt
                          FROM DUAL;
                    END IF;

                    IF NVL (r.premium_amt, 0) <> 0
                    THEN
                        SELECT SUM (
                                   DECODE (itb_drcr, 'D', -1, 1) * itb_amount)    itb_amount
                          INTO v_itb_amount
                          FROM lms_interface_table t, lms_ord_prem_receipts
                         WHERE     itb_opr_code = opr_code
                               AND itb_opr_code IS NOT NULL
                               AND itb_opr_code = v_opr_code --2016738076 --20171606344
                               AND itb_transaction_type IN
                                       ('APPEND_GL', 'APPEND_CB')
                               AND (   itb_narrative LIKE
                                           'ALLOCATED PREMIUM%'
                                    OR t.itb_narrative LIKE 'PREMIUM INCOME%'
                                    OR t.itb_narrative LIKE 'NF PREMIUM%');

                        SELECT     DECODE (r.opr_drcr, 'D', -1, 1)
                                 * NVL (r.premium_amt, 0)
                               - NVL (v_itb_amount, 0)
                          INTO v_prem_amt
                          FROM DUAL;
                    END IF;

                    SELECT SUM (DECODE (itb_drcr, 'D', -1, 1) * itb_amount)    itb_amount
                      INTO v_itb_amount
                      FROM lms_interface_table t, lms_ord_prem_receipts
                     WHERE     itb_opr_code = opr_code
                           AND itb_opr_code IS NOT NULL
                           AND itb_opr_code = v_opr_code          --2016738076
                           AND itb_transaction_type IN
                                   ('APPEND_GL', 'APPEND_CB')
                           AND (   t.itb_narrative LIKE 'POLICY FEE%'
                                OR t.itb_narrative LIKE 'INVESTMENT FEE%');

                    IF NVL (r.investment_fee, 0) <> 0
                    THEN
                        SELECT     DECODE (r.opr_drcr, 'D', -1, 1)
                                 * NVL (r.investment_fee, 0)
                               - NVL (v_itb_amount, 0)
                          INTO v_inv_fee
                          FROM DUAL;
                    ELSIF (    NVL (r.investment_fee, 0) = 0
                           AND NVL (v_itb_amount, 0) <> 0)
                    THEN
                        SELECT SUM (
                                   DECODE (itb_drcr, 'D', -1, 1) * itb_amount)    itb_amount
                          INTO v_inv_fee_clnup_amt
                          FROM lms_interface_table t, lms_ord_prem_receipts
                         WHERE     itb_opr_code = opr_code
                               AND itb_opr_code IS NOT NULL
                               AND itb_opr_code = v_opr_code      --2016738076
                               AND itb_transaction_type IN
                                       ('APPEND_GL', 'APPEND_CB')
                               AND (   t.itb_narrative LIKE 'POLICY FEE%'
                                    OR t.itb_narrative LIKE 'INVESTMENT FEE%')
                               AND t.itb_narrative LIKE '%CLNUP';

                        IF v_inv_fee_clnup_amt <> 0
                        THEN
                            v_itb_amount :=
                                  NVL (v_itb_amount, 0)
                                - NVL (v_inv_fee_clnup_amt, 0);
                        END IF;

                        SELECT     DECODE (r.opr_drcr, 'D', -1, 1)
                                 * NVL (r.investment_fee, 0)
                               - NVL (v_itb_amount, 0)
                          INTO v_inv_fee
                          FROM DUAL;
                    END IF;

                    IF NVL (r.investment_contri, 0) <> 0
                    THEN
                        SELECT SUM (
                                   DECODE (itb_drcr, 'D', -1, 1) * itb_amount)    itb_amount
                          INTO v_itb_amount
                          FROM lms_interface_table t, lms_ord_prem_receipts
                         WHERE     itb_opr_code = opr_code
                               AND itb_opr_code IS NOT NULL
                               AND itb_opr_code = v_opr_code      --2016738076
                               AND itb_transaction_type IN
                                       ('APPEND_GL', 'APPEND_CB')
                               AND (t.itb_narrative LIKE
                                        'INVESTMENT PREMIUM%');

                        SELECT     DECODE (r.opr_drcr, 'D', -1, 1)
                                 * NVL (r.investment_contri, 0)
                               - NVL (v_itb_amount, 0)
                          INTO v_inv_contri
                          FROM DUAL;
                    END IF;

                    IF NVL (r.investment_admin, 0) <> 0
                    THEN
                        SELECT SUM (
                                   DECODE (itb_drcr, 'D', -1, 1) * itb_amount)    itb_amount
                          INTO v_itb_amount
                          FROM lms_interface_table t, lms_ord_prem_receipts
                         WHERE     itb_opr_code = opr_code
                               AND itb_opr_code IS NOT NULL
                               AND itb_opr_code = v_opr_code      --2016738076
                               AND itb_transaction_type IN
                                       ('APPEND_GL', 'APPEND_CB')
                               AND (t.itb_narrative LIKE
                                        'INVESTMENT ADMINISTRATION%');

                        SELECT     DECODE (r.opr_drcr, 'D', -1, 1)
                                 * NVL (r.investment_admin, 0)
                               - NVL (v_itb_amount, 0)
                          INTO v_inv_admin
                          FROM DUAL;
                    END IF;

                    IF NVL (r.comfnd, 0) <> 0
                    THEN                --AND NVL(r.opr_fund_posted,'N') = 'Y'
                        SELECT SUM (
                                   DECODE (itb_drcr, 'D', -1, 1) * itb_amount)    itb_amount
                          INTO v_itb_amount
                          FROM lms_interface_table t, lms_ord_prem_receipts
                         WHERE     itb_opr_code = opr_code
                               AND itb_opr_code IS NOT NULL
                               AND itb_opr_code = v_opr_code      --2016738076
                               AND itb_transaction_type IN
                                       ('APPEND_GL', 'APPEND_CB')
                               AND (t.itb_narrative LIKE 'COMPENSATION FUND%');

                        --SELECT DECODE(R.OPR_DRCR,'D',-1,1)*NVL(R.COMFND,0) - NVL(r.cfpr_companycont,0) INTO v_comfnd FROM DUAL;
                        SELECT     DECODE (r.opr_drcr, 'D', -1, 1)
                                 * NVL (r.comfnd, 0)
                               - NVL (v_itb_amount, 0)
                          INTO v_comfnd
                          FROM DUAL;
                    END IF;

                    IF   NVL (v_loan_amt, 0)
                       + NVL (v_prem_amt, 0)
                       + NVL (v_inv_fee, 0)
                       + NVL (v_inv_contri, 0)
                       + NVL (v_inv_admin, 0) <>
                       0
                    THEN
                        IF   NVL (v_loan_amt, 0)
                           + NVL (v_prem_amt, 0)
                           + NVL (v_inv_fee, 0)
                           + NVL (v_inv_contri, 0)
                           + NVL (v_inv_admin, 0) =
                           -1111111111111111
                        THEN
                            CONTINUE;
                            raise_application_error (
                                -20001,
                                   'Over allocation...v_loan_amt='
                                || v_loan_amt
                                || '; v_prem_amt='
                                || v_prem_amt
                                || '; v_inv_fee='
                                || v_inv_fee
                                || '; v_inv_contri='
                                || v_inv_contri
                                || '; v_inv_admin='
                                || v_inv_admin);
                        ELSE
                            --loan===================================================================================================================
                            IF NVL (v_loan_amt, 0) <> 0
                            THEN
                                IF NVL (v_loan_amt, 0) > 0
                                THEN
                                    v_opr_drcr := 'C';           --r.OPR_DRCR;
                                    v_opr_drcr_reverse := 'D'; --r.OPR_DRCR_REVERSE;
                                ELSE
                                    v_opr_drcr := 'D';   --r.OPR_DRCR_REVERSE;
                                    v_opr_drcr_reverse := 'C';   --r.OPR_DRCR;
                                END IF;

                                lms_api.get_gl_code ('NL',
                                                     r.pol_prod_code,
                                                     v_trnt_code,
                                                     v_trnt_gl_code,
                                                     v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
                                lms_api.valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                                                   v_org_code,
                                                   r.pol_bra_code,
                                                   'NL');
                                v_count := v_count + 1;
                                lms_api.interface_append_gl (
                                    v_trans_code,             -- v_trans_code,
                                    v_user,                     -- v_raise_by,
                                    r.pol_code,                 -- v_pol_code,
                                    r.pol_prod_code,           -- v_prod_code,
                                    NULL,                        -- v_vchr_no,
                                    r.opr_code,                 -- v_opr_code,
                                    NULL,                      -- v_oppr_code,
                                    r.opr_receipt_no,             --v_rcpt_no,
                                    v_count,                       -- v_count,
                                    'ALLOCATED LOAN' || ' - ' || r.policy_no, -- v_narrative,
                                    ABS (NVL (v_loan_amt, 0)),
                                    -- v_amount,
                                    v_opr_drcr,                     -- v_drcr,
                                    v_trnt_gl_code,          -- v_acc_number1,
                                    r.pol_bra_code,          -- v_branch_code,
                                    v_gl_trans);
                                v_tot_amt :=
                                    NVL (v_tot_amt, 0) + NVL (v_loan_amt, 0);
                            END IF;

                            --premium===============================================================================================================
                            IF NVL (v_prem_amt, 0) <> 0
                            THEN
                                IF NVL (v_prem_amt, 0) > 0
                                THEN
                                    v_opr_drcr := 'C';           --r.OPR_DRCR;
                                    v_opr_drcr_reverse := 'D'; --r.OPR_DRCR_REVERSE;
                                ELSE
                                    v_opr_drcr := 'D';   --r.OPR_DRCR_REVERSE;
                                    v_opr_drcr_reverse := 'C';   --r.OPR_DRCR;
                                END IF;

                                lms_api.get_gl_code ('UP',
                                                     r.pol_prod_code,
                                                     v_trnt_code,
                                                     v_trnt_gl_code,
                                                     v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
                                lms_api.valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                                                   v_org_code,
                                                   r.pol_bra_code,
                                                   'UP');
                                v_count := v_count + 1;
                                lms_api.interface_append_gl (
                                    v_trans_code,             -- v_trans_code,
                                    v_user,                     -- v_raise_by,
                                    r.pol_code,                 -- v_pol_code,
                                    r.pol_prod_code,           -- v_prod_code,
                                    NULL,                        -- v_vchr_no,
                                    r.opr_code,                 -- v_opr_code,
                                    NULL,                      -- v_oppr_code,
                                    r.opr_receipt_no,             --v_rcpt_no,
                                    v_count,                       -- v_count,
                                       'ALLOCATED PREMIUM'
                                    || ' - '
                                    || r.policy_no,
                                    -- v_narrative,
                                    ABS (NVL (v_prem_amt, 0)),
                                    -- v_amount,
                                    v_opr_drcr,                     -- v_drcr,
                                    v_trnt_gl_code,          -- v_acc_number1,
                                    r.pol_bra_code,          -- v_branch_code,
                                    v_gl_trans);
                                v_tot_amt :=
                                    NVL (v_tot_amt, 0) + NVL (v_prem_amt, 0);
                            END IF;

                            --policy fee===============================================================================================================
                            IF NVL (v_inv_fee, 0) <> 0
                            THEN
                                IF NVL (v_inv_fee, 0) > 0
                                THEN
                                    v_opr_drcr := 'C';           --r.OPR_DRCR;
                                    v_opr_drcr_reverse := 'D'; --r.OPR_DRCR_REVERSE;
                                ELSE
                                    v_opr_drcr := 'D';   --r.OPR_DRCR_REVERSE;
                                    v_opr_drcr_reverse := 'C';   --r.OPR_DRCR;
                                END IF;

                                lms_api.get_gl_code ('INVFEE',
                                                     r.pol_prod_code,
                                                     v_trnt_code,
                                                     v_trnt_gl_code,
                                                     v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
                                lms_api.valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                                                   v_org_code,
                                                   r.pol_bra_code,
                                                   'INVFEE');
                                v_count := v_count + 1;
                                lms_api.interface_append_gl (
                                    v_trans_code,             -- v_trans_code,
                                    v_user,                     -- v_raise_by,
                                    r.pol_code,                 -- v_pol_code,
                                    r.pol_prod_code,           -- v_prod_code,
                                    NULL,                        -- v_vchr_no,
                                    r.opr_code,                 -- v_opr_code,
                                    NULL,                      -- v_oppr_code,
                                    r.opr_receipt_no,             --v_rcpt_no,
                                    v_count,                       -- v_count,
                                    'INVESTMENT FEE' || ' - ' || r.policy_no, -- v_narrative,
                                    ABS (NVL (v_inv_fee, 0)),
                                    -- v_amount,
                                    v_opr_drcr,                     -- v_drcr,
                                    v_trnt_gl_code,          -- v_acc_number1,
                                    r.pol_bra_code,
                                    -- v_branch_code,
                                    v_gl_trans);
                                v_tot_amt :=
                                    NVL (v_tot_amt, 0) + NVL (v_inv_fee, 0);
                            END IF;

                            --investment premium===============================================================================================================
                            IF NVL (v_inv_contri, 0) <> 0
                            THEN
                                IF NVL (v_inv_contri, 0) > 0
                                THEN
                                    v_opr_drcr := 'C';           --r.OPR_DRCR;
                                    v_opr_drcr_reverse := 'D'; --r.OPR_DRCR_REVERSE;
                                ELSE
                                    v_opr_drcr := 'D';   --r.OPR_DRCR_REVERSE;
                                    v_opr_drcr_reverse := 'C';   --r.OPR_DRCR;
                                END IF;

                                lms_api.get_gl_code ('INVPREM',
                                                     r.pol_prod_code,
                                                     v_trnt_code,
                                                     v_trnt_gl_code,
                                                     v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
                                lms_api.valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                                                   v_org_code,
                                                   r.pol_bra_code,
                                                   'INVPREM');
                                v_count := v_count + 1;
                                lms_api.interface_append_gl (
                                    v_trans_code,             -- v_trans_code,
                                    v_user,                     -- v_raise_by,
                                    r.pol_code,                 -- v_pol_code,
                                    r.pol_prod_code,           -- v_prod_code,
                                    NULL,                        -- v_vchr_no,
                                    r.opr_code,                 -- v_opr_code,
                                    NULL,                      -- v_oppr_code,
                                    r.opr_receipt_no,             --v_rcpt_no,
                                    v_count,                       -- v_count,
                                       'INVESTMENT PREMIUM'
                                    || ' - '
                                    || r.policy_no,
                                    -- v_narrative,
                                    ABS (NVL (v_inv_contri, 0)),
                                    -- v_amount,
                                    v_opr_drcr,                     -- v_drcr,
                                    v_trnt_gl_code,          -- v_acc_number1,
                                    r.pol_bra_code,          -- v_branch_code,
                                    v_gl_trans);
                                v_tot_amt :=
                                      NVL (v_tot_amt, 0)
                                    + NVL (v_inv_contri, 0);
                            END IF;

                            --investment admin===============================================================================================================
                            IF NVL (v_inv_admin, 0) <> 0
                            THEN
                                IF NVL (v_inv_admin, 0) > 0
                                THEN
                                    v_opr_drcr := 'C';           --r.OPR_DRCR;
                                    v_opr_drcr_reverse := 'D'; --r.OPR_DRCR_REVERSE;
                                ELSE
                                    v_opr_drcr := 'D';   --r.OPR_DRCR_REVERSE;
                                    v_opr_drcr_reverse := 'C';   --r.OPR_DRCR;
                                END IF;

                                lms_api.get_gl_code ('INVADM',
                                                     r.pol_prod_code,
                                                     v_trnt_code,
                                                     v_trnt_gl_code,
                                                     v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
                                lms_api.valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                                                   v_org_code,
                                                   r.pol_bra_code,
                                                   'INVADM');
                                v_count := v_count + 1;
                                lms_api.interface_append_gl (
                                    v_trans_code,             -- v_trans_code,
                                    v_user,                     -- v_raise_by,
                                    r.pol_code,                 -- v_pol_code,
                                    r.pol_prod_code,           -- v_prod_code,
                                    NULL,                        -- v_vchr_no,
                                    r.opr_code,                 -- v_opr_code,
                                    NULL,                      -- v_oppr_code,
                                    r.opr_receipt_no,             --v_rcpt_no,
                                    v_count,                       -- v_count,
                                       'INVESTMENT ADMINISTRATION'
                                    || ' - '
                                    || r.policy_no,
                                    -- v_narrative,
                                    ABS (NVL (v_inv_admin, 0)),
                                    -- v_amount,
                                    v_opr_drcr,                     -- v_drcr,
                                    v_trnt_gl_code,          -- v_acc_number1,
                                    r.pol_bra_code,          -- v_branch_code,
                                    v_gl_trans);
                                v_tot_amt :=
                                    NVL (v_tot_amt, 0) + NVL (v_inv_admin, 0);
                            END IF;

                            IF NVL (v_comfnd, 0) <> 0
                            THEN
                                IF NVL (v_comfnd, 0) > 0
                                THEN
                                    v_opr_drcr := 'C';           --r.OPR_DRCR;
                                    v_opr_drcr_reverse := 'D'; --r.OPR_DRCR_REVERSE;
                                ELSE
                                    v_opr_drcr := 'D';   --r.OPR_DRCR_REVERSE;
                                    v_opr_drcr_reverse := 'C';   --r.OPR_DRCR;
                                END IF;

                                IF NOT NVL (v_comp_param, 'N') = 'Y'
                                THEN
                                    --Compensation fund...
                                    lms_api.get_gl_code (
                                        'CMPFND',
                                        r.pol_prod_code,
                                        v_trnt_code,
                                        v_trnt_gl_code,
                                        v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
                                    lms_api.valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                                                       v_org_code,
                                                       r.pol_bra_code,
                                                       'CMPFND');
                                    v_count := v_count + 1;
                                    lms_api.interface_append_gl (
                                        v_trans_code,         -- v_trans_code,
                                        v_user,                 -- v_raise_by,
                                        r.pol_code,             -- v_pol_code,
                                        r.pol_prod_code,       -- v_prod_code,
                                        NULL,                    -- v_vchr_no,
                                        r.opr_code,             -- v_opr_code,
                                        NULL,                  -- v_oppr_code,
                                        r.opr_receipt_no,         --v_rcpt_no,
                                        v_count,                   -- v_count,
                                           'COMPENSATION FUND'
                                        || ' - '
                                        || r.policy_no,
                                        -- v_narrative,
                                        ABS (NVL (v_comfnd, 0)),
                                        -- v_amount,
                                        v_opr_drcr,                 -- v_drcr,
                                        v_trnt_gl_code,      -- v_acc_number1,
                                        r.pol_bra_code,      -- v_branch_code,
                                        v_gl_trans);
                                    v_tot_amt :=
                                          NVL (v_tot_amt, 0)
                                        + NVL (v_comfnd, 0);
                                END IF;
                            END IF;


                            IF v_count <> 0
                            THEN
                                IF NVL (v_tot_amt, 0) > 0
                                THEN
                                    v_opr_drcr := 'C';           --r.OPR_DRCR;
                                    v_opr_drcr_reverse := 'D'; --r.OPR_DRCR_REVERSE;
                                ELSE
                                    v_opr_drcr := 'D';   --r.OPR_DRCR_REVERSE;
                                    v_opr_drcr_reverse := 'C';   --r.OPR_DRCR;
                                END IF;

                                SELECT SUM (
                                             NVL (
                                                 DECODE (
                                                     itb_acc_number,
                                                     v_bank_acc,   DECODE (
                                                                       itb_drcr,
                                                                       r.opr_drcr, -1,
                                                                       1)
                                                                 * itb_amount),
                                                 0)
                                           + NVL (
                                                 DECODE (
                                                     itb_acc_number2,
                                                     v_bank_acc,   DECODE (
                                                                       itb_drcr,
                                                                       r.opr_drcr, 1,
                                                                       -1)
                                                                 * itb_amount),
                                                 0))
                                  INTO v_bank_amt
                                  FROM lms_interface_table
                                 WHERE itb_opr_code = r.opr_code;

                                IF     NVL (v_tot_amt, 0) > 0
                                   AND NVL (v_bank_amt, 0) > 0
                                   AND v_bank_amt <> ar.opr_amt
                                   AND ar.opr_amt - v_bank_amt >= v_tot_amt
                                   AND (ar.amount - ar.unprocessed) <
                                       v_tot_amt
                                THEN
                                    v_contra_acc := v_bank_acc;
                                ELSIF     NVL (v_tot_amt, 0) < 0
                                      AND NVL (v_bank_amt, 0) > 0
                                      AND v_bank_amt <> ar.opr_amt
                                      AND v_bank_amt - ar.opr_amt >=
                                          ABS (v_tot_amt)
                                      AND (ABS (ar.amount) - ar.unprocessed) <
                                          ABS (v_tot_amt)
                                THEN
                                    v_contra_acc := v_bank_acc;
                                END IF;



                                IF v_opr_drcr = 'C'
                                THEN
                                    v_count := v_count + 1;
                                    lms_api.interface_append_gl (
                                        v_trans_code,         -- v_trans_code,
                                        v_user,                 -- v_raise_by,
                                        r.pol_code,             -- v_pol_code,
                                        r.pol_prod_code,       -- v_prod_code,
                                        NULL,                    -- v_vchr_no,
                                        v_opr_code,
                                        -- v_opr_code,
                                        NULL,                   --v_oppr_code,
                                        r.opr_receipt_no,         --v_rcpt_no,
                                        v_count,                   -- v_count,
                                           'UNPROCESSED RCPTS FUTURE ALLOC-DUE - '
                                        || r.policy_no,        -- v_narrative,
                                        ABS (NVL (v_tot_amt, 0)), -- v_amount,
                                        'D',                        -- v_drcr,
                                        v_contra_acc,        -- v_acc_number1,
                                        r.pol_bra_code,      -- v_branch_code,
                                        v_gl_trans);
                                ELSE
                                    v_count := v_count + 1;
                                    lms_api.interface_append_gl (
                                        v_trans_code,         -- v_trans_code,
                                        v_user,                 -- v_raise_by,
                                        r.pol_code,             -- v_pol_code,
                                        r.pol_prod_code,       -- v_prod_code,
                                        NULL,                    -- v_vchr_no,
                                        v_opr_code,             -- v_opr_code,
                                        NULL,                   --v_oppr_code,
                                        r.opr_receipt_no,         --v_rcpt_no,
                                        v_count,                   -- v_count,
                                           'UNPROCESSED RCPTS FUTURE ALLOC-DUE - '
                                        || r.policy_no,        -- v_narrative,
                                        ABS (NVL (v_tot_amt, 0)), -- v_amount,
                                        'C',                        -- v_drcr,
                                        v_contra_acc,        -- v_acc_number1,
                                        r.pol_bra_code,      -- v_branch_code,
                                        v_gl_trans);
                                END IF;

                                lms_api.interface_update_vgl (
                                    v_trans_code,              --v_trans_code,
                                    v_user,                      --v_raise_by,
                                    r.pol_code,                  --v_pol_code,
                                    ar.post_date,                    --v_date,
                                    r.opr_code,                  --v_opr_code,
                                    NULL,                       --v_oppr_code,
                                    'LMS RECEIPTS BATCH',
                                    --v_btc_description,
                                    'JV',                        --v_btc_type,
                                    r.pol_bra_code,           --v_branch_code,
                                    'LMS RCPT ' || r.opr_receipt_no,
                                    --v_description,
                                    r.opr_receipt_no,             --v_rcpt_no,
                                    v_gl_trans);

                                SELECT vgl_no
                                  INTO v_vgl_no
                                  FROM fms_vougl
                                 WHERE vgl_itfc_trans_code = v_trans_code;

                                INSERT INTO itb_corrections (
                                                ic_itb_transaction_code,
                                                ic_cleanup_date,
                                                ic_opr_code,
                                                ic_clnup_reason,
                                                ic_vgl_no)
                                     VALUES (v_trans_code,
                                             SYSDATE,
                                             r.opr_code,
                                             'UN-ALLOCATED POSTING',
                                             v_vgl_no);
                            ELSIF     v_count = 0
                                  AND v_tot_amt = 0
                                  AND ar.unprocessed >= 0
                                  AND (ar.amount - ar.unprocessed) > 0.1
                            THEN
                                v_tot_amt := ar.amount - ar.unprocessed;

                                --v_bct_code := fms_rcts_pkg.get_rcpt_debited_bank(v_fms_receipt_pk);
                                --v_bank_acc := fms_gen_pkg.bnk_acct_no (v_bct_code);

                                v_count := v_count + 1;
                                lms_api.interface_append_gl (
                                    v_trans_code,             -- v_trans_code,
                                    v_user,                     -- v_raise_by,
                                    r.pol_code,                 -- v_pol_code,
                                    r.pol_prod_code,           -- v_prod_code,
                                    NULL,                        -- v_vchr_no,
                                    v_opr_code,
                                    -- v_opr_code,
                                    NULL,                       --v_oppr_code,
                                    r.opr_receipt_no,             --v_rcpt_no,
                                    v_count,                       -- v_count,
                                       'UNPROCESSED RCPTS FUTURE ALLOC-DUE - '
                                    || r.policy_no,            -- v_narrative,
                                    ABS (NVL (v_tot_amt, 0)),     -- v_amount,
                                    'D',                            -- v_drcr,
                                    v_contra_acc,            -- v_acc_number1,
                                    r.pol_bra_code,          -- v_branch_code,
                                    v_gl_trans);


                                v_count := v_count + 1;
                                lms_api.interface_append_gl (
                                    v_trans_code,             -- v_trans_code,
                                    v_user,                     -- v_raise_by,
