                                    r.pol_code,                 -- v_pol_code,
                                    r.pol_prod_code,           -- v_prod_code,
                                    NULL,                        -- v_vchr_no,
                                    v_opr_code,
                                    -- v_opr_code,
                                    NULL,                       --v_oppr_code,
                                    r.opr_receipt_no,             --v_rcpt_no,
                                    v_count,                       -- v_count,
                                       'BANK ACCOUNT CORRECTION - '
                                    || r.policy_no,            -- v_narrative,
                                    ABS (NVL (v_tot_amt, 0)),     -- v_amount,
                                    'C',                            -- v_drcr,
                                    v_bank_acc,              -- v_acc_number1,
                                    r.pol_bra_code,          -- v_branch_code,
                                    v_gl_trans);


                                lms_api.interface_update_vgl (
                                    v_trans_code,              --v_trans_code,
                                    v_user,                      --v_raise_by,
                                    r.pol_code,                  --v_pol_code,
                                    ar.post_date,                    --v_date,
                                    r.opr_code,                  --v_opr_code,
                                    NULL,                       --v_oppr_code,
                                    'LMS RECEIPTS BATCH',
                                    --v_btc_description,
                                    'JV',                        --v_btc_type,
                                    r.pol_bra_code,           --v_branch_code,
                                    'LMS RCPT ' || r.opr_receipt_no,
                                    --v_description,
                                    r.opr_receipt_no,             --v_rcpt_no,
                                    v_gl_trans);

                                SELECT vgl_no
                                  INTO v_vgl_no
                                  FROM fms_vougl
                                 WHERE vgl_itfc_trans_code = v_trans_code;

                                INSERT INTO itb_corrections (
                                                ic_itb_transaction_code,
                                                ic_cleanup_date,
                                                ic_opr_code,
                                                ic_clnup_reason,
                                                ic_vgl_no)
                                     VALUES (v_trans_code,
                                             SYSDATE,
                                             r.opr_code,
                                             'UN-ALLOCATED POSTING',
                                             v_vgl_no);
                            END IF;
                        END IF;
                    ELSIF     ar.unprocessed >= 0
                          AND (ar.amount - ar.unprocessed) > 0.1
                    THEN
                        v_tot_amt := ar.amount - ar.unprocessed;

                        v_bct_code :=
                            fms_rcts_pkg.get_rcpt_debited_bank (
                                v_fms_receipt_pk);
                        v_bank_acc := fms_gen_pkg.bnk_acct_no (v_bct_code);

                        v_count := v_count + 1;
                        lms_api.interface_append_gl (
                            v_trans_code,                     -- v_trans_code,
                            v_user,                             -- v_raise_by,
                            r.pol_code,                         -- v_pol_code,
                            r.pol_prod_code,                   -- v_prod_code,
                            NULL,                                -- v_vchr_no,
                            v_opr_code,
                            -- v_opr_code,
                            NULL,                               --v_oppr_code,
                            r.opr_receipt_no,                     --v_rcpt_no,
                            v_count,                               -- v_count,
                            'UNPROCESSED RCPTS FUTURE ALLOC-DUE - ' || r.policy_no, -- v_narrative,
                            ABS (NVL (v_tot_amt, 0)),             -- v_amount,
                            'D',                                    -- v_drcr,
                            v_contra_acc,                    -- v_acc_number1,
                            r.pol_bra_code,                  -- v_branch_code,
                            v_gl_trans);


                        v_count := v_count + 1;
                        lms_api.interface_append_gl (
                            v_trans_code,                     -- v_trans_code,
                            v_user,                             -- v_raise_by,
                            r.pol_code,                         -- v_pol_code,
                            r.pol_prod_code,                   -- v_prod_code,
                            NULL,                                -- v_vchr_no,
                            v_opr_code,
                            -- v_opr_code,
                            NULL,                               --v_oppr_code,
                            r.opr_receipt_no,                     --v_rcpt_no,
                            v_count,                               -- v_count,
                            'BANK ACCOUNT CORRECTION - ' || r.policy_no, -- v_narrative,
                            ABS (NVL (v_tot_amt, 0)),             -- v_amount,
                            'C',                                    -- v_drcr,
                            v_bank_acc,                      -- v_acc_number1,
                            r.pol_bra_code,                  -- v_branch_code,
                            v_gl_trans);


                        lms_api.interface_update_vgl (
                            v_trans_code,                      --v_trans_code,
                            v_user,                              --v_raise_by,
                            r.pol_code,                          --v_pol_code,
                            ar.post_date,                            --v_date,
                            r.opr_code,                          --v_opr_code,
                            NULL,                               --v_oppr_code,
                            'LMS RECEIPTS BATCH',
                            --v_btc_description,
                            'JV',                                --v_btc_type,
                            r.pol_bra_code,                   --v_branch_code,
                            'LMS RCPT ' || r.opr_receipt_no,
                            --v_description,
                            r.opr_receipt_no,                     --v_rcpt_no,
                            v_gl_trans);

                        SELECT vgl_no
                          INTO v_vgl_no
                          FROM fms_vougl
                         WHERE vgl_itfc_trans_code = v_trans_code;

                        INSERT INTO itb_corrections (ic_itb_transaction_code,
                                                     ic_cleanup_date,
                                                     ic_opr_code,
                                                     ic_clnup_reason,
                                                     ic_vgl_no)
                             VALUES (v_trans_code,
                                     SYSDATE,
                                     r.opr_code,
                                     'UN-ALLOCATED POSTING',
                                     v_vgl_no);
                    END IF;
                EXCEPTION
                    WHEN OTHERS
                    THEN
                        raise_application_error (
                            -20001,
                               'Error opr_code='
                            || r.opr_code
                            || ' '
                            || SQLERRM (SQLCODE));
                END;
            END LOOP;

            IF v_oprcode IS NULL
            THEN
                COMMIT;
            END IF;
        END LOOP;
    END unprocess_posting_corrections;

    PROCEDURE post_clm_srvc_provider_pymts (
        v_csp_code     lms_clm_service_providers.csp_code%TYPE,
        v_user         VARCHAR2,
        v_pay_method   VARCHAR2 DEFAULT 'CHQ'
    )
    IS
        CURSOR cur_service_prov_pymt IS
            SELECT pol_code,
                   pol_prod_code,
                   pol_bra_code,
                   spr_name,
                   spt_name,
                   spt_code,
                   spr_bank_acc_no,
                   spr_phone,
                   spr_bbr_code,
                   lms_clm_service_providers.*
              FROM lms_clm_service_providers,
                   lms_claims,
                   lms_policies,
                   tqc_service_providers,
                   tqc_service_provider_types
             WHERE     csp_code = v_csp_code
                   AND csp_clm_no = clm_no
                   AND clm_pol_code = pol_code
                   AND csp_spr_code = spr_code
                   AND spr_spt_code = spt_code;

        v_payee_eft_rec         fms_cheques_pkg.type_payee_eft_table;
        v_trns_rec              fms_cheques_pkg.type_rqn_dtls_table;
        v_eft_enabled           VARCHAR2 (1) := 'N';
        v_crt_acc_no            VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_org_code              NUMBER;
        v_cur_code              NUMBER;
        v_bct_code              NUMBER;
        v_bct_brh_code          NUMBER;
        v_authorized_by         NUMBER;
        v_no                    NUMBER := 0;
        v_prod_code             NUMBER;
        v_trnt_code             VARCHAR2 (10);
        v_trnt_gl_code          VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_trnt_contra_gl_code   VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_gl_trans              fms_vouchers_pkg.tgl_rec_type;
        v_gl_count              NUMBER := -1;
        vgl_code                NUMBER;
        v_trans_code            NUMBER;
        v_vchr_no               VARCHAR2 (100)
                                    := lms_api.trans_voucher ('CLMSVC');
        v_acc_no                VARCHAR2 (30);
    BEGIN
        v_trns_rec.delete;
        v_no := 0;

        FOR f IN cur_service_prov_pymt
        LOOP
            SELECT    TO_NUMBER (TO_CHAR (SYSDATE, 'RRRR'))
                   || lms_transaction_seq.NEXTVAL
              INTO v_trans_code
              FROM DUAL;

            IF (v_pay_method = 'EFT')
            THEN
                v_acc_no := f.spr_bank_acc_no;
            ELSIF (v_pay_method = 'MFT')
            THEN
                v_acc_no := f.spr_phone;
            ELSE
                v_acc_no := NULL;
            END IF;

            v_org_code := fms_interfaces_pkg.get_org (f.pol_bra_code);
            v_no := v_no + 1;
            get_gl_code ('CLMSVC',
                         f.pol_prod_code,                       --v_prod_code,
                         v_trnt_code,
                         v_crt_acc_no,
                         v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
            valid_acc (v_crt_acc_no,
                       v_org_code,
                       f.pol_bra_code,
                       'CLMSVC');
            valid_acc (v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                       v_org_code,
                       f.pol_bra_code,
                       'CLMSVC CONTRA');

            BEGIN
                interface_append_chq (
                    v_trans_code,                --v_trans_code        NUMBER,
                    v_user,                    --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                    f.pol_code,                 --v_pol_code           NUMBER,
                    f.pol_prod_code,
                    --v_prod_code,               --v_prod_code          NUMBER,
                    v_vchr_no,                 --v_vchr_no           VARCHAR2,
                    v_no,                       --v_count              NUMBER,
                    f.csp_amt_to_pay,           --v_amount             NUMBER,
                    f.spr_name || ' - ' || 'PAYMENT FOR CLAIM SERVICES',
                    --v_narrative          VARCHAR2,
                    v_trnt_contra_gl_code,  --v_acc_number           VARCHAR2,
                    v_org_code,                --v_acc_org_code        NUMBER,
                    f.pol_bra_code,             --v_branch_code        NUMBER,
                    'D',                      --v_drcr               VARCHAR2,
                    v_trns_rec--v_trn_rec   IN OUT   Fms_Cheques_Pkg.Type_rqn_dtls_table)
                              );
            EXCEPTION
                WHEN OTHERS
                THEN
                    tqc_error_manager.raise_error (
                        270102501,
                        text_in   => 'Error appending cheque details.');
            END;

            IF v_no <> 0
            THEN
                BEGIN
                    interface_create_reqn (
                        v_trans_code,           --v_trans_code         NUMBER,
                        v_vchr_no,         --v_ref                   VARCHAR2,
                        f.csp_code,        --v_ref2                  VARCHAR2,
                        TRUNC (SYSDATE),       --v_ref_date              DATE,
                        f.spr_name || ' - ' || 'PAYMENT FOR CLAIM SERVICES',
                        --v_narrative             VARCHAR2,
                        NVL (f.csp_amt_to_pay, 0), --v_amount                NUMBER,
                        f.spr_name,        --v_payee                 VARCHAR2,
                        v_pay_method,
                        --v_pay_method            VARCHAR2, --CHQ, EFT
                        v_acc_no,       --v_payee_bank_acc_no        VARCHAR2,
                        f.spr_bbr_code,   --v_payee_bank_branch_code   NUMBER,
                        v_user,            --v_source_auth_by        VARCHAR2,
                        TRUNC (SYSDATE),       --v_source_auth_dt        DATE,
                        v_user,          --v_raise_by                VARCHAR2,
                        'CLMSVC',          --v_pmt_type              VARCHAR2,
                        f.pol_bra_code,       --v_branch_code          NUMBER,
                        NULL,                                    --v_pol_code,
                        v_trns_rec--v_dtls_table  IN OUT  Fms_Cheques_Pkg.Type_rqn_dtls_table)
                                  );
                --v_dtls_table  IN OUT    Fms_Cheques_Pkg.Type_rqn_dtls_table)
                EXCEPTION
                    WHEN OTHERS
                    THEN
                        tqc_error_manager.raise_error (
                            270102502,
                            text_in   =>
                                'Error creating Medicl cheque details.');
                END;

                BEGIN
                    v_gl_count := v_gl_count + 2;
                    interface_append_gl (
                        v_trans_code,            --v_trans_code        NUMBER,
                        v_user,                --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                        f.pol_code,              --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                        f.pol_prod_code,
                        --v_prod_code,               --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                        v_vchr_no,             --v_vchr_no           VARCHAR2,
                        NULL,                    --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                        NULL,                    --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                        NULL,                   --v_rcpt_no          VARCHAR2,
                        v_gl_count,              --v_count             NUMBER,
                           f.spr_name
                        || ' - '
                        || 'PAYMENT FOR CLAIM SERVICES'
                        || v_vchr_no,
                        --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                        NVL (f.csp_amt_to_pay, 0), --v_amount            NUMBER,
                        'D',                   --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                        v_crt_acc_no,        --v_acc_number1         VARCHAR2,
                        v_trnt_contra_gl_code, --v_acc_number2         VARCHAR2,
                        f.pol_bra_code,          --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                        v_gl_trans--v_trn_rec   IN OUT  fms_test.Fms_Vouchers_Pkg.Tgl_rec_type,
                                  );
                    interface_update_vgl (
                        v_trans_code,               --v_trans_code     NUMBER,
                        v_user,                --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                        f.pol_code,              --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                        TRUNC (SYSDATE),                --v_date         DATE,
                        NULL,                    --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                        NULL,                    --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                        'LMS CLM SERVICE PROVIDERS',
                        --v_btc_description   VARCHAR2,
                        'JV',                 --v_btc_type           VARCHAR2,
                        f.pol_bra_code,
                           --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                           f.spr_name
                        || ' - '
                        || 'PAYMENT FOR CLM SERVICE PROVIDERS: '
                        || v_vchr_no,
                        --v_description       VARCHAR2,
                        v_vchr_no,
                        --v_ref_no            VARCHAR2,
                        v_gl_trans--v_gl_trans  IN OUT  fms_test.Fms_Vouchers_Pkg.Tgl_rec_type,
                                  );
                EXCEPTION
                    WHEN OTHERS
                    THEN
                        tqc_error_manager.raise_error (
                            270102503,
                            text_in   => 'Error populating GL details.');
                END;

                UPDATE lms_clm_service_providers
                   SET csp_paid = 'Y',
                       csp_authorised_by = v_user,
                       csp_authorised_date = TRUNC (SYSDATE),
                       csp_pymt_vchr_no = v_vchr_no,
                       csp_pay_method = v_pay_method
                 WHERE csp_code = v_csp_code AND NVL (csp_paid, 'N') = 'N';
            END IF;
        END LOOP;
    EXCEPTION
        WHEN OTHERS
        THEN
            tqc_error_manager.raise_error (
                270102504,
                text_in   => 'Error posting  claim service provider payment.');
    END post_clm_srvc_provider_pymts;

    PROCEDURE update_clm_service_providers (
        v_vchr_no    VARCHAR2,
        v_csp_code   NUMBER,
        v_chq_no     VARCHAR2,
        v_chq_date   DATE,
        v_chq_amt    NUMBER,
        v_user       VARCHAR2
    )
    IS
    BEGIN
        BEGIN
            UPDATE lms_clm_service_providers
               SET csp_chq_no = v_chq_no,
                   csp_chq_date = v_chq_date,
                   csp_chq_update_by = v_user,
                   csp_chq_update_date = SYSDATE,
                   csp_chq_amt = v_chq_amt
             WHERE     csp_pymt_vchr_no = v_vchr_no
                   AND csp_code = v_csp_code
                   AND csp_paid = 'Y';
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                raise_error (
                    'ERROR UPDATING CLM SERVICE PROVIDER DETAILS....');
        END;
    END update_clm_service_providers;

    PROCEDURE post_grp_other_expenses (
        v_pol_code    NUMBER,
        v_username    VARCHAR2,
        v_trans_no    NUMBER,
        v_poep_code   NUMBER DEFAULT NULL
    )
    IS
        CURSOR c_expenses IS
              SELECT poep_pha_code,
                     TRUNC (poep_date)           poep_date,
                     SUM (NVL (poep_amt, 0))     amount,
                     poep_brn_code,
                     TRIM (pha_org_name)         client,
                     poep_prepared_by,
                     pol_policy_no,
                     poep_pay_method,
                     poep_bbr_code,
                     poep_bank_acc_no,
                     prp_code
                FROM lms_pol_other_expense_pymts,
                     lms_proposers,
                     lms_policies,
                     lms_policy_endorsements,
                     lms_policy_hmo_aportionments
               WHERE     poep_pol_code = v_pol_code
                     AND pol_code = poep_pol_code
                     AND prp_code = pol_prp_code
                     AND pha_code = poep_pha_code
                     AND endr_code(+) = poep_endr_code
                     AND endr_pol_code(+) = pol_code
                     AND poep_code = NVL (v_poep_code, poep_code)
                     AND NVL (poep_authorized, 'N') = 'N'
                     AND NVL (poep_paid, 'N') IN ('N', 'R')
                     AND poep_authorized_date IS NULL
            GROUP BY poep_pha_code,
                     poep_date,
                     poep_brn_code,
                     TRIM (pha_org_name),
                     poep_prepared_by,
                     pol_policy_no,
                     poep_pay_method,
                     poep_bbr_code,
                     poep_bank_acc_no,
                     prp_code;

        v_org_code               NUMBER;
        v_crt_acc_no             VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_sys_code               NUMBER;
        v_bct_code               NUMBER;
        v_bct_brh_code           NUMBER;
        v_chq_dtls_rec           fms_cheques_pkg.type_rqn_dtls_table;
        v_prod_code              NUMBER;
        v_trnt_prod_applicable   VARCHAR2 (3);
        v_trnt_contra_gl_code    VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_count                  NUMBER := 0;
        v_cont                   NUMBER := -1;
        v_cnt                    NUMBER := 0;
        v_gl_count               NUMBER := 0;
        v_cur_code               NUMBER;
        v_brh_code               NUMBER;
        v_raised_by              NUMBER;
        v_auth_by                NUMBER;
        v_trnt_code              VARCHAR2 (10);
        v_gl_trans               fms_vouchers_pkg.tgl_rec_type;
        v_gl_acc                 VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_gl_acc2                VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_vgl_no                 NUMBER;
        v_contra_gl_code         VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_drcr                   VARCHAR2 (2);
        v_trans_code             NUMBER;
        v_agn_name               VARCHAR (100);
        v_currency_code          NUMBER;
        v_policy_no              lms_policies.pol_policy_no%TYPE;
    BEGIN
        SELECT    TO_NUMBER (TO_CHAR (SYSDATE, 'RRRR'))
               || lms_transaction_seq.NEXTVAL
          INTO v_trans_code
          FROM DUAL;

        BEGIN
            SELECT pol_prod_code, pol_cur_code, pol_policy_no
              INTO v_prod_code, v_currency_code, v_policy_no
              FROM lms_policies
             WHERE pol_code = v_pol_code;
        END;

        FOR r IN c_expenses
        LOOP
            v_org_code := fms_interfaces_pkg.get_org (r.poep_brn_code);

            IF r.amount < 0
            THEN
                NULL;
            ELSIF r.amount >= 0
            THEN
                IF NVL (r.amount, 0) <> 0
                THEN
                    get_gl_code ('MXP_GB',
                                 v_prod_code,
                                 v_trnt_code,
                                 v_crt_acc_no,
                                 v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
                    valid_acc (v_crt_acc_no,
                               v_org_code,
                               r.poep_brn_code,
                               'MXP_GB');
                    valid_acc (v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                               v_org_code,
                               r.poep_brn_code,
                               'MXP_GB CONTRA');
                    v_gl_count := 0;
                    v_gl_count := v_gl_count + 1;
                    interface_append_gl (
                        v_trans_code,
                        --v_trans_code           NUMBER,
                        v_username,
                        --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                        v_pol_code,              --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                        v_prod_code,             --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                        NULL,                --v_vchr_no             VARCHAR2,
                        NULL,                    --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                        NULL,                    --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                        NULL,                --v_rcpt_no             VARCHAR2,
                        v_gl_count,              --v_count             NUMBER,
                        'GROUP HEALTH EXPENSE - ' || r.pol_policy_no,
                        --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                        r.amount,                --v_amount            NUMBER,
                        'D',                   --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                        v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                        v_crt_acc_no,
                        r.poep_brn_code,
                        --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                        v_gl_trans);
                    v_count := v_count + 1;
                    --raise_error('amount ='||r.amount||';'||v_count);
                    interface_append_chq (v_trans_code,
                                          --v_trans_code         NUMBER,
                                          v_username,
                                          --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                                          v_pol_code,
                                          --v_pol_code           NUMBER,
                                          v_prod_code,
                                          --v_prod_code          NUMBER,
                                          NULL, --v_vchr_no              VARCHAR2,
                                          v_count, --v_count              NUMBER,
                                          r.amount, --v_amount             NUMBER,
                                          'GROUP HEALTH EXPENSE PAYMENT',
                                          --v_narrative          VARCHAR2,
                                          v_crt_acc_no,
                                          --v_acc_number            VARCHAR2,
                                          v_org_code,
                                          --v_acc_org_code          NUMBER,
                                          r.poep_brn_code,
                                          --v_branch_code        NUMBER,
                                          'D', --v_drcr               VARCHAR2,
                                          v_chq_dtls_rec);
                END IF;

                v_brh_code := r.poep_brn_code;
                interface_create_reqn (
                    v_trans_code,
                    --v_trans_code           NUMBER,
                    v_trans_no,
                    --v_ref                   VARCHAR2,
                    NVL (r.poep_pha_code, r.prp_code),
                    --v_ref2                  VARCHAR2,
                    r.poep_date,
                    --v_ref_date              DATE,
                    'GROUP HEALTH EXPENSE PAYMENT( ' || r.client || ')',
                    --v_narrative             VARCHAR2,
                    r.amount,                --v_amount                NUMBER,
                    r.client,                                      --r.client,
                    --v_payee                 VARCHAR2,
                    NVL (r.poep_pay_method, 'CHQ'),
                    --v_pay_method            VARCHAR2, --CHQ, EFT
                    NVL (v_bct_code, r.poep_bank_acc_no),
                    --v_payee_bank_acc_no        VARCHAR2,
                    NVL (v_bct_brh_code, r.poep_bbr_code),
                    --v_payee_bank_branch_code   NUMBER,
                    v_username,
                    --v_source_auth_by        VARCHAR2,
                    TRUNC (SYSDATE),
                    --v_source_auth_dt        DATE,
                    NVL (r.poep_prepared_by, v_username),
                    --v_raise_by                VARCHAR2,
                    'MNGEX',
                    --v_pmt_type              VARCHAR2,
                    v_brh_code,                        --v_branch_code NUMBER,
                    NULL,
                    --v_pol_code,                                   --v_branch_code           NUMBER,
                    v_chq_dtls_rec);
            END IF;
        END LOOP;

        IF v_count != 0
        THEN
            interface_update_vgl (
                v_trans_code,                     --  v_trans_code     NUMBER,
                v_username,                    --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                v_pol_code,                      --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                SYSDATE,                           --v_date              DATE,
                NULL,                            --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                NULL,                            --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                'LMS GROUP HEALTH EXPENSE PAYMENT', --v_btc_description   VARCHAR2,
                'JV',                       --v_btc_type             VARCHAR2,
                v_brh_code,                      --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                'GROUP HEALTH EXPENSE PAYMENT ( ' || v_policy_no || ')',
                v_trans_no,                      --v_ref             VARCHAR2,
                v_gl_trans,
                NULL,
                NULL,
                NULL,
                NULL,
                NULL,
                NULL,
                NULL,
                NULL,
                NULL,
                v_currency_code);
        END IF;

        UPDATE lms_pol_other_expense_pymts
           SET poep_authorized = 'Y',
               poep_paid = 'Y',
               poep_authorized_by = v_username,
               poep_authorized_date = TRUNC (SYSDATE),
               poep_trans_no = v_trans_no
         WHERE     poep_pol_code = v_pol_code
               AND NVL (poep_authorized, 'N') = 'N'
               AND poep_paid = 'N'
               AND poep_authorized_date IS NULL
               AND poep_code = NVL (v_poep_code, poep_code);
    EXCEPTION
        WHEN OTHERS
        THEN
            raise_error ('Error posting health expense pymnt...');
    END post_grp_other_expenses;

    PROCEDURE post_claim_other_expenses (
        v_claim_no     VARCHAR2,
        v_pol_code     NUMBER,
        v_trans_no     NUMBER,
        v_prod_code    NUMBER,
        v_brn_code     NUMBER,
        v_user         VARCHAR2,
        v_charge_amt   NUMBER
    )
    IS
        v_org_code              NUMBER;

        v_crt_acc_no            VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_trnt_contra_gl_code   VARCHAR2 (20);

        v_trans_code            NUMBER;

        SELECT    TO_NUMBER (TO_CHAR (SYSDATE, 'RRRR'))
               || lms_transaction_seq.NEXTVAL

          FROM DUAL;

        v_org_code := fms_interfaces_pkg.get_org (v_brn_code);

        THEN

                         v_prod_code,
                         v_trnt_code,

                       v_org_code,

                v_trans_code,                    --v_trans_code        NUMBER,
                v_user,                        --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                v_pol_code,                      --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                v_prod_code,                     --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                v_claim_no,                    --v_vchr_no           VARCHAR2,
                NULL,                            --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                NULL,                            --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                NULL,                           --v_rcpt_no          VARCHAR2,
                v_gl_count,                      --v_count             NUMBER,

                --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,

                --v_amount            NUMBER,

                --v_acc_number1         VARCHAR2,
                v_brn_code,                      --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                v_gl_trans,
                --v_trn_rec   IN OUT  fms_test.Fms_Vouchers_Pkg.Tgl_rec_type,
                NULL,
                --v_cad_code                   NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                NULL,
                --v_otop_code                  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                NULL,
                --v_fpmt_code                  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                NULL,
                --v_ort_code                   NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                NULL,
                --v_btr_no                     NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                NULL,
                --v_ppr_code                   NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                NULL,
                --v_ocl_code                   NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                NULL,
                --v_agn_code                   NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                v_trans_no--v_trans_no                   NUMBER DEFAULT NULL
                          );

            v_gl_count := v_gl_count + 1;
            interface_append_gl (
                v_trans_code,                    --v_trans_code        NUMBER,
                v_user,                        --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                v_pol_code,                      --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                v_prod_code,                     --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                v_claim_no,                    --v_vchr_no           VARCHAR2,
                NULL,                            --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                NULL,                            --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                NULL,                           --v_rcpt_no          VARCHAR2,
                v_gl_count,                      --v_count             NUMBER,
                'CLAIM INVESTIGATION PAYABLE ' || v_claim_no,
                --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                v_charge_amt,
                --v_amount            NUMBER,
                'C',                           --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                v_crt_acc_no,
                --v_acc_number1         VARCHAR2,
                v_brn_code,                      --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                v_gl_trans,
                --v_trn_rec   IN OUT  fms_test.Fms_Vouchers_Pkg.Tgl_rec_type,
                NULL,
                --v_cad_code                   NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                NULL,
                --v_otop_code                  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                NULL,
                --v_fpmt_code                  NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                NULL,
                --v_ort_code                   NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                NULL,
                --v_btr_no                     NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                NULL,
                --v_ppr_code                   NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                NULL,
                --v_ocl_code                   NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                NULL,
                --v_agn_code                   NUMBER DEFAULT NULL,
                v_trans_no--v_trans_no                   NUMBER DEFAULT NULL
                          );
        END IF;

        IF v_gl_count > 0
        THEN
            BEGIN                     --v_fpmt_code       NUMBER DEFAULT NULL)
                interface_update_vgl (v_trans_code, --v_trans_code     NUMBER,
                                      v_user,  --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                                      v_pol_code, --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                                      TRUNC (SYSDATE),  --v_date         DATE,
                                      NULL,      --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                                      NULL,      --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                                      'LMS CLAIM INVESTIGATION',
                                      --v_btc_description   VARCHAR2,
                                      'JV',   --v_btc_type           VARCHAR2,
                                      v_brn_code,
                                      --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                                      'CLAIM INVESTIGATION ' || v_claim_no,
                                      --v_description       VARCHAR2,
                                      v_claim_no,
                                      --v_ref_no            VARCHAR2,
                                      v_gl_trans,
                                      --v_gl_trans  IN OUT  fms_test.Fms_Vouchers_Pkg.Tgl_rec_type,
                                      NULL,

            EXCEPTION
                WHEN OTHERS
                THEN
                    tqc_error_manager.raise_error (
                        270102503,
                        text_in   => 'Error populating GL details.');
            END;
        END IF;
    END post_claim_other_expenses;

    PROCEDURE book_valuation_gl_commission (
        v_receipt_data   IN lms_receipt_comm_tab,
        v_pol_code          NUMBER,
        v_ipol_code         NUMBER DEFAULT NULL
    )
    IS
        v_comm_basis            VARCHAR2 (10);
        v_agnt_code             NUMBER;
        v_brn_code              NUMBER;
        v_pol_prod_code         NUMBER;
        v_wtax_amt              NUMBER;
        v_count                 NUMBER := 0;
        v_trans_no              NUMBER;
        v_paid_comm_amt         NUMBER := 0;
        v_user                  VARCHAR2 (100)
            := pkg_global_vars.get_pvarchar2 ('pkg_global_vars.pvg_username');
        v_alloca_type           VARCHAR2 (25);
        v_comm_amt              NUMBER := 0;
        v_pol_bra_code          NUMBER;
        v_org_code              NUMBER;
        v_gl_trans              fms_vouchers_pkg.tgl_rec_type;
        v_vgl_no                NUMBER;
        v_trnt_code             VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_trnt_gl_code          VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_trnt_contra_gl_code   VARCHAR2 (20);
        v_whdtx                 NUMBER;
        v_policy_no             VARCHAR2 (50);
        v_wht_posting_param     VARCHAR2 (5);
        v_trans_code            NUMBER;

        CURSOR comm_cur (v_pcp_code NUMBER)
        IS
            SELECT *
              FROM lms_policy_commission_pymts
             WHERE pcp_code = v_pcp_code;

        v_rec_count             NUMBER := 0;
    BEGIN
        BEGIN
            lms_ord_misc.system_param_val ('POST_WHT_AT_ALLOCATIONS',
                                           v_wht_posting_param);
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN OTHERS
            THEN
                raise_error ('Parameter error.' || 'POST_WHT_AT_ALLOCATIONS');
        END;

        v_rec_count := v_receipt_data.COUNT;

        IF v_rec_count > 0
        THEN
            FOR i IN 1 .. v_receipt_data.COUNT
            LOOP
                FOR cm_rec IN comm_cur (v_receipt_data (i).pcp_code)
                LOOP
                    IF cm_rec.pcp_comm_booked = 'Y'
                    THEN
                        raise_error (
                            'This commission record has been booked !');
                    END IF;

                    IF cm_rec.pcp_ipol_code IS NULL
                    THEN
                        BEGIN
                            SELECT endr_agen_code,
                                   pol_prod_code,
                                   pol_bra_code,
                                   pol_policy_no,
                                   endr_commission_basis
                              INTO v_agnt_code,
                                   v_pol_prod_code,
                                   v_pol_bra_code,
                                   v_policy_no,
                                   v_comm_basis
                              FROM lms_policies, lms_policy_endorsements
                             WHERE     pol_current_endr_code = endr_code
                                   AND pol_code = cm_rec.pcp_pol_code;
                        EXCEPTION
                            WHEN OTHERS
                            THEN
                                raise_error ('Error Determining agent');
                        END;
                    ELSE
                        BEGIN
                            SELECT mendr_agen_code,
                                   ipol_prod_code,
                                   ipol_bra_code,
                                   ipol_policy_no,
                                   mendr_comm_basis
                              INTO v_agnt_code,
                                   v_pol_prod_code,
                                   v_pol_bra_code,
                                   v_policy_no,
                                   v_comm_basis
                              FROM lms_individual_policies,
                                   lms_policy_member_endorsements
                             WHERE     ipol_current_mendr_code = mendr_code
                                   AND ipol_code = cm_rec.pcp_ipol_code;
                        EXCEPTION
                            WHEN OTHERS
                            THEN
                                raise_error (
                                    'Error Determining Commission Basis');
                        END;
                    END IF;

                    BEGIN
                        SELECT    TO_NUMBER (TO_CHAR (SYSDATE, 'RRRR'))
                               || lms_transaction_seq.NEXTVAL
                          INTO v_trans_code
                          FROM DUAL;
                    END;

                    BEGIN
                        INSERT INTO lms_transactions (ltr_trans_no,
                                                      ltr_btr_trans_code,
                                                      ltr_uw_clm_tran,
                                                      ltr_trans_date,
                                                      ltr_done_by,
                                                      ltr_comm_date_from,
                                                      ltr_comm_date_to,
                                                      ltr_cla_code,
                                                      ltr_cla_sht_desc,
                                                      ltr_pol_code,
                                                      ltr_ipol_code,
                                                      ltr_pcp_code)
                                 VALUES (
                                     v_trans_code,
                                     'COM',
                                     'P',
                                     SYSDATE,
                                     v_user,
                                     NVL (
                                         cm_rec.pcp_valuation_wef,
                                         (TO_DATE (cm_rec.pcp_date,
                                                   'DD/MM/YYYY'))),
                                     NVL (
                                         cm_rec.pcp_valuation_wet,
                                         (TO_DATE (cm_rec.pcp_date,
                                                   'DD/MM/YYYY'))),
                                     20022,
                                     'GRP',
                                     cm_rec.pcp_pol_code,
                                     cm_rec.pcp_ipol_code,
                                     cm_rec.pcp_code);
                    EXCEPTION
                        WHEN OTHERS
                        THEN
                            raise_error (
                                'Unable to create New Transaction...');
                    END;

                    v_comm_amt := NVL (cm_rec.pcp_comm_amt, 0);
                    v_whdtx := NVL (cm_rec.pcp_whdtax_amt, 0);
                    v_org_code := fms_interfaces_pkg.get_org (v_pol_bra_code);
                    v_agnt_code := NVL (cm_rec.pcp_agn_code, v_agnt_code);
                    v_comm_basis := NVL (cm_rec.pcp_comm_basis, v_comm_basis);
                    v_paid_comm_amt := NVL (cm_rec.pcp_amt_paid, 0);

                    IF     NVL (v_comm_amt, 0) != 0
                       AND NVL (v_comm_basis, 'M') IN ('A', 'AI')
                    THEN
                        get_gl_code ('DC',
                                     v_pol_prod_code,
                                     v_trnt_code,
                                     v_trnt_gl_code,
                                     v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
                        valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                                   v_org_code,
                                   v_pol_bra_code,
                                   'DC');
                        valid_acc (v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                   v_org_code,
                                   v_pol_bra_code,
                                   'DC CONTRA');
                        v_count := v_count + 2;
                        interface_append_gl (
                            v_trans_code,        --v_trans_code        NUMBER,
                            v_user,
                            --v_user_name,                 --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                            v_pol_code,          --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                            v_pol_prod_code,     --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                            NULL,             --v_vchr_no            VARCHAR2,
                            NULL,                --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                            NULL,                --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                            'Valuation',      --v_rcpt_no            VARCHAR2,
                            v_count,             --v_count             NUMBER,
                            'PENSION COMMISSION - ' || v_policy_no,
                            --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                            NVL (v_comm_amt, 0),
                            --v_amount            NUMBER,
                            'C',               --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                            v_trnt_gl_code,   --v_acc_number1        VARCHAR2,
                            v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                            --v_acc_number2        VARCHAR2,
                            v_pol_bra_code,      --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                            v_gl_trans);

                        IF NVL (v_wht_posting_param, 'N') = 'Y'
                        THEN
                            IF NVL (v_whdtx, 0) <> 0
                            THEN
                                get_gl_code ('WTHTX1',
                                             v_pol_prod_code,
                                             v_trnt_code,
                                             v_trnt_gl_code,
                                             v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
                                valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                                           v_org_code,
                                           v_pol_bra_code,
                                           'WTHTX1');
                                valid_acc (v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                           v_org_code,
                                           v_pol_bra_code,
                                           'WTHTX1 CONTRA');
                                v_count := v_count + 2;
                                interface_append_gl (
                                    v_trans_code,
                                    --v_trans_code         NUMBER,
                                    v_user,    --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                                    v_pol_code,  --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                                    v_pol_prod_code,
                                    --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                                    NULL,
                                    --v_cop_paid_vchr_tab (v_com_rec).comm_voucher,
                                    --v_vchr_no          VARCHAR2,
                                    NULL,        --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                                    NULL,        --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                                    'Valuation', --v_rcpt_no           VARCHAR2,
                                    v_count,     --v_count             NUMBER,
                                    'WITHOLDING TAX RECOVERY',
                                    --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                                    v_whdtx,
                                    --v_amount            NUMBER,
                                    'C',       --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                                    v_trnt_gl_code,
                                    --v_acc_number1        VARCHAR2,
                                    v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                    --v_acc_number2            VARCHAR2
                                    v_pol_bra_code,
                                    --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                                    v_gl_trans);
                            END IF;
                        END IF;
                    END IF;

                    IF     NVL (v_paid_comm_amt, 0) != 0
                       AND NVL (v_comm_basis, 'M') IN ('A', 'AI')
                    THEN
                        get_gl_code ('DC_P',
                                     v_pol_prod_code,
                                     v_trnt_code,
                                     v_trnt_gl_code,
                                     v_trnt_contra_gl_code);
                        valid_acc (v_trnt_gl_code,
                                   v_org_code,
                                   v_pol_bra_code,
                                   'DC_P');
                        valid_acc (v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                                   v_org_code,
                                   v_pol_bra_code,
                                   'DC_P CONTRA');
                        v_count := v_count + 2;
                        interface_append_gl (
                            v_trans_code,        --v_trans_code        NUMBER,
                            v_user,
                            --v_user_name,                 --v_raise_by          VARCHAR2,
                            v_pol_code,          --v_pol_code          NUMBER,
                            v_pol_prod_code,     --v_prod_code         NUMBER,
                            NULL,             --v_vchr_no            VARCHAR2,
                            NULL,                --v_opr_code          NUMBER,
                            NULL,                --v_oppr_code         NUMBER,
                            'Valuation',      --v_rcpt_no            VARCHAR2,
                            v_count,             --v_count             NUMBER,
                            'PENSION COMM WITHHELD- ' || v_policy_no,
                            --v_narrative         VARCHAR2,
                            NVL (v_paid_comm_amt, 0),
                            --v_amount            NUMBER,
                            'C',               --v_drcr              VARCHAR2,
                            v_trnt_gl_code,   --v_acc_number1        VARCHAR2,
                            v_trnt_contra_gl_code,
                            --v_acc_number2        VARCHAR2,
                            v_pol_bra_code,      --v_branch_code       NUMBER,
                            v_gl_trans);
                    END IF;

                    BEGIN
                        UPDATE lms_policy_commission_pymts
                           SET pcp_comm_booked = 'Y',
                               pcp_comm_booked_by = v_user,
                               pcp_comm_booked_date = SYSDATE
                         WHERE pcp_code = cm_rec.pcp_code;
                    EXCEPTION
                        WHEN OTHERS
                        THEN
                            raise_error (
                                'Error updating policy commission payment');
                    END;
                END LOOP;
            END LOOP;
        ELSE
            raise_error ('No record slected !');
        END IF;
    END book_valuation_gl_commission;
END lms_api;
